title: Saints Peter and Paul
alt_text: A marble relief of two men shown in profile facing each other. Each figure is carved with a thick beard, curly hair, and a garment draped over his shoulders. Between their heads is a faint carving of a bird with wings spread out. Above the man on the left, the text reads "S.PETRUS," while the man on the right is labeled "S.PAULUS." A thin, light-colored strap runs vertically down the center of the rectangular stone slab.

title: Virgin and Child with Angels
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows a woman sitting on a high-backed throne while holding a child. Both figures wear gold halos and have greenish-toned skin. They are dressed in long, deep blue and reddish-brown robes with gold trim. On either side of the throne, two smaller figures with red wings stand and play musical instruments. A vertical crack runs down the center of the panel, and three gold-colored vases sit on the floor at the base of the throne.

title: Evening in the Meadow
alt_text: A painting of a herd of cattle standing in a dark, open field under a cloudy sky. The painting is enclosed in a thick, ornate frame with intricate carved patterns. In the foreground, one cow faces to the left while another stands beside it, slightly turned away. More cattle are visible further back, blending into the shadowy landscape. Low hills rise in the distance against a vast, overcast horizon.

title: Architecture, Painting, and Sculpture Protected by Athena from the Ravages of Time
alt_text: A plaster sculpture showing a circular relief carving of several human figures. In the center, a seated figure is surrounded by standing individuals on both the left and right sides. The figures are rendered in low relief, making them appear subtle against the circular background. The entire piece is a pale, off-white color and is set against a dark background. The scene depicts a group of people gathered closely together in a quiet arrangement.

title: Architecture, Painting, and Sculpture Protected by Athena from the Ravages of Time
alt_text: A plaster and plasticine sculpture shows a group of figures in a circular relief. In the center of the scene, a woman sits wearing a long, flowing dress that drapes over her legs. To her left and right, other seated figures are huddled close to her, partially obscured by the relief's texture. A slightly curved, arm-like shape arches over the top of the group, connecting the figures. The entire piece is a light, uniform tan color with some visible cracks on the surface.

title: James Gamble Rogers
alt_text: A painting of an older, balding man with wire-rimmed glasses sitting in a chair. He wears a dark suit jacket, a light-colored vest, and a bright red necktie. His right hand rests on his knee, while his left hand holds a large, rolled-up architectural drawing or blueprint. To the right of the man, the background fades into a shadowy cityscape featuring several buildings and a tall, thin tower. The entire scene is bathed in warm, brown tones that create a serious and formal mood.

title: Head of Vespasian after a Roman portrait type of the 1st Century A.D.
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows the head and upper neck of an older person. The face is round with deep lines around the mouth and eyes, suggesting a mature or elderly appearance. The stone is a light, off-white color with mottled grey markings across the surface. A simple white string is wrapped horizontally around the neck. Below the chin, a human hand is partially visible, holding the sculpture against a padded cloth background.

title: Self-Portrait of the Artist Painting His Wife (Sarah Annis Sully)
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman who are positioned close together. The man is in the foreground, turned slightly toward the viewer with wavy brown hair. He wears a dark brown coat over a white collared shirt with a hint of red at the neckline. Behind him, the woman stands partially in shadow, wearing a sheer white veil over her dark hair. Her hand is visible in the lower left corner, holding a thin, light-colored object like a stylus or brush.

title: Judge Matthias Burnet Tallmadge (1774-1819), B.A. 1795
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair, shown from the chest up. The man has short, dark brown hair and is wearing a dark suit jacket over a white collared shirt with a neckcloth. He holds an open book in his hands, which rests on his lap. He is seated on a reddish chair against a dark, shadowy background. The painting is enclosed within a wide, ornate gold frame.

title: Andrew Jackson (1767-1845)
alt_text: A painting of a man shows him from the chest up against a dark, cloudy background. The man has short, light gray hair and a serious expression. He wears a dark, high-collared coat or robe with a wide, reddish-brown fabric draped over his shoulders. His face is turned slightly to the left, and he looks away from the viewer. The painting is set within a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: General Winfield Scott (1786-1866)
alt_text: A painting of a man in a dark military uniform sitting on a horse. The man looks serious as he holds the reins and stares to his right. He wears a large, feathered hat on his head. The horse is dark and stands on a rocky, uneven path in a grassy area. Faint outlines of trees and distant landscape details appear in the background.

title: Chair Used at Coronation of George VI
medium: Velvet, blue with embroidered insignia, oak
alt_text: A chair made of wood and dark blue velvet shows an embroidered symbol on its backrest. The chair has a rectangular, upholstered backrest and a flat seat cushion, both covered in deep blue fabric. Thin, light-colored piping outlines the edges of the blue velvet on both the seat and the back. On the top left corner of the backrest, there is a golden stitched emblem featuring a crown over the letters "GR." The wooden frame of the chair has simple, straight legs and supports. The chair sits on a wooden floor in front of a light-colored wall.

title: The Apotheosis of Saint Roch
alt_text: A painting of several figures floating in the sky. In the center, a person wearing a bright red cloth reaches both arms upward with their face turned away. To their left, a winged figure with flowing white robes looks upward with a serene expression. Below them, a smaller, darker figure holds onto the others while moving through the air. A thin, diagonal pole stretches across the background near a large, dark green cloth draped over the right side. The scene is set against a soft blue and beige background framed in an oval shape.

title: Classic and Romantic Art
medium: Plaster, gilded, shellacked, and mounted on cloth
alt_text: A plaster sculpture showing five figures standing on clouds against a dark oval background. In the center, a man stands taller than the others with golden light rays radiating behind his head. To his left, a man with a long beard sits, while a second man stands beside him. To the right of the center figure, a woman stands with her arm raised, and another person stands partially behind her. The figures are painted in a pale, worn white color, and the background clouds have traces of gold paint.

title: Classic and Romantic Art
medium: Plaster, painted, shellacked, and mounted on cloth
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of several figures arranged in an oval composition. The central figure stands tall with straight lines radiating from behind their head like light beams. title: Classic and Romantic Art
alt_text: A plaster sculpture in an oval shape shows a scene with several figures. In the center, a person stands tall with arms outstretched. To their left, another figure stands looking toward the center, while a horse appears in the background. To the right of the central figure, two more people interact, with one reaching out toward the other. All the figures are carved in relief and appear against a cloudy background.

title: Cartouche with Two Male Figures
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows two figures lounging together inside an archway. The figures are carved in light-colored material and are draped in flowing fabric. title: Cartouche with Two Male Figures
alt_text: A sculpture showing a rectangular decorative panel carved with figures and borders. In the center, a small figure appears to be kneeling or bending forward, though it is missing its head. Above the figure, a swag or garland hangs across the top of the design. A large, curved arch shape cuts into the bottom edge of the rectangular panel.

title: Cartouche with Two Male Figures
alt_text: A sculpture of plaster and plasticine shows a tall, rectangular panel decorated with relief carvings. title: Cartouche with Two Male Figures
alt_text: A sculpture made of plaster and plasticine showing two figures engaged in a scene. The beige piece has a trapezoidal shape with a curved cutout at the bottom edge. In the center, two nude figures are depicted in a close pose, with their arms raised and holding what looks like a cloth or banner above their heads. Floral garlands hang down vertically along the left and right sides of the sculpture. The entire piece has a glossy, shellacked surface texture.

title: Decorative Cartouche
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of an architectural relief panel is shown against a dark gray background. The off-white piece is trapezoidal with a large oval shape carved in its center. A draped garland of fabric hangs over the top part of the oval. Below the oval, a curved arch structure frames the bottom of the relief. Straight, pillar-like forms run vertically along both the left and right edges of the panel.

title: Cartouche with Two Male Figures
alt_text: A plaster sculpture showing two seated figures framed by an arched border. The entire piece is set against a dark gray background.

title: Cartouche with Two Male Figures
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows two figures positioned in the upper portion of a rectangular panel. Below the figures, a large, prominent circle is embossed directly into the center of the panel. The entire piece is light beige in color and appears to have a slightly glossy, smooth texture. The panel is wider at the bottom and tapers slightly toward the top.

title: Cartouche with Two Male Figures
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a vertical relief panel with two figures at the top. The off-white relief features a central, circular, empty area in the lower half of the rectangular frame. The background appears dark, suggesting the object is displayed on a wall.

title: Fame
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a scene carved in low relief on a rounded, tan-colored surface. These forms have a smooth, light tan finish against a textured, darker background. Light reflects off the surface in several spots, suggesting a glossy coating or protective covering.

title: Urn with Two Sphinxes
medium: Plaster and plasticine on wood, shellacked
alt_text: A sculpture made of wood, plaster, and plasticine shows two winged creatures flanking a central container. The central part is a smooth, dark wooden vessel shaped like a cup or urn with a small knob on top. They are posed symmetrically, with their wings rising upward to meet near the center knob. The entire object rests on a flat, solid base against a plain background.

title: Tragic Mask
alt_text: A sculpture made of plaster and plasticine shows a human face carved into a triangular shape. The object is mounted against a dark, plain background.

title: Tragic and Comic Masks

title: Tragic Mask
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a human face centered on a flat, triangular piece of material. The pale, off-white triangle points downward and is mounted against a dark gray wall. title: Tragic Mask
alt_text: A plaster sculpture showing a face carved in relief on a triangle-shaped piece. The face is centered and looks straight ahead with a sad or worried expression. The entire object is light cream in color and is mounted against a dark gray background.

title: Comic Mask
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a triangular piece with a relief carving of a face in the center. title: Apollo and the Muses
medium: Plaster, painted, gilded, shellacked, and mounted on cloth
alt_text: A plaster relief of an oval shape shows a central figure surrounded by several dancing people. A person stands in the middle holding a stringed instrument and wearing a loose robe. The entire scene is contained within an oval frame.

title: Apollo and the Muses
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a group of figures in a circular dance. The figures are carved in shallow relief on an oval background that is slightly chipped on the left edge. A central figure stands in the middle, surrounded by several other people holding hands. The sculpture is creamy white and mounted against a dark rectangular frame. The figures are stylized with flowing robes that seem to move as they dance.

title: Apollo and the Muses
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a scene carved in low relief on an oval background. Several figures are arranged across the center in dynamic, fluid poses. The smooth, off-white surface of the plaster creates soft shadows that highlight the curves of the bodies. The entire relief rests on dark wooden supports visible at the top and bottom.

title: Birth of Venus
medium: Plaster and plasticine, gilded and shellacked

In the center, a standing woman with wavy hair faces forward, her left arm raised as if holding something near her head. Flanking her on either side are winged figures, one on the left appearing to hold a piece of cloth or drapery. At the woman's feet, a smaller figure with wings looks up toward her. The entire surface has a uniform, warm, brownish-tan tone with textured details throughout the carving.

title: Eros and Psyche
alt_text: A plaster sculpture relief shows two figures entwined against a background framed by two tall, thin columns and a rounded arch top. One figure is positioned below, facing forward with small wings, while the second figure is positioned above, upside down with large wings spread out. The two figures are locked together in a close embrace. The entire scene is carved in low relief and has a pale, matte surface. The background behind the pillars is smooth, giving the figures a sense of depth and movement.

title: Eros and Psyche
alt_text: A plaster and plasticine sculpture shows a tall, narrow panel with two human figures inside a curved arch. The figures are positioned vertically, with one figure seemingly lifting or embracing the other against a background of columns. The upper figure is bent with one leg raised high, while the lower figure is standing or kneeling. The entire relief has a warm, brownish tone and appears to be made of a smooth material. The frame around the scene is decorated with a simple, lined pattern.

title: Three Dancing Figures
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows three figures standing close together on a flat, rectangular base. The figures appear to be nude and are arranged in a row, with their bodies slightly overlapping. Each figure has their arms raised or bent, and they stand with graceful, curved postures. The surface of the carving is smooth and pale white, catching the light in the center of the image. The background is a dark, indistinct color that contrasts with the light figures.

title: Three Dancing Figures
alt_text: A plaster and plasticine sculpture showing three standing figures carved in shallow relief against a rectangular background. title: Three Dancing Figures

title: Three Dancing Figures

title: Three Dancing Figures

title: Satyr and Maenad
alt_text: A plaster sculpture showing two figures in dynamic motion on a square, pale surface. The figures appear to be entangled as if running or struggling together. title: Satyr and Maenad
alt_text: A sculpture of two figures locked in a close struggle on a flat, rectangular slab. The figures are light brown in color and appear to be molded in relief against the textured background. The surface of the relief has a shiny, shellacked finish with small glints of reflected light.

title: The Centaur Chiron and His Pupil Achilles

title: Aurora: Sketch for a Proposed Ceiling Decoration

title: John Ferguson Weir (1841-1926), M.A. (Hon.) 1871

title: Reverend Edward Elias Atwater (1816-1887), B.A. 1836, M.A. (Hon.) 1839

title: Timothy Dwight (1752-1817), B.A. 1769, M.A. 1772

title: Ezra Stiles (1727-1795), B.A.1746, M.A.1749

The background is a plain, dark brown color with a hint of red on the far right edge.

title: Daniel Wadsworth (1771-1848)
alt_text: A painting of an older man with short, dark hair sitting against a dark, plain background. He wears a dark blue coat that has a wide, brown fur collar and fur cuffs. Under his coat, he has a white shirt with a high, folded collar and a light-colored cravat tied at his neck. His hands are resting together on his lap, and the fingers are slightly curled. The man is looking directly forward with a calm expression on his face.

title: Denison Olmsted (1791-1859), B. A. 1813, M. A. 1816
alt_text: A painting of a man standing against a dark, shadowy background. He is a light-skinned man with dark, wavy hair and a serious expression. His right hand rests flat on a piece of paper that lies on the table in the lower left corner of the frame.

title: Jane Griswold Coit (née Jane Griswold Lanman, 1806–1874)

title: Portrait of Elihu Yale (1648/49–1721)
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in a long coat and a curly wig. He wears a brown coat with large, patterned cuffs over a long, flower-print vest. A long, white cravat hangs from his neck down the center of his chest. His right hand rests on a table covered by a bright red cloth. In the background on the right, a rectangular inset shows a view of ships on the water near a rocky coast under a cloudy sky.

title: Reverend Nehemiah Strong (1728/29–1807), B.A. 1755, M.A. 1758
alt_text: A painting shows an older man with white hair sitting in a dark-colored chair. He is wearing a long, muted purple coat over a white vest and dark pants. A heavy, dark green curtain hangs partially across the top and right side of the scene.

title: Jeremiah Dictating His Prophecy of the Destruction of Jerusalem to Baruch the Scribe
alt_text: A painting showing a bearded man sitting on a stone bench while a younger person writes near his feet. The man is large and wears a long, yellowish garment with a dark cape draped over his left arm. He sits on a raised platform, gesturing upward with his right hand as he looks toward the viewer. A smooth, light-colored ceramic jar sits on the floor to the left of the man. To the right, a smaller, younger figure sits on the lower step, holding a writing tool and a tablet. The background features dark, shadowed stone walls with a doorway or archway visible in the distance.

title: Dying Hercules
alt_text: A painting of a muscular man reclining against a dark, rocky backdrop. He is semi-nude, with a piece of white cloth draped over his lap and held high in his raised right hand. His head is tilted back, and his gaze is directed upward toward the light. The setting appears to be a gloomy cave or cliffside with shadows obscuring the background. Large, textured stones are visible in the lower right corner of the foreground.

title: Dying Hercules
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a muscular, bearded man lying on his back. The man rests his body on a rough, block-like base. His left arm extends straight up toward the top of the frame with a clenched fist. His right arm is bent, propping his upper body up, while his legs are stretched out to the left side. The entire figure is pure white and set against a solid black background.

title: George Peabody (1795-1869)
alt_text: A painting of an elderly man sitting in a formal chair. He has white hair, a beard, and wears a dark suit with a white shirt. The man holds some papers in one hand while resting his other hand on a table covered with a patterned, reddish cloth. To his left sits a tall framed picture featuring a portrait of a person in royal clothing. A wicker wastebasket filled with papers rests on the floor near the table, and deep red curtains hang in the background.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LL.D. 1781, (copy after Gilbert Stuart's "Atheneum" portrait)
alt_text: A painting of a man's portrait sits inside a rectangular gold frame. The portrait itself is oval in shape and features a man with pale skin and light, white hair. He wears a dark coat over a white neckcloth. The background behind the man is dark and plain. A small, light-colored tag hangs from the bottom left corner of the frame.

title: James Hillhouse (1754-1832), B. A. 1773, M. A. 1776, LL.D. 1823
alt_text: A painting of a man shows him from the chest up against a dark, plain background. The man has short, gray hair and is looking forward with a serious expression. A metal light fixture is mounted on the wall directly above the frame, casting a bright reflection on the man's hair.

title: Winter Scene in New England
alt_text: A painting of a snow-covered farm in winter under a cloudy, overcast sky. A large, weathered barn stands in the center with an open doorway where cows and chickens shelter inside. Bare, leafless trees surround the structures, and a thin layer of snow covers the ground. To the right, a person walks toward the barn carrying a bundle of straw. In the distance, rolling hills appear softly through the gray, wintry light.

title: Augustus Russell Street (1791-1866), B. A. 1812 (after Nathaniel Jocelyn)
alt_text: A painting of a man with a long, white beard. The man is wearing a dark suit jacket that covers his shoulders and chest. He is positioned slightly to the right of the center of the frame. The background is a solid, deep red color with a hint of a curtain on the left side. The painting is enclosed in an ornate, gold-colored frame with floral patterns.

title: Bust of a Young Boy
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a young child's head and chest sits against a plain gray background. The figure faces forward with a calm, neutral expression. The child has short hair carved with fine, smooth lines that follow the shape of their skull. Their eyes are blank and featureless, without carved pupils or irises. A smooth, round pedestal supports the bust from below.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LL. D. 1781 (after Charles Willson Peale)
alt_text: A painting of a man's face and shoulders. The man has pale skin, light-colored hair worn pulled back, and a direct gaze looking forward. He is wearing a dark coat with a light, textured collar that wraps around his neck. The background is a simple, dark green color that contrasts with his face. Fine lines, like cracks in paint, are visible across the surface of the artwork.

title: The Honorable James Lanman (1769-1841), B.A. 1788, M.A. 1791
alt_text: A painting of an older man with graying hair, shown from the chest up against a dark, shadowy background. He has a fair complexion, a round face, and light-colored eyes. The man wears a black coat with a high, stiff collar that touches his jaw. A white cravat or ruffled shirt is visible beneath the collar at his throat. He faces slightly to the left while looking directly forward with a neutral expression.

title: Still Life in the Studio
alt_text: A painting of a still life arrangement set against a dark background. On a wooden tabletop sits a tall, white ceramic vase decorated with dark blue floral patterns. Next to it stands a cylindrical, metallic container with small holes carved into its side. A few small clusters of purple flowers lie scattered across the front of the table. To the right of the flowers sits a small, gleaming copper bowl. In the shadowy background, the faint, curved shape of a wooden wheel is partially visible.

title: Theodore Dwight Woolsey 1801-1889, B.A. 1820, M.A. 1823
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man seen from the chest up. The man has short, slightly wavy hair and wears a loose, pleated robe with large, puffed sleeves. He holds an open book in his left hand, resting it against his chest. His expression is serious, and his head is turned slightly to his right. The light-colored stone figure stands against a plain, neutral background.

title: Elias Loomis (1811-1889), B. A. 1830, M. A. 1836
alt_text: A painting shows a portrait of a man seated in an ornate, dark wooden chair. He wears a dark suit, a white shirt, and a dark cravat. The entire image is enclosed in a thick, textured gold-colored frame.

title: Frederick Marquand 1799-1882
alt_text: A marble bust of a middle-aged man sits on a simple, square platform. The figure has short, curly hair framing a serious face with focused eyes and a firm mouth. title: Hetty Perry Marquand (1801–1859)
alt_text: A marble bust shows a woman facing forward from the chest up. Her light-colored hair is styled in distinct, tight curls framing both sides of her face. The statue is a smooth, pale stone set against a plain grey background.

title: Henry Farnam (1803-1883), M.A. (Hon.) 1871
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man’s head and shoulders stands against a dark background. The man has short, swept-back hair and a stern expression on his face. title: Spring
alt_text: A painting showing a woman in a blue dress standing by a wooden fence in a meadow. The woman wears a white head covering and has her arms crossed in front of her. title: Pelatiah Perit (1785-1864), B. A. 1802

title: Reverend Alexander MacWhorter (1734-1807), D. D. (Hon.) 1776

title: Mary Cummings MacWhorter (1735–1807)

title: My House
alt_text: A painting of a house exterior shows a porch with columns and a small garden. The house is painted in soft, pale colors with a gray roof and shadowed walls. The overall scene is bright and dappled with patches of light and shadow.

title: Thomas Anthony Thacher (1815-1886), B.A. 1835, M.A. 1838

The portrait is housed in a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: Benjamin Silliman, Sr. (1779–1864)

title: The Honorable Roger Sherman Baldwin (1793-1863), B.A. 1811, M.A. 1814, LL.D. 1845 (after a posthumous portrait of 1863)

title: Reverend Joseph Buckminster (1751-1812), B.A. 1770, M.A. 1773

title: Dr. Jonathan Knight 1789-1864 B.A. 1808, M.A. 1811, M.d. (hon.) 1818

title: Jonathan Knight 1789-1864

The sculpture is colored in a dull, muted grey-brown tone throughout.

title: Commodore Isaac Hull (1773-1843) (copy after Gilbert Stuart)

title: Roger Sherman (1721-1793), M. A. (Hon.) 1768, (copy after Ralph Earl)

title: William C. Leffingwell (1765-1834), B. A. 1786, M. A. 1789

title: Reverend Timothy Cutler (1684–1765) (after Peter Pelham)

title: Dr. William Samuel Johnson (1727-1819), B. A. 1744, M. A. 1747, LL. D. 1788, (after Gilbert Stuart)

The background is a solid, dark brown color, and the entire scene is enclosed in a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: General Humphreys Delivering the Standards taken at Yorktown to Congress Hall (Philadelphia)

Behind him, a younger person helps manage a tan horse and a darker horse, while soldiers stand in formation in the distance. To the lower right, a large, dark cannon with wooden wheels rests on the ground. The background shows brick buildings under a cloudy, slightly dim sky.

title: David Wooster (Chinese Artist after an 18th century mezzotint)

He holds a long, thin pole with a pointed metal tip that extends from the bottom right to the upper left of the canvas. Behind him, there appears to be a suggestion of a structure on the right side of the dark background. The artwork is enclosed in a simple, rectangular gold-colored frame. A small white label with the number "1837.1" is attached to the bottom of the frame.

title: Sarah Hope Harvey Trumbull (1774–1824)

The background is a very dark, indistinct space that fades into black.

title: Colonel Jared Mansfield (1759-1830), B. A. 1777, M. A. 1787, LL. D. 1825 (after Thomas Sully)
alt_text: A painting of an older man, shown from the chest up. The man has thin, light-colored hair and a serious but gentle expression on his face. The entire portrait is enclosed in a simple, rectangular gold-colored frame.

title: Holy Family (Madonna and Child with Joseph, Elizabeth, and John the Baptist)

To the left, a second, younger child reaches toward the child being held, holding a thin stick. On the far left, a woman in a reddish-orange dress stands with one hand raised, looking toward the children. On the right, a bearded man with dark hair wears a reddish-brown garment and looks toward the group. The entire scene is set against a dark background, and the painting is encased in an ornate gold frame.

title: Joshua at the Battle of Ai - Attended by Death
alt_text: A painting showing a chaotic battle scene with many figures in motion. A soldier in golden armor and a red cape stands in the foreground, holding a shield and sword while facing a pale skeleton. The skeleton is partially transparent and reaches toward the crowd with long, bony fingers, holding a spear in its other hand. Around them, other soldiers on horseback appear distressed and are falling amidst the commotion. The background is dark and stormy, with flashes of light filling the air above the fighting figures. Several figures are lying on the ground near the center and right side of the painting.

title: The Last Family Who Perished in the Deluge (Genesis 7:4-24)
alt_text: A painting shows a dramatic scene with people on rocky shores under a stormy, dark sky. On the right, an older man with a white beard sits on a large rock and reaches his hand toward bright, zigzag lightning bolts above. Next to him, a woman with auburn hair sits and holds a sleeping baby on her lap. To the left, another figure is falling or tumbling backward into the churning ocean waves. The overall atmosphere of the painting is dark, gloomy, and tense.

title: I Was in Prison and Ye Came Unto Me (Matthew, 25:36)
alt_text: A painting of a dimly lit, stone-walled room where several figures interact. On the right, a bare-chested, thin man sits on a stone block with a metal chain around his ankle, looking upward with a weary expression. To his left, a bearded man wearing a tan tunic and a red cloak stands and gestures toward him with one hand. Two other figures in dark clothing stand further back in the shadows, partially obscured near a barred window. The scene uses deep shadows and muted, brownish tones to create a somber atmosphere.

title: The Transfiguration
alt_text: A painting of a bright figure floating in the sky above a large group of people on the ground. The central figure in the air wears white robes and has arms raised toward the sky. Below, a group of people in colorful robes are gathered on a grassy hill, with some kneeling and looking upward. Other people are seated or standing in the foreground, with one person gesturing with their arm raised high. The scene is lit with a bright glow around the floating figure, while the lower parts of the painting are darker and shadowed.

title: The Last Communion of St. Jerome
alt_text: A painting of a group of people gathered inside a room with stone pillars. An older man with a white beard sits near the center, draped in a bright red cloth. Standing over him is an older man in a yellow robe, holding a small object toward the man. A person in a long, light-colored robe kneels in the foreground while holding a thick book. Above the group, three small, winged figures float in the air against a patch of blue sky. The scene is dark and shadowed, illuminated primarily by a soft light falling on the main figures.

title: The Last Communion of Saint Jerome
alt_text: A painting of several people gathered in a dimly lit, architectural space. An older man with a white beard sits near the front, wearing a red cloth draped over his lap. Another man in a reddish-brown robe stands to his right, holding a small cup and offering something to the seated man. Several other figures, including people in robes and a person kneeling on the right, watch the interaction. High above the group, three winged figures float in a bright, arched opening that shows a landscape beyond. The scene uses deep shadows and warm, muted colors to highlight the figures.

title: Arthur Wellesley, Duke of Wellington (1769-1852)
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a red military-style jacket. The man is shown from the chest up and looks slightly to his left with a neutral expression. title: Theodore Dwight Woolsey (1801-1889), B. A. 1820, M. A. 1823

title: Ithiel Town 1784–1844, M.A. (Hon.) 1825

The front of this base features a small, raised panel with a cross-hatched grid pattern.

title: George Nugent-Temple-Grenville, First Marquess of Buckingham and Lord Lieutenant of Ireland (1753-1818)

In the background, large, indistinct stone columns and a red-covered table are partially visible in the shadows.

title: Timothy Dwight (1752-1817), B.A.1769, M.A.1772

title: William Augustus Larned (1806-1862), B. A. 1826, M. A. 1829, Divinity School 1834

title: The Honorable Roger Minnot Sherman (1773-1844), B. A. 1792, M. A. 1795, LL.D. 1829, (copy after his earlier portrait of 1840)

title: Man having a drink at the door of a farm house.

title: Man Grooming Horse

title: At the Blacksmith's

title: Noah Porter (1811-1892), B.A. 1831, M.A. 1834

title: John Trumbull (1756–1843)

title: Theodore Dwight Woolsey (1801-1881)

The entire scene is captured in black and white.

title: James Kent (1763-1874), B. A. 1781, M. A. 1784, LL.D. 1874
alt_text: A painting shows a man in a dark coat sitting for a portrait. The man has short, dark hair and is looking directly forward with a calm expression. He wears a high-collared dark jacket over a white, ruffled shirt or cravat that covers his neck. His face is lit from one side, creating soft shadows across his cheeks and chin. The background is a plain, dark brown color that provides no extra detail. The entire painting is housed inside a simple, shiny gold frame.

title: William Henry Brewer (1828-1910), Ph.B. 1852, M.A. (Hon.) 1859, LL.D. 1903
alt_text: A painting shows an older man with a full beard and glasses standing against a textured wall. He is wearing a dark, long robe over a suit, with a bow tie visible at his neck. In his left hand, he holds a dark hat close to his chest. His right hand hangs down at his side, holding a small object. The entire scene is captured in black and white tones.

title: The Scream of Shrapnel at San Juan Hill
alt_text: A painting of a group of soldiers in uniform moving across a grassy field. One soldier stands on the far left, while the others are crouched or lying on the ground behind him. They wear dark blue uniforms, tan hats, and carry long rifles and white packs. The soldiers are scattered across a dirt path that cuts through the tall, golden grass. Dense green trees fill the background under a pale, hazy sky.

title: The Wounded Bunkie
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of two people riding horses at a fast pace. The two horses are leaping forward, with their front legs raised off the ground. Each horse carries a rider who is wearing a wide-brimmed hat. One rider leans backward with an arm outstretched, while the other holds the reins. On the ground beneath the horses, a round base holds a small, skull-like object with two short horns.

title: Isaac H. Townsend (1803-1847), B.A. 1822, M.A. 1825
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a dark coat and a light-colored vest. He is shown from the chest up against a plain, dark background. The man has short, dark hair and is wearing a dark necktie or cravat over a white shirt. One of his hands rests in the lower part of the frame. The entire painting is held inside a large, rectangular frame with ornate, carved gold decorations on all four sides.

title: New Haven Green--Churches and State House (after William Henry Bartlett)
alt_text: A painting of a tree-lined avenue leading through a town toward a classical building. Large, leafy green trees stretch along both sides of a dirt path that runs through the center of the scene. On the right side, a building with tall white columns and a triangular roof stands in an open grassy area. To the left, several taller, more shadowed buildings rise among the trees in the distance. Small, indistinct figures of people walk along the path and gather near the structures. The entire scene is bathed in the warm, soft light of a setting or rising sun, casting long shadows across the ground.

title: View of the Roman Campagna
alt_text: A painting of a vast, open landscape with tall, crumbling stone arches in the distance. The large structures are built of light gray stone and stand in a long line stretching across the horizon. A lone figure stands near a small group of sheep in the grassy foreground. The sky is filled with the soft, pink and orange light of either sunrise or sunset. Faint, dark mountains rise up in the far background behind the broken stone arches.

title: Daniel Webster (1782–1852)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows the head, neck, and shoulders of an older man. The man has short, wavy hair and a serious, focused expression on his face. He is wearing draped cloth over his shoulders that is pinned with a circular brooch on his right side. The sculpture rests on a round base that appears to be broken into pieces at the bottom. The entire object has a light, matte gray color against a simple background.

title: Walt Whitman (1819-1892)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a man’s head and chest shows a person with a long, thick beard and shoulder-length hair. The material appears rough and textured, with visible finger marks and uneven surfaces across the face and shoulders. The man has deep-set eyes that look straight ahead with a serious expression. His facial features are carved with heavy lines and shadows that suggest age or wear. The sculpture is colored in muted shades of gray and tan against a plain background.

title: Abraham Lincoln (1809-1865)
alt_text: A painted plaster bust of a man shown from the chest up. The man has wavy hair, a thick beard, and a mustache. He is wearing a button-down shirt with a bowtie under a coat. A large piece of fabric or a cloak is wrapped across his chest and shoulders. He is looking off to the left side of the frame with a calm expression. The sculpture rests on a simple circular pedestal base.

title: James Anthony Froude
alt_text: A plaster cast sculpture of a man’s head and shoulders. The man has short, swept-back hair and a light beard along his jawline. He is wearing a jacket with a collared shirt and a simple bow tie underneath. His face is turned slightly to the right with a serious, thoughtful expression. The entire object has a smooth, matte, tan-colored surface and rests on a square pedestal base.

title: William Alfred Buckingham (1804-1875)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a man’s head and shoulders stands against a plain background. The figure has curly hair and sideburns, with a serious expression and eyes looking slightly to the side. He is draped in a cloth-like garment that covers his chest and shoulders. The surface of the sculpture is a dull, muted green color with areas of lighter paint worn away to show the material underneath. The entire piece rests on a round, pedestal-style base.

title: William Wolcott Ellsworth (1791-1868)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture showing a bust of a man. The figure faces forward with a serious expression and short, wavy hair. He is wearing a draped piece of fabric that covers his shoulders like a cloak. The bust sits on a simple, round base on a dark surface. The light creates a soft shadow behind the sculpture against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Captain Charles Knapp (1785-1859)
alt_text: A painting of a man facing forward with his head slightly turned to the left. He has light brown, wavy hair and wears a dark, buttoned jacket with a high white collar and a cravat. The background is a plain, dark olive green color that fades slightly toward the edges. The man has a clean-shaven face and looks directly at the viewer. A thick, ornate, gold-colored wooden frame surrounds the rectangular painting on all sides. A small, rectangular label is attached to the bottom center of the frame.

title: Joseph Battell (1806-1874), B. A. (Hon.) 1823, M. A. (Hon.) 1871
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a red chair. The man has short, dark brown hair and is looking forward with a neutral expression. He wears a dark, possibly black, jacket with a white shirt and a dark cravat underneath. His hands are folded loosely in front of him, resting near the bottom of the frame. The background is a dark, shadowy brown, which makes the figure stand out. The entire portrait is encased in a large, ornate gold frame.

title: Thomas Glasby Waterman (1862-1889), B.A.1886
alt_text: A painting of a young man sitting at a desk. He has short, dark hair, a mustache, and is wearing a dark jacket with a white collar. His body is angled slightly to the left, and he rests one hand on the desk in front of him. Behind him, the background is dark and indistinct, with hints of bookshelves or papers. The painting is enclosed in a wide, ornate, gold-colored frame decorated with carvings. A small, rectangular label is attached to the bottom center of the frame.

title: The Wept of Wish-ton-Wish
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a standing figure with long, wavy hair who wears a short tunic and sandals. The person is captured with their right hand raised near their chin as if in deep thought. They wear a loose, flowing garment that is gathered at the waist and falls down behind them. The figure stands on a simple, round base against a plain black background. The statue is rendered in a realistic style, with soft folds of fabric and lifelike facial features.

title: Asian Harbor Scene (China?)
alt_text: A painting of a coastal scene with a quiet sea and a rocky shoreline in the foreground. Two figures stand and sit on the edge of the land, looking out toward the water. On the right side, there is a large stone building complex with towers and a wooden structure extending over the water. A small boat with a person in it floats nearby on the calm surface of the bay. In the distance, the shoreline stretches out with several small, low structures and rounded towers. The sky above is open and appears somewhat hazy or pale.

title: Henry Stevens (1819-1886), B.A. 1843, M.A. 1846
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in front of a bookshelf filled with many books. He has short, wavy brown hair and light sideburns. The man wears a dark suit jacket over a white shirt and a dark tie. He holds a pair of glasses in one hand near his chest. His other hand rests on an open book placed on a dark table next to him.

title: Irene Battell Larned (1811–1877)
alt_text: A painting of a woman with long, brown, wavy hair. She faces forward and wears a deep red, off-the-shoulder dress with a laced bodice. The background shows a soft, cloudy sky. This painting sits inside a very thick, ornate gold frame with detailed carvings of leaves and scrolls. At the bottom of the frame, there is a small plaque with faded text on it.

title: David Curtis DeForest (1774-1825)
alt_text: A painting of a middle-aged man shown from the chest up. He sits in a chair with his arms crossed over his chest, facing toward the left side of the frame. The man wears a dark blue, double-breasted coat with brass buttons over a tan vest and a white collar. His brown hair is brushed back, and his expression is neutral. A large, dark red curtain hangs vertically along the right side of the background, contrasting with the muted brown tone of the wall behind him.

title: Daniel Burton Fayerweather (1822-1890)
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a dark suit, set inside a decorative gold frame. The man faces slightly to the left, with his head tilted in the same direction. He has short brown hair and a full beard that covers his chin and jaw. Under his dark coat, he wears a white collar and a small, dark necktie. The background of the portrait is a dark, muted brown color that surrounds the man. A small, white tag with the number "1894.2" hangs from the bottom edge of the frame.

title: Thomas Chalmers Sloane (1847-1890), B.A. 1868, M.A. 1870
alt_text: A painting shows a man in a dark coat standing in front of a shadowed, indistinct background. He has a thick mustache and sideburns, and his expression is serious as he looks off to the right. His left hand is tucked into his coat pocket, while his right hand holds a small dark object at his side. He wears a dark suit with a patterned tie underneath his heavy overcoat. The portrait is displayed inside a large, ornate gold frame with carved leaf designs along the edges. A small rectangular plaque is attached to the bottom center of the frame.

title: General Ulysses Simpson Grant (1822-1885)
alt_text: A painting of a bearded man wearing a dark, military-style uniform stands within an ornate, gold-colored frame. The man faces slightly to the right, with his hair parted on the side and a thick beard covering his jaw. He wears a dark coat featuring a row of lighter buttons down the front and shoulder epaulets. His left hand is raised slightly near his chest, while his right hand rests on a dark surface near the bottom of the frame. The background is a murky, dark grey color that makes the figure stand out. A small, rectangular plaque is attached to the bottom center of the frame with white text written on it.

title: The Sibyl
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting and looking off to the side. She has light skin and wavy brown hair. She wears a white top with long, ruffled sleeves and a dark belt around her waist. One of her hands is raised to touch the side of her head, while the other rests on a white cloth on a table. The background is a warm, swirled mix of brown and tan colors. The entire scene is held in an ornate, shiny gold frame.

title: Oliver Wolcott, Jr. (1760-1833), B.A. 1778, LL.D. 1819
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a man's head and chest sits against a dark, solid background. The bust features an older man with wavy, swept-back hair and a serious expression. His eyes look forward, and his lips are closed in a straight line. The figure is shown from the chest up and ends in a smooth curve across the shoulders. Below the chest, the sculpture rests on a thick, circular base.

title: Bust of Caracalla (?)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a man's head and neck sits on a small, circular pedestal. The figure has thick, curly hair that frames his forehead and covers his ears. He has a full beard and mustache, also with a curly texture, that covers his chin and jaw. His eyebrows are thick and slightly furrowed above deeply set, shadowed eyes. The sculpture is a light brown color and shows clear, carved details throughout the face and hair.

title: A View of the Quinnebaug River near Jewett City, Connecticut
alt_text: A painting of a calm river landscape shows a peaceful, rural scene. Lush, dark green trees line the banks of the river, which reflects the soft light of the sky. In the lower right foreground, two small figures stand on a path near the water's edge. One figure wears a bright red dress, and the other wears dark clothing. A thick, golden frame surrounds the entire painting.

title: Lady Arranging Flowers
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a chair and arranging flowers. She wears a long, light-colored dress and holds a bouquet in her hands while looking down at it. Behind her sits a blue striped cushion and a white vase against a plain wall. A large, colorful bunch of flowers rests on the floor at her feet. To the left, delicate vines with small flowers hang down from the top edge. The scene is framed in a plain gold-colored frame.

title: Girl in the Sunshine
alt_text: A painting of a young girl standing outdoors in a lush, green environment. She wears a long, light pink dress with ruffled sleeves and a large, wide-brimmed white hat. The girl holds a small bunch of white flowers in one hand and looks down toward them. Behind her, a dense background of green leaves and grasses fills the frame. The painting is enclosed in a simple, dark wood frame.

title: Othniel Charles Marsh (1831-1899), B.A. 1860, M.A. 1863
alt_text: A painting of a middle-aged man with a light brown beard and a balding head. He faces forward with a serious expression and blue eyes. The man wears a dark, simple coat against a plain, dark background. The portrait is oval-shaped and set inside a rectangular, ornate gold frame with leaf patterns. A small rectangular plaque is centered at the bottom of the frame with white text on a gold background.

title: The Education of the Virgin
alt_text: A painting of three people sitting together in a dark room. An older man with a grey beard on the left looks at a book held by a younger woman on the right. A small child in a red robe stands between them, also looking at the open book. The woman wears a long, draped yellow garment over a blue dress and a white head covering. Her right hand points to a page in the book, while the child's small hand points to the same spot. A small table with a bowl sits to the left, and a dog sleeps on the floor near the bottom.

title: Sleeping Children
alt_text: A marble sculpture of two young children sleeping together on a cushioned surface. The two figures lie side-by-side with their heads resting on a plush, rectangular pillow. Their bodies are partially covered by draped fabric that folds gently over their legs and torsos. One child rests their arm across the other, and both have their eyes closed in a peaceful expression. The entire scene is set against a plain black background.

title: Above the Falls
alt_text: A painting of a quiet lake nestled between steep, rocky cliffs. To the right, a large, light-colored rock wall rises vertically from the water, topped with a few tall pine trees. Several trees with vibrant green and reddish-orange leaves cling to the cliffside near the water's edge. On the left, a smaller, shadowed cliff face slopes downward toward the calm lake surface. The sky above is bright with puffy white clouds, suggesting a pleasant, partly cloudy day. The painting is set inside a dark, carved wooden frame with a gold inner trim.

title: Taking the Veil
alt_text: A painting of a church ceremony where a person in a long white dress kneels before an older figure in ornate robes. The figure in robes, wearing a pointed hat, holds their hands over the kneeling person as if offering a blessing. Several other people, including children in red and white robes, stand or kneel nearby as part of the formal event. A large, bright red curtain hangs on the right side of the scene. In the background, tall stone columns and a large pipe organ are visible inside the cathedral-like setting.

title: Sailing by Moonlight
alt_text: A painting of a calm lake scene set during twilight or moonlight. The sky is filled with dark, moody clouds that allow a hazy light to glow on the water below. Several sailboats and a smaller rowboat drift across the lake. To the right, a rocky shoreline rises up with leafy trees and dark evergreen foliage. The water reflects the dim light, and a few large rocks poke out above the surface in the foreground.

title: Demosthenes
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man’s head and upper chest. The man has short, wavy hair and a thick beard that covers his chin and jaw. His face shows deep creases on his forehead and around his eyes. He is looking downward with a serious expression. A piece of fabric is draped over one of his shoulders.

title: Cicero
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows the head and upper torso of a middle-aged man. The figure has short, thin hair and a serious, focused expression with deep lines on his forehead and around his eyes. He is turned slightly to his right, looking off into the distance with a strong, prominent nose. The man wears a draped garment that wraps around his shoulders and chest like a simple robe. The entire piece is smooth, white stone set against a dark, plain background.

title: Homer
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man’s head and chest shows him looking forward with a serious expression. He has a thick beard, curly hair, and a cloth wrapped loosely around his head like a hood. Deep lines wrinkle his forehead above intense, hollow eyes. The smooth marble skin contrasts with the detailed texture of his facial hair. This bust rests against a plain, dark gray background.

title: Bust of an Unidentified Man
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man's head and shoulders is shown in this portrait bust. The man has a lined face, showing his age with wrinkles around his eyes and mouth. His hair is short, slightly wavy, and combed forward towards his forehead. He wears a piece of fabric draped loosely over his shoulders like a shawl or toga. The stone is a light, creamy color with subtle streaks and shadows across the surface.

title: Joseph Parrish Thompson (1819-1879) B.A. 1838 M.A. 1841
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man's head and chest shows him looking slightly downward. The figure has wavy hair swept to the side and a thick, rounded beard covering his chin and jaw. His face is pale and smooth, with deep-set eyes that are cast down. The sculpture rests on a flat, solid base that extends to his shoulders. Faint writing is carved into the front of the base near the bottom edge. The entire piece is set against a plain, dark gray background.

title: Joseph Earl Sheffield (1793-1882), M.A. (Hon.) 1871
alt_text: A painting of an older man sitting in a chair and looking slightly to his left. He has thinning light hair and wears a dark suit, a vest, and a white shirt with a high, dark collar. His hands rest gently on his lap. Behind him on the left sits a small table with a dark vessel or jar. To his right, the faint outline of a bookshelf filled with books appears in the shadows. The background is a warm, dark, and muted brown color.

title: Henry Strong Durand (1861-1929), B.A. 1881
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a dark, upholstered chair. He is shown from the waist up, facing forward with a serious expression. He has short, light-colored hair and a thin mustache. The man is wearing a dark, buttoned jacket over a light shirt with a high collar. In his lap, he holds an open book, resting his hands on its pages. Hand-written text in the lower right corner identifies the subject and his graduating class.

title: Marion Crossing the Peedee
alt_text: A painting shows a crowded flat-bottomed boat filled with people and horses crossing a calm, wide river. The boat is packed with many figures, some dressed in dark green military-style coats and others in civilian clothes. One person stands near the front, pointing toward the distance, while others sit or stand around them. A few brown and white horses are positioned among the passengers, standing calmly on the deck. Dense green trees line both banks of the river, and the sky above is a pale, hazy yellow.

title: General Wayne Refusing the Last Blanket
alt_text: A painting of an indoor scene features a man in military-style clothing standing in the center. He wears a dark coat, yellow vest, and light-colored breeches, gesturing with his left hand as he holds a piece of fabric in his right. A woman stands opposite him, wearing a white cap, a yellow top, and a long blue apron over a reddish skirt, while she holds out a large piece of white cloth. To the left, a wooden barrel sits near two small children who are looking down. In the foreground to the right, a wooden cradle rests on the floor with some items inside. The entire scene is framed in a decorative gold border.

title: Long Jakes (copy by the artist after an original in 1844)
alt_text: A painting of a bearded man riding a dark horse through a hilly landscape. The man wears a tan hat, a gray jacket with a black scarf, and fringed tan pants. He holds the reins in one hand and a long, thin stick or crop in the other. The horse is solid black with a simple bridle, stepping forward on a rocky path. In the background, there are jagged, light-colored mountains under a bright blue sky filled with puffy white clouds. The scene is lit by soft daylight, casting few strong shadows.

title: The Irish Parliament
alt_text: A painting of a large, dimly lit assembly hall filled with many people. Rows of seated individuals in formal coats and wigs line the sides of a wide, checkered floor. In the center of the room, a man stands and gestures toward the crowd, while others stand in small groups or walk along the perimeter. A high balcony with railings wraps around the upper part of the room, crowded with more spectators. Tall columns support a curved ceiling above, and a large chandelier hangs from the center.

title: William Elliott
alt_text: A painting of a man standing and looking toward the viewer. The man is dressed in a dark coat, a buttoned vest, and a white shirt with a dark necktie. He has dark, wavy hair and a slight smile on his face. His left hand rests on a dark surface, holding a small round object like a hat. Behind him, a blurred background shows shadows and a suggestion of a stone pillar on the left.

title: The Battle of Bunker's Hill, June 17, 1775
alt_text: A painting of a chaotic battlefield scene filled with many soldiers in uniform. In the center, a group of soldiers in bright red coats gathers around a man lying on the ground, while other figures nearby are wounded or falling. To the left, a man in a white shirt and vest stands among the fighting, reaching out toward the fallen figure. Two large flags wave in the smoky, dark sky above the crowd, adding to the intense atmosphere. In the foreground, men are shown struggling or tending to others amidst the smoke and fire.

title: The Death of General Montgomery in the Attack on Quebec, December 31, 1775
alt_text: A painting of soldiers and other figures engaged in a chaotic scene outdoors. In the center, a man wearing a yellow uniform slumps backward and is supported by several other men in military clothing. Below him on the ground, another man in a similar yellow uniform lies flat, appearing to be wounded or fallen. To the left, a man wearing fringed clothing and a cap gestures toward the center with his arm raised. Dark, stormy clouds fill the sky above the group, while a large, pale flag waves near a tree branch on the right. Several other figures in uniform stand or gesture in the background, surrounded by smoke and dim light.

title: Portrait of Edward S. Harkness, B.A. 1897
alt_text: A painting of a man seated in a dark chair against a plain, dark background. The man has short, light-colored hair and wears round wire-rimmed glasses. He is dressed in a dark suit with a vest, a crisp white shirt, and a dark bow tie. His hands are folded and resting on his lap in the center of the frame. The portrait shows him from the chest up, and he is looking directly toward the viewer with a neutral expression.

title: Dancer in Arabesque
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a person standing on one leg. The figure is made of dark, textured metal with a rough, uneven surface. One leg is planted firmly on a thick, round base. The other leg is bent upward at the knee, held by the hand on the same side. The opposite arm is extended outward to the side for balance. The figure’s head is tilted slightly toward the raised arm.

title: The Palanquin
alt_text: A textile made of wool and silk showing a detailed outdoor scene framed by a decorative border. The center of the piece features a person being carried in a sedan chair by four attendants, while other figures stand nearby or walk along the ground. A wide landscape stretches across the background, filled with stylized trees, small buildings, a bridge, and patches of land against a dark backdrop. The border around the entire scene is decorated with repeating patterns of fruit, flowers, and small animals in each corner. Several more figures are shown in the bottom section, carrying items or walking through the grassy area.

title: George Washington
alt_text: A gilt copper sculpture of a man sitting on a chair. He wears a military-style uniform with epaulettes and sits with one leg bent. In his hand, he holds a rolled document or scroll that rests on his lap. Beside him, a cornucopia spilling fruit spills down toward the base of the sculpture. The figure stands on a square, green and grey marble pedestal with a rectangular gold plaque on the front. This plaque shows a relief design of a bird with spread wings surrounded by sun rays.

title: Female Torso
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a torso shows a person's upper body without a head or arms. The figure has a dark green, metallic finish and stands upright. One hand rests against the chest area, while the other arm is missing near the shoulder. The torso is attached to a square, mottled green and grey marble base. A small rectangular white label with a barcode is stuck to the front side of the base.

title: The Fog
alt_text: A painting showing a rocky coastline overlooking a calm sea. In the foreground, large, jagged golden-brown rocks fill the lower left and center of the frame. The water stretches out in the background, appearing dark and muted with shades of blue and gray. A soft, hazy light hangs over the horizon, blurring the line between the sky and the sea. The entire scene is encased in an ornate, cream-colored frame with decorative carvings along the edges.

title: Why Don't You Speak for Yourself, John?
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a man standing next to a seated woman. The man, on the left, wears a collared jacket and holds a brimmed hat in his hands. The woman, on the right, sits in a chair while working at a wooden spinning wheel. She wears a long dress and looks up toward the standing man. The base of the sculpture features large, carved lettering that includes the names "John Alden" and "Priscilla."

title: The Wounded Scout, A Friend in the Swamp
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows two standing men leaning against each other. One man, on the left, wears a collared jacket and has his head resting on the shoulder of the taller man to his right. The man on the right wears torn clothing and stands with his arm around the shoulder of the first man, their hands clasped together. They both stand on a textured, uneven base that resembles rocky or plant-covered ground. The sculpture is monochromatic, with a worn, light brown finish throughout the entire piece.

title: The Favored Scholar
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a scene with three people grouped around a tall, flat-topped desk. At the center, a young man leans over the desk, writing in an open book. Standing to his left is a young girl wearing a dress with a ruffled apron, who watches him while holding a small object to her lips. Seated on a low stool to the right is a barefoot young boy who looks up at the girl, resting his chin on his hands. A decorative basket sits on the floor near the desk, and a bouquet of flowers rests on the top corner of the desk. The base of the sculpture has the words "THE FAVORED SCHOLAR" carved into the front.

title: Coming to the Parson
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of three people and two small animals standing on a rectangular base. On the left, an older man sits in a chair, looking up and talking to a younger man who stands in the center. A woman stands beside the younger man on the right, her hands held near her face as she looks toward the seated man. A cat stands on the base near the seated man, and a small dog sits near the feet of the standing man. The words "COMING TO THE PARSON" are carved into the front of the base.

title: Fighting Bob
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a standing man dressed in old-fashioned clothing and a triangular hat. He wears a long coat, a vest, and a scarf tied around his neck. His right arm is raised, holding what looks like a long, thin pistol. In his left hand, he holds another similar pistol pointing downward near his hip. A small white tag labeled "1932.161" is attached to his raised hand. The figure stands in front of a white brick wall.

title: The Council of War
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture showing three men engaged in a meeting. A man sits in a chair in the center, looking down at a large document he holds open in his hands. To his left stands another man, who looks toward the seated figure while resting one hand on the back of the chair. To the right of the seated man stands a third figure, who holds a cloth in one hand and gazes downward toward the paper. The base of the sculpture is circular and features the engraved words "THE COUNCIL OF WAR" across the front.

title: Is it so Nominated in the Bond?
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows four figures surrounding a central structure with a scroll. Two men stand on the left, one slightly behind the other, both wearing tunics and leggings. A central figure stands behind a raised, podium-like structure, looking toward the right. To the right, a bearded man in a long robe reaches out and points at the scroll held by the central figure. A base at the bottom includes the engraved words, "Is it so nominated in the bond?"

title: A Matter of Opinion
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows three figures standing and sitting together on a round base. On the left stands a man in a long coat, reaching into his jacket with one hand while looking toward a person sitting in the center. In the middle, a person sits in a chair, wearing a long dress with a ruffled collar and holding a book in their lap. To the right, a second man leans forward, holding out one hand toward the seated person's hand. The base of the sculpture has the words "A MATTER OF OPINION" carved into the front.

title: Playing Doctor
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows three figures gathered together on a rectangular base. On the left, a girl stands with one hand on a boy's head and the other holding a cloth draped around his shoulders. The boy sits in the middle in a wooden bucket, looking up toward the girl. To the right, a young man sits on a chair, reaching out to touch the boy's hair while holding a thin stick in his other hand. The base of the sculpture features the words "PLAYING DOCTOR" carved in capital letters. The entire scene is monochromatic, featuring a uniform, muted tone throughout.

title: Rip Van Winkle Returned
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows an elderly, bearded man standing outside. He has long, messy hair and a long beard, and he holds one hand up to his forehead as if he is confused. He wears a ragged, heavy coat that hangs loosely on his body, with visible patches of white paint peeling away. To his left, a small, hunched dog stands against a rocky base. The man stands on a round pedestal with words carved into the front that are difficult to read.

title: Rip Van Winkle on the Mountain
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a man in a wide-brimmed hat standing over a small child. The man wears a long coat and holds a long, thin rod in his right hand. The child is crouched low and holds their hands on top of a small, wooden-style barrel that sits between them. Both figures have a weathered, textured surface with dark grey and brown spots. A smooth, light-colored figure stands in the background, facing away from the viewer.

title: Rip Van Winkle at Home
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a man sitting on a wooden bench with two young children. The man is in the center, resting one leg over his other knee while wearing a jacket and trousers. On his left, a small child in a hat stands close to his side with hands covering their face. To the man's right, a second child wearing a bonnet leans against him while looking upward. The base of the sculpture has the words "RIP VAN WINKLE AT HOME" carved across the front. The sculpture has a light grey, worn finish with patches where the paint has chipped away.

title: The Tap on the Window
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a woman standing beside a seated man. The woman holds a fan in her right hand while her left hand is held by the man. He sits on a chair to her right, looking up with a surprised expression. A small, square table stands between them with a bouquet of flowers resting on top. Beneath the table, two cats sit closely together on the base. The round base of the sculpture has the words "THE TAP ON THE WINDOW" carved into its front edge.

title: Madam, Your Mother Craves a Word with You
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows three figures standing together on a rounded base. On the left, a man leans slightly forward while looking at and touching the hand of the woman in the center. The woman in the middle wears a long dress with a veil and looks toward the older woman standing on the right. The woman on the right wears a heavy gown, a head covering, and holds a small beaded purse. Text is etched into the front of the base, identifying the characters and providing a snippet of dialogue.

title: Taking the Oath and Drawing Rations
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture showing a group of four people gathered around a wooden barrel. A man in a military-style uniform stands in the back, holding his cap in one hand and offering something from his other hand. Beside him stands a woman wearing a long dress with a high collar, her hand resting on a small boy who clings to her skirt. On the other side of the barrel, a second, younger child reaches up toward the man. Carved into the base of the sculpture is the text, "TAKING THE OATH AND DRAWING RATIONS."

title: Returned Volunteer: How the Fort Was Taken
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture showing three people gathered around a large anvil. At the center stands an older man wearing an apron, with one hand resting on the metal anvil and the other held by a young girl. To the left, a young girl in a simple dress stands beside the anvil, looking toward the man. To the right, a man in a military-style cap and uniform kneels on the base, looking up at the standing man. The group is set on a rounded base with text engraved on the front. The entire scene is monochromatic and appears to be made of a solid, chalky material.

title: The Peddler at the Fair
alt_text: A sculpture of three figures and a horse made of painted plaster. A person sits on the horse's back wearing a tall, decorated hat and holding a box on their lap. Beside the horse stands another person in a long dress, looking up toward the rider. In front of the horse, a man stands wearing a suit and hat, with his hands clasped near his waist. The entire group rests on a round base that has the words "THE PEDDLER AT THE FAIR" carved into the front rim.

title: Weighing the Baby
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture showing a group of people clustered around a table to weigh a baby. On the right, a man in an apron stands and adjusts a small scale, while a woman beside him supports the infant in a cloth sling. A young boy leans against the left side of the table, resting his chin on his hands and holding a hat. Underneath the table, several containers and a broom sit on a raised base. The base has the words "WEIGHING THE BABY" carved across the front.

title: The Mock Trial, Argument for the Prosecution
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a group of four people arranged in a scene. Two women in long, textured dresses stand on either side of the group. A man stands behind a low wooden bar in the center, looking toward the right. Another man kneels in front of the bar with his hands clasped together near his chest. The base of the sculpture has text carved into it that reads "THE MOCK TRIAL" and "ARGUMENT FOR THE PROSECUTION."

title: The Picket Guard
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows three figures standing together on a rectangular base. The central figure is a tall man in a military uniform wearing a peaked cap and holding a sword at his side. Flanking him on both sides are two smaller figures wearing loose-fitting tunics, trousers, and head coverings. The figure on the left holds a long rifle, while the figure on the right holds a hand up to shade their eyes. The front edge of the base is inscribed with the words "THE PICKET GUARD" in capital letters.

title: The Home Guard, Midnight on the Border
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a woman and a child standing together on a round base. The taller woman stands on the left, looking off to the side with a serious expression. A smaller child stands slightly behind and to the right, looking up at the woman and clutching her hand. Both figures are dressed in draped, long clothing that covers their bodies. Patches of paint are worn away across the surface of the sculpture, revealing the light material underneath. The base of the statue features raised lettering that reads "THE HOME GUARD" and "MIDNIGHT ON THE BORDER."

title: Neighboring Pews
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a group of people seated in two separate church pews. On the left, a small boy wearing a top hat sits in the smaller pew. Beside him, a woman in a decorated hat stands and holds an open book. In the adjacent pew on the right, another seated woman looks at a book while a man leans over her shoulder to point at the pages. The base of the sculpture has the words "NEIGHBORING PEWS" carved into the front.

title: Uncle Ned's School
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows an older man teaching two children. The man sits on top of a tall, rectangular wooden box while wearing a collared shirt and patched trousers. A young girl stands to his left, holding a small book that rests on the box. A young boy sits on the floor at the base of the box, looking up and holding an open book in his lap. The words "UNCLE NED'S SCHOOL" are carved into the front of the sculpture's round base.

title: The Charity Patient
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows an older man with a bald head and a beard standing on the left side. He wears a long, open coat and reaches out with his right hand to touch the forehead of a small baby. The baby is wrapped in a blanket and held by a young woman standing to the man's right. Between the man and the woman sits a tall, narrow cabinet with several small drawers and a bowl on top. The entire group stands on a round base with the words "THE CHARITY PATIENT" carved into the front.

title: A Frolic at the Old Homestead
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture of four people gathered around an older woman. The central figure is an elderly woman sitting in a chair, wearing glasses and a cap, with her hands busy knitting a cloth. To her left stands a man with a blindfold over his eyes, reaching out with one arm to touch her shoulder. Behind the seated woman stands another man looking forward with a smile, while a woman stands to the right holding up the side of her long skirt. The figures are arranged on an oval base that features the carved words "A FROLIC AT THE OLD HOMESTEAD" along the front edge.

title: The Watch on the Santa Maria
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows three men standing together around a central post. The man on the left wears a long coat and points his finger into the distance with a serious expression. In the center, a man with a beard and a cap leans forward, resting his hands on the top of a thick, rounded post. The third man stands on the right, looking upward while holding a hat in his hand. A thick rope is coiled around the base of the post at their feet. The words "THE WATCH ON THE SANTA MARA" are carved into the front of the flat base.

title: The Foundling
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a man standing in front of a flat, upright board. The man is wearing a long coat and holding a small, bundled shape in his arms. In his right hand, he holds a rectangular object that looks like a small box. Below the man, a rectangular basket sits on a flat base. The entire figure and the items are a single, light brown color.

title: Parting Promise
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a man and a woman standing together. The man is taller and stands on the left, wearing a suit with a coat and trousers. He holds a small, flat object in his hands, which the woman is touching as well. The woman stands to his right, wearing a long dress with ruffled details and leaning her head toward his shoulder. Both figures have light brown, matte coloring and stand on a simple, circular base.

title: Checkers Up at the Farm
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows four people gathered around a wooden barrel used as a table. An older man sits on a small wooden crate on the left, resting his chin on his hand while looking down at the tabletop. A younger man sits on a woven basket on the right, smiling and reaching toward the center of the barrel. Between them, a woman stands holding a small child who gazes down at the playing surface. The group appears to be playing a game with small, flat, round pieces placed on top of the barrel. The entire scene rests on a round base with the word "CHECKERS" carved into the front.

title: Politics
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture of a woman standing between two seated men. The woman is positioned slightly behind a small, square table, holding a small object in one hand while reaching toward the man on the right. Both men are sitting and looking upward toward the woman, and the man on the right is holding a closed umbrella in his hand. The table between them features an open compartment filled with small, upright items like bottles. The word "POLITICS" is carved clearly onto the front of the sculpture's base.

title: School Days
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture of a man, a monkey, and two children. On the left, a tall man in a hat stands with a box-like instrument strapped around his neck, upon which a small monkey sits. The monkey holds a small circular object in its hand. To the right of the instrument, a young girl and a young boy stand and look towards the man and the monkey. The base of the sculpture has the words "SCHOOL DAYS" engraved on the front.

title: Courtship in Sleepy Hollow, Icabod Crane and Katrina van Tassel
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a man sitting on a chair and leaning forward toward a young woman seated next to him. The man wears a long coat, breeches, and buckled shoes. The woman wears a long dress with puffed sleeves and holds a small animal, possibly a cat or dog, in her arms. Behind them is a curved backrest that looks like part of a bench or chair. The base of the sculpture has text written on the front, including the words "COURTSHIP" and "SLEEPY HOLLOW."

title: Union Refugees
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows three figures standing together on a round base. A tall man stands on the left, wearing a hat and a long coat, with his right arm holding an object over his shoulder. A woman stands beside him, resting her head against his shoulder with her eyes closed. A small child stands to the right of the woman, looking up at her and holding her hand. The words "UNION REFUGEES" are carved into the front of the base.

title: We Boys
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture of two young boys riding on the back of a horse. The horse stands with its head bowed low, seemingly grazing or resting. One boy sits upright near the horse's neck, holding on, while the second boy lies flat on his stomach across the horse’s back behind him. They are positioned on a small, textured base that features a tree stump beneath the horse's belly. The words "WE BOYS" are carved directly into the front of the base.

title: Challenging the Union Vote
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows three figures gathered around a small desk. One man sits on a stool, leaning over a large, open book while pointing at a page.
