Standing behind him is an older man with his hand resting on the shoulder of a young woman. The woman stands to the right, looking toward the seated man with her hands clasped. A small, square box sits on the desk next to the book, and a rounded hat rests on the floor at the base of the scene.

title: Going for the Cows
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a horse standing within a cardboard storage box. The sculpture is colored in muted brown tones and rests on a circular base. It is partially wrapped in clear plastic and white batting material around its midsection for protection. Several rectangular foam blocks are placed around the base and on top of the sculpture to keep it stable. The horse's head is bowed downward as if grazing.

title: The Elder's Daughter
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture showing three people and a horse. A bearded man wearing a brimmed hat sits on the horse, holding a small book. A woman sits behind him on the horse, leaning her head on his shoulder. A younger person stands next to the horse, looking up and holding a bowl of fruit. The figures all stand on an oval base with words carved along the front edge.

title: The Traveling Magician
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a man performing a magic trick for a small audience. The man stands behind a table covered with a cloth, lifting a rabbit by its ears out of a top hat. To his left, a young child sits on the floor while holding a small instrument. On the right side, two other figures stand close together and watch the trick intently. Several paper tags with writing on them are attached to the figures.

title: The Town Pump
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows two figures standing on a circular base. A woman stands on the left wearing a long dress with a shawl draped over her head and shoulders. A man stands on the right wearing a long coat, a brimmed hat, and a pack on his back. He rests his right hand on a tall, rectangular block that separates him from the woman. The entire sculpture is surrounded by a wooden frame and supported by several white, rectangular foam blocks.

title: Batsman
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a person standing in a pose as if ready to swing a bat. The figure wears a collared shirt, long pants, and a cap while holding a long, thin rod over one shoulder. They stand with their feet apart on a textured, oval-shaped base. The statue has a dark, metallic finish that appears mostly black with hints of bronze. A shadow is cast behind the figure, suggesting light coming from the front.

title: Pitcher
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a figure in a dynamic pose. The figure is a man wearing a flat cap, a collared shirt, and pants. He is reaching his right arm out to the side as if holding or throwing a small object. His body is bent at the knees and leans forward slightly. He stands on a rough, oval-shaped base that is part of the sculpture. The entire piece is made of dark bronze with highlights on the surfaces.

title: The Boxer
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a muscular man standing in a boxing pose. He is leaning slightly forward with one arm extended out and the other tucked closer to his chest. The figure is made of dark brown metal and stands on a rectangular base. He appears to be wearing wraps on his hands and ankles. A small white tag is attached to one of his ankles.

title: Spear Thrower
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a nude male figure standing on a flat, rectangular base. The figure is posed as if preparing to throw a long, thin spear held in his right hand. His left arm is extended forward, and his head is turned toward his left. His body is muscular, with a dark, brownish-green surface texture. He stands with his legs spread apart, leaning slightly back as he holds the weapon.

title: The Onslaught, study of a football scrum
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a large, tangled group of male figures engaged in a chaotic pile. The figures are dark brown and appear to be in a struggle, with their bodies twisted and overlapping on a low, irregular base. On the left, one figure sits apart while others reach toward the center. Toward the right, several bodies are bent over with their limbs intertwined in the dense mass. The entire scene captures a moment of intense, messy action with no clear focal point.

title: The Joy of Effort
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a circular plaque shows three figures in active motion. The figures appear to be leaning forward with their arms stretched out, as if running or diving. Their bodies overlap, creating a sense of movement across the surface of the dark metal. A border of subtle leaf-like patterns circles the edge of the plaque. At the bottom, there is a small, rectangular structure and some indistinct text or lettering.

title: The Pole Vaulter
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a figure diving into a tall, rectangular block. The figure is positioned upside down with its legs pointing toward the top of the image. Its arms extend downward, gripping a thin, pole-like object that runs along the center of the block. The base of the sculpture is a smooth, dark, vertical pillar that rises from the bottom. The sculpture is dark brown in color against a plain, light background.

title: The Icebird
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a figure leaning forward while balancing on one skate. The figure has an athletic build and is dressed in tight-fitting clothing. One arm extends forward while the other arm and leg are stretched out behind in a graceful pose. The statue has a dark brown, shiny finish and stands on a rectangular wooden base. It is placed in front of a tall, dark wooden door with vertical panels.

title: The Javelin Cast
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a male figure balancing on one leg. The figure is made of smooth, dark brown metal and is posed with one leg extended straight back and one arm reaching forward. His other arm hangs down near his knee. He stands on top of a round, green stone base. The sculpture rests on a white table surface.

title: The Upright Discus Thrower
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a male figure in a dynamic, athletic pose. The man stands on one leg atop a rough, blocky base with a greenish-brown finish. His body faces slightly to the right, and his arms are outstretched to the sides. In his right hand, he holds a small, round, disc-like object. The figure is nude, with visible muscle definition across his chest, torso, and legs.

title: The Modern Discus Thrower
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a male athlete in a bent, athletic stance. The figure is made of dark reddish-brown metal and appears to be in motion. His right arm is pulled back and holds a flat, round disk. The man is crouching with his weight shifted onto his back leg. The sculpture rests on a flat rectangular base in front of a wooden panel background.

title: The Shot Putter
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a human figure in the middle of a dynamic movement. The figure stands on one leg while the other leg is lifted high and bent at the knee. One arm is held out to the side while the other arm is bent near the chest, appearing to hold a small, round object. The surface of the statue has a mottled brown and dark green finish that catches the light. The figure is balanced on a small, round base that sits on a flat, white surface.

title: The Flying Sphere
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man balancing on one leg. The figure is made of dark brown metal and is posed in a horizontal line, stretching his body outward. His right leg is planted firmly on a rounded, green stone base while his left leg extends straight back behind him. Both of his arms are stretched out, with one reaching forward and the other reaching toward his back leg. The background consists of dark wooden panels that show vertical grain.

title: The Competitor
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a kneeling person is shown from the side. The figure is made of dark, smooth, reddish-brown metal and is hunched over with its head bowed. It rests on a rough, rock-like base made of the same dark material. The person's back is rounded, and their knees are bent, with their legs tucked beneath them. The sculpture is set against a plain, dark gray background.

title: The Relay
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a muscular, young man crouching on a rock. The figure has dark reddish-brown skin and short, wavy hair. He looks to his left with a focused expression, leaning forward with one hand resting near his knee. He is kneeling on a rough, uneven base that features some lettering and a date. The sculpture is situated in a room filled with cardboard storage boxes and overhead pipes.

title: The Athlete
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a standing, nude man looking downward. The man has a muscular build and a dark, reddish-brown color. He is bent slightly forward with both hands held near his midsection as if he is examining something. His body faces toward the right, with one leg extended behind him and the other supporting his weight. The sculpture stands on a simple square base against a wooden, paneled background.

title: Setter
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a dog is shown in a standing position. The dog is positioned in profile, facing toward the right side of the frame with one front paw lifted slightly. Its long, fluffy tail extends horizontally behind it. The surface of the sculpture has a dark, textured brown finish that mimics the look of fur. It stands on a rough, uneven oval base that sits on a white surface.

title: Tranby
alt_text: A painting of a bay horse standing in a grassy field. The horse is positioned in the center, facing left with its body angled toward the viewer. Its coat is a warm, dark brown, and its mane and tail are a deep black. In the background, rolling hills and a light, cloudy sky stretch across the horizon. A bare, slender tree trunk stands on the far right edge of the frame. The scene is bathed in soft, muted tones that suggest a calm, open landscape.

title: Taking the Count
alt_text: A painting of a boxing ring showing three men in a central area and a large crowd in the background. On the left, a standing man with short, dark hair wears only white trunks, a green sash, and lace-up boots. Beside him, a man in a black tuxedo and bowtie stands straight, looking down toward the floor while gesturing with his hands. A second, shirtless man crouches on the right, kneeling on one knee with his hands touching the mat. Two large, rectangular posters hang on the wall behind the ring, and many blurry figures of people fill the seats surrounding the area. The scene is lit with warm tones, highlighting the figures in the center against the darker background.

title: John Biglin in a Single Scull
alt_text: A painting of a man rowing a single-person boat on the water. The man sits in the center of a long, narrow, reddish-brown boat, facing to the left while he pulls on the oars. He wears a white sleeveless shirt, dark shorts, and a bright red bandana tied around his head. Behind him, the water is a calm, deep blue color, and a low, thin line of land stretches across the horizon under a clear sky. The water in the foreground reflects the dark colors of the boat.

title: Andrew Jackson (1767-1845) (attributed to Ralph Eleaser Whieside Earl)
alt_text: A painting of an elderly man with pale skin and light gray hair. He is shown from the chest up against a very dark, indistinct background. The man has a long, thin face with deep lines around his mouth and nose. He wears a dark, high-collared coat over a white shirt and a white necktie. His gaze is directed forward toward the viewer with a serious, unsmiling expression.

title: Commodore Charles Stewart (1778-1869)
alt_text: A painting of a man in a military uniform wearing a gold-trimmed coat. The man has short, light brown hair and is looking slightly to his left. He has his hands clasped over the handle of a sword that rests near his waist. He wears a dark jacket with large gold buttons and gold epaulettes on his shoulders. The background shows a simple wall on the left and a glimpse of a faint outdoor scene on the right. A simple, worn, gold-colored frame surrounds the painting on all sides.

title: Portrait of a Man
alt_text: A painting of a man showing him from the chest up. He wears a dark coat over a high, light-colored collar that wraps around his neck. His face is pale, and he has short, dark hair that falls across his forehead. A white paper tag with handwritten text is attached to the right side of the canvas edge. The overall tones of the painting are dark and muted, and the edges appear worn.

title: Trifle
alt_text: A painting of a horse standing in an open field. The horse has a smooth, reddish-brown coat and is facing toward the left side of the frame. Its body is lean, and it stands on a patch of light-colored ground. In the background, rolling green hills and dark trees stretch toward the horizon under a cloudy, yellow-toned sky. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: Sir Bertrand with a Groom
alt_text: A painting shows a brown horse standing in an open field, accompanied by a man and a dog. The horse faces to the left, taking up the center of the image. A man wearing a dark coat, light trousers, and a tall hat stands near the horse's head. On the ground near the man, a dark-colored dog lies resting. In the background, there are green trees under a pale, yellowish sky.

title: Pocahontas
alt_text: A painting of a brown horse standing in a landscape. The horse is positioned in the center, facing toward the right side of the frame. Its coat is a deep reddish-brown color with a darker mane and tail. Behind the horse, a flat, grassy field stretches toward a faint, pale horizon. Several small trees grow on the right side of the composition. The entire image is enclosed in a thick, textured gold frame.

title: Argyle
alt_text: A painting of a brown horse standing in a grassy field. The horse is positioned in the center and faces to the left. It has a dark mane and a long tail that hangs down. A thin, bare tree grows on the right side of the canvas. In the background, there are low bushes and some distant buildings under a pale, cloudy sky. The entire artwork is enclosed in an ornate gold-colored frame.

title: Branch
alt_text: A painting of a brown horse standing in a grassy field. The horse is positioned in the center, facing toward the right side of the frame. Its coat is a solid reddish-brown color, and its tail hangs down toward the ground. The background is a muted, pale yellow sky above a flat, brownish landscape with a few small trees in the distance. The entire artwork is enclosed in a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: Lady Nashville
alt_text: A painting of a horse standing in an open field. The horse is dark brown and faces toward the left side of the frame. It stands in the center of the painting on flat, light-brown ground. To the right of the horse, a single, thin tree without leaves reaches upward. In the far background, a line of trees appears against a pale, golden sky. The entire scene is enclosed in an ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Unknown Horse
alt_text: A painting of a reddish-brown horse stands in the center of the frame. The horse faces to the left, showing its full profile against a simple background. The background features a muted, pale yellow sky above a darker, grassy field with a line of distant trees. To the right, a bare, thin tree trunk stands vertically near the edge of the scene. The entire painting is held within a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a small, horse-drawn carriage outdoors. The man wears a tall, dark hat, a dark jacket over a yellow vest, and white pants, and he holds the reins to a white horse on his right. To the left, a brown horse stands facing the carriage, held by a young boy wearing a white shirt and blue pants. A brown leather saddle sits on the dirt ground near the boy's feet. The background shows an open field with sparse trees under a cloudy blue sky.

title: Bertrand (after Edward Troye)
alt_text: A painting of a brown horse standing in a field with a person. The horse faces left, and its body is large and muscular with a dark tail. A person stands facing the horse's head, holding a thin rope that connects to the horse's halter. To the left, a tall, brick-colored wall stands next to a small red bucket and some folded cloth on the ground. Green trees fill the background under a warm, yellow-toned sky. The entire scene is displayed within a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: Juno
alt_text: A painting of a brown horse standing in a grassy field. The horse is positioned in the center, facing toward the left side of the frame. Behind the horse, a large, dark tree stands next to the stone wall of a small building. In the distance, the landscape features rolling green hills under a soft, light-colored sky. The ground is covered in patches of green grass and dirt.

title: Quail and Young
alt_text: A painting of two adult birds and many chicks standing in a grassy field. The larger, upright adult bird stands near the center with brown and white patterned feathers. Beside it, a second adult bird leans down toward the ground as if eating. A group of ten small, fuzzy chicks with light brown feathers are scattered around the adults in the grass. Green grasses and a few small white flowers fill the background on the left side of the scene. The entire setting is bathed in a soft, natural light against a muted, hazy sky.

title: A Good Chance
alt_text: A painting of two men in a canoe on a calm river. One man wearing a red shirt sits at the back, paddling with a long wooden oar. The second man wears a brown jacket and kneels at the front, aiming a rifle at a deer standing on the riverbank. A brown and white dog swims in the water near the canoe. The background features thick green trees and soft purple mountains under a cloudy, bright sky.

title: Shooting From Ambush
alt_text: A painting of two men kneeling inside a leafy, homemade shelter while hunting birds. The man in front holds a long rifle and looks intently toward the right side of the scene. Beside him, a second man hides in the brush, watching the same direction. A small, wooden pole with crossbeams sits in the clearing ahead, where several small birds are perched. A pile of hunted birds lies on the ground near a hat on the forest floor.

title: Pointers and Woodcock
alt_text: A painting of two dogs standing in a grassy field. The dog on the left is white with dark patches, and it is positioned lower in the grass, facing toward the right side. Behind it, a second dog with a brown head and a white-and-dark body stands facing forward, looking toward the viewer. The background features a flat, open landscape under a cloudy, light-colored sky with some trees in the distance. The entire scene is enclosed within a wide, textured, light brown wooden frame.

title: Pointers and Quail
alt_text: A painting of two dogs standing in a grassy field. The dogs are both brown and white and are looking intently at something hidden in the bushes. To the left, a rustic wooden fence stands near the brush, and a small bird is visible near the ground in the lower left corner. The background is a soft, muted landscape under a light sky. The painting is enclosed in a wide, ornate gold frame.

title: Startled Deer
alt_text: A painting of two deer standing in a grassy field. A large male deer with prominent antlers stands on the left side of the scene, looking toward the right. A smaller deer with no antlers stands behind a rocky, grassy mound on the right. Both animals are brown with lighter coloring on their undersides. In the background, a flat landscape with water stretches out under a cloudy, overcast sky. The painting is enclosed in an ornate gold frame.

title: American Frontier Life
alt_text: A painting of two men riding horses through a wooded area. In the foreground, a man sits on a white horse, looking off to his left while holding a long rifle across his lap. He wears a tan, fringed jacket and a wide-brimmed hat. Behind him, partially hidden by a large dark tree trunk on the left, a second man sits on a darker horse and looks through a rifle scope. The scene is filled with tall grasses, thick brush, and a bright, cloudy sky in the upper right corner.

title: Woodcock and Young
alt_text: A painting of two adult birds and five chicks standing on the muddy ground. The adult birds have brown, speckled feathers and long, thin beaks pointing downward. Five small, fluffy chicks are clustered around them, each with similar patterned feathers. Large, rounded green leaves fill the background, creating a dense, natural setting. The ground is brown and textured, suggesting a damp forest floor.

title: Touchdown, Yale vs. Princeton, Thanksgiving Day, Nov. 27, 1890, Yale 32, Princeton 0
alt_text: A painting of a football game showing several men playing on a grassy field in front of a crowd. In the foreground, two players in white uniforms are tangled together on the ground near a wooden post and a rope line. A third player in a white uniform runs toward the pair on the ground, leaning forward with his arms out. Behind them, two other players in white uniforms are moving toward the right side of the frame. To the left, a large, dense crowd of men wearing dark suits and bowler hats watches intently from behind the rope. The background behind the crowd is a hazy, light-colored sky.

title: Portrait of George Washington (Chinese artist after Gilbert Stuart)
alt_text: A painting of an older man with white hair, shown from the chest up. He wears a dark coat and a high, folded white neckcloth. The man has a serious expression and is angled slightly toward the left side of the frame. The background is a very dark, indistinct shadow. A shiny, gold-colored frame surrounds the entire image.

title: Winter Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a snowy, rural landscape featuring a house and barn. In the center foreground, a person in a brown coat stands on a path facing away from the viewer. To the left, a yellow house sits behind a wooden fence, with some brown cattle standing nearby. A large, gnarled tree trunk dominates the right side of the scene, its branches bare against the pale sky. The ground is covered in snow, and dark storm clouds gather in the upper left corner. In the distance, muted mountains rise above the snow-covered fields.

title: View along the East Battery, Charleston
alt_text: A painting of a coastal town scene shows a large, multi-story building with porches on the left side and a row of smaller buildings stretching into the distance. In the foreground, an open, grassy park area features several groups of people walking, talking, or playing, alongside a few dogs wandering about. To the right, a wooden fence runs along the edge of a harbor where the masts of tall ships are visible on the water. The sky above is bright blue and filled with large, fluffy white clouds. The entire scene is bathed in clear, daylight illumination.

title: Illustration for Tom Sawyer
alt_text: A painting of two boys playing in front of a wall, rendered in shades of gray. One boy sits on a wooden barrel in the foreground, eating an apple while looking off to the side. Behind him, a second boy stands near the wall and uses a brush to paint a mark on its surface. A small metal bucket sits on the ground near the standing boy. In the background, there is a simple house and some trees visible above the wall. The entire scene is framed in black.

title: The Declaration of Independence, July 4, 1776
alt_text: A painting of a large group of men gathered in a dimly lit room. Most of the men are seated at tables in rows, while a small group stands near a central table covered with papers. The men wear formal 18th-century coats, breeches, and white wigs or powdered hair. Behind the group, a display of flags and a drum hangs on the back wall. Dark red curtains flank the doorways on both the left and right sides of the room. The overall scene appears somber and serious with warm, muted tones.

title: The Surrender of Lord Cornwallis at Yorktown, October 19, 1781
alt_text: A painting of two groups of soldiers facing each other on a wide field under a stormy sky. In the center, a man in a dark blue coat sits on a white horse, while a man in a bright red coat stands beside him. On the left side, a large group of men with a plain white flag stands near their horses. On the right side, a second group of soldiers with a flag featuring red and white stripes stands near their own horses. The scene is framed by dark, heavy clouds above and a dirt ground below.

title: The Capture of the Hessians at Trenton, December 26, 1776
alt_text: A painting of a battle scene shows many soldiers in uniform, some on horseback and some on foot. In the center, a man in a blue and yellow uniform sits on a brown horse, gesturing toward the surrounding chaos. Men are scattered on the ground, some lying still and others being helped by their companions. Several horses appear throughout the scene, and two flags wave in the background under a dark, stormy sky. This active scene shows figures in military clothing holding swords and interacting with one another on a muddy field.

title: The Death of General Mercer at the Battle of Princeton, January 3, 1777
alt_text: A painting of a chaotic battle scene shows many soldiers in colorful uniforms fighting in a field. In the center, a man sits on a brown horse, while another soldier nearby has fallen from a white horse to the ground. Red-coated soldiers grapple with others dressed in blue and buff uniforms, with some figures wielding swords and rifles. Several people lie on the ground, seemingly wounded or dead, near a large drum and scattered weapons. The sky is dark and cloudy above the scene, and there are trees and flags visible in the background.

title: The Death of General Mercer at the Battle of Princeton, 3 January 1777 (unfinished version)
alt_text: A painting of a chaotic battlefield shows many soldiers in red coats fighting and falling. In the center, a person wearing a dark blue coat sits on a brown horse and points forward. Nearby, a white horse rears up, its head thrown back in the middle of the struggle. Several soldiers are lying on the ground, while others stand and fight with raised weapons. Dark, stormy clouds fill the sky above the figures, and a large flag waves in the background.

title: The Surrender of General Burgoyne at Saratoga, October 16, 1777
alt_text: A painting of a group of military men standing in an outdoor field during the day. In the center, a man in a dark blue military coat stands with his arms outstretched toward two men in bright red coats who stand to his left. To the right of the central man, a man in a light-colored uniform stands next to a large brass cannon on wheels. Several other men in various uniforms stand behind them, and a tall American flag flies on a pole near a large white tent in the background. Large leafy trees and a cloudy sky fill the space behind the group of figures.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LL.D 1781
alt_text: A painting of a middle-aged man shown from the chest up against a dark, shadowy background. He has light skin, blue eyes, and his wavy white hair is pulled back. He wears a dark, possibly black, suit jacket that hangs over his shoulders. Beneath the jacket, a white shirt or cravat with ruffles sits at his neck. The man looks directly forward with a calm, neutral expression on his face.

title: Alexander Hamilton (1757-1804)
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up against a very dark, plain background. The man has fair skin, a pale face, and light hair styled in short, loose waves. He is wearing a dark brown jacket with a high collar that stands up around his neck. A white, ruffled fabric cravat is tied at his throat. His face is turned slightly to his right, and he has a serious expression with his gaze fixed toward the distance.

title: Stephen van Rensselaer (1764-1839), LL.D. 1822
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair, shown from the chest up. The man has short, light brown hair and is looking slightly to his left. He wears a dark, heavy coat over a pale, cream-colored ruffled shirt or cravat. His right hand rests on the arm of a wooden chair with dark padding. The background is a simple, muted brown color that is darker near the edges.

title: Rufus King (1755-1827)
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up. The man has short, powdered white hair styled with curls at the sides. He is wearing a dark coat over a white shirt with a ruffled cravat at his neck. His expression is calm and neutral as he looks directly at the viewer. One of his hands is visible in the lower left, resting on top of a red, leather-bound book. The background is a very dark, indistinct shade of brown that fades into black.

title: Christopher Gore (1758-1827)
alt_text: A painting of a man with light skin, seen from the chest up. He has short, light, curly hair and looks directly forward with a serious expression. He wears a dark jacket over a white shirt with a ruffled cravat at his neck. His right hand rests on a small, reddish-brown book held at the bottom of the frame. In the background, a dark red curtain hangs to one side, beside a tall stone pillar.

title: Henry Laurens (1724–1792)
alt_text: A miniature oil on wood painting shows a portrait of an older man within an oval frame. The man has white hair styled in curls and a fair complexion. He wears a dark, solid-colored coat with a white cloth wrapped around his neck. His head is turned slightly to the left, and he gazes calmly toward the side. The gold-colored border surrounding the portrait contains dark, printed text that circles the image.

title: John Jay (1745–1829)
alt_text: A miniature painting on wood of a man’s head and shoulders is set inside an oval, gold-colored frame. The man has pale skin, a prominent nose, and thin, short, light-brown hair. He wears a dark gray coat with a high collar over a white neckcloth. The background behind him is a plain, light gray color. Text is printed in black ink directly onto the gold frame surrounding the oval portrait.

title: John Adams (1735-1826), LL.D. 1788
alt_text: A miniature painting of a man's head and shoulders shown in profile. The man has grey hair tied back and wears a light brown coat over a white collared shirt with a ruffled cravat. His face is turned slightly to the left, showing pinkish skin tones and light-colored eyes. This portrait is set within a gold oval frame with a textured, beaded edge. Below the portrait, black text is printed directly onto the gold background, identifying the subject as "John Adams" and providing his birth and death years.

title: George Hammond (1763–1853)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a man shown from the chest up. The man has pale skin, light blue eyes, and hair that is white and styled off his forehead. He wears a dark blue jacket with bright red lapels and a white cravat at his neck. His body is turned slightly toward the right, while his head is turned further to look off into the distance. This portrait sits inside an oval frame surrounded by gold-colored material printed with black text.

title: William Temple Franklin (1760–1823)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a man shown from the chest up, framed in an oval shape. The man has wavy white hair and is looking toward the left side of the frame. He wears a dark green coat with a high, ruffled white collar around his neck. The background behind him is a dark, solid brown color. Text identifying the man is written in cursive along the gold oval border surrounding the portrait.

title: Nathanael Greene (1742–1786)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a man dressed in a dark blue military uniform with gold lapels and gold shoulder decorations. He has fair skin and short, lightly powdered hair, and he is looking off to the side with a calm expression. The man wears a white scarf or cravat around his neck. The portrait is oval-shaped and set within a gold frame. Words are written in black script around the curved border of the frame. The background behind the man is a soft, light blue color that looks like a cloudy sky.

title: William Hull (1753–1825), B.A. 1772, M.A. 1779
alt_text: A miniature oil on wood portrait shows the head and shoulders of a man facing slightly to his left. He has light, powdered hair tied back and wears a dark, buttoned military-style coat with gold shoulder epaulets and a white collar. The painting is set inside an oval frame, which is itself set against a square, textured golden background. Text is printed around the oval border in a dark font. The surface of the painting shows a fine network of small cracks throughout.

title: Ebenezer Stevens (1751–1823)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a man is set within a gold oval frame. The man faces slightly to his left with a neutral expression and light, wavy hair. He wears a dark military-style coat with bright red lapels, gold shoulder epaulets, and a white ruffled collar. Below the oval frame, black text is painted directly onto the gold backing. This text provides names and dates in several lines of printed lettering. The entire image has a cracked, aged surface texture throughout the paint.

title: Thomas Youngs Seymour (1757–1811), B.A. 1777
alt_text: A miniature painting of a man dressed in a military uniform. The portrait shows the man from the chest up, facing toward the right side of the frame. On his head, he wears a shiny, domed golden helmet topped with a large, wispy white feather and a blue ribbon. The oval portrait is framed by a gold-colored border that contains text written in black letters.

title: John Brooks (1752–1825), M.A. (Hon.) 1781
alt_text: A miniature oil painting shows a man’s head and shoulders inside an oval frame. The man has wavy, light gray hair and is looking off to the left side. A thick, textured, gold-colored border surrounds the portrait, and dark text is printed across the bottom of this frame.

title: Rufus King (1755–1827)
alt_text: A miniature oil painting on wood shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. He has light skin, rosy cheeks, and light-colored hair styled back from his face. title: Fisher Ames (1758–1808)
alt_text: A miniature painting on wood shows a portrait of a man in an oval frame. title: The Infant, Chief of the Seneca Indians

The entire surface of the painting shows a network of fine cracks across the paint.

title: John Langdon (1741–1819)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a man's face and shoulders fills an oval frame. The man has a pale complexion, reddish cheeks, and light hair styled in a ponytail. The painting sits on a square, gold-colored background that has text written in black ink around the oval edge. title: John Brown (1757–1837)

title: Faith Trumbull (later Faith Wadsworth, 1769–1846)

title: Faith Robinson Trumbull (1718–1780)

title: Catherine Wadsworth (later Catherine Terry, 1774–1841)

title: Jonathan Trumbull, Sr. (1710–1785), LL.D. 1779

title: Arthur Lee (1740–1792), LL.D. 1781

title: The Woman Taken in Adultery

On the left side, a bearded man with long brown hair wears a bright pink shirt and a dark green robe draped over his shoulder. He holds his left hand out toward the kneeling woman as if speaking to her. The woman, positioned in the lower right, wears a light yellow dress and rests her hands against her chest with her head bowed down. Several other bearded men stand behind them, watching the interaction with solemn expressions. An archway in the background reveals a glimpse of a cloudy, light-filled sky.

title: St. John and the Lamb
alt_text: A painting showing a young child sitting on the ground with a lamb. The child has wavy brown hair and is draped in a piece of light brown fabric. The child’s arms are wrapped around the fluffy, light-colored animal. They sit against a dark, shadowy background that suggests a rocky or outdoor setting. The entire artwork is enclosed in a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: The Earl of Angus Conferring Knighthood on de Wilton, from Scott's "Marmion"
alt_text: A painting of a group of people inside a dimly lit stone room. A knight in armor kneels in the center of the room with his hands held to his chest, looking toward another man who stands wearing robes and a tall hat. Beside the kneeling man, a woman stands with her hand resting on his shoulder. Another man in armor stands on the left side of the scene holding a sword. In the background, a small crucifix hangs on the wall near a barred window showing the moon.

title: Holy Family (Madonna and Child with Joseph, John the Baptist, Elizabeth, and Zacharias)
alt_text: A painting of a woman and two young children sitting outside with two older men standing behind them. The woman sits in the center wearing a long dress with her hair pulled back. A small, light-haired child stands to her left, resting a hand on her arm. Another child kneels on the ground in front of her, looking up and holding an object. Two men stand in the background, one leaning his chin on his hand and the other wearing a head wrap. A dark, rocky landscape with a single tree fills the background.

title: Infant Savior with John The Baptist Dressing the Lamb with Flowers
alt_text: A painting of two young children shown against a dark, cloudy sky. On the left, a light-skinned child stands upright, looking upward with one hand near their chin. They are wrapped in a white cloth that drapes down their side. To their right, a second child with darker hair sits on the ground, holding a small white animal in their lap. This seated child wears a simple, brownish garment that drapes over one shoulder. The entire scene is framed by a decorative gold-colored border.

title: Lamderg and Gelchossa, from Macpherson's "Ossian," 5th book of "Fingal"
alt_text: A painting of a man in armor standing next to a woman in a yellow dress. The man has brown hair and is looking down with his head near the woman's shoulder. He wears reddish-brown fabric over his armor and holds a thin, metallic sword pointing toward the ground. The woman stands beside him with her head turned slightly away and her left arm raised toward his back. The background is a blurry, cloudy sky with dark and light gray colors. Both figures are barefoot and stand on a dark, rocky ground.

title: Maternal Affection, Tenderness, or Love
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a baby. The woman has her hair pulled up and wears a brownish-pink top with white trim. She holds a small, light-skinned baby on her lap who is nursing. A deep red cloth is draped over her lap underneath the child. The background is a dark, indistinct interior setting with a pillar on the right. The painting is set in a large, ornate, gold-colored frame decorated with carvings.

title: Our Savior and Little Children (or Suffer Little Children)
alt_text: A painting of a central figure with a beard, seated on a rock and holding a small child on his lap. To the left, a woman kneels on the ground with her hands extended toward the child, while several other adults and children stand nearby. On the right, two men with beards stand and look toward the center group, one with his hands folded over his chest. A large, dark stone pillar stands in the upper left corner, and a landscape with rolling hills stretches into the background. The scene is illuminated by light that highlights the figures in the center while casting shadows toward the sides and background.

title: Peter the Great at the Capture of Narva, 1704
alt_text: A painting showing two prominent men surrounded by a crowd. On the right, a man with long, wavy brown hair wears a dark green coat with a light blue sash and a large star-shaped brooch on his chest. He points his right hand toward a table where a sword lies across some papers. To his left, an older man with a grey beard and a large white ruff collar gazes intently at him with both hands pressed against his own chest. Behind them, a dense, shadowy crowd of men and women look on with serious expressions. The scene is set in a dimly lit, large room with stone-like columns visible in the background.

title: Preparation for the Entombment of the Savior (or The Lamentation for the Dead Christ)
alt_text: A painting of several figures gathered around a man lying on the ground. The central figure is a man lying horizontally, his body limp and partially covered by a white cloth draped over his legs. A woman in a red dress sits behind him, leaning over with a somber expression. To the right, another woman in yellow kneels and rests her head against the man's arm. Standing on the left, a woman in a white dress looks down at the group with a sad, quiet posture. Two other men stand in the dim background on the right side. The scene is enclosed in an ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Madonna and Child with St. John the Baptist
alt_text: A painting of a woman with two young children. The woman sits in the center wearing a red dress and a blue cloak, with a dark veil covering her head. A light-skinned young child stands to her left, looking up at her face with hands resting on her lap. Another child kneels on the ground to her right, holding a thin wooden stick with a cross on top. Behind them, a dark, cloudy sky hangs over a landscape with trees and a small building in the distance. To the right of the woman, a white stone pillar decorated with pink flowers stands near some large green leaves.

title: Christ under the Cross (or Our Savior Bearing the Cross and Sinking under Its Weight)
alt_text: A painting of a crowded scene featuring several people in robes and armor surrounding a central, fallen figure. In the foreground, a woman in a rusty-orange dress kneels and touches the head of a man who is collapsed on the ground. Several other figures stand around them, including a man in yellow fabric carrying a heavy, rectangular object on his shoulder. In the background, soldiers on horseback wear golden helmets, and one holds a long pole with a flowing red flag. The entire scene is enclosed in an ornate, heavy gold-colored frame with intricate carvings.

title: The Death of Paulus Aemilius at the Battle of Cannae
alt_text: A painting of a chaotic battle scene featuring many soldiers in ancient-style armor. In the center, a man sits on a rock while looking toward a soldier standing next to a dark horse. To the left, several figures are engaged in combat or lying on the ground, with one soldier holding a pole topped by an eagle emblem high in the air. The background is filled with a hazy, swirling smoke that obscures distant figures and the sky. On the right side, other soldiers stand near a tree, while more figures are scattered across the uneven ground.

title: Colonel John Trumbull (1756-1843)
alt_text: A painting shows the head and shoulders of an older man. He has thinning, light-colored hair styled softly around his head. His face is pale and his expression is calm as he looks toward the right side of the image. The man wears a dark, heavy coat with a wide collar over a high, white collared shirt or scarf. A simple, dark, and blurry background frames him, focusing all attention on his face.

title: William C. Leffingwell (1765-1834), B.A. 1786, M.A. 1789
alt_text: A painting of a man's head and shoulders shown from the chest up. The man has short, dark brown hair and faces slightly to the right with a neutral expression. He wears a dark, heavy coat with a high collar over a white shirt with a folded cravat at his neck. The background behind him is a soft, warm mix of reddish and brownish tones. The entire artwork is enclosed in a thick, light-colored wooden frame with a carved design.

title: Sally Beers Leffingwell (1765–1830)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up against a dark red background. She has brown hair pulled back with a light-colored headband or ornament on top. A ruffled white collar sits high around her neck. She wears a dark shawl or wrap with a faint floral pattern draped over her shoulders. The entire painting is enclosed in an ornate gold-colored frame.

title: The Honorable James Gould (1770–1838), B.A. 1791, M.A. 1794, LL.D 1819
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up. The man has short, gray hair and is looking directly toward the viewer with a calm expression. He wears a dark black coat with a wide, reddish-orange collar. Underneath the coat, he has a white shirt with a ruffled front. The background is a simple, dark brown tone that fades into shadow. The entire image is enclosed in an ornate, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: Mahl stick belonging to John Trumbull
alt_text: A wooden tool shows a long, thin, and straight pole. This object is reddish-brown in color and spans almost the entire height of the image. The wood has a smooth, polished appearance with a few subtle darker bands along its length. At the very top, there is a small, pale, capped tip. The entire rod sits against a plain, light grey background.

title: Lowell Mason (1792-1872)
alt_text: A marble bust shows the head and upper chest of a man. The figure has short, wavy hair swept back from a serious, older face. A thick piece of cloth is draped loosely over the shoulders like a toga. The sculpture sits on a circular pedestal base. The entire object is smooth, white stone set against a neutral, grey background.

title: William Augustus Larned (1806-1862) B.A. 1826, M.A. 1829 Divinity School 1834
alt_text: A marble bust of a man shown from the chest up. The man has short, wavy hair swept to one side and mutton-chop sideburns that frame his face. His expression is neutral with his eyes looking forward. A simple piece of fabric is draped loosely over his shoulders and chest like a shawl. The figure rests on a small, round pedestal that sits atop a rectangular base.

title: Giuseppe Ceracchi (1751–1802)
alt_text: A miniature painting on wood of a man's portrait set within an oval frame. The man has grey, wavy hair that reaches past his ears. He wears a grey jacket over a white ruffled shirt. The background of the portrait is a light blue color. Surrounding the oval portrait are gold-colored borders and black printed text that curves along the frame.

title: Tristram Dalton (1738–1817)
alt_text: A miniature painting on wood shows a portrait of an older man. He is set within a gold, oval frame that is decorated with a beaded pattern along the inner edge. The man has short, white hair and fair skin with rosy cheeks. He wears a dark red coat with a white cravat at his neck. Dark, black text is written in an arc around the top of the oval frame. The painting’s surface has a visible network of tiny cracks throughout the image.

title: The Young Sachem, A Chief of the Six Nations
alt_text: A miniature of a person with long, straight brown hair and a tan complexion. The individual faces forward with a calm expression against a pale gray background. They wear a white cloth draped over their shoulders. The painting is set inside an oval frame with beaded edges. Words at the bottom read "The Young Sachem," "A Chief of the Six Nations," and the years "1792" and "1832-42."

title: Theodore Sedgwick (1746–1813), B. A. 1765, M.A. (Hon.) 1772
alt_text: A miniature oil painting shows a portrait of a man in his later years. The man has shoulder-length white hair and looks toward the right side of the frame. He wears a dark, greenish-blue collared coat over a white shirt with a folded white neckcloth. A fine network of age cracks covers the surface of the image. The painting is set inside a small, oval-shaped decorative frame with a raised, bumpy gold border.

title: Oliver Ellsworth (1745–1807), LL.D. 1790
alt_text: A miniature oil painting on wood shows the portrait of a man from the chest up. He has short, white, swept-back hair and is looking slightly toward his left. The man wears a dark coat with a high collar and a white ruffled cravat at his neck. His expression is serious, with thin lips and pale blue eyes. The oval portrait is set inside a gold, textured frame. Text written in black ink curves around the frame, noting a name, dates, and a title.

title: Otho Holland Williams (1749–1794) (after John Trumbull)
alt_text: A miniature oil on wood painting shows a man’s head and shoulders framed in an oval shape. He has light, wavy hair and is looking slightly up and to the left. He wears a dark blue military-style coat with red lapels, gold buttons, and gold fringe epaulets on his shoulders. Underneath, a white ruffled cravat is visible at his neck. The oval frame is a light gold color and is surrounded by text written in a circle.

title: Thomas Pinckney (1750–1828)
alt_text: A miniature oil painting of a man shown from the chest up. The man has light skin, blue eyes, and light brown, wavy hair. The portrait is framed within an oval border decorated with a repeating beaded pattern, and the background behind his head is a soft, light blue sky with wispy white clouds.

title: John Rutledge (1739–1800)

title: Charles Cotesworth Pinckney (1746–1825)

title: William Moultrie (1730–1805)
alt_text: A miniature painting on wood shows a portrait of an older man with pale skin and white hair. title: Rufus Putnam (1738–1824)

title: Jacob Read (1752/53–1816)

title: Ralph Izard (1741/42–1804)

title: John Faucheraud Grimké (1752–1819)

title: Eleanor (Nelly) Parke Custis (later Eleanor Parke Custis Lewis, 1779–1852)

title: Cornelia Schuyler (later Cornelia Morton, 1776–1808)

title: Martha Washington (née Martha Dandridge, formerly Martha Parke Custis, 1731–1802)

title: Sophia Chew (later Sophia Chew Philips, 1769–1841)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a woman with curly, light reddish-brown hair. She wears a tall white head covering and a loose white shawl over her shoulders. title: Harriet Chew (later Harriet Chew Carroll, 1775–1861)

title: William Smallwood (1732–1792)

title: Daniel Morgan (ca. 1736–1802)

title: Egbert Benson (1746–1833)

title: Philip John Schuyler (1733–1804)

title: Judge George Gould (1807-1868), B. A. 1827

title: Simeon Baldwin Chittenden (1814 - 1899), M.A. (Hon.) 1871

title: Four Tiles
alt_text: An architectural tile arrangement of four square, glazed ceramic tiles placed in a larger square grid. Some sections of the tiles appear worn, chipped, or faded, especially along the edges and in the lower-left corner. A small, light-colored rectangular label with black numbers sits at the very bottom edge of the grouping.

title: Death of General Wolfe (after Benjamin West)

Many of the men wear military-style coats and breeches, while the seated man is mostly unclothed. The scene is depicted in grayscale, focusing on the dramatic positions and expressions of the figures.

title: Reverend Samuel Seabury (1729-1796), B.A. 1748, M.A. 1761, (Copy after Thomas Spence Duche)

title: December Sunshine (Peasant Knitting)

title: John Davis (1787-1854), B.A. 1812, M.A. 1822

title: Gutenberg Inventing Movable Types

The background behind them is a soft, muted green wash of color. The artwork is enclosed in a large, ornate, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: The Rape of Europa

A small, winged cherub flies in the dark sky above, while another small cherub sits on the ground near the bull. To the right, a dark, large bird is perched in a tree, and a brown cow stands behind the group. The scene is set in an outdoor landscape with trees and a cloudy sky.

title: Henry Parks Wright (1839-1918), B. A. 1868, M. A. 1871, Ph.D. 1876

title: Reverend Jonathan Edwards (1703–1758), B.A. 1720, M.A. 1723 (after an unknown artist)

He holds a quill pen in his right hand as if he is about to write. A banner with writing on it hangs across the top of the dark scene.

title: Stanley Trott Woodward (1833-1906), B. A. 1855
alt_text: A painting of an older man in profile facing to the left. He has light hair, a thick mustache, and wears glasses with thin gold frames. title: William Petit Trowbridge (1828-1892), M. A. (Hon.) 1870

title: Maternité
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture of a seated woman holding two young children. The woman is wearing a simple dress with short sleeves and a head covering. A beige paper tag with a barcode hangs from the woman's arm on the right side of the sculpture.

title: Louis Valentine Pirsson (1860-1919), Ph.B. 1882, M.A. (Hon.) 1902

title: Alvin Chase Bradley (1810-1881), B.A. 1831

title: Noah Porter (1811-1892), B.A. 1831, M.A. 1834

title: Jacob Sutherland (1788-1845), B.A. 1807

title: Charles Lee Frank

title: A Sycamore Tree, Plaaterkill Clove (The Sycamore, Kaaterskill Clove)

title: Old Brick Row
alt_text: A painting of a series of large, multi-story buildings sitting in a flat, open area. A white fence stretches horizontally across the foreground, separating the viewer from a grassy field. Several large, leafy trees stand scattered across the property, with two particularly prominent ones on the left and right sides. The buildings are rectangular with many windows and chimneys on their roofs. A dirt road or pathway runs along the bottom of the scene, in front of the fence.

title: Arthur Twining Hadley (1856-1930), B.A. 1876, M.A. (Hon.) 1887, LL.D. 1899
alt_text: A painting of a man standing and wearing long, dark academic robes. He has a gold chain resting over his shoulders with a large, shield-like pendant centered on his chest. His right hand rests on a wooden table, while his left hand is tucked into his pocket. Behind him, a dark blue flag with gold symbols hangs vertically. The man has short, light hair and looks directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. The entire portrait is set within a thick, carved, gold-colored frame.

title: Winter Twilight, North Shore
alt_text: A painting of a rugged, snowy coastline framed by dark, gnarled trees. The ground in the foreground is covered in white, suggesting snow or ice on rocky terrain. Two distinct trees stand in the foreground, with their dark, twisted branches reaching across the top of the scene. In the distance, a dark, calm body of water meets a rocky shoreline. The contrast between the light ground and the dark trees creates a moody and wintery atmosphere.

title: John Hancock DeForest (1776-1839)
alt_text: A painting of a man in a dark jacket and vest. He faces slightly toward the right while looking directly at the viewer. He has short dark hair and a serious expression on his face. Underneath his jacket, he wears a white shirt with a dark cravat tied around his neck. A small, shiny object hangs from the front of his vest near the bottom. The background is dark and plain, making him stand out clearly.

title: East Rock
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a large, flat-topped hill centered in the distance. The artwork is held inside a simple, oval gold frame. Beneath the brown, rocky cliff of the hill sits a flat green meadow with a few small white buildings. A dark blue river curves along the bottom right side of the image. The sky above the hill features a mix of soft blue areas and large, billowy white clouds.

title: The Wood Cart
alt_text: A painting of two oxen pulling a wooden cart through a forest. The scene is filled with warm, autumnal colors like yellow, orange, and brown. The pair of oxen stand to the left, facing forward with curved horns. A person stands behind the cart on the right side, leaning over as if doing some work. Behind them, thin trees stretch upwards and create a dense, hazy background.

title: Chester Smith Lyman (1922)
alt_text: A white marble sculpture of a man's head and shoulders shows him facing forward. The man has thick hair that is swept back from his forehead and large, prominent sideburns on his cheeks. His eyes are carved without pupils, giving them a smooth and blank appearance. He wears a collared jacket that sits over his chest and shoulders. The entire sculpture is uniform in color and texture, resting against a plain, light grey background.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LL.D. 1781
alt_text: A painting shows an older man with light skin, looking directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. He has short, white, styled hair that puffs out slightly at the sides. He wears a dark black coat over a white shirt with a high, stiff collar. A light-colored, lacy cravat or necktie is tucked into the opening of his jacket. The background is a solid, dark, brownish-grey color that fades into shadow around his shoulders.

title: William Whitman Farnam (1844-1929), B.A. 1866, M.A. 1869
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a dark suit against a dark background. He has a pale, round face with a short, white beard and mustache. His eyes look forward toward the viewer. The man's suit jacket and tie are dark, blending into the shadows that surround him. He is enclosed within a decorative, rectangular gold frame.

title: Yosemite Valley, Glacier Point Trail
alt_text: A painting of a vast, golden-lit mountain valley viewed from high on a cliff. On the left, a steep, rocky path winds through pine trees where two small figures on horseback have paused. A wide, flat valley floor stretches into the distance, with a narrow, shimmering river snaking through the center. On the right, a massive, sheer cliff wall rises sharply, fading into a warm, hazy glow. The sun hangs high in the pale sky, casting a bright, yellow light over the entire landscape.

title: The Crucifixion, One of Three Panels from a Tabernacle Wing
alt_text: A painting on panel showing a central male figure on a blue cross. The figure has long dark hair, a beard, and wears a pink cloth around his waist. To the left of the cross stands a woman wearing a blue robe and a red head covering. To the right stands a person wearing a pink cloak and a blue robe, with their hand resting against their face. The background is painted with gold and includes decorative arches at the bottom and two tall structures at the sides.

title: The Crucifixion with the Penitent Magdalen
alt_text: A painting of a crucifixion scene set against a flat, gold background. A central figure is pinned to a dark blue cross, with a smaller figure kneeling at the base of the cross draped in red robes. On the left, a group of three standing women in blue, red, and purple cloaks look on with expressions of grief. To the right of the cross, a young person in blue and pink robes stands facing the center, while several men in armor and tunics gesture nearby. The entire painting is shaped like a triangle, with a distinct red border tracing the edges.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned between Saints Leonard and Peter and Scenes from the Life of Saint Peter
alt_text: A painting of a central woman seated on a throne, holding a small child on her lap. Two standing figures flank the woman on either side, each dressed in long, colorful robes and holding a scroll or a book. Above the woman, two small winged figures hover against a gold background. Smaller, rectangular panels containing other figures and scenes frame the central group on both the left and right sides. The entire painting uses flat colors and gold paint, with clear black outlines defining the shapes.

title: Triptych: Virgin and Child with Saints Dominic and Francis; Crucifixion with Penitent Magadalen; Saints Michael  the Archangel, Peter Martyr and Catherine of Alexandria
alt_text: A painting of a triptych on wood panels with a gold background shows multiple figures in religious scenes. The central panel features a large woman in a dark blue cloak holding a small child in a red tunic, flanked by two smaller figures. On the left wing, a man is depicted on a cross with three other figures standing nearby. The right wing shows a standing figure in robes above a coiled creature, with two more figures standing below in an arched hallway. All figures are painted in a flat, stylized manner, and the entire piece is bordered by a reddish-orange frame.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints James, John the Baptist, Peter, and Francis
alt_text: A painting on panel shows five figures arranged in a line, with a woman holding a young child in the center. She wears a dark blue robe and has a gold halo, while the child sits in her lap wearing a bright red tunic. The central section behind them features a red-and-gold diamond pattern, contrasting with the plain, light-colored background behind the four men standing at the sides. Two men stand on the left, and two men stand on the right, all wearing draped, colored robes and gazing forward. Small, rectangular labels with painted text sit above each person's head near the top edge of the panel. The painting is rectangular with a small, pointed arch shape rising from the center of the top edge.

title: Vision of Saint Dominic
alt_text: A painting of a figure kneeling before two figures appearing in the sky. The kneeling person is on the left and wears a long, dark robe. Two figures float on the upper right side, reaching down towards the person below. These floating figures are dressed in colorful robes and have golden circular halos around their heads. The background is a textured, golden-red color, while the ground at the bottom is a flat, muted grey.

title: The Crucifixion with the Penitent Magdalen and Saints
alt_text: A painting of a crucifixion scene on a tall, pointed wooden panel has a gilded frame that is worn and chipped. In the center of the dark red background, a man hangs from a black wooden cross. A large crack runs vertically down the entire center of the panel, cutting through the cross and the figure. Below the cross, a group of people in colorful, flowing robes stand clustered together, with one figure kneeling at the bottom. The background is mostly a faded, textured red with a thin layer of gold leaf visible in spots.

title: The Entombment of Christ
alt_text: A painting of three figures supporting a reclining man, set against a gold background. In the center, a woman in a dark brown hooded robe embraces a shirtless man who is lying back in a rectangular tomb. A second figure wearing a light green tunic sits on the right, resting a hand on the man's arm. Two small winged figures appear in the upper corners, hovering on either side of a central vertical mark on the gold wall. The main figures have somber expressions and pale, detailed skin tones. The scene is framed by a background covered in thin cracks, suggesting an aged surface.

title: Portable Triptych with Scenes from the Lives of Christ and Saint John the Baptist
medium: Tempera, silver and gold on panel
alt_text: A painting on a panel shows a triptych, which is a three-part hinged artwork arranged in small square scenes. The central section has a tall, peaked top and holds two rows of four rectangular images, all framed by bright red painted borders. The two side panels are shorter and rectangular, each containing four small, stacked scenes that show people interacting in various settings. These many small pictures feature figures dressed in robes against backgrounds detailed with gold and silver, giving the whole piece a textured appearance. The overall color palette relies on deep reds, blues, and gold accents to highlight the intricate storytelling within each framed square.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Six Angels and The Crucifixion
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on panel shows a woman holding a small child on her lap while sitting on a throne. Both the woman and the child have golden halos behind their heads, and their faces are painted in soft, pale tones. They are surrounded by six standing figures, with three on each side, who all have golden halos and their hands folded in front of their chests. The background behind the throne is a patterned red fabric, and a curved, golden canopy arches over the top of the group. The entire scene is framed by a worn, rectangular border of aged wood.

title: The Penance of Saint Jerome with the Stigmatization of Saint Francis
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows two different scenes set in a rugged landscape. In the lower-left corner, an older man with a white beard kneels in a dark rocky cave with a lion lying behind him. To the right, a monk kneels on a grassy cliff looking up toward a small, red, winged figure flying in the sky. Between the man in the cave and the monk, a small cross with a figure on it stands on the ground. Near the bottom center, a rectangular inset shows another small figure standing within a frame. Two tiny figures in the top sky round out the composition against a background of hills and water.

title: The Adoration of the Christ Child with the Stigmatization of Saint Francis, Tobias and the Archangel, Saint John the Baptist Entering the Wilderness, and the Penance of Saint Jerome
medium: Tempera, tempera grassa, and gold on panel
alt_text: A painting of a woman with long hair kneeling and praying before a baby on the ground. The woman wears a large blue cloak over a pink dress and has a golden halo behind her head. The baby lies on the grass in the bottom left corner, also wearing a golden halo. In the background, rocky hills and trees stretch out under a pale blue sky. Several other small figures are scattered across the landscape, including one man kneeling near a cave on the right.

title: Virgin and Child with Angels
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small child on her lap. The woman has long, light brown hair, a soft face, and wears a dark blue robe over a pale peach-colored dress. She holds a thin, dark branch in her right hand. Beside and below them, four small figures with wings emerge from a background of horizontal clouds. A soft, golden light circles the heads of the woman and the winged figures.

title: Saint Sebastian
alt_text: A painting shows a shirtless man standing in front of a dark pillar against a light blue sky. He has pale green skin, brown hair, and wears a pinkish cloth wrapped around his waist. Several arrows are stuck into his torso, sides, and arm. Above his shoulder, a small figure with wings floats in the sky and holds a long, thin object. In the background below, a city with pointed towers and red-roofed buildings sits among rolling green hills.

title: Actaeon and the Hounds
alt_text: A painting showing several figures with deer heads walking through a green landscape. Three of the figures wear dark tunics, purple capes, and hold spears while standing among dogs. In the center, a person in a colorful outfit rides a brown horse near a large tree. The background features rolling green hills, a small pond, and a distant city under a pale sky. The rectangular panel has visible wear and chips along its top edge.

title: The Charity of Saint Martin
alt_text: A painting showing a person on horseback sharing a red cloth with a scantily clad man. The rider wears a metallic hat, armor with ornate patterns, and a golden halo behind their head. The horse is brown and stands on a paved stone ground. To the left, a man with a beard stands with only a white cloth wrapped around his waist. Behind them, a reddish stone wall with arched designs stretches into the background.

title: The Assumption of the Virgin
alt_text: A painting of a central female figure rising inside a blue, almond-shaped halo, surrounded by several smaller figures with wings. The central woman wears an elaborate, textured gold robe and holds her hands together in prayer. Below her, two large, winged figures with orange wings face upward toward her, hovering above a rectangular, box-like stone object at the bottom. A smaller male figure is depicted at the very top, set within a pointed, golden architectural frame that includes several thin, tall spires. The background behind the figures is bright, shining gold, and small faces are painted within circular openings high in the frame.

title: Saint Peter
alt_text: A painting on a panel shows a bearded man standing against a gold background. He wears a blue tunic under a long, flowing yellow robe that has a red lining. In his right hand, he holds a large dark key, and in his left hand, he holds a closed black book. The figure stands on an ornate, patterned floor that is orange and red. The top of the painting is shaped into a pointed arch, with a thin wooden frame bordering the entire image.

title: The Creation of Adam and Eve
alt_text: A painting of four figures in a wide, outdoor landscape. On the left, a man with long hair sits on the ground looking up at a standing, bearded man in long robes. Toward the center stands another cloaked figure who looks toward the right side of the frame. Two nude figures are on the right side, one kneeling with hands together and another lying on the ground. The background shows rolling hills, a body of water, and a few tall trees under a muted, golden sky.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a baby in front of a landscape. The woman has long, reddish hair, pale skin, and is wearing a dark red dress under a blue cloak. She looks forward with a calm expression while holding the naked child in her arms. The baby is looking upward, holding a small object in his hands, and is wrapped in a light-colored cloth. In the background, there are green hills, water, and tall stone buildings on either side.

title: The Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting of a man with long dark hair nailed to a wooden cross in the center of the scene. To his left, a woman draped in a teal cloak stands with her hands clasped. To his right, a person with wavy hair and a pink-and-black robe looks upward with hands together in prayer. In the background, a light blue sky stretches above a distant landscape of low mountains and buildings. The figures stand on a patch of brown, uneven earth.

title: Portrait of a Lady
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown in profile against a dark, worn background. She has wavy, light brown hair that falls past her shoulders and is covered by a simple white head cloth. Her face is turned to the right with a serious expression and visible texture on her skin. She wears a golden-orange garment over her shoulders with hints of a dark green drape behind her. The surface of the painting appears weathered with patches of worn paint and rough edges.

title: Penance of Saint Jerome
alt_text: A painting of an older man with a long gray beard kneeling in a rocky landscape while looking upward. He holds a smooth, pale stone against his bare chest, and his lower body is wrapped in a large, loose, grayish-blue cloth. Behind him to the left, a large brown lion crouches near an open book on the ground. In the background, two small figures stand near a light-colored building, and a tiny cross is visible in the distance at the top of a thin, dead tree. The background features tall, dark rock formations that frame the scene.

title: Christ on the Cross
alt_text: A painting of a figure on a wooden cross, with a person kneeling at its base. The figure on the cross is pale, wearing only a blue cloth around their waist, and has arms outstretched against the wooden beam. A woman with long hair kneels to the left, wearing a blue robe and a bright red cloak, and she looks up toward the cross. Behind them, a landscape shows rolling green hills, trees, and a small town with several buildings in the distance. The overall image has muted colors, with some areas showing signs of age or wear.

title: The Baptism of Christ
alt_text: A painting of four figures in an outdoor setting. On the left side, two women with long hair kneel in the grass, both wearing colorful robes. On the right side, a standing figure with long, light-colored hair and a red cloak pours water onto the head of another standing figure who appears unclothed. The background shows a pale blue sky over rolling hills and distant trees. The surface of the painting is worn and shows cracks across the middle.

title: The Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows a figure hanging with arms stretched wide on a horizontal wooden beam. The figure has pale green skin and wears a draped cloth around the waist. Behind the head is a rounded red halo shape. Above the figure's head, small letters are painted on a light-colored rectangular background. The painting's surface appears aged with cracks and areas of faded, worn paint across the light brown background.

title: Saint Anthony Abbot Tempted by the Devil in the Guise of a Woman
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows an elderly man with a long beard and a black robe walking on a dirt path near a bright red building. A golden halo circles his head, and he carries a tall wooden staff in his right hand. To his right, an angelic figure with pale skin and light-colored wings stands in a long, pink dress. The background features rolling brown hills, scattered small trees, and a pale, cloudy sky. A narrow, winding path connects the figures and disappears into the hilly landscape behind them.

title: Saint Anthony Abbot Tormented by Demons
alt_text: A painting showing an older man with a long white beard lying on the ground. Two winged creatures with horns and long tails stand over him, each raising a long, thin stick as if to strike. Another dark, winged creature with horns flies in the upper right, holding a long green snake that hangs down toward the ground. In the background, a path leads uphill past a group of trees toward a simple white building with a bell tower. The scene is set on a light-colored, dusty landscape against a clear blue sky.

title: Saint Clare Blessing the Bread before Pope Innocent IV
alt_text: A painting of a kneeling figure and several standing people inside a room. On the left, a person wearing a dark habit and a golden halo kneels on the floor with their hands raised. A central figure wearing a tall, decorated crown and red robes stands in the middle, gesturing with their hands. Two other people stand to the right, wearing long blue and red robes with wide, flat hats. Between the kneeling and standing figures sits a table covered by a white cloth that holds several small, round objects. Fine cracks cover the entire surface of the paint, giving it an aged appearance.

title: The Coronation of the Virgin with Eighteen Saints and Fourteen Angels
alt_text: A painting of a woman in white and a man in blue sitting together on a large, ornate throne. The man, who has long hair and a beard, is placing a crown on the woman’s head. Many other figures with golden halos, including angels with wings, are crowded around them. Above the pair, a white bird flies in the center of a blue sky. At the bottom of the scene, two kneeling figures in dark robes flank a vase of flowers on a patterned floor.

title: The Adoration of the Magi with Kneeling Confraternity Members
alt_text: A painting on a long, narrow wooden panel shows a busy outdoor scene filled with many people and animals traveling across hills. On the left and right sides, small groups of figures dressed in colorful robes walk and ride horses along rolling, brownish-green hills dotted with tiny trees. In the center, a woman in blue and a man in a pink cloak stand near a large, cave-like opening in the hillside. A few small buildings or towers are painted in the distant background near the top edge of the scene. The bottom of the wooden panel is rough and worn, while the painted scene stretches horizontally across the center.

title: The Martyrdom of Saint Donatus
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting showing a kneeling figure about to be struck by a man with a raised sword. To the left, a group of soldiers with red shields decorated with scorpion designs stand in a line. The man standing on the right holds a tall spear and carries an identical red shield with a scorpion on it. The kneeling figure wears a pink robe, white clothing underneath, and a tall, pointed head covering with a golden halo around it. They are positioned on a grey landscape under a blue sky, while small birds fly in the background.

title: The Annunciation
alt_text: A painting of a winged figure kneeling before a seated woman on a checkered floor. The figure on the left has blond, curly hair and wears a white robe over a blue shirt, with large wings extending behind them. Across from them, a woman in a dark, flowing robe sits on an ornate chair. Between the two figures, a small, dark red vase holding a green plant sits on the black-and-white tiled floor. In the background, a low stone wall features carved figures, and a bed with red covers sits on the right side. Above, a small, glowing figure floats among blue clouds in the upper center of the rounded frame.

title: Virgin and Child with Two Angels
alt_text: A painting of a woman and several other figures set inside a wooden frame with an arched top. On the left, a tall woman with light hair wears a dark blue cloak over a gold and purple dress. A young, light-skinned child sits on a low, pink-and-white stone bench to the right and reaches a hand toward the woman. Behind the child, two other figures stand near tall white lilies and pink flowers against a blue background. Near the top center, a small white bird with light rays around it is painted inside an oval shape against the sky.

title: Desco da Parto with Love Bound by Maidens
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on a circular wood panel shows a blindfolded, winged figure standing in the center. He is surrounded by several women in long, flowing dresses of pink, yellow, and white, who appear to be helping or restraining him. To the right, a person on a grey horse rides along a curved path in the background landscape. A person wearing a dark red robe kneels near the bottom right, looking down toward the ground. Above the group, a few small, dark birds fly across a pale blue sky.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned
medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on panel
alt_text: A painting shows a woman and a young child surrounded by gold and floral details. The woman has a pale face and wears a blue cloak over her shoulders, with a bright gold halo framing her head. In her arms, she holds a young child who is also wearing a gold halo and looking toward the viewer. The background features dark green foliage on both sides, including blooming roses on the left and fruits on the right. An arched structure made of gray stone frames the entire scene, adding depth to the composition.

title: The Realms of Love
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting showing many people in medieval clothing gathered in a grassy outdoor scene. On the left side, figures stand near a large, pink and white tent, with a small dog walking on the grass below. In the center, a brick archway separates a group of people walking toward the right side. On the right, figures stand near a raised stone fountain that is topped with a gold sphere. Above the landscape, small winged figures appear in the sky, and a red carriage pulled by a white deer moves across the upper right. The scene is set against a dark blue sky with brown, rolling hills in the background.

title: Penitent Saint Jerome
alt_text: A tempera painting shows a bearded man kneeling on the ground in front of a thin wooden cross. He holds a small, round object in one hand while his other hand rests on his chest. To his right, a large lion crouches on the ground near the opening of a dark, rocky cave. A bright red hat lies on the ground near the man's knees. Behind the scene, a blue landscape with hills and trees stretches into the distance under a pale sky.

title: The Adoration of the Magi
alt_text: A painting of a group of people gathered around a seated woman and a baby. The woman wears a bright pink top and a blue skirt, holding the small baby on her lap.
