Several men dressed in elaborate, colorful, and gold-patterned robes stand around them, with some holding gold cups. One man with a long white beard kneels on the ground in front of the mother and child. To the right, a large wooden shelter houses an ox and another animal that looks out toward the group. In the background, a hilly landscape includes a few trees and a small procession of figures walking in the distance.

title: The Lamentation over the Dead Christ
alt_text: A painting showing a group of people clustered around a seated, slumped figure against a background of gold. In the center, a woman in a white and blue head covering holds the man, whose skin is tinged with green and who is only partially clothed in a white wrap. A woman in a red dress sits on the ground in the lower right corner, holding the man's hand. Behind them, two other figures with somber expressions stand close, while a ladder leans against a dark structure in the top left. Every figure has a flat, gold halo around their head, and the entire scene is enclosed in an arched, pointed frame.

title: The Nativity
medium: Tempera and gold on panel, transferred to canvas
alt_text: A painting of a religious scene shows three people outdoors under a bright blue sky. A woman with long hair wears a red dress and kneels with her hands together near an infant who lies on the ground. A bearded man in a yellow robe kneels beside the baby with his hands raised. In the upper part of the sky, a figure with a white beard appears within a cloud. To the left, a small rustic shelter stands near rocky, uneven terrain. The scene is enclosed in a rounded, ornate gold frame.

title: Pietà
alt_text: A painting showing a scene with four figures on a landscape. In the center, a person lies stretched out horizontally, supported by an older bearded man on the left and a person wearing a head covering in the middle. A woman with long hair sits on the right, kneeling and holding the feet of the person lying down. Behind them stands a tall, plain pillar, while the background reveals rolling hills, trees, and small buildings under a light blue sky. The figures wear long, draped robes in muted shades of pink, blue, and brown.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a small child. The woman is on the left with her head tilted slightly toward the child on the right. She has reddish hair and wears a dark head covering. The child faces forward with a serious expression and curly hair. Their bodies overlap in the center, and the background is a faded, textured tan color with patches of red and yellow. The surface of the painting looks worn and cracked throughout.

title: Archangels Gabriel, Michael, and Raphael with Tobias and a Female Donor
alt_text: A painting of three winged figures and a small child standing behind a person kneeling on the left. The figure on the far left wears long, layered robes in shades of green and white, with coral-colored wings and a thin halo. In the center stands a figure wearing golden armor over a dark green skirt with red leggings, holding a sword and a golden sphere. To the right, another figure in a long yellow dress holds the hand of a small child dressed in a light blue tunic. The child looks up toward the figure in yellow, who also has a halo and large, dark wings. All the figures stand on a stone platform against a plain gray wall.

title: Saint John the Baptist
alt_text: A painting of a man standing inside a decorative, pointed gold frame. The man has long, dark brown hair and a beard, and he is wearing a dark, furry tunic beneath a long pink robe with a bright blue lining. He holds a tall, thin gold cross with his left hand while gesturing toward it with his right hand. He is barefoot, standing on a ground patterned with small, stylized floral shapes. The background behind him is a solid, shimmering field of gold.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned between Saints Nicholas, Margaret of Antioch(?), Dorothy, and John the Baptist; The Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting of an ornate altarpiece with a gilded frame contains two scenes stacked vertically. The upper, smaller scene shows a cross with a central figure flanked by two mourning figures sitting on the ground. The larger, lower scene features a central female figure in a blue robe seated on a throne and holding a small child. She is surrounded by four standing figures wearing colorful robes and halos around their heads. The entire work is framed by detailed, carved gold wood that arches at the top.

title: The Nativity and Resurrection of Christ
alt_text: A painting on a triangular panel shows a scene set against a gold background within an ornate, gilded wooden frame. On the left, two figures in robes sit on the ground, with one cradling a small swaddled figure near a dark structure. To the right of them, a figure in brown clothing kneels, while a figure in blue robes floats in the air above a rocky, dark hill. Further to the right, a group of several people in colorful, detailed garments sits on the ground near a large stone tomb. The entire triangular scene is framed by elaborate, carved gold leaves that follow the sharp peak of the panel. A long, rectangular base supports the triangle, featuring a simple natural wood finish on the left and a painted blue surface on the right.

title: Holy Trinity with the Virgin and Saints Mary Magdalen, John the Baptist, and John the Evangelist
alt_text: A painting shows a large, central figure holding a cross with a smaller figure on it. The main figure wears a dark blue robe and is set against a red and gold background inside a tall, arched frame. Four smaller figures sit or kneel at the bottom, arranged around the central scene. Each person has a gold circle or halo around their head. A thin black banner with gold writing crosses the very bottom of the piece, above a small metal label.

title: Christ and the Virgin Enthroned with Angels; Allegories of the New (Ecclesia) and Old (Synagoga) Dispensation
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a man and a woman sitting together against a background of bright gold and red patterns. The man on the left has long hair, a beard, and a crown, and he holds a book in his hands. The woman on the right wears a blue cloak over her head and has her hands crossed on her chest. Above them, small heads in red and blue colors float in a semi-circle. Below the main figures, a group of smaller, pale figures stand and hold instruments on the bottom edge of the panel. The entire work is framed in an arch shape with decorative gold edges.

title: Saints Julian, James Major, and Michael
alt_text: A painting showing three figures standing in a row against a solid gold background. The person on the left is a man with long reddish hair wearing a red tunic and a blue cloak, holding a long sword pointed downward. The central figure is a man with shoulder-length brown hair draped in a loose pink robe, holding a dark, decorated book in one hand and a tall wooden staff in the other. To the right stands a winged figure with blond hair wearing a yellow dress and a blue cloak, holding a gold orb topped with a cross. All three figures have golden circular halos outlined above their heads.

title: The Annunciation
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a winged figure standing on the left and a woman sitting on a throne on the right, both set against a gold background. The figure on the left wears a yellow and white robe with colorful wings, and he points upward while holding a tall green stem with white flowers. The woman sits on a patterned red and white chair, wearing a pink dress under a large blue cloak, with her hands crossed over her chest. Between them sits an open book on a small stand, while a smaller, flying figure appears in the pointed top of the frame. The entire scene is decorated with gold paint and has a weathered, cracked texture across the surface.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned between Saints Albert of Trapani and Peter and Saints Paul and Anthony Abbot; The Annunciation
alt_text: A painting of figures on a gold background, organized into a frame with three arched panels. The center panel features a woman in a blue robe holding a small child, with two small figures playing musical instruments at her feet. On each side of the center, two standing figures in colorful robes hold various objects like books and staffs. Above each of these side panels, a small circle contains the face or upper body of a person. A final, smaller circle with a person is centered at the very top of the frame. The entire structure is outlined in decorative, carved gold trim.

title: Two Scenes from the Legend of Saint Michael
alt_text: A painting on panel showing two distinct scenes divided by a red column. The left side depicts a group of horsemen traveling near a person in robes standing with a child by a doorway. The right side features a chaotic battle scene with figures in armor and helmets holding shields with red crosses. These figures are fighting against dark, monstrous shapes on a brown, textured background. Gold paint is used throughout the composition, particularly in the background of the right panel and the halo on the figure to the left.

title: The Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a central cross with a human figure mounted upon it, set against a background of textured, reddish-gold color. Below the cross, two people with golden halos are kneeling on rocky ground. The person on the left wears a long blue robe, while the person on the right wears a pink robe. Above the cross, a small, floating figure in blue holds an open book and sits among stylized clouds. A narrow, pointed golden frame surrounds the entire scene.

title: The Stigmatization of Saint Francis
alt_text: A painting of two monks kneeling on a rocky, uneven landscape. On the left, a monk with a shaved head sits on the ground while holding a small book. Across from him on the right, a second monk with a golden halo kneels with his arms raised toward a small, red, winged figure flying in the gold-colored sky above. Several dark, pointed trees grow among the gray rock formations. Two simple buildings sit on high ridges at the far left and far right edges of the scene.

title: Six Saints (James the Greater, John the Baptist, Bernard of Clairvaux, Philip, Anthony Abbot, and Dorothy); Annunciatory Angel, One of Three Panels from a Tryptich
alt_text: A painting of several figures against a gold background, shaped like a vertical wooden panel with a curved top. At the top, a single winged figure kneels on a textured, patterned floor while holding a plant stem. Below this, the main panel features five standing figures arranged in rows within an arched gold frame. The individuals have golden halos around their heads and wear colorful, draped clothing. They hold various objects, such as books, a cross, and a staff, while looking in different directions. The entire scene is decorated with gold leaf, creating a shining effect across the panel.

title: Saints Augustine and Lucy; Two Evangelists
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows two full-length figures framed by two pointed arches with gold backgrounds. On the left, a man with a beard wears a tall, patterned bishop's hat and a green robe with an orange and gold sash, holding a tall staff and a red book. On the right, a woman with blonde hair and a crown wears a pink cloak over a blue patterned dress, holding a green palm leaf and a small bowl with a flame. Above each figure, within the pointed arches, is a small circular painting of another person. At the bottom of the painting, two rectangular black panels display text written in a decorative, golden script. The entire piece is set within a decorative gold frame with sharp, triangular tops.

title: Saints Agnes and Dominic; Two Evangelists
alt_text: A painting on panel showing two arched compartments within a gold frame. In the left compartment, a woman in a long red robe holds a small white lamb against her chest. In the right compartment, a bearded man in a black and white robe holds a long-stemmed white flower and a thick red book. Above each main figure, a small circular portrait shows a head and shoulders view of a person. A blue plaque with gold lettering runs across the bottom of both compartments. The background behind the figures is a solid, shimmering gold.

title: Scenes from the Legend of Saints Cosmas and Damian
alt_text: A painting of several figures arranged in two distinct scenes separated by a vertical crack. The left scene shows people in colorful, long robes gathered in a group, with one person riding a grey horse toward the right. The background is a worn, dark brown, and there are faint gold leaf details above the figures. The right scene depicts a person lying in a bed with red and white covers, while a figure in a pink robe bends over them. Another person in a green robe sits on the floor near the foot of the bed. The entire image has a textured, aged look with visible cracks across the panel.

title: Scene from the Legend of Saint John Gualbert
alt_text: A painting showing several figures in a structured architectural setting with gold leaf accents. On the left, a man in red clothing leads a large black horse toward a building entrance. In the center, a man wearing a bright red coat and a golden halo walks toward a kneeling man in blue. The kneeling man faces a small, red box and a tiny figure suspended on a cross against a pale, arched wall. On the ground near the kneeling man, there is a round object and a sword lying flat. The scene is framed by a simple, light-colored wooden border.

title: Saints Zenobius, Francis, and Anthony of Padua
alt_text: A painting of three men standing side-by-side against a gold background. On the left stands a man wearing a white robe, a blue and gold cape, and a tall white hat. He holds a blue book against his chest with one hand. In the center is a man with short brown hair wearing a simple brown robe, with his hands clasped together in front of him. To his right stands a third man with a graying beard, wearing a plain gray robe and holding a red flame-like shape in his hand. All three figures have gold, circular halos behind their heads.

title: The Agony in the Garden
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on a rectangular wooden panel shows a group of figures in a rocky, mountainous landscape. A single figure kneels in the center, looking up toward a winged being in the upper right sky. Below them, three other figures sit closely together on the ground, wearing draped robes in shades of blue, red, green, and orange. Each figure has a gold circle, or halo, around their head. The edges of the panel are worn and show exposed wood with several metal nails driven into the frame.

title: A Tournament in Piazza Santa Croce
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting shows a crowded jousting tournament taking place in an outdoor arena. Many riders in armor sit on horseback, holding long spears and facing each other in the center of the scene. On the sidelines, many people in colorful tunics and hats stand or sit on benches, watching the action. In the background, there is a stone wall with archways and a raised balcony where figures dressed in red are seated. The overall scene is filled with intricate detail, rich colors, and decorative patterns.

title: Military Commander
alt_text: A painting showing a man standing in a landscape. He wears a suit of shiny metal armor over a plain coat and loose trousers. A long sword with a decorated handle hangs at his side. He holds a long, thin walking stick in his right hand. His left hand is placed firmly on his hip. He has dark, wavy shoulder-length hair and a thin mustache.

title: Saint George
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a person with curly hair riding a white horse against a gold background. The rider wears golden armor and a flowing red cape while holding a long spear. The horse rears up over a green, winged creature that is curled on the ground near rocky hills. The spear pierces the neck of the creature, and red lines mark the spot. The entire scene is framed by a thin, worn red border at the top and bottom.

title: The Nativity
alt_text: A painting showing a golden-toned scene set against a rocky landscape. In the center, a dark cave contains a small figure wrapped in white cloth inside a manger. A woman wearing a long red robe kneels on the left side, looking toward the cave. In the bottom right corner, an older man with a white beard sits and rests his chin on his hand. Above the cave, a small structure with a brown roof sits on the rocks, while an angel floats in the upper left corner.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small child on a wood panel. The woman wears a large, draped red cloak over a blue garment, and she has a gold halo around her head. She holds the child against her left side, and the child wears light-colored clothing with a gold-patterned skirt. The child also has a smaller gold halo and looks toward the woman's face. The background is a worn, gold-colored surface that shows signs of age. There is a large, light-colored patch of missing paint across the lower portion of the figures' robes.

title: The Annunciation
alt_text: A painting of a figure with wings standing before a woman in a long red robe. The scene is set inside a frame with a gold, arched top and twisted side columns. The winged figure on the left wears a pale, flowing garment and holds a thin green plant. The woman on the right stands near a structure with pillars and a rounded top. She has her hand raised toward the winged figure. The background has a soft, glowing circle behind the woman.

title: Christ Appearing to Saints Catherine of Alexandria and Mercurius
alt_text: A painting on a wood panel depicts a religious scene enclosed in an arched, golden frame. Two standing figures, one in a long red robe and another in armor with a shield, appear to be fighting or subduing two other figures who lie on the ground below them. Above these four people, a smaller figure with arms outstretched floats in the upper center of the image. The entire scene is set against a faded green background, and there are faint inscriptions in a dark script near the figures. The frame features decorative twisted pillars on the sides and elaborate gold carvings at the top.

title: The Descent of Christ into Limbo; TheTransfiguration; Seven Scenes from the History of Moses
alt_text: A painting on panel featuring three sections that fold together into a triptych. The central panel shows a standing figure surrounded by a glowing oval, with kneeling figures on either side above a dark pit. The left panel depicts figures climbing rocky mountains while others crouch below in colorful robes. The right panel displays a landscape with a large, pointed mountain emitting a cloud, several small buildings, and tiny figures on the ground. A golden, ornate frame with a rounded top surrounds the central image, separating it from the side panels.

title: The Dead Christ Supported by Joseph of Arimathaea
alt_text: A painting of four people seated together in front of a dark, rolling landscape. In the center, a man with long hair sits on a stone block, wrapped only in a white cloth around his waist. He is supported from behind by another man wearing a yellow and red turban-like head covering. To the left, a woman wearing a dark veil and red dress looks down with a somber expression. To the right, a second woman with long hair wears a long, bright red dress and holds the central man's hand. The background is a muted, dark green sky above a shadowy, hilly horizon.

title: Honoré Gabriel Riqueti, Comte de Mirabeau
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of an older man’s head and shoulders stands against a plain background. The figure has a round face with deep lines around his mouth and nose, and he looks slightly to his left. He wears a wig styled with puffy curls on both sides of his head. Around his neck, he has a folded fabric scarf that hangs down over his chest. He wears a buttoned jacket with wide lapels over a simple shirt. The entire bust sits on a small, round pedestal.

title: François-Marie Arouet, called Voltaire
alt_text: A painted plaster cast sculpture of a person's head and shoulders. The sculpture shows an older person with thinning hair and deep wrinkles across their forehead. They have a slight smile and are looking downward and toward the left. The figure is draped in a plain cloth garment that covers their shoulders. It sits on a simple, square pedestal base against a plain background.

title: Benjamin Franklin
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of an older man's head and shoulders. The man has a high forehead with thinning hair that falls in loose waves down to his neck. His face shows signs of age with creases around his eyes and mouth. He wears a plain coat with large buttons and a high collar. A small, white paper tag with a barcode hangs from the base of the statue. The entire object is light cream in color and sits on a simple, round stand.

title: James Abraham Hillhouse (1789-1841), B.A. 1808, M.A. 1811
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up against a plain dark background. The man has dark hair, light skin, and is wearing a high-collared white shirt under a black coat. He is sitting on a chair that has a hint of a red back visible to his right. The portrait is housed in a wide, ornate, gold-colored frame with decorative details. The overall lighting is soft, highlighting the man's face and shirt against the muted backdrop.

title: The Old Man's Story
alt_text: A painting shows an elderly man with a long white beard sitting on the left side of the frame while gesturing with his hands. A young boy stands next to him, looking attentively at the older man. Behind the boy, a young woman stands and looks toward the group. To the right, another woman is seated while holding a small baby wrapped in a light-colored cloth. The figures are illuminated against a plain, dark background, and they all appear to be listening to or interacting with the man.

title: John Addison Porter (1822-1866), B.A. 1842, M.A. 1845, M.D. (Hon.) 1854, (after Jennette Shepherd Harrison Loop)
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up against a plain background. The man has short, light brown hair and prominent sideburns along his jawline. He is wearing a dark blue suit jacket over a white shirt with a dark blue bow tie. He is positioned in the center of the frame, facing slightly to the viewer's left with a neutral expression. The painting is enclosed in a wide, ornate, gold-colored frame with floral details. A small metal plaque with text is attached to the bottom center of the frame.

title: George Jarvis Brush (1831-1912), Ph.B. 1852, M.A. (Hon.) 1857
alt_text: A painting of an older man with a large white mustache looking toward the right. He has light skin, thinning light hair, and wrinkles around his eyes and mouth. He wears a dark, formal suit jacket over a white collared shirt. A small, dark bowtie is visible at his neck. The background behind him is a solid, muted olive-green color with soft shadows.

title: Dead Christ
alt_text: A painting of a man’s head and shoulders shown from the chest up against a dark, circular background. The man has long, light brown hair and his face is tilted upward with eyes closed. His forehead shows several small, red spots and tiny dark prick marks. A light-colored fabric drapes diagonally across his shoulder. The painting is framed within a simple circular wooden border.

title: The Procession to Calvary
alt_text: A painting shows a crowded outdoor scene with a path leading to three distant wooden crosses on a hill. In the lower right corner, a group of four people stands together, featuring women in colorful long robes, a person holding a small baby, and a young boy wearing an orange tunic. To their left, a large, chaotic crowd of people includes many figures carrying long spears and walking along the path. In the distance, a winding road leads up the grassy slope toward the three wooden structures. Large, pale rock formations and a city with tall walls border the open landscape under a cloudy blue sky.

title: Charles V
alt_text: A painting of a man's head and shoulders shown from a slightly side-facing angle. He has a dark, full beard and mustache, with short brown hair peeking out from under a dark, flat cap. He wears a dark jacket with a simple, white collar folded over the neckline. A small, blurry red symbol sits on his chest near the bottom of his jacket. The background is a flat, solid shade of olive green.

title: Venal Love
alt_text: A painting of a group of four people shown from the waist up against a dark, textured background. On the left, an older man with a long white beard leans forward and rests his hand on the shoulder of a woman. The woman has her head turned toward the man while wearing a dress with draped fabric around her shoulders. To the right, a small, young child stands and looks toward the left side of the scene. Behind the child, a smiling man with short hair gazes toward the others. The lighting highlights the faces and figures against the murky, indistinct surroundings.

title: The Virgin in the Egg
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing inside a large, white oval shape that resembles a cracked egg. An older man with a long white beard and red robes floats above the oval, reaching down to point at the woman's head while holding a blue globe with a golden cross. Six small winged heads, representing cherubs, surround the main figures in the clouds. Below the oval, one more cherub with pink wings looks upward. Two men in robes stand on either side of the oval, one on the left in brown and one on the right in black and white, both looking toward the woman. All the figures are set against a muted, grey background.

title: The Shipwreck of Aeneas
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on a rectangular panel shows a busy, detailed scene with many figures by the sea. On the far left, a person sits in a cave opening while another figure stands nearby wearing a long cloak. The middle of the painting is filled with several boats on dark water, some of which feature tall, white, sail-like shapes. One distinctive boat is shaped like a wagon with wheels and is pulled across the water by a large, dragon-like sea creature. On the right side, multiple people stand on the shore near rocky cliffs and trees, dressed in colorful clothing. The entire scene is framed by a decorative, wavy gold border.

title: Aeneas at Carthage
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting of a crowded, complex scene is framed in a decorative gold border. The composition is divided into several areas, with a large, multi-story building standing in the center. Inside and around this structure, many small figures wearing elaborate, gold-colored clothing gather in groups. To the left, several figures are hunting in a dark, wooded area filled with deer and horses. To the right, workers are busy constructing stone walls near a large wooden scaffold. In the far distance on the right, a city with high towers sits under a muted sky.

title: The Meeting of Solomon and the Queen of Sheba
alt_text: A painting of a crowded, festive scene depicts a group of many people gathering under an arched, gold-accented structure. On the left, several people on horseback are followed by a procession of figures wearing tall, ornate, cone-shaped hats and elaborate, textured robes. In the center, a person in a long, shining gold garment stands near a dark arched doorway and shakes hands with another figure dressed in dark, patterned clothing. The background includes decorative arches and small hanging banners above the crowd. The entire scene is filled with rich, warm colors, including deep reds, blues, and gold accents.

title: Fragment of a Thebaid with Scenes from the Lives of Saint Pachomius and Another Holy Hermit
alt_text: A painting shows several scenes set in a landscape with reddish buildings on the left and right. On the far left, a person with a halo sits near an open doorway, while another person with a halo steps out of a nearby building. A nearly nude, pale figure walks between the buildings, and a second nude figure stands hunched over on a hill to the right. In the bottom right, a group of people wearing long, colorful robes gather near a small structure. The background is a soft, muted green, and the ground is an earthy brown.

title: The Death of the Virgin
alt_text: A painting shows a large group of men in long robes standing around a figure lying on a rectangular bed. The person on the bed is wrapped completely in white fabric and rests their head on a patterned pillow. A central figure in the group holds a small, swaddled white bundle toward the reclining person. Most of the men have beards and hold open books or papers, while others gesture with their hands. They are gathered in a room with a decorative pink wall in the background and simple columns on the far left and right.

title: The Charity of Saint Nicholas of Bari
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows an architectural setting with four people. To the left, a man in a red tunic and blue leggings stands outside a corner wall, looking through an opening. Inside the structure, a person wearing a gold-colored robe sits on a small stool. To the right, a woman in a long pink dress stands near a man wearing a blue robe and a red hat. The scene is encased in a rustic, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: The Annunciation
alt_text: A painting of a kneeling angel and a seated figure in an ornate interior. The angel on the left has large, colorful wings and wears a long purple robe with hands folded across its chest. Facing the angel on the right, a figure in a blue cloak sits on a chair, holding an open book and gesturing with one hand. Between them stands a stone archway with grey columns, and a reddish floor extends across the bottom of the scene. In the top left corner, a small bearded figure with a golden halo appears in the clouds above a dark tree. Both the angel and the seated figure have large, round golden halos around their heads.

title: The Infancy of Saint Thomas Aquinas
alt_text: A painting of a tall pink building with several people standing inside and around it. A woman in a red dress sits on a bench on the ground level, while a small, nude child crawls on a colorful rug at her feet. To her right, a woman in a green dress stands and holds her hand, facing toward the seated figure. On the left, a person in a brown hooded robe stands at the bottom of a set of stairs, looking up at another person in a brown robe who stands near a doorway. Further in the background on the right, more people gather near a small pool or fountain against a wall. The scene is framed by golden edges that appear worn or chipped.

title: Virgin and Child with Saint Catherine and Four Angels
alt_text: A painting shows a woman with blonde hair cradling a small, naked child in her arms. She wears a pink dress with a dark robe and has her hands together as if in prayer. Behind her and to her sides are several figures with golden halos around their heads, appearing to be angels. The background behind the figures is filled with green leaves and small flowers. The artwork is set within an ornate, gold-painted wooden frame that has a curved top and a small shield at the bottom.

title: Angel in Adoration
alt_text: A painting of a winged figure standing in an architectural frame. The figure has light skin, curly hair, and a glowing halo above its head. It wears flowing robes in shades of yellow, pink, and dark red. Large, colorful wings stretch out from its back, displaying feathers of red, purple, and green. The background is a simple, dark green archway. Several white cracks run across the surface of the painting.

title: Cosimo de'Medici, Grand Duke of Florence
alt_text: A painting of a man with a serious expression and a short, brown beard. He has a bald head and looks directly forward at the viewer. The man wears a dark, possibly black, jacket with a wide, white collar around his neck. A thick, ornate gold chain with intricate designs hangs around his shoulders over the jacket. The background is a plain, dark olive green color with no other details.

title: The Martyrdom of Theban Legion
alt_text: A painting of a crowded scene shows many people gathered outdoors in a dark, hilly landscape. A central figure sits on a raised platform, wearing robes and facing toward the right side of the frame. To the left, a large, chaotic group of smaller figures appears to be moving or struggling in the shadows. On the right, a person in a yellow garment stands facing the seated figure while holding an object. The upper left corner of the scene features a dark sky with small, winged figures floating above the rest of the group. Large patches of paint are missing from the surface, revealing the light-colored wood panel underneath.

title: Dead Christ with Joseph of Arimathea
alt_text: A painting of a man with his head bowed and eyes closed. He sits in a relaxed position with a light-colored cloth draped across his lap. His bare chest and arms are visible, and his skin has a warm, tan tone. A dark, reddish-colored cloth hangs over his left shoulder and arm. The background is shadowy and dark, making the figure stand out. At the bottom of the frame, there is a small white rectangular label with the numbers 1871 80 written on it.

title: The Adoration of the Magi
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a large group of people gathered in front of an open stone archway. In the center, a woman sits and holds a small, unclothed baby on her lap. Several men kneel before them, dressed in heavy, flowing robes of deep red and brown. Surrounding the center group are many other figures standing in the shadows, some looking toward the woman and child. High above the archway, a faint, reddish figure floats against the dark, cloudy sky. Through the arch, a distant landscape of low hills and a pale sky is visible.

title: Lucretia
alt_text: A painting of a woman with pale skin who looks over her left shoulder while holding a dark, thin dagger against her chest. She has reddish-brown hair styled with a gold ornament at the top of her head. Her body is mostly unclothed, but a soft pink cloth wraps around her waist. Behind her, a large, folded green curtain hangs against a dark background. One of her hands is visible resting at her side, while the other hand grips the handle of the weapon.

title: Bianca Capella, Mistress of Duke Ferdinand de' Medici
alt_text: A painting of a woman with her hair pulled back away from her face. She has light skin, large eyes, and a neutral expression while looking directly forward. She is wearing a dark, wide-necked garment with a prominent, ruffled white collar that frames her neck. A simple string of round beads sits against her collarbone as a necklace. Behind her, the background is painted in muted, dark tones that offer little detail.

title: Piero Strozzi
alt_text: A painting of a man wearing metal armor. He has dark hair, a full beard, and is looking directly forward. A white ruffled collar sits at his neck, just above the smooth, dark plates of his chest armor. Gold accents highlight the edges of the armor and a chain hanging across his chest. The man is set against a dark background, and his name is written in capital letters across the top corners.

title: Dante Alighieri
alt_text: A painting shows a man in a bust-length portrait against a dark, textured background. He wears a red cap with a crown of dark green laurel leaves resting on his head. His expression is serious, and he looks toward the upper left corner of the frame. He wears a red tunic over a dark shirt and holds an open white book in his hand. Two lines of light-colored capital letters are painted at the very top of the image.

title: Amerigo Vespucci
medium: Oil on panel transferred to canvas
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up, facing toward the right side. He wears a muted red, brimless cap that sits low on his forehead. Below, he is dressed in a matching red garment with a simple, high neckline. His face has a serious expression with defined cheekbones and a narrow nose. The background is a plain, dark greenish-grey color that surrounds him. A vertical line runs down the center of the painting, appearing to be a crease or seam.

title: Fernando Cortez
alt_text: A painting shows a portrait of a middle-aged man against a dark, muted background. He has a pale, serious face with a short, light-colored beard and mustache. He wears a dark, simple cap that sits low on his forehead. The man is dressed in a dark, high-collared garment that blends into the shadows behind him. Some faint, partial text is visible in the upper portion of the frame.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints John, Catherine and Bernardino of Siena
alt_text: A painting shows a woman holding a baby in the center, with another child and two other figures beside them. The central woman wears a dark cloak over a red dress and gazes toward the left. In her arms, a small baby reaches out with one hand, while another young, curly-haired child sits to the right, arms crossed over their chest. To the far left, a woman in a white head covering looks forward, and to the right, a man with short hair holds a small, rectangular object with a symbol on it. Each figure has a faint, thin halo around their head, and the background is dark and indistinct.

title: Christ bearing the Cross
alt_text: A painting of a man with long, wavy brown hair wearing a crown of sharp thorns. He has a somber expression and is partially draped in a red robe that exposes his muscular shoulder. Behind him, a large, light-colored wooden beam rests across his shoulders. To his left, a person with gray hair and a grimacing face stares forward from the shadows. Another shadowy figure with a dark helmet is barely visible behind the wooden beam on the right side.

title: The Ecstasy of Saint Catherine of Siena
alt_text: A painting of a woman in a white headcovering and dark robes kneeling on the floor. She is surrounded by several small, winged infants who appear to be flying or hovering around her. Behind them, two tall stone columns frame an open window that looks out onto a green landscape with distant hills. High above the woman, a figure with arms outstretched floats in the sky, surrounded by bright light. The overall scene has warm, shadowed lighting that emphasizes the figures in the foreground.

title: Saint Sebastian
alt_text: A painting shows a bare-chested person looking upward with their hands held together against their chest. Three arrows are stuck into the figure's body, one near the right shoulder, one near the left arm, and one in the lower right side. The background is a dark, solid color that contrasts with the pale skin of the figure. Two small, winged figures hover on fluffy white clouds on either side of the main person's head. They both hold thin, curved objects above their heads, like small crowns or branches.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints
alt_text: A painting of a group of people clustered together is set within a tall, arched, gold-colored frame. At the center, a woman with reddish-brown hair holds a young, naked baby who faces outward. To the left, a man wearing a tall, dark hat and robes stands beside the woman. On the right side, another young child stands with hands pressed together, looking up toward the baby. Behind the woman and the baby, two bearded men stand close together, looking in the same direction. The entire scene is bathed in soft, muted tones.

title: The Baptism of Christ
alt_text: A painting of a man being baptized in a river by another man. In the center, a man with long hair stands in shallow water, bowing his head with his hands folded. Next to him, a man wearing a red robe reaches out to pour water on the other man's head. Two winged angels kneel on either side of the riverbank, watching the scene. Above the central figures, a circular glowing light surrounds an older, bearded man who holds a dark sphere. The background shows rolling green hills and a faint landscape under a pale blue sky.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints and Donors
alt_text: A painting of five figures outdoors with a hilly landscape in the background. In the center, a woman with a white veil holds a small, unclothed baby on her lap. To the left, a man with long, wavy brown hair holds a thin, tall cross. Below him, a man in a blue tunic kneels and looks up toward the center figures. To the right, another woman with long, light-colored hair wears a dark red robe and holds a small, lidded cup in her hand.

title: The Circumcision of Christ
alt_text: A painting of five figures gathered around a rectangular table. A woman wearing a dark blue robe sits on the right side of the table with her hands together. An older man with a long beard wears a reddish-pink robe and sits across from her, reaching toward the center of the table. Two other men stand behind the table near the center, while a third man stands on the far left holding a small brown container. Through an opening behind them, a bright blue sky with white clouds is visible. The entire scene is enclosed in an ornate, gold-colored frame with decorative carvings.

title: Venetian Nobleman and Two Women
medium: Oil transferred from panel to canvas
alt_text: A painting of three people standing close together in a dark setting. On the left, a man with light brown hair and a dark cap wears a reddish-brown garment. In the center, a woman with light skin and reddish hair looks toward the man while wearing a cream-colored top with a ruffled neckline. A second woman stands to the right, slightly behind the others, looking toward the left with a serious expression. Dark, leafy foliage fills the background behind all three figures. The lighting focuses on the faces of the people, leaving their lower bodies in deep shadow.

title: Saint Peter
medium: Oil on canvas, possibly transferred from panel
alt_text: A painting showing an older, bearded man standing in a full-length portrait. He wears a dark blue tunic covered by a long, loose, golden-brown robe that drapes across his body. In his left arm, he holds a large, thick, dark green book close to his chest. His right hand hangs down, holding a long, dark grey key. Behind him, there is a simple landscape with faint trees under a soft, light-colored sky.

title: Portrait of a Lady
alt_text: A painting of a woman wearing a simple white cap and a black dress. She is shown from the chest up, facing forward with a calm expression. Around her neck, she wears a thin gold chain with a small, round pendant that rests against her chest. In her right hand, she holds a small, rectangular book. The background shows a dimly lit landscape with faint trees under a dusk-like sky.

title: The Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting shows a central figure hanging on a wooden cross against a dark, stormy sky. Two other figures hang on smaller crosses on the far left and right sides of the scene. Below the central cross, a group of people gathers on the ground. A woman in a long golden dress stands on the right, reaching up to touch the base of the cross. A cluster of figures on the left supports another person who appears to be fainting or sitting slumped on the ground.

title: Christ in Glory Appearing to Saints Peter and Paul
alt_text: A painting of a central male figure floating in the sky while draped in a simple blue cloth. He is surrounded by a crowd of winged cherubs and several figures who are looking up toward him from the clouds. Below this scene, two bearded men stand on a cloud, with one gesturing upward and the other holding an open book. A small, distant landscape with buildings sits at the very bottom of the painting. The entire scene is bathed in a warm, ethereal light.

title: The Holy Family
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a central woman sitting on a dark bench, cradling a sleeping child across her lap. The woman wears a reddish-purple tunic over a blue-green skirt and rests one hand on an open book. To her left, a small, cherubic figure peers out from behind a green curtain. On the right side, an older person with a tan hooded cloak sits with their head resting on their hand. A small, shallow, curved stone basin with a patch of green liquid sits on the floor in the foreground.

title: Venus, Juno, and Minerva, with Cupid
alt_text: A painting of three women and a small, winged child sitting against a dark background. On the left, a woman with brown hair reaches upward with her right arm, wearing a light pink garment draped with blue fabric. A small, nude child with light brown hair and feathered wings sits on the lap of the woman in the center, who wears a white robe and yellow cloth. The child holds a small blue quiver, while the woman on the right reaches toward it with her hand. This woman on the right has braided hair and wears a grey tunic over a white skirt, with a bright red cloth across her lap and a tall spear in her left hand. The figures are arranged close together in a group, all gazing toward one another.

title: Saint Joseph and the Infant Christ
alt_text: A painting on wood shows an older man with a long white beard holding a small baby. The man has his head tilted downward as he looks lovingly at the infant. The baby is resting in the man's arms, facing toward him. They are both centered in the dark, muted scene against a shadowy background. The colors of the painting are mostly dark browns and muted grays, giving the image a soft appearance.

title: Artemisia, the widow of Mausolus, King of Caria
alt_text: A painting of a woman with light skin and long, wavy brown hair. She wears an elaborate dark turban adorned with a central jewel, and a rich, rust-colored robe draped over a dark dress with decorated trim. Her right hand reaches out to hold a delicate, translucent bowl filled with dark liquid. To her side, a large, ornate metal bowl sits on a table, partially obscured by her sleeve. The woman looks away from the viewer, with a soft expression on her face, set against a dark, shadowy background.

title: Mater Dolorosa
alt_text: A painting of a woman, created with oil on canvas. The woman is centered in the frame and faces forward with a serious expression. She wears a tan head covering that drapes down over her shoulders. Her hands are held in front of her, and she grasps a dark, circular object with thorns on it. The background is a very dark, indistinct shadow.

title: Potrait of Pope Clement X Altieri (r.1670-1676)
alt_text: A painting shows a man with a mustache and a goatee looking toward the viewer. He wears a dark red cap with a white trim that sits on his head. He also wears a matching red robe with a wide, white collar around his neck. The background is a simple, dark brown color. The edges of the canvas appear ragged and worn, contrasting with the detailed portrait in the center.

title: Albert Arnold Sprague, (1835-1915) B.A. 1859, M.A. (HON.) 1927
alt_text: A painting of an older man sitting in a chair. The man is wearing a dark suit with a white shirt and a light-colored tie. He has short, thinning light hair and a thin mustache, and he is looking directly at the viewer. His left hand rests on his lap while holding a small object, and his right hand rests on the arm of the upholstered chair. The background is dark and indistinct, focusing attention on the man in the center. The painting is enclosed in an ornate, light-colored frame with decorative details at the corners.

title: Indians Playing Lacrosse on the Ice
alt_text: A painting of people playing a game on a frozen lake during the winter. Numerous figures in colorful clothing skate across the ice, swinging sticks toward a ball. To the left, a snowy bank sits beneath bare trees and a cluster of cone-shaped tents. On the right, several people in dark blankets sit on the shore, watching the activity. The background features distant mountains under a blue sky with soft, bright clouds.

title: The Castle of Taormina
alt_text: A painting of a landscape featuring a path, trees, and a mountain. A dirt path winds from the foreground toward the base of a large, pale mountain in the background. Several tall, slender, dark green cypress trees stand in a row to the left of the path. To the right, small buildings with light-colored walls and warm-toned roofs sit along the edge of the road. A long, light-colored wall runs along the left side of the path, separating it from the trees and mountain. The scene is bathed in soft, diffused light, suggesting either early morning or late afternoon.

title: Faucheur
alt_text: A cast sculpture of a standing figure holding a large curved tool, likely a scythe, above their head. The figure wears a simple hat and a long, pleated garment that reaches down to just below their knees. They are facing slightly upward with their hands raised to grasp the handle of the tool. The entire piece is made of a single, uniform material with a rough, stone-like texture. The figure is framed within a rectangular border, standing on a flat ledge at the bottom.

title: Tete Ange
alt_text: A sculpture cast showing the head and shoulders of a person with curly hair. The figure has a smooth, pale gray surface that looks like matte stone or plaster. The hair is styled in distinct, round curls that frame the face on both sides. The person has an oval face with almond-shaped eyes and a calm, slight smile. They are wearing a simple garment that covers their shoulders and neck.

title: Un Moine de Dijon
alt_text: A cast sculpture showing a figure wrapped in a long, hooded robe. The figure has a beard and appears to be looking slightly downward with a calm expression. Soft, heavy fabric folds drape from the figure’s head down to the base. The sculpture is colored in a muted, off-white or light gray tone. It stands on a low, hexagonal pedestal.

title: Buste de Marquis de Mejane -- Houdon
alt_text: A cast sculpture of a man's head and chest stands against a simple, gray background. The figure features light, pale skin tones with subtle shading that highlights his facial features and the folds of his clothing. He has short hair styled away from his face and looks slightly off to the side with a serious expression. He wears an open-collared shirt with a draped layer of fabric across his chest, similar to a robe. The bust sits on a circular pedestal base that tapers slightly in the middle.

title: Buste Christ du Puits de Moise
alt_text: A cast sculpture shows the head and shoulders of a man with a beard looking downward. He wears a dark, pointed hat that sits low on his forehead. His thick, wavy hair flows back from his face and curls over his ears. His eyes are closed, and his mouth is set in a serious expression. The entire object is a single, uniform dark brown color, suggesting a plaster or terracotta cast.

title: Saint Michael Weighing a Soul
alt_text: A painting shows a winged figure in gold armor standing over a man who lies flat on the ground. To the left, another winged figure in a green robe holds a long scroll and a small figure. On the right, a black creature with horns, wings, and a red tongue kneels while holding a scroll. A small, seated figure appears in a white cloud at the very top of the scene. Two tall, grey buildings with red roofs frame the background behind the figures.

title: Cover
alt_text: A textile of velvet shows a deep red, rectangular piece of fabric displayed inside a frame. The main body of the fabric is made of several stitched panels that create vertical lines. The surface has a subtle, shiny pattern woven into the dark red velvet. A wider, decorative border with an intricate scroll pattern frames all four sides of the red cloth. A small white label with the text "1934,94" sits at the bottom edge, resting against a piece of foam.

title: Thomas Fitch (?)
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair, shown from the chest up. The man has long, light-colored hair and wears a dark, long-sleeved jacket over a light shirt. He sits with his right hand resting on a surface and his left hand on his lap. He is positioned against a simple, dark brown background that fades toward the bottom. The painting is enclosed in a wide, textured gold-colored frame.

title: Study for the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, Murals: Orestes and the Furies
alt_text: A painting shows a group of pale, green-toned figures surrounding a single man in the center. The man is nude and reaches his hands forward toward a draped woman on the right. The figures on the left have long, flowing hair and grasp green, rope-like shapes that extend toward the man. All the figures are set against a deep, dark red background that fills the entire space. The overall scene feels like a frantic or intense moment of movement.

title: William Buckland (1734-1774)
alt_text: A painting showing a man sitting at a desk with a serious expression. He has short brown hair and wears a dark red coat with a white collar. He holds a thin tool in his right hand while his left hand rests on the table. On the table, there is a piece of paper with drawings, a black case, and some small metal tools. Behind him, a large dark column stands next to a window that shows a tall building with pillars.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on the ground and holding a small child in her lap. The woman wears a light-colored top and a long skirt that drapes over her legs. She looks down at the child, who is mostly wrapped in white cloth. They are positioned in a dark, outdoor setting with shadowy trees in the background. The entire scene is encased in a decorative, rectangular frame with black and gold sections.

title: Samuel Bishop (1725-1803)
alt_text: A painting of an older man wearing a white wig and a dark coat. He is shown from the waist up, facing forward against a plain, circular background. In his right hand, he holds a small, rectangular brown book upright. A stack of white papers and a quill pen sit on the table in front of him. His left hand rests quietly on his lap, and the entire scene is enclosed within a simple dark frame.

title: River Scene
alt_text: A painting of a landscape at dusk features a river curving through the center of the scene. In the foreground, a grassy bank slopes down toward the water and is lined with small, upright lampposts. A large, dark, rounded tree stands on the left side near the riverbank. Across the water, a bridge arches over the river, with a town or city faintly visible in the background. The sky above is filled with muted, cloudy gray tones, suggesting late evening light.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the side in profile. He has dark brown hair and a thick mustache that covers his upper lip. He is wearing a dark suit jacket with a high white shirt collar and a dark tie. His gaze is directed toward the left, and the background is a simple, dark brown tone. The entire painting is housed inside a simple, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: William Graham Sumner (1840-1910), B.A. 1863, LL.D. 1909
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a formal suit. He is seated and faces forward with a serious expression. He wears a dark jacket, a vest, a crisp white shirt, and a dark tie. His hair is thinning on top, and he has a mustache. In his right hand, he holds a small, rectangular book. The background is a dark, solid, and indistinct tone.

title: Lucretia
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the waist up against a dark, plain background. She has light skin and brown hair pulled back with a small, golden band. She wears draped, tan-colored cloth that leaves her chest and shoulders bare. Her head is turned slightly to the right as she looks off-screen. In her right hand, she holds a small, dark dagger near her chest.

title: A Battle of Greeks and Amazons (Theseus and Hippolyta or Achilles and Penthesileia?); Allegories of Hope and Justice; Reclining Nude
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A piece of painted wooden furniture shows a rectangular chest featuring a wide panel on the front. This panel displays a busy outdoor scene that includes a large sailing ship anchored near a harbor on the left. In the center, a group of people on horseback carry tall spears and move toward a walled city on the right. Several figures stand near the gates of the city, which is depicted with stone walls and towers. The chest itself has dark, polished wood edges and a decorative, carved border along the base.

title: The Annunciate Virgin and the Archangel Gabriel
alt_text: A marble sculpture of two tall, rectangular panels featuring carved figures. On the left, a figure draped in long robes stands facing slightly to the side, holding a rectangular object in front. This figure has a halo around its head and appears to be looking downward. To the right, a second panel shows a figure standing and facing forward with one arm raised. This figure also has a halo and wears loose, flowing garments that gather at the waist. Both light-colored stone carvings are mounted against a simple, textured wall.

title: Vegetables
alt_text: A painting showing a collection of vegetables and a bottle arranged on a table. On the left stands a tall, dark glass bottle next to a round head of red-tinged lettuce. To the right of the bottle, a bunch of asparagus lies horizontally near a large pile of leafy green vegetables. In the background, a woven basket holds more greens and a piece of fruit or bread. The items rest on a table with a light-colored, checkered surface, and the entire scene is contained within a dark, worn wooden frame.

title: Skirt border
alt_text: A textile fragment of cotton with red silk embroidery shows a repeating decorative border pattern. The design features a row of tall, potted flowering plants stitched in deep red thread against the off-white fabric. Below these main plants, a narrower, continuous horizontal band runs across the bottom, filled with smaller stylized floral and geometric motifs. The embroidery is dense and symmetrical, with each large flower shape rising from a decorative urn or vase. A black identification label with white text sits at the very bottom edge of the textile.

title: Part of a bed curtain or bed valance
alt_text: A textile made of plain cloth with embroidery showing a repeating plant pattern. This long, narrow strip has a light cream background color. It features a central vertical design of orange and green leaves that alternate in a symmetrical stem pattern. Along the right side, there is a thick, textured fringe made of matching orange and cream threads. The overall look is decorative and symmetrical from top to bottom.

title: Three lengths of drawn work
alt_text: A textile made of linen featuring an intricate woven pattern of repeating designs. The pattern displays stylized birds or creatures in reddish-orange against a cream-colored background. Between these figures are geometric shapes filled with blue-grey threads. The overall design looks like a woven fabric with a consistent, grid-like texture. A black label with white numbers sits at the bottom edge.

title: End of a pillow cover (?)
alt_text: A textile made of embroidered linen cloth displays a repeating geometric pattern in red and pale green. The fabric has a jagged bottom edge trimmed with small, dangling tassels that alternate between these two colors. A thick band of intricate, angular stitching runs horizontally across the upper and middle sections of the piece. The background material is a light beige color, providing a soft contrast to the bright thread. A black label with white numbers sits at the bottom, resting on a white, foam-like surface.

title: Kerchief
alt_text: A textile made of plain cloth features an embroidered design. The rectangular fabric is tan and has a long, frayed fringe along its bottom edge. Two large, ornate, symmetrical floral patterns sit on the left and right sides of the fabric. Between these two larger designs are two smaller, stacked floral patterns centered on the cloth. The embroidery uses bright red, blue, and brown thread to create these intricate, leafy shapes.

title: Pillow cover
alt_text: A piece of embroidered cloth displays a decorative border on all four sides. The fabric itself is a plain, light beige color. The border features a repeating pattern of stylized floral shapes in deep red and dark green thread. These shapes are symmetrical and sit against the edges of the cloth, leaving a large empty square in the center. A black label with white numbers rests at the very bottom edge of the textile.

title: Augustus Russell Street (1791-1866), B.A. 1812
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up. The man has brown hair brushed back with sideburns along his jaw. He wears a dark black coat over a lighter waistcoat with a white collared shirt and a white necktie. His expression is serious as he gazes off to the right side of the frame. He sits on a chair that has a red backrest and small round decorative knobs visible behind his shoulders. The background is a flat, dark brown color.

title: Roger Sherman (1721–1793, M.A. [Hon.] 1768)
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a dark room. He faces forward with a serious expression and short, light brown hair. He wears a dark red suit with a white collar and cuffs, along with dark stockings and buckled shoes. The man sits in a green wooden chair that has dark red upholstery. Behind him, a heavy, draped curtain in a deep reddish-brown color hangs on the left side of the scene. The room itself is dark and plain, with simple brown walls.

title: Edward Elbridge Salisbury (1814-1901), B.A. 1832, M.A. 1835, B.D. 1836, LL.D. 1869
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of an older man with light skin. He is wearing a dark suit coat with a white collared shirt and a dark necktie. The man has thinning, light hair and long sideburns that frame his face. He is looking off to the right side of the frame with a serious expression. The portrait is set against a simple, muted background and is surrounded by a large, ornate gold frame.

title: Matthew Chaloner Durfee Borden (1842-1912), B.A. 1864, M.A. 1867
alt_text: A painting of a man sits inside an ornate, gold-colored frame. The man is shown from the chest up and wears a dark suit with a collared shirt and tie. His hair is light, and he has a distinct mustache that extends to his sideburns. The background is very dark, making it difficult to see details of the room behind him. A horizontal metal plaque is attached to the bottom center of the frame.

title: In Front of Yorktown
alt_text: A painting of men in uniforms sitting around a campfire in the woods at night. On the left, two figures wrapped in blankets sit near the bright, flickering flames. To the right of the fire, two more men in uniform sit or lie on the ground in front of a low wooden shelter. Dark tree trunks stand in the foreground, framing the scene. Equipment hangs on a wooden pole near the shelter, and a thin haze of smoke rises from the fire into the dark forest background.

title: Clock with revolving dial
alt_text: A bronze and ceramic timepiece in the shape of an ornate vase stands on a dark square base. The main body of the object is a pale blue, bulbous vase decorated with faint, blurry patterns of flowers and birds. A wide, metallic gold band wraps around the middle, featuring a small horizontal window that displays the Roman numeral VIII. On both sides of the vase, large, decorative gold handles shaped like bird heads extend outward, with dangling flower garlands beneath them. A separate, circular bronze gear-like object sits on the shelf to the lower left, partially cut off from view.

title: Tapestry
alt_text: A textile tapestry shows a dense, outdoor forest scene filled with tall, leafy trees. The entire image is rendered in shades of grey, black, and white. In the foreground, various types of flowers and bushes grow along the ground. Several large, long-necked birds stand among the plants in the lower middle and right side of the scene. A decorative, patterned border frames the entire rectangular composition.

title: Triumph of the Dance
alt_text: A painting of figures floating and dancing among light blue clouds. Several nude or semi-nude women are positioned across the scene in graceful, flowing poses. Small, nude infants or cherubs are interspersed among the women near the center and bottom. White birds are visible flying through the misty blue space. The entire image has a soft, pale color palette with hazy edges.

title: Cupid with Bow and Arrows ("The Archer")
alt_text: A painting of a figure floating in the air. The central figure is a muscular person with reddish hair, shown from the waist up, who is reaching one arm high into the sky. In their raised hand, they hold a long, curved bow. Their body is tilted at an angle against a soft, pale, and cloudy background. Below them, a quiver filled with arrows hangs diagonally against the hazy backdrop.

title: Female Figure
alt_text: A painting of a woman in a flowing garment. The figure is positioned in the center, appearing to dance or move with her arms raised above her head. She is draped in a pale, sheer white cloth that swirls around her body against a soft, muted greenish-grey background. The colors are very light, giving the image a hazy or misty quality. A simple wooden frame surrounds the tall, rectangular canvas.

title: Abundance of The Days of the Week
alt_text: A painting of many figures arranged in decorative, circular frames against a gold background. In the large center circle, a young, light-haired man stands playing a harp while surrounded by several other figures in flowing, draped clothing. Two large circular scenes on the left and right sides show more figures in reclining or active poses against deep blue backgrounds. Winged figures are placed in the smaller spaces between these circles, and the entire image is filled with detailed patterns of flowers, fruit, and geometric designs. The overall composition is symmetrical, ornate, and rich in color.

title: Goddess of Fortune Stay with Us
alt_text: A painting of a central winged woman with two boys standing on a balcony. The winged woman, who is partially undressed, stands on a small cloud and holds a large spoked wheel with long, flowing pink fabric draped around her. To her left, a young boy holds a framed sign with writing on it, while a second boy sits to her right and adjusts a length of blue fabric. A decorative chair with a pink cushion sits on a rug in front of the woman. In the background, rolling hills, a distant town, and a blue sky are visible through the arches.

title: Drama
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing inside a large, circular wreath of green leaves against a dark blue background. The woman has long reddish-brown hair and wears a flowing, light-colored dress that ripples as if she is moving. She holds a small, gold-colored mask in her right hand and a larger, darker mask in her left hand. A wide, gold-colored border surrounds the central circle, filled with an intricate pattern of swirling ribbons. The entire composition is shaped like a half-circle with a flat bottom edge.

title: Fame
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing inside a large, circular wreath of green leaves. The woman has long, reddish hair and wears light-colored, flowing robes that drape around her body. She holds a long, slender trumpet in her right hand and a small, circular wreath in her left hand. The background inside the wreath is a dark, solid color. Outside the wreath, long, curving ribbons swirl across a golden, semi-circular background.

title: Poetry
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing inside a large wreath on a semi-circular canvas. The woman wears a long, flowing cream-colored dress and has a wreath on her head. She holds a thin pen in one hand and a scroll of paper in the other hand. She stands in the center of a circular, dark blue background. A large green laurel wreath surrounds her, decorated with flowing light-colored ribbons that fan out across the rest of the gold-colored surface.

title: Bounty
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in profile inside a large, round laurel wreath. She wears a long, flowing light-colored gown and carries a basket of fruit in her right hand. In her left hand, she holds a thin, leafy branch. The wreath encircles her against a dark, round background. The area outside the wreath is a gold-colored semi-circle decorated with long, swirling pink ribbons.

title: Victory
alt_text: A painting of a person standing inside a large wreath, shaped like a semi-circle. The figure is centered on a dark blue background and wears a long, draped, light-colored robe. They hold a leafy branch in their right hand and a small, circular wreath in their left hand. A larger, green wreath made of leaves and berries surrounds the figure. Behind the wreath, the background is a soft yellow, decorated with long, wavy pink ribbons that flow out to the edges.

title: Frivolity
alt_text: A painting showing a woman in a flowing dress moving inside a circular frame. The circular frame is decorated with a wreath of green leaves and tied with long, pink ribbons that curve out into the gold background. The woman faces to the right, holding a small bunch of grapes in her right hand and a shallow golden cup in her left hand. Her dress is white with soft pink highlights, and it looks like it is blowing behind her as she walks. The background inside the circle is a dark, solid teal color, while the rest of the semi-circular canvas is a flat gold.

title: Henry Harland (1789–1841)
alt_text: A painting of a man shows a portrait of a person against a dark, mottled background. The man has short, dark brown hair and is looking slightly to his right. He wears a high, white, starched neckcloth that wraps around his throat. Over this, he has on a light-colored vest and a dark, heavy coat with wide lapels. The lighting in the scene highlights his face while leaving the background in shadow.

title: Triumph of Love (?)
alt_text: A fresco painting of five figures standing together in a line. The figures appear in a muted, earthy color palette with light browns and hints of green. On the far left, a curly-haired person looks to the side while holding a small object. To the right, a central figure with long hair wears a headband and draped robes. On the far right, a person stands wearing detailed armor and a leafy wreath on their head. The entire painting is encased in a rectangular frame carved with repeating circular shapes.

title: Saint Andrew (from the church of Saint Martin in Angers)
alt_text: A limestone sculpture shows a standing figure draped in long, flowing robes. The figure is missing its head, except for a large, rounded halo-like shape that rises behind where the head would be. The sculpture is painted in faded tones of brown, red, and cream, with the paint chipping away in several areas. One arm is bent at the elbow to hold a book or tablet against the figure's chest. The figure stands on a sturdy, cylindrical base.

title: Virgin and Child (from the church of Saint Martin of Angers)
alt_text: A limestone sculpture shows a standing, robed figure against a solid black background. The figure wears long, pleated garments that appear worn and are painted in muted tones of red, grey, and off-white. The upper body and head are heavily damaged, with the facial features and upper torso mostly missing or worn smooth. The figure stands on a thick, rectangular base that shows patches of faded red paint. The surface texture is rough and uneven throughout the piece, suggesting significant age and weathering.

title: Saint John the Evangelist (from the church of Saint Martin of Angers)
alt_text: A limestone sculpture shows a standing figure draped in long, heavy robes. The figure’s head is missing, and it holds a rectangular, dark-colored object near its chest with both hands. Behind where the head should be, a large, circular halo rises upward, featuring a small raised circle in its center. The statue has remnants of painted colors, including faded reds and blues on the fabric folds. The entire piece stands on a thick, uneven base against a plain black background.

title: Sur La Plage -- Retour du Pardon
alt_text: A painting showing a group of people walking across a flat, light-colored landscape under a cloudy sky. The ground appears to be wet or icy, reflecting the light from above. Several figures in pink, orange, and blue coats stand together on the right side of the frame. Above them, large, fluffy clouds in shades of purple and grey dominate the sky. The horizon is a thin, pale yellow line separating the ground from the sky.

title: James Fenimore Cooper (1789-1851), Class of 1806
alt_text: A painting of a man shows him from the chest up, seated and looking directly at the viewer. He has short, light brown hair that is parted on one side and blue eyes. He wears a dark, heavy coat with a high collar and brass buttons over a white shirt with a small, ruffled cravat at his neck. His hands are clasped together and rest on the arm of a wooden chair. The background is a simple, plain wall painted in shades of light yellow and beige.

title: Road up the Hill: Cornwall, Connecticut
alt_text: A painting of a quiet landscape showing a cluster of tall, leafy trees standing on a small hill. The trees dominate the upper center of the frame, with deep green foliage and thin, vertical trunks. In the foreground, a gentle grassy slope stretches across the bottom, appearing mostly brown and muted green with hints of reddish color. Behind the trees, the sky looks soft, cloudy, and somewhat overcast. The entire scene is enclosed within a dark, decorative wooden frame, with a small white tag attached to the bottom edge.

title: Female Figure Heavily Draped in Red
alt_text: A painting of a woman with long, dark hair looking down while wearing a flowing red robe over a greenish dress. She sits at a table or stone ledge, holding an open book with light-colored pages in her left hand. The book has dark writing on its pages. To her left, resting on the ledge, is a human skull that looks slightly shadowed. The background is dark and indistinct, focusing the viewer's attention on the woman.

title: The Concert
alt_text: A textile of wool and silk depicting a detailed landscape filled with many people, animals, and buildings set against a dark background. The scene is filled with tiered platforms that hold small pavilions and groups of figures wearing colorful robes and hats. On the right side, a procession of people rides horses across the landscape. The entire image is surrounded by a wide, lighter-colored border decorated with patterns of flowers, fruits, and garlands. Various birds and small, leafy trees are scattered throughout the scene, adding to the crowded and active atmosphere.

title: The Toilet of the Princess
alt_text: A textile of wool and silk shows a dark, layered landscape filled with small figures, structures, and exotic plants. The scene is divided into several sections by rolling hills and patches of stylized trees and foliage. People dressed in ornate, light-colored clothing are scattered throughout, standing, sitting, or walking across a red bridge. Animals, including large birds with long, colorful tails, are perched in the trees and near the water. The entire piece is enclosed by a wide, decorative border featuring garlands of fruit, flowers, and vines.

title: The Promenade
alt_text: A wool and silk textile shows a dark landscape filled with small islands, buildings, and figures. The entire scene is framed by a decorative border of fruits, flowers, and climbing animals. Within the dark space, several small structures resemble pagodas or open temples, some holding people inside. People walk between the islands, and a musician plays a large harp while sitting near a palm tree in the lower right corner. Exotic birds fly between the floating patches of ground, which are scattered across the dark background.

title: Walter Chauncey Camp (1859-1925), B.A.1880, M.A.(Hon.) 1908
alt_text: A painting of a man emerging from the shadows. The portrait is framed in a simple, rectangular gold-colored border. Most of the canvas is covered in dark blue horizontal stripes that distort the figure. The man's face and one hand are visible but appear blurry and faint through the dark lines. The overall effect creates a sense of depth and mystery.

title: East Rock
alt_text: A painting of a vast landscape shows a large, steep cliff rising in the distance under a pale blue sky. In the foreground, a dry, open field stretches across the bottom of the scene with scattered trees and bushes in shades of orange and brown. A simple wooden fence made of thin posts runs from the bottom right corner toward the middle of the field. Several tall, slender trees stand in the middle ground, their leaves tinged with autumnal colors. The overall color palette is warm and earthy, suggesting the season is autumn.

title: Firedog (Venus), one of a pair
alt_text: A gilt bronze object shows a human figure sitting on an ornate, curving structure. The central figure has their hair pulled up and wears draped cloth around their lower body. They hold a thin, dark wire or string that extends outward to the right side of the frame. The entire base is decorated with elaborate, scrolling leaf-like patterns in a metallic gold color. Small, decorative finials shaped like vases or urns sit on the lower parts of the frame.

title: Diana and Her Attendants among the Constellations
alt_text: A painting of figures floating in the clouds inside an octagonal frame. In the center, several nude and partially draped figures are posed in dynamic positions, appearing to drift through a sky filled with wispy, pink and blue clouds. The edges of the painting feature golden, crescent-shaped bands that contain relief-like figures of animals and people alongside carved lettering. One prominent male figure on the left reaches upward with both arms extended wide. Near the bottom, a small winged figure rests their head on their hand while looking toward the right. To the lower right, a fair-haired female figure reclines while extending a hand filled with flowers.

title: Archibald Henderson 1877-1963
alt_text: A bronze relief sculpture depicts the profile of a man facing toward the left side of the frame. The man has short, neatly styled hair, a thin mustache, and wears a collared jacket. At the top left, the words "ARS ET SCIENTIA" are embossed in capital letters, accompanied by a small drawing of a quill pen and a divider tool in the upper right corner. The man's name, "ARCHIBALD HENDERSON," appears in large letters at the bottom of the plaque. Below the name, a small spray of leaves sits in the bottom left corner. The entire scene is set against a textured, dark bronze background.

title: Mr. Simon Sterne (the donor's father)
alt_text: A painted plaster cast sculpture shows the head and shoulders of a man. He has short hair that is combed back from his forehead. A thick mustache covers his upper lip. His eyes look straight ahead with a serious expression. He wears simple, draped clothing around his neck and shoulders. The entire surface has a dull, brownish color.

title: An Interior
alt_text: A painting of a dimly lit interior room with green walls covered in numerous framed pictures. On the left side of the room, there is a dark wooden desk with drawers.
