In the center, a light-colored double door stands against the wall, flanked by two wooden chairs. To the right, a long green sofa sits against the wall, with a small fireplace visible on the far right edge. The floor is made of dark wood planks that stretch across the entire bottom of the view.

title: Head of a Saint (?)
alt_text: A fresco painting shows the side profile of a man with long, wavy hair and a beard. The figure is positioned to look toward the left side of the frame. He has dark, sunken eyes and visible lines on his forehead and cheeks. His clothing is painted in dark, muted tones of green and black. The painting appears as a fragmented piece with rough, uneven edges against a light-colored, stony background.

title: Processional Crucifix (from the Church of Sant Miquel de Prats, Canillo, Andorra)
alt_text: A wooden sculpture shows a stylized figure attached to a tall, cross-shaped board. The vertical board has wide, circular ends at the top and bottom, and horizontal arms that extend outward. A carved, bearded human figure is mounted in the center, stretching their arms straight across the crossbar. The figure wears a long, robe-like garment that reaches down to their ankles. The wood appears aged, with worn, light-colored paint still clinging to the surface, especially around the circular decorations.

title: Cross
alt_text: A sculpture of a man on a wooden cross hangs against a plain, light background. The figure is carved with his arms stretched out wide to reach the horizontal bar of the cross. He wears a cloth wrapped around his waist that hangs down loosely on both sides. A crown-like shape sits on top of his head, and his face looks downward. The sculpture appears to be made of carved material with visible texture.

title: God the Father
alt_text: A sculpture of a man made from gilded wood shows a bearded figure with long hair wearing flowing robes. The figure is positioned from the waist up and appears to be sitting inside a white foam storage box. His right hand is raised with fingers pointing upward, and his left hand rests on a large, round sphere. The man’s face has a solemn expression with deep-set eyes. The surface of the sculpture shows signs of wear, with some of the gold paint worn away to reveal darker wood underneath.

title: Commodore Edward Tyng (1683-1755) (formerly attributed to John Smibert)
alt_text: A painting showing a man in an 18th-century coat and wig, standing against a dark background. He faces forward with his head slightly turned, and he wears a long, light-colored necktie over an ornate vest. One of his hands is tucked under his arm while the other hand points toward a ship in the distance on the left side of the frame. The ship has multiple masts and appears to be sailing on water. He holds a long, thin object, likely a baton or cane, in his right hand.

title: Arthur Murphy (1727–1805)
alt_text: A painting of a man seated at a table. The man is wearing a dark coat and a pale necktie. He is holding a small, open book and looking toward his right. The portrait is housed in a wide, ornate gold frame. The painting sits on the floor in a storage room filled with other framed pictures leaning against shelves.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting shows a desert scene framed in an ornate gold border. In the center, a large, tan-colored building with a small dome stands on dry land next to a body of water. Along the water's edge, a few small figures in robes and a horse appear to be resting or working. The background is a flat, pale landscape under a light blue sky with wispy clouds. The entire scene is enclosed in a heavy, highly decorated gold frame with leaf-like patterns.

title: The White Barn
alt_text: A painting of a rolling green landscape with a small house and some outbuildings. A grassy hill rises in the center of the scene, dotted with several trees and bushes against a pale sky. In the foreground, a low stone wall cuts across the grassy field where a small figure stands near the center. To the left, a single, larger house with a light-colored roof sits near the stone wall. Several darker, smaller structures are nestled along the middle ground behind the wall. The painting is enclosed in a thick, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: James Jackson Jarves (1818-1888)
medium: Bronze, dark brown and bronze patina
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man seen in profile against a dark brown, rectangular background. The man has a thick, wavy beard and matching hair that sits neatly against his head. He is shown from the chest up and wears a collared jacket with a visible button on the side. The surface has a metallic, dark finish that creates highlights on his forehead, nose, and jacket lapel. Text is etched into the upper left and lower left corners, along with a date in the bottom center.

title: Lydia at the Table
alt_text: A painting shows a young woman sitting at a table. She has dark hair pulled back and is wearing a solid green long-sleeved shirt with a wide, ruffled collar that has small red and blue dots. Her hands are clasped under her chin, and she looks downward with a serious expression. Behind her, part of a dark wooden chair with floral carvings is visible. The background is a dusty, reddish-brown color, matching the surface of the table where she rests her arms.

title: Anne Hope Bennett (1874–1942)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a chair, shown from the waist up. She has dark hair styled up and looks directly toward the viewer with a calm expression. She wears a reddish-purple, loose outer garment over a light-colored blouse. Her hands are clasped together in her lap as she rests her arms on the chair. The portrait is surrounded by a dark frame decorated with shiny gold scrollwork patterns. A small white tag with black numbers is attached to the bottom of the frame.

title: Sibyl
alt_text: A painting of a person with dark hair pulled back from their face. The subject has high cheekbones, dark eyes, and bright red lips. They have a long, slender neck and wear a thick, round collar that sits around their shoulders. The background is a soft, blended brown, and the portrait is inside a simple, metallic frame. Two small white blocks support the bottom of the frame, and a yellow identification tag hangs from the top right corner.

title: Cassone
alt_text: A gilt piece of furniture, appearing as a rectangular wooden chest, shows a carved decorative panel on its front. The chest is a weathered gold color, with worn surfaces revealing darker wood underneath. A central relief carving depicts four standing figures dressed in long, flowing robes. On either side of the figures, two ornate vases stand atop carved pedestals. Further out on both ends, two larger figures are shown in motion, each riding a horse-like creature. The entire chest has a flat, thick lid that rests on top of the carved body.

title: Les Coureurs
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of three men leaning forward in a dynamic group. They are positioned one behind the other and appear to be lunging or racing. All three figures are nude and have athletic, muscular builds. They stretch their arms out in front of them while their legs extend behind them. The group stands on a small, dark rock-like base that sits atop a pedestal.

title: Timothy Dwight (1828-1916), B.A. 1849, M.A. 1852, D.D. 1886
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in a formal pose. He is an older, bald man with white sideburns, and he wears a long, flowing black robe over a black suit and white shirt. His right hand rests on the back of a wooden chair and holds a small roll of white paper. His left hand rests on the edge of a table draped with a dark blue cloth. The background is a plain, dark gray wall with subtle vertical lines.

title: Henry W. Allis (c. 1824-1841), class of 1844
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory portrait shows a young person with light brown hair parted to the side. They are wearing a black coat with a white shirt and a dark necktie. The figure is centered against a soft, pale blue background that fades toward the edges. The painting is encased in a simple, dark, square wooden frame. A small metal hanging loop is attached to the top of the frame.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a quiet, wooded path at dusk. On the right side, a tall tree stands prominently near a shadowy, rocky hillside. Two small figures in light-colored clothing stand in the lower center along a dirt path. In the distance to the left, soft hills and faint building structures are visible against a hazy horizon. The sky above is filled with warm, muted clouds colored in light peach and grey tones.

title: Tapestry
alt_text: A textile of wool and silk shows a scene featuring a garden structure with tall, decorative columns covered in vines. In the foreground, a seated person in flowing robes is positioned to the left, while a standing person in similar attire appears on the right. The background behind the columns depicts bushes, trees, and glimpses of a distant landscape. A wide, decorative border surrounds the entire scene, filled with patterns of flying birds and leafy plants. The bottom edge of the image features a patterned strip with a small bird figure in each corner.

title: Bellerophon Attacking the Chimera
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows a scene carved in relief against a smooth white background. In the center, a nude figure with wings rides a horse while holding a long spear pointed downward. Below the rider, a winged lion-like creature with an open mouth stands on a rocky mound. The horse and the creature both appear to be in mid-motion, with their wings spread wide. A small, thin crescent moon hangs in the upper right corner of the scene.

title: View of Yale University and New Haven Green
alt_text: A painting showing a park with two people resting under a tree in the foreground. On the right, a large tree with dark green leaves towers over a pair of people sitting together on the grass. To the left, a white fence wraps around a field, leading the eye toward several buildings with columns in the distance. The background features more trees and a sky filled with large, wispy white clouds. The overall scene is quiet and has a muted, somewhat dark color palette.

title: Aaron Nichols Skinner (1800–1858), B.A. 1823, M.A. 1828
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up. The portrait is oval-shaped and set inside a square, dark-colored frame. The man has short, dark hair and pale skin, and he wears a dark jacket with a high white collar. A dark scarf or cravat is tied around his neck. Below the oval, a small, worn rectangular label is attached to the frame with printed text.

title: Colonel John Trumbull (1756-1843)
alt_text: A painting of a man with graying hair who sits for a portrait while looking directly at the viewer. He wears a dark, tailored coat over a white shirt with a ruffled cravat around his neck. His right hand rests near a wooden artist's palette holding small piles of paint and several brushes, which sits on a green surface next to a gold-handled sword. In his left hand, the man holds a large, rolled-up sheet of white paper. A plain, muted background with a hint of a column design behind him keeps the focus on his upper body.

title: Thetis Giving the Infant Achilles to Chiron and Achilles and Chiron Hunting a Lion
alt_text: A jasperware ceramic relief shows several white figures against a black background. On the far left, a draped figure stands facing a horse-bodied man, who holds a small child up toward her. In the center, a horse-bodied figure gallops to the right with a small figure riding on its back while aiming a bow and arrow. To the right of the galloping figure, a lion leaps forward with an arrow stuck in its side. A simple column stands on the far right edge of the scene near a small leafy branch. The figures are arranged in a horizontal row, resembling a classic decorative frieze.

title: Dr. Lemuel Hopkins (1750–1801), M.A. (Hon.) 1784
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up against a plain, brown background. The man has pale skin, brown hair that is wavy and worn at ear-length, and wide, light-colored eyes. He wears a dark, possibly black, coat over a high-collared white shirt with ruffles at the neck. His hands are clasped together at the bottom of the frame, resting on what appears to be the spine of a book or a similar object. The man looks directly at the viewer with a serious expression.

title: Figure with Two Hounds
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on a rock in a wooded area with two tall, thin dogs. The woman wears a short, light-colored dress with a wide belt and tall boots, and she holds a thin leash that connects to the dogs. Next to her on the rock lies a bright red cloth and a curved horn. The two dogs are light tan or cream-colored and sit calmly on the ground in the foreground. Green trees and leaves fill the background, creating a soft and shaded forest setting.

title: Study of a Woman in a Brown Dress
alt_text: A painting of a young person wearing a white bonnet and a light brown jacket. The person faces forward with a calm expression, and their hands are clasped together in their lap. They wear a light blue skirt underneath the jacket, which is tied at the neck with a white ribbon. The background is a simple, muted grey-blue color. The entire portrait is framed in a plain, rectangular metal frame.

title: Study of a Male Nude Leaning on a Staff
alt_text: A painting of a nude man standing tall against a dark, plain background. He is a muscular figure with a short, dark beard who holds a straight, thin wooden staff in his right hand. Beside him, in the lower right corner, sits a second man shown only from the waist up. This second figure wears a white coat and a bright red cap while looking toward the right. Writing and scribbles are faintly visible in the upper left corner of the dark background.

title: Study of a back of Male Nude
alt_text: A painting of a muscular male figure seen from the back. The figure is centered and shown from the shoulders down to the hips, appearing against a dark, mottled background. The person's skin is pale and highlighted by light from the side, emphasizing the curves of the shoulder blades and back muscles. One hand rests on the hip, while the other arm hangs down loosely at the side. The surface of the canvas shows several horizontal lines of wear or damage that run across the figure.

title: Study of a Seated Male Nude
alt_text: A painting of a seated man with a bare torso and dark hair. The figure is positioned slightly to the right, with his head tilted down and looking forward. His skin is pale against a deep, dark green and black background. The canvas appears to be damaged, with several horizontal lines across the surface where the material may be creased or joined. The edges of the painting are frayed and worn.

title: Study of a Standing Male Nude
alt_text: A painting showing a nude male figure standing against a dark, muted background. The figure faces toward the left with his upper body hunched forward and his arms raised near his head. His weight rests on his back leg, while his front leg is slightly bent. The surface of the painting appears worn, with visible creases and light-colored scratches throughout the dark background. The edges of the canvas are frayed and rough, suggesting an unfinished or weathered piece.

title: Male Nude Study
alt_text: A painting of a nude man seated on a draped stool. The man has dark, wavy hair and is looking to his left with his right arm extended outward. He sits perched on a small, box-like seat covered with a muted, teal-green cloth. His left leg is bent with his foot resting on the stool, while his right leg extends straight down toward the floor. The background is a flat, dark grey surface that emphasizes the figure. Two horizontal, faint lines stretch across the entire composition, suggesting that the canvas is made of three joined sections.

title: Nude Study of a Man
alt_text: A painting of a nude young man stands against a dark, shadowy background. He is turned slightly to the side with his head tilted down, looking toward his hands. In his left hand, he holds a small, rectangular wooden object and a thin stick or tool. Behind him, on the left side of the frame, the round face of an analog clock is partially visible against a reddish wall. The lighting highlights his chest and arms while keeping much of the rest of the scene in deep shadow.

title: Timothy Pitkin (1726-1812), B.A. 1747
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair, shown from the chest up. The man has pale skin, a serious expression, and short white hair worn in a style that puffs out on the sides. He wears a dark, long-sleeved jacket over a white collared shirt with two white rectangular tabs hanging down the front of his chest. His right hand rests on his lap and holds a thin, light-colored book or pamphlet. He sits in a dark, curved wooden chair upholstered with reddish-brown fabric. The background is a simple, shaded wall with a curved arch shape behind the man.

title: Ezra Stiles (1727-1795), B.A.1746, M.A.1749
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up, framed within a dark oval. He has short brown hair covered by a soft, tan-colored cap. The man wears a dark vest over a white shirt, topped with a shiny, patterned brown robe. In his right hand, he holds a small, rectangular book with a bright red cover. He gazes directly forward with a neutral, calm expression against a dark background.

title: The Angel Abdiel
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a young winged figure standing against a plain gray background. The figure has curly hair and wears a helmet with a crest on top. He is dressed in armor on his chest and a short skirt that hangs to his mid-thigh. Large, textured wings extend from his back, rising behind his shoulders. One hand is bent near his chest, while the other hand rests at his side near a stone pillar.

title: The Angel Warning Saint John
alt_text: A marble sculpture showing two figures in profile against a flat stone background. On the left, an older man with a beard kneels on the ground with his hands held out in front of him. He is draped in fabric that falls around his body. To his right stands a winged figure who is slightly taller and faces the kneeling man. This winged figure has curly hair, wears simple drapery, and has one arm raised.

title: Aeschines
alt_text: A white marble sculpture shows a man standing and wearing long, draped fabric. The man has short, curly hair and a short beard, and he looks toward his left. His right arm is bent across his chest, with his hand tucked into the fabric. The heavy cloth wraps around his body and hangs down to his feet. He wears sandals on his feet and stands on a rectangular base against a solid, dark gray background.

title: Fragment
medium: Linen ground with red silk thread
alt_text: A textile on a linen ground with red silk thread shows an embroidered scene full of figures, plants, and animals. On the left, a winged figure stands near a small building, while a person sits resting their chin on their hand upon a large tree stump in the center. To the right, another person appears to be emerging from or sitting in a body of water filled with fish. A large branching tree stretches across the top of the scene, and a small animal is crouched on the ground near the center. The bottom edge features a repeated floral or geometric pattern running horizontally.

title: Virgin and Child Surrounded by Heads of Saints and Prophets
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a central scene surrounded by a border of small figures. In the middle, a woman sits on a chair while holding a child on her lap. To her left and right, two tall figures in green robes stand with their hands raised toward her. All the central figures have round halos behind their heads against a gold background. A border runs around the edges of the painting, filled with small square panels, each containing a bust of a bearded man holding a scroll.

title: The Crucifixion with the mourning Virgin and Saints John the Evangelist and Mary Magdalen
alt_text: A painting of a cross with a figure on it, set against a gold background. A central figure hangs on a cross, with three other figures standing or kneeling around the base. To the left, a person stands partially obscured by dark robes. In the center, another person kneels while facing the figure on the cross. On the right, a third person stands wearing light-colored, flowing robes and looks upward. Each of the four figures has a round, textured halo behind their head.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting shows an adult figure holding a small child against a golden background. The adult wears a dark, hooded robe that covers their head and shoulders. The child, who is naked, sits in the adult's arms while wrapped in a small, reddish cloth. Both figures have faint, circular halos painted behind their heads. The entire scene is framed within an arched wooden structure that has carved details at the bottom.

title: Virgin and Child with two Saints and Angels
alt_text: A painting on a wood panel shows a woman holding a small child. The woman wears a dark robe over her head and shoulders, and she looks down toward the child. The child is wrapped in white cloth and faces slightly to the left. Behind them are three other figures with halos around their heads, looking out toward the viewer. The background is a faded gold color, and the top of the panel is arched.

title: The Baptism of Christ and Saint John
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows two separate scenes side-by-side, framed by decorative gold carvings. In the left scene, a man with a beard pours water over the head of a shirtless man standing in a stream, while a group of figures in red and gold robes watches from the left side. Above them, a bearded figure in blue robes floats within a gold-patterned cloud. The right scene features a person in a red robe writing in a book on a rocky ledge, with a large black bird perched behind them and another floating figure above. The background of both scenes is filled with raised, ornate gold leaf patterns and small, stylized landscapes.

title: The Martyrdom of Saint Catherine
alt_text: A painting of a central figure kneeling with their arms tied to a pole between two spiked wooden wheels. To the left, a man wearing a golden crown and patterned red robes sits on a throne while a man in a dark cap stands behind him. Two other men in colorful red and green clothing sit on the floor in the foreground, watching the scene. Above the central figure, a winged angel with a gold halo flies downward, pointing a long sword toward the wheels. The scene takes place on a tiled floor with a light-colored wall in the background.

title: Investiture of San Ildefonso
alt_text: A painting of a man kneeling while surrounded by two figures above him. The man in the center wears a pale, patterned robe with his arms crossed over his chest, and he looks slightly upward. To his left, a woman with long dark hair wears a red dress and a golden crown. To his right, an angel with large wings leans forward with a hand resting on the man's shoulder. A large, curved, golden arch partially frames the heads of the man and the figures above him. The background is a dark, warm, muted gold color.

title: Harriet Wadsworth (1769–1793)
alt_text: A miniature painting on wood shows the portrait of a young woman inside an oval frame. She has curly blonde hair, light skin with rosy cheeks, and is looking slightly to her right. The woman wears a white dress with a ruffled collar that sits high around her neck. Her hair is styled up and held in place by a thin white headband. The portrait is set within a gold-colored frame that has small, raised beads along the edge. The text written around the frame identifies the subject of the portrait.

title: Four Cuttings from an Antiphonary with Initial Letters
medium: Tempera and gold leaf on parchment
alt_text: A manuscript illustration using tempera and gold leaf on parchment showing four distinct, decorative letter frames. The top left frame is a dark blue, stylized shape with a green floral pattern set against a gold background. To the right, a rounded shape frames a bearded man in red robes wearing a tall, pointed hat while holding a book. The bottom left frame contains a bearded man in a red hat and green coat, who rests his hand near his face. Finally, the bottom right frame shows a winged figure with light hair holding a small, white musical instrument.

title: Cuttings from an Antiphonary (?): Six Initial Letters, U or V, E, S, G, B, B
alt_text: A manuscript page fragment showing six ornate, illuminated letters arranged in a two-by-three grid. Each square contains a large, stylized letter filled with intricate floral and leafy patterns. These letters are painted in vibrant shades of pink, blue, and green against a shiny gold background. The designs feature swirling lines, small circular accents, and delicate decorative flourishes that fill the space within and around the characters. Each letter occupies its own distinct rectangular border within the overall composition.

title: Initial "G" with the Virgin and Child Enthroned
alt_text: An illuminated manuscript page shows a woman holding a child within a large, C-shaped letter. The woman wears a long blue head covering and a bright red dress, while the child is wrapped in white cloth and a light green tunic. Both figures have gold circles behind their heads that look like glowing halos. The surrounding letter is painted in thick blue, orange, and light green colors with decorative swirls. The entire scene is set against a background of gold leaf, which is filled with small, white, star-like markings.

title: Figure of an Allegory (possibly Thrift)
alt_text: An oak sculpture of a woman sits posed with her body angled toward the left. She has her hair pulled back into a simple bun and her head tilted down. She wears a long, loose garment with a wide, decorated belt at her waist. Her legs are crossed, with one bare foot hanging down toward the bottom right. Her left hand is slightly raised and extended forward. The dark wood of the figure stands out against a light, plain background.

title: Palette
alt_text: An artist's palette sits on a flat, tan-colored surface. The palette is a flat, irregularly shaped oval piece of wood with a thumb hole near the top edge. A large patch of dried, light gray paint dominates the center of the surface. Surrounding this gray area are dark, rough stains of dried paint in various shades of brown, black, yellow, and red. A long, thin crack runs horizontally across the middle of the wood.

title: Nathan Loomis (1794-1876)
alt_text: A painting of an older man with a long, thick white beard and thinning white hair. He is wearing a dark, textured coat with a wide, white cravat or collar visible at his neck. His face is turned slightly to the right, and his expression is neutral. The entire painting has a pattern of fine cracks running across the surface. The portrait is framed in a simple, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: Hill
alt_text: A painting shows abstract shapes in bold, visible brushstrokes against a plain background. The center is dominated by large, dark black forms that stand vertically. To the left and below these dark shapes are patches of bright orange, green, and red paint. The upper right and left corners feature swaths of blue, while the lower right side has a large area of pink. Thick layers of paint create a textured appearance across the entire surface.

title: Doux Pays (Pleasant Land)
alt_text: A painting shows a group of figures resting and playing in a sunny, outdoor setting near the sea. On the left, a person stands partially hidden by a large tree while others sit on the ground, some with baskets of fruit. In the center, two young figures play or wrestle on the dirt ground. To the right, a person in a white garment stands near a basket, while another figure reclines on the edge of a cliff. Beyond the land, a dark blue body of water stretches out with a small white sailboat visible in the distance. The overall scene uses muted, earthy tones under a soft, golden sky.

title: Admiral Sir John Beresford
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a dark military-style uniform. He is shown from the chest up, facing slightly to his right while looking toward the viewer with a calm expression. His dark coat features gold decorative details on the shoulders and lapels, and a ruffled white cloth is visible at his neck. The background is a blurry, dark brown wash that creates a soft contrast with his face. The portrait is held in a wide, ornately carved gold frame.

title: Star Bead Flask
alt_text: A glass container shaped like a long, thin bottle stands centered against a neutral background. The base is a rounded, bulbous shape that narrows into a slender, pointed neck at the top. The entire surface is covered in a colorful, mottled pattern of blue, red, green, and white swirls. These swirling colors create an intricate, mosaic-like effect across the clear glass body. The bottle narrows slightly at the neck, creating a small, rounded bump before tapering to a very thin point at the opening.

title: Repentance of Nineveh
alt_text: A painting of a night scene shows a large city under a dark, stormy sky illuminated by a single bolt of lightning. In the foreground, a group of people in robes and cloaks kneel and stand on a raised stone platform, facing toward the distant city. Some individuals are bowed low toward the ground, while others stand with their heads turned or their arms raised. Below the platform, a vast, shadowy landscape stretches out, filled with numerous dark, indistinct figures. To the right, part of a large architectural structure with arches and columns stands at the edge of the scene.

title: Frontier No. 1
alt_text: A painting on composition board showing a large, abstract shape of thick black paint centered against a cream-colored background. The black paint forms a jagged, asymmetrical silhouette that looks like a heavy, sprawling mark with textured edges. To the left, a smaller patch of lighter, white paint overlaps the cream background. Several small, isolated black splatters and flecks are scattered around the main shape and across the surface. The brushstrokes appear forceful and layered, leaving varied textures throughout the dark center.

title: Yarmouth Beach
alt_text: A painting shows a quiet coastal scene with a sandy beach and calm water under a cloudy, pale sky. In the foreground, several people are gathered on the shore, some working with large round baskets. A person stands near the water holding a long pole, while horses rest nearby on the sand. Further to the right, a few boats are pulled up onto the land near some dark buildings. A long wooden pier extends out into the distance across the calm sea. Small sailboats are faintly visible floating far out on the horizon.

title: Poster Portrait: Duncan
alt_text: A painting of a sign with a pink background and a black border. The large, bold black letters spelling "C. DUNCAN" are centered in the upper portion of the image. A horizontal stripe colored with a rainbow gradient crosses over the middle of the lettering. Below this stripe, a circular black shape contains a drawing of a white flower with dark leaves. The entire design is set against a red and white background inside a thick, plain white frame.

title: Capital with Head and Foliage
alt_text: A limestone sculpture of a carved architectural block shows a human head and decorative foliage. The block has a flat, rectangular top ledge that projects over the carved forms below. On the left side, the face of a person with wavy hair peers forward, tilted slightly downward. Next to the face, the right side of the block features rounded, leafy carvings that wrap around a small, vertical pillar shape. The entire piece is made of rough, grey-toned stone with visible weathering and worn textures.

title: Saint John the Baptist
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a standing man with long, wavy hair and a full beard. He wears a textured garment that covers his upper body and long, draping robes that fall to his feet. His right arm is bent near his waist, while his left arm appears to be missing below the shoulder. The figure’s left leg is crossed over his right, and both feet are bare, standing on a circular base. The entire sculpture is carved from a single piece of dark, brown-toned wood against a plain gray background.

title: Lazarus and the Rich Man
alt_text: A walnut relief sculpture shows an elaborate architectural scene filled with multiple figures. To the left, a large building features arches and detailed balconies where figures are seated. Below this structure, swirling, flame-like patterns occupy the lower section. To the right, a person walks down a set of stairs towards a doorway. Another figure stands near the base of the stairs, seemingly leaning against a wall. The entire scene is presented within a wide, simple wooden frame.

title: Shepherd Stevens (1880–1962, B.F.A. 1922, M.A. (Hon.))
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting at a desk in a dimly lit room. The man has short brown hair and a mustache, and he wears a dark suit with a red bow tie. He sits in a wooden chair, facing slightly to the side while holding a small, dark object in one hand. On the table in front of him sits an open book and a small stack of other books. To the left, a tall, thin brass lamp with a single candle stands on the desk. The background is a soft, muted mix of brown and green tones that look like fabric or leaves.

title: The Temptation of Adam
alt_text: A brass sculpture showing two people standing near a tree. On the left, a man sits on a rock, looking down and away from the center. To his right, a woman stands and reaches up toward the branches of a tree. A long snake winds its body around the tree trunk between them. The entire relief has a golden, metallic finish with rough textures on the background.

title: Antaeus
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man moving in the air. The man appears to be floating or leaping against a tall, light-colored rectangular stone panel. He has a beard and short, curly hair. His body is bent backward with his arms reaching forward as if he is falling or diving. His legs are kicked back, creating a sense of dynamic motion.

title: Hercules
medium: Hollow-cast bronze; fully chased and highly polished with dark-brown natural patina (Seymour 1962).
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a nude, bearded man stands on a round pedestal. The man is shown from the waist up in a slight twist, with his head turned to his left. He has a muscular build and curly hair. He holds a straight, stick-like object in his hands across his torso. The figure rests on a cylindrical base made of reddish-brown, mottled stone.

title: Allegory of Summer
medium: Figure: bronze; base: wood and gilded metal
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a standing nude female figure holding a torch. She stands straight on a simple, round, dark base. Her right arm is raised, holding a small torch with a flame pointing upward. Her left arm hangs down by her side, holding what looks like a bundle of leaves or branches. Her hair is styled in short, wavy curls that frame her face. The surface of the statue is smooth and dark, reflecting light in several places.

title: Venus Marina
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a standing, nude woman. She is facing slightly to the right with her head turned to look in that same direction. Her left arm is raised above her head, with her hand holding a small, flat object. Her right arm is extended out to her side, with her index finger pointing outward. She stands on a small, textured, cylindrical base that looks like a rock or a mound. The sculpture has a dark, metallic, brownish-gray color throughout.

title: Dalmatic
alt_text: A silk garment lies flat on a light-colored surface. The apparel features heavy, golden embroidery in intricate floral and scrollwork patterns across its entire surface. A large, circular emblem with a face sits prominently in the center of the piece, flanked by two small figures on either side. Thick bands of gold thread form a large rectangle around this central design. The fabric appears to be stiff and richly decorated with colored threads of blue, orange, and green. A small black label with the number "1956.36.2" rests on the table just below the hem of the clothing.

title: Chasuble
alt_text: A silk costume garment shows a long, sleeveless robe in deep red. A light-colored, cream-toned panel sits in the center, featuring colorful embroidered flowers and vines. Bright, textured gold fabric trims the edges of this central panel and follows the rounded shape of the neckline. The garment has a distinct, elongated bell shape that widens toward the bottom. A small black rectangular label with white text appears in the upper left corner of the image.

title: Chasuble of gold and polychrome silk embroidery
medium: Linen ground cloth, silk grounds, silk embroidery threads, metallic silk core embroidery threads, silk lining, linen interlining.
alt_text: An embroidered garment shows a sleeveless tunic-like shape decorated with gold thread and colorful flowers. The front of the item features a vertical center panel with two blooming flower designs stacked above a decorative vase. On both the left and right sides of this central design, larger flowers bloom outward in shades of red, blue, and pink. Thick bands of shiny gold embroidery outline the edges of the garment and frame these floral scenes. The background of the piece is a pale, off-white fabric that appears clearly along the outer borders.

title: Chasuble of compound cloth, brocaded.
alt_text: A piece of clothing showing an ornate, sleeveless garment with a curved, rounded bottom edge. The main body of the garment is covered in a pattern of raised, gold-colored semicircles that resemble scales or fan shapes. A vertical band of shiny, textured gold fabric runs down the center, dividing the scales into two symmetrical sides. Small, colorful flower-like accents are tucked between some of the gold scales. The entire piece is lined or bordered by a deep red fabric that is visible around the edges and at the collar opening.

title: Chasuble
alt_text: A piece of apparel shows a long, sleeveless garment made of pink fabric covered in a pattern of small flowers. Broad, gold-colored bands run vertically down the front of the garment, outlining the armholes and framing the center panel. A similar gold band also lines the curved bottom hem. The fabric displays repeating floral bouquets in shades of white, yellow, and green. A small color chart and text label appear in the upper left corner against the dark background.

title: Front of a Chasuble
alt_text: An item of clothing made of silk and metallic embroidery is shaped like a bell with a smaller, rectangular top section attached to a wider, triangular base. The entire surface is covered in ornate, shimmering gold-colored stitching. Intricate designs featuring colorful flowers, leaves, and small winged figures are worked into the metallic fabric across the front. The edges of the piece are finished with a textured, scalloped border of gold thread. This garment appears to have a stiff, ornate quality, set against a dark background.

title: Chasuble (a) and burse (b)
alt_text: An apparel costume made of silk and metallic embroidery features a deep purple garment shaped like a sleeveless vest or tabard. The fabric has a subtle, tone-on-tone pattern of floral and leaf designs woven into the silk. Bright gold metallic trim outlines the rounded neck, forms two vertical bands down the front, and borders the entire outer edge of the piece. The garment is presented flat against a plain, off-white background and is held in place by small, clear clips at the shoulders.

title: Chasuble
medium: Silk fabric, silk and metallic supplementary weft, linen lining
alt_text: A garment made of red silk fabric is shown against a dark grey background. The sleeveless tunic features a long, central panel decorated with intricate patterns of small flowers and foliage in gold, white, and blue. Thick, shiny gold bands frame this central red section and line the armholes and the rounded hem at the bottom. Underneath the vibrant red material, a plain grey lining is visible. Near the top left corner, a small color chart card is attached to the wall.

title: Front of a Chasuble
alt_text: A garment made of silk and metallic embroidery is shown against a dark background. It is a long, bell-shaped piece that is rounded at the bottom and tapers slightly toward the top. The fabric is a deep red color and is covered in detailed, shimmering gold patterns. These designs feature symmetrical floral and leafy motifs that run in vertical columns. A small color chart and labels are attached in the upper left corner outside the garment.

title: Square silk brocade panel.
alt_text: A textile showing a pattern of woven flowers in a soft, peach-colored fabric. Shiny, silvery metallic threads trace the outlines of these floral shapes across the material. A straight, silver band runs horizontally along the bottom edge of the fabric. The cloth is displayed flat on a wooden surface, with a small black label showing the number 1956.36.11 resting at the bottom. The overall tone of the fabric is warm and muted.

title: Brocade panel
alt_text: A silk textile shows a light green fabric with a shiny, gold-colored floral pattern woven into it. The fabric is draped over a support structure, creating soft folds and shadows that highlight the intricate design. A wide, bright gold band runs along the bottom edge of the cloth as a decorative border. Below this gold border, a small black label with white numbers sits on a white foam piece. A light-colored wooden frame supports the entire display from underneath.

title: Bowl with Fish Design
alt_text: A ceramic bowl shows a fish painted on its exterior. The bowl is shaped like a wide, shallow circle with a plain, light-colored interior. Its outer surface is textured with a dense pattern of tiny dark specks, which contrasts with the single, large, blue-and-white fish illustration. The fish faces to the left, and its body is detailed with overlapping scales and fins. A small paper tag with a barcode sits to the left of the bowl on the white surface.

title: Red damask bag with tassels
alt_text: A textile of silk bengaline shows an intricate golden pattern against a light, ribbed fabric background. The design features a central, stylized floral spray tied with a bow at the base. Wavy, leafy vines curve around this central motif to form an interconnected, symmetrical pattern across the surface. The fabric is rectangular and appears slightly wrinkled with loose threads along the edges. Below the fabric, a black rectangular tag displays the white numbers 1956.36.18.

title: Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting of a crucifixion scene features a figure hanging on a wooden cross against a bright, gold background. Three figures stand or kneel below the cross, looking up toward the figure on the cross. On the left, a woman wears a dark blue robe and head covering, while a woman with long blonde hair kneels in the center wearing a pink and blue dress. To the right stands a figure wearing a flowing, light green robe. Each of the four figures has a circular, ornate halo around their head. The entire scene is framed by a decorative border with a diamond pattern.

title: Plusieurs ont vécu (Many Have Lived)
alt_text: A painting of an abstract landscape features a hazy, grey-brown sky fading into a darker, horizontal striped ground. In the lower left, a cluster of small, smooth, colorful shapes stands upright, resembling organic forms or sculpted figures. To their right, a spindly, reddish-orange structure with sharp protrusions casts a long, dark shadow across the ground. Two thin, white lines reach up from the ground towards the sky, with small, unidentifiable objects appearing to float near the top of the lines. A blue-and-white spherical object sits alone in the middle right distance, near the dark stripes of the ground.

title: Sir George Henschel (1850-1934)
alt_text: A painting of a man presented from the chest up against a plain blue background. The man has a bald head with thinning, light-colored hair on the sides. He has a neatly trimmed gray beard and mustache. He wears a dark suit jacket, a light-colored button-up shirt, and a dark red necktie. The portrait is housed in a thick, ornate gold-colored wooden frame. A small rectangular identification plaque is attached to the bottom edge of the frame.

title: Anson Phelps Stokes (1874-1958), B.A. 1896, M.A. (Hon) 1900, LL.D 1921
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting and reading a book. The man has short, light-brown hair, a thin mustache, and wears round glasses. He is dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt and a black tie. He sits in a dark chair against a plain, brownish background. A simple, light-colored wooden frame surrounds the artwork.

title: Event
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes that fills the canvas. A large, rough circle of white sits near the top, partially filled in by a dark, charcoal-colored shape. This dark form extends downward, spreading out into angular, jagged edges that look like paint strokes. The background is divided into large, uneven sections of mustard yellow and olive green. There is a small, indistinct signature in the top left corner.

title: Occurrence
alt_text: A painting of abstract, organic shapes against a white background. A large, bright red curve sweeps across the right side of the frame, taking up much of the space. In the upper left, there is a smaller, rounded shape in a muted, grayish-blue color. A tiny, dark blue circle sits near the center of the canvas, between the red curve and the blue shape. The paint appears applied with visible brushstrokes, giving the edges of the shapes a rough, textured quality.

title: Blue Curve
alt_text: A painting of a large, dark blue curved shape that sweeps across a light cream-colored background. This thick blue stroke arches downward from the top left corner toward the center. Within the open curve of the blue shape, three irregular orange-red circular marks sit in a vertical row. The marks grow slightly larger from top to bottom. A small, dark signature appears in the bottom left corner of the composition.

title: The Wave
alt_text: A painting shows a dark blue shape set against a bright, textured white background. The blue shape stretches horizontally across the canvas and has a curved, fin-like point near the top. The white area fills the bottom and upper portions of the image, appearing almost like rough, swept snow. A thin, flat band of light blue color runs across the very top edge. The paint strokes are thick and visible throughout the entire composition. A small signature is painted in the lower right corner.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a quiet countryside scene at sunset. Large, dark, leafy trees occupy the left side of the frame, casting shadows over a field of tall grass. In the center, a gentle hill slopes upward, leading to more soft trees in the distance. To the far right, part of an old stone structure with columns stands near the water's edge. A small figure stands in the open grassy area near the water, looking toward the horizon. The entire scene is bathed in a warm, hazy golden light.

title: Portrait of a Man
alt_text: A painting of a man presented in an ornate, gilded gold frame. The portrait shows the man from the chest up against a dark, shadowy background. He has long, voluminous, light-brown curly hair that falls around his face and shoulders. He wears a white ruffled neck scarf and a reddish-brown coat. One of his hands is resting across his chest near the bottom of the frame.

title: Epoch
alt_text: A painting shows an abstract composition filled with irregular shapes and rough, textured brushstrokes. The surface is covered in layers of thick white paint mixed with patches of black, dark brown, and grey. Towards the right side, there are small areas of muted orange and faint purple tones. These blocks of color overlap and connect in a messy, layered arrangement that covers the entire canvas. The overall effect creates a sense of depth and movement across the surface.

title: An Art Lover
alt_text: A painting of a group of people gathered indoors near a small, ornate water fountain. Several figures wearing draped, historical-style robes stand and sit around a central table while looking at a small statue placed on top of it. To the right of the table, a white marble sculpture of a man stands on a square pedestal that spouts a stream of water into a pool below. The background features dark walls decorated with what appears to be large tapestries or wall paintings. The floor is covered with intricate, detailed tile patterns that suggest a grand hall or atrium.

title: The "Don Quixote" Curtain: "Sancho Panza"
alt_text: A painting of a surreal, cloudy scene with figures floating in the sky above a landscape. On the left, a figure with a beard rides a small horse toward the center, while a horse and rider in armor leap near two large, wooden crosses. These crosses hold large, frowning faces, and they seem to float amidst thick, dark red and black clouds. Below this chaotic sky, a bright sun shines over rolling blue hills, a small town with a tower, and a distant bridge. The bottom of the image features green fields and hills that contrast with the turbulent, stormy atmosphere above.

title: Portrait of a Woman
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing and looking directly at the viewer. She has light skin and wears a pale, possibly silver or light blue, dress with detailed lace trim around the neckline. Her light hair is styled up and adorned with a dark decorative clip. A dark red, velvety fabric is draped over one arm, featuring textured, darker accents. The background is simple and dark, contrasting with the lighter tones of her skin and clothing.

title: Red Core
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a series of vertical rectangles in different colors arranged against a light off-white background. On the far left, there is a bright yellow rectangle that runs nearly the entire height of the canvas. Next to it is a slightly shorter, pale yellow bar that blends into the background. A small, solid red rectangle sits near the bottom center of the painting. To the right of the red square is a tall, pale blue bar. On the far right edge, there is a thick, dark navy blue rectangle that extends from top to bottom.

title: Portrait of a Lady
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a young woman with wavy brown hair. Her head is turned slightly to the left, and she looks directly forward with a gentle expression. She has fair skin, soft facial features, and is wearing a simple, light-colored dress with a scooped neckline. The background consists of dark, muted, and indistinct tones that fade out around her shoulders. The brushwork throughout the piece appears soft and blended, giving the image a calm and hazy feeling.

title: Lynn Meadows
alt_text: A painting of a vast, flat landscape at dusk under a colorful sky. The horizon glows with pinks and oranges where the sun has set behind low hills. In the middle distance, a long, dark trestle bridge stretches across the water, reaching toward land on the right side. The foreground is filled with low, grassy marshland and patches of muddy, shallow water. Several small, indistinct figures stand in the shallow water on the left, looking toward the horizon. The overall scene feels quiet and hazy as evening light fades over the water and land.

title: Jedidiah Morse (1761-1826) B.A. 1783, M.A. 1786
alt_text: A painting of an older man with thinning white hair and a high forehead. He is shown from the chest up against a very dark, plain background. The man wears a dark, simple coat with a white collar visible at his neck. His expression is neutral with his eyes looking toward the viewer. A small portion of a wooden chair with a curved top is visible in the lower left corner.

title: Joshua Winslow (1694-1769)
alt_text: A painting of a man, oil on canvas, shows his upper body and head against a dark background. The man has pale skin, flushed cheeks, and white hair styled in soft curls. He wears a brownish-orange coat with gold-colored buttons, and a white collar or cravat is visible at his neck. His expression is calm, and his gaze is directed slightly toward the viewer. The painting is enclosed within a wide, ornate gold frame featuring intricate leaf and scroll designs.

title: Portrait of Robert Ladbroke, M.P.
alt_text: A painting of a man shows him from the chest up. The man has a receding hairline, pale skin, and is looking slightly toward his right. He wears a dark coat over a white collared shirt or cravat. The portrait is enclosed in a large, ornate, gold-colored frame decorated with carvings. The background behind the man is a solid, dark, and muted color.

title: Self-Portrait of the Artist in His Studio
alt_text: A painting of a man relaxing in a room, holding a violin while looking at a canvas. The man wears a white collared shirt with a red necktie and dark trousers. He sits in an armchair with his feet propped up on a small, light-colored wooden stool. To his left, a wooden artist's palette hangs on the wall near a shelf filled with books. In the foreground, a large easel holds a canvas that partially blocks the view of his legs.

title: Cityscape
alt_text: A painting of a city scene viewed from a balcony. The foreground shows a shadowed, flat balcony area with a white or light blue floor and dark blue walls. To the far left, a sheer, light-colored curtain hangs by a doorway leading inside. Beyond the balcony, the view opens up to a sprawling cityscape with scattered buildings in shades of green, red, and brown. A large, bright sky with loose, visible brushstrokes in pale blue and white hangs above the city. The entire scene is rendered in thick, expressive paint strokes.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LL.D. 1781
alt_text: A painting of a man with light skin, shown from the chest up against a dark, plain background. He wears a dark-colored coat with a high collar and a light-colored, textured scarf or cravat wrapped around his neck. His hair is white or light gray, styled in soft waves that frame his face. He has a serious expression and looks directly toward the viewer. The portrait is enclosed in a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Silvio Set Two
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and colorful splatters on a white background. Large, organic forms in deep blue dominate the composition, appearing rounded and blob-like. Scattered across the surface are bright dots and splashes of red, yellow, and green paint. Faint, curved lines and translucent washes of color connect some of these shapes. The entire image has a lively and energetic feel, like paint was thrown or dripped onto the canvas.

title: The Port of Honfleur
alt_text: A painting of a harbor scene shows a large ship anchored on the left side of the composition. In the center distance, a tall white lighthouse stands near a small building on a narrow strip of land. To the right, dark industrial-looking buildings with chimneys sit along the shoreline. The sky above is filled with thick, swirling gray and blue clouds that suggest stormy weather. Calm water reflects the ships and the structures in the foreground.

title: Sleeping Man
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair, his body leaning back with his head tilted upwards. The man wears a dark jacket and trousers over a light-colored shirt. He is seated against a simple, yellow-toned background that suggests furniture or a wall. The man's hands rest loosely by his sides, and his legs are stretched forward. The entire artwork is enclosed in a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: VONAL - K - SZ
alt_text: A painting of many rectangular shapes nested inside one another. These rectangles create a tunnel-like effect that draws the viewer’s eye toward the upper right section of the canvas. The lines are colored in alternating shades of dark blue, light blue, black, and gray. This pattern of concentric rectangles repeats as the shapes get smaller toward the center. The composition is set within a dark frame.

title: April Blue-White
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes in white against a deep blue background. The main shape is a large, wavy white form that stretches across most of the upper part of the canvas. It has curved edges and appears almost like a flat, floating cloud. Below this large shape sits a separate, smaller white circle. The blue paint fills the rest of the canvas and creates the negative space around these white forms.

title: Angel
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a tall, dark figure standing inside a storage crate. The figure has a smooth, rounded top and a textured, slender body that reaches toward the base. It is supported by a flat, square white platform on the floor of the crate. A horizontal wooden brace runs across the middle of the sculpture to keep it steady. The dark metal surface has a greenish-black tone that contrasts with the tan cardboard walls of the container. Green metal shelving poles frame the structure on both sides.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A miniature painting shows a man from the chest up. He has short, curly brown hair and pink cheeks. He wears a dark blue coat over a white shirt with a high, tied white collar. His face is framed by a thin gold oval, which is set inside a plain black square background. A small gold loop and ring sit at the very top for hanging the artwork.

title: Timothy Dwight (1752-1817) BA 1769, MA 1772
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory depicts the portrait of a fair-skinned man. The subject has short, graying hair, thin eyebrows, and a calm expression. He is wearing a dark, high-collared coat over a white shirt. The portrait is housed in an oval gold frame, which is set inside a larger, rectangular black frame with a crackled surface. At the top of the black frame, a decorative gold-colored metal piece features a leaf design and a hanging loop.

title: John T. Woolsey (?) (d. 1798)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a portrait of a man. The portrait is painted in watercolor on ivory and sits inside a shiny oval metal frame. The man has light hair, a pale face, and looks directly ahead. He wears a blue coat over a high-collared white shirt with a loose cravat. The background behind the man is a muted, brownish-red color. A small metal loop sits at the very top of the frame for hanging.

title: William Samuel Johnson (1795–1883)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry portrait of a man, painted in watercolor on ivory. The piece is shaped like an oval and set inside a simple, thin gold frame with a loop at the top. The man has short, wavy brown hair and light skin, and he looks directly forward with a serious expression. He wears a dark blue or black coat with a high, white cloth necktie tucked neatly into his collar. The background behind him is a plain, muted gray color that highlights his face and upper chest.

title: Triple Flower
alt_text: A steel and aluminum sculpture showing three curved, funnel-shaped pieces mounted on a group of thin metal rods. The base is made of several straight wires that extend outward like legs along the floor. These rods continue upward to support the three metal shapes, which vary in height and direction. The curved shapes are smooth and silver-grey, reflecting light evenly. Several of the support rods rise higher than the funnels, creating a spiky, vertical silhouette.

title: The Waterfall
alt_text: A painting of enamel on copper shows an abstract design with a layered, textured appearance. The central portion of the artwork features a mix of dark, muddy blues and blacks blended with thick, creamy white shapes that look like clouds or foam. Patches of warm, light tan colors appear at the bottom right corner, contrasting with the cooler tones above. The surface seems uneven and slightly bumpy, as if the material was applied in thick, dripping layers. The painting is enclosed within a wide, simple frame that has a light-colored, textured border.

title: Acumulacion
alt_text: A painting showing a white background covered in a grid of small, black rectangular shapes. Each of these black shapes has a single, small white dot near its center, creating a repeating pattern. Across the middle of the canvas, a large, dark rectangular block sits horizontally. This block has a textured surface that looks like many small, round bumps packed closely together. The grid of smaller shapes continues behind and around this large central piece.

title: A Riding School in the Open
alt_text: A painting showing a landscape scene with people and horses near a stone archway. A crumbling, weathered stone structure sits on the left side of the frame with trees growing on top. Several people, some mounted on horses, are gathered on the dark, grassy ground in front of the arch. A bright white horse stands out in the center, facing toward the right. The background features a wide, cloudy sky that takes up the upper portion of the canvas. A heavy, ornate gold frame surrounds the entire image.

title: Sculpture Screen
alt_text: A metal sculpture shows many rectangular tiles attached to a tall, grid-like frame. The tiles are arranged in five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns across three main support poles. Each tile has a textured, shiny gold surface that catches the light differently. The entire piece is mounted against a plain, light-brown wall and stands on the floor. The tiles appear slightly varied in color, with some looking more brassy or yellow and others having a weathered, darker tint.

title: Oliver Wolcott, Jr. (1760-1833), B.A. 1778, ML.d. 1819
alt_text: A miniature oil painting of a man with light, powdered hair shown from the chest up. The man faces slightly to the right with his gaze directed toward the viewer. He has light skin, blue eyes, and a neutral expression. He wears a dark green coat with a tan vest and a white cravat at his neck. The portrait is set inside a gold-colored oval frame, which is mounted on a larger rectangular black block.

title: Interior of a Capuchin Convent
alt_text: A painting of the interior of a church with rows of monks sitting in wooden pews on either side of a long, tiled aisle. In the center, a group of figures in robes stands around a small stand during a service, with a beam of light shining down from above. Several framed paintings hang high on the walls above the pews, which are painted a soft yellow. The ceiling is vaulted and high, featuring a large crucifix and several statues on a raised ledge near the back wall. In the foreground, one monk kneels on the floor with his back to the viewer.

title: Charles Briggs
alt_text: A watercolor miniature of a young man shown in profile facing to the left. The man has short, wavy brown hair and light skin. He wears a dark, collared coat over a white shirt with a high collar. The portrait is oval-shaped and set inside a round gold frame. This circular piece sits within a larger, square-shaped dark wooden frame that has a small metal loop at the top for hanging.

title: Portrait Bust of Charles Garnier (1825–1898)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a man's head and shoulders faces slightly to the right. He has wavy hair that looks ruffled and wild. Around his neck, he wears a large, folded cloth or scarf tied in a knot. He is dressed in a jacket with a wide lapel that sits across his chest. The entire bust is made of a single light-colored material and stands on a plain, blocky base against a dark background.

title: Two Arches
alt_text: A copper sculpture shows a complex arrangement of curved, sheet-like forms arranged in a dynamic, open structure. Large, sweeping arcs made of hammered metal extend from the center in different directions, creating a sense of movement. Near the top center, a series of thin, straight rods intersect to form a star-like pattern within an open space. The sculpture rests on a plain, white rectangular base. The dark metal surface has a dull, matte appearance with visible seams where the pieces are joined together.

title: Flying Hawk
alt_text: A sculpture of forged steel shows a large, curved object that resembles a giant seed pod or crescent moon. The piece has a dark, uneven gray patina and rests on a white, flat surface. Its main body is a broad, curved shell with a pointed top, and a thinner piece curves downward from the same point. A narrow, white ribbon is tied around the very top edge of the sculpture. The entire structure is set against a dark olive-green background.

title: Oxenbridge Thacher (in the manner of Robert Feke)
alt_text: A painting of a man standing outdoors with a dog. The man wears a pale gray coat over a black vest and white ruffled shirt sleeves, with a white wig on his head. His right hand rests gently on the head of a brown and white hound dog beside him. Behind the man, a dark tree trunk stands on the right side of the frame. The background shows a dim, open landscape with a winding path and distant hills under a moody sky.

title: Splendor of Red
alt_text: A painting of a bright orange square centered against a red background filled with radiating lines. The entire image is enclosed within a solid, pale blue border. Dozens of thin, straight lines fan out from the corners and sides of the center square. These lines create a rhythmic pattern that spans from the square to the edges of the red area. The strong contrast between the colors gives the design a vibrating effect.

title: Judge Pierpont Edwards (1750-1826)
alt_text: A painting of a man facing forward, set within a simple wooden frame. The man has a fair complexion, grey hair, and a serious expression. He wears a dark-colored coat with a high, folded collar and a white cravat at his neck. The background is a solid, dark brownish-grey color that creates a subtle shadow around him. A small white label with blue numbers is attached to the bottom edge of the frame.

title: Portrait of Judge Pierpont Edwards (1750-1826)
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man has short, light gray hair that is curled slightly at the sides. He wears a dark blue coat over a white shirt with a ruffled cravat at his neck. His expression is serious, and he looks directly toward the viewer. The background behind him is a plain, dark, and rounded shape.

title: Cubi XXII
alt_text: A stainless steel sculpture shows a cluster of rectangular pillars and blocks arranged in an abstract, open shape. The metal has a shiny, burnished finish with visible swirls and scuff marks reflecting the daylight. Three tall, vertical columns stand at different heights, connected by horizontal rectangular blocks that jut out to the sides. A smaller square block sits near the ground, anchoring the base of the structure. The sculpture stands on brown dirt in front of a tall metal fence, with a brick building and green trees visible in the background.

title: Descent from the Cross with Cardinal II [From series: Variations on a Theme]
alt_text: A bronze relief shows two nude figures bound to a tall, thin vertical pole. The figures stand in the center and to the left, with their arms raised and tied to the top of the pole. To the right stands a person wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a long, heavy cloak that drapes to the ground. The background is a flat, dark, and uneven surface. The entire piece has a worn, metallic appearance.

title: Figurine Head after a Classical Portrait Type (Alexander)
alt_text: A terracotta sculpture of a human head shows a person with thick, wavy hair and distinct facial features. The sculpture has a dark, muted color that looks smooth and rounded. Its face has a prominent nose, deep eye sockets, and a slightly open mouth. To the right of the head, a light-colored rectangular tag hangs from a thin white string. The tag features printed text with black numbers and letters, identifying it as a museum object.

title: The Annunciation
alt_text: A limestone sculpture of two standing figures carved in relief against a solid background. On the left stands a winged figure with smooth hair holding a rectangular book against its chest. On the right, a second figure stands wearing a tall, decorated crown on its head. Both figures wear long, draped tunics with distinct patterns of horizontal and vertical lines carved into the stone. Between the two figures, a small, flower-like shape is carved near the top of the panel. The entire carving has a rough, weathered texture and appears slightly yellowish in color.

title: Dying Centaur
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows a figure that is part human and part horse, lying on its side. The human upper body is muscular, with one arm raised upward and the other arm broken off at the shoulder. The lower body is that of a horse, with bent legs resting against a flat, oval base. The head is tilted back, and the face looks upward with a serene expression. A carved signature is visible on the flat base near the animal's legs.

title: A Quai of Paris
alt_text: A painting of a city scene features a stone bridge arching over a dark river in the foreground. Large, multi-story buildings with steep, pointed roofs rise behind the bridge on the left side. A thin, tall church spire reaches upward in the center background behind several trees. On the right, a wider building with many windows sits near the edge of the water. Stone steps lead down from the street level toward the riverbank under the sunlight.

title: Canal of Venice
alt_text: A painting of a canal scene on canvas shows two large buildings along the water. To the right, a tall structure with a square tower stands over the canal, its base supported by long, striped poles sticking out of the water. To the left, another large building with balconies and arched windows lines the edge of the water. A small, dark boat floats on the calm surface of the canal in the lower left corner. The background features softer, lighter buildings in the distance beneath a pale, cloudy sky. The entire scene is enclosed within a wide, textured, light-colored frame.

title: Benjamin Pickman (1740–1819)
alt_text: A painting of a young man with light skin standing against a dark background. He wears a long, brown coat with shiny gold buttons over a red vest that has vertical gold trim. Underneath, he has a white shirt with ruffled cuffs visible at his wrists. One of his hands rests on a large, red book that sits on a blue surface to his left. The man has short, dark hair styled back and looks directly toward the viewer with a neutral expression.

title: Paris Street Scene
alt_text: A painting of a bustling city street scene with tall buildings on both sides. The wet ground reflects the overcast sky and the surrounding structures. Several horse-drawn carriages move along the center of the wide road. Numerous people walk on the sidewalks, including a figure with a child near a street lamp on the bottom right. A large, domed building stands in the distance on the left side of the street.

title: Seven Men with Hats
alt_text: A painting of seven figures wearing dark suits and matching dark hats. The figures are arranged in a dense group, facing forward with their hands clasped together near their waists. Their faces are largely obscured by the low brims of their hats, which are painted in deep shades of black. The outlines of their clothing and hands are highlighted with thin, bright white lines against the dark tones. The background is a solid, muted grey color that emphasizes the dark figures in the foreground.

title: Port Royal
alt_text: A painting shows a tall, narrow structure with a yellow sliding surface in the center. The object has a striped awning at the top with bands of blue, white, and yellow. A light gray metal frame supports the structure on both sides. The background is divided horizontally with a deep brown color on top and a solid reddish-pink color on the bottom. An orange rectangular shape sits directly at the base of the structure on the ground.

title: Metamorphosis
alt_text: A marble sculpture of an abstract, cage-like structure stands upright against a dark grey background. The white marble piece is tall and narrow, featuring long, vertical rods that connect horizontal platforms at the top and bottom. Inside the open frame, various shapes are attached, including a smooth oval disc on the left side and a star-like shape on the right. Smaller, curved forms dangle from the upper section and rise from the base. The overall composition creates a complex, airy tower of smooth, white geometric forms.

title: Foreshadowings
alt_text: A painting of several figures in an outdoor landscape, all set inside a thick gold frame. On the left side, three figures in draped, flowing robes dance or move across a grassy field. The figure on the far left wears a dark purple or blue shawl that billows behind her. A second figure in a light green dress reaches toward the center, while a third figure in a pinkish-red dress kneels on the ground with one arm stretched upward. On the right side of the painting, three nude figures stand closely together in a group, their arms raised above their heads. The background shows dark green trees and a pale, cloudy sky.

title: Beach at Apia, Samoa
alt_text: A painting of a tropical beach landscape with a calm ocean and distant mountains. In the foreground, tall, thin palm trees lean from the right side of the sand towards the center. A single person stands in the shallow water near the left, wearing a simple red cloth. Another person is visible further down the shoreline, and two large ships sit in the water in the middle distance. The sky above is filled with soft, white clouds scattered across a light blue background.

title: The Hoop
alt_text: A wax sculpture shows a rectangular relief featuring light-colored figures set against a dark background. On the left, a woman reaches out toward a tall, stone-like column topped with a horned face. In the center, a person dives head-first through a large, circular hoop held by another figure. To the right, another person is upside down on the ground, while two women stand watching near a tree. The entire scene is enclosed within a simple, rectangular wooden frame.

title: Coney Island
alt_text: A painting on canvas displays a background of alternating horizontal yellow and red stripes. These stripes run across the entire width of the square canvas and appear to be roughly equal in thickness. In the center of the painting is a solid, medium-blue square that occupies a large portion of the middle area. This blue shape sits directly on top of the stripes, blocking them from view in that area. The paint appears applied by hand, with slightly uneven edges visible on the stripes and the blue square.

title: Aaron Burr (1756-1836)
alt_text: A painting of a man presented in a gold-colored frame. The man has pale skin, short light hair, and is looking off to his left. He wears a dark coat over a bright white scarf tied around his neck. The background is a dark, solid brown color that fades into shadow. A small metal label is attached to the bottom center of the frame with writing on it.

title: Still Life with Roses
alt_text: A painting shows three light-colored roses in a simple glass vase. The flowers are white and pale pink with ruffled petals, arranged in a tight bunch. Dark green leaves sit around the roses, adding color and texture. The vase is clear and sits on a brown surface against a very dark background. The artist’s signature appears in the bottom left corner.

title: Reverend Aaron Burr (1716-1757)
alt_text: A painting of a man’s head and shoulders shown inside an oval frame. He has pale skin, a calm expression, and wears a short, light-colored wig with waves. His dark, buttoned coat features two white rectangular strips of fabric that hang down from his neck. The background is a dark, shadowy mix of olive and brown colors that get darker toward the edges. Soft light illuminates the front of his face and the white fabric at his throat.

title: Boy on a Cliff Leaning on a Stick
alt_text: A painting of a young child holding a long, thin pole. The child is standing on a grassy hill in front of a wide body of water. They have short blond hair and wear a light-colored shirt and dark brown shorts. One of the child's socks is visible and has red horizontal stripes. In the background, a light purple sky hangs over the calm, green-colored water.

title: Genesis
alt_text: A painting of overlapping geometric shapes and lines on a dark background. Thin, glowing white and pale yellow lines intersect to create complex web-like patterns across the canvas. Several circular forms appear in the center, stacked vertically and layered on top of each other. Straight, diagonal, and intersecting lines stretch outward from the center toward the rectangular frame's edges. The overall effect creates a sense of depth and intricate structure against the black backdrop.

title: Deux femmes dans un paysage
alt_text: A painting of two women standing on a grassy hill outdoors. The woman on the left wears a blue shawl and a large, wide-brimmed green hat. The woman next to her wears a long green shawl over a light-colored dress. Behind them, there is a path and a backdrop of several dark trees. The sky is a pale, cloudy blue, and the colors throughout the scene are applied in loose, painterly strokes.

title: Woman and Child
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a young child in a room with pink walls. The woman wears a light blue dress with puffed sleeves and looks toward the child. The child stands on the left, wearing a bright reddish-orange dress and has blonde hair. Between them, the woman holds out a piece of fabric, possibly a garment or curtain. Behind the pair, a faint white statue stands on a pedestal against the wall. The artist’s signature is visible in the bottom left corner.

title: Cat
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a cat lies on a plain gray background. The cat is shown resting on its belly with its head turned to the left. Its front paws are tucked close to its face. The wood has a medium brown color and visible tool marks across the surface. Its back legs are folded underneath its body, and a short tail extends to the right.

title: Kingman Brewster, Jr. (1919-1988) B.A. 1941, M.A. (Hon.) 1960, LL.D. 1977
alt_text: A painting of a man standing with his arms crossed. He is wearing a white dress shirt, a tie, and a dark suit underneath a long, blue academic robe. Around his neck hangs a thick, golden chain. The man has grey hair and is looking slightly to his left. The background is a simple, textured wall in light, neutral tones.

title: Virgin of the Annunciation
alt_text: A dark wooden sculpture shows a person kneeling in profile. The figure has long, wavy hair and wears a robe with folds that drape down toward the floor. Their hands rest on top of a rectangular, boxy object positioned in front of them. The person’s head is turned slightly to look toward the right. This entire carving sits on a flat, rectangular base against a plain background.

title: Fragment of a Crucified Christ
alt_text: A sculpture of a man’s upper torso, carved from light-colored ivory. The figure is angled to the left, with long, wavy hair and a full beard framing a downward-looking face.
