His chest and stomach are muscular, and his arms are missing below the shoulders. A textured cloth is wrapped around his hips, appearing to be held in place by a rope-like tie. The carving ends at the lower abdomen, showing a jagged break in the material.

title: The Missions: Before the Storm
alt_text: A painting of a lush, wooded landscape scene is displayed in an ornate gold frame. On the left, a small stream flows through the forest, crossed by a thin wooden bridge. The right side of the painting features a group of figures and animals resting on the grassy bank. Above them, tall trees with dense, dark green and autumn-colored leaves stretch towards the sky. In the background, a dramatic, misty mountain rises against a glowing, cloudy sunset. The overall mood of the scene feels calm and slightly mysterious.

title: Nasturtiums
alt_text: A painting of a lush, dense bouquet of bright orange and red flowers set against a warm, reddish-brown background. Many small, round green leaves are scattered throughout the floral arrangement. In the center of the flowers, a pale, hazy, and rounded form suggests a vase that is partially hidden by the thick growth. The colors are soft and blended, giving the scene a dreamy and gentle quality. The composition fills the entire canvas with a vibrant, overlapping pattern of petals and foliage.

title: Portrait of a Man
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a formal red coat. The man has short, light-colored hair and faces forward with a neutral expression. He wears a dark, embroidered vest underneath his bright red coat. A white ruffled fabric sits at his neck, likely part of a shirt or cravat. The portrait is housed in an ornate, metallic gold frame. A small paper tag hangs from the right side of the frame with handwritten text on it.

title: The Five Hundred Franc Note
alt_text: A painting of a framed paper note displayed on a dark background. The central rectangular note is light-colored and covered with intricate blue-toned drawings, text, and two small circular portraits. It appears to be folded or creased into a grid-like pattern. This note sits inside a wide, ornate, gold-colored wooden frame with carved patterns along its edges. The entire piece rests against a white, diamond-patterned metal grate.

title: Still Life with Fish
alt_text: A painting showing two fish lying on a piece of white cloth. The fish are dark in color, appearing brown and gray against the lighter background. They are positioned at an angle, with their heads pointing toward the bottom left of the frame. One fish overlaps the other slightly, creating a layered effect. The background behind the cloth is blurry and painted in muted, dark tones. The entire scene is enclosed within a simple wooden frame.

title: Christ au Mont des Oliviers
alt_text: A painting of figures in a dark, textured room. A tall, pale, vertical shape stands in the center of the frame against a background of blues and greens. Two rounded pink vertical patches sit on the right side of the composition. A shadowy, seated figure with indistinct features rests in the lower right corner. The entire scene is surrounded by a thick, dark border framed by faint pink and green edges.

title: A Moroccan Street Scene
alt_text: A painting showing a narrow, empty alleyway between two tall, white walls. The walls cast long, cool blue shadows across the ground and up the side of the building on the right. A rough, stone-paved path stretches into the distance toward a bright opening. In the background, a small, leafy green bush stands over a white wall. The bright, clear blue sky is visible at the very top of the passage.

title: Landscape with House
alt_text: A painting of a house partially hidden by thick, green foliage. The large building has a bright red, slanted roof with several small dormer windows and chimneys. Below the roof, the cream-colored walls feature rows of windows with blue shutters. Dense green bushes and trees occupy the foreground and the right side, obscuring the lower portion of the house. A dark, moody sky of blue and grey swirls above the roofline. The paint is applied with thick, visible strokes that create a textured look throughout the scene.

title: Ombres (Shadows)
alt_text: A pile carpet features bold, abstract shapes in dark blue against a light cream-colored background. On the left, a rounded, arch-like form contains several vertical stripes. To the right of that, a dark blue silhouette of a curvy figure stands out against a large, lighter area. A pointed, wing-like shape extends from the right side towards the center. The entire design uses high contrast between the two colors to create a modern, graphic appearance.

title: Interior
alt_text: A painting shows a person sitting at a table and working on something with their hands. The person wears a plain, dark blue dress and sits with their back toward the viewer. To the left, a wall is covered with a patterned wallpaper featuring large, swirling shapes in red, green, and white. A wooden table sits to the right of the person, holding some small objects. The entire scene uses thick, textured brushstrokes in muted and earthy colors.

title: Two Planes Vertical-Horizontal II
alt_text: A stainless steel sculpture stands outside on a grassy lawn. It consists of a tall, thin vertical pole that holds up two flat, rectangular metal plates. The plates are positioned at slightly different angles and are reflective with a burnished texture. A large, leafy green tree shades the sculpture, and a brick building is visible in the background. The entire structure is set on a low concrete base in the dirt.

title: Kneeling Woman (Kniende)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a kneeling woman. She is facing slightly to the left with her head tilted downward. Her body is smooth and brown, with small imperfections on the surface that suggest the texture of clay. Her arms hang loosely by her sides. The figure rests on her knees against a plain, grey background.

title: Football
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture shows four men engaged in a rough physical interaction. The figures appear to be wearing athletic jerseys and pants as they crowd together in the center. One man stands tallest in the middle while holding a small, oval-shaped ball near his waist. Three other figures surround him, with their arms wrapped around him from the front, side, and back. The entire group stands on a rectangular base that features the word "FOOTBALL" embossed on the front.

title: Barn Swallows
alt_text: A painting of many birds in flight is shown within a simple wooden frame. The scene features a large group of small, dark-colored birds, possibly swallows, flying upward across a pale, vertically oriented background. Their wings are spread open as they move in various directions across the canvas. The background uses soft, blurry shades of light blue and tan, suggesting a cloudy sky. A small yellow label hangs from the bottom of the wooden frame.

title: Portrait of the Young Queen Victoria
alt_text: A painting of a young woman shown from the side in profile view. She has light brown hair styled with loose curls and a dark ribbon or decoration at the back of her head. The woman wears a dark collared top with a scarf tied at her neck. A reddish-brown patterned shawl or piece of fabric is draped over her arms across the bottom of the painting. The background is a plain, light beige color with visible brushstrokes.

title: Two Figures
alt_text: A painting of two figures in a loose, sketched style. On the left sits a person with light skin and dark hair, wearing a blue cloth draped over their lap. To their right stands a second, taller figure who appears to have a green cloak draped over their shoulder. The background is a soft, mottled mix of tan and brown brushstrokes. Both figures are painted with quick, visible lines and muted colors. A small, faint signature is visible in the bottom right corner.

title: Portrait of a Man
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a person with shoulder-length white hair. The person wears a dark coat over a white, long neckpiece that hangs down their chest. Their face is angled slightly toward the left, with a serious expression and visible brushstrokes. The background is a muted, warm brown color that fades into shadow. The portrait is housed in a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame with intricate decorative carvings.

title: Queen Anne's Lace
alt_text: A painting of a flowering shrub is set in a wooden frame. The artwork shows clusters of white flowers growing on stems with green leaves against a dark reddish-brown background. The wide, polished wood frame has metal accents shaped like small animals on each of its four corners. A white paper tag with the number "1969.427" is attached to the right side of the frame. The painting hangs in front of a background made of grey, vertical metal slats.

title: Interior with Man Writing
alt_text: A painting of a quiet indoor scene depicts a person sitting at a table. The figure is positioned in the center, wearing a green coat and sitting in a dark chair. To their right, a wooden chair sits empty with a small, light-colored object resting on its seat. In the background, there is a blurry wall with vertical lines and a lamp stand. The entire scene uses soft, muted colors and appears slightly hazy. The painting is encased in a thick, decorative gold frame.

title: Mountain Landscape with lake and Figures
alt_text: A painting shows a moody mountain landscape enclosed in an ornate gold frame. A large, craggy mountain rises in the center, partially hidden by thick gray mist or low clouds. Below the mountain, dark, shadowy trees line the edge of a calm, dark body of water. On the right side of the water, a tiny, dark boat with a single figure sits quietly. The entire scene uses muted tones of gray, brown, and dark green to create a somber atmosphere.

title: Jungle Orchids and Hummingbirds
alt_text: A painting of large, light pink orchid flowers blooming in a lush, green jungle setting. Two prominent orchid blossoms dominate the foreground, showing ruffled petals with deep pink centers. To the left, a small, multi-colored hummingbird hovers near the leaves and flower buds. The background shows a dense forest of trees and distant mountains under a dark, stormy sky. Light shines down through the clouds, highlighting the delicate texture of the flower petals.

title: Head of William Rush (1756–1833)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows the head and upper neck of an older person. The surface of the metal is reddish-brown and has a rough, uneven texture that suggests a sketch-like quality. The figure's face is narrow with deep-set eyes, thin lips, and distinct lines across the forehead. The neck is thick and bumpy, appearing as if it was formed from thick, messy layers of clay. The entire bust sits upon a simple, solid, square-shaped base made of the same dark material.

title: Water Nymph and Bittern
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a standing woman holding a small, long-eared animal above her head. The woman is tall and wears a long, flowing dress that drapes down to her feet. Her arms are raised and bent at the elbows to support the creature she holds. The figure has a reddish-brown color throughout and stands on a simple, rectangular base. Her features are somewhat abstract and not very detailed.

title: Below Zero
alt_text: A painting of two people standing in a snowy landscape while looking toward a dark, stormy horizon. The two figures are seen from behind and are wrapped in thick, brown hooded coats. Each person holds a wooden snowshoe at their side. They stand on a flat, white expanse of snow under a heavy, grey, and turbulent sky. A patch of dry, brown brush sits on the right side of the snowy hill in the distance.

title: Country Scene with Three Houses and Trees
alt_text: A painting of a view through trees looking toward a group of buildings. Two large, dark tree trunks frame the left and right sides of the scene. In the center, a bright white wall sits behind dark green bushes. Behind the wall, rooftops rise against a pale blue sky. The ground in the foreground appears to be covered in soft green grass or low foliage.

title: River God
alt_text: A terracotta sculpture shows an elderly man with a long beard reclining on his side. He is nude except for a piece of cloth draped over his legs. In one hand, he holds a thin, vertical rod, while his other hand rests on a rounded jug tipped on its side. Water or liquid appears to be pouring out of the mouth of this jug. The figure is positioned on a rectangular base, which has a smooth gold-colored finish.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of a still life features geometric, angular shapes arranged on a table. In the center, a round bowl filled with several round, dark green fruits sits next to a tall, tan glass or vessel. A small, bright green bottle with a thin neck is tucked into the background behind these items. To the left, a textured, rust-colored object sits near a knife with a silver blade pointing downward. The scene is set against a background of flat, overlapping patterns in shades of blue, red, brown, and light purple.

title: The Trappers' Camp
alt_text: A painting of a dark, rocky landscape lit by the moon and a small campfire. A round, white moon glows in the upper left corner against a dark, cloudy sky. Tall, jagged rock cliffs and thin, silhouetted trees rise up in the center. In the lower right, a small, bright orange campfire illuminates the ground and a single person sitting nearby. The rest of the scene fades into deep shadows, creating a strong contrast with the warm light of the fire.

title: Eagle
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows a bird standing on a rock base. The bird has a long neck that curves downward with its head looking toward the ground. Its body is covered in mottled, beige and off-white patches. Carved feathers are visible along its closed wings and legs. The sculpture rests on a rough, brownish base that supports the bird’s feet.

title: Jeanne Cartier
alt_text: A painting of a woman wearing a bright yellow dress and a decorative overskirt. She is standing with her arms slightly outstretched against a dark background filled with painted red and blue flowers. The woman wears a dark hat on her head and bright purple stockings with light-colored shoes. She also has gold earrings and a long necklace with a large pendant. Her expression is cheerful as she looks directly toward the viewer.

title: Atmosphere and Environment XI
alt_text: A Cor-Ten steel sculpture shows a tall, rectangular grid standing outdoors in front of a stone building. This large structure is made of several vertical columns divided into box-like openings. Inside these open boxes, there are various flat metal shapes, including circles, wavy lines, and semi-circles. The steel has a rusted, brownish-orange color that looks weathered. The entire sculpture is supported by a solid, rectangular base resting on gravel.

title: Pointing Figure
alt_text: A sculpture of white, smooth, curved forms sits on a wooden table. The object has a rounded base and a protruding arm extending horizontally to the left. A smooth, egg-shaped section rests tucked into the curve of the body, with a textured, slightly rough strip running along the top of this part. A small, rectangular paper tag with numbers hangs from the center of the piece. The background shows shelves filled with other stored items in a room.

title: Scene from Byron's "Manfred"
alt_text: A painting of a vast, cascading waterfall set within a deep, rocky canyon. The water rushes down from the left side, surrounded by tall, dark, textured cliff faces that fade into a hazy, light-colored mountain peak in the distance. On the right side, a thick cloud of mist rises from the water, displaying a faint, colorful rainbow arching across it. Floating within the misty light on the right is a small, pale figure wearing a reddish garment, looking towards the waterfall. A large, dark rock juts out into the foreground at the bottom left, framed by a few bare tree branches.

title: Saint Mark with the Lion
alt_text: A bronze plaque shows a bearded man sitting in the center with a large book on his lap. He wears loose, flowing robes and has a piece of fabric billowing behind him to his left. Below the man and the book, a lion lies down among wavy, cloud-like forms. The man's right hand is raised near his shoulder while his left hand rests firmly on the open book. This dark sculpture is mounted on a small black stand and is circular in its overall shape.

title: Head of Medusa
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a face showing an aggressive expression. The face has wide, staring eyes and an open, shouting mouth with visible teeth. Thick, curled shapes that resemble snakes or hair surround the entire head. The metal has a shiny, dark gray surface that reflects light in uneven patches. It is mounted on a small, vertical rod attached to a flat rectangular base.

title: Cours la Reine
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes in various shades of green and yellow. The canvas is filled with blocky, rectangular forms in dark olive, bright lime, and deep black. A small, textured white shape sits nestled within one of the dark green blocks on the left side. The paint looks thick and heavily textured, showing visible brushstrokes throughout. The entire piece is contained inside a simple, shiny gold frame.

title: Pots and Profiles
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes in a variety of colors. The composition features two main vase-like forms that sit on a dark, flat surface. The colors include shades of tan, deep brown, orange, blue, and a pale, creamy white. These shapes are created with smooth, clean lines that overlap each other against a blue background. The entire image is enclosed in a thin, gold-colored frame.

title: Reverend James Pierpont (1659/60–1714)
alt_text: A painting of a man shows him from the chest up against a plain, dark brown background. The man has light brown hair that hangs down to his shoulders in wavy locks. He has a pale complexion with round, dark eyes and a serious expression on his face. He is wearing a black robe over a dark shirt. A simple, rectangular white collar hangs down onto the center of his chest.

title: Mt. Ktaadn
alt_text: A painting of a peaceful landscape features a large, snow-capped mountain under a dramatic, reddish-pink sunset sky filled with small, scattered clouds. In the foreground, a tall, leafy tree stands on the left near a small, seated figure. A calm lake occupies the middle ground, where a few cows graze along the water's edge. To the right, a small house sits nestled near a gentle waterfall and a bridge crossing a stream. The overall scene is warm and quiet, with deep green forests surrounding the water and hills.

title: St. Ives harbor
alt_text: A painting of a harbor scene features a stone pier jutting into calm, greenish-blue water filled with several small sailing boats. A stone lighthouse or tower stands near the end of the pier, where tiny, indistinct figures of people are gathered. In the background, a large, rolling green hill rises above the water under a sky filled with fluffy white clouds. The entire scene is enclosed within an ornate, rectangular gold frame. Below the frame, a white card displays the blue handwritten numbers "1969.72."

title: Calligraph Gee III
alt_text: A copper sculpture stands in an outdoor garden setting. The sculpture consists of long, curved metal strips that twist and loop in an abstract shape. The metal has a dark, weathered look with some greenish tones. Behind the sculpture, a large tree with bright yellow leaves fills the background. A brick building with white window frames and a door is visible in the distance.

title: Ave Caesar! Morituri te salutant (Hail Caesar! We Who Are about to Die Salute You)
alt_text: A painting of a large arena filled with a crowd of people. In the foreground, a group of armed fighters stands together, while a man in a green cloak looks toward them. Several other figures are scattered across the sandy ground, including some who appear to be lying down. On the right side, a raised platform features decorated pillars and people sitting in a prominent position. A giant, patterned cloth canopy stretches across the top of the stadium.

title: A Reconnaissance
alt_text: A painting of a snowy, muddy street scene in a town. A group of soldiers dressed in dark uniforms and carrying rifles stands in the middle of the road. On the right side of the road, a dark horse lies on the ground, appearing to have fallen. Several other figures, some standing and others sitting, are scattered along the sides of the street near simple stone buildings. The sky above is overcast and gray, and the overall color palette of the painting consists of muted, earthy tones.

title: Guitar Player in Chair
alt_text: A cast stone sculpture shows an abstract figure with curved, blocky shapes. The figure sits on a flat, square base and has a rounded top part resembling a head. One side of the figure features a distinct shape with four parallel grooves carved into it. The overall texture of the stone appears rough and gray with small speckled details throughout. The entire sculpture is composed of solid, interlocking curves that create a sense of weight.

title: Half Standing Figure
alt_text: A lead sculpture of stacked, geometric shapes stands upright against a plain, light gray background. It rests on a circular, dark metal base that is slightly wider than the sculpture itself. The main body is composed of rectangular and blocky forms that rise vertically in an irregular, staggered pattern. These metal forms have a dull, dark gray surface marked with varied, scratchy textures and visible tool marks. At the very top, a small, curved cutout creates a subtle, open-ended notch. The entire structure feels solid and heavy, with sharp, rigid edges meeting in a complex, pillar-like arrangement.

title: Head of a Young Man
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows the head and neck of a person looking slightly downward. The surface of the metal is a dark, brownish color with a rough, textured finish. The face has features like deep-set eyes, a defined nose, and closed lips. A pale, rectangular tag with a small green sticker hangs from the base of the neck by a thin white string. The entire bust sits upon a dark, rectangular pedestal.

title: Scene in the Forest of Fontainebleau
alt_text: A painting of a wooded landscape frames a small opening of light in the center. Tall, dark trees with dense foliage curve inward from the left and right sides to create a canopy. In the lower center, a small, still pool of water reflects the sky, surrounded by grasses and low plants. Beyond the water, the ground opens up to show a distant, lighter field under a pale, cloudy sky. The overall color palette is dark, consisting of deep greens, browns, and earthy tones.

title: Scene in Devonshire
alt_text: A painting of a dark, narrow dirt path leading through a dense forest. Tall, dark trees with thick trunks and heavy foliage frame both sides of the path. Two small figures, appearing to be people, walk along the path in the distance, heading away from the viewer. The path opens up at the end, revealing a small patch of bright blue sky and distant water. The colors are mostly deep greens, browns, and dark shadows, which contrast with the light patch in the background.

title: Nicangi
alt_text: A painting of dark, abstract shapes divided by curved lines. The composition is split into three main vertical sections. A large central panel, which is slightly lighter in tone than the rest, is shaped like an hourglass or a wide vase. To the left and right are two thinner, darker vertical sections that mirror the curve of the center panel. These shapes are entirely black or dark gray, with faint variations in texture across the surface.

title: Race
alt_text: A walnut sculpture shows the upper bodies of two figures carved from a single piece of wood. The primary figure is in the foreground, with its head tilted sharply back, looking upward and to the side. A second, smaller face is visible on the left side of the main figure, appearing to look straight ahead. The wood has a rich, medium-brown color with visible carved lines throughout the texture. A small white tag is attached to the sculpture with a thin, light-colored string.

title: Election Day, 2 A.M.
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes in shades of green, brown, and black. The composition features large blocks of muted color that bleed into one another across the canvas. Thin, dark, vertical lines suggest the edges of undefined shapes or structures. Near the center, a small rectangular patch of bright blue creates a sharp contrast against the darker tones. Light green highlights appear near the top and left side, giving the surface a layered effect.

title: Head
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a human head sits on a simple wooden block. The face is smooth and dark, with a long, straight nose and thin, closed lips. The eyes are almond-shaped and look forward with a calm, neutral expression. Shallow, etched lines define the ears and suggest hair on the sides of the head. The entire head is finished with a deep black patina that gives it a metallic sheen.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of several overlapping, abstract shapes drawn in black lines against a muted, grey-brown background. The shapes resemble large, rounded rectangles or stones stacked on top of one another. The background has a rough, uneven texture, showing faint, vertical streaks and lighter brush marks throughout. Some of the black lines cross over each other, creating a layered, sketch-like effect. The overall composition feels simple and minimalist, with a calm, earthy tone.

title: Patience
alt_text: A painting of an older man sitting on a wooden chair in a dimly lit room. He wears a dark coat, a black hat, and a bright red scarf around his neck. His hands are clasped over the handle of a green closed umbrella resting between his knees. To his left sits a large, textured bag with red and brown patterns. Behind him, a fireplace with a pair of bellows stands against a dark wall.

title: River at Sunset
alt_text: A painting showing a dark, moody landscape with a river flowing through the center. On the left, tall trees cast deep shadows that stretch across the water and the grassy bank. To the right, a small, dark building sits partially hidden by more trees and dense vegetation. The sky above is filled with swirling, golden-brown clouds that suggest twilight or sunset. The entire scene uses rich, dark tones with faint, glowing light reflecting off the water.

title: Black Cow in a Meadow
alt_text: A painting of a dark cow standing in a bright yellow-green field. The cow is solid black and faces to the right as it eats grass. Two thick, dark tree trunks stand in the background on the right side. The sky above is painted with horizontal streaks of white and light blue. The entire scene is created with visible, thick brushstrokes that give the surface texture.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A stucco sculpture shows a woman and a young child in a relief scene. The woman is positioned on the left, looking down toward the child with her hands held together in front of her chest. A halo with a dotted pattern encircles the back of her head. The child sits on the right, facing the woman with their body turned toward her. Both figures are rendered in soft, rounded forms that emerge from the rectangular surface. The entire piece has a worn texture with visible cracks and rough areas.

title: Two Stonebreakers
alt_text: A painting of two figures standing in a lush, green landscape. On the right, a tall figure wears a white shirt and tan pants while facing away from the viewer. To the left, a smaller figure is crouched down and dressed in reddish-orange clothing. Both people are surrounded by thick, textured brushstrokes in shades of green, blue, and brown that suggest dense foliage or tall grass. A lighter, beige-colored patch on the ground connects the two figures. The overall style uses short, distinct strokes of paint.

title: Mountain Lake
alt_text: A painting of a vast, misty landscape scene. In the foreground, a small flock of sheep grazes on a grassy field dotted with colorful wildflowers. A dark, still lake sits just behind the field, stretching horizontally across the middle of the frame. Beyond the water, a dense, dark forest leads the eye to a large, hazy mountain range in the distance. The sky above is filled with soft, light clouds under a warm, pale light.

title: The Raising of the Widow's Son
alt_text: A painting shows a group of people gathered near a person lying on the ground. A tall figure in a light, flowing robe stands in the center and reaches out with one hand toward the person on the ground. The person on the ground is covered in white cloth and appears to be resting on a low, makeshift bed. Other figures surround this central scene, wearing robes in muted shades of red, green, and brown. In the background, there is an arched bridge and buildings that rise up toward a hazy sky.

title: Indian Sunset: Deer by a Lake
alt_text: A painting of a forest clearing by a calm lake during autumn. Three deer stand in the grassy foreground near the water, with one deer having antlers. Large trees frame the scene on the left and right, their leaves turning shades of red and orange. In the background, a thick forest of trees stretches along the misty shoreline. The light in the center glows warmly, suggesting either sunrise or sunset.

title: Figure from an Altar Retable
alt_text: A sculpture of polychromed wood showing a figure wearing a crown. The figure appears to have wavy, dark hair and is wearing a robe with a high collar. The entire sculpture is encased in a crinkled, clear plastic bag with some red tape visible on the front. To the right of the plastic-covered figure stands a tall, thin, black metal pole that seems to be a display mount. A small white label with handwritten numbers is attached to the pole.

title: Yacht Race
alt_text: A painting of several sailboats navigating a choppy, dark sea under a stormy, grey sky. The largest boat occupies the center foreground, tilting slightly to the right with its tall, off-white sails fully extended. Smaller sailboats are visible behind and to the sides of the main vessel, dotting the horizon line. A small wooden barrel floats in the water near the bottom right corner of the scene. The ocean water is painted with rough, deep green waves that suggest windy conditions.

title: Lake Scene in Autumn
alt_text: A painting of a quiet mountain landscape features a calm river winding through the center. A large, jagged rock sits prominently on the grassy bank in the bottom right corner. Behind the bank, tall trees with autumn-colored leaves lean toward the water. In the background, rolling hills and a distant mountain peak fade into a soft, hazy sky. The overall scene is lit by warm, golden light that suggests either sunrise or sunset.

title: Rogers Slide, Lake George
alt_text: A painting of a calm lake surrounded by large, green, rounded hills under a light sky. On the grassy shore in the bottom left, there is a small wooden cabin with a simple, slanted roof. Several small boats with white sails drift quietly on the water near the center. Dense, dark green trees and bushes grow along the near shoreline in the foreground. The sky above the hills is pale blue with some white clouds.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LL.D. 1781
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up. He has light skin, pinkish cheeks, and white hair that is pulled back away from his face. The man is wearing a dark, high-collared coat with a plain white cloth tucked at his neck. The background behind him is very dark and shadowy, with visible paint strokes creating a textured effect. Bright light shines on his face, making it stand out against the gloomy surroundings.

title: View of Cotopaxi
alt_text: A painting of a vast landscape shows a large, snow-capped mountain dominating the center background. Clouds in shades of pink, purple, and gray surround the mountain peak, which is catching the golden light of the sun. Below the mountain, a calm, wide body of water stretches across the middle ground. In the foreground, a lush forest filled with green trees and a tall palm tree on the left covers the hills. A small path winds through the lower brush, where a single person in a dark cloak walks away from a small cottage.

title: Poughkeepsie Iron Works (Bech's Furnace)
alt_text: A painting of a river valley scene shows an industrial area nestled among rolling hills. In the foreground, several brown and grey buildings sit on a grassy slope, with white smoke rising from a prominent brick chimney. A few small figures and goats gather on the hillside overlooking the structures. Beyond the buildings, a wide river stretches into the distance, with small boats visible on the water. Hazy blue mountains rise on both sides of the river under a pale, cloudy sky. The entire scene is bathed in the warm, soft light of a setting or rising sun.

title: Hook Mountain, near Nyack, on the Hudson
alt_text: A painting shows a calm, wide body of water reflecting a large, distant mountain. On the right side, a sandy shore curves into the frame, lined with trees that are tinted with autumnal colors of orange and gold. The water is smooth and glassy, with several tiny sailboats visible near the base of the mountains in the center. The mountains appear dark and rocky, stretching horizontally across the middle of the scene. Above, the sky is a pale, clear blue that fades lighter as it meets the horizon. The entire scene is quiet and still, emphasizing the vast, open space of the lake.

title: Burial of DeSoto
alt_text: A painting shows a dark, night scene of people gathered near a calm body of water. To the left, a small group of figures stands around a glowing lantern that casts warm light on their clothes. In the distance, a large, pale sun or moon sits low on the horizon, reflecting a soft light across the water's surface. A solitary person sits on the grassy bank in the lower right, looking out over the water. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: Figure in Landscape I
medium: Oil on paper mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting of abstract, sweeping brushstrokes in white, pink, and dark red sits at the center of the canvas. These shapes are thick with paint and look like messy, tangled lines. The background is a mix of muted greens, browns, and a bright yellow patch in the upper right corner. Below the central shapes, thin green streaks suggest blades of grass rising up from the bottom. The paint appears uneven, with some areas thick and textured and others thin and watery.

title: The Bather
alt_text: A painting of a seated woman in a simple white dress. She has reddish-brown hair and is looking down to her right. Her left hand is touching the strap of her dress at her shoulder. The woman sits in a relaxed pose with her legs tucked in. The background is composed of soft, blended strokes of green and yellow that look like grass or foliage.

title: Boeing 707
alt_text: A painting made of aluminum shows a grid-like pattern of metallic panels and bold red stripes. The surface is created from rectangular, silver-colored metal pieces joined together. Small rivets or screw heads are visible along some of the edges where the panels meet. Thick, bright red bands form a large cross shape that extends horizontally and vertically through the center. Additional smaller, red-painted shapes with rounded ends extend from the outer borders into the silver field. The overall arrangement consists of industrial sheets joined together on a flat plane.

title: Abstract Composition
alt_text: A painting showing abstract shapes in bright colors against a dark background. A large, blurred shape of orange paint dominates the center, stretching diagonally from the lower left toward the top. A dark, blackish arc rests above the orange shape, framing it like a curved canopy. In the lower right corner, a smaller rectangular patch of dark blue sits against the reddish-brown backdrop. The entire surface has a soft, smudged appearance without clear lines or edges.

title: Study for Archimedes
medium: Bronze, black and exposed bronze patina
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a rough, abstract form resting on a dark, rectangular wooden base. The sculpture is made of several block-like shapes that appear joined together. A large, jagged mass sits at the top, supported by a vertical, pillar-like segment. Two smaller, lower pieces form a wide base that connects to the wooden stand. The entire metal surface is dark and uneven, with deep textures and sharp edges.

title: Dialogue
alt_text: A painted steel sculpture shows abstract geometric shapes in a bright yellow color. The object is composed of several solid, angular blocks that connect to form an archway. It sits on a large, flat white platform placed on the bed of a long green trailer. Several fabric straps are draped across the white platform near the base of the sculpture. In the background, green trees and a brick wall are visible under a clear, bright sky.

title: After Dinner
alt_text: A painting on wood shows three men sitting together in a dimly lit room. In the center, a man in a black coat plays a violin, looking off to the side. To his left, a man wears a tall black hat and sits with his hand resting against his head. To the right of the violinist, a third man sits wearing a small red cap and a light-colored coat. A small table in the foreground holds a glass decanter and a glass filled with a dark liquid.

title: Still Life with Dried Fruit
alt_text: A painting of nuts and dried fruits sits on a dark, flat surface against a black background. On the left, a paper cone lies on its side, spilling out several greyish-brown dried fruits. Near this cone, a small cluster of smooth, dark acorns and chestnuts sits next to a single walnut. To the right, two additional paper cones stand upright, filled with piles of light-colored nuts and dark raisins. The lighting highlights the textures of the paper and the food, while the shadows create deep contrast across the scene.

title: Portrait of a Man
alt_text: A painting of a man with a dark beard sitting beside a table. The man looks toward the viewer with a serious expression and has dark hair. He wears a dark, textured jacket over his shoulders. His right hand rests on the edge of a table covered with a light-colored cloth. Beside his hand on the table, a stack of flat, square objects sits in the shadows. The background is a plain, dark, and undefined space.

title: Cavaliers dans les Bois
alt_text: A painting of people on horseback and people standing in a grassy area with trees. Two horses are galloping across the middle of the frame, carrying riders dressed in bright red jackets. Below them, three people stand in a small group near the bottom right, with three empty chairs arranged to their left. The background is filled with swirling shades of green and dark blue, suggesting a wooded outdoor setting. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, textured, and gilded wooden frame.

title: Tale of the Soldier
alt_text: A painting of a group of four people gathered near stone structures outdoors. To the left, a woman in a light-colored dress holds a tray of food, while a young boy in an orange vest sits on a stone block near her. A man with a bandaged head sits in the center, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. To the right, a man wearing a dark helmet and armor listens with his hand raised to his face. Between the men, a glass decanter sits on a stone surface alongside a piece of bread.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows large, abstract shapes in dark, flat colors. A massive, irregular black form dominates the center and the upper portion of the frame. Below this central area, smaller patches of ochre, brownish-red, and dark blue sit against a pale, off-white background. The edges between these color fields are uneven, curved, and sometimes jagged. The overall composition feels heavy and dense, with very little empty space.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of dark, abstract shapes fills the canvas. The background is composed of deep black and charcoal grey tones. Two large, vertical rectangular forms appear to overlap slightly in the center. On the far left, two small, dark, smudge-like marks sit one above the other. The texture of the surface appears matte and slightly uneven throughout.

title: Series 5, No. 7
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas featuring large, abstract geometric shapes against a pale, off-white background. A dominant, wide black rectangle spans the upper portion of the frame, resting above several smaller, jagged black and dark brown forms. A bright, light blue square sits in the upper left corner, contrasting with the muted tones nearby. Other dark, angular shapes in shades of blue and black cluster in the lower center and right of the image. The entire composition is defined by sharp, clean edges and a feeling of heavy, layered depth.

title: Etruscan No. 7
alt_text: A painting shows large, abstract shapes in red, black, white, and gray. A dominant, wide band of bright red paint stretches across the middle of the canvas in an irregular, blocky form. Below the red shape, a patch of solid black sits on the left side against a background of light gray. A thick, textured area of white paint appears in the upper right, blending into the surrounding gray tones. Thin drips and small flecks of paint are scattered across the red and gray surfaces.

title: Chest
alt_text: A walnut piece of furniture, specifically a rectangular chest, features elaborate carvings on its front panel. The dark wood surface displays several standing figures dressed in long, flowing robes. These figures are separated by vertical, decorated columns and are framed by draped curtains above them. Small, winged cherub-like figures are carved into the upper section between the curtains. The bottom edge of the chest has a gently curved, scalloped design and rests on a dark rectangular base.

title: Free Sample / Try One
alt_text: A painting of a wooden board with a rectangular hole cut out of the center. Inside the dark, recessed opening, there is a small pile of peanuts sitting on the ledge. A thin, green string stretches across the opening, passing through or behind some of the peanuts. A small, rectangular piece of paper is tacked to the upper right corner of the wooden board. The paper has handwritten text on it that reads "Free Sample Try One."

title: Invocation to the Goddess Hygieia
alt_text: A painting of three women gathering at the foot of a tall stone statue set into a red brick wall. The statue is white and depicts a figure wrapped in a long snake. The three women are standing together, with one woman dressed in blue, another in white, and the third in a dark purple robe reaching toward the statue. A fourth person, dressed in a long black cloak, sits slumped on the ground to the right near the base of the wall. Bare, dark vines grow along the brick wall and frame the scene on both sides.

title: Two Nudes
alt_text: A painting of two figures in muted, earthy tones. A kneeling figure dominates the foreground, with its body angled toward the right. Behind and slightly above this figure stands a second, taller person, whose form is softer and less distinct. Both figures appear to have pale skin and are rendered with swirling, blurred brushstrokes. The background is a hazy, blended mix of brown, grey, and off-white colors.

title: Paradise Lost (?)
alt_text: A painting of figures in a landscape with a large tree in the center. On the left, a person with long, reddish-brown hair stands with their back to the viewer, while a small, round brown animal sits near their feet. To the right, two people wearing green skirts walk across a light-colored grassy field. Above these figures, a large, white, cloud-like shape floats in the blue sky. A small, round bush with bright red flowers sits in the bottom right corner, and a palm tree stands on the far right edge.

title: Roasting the Christmas Beef in a Cavalry Camp
alt_text: A painting of a group of men standing around a campfire in an open, dry field. Several men in dark military-style uniforms and cowboy hats gather around the small fire to cook food using long metal rods. One man kneels near the fire while others stand in a loose circle. Behind them, multiple white cone-shaped tents sit on the dusty ground under a clear, pale blue sky. A few more figures are visible near the tents in the background, and a lone horse stands on a ridge in the distance.

title: Stringed Figure, Bowl
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a tall, hollowed-out oval shape stands on a rectangular base. The exterior of the oval is smooth and brown, curving inward to form a deep, dark interior space. Inside this hollow, a vertical, pale yellow element runs from top to bottom. A web of thin white strings stretches across the center of the opening, connecting the two sides of the oval. The entire piece rests on a solid, dark, blocky stand.

title: A Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a green parrot perched on a brass stand inside a room. The bird dominates the foreground, with its head turned to the right and its body showing green, yellow, and red feathers. A large, circular golden ring frames the perch and the bird. In the background, there is a fireplace, a birdcage, and a decorated rug on the floor. Two framed pictures hang on the dark red walls behind the furniture.

title: Torso
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows the dark, rough torso of a figure. The sculpture has uneven, bumpy textures and sits in the center of the image. A white, rectangular backdrop stands behind the main object. To the right, a person wearing a maroon shirt holds the white backdrop. Another darker, amorphous sculpture piece lies partially in the foreground near the bottom.

title: Bagpiper in an Inn
alt_text: A painting of a man playing bagpipes while seated on a wooden barrel. The man wears a dark hat, a light-colored coat, and dark trousers, and he holds the bagpipes up to his face. To his left stands a plain, round pottery jug atop another large barrel. In the background, behind a doorway, three other men sit in a darker room around a table playing cards. A small brown pot sits on the floor in the bottom right corner of the painting. The scene is lit by dim, natural light coming from the left, casting shadows throughout the room.

title: Still Life with Flowers
alt_text: A painting of objects sitting on a table in front of a green patterned wall. In the center, a dark, rounded vase holds a cluster of spiky, white-and-black leaves. To the right of the vase, an open book with printed text rests against a white, rounded object that holds two round, golden shapes. The table below them is a flat, solid yellow color. The background consists of a repeating, woven green pattern that looks like a screen or wallpaper.

title: Shipwrecked on a Beach (The Tempest)
medium: Oil on paper mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a lone, bearded figure standing on dark, jagged rocks beside a rough, churning sea. The man is positioned on the left side, with his back partially turned, and he appears to be wearing simple, light-colored cloth wrapped around his waist. Behind him, the ocean is dark and turbulent with visible white foam crashing against the shore. A large, dark rock formation dominates the foreground on the right side. The overall color palette is muted, using deep browns, blacks, and murky greens to suggest a storm or evening light.

title: The Crucifixion; The Entry into Jerusalem
alt_text: An ivory sculpture showing two stacked scenes carved into a rectangular panel. The top section features a central figure suspended on a cross, flanked by several standing figures on either side. An archway with decorative pointed tops runs along the top of this scene. The bottom section displays a figure riding an animal toward a stone structure, accompanied by a small group of people standing nearby. This scene is also framed at the top by a series of pointed arches similar to the one above. The entire carving is creamy white and deeply etched to create shadows and form.

title: The Thinker
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man sitting in a hunched position. The dark, metal figure is curled over, with one elbow resting on a knee. His hand is pressed against his chin, as if he is deep in thought. The sculpture has a rugged texture and is set against a plain, light gray background.

title: Ganymede
alt_text: A brass sculpture shows a tall, upright shape balanced on a sturdy, tan box. The object features thin, angular metal rods that extend outward and upward, resembling a geometric frame or structure. A central, shiny brass cone or cylinder stands vertically inside the frame. Fine, thin wires connect parts of the frame to help hold the structure together. The sculpture sits in the center of a cluttered room with a wooden door and white brick walls in the background.

title: Kathleen
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a bust shows the head and shoulders of a person with a textured, green-toned surface. The figure has long, wavy hair that falls around the face and shoulders. Their eyes are wide and focused forward, while the mouth is slightly open. The sculpture has a rough, uneven texture across the skin and hair, giving it a weathered appearance. The bust stops at the chest, creating a straight, horizontal edge along the bottom.

title: Spatial Organziation
alt_text: A painting of a mosaic-like pattern filled with many colorful, irregular shapes. The center of the canvas is composed of a tightly packed grid of rectangular and square blocks in bright colors like red, blue, yellow, and green. These shapes are separated by thin, dark lines that curve and bend to form an oval shape in the middle. The background surrounding this central oval consists of larger, darker blocks in shades of brown, grey, and deep blue. A small signature is written in white in the bottom right corner of the canvas.

title: Wild Flowers
canvas_label: This Image was Created for documentation purposes prior to going off site to 300 Prospect- photographed on August 12, 2008
alt_text: A painting of a tall, vertical arrangement of colorful flowers against a dark, shadowy background. Deep red, star-shaped blossoms are clustered primarily on the left side of the arrangement. Bright, feathery yellow stems stretch upward toward the center of the bouquet. Dark green leaves and thinner, fern-like sprigs fill in the gaps and spill toward the bottom of the painting. The surrounding background is a muted, muddy brown that grows darker toward the corners of the frame.

title: Hunting scene with Inco and Sylvio (?)
alt_text: A textile made of wool and silk showing a detailed woven scene with multiple figures. Two large, standing figures in ancient-style clothing occupy the upper portion of the design, with the name "SILVIO" visible near one of their feet. Below this main scene, there is a distinct border containing an oval frame that surrounds a smaller, seated figure. To the right of this frame, there is a cluster of woven fruit or plant shapes. The color palette is composed of faded, earth-toned browns, tans, and deep blue-greens.

title: Gravitational Shift
alt_text: A painting of an abstract scene features a pale, cream-colored background. In the center, a dark, rounded shape sits low in the frame, topped with a lighter, swirling blue form that reaches upward. Two solid yellow circles float to the right and left of the central blue shape. Thin, dark lines stretch out from the middle toward the right side of the canvas. The entire work is enclosed in a simple, rectangular frame with a worn, light-colored finish.

title: Young Girl Seated in a Chair
alt_text: A painting of a young girl sitting on a tall, wooden chair. She wears a dark dress with a white collar and a small red accent at her neck. Her hair is pulled back, and she rests her feet on a low stool in front of the chair. The background is a flat, dark brown color that makes the figure stand out. The girl looks directly toward the viewer with a calm expression.

title: Woman Seated at an Easel
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on a small wooden stool, seen from behind. She has her brown hair pulled up into a neat bun on the top of her head. She wears a long, dark dress with a high collar and a wide waistband. In front of her stands an easel holding a blank, light-brown canvas. Her right arm is extended toward the canvas, holding a small white tool or brush. The background is simple and blurry, with hints of muted greens and browns.

title: Grey and Pink Still Life
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes using oil on canvas shows a calm composition of blocked colors. A large, dark gray rectangle forms the bottom half of the image, grounding the shapes above it. Sitting on top of this dark base are several vertical, rectangular blocks in shades of light gray, white, and a vibrant orange-red. A single, tall red line stretches upward from the center toward the top edge, cutting through the muted lavender background. The entire painting is held within a plain, light-colored wooden frame with a museum tag attached to the top right corner.

title: The Slaughterhouse
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes in shades of cream, dark brown, and reddish-orange. Large, curved forms in cream dominate the left and center of the composition, resembling soft, organic shapes. These light shapes are set against darker, angular background blocks of brown and black. The texture of the paint appears thick and brush-stroked throughout the entire surface. A thin, metallic gold frame surrounds the rectangular canvas.

title: Le Principe d'Archimede
alt_text: A painting of several green apples against a dark, cracked background. A footed white bowl sits on a wooden surface in the lower center, holding a small pile of apples. Four additional apples float in the dark space surrounding the bowl, with one in each upper corner and one in each lower corner. All the apples appear to be similar in size, color, and shape, each featuring a single leaf on top. The background is nearly black, while the table surface below is a warm brown wood tone.

title: Landscape I
alt_text: A painting of oil on canvas depicts a textured, abstract field of layered brushstrokes. The surface is covered in dense, repeating marks in shades of green, gray, purple, and brown. These small, dark, V-shaped lines create a sense of vibrating movement across the entire space. The colors gradually shift from slightly darker, cooler tones at the top to brighter, more vivid greens and purples near the bottom. The overall effect is like looking at a vast, busy landscape that is blurred or viewed from a distance.

title: Saint Matthias
alt_text: A painting of a bearded man viewed from the side. The man is looking to his left, with his head turned slightly and his body facing forward. He wears a bright red garment underneath a dark blue, heavy fabric that drapes over his shoulders and arms. His hands are clasped together at the bottom center of the painting. The background is a dark, indistinct brown color that highlights the figure.

title: Portrait of Godfrey Wentworth and Dorothy Wentworth (née Pilkington)
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman sitting together outdoors. The man stands on the left, leaning his elbow on a stone ledge while wearing a dark grey coat and a white wig. Beside him on the right, a seated woman wears a pale, shiny dress with ruffled white lace sleeves and a matching white cap. She holds a small, fluffy black and white dog in her lap with both hands. Behind them, the background shows a blurry scene of green and brown trees under a cloudy sky.

title: Portrait of Alexander Pope
alt_text: A marble sculpture showing the head and shoulders of an older man. The man has a lined face, a narrow nose, and wavy hair that is swept back from his forehead. He is wearing a draped garment that covers his chest and shoulders. A rectangular paper tag hangs from a string around his neck, resting against his chest. The tag is light yellow, features a green circle, and includes handwritten numbers. The entire sculpture is set against a dark, plain background.

title: Haying in Connecticut
alt_text: A painting of a rural landscape with two men working near a large stack of hay. On the left side, one man stands on top of the rounded haystack while another man stands at its base, both pushing or gathering the material. Two large, dark cattle stand to the right of the haystack, facing toward the right side of the frame. The background shows rolling green hills and a light-colored field under a sky with patchy clouds. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, plain wooden frame.

title: A Corner of the 72nd Street Studio
alt_text: A painting of a dimly lit interior scene featuring a glowing golden lantern hanging from the ceiling. On the left side, a variety of green potted plants sit near a wall, while a rectangular framed picture hangs in the shadows behind them. In the lower-left corner, a person with bare shoulders leans forward over an unseen work surface. To the right, a large, dark, undefined shape looms, obscuring much of the view. A small, dark pot or container hangs in the middle ground, suspended near the side of the large dark shape.

title: Inkwell with Seated Putto Lid
alt_text: A bronze tool showing a small, dark metallic vessel with a lid. The lid is topped with a figure of a young child sitting on a rounded, decorated base. The body of the bowl has three legs shaped like animal paws and is decorated with sculpted faces on the sides. The surface of the metal is a dark, brownish-black color with smooth, rounded curves throughout. The entire object stands on a plain, light surface against a simple light background.

title: Sentinel
alt_text: A metal sculpture shows an abstract, upright structure made of textured, dark gray panels. A tall, central column rises from a square black base and splits slightly at the top. Several angled, flat pieces attach to this central post, creating sharp points and jagged outlines that extend to the left and right. The surface of the metal has a rough, pitted texture that catches the light in various spots. Overall, the piece appears geometric, irregular, and somewhat precarious in its balance.

title: The Dance of the Nymphs
alt_text: A painting of a group of people dancing in a grassy field at twilight. Four figures wearing flowing garments move together near the center foreground. To their right, dense, dark green trees rise up and stretch across the upper part of the scene. On the left side, the landscape opens up to reveal a pale, hazy horizon line under a soft, cloudy sky. In the middle distance, faint outlines of buildings appear between the trees and the open sky.

title: By the Sea
alt_text: A painting of a vast, cloudy sky above a dark blue sea. The sky is filled with thick, textured clouds in shades of purple and grey that float against a bright, golden-yellow background. Below the horizon, the water is painted in wide, flat bands of deep blue. The foreground features a beach or shoreline area with dark, horizontal stripes of reddish-brown and lighter blue tones. The entire scene is created with short, visible brushstrokes that give it a rough and energetic look.

title: A Sandy Road with Thatched Cottages
alt_text: A painting of a rural landscape features a group of small cottages with thatched roofs on the left side. Tall, dark green trees stand behind the buildings, while a dirt path winds through the open, brownish foreground. Several small figures, including a person sitting and others walking, are scattered across the scene. A horse-drawn carriage waits near the cottages, and a church tower is visible in the distant background. The sky above is vast and cloudy, filled with soft shades of blue and grey.

title: Gum Wrapper
alt_text: A painting of a rectangular, metallic object angled across a smooth, light gray surface. The object appears to be a long, crinkled wrapper with serrated, zigzagged edges along the top. The outside of the wrapper reflects a dark, glossy blue and silver, while the inside is filled with a textured, golden-brown substance. The object casts a soft, blurred shadow onto the surface below it. The overall lighting highlights the sharp folds and shiny material of the wrapper.

title: Second President's House, Yale University
alt_text: A painting shows a two-story white house sitting among many tall trees. A wooden fence runs horizontally across the bottom third of the yard. The house has several dark windows and a prominent red chimney near the center of the roof. Dense bushes and smaller plants obscure the front entrance of the building. The scene feels somewhat dim, with soft greens and browns creating a quiet, shaded atmosphere.

title: Yale College: Old Brick Row
alt_text: A painting of a town scene with large trees framing the view. In the background, a long, light-colored building with many windows sits behind a low fence. This building features a prominent steeple in the center and a smaller domed structure to the left. A wide, empty field occupies the foreground area. In the lower center, a person stands next to a small, two-wheeled cart being pulled by an ox. Another solitary figure stands a short distance to the left.

title: A Lion Attacking a Horse
alt_text: A painting of a white horse being attacked by a lion. The scene is set in a dark, rocky landscape beneath a stormy, overcast sky. On the right side, the horse rears up and turns its head with an open mouth while a dark-colored lion clings to its back. A large, shadowy rock formation looms over them, blocking out much of the light. To the left, a grassy hill rises in the distance near a body of dark water. The ground in the foreground is uneven and covered in scattered rocks.

title: Daniel Merriman (b. 1908), Class of 1914 (Hon.), Ph.D. 1939
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair in front of a large world map. The man is fair-skinned with short, light hair and wears glasses, a dark suit, and a tie. He holds a smaller framed picture in his lap with his right hand. The background features a large, faded map of the world with a faint illustration of a sailing ship on the right side. The overall image has a soft, muted quality and is enclosed in a simple wooden frame.

title: Madonna and Child, initial letter "C"; from illuminated manuscript
alt_text: A manuscript on parchment shows a rectangular page filled with black gothic calligraphy and musical notations on red staves. In the upper left corner, an oval miniature painting depicts a robed figure holding a smaller child in red, surrounded by two stylized trees. A decorative border with blue, red, and gold scrolling leaves runs down the left side and extends across the bottom of the page. The background of the paper is a yellowish, weathered tone. Dark, diamond-shaped musical notes are arranged in rows alongside the written text.

title: Cherries in a Basket
alt_text: A painting of a rectangular woven basket filled with many ripe, red and yellow cherries. The basket sits on a bed of green grass next to the base of a large tree. Several loose cherries have spilled out onto the grass near the bottom and left side of the basket. In the background, a calm stream flows through a grassy area. The scene is set outdoors during the daytime.

title: View of Lake Nemi at Sunset
alt_text: A painting of a landscape shows a tall, stone tower standing on a cliff edge on the right side. Below the tower, a cluster of small buildings with reddish roofs sits on the rocky ledge near green trees. A calm river or lake flows through the center of the scene, winding between the cliff and a distant, misty mountain range. On the left, a pale sun hangs low in a pink and orange sky, casting a warm glow over the entire view. The horizon is filled with hazy mountains that fade into the soft light of sunset.

title: In the Orchard
alt_text: A painting showing a woman sitting in a wicker chair outdoors. She has dark hair and wears a light-colored, patterned dress with a thin, coral-colored necklace. Her right hand rests on the arm of the chair, while her left hand grips the front of the chair's dark green frame. The background is a lush, green yard with grass, dappled sunlight, and a large tree trunk. The overall scene uses soft, impressionistic brushstrokes and shades of green and yellow.

title: Reverend Joseph Sewall (1688-1769)
alt_text: A painting of an older man with long, wavy brown hair. He is shown from the chest up and looks directly ahead with a serious expression. The man wears a dark, possibly black, coat or robe. Around his neck is a white, rectangular collar piece that hangs down his chest. He is framed within a dark, oval shape that contrasts with the lighter brown background.

title: Doorknocker with head of Panther
alt_text: A bronze tool showing a decorative circular plate attached to a vertical handle. The dark metal plate has a serrated, jagged edge that resembles a gear. Centered on the plate is a raised animal head with almond-shaped eyes and textured fur markings. A smooth, rod-like handle hangs down from the mouth area of the animal. A small paper tag is attached to the handle with a thin string.

title: Carved Wood Panel
alt_text: A wood sculpture shows a long, rectangular panel decorated with carved patterns. The carving features swirling, leafy vines and floral motifs that run horizontally across the entire width of the piece. To the far left, a distinct cluster of rounded shapes resembles a bunch of grapes nestled among several broad leaves. The rest of the panel displays continuous, curving scrolls that intertwine with more foliage and petal-like shapes. The wood is a warm, light brown color with a slightly weathered, matte texture.

title: Plaque of St. Elijah riding his chariot over the clouds...
alt_text: A sculpture shows a scene engraved onto a flat, rectangular bronze-colored metal plaque. The central panel features several figures standing and kneeling among wavy lines that suggest rocky or hilly ground. Above the figures, there are faint outlines of winged forms in the sky. A wide, decorative border with darker, intricate floral patterns frames the central scene. Below the plaque, a light yellow paper museum tag with a barcode and handwritten numbers is attached with a white string.

title: Blue Enamel cross representing the Crucifixion
alt_text: A metal and enamel sculpture shows an intricate crucifix shaped like a cross with several arms. The center of the piece features a figure on a cross, surrounded by smaller standing figures on either side within rectangular panels. The entire object has a dark, bronze-colored metallic finish with patches of light blue enamel filling the background spaces. A small white label with a black barcode and numbers is attached to the right side of the object. A string with a paper tag hangs from the lower left corner of the sculpture. The cross is displayed against a plain, light beige textured cloth background.

title: Architects
alt_text: A painting of a town square featuring three central figures. To the left, a woman with curly hair sits on the ground, gesturing upward while reading a large, open book. Beside her, another woman stands with her back to the viewer, looking over her shoulder while a man in dark clothes stands closely behind her. The man holds a rolled document in one hand and rests his other hand on the woman's shoulder. In the background, there is a large stone building with a fountain and a few other small figures walking in the distance.

title: Blue and white enamel plaque with four Biblical scenes
alt_text: A metal sculpture shows four small square panels arranged in a grid inside a single frame. Each square panel contains raised figures and details set against a light blue background. The top left square shows three standing figures, while the top right square depicts two figures interacting with a third figure between them. In the bottom left square, a central figure stands surrounded by radiating lines with two flanking figures. The bottom right square shows a figure on an animal with other figures standing nearby, all cast in a dark, weathered metal.

title: Still Life with Watermelons, Grapes, and Peaches
alt_text: A painting of fruit shows a still life arrangement sitting on a wooden surface against a dark, plain background. To the left, there are two large slices of watermelon with red centers and dark seeds, partially covered by dark grapes. A cluster of pale green grapes hangs down from the center, resting near the edge of the table. To the right, a group of several round, orange and red peaches are piled together with their green leaves. The lighting creates soft shadows across the table and highlights the textures of the fruit skins.

title: Charter
alt_text: A painting of two distinct shapes arranged vertically. The top two-thirds of the canvas is white and features a large, orange, rounded rectangle. This orange shape is soft and organic in appearance, with curved corners and bulging sides. Below this section, a solid black rectangle fills the bottom third of the image. The black area has sharp, straight edges that span the entire width of the painting.

title: Jungle Bloom
alt_text: A gilded bronze sculpture shows a series of abstract, curved, wing-like forms radiating from a central point. The textured surfaces of these shapes appear rough and metallic, resembling curled leaves or petals. Several of the curved sections point outward in different directions, creating an airy and open composition. The entire sculpture is balanced precariously on a single, thin, vertical rod at its base. The background is a simple, neutral gray that makes the sculpture stand out clearly.

title: The Old State House on New Haven Green
alt_text: A painting showing a white neoclassical building set in the middle of a park. The structure features a row of tall columns and a triangular roof, and it stands centered behind a large, grassy field. Thick clusters of dark green trees frame both sides of the building, reaching upward into a hazy, light-colored sky. A single, thin tree stands directly in front of the building, its branches bare or sparse. The foreground is filled with a broad expanse of muted green grass that stretches across the bottom of the scene.

title: Volupté
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows a headless, armless female torso standing on a small, rectangular base. The figure is carved in a smooth, light-colored stone with gentle curves that define the chest, waist, and hips. Both arms are cut off near the shoulders, and the neck is cut off at the base. The figure stands upright with a subtle shift in weight toward one side. Etched into the front of the base is the word "VOLUPTE" in capital letters.

title: Roses
alt_text: A painting of several blooming roses against a dark background. The flowers appear in various colors, including shades of pink, soft yellow, white, and a deep reddish-pink. They grow on leafy green stems that branch upward and across the dark space. The petals on the roses look soft and layered, showing gentle highlights and shadows. The dark background helps the bright colors of the flowers and leaves stand out clearly.

title: Still Life- Table with Ochre Wall
alt_text: A painting of a wooden table holding various objects against a tan background. Several smooth, oval-shaped eggs are scattered across the surface of the table. A tall, thin brown bottle stands on the left side near some of the eggs. A small olive-green bowl sits in the center next to a larger white bowl with a blue stripe. On the far right, a stemmed white dish holds a few more eggs. The table itself is a simple wooden piece with a single drawer panel.

title: Portrait of Miss Fanny Clapp
alt_text: A painting of a woman with reddish-brown hair facing forward against a dark, shadowy background. She wears a high-collared, light blue dress with white lace trim at the neck and sleeves. A dark blue velvet band wraps around the collar and waist, with a large blue bow tied at the front. Her hands are crossed and resting in her lap, and she wears a simple ring on one finger. The woman has a calm expression and looks directly at the viewer.

title: Night Festival
alt_text: A painting of an outdoor scene at night showing several people in the foreground. Three people are closely grouped at the bottom, their faces looking towards the right side of the frame. The background shows dark water with glowing, light-colored shapes floating on it, possibly boats. Tall, thin yellow lines rise from the water into the dark green sky, resembling fireworks or lights. These elements are set against a dark background, and the entire scene is enclosed within a simple wooden frame.

title: Samuel Pepys
alt_text: A painting of a man with long, curly dark hair or a wig that frames his face. He is shown from the chest up against a very dark, indistinct background. The man has a serious expression and is looking directly at the viewer. Around his neck, he wears a light-colored, lacy neckpiece that contrasts with his dark clothing. Over his shoulders, he wears a heavy, dark-red fabric drape.

title: George Theodore Bliss
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in front of a dark, shadowy background. The man has short, light brown hair and a thin mustache. He wears a dark blue suit jacket over a matching vest, a white collared shirt with a dark necktie, and light-colored pants. His right hand holds a small book at his side, and his left hand rests in his pocket. The entire portrait is encased in an ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Night Lake
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes uses a palette of muted blues, browns, grays, and pale greens. A large, dark gray triangular shape dominates the top section of the canvas. Below this, a vertical white rectangle stands tall against a darker blue-gray background. A small, light beige triangle sits slightly to the right of the vertical shape. The bottom portion of the painting features a large, angular brown shape that overlaps a light green field. Thin, vertical lines run down through several sections of the composition, adding a textured appearance.

title: Torso of a Young Woman
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a female torso from the chest down to the upper thighs. The figure is missing its head, arms, and lower legs. It has a smooth, dark brown surface with subtle highlights from the lighting. The body curves gently, showing the shape of the breasts, waist, and hips. It stands upright on a simple, rectangular base.

title: Pleasant Valley, Essex County, New York, Adirondacks
alt_text: A painting of a vast, hilly landscape beneath a cloudy sky. In the foreground, large rocky boulders sit amidst trees and patches of green grass. A small, dark pool of water rests among the trees near the center of the frame. Beyond the foreground, the land stretches out into a valley filled with light-colored fields and scattered houses. Several tall, rolling mountains rise up in the distance, colored in shades of brown and tan. White, fluffy clouds fill much of the bright blue sky above the peaks.

title: Timothy Dwight (1752 - 1817) BA 1769, MA 1772 (copy after Ralph Earl)
alt_text: A painting of a man who is shown from the chest up. The man has a shaved head, wears small round glasses, and is dressed in a dark, heavy coat with a high collar. He holds a white paper in his left hand while looking directly at the viewer. To his right, a desk with books and a quill pen sits in the foreground. In the background, a curtain is draped loosely behind him.

title: Icon
alt_text: A piece of carved cedar furniture shows a rectangular panel surrounded by a wide, elaborate border. The deep frame is densely carved with swirling vines, leaves, and flowers that wrap all the way around the central area. The center section is divided into a grid of many smaller squares and rectangular compartments, each containing tiny relief carvings of figures or scenes. A larger, circular design sits prominently in the middle of this grid, also filled with intricate, tiny details. At the very top, an arched decorative crest features carved foliage and a central shell-like shape.

title: The Siege of Troy
alt_text: A textile tapestry of wool and silk shows a scene with several figures moving across a landscape. The upper section features people in flowing robes walking through a field filled with leafy plants and flowers. In the background, there are hints of buildings under a pale, hazy sky. A decorative lower border runs across the bottom, divided into panels by trees and vines. This border contains smaller scenes of figures, including a fountain and small creatures, set within a garden. The entire piece has muted tones of green, yellow, and brown.

title: Nine Books
alt_text: A painting of a row of old books standing against a dark, shadowy background. Several rectangular volumes are arranged tightly together, showing their worn spines and edges. The books range in color from deep forest green to muted shades of brown and tan. One book leans diagonally on the far left, while the others stand upright in the center and to the right. The surfaces of the book covers appear aged and have signs of wear, such as peeling paint or faded textures.

title: Paul Sabatier (1848-1928)
alt_text: A painting of a man with his eyes closed and his head tilted slightly downward. He has brown hair and a full, dark brown beard that covers his chin. He wears a dark, textured jacket or coat over a lighter-colored shirt or collar. The background is a muted, soft brown color that fades into a lighter tone near the bottom. A faint, handwritten signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the painting.

title: Head of Sorrow
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a head shows a face with its eyes closed and mouth open. The metal has a dark brown, polished surface with visible brush-like texture. The head rests on a round, light-colored stone base with swirling orange and white patterns. The facial expression appears tense, with furrowed brows and lips pulled slightly apart. The sculpture sits against a plain, light gray background.

title: Lake Como
alt_text: A painting of a calm lake surrounded by large mountains under a cloudy sky. The mountains dominate the background, featuring rocky slopes colored in shades of brown, green, and grey. A dense forest lines the shore of the water, with a few small white buildings tucked among the trees. In the lower left section, a single small boat with a red cover floats on the quiet, dark water. Soft, fluffy white clouds drift low around the mountain peaks, partially obscuring the upper reaches. The overall lighting suggests a peaceful, overcast day in nature.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: An oil painting of an older man with gray hair and a mustache. He is shown from the chest up against a dark, painterly background. The man wears a large, wide, white collar over a dark garment. His skin has reddish and pink tones, and his expression is neutral. Broad, loose brushstrokes define his clothing and the space around him, leaving much of the canvas visible at the bottom.

title: Seascape (after J.M.W.Turner Rockets and Blue Lights
