alt_text: A painting shows a blurry, atmospheric landscape filled with swirling gray and brown colors. A tall, thin, bright white column of light or steam rises prominently on the left side of the scene. To the right, dark smoke or clouds billow heavily against a murky, hazy sky. Near the bottom left, a few indistinct, dark shapes suggest people or small structures along a dark shoreline. The entire composition feels chaotic and dim, with muted colors and soft, smudged brushstrokes.

title: Spring
alt_text: A painting of a human figure formed entirely from flowers, fruits, and leaves. The face is constructed from clusters of red cherries, small white blossoms, and larger pink roses. Below the face, a pale, textured neck and chest area are decorated with a necklace made of small, round, orange-red berries. Dark green leaves drape over the shoulders, and the figure wears a garland of white and yellow roses around the chest. In the foreground, there is a woven basket overflowing with cherries and other small fruits. The entire figure stands against a cloudy, gray sky.

title: The Matterhorn
alt_text: A painting of a snow-covered mountain peak rising above brown, hilly terrain. The tall mountain is the central focus, showing jagged white cliffs and patches of bright snow against a cool gray sky. Beneath the peak, the landscape is composed of rolling, earthy slopes colored in shades of dark brown, tan, and olive green. Small patches of white snow are scattered along the crevices of the lower hills. To the lower right, a dark, rocky slope leads toward a small patch of bright green grass.

title: Summer
alt_text: A painting of a large, hanging garland made of various fruits against a cloudy, light blue sky. The arrangement curves in a large shape like an "S," featuring bright red pomegranates, pale yellow apples, and dark purple grapes. Many of the fruits are bunched together with deep green leaves that cast shadows across the cluster. One pomegranate in the lower center is split open, revealing bright red seeds inside. The background is a simple sky with wisps of white clouds, making the colorful fruit stand out in the foreground.

title: Autumn
alt_text: A painting of a human figure formed entirely from various fruits and vegetables. The head is made of a large green melon topped with stalks of wheat for hair, while peaches and other small fruits create facial features. The torso is a dense collection of pears, plums, and apples that blend together to form a broad chest and shoulder shape. At the bottom, several large melons and halved fruits, including one showing red flesh and black seeds, rest in the foreground. A light blue sky with white clouds serves as the background behind the figure.

title: Winter
alt_text: A painting of a figure composed entirely of fruits and vegetables. The head is topped with a large, dark cabbage, and its face is formed by a sharp, dark beak and white, fibrous growths that suggest a beard. A garland of pears, lemons, and onions hangs around its shoulders, resting over a garment made of long, draped greens. Two pale, root-like hands are visible at the bottom, holding a pile of round, orange fruits and clusters of garlic bulbs. The figure stands against a simple blue sky and a dark, leafy background.

title: A Member of the Chauncey Family
alt_text: A miniature jewelry portrait of a young person with light, shoulder-length hair. The person is wearing a green jacket that features small, yellow buttons along the front. A large, white ruffled collar surrounds their neck and rests on their shoulders. The background is a dark, solid, and slightly textured gray color. This oval portrait is set within a simple, thin metal frame.

title: Young Lady in White
alt_text: A watercolor on ivory miniature of a young woman is set inside an oval gold pendant frame. The woman is shown from the chest up against a simple, dark gray background. Her light brown hair is pulled back, with a few small curls framing her forehead. She wears a white top with a lace neckline and a pink shawl wrapped around her shoulders. A small, square gold pin is attached to the center of her lace neckline.

title: Maternal Allegory
medium: Watercolor and chopped hair on ivory
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a painted scene featuring a woman and two young children. The scene is oval-shaped and set inside a textured, golden frame with a small loop at the top. On the right, a woman with dark hair wears a long, flowing dress and holds a small child in her lap. To their left, a young boy in a simple suit stands facing them, reaching out with one hand. Above the group, large, drooping branches hang down, suggesting a tree or large plant. The entire image uses soft shades of brown and white against a light background.

title: Lady in a Bonnet
alt_text: A jewelry miniature of a woman wearing a blue head covering. She faces slightly to the left with dark hair pulled back under a light blue cap with white trim. Her skin is pale, and she wears a simple, light-colored dress with a pearl necklace around her neck. Small pearl earrings dangle from her ears. The miniature is set within an oval gold frame that has several small metal loops along its outer edges.

title: Gentleman in a Powdered Wig
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory shows the bust of a man in an oval gold frame with a hanging loop at the top. The man has pale skin, light blue eyes, and white, wavy hair that puffs out at the sides of his head. He wears a dark reddish-brown coat over a plain, white collared shirt. His expression is neutral as he faces slightly toward the viewer. The background behind him fades from a dark brown on the left to a softer green on the right.

title: Saint Cecilia
alt_text: A painting of a person with long hair sitting on a stone bench and playing a large wooden stringed instrument. The figure wears a loose, golden-yellow top over a long, flowing deep green skirt. They hold a bow in their right hand to play the instrument, which has a wide body and a long neck. Behind the figure, there is a dark stone pillar and glimpses of a green, wooded landscape on both sides. A subtle, thin circle of light floats just above the figure’s head against the dark background. The scene is framed by a heavy, dark blue curtain hanging in the top right corner.

title: Simeon Eben Baldwin (1840-1927), BA 1861, MA 1864, LL.D. 1916
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a dark, formal coat. The man has a full beard and a receding hairline. He faces toward the viewer with a calm expression. A thin, light-colored chain is visible across the front of his jacket. One of his hands rests on his lap at the bottom of the frame. The background is a soft, blurry green color that matches the tone of his clothing.

title: John Gurney Jr., the Little Flute Player
alt_text: A painting of a young person holding a wooden flute. The subject wears a dark coat over a white shirt and a bright, golden-yellow cap on their head. They are looking directly at the viewer with a slight smile. In the lower left corner, there is a red book resting near some sheet music. The background shows a dark, shadowy area on the left and a glimpse of a cloudy sky and landscape on the right.

title: Passage du Sud
alt_text: A painting of a quiet landscape features pale buildings nestled behind a curved, dark path. In the foreground, two small figures stand near the center, positioned between a large, feathery tree and a patch of tall, spiky grasses. Behind them, several white, box-like structures sit upon a small hill. Several bare-branched trees rise above the rooftops against a light, overcast sky. The surrounding terrain is muted in shades of brown and gray, creating a calm and somewhat empty atmosphere.

title: Lady with a Lute
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a stringed instrument that looks like a lute. She is positioned in the center of the frame, facing slightly to the right with her head turned to look forward. Her hair is dark and curly, falling around her shoulders. She wears a dark dress with a square neckline and a simple, thin necklace. Her left hand is placed high on the neck of the instrument, while her right hand rests near the sound hole. The background is simple and dark, keeping the focus on the figure.

title: L'auce de L'Aiquillon
alt_text: A painting of a vast, flooded landscape under a gray, overcast sky. In the foreground, a person sits in a small, flat-bottomed boat, rowing with two oars. To the right, a long line of dark, weathered wooden posts rises out of the shallow water. Further back and to the left, another person stands in a small boat while holding a long pole. The distant horizon is flat and hazy, suggesting a marsh or wetland environment with faint lines of plants or stakes stretching into the distance.

title: Interior No. II
alt_text: A painting with abstract shapes and textured brushstrokes across the surface. The left side is dominated by a large, pale cream-colored area with patches of yellow. Moving toward the center, thick, messy splashes of deep orange and reddish-brown create a sense of movement. The right side and background are filled with dark blues and moody purples. The overall composition is chaotic, with no clear figures or objects visible.

title: Dinner Date
medium: Painted wood, plaster, textiles, oil on canvas, metal fork, leather boots, paint, graphite
alt_text: An installation showing two stylized figures seated at a small table. On the left sits a figure with a rounded wooden head and a rectangular torso painted yellow with white collar details. A second figure is on the right, depicted on a tall rectangular wooden panel painted with a portrait of a person wearing a yellow top. A white cloth covers the table, where a single metal fork stands upright in the center. A pair of red leather boots sits on the floor near the table legs, positioned below the seated figures.

title: Rêve
alt_text: A painting of a large, open seashell standing upright against a yellow, cloudy sky. Inside the shell’s two halves, there are eight small, colorful coin purses arranged in rows. These purses are various colors, including brown, yellow, red, and blue, and they cast long shadows against the inside of the shell. One blue purse on the right side appears to be smoking. Another brown purse lies on the ground in the bottom right corner, spilling small round objects onto the dusty floor.

title: White Flow
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas shows an abstract composition with bold, irregular patches of color against an off-white background. Thick, sweeping brushstrokes in black, dark brown, and deep red cluster heavily in the upper center and bottom right of the frame. Brighter accents of yellow and orange are scattered throughout this dark central mass. The rest of the canvas is mostly light and empty, with only faint traces of color and quick, thin marks. A signature is visible in the bottom right corner.

title: A View of the Molo and the Riva degli Schiavone in Venice
alt_text: A painting of a busy waterfront scene with a stone bridge and large buildings. Several groups of people in long cloaks and hats gather on a wide, paved plaza along the water's edge. In the middle of the scene, a stone bridge arches over a canal, with more figures standing atop it. Tall, historic-looking buildings with many windows stretch along the left side and into the background. To the right, small boats with tall, thin masts float on the water under a clear, pale blue sky.

title: Juggler with Young Okapi
alt_text: A painting of a person standing in a desert-like landscape with a small, white animal. The person has dark skin, wears a pointed cap and striped shorts, and has their hand gently resting on the animal's neck. The animal looks like a young zebra or small horse with thin legs and a pale body. A small, round orange object sits on the ground in the foreground. The entire scene is set against a plain, brownish-tan background, and the painting is enclosed in a thick, textured gold frame.

title: Textiles
alt_text: A silk textile shows two long, rectangular strips of bright red fabric lying flat on a white surface. The strips are positioned side-by-side with a narrow gap between them. Each strip of fabric features a wide band of gold-colored fabric running down its length near the outer edge. The red fabric is covered in a repeating, subtle pattern of leaves and flowers woven into the material. At the bottom center of the image, a small, dark rectangular label displays white text reading "1956.36.X.2".

title: Fragile Blue
alt_text: A painting of many vertical stripes of varying widths and colors fills the entire frame. The stripes are arranged in a repeating, parallel pattern that covers the canvas from left to right. Colors include shades of yellow, orange, red, green, light blue, and soft pink. These vertical lines create a textured, linear appearance across the surface. The overall effect is bright and orderly, with no other shapes or figures visible.

title: Clear Water
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping patterns in shades of blue, green, and yellow. Large, dark purple streaks run diagonally from the top center toward the right side. Behind these dark shapes, bright lime-green lines cross the canvas in loose, looping, or scribbled marks. A softer, pale blue wash acts as a background across the entire rectangular surface. The artwork is held within a thin, plain metal frame.

title: Neo-Classic Gold
alt_text: A painting on board of abstract shapes features a textured, light golden-brown background. On the left side, a tall, rough, light-yellow shape stands vertically like a column. Next to it, a large, jagged white form dominates the right side of the composition. This white shape has irregular edges and covers parts of the background. The entire surface appears wrinkled and layered, suggesting that paper has been applied over the board.

title: Mabel Dodge Luhan (1879–1962)
alt_text: A painting of a seated woman wearing a long, white, layered dress and a vibrant green shawl. She is positioned in the center of the frame, facing forward with her hands clasped in her lap. Her dark hair is styled in a bun, and she is sitting in a light-colored, curved chair. The background is a pale, plain wall that appears to be made of light fabric. The woman wears a single, small green ring on one of her fingers.

title: Carl Van Vechten (1880–1964)
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a room with vibrant orange floors and dark curtains. The central figure wears a black suit, purple socks, and holds a book while sitting on a small red stool. He is positioned on a round, dark green rug scattered with pink roses and his name written in gold letters. To his left, a stack of books with a small cat on top sits near a typewriter. The background shows a whimsical scene with a city skyline, a theater sign, and bookshelves filled with colorful books.

title: Studio Party (Soirée)
alt_text: A painting of a group of people inside a pink-walled room filled with furniture and art. In the center, several figures sit or stand, including a person in a bright yellow coat and another sitting on a red cushion in a blue suit. Two standing men wearing dark coats occupy the lower left, while other figures rest on chairs and sofas around the perimeter of the space. Large paintings hang on the pale walls, one showing a reclining figure and another displaying a colorful floral arrangement. Below these figures, a small table holds a vase of flowers and various plates and glasses.

title: At the Sculpture Exhibition
alt_text: A painting of a public indoor gallery space that features many statues and figures. In the foreground, a woman in a dark hat and dress sits and reads a small booklet near a stone bust of a man's head. Nearby, a man with a mustache stands in profile, looking toward the open area in the center. This central area is bright and contains white columns, greenery, and several white statues standing on pedestals. Other people are scattered throughout the room, dressed in formal clothing and looking at the art pieces surrounding them.

title: James Dwight Dana (1813-1895), B.A. 1833, M.A. 1836, Silliman Professor of Geology and Mineralogy, Chairman of the Board of Trustees of the Peabody Museum
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a man’s head and neck, shown in profile facing to the right. The relief is white and shaped like an oval, set against a dark background with decorative flourishes in the corners. The man has wavy hair brushed back from his forehead and over his ears. His nose is prominent, and he has a calm expression on his face. The portrait is carved with depth, casting soft shadows under the chin and along the neck.

title: A Gentleman
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the waist up. He has shoulder-length dark hair and wears a dark coat with a wide, white collar around his neck. His body is turned slightly toward the right, and his face looks directly at the viewer. One of his hands rests on his lap while the other holds a small, folded piece of paper. He sits in front of a dark, shadowed background that takes up most of the left side of the frame. The painting is enclosed in a dark, thick wooden frame that hangs on a light-colored wall.

title: Portrait of a Lady
alt_text: A painting of a woman looking slightly to her right. She wears a dark, long-sleeved dress with a white ruffled collar and a wide white shawl draped over her shoulders. A delicate white lace cap with small pink flowers sits atop her dark, parted hair. The background is a simple, dark, and muted grey. The entire portrait is encased in a thick, shiny gold frame with a simple design.

title: The West Wind, Isles of Shoals
alt_text: A painting of a vast blue ocean stretching to the horizon. The water takes up most of the scene and has many small white highlights across its choppy surface. In the distance, a long, thin strip of land runs horizontally across the middle of the frame. Two tiny, white sailboats are visible near this distant shoreline. Above the water, the pale sky is filled with several soft, white clouds.

title: Day Dreams (Two Women)
medium: Bronze with light green and exposed bronze patina
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows two women sitting together on a couch. The woman on the left sits upright while looking down at a book in her lap. The second woman is reclined against her, resting her head on the first woman's shoulder. They are both wearing long, draped dresses with many folds. The dark brown sculpture sits on a flat, rectangular base.

title: Construction
alt_text: A sculpture made of wood, metal, textiles, paint, and cardboard shows a cabinet filled with many miniature objects. The wooden cabinet stands on a surface and has one door that swings open to reveal shelves packed with tiny figures, furniture, and other small items. On top of the cabinet rests a small house topped by a metal bird, along with other miscellaneous trinkets. A dark, miniature coat hangs on the inside of the open door. The entire scene is captured in black and white, giving the collection a stark appearance.

title: The Silversmith Shop of William Homes, Jr.
alt_text: A painting of a three-story building with a light-yellow exterior. The building has a flat roof with three brick chimneys and several windows with green shutters. On the ground floor, there are three storefronts with black signs above them that display different names. The windows on the bottom level show items like clothing and other merchandise inside the shops. The sky above the building is pale blue with a few light clouds.

title: East 10th Street Jungle
medium: Ink and oil wash on wood fibre-board panel (masonite)
alt_text: A painting of a crowded, busy construction site with many men in work clothes. The scene is set against a partially broken brick wall that runs diagonally from the upper left to the center of the image. Men are scattered throughout, with some sitting on the ground, some standing, and others working or resting among debris. Several of the figures are wearing hats, and some of the men in the foreground are shirtless or covered in dirt. In the background, there are large, industrial structures and tall chimney stacks rising into a pale sky. The overall color palette is muted, consisting mostly of browns, grays, and dull earth tones.

title: Marsan II
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas shows a vertical rectangle divided into two main colored panels. The left side is a light blue, and the right side is a darker forest green. On the left, a large purple diamond sits at the top, a dark green circle is in the middle, and a bright green triangle points downward at the bottom. On the right side, a turquoise oval is at the top, a light blue square sits in the center, and a purple half-circle shape rests at the bottom. These shapes create a colorful pattern of geometric forms against the split-color background.

title: Child of the Briggs Family
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory of a young child shown in profile. The portrait is housed inside a simple, oval-shaped metal frame with a small loop at the top. The child has fair, short hair and is wearing a light blue dress with ruffled sleeves. They are facing toward the left side of the frame against a dark, neutral background. The figure is shown from the chest up with a soft, pale skin tone.

title: The Play Scene in Hamlet, Act III, Scene II
alt_text: A painting of a large group of people in a dimly lit, ornate interior space. In the background, a man and woman in bright red robes sit on a large, carved throne while others stand around them. A person wearing a colorful checkered hat kneels on the far left. In the foreground, a woman in a long, pale pink dress sits on the floor while a man in dark clothes reclines with his head in her lap. The scene is filled with warm, shadowy tones and rich fabrics.

title: B-129
medium: Oil and silver foil on canvas
alt_text: A painting shows a large set of concentric circles centered on a square canvas. The circles alternate between thin rings of dark black and pale white or silver. The pattern starts from a small dot in the very center and expands outward to the edges of the square frame. The background color of the canvas is a plain, light off-white shade. This simple geometric design fills almost the entire surface of the work.

title: Architettura No. 5
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows an abstract arrangement of shapes and lines layered over a background of vertical, muted blue and grey panels. A large, dark, hand-drawn outline, roughly ovoid in shape, dominates the center of the composition. Inside this shape, thin, irregular lines intersect horizontally and vertically across patches of cream and light grey paint. A single, distinct bright blue vertical rectangle sits on the right side of the central design. Scattered small dots and dashes are placed randomly across the surface.

title: Winter Sun
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes made with blurry, blended brushstrokes. A large, hazy red cloud sits in the center of the composition, surrounded by deep shades of blue and gray. The edges of the colors are soft and fuzzy, with no clear lines or details. Toward the bottom of the canvas, a lighter, cool blue area stretches horizontally across the frame. The overall mood of the piece is dark and stormy.

title: Opposite Corners
alt_text: A painting of a tall mirror leaning in the corner of a room. The mirror has a textured, light brown wood frame and stands on light-colored wooden floorboards. Inside the mirror, there is a reflection of the white walls and the same wooden floor seen from a slightly different angle. The room where the mirror sits has bright white walls with plain white baseboards along the floor. The painting creates a realistic illusion of an object placed within the space.

title: Movement
alt_text: A sculpture shows a collection of overlapping, abstract paper shapes arranged inside a clear rectangular box. The shapes include thin, pointed strips in shades of tan, olive green, and dark purple. These pieces are layered on top of each other, creating a sense of depth and shadow. To the left of the box, a separate, flat, clear sheet of acrylic lies on the smooth, tan surface. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the clean edges of the box and the paper elements.

title: Cel 4
medium: Tempera on plastic mounted on wood
alt_text: A painting on plastic shows several layered, abstract shapes against a translucent yellow background. In the upper middle section, a bright orange, irregular form stretches horizontally with a cutout circle. Beneath this, a pale yellow, jagged shape overlaps with a faint white circle. A dark grey, rough-edged form sits near the bottom with another cutout circle. These shapes appear to float on top of one another, creating a sense of depth against the yellow sheet. Four metal mounts hold the plastic sheet slightly away from the white wooden wall behind it.

title: The Halt
alt_text: A painting of a landscape scene features a horse-drawn carriage in the center of the foreground. Beside the white horse, a person kneels on the ground near a large fountain structure. In the background, a tall building with a rounded roof sits on a hill to the left. The rest of the scene is filled with a cloudy sky and rolling hills in the distance. The entire painting is held within a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame decorated with carvings.

title: Tapestry
alt_text: A textile made of wool and silk shows a dense forest scene framed by an ornate, flowery border. In the center, a large, leafy tree stands tall with a small bird perched on a branch. The ground below is filled with low shrubs and plants. A wide, rectangular border surrounds this scene, featuring repeating patterns of vines, leaves, and various flowers. The entire piece is rendered in shades of black, white, and gray.

title: Untitled
medium: Oil on matboard mounted on Masonite
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes set against a solid black background. On the left, a large, uneven white shape appears like a splash of paint with rough, textured edges. Inside the white shape, there are thin black lines forming geometric patterns, along with a small yellow circle and two small red, fuzzy-looking circles. To the right, a thin, white line curves upward, branching out like a slender plant or stalk. Below the white shape, a few simple, horizontal white lines are stacked on top of each other. A single, thin white circle floats near the bottom left corner of the composition.

title: Plastic Abstraction
alt_text: A painting on wood shows several overlapping geometric shapes against a solid gray background. A light tan parallelogram leans near the top left, pointing toward the upper edge. Below it, a large, dark gray rectangle overlaps with a lighter, creamy white rectangle. A smaller, brown triangle sits partially behind the other shapes, pointing downwards. The edges of all the shapes are straight and crisp, creating a feeling of layers and depth.

title: Composition
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes in shades of grey, brown, white, and black. A large, pale grey form curves vertically through the center, filled with thin, light blue dash-like marks. Several smooth, solid-colored geometric shapes are layered over this background, including a red crescent at the top, a small yellow triangle, and dark brown and black sections. The bottom of the canvas features a signature in the right corner. The overall composition is rounded and feels clustered toward the center of the frame.

title: The Genius
alt_text: A painting of a young person playing a musical instrument. The person has curly, light reddish-brown hair and is looking down at a dark, narrow flute held to their lips. They wear a simple, olive-green tunic with long sleeves and a high collar. The tunic has bright red strings or laces tied in small bows down the front. The person’s hands are positioned on the flute as if they are playing notes. The background is a solid, dark, and muted brown color.

title: Piece
alt_text: A textile of silk and velvet shows a repeating pattern of animals against a dark purple background. The fabric is rolled around a tube at the top, while the lower section lies flat on a white surface. The pattern consists of golden-brown shapes featuring mirrored pairs of winged creatures and birds. Small, delicate floral-like details fill the spaces between the larger figures. A small black label with the white text "1954.11.184" rests on the table in front of the fabric.

title: Piece
alt_text: A satin velvet textile shows a repeating, symmetrical floral and scroll pattern in shades of deep red, dark brown, and gold on a light cream background. The fabric is rolled up at both the top and the bottom ends, revealing the ornate design on the flat section in between. The colors are rich and warm, creating a strong contrast against the light-colored surface beneath the textile. A small, dark rectangular label with white numbers sits on the surface below the fabric. The overall scene looks like a view from inside an archive or museum storage room.

title: Bag of hand woven linen
alt_text: A textile bag made of woven linen and embroidered silk displays a rectangular shape with a repeating geometric pattern. The bag's front face is divided into a grid, with each square filled with complex, maze-like designs in shades of orange, yellow, grey, and red. Two twisted cords of red and black thread form a single handle attached to the top edge of the bag. Below the bottom edge of the textile sits a black, rectangular museum tag displaying the white numbers 1954.11.186. The entire object rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Bag of hand woven linen
alt_text: A textile piece depicts two stylized birds facing a central floral element on a cream-colored background. The birds and the central design are stitched in shades of orange, blue, and brown. A wide decorative border frames the central scene with repeating patterns of dark green and reddish-brown shapes. Two simple brown braided handles are attached to the top edge of the rectangular piece. Below the textile, a black rectangular sign displays the white numbers "1954.11.187."

title: The Triumph of Mars
alt_text: A painting shows a chaotic scene with two ornate chariots moving across a battlefield. On the left, a figure in golden armor sits atop a pile of weapons and shields. Beside them, people walk and gesture near the wheels of a large, heavy cart. To the right, another person in red and pink clothing drives a chariot pulled by two horses, holding a flaming torch high in the air. A woman in a long blue dress walks alongside the horses, gesturing with her arms. In the background, dark smoke rises from burning buildings and structures under a moody, grey sky.

title: Headcloth
alt_text: A textile showing an off-white fabric with decorative embroidery along one edge. The main body of the fabric has a rough, woven texture and runs across most of the image. A wide band of intricate stitching featuring red, black, and tan colors runs horizontally along the bottom edge. Above this main border, several small, separate circular or cross-shaped embroidered motifs are spaced out along the left side. The very bottom edge of the fabric is frayed with short, hanging threads.

title: The Kingdom of Hypnos
alt_text: A painting of many figures, including winged people, gathered in a busy outdoor setting. In the foreground, several people sit or lie on the ground, some partially covered by draped fabrics of red, yellow, and blue. A central figure with large, dark blue wings floats upon a gray cloud while gesturing toward the group. Near the top center, two winged figures hold up a large, pink cloth near a tall stone pillar. In the upper left corner, a pale figure flies upward while holding a long, thin rod and a circular object. Several other figures in various states of dress and movement fill the background and sides of the scene.

title: Embroidered cotton
alt_text: A textile showing an intricate pattern of bright red embroidery on a light-colored, off-white cloth. The design features repeating motifs of stylized flowers, swirling leaves, and ornate vines that cover nearly the entire surface of the fabric. Two horizontal bands with a scalloped, repeating geometric border divide the floral patterns across the center. The cloth piece has somewhat irregular, frayed edges where the fabric has been cut. A black identification label with the number "1954.11.196" sits at the bottom edge.

title: Length of embroidered cotton
alt_text: A textile piece of embroidery shows a long, rectangular border featuring bright red, green, and purple floral patterns. The fabric is light-colored and decorated with colorful thread stitches in stylized flower and leaf shapes. Small, round, silver-colored reflective discs are sewn onto the fabric among the embroidered shapes. A thin, wavy metallic thread runs horizontally across the top edge. The design is symmetrical, with two large red flowers flanking a central, complex pink and green figure.

title: The Lady of the Lake, from Scott's "The Lady of the Lake"
alt_text: A painting of four figures standing in a dark, outdoor scene. In the center, a woman in a long, tan dress stands beside a man wearing a bright red tunic and belt. To their right, another man wears a shorter dark outfit and faces slightly toward the left. In the background on the far left, a smaller, darker figure stands alone against a cloudy sky. The entire scene is enclosed within a wide, decorative gold frame.

title: Mucius Scaevola before Lars Porsenna
alt_text: A terracotta sculpture showing a relief scene filled with several figures. In the center, a group of people in robes and armor gathers around a rectangular altar with a fire burning on top. A man in armor reaches toward the flames, while others stand behind the altar watching. One person kneels on the left side, and another figure lies flat on the ground in the foreground. A small child stands on the far right side of the scene.

title: Kaaterskill Clove
canvas_label: This Image was Created for documentation purposes prior to going off site to 300 Prospect- photographed on August 12, 2008
alt_text: A painting of a vast mountain valley viewed from a rocky height. To the left, a tall, spindly pine tree stands on a ledge of light-colored rock. Below the tree, thick forests cover the steep slopes that angle down toward the center of the scene. In the distance, the valley floor fades into hazy layers of pale green and white under a soft blue sky. Another cluster of trees on the right frames the view, balanced against the foreground rocks.

title: Square of silk cloth
alt_text: A textile of silk shows a repeating pattern of birds and flowers set within a diamond-shaped grid. The fabric has an off-white background with a delicate, cracked texture throughout. The dark brown grid lines divide the pattern into sections that contain stylized leaves, branches, and multi-colored birds. A solid, dark brown band forms a border along the top, bottom, and side edges of the fabric piece. Below the fabric, a small label displays the number "1954.11.208" against a black background.

title: The Artist's Son (Frederick F. Durand, 1839-1909)
alt_text: A painting of a young child presented in an ornate, decorative gold frame. The child has fair skin, light-colored hair, and is positioned centrally against a dark, oval-shaped background. They are wearing a white garment and appear to be resting their arms on a soft, light-colored fabric. A small white label with blue writing, which reads "1974.47.2," is visible in the bottom right corner of the frame. The frame features intricate carvings with floral and scroll-like patterns.

title: Gambler's Door
alt_text: A painting of a five-dollar bill resting above a hand of playing cards on a wood-grain surface. The paper bill sits in the top half of the image, showing a portrait on the left and a small scene with figures on the right. Below the bill, five playing cards are fanned out in a spread. Each of these cards displays hearts as their suit, and three of them show the faces of kings. The background of the entire image is painted to look like light-colored wooden planks with long, dark vertical grain lines.

title: Pansies and Spirea
alt_text: A painting of a bowl of flowers sitting on a table. The low, wide bowl is light-colored with wavy edges and rests on a dark, carved wooden stand. Inside the bowl are several small purple and red pansies with green stems and leaves. Behind the bowl, large clusters of white flowers hang down from the upper right. The scene is set against a dark background, with a soft, fringed cloth spread across the surface below the bowl.

title: Wheatstack
alt_text: A painting of a tall, cone-shaped haystack standing in a field. The haystack is colored in shades of golden brown and dark, deep shadow. It sits in the left side of the frame, with a tall, thin wooden pole leaning against its side. Behind the haystack, a large, flat field stretches toward the horizon, where dark shapes of trees can be seen in the distance. The sky above is filled with soft, muted clouds in shades of gray and light blue. A small, tan paper tag with handwritten red text is attached to the bottom right corner of the frame.

title: Runner of cotton cloth with compound cloth borders
alt_text: A textile shows two wide decorative bands against a plain tan background. The long, rectangular piece of fabric lies flat on a light-colored surface. Each decorative section features parallel rows of black and dark red geometric embroidery patterns, including X-shapes and sawtooth edges. These two distinct bands are spaced apart, dividing the plain fabric into three horizontal segments. A small black label with white numbers sits at the very bottom of the frame.

title: Kingman Brewster, Jr. (b. 1919), BA 1941, MA (Hon.) 1960, LL.D. 1977
alt_text: A painting of a man, likely an oil portrait, shows him from the chest up. The man has grey hair and wears a dark suit with a white shirt and a dark tie. He looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression. To his right, a small oval portrait of a woman hangs on the dark wall in the background. High up on the wall to his left is a shield-shaped emblem that features an open book.

title: Charles Seymour (1885-1963), BA 1908, Ph.D. 1911
alt_text: A painting of an older man with short, thinning hair sits in a dark, formal setting. He wears a dark suit jacket, a white collared shirt, and a striped tie. His hands rest on a desk where a small white note lies near his right hand. To the left, a portion of a bookshelf filled with books is visible. On the wall behind him, two circular or shield-shaped emblems hang at different heights. The overall tone of the image is muted and serious.

title: Alfred Whitney Griswold (1906-1963), BA 1929, Ph.D 1933
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up, dressed in a dark suit with a white collared shirt and black tie. He is a middle-aged man with short hair, and he looks directly toward the viewer with a serious expression. To his left, there is a small book with text on the spine and a dark crest attached to the wall behind him. The man's hand is visible near the bottom, holding a thin chain that disappears into his pocket. The background is a simple, dark, and blurry wall.

title: Young Girl
alt_text: A painting of a person with short, reddish hair set against a dark background. The subject is framed within an oval shape on a rectangular canvas. They are wearing a light-colored shirt with a high, ruffled collar and a dark, multi-colored tie or scarf. The person faces forward with a neutral expression, their eyes looking directly ahead. Small, light-colored letters and numbers appear on the lower right side of the dark background.

title: Still Life with Cherries
alt_text: A painting of a cluster of ripe, red cherries resting on a dark surface. Several bright red cherries are grouped together in the center and foreground of the scene. They are attached to a small brown branch with several long, dark green leaves surrounding them. One single cherry sits slightly apart to the left, showing its pale interior. The background is a very dark, indistinct brown, creating a shadow behind the fruit.

title: Artists' Lane after a Shower
alt_text: A painting of a dense forest scene with tall trees and thick vegetation. A large, mossy tree trunk leans diagonally across the left side of the frame. In the center, a fallen log rests on the forest floor, partially hidden by brush. A small, dark pool of water sits in the foreground near the bottom edge. Sunlight filters through the deep green canopy in the background, creating a lighter spot in the middle distance. The overall scene is dark and shadowed with many shades of green, brown, and grey.

title: The Hackberry Giant
alt_text: A painting of a wooded landscape shows a forest scene with a large tree in the foreground. A thick, textured tree trunk stands prominently on the right side, with branches stretching up and across the upper half of the image. The forest floor is covered in rocks and small plants, leading back toward a soft, hazy light in the distance. Lush green trees fill the left side and background, creating a deep canopy overhead. The entire scene is enclosed within an ornate, rectangular gold frame.

title: Fragment of carved molding
alt_text: An architectural stone element shows a curved, decorative carving along one edge. The light tan stone fragment is shaped like an irregular, rounded chunk. A band of repeated floral shapes runs across the top, featuring small, deep holes in the center of each leaf pattern. The rest of the surface is mostly smooth and plain. A museum identification tag is attached to the bottom right side of the piece.

title: Mercury (Ray Parker's Green in the Shadow of Red)
alt_text: A painting of a large, inverted V-shape pattern composed of several colorful stripes. The center of the V is a pale, light-colored triangle pointing downward from the top edge. Surrounding this triangle are thick bands of yellow, bright orange, deep red, and a brownish-gold color. These angled bands extend from the upper sides toward the bottom center point of the canvas. The colors create a mirrored, symmetrical effect on both the left and right sides. All of the colored shapes meet neatly along the straight lines of the V.

title: Lipstick (Ascending) on Caterpillar Tracks
alt_text: A sculpture of a large lipstick tube sits atop the metal tank treads of a heavy vehicle. The tube stands vertically, featuring a bright orange top section and a tan, cylindrical base. Below the lipstick, a brown and rusted metal track assembly supports the upright form. This object is positioned in a paved courtyard outside a modern building with glass walls. Shadows from nearby trees stretch across the ground around the base of the sculpture.

title: Fishermen on a Sandy Bank
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a grassy hill beside a body of water. To the left, a large, sandy-colored ridge rises up with shadows covering parts of its face. Below the ridge, a small, dark figure stands near the edge of the water. On the right side, the land stretches out into the distance, fading into faint lines under a pale blue sky with light, scattered clouds. The painting is housed in a thick, decorative gold-colored frame with ornate details in the corners.

title: Black Man Picking Cotton
alt_text: A painting of a person working in a field of white plants. The figure stands in the center and wears a light-colored shirt and a cap. Their hands reach down into the plants as if they are picking something. The painting is set inside an ornate, rectangular gold frame. A paper tag hangs from the right side of the frame with handwriting on it.

title: Black Woman Carrying Basket of Cotton
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in a field with a basket balanced on her head. She wears a head covering and a long, dark dress with a lighter-colored top. The background shows rows of fluffy white plants stretching out behind her. The painting is held in a rectangular, ornate gold-colored frame with intricate carvings along the edges. A beige paper tag with handwritten red text hangs from the right side of the frame.

title: A Small Rainbow
alt_text: A painting showing a brown and white background with the words "A SMALL RAINBOW" written in shaky, dark letters across the top half. The upper portion of the surface is painted in messy, white, streaky paint, while the bottom portion is a solid, flat brown color. Near the center, a small rectangular area is carved out, revealing a deeper brown square that contains a tiny, simple, arc-shaped drawing of a rainbow. Below this rectangular shape, several thin, vertical drips of white paint run down the bottom half of the canvas. The overall appearance is rough and looks like an unfinished wall.

title: Portrait Bust of David Daggett
alt_text: A plaster cast sculpture of an older man's head and shoulders. The figure has short, thin hair and deep lines around his eyes, nose, and mouth. He wears a heavy cloth drape wrapped over his shoulders and chest. The material of the sculpture is a smooth, pale gray color. The bust rests on a round base. There is some minor damage, such as small chips, on the nose and the fabric of the drape.

title: Gutter I
alt_text: A painting showing a pile of trash and discarded objects on a ground surface. The debris includes a red and white cylindrical container lying horizontally near the center. Next to it is a crushed, crumpled gold-colored metallic item that looks like a box or a can. To the left are two lumpy, bright yellow rectangular shapes that appear soft or thick. Beneath these objects, the ground is dark and uneven, with a large, bright yellow patch of color painted on the rough surface nearby.

title: Art Like Love Is Dedication
alt_text: A painting of abstract, colorful shapes arranged against a light, neutral background. The center is dominated by large, chunky brushstrokes of bright green, royal blue, and deep red. Smaller dabs of orange, white, and brown are scattered throughout this central cluster. The paint is thick and layered in some spots, creating a rough texture. The edges of the painted shapes are soft and undefined, allowing them to bleed into the white space surrounding them.

title: The Blind Man of Paris
alt_text: A painting shows a bearded man sitting outdoors on a wooden bench with a small dog lying next to him. The man has long, dark, messy hair and wears a brown coat with a long, white, fringed scarf wrapped around his neck. He looks down at a small wooden box resting on his lap, which has a metal bowl attached to its front. A small, brown dog rests its head near the man's hand on the bench. To the right of the man, a copper-colored bucket sits on the ground near a broom leaning against a stone wall.

title: Study for the Bather
alt_text: A painting shows a nude figure standing in the center of a room with reddish walls. The person has light skin and shoulder-length brown hair, looking directly toward the viewer. Their right hand rests on the back of a simple wooden chair, and their left hand holds a white cloth that hangs down. On the right side, there is a cabinet with a small pitcher and bowl on top. The room is painted in muted tones with a dark floor, while the figure wears bright red shoes.

title: Yes or No?
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in profile, seen from the waist up. She has wavy reddish-brown hair pulled back and is wearing a dark, long-sleeved dress with a high collar. Her hands are clasped behind her back, and she holds a small, rectangular white object in one hand. To her left, a small glass vase with a flared top sits on a wooden table next to a folded piece of white paper. The background is a solid, textured shade of dark brown, suggesting a simple curtain or wall.

title: Dos cuadritos (Two Squares)
medium: Painted wood and metal, and Formica
alt_text: A sculpture of painted wood, metal, and Formica displays geometric shapes against a patterned background. The background consists of vertical, evenly spaced black and white stripes. Two solid, square panels are mounted onto this striped surface. One square is matte black and sits in the upper-left quadrant, partially overlapping a smaller, ridged black square underneath. A bright blue square sits in the lower-right quadrant, also partially overlapping a smaller, ridged black square behind it.

title: Carl Albert Lohmann (1887–1957), B.A. 1910, M.A. (Hon.) 1926, L.H.D. 1953
alt_text: A painting of an elderly man with white hair and glasses wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and blue tie. He stands against a wooden paneled wall, holding a folded white paper in his hands. On the wall behind him are several items, including a small shield with a green animal, an eagle symbol, and a hand tool hanging on the left. The man stands slightly to the right of center in front of a workbench area. The entire portrait is enclosed in a thick, metallic gold frame.

title: Forest and Hunter
alt_text: A painting of a dark, wooded landscape under a cloudy sky. Bare, thin trees with pale trunks stand scattered across the foreground and middle ground. The ground is covered in shadowed, brownish brush and grass. A thick, dark treeline stretches horizontally across the horizon. The entire scene is framed in a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Odyssey II
alt_text: A red painted aluminum sculpture shows several large, circular, flat shapes joined together. These curved panels intersect in the center to create a dynamic, abstract form. The bright red surface is smooth and reflects the light. The object sits on a plain, light-colored square platform on the ground. A dark, stone building with arched windows is visible in the background, out of focus.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a landscape with two small houses and several large, dark trees. The scene is dominated by a cloudy, textured sky painted in swirls of grey and tan. In the foreground, there is a flat, dark-colored ground that reflects slightly in the lower section of the painting. Two small, simple houses sit nestled among trees in the middle distance. The brushstrokes are thick and visible throughout the entire image, giving the surface a rough and textured appearance.

title: Assisi
alt_text: A painting of a hillside town overlooking a valley. A steep, light-colored path leads up from the bottom left toward a cluster of buildings. Several simple stone houses sit nestled into the slope of the hill. A small tower or church steeple rises above the rooftops in the middle distance. Dark, moody clouds fill the sky above the hills, while the lower valley area appears muted and hazy.

title: Two Women Drinking Tea
medium: Unfinished Oil on canvas, pencil and traces of white chalk
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting at a table in a garden setting. The woman is on the right side of the image, wearing a light-colored, long-sleeved blouse with a high collar. She looks forward while holding a small teacup near her face. To her left sits a vase filled with colorful flowers on the table. Behind her, an arched structure opens up to a view of green trees and a garden. The left side of the canvas remains largely unpainted, showing only the faint pencil outlines of another figure seated across from her.

title: Head of a Young Girl
alt_text: A painting of a girl's head and shoulders shown from above. She has light brown hair held back by a light blue headband. Her head is tilted downward, and her eyes appear to be closed or looking down. A soft, hazy cloud of purplish-gray color surrounds the back of her head and neck. She wears a white collared shirt that blends into the unfinished, beige background.

title: English (?) Scene
alt_text: A painting showing a hazy, light-colored landscape by a waterfront. In the background, buildings with a prominent central dome rise above a low wall. The foreground features a calm body of water with the faint outlines of several small boats floating on the surface. To the far right, a sturdy rectangular pier or dock structure extends into the water. The overall scene is washed in soft, dusty tones of orange, tan, and light blue.

title: Still Life - A Potted Plant
alt_text: A painting of a potted plant sitting on a wooden surface. A simple, reddish-brown clay pot sits in the center of the frame, holding a plant with green leaves and small white flowers. The plant leans slightly toward the right side of the image. Behind the plant, the background is a solid, textured wall painted in shades of dark brown. Below the pot, the rectangular wooden stand has visible horizontal lines across its surface. The entire painting uses earthy colors and appears rustic.

title: Study of a Black Man from Behind
alt_text: A painting shows a person standing with their back to the viewer against a muted, greenish-brown background. The figure wears a dark brown, long-sleeved jacket and light-colored pants. On their head is a simple brown hat with a small, leaf-like accent on the side. Their left arm is bent at the elbow, and they hold a long, thin, vertical pole or staff in their hand. The painting is framed in plain, light-brown wood.

title: Pair of Roof Corbels in the form of Dragons
alt_text: A pair of wood carvings shows two mythical creatures sitting side by side. Both figures are made of brown oak and feature curved, long necks with heads tilted upward. They have large, textured bodies with what look like scales or thick fur. Each creature has a powerful front leg raised slightly off the ground. The background is a plain, light-colored surface, making the darker wood stand out.

title: Shawl
alt_text: A wool textile shows a repeating pattern of teardrop-shaped figures in dark brown against a lighter background. These large, curved teardrops are arranged side-by-side along the top section of the fabric. Below them sits a band decorated with smaller, similar teardrop shapes and wavy lines. The bottom edge of the fabric is finished with a fringe of long, loose threads. The woven material has a slightly rough, textured appearance throughout.

title: Arcadia
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a series of figures in a long horizontal relief. On the left side, a person stands alone and faces away from the other figures. Next to them, a person walks using a long staff, followed by two people walking close together while draped in long robes. On the far right, another person sits down and plays a small flute-like instrument. A small dog sits attentively on the ground right in front of the seated musician.

title: Moses Titcomb (1707-1755) (attributed to Joseph Blackburn)
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up against a dark background. He has a pale face, dark hair, and is looking straight ahead. He wears a dark blue outer coat with large buttons and a red vest underneath. A white cloth is visible at his neck. A small white label with black numbers sits at the bottom edge of the frame.

title: Shawl
alt_text: A textile of jacquard-woven wool shows a symmetrical, rectangular pattern in shades of orange, brown, and cream. The center features a bright orange, lobed shape surrounded by intricate, flowing swirls and paisley-like motifs. A decorative border runs along the edges, containing small, repeating shapes in orange and black. Fringed tassels hang from both the left and right ends of the fabric. The overall design creates a mirrored effect, repeating the complex patterns on both the top and bottom halves.

title: Abraham Davenport (1715/16-1789), B.A. 1732, M.A. 1735
alt_text: A painting of an elderly man with white hair sitting in a dark-colored chair. He is dressed in a formal black suit, vest, and breeches, and he looks directly at the viewer. One of his hands rests on a green-covered table that holds an open book and some papers. Behind him, a heavy red curtain with gold tassels hangs near a window. The room is dimly lit and features simple, neutral walls.

title: Two Boys at Seashore
alt_text: A painting shows a group of three people on a light-colored, sandy beach near the ocean. One person stands in the center foreground, holding a light cloth while looking down. A second person sits on the sand in the foreground, facing the standing figure with one leg stretched out. In the background, a third, smaller figure sits alone on the beach near the water. Behind the beach, a steep, light-colored cliff rises up, and the sea stretches out toward the horizon. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, weathered wooden frame.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a distorted figure within a sparsely furnished room. The figure has long blonde hair and is facing away, sitting on a small, light-green chair in the corner of the room. A large, oversized hand and arm extend prominently into the foreground, stretching across the middle of the frame. Below this arm, a single, large, bare foot rests on the reddish floorboards. The room is painted with muted green walls and a dark reddish-brown floor, creating a surreal and ambiguous scene.

title: Personnages dans un parc (People in a Park)
alt_text: A painting of abstract, wispy shapes that resemble a tall, spindly figure or a tree standing against a light beige background. Thin, shaky lines in reddish-brown and green create delicate, branch-like forms that reach upward across the canvas. Patches of white paint look like soft clouds or misty areas scattered around the scene. A few bright pops of red and yellow paint sit near the center and lower right, acting like small flowers or accents. The entire composition has an airy, sketch-like feel without solid, filled-in areas.

title: Le Zouave (The Sleeping Spahi)
alt_text: A painting of a person lying down, resting on their side. The figure wears a vibrant red jacket and loose, light-colored pants. One arm is propped behind their head, while their knees are bent toward the chest. Heavy, rumpled fabric drapes over the person's upper body and lower legs. The background is a muted, dark brown, creating a somber mood for the scene.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes is presented in an ornate, gold-colored frame. The central composition features flat, interlocking forms in shades of black, gray, white, and dark brown. At the top, thin black lines create a vertical pattern against a dark background. Below, lighter shapes suggest the layered parts of a musical instrument with angular curves. The overall style is fragmented and lacks realistic detail.

title: Grasshopper (Sculpture de la serie des Animaux)
alt_text: A welded iron sculpture sits perched on a simple, square stone pedestal. The sculpture is horizontal and long, resembling a sleek metal object with a wide, flat front section. Its structure becomes thinner and more open toward the right, where many thin metal rods crisscross in a delicate web. A small, dark, fan-shaped piece hangs down near the center of the structure, adding a sense of weight to the intricate frame. The entire dark, weathered object stands in sharp contrast against the plain, light grey background.

title: Builders of Ships
alt_text: A painting of three men standing in front of the large, wooden frame of a ship under construction. The ship's skeleton towers over the scene, made of many thin, tan beams. The men are in the foreground, with one seated on a block and two others standing while handling a rope. To the right of the men, a large, yellow cart with wooden wheels sits on the ground. The background shows a cloudy, dark blue sky and a glimpse of the ocean in the distance.

title: The Greek Slave
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows a standing woman with her head turned slightly to the right. Her hair is pulled back into a simple bun at the nape of her neck. She is unclothed, and her hands are positioned in front of her waist as if holding a short chain that connects her wrists. To her right, a piece of draped fabric with tasseled edges hangs down toward the round, carved base. The entire figure rests on an ornate pedestal that flares outward at the bottom.

title: Girl in White Chemise
alt_text: A painting of a woman lying down on a cushioned surface. She is wearing a short, white, ruffled garment with a lacy top and long sleeves. Her dark hair is pulled back, and she faces the viewer with her head propped on her hand. Behind her, the background is a mix of bold shapes and colors, including deep red, green, and large, abstract floral patterns. She rests her arm on a small, dark circular table to her right. The overall style uses thick, visible brushstrokes and vivid, contrasting colors.

title: Paysage de Provence
alt_text: A painting of a textured, tan landscape that fills most of the frame. The surface is composed of rough, horizontal layers that look like stacked rock or earth. A band of darker geometric patterns stretches across the middle, featuring a row of dark triangles inside a wavy line. In the upper right, a small, dark circle is marked with a grid pattern. A solid, dark, vertical strip runs along the right side of the painting, contrasting with the lighter, brownish colors elsewhere.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured shapes in shades of black, white, red, and blue. The surface is covered in short, thick, and overlapping brushstrokes that move in different directions. Many patches of deep black create dark, vertical streaks through the center and bottom of the composition. Bright white and red highlights are scattered across the top and sides, giving the image a chaotic, lively feel. The painting is framed in a thin, simple metal border that stands out against the textured colors.

title: The Garden of Samurai
alt_text: A painting of abstract, organic shapes set against a bright orange background. Large, deep blue forms dominate the center and left side of the composition, resembling twisting limbs or swirling masses. A small, vibrant orange circle sits near the top of the blue cluster, while a contrasting turquoise disc appears slightly to its right. The lower section is filled with darker, brownish tones that anchor the blue shapes. Streaks of white paint create a sense of motion or light near the top of the canvas.

title: Saint Paul
alt_text: A painting of a bearded man with brown hair, shown from the chest up against a deep red background. He wears loose, draped white robes that fall over his shoulders and arms. In his left hand, he holds a rectangular book with a textured red cover, decorative metal corners, and a central clasp. With his right hand, he grips the hilt of a tall sword that points downward. A long, wavy white ribbon hangs behind his head and shoulders, featuring letters printed in black ink on the left side.

title: La Seine à Bougival (The Seine at Bougival)
alt_text: A painting of a river scene showing two boats moored along a grassy bank. On the left, a person stands near a wooden fence beneath leafy trees. Several other small boats are docked together near the shore, their reflections visible in the water. Across the calm river, a line of houses sits along a green, sloping bank. The sky above is filled with soft, gray clouds.

title: Falls of Tivoli
medium: Oil on paper mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a mountainous landscape with several waterfalls cascading down dark cliffs. A prominent, large waterfall spills down the center right of the scene. To the left, a smaller, lighter waterfall flows over rocks and into a pool at the bottom of the frame. The mountains in the background appear muted and brown under a pale, cloudy sky. Deep greens and earthy tones dominate the rocky terrain surrounding the water.

title: Bather (cast by Rudier, after the wood sculpture of 1896)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a nude woman stands against a neutral gray background. She is depicted in a full-length, standing pose. Her right arm is raised, with her hand resting on the back of her head. Her left arm hangs down beside her body, and some draped fabric rests near her lower left leg. The figure has a smooth, dark metallic surface.

title: Forest Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a quiet outdoor scene framed by dark, leafy trees on the left and right sides. In the center, there is a hazy view of a distant hill covered in forest with some light-colored buildings at its base. A pale, cloudy sky fills the gap between the trees above the distant landscape. In the bottom right foreground, a person wearing a red top stands near a low stone wall. The rest of the foreground is shaded in dark, earthy tones.

title: Still Life with Two Apples
alt_text: A painting of two round, pale fruits sitting on a flat, brown surface. The fruits are light tan or yellow in color with slightly textured surfaces. They are positioned side-by-side against a dark, roughly painted brown background. Each fruit is simple and rounded, with a small dimple at the top. A faint, dark signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the painting.

title: Saint Jerome
alt_text: A painting of an elderly man with a long white beard kneeling in a dark space. He is hunched over and writing in a large open book that rests on a rocky surface in front of him. Next to the book stands a small, simple wooden cross and a dark inkwell with a quill. On the ground near the man's knees lies a human skull. The entire scene is bathed in warm, shadowy brown tones that fade into darkness in the background.

title: A Gentleman in Red Plumed Hat Holding a Glass
alt_text: A painting of a man in an oval frame, rendered in oil on wood. The man has long, dark hair and wears a reddish-orange hat tilted to one side. He looks forward with a mustache and a light beard, while holding a small object in front of his chest. His clothing is muted in color, with a pale shirt visible near his neck. The painting is set inside a heavy, rectangular wooden frame that has layers of molding.

title: Route du Midi
alt_text: A painting of a sunlit road winding through a wooded area. The road is light tan and bordered by a low, smooth wall that curves from the bottom center toward the middle of the frame. Tall, dark trees with thick trunks rise up on the left side and along the background, casting shadows. The ground beside the road is covered in patches of dry grass and brush in shades of yellow and brown. The scene is encased in a wide, ornate, gold-colored frame that takes up the entire border.

title: Elegy to the Spanish Republic, No. 78
alt_text: A painting of large, bold black shapes set against a solid off-white background. A thick, straight black line stretches horizontally across the top third of the canvas. Below this line, several irregular black forms extend downwards into the open space. To the left, a very large, blocky black shape dominates the frame and curves toward the center. Two smaller, rounded black oval shapes hang from the right side of the horizontal line. The painting creates a strong contrast between the dark, uneven edges of the shapes and the bright background.

title: The Great Obsession
alt_text: A painting of seven people arranged against a background of expressive, abstract brushstrokes. A man in a white coat sits on the left side, while a standing woman in a white lab coat holds paintbrushes near him. A man wearing a dark jacket sits in the center of the image and holds a smoking pipe to his lips. To his right, another man in a dark shirt sits in a chair, looking directly forward. Smaller portraits of three other men appear near the top of the canvas, partially blended into the yellow and purple background paint.

title: Bather Putting up Her Hair
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a standing, unclothed woman who looks downward. Her arms are raised and bent with both hands resting behind her head. Her body is smooth and slightly curved, standing on a small, dark rectangular base. One of her feet is placed on a slightly raised stone or ledge attached to the base. The surface of the statue is a dark, uniform brown color.

title: Saint Mary Magdalen Anointing the Feet of Christ
alt_text: A painting shows a group of five people sitting at a long table covered with a white cloth, while another person kneels on the floor in front of them. The seated figures wear colorful robes and have golden circular halos around their heads. On the table sit several small, round plates with pieces of bread and a small dark container. The kneeling person is wrapped in a bright red robe and has long hair with a golden halo. In the bottom left corner, a small, furry brown animal lies on the tiled floor. The entire scene takes place in an indoor room with a patterned fabric wall hanging in the background.

title: Portrait of a Woman
alt_text: A painting of a young woman set against a circular, dark blue background. She wears a white headpiece that drapes down the sides of her face and a black dress with intricate, patterned details at her waist. In her right hand, she holds a small, bright red flower. Her left hand rests near her waist and shows two gold rings on her fingers. Text in gold letters is visible on either side of her head.

title: Woman in Patterned Blouse
alt_text: A painting of a woman wearing a white blouse with colorful floral patterns. She has short, wavy reddish-brown hair and bright red lips. Her white shirt is covered in simple painted flowers in blue, purple, red, and green. She also wears a necklace made of several strands of dark and red beads. A solid, textured blue color fills the background, with a dark brown shape on the left side that looks like the back of a chair.

title: Square
alt_text: A brocaded satin textile shows a large, rectangular piece of fabric lying flat against a white surface. The fabric is a dusty gold or mustard color and features an intricate pattern of swirling lines and floral shapes. Faint, muted patches of blue, orange, and white are woven into the design. A visible seam runs vertically down the center, dividing the piece into two slightly uneven halves. The edges of the fabric appear frayed and rough. A small black tag with white numbers sits centered along the bottom edge of the textile.

title: Poster Portrait: Dove
alt_text: A painting showing the word "DOVE" in large, white, capital letters against a light blue sky. Below the word, a curved brown sickle arches over a bunch of dark purple grapes and a pinecone sitting on a green surface. The handle of the sickle is wrapped with a bright red ribbon tied in a bow. The background includes a dark green textured area at the bottom and a small patch of blue water in the distance. The composition is simple and focuses on these few objects arranged together.

title: Charles Reynolds Brown (1862-1950), MA (Hon.) 1911, D.D. (Hon.) 1928
alt_text: A painting of an older man wearing a suit. The man is shown from the chest up and faces toward the front. He has a receding hairline, pale skin, and is wearing small, round glasses. He is dressed in a dark grey suit jacket, a white collared shirt, and a simple blue tie. The background is a plain, muted brown color, and the painting is enclosed in a thick, metallic gold frame.

title: Zedekiah Smith Barstow (1790-1873), BA 1813
alt_text: A painting of a man, shown from the chest up, sits within a gold, rectangular frame. The man has short, dark brown hair and is looking slightly to his left. He wears a dark, possibly black, high-collared jacket. A white, rectangular neckpiece, split into two vertical bands, hangs down over his chest. The background is a dark, indistinct brown color that fades into shadow behind him.

title: Moses and the Brazen Serpent
alt_text: A painting of a crowd gathered outdoors in a rocky landscape beneath a cloudy sky. An older man with a long white beard stands on a central ledge, wearing robes and holding a long staff out to his side. Below him, people are scattered across the ground, with many sitting, kneeling, or lying down in poses of distress or rest. Some individuals are unclothed, while others wear draped fabric in muted colors like grey, blue, and red. A tall, thin, leafless stick or pole stands upright on the rocky formation behind the central figure.

title: Green Lips
medium: Oil on canvas with rubber lips
alt_text: A painting of a large, circular shape set against a black background. The circle is painted in a solid, vibrant shade of teal or blue-green. In the very center of this circle, there is a small, dark, circular feature that looks like a pair of lips. This central element is textured and creates a focal point in the smooth expanse of color. The overall composition is simple and symmetrical, with the dark lips resting perfectly in the middle of the teal disk.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Saint William of Maleval (Guglielmo da Malavalle), a Deacon Saint (probably Saint Stephen), and a Bishop Saint (probably Saint Sabinus)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on a throne and holding a baby on her lap. She wears a long, dark robe while the child is wrapped in thin, light-colored fabric. To her left, an older man with a beard stands wearing a brown cloak and holding a staff. On her right stands a younger man in a red robe, and below them, a figure in elaborate, patterned robes kneels on the ground. The background is filled with gold leaf, and the figures are framed by a rounded, decorative golden border.

title: A Texas Pony
alt_text: A painting of a person riding a horse across a barren, flat landscape. The rider is a man wearing a wide-brimmed hat and dark clothing, leaning forward in the saddle. He sits on a horse with a coat of white and dark patches. The horse is walking slowly, with its head lowered toward the dry ground. The entire scene is depicted in shades of grey and white.

title: Skylark
medium: Bronze, dark reddish-bronze patina, and steel base with dark reddish-bronze patina
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a tall, thin figure stands against a plain grey background. The figure has a rough, pitted surface that looks like dark, weathered metal. Its narrow, spindly legs come together at the bottom to balance on a rectangular base. The torso is slender and bony, branching out into wing-like arms that curve upward. A spiky, star-shaped form sits near the top, resembling a head or crown.

title: The Assumption of the Virgin
alt_text: A painting of a central figure rising upward toward a golden light while surrounded by swirling clouds and cherubs. Below this, a large, dense crowd of people gazes up at the sky with their hands raised in wonder. Many of these figures are kneeling or standing close together, dressed in loose, flowing robes of muted red, white, and brown. The scene is filled with soft, glowing light, and the brushstrokes appear loose and energetic. The overall tone of the painting is hazy and dramatic, with the bottom half occupied by the group of people and the top half dominated by the ascending figure and surrounding spirits.

title: Silver Dispersion
alt_text: A sculpture of reprocessed wire shows three dark, tangled, and cloud-like masses floating on a white background. These three shapes are clustered together, with one large cluster in the foreground and two smaller ones sitting behind it. The texture of the wire looks like messy, interlaced loops and thin threads, creating a dense and shadowy appearance. The edges of each mass are fuzzy and irregular, fading slightly into the white surface underneath. The overall composition creates a sense of depth as the shapes overlap each other.

title: Gallows and Lollipops
alt_text: A painted steel sculpture of an abstract structure stands in the center of a graveled outdoor area. The base of the sculpture is a large, red, tripod-like shape that tapers to a point at the top. From this central point, thin metal arms extend outward, holding flat geometric shapes that are black, orange, yellow, blue, and white. These shapes hang in the air at various levels. In the background, there is a tall green hedge, a brick building, and a glass-walled building under a clear sky. A set of small tables and chairs sits on the gravel to the right of the red sculpture.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a quiet, green landscape featuring a wooden bridge crossing a stream in the foreground. Tall, leafy trees frame the scene on both the left and right sides. A simple wooden fence separates the grassy foreground from a distant open field. In the lower right corner, a cow with a dark brown coat grazes among the bushes. Beyond the field, light blue mountains fade into a bright, cloudy sky.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a landscape set inside a round frame that is mounted within a square, ornate gold frame. The scene shows trees with autumn-colored foliage, including patches of deep orange and brown. A dark, still body of water reflects the sky in the lower portion of the circle. On the right side, a large, light-colored tree trunk leans across the view. Below the frame, a white tag with the handwritten number 1965.37 sits against a background of metal storage shelves.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature jewelry portrait shows a watercolor painting on ivory of a young man with curly brown hair. He is set inside a detailed, oval-shaped gold frame that features decorative scrolling patterns along the edges. The man wears a dark coat and a black necktie over a white collared shirt, and he looks directly toward the viewer. The portrait is housed within a red, open case lined with green velvet. A small gold loop sits at the very top of the frame for hanging or attachment.

title: Catskill Waterfall
alt_text: A painting of a dark, rocky forest scene shows large, mossy boulders stacked around a small stream. In the center, a thin waterfall trickles down between the rocks into the shadows. High up on the rocks, two tiny figures stand near the top edge of the stone formation. Lush green trees and dense foliage fill the background, obscuring much of the sky. A textured birch tree with pale bark stands prominently in the bottom right corner near more rocky ground.

title: Wrexham Tower
alt_text: A painting of a stone building with a tall tower rising above surrounding structures. The tall tower stands in the center and has many arched windows and pointed details. Lower wings of the building extend to the left and right, with smaller windows and peaked roofs. Large, leafy green trees grow on both sides of the central tower. A wide, smooth green lawn stretches across the entire foreground, sitting in front of the buildings. The sky behind the building is a soft, warm orange color.

title: Exterior of a Russian Church
alt_text: A painting of a white building with a large golden dome and several arched openings. The building is set against a dark, stormy sky with sweeping, cloud-like brushstrokes. To the right, the structure has an open section with two bell-like shapes visible inside. In front of the building, the ground is a muted, brownish color. A small, dark, shadowy figure stands near the base of an archway on the lower right side. The entire scene is framed by a simple, dark-colored border.

title: Interior of a Russian Church
alt_text: A painting of an ornate church interior shows a solitary person standing and praying in the center of a large hall. The walls are covered in colorful religious murals and decorative paneling that spans the entire width of the room. Two large, intricate chandeliers hang from the ceiling, casting dim light over the dark floor. Small doorways and columns separate different sections of the wall art.
