A person in a long robe stands facing a small pedestal, their back to the viewer.

title: Benjamin Silliman (1779-1864), BA 1796, MA 1799
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory of a man’s portrait in an oval gold frame. The man has short, light brown hair and is facing forward with a neutral expression. He wears a dark, possibly black, jacket with a high collar and a white ruffled cravat at his neck. The portrait is mounted on a rectangular, black, cracked surface with a small gold loop at the top for hanging. A gold floral ornament is attached just above the oval frame on the black background.

title: The Peaceable Kingdom
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a group of people standing on the left and a collection of wild and domestic animals on the right. In the center foreground, a young person in a long white robe stands with an arm resting on the head of a lion, while a leopard lies down in the grass at their feet. Behind them, a cow, a small goat, and a white sheep gather in a peaceful group near the woods. On the left side of the scene, a crowd of men in 18th-century clothing stands on a hill under a pink and blue sky. A long, flowing banner with faint writing weaves through the people and extends toward the center of the painting. The entire image is bordered by a dark wooden frame with the words "PEACEABLE KINGDOM" painted in gold letters at the bottom.

title: The Peaceable Kingdom and Penn's Treaty
alt_text: A painting of various animals gathered together in a grassy landscape. In the foreground, a large, brown, and white ox stands behind a tan leopard that is lying on the ground. Next to the ox, a brown lion with a full mane faces the viewer while standing near a small, pale-skinned child wearing white and red clothing. The background shows a river with small figures standing on a beach and a large, stone archway surrounded by trees. The sky above is cloudy with soft, reddish light on the horizon. A group of smaller animals, including a small wolf-like creature and a white lamb, rest near the lion and child.

title: Bob's Steer Head
alt_text: A painting of an animal skull centered against a soft, tan background. The skull is bone-colored with prominent, long horns that curve outward and down on both sides. A thick, textured patch of light-colored hair sits on top of the skull between the base of the horns. The face of the skull is symmetrical, with deep, dark eye sockets and a large, open nose cavity at the bottom. The entire composition is simple, featuring only the skull and the solid, muted backdrop.

title: Floating Helmets
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing an abstract, dark figure standing upright. The sculpture rests on a plain, light-colored square base. Its top section resembles a wide, curved canopy or a large mushroom cap that hangs over the rest of the form. Below this cap, several thin, dark, vertical shapes extend downward to the base, looking somewhat like legs or stems. The entire sculpture has a rough, textured surface and a very dark, matte finish.

title: The Lamentation
alt_text: A wooden sculpture shows a group of people gathered around a figure lying on the ground. A central figure is stretched out horizontally, while the other figures sit or stand in a circle around them. Some figures reach out to hold the person in the center, while others hold their hands against their chests or faces in a gesture of concern. All the figures wear long, draped clothing with many folds and creases. The entire sculpture is carved from a single color of wood and set against a neutral grey background.

title: Undine at the Window
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing outside a stone cottage. She has long, flowing hair that is blowing in the wind across her face and behind her. She wears a long, light-colored dress and stands barefoot in a field of small white flowers. Behind her, a twisted tree stands near a grassy hill, with a hint of water in the distance. The overall scene uses soft, muted colors like brown, tan, and faded green.

title: Spanish Gothic Carpet
alt_text: A textile shows an intricate, repeating pattern in shades of brown and tan. The fabric has a main field covered with large, circular floral-like motifs connected by thin, branching lines. A distinct horizontal border runs along the bottom edge, featuring a row of smaller, symmetrical designs that look like stylized plants or crests. The entire surface appears textured, with the darker brown pattern standing out against the lighter, golden-brown background. A small black label with white text rests on the white surface just below the bottom edge of the fabric. The cloth extends upward and rolls up slightly on the far left side.

title: Robert Louis Stevenson 1850-1894
alt_text: A bronze sculpture in the shape of a large, dark brown circular medallion shows a man in profile. He is seated and propped up by large pillows, with a blanket draped over his legs. He holds a pen in one hand and seems to be resting against a chair or headboard on the right side. The background is filled with rows of carved text that cover the entire surface behind the man. The bronze surface has a smooth, metallic sheen that catches the light on his face, hands, and the folds of his clothes.

title: Virgin and Child
medium: Tempera on panel, transferred to canvas and mounted on panel
alt_text: A painting of a larger figure holding a smaller figure against a gold background. The larger figure is on the left, draped in a dark blue garment that covers their head and shoulders. They hold the smaller figure, who is wrapped in an orange cloth, close to their chest. Both figures have pale, worn facial features and are turned toward one another in an embrace. The surface of the painting is heavily cracked and shows signs of wear, with patches of the gold background flaking away. The top of the rectangular painting is arched.

title: Harbor Scene
alt_text: A painting of a dark, moody waterfront scene with several buildings and boats. On the left, tall, dark brick structures with pointed roofs line the water's edge. A few small boats are moored near the shore, their masts reaching up toward the sky. The water is calm and reflects the buildings and the gray, overcast sky above. Farther out on the water, a few other boats and small figures are visible in the distance. The entire scene is painted in muted tones of gray, brown, and deep red.

title: Balance
alt_text: A bronze weighing tool shows a metal bar with several hooks and a decorative counterweight. The horizontal bar hangs from a small hook at the top, and two long chains dangle from one end, ending in two separate hooks. On the opposite end of the bar, a solid bronze weight shaped like a person’s head hangs from a small chain. The head features stylized hair and a robe draped over the shoulders. A white paper tag with a barcode hangs near the counterweight. The entire object rests against a light-colored, textured fabric background.

title: Landscape with Grotto and Figures
alt_text: A painting of people riding horses through a large, rocky cave. The massive cave entrance creates a dark frame, with hanging plants and vines draping from the top. Through the opening, a bright, distant landscape with green trees and hills is visible. In the foreground, two figures on horseback and one person sitting on the ground occupy a narrow, light-colored path. A small dog stands near the riders on the right side of the cave floor. Water trickles down the smooth, light-colored rock wall on the far right.

title: Saint Gangolf
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in a landscape. He has a brown beard and a golden halo behind his head. He wears a flowing pink robe over a dark blue tunic and grey leggings. In his right hand, he holds a green leafy palm frond, and in his left hand, he holds a tall, upright sword. Text is written at both the top and bottom of the frame on painted banners.

title: The Hindu Model (Le Modele Hindou)
alt_text: A painting of a person reclining on a pale purple surface. The figure is lying on their side with one arm raised behind their head, holding a white folding fan with painted red, blue, and green designs. They are wearing a simple necklace and have dark hair. Behind the figure, a long, horizontal band of red fabric features repeating floral patterns and decorative swirls. The lower portion of the purple surface is covered with scattered, short dark blue brushstrokes.

title: George Washington (1732-1799) LL.D. 1781, 1789
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a profile portrait of a person in white set against a dark background. The portrait is shaped like an oval and features a person with hair tied back, facing to the left. A wide, metallic frame surrounds the oval center, decorated with a border of small, clear, faceted stones. These stones create a sparkling edge around the dark, central image. The entire piece has a long, pointed, almond-like shape.

title: Marquis de Lafayette (1757-1834)
alt_text: A miniature enamel painting shows a portrait of a man looking toward the left. He has light brown, wavy hair and wears a dark blue coat over a white collared shirt with a cravat. A light-colored coat with a fuzzy or textured collar is draped over his shoulders. The background features dark, swirling clouds that fill most of the space behind him. In the lower-left corner of the background, a small, faint image depicts tiny figures standing near a tall structure. The entire scene is encased in a simple, square frame with a gold inner border and a black outer edge.

title: Gentleman, possibly George Livermore
alt_text: A miniature of a young man shows him from the chest up against a muted, greenish-gray background. He has light brown hair parted to one side and a smooth, fair complexion. He wears a dark, possibly black, coat over a high-collared white shirt with a wide, dark necktie. The subject is framed within a rectangular case that has a thin, deep red border. The image looks like it is protected by a layer of glass or clear plastic.

title: Unknown Divine
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a person with dark, wavy hair looking off to the side. The person wears small round glasses and a dark, high-collared garment with a white neck tab. The portrait is set inside a thin gold-colored frame, which is encased in a larger, rectangular black frame with a cracked, textured finish. A small, golden decorative piece shaped like a leaf and acorn sits at the very top of the black frame. A simple gold ring hangs above the leaf ornament, likely for hanging the frame on a wall.

title: Gentleman of the Dunlap Family
alt_text: A miniature painting in watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a man looking forward. He has dark, wavy hair and wears a dark coat over a high, white collar. The portrait is set inside a thin, rectangular gold frame. This frame is mounted on a larger, square black plaque with a shiny, cracked surface. A small brass ring hangs from a floral-shaped ornament at the very top of the black frame.

title: Lady
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows the head and shoulders of a woman. She faces forward with her body angled slightly to the side. Her dark brown hair is styled high on her head, with a small string of pearls visible in the back and a lock resting on her right shoulder. She wears a low-cut dress with light, ruffled fabric at the neckline. A thin, gold oval frame surrounds the portrait, which includes a small metal loop at the top. The background is a soft, muted grey-green color that fades to a lighter tone near the woman.

title: Lady
alt_text: A watercolor miniature showing a woman from the chest up. She has dark hair parted in the middle and pulled back, and she is wearing a dark blue dress with a white ruffled collar. A small, oval brooch is pinned at the center of her collar. The woman is set within a decorative, golden oval frame with intricate swirled patterns. This frame is displayed inside a simple, dark brown case with soft, dark red inner edges.

title: Benjamin Frederick Augustus Dashiell (1763-1820)
alt_text: A collection of miniature jewelry components and a portrait arranged inside a frame. On the left is an oval miniature painting of a man wearing a dark blue coat and a white cravat. Nearby are several small items, including a purple faceted oval, a scrap of aged newspaper, and a white oval containing a brown hair design. On the right, there is a large oval pendant with a deep blue glass insert framed in gold. Below these are a plain oval piece of card, a thin gold-colored metal ring, and a purple decorative oval frame. All these objects are displayed against a dark gray background.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows the head and shoulders of a man. The oval portrait is set against a square, golden background and enclosed in a dark, textured wooden frame. The man faces slightly to his right, wearing a dark blue coat with a high collar and a white cravat at his neck. He has dark brown, wavy hair and distinct sideburns framing his face. His expression is serious, and he looks directly toward the viewer.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory shows a man’s head and shoulders against a light, pale background. The man has brown hair swept up and away from his forehead. He wears a dark coat with a high, stiff collar and a white shirt with red buttons underneath. His face is pale with rosy cheeks, and his expression is neutral. This portrait is set inside a delicate, oval-shaped metal frame decorated with textured leaf designs.

title: Mrs. Hurd (?)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory showing the portrait of a woman. The woman has dark hair styled back and is facing slightly to the right of the viewer. She has a pale complexion with rosy pink cheeks and wears a simple brown dress. Behind her, a bright red curtain hangs in the upper right corner against a muted, light background. The entire image is set within a textured, oval metal frame.

title: Marquis de Lafayette (1757-1834)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor portrait shows a man in profile facing to the left. He has short, dark, textured hair and a fair complexion. The man wears a dark blue coat with visible gold-colored buttons down the front. Beneath the coat, a high white collar is visible around his neck. The portrait is set inside a brass oval frame, which is mounted against a rectangular black background with a metal loop for hanging at the top.

title: Chief No-Cush (No-Cush)
medium: Oil and watercolor over graphite pencil, varnished, on ivory
alt_text: A miniature portrait of a man with his head turned slightly to the right. He has light skin, dark hair pulled back, and wears a blue coat with a white collar and a fringed edge. Bright red paint stripes are visible on his forehead and across his nose. A wide, tan-colored strap crosses his chest diagonally, and a large oval pendant hangs from his neck. The portrait is housed in a simple, dark rectangular frame.

title: Polly Stuart Webb Vincent (1807–1883)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting of a woman, set inside a rectangular gold frame with a hanging loop at the top. The woman has dark, smooth hair parted in the middle and styled close to her face. She is looking directly at the viewer with a calm expression. Her skin is pale and soft, and her cheeks have a subtle pink flush. She wears a deep, dark green dress with an off-the-shoulder neckline trimmed with white lace. The background is a plain, light grey wall that creates a simple backdrop for her portrait.

title: Archibald Taylor (ca. 1750–1821)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature of a man is set inside a thin, oval-shaped gold frame. The man has short, light brown hair and is looking directly forward with a serious expression. He wears a dark coat over a white shirt with a high collar that wraps around his neck. The background behind him is painted in soft, blended shades of blue and white. A small gold loop at the top of the frame suggests it was designed to be worn as jewelry.

title: Thomas Radcliffe (1776–1806)
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory showing a young person with long, wavy brown hair. The person wears a dark blue jacket over a high, white, ruffled cravat. They have fair skin, rosy cheeks, and light blue eyes that look directly forward. A thin, gold-colored oval frame surrounds the painting, featuring a small loop at the top for hanging. The background is painted in soft, light blue shades, suggesting an outdoor scene or sky.

title: Gentleman, possibly Robert Goldsborough (1740-1798)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a watercolor portrait on ivory set inside an oval frame. The portrait features a man with light, slightly gray hair styled neatly to the sides. He wears a dark jacket over a lighter, striped vest with a ruffled white fabric at his neck. His expression is calm, and he looks forward with light-colored eyes. The entire oval is encased in a simple, shiny metallic frame with a small loop at the top.

title: Rembrandt Peale (1778-1860)
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory showing a young man. The oval painting is set inside a red, hinged case with a metallic, textured frame. The man faces slightly to the left with light brown, wavy hair and fair skin. He wears a dark gray jacket over a white necktie that has small, thin blue lines in a grid pattern. His expression is calm with a light, closed-mouth smile. The background behind him is a soft, blended mix of light brown and pale blue colors.

title: Colonel James Chesnut (1773-1866)
alt_text: A miniature in watercolor on ivory shows the portrait of a man. He has fair skin, light-colored eyes, and short, light brown hair that is brushed back. The man wears a dark blue coat over a white shirt with a decorative white cravat tied at his throat. The background consists of soft, blurry washes of light blue, white, and peach. The painting is set inside an oval frame with a small metal loop at the top.

title: John Taylor (died before 1800)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows the portrait of a man, placed inside an open oval case. The man has short, powdered hair and wears a tan coat with gold buttons over a white shirt with a ruffled cravat. His face is slightly turned to the left, and he has a gentle, closed-mouth smile. The painting is framed in a wooden oval case that has a textured, bark-like edge. To the right of the portrait, the inside edge of the case is visible, showing a fabric lining and a small metal hinge.

title: Anthony Rutgers (1770-1799)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory shows a portrait of a man with light-colored, powdered hair. The man faces slightly to the left, wearing a dark green coat over a white ruffled cravat with brown stripes. His face is pale with rosy cheeks, and his expression is neutral. The portrait is housed inside a simple, oval-shaped metal frame with a small ring at the top for hanging. The background of the painting fades from light gray to dark brown.

title: New York Dandy
alt_text: A miniature of a portrait shows a man from the chest up set in an oval metal frame. The man has pale skin, light eyes, and short, gray, curled hair styled close to his head. He wears a cream-colored coat over a white shirt with a ruffled cravat at his neck. His body is turned slightly to the right, but he looks forward toward the viewer. The background behind him fades from a dark shadow on the right to a soft, murky green on the left. The entire portrait is encased in a simple gold-colored oval frame with a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a painted portrait of an older man with gray, shoulder-length hair. The man faces forward with a serious expression and wears a dark blue coat over a white shirt with a ruffled cravat. The portrait is oval-shaped and set inside a simple metallic frame. Above the oval frame, a small, round metal ring is attached for hanging. The background of the portrait is a solid, warm brown color.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting on ivory shows a portrait of a fair-skinned man set inside a simple, oval, gold-colored frame. He has short, light brown hair parted in the middle and bright blue eyes. The man is wearing a dark, high-collared coat over a white shirt with a small, ruffled cravat at his neck. His expression is calm and neutral as he looks directly toward the viewer. The background behind him is a soft, light-colored cream with faint, diagonal shading lines. A small loop at the top of the frame allows it to be worn as jewelry.

title: Lady of the Sully Family
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a watercolor painting of a woman set inside an oval gold locket. The woman has dark hair parted in the middle and is wearing a plaid shirt with a white lace collar. A small, oval-shaped pin is fastened at her neckline, and she wears simple earrings. The portrait is framed by an ornate, textured gold border. A gold loop at the top of the locket allows it to be worn as a pendant.

title: Sketch for a Portrait of a Man
alt_text: A watercolor miniature of a person seated inside a room. The figure is a man with light hair who wears a dark brown jacket over a white collared shirt. He holds a white paper in one hand while resting the other arm on the back of a patterned, red chair. Behind him, a tall, dark bookshelf filled with books stands against the wall. The room appears somewhat dim and has simple, muted walls.

title: Nicholas Bleecker (1770-1827)
alt_text: A jewelry miniature of a man with light-colored hair and blue eyes. The small oval portrait shows the man from the chest up, facing forward with a gentle expression. He wears a dark blue coat over a white collared shirt with a high, tied cravat. The portrait is set inside a thin, metallic oval frame that has a small round loop at the top for hanging. The background of the portrait is a simple, neutral off-white shade.

title: Edward Stow (?) (1768-1847)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry portrait in watercolor on ivory shows a man looking directly ahead. He has light-colored hair that is styled in soft waves around his head. The man wears a deep blue coat over a black vest with a white, ruffled shirt underneath. His expression is neutral and calm. The portrait is housed in a simple, gold-colored oval frame with a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Endersleigh Burlingham
alt_text: A miniature watercolor portrait on ivory shows a man’s head and shoulders. He has dark, short hair styled with volume on top and wavy locks around his ears. He wears a dark blue coat with visible buttons and a high, white collared shirt or cravat. The portrait is framed within an oval, gold-colored metallic setting that includes a small loop for hanging at the top. The background of the portrait is a soft, pale yellow gradient.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A watercolor miniature shows a portrait of a young man against a blue stippled background. He is centered in the frame, facing slightly to his right, with dark hair swept back from his forehead. He wears a brown coat with a high collar, revealing a white cravat and a darker waistcoat underneath. The portrait is housed inside a simple, oval-shaped silver metal frame with a small loop at the top. The image has a smooth, glass-like appearance.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting shows the head and shoulders of a man inside an oval frame. He has short, light brown hair styled forward on his forehead and sideburns that stop at his ears. The man looks directly ahead with light blue eyes and a serious expression. He wears a dark, high-collared coat over a white shirt with a tied cravat at his neck. The portrait is set inside a thin, gold-colored metal frame with a small loop at the very top. The background is a soft, blended mix of muted brown and grayish tones.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature collage on fabric shows a man in profile facing to the left. He has pale skin and gray hair tied back with a small bow at the nape of his neck. The man wears a dark, possibly navy blue coat over a light-colored vest. A large, white frilled ruffle extends from his collar area, covering part of his chest. The entire image is set within a simple, oval-shaped brass frame. The background of the portrait is a plain, dark gray or black fabric.

title: Gentleman, probably with the initials W.K.
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a young man in an oval frame. The subject is a fair-skinned man with brown hair that is styled upwards and combed forward at the sides. He wears a dark, buttoned jacket over a white, high-collared shirt with a ruffled cravat. The portrait is set within a simple, metallic oval frame that has a small hanging loop at the top. The background of the painting is a light, neutral gray color with subtle, vertical brushstrokes.

title: Memorial for Henry G. Staats
medium: Watercolor, chopped hair, and graphite pencil on ivory; reverse-glass painting
alt_text: A jewelry miniature showing a painted scene inside an oval gold frame with a bail at the top. The scene depicts a woman in a long, dark dress standing beside a tall, thin tree with drooping branches. She holds a white cloth up to her face as if she is crying. Behind her, a white stone structure features an oval plaque with fancy cursive initials inscribed on it. The background uses a soft, light blue wash, and the bottom foreground is painted with dark, textured details that look like hair.

title: Memorial for John Foreman (c. 1736-1789)
medium: Watercolor and chopped hair on ivory
alt_text: A jewelry miniature shows a painted scene set inside a gold, oval-shaped pendant frame. On the left side, a woman with a veil sits beside a tall, square monument topped with an urn. The side of the monument features the words "SACRED WILL I KEEP THY DEAR REMAINS." Above the monument, a small, winged figure floats in the air holding a banner that says "BLISS." The scene is painted in shades of brown and white against a light, cloudy background. A thin layer of dark, textured material is visible at the very bottom, likely made of chopped hair.

title: Memorial to His Mother, Sarah Sully
alt_text: A miniature painting in a round locket shows a woman in a long white dress and a black shawl leaning against a stone monument. She rests her head in one hand, while her other hand touches the stone. The monument is shaped like a block and has an urn on top, with the words "Sacred to the memory of Sarah Sully" inscribed on the front. Behind her, wispy green tree branches hang down from the top of the frame. The painting is set inside a gold-colored frame, which is nestled in a fabric-lined round case.

title: Memorial for George Washington (1732-1799), LL.D. 1781
medium: Watercolor and chopped hair on ivory
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a woman sitting next to a stone monument under a tree. The scene is rendered in shades of brown and sepia on a white background. The woman leans her head on one hand, looking down toward a square pedestal. On the front of this pedestal is a small, carved profile of a man's face. Above the monument, tree branches hang down like willow leaves. The entire painting is housed inside an oval, metallic frame with a small loop at the top.

title: Eye
alt_text: A jewelry miniature watercolor on ivory shows a close-up of a human eye. The round, glass-covered piece features a blue eye centered against a pale, skin-toned background. A thin, dark eyebrow arches above the eye, while soft pinkish-orange coloring tints the cheek area below. To the right, faint blue paint suggests the edge of clothing or hair. A plain metal border surrounds the painting, with a small pin visible on the right side.

title: Memorial for Hannah Hodges (1780-1792)
medium: Watercolor and chopped hair on ivory
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a painted scene behind an oval glass cover. A light-colored monument stands on the left side of the scene. The words "NOT LOST" are written in dark letters on the front of this stone base. To the right of the monument, a large, drooping brown flower hangs from a stem. Above the monument, a small, pale winged figure floats in the sky. A thin, braided gold frame surrounds the entire oval image.

title: Gentleman (Memorial on reverse)
medium: Watercolor, natural, and chopped hair on ivory
alt_text: A miniature portrait of a man set in an oval gold brooch. The portrait features a man with dark, wavy hair and pale skin against a light-colored background. He has a bit of dark stubble on his chin and cheeks. He wears a high white collar with a small bow and a black coat. The frame is simple and shiny, with a metal pin visible sticking out from the right side.

title: 2 silhouettes
alt_text: A miniature showing a black silhouette of a person. The silhouette is in profile, facing toward the left side of the frame. The figure has a rounded nose and a distinct chin, and appears to be wearing high-collared clothing. This black shape is set against a pale, off-white background. The entire image is encased in a smooth, oval-shaped metal frame with a small loop at the top.

title: Unknown man, called Smith
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory shows a portrait of a person in an oval frame. The person has light skin and wears a white powdered wig that is curled at the ears. They are dressed in a dark red jacket with a white collar and a white cravat at the neck. The background is a simple, muted olive-green color that fades slightly toward the edges. The entire portrait is set inside a thin, metallic oval frame with a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Unidentified Man
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a painted portrait of a young man against a soft gray background. The oval portrait is set in a simple, thin metal frame with a twisted edge. The man has pale skin, blue eyes, and light, wavy hair styled in a short, powdered fashion. He wears a dark blue coat with visible gold-colored buttons over a white shirt with a ruffled collar. A small, dark ribbon is tied at the back of his neck.

title: Unknown Man
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a portrait of a young man against a plain grey background. He has light brown, wavy hair and is facing forward with his head slightly turned. He wears a bright blue coat over a white collared shirt with a ruffled cravat tied at the neck. A small, round pin is visible on the center of his white shirt. The portrait is held in an oval frame made of gold, with a rounded loop at the top for hanging.

title: Mourning Ring for William Haynes
alt_text: A piece of jewelry, in the form of a ring, features an oval miniature painting set into a gold band. The oval miniature displays a sepia-toned urn centered against a white background, flanked by thin, wispy tree branches hanging down from the top. The gold band of the ring has black enamel sections inlaid with gold lettering on both the left and right sides. The scene inside the oval appears to be painted in fine, delicate strokes. The overall composition centers the urn as the main focus of the piece.

title: Initial L, with a Saint inside
alt_text: A manuscript illumination on parchment shows an older man with a long beard and a gold halo. He stands behind a blue frame, looking to the left and holding a vertical sword in one hand and a blue book in the other. The central portrait is framed by intricate borders painted in shades of bright blue, pink, and gold. Delicate, swirling floral decorations extend down the left side of the white page. Handwritten notes in cursive script appear in the bottom right corner of the page.

title: Mrs. Clark Thebaux
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory of a young woman shown from the chest up. She has dark, curly hair adorned with a small crown of pink flowers and green leaves. A sheer white veil hangs from the back of her head, framing her face and draping over her bare shoulders. She wears a simple white dress and holds her hands near her chest. The portrait is oval-shaped and framed inside a gold-colored border, which is set within a black hinged case.

title: Dr. William Tully, Jr. (1785-1859), B.A. 1806, M.A. 1809, M.D. (Hon.) 1819
alt_text: A watercolor miniature shows the portrait of a young man with curly brown hair. He is wearing a dark coat with a high, black necktie wrapped around his collar. The man looks off to his left with a neutral expression on his face. Behind him is a soft background with hints of light blue and pink colors. The painting is set inside an oval frame made of ornate, textured gold metal.

title: A. Franz Kafka
alt_text: A painting shows abstract shapes against a muted blue-gray background. Many overlapping geometric forms create a complex, layered composition in the center. These shapes are mostly shades of beige, tan, brown, and pale yellow. A small, bright blue semi-circle sits toward the bottom left, while a golden-yellow square appears near the lower center. Thin, dark lines cut across and divide the various planes, giving the piece a sharp, architectural look.

title: Pursuer and Pursued
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes and dark, muted colors arranged in a grid. The central section features a large, rectangular face-like shape with black eyes and a pointed, triangle-shaped nose. To the left of the center, a tall, spiral-like form sits against a blue background. The upper right corner contains a striped, column-like shape. At the bottom, a fish-like figure with triangular fins rests horizontally across the lower edge. These various shapes are outlined in thick, black lines and filled with shades of blue, brown, tan, and dark grey.

title: La Resistance
medium: Oil and paper collage on cardboard
alt_text: A painting showing a variety of abstract shapes and colorful sections. On the left, a large rectangular block features a speckled, brown textured background with a simple line drawing of a circle and a stick-like figure. To the right of this, a bold vertical stripe of bright red separates the patterned section from a large, plain gray area. Within the gray space, there is a prominent, bright blue rectangle framed by a lighter gray border. The bottom of the image is divided into several smaller, solid-colored rectangular blocks in shades of purple, brown, gray, and white.

title: John Davenport (1752-1830), B.A. 1770, M.A. 1773
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair. The man faces forward and wears a brown coat over a pale yellow striped vest with a white neck scarf. In his left hand, he holds a rolled-up white paper, and he rests his right arm on a dark green table. Behind him is a bookshelf with several books and an open window showing a view of green trees and a field. He sits on a red cushioned chair with gold trim along the bottom. The background also includes a heavy red curtain hanging down on the left side.

title: The Last of His Race (The Vanishing American)
alt_text: An oil painting of a man standing alone in a wide, flat landscape. The man is shown in profile, facing left, and he wears a long, fringed tan garment and light-colored pants with horizontal stripes. A single feather is upright in his dark hair. He holds a long, thin rod horizontally across his body. Behind him, the terrain is dry and pale, while the sky above is a light blue filled with fluffy white clouds.

title: Barbison, Forest of Fountainebleu
alt_text: A painting showing a dark landscape scene set within a thick, gold, rectangular frame. Dense, dark green trees fill most of the upper right and left sides, framing a lighter, clouded blue sky in the center. In the middle distance, a small, light-colored building with a peaked roof sits nestled among the trees. The foreground appears as a shadowy path or field where several dark, indistinct shapes that look like grazing cattle are visible. Above the frame on the left, a small, white rectangular museum tag with red dots is attached to the wall.

title: Two Hanging Apples
alt_text: A painting of two apples hanging against a wooden board. The apple on the left is mostly red with yellow tones and seems slightly bruised. The apple on the right is light yellow or cream-colored with small, dark brown spots. Both fruits hang from thin, light-colored strings attached to the top of the board. A small rectangular tag with handwritten text is tucked behind the strings at the very top. The wooden background shows dark circular knots and a vertical grain pattern.

title: The Foundation of New Orleans
alt_text: A painting of a strange, upright figure standing in a rocky landscape. The central figure has a tall, skeletal shape with parts that look like yellow ribbons or leaves draped around it. It is colored in shades of dark blue, pale yellow, and a touch of orange fabric near its base. Below the figure is a messy pile of muted, grayish-brown stones or rocks. The background is a simple, flat expanse of pale blue that fades into white near the bottom. This artwork is displayed inside a thick, black frame.

title: Congress Place
alt_text: A painting of a quiet outdoor scene features a hazy, light-filled sky above a flat, grassy landscape. The painting is enclosed in a wide, dark-gold frame with ornate, carved designs on its edges. In the center of the image, two small figures stand near some trees and a building. Thick, textured strokes define the trees and the architectural structure to the right. A small, rectangular tag hangs from the upper right corner of the frame.

title: The Old Violin
alt_text: A painting of a violin hangs centrally against a dark, vertical wooden background. A sheet of music with notes rests behind the reddish-brown violin, and a long, thin bow is positioned vertically to the right of the instrument. In the upper left corner, there is a small, rectangular playing card tilted at an angle. Below the card, a small paper scrap features a tiny, upright drawing of a donkey. The entire composition is encased within a simple, thick, dark brown wooden frame.

title: Portrait of Edward Mendall House 1858-1938
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in formal, dark clothing. He wears a wide-brimmed hat tilted slightly on his head. Underneath, he has a light-colored shirt with a dark necktie. He is wearing a long coat that appears to be made of a textured, possibly fur-lined material draped over his shoulders. His gaze is directed toward the right side of the frame, away from the viewer. His hands are visible at the bottom of the image, resting near his waist.

title: Chauncey Mitchell Depew, B.A. 1856, LL.D. 1887, Fellow 1888-1906
medium: Oil on board - framed and glazed
alt_text: A painting shows the head and shoulders of an older man wearing a dark suit. He has light skin, a receding hairline with hair on the sides, and a white beard along his jawline. The man is looking forward with a calm expression against a dark, shadowy background. He wears a dark jacket, a white shirt collar, and a dark necktie. The painting is enclosed in a large, elaborate gold frame with decorative carvings along its edges. A small, rectangular nameplate is centered at the bottom of the frame.

title: Mille fleurs tapestry
alt_text: A textile made of wool and silk shows a dark, densely patterned forest scene populated by several animals. A large deer with tall antlers stands prominently in the center of the rectangular composition, facing toward the right. To the left of the deer are two small rabbits near the bottom and a bird perched above them. A second bird is perched on the right side of the scene, with another small rabbit sitting near the bottom right corner. The background is filled with repeating motifs of stylized leafy plants and flowers that cover nearly the entire surface.

title: Unknown Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature showing a portrait of a man, rendered in watercolor on ivory. The man has wavy, light greyish hair and looks directly forward with a neutral expression. He wears a bright blue coat with a dark collar and a white ruffled cravat at his neck. The portrait is oval-shaped and set inside a simple, shiny gold frame with a small metal loop at the top. The background is a soft, light blue color with wispy, cloud-like brushstrokes.

title: W. G. Miller
alt_text: A watercolor on ivory miniature shows the head and shoulders of a man. He has short, dark hair that is brushed forward with a bit of a curl on his forehead. The man is wearing a dark coat over a white vest and a high, white collar tied with a simple knot at his throat. He faces toward the right with a serious expression and clear, light-colored eyes. The painting is set within a shiny, gold-colored oval frame that has a small loop at the top.

title: Candlestick
alt_text: A metal lighting device shows a tall, three-legged stand with a flat, circular top. The top section holds three small, round cups for candles or fuel and features a decorative pinecone shape in the center. Two thin metal chains hang down from the sides of the top, each holding a small tool at the end. The stand is thin and stands on a tripod base with wide feet. The entire object appears to be made of dark, aged metal.

title: Governor George Clinton
alt_text: A painting on a copper plate shows a portrait of a person in profile. The portrait is enclosed within a circular border in the center of the square, metallic surface. The person faces to the left, and their features are hazy and washed out. There are dark, irregular spots of tarnish or damage on the neck area and along the outer edges of the plate. The overall surface of the plate is shiny and reflects a bright light source near the top.

title: Daniel Powers (1815-1845), B.A. 1837
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece of watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a young man against a light, neutral background. The oval painting depicts a person with light brown, wavy hair and pale skin, shown from the chest up. He wears a dark, possibly black, high-collared coat over a white shirt and a dark, tied cravat at his neck. The portrait is housed inside an ornate, oval metal frame with a hanging loop at the top. The entire object is centered on a solid black background.

title: East India Jack
alt_text: A painting showing a flat, solid, brick-red background scattered with many small, simple shapes. These shapes are either perfect circles or small, elongated ovals. The circles are a light, muted green color, while the ovals alternate between light blue and soft pink. The shapes are spread out across the entire surface in an uneven, random pattern. No shapes touch or overlap, and they appear to be roughly the same small size.

title: Sketches for "Home-Spun", (recto and verso)
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting in a dark, dimly lit room. The figure is shown from the side, with their head bent down as they focus on their hands. They are wearing a light-colored garment that contrasts with the deep brown shadows filling the space. In front of the person sits a dark, circular wooden frame that looks like part of a spinning wheel. The background is mostly dark and indistinct, making the figure the main focus of the scene.

title: His Favorite Model
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in a studio holding hands with a jointed mannequin. The man is wearing a grey suit and glasses, and he stands on the left side of the room. A large, pale mannequin stands on the right, supported by a wooden stand. The room is filled with framed paintings leaning against the walls, including one very large, golden frame behind the man. The floor is made of wood, and the overall color tone is dark and warm.

title: That July Afternoon
alt_text: A painting of an indoor room with light blue floors and deep blue shadows. To the left, a small easel holds a vase of white flowers and a small framed picture. Nearby, a brown, fuzzy stuffed animal sits on the blue wooden floorboards. Strong light streams in from a window on the left, casting long shadows across the scene. A tall, pale wooden chair stands in the background near the stuffed animal.

title: Island Weather II
alt_text: A painting of abstract, organic shapes set against a bright yellow background. On the left side, a tall, wavy blue shape stretches vertically, containing a small, off-white oval and a larger, mossy-green blob. Below the green area, a soft, brownish-orange patch blends into a lighter orange shape at the bottom. To the right, a long, narrow strip of blue runs straight from the top to the bottom edge. The colors have soft, blurred edges, appearing like watercolor washes on the canvas.

title: Double Time
alt_text: A painting of acrylic on canvas presents a very tall, narrow, vertical field of light peach color. The color is slightly lighter and brighter in the middle, creating a faint, glowing vertical streak. The vast majority of the tall surface is entirely blank and uniform in tone. At the very bottom edge, a small, horizontal cluster of thick paint sits against the light background. This small cluster contains bright dabs of yellow, orange, reddish-pink, and green.

title: Two Seated Male Figures
alt_text: A painting showing two figures sitting close together on a bench. The entire scene is painted in dark, muted shades of gray, black, and brown. One figure sits on the left, slightly behind the other, while the second figure sits on the right with their arms crossed over their chest. Both figures appear to be nude, with thick, rough outlines and indistinct facial features. The background is a flat, dark color that blends into the figures. The overall effect is shadowy and dim.

title: The Stained Glass Window
alt_text: A painting of an indoor and outdoor scene, rendered in oil on canvas, depicts various figures in a warm, dreamlike setting. To the left, a large grid-like window overlooks a beach scene with a reddish-orange sun high in the sky. Several thin, dark silhouettes of people sit or stand in the foreground against a rusty-red floor. On the right side of the composition, a panel shows a sandy beach with tiny figures and a blue ocean under a hazy horizon. The overall scene appears to be a collage of different viewpoints, blending an interior room with an outdoor seaside landscape.

title: Francis P. Garvan, Jr.
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a young person shows their head, neck, and shoulders. The figure has short, smooth hair that curves around their face. They are wearing a collared shirt fastened with several round buttons down the front. A small, decorative tie with tassels hangs at the center of the collar. The bust sits on a dark green, rectangular stone base.

title: Cityscape
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes in a wooden frame. The artwork is vertical and filled with blocks of color in shades of gray, dark purple, and pale blue. Some areas look like tall, narrow buildings or rectangular structures stacked together. There are thin, scratched-looking lines that cut through parts of the painted surface. A wide, fabric-covered mat separates the painting from the smooth wood frame.

title: Alpha
alt_text: A steel sculpture features a tall, vertical beam that stands upright from a low base. A wide, pointed metal plate extends horizontally from the center of the vertical column. Several thin wires are attached to the column and connect to the edges of the horizontal plate, appearing to hold it in place. Below the central section, long, thin metal bars angle out towards the ground. The entire structure is colored in muted, dark industrial tones and rests against a plain white wall.

title: The Bather
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting outdoors in a dark, shadowed setting. The figure is pale and wears a loose, light-colored cloth wrapped around their lower body. Their back is slightly hunched, and their head is bowed down toward the ground. Beside them on the brown earth lies a dark, stick-like object and some blue fabric. The background is a murky, indistinct brown that makes the figure stand out in the light.

title: Waxenstein Peaks, Garmisch-Partenkirchen
alt_text: A painting of a mountain landscape covered in snow. Sharp, jagged, grey peaks rise into a pale sky, dominating the center and upper parts of the scene. Below the mountains, a dark, textured band suggests a dense forest of evergreen trees. In the foreground, several small, dark, rectangular huts sit on a flat, snow-covered surface. The entire work uses cool, muted tones of grey, white, and deep black.

title: Portrait of a Hanseatic Merchant
alt_text: A painting of a man with a reddish-brown beard who is facing forward against a plain, dark green background. He wears a dark, soft-looking hat and a heavy, dark coat with a white collar showing at his neck. His hands are crossed in front of him, resting one on top of the other. On his left ring finger, he wears a gold band set with a dark red stone. Faint, golden text is visible on the wall behind him on either side of his head.

title: Midsummer Shadows
alt_text: A painting of a dirt road winding through a sunny, tree-lined path. Large, leafy trees grow on both sides of the path, casting deep shadows over the grass and the road. On the right side, a rustic wooden building features large, colorful posters pasted on its side. A small, dark carriage sits in the grass near the building, and two horses stand nearby. In the distance, the path continues upward towards a bright, sky-blue background.

title: White Painting
medium: Nacreous pigment in acrylic lacquer sprayed on a fiberglass support
alt_text: A painting made with pearly white pigment shows three vertical, rectangular columns against a plain white background. The columns are made of several joined sections that feature right-angle cutouts, creating shapes like large, simplified letters. The left column has a notched cutout in its center, while the middle column has a similar cutout positioned slightly lower. The right column is straight on its inner edge, but features a short, blocky extension sticking out at the very bottom. These geometric white shapes create a series of interlocking lines and empty spaces across the center of the frame.

title: Homage to the Square: Late Thought
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares arranged in a flat, symmetrical design. The outermost border is a medium shade of golden yellow. Inside that border is a larger square painted in a muted, brownish-yellow or olive tone. At the very center sits the smallest square, which is a bright and vibrant orange-yellow. All shapes have sharp, straight edges and flat, even colors.

title: Construction: Night
alt_text: A painting shows a stark, dark scene featuring large, blocky geometric shapes. In the upper center, a tall rectangular tower glows with a pale light against a black background, with a row of small, dark, rectangular windows down its side. Below this tower, large dark forms create deep shadows across the lower portion of the image. Two bright, narrow lights shine down, illuminating small patches of the dark surfaces below them. Simple, dark beams or supports are angled against the right side of the composition.

title: Diptych I
medium: Acrylic on canvas mounted on stretched canvas
alt_text: A painting in acrylic on canvas shows rectangular layers of vibrant color stacked on top of each other. A large, bright orange border surrounds the outer edge of the composition. Moving inward, there are layers of deep red, hot pink, and streaks of black. At the very center, a rectangular block of magenta sits above a strip of yellow. Bright white light reflects off the shiny surface of the painting, obscuring parts of the center.

title: Diptych II
medium: Acrylic on canvas mounted on stretched canvas
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract composition dominated by vibrant shades of red. A large, textured white vertical shape sits left of the center, surrounded by bold black lines and splashes of color. Patches of yellow and pink frame the outer edges of the canvas, adding contrast to the dark red background. The entire surface has a glossy, thick, and layered appearance. A small white tag with black numbers is taped to the bottom center of the frame.

title: Freight Yards, Argentine, Kansas
alt_text: A painting of a vast rail yard filled with many colorful freight train cars. Rows of red, yellow, and green train cars stretch across the lower and middle parts of the scene. They are packed closely together, creating a dense pattern of rectangular shapes. Beyond the train cars, a flat, green landscape extends toward the horizon under a pale, cloudy sky. A simple, light-colored frame surrounds the entire painting.

title: Ravenna
alt_text: A painting of abstract, bold black strokes set against a light background. Large areas of dark paint dominate the left side and center of the frame, looking like heavy, sweeping brush marks. A patch of off-white color sits at the bottom center, separating the large black shapes. Hints of deep green are visible within the black paint, particularly on the left side and toward the right edge. The composition feels heavy and energetic, with thick texture clearly visible in the application of the paint.

title: Dunes
alt_text: A painting shows an abstract landscape with soft, muted colors. In the background, there are jagged, mountain-like shapes in shades of light green, white, and a touch of deep purple. The foreground is filled with pale, textured layers of light beige and purple that suggest flat, open ground. Dark, thin lines sketch out geometric shapes and structures across the middle area. A small, blurry collection of vertical lines sits near the bottom, suggesting grasses or small fences. The entire work is framed in a simple, weathered wooden border.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a person’s face and shoulders, rendered in blocky, colorful shapes. The figure wears a dark blue cap on their head and a plain, bright red shirt that covers their neck and shoulders. Their skin is painted a soft, dusty pink on the left side, while the right side of their face is obscured by a large, deep green shadow. One visible eye is light blue with a small, textured appearance, while the other side of the face remains dark and indistinct. A signature and date are faintly visible in cursive handwriting on the lower right side of the tan background.

title: Chair and Table
alt_text: A painting showing a table with various objects in a fragmented, abstract style. The scene is filled with sharp, dark lines that outline blocks of muted green, white, purple, and brown paint. In the center, a light purple rectangle appears to rest on a surface, with dark, irregular shapes layered around it. To the right, tall, vertical black and dark gray forms suggest a background or an arrangement of objects. The entire composition has a rough, sketched quality with thick, uneven brushstrokes. The artwork is set within a thick, textured gold-colored frame.

title: Islands No. 4
alt_text: A painting of oil on canvas shows a grid of twelve identical, oblong shapes arranged in two vertical columns. Each shape is a rounded rectangle that sits inside a darker tan border with thin black outlines. The center of every shape is a lighter, off-white color filled with faint, horizontal lines. The entire arrangement creates a uniform, repetitive pattern across the square surface. The background of the painting is a solid, warm tan color that fills the spaces between the shapes.

title: Small Elegy
alt_text: A painting of thick black brushstrokes against a light, creamy background. Several large, dark shapes dominate the composition. They stretch vertically and horizontally in a sprawling, messy pattern. The paint appears heavy and textured, showing visible ridges from the brush. The beige background peeks through the gaps between the dark marks.

title: Between
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping geometric shapes arranged across a canvas. Large blocks of color, including deep purple, dark green, and muted gray, dominate the lower and central sections. Surrounding these solid shapes are lighter, tilted rectangles in shades of white, cream, and pale blue. Faint, circular marks appear in the upper right quadrant of the composition. The entire image has a rough, textured appearance with visible brushstrokes throughout.

title: Turkey Girl
alt_text: A painting showing large, colorful abstract shapes on a light background. A dominant, wide vertical band of bright red sits on the left side. To the right of the red shape is a large, square-like area of solid orange. A thin, vertical blue stripe separates the red and orange sections, with a small patch of green just below it. At the very top, a horizontal band of purplish-pink stretches across the upper portion of the frame.

title: Combination
medium: Oil and collage on canvas mounted on board
alt_text: A painting of four square panels arranged in a grid, all painted in a flat white color. Each panel features a different geometric design built from raised, textured strips that look like collage material. The top-left panel contains an X shape that reaches toward the corners. The top-right panel displays a circular shape intersected by horizontal and vertical lines. The bottom-left panel shows a tilted X shape similar to the one above it. Finally, the bottom-right panel has a V shape resting on a horizontal base line.

title: Low Tide
alt_text: A painting of a calm coastal scene with boats. In the foreground, a sandy beach area is textured with dark brown and grey shapes representing rocks. The water extends across the middle of the painting in shades of light tan and grey. Three small, dark boats are scattered on the water, appearing tiny against the wide expanse. A soft, pale sky fills the top half of the frame above faint shapes of distant land. The scene is filled with muted, earthy colors like tan, beige, and soft grey.

title: Red Abstract
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes. The composition features vertical columns of orange and dark pink. A large, horizontal red rectangle sits prominently in the center of the image. The colors overlap in some areas, creating different shades of reddish-orange where the columns meet the center rectangle. The arrangement creates a balanced, grid-like pattern across the vertical canvas.

title: Blue Abstract
alt_text: A painting of simple, rectangular geometric shapes in different shades of blue and purple. A tall, vertical rectangle colored in a deep, bright violet sits at the top center. A matching violet rectangle sits directly below it at the bottom center. These two violet shapes are connected by a horizontal band of a darker, muted blue that spans the width of the painting. The background area surrounding these shapes is filled with a slightly lighter, solid shade of blue. This arrangement of shapes creates a single, bold form that resembles the letter H.

title: Newburyport
alt_text: A painting of two square geometric designs placed side by side. Both squares are composed of several concentric, nested square frames separated by thin white lines. The left square features a dark blue outer border that surrounds layers of dark green, red, and orange, ending with a small yellow center. The right square reverses this pattern with a bright yellow outer border, surrounding orange, red, dark green, and blue layers, ending in a small dark gray center. Each distinct square frame has a flat, solid color.

title: Noon Place
alt_text: A painting shows two distinct, horizontal rectangular shapes stacked on top of each other. The bottom shape takes up most of the frame and is a solid, warm shade of muted orange. Directly above this is a thinner, horizontal rectangle that stretches across the width of the canvas. This upper band is a lighter, more faded shade of orange. The entire composition has a smooth, flat appearance without any visible texture or markings.

title: Fontella
alt_text: A sculpture of two circular discs made of etched glass hangs against a plain white wall. The discs are pale green and arranged one above the other in a vertical line. A thin, dark wire connects the two circles, framing the space between them like an open box. A soft shadow falls to the left and behind the glass, showing the object is set away from the wall. The texture of the glass looks slightly rough or frosted.

title: Clear Patch
medium: Etched and clear glass, and wire
alt_text: A sculpture of etched and clear glass and wire shows a rectangular, semi-transparent form. The object is long and horizontal, with rounded edges on the right side. Several thin, dark lines cross the surface, resembling cracks or scratches. The material appears mostly smooth and glassy, with subtle variations in opacity and reflection. The object sits against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Half Open Drawing
medium: Etched and clear glass, and wire
alt_text: A glass sculpture made of etched and clear glass and wire shows two overlapping translucent, greenish-tinted rectangles. A single, thin, dark wire runs vertically across the center of the pieces. The wire is bent slightly at the top and bottom ends. A small, dark, knotted piece of thread or fiber is tied around the center of this wire. The entire object casts a soft, blurry shadow on the plain white wall behind it.

title: Flowers
alt_text: A painting of four flat, graphic flowers set against a dark background. The background is filled with messy, bright green lines that look like tall blades of grass. Three of the flowers are pale, creamy white, while the bottom left flower is a brighter, more distinct yellow. Each flower has five rounded petals and a dark, sketchy center. The layout feels loose, with the flowers scattered across the dark, grassy surface.

title: A Rose Garden
alt_text: A painting of a garden filled with blooming bushes and greenery. In the foreground, patches of dark green grass curve around the base of rose bushes. These bushes are dotted with small pink and red flowers that stand out against the deep green leaves. Behind the roses, a taller tree with thick, leafy branches rises toward the top of the scene. The entire area is framed by a background of dark, shadowed foliage.

title: Woman Seated on Green Sofa
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting and reading a book. She sits on a green chair with a red cushion behind her back. She wears a long, light-colored skirt and a sleeveless top. The artist has sketched parts of the scene, such as the area on the left where she rests her feet, using loose and unfinished lines. The background is painted in muted, neutral tones. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, textured gold frame.

title: The Escaut River in Antwerp
alt_text: A painting showing a busy harbor scene under a cloudy blue sky. On the left, a grassy bank slopes down to the water, featuring a small house with a prominent, bright red roof. A path runs along the shoreline where a few small figures and a dog walk. Several tall ships with dark masts and sails are docked or moored in the calm water to the right. The water reflects the ships and the soft light of the sky.

title: Mother
alt_text: A painting of an elderly woman's head and shoulders shown against a tan background. The woman has pale, fair skin and hair pulled back from her face in a soft, light-gray tone. She wears a high-collared, dark blue or black top with a small, circular pin featuring hints of pink and green at the center of her collar. Her expression is serious and solemn, with her gaze directed slightly to the right of the viewer. To her lower left, there is a dark, handwritten signature and a date on the plain background.

title: Juho Saarinen
alt_text: A painting of an elderly man shown from the side in a head-and-shoulders portrait. He has white hair and a white beard that blends into his chin and cheeks. The man is wearing a dark blue or black jacket over a tan vest and a white collar. His face is angled toward the right, with deep shadows across his cheek and nose. The background is a plain, textured tan color that looks like the canvas itself.

title: First Theme, 1963
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes featuring a large black area that fills most of the frame. In the center, a vertical white rectangle extends from the top edge, stopping about halfway down the canvas. Inside this white rectangle is a narrower, bright yellow vertical stripe. On both the far left and right sides of the painting, thick white rectangular shapes rise from the bottom edge but do not reach the top. The overall design looks like three distinct columns set against a dark background.

title: Denis Diderot
alt_text: A sculpture of a plaster bust shows the head and shoulders of a middle-aged man. The figure is made of a smooth, brown material and faces to the left with an alert expression. His hair is short and swept back from his forehead, and his eyes are fixed in the same direction as his head. Deep lines are visible around his mouth and nose, giving him a thoughtful look. The bust rests on a small, round pedestal that matches the color and texture of the sculpture.

title: Composition
medium: Wood and cardboard relief, gouache, and oil on cardboard
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract arrangement of geometric shapes in wood, cardboard, and paint. The composition features a variety of rectangles and a single black circle placed against a background of beige and gray rectangular blocks. A long, red rectangular bar extends horizontally across the lower middle section, casting a sharp shadow. Above it, a smaller blue block also appears to float, creating a three-dimensional effect with its own dark shadow. The entire piece is framed by a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of a still life arrangement sits on a dark, flat surface against a pitch-black background. On the left, a dark glass pitcher stands next to a bowl overflowing with yellow lemons and oranges. A split pomegranate with bright red seeds rests on the table's edge in front of the pitcher. To the right, a footed golden dish holds a dark mound of fruit, while a smaller, flat ceramic plate beneath it contains curled, light-colored pastries decorated with blue and red markings. Further to the right, a stack of small, round, light-colored boxes is topped with a single, dark, rounded object.

title: Horses
alt_text: A painting of two horses rearing up against one another. The horse on the left is dark brown or black, while the horse on the right is a lighter, beige color. Their bodies overlap in the center of the dark, muted background, creating a sense of movement. Thick, visible brushstrokes define their forms and muscles. The entire scene is enclosed within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Foot of Lake
alt_text: A painting showing abstract, flat shapes in earthy colors against a muted gray background. On the left, a tall, brown, jagged shape contains a thin, wavy white line running vertically. In the center, a large, dark green blob stands prominently, with a small patch of dark black near its top. To the right, a blocky, maroon shape sits lower down, featuring small yellow dots. Across the bottom of the scene, a large, uneven yellow-brown form stretches horizontally, marked with a signature in black script.

title: John Monroe
alt_text: A watercolor miniature shows the portrait of a young person with short, dark brown hair. They are wearing a bright blue coat with visible buttons over a white, patterned shirt. A thin, dark ribbon is tied around their neck. The person has fair skin, rosy cheeks, and brown eyes looking directly forward. The portrait is set inside a textured, oval gold frame with a decorative border.

title: Fresh Roasted (Peanuts)
alt_text: A painting of a rectangular bin filled with numerous light brown, shelled peanuts. A tall, gray metal cup sits inside the bin on the left side, containing a few more peanuts. A thin, dark, and cracked pane of glass covers the entire bin, with a noticeable shatter mark extending across the middle. A small, single peanut rests on the dark wooden frame at the bottom right corner. The painting is set inside a dark, simple wooden frame.

title: Reuben Nye of Fairhaven, Massachusetts
alt_text: A miniature portrait shows a young man inside an open jewelry case. The portrait is painted in watercolor on ivory and features a man with brown hair and sideburns, wearing a dark coat, white shirt, and high black collar. He is positioned from the chest up against a soft, faded green and yellow background. The portrait is oval and encased in a brass frame. This frame sits within a red, possibly velvet or leather, protective case that is hinged on the left.

title: Lady with High Comb in Her Hair
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a young woman centered inside an oval frame. She has fair skin, blue eyes, and light brown hair styled up with a small, dark decorative piece on top. Her off-the-shoulder dress is a deep, reddish-purple color with thin, dark straps. The background is a soft, light blue and gray blur. The oval portrait is held within a thick, worn, dark red casing that looks like leather.

title: Lady in a Black Dress
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory showing a woman from the chest up against a solid black background. The painting is oval-shaped and is set within a simple, textured gold frame that has a small loop at the top for hanging. The woman has pale skin, dark hair parted in the middle with soft curls framing her face, and dark eyes looking directly ahead. She wears a plain black garment with a wide, open neckline that reveals her neck and upper chest. Her expression is calm and neutral, with a closed mouth.

title: Boy with a Toy Violin
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a young child sitting against a light, hazy background. The child has short brown hair and wears a dark-colored short-sleeved dress with a simple neckline. They are holding a small, reddish-brown violin in their lap. The child sits on a blue cushion or chair. The portrait is displayed within a simple, oval black frame with a thin gold inner border.

title: Portrait of a Lady
alt_text: A miniature oil painting on wood shows a portrait of a woman enclosed within a circular frame. The woman has dark, wavy hair topped with a red flower wreath and wears a dark, teal-colored dress with puffed sleeves. She holds a small, white flower in one hand and a red rose in the other. Her head is tilted slightly, and she wears dangling gold earrings. The woman is set against a pale, light-blue background that fades into a sunset orange near the bottom. This circular scene is mounted inside a square, dark brown wooden frame.

title: Adios Vallecitos
alt_text: A painting shows a horse-drawn wagon traveling across a rugged, hilly landscape. A group of horses pulls a covered wagon towards the viewer on a dirt path in the foreground. In the distance, a small, light-colored building sits alone on a rise in the land. Large, rolling mountains fill the background under a pale sky. Several dark trees are scattered around the building and the path. The entire scene is depicted in shades of grey and white.

title: Saint Mark with the Lion
alt_text: A limestone sculpture shows a standing man with a full beard and wavy hair. He wears long, layered robes that fall to the ground in soft folds. His hands are held in front of his chest, clutching a small, rectangular object. The figure is light tan in color and appears to be carved from a single piece of stone. It stands on a raised pedestal against a plain, off-white wall inside what looks like a museum.

title: Still Life: Basket of Peaches
alt_text: A painting of a basket filled with peaches and grapes sitting on a table. The basket is round and woven, holding a large mound of yellow and orange peaches, some with green leaves attached. A small, dark purple cluster of grapes lies at the base of the basket on the right side. A thin, silver knife with a light-colored handle rests diagonally on the table in front of the basket. Green leaves drape down over the front of the basket and the grapes. The background is divided between a dark shadow on the left and a lighter wall on the right.

title: Rocky Pool, Bash Bish Falls
alt_text: A painting of a rocky waterfall tucked into a dark, wooded mountain landscape. Two distinct streams of white water cascade over large, jagged grey cliffs and fall into a dark pool below. The surrounding hillsides are dense with deep green and brown trees that cast heavy shadows. Above the cliffs, the sky is filled with ominous, dark storm clouds that contrast with a sliver of lighter sky in the center. The lower foreground is dark and rocky, while the overall scene feels cool and enclosed by the steep walls of the gorge.

title: The Bath House
alt_text: A painting of a beach scene features a large, light-colored wooden building standing on stilts at the left edge. The building has a balcony where a person stands near a doorway, and the exterior walls show faint, large letters. In the sandy foreground to the right, three people stand together facing the ocean. One person wears a bright green shirt with the number eleven on the back, while the others are shirtless or wearing light clothing. The background shows the dark, calm ocean under a muted, hazy sky.

title: Study of a Male Nude
alt_text: A painting of a nude man shown from behind, sitting on a rock or ledge. His back muscles are clearly defined in warm, golden light against a dark background. He has short dark hair and his legs are tucked in close to his body. A piece of light-colored fabric drapes loosely around his hips. The painting is enclosed in a rectangular, ornate gold frame.

title: On the Hillside (recto); Girl in the Woods (verso)
alt_text: A painting of two figures sitting on a grassy hillside. An adult woman sits on the right, wearing a pale dress and a white head covering while holding something in her lap. Standing to her left is a child in a dark jacket and a skirt with a red accent. The ground beneath them is covered in brown and green grass, with a small path running up the slope. In the background, to the left, a distant shoreline is visible under a cloudy, pale blue sky.

title: Flowers and Fruit
alt_text: A painting of a floral arrangement and fruit sitting on a tabletop. In the center, a dark vase holds a large bouquet of fluffy, pale white roses with green leaves. A single white rose lies on the table to the left of the vase. To the right of the vase, a small pile of pale green grapes sits next to several round, orange fruits. One of the orange fruits is sliced in half to show its light-colored inside. The entire scene is set against a very dark background and is enclosed in a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: Evening Note
alt_text: A painting of a landscape features a wide, grassy field under a pale, cloudy sky. Several dark, bushy trees are scattered across the middle distance of the scene. The foreground shows flat, green ground that stretches toward the horizon. A thick, rectangular gold frame with many carved lines surrounds the central painting. The overall scene appears muted in color with soft, blended brushstrokes.

title: William Rush Carving His Allegorical Figure of the Schuylkill River, Study
medium: Oil on canvas mounted on composition board
alt_text: A painting of a dimly lit studio space with several figures. In the center, a nude person stands with their back to the viewer while posed on a low platform. To the left, a person sits and works at a table, partially obscured by shadows. Another person sits on the right side, facing away from the viewer and toward the standing figure. A tall, pale statue-like form stands between the seated person on the left and the nude figure. The background is composed of dark, muted tones that make the figures appear to glow under a single light source.

title: Effet de Neige
alt_text: A painting of a quiet, hazy landscape scene set within a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame. The landscape is painted in muted tones of gray, brown, and pale yellow, suggesting a misty or overcast day. Thin, bare trees rise from the foreground and stretch toward a blurry, light-colored sky in the distance. The ground appears uneven and shadowy, with indistinct shapes scattered across the landscape. The frame features raised patterns of leaves and swirls that surround the rectangular painting.

title: The Plain of La Beauce
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a quiet, outdoor scene under a cloudy sky. On the left, a small figure wearing a white head covering stands and looks out over a flat, hazy horizon in the distance. A large, dark tree trunk lies horizontally across the foreground, stretching from the left toward the center. Near the right side, an old wooden cart with a large round wheel rests against a patch of tall, dry brush. The ground is a mix of muted greens and browns, suggesting a field or hillside.

title: The House of Dr. Gachet in Auvers-sur-Oise
alt_text: A painting of a narrow, winding road leading toward a small cluster of buildings. The path is light tan and earth-colored, curving slightly into the center of the scene. On either side of the path, patches of green and yellow vegetation line the ground. Several light-colored buildings with dark, peaked roofs stand in the middle ground, surrounded by trees with autumn-colored leaves. The sky above is a soft, cloudy gray that fills the upper portion of the frame.

title: View of the Bridge
alt_text: A painting of a bridge crossing a river with city buildings visible in the distance. The tall stone bridge has many arches and spans the right side of the scene. Below the bridge, a river flows with a small boat floating near the center. Bare trees with thin branches stand on a rocky bank in the foreground on the left. The scene is painted with visible, textured brushstrokes in shades of green, brown, and tan.

title: Portrait Bust of Henry IV (1553–1610), King of France
alt_text: A bronze and ivory sculpture shows the head and chest of a man on a pedestal. The man's head is carved from light-colored ivory and features curly hair, a beard, and a serious expression. His shoulders and chest are made of dark bronze and are covered in textured armor with a draped cloth over his left shoulder. This bust sits on a dark, cylindrical, fluted pillar that rests on a square base. A white identification tag with small black text is attached to the front of the base.

title: Spring or Crouching Flora
medium: Probably plaster case, coated with terracotta slip and wood base
alt_text: A sculpture showing the head and shoulders of a young girl. The bust is made of a light, tan-colored material that looks like clay or plaster. She has a gentle smile on her face and is looking slightly toward her right. Her hair is styled with what appear to be bunches of grapes and leaves wrapped around the sides of her head. The figure rests upon a rectangular, carved wooden pedestal base.

title: Route a Brumetz (Aisne)
alt_text: A painting of a quiet village scene features a dirt path winding past several buildings. In the foreground, a lone person dressed in dark clothing stands on the right side of the path, facing away from the viewer. To the left, a small group of light-colored, simple buildings lines the road, with another small figure visible in a doorway. A tall church tower with stone-colored walls rises prominently in the center background, surrounded by dark green trees. The scene is illuminated by a soft, pale sky that suggests either early morning or late afternoon.

title: The Red House
