alt_text: A painting of a rural landscape with a small house in the center. The house has a light-colored wall and a reddish-brown roof, and it sits behind a low stone wall. In the foreground, there are patches of earthy brown ground mixed with green bushes. To the right of the house, there are several small, indistinct buildings surrounded by greenery. A thin, dark blue line of hills stretches across the distant horizon under a soft, grayish sky.

title: Still Life (with Johnson's Folio Dictionary)
alt_text: A painting shows a still life arrangement of various objects resting on a wooden table against a dark, plain background. In the center sits a large, circular, metal scientific instrument with a pointed rod passing through its middle. To the left, an open book with pages spread out rests on a thicker, closed book. Near the books, a small metal candle holder with a short, white candle stands alone. On the right side, a small ceramic mug with a lid and a red-covered book sit side by side on the table surface. A few loose papers lie scattered among the other items on the wooden surface.

title: Harlem River Winter Scene
alt_text: A painting of a shoreline in winter shows a sloping, snow-covered hill in the foreground with two bare trees standing tall. To the left, a dark wooden house sits on stilts over the water, and another low building is visible on the right. Below the houses, a wooden pier juts out into green water. In the background, the scene fades into a hazy, muted gray and green cityscape. The ground is covered in textured patches of white paint, suggesting snow and frost on the landscape.

title: Landscape Sketch
alt_text: A painting of a dark, stormy landscape showing a gloomy scene at twilight. In the center, a large, gnarled, and leafless tree stands tall against a dramatic sky filled with heavy, dark clouds. A faint glow of pinkish light breaks through the clouds behind the tree. To the left, there is a stone structure that looks like a ruined wall or building. The ground is dark and uneven, with a few small, indistinct figures sitting near the base of the tree.

title: What an Unbranded Cow Has Cost
alt_text: A painting of a vast, flat landscape scattered with several men and horses in dark clothes and natural colors. A central standing man, wearing dark clothes and chaps, holds a pistol in one hand while his other hand rests on the shoulder of a man sitting on the ground beside him. Nearby, other figures lie prone or sit on the ground, seemingly injured or resting, with a white horse and a brown horse also lying on the open ground. In the distance, several other men on horseback appear against a horizon line under a cloudy, overcast sky. The overall scene feels quiet and somber, with a muted palette of browns, grays, and earth tones.

title: Interior Corner--Door and Rush-Seat Stool
alt_text: A painting of an indoor scene features a weathered corner with peeling plaster walls. On the left, a tall, dark wooden door with several glass panes stands slightly ajar. A simple wooden stool with four legs sits on the floor in the bottom right area of the room. A round, woven basket hangs high on the wall above the stool. The lighting is dim and casts soft shadows across the rough surfaces of the room.

title: Dombor
alt_text: A painting of a distorted grid creates the illusion of a large sphere expanding from the center. The surface is covered in a pattern of small, repeating red and blue squares. In the middle of the canvas, the squares appear stretched and rounded, making the sphere look three-dimensional. Toward the edges of the painting, the squares return to a flat, uniform grid pattern. The colors transition from bright reds in the bulging center to darker blues near the corners of the frame.

title: Les Amoureux et Fleurs
alt_text: A painting of a vibrant bouquet of flowers in a large vase. The flowers are brightly colored in shades of red, white, yellow, and blue against a textured blue background. Below the flowers, two human figures with reddish skin tones are positioned closely together in the bottom right corner. To their left, a smaller bouquet of flowers sits near a simple, light-colored animal figure. A small bowl containing round shapes rests in the center foreground near the bottom edge.

title: Blue Towel
alt_text: A painting of a blue cloth draped over a dark, mysterious shape. The object sits centered against a flat, pale green background. The cloth has visible folds and ripples in shades of light and dark blue. Below and to the left of the cloth is a large, shadowy form that lacks clear details. The entire painting is held inside a wide, ornate gold frame.

title: Seely's Place No. 1
alt_text: A painting of a landscape shows a calm pond nestled in a grassy field. Several large, leafy trees with green and dark foliage stand behind the pond. The water in the foreground reflects the light and has brownish, murky tones. A dirt bank curves along the edge of the pond and separates the water from the grassy meadow. Beyond the trees, a hint of a distant, flatter horizon is visible against a pale, cloudy sky. The entire scene is framed within a simple, light-colored wooden box.

title: Dead Oven Bird
alt_text: A painting showing a small, dead bird resting on a dark, textured surface. The bird is mainly green with patches of white and lies in the center of the dark, murky landscape. Below the bird, the ground is painted with streaks of yellow, brown, and green colors. The background behind the bird is a very dark, indistinct shadow. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, ornate, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: Jean-Marie Fruchard: Disgust Personified
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man’s head and shoulders is captured in a rough, textured style. The figure has a large, bulbous nose and deep, frowning lines across his face. His expression is intense, with heavy brows and a closed, downturned mouth. The surface of the sculpture looks uneven and modeled with visible finger marks or tool strokes. He appears to be wearing a thick jacket or coat with a wide, rounded collar.

title: Portrait of Mary Cushing Fosburgh
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a quiet, indoor room filled with furniture. She wears a long, light-colored dress and sits in a chair near a tall window with yellow curtains. To her right, there is a reddish-orange sofa with several small framed pictures hanging on the patterned wallpaper above it. A small, dark table sits in front of the sofa with objects on top. In the lower-left corner, a white swan or decorative bird figure stands on the carpet near the chair. The entire painting is encased in an ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Boldero Brothers of Cornborough, Yorkshire
alt_text: A painting of four men in formal coats and knee-length pants standing and sitting in a wooded landscape. Three of the men are standing, while one sits on a rock near the center of the scene. The men wear colorful jackets, vests, and hats, and one person on the right holds a long wooden rifle. They are surrounded by tall green trees, while a gentle river and rolling hills appear in the distance. A small dog walks through the grass on the right side of the frame.

title: Winter Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a rocky, winter landscape is displayed inside an ornate gold frame. The scene features a central, snow-covered cliff face surrounded by dark, barren trees and bushes. To the left, a small figure on horseback travels along a snowy path near a rushing stream. A second pair of figures walks along a higher ridge towards the right side of the image. The background is filled with a cloudy, gray sky that suggests a chilly and overcast day.

title: Romantic Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a calm lake surrounded by trees and mountains. A small, white sailboat drifts on the quiet water in the distance, while a few others are visible further away. In the foreground, a grassy bank is covered with large, light-colored rocks and thick shadows from the trees. A tiny figure stands on the left side near a dark, uneven rock formation. Tall trees frame the scene on both the left and right sides, reaching up toward a cloudy blue sky.

title: Number 4
medium: Oil, enamel and aluminum paint with pebbles on cut canvas, on composition board
alt_text: A painting shows a complex network of paint layered across the entire surface. Thick, thin, and overlapping lines of black, white, and silver paint crisscross in every direction. Patches of yellow and tan peek through these dense layers of color. Some small, pebbly textures are visible, adding to the rough surface. The overall effect creates a chaotic and busy appearance with no clear subject or pattern.

title: Sisters in the Gallery
alt_text: A painting of a figure in a white dress standing in a dark, shadowy room. The figure is viewed from behind and stands in the center of the frame. They wear a long, light-colored skirt that flows down to the bottom of the painting. The background is mostly black, with only a small, dim vertical streak of light visible on the left side. The painting is encased in an ornate, rectangular, gold-colored frame with carved edges. A wire grid is faintly visible behind the top of the frame.

title: Flight of the Mother
medium: Mixed media on canvas (telephone, light switch, pole, oil over gesso)
alt_text: A painting of a figure using mixed media on canvas shows a pale, off-white background with a faint, hand-drawn outline of a person standing on the left. The figure is tall and slender, rendered in thin, dark, gestural lines. Attached to the left side of the canvas is a real, beige-colored wall telephone with a matching light switch plate below it. A long, vertical pole runs along the entire right edge of the rectangular canvas. The background surface is textured, featuring crackled lines and patches of soft, washed-out green and orange paint.

title: Violets in a Glass Tumbler
alt_text: A painting of a bouquet of dark purple flowers in a clear glass vase. The vase sits on a flat, light-colored surface against a dark, shadowy background. Inside the glass vase, faint green stems are visible in the water. To the right of the vase, a small, crumpled piece of white paper lies on the surface. The background is mostly dark brown and gray, with a soft light hitting the left side of the scene.

title: Nude Male Torso from Back
medium: Oil on paper adhered to canvas
alt_text: A painting of a nude human figure shown from the back against a dark background. The figure is positioned in the center, and the torso is illuminated by light coming from the upper right. Deep shadows obscure the edges of the body, blending it into the dark brown and black surroundings. The person's right arm extends horizontally toward the right side of the frame. The colors are muted, featuring dark earth tones with hints of orange and yellow highlights on the skin.

title: Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting of a figure with a beard and dark hair attached to a cross. The central figure has tan skin and is wearing a white cloth around the waist. Behind the figure, the cross is dark brown and sits inside a blue-toned rectangular frame. The figure has a bright yellow halo around their head and appears to be in an archway. A textured, gold-colored frame with intricate carvings surrounds the entire artwork.

title: Bowl of Tulips
alt_text: A painting of a bouquet of colorful tulips in a shallow bowl. The flowers sit in a pale, ruffled bowl in the center of the frame. Long, green leaves and thin stems rise up from the bowl, topped with blooms in shades of dark purple, bright red, and yellow. To the left and right, soft, draped curtains with decorative trim frame the background. The wall behind the flowers is painted in light, neutral tones.

title: Shinnecock Hills
alt_text: A painting of a vast, open field under a cloudy sky. In the bottom left, a person with a bright red hat and long red socks sits in the grass. A second, smaller figure dressed in white stands in the grass further to the right. The landscape is filled with low, green, and brownish patches of meadow stretching toward a distant, darker green horizon. Soft blue and white clouds fill the large sky that takes up more than half of the scene.

title: Mlle. Pogany II
alt_text: A bronze sculpture sits on top of a plain, light-colored square pedestal. The sculpture is made of polished metal with a gold-toned, reflective surface. It has a smooth, curved shape that tilts downward as if bowing. One side of the metal form shows dark, ridged details that look like layers or pleats. The sculpture rests on a rough, stony base that connects it to the pedestal below.

title: The Luncheon
alt_text: A painting shows three people sitting around a dining table covered with a white tablecloth. In the foreground, a woman wearing a white, lacy top faces away from the viewer with her hair in a bun. Across the table, a man with a dark beard sits wearing a black jacket and a white shirt. To the right of the man, another person is partially visible, facing forward with light-colored, ruffled clothing. The table is filled with dishes, glasses, a melon slice, and a green pitcher. The background features a patterned wall on the left and a dark, indistinct area on the right.

title: Evening Star
alt_text: A painting of a dark, murky landscape showing a small bird perched in the lower left corner. The background consists of large, blurry, and shadowed shapes that suggest dense trees or brush. The ground area in the foreground appears to be wet or muddy, with light reflections. The sky is a broad, pale expanse with faint, horizontal strokes across the top of the canvas. The entire scene uses a muted, monochromatic palette of blacks, greys, and whites.

title: Interior at Le Cannet
alt_text: A painting of an interior room showing a view through an open doorway. The foreground features a light yellow wall with a tall, rectangular mirror hanging in the center. To the right, a small white vanity table holds a bright blue object, and a patterned chair sits in front of it. A doorway on the left leads into a darker, teal-colored room with a patterned floor. The overall scene uses soft, light colors like yellow, cream, and lavender to create a quiet, domestic atmosphere.

title: Five Oranges
alt_text: A painting of four round objects resting on a flat, pale surface against a dark, shadowy background. These objects are textured and brownish in color, resembling pieces of fruit. They are grouped closely together in the center of the frame. The lighting creates soft shadows on the surface beneath the round shapes. The painting is enclosed in a thick, worn-looking frame, and a white identification tag hangs from the upper right corner.

title: Harvesters on the Roman Campagna
medium: Oil on canvas in an original frame
alt_text: A painting of a vast, sunny landscape shows people working and resting in a wide, grassy field. On the left side, small groups of people are gathered near temporary shelters made of hay and simple fabrics. In the center and right foreground, figures guide teams of horses across the dry, yellow ground as if threshing grain. Several horses are shown mid-motion, while other groups of people stand near hay piles or rest on the ground. In the background, rolling hills and distant mountains stretch across the horizon under a pale, hazy sky. The overall scene feels busy with agricultural activity across a broad, open valley.

title: Heitere Gebirgslandschaft (Joyful Mountain Landscape)
alt_text: A painting of abstract, multi-colored geometric shapes arranged in a layered landscape. Sharp triangles, rectangles, and trapezoids in shades of orange, yellow, green, brown, and blue fill the composition. A thin, dark line runs horizontally across a large, bright orange shape in the center. Near the top, a small dark circle and a larger pale yellow circle appear against a brown background. A very fine, thin drawing of a tree stands near the center, placed on top of the shapes.

title: The Tulip
medium: Painted sheet metal and steel wire, painted red
alt_text: A sculpture of a hanging mobile is made of thin red wire and small red metal shapes. The object features many flat, leaf-like red pieces attached to slender red wires that branch out into the air. These red elements are arranged at different levels, creating a delicate, floating structure. The entire piece is bright red and set against a simple, light gray background. Soft shadows of the shapes are cast onto the wall behind it, mimicking the structure's overall form.

title: No. 3
alt_text: A painting of two large, stacked rectangular blocks of color. The top rectangle is a bright, vibrant orange that fills the upper half of the canvas. The bottom rectangle is a deep, muted reddish-purple that covers the lower half. The edges of both shapes are soft and slightly blurred, fading into the surrounding background color. A thin border of lighter, brownish-orange paint frames the entire composition on all four sides.

title: Bust of a Man
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man's head and shoulders rests on a tall base. The dark brown metal figure has curly hair and a short beard. He is wrapped in draped fabric that covers his chest and shoulders. The sculpture sits on a cylindrical pedestal with a mottled, brownish-gold finish. Below the pedestal is a simple, dark circular base. The entire object is set against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Bust of a Man, possibly Saint Paul
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man in profile facing to the left. The oval relief shows the man from the chest up, and he has a thick, curly beard and hair. His left hand is raised in front of his face with his fingers slightly parted. He wears draped clothing that covers his shoulders and chest. In the background, simple architectural pillars are carved behind his head and shoulders.

title: Portrait of Antinous
medium: Bronze, hollow cast with separately cast curls
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows the head and upper shoulders of a person with wavy hair. The person has a somber expression with downcast eyes and a straight nose. The dark metal surface of the head is weathered and uneven in color. This bust rests on a small, smooth, gold-colored pedestal that has a rounded base. The sculpture is set against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting shows two large, rectangular blocks of color stacked one on top of the other. The top rectangle takes up most of the vertical space and is a warm, soft shade of orange. Below it is a smaller, horizontal rectangle filled with a muted lavender color. A thin, bright yellow line separates the orange and the lavender sections. The edges of both shapes are soft and slightly blurred, rather than having sharp, straight lines.

title: View of Alkmaar
alt_text: A painting of a river landscape under a wide, cloudy sky. In the foreground, a small boat carries several people and a group of cows across the dark water. To the right, two sailboats with pale, pointed sails move across the river. The distant shoreline is lined with trees and the faint outlines of buildings and church spires. A few more cows graze on the grassy riverbank on the left side of the scene.

title: The Holy Family
alt_text: A painting of a woman, a man, and a baby sitting outdoors. The woman wears a light blue shirt, a pink skirt, and a white head covering, and she holds the naked baby on her lap. To her left, an older man with a grey beard and a red shirt leans forward, pointing toward a small branch with red berries that the baby is reaching for. Near the man's feet lies a brown hat resting on a white cloth bundle. They are surrounded by a dark and leafy landscape under dim light.

title: Head of a Wounded Soldier
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows the head of a person wrapped in a thick cloth. The sculpture is a dark, metallic brown color with a rough and uneven surface texture. The person's eyes appear to be closed under the wrapping, which covers the forehead and the bridge of the nose. The mouth is slightly open, showing a gap between the lips. The head is tilted upward and leans slightly to the right.

title: Two Calves Resting
alt_text: A painting of two calves resting together in a barn. The animal on the left has light brown and white markings and faces away to the left. The second calf is mostly white and rests its head on the straw, facing toward the viewer. They are lying on a patch of straw in a dimly lit, shadowy space with a wooden post in the background. The entire scene is encased in an ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: William Hance MacDowell, 1816-1906
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture of a man’s head and chest shows him looking slightly downward. The man has wavy, short hair and a thick, groomed mustache. He wears a formal jacket with wide lapels over a collared shirt. A small bow tie sits at the center of his neck. A thin, white ribbon with a small brown tag is tied loosely around his neck and shoulder area. The entire piece is a uniform, matte off-white color and sits on a rectangular base.

title: Green Grapes
alt_text: A painting of green branches with small, round fruit resting against a soft, light green background. The thin, brown twigs stretch horizontally across the center of the canvas. Many round, green clusters hang from these branches, appearing almost like grapes. The entire scene is painted with loose, textured brushstrokes. This artwork is enclosed in a wide, ornate, gold-colored frame that shows signs of wear and age.

title: The Young Harpist
alt_text: A painting of a young woman playing a large, ornate harp. She sits on a simple wooden chair against a plain, dark background. She wears a white dress with short sleeves and a bright orange ribbon tied around her waist. Her dark brown hair is pulled back with small curls framing her face. Her hands rest gently on the strings of the harp, which takes up much of the left side of the frame.

title: Falling Man Series #62
alt_text: A painting of a repeating pattern in the shape of a large, spiraling wheel. This wheel is set against a plain, light-tan background. The pattern is made of many identical, light-colored figures radiating from a small, dark center circle. These figures are arranged side-by-side to form a spiral shape that gets wider as it extends outward. At the top of the painting, the spiral pattern breaks off into a rectangular segment that continues the same design.

title: Wild Roses in Vase
alt_text: A painting of white flowers in a glass vase sitting on a dark surface. The vase is clear and tall, showing the green stems of the flowers inside the water. Several white blossoms with yellow centers bloom from the thick, green leafy stems. The background is a plain, muted tan color. A long, soft shadow extends diagonally from the vase across the light-colored wall behind it.

title: Popovers
alt_text: A painting of several round, brown objects resting on a flat surface against a dark, moody background. These objects are clustered together in the center and appear to be some kind of tuber or root vegetable. Bright, white, crumpled fabric or paper sits in front of the objects and to the right side of the group. The overall color palette is dark, with deep browns and shadows contrasting against the pale white material. The entire scene is encased in a simple, metallic gold frame.

title: Twelve Plums
alt_text: A painting of several dark purple plums sitting on a plain, light-colored surface. The plums are round and smooth, and they are clustered together in the center of the frame. One plum sits slightly apart on the far left, while the others form a small pile. One plum in the front has been sliced open to show a bright yellow and orange interior. A small, faint signature and the year 1826 are visible in the bottom left corner.

title: Fragment II
alt_text: A painting of a light-colored stone head resting on a block. The head is sculpted and appears aged or weathered with a pale, grayish tone. It wears a textured cap that looks slightly uneven or damaged on top. The head sits directly atop a rectangular stone base that matches its color. A dark, moody background of deep red and black surrounds the objects. The paint application looks loose and thick, creating a rough texture throughout the image.

title: Factory
alt_text: A painting made of flashed glass shows a red background covered in geometric shapes. These shapes are white and black lines, rectangles, and squares. On the left and in the middle, groups of these shapes create grid patterns that look like simplified building designs. Several long, vertical black lines stretch from the top of the piece towards the bottom. The shapes overlap and layer on top of each other, creating a sense of depth against the solid red surface.

title: Petit Cheval (Gelinotte)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a horse stands against a plain, light background. The figure has a long, upright neck and a blocky, angular body that looks stylized and simplified. It stands on four thick, column-like legs that provide a sturdy base. A simple, thin rein hangs from the horse's head down to the front of its body. The dark metal surface has a rough and uneven texture throughout the entire piece.

title: Petunias in a Flower Pot
alt_text: A painting of a potted flower sitting on a saucer. The plant has dark, leafy stems and a large, bright, ruffled blossom near the top. Two smaller, lighter buds are visible on the left and right sides of the plant. The flower is planted in a simple, cylindrical terracotta pot. The pot rests in the center of a matching round saucer. The entire scene is set against a plain, textured background.

title: Mobile
alt_text: A sculpture of painted sheet metal and wire showing a complex mobile suspended in mid-air. The object consists of many thin, dark wires that branch out in various directions. Attached to these wires are several flat, bright orange shapes that look like small leaves or petals. The orange pieces vary in size and point in different directions across the structure. Below the mobile, soft, grey shadows of these same shapes are cast against a solid grey background.

title: Fragment I
alt_text: A painting of a face shown against a dark, solid background. The portrait centers on a pale head with short, light-colored hair and a headband. The face has soft features and looks downward with a subtle expression. The painting sits inside a simple, weathered wooden frame with a rough texture. A small, white rectangular tag with numbers hangs from the top right corner of the frame.

title: Standing Mobile
medium: Painted sheet metal, painted wire and clay
alt_text: A metal sculpture shows many thin, branching wires connected to small dark shapes. The entire structure balances on a curved metal base that rests on the ground. Several dark, leaf-shaped pieces dangle from the ends of the wires at different heights. Some of these shapes are solid and dark, while others appear more textured. The whole piece is set against a plain, light background.

title: Cadence
alt_text: A painting showing two tall, vertical rectangular forms set against a deep red background. Each rectangle contains complex geometric shapes made of lighter and darker shades of red and orange. These shapes overlap to create sharp, angular, and transparent-looking patterns within the main rectangles. The composition is centered on a flat surface and enclosed within a simple, light-colored square frame. The overall image relies on variations of red to define its shapes and structure.

title: Conversation
alt_text: A painting of a person seen from the back or side with their head bowed. They are wearing a light-colored, loose garment that hangs down over their arm and torso. Their arm is raised, with the hand resting against their head or neck in a relaxed position. Thick, visible brushstrokes create the figure and the dark blue background. The colors include pale pinks, light blues, and deep, dark blue tones.

title: Water, Rocks, and Seagulls
alt_text: A painting of a rocky seascape under a cloudy, overcast sky. In the foreground, a large, dark, jagged rock rises out of the calm water, with several smaller rocks gathered around it. Below these rocks, dark reflections shimmer on the water’s surface. A group of white birds flies through the air in the upper right part of the scene. The entire painting is enclosed within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Kinetic IV
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes that overlap and twist. The composition features two large, deep green rectangular forms that appear to be folded or bent against one another. These green shapes are outlined and intersected by wide, light blue bands that create the illusion of three-dimensional depth. The entire structure is set against a dark, textured background that fades into a lighter cream-colored border within the frame. The overall geometric design feels both flat and spatial at the same time.

title: The Betrothal
alt_text: A painting of abstract, shadowy shapes and thin lines covering the entire canvas. Most of the image is filled with washes of gray, black, and white paint. Within these dark tones, thin black outlines draw various unrecognizable, curved forms that look like tangled objects. Small patches of bright yellow, green, and red paint are scattered throughout, providing spots of color against the gray background. Some of the shapes resemble fragments of bodies or organic, flowing structures. These lines and colors create a complex and layered scene without a clear focus.

title: Study for Construction in Red, Blue, and Black
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes in red, black, and blue arranged against a white background. At the top, a sharp, narrow band of textured black paint cuts across the width. Below this, a large, jagged red shape dominates the upper center, featuring a small white rectangle with a black line inside it and a white box containing a small black mark. A solid black, trapezoidal form sits beneath the red shape, creating a strong diagonal contrast. The bottom section of the composition is filled with a textured, dark gray-black pattern that spans the width of the frame. The blue sections appear as angled, rectangular blocks that bridge the space between the red and black areas.

title: The Baptism of Christ
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in a river while another man pours water over his head from a small bowl. The man on the right is muscular, wearing dark cloth, and holding a tall, thin wooden cross. A white bird flies in the sky above the central figures, surrounded by large, dark storm clouds and a patch of bright blue sky. Two winged figures sit in the water on the left, holding a bright blue and red fabric near the man in the center. In the distant background on a hill, two smaller, faint figures stand on the grass.

title: Sweet Corn
alt_text: A painting of three ears of corn shown against a plain brown background. Two of the ears stand upright in the center and are partially husked to reveal light-colored kernels. A third ear of corn lies horizontally across the bottom of the frame, fully covered by a green husk. Dark green leaves extend from the sides of the upright corn stalks. The entire scene is enclosed within a simple, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: Oblique White, Grays, Yellow
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes in bold colors. A large, off-white rectangle sits in the center of the frame, tilted slightly to the right. Surrounding this central shape are two large, grey, parallelogram-like forms that overlap and extend toward the edges. The background is divided into blocks of solid bright yellow and vibrant orange. The entire composition is contained within a simple, thin frame.

title: Loon
alt_text: A painting of a bird with a long, thin beak. The bird is mostly black and white and stands on the left side of the frame. Its neck is curved and slender, and its body is rounded and full. Beside the bird, on the lower right, sits a small, textured, oval shape that could be an egg or a nest. The background is a soft, pale gray-blue color with swirling, loose brushstrokes. The entire image is encased in a simple, metallic gold frame.

title: Loon III
alt_text: A painting of a bird with its head tilted back and beak open. The bird has dark, mottled feathers and a patch of bright white plumage on its neck and chest. It sits in a patch of dark green grass or reeds at the bottom of the painting. The background is a swirling, greyish-blue area that suggests water or a cloudy sky. The entire scene is held in a simple, gold-colored rectangular frame.

title: Facade
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes displayed on a grey background. The painting features rectangular blocks of black, white, and grey color arranged in a precise, grid-like pattern. Several vertical and horizontal stripes extend from these larger blocks, overlapping each other. The composition is contained within a simple, light-colored wooden frame. The overall arrangement creates a sense of order with alternating light and dark colors.

title: Either. . . Or
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes in shades of gray, white, and black. Several angular, geometric forms overlap each other against a neutral background. The shapes create the illusion of three-dimensional depth, resembling folded paper or stacked blocks. A bright, light-gray central rectangle stands out against darker, angled planes. The entire composition is contained within a thin, square frame.

title: Untitled (Orange)
alt_text: A painting of three horizontal, stacked rectangular blocks of color against a canvas. The top block is a bright, warm orange that fills the upper third of the composition. Below it, a wider, darker band of muted brown or gold stretches across the center. A second orange block, similar in color to the top one, occupies the bottom third of the image. The edges where the colors meet are soft and slightly blurred rather than sharp. The entire painting is framed by a thin, rough border of golden brown.

title: Lightning Struck
alt_text: A painting of a bird resting on a piece of wood. The bird is small and has light-colored feathers, positioned near the center of the image. Below it sits a large, curved piece of light brown wood that spans the width of the canvas. The wood has a rough, textured surface with many small, blocky details. A dark, shadowy background surrounds the bird and the wood, making them stand out. The painting is enclosed in a simple, rectangular frame.

title: Variant: Tension between Reds
alt_text: A painting shows several stacked, rectangular shapes in bright colors. A solid, warm red border frames the entire design. Inside this border sits a large, pink rectangle that acts as a background for the other shapes. In the center, a dark, reddish-brown rectangle sits above a wider, olive-green base. Two smaller olive-green vertical rectangles are placed symmetrically within the center section. The entire artwork is presented inside a thin white inner frame and a thick, muted gray outer frame.

title: Variant - Adobe- 2 Light and 2 Dark Grays
alt_text: A painting showing abstract geometric shapes in shades of gray. The composition is built from several rectangular blocks arranged to create layers of different tones. A large, light gray rectangle sits centrally within a darker gray background. Inside this central shape, two smaller, dark gray vertical rectangles are placed side by side, leaving a lighter space between them. The overall effect creates a sense of depth through stacked, flat areas of color.

title: Lac Achigan
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and lines on a pale background. A large, dark, irregular shape sits in the top right corner. A smaller, rectangular dark block is positioned lower on the left side. The center of the canvas features soft washes of yellow and hints of lavender paint. Scattered vertical black lines look like thin drips or marks that run down the middle section. A few dark, scribbled marks sit at the very bottom edge of the frame.

title: Variant: Cobalt Green Wall
alt_text: A painting featuring abstract, geometric shapes in shades of brown and teal. The background is composed of large, stacked horizontal bands in dark and medium brown tones. A wide, teal horizontal bar sits in the center of the painting, spanning most of the width. A reddish-brown shape that resembles a wide U-bracket sits on top of the teal bar. Two vertical, slightly darker brown rectangles stand inside the U-shape. These shapes are layered to create a sense of depth and overlapping transparency.

title: Variant: Leaf Green Wall
alt_text: A painting of bold, geometric shapes arranged in layers. A wide band of dark red frames the outer edge, while a thick band of gray sits inside that frame. In the center, a large, bright green shape dominates the composition. This green area has an inverted U-shape cut out of its bottom, creating two vertical green arms. Two small, vertical rectangles of red are placed inside the green arms, adding contrast to the center.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting shows three concentric squares in shades of green and grey. The outermost border is a thick, dark forest green frame. Inside this border lies a larger, solid dark grey square that fills most of the center space. Floating directly in the middle is a smaller, lighter grey square. The artwork is framed by a thin, neutral off-white edge.

title: Portrait of Dr. Ira De Ver Warner
alt_text: A painting of a man's portrait is shown in an ornate, gold-colored frame. The man appears to be middle-aged or older with short, light hair and a serious expression. He wears a dark suit jacket over a light-colored shirt that has a high, yellowed collar. The background of the portrait is dark and plain, making the man stand out. A small white tag with handwritten text hangs on the right side of the golden frame. Below the frame, a blue handwritten number is visible on a white sign.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares shows a flat, geometric design. The largest, outermost square is a dark gray color that creates a border. Inside that is a second, lighter gray square border. A solid, bright lime green square sits in the very center. The entire piece is enclosed in a thin, plain metal frame.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting showing three concentric squares of different colors centered on a square canvas. The largest outer square is a bright, vibrant lime green. Inside this is a smaller square in a rich, dark emerald green. At the very center lies the smallest square, which is a deep, muted teal color. The edges of all three squares are clean and straight. Each color field appears to have a slightly textured, matte surface.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting shows three concentric squares of different sizes and colors. The largest square forms a wide brown border around the entire image. Inside this brown square is a large, solid gray square. Centered within the gray area is a smaller, vibrant teal square. The edges of all the shapes are clean and straight.

title: Bark Painting with Landscape with Birds and Pond
medium: White, yellow and red pigments on a black ground
alt_text: A painting shows a flat, rectangular surface covered in a black background with detailed, intricate patterns made from white, yellow, and red lines and dots. The composition is divided by thin white lines into rough sections containing stylized shapes like ovals, small leaf-like forms, and bird-like silhouettes. In the center, a large, almond-shaped area filled with a repeating diagonal pattern dominates the upper middle section. Similar smaller shapes and lines are scattered throughout the rest of the dark space, creating a dense texture across the entire surface. The overall effect is like looking at a complex, woven design or a detailed map created from basic geometric marks.

title: Homage to the Square: Owl
alt_text: A painting shows three nested squares of different sizes and colors. The largest outer square is a deep, solid charcoal gray that covers almost the entire background. A smaller square in a medium shade of brownish-gold sits centered directly on top of the gray area. In the very middle, there is a final, smallest square painted in a bright, vivid yellow. The edges of all three squares are clean and straight.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares centered within one another. The outermost square is a frame of vibrant teal-green. Inside that is a large, flat gray square that fills most of the composition. In the very center lies a smaller, solid brown square. The edges of all shapes are straight and sharp, creating a clean geometric design.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares arranged symmetrically against each other. The outermost square is a wide, bright yellow border. Inside this border sits a larger square filled with a muted, olive-green color. Centered within that green area is a smaller, light gray square. The entire composition has a very flat, clean appearance with sharp, straight edges.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of a central, bright green square framed by a deep border. This border consists of four dark gray trapezoidal shapes that surround the green center. These shapes are shaded in a way that suggests depth, as if looking down into a square hole. The outer edges of these gray shapes form a large, dark outer square. A small, subtle signature appears in the bottom right corner of the border.

title: Synod of Bishops (Trial of Saint Athanasius(?))
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a group of people inside a decorated room with a gold-colored frame. On the left side, a woman in a dark robe stands near a doorway while a large, decorated door is slightly ajar. To the right of the doorway, a larger room features a group of people sitting and standing, all dressed in patterned robes. Several of these figures have glowing, circular halos around their heads. The floor is covered in a grid of red tiles, and the ceiling has detailed wooden beams.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares. The outer border is a thick frame of deep blue. Inside this blue frame sits a large, medium-grey square. Centered within that grey square is a smaller, dark charcoal square. All shapes have straight, clean edges and are arranged symmetrically.

title: Study of an Animal Skull
alt_text: A painting shows an animal skull centered against a light blue, vertical-planked background. The bone-colored skull faces forward and casts a dark blue shadow to its left. The painting is enclosed in a thick, textured gold frame with simple molding. A small white label with handwritten numbers sits just below the bottom edge of the frame. The entire object appears to be resting against a dark, metallic shelving unit.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of a series of nested squares on a textured background. The artwork features a large, dark black square that serves as a border. Inside this black area is a smaller square in a muted, grayish-brown tone. The surface of the painting has a rough, visible texture throughout. The entire composition is contained within a simple, metallic-colored frame.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares in varying shades of green. The largest square forms the outer border of the image in a dark, forest green. Inside that, a medium-sized square sits slightly lower than the center in a lighter shade of green. The smallest square is placed in the center of the medium square and is a bright, vibrant green. The entire composition is contained within a simple, thin frame.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting showing stacked rectangular shapes and horizontal stripes. The top third of the image is filled with alternating horizontal bands of dark red and orange. Below this section, a large, solid rectangle of deep red sits in the center, flanked by two pale pink columns. At the bottom, two thin, horizontal white stripes break up a band of orange. The entire composition is bordered by a thin, dark line, giving the work a framed appearance.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares set against each other. The outermost square is the largest and is a deep, grass green. Inside that is a smaller square in a dark, teal-blue green shade. The smallest and innermost square is a bright, lighter mint green. Each square is centered perfectly within the one surrounding it. The entire image is bordered by a thin, off-white strip at the top and bottom edges.

title: Fisherman at Low Tide
alt_text: A painting of a person walking along a beach. The figure stands in the shallow water, carrying a long pole across their shoulders with baskets hanging from the ends. In the foreground, another pole with similar baskets lies on the dark, wet sand. The beach stretches out toward a hazy, muted horizon line where the sky and water meet. The entire scene is painted in soft, cool tones of grey, blue, and brown.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares arranged symmetrically. The outermost square is a bright, yellowish-green color. Inside that frame is a larger, medium-toned green square. The central square is the smallest of the three and is painted a dark, blue-green shade. All the edges of these shapes are straight and sharp.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting showing bold, abstract brushstrokes in several colors on a light background. Large, dark green marks fill the bottom half of the image, appearing thick and layered. Above the green section, jagged strokes of grey and black stretch across the top, looking like harsh, chaotic lines. A vibrant patch of pink paint sits on the upper left side, contrasting with the other colors. The background consists of a creamy, off-white surface that peeks through the painted areas.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three concentric squares centered within one another. The outermost square is a deep, dark forest green. Inside that is a square of a lighter, olive-toned green. The center square is the smallest and is a bright, vibrant lime green. These squares are arranged to create a nested effect inside a simple, metallic frame. The entire composition is symmetrical and square in shape.

title: An Abandoned Quarry
alt_text: A painting of a rocky quarry carved into the side of a grassy hill. The quarry features a large, steep vertical rock face on the left with shades of tan and brown stone. Below the rock wall, the ground is scattered with many large, rough chunks of gray stone and broken debris. To the right, the terrain slopes upward and is covered in dark green grass and small, muted trees. A few small, simple buildings sit quietly near the top edge of the hill against a cloudy, dim sky.

title: Homage to the Square: Cool Rising
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares centered on a solid field. The largest outer square is a deep, vibrant green that fills most of the frame. Inside this is a slightly smaller square in a dusty, blue-green tone. The smallest, innermost square is a darker, forest green color. All the shapes are perfectly aligned with the edges of the board.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares centered on a flat surface. The largest square forms a dark, moss-green border around the outside. Inside that is a medium-sized square in a lighter, teal-blue color. The smallest square is in the center and is a bright, grassy green. Each shape is perfectly square and shares the same center point, creating a layered effect.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting shows three nested squares of different sizes and colors centered on a square canvas. The outermost square is a deep, solid blue that fills the entire background. A smaller square of dark, teal-green sits in the middle, appearing as a frame around the center. The smallest, innermost square is a vibrant, bright green. The entire composition is symmetrical and relies on clean, geometric lines.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of four nested, concentric squares. The outer border is a bright, vibrant green. Moving inward, the next square is a darker, teal-blue color. The third square is a muted, medium-toned blue-grey. The smallest, center square is a solid, bright blue. These four colored shapes create a geometric pattern centered within a thin, silver frame.

title: Portrait of Mary Cushing Fosburgh (1906–1978)
alt_text: A painting of a woman in an oval frame shows her from the chest up. She has light brown hair styled in soft waves that fall to her shoulders. The woman wears a dark blue, short-sleeved dress and a white pearl necklace around her neck. Her face is turned slightly to the left, and she has soft, neutral makeup on her lips and cheeks. A simple, dull-colored background surrounds her. The entire portrait is encased in a weathered, gold-toned oval frame.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares arranged symmetrically within each other. The outermost square is a textured, dark forest green that forms a wide border. Inside that is a second, slightly smaller square in a cooler, darker shade of blue-green. In the very center sits the smallest square, which is a bright, solid blue. The composition creates a sense of depth as the colors move from dark to light toward the center.

title: Serene Mountain View (White Mountains, New Hampshire)
medium: Oil on paper, backed with board
alt_text: A painting of a rocky, uneven landscape under a hazy sky. Large, dark hills or mountains fill the middle and left side of the scene. The foreground appears to be flat, barren ground painted with rough, horizontal brushstrokes in muted brown and grey tones. Light hits parts of the mountain ridges, showing warm hints of orange and yellow against the darker rock. Above the peaks, the sky is a pale, clouded grey that fades slightly toward the right.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested rectangles of different sizes and colors. The outermost rectangle forms a thick, wide border of mottled, brownish-orange paint. Inside that is a smaller, medium-gray rectangle that creates a thick frame. At the very center sits the smallest rectangle, which is painted a flat, bright turquoise color. These shapes are centered within one another to create a target-like design.

title: Homage to the Square: Festive
alt_text: A painting of nested squares features three distinct, solid-colored shapes centered within each other. The largest square on the outside is a vibrant, bright orange color that fills the background. Inside that lies a smaller, light blue square with soft, muted tones. At the very center is a final, smallest square that is a deep, dark blue. These shapes create a layered effect, with each square resting directly in the middle of the one surrounding it.

title: Portrait of Princess Natalia Paley as Ophelia
alt_text: A painting of a woman with long, dark hair that flows over her shoulders. She wears a crown of white daisies tucked into her hair, and more white daisies decorate the shoulders of her pale, pleated top. Her face is turned slightly downward, with her eyes cast away from the viewer. The background is a soft, muted mix of brownish-green colors that blend into the shadows around her. Dark vertical lines run down her garment, adding a sense of texture to the fabric.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of four nested, colored squares set within a simple, light gray frame. The outermost square is a dark, teal-green border. Inside that is a square in a medium blue tone. Within the blue area sits a smaller square in a bright, vivid orange. At the very center lies the smallest square, which is a solid, vibrant yellow. The overall design creates a concentric pattern that draws the eye directly to the center.

title: Homage to the Square: Private Sky
alt_text: A painting shows three nested squares of different colors centered on a pale gray background. The largest square on the outside is a deep, dark blue. Inside that is a smaller square in a vibrant shade of green. The smallest square at the very center is a soft, light blue. All the squares have sharp, straight edges and sit neatly within one another. The entire work is enclosed in a plain, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Homage to the Square: Floating
alt_text: A painting shows four concentric squares centered on a flat field. The outermost square is a wide border of light blue. Inside that is a square of dark brown, followed by a square of dark green. The innermost shape is a solid square of deep, dark blue. The entire image is arranged to create a nested, box-like appearance.

title: Crucifixion Among the Three Marys
alt_text: A wood relief sculpture depicts five figures in a scene carved from light-colored wood. A central figure is suspended on a cross, with arms outstretched and head tilted to the side. To the left stands a figure in a long robe with a round halo behind their head. To the right, another figure kneels, while a second figure stands behind them in draped clothing. Two smaller, winged heads occupy the upper corners of the rectangular carving, set against a background of wavy, cloud-like patterns.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting with oil on masonite shows four concentric squares centered on the canvas. The outer square creates a border of solid, deep blue. Inside this is a slightly smaller, dark gray square that fills much of the middle area. A medium-brown square sits inside the gray one, featuring a slightly textured look. At the very center lies the smallest square, which is a solid, warm mustard yellow color. The entire composition uses flat, geometric shapes to create a nested effect.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A wooden sculpture shows a tall, upright figure wearing a crown. The figure is draped in a long, dark garment that falls to the floor. Held on the figure's left side is a smaller, child-like form. Both figures have light-colored faces that stand out against the darker material of their bodies. The overall texture of the wood appears worn and aged.

title: Homage to the Square: Skyward
alt_text: A painting of three concentric squares centered on the canvas. The outer square has a wide, brown border that frames the other shapes. Inside the brown border sits a medium-gray square of equal width. In the very center lies a solid, bright blue square. The entire composition is encased in a simple, thin metal frame.

title: Seated Man with Object
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting alone against a gray background. The figure sits in the center of the frame and is painted with loose, textured brushstrokes. They wear a light-colored top with a vertical orange stripe and dark pants. The person's face is dark and angled upward as if looking toward the sky. A few thin, black lines cross the lower left corner, and a broad, curved brown line sweeps across the bottom right. The surrounding space is filled with swirling shades of gray and white paint.

title: Homage to the Square: Somber Promise I
alt_text: A painting of a dark, framed square surrounding a bright blue center. The frame itself is made of four thick, gray borders that slant inward toward the middle. These borders create a simple, tunnel-like effect that draws the eye toward the center. In the very middle sits a solid, perfectly square block of deep, uniform blue. The edges of the entire square are straight and sharp, creating a clean geometric look.

title: Still Life with Melons and Grapes
alt_text: A painting of fruit shows a large yellow squash and bunches of light-colored grapes inside an oval border. The round, pale yellow squash sits near the bottom left, resting on a flat surface. A large cluster of translucent grapes hangs downward across the top of the squash. Another smaller bunch of grapes rests near the bottom center of the frame. The background is dark and shadowy, with a few green leaves peeking out from behind the fruit. The entire image is encased in an ornate, rectangular gold frame with detailed carvings at the corners.

title: Homage to the Square: What You Want
alt_text: A painting of nested squares in shades of red and orange. The outermost shape is a large, deep red square that fills the entire frame. Inside that is a slightly smaller square in a lighter shade of red. At the very center sits the smallest square, which is a bright, warm orange color. These three squares are stacked perfectly, one inside the other.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting shows a series of three nested squares centered within one another. The outermost square is a dark, vibrant red that fills most of the frame. Inside that is a slightly smaller square of a lighter, more medium-toned red. The innermost square is the smallest and is a warm, bright orange color. The edges of all three squares are straight and parallel to the borders of the image. The composition is entirely flat, with solid blocks of color stacked in layers.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares set against a plain background. The artwork is framed and features a dark yellow outer border, a lighter yellow square inside it, and a bright, solid yellow square in the center. Each shape is a square with sharp, clean edges. The colors appear to be shades of mustard, lemon, and sunflower yellow. The painting is displayed in a simple, thin metal frame.

title: Still Life with Flowers and Fruit (Apples?)
alt_text: A painting of a lush bouquet of flowers arranged in a dark, simple vase sitting on a stone ledge. The flowers appear in shades of pink, white, and deep purple against a muted, brown background. To the left of the vase, a cluster of small, round, reddish-orange fruits rests on the same flat surface. The lighting is soft and moody, highlighting the delicate petals of the flowers and the round shapes of the fruit. This scene creates a quiet and classic composition centered in the frame.

title: Signor Mario
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a bearded man with dark hair. He looks off to the side with a serious expression on his face. The man wears a dark-colored jacket layered over a bright green scarf or collar. The background is a soft, warm brown shade that highlights his features. The entire portrait is framed by an ornate, textured gold frame.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of four nested, concentric squares centered on a flat background. The outermost square is a wide border of dark, muted grey. Inside that is a thick square frame of dark, forest green. A slightly lighter, medium-toned green square sits within that frame. Finally, a smaller, vibrant teal-green square fills the very center.

title: Indian in Turban Seated by a Ruin
alt_text: A painting depicts a dark, wooded landscape surrounded by a large, ornate gold frame. In the center, a tall, crumbling stone structure stands amid thick, tangled foliage and overgrown vines. The ground beneath the structure appears bright and sandy, contrasting with the dark shadows that surround the scene. Small figures are barely visible sitting near the base of the structure. The overall tone of the scene is moody and dim, suggesting a place that is wild and untamed.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting showing three large concentric squares layered one on top of the other. The outermost square is a wide border of dark, olive-toned mustard yellow. Inside this sits a smaller, bright orange square that fills most of the center space. At the very middle is a slightly smaller square of a lighter, paler yellow-orange color. These colored sections create a nested effect against a plain white background border. The entire work is enclosed within a thin, silver-colored metal frame.

title: Blue Plasticine Mountain Where the Queen of the Night Lives
alt_text: A sculpture of green plasticine sits on a light-colored, rectangular base. The form is irregular and rises to a pointed peak near the center. It has several flat, block-like edges at the bottom that look like small steps or pillars. A small hole, appearing as a dark oval, is visible on the upper right side of the object. A barcode sticker with the number 1981.95 rests on the left side of the base near the bottom edge.

title: Homage to the Square: Another Growth
alt_text: A painting showing three concentric squares nested inside each other. The outermost square is the largest and is filled with a dark, mossy green color. Inside that is a slightly smaller square in a cooler, teal-blue shade. The smallest square sits in the very center and is a vibrant, bright green. The squares are perfectly aligned, creating a clean geometric design with flat color.

title: Saint Gennaro, Bishop of Naples
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in elaborate clerical robes and a tall, pointed hat standing in the center. He wears a yellow and gold patterned vestment over a dark, textured undergarment and holds a tall, silver staff in his left hand. His right hand rests against his chest. To his left, a small, winged figure holding a green palm leaf extends a tray with two small red objects toward the man. The background is dark and indistinct, framing the figures in an oval shape.

title: Untitled
medium: Oil and mixed media (plaster and plaster mixed with sand?) on burlap laid down on canvas
alt_text: A painting shows two abstract, tall, and thin figures against a textured blue background. On the left, a brown, blocky shape stands with a flat top extending toward the center. On the right, a second figure has a rounded top, defined by a thin, dark outline that creates a halo-like shape above its head. Both figures are painted in shades of earthy brown, tan, and cream, with rough, thick patches of paint visible throughout the surface. The background is a mottled, deep blue that fades into darker colors near the edges. The overall style is heavy and textured, with layers of paint and plaster showing distinct, gritty brushstrokes.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting displays three nested squares centered within a larger square frame. The outermost square is a wide, bright yellow border. Inside that, a second, slightly smaller square is a muted, brownish-gold color. The innermost square is the smallest of the three and is a solid, light grey. These shapes create a layered effect, with each color filling a perfectly aligned square frame.

title: T 1974 R-24
alt_text: A painting of an abstract composition set against a solid, dark reddish-brown background. In the center, a thin, vertical stripe of deep blue stretches from top to bottom, fading slightly into the surrounding color. Flanking this blue stripe are two curved, wing-like shapes in a light yellow-orange color. These two shapes have a textured appearance, created by numerous fine horizontal lines that look like strokes from a dry brush. The lighter shapes appear to float on either side of the dark center line, creating a symmetrical design.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares set against a dark gray square background. The outermost square is a large, solid block of deep rust-brown. Inside that sits a smaller square in a lighter, golden-tan color. At the very center is a final, smallest square in a bright, pale yellow. The entire image is enclosed within a thin, simple silver-colored frame.

title: Together Come Rightly Many
medium: Oil and isobutyl methacrylate on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a dark, textured surface covered in thin, colorful lines. The background is a murky mix of brown, grey, and deep green tones that looks like rough concrete or stone. Several slender, curved lines of yellow, white, blue, and orange loop and cross over each other across the expanse. These lines are delicate and appear to be drawn or painted on top of the darker textured layer. The overall effect is like a diagram or a sketch floating above a weathered wall.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting showing three nested squares arranged in the center of the frame. The largest outer square has a dark, reddish-brown color that forms a border against the edge of the image. Inside that border is a slightly smaller square in a lighter, golden-brown shade. Centered within that is the smallest square, which is a bright, olive-yellow color. The entire image features flat, solid blocks of color with sharp, distinct lines separating each shape.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting showing three nested squares of different colors. The outermost square is a wide, black border. Inside this sits a larger square filled with a muted, dark gray color. At the very center is a smaller, bright green square. The shapes are stacked perfectly, creating a frame-like effect. The entire image has a flat, matte appearance.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows an abstract composition in a tall, narrow vertical format. The surface is textured with layers of gray, white, and pale blue paint, creating a hazy background. Scattered throughout are small, distinct patches of brighter colors, including square shapes of red and blue, and small, irregular dots of yellow and orange. The texture appears thick and uneven, with some areas showing visible brushstrokes or paint build-up. The overall effect is a mix of muted tones broken by intermittent, contrasting spots of color.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting showing a series of nested squares in varying colors. A large, pale yellow outer square acts as the frame for the shapes within. Inside it sits a bright, vibrant yellow square. Moving further inward, there is a smaller, darker brown square. The center contains the smallest square, which is a lighter, golden-brown shade. All the squares are centered within one another to create a geometric, layered pattern.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting showing a series of three nested squares set against an orange border. The outermost border is a vibrant, bright orange. Inside that is a square of a darker, golden-orange hue. At the center is a smaller square in a muted, earthy shade of brown or tan. The colors are applied in flat blocks, and the entire work is framed in a simple, metallic border.

title: On High (maquette)
alt_text: A sculpture made of painted red metal shows several hollow, tube-like shapes joined together. The object features a central vertical column with other angled tubes branching out in different directions. These curved pieces have slanted, open ends that look like scoops or cut-off pipes. The entire structure stands on a light-colored, flat surface. To the right, a blurred, ornate vase with gold details is partially visible in the background.

title: Untitled
medium: Recto: Oil on paper, mounted on board; verso: Oil on board
alt_text: A painting of a figure standing in a colorful, abstract outdoor setting. The figure, which is pale and appears unclad, stands in the center and holds a piece of white cloth above its head. Behind the figure, the background is divided into horizontal bands of dark green, bright yellow, and muted blue tones. Dark vertical shapes resembling trees rise up into the upper part of the image. To the right of the figure, there is a cluster of dark, rounded shapes resting on the ground. The entire scene is rendered with thick, visible brushstrokes.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares in shades of yellow and brown. The largest square on the outside is a bright, deep yellow. Inside that square sits a second square, which is a paler, lighter yellow. In the very center is the smallest square, which is a dark, brownish-gold color. All the shapes have sharp, straight edges and are perfectly aligned. The entire image is encased in a thin, simple frame.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A gilded wood sculpture shows a seated woman with a small infant lying across her lap. The woman wears a long dress with heavy folds and a veil over her dark-colored hair. Her hands are pressed together in front of her chest as if in prayer. The infant lies horizontally on her lap, facing slightly away from the viewer. The entire figure sits on a dark, hexagonal base that features faint, carved lettering along its front edges.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a pale, seated figure set against a dark, textured background. The figure is painted in loose, visible brushstrokes of white and light blue, appearing to sit with knees apart. Its body is abstract, lacking defined facial features or clear outlines. The background consists of patches of deep brown, bright blue, and black. Thick, expressive paint strokes create the scene, giving the composition a rough and energetic look.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of trees in a landscape. The artwork uses thick, textured brushstrokes in shades of blue, teal, and green to represent the foliage and grass. Dark brown trunks and branches stand out against the lighter colors of the leaves. Several circular shapes of orange and yellow appear throughout the canopy, suggesting sunlit spots or perhaps flowers. The painting has a horizontal band of lighter, warmer colors across the very bottom, framing the scene.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting shows three nested squares of different colors. The largest outer square is a deep, earthy brown color. Inside that is a medium-sized square that is a lighter, golden-tan color. In the very center is the smallest square, which is a bright, vibrant yellow. Each shape is perfectly centered within the one surrounding it.

title: Archtype I
alt_text: A painting of a bright orange shape floating in the center of a soft, abstract background. This central form is shaped like a trapezoid and displays a dark, cross-like symbol on its face. The background consists of hazy, blended colors including pale yellow, light blue, and creamy white. Wispy, diagonal brushstrokes streak across the composition, giving the scene a sense of movement. The overall effect is dreamlike and simple.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a landscape features a dense collection of round, leafy trees under a bright sky. The trees are painted in thick strokes of teal, blue, and green, filling most of the upper half of the frame. Below the trees, there are abstract patches of orange, yellow, and blue that suggest a field or rolling ground. One large tree stands prominently on the right side of the canvas with a thick brown trunk. The entire scene is framed in a simple, thin silver metal border.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of nested squares in shades of yellow and gold. The artwork consists of three distinct squares layered within each other. The outermost square is a pale, muted gold that borders the entire edge of the frame. Inside that is a slightly smaller square in a richer, warm yellow tone. The innermost square is the smallest and features a vibrant, bright yellow color. This geometric arrangement fills the entire square-shaped frame.

title: Virgin and Child

alt_text: A sculpture of papier-mâché on a wood panel shows a woman holding a small child close to her face. The figures are raised in relief and colored in muted, weathered tones. Both the woman and the child have curved, golden shapes behind their heads that look like halos. The child has one hand resting on the woman’s chest, while the woman holds the child with her other hand. A wide, rectangular frame with a decorative gold rope-like pattern surrounds the figures.

title: Homage to the Square: Light Soft
alt_text: A painting showing three nested squares of different colors. A large outer square fills most of the frame in a muted, grayish-beige color. Inside this, a slightly smaller square is a light, creamy yellow. In the very center, a third, smaller square is a bright, solid lemon yellow. The overall shape of the canvas is square.

title: Ariel
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes in shades of brown, tan, and soft pink. On the left side, tall, curved, and jagged forms rise upward. A central figure features sharp green and red angular lines that point toward the top of the frame. To the right, another large, indistinct figure stretches across the lower portion of the canvas. The background is a light, dusty pink that fills the spaces between the darker shapes.

title: Homage to the Square: Dense-Soft
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares placed one inside the other. The largest square serves as the background and is a light, neutral gray color. A medium-sized square sits in the center of the gray background and is colored a muted, golden yellow. Inside that yellow square is a smaller, bright, solid yellow square. The composition is centered, creating a symmetrical look of simple geometric shapes.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of nested, flat-colored squares within a silver frame. The outermost square is a large border of bright, light blue. Moving inward, there is a square frame of darker, deeper navy blue. Inside that is a smaller square frame of dark, muted purple. The center is a solid, bright red square. The overall composition creates a sense of depth by layering these colored shapes one inside the other.

title: Street Scene with Two Women and a Dog
alt_text: A painting of two dark-skinned figures standing side-by-side against a blue background. The taller figure on the left wears a long, gray dress and balances a red bowl on her head. The shorter figure on the right wears a bright red dress and also carries a red container on her head. At their feet lies a dark animal, possibly a dog, resting on the reddish ground. A small, blue, box-like shape sits on the ground to the right of the animal. Dark walls frame the scene on both the far left and far right sides.

title: Homage to the Square: Earthbound
alt_text: A painting of four nested squares of different sizes and colors. The largest square on the outside is bright orange. Inside that, there is a slightly smaller square in a medium shade of brown. The next square toward the center is a darker, reddish-brown color. Finally, the smallest square in the very center is a bold, deep red. All the shapes are perfectly square and centered within each other.

title: Transformation of a Scheme No. 24
alt_text: A painting made of engraved vinylite on wood showing a geometric design of white lines against a stark black background. The white lines form overlapping rectangular and triangular shapes that look like a partially transparent box. A larger, tilted square outline surrounds these central shapes. The lines intersect at various points, creating a sense of depth and three-dimensional space. The entire composition is centered and features sharp, clean edges.

title: Weary of the Truth
alt_text: A painting of a man with a beard wearing a tall black hat. The man is shown from the side in profile, facing left. He wears a dark brown coat or cloak wrapped around his shoulders over a white collared shirt. In the background on the left, a sketch-like, white dome structure stands against a grey wall. To the right of the man, a tall, thin, light-colored column or monument rises vertically. The entire background has a textured, grey, and painted appearance.

title: Transformation of a Scheme No. 30
alt_text: A painting shows a series of white geometric lines on a solid black background. These lines form the overlapping shapes of three tall, rectangular prisms. Some of the lines are very bright, while others appear thinner and dimmer. The prisms are tilted and angled, creating the appearance of depth and intersecting planes. The composition is centered, filling most of the space within the frame.

title: Birch Tree
alt_text: A painting of a wooded landscape in autumn. Several tall trees with trunks featuring light gray and dark red horizontal bands stand in the foreground. The forest floor is covered with a layer of brownish-orange leaves and patches of dull, gray-green grass. Behind the main trees, other dark tree trunks disappear into the distance, creating a sense of depth. The color palette uses muted, earthy tones that suggest a cool, overcast day.

title: Rocks in Pasture land
canvas_label: This Image was Created for documentation purposes prior to going off site to 300 Prospect- photographed on August 12, 2008
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a large, rocky outcrop nestled among trees. The gray rock sits in the center of the scene, surrounded by grassy, earth-toned slopes. To the left, a cluster of trees displays orange and yellow autumn leaves. The ground in the foreground is covered in dried, brownish-green grass. A hazy, pale sky fills the upper portion of the canvas above the distant treeline.

title: Crowd of Women on Beach
alt_text: A painting of a beach scene shows several small boats resting on the shore near the water's edge. A cluster of indistinct figures stands in the sand, looking towards the boats or the water. The sky above is pale, with faint clouds in shades of light blue and grey. The painting is set in a wide, textured frame that appears light gold or beige in color. A small white museum tag with handwritten numbers hangs from the bottom of the frame against a storage grid background.

title: Virign and Child
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a woman holding a small child. The tall figure stands upright with a draped cloth covering her head and shoulders, extending down to her feet. A smaller child is nestled in her arms, held against her chest. The sculpture has a dark, worn appearance with some areas showing hints of lighter tones. The overall surface texture looks rough and aged.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a man, shown from the chest up, looks directly at the viewer with a serious expression. He has wavy, light gray hair and fair skin. He wears a dark-colored coat with brass buttons over a light-colored shirt with a white cravat at his neck. In front of him, his hand rests near a wooden palette holding several slender paintbrushes. A heavy, dark red curtain hangs in the background behind him.

title: George Washington (1732–1799), LL.D. 1781
medium: Ink on paper enclosed in gold breast pin with 12 diamonds set in silver mounts, gold and silver foliate stem set with 2 diamonds; linked with gold chain to silver and gold stickpin with pearl head
alt_text: A jewelry miniature shows a portrait pin attached to a long stickpin by a gold chain. The main pin features a small oval portrait surrounded by a ring of twelve sparkling stones set in metal. Below the portrait, a metal stem decorated with two leaves and two smaller stones extends downwards. A thin gold chain connects the back of this main pin to a separate, slender stickpin. This stickpin is long, straight, and topped with a single, smooth white pearl at its end. The entire piece rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Sarah Trumbull with a Spaniel
alt_text: A painting of a woman wearing a white turban and a reddish-brown dress with white sleeves. She looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression, her head tilted slightly. A small, white, fluffy dog with brown patches stands to her left and looks up at her. She rests her right arm gently on the dog's back. A dark curtain hangs in the background, revealing a glimpse of a cloudy, light-blue sky on the left side. The woman also wears a necklace made of small, red beads that matches her simple drop earrings.
