title: Mounted Groom Awaiting Companion
alt_text: A painting of a man riding a horse near a large stone building. The man wears a dark jacket, light-colored pants, and a dark top hat. He sits atop a tall, brown horse that faces toward the right side of the frame. Standing slightly in front of the large horse is a smaller, light-brown horse with a saddle on its back. Two small dogs are on the ground in the foreground, one lying down and the other standing. The scene is set in an open, grassy area with a cloudy sky in the background.

title: Untitled
medium: Bronze wire garden sculpture. Manufactured bronze rods welded to bronze base, brown and green patina
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a tall, cylindrical structure made from many thin, vertical rods. These rods are arranged closely together to create a dense, fence-like shape. At the bottom, the rods are welded to a circular base that has a small gap in the front. The entire object has a textured appearance with colors that look like a mix of brown and green. The background is dark and fades into a lighter surface near the bottom where the sculpture rests.

title: Cranberry Pickers
alt_text: A painting of many people working in a large, grassy field. In the foreground on the right, a man and two women stand near wooden barrels while handling baskets of red fruit. The rest of the field is filled with numerous other people spread out, appearing to bend over or sit while they work on the ground. A dark, rolling hillside stretches across the background under a pale, cloudy sky. The lighting in the scene is soft and hazy, casting long shadows across the golden-brown grass.

title: Mobile
medium: Painted sheet metal and steel wire; black and red wires with red, yellow, blue, black and white plates
alt_text: A sculpture of a hanging mobile floats against a solid, light grey background. It consists of thin, curved black and red metal wires that branch out in several directions. Attached to the ends of these wires are flat, geometric shapes in red, yellow, blue, black, and white. These shapes vary in size and angle, creating an airy, balanced structure. A faint shadow of the mobile appears on the wall behind it.

title: Continual Light-Forms in Contortion
alt_text: A sculpture of steel and light shows a tall, box-like frame with an open front. The frame has thick, black sides and a solid, rectangular black base at the bottom. Inside the box, a smooth, light-colored panel serves as a plain background. A thin, curved piece of shiny metal stretches across the upper half of the box in a wavy, ribbon-like shape. Two small, vertical rods connect the metal strip to the background, holding it in place.

title: The Upheaval
alt_text: A painting of an abstract composition created with collage and oil paint on canvas. The image is filled with many irregular, light-colored shapes that overlap and fit together like puzzle pieces. Dark black spaces peek through the gaps between these shapes, creating high contrast across the entire surface. The shapes vary in size and form, ranging from long, rectangular strips to rounded, blob-like figures. This arrangement covers the canvas entirely, leaving no open background space.

title: No. 7
alt_text: A painting of overlapping shapes in muted tones of white, cream, and tan. Several rectangular patches of smooth, light-brown paper or canvas are attached to the surface. These are set against a background of painted white or off-white areas. Dark, thin lines form jagged or curving borders between the different shapes. The overall effect is like a collection of layered paper scraps or an abstract map.

title: Untitled
alt_text: An oil painting displays a close-up view of a surface with layers of peeling yellow and beige paint. The texture appears uneven and bubbly, with darker yellow spots scattered across a lighter cream-colored background. Some areas show the paint flaking off, revealing lighter patches underneath. The surface looks rough and degraded, with the focus getting slightly softer toward the edges. The overall effect is a dense, abstract pattern of yellow and beige tones.

title: The Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting of a figure suspended on a wooden cross against a dark, cloudy sky. Below the cross, one person with long hair stands to the right while raising a hand and holding the hand of another figure lying on the ground. A second person sits on the left, looking up with an open hand and supporting the figure on the ground. The person on the ground wears pink and blue clothes and appears to be fainting or resting. The background is shadowy and creates a somber mood for the scene.

title: Portrait of Francis P. Garvan (1875-1937)
medium: Oil on canvas; frame is gilded wood with floral carved trim
alt_text: A painting shows a man in a dark suit standing in front of a decorative panel. The man is middle-aged, has gray hair, and wears a red-patterned tie. Behind him, the panel features a mural showing two men in red coats sitting at a table near a window. A shiny, silver-colored cup with two handles rests on a shelf to the right of the man. To the far left, a small, dark blue vessel sits on the same shelf.

title: Two Crescents
medium: Painted sheet metal, steel wire and string; red and black wires with varying-shaped plates in black, yellow and red
alt_text: A sculpture of a hanging mobile suspended against a light gray background. This object is made from red wire branches that support many small, thin plates of metal. The plates are painted in bright red, yellow, and black colors and have various triangular shapes. The mobile hangs from a single thin wire at the top. Its long, slender arms extend downward and outward in a tree-like pattern.

title: The Dutchman
alt_text: A painting of a seated man wearing a hat and period clothing. The man wears a wide-brimmed, dark hat, a brown jacket with a white collar, and white cuffs at his wrists. He sits in a tall chair, his hands resting in his lap. To his left, there is a green, rectangular table surface with a blurry, indistinct object sitting on top of it. The background is a mix of dark, loose brushstrokes that suggest an indoor setting. The entire scene is encased in an ornate, gold-colored frame with carved edges.

title: William Cranch
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a man's head and shoulders faces forward. The sculpture is a light brown, matte color and shows the man with wavy, short hair and a serious expression. A thin white string loops around the statue's neck and holds a plain white tag with a small green sticker on it. The background behind the statue is plain white, and the surface it rests on is a tan, flat color. The object is centered in the frame.

title: Homage to the Square: Luminous Setting
alt_text: A painting made with oil on board shows three stacked squares. The largest square on the outside is a dark, olive-green color. A smaller, medium-sized square inside it is colored a lighter, burnt orange. A final, smallest square sits in the very center and is a bright, vivid orange. The edges of all three squares are straight and parallel to each other.

title: Homage to the Square: Astonished
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares centered on a flat field of bright yellow. The outer square is a large, vibrant yellow border that fills the entire background. Inside this is a slightly smaller square made of a lighter, pale lime-yellow shade. At the very center sits a small white square. Each square is positioned symmetrically within the one surrounding it, creating a simple geometric pattern.

title: Untitled
medium: Tempera on paper mounted on linen
alt_text: A painting showing two large, rectangular blocks of bright color stacked on top of each other. The top block is a deep, solid shade of red. The bottom block is a lighter, more orange-red hue. Horizontal brushstrokes are visible in the paint texture across the entire surface. A thin, light-colored border frames the edges of the colorful shapes.

title: Untitled (landscape)
alt_text: A painting of a rocky, tree-covered hillside rising above a calm body of water. The hillside is filled with trees showing autumn colors of orange, yellow, and red. Below the trees, large patches of grey rock and stone are visible along the water's edge. The water itself is a muted, greyish-brown color and reflects the bank above it. A hazy, light-colored sky sits in the background behind the hill.

title: North Mountain and Catskill Creek
alt_text: A painting of a calm river scene at sunset with mountains in the background. A person in a small boat filled with greenery floats in the center of the water. To the right, another person on horseback stands near the water's edge, partially submerged. The sky is filled with soft, pink and blue clouds above the distant, pale blue mountain range. Large, dark green trees frame both sides of the river, casting reflections onto the smooth water's surface.

title: Thinking of Him
alt_text: A painting of a woman crying with a thought bubble above her. The woman, shown in profile on the left side, has blonde hair, closed eyes, and a single teardrop rolling down her cheek. Her face is made of tiny red dots against a light pink background, typical of a comic book style. To her right, a thought bubble contains the profile of a man with dark hair wearing a blue suit and red tie. The background of the entire scene is a solid, bright yellow. All the figures are outlined with thick, bold black lines.

title: Untitled (Curve XXIII)
alt_text: A stainless steel sculpture of a tall, thin, and flat vertical form stands on a wooden base. The metal piece is widest in the middle and tapers slightly toward the top and bottom. Its surface is smooth, reflective, and light gray in color. This object sits on a light-colored wooden floor in front of a plain white wall. A small piece of dark trim separates the wall from the floor at the bottom of the room.

title: The Beach at Trouville
alt_text: A painting of a crowd of people gathered on a sandy beach under a cloudy, blue sky. Many people are standing or sitting in small groups, wearing dark coats, hats, and formal clothing. A few individuals carry open umbrellas in red or dark colors to shade themselves from the sun. The ocean stretches out in the background, with a tiny sailboat visible on the horizon. The beach is a wide, light brown space that takes up the bottom third of the scene.

title: Trouville at Low Tide
alt_text: A painting shows several sailboats resting in calm, shallow water under a cloudy, blue-grey sky. In the foreground on the right, a darker boat with reddish-brown wood near the hull dominates the scene. To its left, a small rowboat carrying a few people moves across the water. Several other smaller sailboats appear in the hazy distance toward the horizon line. The shore is barely visible as a sandy, light-colored band at the very bottom of the frame.

title: Sailboats near Trouville
alt_text: A painting of a stormy seascape shows several sailboats navigating choppy, greenish-blue waves. A massive expanse of dark, heavy gray clouds dominates the upper half of the sky, with lighter patches of blue visible on the right. Four sailing vessels are scattered across the horizon line, with the two boats on the right appearing larger and closer than the others. The water in the foreground is rough, with white-tipped waves indicating windy conditions. A signature is visible in the bottom-left corner of the painting.

title: Picnic on a Riverbank
alt_text: A painting of three people relaxing outdoors by a dark body of water. A woman in a long, light pink dress sits on the grassy bank to the left next to a tall, thin tree. Beside her, a man wearing a hat and blue pants sits while holding a long, thin stick over the water. Another man stands behind him, wearing a white shirt and dark blue pants against the backdrop of a large green tree. The sky above is a mix of bright blue and thick, white brushstrokes. A small boat rests in the water at the bottom right corner of the frame.

title: Medieval Time
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes and lines covers the gray canvas. Thin, dark, ink-like lines create geometric forms and curved patterns that crisscross over the surface. The design is dense and chaotic, featuring sharp angles and rounded, swirling segments throughout the composition. A ghostly, circular shape vaguely resembles a head near the center of the image. The artist's signature is visible in the bottom left corner in a light script.

title: Iron Hawk
alt_text: A painting with abstract geometric shapes in shades of gray, yellow, red, and orange. The image features a large, dark gray central area that is divided by light gray horizontal bands. Two bright yellow triangular shapes are at the top and far left edges. A sharp, white diagonal line cuts across the gray sections in both the top-left and bottom-right areas. A bold red vertical shape sits on the far right edge, while a flat orange rectangle is at the bottom.

title: Mithraic Sacrifices
alt_text: A painting shows a chaotic scene with several abstract human figures in shades of pink, tan, and white. In the center, a large figure appears to be holding a dark, knife-like object above another figure lying on the ground. A third figure stands on the right, bending forward with arms raised. The background is filled with sharp, jagged shapes in deep reds, greens, and blacks, creating a sense of movement and tension. The entire work is enclosed in an ornate, gold-colored wooden frame with detailed carved patterns.

title: untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured shapes set against a dark green background. Thick, black brushstrokes create blocky and layered forms that dominate the center and upper portions of the canvas. These shapes appear to overlap one another in a dense, messy stack. Below these forms, a solid horizontal black bar stretches across the lower section of the painting. The surrounding colors are a mix of murky green and shadowed gray.

title: Rock Painting No. 2
alt_text: A painting of many rounded, grey stones packed closely together. The rocks fill the entire frame, creating a textured surface that resembles a stone wall or a rocky riverbed. Thin, dark lines outline the shape of each individual stone, giving them depth and definition. A winding path of smaller, brownish, speckled pebbles cuts horizontally across the middle of the composition. The colors are mostly muted shades of grey, white, and brown.

title: Sun at Cathedral Rocks
alt_text: A painting of a quiet shoreline during a soft sunset. A wide band of light blue water stretches across the middle of the scene. Above the water, a large and puffy cloud tinted with bright pink paint hangs in a pale gray sky. The foreground shows a rocky beach with dark, blocky shapes in shades of gray, purple, and green. A vertical reflection of pink light glows on the surface of the calm water near the center.

title: Child of the Moon
alt_text: A painting of a tall, slender, light blue shape centered against a dark blue and black background. This pale figure has a slightly wavy, organic outline and curves gently toward the left side. At the very top, two small, horn-like projections point upward. To the right of the figure, a bright, oval-shaped light floats in the darker upper area. The bottom of the canvas is darker, with a small patch of lighter blue near the center edge.

title: Arneb
alt_text: A painting shows a series of concentric, wavy-edged shapes centered on a square canvas. At the very center sits a solid green square with rounded, wavy corners. Surrounding the green center is a thick, cream-colored band that follows the same wavy outline. A ring of bright blue encircles the cream band, and finally, a thick band of reddish-orange surrounds the blue ring. The background behind the outermost shape is a plain, off-white color. The entire design is encased in a simple, thin wooden frame.

title: Smoke
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a geometric framework made of dark metal bars. This open structure is composed of angled, rectangular sections that fit together to form a box-like shape. The sculpture stands on several legs that extend down to the floor at different points. Its surface has a dark, matte finish that creates highlights and shadows along the sharp edges of the metal. The entire object rests on a plain, light-colored floor against a solid, neutral background.

title: Ophir
alt_text: A painting of copper paint on canvas shows an abstract, non-rectangular shape. The artwork consists of a large, bent strip that resembles an "L" shape turned on its side or a zig-zag pattern. The entire surface is a solid, metallic copper-brown color. Narrow, light-colored lines run parallel to the edges of the shape, creating a series of concentric, bent borders throughout the piece. The object is set against a plain white background.

title: Nude (Angna Enters)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a human torso and legs rests on a sheet of wrinkled, silver plastic. The sculpture has a golden metallic color and is shaped to show a figure reaching or stretching outward. One leg extends horizontally toward the right, while the other leg points downward. The upper body is bent, and the arms are not visible. A long, thin rod or pin extends from the bottom of the lower leg.

title: Jacob Hale
alt_text: A painting of a man with light skin, shown from the chest up. He has a pale, curly wig and is wearing a dark brown jacket over a white shirt with ruffled cuffs. One hand rests on his hip, while the other is tucked into his clothing near his waist. His expression is serious, and he looks directly forward at the viewer. In the background, a simple landscape shows a green field under a light sky with a few trees.

title: Saint Mary Magdalen
alt_text: A painting on panel shows the upper body of a woman with a serious expression, facing forward. She wears a vibrant red headscarf and matching red robes that drape over her shoulders. A bright gold halo, showing signs of age and cracking, surrounds her head. In her left hand, she holds a slender black cross with thin arms. In her right hand, she holds a small, box-like container with a pointed lid. The background is worn and faded, with large patches of the original light-colored surface visible.

title: Christ at the Column
alt_text: An ivory sculpture shows a standing man with his head tilted to his right. His arms are bent behind his back, as if they are tied together. A piece of fabric is draped loosely around his waist, knotted in the front. The figure has a muscular build and a beard. The sculpture stands on a small circular base, which rests on a square black block.

title: Figures by a River
alt_text: A painting of a quiet outdoor scene showing people near a riverbank. Large, dark trees frame the left and right sides of the view. In the lower center, a group of figures gathers near the water, with one person sitting near a small boat. The background shows a hazy, open field leading toward some faint stone structures in the distance. The sky above is filled with soft, light blue and white clouds.

title: Egg
alt_text: A painting of a single, oval-shaped object centered on a rectangular background. The background is painted in a muted, greenish-brown color with visible brushstrokes and a rough, textured surface. The central object is rounded and egg-like, also appearing in shades of light brown or beige. A darker shadow is cast beneath the bottom curve of this central shape, creating a sense of depth against the background. The entire composition uses a limited, earthy color palette.

title: The Loire at Beaulieu
alt_text: A painting of a quiet landscape by the water, set within a highly ornate, gold-colored frame. The painting shows a dark cluster of tall, leafy trees on the left side, casting a shadow over the riverbank. To the right, a small boat rests near the shore of a wide, calm body of water that stretches into the distance. The sky above is filled with soft, gray, and white clouds, suggesting an overcast day. The frame surrounding the painting features intricate, swirling leaf-like carvings and metal corner details. A small, empty metal plaque is attached to the bottom center of the frame.

title: Shepherds on a Lake
alt_text: A painting of a calm landscape scene shows a small figure standing near a group of tall trees on the left. The figure is wearing dark clothing and looks toward a stretch of water that extends into the distance. Behind the water, a small house and other structures sit low on the horizon under a soft, cloudy sky. The entire scene is painted in muted tones of gray, brown, and pale blue. The artwork is contained within a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Forest Landscape with Stags
medium: Oil on panel (cigar box lid, cradled)
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a grassy field with a pond in the center. Three large, leafy trees stand clustered together just behind the water, casting reflections on the surface. In the foreground, one deer lies resting in the grass, while another stands near the edge of the pond on the right side. The sky is filled with grey and blue clouds, suggesting a cloudy day. The overall colors of the scene are muted greens, browns, and earthy tones.

title: Shawl
alt_text: A textile of woven wool shows a large rectangular shawl laid flat on a white table. The center of the shawl is a plain, light cream color. A wide border runs along the edges, filled with intricate, dark-colored patterns that look like large, curving tear-drop shapes. Small accents of deep red are woven into the base of each large tear-drop shape. Fringed edges hang off the bottom of the fabric, and a small black label with the white number 1982.33.1 sits in front of it.

title: The Vine
alt_text: A sculpture of a nude female figure stands on a dark, square base, her body arching backward in a deep curve. She rests on the balls of her feet and balances on a rough, rock-like mound. Her head is tilted back, and her hair flows downward with flowers nestled within it. One arm is raised high to hold a long, slender vine that extends down behind her back. Clumps of flowers are attached to the vine near her hand and at her waist. The entire figure has a dark, smooth, metallic surface.

title: Scarf
alt_text: A textile made of wool showing a detailed, orange patterned fabric. The fabric has large, looping shapes that curve gracefully across the surface. These designs are mostly in shades of muted purple, gold, and light orange, contrasting against the darker orange background. Below the patterned section, a solid orange band of fabric ends in a fringe of loose, shaggy threads. A small black label with white text reading "1982.33.3" sits at the bottom edge.

title: Figures in a Field
canvas_label: This Image was Created for documentation purposes prior to going off site to 300 Prospect- photographed on August 12, 2008
alt_text: A painting of a landscape with trees and an open field. The foreground is made of uneven, grassy earth in shades of dark green and brown. On the right, a cluster of tall trees with leafy branches grows on a hillside. To the left, a dark band of low bushes stretches across the middle ground. The background shows a wide, flat valley fading into the distance under a large, cloudy sky. A small, faint spot of red sits in the grass near the lower center of the scene.

title: Portrait of General George Washington
alt_text: A painting on board shows a portrait of a man wearing a military-style uniform. He is positioned in the center, looking forward with a neutral expression, and is set against a dark, oval background. His uniform includes a dark blue coat with gold trim and epaulets over a light-colored vest and cravat. The portrait is housed in an ornate, rectangular gold frame featuring intricate, carved leaf patterns along the edges. Faint, dark text curves along the upper and lower edges of the oval within the painting. A white paper tag with the number "1984.329" sits at the top of the frame.

title: Vedette in Hamburg
alt_text: A painting of a harbor filled with several boats on a cloudy day. In the lower right corner, the reddish-orange bow of a boat prominently extends into the frame, flying a small tricolor flag from a pole. To the left of center, a green boat with a black smokestack moves across the choppy, brownish water, leaving a small wake. Further back, several other ships and steam-powered vessels are scattered across the water under a gray sky. Faint outlines of large buildings and masts are visible along the distant horizon line.

title: Timothy Dwight (or Theodore Dwight?)
alt_text: A painting of a man facing forward, seen from the chest up. The man has a bald, pale head and thin hair on the sides. He wears round, thin-rimmed eyeglasses that rest on the bridge of his nose. He is dressed in a dark coat with a high, stiff collar and a white cravat or neckcloth underneath. The background is a simple, dark, brownish tone that fades into shadow.

title: The Artist's Garden in Giverny
alt_text: A painting of a garden path surrounded by many tall purple flowers and green plants. Several slender tree trunks rise up into the foliage, stretching from the ground toward the top of the scene. The path itself is a narrow, light brown strip that winds toward the back of the garden. Patches of bright green grass and darker leafy bushes fill the spaces between the flowers. Soft, loose brushstrokes give the entire garden a textured and colorful appearance.

title: A Seated Peasant Woman
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in profile against a background of green grass. She wears a long-sleeved, blue-green dress and a checkered red-and-white headscarf. Her head is bowed, and she looks downward with a neutral expression. Her hands are clasped together loosely in front of her lap. The artist uses small, visible brushstrokes of color throughout the entire scene.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a sunlit forest scene is enclosed in an ornate, gold-colored frame. The landscape shows a hillside covered in lush green and yellow trees under a clear, bright blue sky. On the right side, there are rocky patches visible near the base of the trees. The brushstrokes appear soft and blended throughout the foliage. A small, rectangular plaque with text is centered on the bottom edge of the frame.

title: The Tuileries Gardens, Paris
alt_text: A painting of two women sitting outdoors in a park or garden. The woman on the left wears a dark green coat and a matching green hat, while looking downward. Beside her, a woman in a dark top holds a small, white dog. A horizontal railing runs across the front of the scene, separating the women from a dense background of green trees and yellow shrubs. In the far distance, a large, light-colored building with red-and-white striped window shutters stands behind the trees. Other blurred figures walk in the background beyond a low, green fence.

title: L’aiguillée (The Thread)
alt_text: A painting of two women sitting at a table inside a room. On the right, a woman in a dark dress faces away from the viewer toward a window, her hand raised near the glass. Next to her, another woman sits in profile, wearing a lighter patterned dress and looking down at the table. The wall behind them is covered in a dense, multi-colored floral pattern, contrasting with a tall, light-colored window frame. A wooden chair back is visible in the lower left corner, while white fabric and small items clutter the table surface.

title: '64 Valiant
alt_text: A painting of a restaurant storefront featuring a white car parked in front. The building has a prominent green and white striped awning and a sign that says "FRIED CHICKEN" in red letters. A light-colored sedan sits in the foreground, facing slightly away from the viewer. To the right, another car with a dark top is partially visible in the parking lot. The ground in the parking area is a light, flat color with a few shadows stretching across it. Large windows on the building reveal a glimpse of the dark interior.

title: Munchener Bote
alt_text: A painting of a still life on a wooden table. On the left side of the table, two pale root vegetables with green stems lie next to a tall glass filled with red liquid. Behind these, a dark green book sits stacked on top of other books. To the right, a rounded loaf of bread rests on a folded newspaper with printed text. A speckled ceramic pitcher with a handle stands behind the bread, and a small smoking pipe lies on the edge of the paper nearby.

title: The Smugglers
alt_text: A painting of a dark, moonlit coastal scene with heavy texture throughout. On the left, a tall sailing ship stands as a dark silhouette against the dimly lit sky. To the right, a large, looming rock formation takes up much of the foreground. At the base of this rock, a small figure is riding a light-colored horse. The entire scene is washed in gloomy, murky greens and browns, creating a moody atmosphere.

title: Basin for an Ewer
alt_text: A ceramic plate made of tin-glazed earthenware shows a portrait within a central round medallion. This circular image features the side profile of a woman with long hair wearing an amber-colored garment against a blue background. Surrounding the center are sections radiating outward that alternate between scales and leafy plant designs in blue, yellow, and white. The very outer edge of the plate is bordered by a repeating pattern of small blue and white diamonds. The overall color scheme of the dish is a blend of earthy ochre, warm yellow, and bright blue.

title: Essex Harbor Series, Untitled #22
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes set against a large, solid yellow background. Two large, pale blue rectangles occupy the top section of the image, one on the left and one on the right. Below the blue rectangles, two thin, vertical blue lines stand near the bottom left corner. A small, triangular orange shape sits right next to the left vertical line. Along the very bottom edge, there is a small, dark shape with hints of pink and grey.

title: Essex Harbor Series, Untitled #34
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and colorful blocks on a light pink background. Wide bands of pale blue run horizontally across the top and bottom of the canvas. On the left side, tall rectangles of deep blue and muted orange create a vertical border. A large, curved yellow shape sits in the upper right corner, while a smaller, geometric teal square rests near the lower middle. The overall surface is made of loose, visible brushstrokes in shades of pink, tan, and soft red.

title: Reliquary Bust of Young Martyr
alt_text: A polychromed wood sculpture of a person's head and upper chest is set against a plain gray background. The figure has curly brown hair and a light-colored, painted face with a gentle smile. Around the neck and shoulders, the sculpture is painted a deep reddish-orange color. Three open, clover-shaped holes are cut directly into the chest area of the piece. The base of the sculpture forms a rounded shape, suggesting it is meant to sit flat on a surface.

title: Ada with Wild Flowers
alt_text: A painting shows a close-up portrait of a woman looking directly ahead. Her face is pale and framed by dark brown hair that falls past her shoulders. A vibrant cluster of yellow, white, and purple flowers fills the bottom portion of the image, obscuring her chest and neck. One tall, thin stalk with small blue blossoms crosses over the right side of her face. The background is a flat, warm yellow color.

title: Two Boys with a Basket of Fruit
alt_text: A sculpture of two young children made from painted clay showing them with a large bowl of fruit. The child on the left stands with one arm raised while holding a piece of fruit. The child on the right sits on a low base and eats from a full basket of grapes and other fruit. Between the children sits a bowl piled high with various fruits, and more pieces of fruit lie on the ground below. The entire sculpture is finished in warm, earthy brown and tan tones.

title: Teatro IX
medium: Bronze, mottled dark green and light green patina
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a rectangular, shallow tray-like object with a dark green, mottled surface. A smooth, round sphere sits on the left side of the base. On the right side, a single, fluted column stands upright. The entire piece rests on a light-colored wooden rectangular base. A rectangular white tag with handwritten numbers hangs from the base of the column.

title: Love of Four Horses
alt_text: A painting of several human figures and abstract mechanical shapes set against a dark background. In the top left, a woman stands near a circular dial labeled with words, while another naked woman stands near a curved, blue metallic structure in the center. To the right, a third person sits near a round sign that says "RELAIS SUPER," and a large, dark horse shape appears on the far right. The foreground is dominated by a large, blue, machine-like object with two green, grid-patterned circular shapes that resemble eyes. The entire scene is set on a dark, tiled surface, with various smaller items like a scale and abstract symbols scattered throughout the composition.

title: The Adoration of the Sheperds
alt_text: A painting of a group of people and animals gathered around an infant lying in a stone manger. In the center, a woman in a blue robe sits beside the baby, while a bearded man kneels to her left. Several other figures crouch and stand around them, looking down at the child with expressions of curiosity and wonder. An ox stands near the center of the scene, and a small lamb sits on the ground in the lower right corner. The figures are positioned inside a dark, crumbling structure with tall stone columns, while a small, winged being flies in the upper left sky.

title: He Swallowed the Chain
medium: Oil on plastic, canvas, string, and bamboo
alt_text: A painting of oil on plastic, canvas, string, and bamboo hangs on a wall above a floor-based structure. The upper part is a square, open frame made of various materials, including a smooth, painted top and bottom border with pink, white, and grey streaks. Long strings are stretched from the sides of this frame to a central point, where they are knotted together. A thin, upright bamboo pole stands on a small circular base on the floor below the frame. This pole is decorated with black bands at even intervals along its length. The entire display is set against a plain, light grey wall.

title: Venice
alt_text: A painting of several boats on a calm body of water with a city skyline in the distance. The largest boat on the left features a prominent white sail decorated with a faint red pattern. In the background, a hazy city includes a tall, thin tower and long buildings that stretch along the shoreline. The sky above is filled with soft, cloudy light that blends into the misty horizon. Smaller boats carrying figures are scattered across the foreground and middle ground of the water.

title: Jonathan Brace (1810–1877)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature showing a portrait of a man sitting in a red chair. He has dark hair, blue eyes, and small, thin-framed glasses resting on his nose. The man wears a dark coat over a white shirt with a high collar. He holds a rectangular book in his left hand, which rests on his lap. The portrait is framed in a plain gold border inside a small, red velvet case.

title: Coupe et cristal
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a smooth, bowl-shaped vessel sits against a dark gray background. The object is rounded like a hemisphere, with its hollow interior facing mostly forward and slightly upward. Inside the center of this smooth basin rests a smaller, multi-faceted form with sharp, geometric edges. This smaller object has a crystalline, angular appearance that contrasts with the curved bowl. The entire piece is a uniform, matte white color.

title: Gentleman
medium: Watercolor over graphite pencil on ivory
alt_text: A miniature watercolor shows a portrait of a man with light brown hair worn in a center part. The man faces forward, wearing wire-rimmed glasses and a dark coat with a high collar over a white shirt. He has a pale complexion, light eyes, and a neutral expression. The portrait is framed in an oval shape, surrounded by a thick, dark purple, velvet-like border. A thin, light-colored trim separates the portrait from the purple frame.

title: Phoenix
alt_text: A painting of several people in a landscape with a large white bird shape at the top. The central figure is a person wearing a dark blue shirt and a pink headband, holding an orange bowl filled with light green contents. To the left of the center, a smaller figure is doing a handstand, while another person stands nearby holding a brown mug. To the right of the center, a woman in a long teal dress holds a red flag. In the background, there is a large, hazy orange area that looks like a field of tall grass or flames. Green plants grow along the bottom edge of the scene against a soft, muted green background.

title: Metamorphosis
alt_text: A painting showing a creature that is half-person and half-animal standing in a landscape. The figure has the four legs and head of a deer-like animal but also features human arms and a human face. It stands on a patch of light-colored, patterned ground next to a flowing blue river. Tall, thin trees with sparse green leaves grow directly out of the creature's back. In the background, soft, rounded hills rise against a pale blue sky.

title: Table Piece CII
alt_text: A sculpture of painted stainless steel shows a cluster of bright orange geometric shapes balanced on a dark gray pedestal. These shapes consist of flat, thin squares and rectangles that seem to drift or pile up together. One small, zig-zagging line hangs off the left side of the main arrangement. The arrangement looks chaotic, with some pieces standing upright and others laying flat. The entire sculpture sits on a solid, rectangular block against a plain light gray background.

title: The Lost Whale (in the manner of Ryder)
alt_text: A painting of a dark, moody landscape is encased in a thick, ornate gold frame. The scene features a flat, open plain stretching toward a distant, low horizon. Swirling, shadowy clouds fill the upper portion of the sky in shades of murky brown and black. The ground below is textured with patches of deep shadow and faint, golden highlights that suggest tall grass or uneven terrain. This small, rectangular work is dark overall, making it difficult to distinguish specific details.

title: Corn Festival
alt_text: A painting shows a fantastical, dark-toned scene framed in ornate gold. In the center, a small, glowing figure stands inside a soft, cloud-like shape near the top. Below this, a large, rounded mound covered in tiny, star-like dots sits in the middle of the composition. Two tall, white, cloud-like forms rise up on either side of the mound. Decorative, twisting plant-like vines with small flowers frame the sides of the entire dark background. The whole scene is enclosed by a wide, patterned green border inside the heavy gold frame.

title: Valence with Grey Cloud
alt_text: A painting of a vast, cloudy sky stretching across a landscape. The upper section of the sky is dominated by a large, dark, grayish-blue cloud formation that fills most of the frame. Below these clouds, a horizontal band of soft, peach-colored light glows along the horizon. A thin, dark, indistinct line of land or trees sits quietly at the very bottom of the scene. The entire image is bordered by what looks like light-colored masking tape or a frame that bleeds slightly into the surrounding edges.

title: View of Saint-Ouen-l'Aumône
alt_text: A painting showing a wide, outdoor landscape with a town nestled in the distance. Two figures in dark clothing stand on a dirt path in the lower left, looking out over the scene. In the foreground, a grassy hill slopes downward, dotted with a few leafy trees. The middle ground features a small town with rooftops, buildings, and a bridge crossing a river. A cloudy, blue sky stretches across the top of the canvas, filled with light brushstrokes of white and peach. The entire scene is rendered with many small, distinct dabs of bright and earthy paint colors.

title: Portrait of Man Facing Left
alt_text: A painting of a man is displayed inside a large, ornate gold frame. The painting shows a man in profile, looking down at something held in his hands. He wears a dark brown jacket and has a short beard. The background is a very dark, indistinct shadow. The man's face and hands are lit from above, which draws attention to his focused expression.

title: Woman Giving Birth
alt_text: A steel sculpture showing a flat, stylized figure of a person. The figure has a large, pointed head with hollow spaces for eyes and a mouth. Its arms hang down at its sides, and its legs are spread wide apart as if in a squatting position. Between its legs, a smaller, upside-down figure hangs down toward the bottom. The entire object has a dark, metallic brown surface with lighter, shiny spots on the chest area.

title: Portrait of Man
alt_text: A painting of a man's head and shoulders is set inside a heavy, ornate gold frame. The man faces slightly to the right with short brown hair and a pointed beard. He wears a dark, high-collared garment with a wide, white collar that lays flat against his neck. The painting uses a dark, muted background that contrasts with his lighter face and white collar. The frame surrounding the small portrait is wide, textured with vertical lines, and has a metallic gold finish with visible wear.

title: Head of Diego
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a person's head and shoulders stands against a plain background. The figure has a very thin, long neck and a narrow, elongated face. The surface of the metal is rough and uneven, with many small ridges and indentations. The head is bald and sits centered above wide, sloped shoulders. Dark tones highlight the textured details of the face and clothing.

title: Seated Woman II
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an upright form with a textured, dark surface. The base is a thick, blocky shape with jagged, rough carvings covering its sides. A vertical piece rises from the center of this base, extending upwards and tapering to a point. A sharp, horizontal spike sticks out to the right from this central column. Two small white paper tags hang from the object on thin strings.

title: Virgin with Penitent Angels
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a standing figure with smaller carved faces at its base. The tall, brown, dark-toned wood carving features a main figure with its hands clasped near its chest. The head of the figure is rounded at the top, showing carved hair or a textured surface that extends down the sides of the head. Below the main figure, two distinct faces are carved directly into the lower portion of the wooden column. A small white paper label with a barcode is attached to the figure's neck area with a piece of white string.

title: Sheen of Order
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured layers of color. The background is a solid, dull brown that occupies the bottom and right side of the canvas. Above this, a thick layer of gritty, sand-like material in shades of orange, green, and yellow stretches across the top half of the piece. Flecks of blue and grey paint are scattered along the border between the solid brown and the textured section. These colorful spots blend into the sandy surface in an uneven, hazy pattern. The overall effect creates a sense of depth and rough, layered texture.

A painting shows a series of dark rectangular shapes arranged on a tall, vertical surface. The work is composed of shades of black and deep navy blue. A large, darker band runs across the middle of the frame. Two distinct rectangular forms in a slightly lighter blue tone sit within the upper and center sections. Fainter, horizontal rectangular blocks are visible near the bottom of the canvas. The entire image has a muted, uniform appearance.

title: Portrait of Mme Antenor Firmin
alt_text: A painting of a woman with gray hair, shown from the chest up against a light blue background. She has brown skin and dark eyes, and her hair is styled in a high bun. She is wearing a high-necked, magenta-colored blouse with black detailing around the chest. A long, thin gold necklace hangs down from her neck, featuring a small, oval-shaped pendant at the center. Text is written on the left side of the painting, and a small white rectangle with handwriting on it is attached near her right arm.

title: Ushas (Dawn)
alt_text: A stone sculpture of a face shows a mask with closed eyes and a calm, straight mouth. The stone has a speckled grey color and appears rough and granular, like granite. The face has a rounded, oval shape that narrows toward the chin. A white paper tag is tied to the top of the forehead with a thin string. The mask sits on a dark shelf, and a small identification number is visible in the bottom corner of the frame.

title: Self-Portrait in Sombrero
alt_text: A painting shows a large, central figure of a man wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat and blue patched trousers. The man's clothing acts as a border for several smaller scenes depicting outdoor life, groups of people, and landscapes. On the left side of the composition, there are panels showing people sitting at tables, working in fields with donkeys, and walking in a rural village. The right side features scenes of swimmers in a pool, a girl standing alone, a town with a church, and a nighttime landscape. Above the man, the sky transitions from a starry night on the left to a bright, golden sun on the right. Below the man's bare feet, a glowing, light-filled circle sits at the bottom of the painting.

title: Tondo
medium: Oil and spray paint on canvas
alt_text: A painting shows abstract shapes swirling inside a circular frame. Dark, thick, black curved lines dominate the center, spiraling outward. Beneath these dark lines, layers of gold, brown, and grey paint create a sense of depth and movement. A small splash of red appears in the middle right, contrasting with the muted colors. The painting is encased in a thin silver-colored border against a plain grey background.

title: Favela: Bordello
alt_text: A painting of a colorful, busy village scene shown from an elevated perspective. Small, brightly colored houses with red roofs climb a hillside in the background, while a grassy field in the foreground serves as a playground. Many people are scattered throughout the scene, with some standing in doorways or windows of the houses, and a large group playing on the green field. The figures are simplified in style, wearing solid-colored clothing against a landscape of tan hills and light green ground. Bare trees with detailed, thin branches are sprinkled throughout the landscape.

title: ANUI
alt_text: A painting shows a composition made of three distinct geometric shapes defined by thick black lines. A large, dark purple triangle occupies the upper right portion of the canvas. Below this, a large, teal triangle fills the left side of the image. A smaller, lime-green triangle sits in the bottom right corner. The three colors meet at distinct angles, creating a sharp, abstract pattern across the rectangular canvas.

title: Building the House
alt_text: A painting shows a large group of people wearing colorful, patterned clothing standing near a stone building with a yellow straw roof. Many of the people are holding tall, slender wooden poles that lean at different angles across the scene. The individuals wear various hats in shades of blue, green, and brown, along with shawls or ponchos featuring striped and geometric designs. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a large rectangular block of printed text. The figures are set against a plain, off-white background.

title: Bather on the Sand
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting outdoors in a lounge chair. The figure is shown from the chest up, with dark hair and a peach-colored face, wearing a bright blue top. Their body is angled toward the right side of the canvas where their knees and legs are visible in a bent position. Behind them is a dark blue sky or sea, while a patch of yellow sand appears on the left side. The entire image uses loose, thick brushstrokes and bold colors to create the scene.

title: The Sinking Titanic
alt_text: A painting on glass shows a large ship sinking in dark, icy waters. The ship is angled sharply downward, with its stern rising into the air and several smokestacks visible along its deck. Large, jagged white icebergs loom behind and around the sinking vessel, reflecting light against a deep black background. The surface of the water is turbulent and dark, contrasting with the bright, shiny texture of the ice. A faint, glowing moon or light source is positioned near the top center of the scene.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a collage on canvas shows an abstract composition filled with overlapping shapes. Large, rounded, tan and cream-colored forms dominate the center of the artwork. These shapes are set against a textured, light gray and white background. Thin, dark, uneven lines outline many of the overlapping sections. The overall effect is like a collection of puzzle pieces fitted together on a rough, weathered surface.

title: 21 Aout 1957
alt_text: A painting showing a composition of thick, rectangular black forms set against a pale blue background. These dark shapes are arranged horizontally in layers, with some overlapping others. Several of the black sections have drips or streaks that run vertically downward. Glimpses of the light blue surface appear between these dark blocks and near the edges of the frame. The entire work is enclosed within a thin, simple metallic frame.

title: Mist
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes floating against a blurry, muted background. The background is a soft blend of blue, purple, and gray tones. In the upper left, a pale, glowing oval shape is surrounded by delicate, thin lines that look like tendrils. Towards the bottom center, a tall, dark brown form rises vertically with triangular cutouts along its right side. A single, long, wavy line descends from near the top right, twisting down towards the bottom of the canvas.

title: Red and Green
alt_text: A painting shows two distinct shapes against a plain white background. At the top sits a large, circular form with a dark red center, surrounded by a ring of green that fades into white. Below this, a chaotic, splash-like shape in black dominates the lower half of the canvas. This black shape has sharp, uneven edges with thin black drips extending outward into a gray, smoky area. A small, bright blue rectangle sits in the lower right corner, isolated from the other forms.

title: Ransforms
alt_text: A painting made of collage on canvas shows a crowded arrangement of irregular paper shapes. The shapes are black, white, and various shades of dark brown. There are also a few areas with mustard yellow colors scattered throughout the composition. These pieces overlap to fill the frame without any empty background spaces. The shapes have jagged, torn edges and appear flat against the surface. This creates a dense and jumbled pattern across the entire canvas.

title: Small White Tondo
alt_text: A painting shows a circular board divided into several geometric shapes by thin, dark lines. The entire surface is painted in a light, neutral gray color. These straight lines cut through the circle, creating a pattern of squares and rectangles of different sizes clustered toward the right side. The background behind the circular painting appears to be a metal storage rack with many rectangular slots. A small white label with the text "1984.75.18" is attached to the bottom center of the painting.

title: Positano #1
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured shapes in muted colors fills the frame. The upper portion is dominated by layers of dark grey and earthy brown paint. Below this, a large, lighter band of pale green and white stretches horizontally across the center. The lower corners contain darker, triangular forms in deep brown and black. Thick brushstrokes and visible texture give the entire surface a rugged and uneven appearance.

title: Female Head (Angelica Archipenko)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a stylized human head and neck stands against a dark grey background. The object is a smooth, elongated shape with a dark green, metallic finish. A faint, arched line runs across the forehead, suggesting a headband or hair. Beneath the head, a thin, rectangular neck widens slightly at the shoulders. This piece rests on top of a plain, solid black cubic base.

title: Lointain
alt_text: A painting of thick, messy oil strokes covers the canvas in a mix of bright and dark colors. Deep blue swirls dominate the left-center of the composition. Strips of red and orange paint run diagonally across the lower section, standing out against the surrounding cool tones. White and light purple highlights add texture to the right side and top. The thick application of paint creates a rough, layered surface across the entire work.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and bold, thick brushstrokes fills the rectangular frame. Deep shades of blue and purple sit at the center of the canvas, surrounded by darker olive-green tones. The paint appears textured, with raised areas showing the artist's heavy hand. Much of the background consists of lighter, washed-out tones of white, beige, and pale gray that contrast with the darker cluster. Small, sketchy lines in lighter colors are visible near the top and bottom edges of the composition.

title: Still Life
medium: Oil on canvas, mounted on cardboard
alt_text: A painting showing several abstract, bowl-like shapes and bottles against a muted, light-gray background. On the left side, a large, dark blue base supports a pale, rounded container that looks like a bowl or a dish. A slender, dark blue bottle stands near the center of the canvas, topped with a small, circular lid. To the right, a stack of white, swirled forms creates a taller, tower-like structure with bright blue lines curving across its surface. Streaks of brown paint fill the spaces between the objects, adding texture to the overall scene.

title: Plug
alt_text: A painting of a small, metallic machine part resting on a flat, brownish surface. The object is gray and stands upright, shaped like a wide cylinder at the base topped by a narrower cylinder with a pointed tip. Two silver-colored screws project horizontally from the sides of the middle section. The background is a textured, dark reddish-brown color with faint, cloudy blue marks. The lighting is soft and casts a slight shadow beneath the object.

title: Pask
alt_text: A painting of an abstract scene features large areas of dark color against bright, bold shapes. A prominent patch of yellow paint sits in the upper-left corner, transitioning into white and grey tones. A deep, solid black section dominates the right and middle portions of the canvas. A vertical band of blue runs along the right side, accompanied by a thin, jagged yellow line. Near the bottom, a splash of bright pink adds a final, distinct area of color.

title: East Hampton I
medium: Oil on paper mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured brushstrokes in a vertical frame. Thick swipes of white, gray, and blue paint dominate the upper and center sections. Below them, bright yellow and vibrant green patches fill the bottom area. Long, curving lines of dark blue and red create movement across the composition. The colors are layered, creating a sense of depth and rough, messy texture throughout the canvas.

title: The Oarsmen (The Schreiber Brothers)
alt_text: A painting of two rowers in a long, thin red boat on a river. The rowers wear white shirts, dark pants, and bright pink caps while holding yellow oars. They are paddling past a large, dark stone wall that rises from the water on the right side of the frame. In the background on the left, a line of green trees stands against a light, hazy sky. Another small, dark boat with indistinct figures sits in the shadows near the wall. The water is calm and reflects the light from above.

title: The One-Eyed Poet
alt_text: A wood sculpture of a stylized figure captured in a running pose. The figure is made of thin, angular, dark brown pieces that represent limbs and a torso. At the top of the sculpture, two small circular shapes suggest heads. The entire figure stands on a rectangular wooden base that features a grid of letters. The words "THE ONE-EYED POET" are visible in light-colored lettering on the base surface. The background is a plain, solid grey color.

title: Vase, Gourd, and Fruit on a Table
alt_text: A painting of a still life set on a brown tabletop. In the center sits a tall, pale vase surrounded by a dark brown cloth. To the right of the vase, a large, green, pear-shaped object rests on a piece of vibrant teal fabric. This fabric drapes across the table and covers several smaller, dark-colored, triangular fruits. In the background, large, leafy green shapes lean against a wall, completing the composition.

title: Boy with Melons
alt_text: A painting of a person wearing a yellow hat and sitting at a table with several slices of watermelon. The person, positioned in the center, holds a bright red slice of watermelon with both hands. Their face is segmented into dark, angular shapes, and they wear a plain gray shirt. Three other slices of watermelon rest on the reddish-brown tabletop below. The background is a muted brown color with a repeating pattern of dark, oval-shaped marks.

title: Parau Parau (Whispered Words)
alt_text: A painting of people gathering outdoors in a landscape with reddish ground. In the foreground on the left, a woman stands facing forward, wearing a dark blue patterned skirt and no top. Behind her to the right, another person stands wearing a bright red cloth. A small group of people sits together on the ground underneath the shade of a large, dark green tree in the center. To the left, a simple wooden structure with a sloped roof sits among trees. The scene is filled with lush greenery, trees, and patches of bright pinkish-red earth.

title: The False Start
alt_text: A painting shows a horse race taking place in front of a large, open-air grandstand. In the foreground, a dark horse runs toward the left with a rider wearing a dark jacket. A second horse, ridden by someone in a yellow jacket, is positioned slightly behind and to the right of the first. In the background, many people sit in a tiered wooden viewing area protected by a roof. A man wearing light-colored clothes and a red sash stands on the grass to the right of the track. Trees fill the background behind the stands, and the sky above is filled with soft, light clouds.

title: Haystack
alt_text: A painting of swirling abstract shapes and colors creates a textured, clouded appearance across the entire surface. Deep shades of blue, dark grey, and black mix together in the center and lower areas. Bright pink splashes and specks stand out, particularly on the right side and near the top. Patches of white paint appear on the left and upper areas, resembling light reflecting on a surface. The colors blend into one another with soft, blurry edges throughout the composition.

title: Torments of Hell
alt_text: A painting of a chaotic scene filled with dark shadows and bright flickers of fire. The landscape is rocky and uneven, with many nude figures clambering over the terrain and lying in piles. On the right, a bright, glowing area illuminates a body of water tucked between tall, jagged cliffs. Towards the bottom right corner, a smaller group of people in detailed clothing walks together away from the main chaos. The entire background is filled with smoke, orange flames, and tiny winged creatures flying through the dark sky.

title: reverse copy of Durer's Nativity engraving
alt_text: A painting of a scene features a tall, narrow, ornate gold frame. The frame has intricate carvings, including a decorative arch at the top. Inside the frame, the painting depicts a rustic house with exposed timber beams on the right side. To the left, there is a round stone well with a small roof structure. A few small figures in simple clothing are visible near the base of the house and the well. In the background, a leafy tree stands near a stone building under a pale, muted sky.

title: Abstraction
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes set against a solid, light green background. Several large, overlapping geometric forms stretch diagonally across the center of the canvas. These shapes include long, thin rectangles in shades of deep teal and lime green, which cross each other to form a large "X" shape. Scattered around these lines are multiple circles in varying sizes, including some with smaller concentric rings inside them. Near the bottom left and bottom right corners, there are smaller, complex clusters of intersecting straight lines and rectangular blocks.

title: Doric Diamond
alt_text: A painting of a square geometric design is set inside a white frame and hung on point to look like a diamond. The surface is covered in a grid of rectangles and squares of varying sizes. These shapes are filled with a repeating pattern of white, light gray, blue, red, and yellow colors. Thick, solid horizontal and vertical lines divide the different color blocks. The entire composition has a flat, clean appearance with no shading or texture.

title: Given #1
alt_text: A sculpture of etched glass, steel, and wire shows a square, semi-transparent pane with a muted greenish-gray tone. The surface has a rough, brush-stroked texture and is divided into slightly different shades. Two thin, dark vertical wires hang from the top edge and extend partway down the face of the glass. The left section of the glass appears slightly lighter and more translucent than the darker right side. These elements sit against a plain white background, casting a soft shadow beneath the lower edge.

title: The Banks of the Seine River in Paris
alt_text: A painting of a river scene is filled with small dots of color that create a hazy, misty appearance. On the left side, tall buildings with sharp rooflines stand near the water's edge. A long, flat bridge stretches horizontally across the middle of the frame, supported by several thin vertical pillars. Below the bridge, the dark shapes of a few small boats float on the rippling water. The entire scene is washed in soft, light tones of pink, blue, and gray that blur the details together.

title: Marine Effet du Soir (Harbor Scene)
alt_text: A painting of a coastal landscape under a bright, cloudy sky. In the foreground, a brown dirt path leads toward a calm body of water. Rough, grey stone walls line the sides of the path and the edges of the water. On the left, a small grove of green trees stands against the horizon. Across the water, a distant shoreline shows low buildings under a expansive blue sky filled with white clouds.

title: The Matrat Boatyard, Moret-Sur-Loing, Rainy Weather
alt_text: A painting shows a calm, light-filled landscape scene next to a river. On the left, tall green trees stand near a grassy bank where a small figure in dark clothing works. Several small, simple wooden boats are moored along the water's edge, partially reflecting in the surface. In the distance, a cluster of buildings including a church with a spire appears among more trees. The sky above is soft, hazy, and filled with pale blue and white colors. The overall scene feels quiet and peaceful with a focus on the natural environment.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a crowned woman holding a young child. The woman stands tall and wears a long, flowing garment that is decorated with patches of blue paint and gold leaf. A veil falls from beneath her crown, framing her face and draping over her shoulders. She holds the small child in her left arm, and the child reaches toward her with one hand. The entire figure shows signs of age, with worn spots and chipped paint throughout the fabric and details.

title: Architectural Fragment with Animal and Floral Ornament
alt_text: An architectural element made of marble shows a carved, horizontal block with intricate designs. The top part is a flat, rectangular border that runs across the entire length. Below this, the stone is carved into detailed, leafy patterns and rounded shapes that look like stylized fruit or buds. On the far left, two circular, hollow forms resemble eyes or wide openings set deep into the stone. The marble has a light, off-white color and appears aged with some rough patches. The entire piece sits on a plain, light-colored surface against a neutral background.

title: An Allegory of Modesty
alt_text: A wood sculpture showing a seated woman wearing a long red dress. The figure sits on a plain, dark wooden bench and looks slightly toward her left. Her dress is gathered at the waist with a gold band and has a wide, golden neckline. Her arms are raised and bent, with her hands open as if she is holding something invisible or gesturing. The wood is painted in colors, and she wears simple gold-colored sandals on her feet.

title: Dame Edith Sitwell
alt_text: A sculpture of a human head shows a face made from a translucent, brownish-yellow material. This waxy face is set in profile, showing closed eyes and a prominent nose. The back of the head consists of a dark wire mesh structure that forms the shape of a skull. This metal cage connects the back of the head to a simple, flat base. The entire object rests on a light-colored wooden block.

title: Lake George
alt_text: A painting of a calm lake surrounded by mountains at sunset. The sky is filled with glowing pink and orange clouds that reflect on the still water. On the left and in the middle of the water, several small, tree-covered islands feature bright autumn leaves. Along the shore in the bottom right corner, two small figures stand near a rowboat pulled up on the sandy beach. A large, sloped mountain with rocky patches rises steeply on the right side of the frame.

title: Old Woman with a Brazier
alt_text: A painting of a person wearing a dark fur hat and a warm coat. They have a white cloth wrapped around their neck and look directly forward with a serious expression. Their hands are busy, holding a small metal bowl filled with food or objects. The person sits against a dark, textured background that looks like a brick wall. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, simple wooden frame.

title: Unit #50, Elliptical Prelude and Chalice, from the First Table Model Clavilux (Luminar) series
medium: Metal, fabric, glass, and electrical and lighting elements on a maple table
alt_text: A sculpture showing a lamp placed on a wooden table. The lamp has a cylindrical brown fabric shade with silver metal edges at the top and bottom. Beneath the shade, a white, tiered glass base connects the light to the table surface. The wooden table is brown with a rounded top and four carved, spindle-style legs that end in rounded feet. A long, rectangular, dark brown box sits on a lower shelf between the table legs.

title: Abstract, Op. 91 (The Firebird)
medium: Metal, glass, gel filters, electrical and lighting elements, and a frosted-glass screen in a wood cabinet
alt_text: A sculpture of metal, glass, and wood shows a rectangular light box sitting on a tall, white pedestal. The light box features a large, rectangular frame that surrounds a smooth, frosted-glass screen. The cabinet holding the screen is dark wood, which contrasts with the light, matte-finish of the pedestal beneath it. The overall structure is symmetrical and clean-lined, standing against a neutral, grey background. A small, rectangular label is centered on the bottom edge of the wooden cabinet.

title: Tranquil Study, Op. 92
medium: Metal, glass, gel filters, electrical and lighting elements, and a frosted-glass screen in a wood cabinet
alt_text: A sculpture of a tall, rectangular light box rests on a plain white pedestal. The light box has a dark wooden frame with a glowing, frosted-glass screen on its front. A thin metal border surrounds the screen. At the very top of the box, a thin brown strip extends across the width. The entire object sits against a dark, neutral background that fades to light grey at the bottom.

title: Design # 1
alt_text: A tapestry showing an abstract pattern hangs on a gray, concrete wall above a hallway. The tapestry is rectangular and features a series of bright orange, blocky shapes arranged in the center. These orange shapes are outlined by a dark, textured border that separates them from the muted gray background. Below the artwork, a hallway extends into the distance between two smooth, light gray walls. The scene is brightly lit from above, casting soft light onto the textured surface of the tapestry.

title: Design # 2
alt_text: A textile tapestry shows a rug with geometric patterns laid flat on a concrete floor. The rug is mostly a light cream color with a thick, textured pile. On the left side, there is a large, dark-gray trapezoid shape decorated with a grid of small, white square dots. In the top right corner, a series of nested rectangular shapes appear in bright blue, orange, yellow, and black. These colored shapes create a focused, target-like pattern against the lighter background of the rug.

title: Design # 3
alt_text: A tapestry of beige fabric hangs flat against a gray concrete wall. The design on the light-colored textile features several dark gray rectangular shapes scattered across its surface. In the center, a dark gray square frame surrounds a small, simple outline of a box drawn in red. To the left of the hanging, two thin white poles extend vertically down the wall. The entire piece is mounted high on the textured wall near a corner.

title: Design # 4
alt_text: A tapestry showing a large, abstract design set against a solid red background. The central shape is an off-white, blocky figure that looks like a maze or a simple map. This shape has a thick, dark-colored outline and is filled with small, colorful squares scattered across its surface. The small squares are various colors, including light blue, pink, dark purple, and yellow. The entire textile is rectangular and lies flat on a light-colored, speckled floor.

title: Design # 5
alt_text: A tapestry shows a square design with four distinct sections set against a background of white rectangular tiles. The top-left and bottom-right sections are dark with small, light-colored rectangles scattered across them. The top-right section contains a large, red-orange triangle pointing downward. The bottom-left section displays a triangle outlined in blue with a bright orange center. The tapestry lays flat on the floor, surrounded by a light-colored, blocky tiled surface.

title: Phenomena Blue Flange
alt_text: A painting shows abstract shapes on a solid, light-colored background. On the left side, a large, vibrant blue curved shape stretches upward, separated from the other elements by a long, thin, dark line. To the right of this line, a larger, darker mass of blue and deep indigo flows down the canvas. This darker form fades from a lighter blue at its edges to a dense, almost black shade near the center. The paint application appears smooth and fluid, creating a sense of soft, layered movement.

title: Hunde im Gebüsch (Dogs in the Bushes)
alt_text: A painting of scattered, fragmented shapes against a deep red background. A thick, pale horizontal band crosses the middle of the canvas, suggesting a log or path. Above this band, the pale, distorted heads of animals appear among jagged green patches of grass. Below the horizontal line, several rough, fleshy shapes that look like limbs or faces are clumped together on the ground. The colors are applied in loose, expressive strokes, with earthy greens, reds, and browns dominating the scene.

title: Still Life with Tin Can and Nuts
alt_text: A painting of various nuts arranged on a dark, reflective surface. To the left, a large pile of whole and cracked hazelnuts lies near a simple, cylindrical metal cup that is filled with more nut pieces. On the right side sits a heavy, dark-colored metal nutcracker with a long handle angled toward the back. Scattered throughout the foreground are broken nutshells and a few exposed nut meats showing light brown and white colors. The background is completely dark, casting soft shadows under the objects.

title: The Liberation of Saint Peter
alt_text: A painting of a winged figure visiting a man in a dark, enclosed room. A large, winged figure stands in the center with a soft, glowing light, looking down at an older man. This man is seated on the right, wearing a bright yellow and teal robe with his hands bound by chains. Below them, a person in armor is lying on the floor, appearing to be fast asleep. Metal bars visible in the background suggest they are inside a prison cell. The scene is filled with shadows, making the figures the main focus of the composition.

title: Ifni
alt_text: A painting of various colored rectangles scattered across a light, textured background. The background is a pale, creamy green color that looks slightly uneven in its application. Several solid, rectangular shapes appear in the center right, including a bright orange block, a light pink block below it, and a smaller yellow patch above. A few smaller, darker greenish-gray squares sit near the center and the bottom left of the canvas. The painting is framed and shown at a slight angle, with a piece of paper stuck to the frame on the left side.

title: Pompeian XII Frieze
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract composition of overlapping geometric shapes. A large, upright rectangle in shades of reddish-orange takes up the center of the canvas. This rectangular shape is lighter and more vibrant at the bottom, fading into a darker, brownish-red tone towards the top. A larger, light brown square surrounds the orange rectangle, acting as a background border. The colors seem to blend softly where the shapes meet, creating a hazy, glowing effect.

title: Untitled (Crab Nebula)
alt_text: A painting showing a rectangular surface covered in a textured, mottled blue layer. A bright, irregular white shape sits near the center, resembling a cloud or a burst of light. Fine, dark cracks spread across the entire blue background, creating a network of lines. The blue color is darker toward the edges and lighter where it meets the white patch. The overall appearance is uneven, with speckles of lighter and darker tones throughout.

title: Portrait of George Eliot and Family
alt_text: A painting of a man, a woman, and a child sitting together for a portrait. The man sits on the left wearing a dark coat, a light-colored vest, and a white necktie while holding a closed book. In the center, a young child with fair hair wears a pale yellowish jacket with a large white collar and rests a hand on the man's knee. The woman sits on the right, dressed in a bright blue dress with ruffled sleeves and a white lace cap on her head. She holds a small, open book in one hand and has a small, decorative pouch hanging from her wrist. Behind them, red curtains drape over bookshelves filled with several old, bound books.

title: Unfinished Portrait of a Lady
alt_text: A painting of a person's head and shoulders stands in the center of a neutral, pale gray canvas. The person has short, light hair and a soft, serious expression on their face. They are wearing a plain, brownish-tan shirt with a simple V-neck collar. A soft, hazy white cloud of paint forms an aura or halo around the person's head and shoulders. At the very bottom center of the canvas, a white label with the black text "1983.104" is visible.

title: Pale Susan
alt_text: A painting of a series of vertical, colorful stripes covering the entire square canvas. The stripes are of varying widths and come in a wide range of colors, including bright red, orange, yellow, green, light blue, dark blue, and white. They run from the top edge of the painting to the bottom edge without interruption. The colors are placed side by side in an irregular pattern across the surface. There are no shapes, figures, or other designs present besides these solid-colored lines.

title: Et in Arcadia Ego
alt_text: A painting of a group of people gathered near a stone building in a dim, stormy landscape. A man wearing a bright red cloth kneels on the ground in the foreground, gesturing toward a skull resting on a stone ledge. Behind him, a bearded man with a long staff reaches out, while another person nearby wears a vivid blue garment. To the right, a tall, slender tree stands against a dark, cloudy sky that includes a pyramid-shaped structure. A small sheep walks on the ground near the kneeling man's feet, and another person rests on the ground further back in the shadows.

title: Allegory of Music
alt_text: A painting shows a woman playing a lute while a younger person stands beside her holding an open book. The woman sits on the right, wearing a pink dress with white lace cuffs and a pearl necklace. She looks down at the wooden, pear-shaped instrument in her lap, touching its strings with her left hand. To her left stands a smaller figure in dark clothing, who holds an open book toward the woman as if reading from it. The background is a simple, dark, and mostly empty wall. The lighting focuses brightly on the woman and the book, leaving the surrounding area in shadow.

title: Untitled
medium: Magna on paper mounted on canvas (stretched like an oil painting)
alt_text: A painting showing three horizontal bands of color on a pale pink background. The top section is a large, square-like block of vibrant magenta paint with soft, blurred edges. Below it sits a thin, narrow horizontal strip of light yellow-orange. At the bottom, a second large, rectangular block of deep reddish-orange paint spans most of the width. The surface of the painting has a thin, textured quality where the background pink is visible through the brushstrokes.

title: Peach
alt_text: A painting shows a single, round fruit nestled in white paper. The fruit is large, smooth, and primarily yellow, with a soft orange blush on its right side. It rests in the center of the image, partially wrapped and surrounded by the crinkled, white paper. The paper has many folds and shadows, giving it a sense of texture. The background is a soft, muted blue that surrounds the paper and fruit.

title: Near Alcalde, New Mexico
alt_text: A painting of a light-colored, stucco building stands against a flat, bright blue sky. The building has thick, smooth walls with rounded edges and a simple rectangular doorway in the center. At the top of the roof sits a small, white triangular shape topped with a thin white cross. The foreground consists of smooth, beige ground that slopes gently in front of the building. To the far left and right, small hints of dark, hilly landscape peek out behind the structure.

title: White Birches
alt_text: A painting of a quiet forest scene centered around a dark, still pool of water. Several tall, slender trees with pale, white-grey trunks rise up from the back edge of the water. Their dense, dark green leaves fill the upper half of the image, creating a thick canopy that hides most of the sky. To the left, a large, dark, broken tree stump leans over the water, appearing burnt or decayed.
