The calm surface of the pool reflects the trees above, making the dark water look like a mirror for the forest.

title: James Dwight Dana (1813-1895) B.A. 1833, M.A. 1836, (after Daniel Huntington; see cat. no. 708)
alt_text: A painting shows a portrait of a man looking toward the right. He has wavy, light brown hair and is wearing a dark coat over a lighter shirt with a dark necktie. Two vertical red stripes appear on the front of his dark outer garment. The background consists of a cloudy, golden-brown sky. The entire image is encased in a simple, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: Little Lolie Prince
alt_text: A painting of a young girl standing in an oval frame. The child has shoulder-length curly hair and wears a bright blue dress with white lace trim at the bottom. To her left sits a table covered with a dusty pink floral cloth, holding a clear glass vase with small pink flowers. In her left hand, the girl holds a long white string that leads down to a small, grey cat on the floor. The background is a dark, solid color, and the floor is covered with a patterned rug featuring floral designs in red and blue.

title: From Afar
alt_text: A painting of a group of four figures sitting and standing in the foreground, with a large, distant crowd behind them. The four figures in the front all appear to have glowing halos around their heads. One figure stands on the left wearing dark clothing, while the three others sit nearby in robes of red, light brown, and blue. In the background, a large crowd of people moves up a hill towards a darker sky. The overall scene uses muted, painted colors and loose, visible brushstrokes.

title: The Dying Gaul
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man sitting on the ground in a resting position. He has a muscular build, short curly hair, and is looking down toward his lap. One arm leans back to support his weight, while his legs are stretched out along the base. A white identification tag hangs from his arm, partly covering his thigh. The base of the sculpture is a rectangular platform with a low-relief design on the surface.

title: Horses and Ruins
alt_text: A painting showing two horses standing on a beach. On the left, a large, reddish-brown horse stands tall, looking toward the right. Next to it stands a slightly smaller, white horse that faces forward. Behind them is a shoreline with blue water on the left and rocky, light-colored ruins on the right. The sky overhead is filled with dark, swirling clouds.

title: Still Life with Flute, Vase and Roman Lamp
alt_text: A painting of a collection of objects arranged on a wooden table. A long, thin flute lies across several old, thick books that are stacked in the center. In front of the books, sheets of music with printed notes drape over the edge of the table. A green cloth hangs down from the right side of the table. Behind the books, there is a tall, metal lamp and a small, blue vase. A quill pen sits upright in a small holder on the right side.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints
alt_text: A painting of a triptych showing figures against a gold background. The central, tallest panel features a woman in a red dress holding a child who is also wearing draped clothing. Two smaller, narrower panels on the sides depict additional figures standing alone. The left panel shows a person in a red tunic and hat holding a staff, while the right panel displays a person in a blue robe holding a shallow bowl. Each panel is enclosed in an ornate, pointed gold frame with carved details along the edges.

title: Othello and Desdemona
alt_text: A painting of a woman sleeping in a dark room. She lies horizontally on a bed, dressed in a light-colored gown. A tall, shadowy figure leans over her from behind, mostly obscured by the deep brown and black shadows of the room. A small, glowing light source sits on the wall behind the figure, casting faint highlights on the scene. The woman holds a small, dark object, perhaps a flower, in her hand while resting on the bed.

title: Jacob Porter (1783-1846), B.A. 1803, M.A. 1806
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a light-skinned man with brown hair. He faces forward, wearing a dark green coat over a white collared shirt and a light-colored cravat. His gaze is directed toward the viewer with a neutral expression. The portrait is housed in an oval red case with visible hinges on the left side. Text is written vertically along the left edge of the painting.

title: Illuminated initials
alt_text: A manuscript page showing four decorated letters painted with egg tempera and gold leaf. On the left side, a large, complex letter is attached to a long vertical design featuring swirls, dots, and vibrant red, blue, and green colors. To the right of that, three separate smaller rectangular pieces are arranged vertically, each containing a single decorative capital letter. These letters are enclosed within square or rectangular frames painted in bold, saturated colors. Thin, straight red lines run horizontally across the background paper behind each letter, suggesting musical staff lines.

title: Abstractions
alt_text: A painting showing a composition of abstract shapes and black fields. A vertical central area features a long, light-colored shape against a dark background. To the left, a large rectangular block of purple and pink vertical streaks sits above a rounded shape containing thin, white linear drawings. On the right side, a solid bright pink rectangular patch floats above a grey, oval shape filled with faint, crossing pink lines. The entire artwork is framed by deep black sections that contrast with the lighter colors.

title: Free, White and 21
alt_text: A video shows a simple title screen against a light, off-white background. The text is written in a plain, typewriter-style black font. The first line of text reads "FREE, WHITE AND 21" centered in the upper middle of the frame. Directly below this, a second line of text reads "By Howardena Pindell". There is a slight hint of a thin, colored border near the edges of the screen.

title: Pedagogue
alt_text: A video still from a VHS tape shows a portrait of a person looking directly at the camera. The person has very short, dark hair, pale skin, and a thin brown mustache. They are wearing a dark, textured leather jacket over a blue denim collared shirt. The background is a plain, light-colored wall with soft lighting. This person appears centered in the frame, from the chest up.

title: Video Against AIDS
alt_text: A VHS videocassette shows a brightly colored cover design on a black background. The cover is mostly yellow and red with bold, dark text reading "VIDEO AGAINST AIDS" and a large, red triangle containing the number "1." To the right of the title, a partial image of a person’s face appears in a reddish tone, while a small, rectangular black-and-white photograph of a person speaking is placed toward the bottom right. The label also includes abstract dark shapes and smaller, less distinct lettering scattered across the lower half. Beneath the cassette, a gray strip with technical color swatches and patterns sits against the black backdrop.

title: West Point Foundry, Cold Spring, New York (Rabbit)
medium: Oil on canvas, mounted on board
alt_text: A painting of a dim, cluttered workshop filled with shadows and industrial equipment. A glowing orange light emanates from a furnace or fire set into the brick wall on the left side. To the right of the fire, a large, dark metal bucket or vat hangs suspended in the air. The foreground is filled with debris, scattered wooden planks, and various unrecognizable metal parts. The overall color palette is dominated by deep browns, blacks, and dark grays, creating a gloomy atmosphere.

title: New York Street Scene
medium: Oil and collage on academy board
alt_text: A painting of a busy urban scene created with paint and collage elements on board. The composition is crowded with various signs, words, and shapes in shades of yellow, black, brown, and red. Large, bold letters spell out "AMERICA" across the top, while other words like "ICE," "SODA," and "ROXIN" are scattered throughout. A central rectangular piece of paper features a large, dark-circled star, resembling a vintage letterhead. Various wheels, structures, and blocky shapes are layered beneath the text, giving the work a textured, dense appearance.

title: Open Book
alt_text: A color video shows a close-up, slightly blurry view of an open mouth. The top row of teeth is visible across the upper portion of the frame. Below the teeth, a pink tongue fills the center space of the open mouth. The bottom row of teeth sits along the lower edge of the opening. Soft, pink skin surrounds the lips and the lower part of the face.

title: Exchange
alt_text: A video still showing two figures on a television screen. On the left, the profile of a person faces toward the right, with their face glowing brightly against the background. On the right, a second, darker figure stands facing away or slightly to the side. The image is black and white and has the blurry, grainy quality of an old videotape. The screen itself is framed by a dark border.

title: Female Sensibility
alt_text: A color video still shows two people pressing their faces together. The person on the left is angled slightly to the side with their eyes closed. Their hand is visible on the left side, cupping the side of the other person's face. The person on the right is only partially visible, focused mostly on their forehead, eye, and nose. The lighting is soft and warm, and the image is slightly blurred.

title: I am Making Art
medium: Black and white video with sound
alt_text: A black-and-white video still shows a person standing in front of a plain wall. The person has shoulder-length, light-colored hair and a beard. They are wearing a long-sleeved, button-down shirt and dark pants. Both of the person's arms are raised and bent at the elbows, with their hands held up near shoulder level. The person is centered in the frame and appears to be gesturing.

title: Anxious Automation (.6) and Surprise Attack (.7)
medium: Black and white video with sound
alt_text: A black and white video still shows a hand held open against a light background. The image is blurry and has a grainy texture. The palm faces upward, with the fingers slightly curved as if reaching or gesturing. A dark, shadowed shape appears on the left side of the frame, possibly part of an arm or shoulder. The overall lighting is soft, making the edges of the hand blend into the white backdrop.

title: Pocket Chess Set
medium: Leather pocket chessboard, celluloid pieces, and pins in a black leather wallet
alt_text: A sculpture in the form of a leather pocket chessboard shows a travel game set. The object is a rectangular black wallet that is open to reveal two interior sides. On the left, there is a plain black leather flap. On the right, there is a chessboard surface made of orange and light tan squares, with many small celluloid game pieces pinned into place. The board is organized into rows with white-backed markers featuring black or red designs. A small metal clasp sits on the right edge of the wallet to keep it closed.

title: Reclining Young Woman in Spanish Costume
alt_text: A painting of a person lying on a tufted, reddish-purple chaise longue against a dark brown background. The person has dark hair, wears a black jacket over a white top and pants, and rests one arm behind their head. They hold a small, partially open fan in one hand while resting on the cushioned seat. On the floor in the foreground, there are two round, orange fruits. A small, mottled grey and white dog sits near the bottom right corner of the frame, facing toward one of the oranges.

title: The Old Farm House
alt_text: A painting shows a hillside house framed by trees with rolling hills in the background. The house is two stories tall with a reddish-brown roof and a small balcony on the upper level. Bare branches of trees arch over the top of the scene, while other tree trunks stand to the left and right. The background features soft, muted tones of green, tan, and gray, suggesting hills under a cloudy sky. The overall style uses visible, textured brushstrokes throughout the image.

title: General George Washington on Horseback 1732-1799 LL.D. 1781
medium: Bronze, green, yellow, and orange-brown patina
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a person riding a horse. The person sits tall, wearing a long coat and a wide-brimmed hat with a pointed front. A sturdy horse stands beneath the rider, lifting its front right leg as if taking a step. The entire piece has a dark brown, metallic finish that reflects light across its surface. The sculpture rests on a simple, oval-shaped base against a plain gray background.

title: Red Locomotive (formerly) Train Leaving Tunnel
alt_text: A painting of a stylized, geometric train scene rendered in bold, flat blocks of color. In the center, a large, red, circular shape dominates the view, suggesting the front of a locomotive with bright yellow circles for lights. To the left, a tall, green, angular figure stands holding a small, yellow rectangular lantern. The background contains large blue and brown shapes that hint at architectural structures like archways or station tunnels. Plumes of pale blue smoke rise in curved, simplified forms from the top of the red engine. The overall style uses simple shapes and vivid, contrasting colors to suggest industrial movement.

title: Village Street (Sometimes) Winter
alt_text: A painting of a quiet town scene with several buildings and figures. In the center, yellow and white houses with grey roofs cluster together under a cloudy sky. Bare, spindly trees frame the sides of the street, which curves through the middle of the picture. Two people in long coats stand in the foreground on the right, looking down the path. Other small figures are scattered in the distance near the houses and on a patch of green grass. A tall, thin, cross-shaped signpost stands prominently on the right side of the road.

title: Composition I
alt_text: A painting made with oil on canvas features a collection of interlocking geometric shapes that fill the entire frame. Many triangles, rectangles, and curved forms are packed closely together in a tight, vertical composition. These shapes are painted in a variety of flat, bold colors including dark blue, sage green, light pink, black, red, and mustard yellow. The edges of these color blocks are mostly sharp and defined, creating a busy, angular pattern throughout the image. There are no recognizable objects or figures depicted in this abstract arrangement.

title: Andante V
alt_text: A painting of swirling abstract shapes and vibrant colors. The composition is filled with organic, curving lines that weave through shades of red, blue, yellow, and green. On the left side, a geometric, grid-like pattern appears in pale pink and orange. Near the center, a dark, oval shape floats amidst lighter, blended colors. Smooth, flowing forms overlap each other throughout the canvas, creating a sense of movement.

title: Composition II
alt_text: A painting of many geometric shapes covering the entire canvas. These shapes include triangles, rectangles, and irregular polygons that fit together like a puzzle. The colors are bright and varied, featuring bold blocks of red, deep blue, dark green, black, white, and a touch of gold. The paint looks thick with visible brushstrokes throughout each individual section. The overall composition creates a chaotic, busy pattern that fills the space from edge to edge.

title: Composition III
alt_text: A painting of abstract, colorful shapes and lines filling the entire frame. Many thick, rectangular blocks of color are layered on top of each other at various angles. These shapes appear in a wide variety of colors, including bright red, deep blue, yellow, green, orange, purple, and brown. Some areas feature curved forms that contrast with the straighter, block-like marks. The paint is applied with visible, textured brushstrokes throughout the composition. A small, dark signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the painting.

title: Plums
alt_text: A painting of green fruits resting on a light-colored cloth. The round fruits are grouped together in the center and vary in shade from lime green to pale yellow. Each piece of fruit has thick, visible brushstrokes that create a textured look. The cloth underneath appears slightly crumpled, with soft white and gray tones. In the background, there are muted, brownish-pink areas that frame the central pile of fruit.

title: Composition IV
alt_text: A painting of many colorful, abstract shapes crowded together. Sharp triangles, rectangles, and irregular polygons overlap to fill the entire frame. These geometric forms appear in various colors, including bright red, deep blue, yellow, green, and black. Dark, jagged lines create a sense of movement between the different sections. The texture looks thick and layered, as if created with heavy brushstrokes.

title: Composition V
alt_text: A painting shows a variety of geometric shapes layered across the canvas. Large, bold patches of red, blue, green, and black intersect with smaller white triangles and rectangles. These forms overlap one another to create a dense, textured composition. Some shapes have rounded edges, while others are sharp and angular. No clear subject or scene is visible in this abstract work.

title: Red and Green Steps
alt_text: A painting of various geometric shapes arranged against a solid black background. Three large, white or light grey squares are stacked in a vertical column-like formation. Rectangular bars in shades of grey, green, and blue connect these squares and extend from their sides. Three red semicircles are placed at different points, appearing to sit on the edges of the white squares. Small, translucent green rectangles overlap some of the other shapes in the center area.

title: White with Black Wedge
medium: Oil, enamel, sand and wood on panel
alt_text: A painting of overlapping geometric shapes in white, black, gray, and light tan. A large, grainy gray triangle dominates the left side of the composition. To its right, a solid black triangle sits at an angle against a mostly white background. A thin, light tan shape points upwards behind the gray area, adding depth. Several straight lines define the edges where these different colored planes meet.

title: Harlem River Bridge
alt_text: A painting of a steel bridge spanning a river, viewed through a foreground of trees. The bridge is a dark, structural truss form stretching horizontally across the middle of the scene. In the foreground, tall, stylized trees with thick, dark trunks frame the sides of the image. The entire scene is overlaid with a pattern of diagonal, crisscrossing lines in muted colors, creating a sense of fragmentation. Red, blue, and brown paint strokes create abstract shapes and colors throughout the background and the water below.

title: The Eye of God
alt_text: A painting shows a large, close-up human eye looking directly forward. The iris of the eye is a bright yellow circle containing a dark, translucent triangle. Radiating lines of white and light yellow extend outward from this central pupil across the entire surface. The surrounding eyelid and skin are painted in shades of deep red, rust, and brown with a rough, textured appearance. The painting is framed by a simple, dark border.

title: South Sea Fishermen
alt_text: A painting of people in a boat on the water. A group of men with tan skin, wearing simple white loincloths, work inside a wooden boat. They appear to be fishing, as large, colorful fish lie on the deck and hang over the side. The painting uses jagged lines and sharp angles to show the movement of the water and the bodies of the people. Bright greens, blues, and reds dominate the scene, giving it a vibrant look. A signature and the year 1921 appear in the bottom left corner.

title: The Red Cat
alt_text: A painting of a still life with a cat sitting on a table surface. On the left, a tall purple pitcher sits next to a green vase holding a large sunflower. In the center, a white bowl holds several green and spotted pears, while a yellow lemon and a green apple rest near the front edge. To the right, a reddish-orange cat looks to the left while holding a patterned fish in its front paws. A small white die and some playing cards lie on the table near the objects. The background is a mix of angular shapes in deep shades of red, purple, and blue.

title: Interior with Head and Still Life
alt_text: A painting of a dark room featuring a man in the foreground, a still life, and a smaller figure in the background. On the right, a man with a pale face and large blue eyes holds a round red object in his hands. To his left sits a dark bowl filled with several round fruits, including a pear and a red apple. Further back in the dim room, a small, pale human figure stands behind a four-legged animal with red markings. A small window with a cross shape is visible on the wall behind them. The entire scene is set in shadow with muted, moody tones.

title: Pastoral Scene
alt_text: A painting of two figures in a dark, stylized landscape with trees and animals. On the right, a person with pale green skin sits on the ground, looking upward with a hand resting on their chest. To the left, a second person with yellow skin stands tall, facing the side. Large, colorful trees stand between the figures and behind them in the dark blue space. A small building sits in the background on the right under a glowing, round moon. Several animals, including two horned cattle, are positioned around the figures.

title: The Woodcarver
alt_text: A painting showing a person with an angular, reddish-brown face in the foreground. This figure wears a green jacket with a patterned collar and holds a thin object near their chin. In the background stands a tall, pale, yellow-toned statue of a woman facing away from the viewer. To the right of the statue, several rounded fruits like pears and an apple sit on a dark surface. The background features deep red and black abstract shapes that create a somber mood.

title: The Cloistered Life (Formerly) Russian Fairytale and Country Scene
alt_text: A painting of several figures, animals, and buildings in a dreamlike setting. On the left, two figures stand together with pale, solid-colored faces and long, flowing robes. To the right, another person stands alone in dark clothing while holding a small black creature. Several animals, including a long-necked blue goat and a small bird, are scattered near a striped, tent-like structure in the background. Colorful, jagged shapes and patterns fill the central space near the bottom. The entire scene is bathed in a mix of warm reddish tones and cooler blue shadows.

title: Decorative Panel for a Dining Room
alt_text: A painting of three rectangular panels, joined together, set against a black background. Each panel has a deep blue background and features arrangements of simplified, geometric shapes in muted colors like gray, white, and tan. The left panel shows a pipe and a cluster of grapes. The center panel displays a tall white bottle next to bananas and more grapes. The right panel depicts a dark bottle next to a box of fruit and a white cup.

title: Composition for an Observatory. (Formerly) Abstract Composition
alt_text: A painting showing geometric shapes arranged on a dark background. At the top, a circle split down the middle into black and white sits above a long, thin, angled line. A large, bent shape made of wide black and white bands dominates the center of the image. Behind these shapes are several layered rectangles in shades of light blue and gray. The entire composition is set against a black backdrop with fuzzy, uneven edges.

title: Still Life in Brown and Gray
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes in shades of grey and brown. A central, rounded oval form dominates the middle of the composition, covered in thin, vertical brushstrokes. Behind the oval, two large, flat geometric shapes lean upward like sheets of paper. To the right, a smaller, textured rectangular shape sits at an angle next to the oval. The entire scene is painted with muted, earthy tones that give it a weathered appearance.

title: Still Life in Gray
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes in neutral colors like beige, brown, and cream. The composition consists of various flat, rectangular, and irregular forms that overlap each other. Some sections feature vertical stripes, while others appear as smooth, solid blocks of muted tones. These overlapping shapes create a layered effect against a gray background. The overall style feels structured and geometric, framed by a thin brown border.

title: Brass Band
medium: Oil, cord, nails, and possibly tempera on wood covered in cardboard
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes filled with a pattern of thin, parallel lines. The composition features various geometric forms, including rounded, rectangular, and triangular shapes that seem to be layered on top of each other. The surface is heavily textured with dark brown, grey, and black tones that create deep shadows in the crevices. These lines appear to be ridges or raised material that run across the entire surface of the work. The overall color palette is muted, ranging from light tan highlights to very dark, nearly black areas in the recessed spaces.

title: Time
medium: Oil, carpet tacks, and possibly tempera on commercial pieced wood, covered on both sides in cardboard
alt_text: A painting composed of oil paint and hundreds of small, metal carpet tacks arranged in precise geometric patterns. The background is a flat, pale gray surface featuring thin black lines, drawn arcs, and some handwritten letters and numbers like "A," "B," and "4." Rows of these tacks run vertically and horizontally across the panel, creating a grid-like texture against the smooth painted areas. Several dark, solid black shapes cut through the arrangement, including a large triangular form and a thick, rectangular band on the right side. The overall appearance is technical and diagrammatic, resembling a construction plan or a schematic drawing.

title: Weights
alt_text: A painting of three stylized figures standing in a row against a light-colored background. Each figure is dressed in a light tan outfit and has a simple, cartoon-like face with distinct dark lines. The person on the left wears a pointed hat, the middle person holds a tall rectangular sign, and the person on the right wears a boxy cap and carries a stick. Behind the figures, there are green, tree-like shapes and a faint dark mountain outline in the distance. The entire scene is framed within a large, gray, irregular rectangular shape that contrasts with the lighter background.

title: Will, Intellect, Sensation, Emotion
medium: Oil on commercial pieced wood, covered on both sides in cardboard
alt_text: A painting shows a large, round shape dominating the center of the frame, resting against a pale, neutral background. This central form is smooth, beige, and abstract, curving outward like a large, stylized belly or torso. A smaller, vertical shape at the bottom center of the large form resembles a hand or fingers reaching down toward the base. Dark outlines define the shapes against the lighter background. In the lower right corner, the words "WILL," "INTELLECT," "SENSATION," and "EMOTION" are printed in small, capital letters in a vertical stack.

title: Temptation of St. Anthony
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes rendered in shades of gray, white, and deep blue. A large, dark blue area made of angled, rectangular blocks fills the upper right section of the canvas. Below and to the left of this blue area, there are many sharp, white, and light gray rectangular lines and planes that intersect. A thin, black vertical line stretches from the middle-left area down toward the bottom of the painting, crossing behind the white geometric forms. These shapes create a sense of depth and architectural structure. The overall composition is angular and looks like a stylized construction.

title: From Word to Object
alt_text: A painting of a person wearing a head covering that obscures their hair and shoulders. The person has a rounded face with closed, downward-slanting eyes and a small, downturned mouth. The entire image uses a muted color palette of off-white, gray, and dusty brown tones. There is a distinct, smooth texture to the paint, giving the subject a soft and hazy appearance. In the bottom right corner, the words "FROM WORD TO OBJECT" are printed in plain, capital letters. Below the text, a signature and the number 23 appear in the corner.

title: Mural Decoration
alt_text: A painting of several fragmented figures and abstract shapes in motion. In the center, a person stands with one arm raised high while wearing long, blue-tinted clothing. To the lower left, another figure sits or crouches, wearing a reddish cap and draped in light, colorful fabric. The background is a busy mix of overlapping circles, lines, and varied patterns in shades of red, orange, and green. The entire scene uses choppy, angular brushstrokes that help blend the figures into the background.

title: The Lovers
alt_text: A painting of two figures with smooth, featureless, egg-shaped heads sitting together on a wooden platform. The figure on the left is entirely light grey and wears long, draped clothing. The figure on the right has a dark reddish head and wears a top with a colorful, geometric chest piece over a grey outfit. Both figures are holding hands, and their bodies are angled slightly toward each other. Behind them is a dark, shadowy background with two tall, thin openings showing a bright blue sky with simple white clouds.

title: Metaphysical Interior
alt_text: A painting of a surreal, interior scene with an outdoor view. A large framed picture sits in the center, showing a small boat with figures on a rough, icy sea near large animals. Beside the frame, a tall, triangular object stands on a purple box, featuring a green grid and a red, coiled snake-like shape. To the left, a vertical window reveals a bright blue sky with several small, white clouds. In the foreground, the scene rests on a light-colored wooden floor with dark seams. The walls surrounding the space are painted in shades of dark gray.

title: Still Life with Fruit
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and objects in various bright colors. A pale yellow round fruit sits on the left side next to an orange rectangular form. A large, dark, curved shape stands tall on the right side of the composition. Below these, a rounded, textured dome shape sits in the lower center. Sharp angles and straight lines cut through the background, creating a layered and complex design. The overall scene mixes geometric patterns with soft, shaded surfaces.

title: Still Life with Coffee Pot
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes in warm and cool colors. The composition features a mix of geometric and organic forms that suggest pieces of kitchenware or containers. A vibrant blue shape on the left sits near lighter white and gray curved objects in the center. Behind these items, red and gold blocks of color create a textured background. The entire image uses soft gradients and hard lines to blend the objects into one another.

title: Johnnie Manning
alt_text: A painting of a young boy facing forward. The boy wears a simple, light-colored shirt with thin suspenders and a flat cap on his head. His face is illuminated with light, highlighting his dark eyes and parted lips. The background is a dark, moody shade of brownish-red that contrasts with his lighter clothing. Broad, visible brushstrokes define his clothes and facial features.

title: Little Girl ("Cissie")
alt_text: A painting of a young child with wavy, light-brown hair and a fair complexion. The child faces forward with a soft, serious expression, and their cheeks are tinged with pink. They are wearing a white collared shirt that appears slightly loose, with dark blue fabric visible at the neckline. The background is a moody, dark shade of muted purple and green, creating a shadowed environment around the child. The brushstrokes are visible and thick, giving the portrait a textured appearance.

title: Thomas Jefferson
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up. The man has light brown hair that is slightly wavy. He is wearing a dark, high-collared coat over a white shirt and a light-colored cravat. His expression is serious, and he looks directly toward the viewer. The portrait is enclosed in an ornate, gold-colored rectangular frame.

title: St. Mark's in the Bowery
alt_text: A painting of a city street with a tall church steeple rising in the distance. The center of the scene features the pointed gray spire reaching up into a sky filled with soft, light-blue and pink clouds. Below the steeple, a dense line of trees with green and white leaves stretches horizontally across the middle of the frame. In the foreground, a dark horse-drawn carriage moves along a wet street reflecting the sky's colors. Several small, indistinct figures of people walk along the sidewalk and the street in front of the trees.

title: John William Sterling (1844-1918), B.A. 1864, M.A. 1874, LL.D. 1893
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair. The man has short, dark hair and a mustache, and he wears a dark suit with a white pocket square. He is sitting on a red chair in a room with plain, light-colored walls. To his left, there is a small table draped with a cloth that holds several books. A framed picture hangs on the wall behind him. The entire portrait is set inside a thick, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Bed tent linen, embroidered in silk
alt_text: A silk textile shows a long, hanging fabric with a repeating pattern of dark figures against a lighter background. The design is divided into vertical bands of different widths. A large, rectangular panel at the top features symmetrical, repeating floral or creature-like shapes. Below this panel, the fabric hangs down in wide, pleated columns that are framed by thin, darker borders decorated with leaf or diamond motifs. The overall appearance is highly decorative and dense with intricate, mirrored details.

title: Daniel Bishop (1779-1817)
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up against a dark background. The man has brown hair styled high on his forehead and wears a dark blue coat over a white shirt with a ruffled collar. He holds a large, light-colored scroll in his right hand. His right index finger points directly to a mark on the scroll. The entire painting is held inside a large, ornate, gold-colored rectangular frame.

title: Major General Friedrich Wilhelm Augustus, Baron von Steuben (1730-1794)
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a dark blue military uniform with gold buttons and a tan vest. He has white, powdered hair styled in curls on the sides. Several colorful medals and stars are pinned to his chest. He stands outside against a background of trees and a distant river. One of his hands rests on the hilt of a sword held by his side.

title: Edward Winslow (1699-1753)
alt_text: A painting shows a man from the chest up against a simple brown background. He has a pale complexion and wears a long, curly, light-colored wig that rests on his shoulders. He is dressed in a bright red, long-sleeved coat with a row of buttons running down the front. Underneath the coat, he wears a white shirt with a ruffled collar and cuffs. In his hand, which is held near the bottom of the frame, he holds a rectangular white object.

title: Henry H. ("Pop") Griswold (1861-1943)
alt_text: A painting of an older man with a mustache and a flat cap. He faces forward while holding a cigar in his mouth, with a thin wisp of smoke rising to his left. He wears a dark suit jacket over a white collared shirt and a dark tie. A small, shiny pin is visible on the lapel of his jacket. The background is simple and mostly dark, with a lighter vertical stripe on the right side. The painting is enclosed in a thick, gold-colored frame.

title: Lafayette
alt_text: A bronze and marble sculpture shows the head and shoulders of a man. The bronze bust depicts a person with short, wavy hair and a serious expression. He wears a jacket with a wide, high collar and lapels over a collared shirt. The figure rests on a tall, rectangular base made of yellowish-orange marble. A decorative dark metal border sits at the bottom of this base, which features a small rectangular plaque on the front.

title: Lafayette
alt_text: A painting on parchment shows a portrait of a man, set into a wooden display. The man in the portrait has dark hair and wears a dark blue uniform with gold details and a high white collar. He faces slightly to the left. The portrait is framed in an oval metal border that is textured and dark in color. This oval frame is mounted onto a rectangular wooden board with a light brown, polished grain. A human hand is visible on the left side of the frame, holding the wooden board.

title: La Fin de la Recolte
alt_text: A painting of several people harvesting in a field under a hazy, sunset sky. In the foreground, a man in a light shirt digs into the dirt with a shovel, while a woman wearing a headscarf kneels nearby to pick up items from the ground. Further back, other figures stand and bend over to fill large fabric sacks. Smoke rises from a small fire in the distance, and a cart pulled by a horse sits on the far right side of the field. The ground is brown and textured, appearing like a garden or farm plot.

title: Retour de Pecheur
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on the ground outside of a building, holding a small child in her lap. She wears a light-colored head covering and a long dark skirt. The woman is pointing outward with one hand toward a man walking in the distance. The man is standing on a dirt path in an open field, wearing dark clothes and reddish trousers. An open wooden door stands to the right, framing the view of the landscape behind them. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Les Deux Amis
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting in a field with a flock of sheep. The person sits on the left side of the frame with a small dog by their side. Several sheep are gathered nearby, with some grazing and others resting on the ground. A large, jagged hole cuts through the center and lower right of the canvas, revealing a dark empty space behind the painting. The scene is painted in muted brown, green, and yellow tones, suggesting a cloudy or overcast day. A thin, gold-colored frame surrounds the damaged artwork.

title: Red Jacket, Seneca Chief (Sagoyewatha) (ca. 1758-1830)
alt_text: A painting of an older man with graying hair, shown from the chest up against a natural background. He has a serious expression and looks off to the right side of the frame. He wears a tan, fringed jacket with a white collar and a wide, metallic-looking oval ornament on his chest. A red sash is tied over his shoulder, and he holds a small, decorative hatchet in his right hand. The background features dark trees on the left and a pale, cloudy sky appearing on the right.

title: Captain Cold, or Ut-ha-wah (Onondaga, ca. 1770–1845)
alt_text: A painting of a man with long, dark hair wearing a hat adorned with white feathers. He is dressed in a white shirt, a dark blue coat, and a wide red sash with white accents draped over his shoulder and tied at his waist. The man stands with one hand on his hip and his other hand resting on a ledge or surface. A blurred, green landscape with trees is visible behind him under a muted, cloudy sky. His expression is serious, and he looks toward the left side of the frame.

title: Ojibbeway Chief
alt_text: A painting of a person looking directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. The person has dark hair and wears large, round, intricate metallic earrings. They are dressed in a light-colored, ruffled shirt layered under a dark shawl or cloak. A dark, black fabric piece is tied around their neck like a cravat. The background is a soft, blurry mix of browns and grays, which makes the figure stand out. The painting is enclosed in a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LL.D. 1781
alt_text: A painting on glass shows a portrait of a man in a military-style uniform held by hands wearing blue gloves. The man has short white hair, a high collar, and a blue jacket with gold details, and he sits against a dark red background. The painting is set in a simple, dark brown wooden frame with a white border. To the left on the table sits a silver goblet, a round object in a plastic bag, and a blue measuring tape. To the right, parts of plates or dishes are visible on the surface.

title: Revolutionary Officer
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a military uniform, enclosed in an ornate gold frame. The man is shown from the chest up, facing forward with a slightly turned head. He has light-colored hair, a white ruffled neckpiece, and a dark blue coat with red lapels and gold fringe on the shoulder. The background is a very dark, indistinct color that shows signs of age with fine cracks in the surface. Below the frame, a small piece of white paper with the handwritten black numbers "1939.43" is taped to the display.

title: Washington, Rochambeau, and Lauzun at the Battle of Yorktown
alt_text: A painting of several people on horseback gathered near a body of water. Three figures ride in the foreground, all facing toward the right side of the frame. A small group of additional riders follows them on the left, shown mostly in shadows. In the distance on the right, multiple sailing ships float on the calm water. A large, dark, and cloudy sky hangs above the entire scene.

title: George Washington
alt_text: A bronze plaque showing a profile portrait of a person in relief. The plaque is oval-shaped and dark brown in color. In the center, a person's head and neck are shown in profile facing to the right. The person has hair that is styled back, and their facial features are softly defined. A small hole for hanging the piece is visible at the very top edge of the oval frame.

title: George Washington (1732-1799)
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man's head and shoulders is shown from the chest up. The man has a serious expression and his hair is pulled back in a simple style. The sculpture rests on a sturdy, rectangular base that sits on a flat surface. Light hits the left side of the face, creating soft shadows across the features. The entire piece is light in color and set against a dark, plain background.

title: Taking the Count, study
alt_text: A painting of three figures set against a muted, tan-colored background. On the left stands a nude figure with a slightly bent pose, painted in pale, flesh-toned brushstrokes. In the center, a person dressed in a dark coat, light trousers, and a hat stands upright and faces forward. To the right, a third person is bent over and crouches low toward the ground. The entire scene uses simple, loose brushstrokes with a limited color palette of earthy browns, tans, and creams.

title: Farmyard scene
alt_text: A painting of a rural scene featuring a woman in a dirt yard with geese. The woman stands on the right side of the yard wearing a dark dress and a bright red headscarf. Several small white geese are scattered across the muddy, uneven ground near her. Behind the yard, a weathered wooden fence sits in front of a house with a low, dark roof. A large tree with spreading, dark branches rises in the background under a cloudy sky.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting showing a wide, grassy landscape under a dark, cloudy sky. A large, gnarled tree dominates the left side of the frame with a smaller, bushier tree next to it. To the right, a flat, tan field stretches out toward a dark, rolling hill in the distance. The overall scene is colored in muted tones of brown, olive green, and gray. The heavy clouds above suggest the weather might be stormy.

title: Boy fishing
alt_text: A painting of a young person fishing while standing under a large, dark tree. The figure faces right, holding a thin rod while looking toward the edge of a body of water. They wear a white shirt with a red vest and dark blue pants. At their feet sits a small wicker basket in the grass. The background is shadowy and dark, with a patch of cloudy sky visible on the right.

title: Landscape along a Country Road
alt_text: A painting of a rural landscape with a dirt path winding through golden fields. On the left side, a cluster of dark, leafy trees stands against the horizon. In the center distance, a small, dark stone building with a peaked roof sits amidst the green and yellow grass. The sky above is filled with soft, grey clouds and patches of light blue. A patch of vibrant green vegetation grows in the bottom left corner near the foreground.

title: Landscape with Figure
alt_text: A painting of a lone figure walking through a rugged, hilly landscape. The person is seen from behind, wearing dark clothing and a wide-brimmed hat, standing on a dirt path in the center of the frame. To the left, a steep, grassy slope rises up, with a few small, dark animal shapes visible near the top. The ground in the foreground is rough, uneven, and painted in muted tones of brown and green. Above the hills, the sky is filled with soft, cloudy streaks of light gray and white.

title: The Harbor of Le Havre
alt_text: A painting of a harbor shows several large ships docked along a calm waterfront. In the foreground on the left, a tall, dark ship with complex rigging dominates the scene. To its right, other ships with tall masts are tied up near a small, distant shoreline with low buildings. The sky above is filled with soft, gray and white clouds that reflect in the quiet water below. The overall color palette uses muted blues, grays, and browns to depict a cloudy day.

title: Landscape with Cottage
alt_text: A painting of a quiet, rural landscape under a cloudy, overcast sky. On the left side of the scene, a large, dark green tree stands tall, casting a shadow onto the grass. To the right, a small cottage with a thick, thatched roof sits behind the trees. A calm pond fills the foreground, reflecting the shapes and colors of the trees and the cottage above. The overall scene is colored in muted, earthy tones of brown, green, and grey.

title: Henry Clay 1777-1852
alt_text: A Parianware sculpture of a man standing in formal clothes. The figure is a white, full-body statue of a man wearing a double-breasted coat over a vest and trousers. He holds a rolled-up document in his hand and stands next to a short, round column base draped with fabric. The man stands on a rectangular platform, and the entire figure is set against a plain brown background. The number 1930.830 is visible on the background to the right of the figure's shoulder.

title: The Sortie Made by the Garrison of Gibraltar, 27 November 1781
alt_text: A painting of a group of men in uniform standing in a dark, smoky field. In the center, a man in a dark coat lies on the ground, leaning back on one arm. A man in a bright red coat and light-colored pants stands over him, gesturing toward the fallen figure with his hand. Other men in dark blue or red military uniforms surround them, watching the scene. The background is shadowy, suggesting a field or landscape at dusk. The entire painting is housed in a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame with decorative carvings.

title: Soldiers on Horseback in the Snow
alt_text: A painting of figures traveling through a snowy, dark landscape. The artwork is set within a thick, ornate gold frame with detailed patterns along its edges. In the center of the scene, several figures ride on horseback through what appears to be a field covered in snow or frost. The background is a dim, hazy grey, suggesting a cloudy or stormy day. The overall color palette is dark, with muted browns, greys, and whites dominating the scene.

title: Handkerchief or napkin of fancy twill
medium: Warps white linen (?), weft red silk
alt_text: A textile of red silk and light-colored linen shows an intricate repeating pattern. The fabric is rectangular and laid out on a flat, white surface. In the upper center, an oval wreath surrounds a stylized letter that appears to be a double "F." Below this, the border is decorated with several detailed urns overflowing with flowers. The entire design features a delicate, light-colored weave against a bold, red background. A small black sign with the white text "1938.33" sits at the bottom of the frame.

title: Laboissier
alt_text: A textile portrait of a standing figure displayed in an oval wood and gilt frame. The figure wears a long coat, a large cloak draped over one shoulder, and a tall, feathered hat. They are holding a piece of paper or document over a small pedestal on the right side. The background behind the figure shows simple horizontal lines, and the floor is decorated with a checkered pattern. The text "LABOISSIERE L'UN DES FONDATEURS DE LA REPUBLIQUE" curves around the top edge of the image.

title: Ship Model
medium: Possibly oak, other woods, string, iron chain
alt_text: A model of a wooden ship shows it from the stern looking toward the bow. The ship rests on a rectangular wooden base and features several tall, thin masts reaching upward. Thin strings create a complex web of rigging that connects the masts and extends across the length of the deck. Along the sides of the ship, tiny rows of cannon ports line the dark wooden hull. The entire model sits on a flat, tan-colored surface against a plain, off-white wall.

title: Saluting Cannon
alt_text: An object from the arms and armor collection shows a dark metal cannon mounted on a wooden carriage with four wheels. The cannon is positioned in the center and points directly toward the viewer. Its barrel is smooth and metallic, with a round opening at the front. A small white label with a barcode is attached to the top of the barrel. The carriage supporting the cannon has two wheels on each side that appear weathered and tan. The entire object rests on a flat, light-colored surface.

title: Pair of Lions
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture showing two lion figures facing inward. Each lion stands on a separate, elevated pedestal located at the far left and far right of the scene. The lions are dark in color and appear muscular with large, thick manes. Beneath the lions, a long, horizontal architectural structure runs across the background. This structure features a flat shelf and a row of evenly spaced vertical supports above it.

title: Lieutenant John Trumbull Ray (born ca.1792)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting shows the head and shoulders of a young man wearing a bright red military-style coat. He has short, dark brown hair swept to the side and looks toward the right side of the frame. Under his high, dark green collar, he wears a white shirt and a black cravat. The man's coat features shiny silver buttons, a dark green lapel, and a silver shoulder epaulet. The portrait is housed in a thick, rectangular black frame with a small metal ring at the top for hanging.

title: Piece of plain cloth, brocaded
medium: Light blue silk warp and weft, cloth woven
alt_text: A textile of light blue woven silk displays a repeating pattern of floral bouquets. The fabric features small clusters of flowers in shades of pink, yellow, and green arranged across the light blue surface. Lighter, subtle white flower patterns are woven into the background, weaving through the colorful bouquets. The entire square piece is bordered on its sides and bottom by a dark, metallic fringe. A small rectangular label with the number 1938.64 sits along the bottom edge of the fabric.

title: Hood of a cope, compounded satin
medium: Main warp medium blue silk, white binding warp between every two Main weft coarse white silk
alt_text: A textile shows a blue and white patterned cloth with a curved bottom edge. The fabric has an intricate, woven design featuring stylized leaves and flowering branches in a silvery-white color against a medium blue background. A thick, decorative border of fringe runs along the curved bottom and sides, alternating between tan and off-white colors. A small, tasseled knot sits at the very center of the curved bottom edge. The entire piece rests on a wooden frame, with a black label marked "1938,65" placed below the fabric.

title: Compound cloth, brocaded
medium: Main warp fine pink silk carried in pairs with a pair of soft flossy rose warps between eachà
alt_text: A textile shows a repeating, symmetrical floral pattern embroidered in gold and light blue threads. The background is a warm, textured reddish-brown color that appears to be woven fabric. Large, stylized blossoms with layered petals sit at the center of each repeating unit. Smaller, delicate flower shapes with blue centers are scattered between the larger blooms. A small black rectangular label with the white numbers "1938.67" lies on the white surface below the fabric.

title: Reverend Joseph Hopkins Twichell, (1838-1918), B.A. 1859, M.A. (Hon.) 1886, D.D. 1913
alt_text: A painting of an elderly man shown from the chest up. The man has short, light hair and a white mustache, and he is wearing a dark suit with a bow tie. He is positioned against a dark, brownish-grey background. There is a noticeable, jagged rip in the canvas near the right side of his face. The painting appears old, with visible brushstrokes and some wear along the edges.

title: Sword
alt_text: A sword made of brass and mother-of-pearl showing a long, slender metal blade attached to an ornate handle. The blade is straight, silver in color, and tapers to a sharp point on the left side. Attached to the right end is a gold-colored brass handguard with intricate carvings and swirling designs. A smooth, oval-shaped piece of pale white mother-of-pearl sits in the middle of the handle grip. The entire object is centered horizontally against a plain, solid grey background.

title: Clock
medium: Marble base, columns with bronze ornamentation
alt_text: A timepiece of marble and bronze ornamentation shows a circular clock face supported by two tall, fluted columns. The clock face has black numbers and hands centered between the two white columns, which are topped with gold-colored decorative crowns. Below the clock face sits a rectangular pedestal decorated with golden figures. This entire structure rests on a tiered, white marble base that sits atop a dark rectangular plinth. The base is embellished with small, ornate golden details at its corners. The clock is positioned against a plain, light-colored wall.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A miniature painting of a man's portrait set within an oval metal pendant frame. The man is depicted in a head-and-shoulders view, turned slightly to the left. He has light brown, wavy hair and wears a white cravat tied around his neck. A vibrant, dark blue coat covers his shoulders, which has a few small, light-colored buttons visible on the side. The background behind the man is a soft, pale, greenish-grey color that fades toward the edges.

title: Theseus and the Minotaur
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a muscular man struggling with a creature that has a human body and the head of a bull. The man stands tall on the left, holding a small object in his raised right hand while gripping the creature with his other arm. The bull-like creature is hunched over and twisted, appearing to be pinned down by the man. Both figures are dark brown in color and have smooth, detailed muscle definitions. They stand on a rectangular base that has some rocks and a sword lying on the ground.

title: Panther Seizing a Stag
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a large cat attacking a stag. The sculpture is colored in dark, reddish-brown tones and rests on a solid, rocky base. The big cat is positioned on top of the stag’s back, with its head resting near the stag's antlers. The stag is captured mid-movement, with its head turned sharply to the side and its mouth slightly open. Both animals have textured, muscular bodies that look lean and tense.

title: Juno
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a figure sitting on a rocky ledge. The dark figure is shown from the chest up and looks down and slightly to the left. One hand rests on a hip, while the other arm extends down to hold a thin rod or stick. The figure has curly hair adorned with a cap or headband. The entire sculpture stands on a smooth, round, dark base.

title: Minerva
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a seated woman holding a sword. The figure has a smooth, dark brown finish and rests on a rough-textured, rocky base. She wears a helmet on her head and raises her left arm to hold a strap or cord attached to it. Her right hand grips a short, straight sword that points downward toward her lap. The woman is seated with her knees together, and the entire piece stands on a flat, circular platform.

title: William Loughton Smith (1758–1812)
alt_text: A miniature painting in oil on wood shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, set inside an oval gold frame. The man has light-colored hair worn long and curled at the sides. He is wearing a dark blue coat with visible gold buttons over a pale yellow vest. A ruffled white cravat is tied at his neck. The background behind him is a soft, light gray color that contrasts with his dark clothing. Text in black lettering is written along the border of the gold frame.

title: The Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting on a panel shows a crucifixion scene set against a gold background. In the upper center, a man hangs from a dark cross, his body pale and head tilted downward. Four small, winged figures hover in the air around the cross, each holding a small cup. Below the cross, a group of people stands in a line, with one person kneeling in the center and another small figure holding onto someone's leg near the bottom right. The figures are dressed in long, flowing robes of muted red, blue, and brown, and many have circular halos around their heads. The paint appears worn and cracked in several places, showing the wood underneath, particularly at the bottom edge.

title: The Last Supper
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on a shaped wooden panel shows a group of thirteen people gathered around a table. Each person has a gold circle painted around their head, and they are dressed in robes of red, blue, grey, and yellow. They sit behind and around a long rectangular table, which is covered with a pale cloth and holds small dishes or cups. The scene is set against a textured, gold background with a border of small, dark dots along the bottom edge of the panel. The wooden base of the object is worn and shows signs of age.

title: Orpheus
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a male figure balancing on one leg atop a narrow, pillar-like stand. The figure has pointed, horn-like features on his head and his arms are raised above his head. He appears to be dancing or in motion, with one leg bent and the other lifted behind him. His body is muscular and textured with visible sculpted details throughout his skin. The entire piece is rendered in shades of grey and silver against a plain, light-colored background.

title: William Adams Delano
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man's head and neck sits on a simple black rectangular base. The figure is dark brown with a rough, textured surface that shows clear finger or tool marks. His hair is swept back, and his forehead has visible lines across it. The man has a serious expression with his eyes looking slightly off to the side. The bust ends at his collar, where the material looks crumpled and uneven.

title: Charles Fenton Scott (1864-1944), M.A. (Hon.) 1911
alt_text: A painting of an older man in a dark suit against a plain, light-brown background. He has short, light-colored hair and wears thin-rimmed glasses. He is dressed formally in a dark jacket, a vest, a light-colored shirt, and a dark tie. The man stands facing forward with his right hand resting near his chest and his left hand hanging down at his side. A small, thin metal chain is visible across his vest, likely attached to a pocket watch.

title: Saint Mary Magdalen
alt_text: A limestone sculpture of a standing woman with her head tilted downward and eyes closed. She wears a fitted dress with a decorated bodice and a textured head covering with long braids on either side of her face. Her right arm extends forward, and her left arm holds a small, cylindrical lidded container against her side. The figure’s clothing has deep folds that suggest movement in the fabric. The material appears matte and weathered, with faint signs of original color remaining on the surface.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A limestone sculpture shows a woman holding a small child. The woman stands upright, wearing a long dress with many folds that gather around her feet. She cradles the baby on her left arm, and the baby reaches toward her chest. Both figures have smooth, light-colored skin tones that match the stone material. A small, rectangular paper tag with strings hangs from the base of the sculpture.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A wood sculpture of a standing woman wearing a crown and holding a small child. The woman looks toward the left while the child looks up toward her face. She wears long, draped robes that fall to her feet in vertical folds. Her right arm hangs down with the hand missing. The surface of the sculpture appears weathered and brown, with small hints of red and green paint remaining in the crevices.

title: King Herod
alt_text: A limestone sculpture showing a seated, bearded man holding a long, straight sword. He wears a tall, flat-topped crown that sits on his head beneath a semi-circular canopy. His face features large, wide-open eyes and a prominent, rectangular beard. The man is dressed in a long, layered robe with draped folds visible down his front. He holds a rectangular object in his left hand while his right hand grips the hilt of the sword. The entire figure rests on a plain, blocky base against a solid dark gray background.

title: Jedidiah Morse (1761–1826, B.A. 1783, M.A. 1786)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a portrait painting of a man. The portrait is oval-shaped and is framed in a thin, golden border with a beaded edge and a small loop at the top. The man has short, white, powdered hair and dark eyes looking directly forward. He wears a dark, possibly black, coat with a high collar and a white cravat underneath. The background of the portrait is a soft, muted grey with lighter highlights near the man's head.

title: Caleb Bull (1746-1797)
alt_text: A miniature portrait shows the head and shoulders of a man against a dark blue background. The man has pale skin, light blue eyes, and white hair styled with sideburns. He wears a dark blue coat over a white vest and shirt with a ruffled front. The portrait is housed in an oval gold frame with a decorative, scalloped inner edge. A small gold loop at the top allows the piece to be hung or worn as a pendant.

title: Peter Lanman (1771 - 1854)
alt_text: A painting shows a man in a formal dark coat. He is centered in the frame and faces slightly to the left. He wears a dark blue scarf wrapped around his neck over a white shirt. His hair is short and dark, and his expression is serious. The painting is encased in an ornate, shiny gold frame with decorative corners.

title: Isaac Smith (1719–1787)
medium: Oil on canvas in original gilded white-pine frame
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting at a desk and looking to the right. He wears a dark purple jacket with gold buttons and a white wig. His hand rests on a piece of paper on the blue desk surface. A white feather quill sits in a small inkwell near his hand. Behind him, a heavy blue curtain hangs on the right side of the dark room.

title: The Judgment of Jupiter
alt_text: A painting of a group of four people outdoors in a landscape setting. On the left, a man wearing a metallic helmet and armor embraces a woman in a long, flowing dress. A second, younger man stands to their right, wearing only a flowing red cloak and appearing to look away from the couple. High above them, sitting on a cloud, is an older, bearded man with a large, dark bird with spread wings beside him. The scene is set against a dark, stormy sky with hints of a landscape below.

title: Elbert Brinckerhoff Monroe (1836-1894), M.A. (Hon.) 1886
alt_text: A painting of a man shown in profile against a blurred, golden-brown background. The portrait is oval-shaped and focuses on the man's head and shoulders. He has short hair, a receding hairline, and sideburns that run down the side of his face. He is wearing a dark suit jacket over a white collared shirt and a simple light-colored tie. The man looks toward the right side of the frame with a neutral expression. His skin is pale, and the lighting in the scene creates soft shadows along his jawline and forehead.

title: Naphtali Daggett (1727-1780), B. A. 1748
alt_text: A painting of a man, shown from the chest up. The man has pale skin, round facial features, and is wearing a shoulder-length white wig. He is dressed in a dark, heavy robe with a white collar or cravat at his neck. His body is turned slightly to the right, but his face looks directly toward the viewer. The background is a dark, warm brown color enclosed within a painted oval border.

title: Bull Attacked by Tiger
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a large bull attacking a bear. The bull is positioned on the right, rearing up on its hind legs with its head bowed low. Its muscular body is angled diagonally, with its back leg kicking out behind it. Beneath the bull, a smaller bear is hunched over and struggling on the ground. The entire scene is set on a simple, oval-shaped base against a plain, solid grey background.

title: Outskirts of Madrid
alt_text: A painting of a sandy, unpaved area leading toward a distant city. A shirtless young boy sits in the foreground on the left, playing in the sand. In the center, a person wearing a dark coat and hat walks away from the viewer while carrying containers. To the right, a tall, solid wall casts a dark shadow across the ground. Beyond the open, sandy space, a city skyline with buildings and a smokestack rises against a bright blue sky.

title: The Barnyard
alt_text: A painting of a rustic indoor scene that features a chicken coop or barn. Two chickens occupy the lower left, with a light-colored rooster standing near a seated, lighter-colored hen. A wooden door or gate stands upright in the center, partially blocking a dark, shadowy opening. The surrounding walls appear rough and textured, painted in warm shades of brown, gold, and deep shadow. The overall lighting is dim, suggesting a quiet, enclosed space.

title: Laboureur de Lot
alt_text: A painting of a pair of oxen pulling a plow through a field. The two brown oxen are in the center, yoked together and facing toward the left side of the frame. A person stands behind them, holding a long stick to guide the plow and the animals. In the background, a flat, grassy field stretches toward a soft, hazy horizon under a pale sky. Another small, dark figure walks in the distance on the far left side of the field. The entire scene is enclosed within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Dance Fantasy
alt_text: A painting showing a large, crowded costume party or event filled with many people in varied attire. The figures are scattered across the scene, appearing small and indistinct against a dark, moody background. Several round, glowing shapes that look like colorful balloons float in the upper corners, adding dots of light to the dim space. A group of people stands toward the center of the room, while others fill the periphery in loosely defined clusters. The overall tone is shadowy and textured, with thick brushstrokes creating a sense of movement and depth.

title: Rose to Rose
alt_text: A painting of two women standing close together outdoors in dim, evening light. The woman on the left has reddish hair and wears a dark dress with a pale, ruffled collar. She is reaching out with one hand to touch the long, dark hair of the woman sitting in front of her. The seated woman looks down and wears a light-colored shirt. A dark, leafy bush with small red flowers grows behind them on the right side of the frame.

title: The Glen at Ornans (Bords du Doubs; Effet d'Automne)
alt_text: A painting of a landscape features a large, dark tree with thick, rust-colored leaves standing in the foreground. Beneath the tree, a rocky cliff face rises steeply from a dark river that curves through the lower right side. To the left, a grassy slope leads up to the tree, marked by a few scattered, light-colored stones. In the background, tall, jagged mountains with patches of white snow stretch upward against a cloudy sky. The overall color palette is dark and moody, with warm autumn tones for the trees and deep shadows across the rock and water.

title: Driving Home the Geese
alt_text: A painting of a rural scene shows a figure standing in a field with a group of birds. The person is on the left side of the frame, facing toward the center where several geese or ducks are gathered on the ground. The background is a dark, hazy landscape featuring a large, indistinct tree in the middle. The entire scene is painted in muted, brownish tones that create a soft and moody atmosphere. It is enclosed in a thick, textured gold-colored frame.

title: Jaguar Eating
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a large, dark-colored cat lying down and chewing on a bone. The animal is stretched out with its body angled toward the right side of the frame. It holds a long, thin bone firmly in its mouth with its front paws. The sculpture has a smooth, shiny surface with a dark, almost black color. It rests on a textured, rectangular base that looks like a rough piece of ground.

title: Verdure tapestry
alt_text: A textile of wool and silk shows a lush forest scene framed by a wide, decorative border. The central image features dense trees and foliage with a small castle visible in the distant background. A flowing stream cuts through the lower part of the woods, moving from left to center. The thick border surrounding the square scene is filled with intricate patterns of flowers, fruits, and scrolling leaves. Two birds sit perched on branches in the trees near the right side of the frame.

title: Thomas Fletcher (1787-1866)
alt_text: A miniature portrait of a young man, painted with watercolor on ivory. The portrait is housed in an oval gold frame, which is mounted against a dark, rectangular backing. At the top of the frame, there is a small brass ornament shaped like a leaf and an acorn with a ring for hanging. The man has short, light brown hair, blue eyes, and is wearing a high-collared dark coat over a white shirt. He is shown from the chest up against a soft, light-colored background.

title: Processional Cross
alt_text: A copper gilt sculpture shows a crucifix mounted on a tall pole. The cross itself is a reddish-brown color with intricate patterns and includes several small, three-dimensional figures attached to its surface. A central figure of a man hangs on the crossbar, while smaller figures are placed on the ends of the arms and at the top. Below the cross, a round, golden ball sits on top of a pole, which connects to a simple, rectangular black base at the bottom. The entire object has an antique look, featuring worn metal surfaces and accents of blue enamel.

title: Jabez Huntington, Jr. (Nephew of the artist) (1767-1848), B.A. 1784
alt_text: A painting of a young person looking directly at the viewer. The person has dark, wavy hair and large, dark eyes. They are wearing a dark red jacket over a white collared shirt. The background is a plain, dark brown wall that fades into black. A fine network of cracks covers the surface of the entire painting.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A stucco relief shows a woman holding a small child in her lap. The woman wears a long head covering that drapes over her shoulders and body. She looks toward the child, who sits facing forward with hands reaching out. Behind the two figures is a flat, purple-grey background enclosed by a dark, arched frame. The surfaces of the figures have a worn, light-colored finish that shows reddish tones underneath.

title: Andrew Jackson (1767–1845)
alt_text: A miniature of a portrait painted in watercolor on ivory shows a man in a dark blue military-style uniform. He is positioned in the center, looking slightly to the side with short, light brown hair. His uniform features gold buttons down the front and gold trim on his shoulders. He is set against a background of a light blue sky with fluffy white clouds. The oval painting is set into a simple brass frame and mounted on a rectangular black board with a small gold-colored metal leaf at the top.

title: Hore Browse Trist (1775–1804)
alt_text: A miniature portrait of a man, painted in watercolor on ivory. The oval portrait shows the head and shoulders of a young man with curly brown hair looking off to the right. He wears a dark blue jacket with a high collar and a white ruffled neck cloth. The portrait is set inside a dark red, oval-shaped case with a bright blue and gold decorative rim. At the top of the case is a small loop for hanging the piece as jewelry.

title: Joseph Anthony, Jr. (1762-1814)
medium: Watercolor over graphite pencil on ivory
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory shows a head-and-shoulders view of a fair-skinned man. He has wavy, dark brown hair and is looking directly at the viewer with a slight smile. He wears a dark blue coat with a high, black collar and a white necktie. The portrait is housed inside a simple, oval gold metal frame with a small loop at the top for hanging. The background of the portrait is a plain, muted olive-green color.

title: Harriet Mackie (The Dead Bride) (1788–1804)
medium: Watercolor and graphite pencil on ivory
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting shows the head and shoulders of a woman with her eyes closed, as if she is sleeping or deceased. She wears a white head covering decorated with a band of small, light-colored flowers. The woman lies against a soft, white fabric pillow that is ruffled along the edges. Her dress is a simple, pale-colored garment with a small ruffled neckline. This miniature is framed in an oval-shaped metal case that includes a small loop for a chain at the top.

title: Robert Kennedy (1770-1849)
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a light-skinned man. He is positioned in the center, facing forward with a neutral expression. The man has short, gray hair and wears a dark gray double-breasted coat over a white cravat. The background is a soft, blended mix of pale blue and off-white colors. A gold oval frame with a small loop at the top surrounds the entire portrait.

title: John Mortimer Catlin (1801-1881), B.A. 1820, M.A. 1823
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a young man with curly brown hair. He has blue eyes and is wearing a dark blue coat over a white collared shirt. The man is looking directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. The portrait is framed within a small, rectangular red case that has a velvet border. On the right side of the painting, a faint signature is visible.

title: Le Pêcheur à la Coquille (Neapolitan Fisherboy)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a young figure kneeling on a small, octagonal base. The figure is nude except for a loose cloth wrapped around its waist and a soft cap covering its hair. Its body faces to the left, but the head turns toward the viewer with a slight smile. The figure's left arm is raised near the side of its head, while the right arm rests lower against its chest. The metal has a dark, shiny finish that catches the light on the figure's muscles and face.

title: Benjamin Silliman (1779-1864), B.A. 1796, M.A. 1799
alt_text: A painting of a mature man with white hair, shown from the chest up. The man has a serious expression and is wearing a dark blue coat over a white collared shirt with a dark necktie. He is positioned against a dark, shadowy background that is lighter near his head. The portrait is enclosed within an ornate, rectangular gold frame. A small gold plaque with engraved text is attached to the bottom center of the frame.

title: Head cloth
alt_text: An embroidered cotton textile shows a white cloth square with decorative edges and patterns. A wide band of dark, intricate geometric stitching runs along two adjacent sides of the fabric. Long, knotted tassels hang from the very edge of these two sides, creating a fringe. A dark, branch-like floral pattern of embroidery extends inward from the corner where the two decorated sides meet. The large, open center of the fabric is plain and unadorned.

title: Headdress
alt_text: An embroidered linen textile features complex, colorful stitching on a light, cream-colored background. The fabric is divided into a grid pattern by straight lines, and each square contains a star-like, geometric design made of red, blue, and green threads. A wide, horizontal band runs across the left side and bottom edge, decorated with an intricate, repeating pattern in reddish-orange thread. The entire outer border ends with delicate, lace-like fringe hanging down. Small knots of orange thread mark the intersections of the grid lines.

title: Headdress
alt_text: An embroidered cotton cloth shows a large, square piece of white fabric with decorations on two sides. A detailed pattern of small, dark, floral shapes is stitched into the bottom-left corner of the fabric. Along the left and bottom edges of the cloth, there is a decorative border with geometric shapes. Fringed edges hang down from these same two sides of the square. The rest of the large cloth is plain, smooth white fabric.

title: Plain cloth embroidered
alt_text: A textile shows a repeating geometric pattern across its rectangular surface. The design is made of dark, interlocking shapes that form a grid of squares and diamonds. These darker lines frame lighter-colored diamond shapes filled with small, intricate details. Along the top edge, a narrow, solid border runs horizontally. The entire surface maintains this consistent, lattice-like motif from side to side.

title: Landscape with Figure
alt_text: A painting of a landscape with a person standing near water. On the left side, calm water stretches across the scene with low grasses and reeds growing along the bank. A cluster of tall, thin trees rises from the center of the frame, their leaves painted in shades of muted green. In the lower right corner, a person wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a dark skirt stands facing the trees while holding a long, thin stick. Above the land, the large, cloudy sky is filled with soft streaks of blue, pink, and purple light.

title: River Scene
alt_text: A painting of a quiet river landscape in autumn. A calm body of water fills the middle of the scene, reflecting the soft, light-colored sky above. Several trees line the riverbank, with some showing bright yellow and orange leaves. In the foreground, a large patch of tall, dry grasses leans over the water. A thin, dark line of trees stands in the distance, separating the water from the horizon.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Saints Peter Martyr and Vincent Ferrer(?) and Adoring Angels
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
