alt_text: A painting of a woman in a long blue robe sitting on a bench with a small baby lying on her lap. Several small figures with wings stand behind the bench, and they look toward the woman and the child. Two men wearing dark robes with hoods kneel on either side of the woman with their hands pressed together in prayer. The man on the right holds a small, light-colored book in his hands. The background is painted in a flat, textured gold color that covers the entire upper half of the image.

title: Roger Sherman
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory depicts a portrait of a fair-skinned person with short, straight brown hair. The person faces forward with a serious expression and wears a plain, dark-colored coat over a light-colored shirt. This oval portrait sits inside a shiny gold frame with a textured edge. The frame is mounted on a larger, rectangular black panel that has a slightly cracked surface. A small, golden decorative loop shaped like a cluster of grapes sits at the very top of the black panel for hanging.

title: Lester Wallach (1820-1888)
alt_text: A painting of a man's face and shoulders is centered inside a small, oval frame. The subject has long, wavy brown hair, dark eyes, and a thin mustache. He wears a white shirt with a blue collar, layered underneath a reddish-brown coat. The portrait is painted on a board and encircled by a thin, textured gold border. This inner part is set against a much larger, smooth black frame that is also oval in shape. A small brass loop sits at the very top of the frame for hanging.

title: The Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting of a crowded scene centers on a figure hanging on a wooden cross against a shimmering gold background. To the left, a group of figures in long, colorful robes stands with somber expressions, while one person kneels at the base of the cross. To the right, another group of people wears varied hats and robes, with one man pointing upward toward the cross. The ground beneath the cross shows small splashes of red paint, suggesting blood. All the figures are painted in a flat style with bright, primary colors and gold halos around their heads.

title: Plain cloth embroidered
alt_text: A textile of linen showing a repeating pattern of floral and animal designs in red and green thread. The main pattern features stylized plants with large red leaves and tall green centers that look like small trees. Small, four-legged animals in red are scattered among the plants near the top of each horizontal band. Horizontal borders with complex geometric shapes run across the top and bottom of the cloth. The base fabric is a light, neutral beige color that contrasts with the colorful embroidery.

title: Plain cloth, embroidered
medium: Closely woven cotton cloth, embroidered in red silk in a carefully counted darning stitch
alt_text: A textile of cotton cloth embroidered in red silk shows a rectangular piece of fabric covered in a repeating geometric pattern. This intricate design consists of small, interconnected squares that form a grid across the entire surface. Inside each square, delicate, swirling lines create symmetrical shapes that look like stylized flowers or leaves. A thin border with a simple repeating pattern frames the edges of the rectangular cloth. The background is a light, neutral color, while the embroidered stitching is a darker, muted shade.

title: Piece of embroidery made into a bag
medium: The ground a coarse cotton cloth
alt_text: A textile pouch made of coarse cotton cloth shows elaborate embroidery in shades of orange, red, and purple. Two thin, dark braided straps extend upwards from the top edge of the rectangular pouch. The center of the design features a large, ornate floral shape with rounded curves. Surrounding this central design are dense geometric patterns of leaves and smaller flowers covering the entire surface. A black identification tag with white text reading "1938.360" rests against the bottom edge of the pouch.

title: George Washington and Miss Custis
alt_text: A painting of three people inside a room with dark wood walls and a bright red carpet. On the left, a woman stands wearing a long, light blue dress. In the center, an older woman with white hair sits in a red velvet chair. A man with white hair stands next to the seated woman, wearing a dark coat and a pale yellow vest. Two small, framed pictures hang on the wall in the background behind the figures.

title: The Vision of Pope Innocent III; Saints Peter and Paul Appearing to Saint Dominic
alt_text: A painting of two hooded figures standing in front of light-colored, architectural buildings. On the left, a figure with a golden halo stands facing a tall, pale wall with hands raised upward against it. In the center, there is a small, pink-colored building with an open doorway showing a draped bed inside. To the right, another figure wearing a dark cloak and a golden halo kneels in an open rectangular space. Above this kneeling figure, two smaller, pale, angelic faces float in a cluster of blue cloud-like shapes. The entire scene is set against a background of cracked, pale stone and a patch of bright blue sky at the top left.

title: Gibraltar
alt_text: A painting of several ships sailing near a very large, steep rock formation in the sea. The choppy, dark water occupies the foreground with whitecaps visible on the waves. In the center, a ship with white sails leans slightly as it cuts through the water. A larger, darker ship is positioned to the left in the background. A towering, rocky mountain rises behind the ships, filling much of the upper right side of the view. The sky above is filled with soft, light-colored clouds.

title: Tivoli
alt_text: A painting of a landscape features a tall, square tower overlooking a vast, distant city. The tower stands near the middle right, partly obscured by dark, leafy trees. In the foreground, the ground is shadowed and filled with patches of thick brush. Small, faint figures are scattered near the bottom of the scene among the dark trees. The background fades into a bright, hazy sky behind the sprawling urban area on the rolling hills.

title: Cesare Borgia Receiving Delegates from Julius II at Ostia
alt_text: A painting of people gathered inside a large, arched stone room. On the left side, three figures stand with their backs to the viewer, wearing long, bright red robes that drape down to the floor. Next to them stands a person in a dark green robe. Across from them on the right, a man in a pale vest and dark pants stands by a thick stone column. Near the column, another person wears dark clothing with red leggings and faces toward the group. The room is dimly lit, but an opening in the back wall shows a patch of bright, pale sky.

title: Tasso Entering the Convent of St. Onofrio
alt_text: A painting shows a group of people gathered inside a covered walkway with stone arches and columns. Several men wearing long, dark robes and tunics stand together in the center of the scene. They appear to be in conversation with one another, gesturing with their hands. On the right side, tall columns line a raised ledge, and one figure stands near the edge in the shadows. The entire scene is framed within a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: Roman Gateway
alt_text: A painting of a stone structure in a landscape with figures in the foreground. Large, weathered brick ruins covered in patches of green vines tower over the center and left of the scene. To the left, a rectangular stone block is marked with text that appears to read "ROMA 1827." Underneath an archway in the center of the ruins, three people are walking together. The person in the middle wears a white dress and head covering, while the two figures on either side wear darker clothing. The scene is cast in muted, brownish tones, with a hazy light suggesting either dawn or dusk.

title: Franconia Notch -- White Mountains
canvas_label: This Image was Created for documentation purposes prior to going off site to 300 Prospect- photographed on August 12, 2008
alt_text: A painting of a vast valley nestled between several large mountains. The scene is dominated by a wide, cloudy sky filled with soft grays and hints of white light. Below the mountains, the valley floor is a patchwork of dark greens, browns, and open fields. A few small, scattered buildings sit nestled among trees in the lower left and right areas. The entire landscape is shown in dim, earthy tones, suggesting either early morning or late afternoon light.

title: Good News
alt_text: A painting of two figures in a dark, indoor setting, enclosed in an ornate, gold-colored frame. One figure stands on the left, wearing light-colored clothing and holding a document or light-colored object in their hands. A second figure sits to the right, wearing a dark cap and patterned clothing, partially obscured by shadows. The background is shadowy and indistinct, suggesting a room with simple furniture like a chair. There is a visible tear or damaged area in the upper left section of the canvas where light shines through.

title: Venetian Water Carriers
alt_text: A painting showing a family standing in an outdoor stone courtyard. A man with a red cap leans toward a woman who wears a black hat and dark clothing. She holds a small child in her arms near the center of the scene. To the left, another woman stands in the shadows near a doorway, facing away from the group. The background features old, weathered buildings and a faint blue sky.

title: Street Scene (children under umbrella)
alt_text: A painting of two figures walking in the rain under a large, bright red umbrella. The two people appear to be children dressed in dark, warm clothing and are walking through a puddle on a stone path. Behind them is an arched doorway or entrance, where the faint shapes of other people are visible inside. To the right of the doorway, a small, dark barrel sits on the ground. The scene is set in an outdoor area with muted, brownish tones and an overall sense of dim, rainy weather. A thick, ornate, gold-colored frame surrounds the entire painting.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a quiet, sunlit valley with a stone bridge in the distance. The scene is framed by tall, dark trees on the left and a smaller tree on the right side. In the center, a calm river flows under the arched bridge toward the horizon where soft hills rise up. Along the grassy path in the foreground, two figures stand near a person sitting on the ground. The painting is enclosed in a thick, textured gold frame.

title: Apollo and Daphne
alt_text: A textile painting on linen shows a large rectangular scene framed by decorative borders. The center features a landscape with two standing figures positioned among trees and rocks. Two large, ornate columns stand on the left and right sides of the main scene, decorated with floral patterns and carved details. Above the central scene, small winged figures sit on pedestals at the top of each column. A complex, swirled floral design fills the space along the bottom edge of the hanging.

title: Linen cloth embroidered in wool
alt_text: An embroidered linen textile shows repeating floral patterns stitched in reddish-orange and pale green thread. The design is organized into horizontal bands with vines, leaves, and blooms separated by straight lines of matching orange thread. Along the left side and the bottom edge, there is a distinct, sheer pleated ruffle with a scalloped hem. At the top center, the letters "G.P." are embroidered in a simple dark font. The fabric has a light, cream-colored background throughout the piece.

title: Brutus and His Friends at the Death of Lucretia
alt_text: A painting of several figures gathered inside a dark room with heavy curtains. On the left, a woman in a white dress sits slumped on a chair, while a person behind her covers their face with a red cloth and another woman kneels at her feet. On the right, a man in a blue tunic and gold sandals stands and points toward the seated woman. Two older men, one with a gray beard, stand next to the man in blue while looking in the same direction. A patch of bright red color, resembling liquid, is visible on the floor near the woman's feet.

title: Bust of John C. Calhoun
alt_text: A sculpture of a man's head and shoulders is captured from the chest up. This white porcelain bust shows a man with wavy, short hair and a serious, looking-down expression. He wears a piece of fabric draped over his shoulders like a toga. The bust rests on a dark, tiered circular wooden stand. Behind the sculpture, a row of dark books sits on a shelf in a dim, shadowed room.

title: Allegory of Virtue
alt_text: A wool textile shows a long, rectangular scene filled with several people dressed in flowing robes and armor. In the center, a woman stands near a tree while a figure in armor walks past her toward the right. To the left, another pair of figures stands in a landscape with rolling hills. On the right side, a man in a cape and a woman stand together near more trees and plants. A wide, elaborate border made of woven flowers, leaves, and fruits frames the entire picture.

title: Five pieces peasant embroidery on linen
alt_text: A textile showing a rectangular piece of fabric decorated with colorful embroidery. A large, stylized plant with orange flowers grows up the center of the fabric. Smaller orange and blue floral patterns weave along the left and right edges. There is a decorative, lacy trim running along the right side of the piece. The background fabric is a light, neutral color that provides contrast for the stitching.

title: James Hillhouse(1754-1832), B.A. 1773, M.A. 1776, LL.D. 1823.
alt_text: A painting of a man shows his head and shoulders against a dark background. He is a middle-aged man with gray hair styled away from his face. He wears a dark coat over a high-collared white shirt or cravat. His expression is serious, and he looks directly toward the viewer. The lighting is soft and focuses primarily on his face.

title: James Abraham Hillhouse(1789-1841), B.A. 1808, M.A. 1811 (copy after John Vanderlyn)
alt_text: A painting shows a portrait of a man, visible from the chest up. The man has short, dark brown hair and is looking directly at the viewer with a calm expression. He is wearing a dark coat, a dark waistcoat, and a white collared shirt underneath. The background behind him is very dark and shadowy. The portrait is housed in a large, ornate, gold-colored frame with decorative carvings.

title: Pillow cover
alt_text: An embroidered textile shows a long, rectangular piece of light-colored cloth decorated with symmetrical plant designs. The top and bottom ends feature a row of five pointed, arch-like shapes containing small leaf patterns. In the center, a large circular motif surrounds a stylized flower, which is framed by two large, curved, leaf-like shapes on either side. Above and below this central section, a vertical tulip-like shape sits between two flower blossoms. The entire design uses contrasting dark and light thread colors against the plain fabric background.

title: Length of compound satin
alt_text: A silk textile with a dark, possibly black or dark brown background shows a symmetrical pattern in cream and light green threads. The fabric is rectangular and lies flat on a light-colored surface. A long, vertical panel runs down the center, flanked on either side by a scene featuring a seated figure and stylized plant motifs. Small, repeating floral shapes are scattered across the rest of the dark background. At the very bottom, two horizontal, framed panels each show a figure leaning forward while holding an object.

title: Solid twill cut velvet
alt_text: A textile of red silk shows a rectangular piece of fabric edged with a gold border. The fabric is a deep, solid red color and has a slightly shiny surface. A wide, metallic gold ribbon runs along the right side and bottom edge of the cloth. This gold trim has a decorative, scalloped edge on both sides. A small white label with black numbers sits at the very bottom center of the image.

title: Saddle cloth
alt_text: A textile of red velvet shows ornate embroidery in gold and light-colored thread. The main fabric is a deep, rich red, decorated with large, sweeping floral patterns that swirl across the right side. The entire piece is trimmed with a border of dark green fabric and thick, dangling red fringe. Strands of blue or grey fringe also accent the edges, adding color contrast to the design. A rectangular, black object with the white numbers "1939.520" sits on the white surface in the foreground.

title: Compound cloth, brocaded
alt_text: A silk textile shows a patterned green fabric unrolling from a grey cardboard tube. The dark green material is covered in an intricate design of metallic gold floral shapes and winding vines. These shimmering patterns repeat across the surface of the rectangular piece of cloth. At the bottom edge, a small, dark rectangular tag displays the white numbers "1939.521". The entire object rests on a flat, light-colored surface.

title: 3 Children Playing With Cats
alt_text: A painting shows two children and a young boy playing with animals outdoors against a stone wall. On the left, a small girl sits on a simple wooden chair, while a young boy stands behind her leaning against the wall. A cat sits on a ledge near them. On the right, a second girl kneels on the ground, holding a small dog in her arms. The background features a quiet field and trees under a hazy sky, all enclosed within an ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Compound satin, brocaded
alt_text: A textile of silk shows an intricate, symmetrical embroidered design on a pale, light-colored background. The pattern features mirrored images of large, spiky flowers, leafy vines, and trees spread across the surface. A gold-colored fringe borders the bottom and sides of the fabric. The overall shape is rectangular with rounded bottom corners. At the bottom, a black tag displays the white number "1939.524."

title: Piece of a Chasuble
alt_text: A silk textile shows a repeating pattern of stylized flowers and large, leafy plants in shades of cream, muted orange, pale blue, and soft green. The fabric is shaped like a padded cushion or a seat cover with stitched lines separating vertical sections of the design. A dark, narrow ribbon or trim runs along the bottom edge of the fabric. Beneath the textile, a wooden stand holds a small black label with the white numbers "1939,533" printed on it. The background shows a blurry workshop or office setting on a white table surface.

title: Piece
alt_text: A textile made of silk liseré displays a square piece of fabric with floral patterns. The background is a light, neutral beige color. Large, leafy branches with blue and green tones stretch across the center and upper right. Clusters of small flowers in shades of red, pink, and yellow are scattered among the leaves. A solid, darker yellow border frames the edges of the square fabric.

title: Compound cloth, brocaded
alt_text: A silk textile shows a pattern of repeating vertical stripes in shades of orange, green, and cream. The fabric is folded over on the left side, showing both the front and back layers of the cloth. Intricate floral and leafy designs are woven throughout each stripe, giving the material a textured look. A small black label with the white number "1939.536" rests on the white surface below the fabric. The overall background is a plain, light-colored table or display area.

title: Three Princesses
alt_text: A marble sculpture with mosaic inlay shows three standing women wearing crowns and long, flowing robes. They are carved from pale white stone and stand side-by-side in a row. Each figure has her hair styled upward and wears a simple, jeweled band around her forehead. The two outer women look forward, while the woman in the middle looks toward the left. Behind them, a colorful mosaic background features a pattern of tiny red, green, and blue triangles.

title: The Coronation of the Virgin
alt_text: A painting of two figures sitting on a throne, with many angels surrounding them. The figure on the right, wearing a blue robe and red tunic, places a crown on the head of the figure on the left, who wears a light pink dress. Both central figures have golden circular halos around their heads. The throne sits against a backdrop featuring a colorful, patterned tapestry and a peaked, golden archway. On either side of the throne, numerous small angels with golden halos look toward the center. Two angels kneel in the foreground, each playing a stringed instrument.

title: Angelo and Isabella, Measure for Measure, Act II, Scene IV
alt_text: A painting of a person wearing a pale, long-sleeved robe and a head covering sits on a simple wooden chair. The figure is positioned to the right and faces slightly toward the left of the frame. Behind the figure, a large, dark rectangular table or structure stands against a wall in the background. The entire scene is painted in muted, grayish tones with soft lighting. The surface of the painting appears slightly worn or aged.

title: Sophia Watson (1734–1809)
alt_text: A pencil and wash miniature on vellum shows a portrait of a woman. She faces forward with her head tilted slightly to the right, looking directly at the viewer. Her dark hair is pulled back with soft curls framing her face and falling over her shoulders. She wears a simple, light-colored dress with a small, dark pendant hanging from a chain around her neck. The portrait is enclosed in a simple, smooth, black oval frame set against a plain gray background.

title: Russian Still Life
alt_text: A painting of various abstract shapes and Russian letters in bright, flat colors. A large, circular orange blob dominates the left side, covered with dark letters and brown marks. On the right side, there is a tall, reddish-orange shape that looks like a simplified face or figure with geometric cutouts. Behind these main shapes, patches of yellow, light green, and pink fill the background. Many scattered words in a dark, serif font are printed across the surface, some partially hidden by the shapes. Narrow, striped vertical bars in muted tones appear at the very bottom of the canvas.

title: Compound cloth with satin stripes
medium: Main warp light blue with white, pink, purple, brown and green added as needed
alt_text: A textile showing a rectangular piece of fabric with a striped pattern. The background is a soft, muted blue-green color. Vertical stripes in pale yellow and white run down the length of the fabric. Small, delicate floral patterns are woven into these stripes. A dark, textured border runs along the edges of the cloth. A black tag with the number "1938.66" is attached to the bottom edge.

title: Portrait of Andreas Vesalius, Anatomist (1514–1564)
alt_text: A painting of a man standing indoors. He has short hair and a neatly trimmed beard. He wears a dark, long-sleeved jacket with a subtle pattern and has one hand resting on his hip. His other hand rests on a stone ledge next to a large, vertical column on the left side of the frame. The background behind him is dark and simple.

title: Hunter on Horseback
alt_text: A painting of a man riding a horse through a snowy landscape. The man sits in the middle of the frame, wearing a dark coat, a scarf, and a hat. He holds the reins loosely as the dark brown horse lowers its head toward the snow. Behind them, the background shows a flat, gray, and wintry field under a cloudy, overcast sky. The entire scene uses muted colors, focusing on the dark silhouette of the rider and his horse against the light snow.

title: Bin-Tah, The Wounded Man
alt_text: A painting of a person's head and shoulders shown from the front. The person has dark skin, dark hair with straight bangs, and a small white object resting on the tip of their nose. Large, flat, circular ornaments hang from their ears. Around their neck is a beaded collar and a thin necklace with small red and white beads. The background is a muted, brownish-gray oval shape set against a lighter, textured wood grain surface.

title: Jeremiah Dummer the Younger (c. 1679-1739)
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in front of a bookshelf. He wears a large, light-colored powdered wig that curls down to his shoulders. He is dressed in a dark brown coat over a white cravat and shirt with ruffled cuffs. A bright red cloth is draped over his waist and arm. One of his hands rests on the top of a thick book on a shelf, while the other hand rests on his hip. Behind him, rows of leather-bound books fill the dark, shadowy room.

title: George Washington at the Battle of Princeton
alt_text: A painting of a man in a military uniform standing in a field. He wears a blue coat with gold details, a white vest, white pants, and tall black boots. His right hand rests on his hip, while his left hand rests on the barrel of a large cannon. Behind him on the right, a man holds the reins of a brown horse, and a blue flag with white stars hangs above. On the ground at the bottom of the painting, there is a crumpled red flag and other fabric with gold trim. In the distance, a small group of soldiers marches across an open, grassy area under a stormy sky.

title: Marcus Furius Camillus Expels King Brennus of Gaul from Rome
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting of a crowded scene filled with people on horseback and on foot is set inside a rectangular wooden panel. On the left side, figures in colorful clothing stand near stone buildings and a tall tower. The right side is dominated by a dense group of knights and horses, some holding spears or flags. Golden, dome-topped structures appear in the upper right corner above the bustling crowd. The entire painting is framed by a wide, textured border of unfinished light-colored wood.

title: The Blessing Redeemer
alt_text: A painting of a central figure set against a gold background, painted on a wooden panel with a pointed top. The figure has long brown hair, a serious expression, and a decorative gold halo behind their head. They are wearing a blue robe with a pinkish drape over their shoulder and a yellow sash around their waist. The figure holds up their right hand in a gesture, and their left hand holds an open book filled with dark writing. The entire piece is framed by simple, light-colored wooden edges.

title: Mourning Virgin
alt_text: A painting of a figure draped in a blue cloak against a textured gold background. The figure faces to the left with their head bowed low, obscuring their face. Their pale hands are held out together in front of their chest, palms facing slightly upward. A large, circular halo made of dotted patterns surrounds the figure's head. The entire surface of the painting shows extensive cracking in the paint and gold leaf.

title: Seven Sleepers of Ephesus
alt_text: A painting on wood of a group of six figures resting inside a dark cave. The oval-shaped scene is framed by a border of gold leaf that is cracked and worn in several places. Inside the deep, shadow-filled cave, five people are sitting or kneeling, while a sixth person is curled up and lying down on the ground. Each figure has a thin, circular halo painted above their head. Their clothing is painted in muted tones of red, blue, and green, with several areas of the paint surface chipped or missing.

title: Late Afternoon
alt_text: A painting of a dark, shadowy forest clearing with a bright patch of light in the center. Tall, dense trees with dark brown and black leaves frame the sides of the scene. In the middle, the dense canopy opens up to reveal a glowing yellow and gold sky. Below the trees, the ground appears to be a muddy or watery clearing in deep shadows. The overall mood is moody and dim, with the light in the center providing the only clear focus.

title: Moonlit Landscape with Indians
alt_text: A painting of a dark, moody landscape with several people sitting on the ground. The scene is dominated by deep browns and shadowy tones that suggest a setting at twilight or night. In the center, a small group of three people sits together on the darkened earth near a large, shadowy tree on the left. A fourth person sits alone slightly to the right, facing the others. Thick trees and foliage border both sides of the scene, while the background reveals a faint, glowing strip of horizon under a murky sky.

title: Book of Hours
medium: Tempera, ink, shell gold, and gold leaf on vellum
alt_text: A manuscript page shows a decorative calendar layout framed by intricate, floral vine borders. In a square panel on the left side, two pale, upper-body figures emerge from behind a golden shield against a blue sky and green landscape. To the right of this panel, the text is arranged in several columns containing Roman numerals and lines of dark blue and red cursive letters. Two large, ornate capital letters colored in blue, red, and gold break up the columns of text. The entire page is framed by winding vines filled with tiny green leaves, small red strawberries, and blue flowers on a light background.

title: Fox Trot A
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a diamond-shaped work inside a thin, light-colored frame. The background of the painting is a solid, textured white. Three straight, black vertical and horizontal lines stretch across the white space. The lines do not connect all the way to the edges of the frame in some places, but they do intersect with each other to create open shapes. A small, dark signature is visible on one of the horizontal lines near the left side.

title: Charles Woodward Stearns (1817-1887), B.A. 1837
alt_text: A painting of a young man with short, light brown hair. He is wearing a dark jacket with a row of gold buttons and a tall, crisp white collar. A dark tie or cravat sits neatly at the center of his neck. The man is placed inside a soft, oval shape that stands out against the dark background. A thick, textured gold-colored frame surrounds the entire piece.

title: L'Apres-midi de Septembre
alt_text: A painting of a vast, open landscape under a large and colorful sky. Dark, soft clouds fill the upper portion of the frame in shades of purple and deep blue. Below the sky, rolling hills covered in green and brown grasses stretch across the horizon. A dirt path is barely visible in the dark foreground. The entire scene is encased in an ornate, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: Niagara Falls
alt_text: A painting showing a massive waterfall cascading down a cliff face on the left side of the scene. The water falls in a wide, misty sheet, creating a thick fog at the base of the rocks. A rocky, uneven shoreline stretches across the bottom foreground, filled with large stones and rubble. A small, dark bird stands on a prominent flat rock in the center foreground near the water's edge. In the distance to the right, a second waterfall is visible with a faint rainbow hovering in the sky above it. The sky above is dark and cloudy, casting a somber light over the entire landscape.

title: Landscape with Birds (?)
alt_text: A wool textile shows a peaceful landscape filled with large trees, buildings, and birds. Two long-necked birds stand in the foreground, one on the left and one on the right. Lush, leafy plants grow near the bottom of the scene. In the distance, a small town with several buildings sits on rolling hills. The overall scene is shaded in muted tones, suggesting a quiet forest or garden area.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting on wood of a person wearing an elaborate gown, a crown, and a tall, triangular-shaped dress. The figure holds a small child on one shoulder and wears a thick chain around their neck that hangs down to a cross pendant. Below the cross, a golden crescent moon shape is centered on the front of the skirt. The background consists of dark curtains draped on either side of the figure. The overall image has a worn and textured appearance with faded colors.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LL.D. 1781(after Jean Antoinette Houdon)
alt_text: A painting of a man facing slightly to his left with his arms crossed over his chest. He has light, shoulder-length hair tied back and is wearing a dark coat over a pale, ruffled shirt. The background is a dark, muted tone that highlights his face and upper body. He is set inside a heavy, rectangular wooden frame carved with detailed patterns of flowers and vines. At the top center of the frame, there is a small eagle carving. The painting has a small, bright cross-shaped mark on the sleeve of his coat.

title: Beach Scene in Trouville
alt_text: A painting of a crowded beach scene under a cloudy blue sky. Many small, indistinct figures sit and stand across the sandy foreground. Several people are gathered near the water, while others are huddled in groups further back. A large expanse of sea stretches horizontally across the middle of the frame, meeting a distant coastline. The brushstrokes are loose and textured throughout the entire scene.

title: Two Kings (Tetrarchs?)
alt_text: A wooden sculpture showing two figures standing side-by-side next to a tall, dark green wooden panel. The figures are carved from wood, with worn gold-colored paint on their long, pleated robes and faces. They have beards and appear to be wearing crowns or headgear. The tall panel on the left has a smooth, curved top and is covered in a deep green velvet fabric. A small white rectangular tag with black text sits on the surface below the figures. The entire arrangement rests on a light-colored, textured background.

title: Harlequin and Woman
alt_text: A painting shows two figures standing against a backdrop of deep red curtains within an arched frame. On the left stands a figure wearing a tall, dark hat and a patterned tunic with a brown and tan diamond design. This figure places one hand on the shoulder of the figure beside them. On the right stands a pale, undressed figure with long dark hair, whose hand rests on a low, grey stone-like ledge in front. Both figures have simplified, geometric facial features with dark, direct eyes.

title: Gate
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes layered against a vibrant purple background. In the center, a large, dark gray rectangle stands upright with slightly tilted edges. Inside this shape, a smaller, darker gray trapezoid creates a framing effect. A bright white rectangle sits at the very center, appearing like a glowing opening. Thin, white outlines define the borders between the shapes, separating the dark colors from the purple border.

title: Come hither, gracious sovereign, view this body, King Henry VI, Part II, Act III, Scene II
alt_text: A painting of several figures standing in a dimly lit room with a black-and-white checkered floor. In the foreground, a man in a long, dark robe stands with his head bowed and hands clasped together. Beside him, a figure dressed in armor wears a tunic marked with a large, light-colored cross. Heavy, deep red curtains hang on the right side, partially obscuring a white cloth or garment behind them. Other dimly lit figures are visible in the background, appearing to watch the scene from the shadows. The floor is covered in part by a rough, gray textured mat or rug.

title: Figure Study
alt_text: A painting of a person’s face looking upward. The artwork is composed of three separate pieces of board that are laid horizontally on top of each other. The person's eyes and forehead appear on the top segment, their nose and mouth on the middle segment, and the lower part of their face and neck on the bottom segment. The face is painted in tones of peach, white, and brown, and it is framed by dark, messy brushstrokes of brown paint. A thin, uneven white line runs horizontally across the face where the pieces of board do not perfectly align.

title: Landscape Study
alt_text: An oil painting on a wood panel shows a peaceful landscape with a large tree in the center. The tree has a thick, light-colored trunk and bare, arching branches that spread across the upper half of the scene. In the foreground, a large patch of solid, light green grass stretches across the bottom portion. A dark, elongated shadow from the tree rests on the grass to the left. Behind the tree, a darker green area suggests bushes or foliage, with a small wooden fence visible on the left side.

title: Architectural Study
alt_text: A painting of a stone pedestal set against a dark background. The pedestal stands upright in the center and has a rectangular base with a flat top. It is colored in shades of light tan and brown. To the right of the pedestal, a vertical, shadowy form hints at another object behind it. The overall surface looks aged and worn, with visible wood grain patterns throughout. A small white label with black numbers sits at the bottom edge of the frame.

title: Architectural Study
alt_text: A painting of architectural columns and walls. To the left, a large, light-tan square pillar stands in the foreground, with a horizontal ledge cutting across its middle. Next to it, a tall, round column stands in the center, casting a long, dark shadow on the floor. Behind these shapes, more walls and pillar fragments recede into a shadowy background of brown and grey tones. The entire scene is painted in muted, earthy colors with soft, blended brushstrokes. A small, white label with numbers is attached to the bottom edge of the frame.

title: Architectural Study
alt_text: A painting in oil on wood panel shows a dim, indoor space with vertical structural columns. Two smooth, pale gray pillars rise up in the center and to the left of the composition, standing on blocky bases. On the right, a darker shape resembling a seated person is positioned against the back wall. The background is painted in muted, neutral tones of gray, cream, and faint brown. A thin, horizontal ledge or floor line creates depth toward the bottom of the scene.

title: Figure Study of an Angel
medium: Oil with applied gold leaf on wood panel
alt_text: A painting of a standing figure with large red wings against a gold background. The figure is centered and wears a long, pale blue robe that covers their body from the shoulders down. Their head is rounded and pale, without distinct facial features. Large wings with red feathers spread out behind the figure's upper body. To the left of the figure, an etched gold-colored shape resembles a small crest or symbol. The entire surface has a cracked, weathered texture with areas of worn gold leaf.

title: Architectural Study
alt_text: A painting in oil on a wood panel shows a curved balcony above several standing figures. At the top, a rounded railing features a row of pale, spindly columns. Below this balcony, two distinct figures stand like statues on narrow, square bases. These figures are light in color and have simple, human-like shapes. A third, much fainter figure stands on the right side against a dark, murky background.

title: Landscape Study
alt_text: A painting of a landscape on a wood panel shows a cityscape at dusk. A tall, square tower stands prominently on the left side of the scene. The center is filled with many low, blocky buildings painted in soft, muted tan and brown tones. In the distance, a dark purple-blue sky stretches above the town, with a hint of a light orange horizon line near the top. Vertical streaks are visible throughout the paint surface, especially across the sky area.

title: Mon Repos, Corfu
alt_text: A painting of gnarled trees in a field shows a sunny outdoor scene. The painting features three large trees with thick, twisted trunks that dominate the foreground and middle ground. The ground is colored in shades of sandy tan and yellow, with dark, defined shadows stretching out from the tree bases. Above the trees, the background contains soft patches of green foliage and hints of a pale, light blue sky. The overall color palette uses muted greens, browns, and warm yellows to create the feeling of a bright, sunlit day.

title: Compositional Study, possibly for A Poet
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows three figures in a dimly lit, brownish space. One central figure stands tall in a dark robe with an arm raised upward. To the lower left, a seated figure wears a blue garment. Another figure, dressed in a bright red robe, sits on the lower right side. Above the figures, two pale, indistinct vertical shapes hang down from the top edge. The overall scene is dark and hazy, with very few details visible.

title: Compositional Study, possibly for A Measure
alt_text: A painting shows two figures standing in a dimly lit, shadowy room with muted brown and gray tones. On the left, a figure wears a long, flowing white garment that appears to drape to the floor. Facing this person, a second figure stands in profile wearing a darker, reddish-orange cloak. The background is indistinct, suggesting architectural details like an archway or columns lost in the darkness. Two faint, vertical streaks of bright white light shine down from the upper center of the composition. The entire scene has a hazy, blurred quality, making the details of the figures and their surroundings difficult to discern.

title: Architectural Study of a Garden
alt_text: A painting of a stone structure standing near a staircase in a garden. The central focus is a tall, rectangular pedestal made of light brown and gray stone. On top of the pedestal sits a rounded shape, possibly a fountain bowl or decorative ornament. To the right, a set of wide, weathered stone steps leads upwards and into the shadows. The background is filled with dark, indistinct shapes of greenery or foliage. The entire scene is painted in earthy tones of brown, olive green, and gray.

title: Architectural Study
alt_text: A painting on a wood panel shows a view of old, stone architectural structures. The scene is dominated by tall columns and partial walls painted in shades of muted brown and gray. Through gaps in the stone, patches of bright blue sky and the roofs of other buildings are visible. Shadows are cast across the surface, giving the stone walls a weathered and aged appearance. The perspective focuses on the corner of a building, leading the eye into the depth of the structure.

title: Architectural Study
alt_text: A painting of the exterior facade of an old building. The building is painted in muted tones of cream, tan, and brown, with a weathered, textured look. The upper level features a balcony with vertical columns and a curved archway. Below the balcony, the wall has rectangular doorways and arched openings. A patch of blue sky appears in the top left corner behind the roofline. The overall perspective is angled, showing the side and front of the structure.

title: Compositional Study, possibly for A Measure
alt_text: A painting of an indoor scene in oil on wood panel shows several figures interacting in a room with brown walls. In the foreground, a group of people wearing bright, long garments in white, yellow, and red stand together. To the left, there are indistinct figures dressed in dark colors. A tall, rectangular opening with a bright blue arched top appears in the upper right background. The room has textured, earthy-brown walls and dim lighting that creates a hazy atmosphere.

title: Figure Study
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in a doorway. The man wears a pale, tall hat, a bright yellow jacket with puffy sleeves, and dark green pants. He holds one hand on the door frame while standing on a brick floor. To his left, stone stairs lead up into a dark, shadowy space. The scene is framed by a heavy stone wall on the left and a flat, brown door on the right.

title: Compositional Study of Figures in a Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman walking together on a path. The man wears a dark suit and hat, while the woman wears a long, light-colored dress and a small hat. They are positioned in the center, walking in front of a weathered wooden fence that crosses the middle of the frame. To the left stands a dark, leafless tree reaching up into the sky. The background shows a soft, orange-tinted sky, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. The ground beneath them is painted in shades of muted green and brown.

title: Study of a Fountain
alt_text: A painting of a dark fountain sitting in a park or wooded area. The fountain is the main subject, taking up the center of the frame, with a wide, bowl-shaped top and a solid base. A small, blurry figure stands in the middle of the fountain basin. Behind the fountain, several tall, dark trees are visible against a muted green and brown background. Patches of white and lighter paint are scattered across the fountain's surface, possibly indicating reflections or wear. The entire scene is painted with loose, dark brushstrokes.

title: Compositional Study, for The Hours, House of Representatives Chamber, Pennsylvania State Capitol, Harrisburg
alt_text: A painting of several figures drawn in dark chalk on a light canvas. On the left, a single standing person with their arm raised near their head faces slightly to the right. To their right, two other figures stand close together in a group. One figure in this pair wears a hood or covering and stands with hands folded near their chest. The figure beside them leans forward slightly, with an arm extended as if resting on the other's shoulder. The lines are loose and sketchy, showing the forms of the figures without fine detail.

title: Compositional Study, for The Hours, House of Representatives Chamber, Pennsylvania State Capitol, Harrisburg
alt_text: A chalk painting on canvas showing five figures standing in a line. The figures are drawn with simple, rough gray lines on a plain background. They are holding hands and facing toward the right side of the image. The figures on the left have more detailed clothing, while the figures on the right are drawn with just stick-like outlines. One small, scribble-like mark appears in the upper right corner near the last figure.

title: Steven Williams of Massachusetts
alt_text: A wax sculpture shows a profile portrait of a person facing to the left. The figure is made of colored wax and is mounted onto a dark, reflective glass surface. The person has wavy brown hair and is wearing clothing draped over their shoulders. The background is a flat, dark rectangular panel with some visible wear and texture. A small metal loop at the top of the frame suggests it is meant for hanging.

title: Figure of a Standing Man, study for The Gates of Hell
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a standing figure with its head bowed. The figure is nude and leans slightly forward with its arms crossed against its chest. Its body surface appears textured and uneven, showing dark shadows and bright highlights from the light. The figure stands on a jagged, irregular base that rests on a simple, round pedestal. The background is a stark, plain white.

title: Philomela
medium: Bronze with reddish-brown and green patina
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a kneeling woman with wings held in her hands. The figure is made of dark reddish-brown metal with subtle greenish highlights on her wings and the base. She has her hair pulled back and looks toward the right side of the image. Her body is bare from the waist up, while a draped cloth covers her legs. She holds a feathered wing in each of her hands, extending them outward from her sides. The entire figure rests on a rectangular, dark green marble base with white veins.

title: La Péri
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a male figure holding a female figure. The male stands behind the woman, his arms wrapped around her as she leans backward. The woman’s body is arched, and her head is tilted back with her eyes closed. Both figures have dark, smooth skin and are positioned on a flat, textured base. This base sits on a square, marble-like platform with brown and black streaks.

title: Coronis and Apollo
alt_text: A painting of a light-skinned person lying on their side in the foreground, while others gather near a fire in the background. The reclining person is mostly undressed and rests on red and white fabrics beneath a large tree with dark, leafy branches. Another person, wearing a dark blue garment, leans forward in front of them with an outstretched arm toward the ground. To the right, near a calm stream, several smaller figures stand and crouch around a glowing fire. The background features dense, dark green trees and a bright blue sky filled with white clouds.

title: Saint Bartholomew
alt_text: A painting of a bare-chested man with a thick, short beard looks upward toward the top right corner. His right arm is raised high above his head, holding a dark, indistinct object. He has a pale complexion and his body is lean with visible muscle structure. A piece of white cloth rests on his lap, and a golden-brown fabric drapes over his lower body. The background is a very dark, shadowy space that makes the man's lighter figure stand out clearly.

title: Corbel with Man Blowing Trumpet
alt_text: A limestone sculpture of a figure in motion. The figure is carved into a rectangular slab of tan stone and is posed with knees bent as if dancing or stepping quickly. One hand is raised high, holding a cone-shaped object that resembles a drinking horn near the figure's mouth. The figure wears tight-fitting clothing with visible seams or belts, and their face is detailed with prominent eyes and a beard. The entire piece is rough and textured, suggesting age and weathering across its surface.

title: Pietà
alt_text: A polychromed wood sculpture of two figures shows one person cradling another in their lap. The figure in the back is a person wearing a pale, loose head covering and robe that hides their hair and shoulders. In front, a person with dark hair and a thin, pale body reclines across the lap of the first figure. The person in front wears only a simple cloth around their waist, and their arms hang loosely downward. Both figures sit together on a rough, uneven base that looks like rocks or earth.

title: Seated Virgin
alt_text: An ivory sculpture of a seated figure wearing a long, flowing garment. The figure has a veil covering their head that drapes down over their shoulders. Deep, vertical folds are carved into the heavy fabric of the clothing covering their legs. The material has a warm, tan, and cream-colored grain that shows age and texture throughout the surface. The figure sits squarely on a block-like base, facing forward with a calm expression.

title: Corpus from a Crucifix
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a human figure with arms outstretched. The figure is made of metal with sections of gold color on the face, chest, and arms. A band of deep blue enamel wraps around the waist like a cloth, showing textured lines. The head is tilted slightly to the side, and the body appears tall and thin. The figure is set against a plain, light-colored fabric background.

title: Mars
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a standing, bearded man looking toward the right. He is shown from the front with his weight shifted onto his left leg. His right arm hangs down with his hand loosely clenched, while his left arm extends forward and to the side with two fingers pointed. The man’s body is muscular and completely unclothed. He stands on a plain, dark rectangular base against a simple gray background.

title: Flayed Figure of a Man
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man standing in a dynamic, athletic pose. The figure is nude and muscular, with his body leaning slightly backward. His left arm reaches up toward the sky with his hand open, while his right arm is bent near his waist with a clenched fist. He stands on a dark, two-tiered rectangular base. The metal surface is smooth, dark brown, and reflects the light on the contours of his muscles.

title: Mademoiselle Greuze
alt_text: A painting of a young person’s head and neck, shown from the side in profile. The subject looks upward and slightly to the left with wide eyes and parted lips. Their skin is pale, and they have wavy, reddish-brown hair pulled back with a dark blue band. A soft, golden fabric is draped around their neck and shoulders, partially covered by a dark blue cloth. The background is a plain, dark, and muted grey color that keeps the focus entirely on the face.

title: Wooded Landscape and Distant Vista
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a cloudy sky over a grassy hill. The scene features a single, bare tree standing atop a brown and green hill on the left side. To the right, the land opens up into a flat, distant horizon with fields and patches of trees. The sky above is filled with fluffy white and grey clouds against a soft blue background. This painting is held within a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame decorated with swirling patterns.

title: Construction in Space with Balance on Two Points
alt_text: A sculpture of plastic, glass, metal, and wood features geometric shapes arranged in a complex, balanced structure. At the base, a flat, rectangular wooden block supports the entire piece. Two large, translucent glass semi-circles rise from this base, creating a bowl-like silhouette. Suspended above these glass curves is a clear plastic square frame with a metallic, diamond-shaped insert inside. A small circular cutout sits in the center of the plastic square, aligning with the diamond shape. Thin, straight rods extend horizontally and vertically, connecting the various parts of the composition.

title: Horse Coopers at the Barnet Fair
alt_text: A painting of a scene outdoors is held within a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame. On the right side of the image, a rider sits on a large, pale horse facing forward. To the left, a man wearing a coat and a hat stands with his back to the viewer, appearing to talk to the rider. Two other figures, also wearing hats, stand slightly behind the man in the foreground. In the background, a small, reddish flag waves against a light sky. The ground below them is flat and tan, suggesting an open field.

title: Harvard-Yale Day, New London
alt_text: A painting of a lively waterside scene with many people enjoying a sunny day. Large, dark tree trunks frame the view on the left and right sides. In the foreground, people sit on a grassy lawn, some holding patterned umbrellas or lounging near beds of red flowers. A yellow car is parked on the grass near a small wooden dock, where a white boat is tied up. Beyond the dock, several white sailboats glide across the blue water under a cloudy sky.

title: Christmas
alt_text: A painting of a snowy city square at night, dominated by a large, brightly lit Christmas tree in the center. The tree stands in a circular skating rink where small, colorful figures are ice skating. Around the edges of the rink, several statues and bust-like figures sit on pedestals, surrounded by people in winter coats. In the background, tall city buildings rise up against a hazy, reddish sky, displaying various glowing neon signs and billboards. The foreground shows people standing or walking on the snowy ground, with one figure dressed in a large feathered headdress.

title: Homage to the Square: Unconditioned
alt_text: A painting shows four concentric squares centered on the canvas. The outermost square is a wide border of medium grey. Inside that is a band of bright blue. Next, there is a square ring of white. The innermost shape is a solid black square in the very center.

title: Judith with the Head of Holefernes; The Sacrifice of Isaac
alt_text: A wood sculpture of a scene with carved figures decorated in gold and paint. The top half shows a woman in a long, gold dress standing and holding a severed head in one hand and a sword in the other. Behind her lies a figure whose neck shows a bright red spot, suggesting an injury. Below this scene, two small winged cherubs kneel on either side of a curved architectural structure. The entire carving is set onto a rectangular wooden board with worn, golden edges.

title: Painting
alt_text: A painting made with oil on canvas shows a very dark, rectangular surface framed in a thin, dark border. The entire image is filled with shades of black and deep charcoal gray. A subtle, vertical T-shaped form can be faintly seen in a slightly lighter shade of dark gray against the darker background. This shape creates a very faint contrast in the center of the canvas. The overall appearance is flat and minimal.

title: Double Portrait of a Man and a Woman
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman in a heavy, ornate gold frame. The man stands on the left wearing a dark coat and a white shirt with a high collar. Beside him, the woman has dark hair styled up and wears a dark brown dress. Both figures face forward against a plain, dark background. Below the framed painting, a white tag with the blue handwritten numbers "1956.28.1" is visible.

title: Saint Bernard; Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting of a man with a shaved head, shown from the chest up. He wears a heavy, white hooded robe with many deep folds. His hands are pressed together in front of his chest as if in prayer. He gazes off to the left with a serious expression. A tall, golden staff with a curved top rests against his shoulder behind him. The background is a solid, dark brown color.

title: Landscape with a Waterfall
alt_text: A painting of a rocky, wooded stream landscape showing tall, jagged rock formations rising on the left side. A dense, dark forest fills the center and background, casting deep shadows over the area. In the lower middle, a small waterfall flows over a rocky ledge into a shallow, rushing stream. Large, mossy stones are scattered throughout the water and along the grassy, shadowed banks. The upper right corner reveals a small glimpse of a bright blue sky peeking through the dark tree branches.

title: A Family Group
alt_text: A painting of a family sitting together on a long, red sofa. A woman in a long, pale grey dress sits on the left side holding a small baby wearing a white cap. A young girl in a simple white dress stands in front of the woman, holding a small doll. On the right side, an older man with white hair wears a dark coat and sits looking at the children. A young boy in a dark green outfit stands on the far right, holding a toy sailboat with a large white sail.

title: Portrait of an Ecclesiastic
alt_text: A painting of an elderly man with short white hair sitting at a wooden desk against a dark background. He wears a dark robe over a white collar and a fuzzy, two-toned hat on his head. With his left hand, he holds open a large book on the desk. His right hand is raised and holds a feather quill as if he is ready to write. Beside him on the desk stands a small wooden crucifix and a container filled with more quill pens. A long, light-colored scroll hangs off the front of the desk, covered in columns of dark handwritten text.

title: Saints Andrew and James the Greater, and a Prophet
alt_text: A painting shows two men standing side by side under pointed, gold-trimmed arches. On the left, a man with a gray beard wears a green cloak over a pink robe and holds a light blue book. On the right, a man with a reddish-brown beard wears a bright yellow cloak over a blue tunic and holds a red book. Above them, tucked into the top center of the gold background, a smaller figure with a white beard holds a curled scroll. The entire scene is framed by a thick, carved wooden border with pointed arches.

title: The Coronation of the Virgin with Saint Anthony Abbot, Saint James the Greater, and Four Angels
alt_text: A painting of figures on a gold background set within a decorative, pointed wooden frame. In the upper center, a man in a blue and red robe places a crown on the head of a woman in a light-colored robe, while winged red and blue figures surround them. Below, two standing men in long robes flank a group of four smaller, kneeling figures holding musical instruments. The entire scene is painted on a textured, golden surface that looks aged and cracked in places. The ornate frame has carved columns on each side and a flat base with small, worn letters printed on it.

title: The Crucifixion; The Coronation of the Virgin; Christ between the Twelve Apostles
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows two main scenes against a bright gold background. The scene on the left depicts three figures gathered around a central cross, with one person kneeling and grasping the wooden post. To the right, a second scene shows a figure crowning a seated woman under a red fabric canopy, surrounded by a group of small angelic figures above. Below both main images, a single horizontal row features several small, portrait-style heads of people arranged side by side. The entire artwork has a weathered, aged appearance with visible cracks in the wood and surface.

title: Saint Mary Magdalen and Saint John the Baptist, Two Panels from a Dismembered Altarpiece
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing against a background of bright gold. She wears a long blue dress under a draped, reddish-orange shawl that covers her head. Her expression is serious, and her long wavy hair falls onto her shoulders. In her left hand, she holds a small, cylindrical blue container with a pointed lid. Around her head, a circular halo is etched into the gold leaf background.

title: Virgin Annunciate
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on panel showing a woman sitting on a low, plain seat. She wears a dark blue outer robe over a red garment and has a golden halo behind her head. The background is painted in a textured reddish-orange color with gold highlights. The entire scene is framed by an ornate, gilded wooden structure that looks like a Gothic arch. At the very bottom, a black horizontal panel features gold lettering that reads, "AVE MARIA GRATIA PLENA."

title: The Annunciation
alt_text: A painting of two separate, triangular panels showing two figures on a gold background. On the left, a winged figure with blond hair kneels and reaches out with one hand, holding a long, thin dark branch in the other. This figure wears a white, flowing garment and has a golden halo behind its head. On the right, a seated woman faces toward the left, looking down at an open book held on her lap. She wears a long, bright blue robe over a pink dress and has a golden halo behind her head. Both figures are set against a textured, reddish-gold surface that fills the background of their respective triangular panels.

title: Saint John the Baptist; The Crucifixion and Saint James Major; The Resurrection
alt_text: A painting in tempera and gold on two tall, narrow, and rounded wooden panels. The left panel features a bearded man in a simple garment holding a thin staff and a scroll, set below a small scene of a figure on a cross. The right panel displays a man standing in a draped robe, holding a long pole and a closed book in his hands. Above this man is a small scene showing a figure standing near a stone structure while others lie on the ground. Both sections share a golden, textured background behind the main figures. The artwork shows signs of age, with chipped or flaking paint visible on the figures and the frames.

title: Desco da Parto with the Amorous Hunt
alt_text: A painting shows a circular scene filled with many people, horses, and animals in a wooded setting. On the left, several figures stand in long, flowing robes of pink, red, and dark colors. Toward the center, a dark animal lies on the ground being poked with long poles by people dressed in red and dark garments. To the right, a white horse stands with a rider, and another person kneels nearby on the ground. A small, rectangular container rests on a grassy hill in the background, near several more figures. A dark, jagged area fills the bottom center of the circular composition.

title: Man of Sorrows
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows a close-up of a person with long hair and their eyes closed. The person wears a dark crown made of sharp thorns on their head. Above the person's head, three thin red lines hang down against a pale yellow background. A hand reaches into the scene from the right, holding a long vertical pole with a small striped flag. The painted surface has cracks and is centered on a larger rectangular piece of wood.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small child, rendered in oil on a wooden panel. The woman wears a large, pale head covering that drapes over her shoulders and obscures much of her hair. She looks downward with a gentle expression while cradling the young child in her arms. The child, who has light, curly hair, looks up toward the woman with an open mouth. The background is a textured, faded blue surface, and parts of the painting's edges show signs of wear and age.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Four Angels
alt_text: A painting showing a woman in a long, dark cloak sitting on a throne and holding a small child. The child wears a light yellow garment and looks up toward the woman. Four small, winged figures are placed around them in the corners, appearing to play musical instruments. The background behind the figures is a warm, orange-gold color decorated with hanging fruit garlands. The entire painting is framed by a highly detailed, golden border with carved designs.

title: The Coronation of the Virgin
alt_text: A painting of a woman being crowned by a man, set within a carved gold frame. The man sits on the right and places a crown on the head of the woman, who sits to his left with her hands held close to her chest. Both figures have golden circles around their heads and wear long, draped robes in shades of red and dark green. Three angels with large wings hover in the space above and behind the central figures. The background features a patterned, golden surface that fills the space behind the people. The entire scene is encased in a tall, pointed wooden frame with architectural carvings at the top.

title: Saint Peter
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows an elderly, bearded man with a graying beard and short hair. He wears a loose white shirt and a blue cloth wrapped around his waist. He holds a bright red book in his left hand and a large, textured metal key in his right. Behind his head is an arched, golden, and reddish-colored halo. The man looks toward his right, while his body is turned slightly toward the viewer.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Four Saints
alt_text: A painting on a wood panel shows a woman holding a young child in her lap. The woman wears a dark, textured robe and a matching hood that frames her face. She supports the small, pink-clad child who reaches up toward her. Behind them is a textured red backdrop, and small, upright figures stand on the left and right edges of the panel. The wooden panel itself is weathered and rough, with a pointed top arching over the center.

title: Portrait of Gerard Mercator (1512–1594)
alt_text: A painting of a man with a reddish-brown beard and short, dark hair. He wears a plain, dark-colored jacket with a small white collar and thin white cuffs at his wrists. His body is turned slightly to the right, and his right hand rests on a smooth, dark surface. In the background on the left, a large, dark, round object sits behind him. The man has a serious expression and looks off toward the left side of the frame against a dark, shadowy background.

title: Francesco Guicciardini
alt_text: A painting of a man wearing a dark cap and a heavy, fur-lined cloak. He sits at a green desk, holding a thin pen in his right hand while writing on a small piece of paper. The man has a serious expression and looks directly toward the viewer. His dark cloak features bright red sleeves and a wide collar with light brown fur and black spots. A draped, dark purple fabric hangs in the background behind him.

title: Flora and Zephyr
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a man sitting among clouds. The woman wears a white dress with a pink sash and has a flower crown on her head. The man, who is bare-chested and draped in a bright red cloth, looks up at her with large, translucent wings behind him. To the lower left, a winged child figure carries a basket of colorful flowers. In the background, a small portion of a tall, thin staff with green leaves is visible. The entire scene is set against a blue and beige sky within an oval frame.

title: The Crucifixion with the Converted Centurion
alt_text: A painting of three men crucified on wooden poles against a dark, stormy sky. The central figure is in the middle, while a man on a white horse wearing metal armor and a feathered hat looks up toward him. Two other men are crucified on the poles to the left and right, both wearing white cloths around their waists. The ground beneath them is rocky, and a small, mountainous landscape is visible in the bottom right corner. A small, colorful shield emblem is painted in the bottom right corner of the scene.

title: Portrait of a Young Man
alt_text: A painting of a portrait on vellum is set in the very center of an elaborate, layered frame. The small, circular portrait shows a person wearing a bright red cap. This tiny image sits on a square, golden-brown panel with a textured, speckled pattern. Surrounding that panel is a thin, shiny gold frame with a ridged edge. The entire center piece is mounted onto a larger, rectangular fabric-covered border with a faded, blotchy red and tan pattern.

title: The Art of Music
alt_text: A painting shows a group of women and children gathered in a wooded landscape. Several women sit on the ground, some wearing light-colored, flowing robes and others dressed in deeper red or orange. A small, winged cherub holds a triangular musical instrument in the center while interacting with the group. Other children appear nearby, including one child lying down in the lap of a woman on the left. In the background, additional figures play stringed instruments, and an open book lies on the ground near the front.

title: The Ecstasy of Saint Augustine
alt_text: A painting of a central figure in a long robe reaching upward toward a glowing, cloud-filled sky. Above, a male figure sits amidst a group of winged cherubs, one of whom holds a sword while another points to a glowing triangle. Below, the central figure is supported by winged angels on either side, one of whom gestures toward the heavens. To the lower left, a cloaked person stands watching with hands folded, while a kneeling man in robes is positioned on the lower right. The scene is filled with dramatic light and shadow, creating a swirling, ethereal atmosphere.

title: Draped Seated Woman
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a figure sitting on a low, stepped yellow wooden platform. The figure has a dark, textured appearance and rests in a reclined pose with one arm braced behind itself for support. Its legs are stretched out towards the left side of the frame, wearing a simple, draped garment. The figure's head is smooth and small in comparison to its body. The background is a plain, grey wall made of large square panels.

title: Samuel William Brown (1802-1862), MD 1823
alt_text: A painting shows the head and shoulders of a man wearing a dark coat. He faces forward with a calm expression and his dark hair is combed back. Below his chin, he wears a white collar and a small dark necktie. The background behind him is a solid, dark, and textured brown color. The painting is encased in a simple gold frame with a twisted rope-like pattern.

title: Illustration of Gray's ode "On the Death of a favorite Cat"
alt_text: A painting of a cat leaning over a round, dark glass fishbowl. Inside the bowl, several small, bright orange fish swim in the water. To the left of the bowl, there are a few closed books stacked on a wooden surface. On the right side, an open book with visible pages lies flat. The background is a dark, shadowy green color, which makes the cat and the fish stand out. The entire scene is framed in a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Venus in the Workshop of Vulcan
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a man resting together in a cloud-filled scene with several small winged figures. The woman sits in the center, her body turned slightly toward the man while covered in light-colored fabric. To her right, a muscular man with dark hair wears a bright red cloth draped around his waist. He holds a long, slender object that looks like a sword or tool pointing upward. Several small, winged children float in the blue sky above and around them, while rocks and dark shapes fill the bottom corners of the scene.

title: Game of Chance
alt_text: A painting of three strange, abstract figures standing against a dark, cloudy background. On the left, a small, hunched figure wears a wide-brimmed hat with a thin, swirling feather extending upward. Behind it stands a tall, dark, triangular figure with a flat, geometric top that resembles a high hat. To the right, a third figure has a round, hollow head with several curved, layered parts attached to the top and a bright orange cape draped over its side. These figures are placed on a flat, dark surface, with one hand-like extension reaching down toward a small, square object resting on the ledge. The colors throughout the scene are muted, consisting mostly of browns, greys, and deep blues, with small pops of orange and light blue.

title: Carl Albert Lohmann (1887–1957)
alt_text: A painting shows an older man dressed in a formal black robe with a white collar and blue tie. He has light skin and short, grey hair. Above his head, a cluster of nine colorful square flags or crests with different patterns and symbols hangs against a dark green textured background. To the man's left, a blue shield features an open book with Hebrew lettering. Text in Latin is written in the bottom part of the painting and to the right of the man's head.

title: Adam Viscount Duncan, Admiral of the White (1731-1804)
alt_text: A painting of a middle-aged man wearing a dark coat and light-colored wig. The man is shown from the chest up and looks slightly to his left. He has a pale complexion and a neutral expression on his face. The portrait is enclosed in a large, ornate gold-colored frame with decorative carvings. Below the painting, a small white sign with the black text "1962.10" sits on the frame's edge.

title: Interior-Castle
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows a tall, smooth, egg-shaped object resting on a small, rectangular base. The main shape is pale white and tapers slightly toward the flat top. On its front face, a single, vertical, rectangular panel is recessed into the surface. A horizontal line is carved halfway down this rectangle, separating it from the rest of the form. The entire object sits centered against a plain, neutral gray background.

title: George Peabody
alt_text: A painting of a man, shown from the chest up. The man is older and has light-colored hair that is thinning on top. He wears a dark coat over a high, black neck cloth and a white shirt. His expression is serious, and he gazes off toward the left side of the frame. The background is a plain, dark gray shade with no specific details.

title: Neptune
alt_text: A limestone sculpture shows a reclining man with a long beard. He sits with his upper body propped up while his legs stretch out to his right. In his left hand, he holds a long staff that rests against his body. The man has curly hair and looks off to the left side of the frame. He rests on a rocky, uneven base that extends across the bottom of the statue.

title: Hero and Leander
alt_text: A painting of several figures floating in dark, churning water under a stormy sky. The scene shows multiple pale human figures struggling or drifting together in the center of the dark waves. A bright shaft of light breaks through the dark clouds above, illuminating the water and the people. On the far right, a figure with a red garment reaches upward near some misty or cloudy shapes. The entire image is filled with deep shadows, creating a dramatic and moody atmosphere.

title: Crowned Female Figure
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture of a standing figure wearing a tall, carved crown. The figure has long, light-colored hair and looks downward with a neutral expression. One arm is raised to the chest, while the other arm rests across the midsection. The figure wears a long, draped robe that reaches down to its feet, showing faded colors of brown and faint hints of green. The wood texture is visible throughout the piece, with some wear showing on the surface.

title: The Flagellation of Christ
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing three standing male figures, each mounted on its own square pedestal. The figure in the center stands with his head bowed and arms bound behind his back, wearing only a cloth draped around his hips. The figures on the left and right stand facing forward, each holding a chain aloft in one raised hand. All three figures have a dark, smooth, metallic appearance and athletic builds. They are arranged side-by-side against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Page from an Antiphonary
medium: Brush and various colored inks, opaque watercolor, and gold leaf
alt_text: An illuminated manuscript page shows a small, circular painting centered within a block of handwritten text. The painting features a person with a pale face wearing a red hood and a blue garment, set against a blue background with gold accents. This circular portrait is framed by a decorative square border containing gold leaf and intricate, swirling patterns in red and blue ink. To the left of the text, there are two distinct decorative clusters of painted berries, one group red and one group blue, attached to dark, curling vines. Columns of brown and red text surround the central image, filling the page with dense, handwritten letters.

title: Relief with Red Segment
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes in muted and bright colors on a flat background. On the left, a large, vertical pale yellow rectangle sits next to a strip of bright blue. To the right of the center, a small red shape shaped like a rounded wedge sits above a white semicircle. The lower half of the image is mostly a solid, large gray triangle. Above the shapes in the upper right, five thin, raised wooden horizontal bars are attached to the flat, off-white surface.

title: William Whetcroft (c.1735-1799)
alt_text: A painting of a middle-aged man sitting in a chair. He has light, wavy hair and is looking directly at the viewer. He wears a dark blue jacket over a bright yellow vest and a white, ruffled neckpiece. One of his hands rests on his lap while holding a small, wooden cane. Behind him, a heavy, reddish curtain hangs to the right, while a view of a green landscape appears through an opening on the left.

title: Strip
alt_text: A textile of satin velvet showing a weathered, brownish-gold fabric with dark patches. The surface has a rough and uneven texture, suggesting age or heavy wear. Dark, blurry spots and lines are scattered across the fabric's surface, appearing mostly on the left side and center. A thin, dark trim runs along the top edge of the material. At the bottom, a small black label displays the white numbers 1945.77.

title: The Death of Major Peirson (1757-1781)
alt_text: A monochromatic painting in shades of brown showing a crowd of people in active poses. In the center, a group of figures carries a large, dark flag and appears to be supporting or moving another person. To the left, a dense mass of individuals holding staffs or weapons charges forward in disarray. On the right side, several large, faint female figures stand while holding a child.
