The background is shadowy and filled with smoke or clouds, giving the scene a dramatic, blurred effect.

title: Bonnet
alt_text: A cotton voile and silk embroidery garment shows a light-colored, rounded hat or bonnet cap. The main fabric is white and appears thin or sheer. Dark, intricate geometric patterns are embroidered across the lower section and edges of the piece. A long, thin string extends from the back of the cap toward the right side. The entire object is set against a solid, dark black background.

title: The Spinner
alt_text: A painting of a woman spinning yarn by a large window. The woman is seated on the floor with her back toward the viewer, wearing a dark green dress and a white head covering. She holds a circular frame of yarn in her left hand, while a large, dark spinning wheel stands prominently behind her. To her left, baskets filled with round, light-colored balls of fiber sit on the floor. The setting appears to be a rustic room with a window at the top left that lets in cool, bluish light.

title: Square of cotton cloth, embroidered in silk
alt_text: A textile of loosely woven cotton shows a repeating pattern of vertical stripes. The square cloth features many columns that run from the top edge to the bottom edge. Each column contains a wavy line that loops back and forth inside the stripe. Small, evenly spaced dots fill the spaces between the wavy loops. The entire background color is a light, muted gray.

title: Thomas W. Brewer of Roxbury, Mass.
alt_text: A colored wax miniature shows the profile view of a man's head and shoulders. The man is facing to the left and has light, wavy hair and distinct sideburns. He wears a dark blue, collared coat over a white shirt with a ruffled cravat at his neck. His features are realistic and raised from the flat, circular background. The entire portrait is enclosed within a simple, black circular frame.

title: The Workman
alt_text: A painting showing a tall, stylized figure of a man standing in the center. The man has a long, orange-colored neck and head, wearing a long black coat that reaches to his feet. Behind him, the background features a geometric city scene with tall buildings, factory smokestacks, a red sun, and a green circular tree. A large blue number ten is painted near the top right corner, while black letters spelling "DER ARBEITSMANN" are printed vertically down the lower right side. The entire image uses flat, simplified shapes and a limited color palette of red, black, orange, and cream.

title: Pillow sham, linen, embroidered
alt_text: A textile made of fine white linen shows a square fabric piece edged with a wide, intricate lace border. The central area of the linen is smooth and displays a small, detailed embroidered design in the middle. This design features a crown on the left and a floral or leafy shape on the right. The white fabric is gathered or pleated slightly where it meets the decorative lace border. The entire square piece is set against a solid dark background.

title: Square
alt_text: A brocaded satin textile shows a repetitive, colorful floral pattern across its surface. The background is a soft, muted gold color, while the flowers and leaves are mostly in shades of blue, red, and orange. The fabric appears slightly worn and has a fringed edge visible along the sides and bottom. The pattern features swirling vines and full-blooming flowers arranged in an organic, flowing design. A small black rectangular label with the numbers "1945.74" sits directly in front of the fabric on the table.

title: Stole, Maniple, and Burse
alt_text: A textile of embroidered silk shows three yellow fabric pieces laid on a white surface. The largest piece is a long, thin strip that widens into a triangle at one end. A second, shorter piece also has a long neck that widens into a triangle. A third, smaller piece is a square shape located near the top of the others. All three pieces are yellow and decorated with floral patterns in shades of orange, blue, and silver thread.

title: Small Yellow
alt_text: A painting shows a variety of geometric shapes and lines arranged over a light yellow background. A tall, black rectangular pillar stands vertically in the center, topped with a small, crescent-shaped red curve. To the left of the pillar, a grid of small, multicolored squares extends outward, alongside a long, red arc that curves down to a blue circle. Smaller details include a orange triangle, thin black lines arranged in parallel sets, and crossing diagonal lines scattered across the frame. The overall composition balances these structured, colorful forms against the plain, neutral background.

title: Square
alt_text: A brocaded silk textile shows a repeating pattern of flowers and decorative shapes. The fabric is laid out on a white surface, with the left edge rolled up into a tube. The background color is a light tan, and it features pink floral motifs mixed with yellow and light blue designs. A thin, wavy border in a lighter, metallic color outlines the edges of the fabric. At the bottom center of the table, a small black tag displays the white number 1945.75.

title: Rotary Glass Plates (Precision Optics) formerly titled as, Revolving Glass Machine
medium: Painted glass, iron, electric motor, and mixed media (largest blade damaged in 2007 and replaced by facsimile in 2011)
alt_text: A sculpture of mixed media shows a large, freestanding machine with multiple glass blades attached to a central metal arm. The base is constructed from dark, thick wooden beams arranged in an X-shape on the floor. A circular iron wheel sits near the back, connected to a rod that holds several rectangular panes of glass featuring black and white horizontal stripes. At the far end of this rotating arm, a small, striped cone extends outward. Two long, thin white rods support the structure from the front, angled inward toward the center.

title: Spatial Construction (Construction no. 557)
medium: Tin, brass, painted iron, and steel
alt_text: A sculpture of metal forms mounted on a black base. A bright red curved rod rises high above the center, creating a U-shape. Below the rod, thin strips of silver metal curve into circles and spirals. A flat, triangular piece of gold-colored metal is tilted sideways, resting horizontally near the middle. The entire arrangement sits atop a solid, dark, square block that rests on the ground.

title: Growth of the Circle (formerly, Composition II)
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes created with oil on canvas. The entire surface is filled with a dense, interlocking pattern of sharp-edged, angular blocks and triangles. A deep, dark blue shape sits prominently in the lower center, standing out against lighter shades of yellow, cream, and soft grey. Contrasting fields of red and green fill in the remaining spaces, framed by thick black lines that outline every segment. The overall effect is flat and puzzle-like, with no clear subject or depth.

title: Death of General Wolfe at the Heights of Abraham (after Benjamin West)
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a group of men gathered around a fallen figure outdoors. A central man in a red uniform lies on the ground, supported by several other men standing or crouching around him. The men wear dark or reddish coats and appear to be part of a military group. The background is a wide, dark landscape under a cloudy sky. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: Chausable
alt_text: An embroidered silk textile showing a yellow, vest-like garment decorated with intricate floral designs. The garment features a bright, golden-yellow front panel filled with detailed embroidery in shades of red, green, and metallic silver. Large, stylized flowers and swirling leaf patterns cover the central section of the fabric. The edges of the piece show a soft, salmon-pink fabric that peeks out from underneath the embroidered layer. A black label with white numbers sits on the flat, light-colored surface below the garment.

title: Night Fantasy: Composition 125
alt_text: A painting showing a collection of abstract shapes against a mottled purple background. Large, dark rectangular blocks anchor the bottom center and middle areas of the scene. Floating above these are curved, crescent-like forms, thin white lines, and several circular shapes. To the upper right, a blue cloud-like shape contains a central golden circle. The bottom of the canvas features flat, horizontal bands in tan and light blue.

title: Abstract Interpretation
alt_text: A painting shows a collection of overlapping geometric shapes against a solid black background. A large, reddish-orange circle sits near the center, partially obscured by several rectangular bars and triangles in yellow, blue, and purple. To the lower left, a solid brown circle anchors the bottom of the central cluster. Extending toward the lower right, a jagged, saw-toothed pink shape points downward. Below this, a blue triangle points toward the bottom edge, crossed by several thin, parallel yellow lines.

title: Composition 140
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and lines layered over a deep, dark purple and brown background. The composition features sharp, geometric forms including triangles, crescents, and thin, needle-like spikes. Several overlapping circles and straight lines crisscross the center of the canvas. Warm colors like orange, red, and yellow appear in various spots, contrasting with the overall muted, shadowy tone. The bottom of the painting is grounded by a series of horizontal bands and stacked geometric blocks.

title: Improvisation No. 7 (Storm)
alt_text: A painting shows a variety of abstract shapes and bold colors blending into one another. Dark blue and deep green tones fill much of the background, creating a moody atmosphere. Several prominent white, curved strokes cut across the center and upper right sections of the work. Bright patches of orange, yellow, and red appear scattered throughout the composition. A couple of small, solid brown circles sit near the center, adding distinct points of contrast against the other colors.

title: The Port
alt_text: A painting of houses rendered in oil on canvas showing a collection of geometric buildings grouped together. Several red structures with angled roofs and chimneys dominate the center of the scene. To the left, a dark area suggests water with a small, reddish boat shape floating on the surface. Above the houses, large abstract shapes in black, gray, and white fill the background space. The overall composition uses sharp, angular lines to create an abstract view of a townscape.

title: Immaterial Figure (Immaterielle Figur)
alt_text: A painting of a stylized, seated figure composed of geometric shapes and muted, pastel colors. The central figure has a tan body made of large, flat forms, with a head that blends into abstract rectangles and layers behind it. One hand rests on a dark, horizontal bar, while the figure's bent leg extends toward the bottom of the frame where a single foot is visible. To the right of the figure, a blue and white checkered pattern creates a sense of depth on the floor. In the upper left corner, there is a simple outline of a vase within a boxy, frame-like structure. The background is filled with various blocks and shapes in soft tones of peach, grey, light blue, and pink.

title: Model of the Column (formerly Model for Glass Fountain)
medium: Perspex and plastic on aluminum base
alt_text: A sculpture of a vertical, geometric structure standing on a flat, round, metallic base. Four transparent rectangular panels cross each other in the center to form a tall, upright pillar. Two curved, beige, triangular-shaped platforms sit stacked near the middle of the pillar. A thin, white, circular hoop surrounds the lower section of the clear panels. A small, black, pointed shape sits at the very bottom, attached to the center of the base.

title: Two Rooms
alt_text: A painting of an interior room viewed through a dark, open doorway. The scene is mostly gray, with a large black rectangle on the left representing an open door. Inside, a lighter room area features a small, brown, two-shelf unit sitting on the floor. A sharp, geometric shadow is cast on the wall behind the shelf, creating a strong contrast. The floor is a flat, solid gray that stretches from the foreground into the back room.

title: Portrait of Marcel Duchamp
medium: Cellulose nitrate on copper with iron
alt_text: A sculpture of translucent yellow and orange shapes layered over a dark background. The central top piece looks like an abstract, multi-faceted head or helmet. Below this, various triangular and curved sections of yellowish plastic create a geometric composition. The entire piece is framed by a wider, textured border of bright turquoise-green metal. Dark brown and metallic iron elements peek through the gaps between the lighter shapes.

title: Fish and Flowers in Pink Paper
alt_text: A painting of a still life scene showing a bouquet of flowers and a small plate of fish. On the left side, a bundle of pale, leafy greens rests on a crumpled piece of light-colored fabric. To the right of the flowers, a white plate holds several small, pale fish arranged among dark green leaves. The background is a muted, brownish-grey color that creates a simple setting for these items. The entire scene is encased in a weathered, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Landscape with Cattle
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a small group of cows grazing near a stream. A large, dense group of tall, dark green trees stands on the left side of the scene. In the foreground, four cows with different coat colors drink from a narrow, shallow stream that winds through the grassy field. Beyond the stream and the trees, gentle hills rise up in the distance under a bright, cloudy sky. Another single cow stands further back in the field, near the right side of the painting.

title: Nathan Hale (1755-76) Yale B.A. 1773, M.A. 1776, American Spy in the Revolutionary War
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture of a man stands on a flat, rectangular base. The man stands with his body turned slightly toward the right side. He wears a long coat over a vest, with breeches and stockings on his legs. One hand is tucked behind his back, while his head is turned to look off to the side. The figure is colored a solid, dark brown, and there is a small line of text visible on the front edge of the base.

title: The Vernet Family
alt_text: A painting of a family consisting of a man, a woman, and two young children. A woman sits in the center wearing a long white dress, holding a baby who also wears a white dress. A man sits to the right of the woman, dressed in a dark coat and light cravat. To the left, a small boy in a gold-colored vest reaches out toward the woman and baby. Behind the group, a dark column stands on the right, while a landscape with rolling hills and a cloudy sky appears in the distance on the left.

title: Thomas Jefferson (1743-1826), LL.D. 1786
alt_text: A painting of a man standing outside a building, showing him as the main figure in the foreground. He is wearing a long, dark purple coat with a fur collar and is holding a small piece of paper. Several other men in dark clothing stand partially hidden behind him in the shadows near a large stone pillar. To the right, a large outdoor crowd gathers near a building with visible windows. The entire scene is painted in muted tones with soft, loose brushstrokes.

title: Chalice Veil
alt_text: An embroidered silk textile showing a square, yellow fabric decorated with detailed needlework. The center features a radiant, sun-like design stitched in silver thread, surrounding an intertwined symbol. Large, vibrant flowers in shades of orange, pink, and green are arranged in the corners and along the sides. A delicate, lacy silver trim borders all four edges of the piece. A small, dark rectangular tag with white numbers sits on the surface below the fabric.

title: Homage to Herwarth Walden (formerly Compostion I)
alt_text: A painting of a composition filled with many colorful, geometric shapes. Blocks of bright yellow, orange, deep red, green, and blue are arranged across the canvas. Thick black lines create sharp boundaries between squares, rectangles, and angular forms. Several smooth curves and partial circles break up the straight lines throughout the piece. The entire area is completely covered in these overlapping shapes, with no background space visible.

title: Suprematism (formerly) Abstraction
alt_text: A painting of overlapping triangles in shades of black, white, and brown. On the left side, a large solid black triangle points inward toward the center of the frame. A smaller, sharp black triangle is positioned in the lower-middle area, pointing toward the right. The background spaces are filled with textured patterns made of short, dashed brushstrokes in varied tones of grey, white, and tan. Sharp, straight lines clearly separate these solid black shapes from the busy, speckled sections.

title: The Concert Singer
medium: Oil on thick paper, laid down on laminated chipboard
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing alone on a dark stage. The woman wears a light-colored, floor-length dress and stands in front of a bright, semi-circular spotlight. A dark, upright shape on the right side of the stage looks like a curtain or pillar. In the foreground, the backs of audience members' heads are visible in dim silhouettes. A rectangular object, possibly an open book or sheet music, sits on the edge of the stage near the audience.

title: Anthropomorphic Figure (Plaster Man)
medium: Gouache on modelled plaster over plywood
alt_text: A painting of a blocky, stylized figure standing on a textured white and gray background. The figure is composed of dark, ribbed shapes that form a square head with a small circle in the center, a rectangular torso, and two legs. The figure holds a large, rectangular frame in front of its body with both arms. Inside this frame, there is a smooth, vibrant section of yellow fading into blue, dotted with small blue spots. The entire surface has a thick, uneven texture created by layers of plaster.

title: Riding and . . . (Fahrten und . . . )
alt_text: A painting of colorful, abstract shapes includes curved lines and geometric forms. The composition is filled with overlapping ribbons, spirals, and circles painted in shades of blue, pink, purple, and gray. Several sections feature repetitive wave patterns along the edges of the larger shapes. A small, textured circular collage element appears near the center of the design. The background blends darker tones, creating a sense of depth behind the layered foreground objects.

title: Mirror of Women II (Frauenspiegel II)
alt_text: A painting showing several abstract, fragmented human figures interacting in a room with colorful walls and floors. Large, flesh-toned limbs and torso shapes dominate the center, appearing layered over one another in a chaotic arrangement. A dark blue, upside-down figure is positioned in the upper left corner, while a small, solid red shape rests on the tiled floor in the lower right. Brightly colored rectangular sections in blue, yellow, and green form the background walls and floorboards behind the figures. The scene feels disjointed, with overlapping geometric patterns and flat, simplified human forms.

title: The Flight into Egypt
alt_text: A painting of a journey across a landscape featuring a small group of people and winged figures. In the center, a woman sits on a dark donkey, holding a small baby wrapped in a white cloth. An angel with large brown wings walks in front of the donkey and pulls it by a strap, while a man in a tan robe walks behind the donkey pushing it forward. Above them, two small, winged children float in the cloudy sky, dropping colorful flowers toward the travelers below. The background shows a simple landscape with distant hills and a large palm leaf on the right side.

title: Street Scene (Rue de village)
alt_text: A painting of a quiet street scene shows white buildings lining both sides of a narrow road. On the right, a large, two-story white building features turquoise shutters on its windows and a dark green doorway. Similar, smaller white structures with aged walls stretch down the left side of the street into the distance. A few small, dark figures are walking along the sidewalk on the left, dwarfed by the tall buildings. The sky above is a soft, pale gray, suggesting an overcast day.

title: Square
alt_text: An embroidered linen textile shows a repeating geometric pattern across its square surface. The light beige fabric is covered in a grid of diamonds and squares that are connected together. Within the squares, there are smaller, intricate designs that look like tiny, raised knots. A faint horizontal fold runs across the middle of the fabric. Below the textile, a black tag displays the white numbers "1945.80" on a small white base.

title: The Waterfall
alt_text: A painting in oil on pasteboard shows an abstract arrangement of colorful, overlapping shapes. On the left side, a large, dark blue patch sits above a textured green area. A prominent, curved white shape rises through the center of the composition next to a thick, vertical blue streak. Bright yellow, orange, and red patches are scattered throughout the scene, interspersed with dark, earthy tones. The overall effect creates a sense of depth and layered movement across the entire surface.

title: Fabulous Race Track of Death (Instrument very dangerous to the eye)
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract, dreamlike landscape with a mix of smooth and dark, scratchy forms. On the left, a dark, spindly, tree-like shape has branches that look like tangled, metallic scribbles. The background is a wash of deep teal blue that fades into lighter, misty shapes. Below, the foreground is a bright, sunny yellow surface dotted with soft, rounded, grey and white blobs. Several shapes in the middle ground contain splashes of vibrant red, orange, and blue.

title: On the Beach
alt_text: A painting of a beach scene with four people and a boat. A dark, rounded boat sits on the sand in the background, with one person in red trunks sitting on its edge. In front of the boat, a second person with curly hair kneels on the sand while looking toward the right. To the right of the boat stands a woman in a wide-brimmed yellow hat and a large, flowing white robe. She holds the hand of a small child who stands next to her, wearing a pink dress. The sandy shore is a light tan color, and the sky behind them is gray and cloudy.

title: Composition I
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and vertical blocks in a geometric style. The image features a large, white curved form dominating the upper center, marked with a small grey circle. To the left, a brown, ladder-like shape sits against a white rectangle and a black square. Below these elements, a bright red semi-circle forms a small, bold accent point. Various shades of grey and black bars create a layered background effect, giving the composition depth. These blocky shapes occupy most of the frame, arranged in a balanced, structured layout.

title: Rubber Plant
alt_text: A painting of a stylized plant in a vase, rendered in oil on canvas. A dark green, angular vase sits at the center of the composition on a geometric, light-colored surface. A simple plant with dark, pointed leaves stands upright in the center of the vase. The background consists of jagged, overlapping shapes in shades of deep blue, tan, and maroon. These sharp, intersecting lines create a sense of movement behind the stationary plant. The entire image is made up of flat planes of color that give it a structured, abstract look.

title: The Good Samaritan
alt_text: A painting shows a person kneeling in the sand next to a figure lying on the ground. The standing person wears a blue robe and a yellow head covering while leaning over the reclining figure. The reclining figure has dark skin, is mostly unclothed except for a white cloth, and stretches across the bottom of the frame. Behind them, a donkey with a dark gray back stands near large, jagged shapes of orange and brown. The background appears like a desert landscape with rough, blocky brushstrokes of color.

title: The River Wuppe
alt_text: A painting showing a swirling, abstract view of buildings and light. The upper section contains jagged shapes in shades of grey, blue, and orange that resemble roofs or structures. In the center, a dark, arched form creates a bridge-like opening over a turbulent, blue, wave-like area. Below this, small, bright rectangular shapes and angular patches of deep red and dark blue catch the eye. The entire scene is filled with overlapping, sharp lines that create a sense of frantic movement.

title: Composition III
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes arranged in a vertical composition. A tall, pale gray background anchors various solid colors, including dark gray, deep brown, reddish-brown, and muted olive green. Towards the center, a long, thin vertical white rectangle sits against a darker gray shape that resembles a bottle. A semi-circular reddish-brown shape extends from the left, while tan and dark blue blocks form an irregular, step-like pattern on the lower right side. The overall design features clean lines and flat blocks of color that overlap to create depth.

title: Horses
alt_text: A painting on glass showing a stylized outdoor scene with animals and people against a dark sky. Several horses run across a large, flat, wooden-looking platform angled toward the upper right. Below them, two people stand near fenced areas; one person holds a tool while working near a small animal on the ground. The colors are muted, featuring grays, browns, and dull blues. A small, round, light-colored object, possibly a moon or sun, hangs in the upper left corner.

title: Composition II
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes against a gray background. A tall, bright blue vertical shape stretches upward through the center, framed by white and gray sections. A bold red, T-shaped form sits in the lower right area. Below this red shape, a white, wedge-like figure is outlined in black. The composition is built from sharp lines and distinct, flat blocks of color.

title: Child with Dog
medium: Oil on canvas, painted directly on unprepared canvas
alt_text: A painting of a young girl and a small dog sitting together outdoors. The girl has brown, wavy hair and wears a simple, light blue sleeveless dress. She holds a small, round yellow fruit in her lap while resting her other arm around the dog. Beside her sits a brown, fluffy dog with large dark eyes and floppy ears. They are positioned in front of a dense, dark grey bush with pointed leaves. The background shows a soft, blue landscape that fades into the distance.

title: Parrot
alt_text: A wood bas-relief showing a stylized bird carving. The carving is set within a circular, recessed area on a flat, square wooden background. The bird is depicted in profile, with a large, rounded head and a prominent, angular beak pointing downwards. Its wing is folded over its body, creating smooth, sweeping lines. The entire piece has a warm, natural wood grain throughout.

title: The Pool
medium: Oil on printed sheet of music paper, laid down on laminated chipboard
alt_text: A painting of a forest scene shows two figures near a stream. In the foreground, a tall, thin figure with blonde hair stands in the water with arms raised toward the sky. To the left, a second person with dark hair crouches low near the water's edge, partially obscured by the shadows. The background is filled with a dense, dark forest of green and brown trees that look hazy and blurred. A small, faint waterfall appears in the distance between the trees. The overall color palette is dark, using earthy greens and browns with thin, vertical lines visible throughout the background.

title: The Factory
alt_text: A painting of a red factory building sitting atop a grassy hill. The structure features a prominent, tall smokestack and reddish-brown roof sections against a dark, stormy blue sky. Beneath the buildings, the steep hillside is covered in light, yellowish grass and patches of dark, angular green trees. A row of similar stylized trees stands in the foreground on a flat green field. The entire landscape is rendered with bold, blocky shapes and clear, defined lines.

title: Head
alt_text: A painting of a person’s head shown in profile facing left. Thick, dark strokes of black paint form the person's hair. The face is painted with patches of reddish-orange, pink, and hints of green and yellow. A deep blue and dark green background surrounds the head with visible brushstrokes. The person wears a simple white or light-colored garment at the bottom edge.

title: Morning in the Flower Garden
alt_text: A painting of a person standing next to several tall, dark purple flowers. The person is positioned on the right side of the canvas, wearing a yellow necklace and looking toward the flowers. Their skin has a pale blue tint, and they have dark, thick hair. The flowers are large, cone-shaped, and take up the left and center parts of the frame. The background is a mix of muted blue, yellow, and orange colors that look like a soft, painted sky or atmosphere.

title: Papillons (Butterflies)
alt_text: A painting showing seven winged insects or moths floating against a solid, light blue background. The insects are painted in shades of white, gray, and yellow, and they vary in size and position across the canvas. A small, bright green insect sits in the upper left corner, while a larger, pale yellow one is below it. Several grayish insects with delicate, textured wings are scattered toward the center and bottom, including one with a touch of red on its side. The scene is framed by a simple, light-colored wooden border.

title: G5:1923-26
alt_text: A painting showing various geometric shapes arranged on a light beige background. A large, pale grey circle dominates the center, with a horizontal dark grey bar running behind it. A thin, light grey line angles upward from the bottom center to the top right. Below the large circle, a small, bright red circle sits alone to the right side. A thin horizontal line stretches across the background, passing through the red circle and the large grey circle.

title: Architectonic Function 3U
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes arranged against a plain, light-tan background. A long, thin rectangular bar runs diagonally across the center, colored with bands of teal and dark gray. Attached to the middle of this bar is a cluster of three-dimensional cubes and rectangular prisms in shades of dark teal and blue-gray. The composition creates an abstract, structural appearance that looks like a simplified, hovering machine part. The entire object floats in the center of the canvas without any visible supports.

title: The Dancer
alt_text: A brass and celluloid sculpture stands vertically against a neutral gray background. The object is composed of a long central rod that supports a series of geometric, wing-like metal plates. These plates form a diamond-like shape that is split into an upper and a lower section. At the very top, a smooth, rounded, translucent dome sits like a cap on the central rod. The entire structure rests on a small, flared base.

title: Mountain Landscape
medium: Oil on paper, laid down on laminated chipboard
alt_text: A painting of a landscape seen through a framed opening. The scene is filled with thick, textured brushstrokes in shades of green, yellow, brown, and dark blue. A large, hazy shape that could be a mountain or a dense forest occupies the upper center part of the frame. In the lower area, patches of lighter colors and darker shadows suggest rolling ground or low foliage. A thick, mustard-yellow border frames the entire scene, appearing as if the viewer is looking out from a window.

title: Woman at the Card Table
medium: Oil and gold paint on burlap
alt_text: A painting shows a collection of geometric shapes and textures in an abstract arrangement. A central, circular gold halo sits above a textured blue and brown form that resembles a mountain range or a folded cloth. To the right, a large dark gray circle appears against a lighter, cloud-like background. The bottom half of the composition features steps and blocky shapes in shades of blue, teal, and yellow. A small, multi-colored cube floats near the lower right corner, appearing separate from the main structures.

title: Family Portrait II (Familienbild II)
alt_text: A painting of a person with short brown hair wearing a long blue dress. The figure stands at an angle in the center of the image, leaning against a background filled with colorful geometric shapes and patterns. To the upper right, two smaller figures appear to stand behind a wall of patterned blocks. One of these smaller figures wears a green and white striped shirt, and the other wears a blue and white striped shirt. The rest of the background is composed of triangles, squares, and dotted areas in colors like red, blue, green, and black.

title: Construction in Blue
alt_text: A painting of various geometric shapes and lines arranged in a complex pattern on a dark background. The composition is built from triangles, rectangles, and circular forms in shades of black, red, and blue. Several thin, vertical lines reach upward, capped by small, bright circles. In the center, a dense cluster of shapes creates a focal point with sharper angles and vibrant red highlights. The surrounding areas feature darker, solid blocky shapes that provide a sense of structure.

title: Another Station (Andere Station)
alt_text: A painting showing abstract geometric shapes and lines arranged across a dark background. Red, brown, and purple angular forms dominate the center of the canvas. Curved lines, including blue and white stripes, loop through the composition and add texture. Sharp, pointed triangles appear at the top and sides, contrasting with the softer loops below. Subtle, scribbled white lines create intricate patterns within some of the darker shapes.

title: Curving Machine (Kurven Maschinen)
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes in various bright and dark colors. The background consists of large, muted rectangular blocks in shades of blue, brown, purple, and green. Floating over this grid are curved, organic forms that resemble swirls, petals, or seashell fragments. These smaller shapes are painted in vivid reds, blues, purples, and teals, and feature fine, spiraling line patterns inside them. The composition feels dynamic and energetic, with many of the colorful elements pointing in different directions.

title: Happening (Geschehen)
medium: Oil and aluminum leaf on canvas
alt_text: A painting of overlapping geometric shapes in bright and dark colors fills the canvas. Many small circles, triangles, and jagged rectangles are packed closely together in the center. The background is a mix of blocky, angular patterns in red, blue, green, and orange. Some areas have a metallic, silver sheen that catches the light differently than the matte paint. A wooden frame, also painted with streaks of color, surrounds the entire composition.

title: (Space Construction) Room
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes in shades of grey, orange, yellow, and brown. The top section is dominated by a large, dark grey rectangle containing a smaller, bright orange square in its upper left corner. Below this sits a large, vibrant orange section that forms a background for several other shapes. A dark, muted brown quadrilateral sits in the lower center, attached to a black shape that resembles a table leg or stool. To the right, a large yellow rectangle is placed next to a black triangle, creating a sharp diagonal contrast against the orange background.

title: George Robert Dowdall (1783-1829)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature shows a portrait of a man in an oval frame. He has light skin and short, brown hair swept to the side. He wears a dark, high-collared jacket over a light-colored cravat or scarf at his neck. The portrait is set against a dark, rectangular background with gold flower-like designs in the corners. A thick, ornate, gold-colored frame surrounds the entire piece.

title: Portrait of a Man
alt_text: A painting of a man presented within a rectangular, ornate gold frame. Inside the frame, an oval opening shows a portrait of a middle-aged man with dark hair and a serious expression. He wears a dark coat over a white collared shirt with a dark necktie. The background of the portrait is a dark, indistinct brown color. A small white label with the handwritten number "1943.81" is attached to the bottom edge of the frame.

title: George Walton (1749 or 1750-1804)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a man with light-colored hair. The man faces forward, looking directly at the viewer with bright blue eyes. He wears a maroon coat over a white shirt with a small, frilly piece of fabric at his neck. His hair is styled back away from his face. The portrait is oval-shaped and set inside a simple gold frame with a loop at the top for hanging.

title: Portrait of Dorothea A. Dreier (1870–1923)
alt_text: A painting of a woman with dark hair styled upward, shown from the chest up. She wears a bright red, intricate dress with lace-like details and a matching red necklace. Her hands are gently clasped in front of her as she rests on a chair. The background is a muted, solid brown color, with faint text visible near the top left corner. A dark frame edge is visible in the upper right corner of the painting.

title: Cap with pile embroidery
medium: On a coarse narrow hand-woven cotton cloth
alt_text: A textile on coarse, narrow, hand-woven cotton cloth showing two matching rectangular panels side-by-side. Each panel is decorated with large, rounded, flower-like shapes and smaller dark circular forms. A vertical strip with a zig-zag pattern runs down the center, dividing the two mirror-image halves. The top and bottom edges are bordered by a band of small, blocky square patterns. The entire piece has a woven texture that appears light and dark in the black-and-white view.

title: Painting (formerly Machine)
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes arranged in an abstract composition against a light beige background. A large, white circle dominates the lower-right area, surrounded by bands of dark blue, yellow, and black. A vertical, green pillar-like shape rises from behind the circle, extending upward and bending toward the left. Several smaller, angular lines and bars in light blue, white, and green connect and extend from these central forms. Thin, curved black and light blue lines reach out into the negative space, adding to the structured feel of the arrangement.

title: Altar Frontal
alt_text: A textile of embroidered silk shows a repeating pattern of flowers and scrolling leaves. The fabric is dark grey with lighter, floral-shaped highlights that stand out against the background. A wide, decorative border with small, rounded floral buds runs horizontally across the upper section. Below this border, the main surface is filled with larger, detailed flower blossoms and curving stems. The entire piece has a consistent, dense texture created by the intricate stitching.

title: The Bather
alt_text: A painting of a nude figure standing in shallow water. The person is light-skinned and holds a long, thin stick that reaches down into the rippling surface. Their body is positioned in the center, facing forward while looking slightly down. The background shows soft, indistinct green trees and foliage above the water line. The entire scene uses loose, textured brushstrokes in shades of pale yellow, blue, and green.

title: Young Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature oil on copper of a person's portrait encased in a decorative gold frame. The oval painting shows the head and shoulders of a person with long, wavy, light brown hair. They have light skin, blue eyes, and are looking directly at the viewer. They wear a bright blue coat and a white, ruffled neckpiece. The metal frame surrounding the image has a braided edge and a small loop at the very top for hanging.

title: Monkeying with Literature
alt_text: A painting of a dark, cluttered room featuring a monkey sitting on a stack of books. The small, grey monkey perches on a wooden surface, resting its hand on an open book. A bright red cloth is draped heavily behind the monkey and spills down toward the floor. Below the monkey, a pile of books sits on the floor with some pages open. The background is dim and indistinct, with shadows obscuring the corners of the room.

title: Sleeper Awake
medium: Plaster, stones, seashells, paint, and gilt
alt_text: A sculpture of a human face emerges from a thick, textured cluster of materials. The central face is made of pale material with wide, staring eyes and appears partially covered by rough, layered substances. Surrounding the head and neck are numerous seashells, smooth stones, and patches of shiny gold leaf that create a craggy, organic shape. This sculpture rests upon a rectangular, weathered wooden pedestal. A small, rectangular label is attached to the front left side of the wooden stand. The entire piece is set against a dark background, highlighting the contrast between the rough textures and the plain base.

title: Young Woman
alt_text: A painting of abstract, mechanical shapes set against a solid, muted gray-brown background. At the top, a large black rectangle features five vertical, bright orange bars inside it. Below this, a pale blue circle sits in the center, marked with the text "CANTHARIARI" in black letters. To the lower right, a harp-like structure consists of a black base with several thin, dark vertical lines attached to two angled wooden stems. A large, curved, reddish-brown shape extends from the left side, resembling a pair of calipers or a large needle. The lower left corner of the canvas displays the handwritten words "Jeune femme" and the letters "GRD."

title: Sampler of stitches and designs from the Greek Islands
alt_text: A textile sampler showing many black embroidered patterns on a white cloth background. At the very top, a long band features a repeating row of birds. Below that, the words "SAMPLER 1938 ATHENS GREECE" appear, flanked by two horse figures facing each other. The rest of the cloth is covered with various designs, including several stylized flowers, geometric borders, and small symbols. Two larger plant motifs are centered in the middle and bottom sections of the piece.

title: Battle of Lights, Coney Island, Mardi Gras
alt_text: A painting of a crowded, abstract scene filled with many overlapping geometric shapes and bright colors. The composition is packed with small, fragmented triangles, squares, and wavy lines that create a sense of intense motion. In the center, there are hints of structures that look like a carousel and tall, spiky carnival rides. Bold shades of green, yellow, red, and blue are layered together across the entire canvas. Near the bottom center, some letters are faintly visible, including the word "PARK," embedded within the intricate patterns.

title: Brooklyn Bridge
alt_text: A painting of geometric structures and dark, atmospheric forms fills the canvas. Sharp, diagonal lines resembling bridge cables crisscross the composition from the top down. A central, vertical tower-like shape rises into the deep blue upper section. Near the bottom, a striking red diamond-shaped form stands out against the surrounding cool tones. The artwork uses shades of black, gray, and blue to create a sense of depth and layered industrial architecture.

title: Gideon Tomlinson (1780-1854) B.A.1802, M.A.1808
alt_text: A watercolor miniature shows a side-profile view of a man facing left. He has dark hair and wears a dark coat over a high-collared shirt with a ruffled neckpiece. The portrait is oval-shaped and set against a light tan background. It is contained within a rectangular wooden frame that has a small metal loop at the top for hanging. The man's skin appears fair with a soft, painted appearance.

title: Cover of embroidered cotton cloth
medium: Strip of open woven cotton cloth
alt_text: A textile showing a repeating pattern of geometric and creature-like shapes across its entire surface. This cloth is organized into five horizontal bands, separated by narrow strips of lighter open-weave fabric. Within each band, rectangular motifs alternate between a stylized animal figure with two dots and a complex square with a cross at its center. The animal figures have curved lines suggesting tails or manes and rounded bodies. The overall design creates a dense, grid-like appearance against the off-white background of the cotton cloth.

title: Square of cotton cloth, embroidered in silk.
medium: Suare open woven, balanced cotton cloth
alt_text: A square textile shows intricate white patterns woven into a darker grey background. The entire piece is framed by two distinct borders containing repeating geometric shapes like small stars and diagonal lines. Inside the central square, parallel diagonal bands create a texture of repeated wavy lines running from the top right to the bottom left. The overall design appears balanced and symmetrical across the entire cloth. The fabric edges are hemmed and clearly defined against the plain, light background.

title: Running Down the Trades
alt_text: A painting of a tall sailing ship moving across the ocean. The ship has several masts and many large, white sails that are fully spread. It is dark-hulled and sits low in the water, creating a small wake of white foam at the bow. The background is filled with a blue sky that has soft, light clouds. The painting is set within a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: The Honorable Asa Bacon (1771-1857), B.A.1793
alt_text: A miniature of a man showing his head and shoulders. He is an older man with gray-brown hair swept back from his forehead. He wears a dark black coat with a high collar over a white shirt with a simple tied cravat. His face is turned slightly to the right, and he has a calm expression with light-colored eyes. The painting is set inside a red rectangular frame with a tan-colored border around the portrait.

title: Epaphroditus Champion Bacon (1810-1845), B.A. 1833, M.A. 1836
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory of a young man, presented in a red case. The man is shown from the chest up, looking directly at the viewer with light-colored eyes. He has dark, curly hair and a clean-shaven face. He wears a high-collared black coat over a white shirt with a wide black necktie. The background is a soft, light, and cloudy blend of tan and white.

title: The Honorable Samuel Barrington (1729/1730-1800)
alt_text: A painting of an older man with white hair, shown from the chest up. The man has a serious expression and faces the viewer directly against a dark, oval background. He wears a dark coat over a ruffled white shirt with a black bowtie at his neck. Three gold or brown rectangular bars are attached to the left side of his coat near his shoulder. His skin is fair, and the lighting highlights his face while leaving the background in shadow.

title: Bag of Embroidered cotton
medium: The ground material is a coarse white cotton cloth
alt_text: A textile bag of coarse white cotton cloth features a highly detailed, repeating woven pattern. The body of the bag is rectangular and covered in a dark, intricate geometric design that resembles rows of small, pointed leaves or stylized hearts. A simpler, triangular pattern borders the top edge of the bag just below the handle attachments. Two thin, dark cord-like handles rise from the top of the rectangular body and join together at the center point above. The very bottom of the bag is a plain, unpatterned band of light-colored fabric.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LL.D.1781.
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up. He faces slightly to his left with a neutral expression. His light hair is tied back in a small ponytail at the nape of his neck. He wears a dark blue coat with tan lapels and decorative fringes on the shoulders. Underneath, he has a tan vest and a white fabric scarf tucked around his neck. The background is a simple, dark, and mottled gray shade.

title: General Epaphroditus Champion (1756-1834 or 1835)
alt_text: A miniature portrait shows an older man with white, thinning hair and a fair complexion. He is wearing a high-collared black coat over a white cravat and shirt. His head is turned slightly to the left, and he has a calm expression with blue-grey eyes looking toward the viewer. The background behind him features a soft, hazy sky that fades from a cool blue on the left to a warm, peachy light on the right. The entire portrait is enclosed in a rectangular, red velvet-covered case.

title: Elizabeth (Betsy) Stiles (1758–1795)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up against a dark, oval background. She has long, dark brown hair that falls over her shoulders. She wears a greenish-blue dress with a light-colored, ruffled shawl or collar around her neck. Her expression is calm, and she holds one hand near her chest. The portrait is framed in a simple, thin gold border.

title: Square of cotton cloth, embroidered in silk
medium: Square loosely woven balanced cotton cloth
alt_text: A square textile made of cotton shows an intricate repeating geometric pattern. The main part of the cloth features a grid of small, dark brown star-like shapes separated by tiny light-colored dots. This central area is surrounded by a wider border displaying a pattern of repeating circles enclosing diamond shapes. The colors are muted, mixing shades of dusty blue, tan, and dark brown throughout the design. The entire piece has a clean, symmetrical layout that fills the square shape.

title: Life Mask of George Washington (1732–1799)
medium: Mask: plaster; base: wood and glass
alt_text: A plaster mask of a face is centered against a dark blue textured background. The face has closed eyes, a straight nose, and a neutral mouth with lips pressed together. Its surface is a pale, off-white color with some light staining and scratches across the forehead and cheeks. A small, tan rectangular tag with the number "1943.96" written in black ink hangs from the top edge of the mask by a thin string. The overall shape is oval and captures the features of a human head from the neck up.

title: Cover of cotton cloth, embroidered in silk and gold
alt_text: A square open woven cotton cloth displays a highly symmetrical, repeating geometric pattern across its surface. The design consists of a grid formed by dark, linear bands running both vertically and horizontally. Within each square created by this grid, a small, lighter-colored shape sits in the center. These central shapes appear to be rounded, four-sided figures, each containing a tiny, dark interior detail. The overall appearance is a delicate, net-like texture that covers the entire square fabric.

title: Reverend Ammi Ruhamah Robbins (1740–1813), B.A. 1760, M.A. 1763
alt_text: A painting of an older man with gray hair who sits at a desk writing in a large open book. He wears a long, dark coat, a dark vest, and knee-high boots with buckles. To his left, a wooden desk holds a stack of thick, light-colored books and an inkwell. A vibrant red curtain hangs behind the desk, and a shelf of books is visible in the background. The man sits on a wooden chair, and the floor is covered in a patterned rug with round, flower-like designs.

title: Portrait of Joseph Stella
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a man sitting in a chair. The man is shown from the side and wears a dark blue suit jacket with a white shirt and a dark tie. He has short, dark hair and is looking off to the left. Behind him is a white wall with yellow arched windows and a glimpse of a blue and green landscape. The man's hand rests on the brown arm of a chair in the bottom right corner of the frame.

title: Benjamin Franklin (1706–1790)
alt_text: A terracotta sculpture shows a circular medallion with a relief portrait of a man in profile facing left. The man has a stout face and wears a flat, cap-like hat that covers his hair. He is dressed in a collared coat with a simple cravat tied at his neck. Around the edge of the medallion are the words "B. FRANKLIN" on the left and "AMERICAN" on the right. The lower edge of the circular piece is broken and has a noticeable chip. A barcode tag from a museum collection sits at the top of the image.

title: Mother and Child
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes in shades of pink, yellow, blue, and green creates an interlocking pattern across the canvas. A rounded yellow form resembling a head sits on the right side, cradled within larger, curved, and angular shapes. These surrounding sections use deep blues and dark teals to provide contrast against softer pink and orange tones. The overall composition feels crowded and tight, with no clear background or foreground. In the upper-left corner, a small "Stu" and the number "20" are painted in red.

title: Returning from the Market
alt_text: A textile made of wool and silk depicting an outdoor woodland scene. The central area shows a group of people and a small animal walking through a grassy field surrounded by large, leafy trees. On the right side, there is a small, pale stone building nestled among the foliage. A decorative border with repeating floral patterns surrounds the entire central scene. The overall image has a soft, muted look in shades of gray.

title: Nathan Hale (1755-76) Yale B.A. 1773, M.A. 1776, American Spy in the Revolutionary War
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a standing man looking off to his right. He wears a long, open coat over a vest and knee-length breeches. His hands are tied together behind his back, and his ankles are bound with rope. He stands on a small, angular base that has a plaque on the front. The sculpture is a dark brown color and stands against a plain, light grey background.

title: Nathan Hale (1755-76) Yale B.A. 1773, M.A. 1776, American Spy in the Revolutionary War
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a standing man is presented against a plain gray background. The man faces slightly to his left with a neutral expression on his face. He is wearing a long coat, a vest, and knee-length breeches over stockings. Ropes are tied around his ankles, suggesting he is bound. His arms hang down at his sides with his hands open and palms facing forward. He stands upright on a square, dark base.

title: Construction 14
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes layered on a solid black background. A wide, horizontal green rectangle sits in the middle, composed of overlapping, transparent-looking strips of varying green shades. Inside this rectangle, a pale circular shape appears on the left, and a thin, dark blue line cuts diagonally across the center. Towards the right side, a curved, reddish-brown line hooks downward and extends along the bottom of the painting. Two sets of small, dark rectangular blocks decorate the upper-left and lower-right edges of the main green shape.

title: Nathaniel Jocelyn (1796-1881)
medium: Watercolor over graphite pencil on ivory
alt_text: A miniature portrait shows the side profile of a young man against a light, misty background. He has light brown hair styled upward and wears a dark blue coat over a white, high-collared shirt. The portrait is encased in an ornate, oval-shaped brass frame with leafy details and a rose design at the top. This frame sits mounted against a larger, rectangular black background that is covered in a web of thin cracks. A small brass hanging loop is attached to the very top edge of the black backing.

title: Compound twill, brocaded
medium: Warps pale yellow silk with a white binding warp after every four
alt_text: A textile showing a repeating pattern of stylized flowers and swirling vines. This piece of fabric is square in shape and has a light, muted color throughout. The design covers the entire surface and looks like it was woven into the fabric. There is a horizontal crease running across the middle of the textile. The edges of the fabric are straight and defined.

title: No. 46 - 1922: The Town
alt_text: A painting shows a collection of blocky, geometric shapes that look like stylized building structures. The composition is made up of shades of black, gray, and white, with two prominent areas of bright red. One red section is a tall vertical bar on the left, while the other is a long horizontal rectangle near the center. Dark arches and rectangular blocks create a sense of overlapping depths throughout the scene. The overall arrangement feels rigid and architectural, lacking any rounded or organic forms.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of two stylized houses set against a background of geometric shapes and textures. The houses have white walls with stepped gable tops and dark red, shingled roofs. Between the houses, a dark green, fluffy tree stands tall against a background of blue wavy lines that suggest water or hills. A separate, round-topped light green tree sits in the foreground below the gap between the buildings. The entire scene is framed by a solid dark brown border that creates an angled effect.

title: Self-potrait
alt_text: A painting of a human face and a deer head, both overlapping with geometric shapes. The composition uses bright, flat colors like yellow, purple, blue, and brown to create different sections. A large human eye stares forward from the center of the image, set within a stylized face. Below the human features, the head of a deer faces toward the right with its own eye visible. Thin, dark tree branches stretch across the background, dividing the scene into jagged parts. Small, light-colored dots and a crescent shape appear in the dark, sky-like corners.

title: Battle of Cowpens
alt_text: A painting of a battle scene shows many soldiers on horseback fighting with swords in a chaotic landscape. In the center, a soldier holds a flag with red and white stripes and blue stars high in the air. Soldiers in blue and red uniforms charge toward each other, with several men fallen on the ground beneath the horses. Dark clouds fill the upper left sky, while the rest of the scene is lit by a hazy light. Some soldiers appear to be moving away in the background on the far right. The bottom right corner has a small body of water or a muddy path.

title: Seascape with Fisherman Pulling out Nets
alt_text: A painting of a stormy coastal scene features several figures pulling a heavy net from the dark, churning water. On the shore, a group of four men lean back, working together to haul in the ropes attached to the net. The sea is deep, turbulent, and filled with white-capped waves that crash near the men’s feet. A rocky cliff rises sharply on the right side of the scene, topped by a cluster of stone buildings that look like old ruins. Above the dark landscape, the sky is filled with heavy, dramatic clouds swirling in shades of blue and gray.

title: Docks
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract city scene made of blocky shapes and dark lines. Several geometric, gray and brown buildings fill the frame with square windows and flat roofs. A prominent, vertical red-brown shape cuts through the center of the scene, separating the buildings. Sketchy, thin lines are layered over the shapes to suggest structures like chimneys, ladders, and faint writing. The overall color palette is muted, consisting mostly of grays, browns, and blacks.

title: In Memoriam
alt_text: A painting of layered, abstract shapes in shades of brown, grey, dark blue, and light green. The composition features a central, curved, light-brown area that rises toward the top of the canvas, resembling an arched or head-like form. Surrounding this central shape are jagged, overlapping geometric segments in darker tones of grey and brown. A distinct vertical strip of deep blue cuts down through the middle of the painting. The entire image has a textured, matte appearance, with soft edges between the colors rather than sharp lines.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a child while sitting on a throne. The woman wears a long, deep blue robe over a peach-colored garment and gazes down at the child. The small child sits on her lap, wearing a light green top and an orange skirt, while touching the woman's face. Both figures are positioned against a bright, textured gold background shaped like an arch. The seat of the throne is flat and green, and both figures have glowing, circular patterns behind their heads.

title: Capture of the "Serapis" by John Paul Jones
alt_text: A painting of a ship on fire at sea is captured in this oil on canvas work. The main ship sits on the right side, glowing with orange and yellow flames against a dark and stormy sky. A smaller, darker ship sails peacefully to the left in the distance. The churning, dark water fills the lower portion of the frame, reflecting the bright light from the burning vessel. Above, heavy, swirling clouds dominate the scene, partially obscuring a bright moon or sun. The entire painting is displayed inside a large, ornate gold frame.

title: Length of linen embroidered in wool
alt_text: A textile of linen shows intricate dark embroidery on a light beige cloth. The main patterns include large, stylized flowers and long, thin branches that run horizontally across the fabric. Scattered around these floral shapes are several four-legged animals that look like small dogs or mythical creatures. A narrow border with leaves and other designs runs along the left side. A white rectangular label with the black text "1944.111" sits along the bottom edge.

title: At the Piano
alt_text: A painting of fragmented shapes and forms that create a busy, layered composition. Large geometric shapes in shades of deep blue, brown, black, white, and green overlap throughout the scene. Near the center, there is a prominent white rectangular shape that resembles sheet music, with the word "BACH" clearly printed in dark letters at the top. Other abstract shapes suggesting figures or objects seem to be tucked behind and around this sheet music. The entire image uses jagged lines and sharp angles rather than smooth, realistic outlines. Overall, the scene looks like a collection of many different objects smashed together into a flat, patterned design.

title: Generals Washington and Rochambeau before Yorktown
alt_text: A painting of a group of men in military uniforms standing outdoors near a large tent. A central figure in a dark coat and hat stands tall and points to the left with his right hand. To his right, other men gather around a large paper document held out on a table or perhaps being presented by someone. The setting appears to be a field at dusk or under a stormy sky, with dark clouds looming overhead. Some of the men are wearing long coats, breeches, and tall boots. A person sits on the ground in the lower right corner, looking up at the group.

title: Well-head decorated with coats of arms and vases
alt_text: A stone sculpture of a wellhead sits outdoors on a patch of grass. The object is carved from light-colored, rough stone and has a wide, circular opening in the center. Its thick, textured rim features shallow indentations and some darkened, weathered areas. On the front, a faint, decorative relief carving shows a symmetrical, shield-like shape with curved sides. The entire structure looks heavy, sturdy, and sits directly on the ground.

title: Virgin and Child
medium: White marble relief in architectural wooden frame painted in blue and gold
alt_text: A marble relief shows a woman holding a small baby. She is depicted from the waist up, facing slightly to her right, with a smooth, calm expression on her face. The baby is held against her chest, facing upward toward the woman, with one hand resting near her neck. Behind each of their heads, there is a smooth, circular disc carved into the marble. The entire relief is set inside a heavy wooden frame with gold detailing on its edges.

title: Virgin and Child
medium: Tempera, distemper, and gold on panel
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small child against a gold background. The woman stands facing forward and wears a long, bright blue robe over a pale patterned dress, with a matching blue head covering. She holds a small, unclothed child in her arms, who is wrapped in a bright orange cloth. Behind both figures is a smooth, golden surface, and they each have a circular gold halo around their heads. The entire painting is framed within a pointed, arch-shaped wooden structure that is also decorated with gold.

title: Two Deacon Saints
medium: Tempera and gold on canvas, transferred from panel
alt_text: A painting of two figures standing against a gold background. The figures are dressed in long, elaborate robes with gold patterns, one in blue and one in pink. Both figures have golden halos around their heads and hold palm fronds and books in their hands. They are framed within a pointed arch shape, with a carved circular design at the very top. The entire surface has a bright, metallic gold appearance.

title: Colonel John Trumbull (1756-1843)
alt_text: A painting of an older man shown from the chest up. He has short, light gray hair and fair skin with reddish cheeks. He wears a dark, textured coat with a wide, fur-like collar that frames his neck. A white, ruffled cravat sits at his throat. The background is a simple, dark brown wash that is lighter on the right side.

title: The Garden of Love
alt_text: A painting of a group of people gathered in an outdoor garden scene against a gold background. In the center, a large, stone, hexagonal fountain stands tall, with figures surrounding it on both sides. To the left, several people in long robes are standing or sitting, with some holding instruments like a harp. To the right of the fountain, other figures are gathered on the ground, wearing colorful garments. Dark, rounded trees are scattered across the scene, providing a backdrop to the figures. The entire image is enclosed in a thick, textured gold-colored frame.

title: The Adoration of the Magi
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a baby in a rocky, outdoor landscape. To the left, a man in a red robe stands inside a small building, while the woman sits on the ground with the baby. To the right, a large group of men in bright, golden, and patterned clothing gather around them. Some of these men are kneeling and holding decorative cups or containers. In the background, there is a river winding through hills under a textured sky that features a bright, circular shape.

title: Robert John Herman Kiphuth (1890–1967), M.A. (Hon.) 1950
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair, shown from the chest up. The man is middle-aged with light brown hair and wears a tan suit jacket over a light-colored dress shirt. He has a striped tie with dark and light yellow colors. His hands are clasped together in his lap, and he looks directly forward with a calm expression. The painting is set against a solid dark brown background and encased in a large, bright gold frame.

title: Virgin and Child with Two Angels
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a young child, with an angel standing on each side of them. The central woman wears a blue cloak over a reddish dress and has a golden halo behind her head. The child, who stands on a ledge in front of her, also has a halo and reaches his hand toward the woman's neck. On the left, a figure with wings wears a pale pink robe and looks down toward the child. On the right, another winged figure with folded hands wears a yellow robe. A gold, patterned curtain hangs across the top of the entire scene.

title: The Resurrection
medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on panel
alt_text: A painting of a man standing inside a stone box with two other figures sitting on the ground nearby. The central figure has long brown hair, a bare chest, and wears a flowing grey cloth. He holds a tall wooden staff attached to a white flag with a thin red cross on it. To the left, a man wearing dark armor and red sleeves rests his head on his hand. On the right, a person in a blue vest and yellow sleeves leans back while looking toward the center. The background shows rolling green hills under a pale sky, all enclosed by a wide, reddish border.

title: Venus at the Forge of Vulcan, also known as "Thetis receives the Arms of Achilles"
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in the center, wearing a polished metal breastplate over a red cloth wrapped around her lower body. To her left, a large, muscular bearded man with dark skin reaches toward her. Several small, winged babies are gathered around the woman, and one baby floats in the sky above her with a small bow. Another baby holds a metal helmet near the woman's right side, while others play on the ground nearby. The scene is dark, with soft, dramatic lighting that highlights the figures against a cloudy, shadowy background.

title: Noli me tangere
medium: Tempera, oil and gold on panel
alt_text: A painting of two figures standing in an enclosed yard surrounded by a tall wooden fence. A man with long brown hair stands on the left, wearing a long blue robe and holding a thin tool over his shoulder. A woman with long hair kneels on the ground in front of him, reaching out with both hands as if to touch him. She is wearing a bright red dress with dark green sleeves. The yard has a flat, grassy ground, and low green hills appear in the distance behind the fence.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small child is framed by a pointed arch. The woman wears a deep red cloak and a dark blue garment underneath, and she gazes toward the viewer. A small, nude child is nestled in her arms, looking off to the side with an open expression. Behind both figures is a decorative background of textured gold, which is partially faded. The panel is set within a light-colored wooden frame that has a pointed top.

title: Saints Elizabeth of Hungary and Anthony of Padua
alt_text: A painting of two standing figures wearing robes and golden halos against a dark blue, arched background. The woman on the left wears a light-colored head covering and a tan gown, while holding a small dish of flowers in one hand and a bright red flame in the other. The man on the right wears a dark brown monk’s robe with a rope belt and holds a closed blue book in his arms. Both figures look toward the left side of the frame. The background features two decorative, pointed arches at the top with a pattern of dark blue and gray shapes.

title: Saints Louis of Toulouse and Clare
alt_text: A painting of two figures standing side by side against a dark blue background framed by two golden arches. On the left, a man wears a tall, pointed white hat and a bright red robe over a gray garment. He holds a dark rectangular book in one hand and a thin staff in the other, with a golden halo behind his head. To his right, a person with a dark head covering and a simple brown robe holds a small flowering plant and a reddish book. Both figures have light skin and neutral expressions, while their halos appear as flat, gold-textured circles around their heads. The panel has visible signs of wear along the edges and surface.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting showing a woman holding a small child against a gold background within a tall, arched frame. Both figures are heavily worn, with large areas where the paint has flaked away to reveal the wooden panel beneath. The woman wears a blue head covering and robe, while the child is dark and sits on her lap. The background is a faded red with gold patterns that are also peeling. At the bottom of the frame, a horizontal wooden ledge features an inscription written in Latin letters.

title: Saint Lucy Enthroned
alt_text: A painting of a central female figure seated on a throne, surrounded by six figures with large wings. The woman in the center wears a bright red cloak over a blue tunic and holds a thin sword against her chest and a small, round container in her hand. Behind her, a dark blue fabric with intricate patterns hangs as a backdrop against a gold background. Two winged figures stand tall on either side of her, while four other winged figures kneel at the bottom, two playing musical instruments. All of the figures have light-colored skin, long hair, and circular gold halos around their heads.

title: The Story of Rinaldo da Montalbano, or the Four Sons of Aymon
alt_text: A painting of many figures in an indoor room on the left and an outdoor forest scene on the right. On the left, several people in brightly colored tunics stand in a curved, open hall, with some kneeling on the ground. In the middle section, a person in a short green tunic stands in a doorway looking toward a group of men riding pale horses. The scene on the right shows a small forest with dark trees and white, tent-like structures in the background. A group of people gathers near the tents, wearing red, blue, and yellow clothes. The colors throughout the piece appear worn and faded in places.

title: Virgin and Child in Glory with Saint John the Baptist, Saint Peter, and Two Angels
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a central woman in a blue robe holding a small child on her lap against a dark red background. Two angels with folded hands stand on either side of the pair, while two bearded men in long robes stand at the bottom corners. Above the woman, two smaller, winged figures float near the top of the rounded panel. Below, two large, decorative vase-like shapes sit on the ground, each holding a small white flower. A faint red winged circle is painted between the two bottom figures.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a child, done in tempera and gold. The woman has pale skin, a fair face, and a large, flat gold halo behind her head. She wears a dark red dress with gold trim and holds her hands together in front of her chest. A small child sits on her arm, wearing a greenish-yellow tunic and a red sash. The child reaches up to grasp a long piece of light fabric that hangs from the woman's hands. The background is a textured, cracked surface with a faded blue area and remnants of thin, vertical poles on either side.

title: Virgin and Child with Two Angels
alt_text: A painting of a woman and child surrounded by two smaller figures, set within an ornate, arched gold-toned frame. A woman with a large gold halo holds a standing, mostly unclothed child who reaches toward her face. On either side of the pair, two figures with light hair and serious expressions look out from the background. The background behind the figures is filled with a dense pattern of red roses and green leaves, accented with faint gold stars on the black border. At the bottom of the frame, an inscription in gold letters reads "AVE MARIA GRATIA PLENA."

title: Virgin and Child with Three Angels
alt_text: A painting of a woman with her hands clasped in prayer, surrounded by figures on a dark blue background. At the top center, a white dove with wings spread flies above the woman’s golden halo. Below, a small baby sits in the arms of one of three figures who look toward the woman. These three lower figures also wear golden halos and are positioned on the left side of the frame. The entire image is encased in an ornate, arched, gold-colored wooden frame with a small decorative shield at the bottom center.

title: Virgin and Child with Saint John the Baptist
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a young child, surrounded by other figures in a landscape. The woman wears a dark green cloak over a red dress, while the child is unclothed and reaches toward a young boy on the left. The boy holds a tall, thin wooden staff and leans on a rocky ledge. Behind the woman stand two figures, one with wings, who look toward the center. The background shows a winding path, distant buildings, and sparse trees under a pale sky.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Two Angels
alt_text: A painting shows a woman wearing a dark blue robe and a head covering, seated on an ornate throne. She holds a small, unclothed child in her lap, whose head is surrounded by a glowing gold halo. Two winged figures with red wings appear in the background, positioned on either side of the seated woman. The entire scene is set against a background of textured gold, and the throne is decorated with a red pattern. The painting itself is shaped with a pointed top, framed by a thick gold border.

title: Saint Flora, One of Two Panels from an Altarpiece
alt_text: A painting of a woman with a dark veil, set against a bright gold background. The woman faces forward with a calm expression, wearing a dark brown robe covered by a long black cloak with white trim. Her hands are gently clasped near her waist, holding a thin, dark object. Two small, circular portraits of winged figures appear in the upper left and right corners of the gold archway. At the bottom edge of the frame, there is a narrow strip with small, indistinct gold letters. The entire painting is framed within a decorated, golden wooden structure.

title: Laying the Cards
alt_text: A painting of a person with a tall, light-colored head covering, facing forward. They wear a red top with puffy, greyish-blue sleeves and a necklace of small red beads. Their hands are clasped in front of them, resting over a pattern of playing card suits. To the right of the person, two reddish-brown pitchers sit on a shelf. The background is filled with muted shades of brown, orange, and red, creating a busy, textured look.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a young child. The woman wears a dark blue head covering and a deep blue cloak over a reddish-pink garment. She holds a small, round-faced child on her left arm, who is dressed in blue robes. Both figures stand against a textured, metallic gold background that fills the entire upper portion of the frame. The panel itself is shaped with a pointed top edge like a house roof.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of various dark and muted shapes arranged together. The image is filled with many jagged, overlapping geometric forms in shades of gray, dark blue, brown, and black. A brighter, pale white or off-white area sits at the bottom, suggesting a flat surface or a cloth underneath the objects. Some shapes in the center and upper right seem to suggest rounded forms, possibly bowls or fruit. The overall mood of the scene is dim and abstract, with the textures of the underlying canvas fabric visible throughout.

title: Seated Girl
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas shows a person sitting down in an abstract style. The figure is composed of many jagged, overlapping shapes in shades of yellow, green, brown, and gray. These shapes obscure the face and body, making them look like a puzzle of colors. The background consists of large, flat rectangles in dark gray and black, which surround the figure. The overall effect creates a geometric and fragmented appearance throughout the composition.

title: Color perspective (Horizontal)
alt_text: A painting of several flat, overlapping geometric shapes set against a bright red background. A large, yellow polygon sits near the center, flanked by irregular shapes in shades of teal, light blue, and dark gray. These shapes interlock and overlap, creating a complex, angular pattern across the middle of the canvas.
