The entire design is contained within a thin, plain border that frames the colored composition. A small, dark signature is visible in the lower left corner.

title: The Jockey
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes rendered in shades of orange, green, and gray. Large, jagged blocks of burnt orange dominate the composition, appearing to overlap one another. In the center, a cluster of angled, pale gray and off-white shapes breaks up the warm tones. Thin, darker lines trace the outlines of these forms, creating a sense of fragmentation across the rectangular canvas. A pale, seafoam green hue fills the gaps between the orange and gray sections.

title: Mourning Virgin, Fragment of a Crucifix
alt_text: A painting of a woman with her hands clasped in front of her chest. She wears a dark blue hood over her head and a deep blue cloak that covers her shoulders. Beneath the cloak, a simple, light-colored garment is visible at her neck and chest area. Her head is turned slightly downward as she looks toward the bottom right. A bright, textured gold halo circles her head against a rich, orange-red background. The entire image shows signs of age with cracks throughout the painted surface.

title: Everett Victor Meeks (1879-1954), B.A. 1901, B.F.A. 1917, M.A. (hon.) 1919
alt_text: A painting showing a middle-aged man sitting behind a large desk. The man wears a dark suit and looks directly forward with a slight smile and a white mustache. On the desk in front of him are several items, including a white horse figurine, a dark mortarboard cap with a tassel, and a small round mask. Behind the man sits a large, dark, spherical object that looks like a globe. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame with intricate carvings.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Two Angels
alt_text: A painting showing a woman in a blue cloak holding a young child on her lap. She sits at the center of the frame, looking down at the child. To the left, a person in a dark green dress stands playing a small pipe organ. On the right, another person in a long pink dress holds a small book or object. Behind the group, a light-colored stone structure with arches and dark plants adds depth to the scene.

title: Daniel with Two Lions
alt_text: A painting showing a young person standing in front of a large, dark stone rock formation. The person wears a long, blue robe and light-colored boots, and they hold a long white scroll in one hand. Two large, brown lions sit on the ground, one to the left and one to the right of the person. To the far left, a thin tree stands in a green, grassy field. In the background, the sky is a pale blue color.

title: The Nativity; The Crucifixion with Mary Magdalen and a Female Donor(?); Saints Jerome, John the Baptist, Anthony of Padua, and Francis
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows multiple scenes within a tall, arched, gold-trimmed frame. In the larger, lower section, a woman stands with her hands clasped, looking down at a small baby lying on the ground, while an older, bearded man in blue robes kneels beside them. The background features a simple landscape with faint trees and small figures kneeling on the right. Above this main scene, a separate horizontal panel depicts a person on a cross, flanked by four people sitting or kneeling on either side. Narrow vertical panels on the far left and right edges feature small, standing figures dressed in robes. A dark, starry sky fills the upper arch, and the bottom edge of the frame bears a faded, carved inscription.

title: The Agony in the Garden
medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on panel
alt_text: A painting on panel shows several figures in a landscape with a distant city. On the left, a person with long hair kneels and prays while a small, winged figure flies toward them carrying a cup. On the right, three other figures sit on the grass, resting their heads on their hands as if sleeping or deep in thought. They wear long, draped robes in colors like red, green, and yellow. In the middle distance between the two groups, small towers and buildings rise up against a pale blue sky.

title: The Way to Calvary
medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on panel
alt_text: A painting of a figure carrying a large wooden cross across a landscape. On the left side, two women in long dresses stand together. Next to them, a person in dark metal armor walks while holding a round wooden shield. In the center, a figure wearing a long, light-purple robe carries a large cross over one shoulder. To the right, a person in a short, dark tunic leads the way while holding a rope attached to the cross-bearer. In the background, green hills and a distant mountain rise under a pale sky.

title: Mary Magdalene
alt_text: A painting on wood of a young woman with long, wavy reddish hair. She wears a gathered pinkish-red dress with loose sleeves and a dark band across the front of her chest. Her face has a pale complexion, and she looks directly forward with a calm expression. With her right hand, she holds a simple, rounded vase near her waist. The background shows a landscape with a dark, slender tree on the left and a flat field on the right.

title: Saint James
alt_text: A painting of a man with long, wavy hair and a halo. He wears a pale pink robe under a dark blue cloak and holds a golden staff in his right hand. In his left hand, he carries a rectangular red book with dark clasps. The background is a plain, light-colored surface. The figure is centered in the frame and faces slightly to the left.

title: Saint Bridget's Vision of the Nativity
alt_text: A painting of a scene with several figures against a dark, worn background. A woman in a long, muted green robe kneels on the left with her hands clasped in prayer, surrounded by a large golden halo. In the center, a small baby lies on the ground, also surrounded by a golden, glowing circle. To the right, another standing figure wears robes of muted red and blue. Above the figures, a curved, arched shape contains several indistinct, smaller faces looking downward. The entire image has a cracked and faded appearance, with patches of gold paint visible throughout.

title: John Davis (1787-1854), B.A. 1812, M.A. 1822
alt_text: A painting of a man presented in an oval gold frame. The man has short, wavy, light brown hair and is looking slightly toward his left. He is wearing a dark coat with a high, dark collar that rises up around his neck. Underneath the coat, a white shirt or cravat is visible at his throat. The background behind the man is a dark, solid brown color.

title: Saint John the Evangelist
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a person with short, curly reddish hair standing in a pointed arch frame. The background is a bright, solid gold color, and a textured gold circle surrounds the person's head like a halo. They wear a long blue shirt under a loose red robe draped over their left shoulder. The figure holds an open book with their left hand and a thin stylus or pen in their right hand. The frame itself is decorated with carved red patterns and painted with faded gold details.

title: Bust of a Deacon Saint
alt_text: A fresco painting of a person’s head and shoulders is centered on a rectangular surface. The figure is facing forward and has a circular halo behind their head with faint, decorative dotted lines. Their face appears worn and is painted in shades of pale pink and brown. The person wears a garment across their shoulders that is also decorated with a pattern of small, raised circles. Darker, blue-grey shapes appear in the background on either side of the figure.

title: Virgin and Child with Fourteen Saints; The Annunciation
alt_text: A painting of a central woman holding a child, surrounded by a large group of saints against a gold background. The woman wears a dark cloak over a light, patterned dress, and the small child is wrapped in a pink cloth. Many people stand in rows on either side of the pair, all featuring round golden halos behind their heads. Most of the figures wear colorful robes and hold small books or other symbolic items in their hands. The arched top of the painting is framed by intricate golden patterns, and there are two small circular portraits near the very top corners.

title: Virgin and Child with Four Saints and Four Angels
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a child, surrounded by several smaller figures. The woman wears a dark blue head covering that wraps around her shoulders. In her arms, she holds a young child who is wearing a reddish-gold patterned outfit. Both figures are set against a background of bright red with gold details, including halos behind their heads. On either side and above them, smaller faces of other people appear to look toward the center. The entire scene is enclosed within a worn, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: Annunciatory Angel
alt_text: A painting of an angel with long, blonde hair and large wings kneeling on a pink floor. The figure wears a dark red, knee-length tunic over a long, patterned gold skirt. One hand is raised as if gesturing, while the other hand holds a thin, white plant stem with small leaves. A golden halo circles the angel's head against a solid teal background. The entire scene is framed by a thick, gold, weathered border.

title: Virgin Annunciate
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing inside a room with her hands clasped together in front of her. She wears a long, patterned gold dress under a large blue cloak that covers her shoulders and back. A small, thin gold halo floats directly above her head. Behind her, the walls of the room are dark red with a tall, light-brown pedestal visible on the left side. The entire image is enclosed in a thick, distressed gold frame.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints Margaret and Catherine of Siena
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small child, flanked by two other women against a gold background. The central woman wears a bright blue hood and a red dress, looking forward with a serious expression. She holds a naked baby boy on her lap, who also looks forward. To her left, a woman with blonde hair in a tan dress touches the baby’s shoulder. To her right, a woman in a black veil and white head covering holds a flower. All four figures have circular, golden outlines around their heads.

title: The Nativity
alt_text: A painting of a scene set outdoors, featuring four figures within an arched, gold-colored frame. On the left, an older man with a long white beard wears a red robe and leans on a wooden staff. In the center, a woman with light hair kneels with her hands clasped together, wearing a long dress covered by a dark cloak. A small, pale infant lies on the ground between them, reaching upward with both arms. Behind the woman, a second person with darker hair stands and looks toward the child. In the background, a bird flies near a wooden structure, while a cow stands quietly to the left.

title: The Visitation
alt_text: A painting of two women embracing at the center of a room. On the left, two figures stand with wings, and another figure stands further left in a green cloak. The two central women wear long, flowing robes in blue-patterned and deep red fabrics. To the right, a woman in a green cloak and white head covering watches the embrace. A small, white, furry animal rests on the ground in the bottom right corner of the scene. A second room is visible through a doorway in the back, where a person sits reading a book.

title: Christ in Glory
alt_text: A painting on a triangular wooden panel shows a man with long hair and a beard centered against a blue background. The figure wears a blue tunic covered by a draped red garment over his left shoulder. He holds a white sphere in his right hand and an open book with text on the pages in his left hand. The dark blue background is decorated with small, golden, four-pointed stars. A glowing halo made of thin white rays surrounds his head and upper body. The edges of the panel are worn and show the natural texture of the wood.

title: Christ among the Doctors
alt_text: A painting showing a group of people gathered inside a room with stone benches. In the center, a person wearing a dark robe and a golden halo sits on a raised platform, gesturing with their hands. To the left and right, rows of seated men and women in colorful robes listen or look toward the center figure. Several people hold open books, and some wear hats in shades of red, white, or black. The background wall is plain and yellow-brown, framing the figures as they sit around a central green floor area.

title: The Island of Peace
alt_text: A painting of several pale nude figures gathered on a small, grassy island under a curved, rainbow-colored arch. In the center, a woman stands with her arms raised high toward the sky, while other figures stand or crouch nearby in various poses. One person on the left holds a small child, and a figure on the far right bends down low toward the ground. Two dark, leafy trees frame the scene on the left and right sides. The background features deep blue and violet swirling brushstrokes that suggest a dark, cloudy sky.

title: Saint Peter
alt_text: A painting on a wood panel shows a portrait of an older man with gray hair and a short beard. He is wearing a blue shirt under a loose, tan-colored robe. The man holds a thick, red-covered book against his body with his left hand. His right hand is raised toward his chest with his palm facing slightly forward. He stands against a shimmering, textured gold background that forms a wide arch shape above his head.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Four Angels
alt_text: A painting of a seated woman holding a small child on her lap against a gold background. The woman wears a purple head covering and a long, flowing dress, while the child sits on her lap wrapped in an orange cloth. Two kneeling figures in long, reddish-orange robes flank the woman on either side, their hands resting on the edges of a dark blue, possibly fabric, surface. Two more figures with similar reddish hair and expressions peer out from behind the central woman’s shoulders. All five people have circular golden halos surrounding their heads, and the paint across the entire surface shows fine, web-like cracks.

title: Color perspective (vertical)
alt_text: A painting shows abstract shapes arranged against a muted purple background. Sharp, geometric forms in bright red, yellow, black, and green overlap one another in the center of the canvas. These shapes are mostly composed of straight edges and angles, though there is one dark, curved shape tucked behind the yellow and red sections. The entire arrangement is bordered by a thin, reddish frame-like edge painted directly onto the canvas. A small signature with the letters "J.V." sits in the bottom right corner of the painting.

title: Czar Paul I
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a person next to a black fabric backing. The portrait on the right features a person with white powdered hair wearing a dark green coat with red trim and several medals pinned to the chest. They are set against a light blue, cloudy background within a simple, light-colored frame. On the left side, a piece of black material is attached to a tan card and features two white labels with handwritten script. A small, round white sticker with more writing is placed near the bottom corner of the black fabric. At the very top, a white museum tag hangs from a string with numbers and letters printed on it.

title: Hauled Up
alt_text: A painting of a harbor scene with a boat pulled onto a sandy shore. The boat sits at the center, propped up by wooden supports. Behind the boat, there are several buildings with light-colored walls and dark roofs. In the background, tall metal cranes and part of a bridge structure rise against the sky. A small patch of green water is visible in the bottom right corner near wooden planks.

title: The Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting of a figure on a wooden cross, with two people standing below. A person with long hair hangs from the cross with arms outstretched. To the left, a woman in a blue cloak and red dress stands with her hands pressed together near her chin. To the right, another person wearing a green robe and red shawl looks up toward the cross. At the base of the cross, a human skull rests on the green ground. The background shows a pale landscape with distant hills, water, and small figures.

title: A Vision: Buddha
alt_text: A painting depicts a stylized, face-like mask surrounded by jagged shapes and dark, muted tones. This central mask is rendered in shades of green and brown with sharp, angular lines defining the eyes, nose, and mouth. To the lower left, there is a cluster of rounded, fruit-like forms in oranges and dull greens. The background is filled with fragmented geometric shapes, including some that look like a dark blue five-pointed star. Heavy, visible brushstrokes create a textured, somewhat chaotic feeling across the entire surface of the board.

title: Saint John (Fragment of Crucifixion)
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a person with a head covering, looking downward with a somber expression. The person wears a long, deep red cloak over a dark, solid-colored tunic. A golden, textured background surrounds the figure, and a subtle halo is etched in the gold behind their head. The top of the painting is arched with a decorative carved border. Visible cracks in the paint surface run horizontally across the middle of the figure.

title: Samuel Sidney Breese (1768-1848), B.A. (Hon.) 1789
alt_text: A painting of an older man with light skin and white hair. He is wearing a long, dark coat with a high, white collar or cravat underneath. The man is looking directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. Behind him hangs a large, textured red curtain that covers most of the background. On the far left, a small opening in the curtain reveals a view of a distant, cloudy landscape with trees.

title: Double-Sided Processional Cross
alt_text: A painting on a gold-covered wooden panel shaped like a large cross depicts a central figure on the cross with smaller figures in the side arms and at the top and bottom. The central figure is a man with long hair, shown with his head tilted down and arms outstretched against the dark cross. A smaller figure with wings is centered above him near the top of the cross, while one figure dressed in dark robes stands on the left arm and another in red robes stands on the right. Below the central figure, a smaller, kneeling person is painted at the bottom of the cross. The background of the entire cross is a bright, textured gold, and small decorative circles with red and black patterns are placed in the rounded areas of the cross arms.

title: The Blessing Redeemer
alt_text: A painting of a person with a green-toned face and long brown hair. This figure is centered against a dark reddish-orange background with a gold, circular halo behind their head. They wear a light blue robe draped with a reddish-pink cloak that has a decorative gold border. With one hand raised in a gesture, the figure holds a white open book in their other hand at the bottom of the frame. A thin, vertical crack runs straight down the middle of the painting.

title: Saint Jerome, One of Two Panels from a Dismembered Altarpiece
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting of an older man with a white beard wearing a bright red hat and long red robes. He holds a white quill pen in his right hand and clutches a dark, closed book with his left hand. The figure stands against a flat, textured gold background that fills the entire area around him. A thin black cord hangs down from his hat and rests over the front of his red cloak. The man’s gaze is directed slightly to the left, and his face shows detailed, thoughtful features.

title: Portrait of an Augustinian Monk, identified as Fra Mariano da Genezzano
alt_text: A painting of a person’s head and neck, shown in profile facing to the left. The person wears a dark, close-fitting hood that covers their head and neck, leaving only their face visible. Their skin is a light, warm brown tone. They have a short, trimmed beard along their jawline and chin. The background is a plain, pale blue-grey color.

title: Little Girl Holding Flowers (attributed to Joseph Badger)
alt_text: A painting of a young child wearing a light pink dress and a white lace cap. The child stands facing the front and holds a small, round basket filled with white and pink flowers in both hands. The dress has long sleeves with ruffled white cuffs and a wide, long skirt. The background is a simple, dark, and blurry mix of muted browns and grays. Only the tops of the child's dark shoes are visible at the very bottom of the frame.

title: Captain William Richardson (1743-1786)
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up, positioned against a dark oval background. The man has pale skin, light brown hair styled back, and a neutral expression. He wears a white coat over a dark blue waistcoat that has silver buttoned details. A white ruffled fabric collar peeks out from beneath the waistcoat. The lighting on his face is soft, highlighting his features against the shadows behind him.

title: Merz 1003 (Peacock's Tail)
medium: Oil and wood on composition board
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes arranged on a dark background. The composition is dominated by a large white crescent shape on the left side that partially curves around a smaller gray circle. A large black wedge shape spans the right side, bordered by a vibrant red curve on the far edge. Several straight lines and smaller rectangular blocks in yellow and black are positioned near the center of the image. The entire work is built from flat, distinct planes of color with no visible brushstrokes.

title: View of Charleston from the Harbor
alt_text: A painting of a busy harbor scene shows many boats on the water near a city shoreline. Several small rowboats carry groups of people across the choppy green waves in the foreground. To the right, a large, rectangular brown fort sits at the water's edge with tall ships docked nearby. Further out, a sailboat with a blue, white, and red flag moves across the left side of the scene. The background reveals a row of buildings and a tall church steeple under a sky filled with wispy, soft clouds.

title: View of Charleston
alt_text: A painting of a busy harbor scene shows many ships of different sizes sailing on choppy green water. In the center, a large sailing ship with tall masts and flags stands out among smaller sailboats and rowboats. Behind the vessels, a wide city skyline stretches across the horizon, featuring many small buildings. The sky above is light blue with large, soft white clouds drifting across it. The entire painting is enclosed in a simple, metallic-colored frame.

title: Sappho
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small, wooden harp. She is facing away from the viewer with her back exposed and her head bowed down. Her arms are wrapped around the instrument, which sits against her midsection. The painting is circular in shape and framed by a large, square, ornate gold border with swirling decorative carvings. Dark, muted colors surround the figure, contrasting with the soft, pale skin tone of her back.

title: The Eternal Hills
alt_text: A painting of a mountainous landscape with abstract shapes. Dark green mountains rise against a light, cloudy sky in the background. In the foreground, there is a large, dark, reddish-brown expanse of land. Two light-colored, sharp, triangular shapes sit prominently on the right side of the painting, appearing to hover or stand against the dark hill. Long, faint, thin, white lines stretch across the dark brown ground, adding a sense of movement.

title: Tochil'schik Printsip Mel'kaniia (The Knife Grinder or Principle of Glittering)
alt_text: A painting of an angular figure working at a circular tool. The image is composed of many sharp, overlapping geometric shapes in shades of blue, gray, brown, and orange. The central figure appears to be hunched over a round, wheel-like object, resting their hands on top of it. Triangular and rectangular forms surround the figure, creating a fragmented, busy background. The entire composition is broken into small, flat planes of color that give the work a layered, abstract look.

title: Lake Nemi
alt_text: A painting of a landscape scene with a lake, hills, and people. In the foreground, two women sit on a large rock on the grassy shore, while another person swims in the calm water nearby. A tall, leafy tree with yellow and green leaves stands on the left side of the scene. Across the water, a small town sits on top of a distant, rocky hill covered in trees. The sky above is bright blue with scattered, fluffy white clouds.

title: The White Heron
alt_text: A painting of a white heron standing in a garden setting against a blue and green background. The large, white heron is positioned on the right, facing left, with its long neck curved elegantly. To the left, a tall, purple cone-shaped flower rises vertically among dark green leaves. A small, brown bird sits on a green vine near the bottom left corner, below a white flower with a yellow center. In the upper middle section, a pale, spindly flower with yellow, lace-like petals adds texture to the scene. Other green leaves and white blossoms fill the space around the main subjects.

title: Landscape in the Park
alt_text: A painting of an abstract scene made with oil on canvas. The image features a dark, moody background with deep blue and grey tones. Several geometric shapes, including curves, circles, and angled lines, overlap throughout the composition. A structure with railings and what appear to be stairs sits on the left side of the frame. Long, vertical lines cut across the center, creating a path-like divide between the darker shapes.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints Bartholomew and Jerome
alt_text: A painting on a wood panel shows three figures standing against a solid gold background. In the center, a woman with a dark blue head covering sits on a simple white bench, holding a small, naked baby on her lap. To the left, a man with a beard stands wearing a long, grey robe and holding an open book. To the right, another bearded man wears a bright red hat and a matching long red robe, also holding an open book. Each of the three figures has a thin, circular halo etched into the gold behind their heads.

title: Saint John the Baptist
alt_text: A painting on a panel shows a man with long, dark, wavy hair and a thick, divided beard. He is wearing a dark purple robe over a textured, fur-like garment that covers his right shoulder. A large, circular golden halo with patterns fills the space behind his head. The man holds his left hand up in a gesture and carries a thin, red cross over his left shoulder. The background is a flat, textured gold color, and the entire panel has an arched top.

title: Predella: Saint Francis, the Mourning Virgin Mary, Christ on the Cross, the Mourning Saint John the Evangelist, and Saint Dominic
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on a long, rectangular wood panel shows a series of alternating figure portraits and geometric patterns. At the center is a scene depicting a figure on a cross against a gold background, though part of the lower section is damaged or worn away. Flanking this central scene are four squares containing intricate, star-like geometric designs in red, blue, and gold. On the far left and right ends, as well as two positions near the center, are portraits of figures with halos, some wearing robes and hoods. A pale green border with small, evenly spaced vertical notches runs along the top edge of the entire panel.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints Jerome and Leonard and Two Angels
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows a group of figures in a faded, crackled style against a gold background. A larger central figure holds a small, pale child on their lap. The child reaches out to hold a small, round, greenish object. Several other figures are clustered around the central pair, though much of the paint has worn away over time. The entire scene is framed by a simple, worn wooden border.

title: The Kremlin, Moscow, Abstraction
alt_text: A painting of a city scene with towers and buildings stacked on a hill, rendered in a geometric style with muted colors. A tall bridge arches across the middle ground, connecting the lower part of the scene to the hillside. The sky above is filled with angular, jagged patterns in shades of yellow and light green. In the foreground, small figures in dark clothing are walking along a path or bridge. The entire image uses soft, blended brushstrokes and overlapping shapes to create a dreamlike view.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Two Angels
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting shows a woman holding a small child against a bright, patterned red background. The woman wears a dark cloak over a red dress, and both figures have glowing, golden circles around their heads. The child reaches up toward the woman's face while sitting on her lap. Above them, two ghostly figures appear in the arched, decorative border of the panel. The surface of the painting shows signs of age with cracks and worn areas throughout the composition.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints Ansanus and Victor
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small child, surrounded by four figures against a gold background. The central woman wears a long blue robe over a red dress and has a gold crown on her head. The child in her arms wears a pink garment and holds one hand up. Two standing figures flank the woman and child, each holding a long, thin pole or sword. Two smaller figures with wings appear in the upper corners, looking toward the center. The entire scene is enclosed in a narrow, worn gold frame on a wooden panel.

title: Virgin Annunciate
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows a woman with her head bowed and eyes closed. She wears a dark blue hood and a reddish garment underneath. The woman holds her hand near her chest, while an open scroll with dark lettering rests in her other hand. A gold-painted frame with carved arches and pointed decorations surrounds the image. The entire piece has a worn, aged appearance with visible cracks in the paint surface.

title: Saint John the Baptist, One of Two Panels from a Dismembered Altarpiece
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows a man with long, wavy brown hair and a beard against a textured, gold-leaf background. He wears a coarse, dark brown fur garment that leaves one shoulder bare, wrapped in a large, flowing pink cloak. His left hand holds a tall, thin blue cross, while his right hand is raised with fingers slightly bent in a gesture. Across his chest and held by his hand is a long white scroll with black lettering on it. A gold halo, lightly etched with patterns, surrounds his head.

title: Saint Nicholas of Bari; Saint Anthony of Padua, One of Two Panels from an Altarpiece
alt_text: A painting of a figure on a tall, narrow wooden panel with a pointed top. The main section shows a man with a beard, wearing red and blue robes and a gold halo, standing in front of a textured gold background. He holds a tall, decorative staff in one hand and a dark book in the other. Above him, in the triangular peak of the panel, sits a smaller figure in brown robes, also with a halo. The frame is simple and gilded, matching the golden background of the figures.

title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria; Saint Lawrence, One of Two Panels from an Altarpiece
alt_text: A painting on a tall, narrow wooden panel shows a figure standing in the center topped by a triangular peak. The large figure is a woman with long, light-colored hair wearing a crown and a yellow gown that has faded in some areas. She holds a curved sword across her shoulder with one hand and grips a circular, wheel-like object with the other. Above her, a smaller triangular section shows a person in a red robe holding a small cup or chalice. The background behind the woman is covered in textured gold, and the entire panel has worn edges showing age.

title: The Invalid
alt_text: A painting of a woman seated with her hands clasped together in her lap. She wears a plain white head covering and a striped, light-colored shawl draped over her shoulders. Her eyes are closed, and her head is tilted slightly downward in a quiet expression. Behind her, a curved, dark blue and purple chair back frames her form against a textured background of green and yellow. The artist has used thick, visible brushstrokes throughout the entire composition.

title: The Artist's Children
alt_text: A painting of two young women with light-colored hair sitting side-by-side. The woman on the left has her hands clasped together near her chest with her head bowed downward. The woman on the right rests her head on her hand, looking forward with a neutral expression. They both wear light-colored, loosely painted tops against a background of textured blue and tan shapes. The entire scene is enclosed within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: The Kremlin, Moscow
alt_text: A painting of a church complex with a very tall, slender tower reaching toward a blue sky. The tall, white tower is in the center and has many levels, with a dark, rounded top. To the right of the tower sits a larger building complex with other smaller towers and several small, gold, rounded domes. The ground in the foreground appears to be a sandy or dirt square. The painting uses visible, textured brushstrokes in shades of white, cream, blue, and brown. The entire scene is framed by a simple light-brown wooden border.

title: The Adoration of Christ
alt_text: A painting of an outdoor scene shows a group of people gathered under a simple wooden shelter. A man and a woman kneel in the foreground, facing a small baby lying on the ground between them. Behind the couple, two other figures also kneel in prayer. To the right, a donkey and a cow rest near the shelter's pillars, while two small figures stand in the distance on a hilly landscape. The colors are soft and muted, with blue and red clothing on the main figures contrasting with the green earth and pale sky.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints Peter and Paul
alt_text: A painting shows a triptych featuring three figures divided by arched architectural frames. The central panel displays a woman holding a young child in her lap, both facing forward against a gold background. On the left side, a figure with a beard and short hair wears flowing robes and holds a large key. The panel on the right features a bearded man in a red robe standing with his hand held up in a gesture. The paint appears cracked and worn across all three panels, with significant areas of damage and fading.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small child against a gold background. The woman wears a large, dark red hood and cloak that covers her shoulders and head. She holds the child on her left arm, and his small hand is raised in a gesture. The child wears a bright red robe over a blue patterned shirt. Both figures have faint, circular halos etched into the gold leaf behind their heads. The surface of the painting shows signs of age with light cracks throughout the gold background.

title: Madonna of the Candelabra
alt_text: A polychromed stucco sculpture shows a woman holding a young child within an ornate, rectangular frame. The frame features decorative pillars on the sides, horizontal moldings at the top and bottom, and a dark border painted with gold wavy lines. At the base of the frame, large, gold-colored letters are inscribed into a black panel. The central figures are sculpted in a pale material and show a woman with downcast eyes cradling a small child. The woman’s dress is textured and faded, while a faint halo circles her head.

title: Bishop
alt_text: A stone sculpture of a figure wearing a tall, pointed hat and long, layered robes. The figure has a solemn face and stands facing slightly to the side. Faded red, green, and cream-colored paint covers much of the textured surface of the garment. The right arm hangs straight down at the figure's side, while the left hand holds onto a portion of the draped fabric. A dark, vertical frame borders the sculpture on the right side.

title: The Gentleman
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up, set within a thick, ornate gold frame. The man has a beard and wears dark clothing that blends into the shadowy, dark brown background. He looks toward the right side of the frame with a neutral expression. The painting is angled, showing the side of the frame and a small white tag hanging from the bottom corner. The overall lighting is dim, casting warm highlights on the man's face and the gilded frame.

title: Spring (The Procession)
alt_text: A painting of a geometric landscape scene composed of many small, overlapping shapes. These shapes form a pattern of bright colors, including shades of green, blue, yellow, and white. In the center, long thin lines reach upward, suggesting the mast of a boat. Toward the bottom left, a white, bird-like shape curves near a darker patch of blue. The entire image has a fragmented, mosaic-like appearance that hides clear details.

title: Zwei Welten
alt_text: A painting of a large, pale cone that stretches diagonally across the center of the frame. Below the cone, a circular shape with radiating lines creates a sense of depth like a spiral staircase. To the right of the cone, a small white sphere sits nestled inside a curved, shell-like form. Above these objects, there are two simple, wavy white lines on a grey background. The entire composition rests on a background divided into blocky sections of white, grey, and blue, framed by thin red lines.

title: Vox Humana
alt_text: A painting of an abstract figure created with sharp geometric shapes and bright colors. A large, bright red shape dominates the center and features several angular protrusions. To the left, there is a tall panel of yellow against a white background, while the right side is filled with dark black and grey tones. A smaller, tan-colored triangle sits on the right side of the red figure. The overall composition feels flat and uses black stripes to add texture to specific areas of the red and yellow shapes.

title: Expansion of the Plastic Forces of a Village
alt_text: A painting of a town landscape composed of jagged, geometric shapes. The scene is filled with brown, grey, and dark green colors that overlap in sharp angles. Some shapes resemble roofs or walls of buildings stacked tightly together. Near the center, a light-colored rectangular area contains the letters "OST" written in a dark, blocky font. The sky above is made of swirling, stormy grey and white arcs.

title: Moonlight on the Thames, London
alt_text: A painting of a dark river scene at night shows a large bridge in the distance. The bridge has multiple arches and is faintly lit by small, glowing lights. Above the bridge, a pale, blurry circle represents a moon in the dark sky. In the foreground, two vertical street lamps stand on the right side of the frame. The dark, rippling water fills the bottom half of the composition, reflecting a few pinpricks of light.

title: George Washington
medium: Colored wax mounted on paper board
alt_text: A wax sculpture shows a profile view of a man with light skin. He is facing to the right with his hair pulled back and tied with a black bow. He wears a tan vest with a dark green coat underneath, leaving his neck exposed. The sculpture sits on a dark brown board that fills most of the right side of the image. Two white museum barcode labels are attached to the left of the board.

title: Romanesque Capital with Animal Ornament
alt_text: A limestone sculpture shows a blocky, square-topped piece with rounded sides that taper toward a circular base. The top of the stone is flat and rectangular, while the sides are decorated with deeply carved figures. Two animal-like heads with pointed ears face outward from the sides of the stone. Between these heads are detailed, wing-like shapes featuring intricate, grid-like patterns. The entire object has a rough, sandy texture and is light beige in color.

title: Benjamin Franklin
alt_text: A bronze relief medallion shows the portrait of a man in profile facing slightly to the right. The dark, circular metal piece features a raised relief of a person with long hair tied back and wearing a coat with visible buttons down the front. The man's eyes appear to be closed or empty of detail, and his expression is serious and stern. A small loop for hanging sits at the very top edge of the medallion. A white label with a barcode and some text is attached to the bottom of the object.

title: Young Couple
alt_text: A textile of wool showing a man and a woman standing side by side. The man is on the left and wears a hat and a dark coat. The woman is on the right, wearing a dress with a gathered waist and an intricate, rounded collar. Behind the pair, a large, leafy plant with long, thin leaves fills the upper portion of the frame. The entire image is rendered in shades of gray, black, and white. A thin, dark rectangular border frames the scene.

title: Flight into Egypt
alt_text: A textile made of wool showing a journey through a wooded landscape. In the center, a person wearing a long, dark cloak rides a donkey while holding a small child. A man walks on the right side, carrying a long staff over his shoulder with a bundle attached to it. Three other figures stand in the background on the left, observing the scene. The foreground and background are filled with varied plants, flowers, and trees.

title: Roman generals (?)
alt_text: A textile made of wool and silk depicting a group of people standing in a field. In the center, a person wearing a patterned tunic and breastplate holds up one hand. Two other figures dressed in similar, military-style armor flank the central person. A landscape with trees and distant buildings fills the background. A wide, decorative border featuring floral patterns and small figures frames the entire scene.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LL.D. 1781 (after Robert Edge Pine)
alt_text: A painting shows the head and shoulders of a man with light-colored, swept-back hair. He is positioned in the center, looking off toward the left side of the frame. The man wears a dark jacket with a high, bright yellow collar or scarf around his neck. His face is pale and turned slightly, casting one side in soft shadow. The background behind him is a plain, dark grey, and the entire work is held in a wide, textured gold frame.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature on ivory showing a profile portrait of a man in a circular frame. The figure faces left, against a solid, dark blue background. He wears a white shirt with a ruffled front and a collar that stands up around his neck. His hair is white, worn short and pulled back into a small ponytail tied with a ribbon. The portrait is painted in shades of white and gray, creating a relief-like effect against the bright blue circular border.

title: Lady
alt_text: A miniature portrait of a woman, rendered in watercolor on ivory, is set inside a gold-colored oval frame. The painting depicts a woman from the chest up, positioned against a muted, greenish-gray background. She has light skin and pale blue eyes, with her light brown hair styled in a high, voluminous puff that frames her face and falls in curls at her shoulders. She wears a deep red dress featuring a prominent, ruffled white collar. A small, circular loop is attached to the top of the frame, suggesting it was meant to be worn or displayed as jewelry.

title: George Washington (1732–1799)
alt_text: A sculpture of a relief profile, made of plaster, is mounted inside a round wooden frame. The frame is dark brown with a beaded edge and encloses a small, oval, light-blue medallion. A white, raised profile of a person's head faces toward the left side of the frame. The person has curly hair tied back at the nape of the neck. Dark red fabric fills the circular space between the light-blue medallion and the wooden frame.

title: The Port of Trouville
alt_text: A painting of a harbor with several boats along the shore. In the foreground, four small wooden boats rest in shallow, grayish-blue water or on a sandy beach. A red boat sits on the far left, while the others are dark brown or black. Across the water, a long stone quay stretches horizontally, lined with a row of multi-story buildings that have light-colored walls and dark roofs. The sky above is filled with soft, textured clouds in shades of pale blue and grey.

title: Gentleman
medium: Silhouette in India Ink on gold glass
alt_text: A miniature of a silhouette in ink on gold glass shows a profile view of a person. The figure is black and faces left, positioned in the center of an oval frame. The silhouette features a tied-back hairstyle and ruffles at the neck. The background behind the profile is metallic gold and is bordered by a decorative band of geometric patterns in white and black. This oval shape is housed in a smooth, gold-colored metal frame with a small loop at the very top for hanging.

title: The Education of the Virgin
alt_text: A textile of canvas and wool needlework features an ornate, floral pattern surrounding a central scene. The background is covered with dense, repeating flowers and leaves that fill the entire square border. In the center, a circular area highlights two figures standing near each other. One figure stands on the left, while the other sits or stands slightly to the right, with both wearing draped, flowing clothing. The entire piece is rendered in shades of grey, creating a soft, textured appearance.

title: Aurelian (or Alexander?) and the Priest of Serapis; Saint Mamas Comforted by the Wild Beasts Sent to Devour Him
medium: Tempera, gold, and tin on panel
alt_text: A painting shows a group of people inside and outside a pale green building. On the left, a king with a blue robe and crown sits on an ornate wooden chair, holding hands with an older man in a blue cloak. A younger person stands between the king and the older man, while a small child in a green outfit watches from the corner. To the right, a man in a pink tunic stands with his hands clasped in prayer near the entrance. Two lions lie on the checkerboard floor near his feet. High above, a small figure appears in a bright gold circle on the wall.

title: The Coliseum amongst Roman Ruins
alt_text: A painting of a scene with ancient ruins, several people, and a dog. On the left, tall stone columns stand near a man in armor and another person sitting on a rock. In the center, a large circular stone building sits in the background, while a group of people gathers near a well in the foreground. A white statue of a seated figure is positioned on a raised platform on the right side. A small dog stands on the ground near the well. The sky above is filled with soft, light clouds.

title: Virgin and Child with an Angel
alt_text: A painting of a woman and two children set within an ornate, rectangular wooden frame. The woman has fair skin, reddish cheeks, and wears a dark blue head covering and cloak over a red dress. She kneels with her hands pressed together in front of her chest. To her left, a young child with blonde hair stands while looking toward the viewer. Below them, a smaller, naked baby lies on a green surface, reaching up toward the woman's hands. A cut pomegranate with red seeds sits in the bottom right corner of the dark background.

title: Samuel Hubbard (1785-1847), B.A. 1802, LL.D. 1827
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up. The man has short, light brown hair and is looking directly at the viewer. He wears a dark coat over a white shirt with a high, standing collar. His clothing is dark, and the background is a plain, shaded brown color. One of his hands rests near the bottom edge of the frame.

title: Agrippina Landing at Brundisium with the Ashes of Germanicus
alt_text: A painting of a large group of people gathered near a stone building and a docked boat. In the center, a woman wearing a white veil carries a golden bowl while walking with two small children. Behind her, a line of other women in light-colored robes follows closely along the stone edge of a harbor. To the left, a woman in a yellow and green dress sits on the ground with her head resting on her hand. On the right, a man with a red cloak and helmet gestures toward the boat while looking at the crowd. A city with tall buildings and hills rises in the background under a blue, cloudy sky.

title: A Lady of the Vanderbilt Family
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing and facing forward. She has light-colored hair and wears a dark dress with a wide, intricate white lace collar and cuffs. A delicate pearl necklace rests around her neck. Her hands are positioned in front of her, holding a round, light-colored piece of fruit. A second, orange-red fruit sits on a small table to the left. The background is a dark, indistinct brown shadow.

title: Subjective Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a dark, abstract scene filled with mysterious, geometric shapes. The background is a mix of muddy greens and olive tones. In the center, several jagged forms rise up in colors like bright red, deep yellow, and muted white. Thick, dark lines outline many of these irregular shapes, giving them a heavy appearance. A small, lighter area sits in the upper right, and the entire work is encased in a simple wooden frame.

title: Lace flounce
alt_text: A textile showing a long, rectangular piece of light beige lace with intricate patterns. The lace features delicate, swirling motifs that form a continuous, open-work design across its surface. It lies flat on a light grey background with a smaller, folded section at the top. At the bottom of the frame, a rectangular label with the numbers 1947.23 is visible on a white support. The material appears soft and thin with many small, interlocking threads.

title: Cape and Cuffs
alt_text: A textile made of Carrickmacross lace shows three white, intricate pieces displayed against a solid black background. The largest piece is a long, wide shawl with curved edges at the top and bottom, featuring repeating floral motifs throughout its mesh pattern. Above this large section, two separate, smaller rectangular pieces of the same lacy material are positioned side-by-side. The lace throughout all three pieces appears delicate, with visible gaps in the fabric creating a repetitive, web-like design. The contrast between the bright white lace and the dark background makes the complex floral patterns easy to see.

title: Length of Venetian needlepoint lace, "Roselline"
alt_text: A piece of lace shows a long, rectangular strip of off-white fabric with an intricate, open-work pattern. The material has a delicate, net-like mesh with slightly thicker, decorative floral or vine shapes woven into it. A portion of the lace is folded over at the top to create a square section. A small, thin string with a tiny weight at the end hangs off the right edge. At the very bottom, a small rectangular black label displays the white numbers "1947.27."

title: Panel of Lace
medium: Punto in aria ("Stitch in the air") lace
alt_text: A piece of lace textile shows a rectangular design divided into four distinct vertical panels. Inside each panel, a human figure stands surrounded by plants, trees, or objects. Above these figures, there are words woven in capital letters spanning across the top of the panels. Intricate, web-like arched patterns frame the central images on the top and bottom borders. On each side of the main section, a tall, decorative column design completes the rectangular shape.

title: Length of Lace
alt_text: A bobbin lace textile shows an intricate pattern of flowers and leaves against a dark background. The design is repeated across the length of the fabric. Large, rounded floral shapes sit near the top edge, while smaller clusters of flowers fill the space along the bottom. The entire piece is connected by an open, net-like mesh background. A straight, solid band of lace forms the very bottom edge of the strip.

title: Palette
alt_text: A wood tool with oil paint shows a traditional, kidney-shaped artist's palette against a plain light gray background. The surface of the palette is a dark, polished reddish-brown wood. Scattered across the center and left side are dried blobs and smears of thick oil paint in shades of yellow, green, black, and gray. On the right side, there is an oval-shaped thumb hole cut into the wood. The overall shape is curved with smooth, rounded edges.

title: Romanesque Capital
alt_text: A carved limestone architectural element shows a stone capital with decorative, swirling carvings. It features a rectangular, flat top section above a wider, flared body that tapers toward the bottom. The main body displays symmetrical, scroll-like shapes that curve outward on either side. Below the scrolls, leaf-like textures are carved into the stone surface. The entire piece sits on a simple, rectangular base against a dark gray background.

title: Austin's Boats, New Haven
alt_text: A painting of a wooden dock stretching over calm, murky water. A wide wooden walkway leads from the bottom center of the frame toward a collection of small boats moored in the distance. The scene is filled with soft, muted tones of gray, brown, and pale green, suggesting a foggy or overcast day. Tall, thin masts of sailboats rise up into the hazy, light-colored sky in the background. The entire image is enclosed in an ornate, textured frame.

title: Collar and cuffs
alt_text: A piece of bobbin lace apparel shows two separate white lace items arranged against a dark gray background. The larger piece is shaped like a wide V, with long, tapering sides that meet at a point at the bottom. The smaller item sits above the larger one and consists of two separate, curved, comma-shaped sections. Both pieces feature an intricate, repetitive pattern of small flowers, leaves, and stems woven into delicate lace. The white lace stands out in sharp contrast against the dark, solid background.

title: Collar and cuffs
alt_text: A piece of bobbin lace apparel shows two separate white lace items against a dark gray background. The larger piece is shaped like a broad, V-shaped collar or shawl that curves deeply downward to a point. Above it sit two smaller, matching pieces of lace that look like curved collar segments. Both the large and small pieces are intricately patterned with dense, detailed floral and leaf designs. The light-colored lace stands out clearly against the dark backdrop.

title: Collar and cuffs
alt_text: A piece of apparel made of bobbin lace shows three white, intricate lace items against a dark, plain background. The largest item is shaped like a deep V, covering the bottom half of the space. Above this large piece are two smaller, separate lace items that mirror each other, forming a collar shape. All the pieces feature a delicate, dense pattern of many small flowers and leaves. The white lace stands out in sharp contrast against the dark surface behind it.

title: Scarf of bobbin lace
alt_text: A textile made of white lace showing a repeated pattern of floral and geometric designs. The long strip of lace is set against a solid, dark gray background. In the center, a band of star-shaped flowers alternates with small, pointed leaf shapes. On the top and bottom borders, there is a scalloped edge decorated with smaller, circular floral motifs. The right end of the fabric strip is rounded off, showcasing the intricate web-like texture of the lace.

title: Scarf of machine made lace "Handrun Alencon"
alt_text: A textile made of lace shows an intricate floral and scalloped pattern. The piece of off-white fabric is folded over on itself and laid flat on a light blue surface. Along the bottom edge, a row of large, rounded scallop shapes displays detailed weaving. The fabric appears delicate and thin, with the pattern repeating across its surface. A small, dark rectangular tag with the white numbers "1947.47" sits on a white foam support in the foreground.

title: Thalia and Melpomene, the Muses of Comedy and Tragedy
alt_text: A painting of two figures arranged within a circular frame against a patterned background. The background features a repeating geometric pattern of gold and brown flower shapes. On the left, a figure with long hair leans forward, wearing light-colored robes that drape over her body. Beside her on the right sits a second figure, who also wears long, flowing garments and rests near a plain, cylindrical object. The entire composition is contained within a dark, rectangular wooden frame.

title: Judge William Whiting Boardman (1792-1871) B.A. 1812
alt_text: A painting of an older man shown from the chest up. The man has short, light hair that is receding at the forehead and sideburns that frame his face. He wears a dark jacket, a light-colored vest with a subtle pattern, and a high, dark collar. His expression is calm, and he looks directly toward the viewer. The portrait is framed within an oval shape against a simple, dark background.

title: Medallion portrait of Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature of black and gold glass shows a profile portrait of a person. The subject is presented in a circular gold frame against a solid black rectangular background. Inside the circle, the figure is rendered in metallic gold lines and shading. The person faces to the left with a prominent nose, textured hair, and a high-collared coat. The entire scene is simple and focuses on the side view of the head and shoulders.

title: Jonathan Trumbull, Jr. (1740-1809), LL.D. 1797
alt_text: A miniature of a portrait shows an older man with light hair against a soft green background. He faces forward, wearing a dark coat and a white neck cloth. His graying hair is combed back, and his brown eyes look directly toward the viewer. The portrait is oval in shape and framed by a patterned gold-colored metal border. The background behind the man has small, visible brushstrokes.

title: Handkerchief
alt_text: A textile of linen and bobbin lace shows a square cloth with a decorative border. The center of the square is made of a plain, light-colored fabric. A delicate lace edge with small, repeating patterns frames the entire cloth. In the upper left corner, a small, rectangular tag sits on top of the fabric. Below the cloth, a long, dark rectangular label displays the white numbers "1947-52" centered in the foreground.

title: Virgin and Child with Music-Making Angels
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a baby surrounded by two winged figures in a dark, cloudy space. The woman wears a deep blue robe and looks down toward a fair-skinned baby standing on a round, dark object. To the left, a winged figure in a red robe plays a stringed instrument that looks like a lute. On the right, another winged figure with golden-brown cloth draped around their waist plays a stringed instrument that resembles a violin. The figures are bathed in a soft light against a very dark background.

title: The Embarrassed Chess Player
alt_text: A painting of four people gathered around a small table while playing a game. A man in a dark suit sits on the left side of the table. Three women stand or sit around him, watching the game closely. The table is covered with a patterned, reddish cloth, and a small game board sits in the center. A large, dark curtain hangs in the background behind the group. The entire scene is framed by an arched top edge.

title: Summer
medium: Oil on canvas in an original gilded plaster and pine frame
alt_text: A painting shows four women in long dresses holding hands in a line across a misty green field. A fifth woman in a red dress sits on the far right playing a tall, golden harp. All the women face toward the left or center of the frame, and their dresses are shades of white, brown, and pink. The background is a dark, soft green color with thin, vertical lines suggesting trees or rain. The entire scene is encased in a large, ornate gold-colored frame with intricate, raised leaf patterns.

title: Sunrise III
medium: Wax emulsion and oil on canvas, partly coated in gesso
alt_text: A painting of a bright yellow circle surrounded by layered, curved bands of color. The circle sits in the center of the image, appearing as a warm, glowing orb. Moving outward from the center, the colors shift from light blue to various shades of deep purple and dark teal. These surrounding bands create a sense of depth, like ripples in water or rings radiating outward. A dark, jagged horizon line runs along the very bottom of the canvas, grounding the shapes above.

title: Seaquake
alt_text: A painting showing a collection of abstract, swirling organic shapes against a solid, light-brown background. A large, bright green, amoeba-like form dominates the center, featuring soft curves and a small pale circle in its middle. To the right, a darker, brownish-grey structure spirals inward, resembling a shell or a curled leaf. The left side is filled with gentle, flowing waves of pink and light blue that stretch toward the edges. In the bottom-right corner, a simple, thin black line creates an outline of spiky, plant-like forms that are not filled in. The entire composition feels fluid and layered, with soft shadows adding depth to the colorful shapes.

title: Head
alt_text: A painting of a stylized face against a dark brown background. The face is divided into a blue section on the left and a warm orange-brown section on the right. One large, almond-shaped eye sits in the center of the face, featuring a bright yellow star inside a dark circle. Behind the head, there are several tall, thin, angular shapes that look like ribbons or tubes. The bottom of the painting shows scattered, colorful rectangular shapes in red, orange, and blue.

title: George Hathorn Smith (1885-1952), M.S. (Hon.) 1926
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting at a desk in front of a large bookshelf. He is a middle-aged man with short hair and a light shirt, and he wears a dark red tie. His hands rest on a document lying on the desk. To his left, there is a small stack of books and some papers. To his right, there is a small box, a round object, and an open book. Behind him, tall shelves are filled with many colorful books, and a small framed picture hangs on the wall.

title: Portrait of a Young Man
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in a large gold frame. The man wears a dark green coat over a gold-colored, patterned waistcoat. He has light-colored ruffles at his wrists and neck. His right hand rests against his chest, while his left hand hangs down at his side. The background shows a dark, cloudy sky and a faint, shadowy landscape.

title: Peinture Relative (Relational Painting)
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes arranged on a plain white background. Several horizontal black lines are spaced across the canvas, some of which intersect with colored squares and rectangles. The colored shapes are primarily red, blue, yellow, and grey, varying in size and position. One small yellow vertical rectangle sits at the bottom left edge, while a small black rectangle rests at the bottom center. These shapes and lines do not form a recognizable picture.

title: Collar
medium: Point plat de Venise (flat Venice) lace
alt_text: A piece of flat lace apparel forms a wide, curved shape similar to a large collar. The material is a light cream color and features a delicate, open pattern with many small, irregular holes woven throughout the fabric. A central seam runs vertically down the middle, dividing the piece into two matching sides that flare outward. The outer edges of the lace form a smooth, rounded curve. A small, black, rectangular label with the white text "1947.43" sits centered just below the fabric.

title: Scarf
alt_text: A lace textile shows a repeating pattern of white floral designs on a dark background. The pattern includes many leaves and small bell-shaped flowers connected by thin, vine-like stems. On the left and right sides, these stems form large, circular shapes filled with a delicate mesh. A vertical band of plain, semi-transparent white fabric splits the two main sections of the lace pattern. The edges of the fabric are scalloped and wavy.

title: Strip of Lace
alt_text: A textile of white guipure lace is shown against a plain grey background. The lace strip features a repeating pattern of stylized flowers, leaves, and vine-like scrolls. The top edge of the lace is scalloped, creating a wavy border. The bottom edge is straight. Small, circular openings within the delicate, woven design create a complex, net-like appearance.

title: Group of Death I
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of two figures stands on a rectangular base. The forms are carved with sharp, geometric angles and have a smooth, dark-brown finish. One figure arches over the other, while the second figure leans forward with its arms hanging down. A small white paper tag is tied around the arm of the leaning figure. The sculpture sits on a shelf against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Resurrection (Memorial to Two Sisters)
alt_text: A wood sculpture shows two tall, stylized figures standing close together on a flat, hexagonal base. The figure on the right stands upright and holds both hands to its face. The figure on the left is positioned slightly in front, with its upper body bent forward and its head hanging down. Both figures are carved with elongated, thin bodies and smooth, simple features. The wood grain is visible throughout the surface, showing warm, light-brown tones against a gray background.

title: Mary Chickering (1867–1933)
alt_text: A painting of a young woman standing in a muted landscape. She is centered in the composition and faces forward with a calm expression. Her hair is dark, shoulder-length, and wavy. She wears a light-colored blouse with long sleeves and a long, dark skirt. Her hands are clasped loosely in front of her waist. The background is painted in soft, brownish-green tones that suggest an open field under a hazy sky.

title: The Eli Whitney Gun Factory, verso: Blacksmith Shoeing Horse
alt_text: A painting of a landscape shows a valley with a river running through the center. A cluster of simple, light-colored buildings sits near the river in the middle ground, while darker structures appear on the right side. The background features rolling green hills that stretch toward a hazy, light blue sky with a few clouds. In the immediate foreground, large dark rocks frame the scene with a person sitting on the left and a small dog standing on the right. Lush trees and greenery fill the spaces between the buildings and the riverbanks.

title: Composition #21
alt_text: A painting of vertical and horizontal black lines crossing over fields of white, yellow, blue, and red. The background is mostly white, with several wide vertical stripes of color. Bold, solid black lines stretch horizontally across the canvas at different heights. Shorter black bars also appear within the colored stripes, creating small, rectangular shapes. The entire image forms a rigid, abstract grid pattern.

title: Mending the Coat
alt_text: A painting of an older man and woman sitting together in a dim room. The woman sits on the left, wearing a dark long-sleeved dress and working with her hands on something small and dark. Beside her on the right, the man has a full white beard and wears a dark vest over a white shirt. He holds a white piece of paper or cloth in his lap while looking down. A bright, vertical rectangular window frame appears on the far left edge of the wall. The entire scene is enclosed within a wide, decorative gold frame.

title: Reliquary Chasse with Angels
medium: Champlevé enamel, gilt copper, and rock crystal
alt_text: A metal container shows a small chest on four legs decorated with colorful enamel panels. The exterior is made of gilt copper with blue, red, and white enamel designs that feature figures with wings inside circular borders. A row of golden arches lines the top edge of the curved lid, topped by three small, round, semi-transparent stone orbs. The front of the box has a central vertical latch and a keyhole. This box stands on short, sturdy, gold-colored metal legs.

title: Abstraction (Yellow Background)
alt_text: A painting of abstract, colorful shapes set against a textured, light-tan background. On the left, a large, wavy blue shape features a white cutout section with a red curved form above it. To the right, a large, irregularly shaped form includes sections of white, light purple, red, and a speckled gray pattern. A dark green triangle points downward near the bottom left corner. A small, thin crescent moon shape floats in the upper left, while a cluster of short, dark dashed lines sits in the bottom right corner.

title: Abraham Francis (1688-1720)
alt_text: A painting of a man is displayed inside an oval, ornate gold frame. The man has long, wavy dark hair and wears a white cravat at his neck. A deep red, draped fabric covers one of his shoulders. His right hand is visible, resting near the center of his chest. The background is a simple, light-colored wash that fades from darker tones on the right to lighter ones on the left.

title: Untitled [Abstraction (Pink Background)]
alt_text: A painting shows a collection of abstract, flat shapes set against a light, dusty pink background. On the right side, a cluster of dark grey, white, and teal geometric forms creates a central, complex structure. To the left, a curved white shape holds a smaller dark brown square inside it. Other colored rectangles and lines in shades of red, blue, green, and yellow are scattered across the composition. A thin, horizontal dark stripe sits near the bottom, grounding the arrangement of shapes.

title: Untitled [Study for mural, Day Room, Chronic Diseases Hospital, Welfare Island, New York]
alt_text: A tempera painting shows abstract geometric shapes against a flat, grayish-brown background. On the left, a large, slanted quadrilateral contains a dark oval and several smaller triangles and rectangles in muted colors. Toward the center, a tall, rectangular column stands upright next to a smaller, T-shaped form. To the right, a jagged, star-like shape is filled with blue, white, and tan sections. A thin, horizontal bar floats near the top right corner, and the entire scene rests on a dark horizontal line.

title: In Advance of the Broken Arm
medium: Wood and galvanized iron snow shovel
alt_text: A sculpture of a snow shovel made from wood and galvanized iron floats against a plain gray background. The shovel features a long, light-colored wooden handle that ends in a D-shaped grip at the top. Attached to the bottom of the handle is a wide, black, rectangular metal blade with a curved shape. The metal blade has vertical indented lines running down its surface. A soft, dark shadow is cast directly beneath the floating shovel.

title: Untitled [Abstraction]
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract arrangement of geometric shapes against a solid green background. At the center, a large brown rectangle features a vertical white stripe inside it. Overlapping this shape is a bright blue line that forms a jagged, open frame and connects to a small red circle at the bottom left. Above the brown shape, a pink trapezoid sits near a yellow triangle that points upward. The composition is finished with a smaller yellow curved shape peeking out from behind the blue frame on the right side.

title: Chess Players
alt_text: A painting of a dimly lit room with a group of people sitting around tables. In the center, several people with dark clothing and hats sit close together at a table while playing a game with small pieces. To the left, a man with a beard sits at a separate table and looks toward the main group. The background is a dark, warm red color that creates a heavy atmosphere. The overall scene is shadowy and muted, making it hard to see fine details.

title: Horse
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a creature shown in a crouched, seated position. The figure has smooth, dark brown surfaces that curve into shapes suggesting a head, a rounded back, and bent limbs tucked underneath. Small, lighter-colored circular inlays are set into the side of the head, the front of the face, and the bottom corner near its feet. The body has a flattened, stylized look with few distinct features. It rests against a light, woven fabric background.

title: Explosion
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract composition of floating shapes and curved lines against a soft, textured background. In the center, a large, dark blue circular form radiates outward with a bright, light-colored core. Several long, thin, curved white lines swirl across the canvas, overlapping the central circle and pointing in different directions. To the right, a chain of five gold-colored interlocking rings hangs diagonally, accompanied by a single small red dot. Other geometric shapes, including a red triangle and small squares, are scattered faintly near the top and right sides of the image. The entire scene is set on a background with muted patches of green, brown, and grey.

title: Strip of Lace
alt_text: A piece of white lace showing a repeated floral pattern. This long, narrow strip of fabric is set against a dark background. The design features symmetrical, heart-shaped sections filled with open meshwork and solid stitched areas. Curving lines and small leaf-like shapes connect these sections along the straight top edge. The bottom edge is scalloped, following the curves of the intricate pattern.

title: Lace flounce (2)
alt_text: A textile of mezzo punto tape lace displays a rectangular piece of fabric in an off-white color. The intricate surface pattern features swirling floral designs and leafy vines that cover the entire cloth. A thin, delicate border of scalloped lace runs along the bottom edge of the rectangular piece. Directly below the fabric sits a small, rectangular black sign with white numbers that read 1947.30. The entire item is laid flat on a plain, light-colored background.

title: City Shapes
medium: Oil on composition board with canvas textured surface
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping geometric shapes. The composition is made up entirely of black, white, and shades of gray. Large, angular shapes in white and light gray create a sense of depth and overlapping planes. Dark gray and black blocks surround these lighter areas, creating sharp contrasts. Several arched forms are visible along the lower portion, suggesting openings or windows. Overall, the arrangement of shapes creates a jagged, architectural feel.

title: Niagara Falls (attributed to Gustavus Grunewald)
alt_text: A painting of a wide, cascading waterfall set in a lush landscape. The water spills over a long, horizontal cliff in the middle distance, creating a mist at its base. To the right, a large tree with thick green leaves leans over the water’s edge. The foreground is filled with large, dark rocks scattered along a green, grassy bank. The sky above is filled with soft, light clouds that stretch across the horizon.

title: Statuette
alt_text: A Parian ware sculpture shows two young figures sitting together outdoors on a rocky ledge. A young person on the left wears a shirt, pants, and a hat hanging on their back, while the person on the right wears a simple, long dress. Both figures lean toward each other with their heads bowed, appearing to look at something they are holding together in their joined hands. They sit on a stone-like base that blends into the background. To the right of the sculpture sits a small, rectangular color calibration card with black, white, and multicolored squares.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: An ivory sculpture shows a seated woman holding a young child. The woman wears a long, draped robe and a simple head covering that falls onto her shoulders. She is looking slightly downward toward the child she holds on her lap. The small child has curly hair and wears a matching long garment. Deep vertical lines run throughout the carving, creating the texture of the material.

title: Bust of a Woman
alt_text: A glazed terracotta sculpture of a woman's head and shoulders. The figure has pale, smooth skin and is gazing slightly to the right. Her hair is styled in elaborate, tight braids that are wrapped around the top of her head. She wears a simple garment draped across her shoulders, with soft folds visible in the fabric. The sculpture is set against a dark, solid background.

title: Burning Landscape
alt_text: A painting of an abstract work filled with swirling shapes and bright colors. The surface is covered in drips and splashes of yellow, red, blue, and green paint. Thin, dark lines tangle over the brighter colors in the center of the canvas. The background is mostly a light, textured off-white color. A signature and a date are painted in black along the bottom edge of the artwork.

title: Red Knight
medium: Painted plaster with painted wood base
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture showing a tall, abstract form that stands on a light-colored hexagonal base. The object is a uniform tan color and consists of thin, vertical stalks that create a cage-like structure. Several long, spindly legs support the main body from the base. In the center, the form contains empty spaces and delicate, branching arms. The sculpture widens at the top into a rounded, dome-like shape.

title: Abstraction
medium: Aqueous paint, either gouache or size, on fine weave linen
alt_text: A painting of overlapping geometric shapes and lines that create a sense of motion. The artwork is dominated by shades of tan, brown, gray, and accents of bright red. Various circular forms, which resemble wheels, are scattered across the bottom and sides of the composition. Straight, angular lines cut across the scene, dividing the space into smaller sections. The overall design is abstract and energetic, with no clear subjects or realistic figures visible.

title: Cravat or barbe machine made silk lace
alt_text: A textile of lace shows a long, vertical strip of delicate, cream-colored fabric decorated with a repeating floral pattern. The lace features large, rounded flower blossoms and leafy stems woven into a sheer, netted background. The strip is folded over in several places along its length, creating layers and varying textures. It is displayed against a solid, light grey-green background. A rectangular label at the bottom contains the number "1947. 51" in white text.

title: The Flight of the Soldiers before Saint Mamas and the Wild Beasts
medium: Tempera, gold, and tin on panel
alt_text: A painting showing a man standing in front of a wooden structure while a group of armed soldiers approaches him from behind. The man wears a pink tunic and yellow boots, facing toward the soldiers who carry tall spears and wear patterned, golden garments. In the lower right corner, a black bear stands near three light brown lions on a grassy patch of ground. Behind the scene, a stone castle with towers sits nestled between rocky, green hills. A large, shimmering gold background fills the upper portion of the painting.

title: Memorial for Abigail Rogers (1753–1791)
medium: Watercolor, chopped and possibly dissolved hair, applied ivory, pearls, and engraved gold bands on ivory
