alt_text: A piece of jewelry featuring a central oval miniature painting surrounded by gold clasps. Inside the oval, a woman in a long, draped dress sits on the left side, resting her head on her hand. To her right stands a square monument that holds a decorative urn and is inscribed with the words "Abigail Rogers," "Ob. 7 Oct," and "1791." The scene includes trees and foliage rendered in brown tones against a white background. Small gold bands attached to the sides of the oval frame connect to decorative, engraved gold end pieces.

title: John Selden (1584–1654)
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man has long, wavy, light brown hair that falls past his ears. He is wearing a dark, heavy coat with a large, white, folded collar at his neck. His face is angled toward the viewer with a neutral expression, and the background is a plain, dark brown color. The entire portrait is encased in a thick, dark, polished wooden frame with a small metal plaque attached to the bottom.

title: Stump-work box
alt_text: A textile box made of silk embroidered satin shows a central dark-colored animal resting on a platform. The animal has a fluffy texture and looks like a lamb, surrounded by an intricate frame of embroidered flowers and leaves. Bunches of grapes hang on the left and right sides of the design. Swirling stems and vine-like patterns fill the empty spaces around the central figure. The background fabric is a light, cream-colored satin that contrasts with the colorful threads used for the embroidery.

title: Construction
alt_text: A painting of white surfaces accented by thin, colorful lines. The composition is divided by several vertical and horizontal bars in bright yellow, red, and black. A long, thick black horizontal bar extends across the center of the image, appearing to sit slightly in front of the white background. A vertical yellow line runs along the right side and turns at a right angle to cross the bottom left section. A small, thin red line also appears on the far left side, aligned horizontally.

title: Woman's jacket
alt_text: A textile of velvet shows a long, deep red sleeve decorated with intricate gold embroidery. A large, pointed, leaf-shaped gold design sits in the center of the dark red fabric. Towards the cuff, the gold embroidery becomes a dense, rectangular band. The cuff is open, revealing a glimpse of white fabric underneath and a row of small, round metal buttons. The entire sleeve is set against a plain, off-white background.

title: Woman's cap
alt_text: A felt textile shows a round cap or hat seen from directly above. The object is divided into two halves, with one side appearing bright white and the other side appearing dark grey or black. The darker side features subtle, circular patterns that spiral outward toward the edge. A small, dark tassel or tuft of fabric extends from the right side of the circle. The entire object rests against a light, neutral background that is speckled with tiny dark dots.

title: Moonlit Marine
alt_text: A painting of a lone boat sailing on dark water at night. A bright, pale yellow circle representing the moon shines in the upper-left corner of the sky. The sky is filled with thick, swirling, dark clouds that obscure most of the light. A small, dark boat with a single, triangular sail sits in the middle of the water. Wisps of light from the moon reflect off the water's surface near the boat's hull.

title: Malacca Cane
alt_text: A tool and equipment object shows a long, thin stick, likely a cane or walking stick, lying diagonally across a gray, padded surface. The long shaft of the stick is made of a smooth, brown wood. One end of the stick has a rounded, off-white handle with a thin cord loop attached just below it. A small, rectangular white label with black text sits on the padded surface near the middle of the stick. The entire object is captured against a neutral, slightly textured background.

title: Cap of Muslin and machine made lace
medium: The cap is made of a rectangular piece of lace folded and sewed together at the back
alt_text: A textile made of white lace shows a piece of fabric folded and stitched to form a cap. The main body of the object is a rectangular panel covered in a repeating pattern of small, circular flower designs. On the right side, a smooth, pleated white fabric section connects to the lace panel. This pleated section angles upward and tapers toward the right edge. Below the textile, a black rectangular label displays the white numbers "1945.457". The entire object rests on a light gray surface.

title: The Vesper Hymn
alt_text: A painting showing a coastal landscape at dusk with a tall, stone clock tower in the foreground. The tower stands on a rocky cliff covered in green plants and trees. Beyond the cliff, a calm body of water stretches out toward a distant coastline where a large castle structure sits. In the lower right corner, a small person in a red and white dress rests near a stone archway. The sky above is filled with soft, reddish-orange clouds as the sun begins to set.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a rural landscape features a small stone cottage sitting at the base of a large, grassy hill. The cottage is on the left side of the scene and has a dark roof and a shadowed doorway. To the right of the cottage, a person stands next to a horse that is pulling a two-wheeled cart. The ground in the foreground is a dirt path leading toward the distant, rolling hills on the right. Above the scene, a large, cloudy blue sky fills the upper half of the frame. The entire image shows signs of age with fine, grid-like cracks visible across the surface.

title: Altar frontal
alt_text: A textile of cotton with silk embroidery shows a long, runner-like strip decorated with flowing patterns. The central design features repeating floral and leaf motifs in shades of gold and tan, laid out against a light, off-white background. The edges of the fabric are finished with a thick, golden-brown border that runs along the sides. A long fringe of matching golden-brown threads hangs down from the left side of the piece. The textile lies flat on a plain surface, with a small black label showing the number "1947.150" placed at the bottom center.

title: Enduring New England
alt_text: A painting of a white church with a tall, slender steeple standing in the center of a grassy field. To the left of the main church building, there is a dirt road that winds past smaller, older-looking houses. The sky above is a clear, bright blue with a few soft clouds. Shadows from the buildings stretch across the grass, suggesting it is either morning or late afternoon. The entire scene is framed by a decorative, light-colored wooden border.

title: Shawl
alt_text: A textile of compound twill showing an intricate pattern on a light, off-white background. The fabric has a border featuring repeated, elongated teardrop shapes that are oriented vertically. These shapes are detailed with fine, grey, and white floral or leafy textures. The bottom edge of the textile is finished with a row of loose, dangling fringe. The pattern continues up both the left and right sides of the piece, leaving a large, plain rectangular area in the upper center.

title: Suffolk Punch
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows the head and neck of a horse. The sculpture rests on a large, rectangular stone block that is dark and textured. The horse has a braided mane that runs along the top of its neck. Its ears are pricked forward and it faces toward the right. The surface of the horse's head appears smooth and dark.

title: New York: The Little Church around the Corner
alt_text: A painting of a dense city scene filled with buildings and a small park. Tall brick structures in shades of red, yellow, and grey rise up against the sky, crowding the space. In the center, a small church with a pointed roof stands among the taller buildings. Below, a green park area sits behind a dark railing. Three people walk along the street in the foreground, near the bottom edge of the canvas. The entire scene is painted with visible, textured brushstrokes.

title: Length of satin, brocaded
alt_text: A satin textile shows an intricate, repeating pattern across its surface. The design features soft, wavy lines that intersect to create a grid of large, diamond-like shapes. Inside each of these shapes sits a small, detailed leaf or floral motif. The overall color of the fabric is a pale, uniform gray or cream, which makes the pattern look subtle and embossed. The light catches the smooth material to highlight the textured, flowing shapes of the design.

title: George Washington (1732–1799), LL.D. 1781; verso: Eleanor (Nelly) Parke Custis (Mrs. Lawrence Lewis) (1779–1852)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a white profile portrait of a man on a dark oval background. The man faces left and wears a laurel wreath crown in his hair, which is tied back with a bow. The words "GEORGE" and "WASHINGTON" are printed in light letters on either side of his head. The entire oval shape is set inside a thin, gold-colored metal frame with a small loop at the top. There is some faint cursive text written at the very bottom edge of the oval.

title: Torso-Navel
alt_text: A painting on wood shows an abstract shape that resembles a teardrop or a simplified face. The main part of the form is colored a dark, matte black. A light blue area shaped like a rounded triangle sits at the top, featuring two small, circular indentations near the top edge. A separate blue, oval-shaped form sits near the bottom center of the black area. The entire piece has soft, rounded edges and casts a subtle, dark shadow against the white background.

title: Col. Thomas Edward Lawrence (1888- 1935)
alt_text: A painting of a man's head and shoulders shown in profile. The man has pale skin, light blue eyes, and a neutral expression. He wears a white head covering that is draped around his face and neck. On top of the head covering sits a thick, striped band that is colored gold and maroon. He is dressed in a plain, tan-colored robe. The background is a solid, dark brown color.

title: Saint Lucilla, One of Two Panels from an Altarpiece
alt_text: A painting of a woman wearing a black veil and dark robe set against a bright, textured gold background. The woman stands in the center, looking slightly to the side with a calm expression while holding a small green branch in one hand. Two small figures with wings, resembling angels, appear in circular frames in the upper corners against a reddish, patterned backdrop. The entire scene is framed by a gold border with a decorative base that features an inscription of text. The woman's dark clothing contrasts sharply with the shining gold surrounding her.

title: A Hudson Valley Lady with Dog and Parrot
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing and looking directly at the viewer. She wears a dark blue dress with a flowing pink wrap over her shoulder. Her right hand reaches out to touch a small green bird perched on a tall, gold-colored stand. Below the bird, a small dog with brown and white fur sits on a red chair. In the background, there is a view of green trees and a blue sky with soft white clouds.

title: Chef d'oeuvre accordéon
medium: Oil, gouache, and silver leaf on canvas
alt_text: A painting shows a large, circular form centered against a white background. This central shape is metallic silver with various black, red, and yellow abstract lines and shapes placed across its surface. A thick, dark black border surrounds the circle, and a thin, vertical black bar stretches from the top edge of the circle toward the top of the canvas. To the right, black and white stripes emerge from behind the circle, while a few simple geometric shapes float in the upper corner. The lower left corner of the canvas features small printed text.

title: Composition
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes and intersecting lines in a variety of colors. The composition is filled with angular, overlapping forms in shades of blue-green, brown, gray, and reddish-orange. Several of the curved, reddish-orange shapes contain small, repeating white dashes along their edges. These shapes fit together like a jagged puzzle, creating a sense of layered depth across the canvas. A few areas of black and bright white provide sharp contrast against the softer, muted colors.

title: Major-General William Williams (1765-1838)
alt_text: A painting shows a middle-aged man in a dark coat and high white collar against a dark background. He faces forward with a serious expression and gray, short hair. His right hand is visible in the lower left corner, holding a small piece of folded white paper. The man sits in a chair that is partially visible on the right side. He is framed by an elaborate, wide gold border with carved details.

title: Reverend Samuel Nichols (1787-1880), B.A. 1811, M.A. 1814
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a person with dark, short hair wearing small, round glasses. The person is dressed in a dark jacket with a light-colored shirt or scarf visible at the neckline. They face forward with a neutral expression against a dark, shadowy background. The painting is enclosed in a wide, ornate, gold-colored rectangular frame with detailed carvings. A small white label hangs from the top edge of the frame.

title: Thomas Wheeler Williams (1789-1874)
alt_text: A painting of a man shows him from the chest up against a plain, dark background. The man has short, graying hair, dark eyes, and is looking forward at the viewer. He wears a high, white collared shirt underneath a dark, buttoned jacket. The portrait is held in an ornate, rectangular gold frame with carved patterns. A small white label hangs from the bottom edge of the frame.

title: Alfred Stieglitz (1864–1946)
alt_text: A painting shows the geometric, abstract face of a man with angular features. He wears round, dark-rimmed glasses atop his forehead. A thick, dark mustache sits above a simple, downturned mouth. Large, blocky shapes of mustard yellow, grey, and green define the planes of his face and background. The number "291" is painted in large, dark figures at the bottom center of the canvas.

title: Piece
alt_text: A textile of cotton with silk embroidery shows a dense pattern of flowers and animals across its surface. The design is organized into repeating sections featuring large, circular blossoms at the top. Beneath the flowers, curved stems and leaves create a framework for small birds that appear throughout the composition. The entire piece is filled with these repeating motifs, creating a sense of continuous movement across the fabric. The black-and-white image contrasts the dark, stitched lines against a lighter background.

title: Abstraction, No. 3
alt_text: A painting of a surreal landscape featuring a large, central white sphere balanced atop a dark, arched opening. Behind this sphere is a light blue expanse of water that stretches to the horizon under a soft, pale blue sky. Framing the sides are two tall, vertical panels of light-colored wood that slant inward towards the center. Above the sphere, a white, paper-like shape curves upward, accompanied by two thin, white line shapes that look like stylized birds in flight. The outer corners of the composition are filled with textured, brownish-red walls that create a sense of being inside a room or tunnel.

title: Piece
alt_text: A textile of brocaded silk showing a repeating floral pattern on a yellow background. The fabric is rolled around a long grey tube at the top, allowing a large section of the material to drape down onto a flat white surface. The pattern consists of stylized, fan-like flowers in muted shades of pink and brown, arranged in rows. Between these flowers are delicate, trailing vines with light green leaves. At the very bottom center, a small black rectangular label displays the white numbers "1947.146."

title: Length of compound cloth made up as an apron
medium: Warps white cotton, wefts white, red, black wool, cloth woven
alt_text: A textile showing a rectangular piece of fabric with a striped pattern. The fabric is decorated with repeating horizontal bands in shades of red, white, and thin black lines. A thin fabric strap is attached to the top corners and drapes across the front of the cloth. The surface appears textured and woven with fine threads. A small identification tag with the number 1945.459 sits along the bottom edge.

title: Joseph Norton Ireland (1817-1889)
alt_text: A painting of an older man sitting in a tall, dark chair. He is bald and has thick, white mutton-chop sideburns that connect to a mustache. The man wears a dark suit, a white shirt, and a black bow tie. His hands are clasped neatly in his lap. He also wears wire-rimmed glasses and looks directly forward with a serious expression.

title: Ecclesiastical Panel
medium: Embroidered silk with gold and silver
alt_text: A textile shows a rectangular panel filled with ornate embroidery using gold and silver threads. The center features a cross-shaped pattern made of dense, repeating diamond shapes. Around this center, swirling vine-like designs in metallic tones fill the entire background. Scattered among the gold and silver work are several embroidered flowers in shades of pink, orange, and pale green. These floral elements appear at regular intervals across the surface of the fabric.

title: Umbrella
alt_text: A textile of brocaded lace shows a cone-shaped fabric covering that is draped like a tent. The material is a tan and gold color with intricate floral patterns woven throughout the surface. A band of heavy, dark gold fringe borders the lower, scalloped edges. Several small, matching tassels hang down from the bottom points of the fabric. A human hand on the right side of the frame gently lifts one side of the piece.

title: Virgin and Child
medium: Poplar with renewed polychromy and gilding
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a woman standing and holding a young child. The woman wears a golden crown and a long, flowing dress that is colored with gold, black, and red paint. She holds the naked child in her left arm, while her right hand is slightly extended toward him. The child has curly hair and looks forward with an open mouth. Both figures stand on a small, octagonal base that is painted in dark red and black.

title: View near East Hartford
alt_text: A painting of a landscape shows six people gathered on a dirt road in the foreground. A man sits on a stool in the center of the road, while five others stand nearby in a loose group. Behind them is a calm pond with green fields and a few small wooden buildings set back in the distance. The sky above is filled with many heavy, gray and white clouds. A few tall, leafy green trees are scattered across the scene.

title: Flaming Pool—Dogtown
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a small, bright blue pool of water surrounded by large, dark purple rocks. The ground rising up behind the rocks is covered in rounded, rusty-orange hills. Along the top of the scene, a row of thin, dark, vertical trees stands against a pale, greenish-blue sky. Two small, soft pink clouds float in the sky above the hills. The painting uses thick brushstrokes and bold colors to define the shapes of the rocks and earth.

title: Yellow Bird
alt_text: A yellow marble, limestone, and oak sculpture shows a tall, vertical arrangement of stacked shapes. At the very top sits a smooth, elongated piece of yellow marble that curves to a point. This yellow piece rests on a small, white limestone block shaped like an hourglass. Below that, the sculpture continues downward with alternating sections of light-colored stone cylinders and darker, rounded oak wood forms. The entire structure stands upright as a single, combined pillar on a solid base.

title: Length of machine-made lace
alt_text: A textile shows a long, thin strip of off-white lace. The piece has a straight top edge and a scalloped bottom edge. The lace is patterned with repeating floral or circular designs. A delicate net-like background fills the spaces between these patterns. Below the lace, a black rectangular label displays the white numbers "1946.255."

title: Z (The Speared Fish)
medium: Painted wood with metal and glass
alt_text: A sculpture made of painted wood, metal, and glass stands vertically against a plain gray background. The main part of the object is a tall, curved piece of wood that tapers toward the top, which is shaped like a gentle hook. This wooden section is colored with a gradient, fading from a dark, metallic brown at the bottom to a lighter silver color near the top. Two clear, round glass spheres are set into the wood, one near the top hook and one lower down. A small, dark metal rod sticks out at an angle from the side of the wooden curve. The whole structure rests on a semicircular black base attached to a thin, rectangular stand.

title: Untitled (The Dancer)
alt_text: A terracotta sculpture sits atop a tall, square, black pedestal. The object is a cluster of angular, interlocking shapes stacked on top of one another. Most of the surfaces are a pale cream color, marked with geometric sections painted in black. Some smaller, hidden areas reveal touches of light green paint. The overall form looks dense and busy, with many sharp edges and flat planes.

title: The Philosopher
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting and reading. The figure is positioned in the center and is wearing a light, draped garment over their shoulders. They are holding a small, white rectangular object that looks like a book or paper. Their lower body is angled, with one leg extended forward on a surface that appears to be wooden floorboards. The surrounding background is dark, muted, and indistinct, framing the seated figure in the middle of the composition.

title: Paris-Rêve
alt_text: A painting of oil on canvas showing a textured landscape under a pale sky. In the upper center, a large, translucent semicircle made of many fine lines floats against the white and blue background. Below this, three arched, mountain-like shapes dominate the lower half of the composition. These structures are filled with a grid pattern of small, multicolored squares in shades of red, orange, and brown. To the right, the grid pattern shifts into dark blue, green, and black blocks that blend into the shadows at the bottom.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a woman, shown from the chest up against a plain, light background. She has wavy, reddish-brown hair swept up on top of her head. Her expression is calm as she looks toward the viewer with light blue eyes. She is wearing a dark purple or maroon coat with a high, white ruffled collar. The brushstrokes are visible throughout the image, giving the textures of her hair and clothing a soft, blended appearance.

title: Seated Woman
medium: Bronze with a black marble pedestal and base
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a figure sitting in a crouched position. The figure has a smooth, rounded head with no visible facial features. Its body is also sleek and abstracted, showing broad, simple shapes rather than realistic details. The figure rests on a tall, dark, rectangular pedestal. Both the figure and its base sit on a wider, square black stand.

title: The Rustic Bridge
alt_text: A painting of a rocky, rural landscape featuring a bridge over a stream. On the left stands a tall, gnarled tree with bare branches. In the center, two people stand on a simple wooden bridge, with a small dog nearby. Below them, a person sits on a rock near the water's edge, holding a long stick. A large, steep, and shadowed hillside rises on the right side of the scene. The overall lighting is dramatic and dark, emphasizing the rugged terrain.

title: Saint John the Evangelist
alt_text: A painting of a person with reddish hair wearing a bright orange robe over a blue shirt. The figure is shown from the chest up, holding an open book with bright red covers. A thin white feather pen is held in one hand, resting against the edge of the book. Behind the figure, a large, textured gold circle serves as a halo against a shimmering gold background. The entire image is set within a decorative gold-colored frame with arched details.

title: Street Scene with Snow (57th Street, NYC.)
alt_text: A painting of a snow-covered city street at night. Tall, dark buildings line both sides of the road, creating a narrow view toward the center. A horse-drawn carriage moves away from the viewer down the slushy, white street. On the left side, a person shovels snow near the sidewalk while a few other figures walk nearby. A pointed church steeple rises into the dark, cloudy sky on the left. The scene is dim, with muted colors and soft, blurry edges.

title: Belt- tablet woven
alt_text: A textile of wool and cotton shows a long, decorative band rolled into a tight coil at the bottom. The band is mostly dark red and features a repeating geometric pattern in white and dark colors running up its length. At the very top, the end of the band extends upward and divides into three thin, frayed fringe-like cords. The entire object sits on a smooth, gray surface behind a small black sign with white numbers. The overall shape of the object resembles a snail shell or a coiled snake.

title: Sculpture
medium: Oil and tempera on cheesecloth or muslin laid down on masonite
alt_text: A sculpture shows a tall, vertical rectangle divided into blocks of flat color. The top section is a bright red square. Below the red, there are white rectangles separated by thick black horizontal lines. In the middle area, a large yellow square sits between the white blocks. The entire colorful tower rests on a sturdy, dark gray pedestal with a wide, flat base.

title: Lateral Volume #2
medium: Oil and tempera on cheesecloth or muslin, laid down on masonite
alt_text: A sculpture made of oil and tempera on board shows a tall, vertical panel with a geometric design. The surface is primarily white, divided into sections by thin, black horizontal lines of varying widths. Near the lower third of the panel, there is a bold, horizontal red band that extends across the width of the white space. The entire composition is contained within a simple, narrow frame. This vertical arrangement creates a pattern of alternating blocks of color and dark lines.

title: Chocorua, New Hampshire
alt_text: A painting of a vast, open landscape under a soft, light-filled sky. In the center, large, dark-toned mountains rise up against the horizon. Below the mountains, the landscape opens into a wide green valley filled with fields and small clusters of trees. On the left and right sides of the foreground, darker, more detailed trees frame the scene. A small, indistinct figure of a person walking a dog appears in the lower right corner, on a dirt path that winds into the distance.

title: Pennsylvania Winter Scene
alt_text: A painting showing a winter landscape with a snowy field and a house. A horse-drawn sleigh with several people sits on a stone bridge in the foreground. Two people stand near the side of the bridge, and a small dog runs near the horses. In the background, a two-story house with a chimney stands behind a wooden fence. The sky above is filled with soft, grey and white clouds. Bare trees and snow-covered ground cover the open landscape.

title: Velvet purse and mirror
alt_text: An embroidered textile showing a small pouch and an octagonal metal frame. On the left sits a shiny, silver-colored octagon with a small paper tag attached that is marked with the number 514. To the right is a small pouch made of dark red velvet, decorated with intricate, gold-colored swirly patterns. The pouch has a flap that folds over the front. A black rectangular sign with the white text 1947.171 sits along the bottom edge. All items rest against a plain, light blue background.

title: Noah Webster (1758-1843) B.A. 1778, LL.D. 1823
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture of an older man’s head and shoulders stands against a plain background. The man has a serious expression with visible wrinkles on his forehead and around his mouth. His hair is short and combed back close to his scalp. He wears a piece of fabric draped over his shoulders like a loose cloak. The entire bust is a muted, pale green color with some worn spots revealing lighter material underneath. A simple pedestal base supports the figure.

title: Augusta Tabb Daniel
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece depicting a watercolor portrait of a young child. The portrait shows the child from the chest up, with light brown hair worn in soft curls that frame a round face. The child wears a pinkish-orange garment with simple blue decorative trim and buttons down the front. The portrait is set inside an oval frame with a metallic, etched border and a loop at the top for hanging. The background of the portrait is a plain, dark, and cloudy shade of purple.

title: Thomas Day Seymour (1848-1907), B.A. (Hon.) 1870
alt_text: An oil painting of a bearded man wearing academic robes and a red hood, framed within a simple gold border. He is positioned on the right side of the image, facing toward the left. The man has short, thinning hair, wears glasses, and has a full, light-colored beard. His right hand reaches forward, holding a white rectangular paper or book. Behind him, the dark background features shelves filled with books and a small, pale bust sitting on a ledge.

title: Joseph Hergesheimer (1880–1954)
alt_text: A painting of a man wearing a white suit and red-rimmed glasses sitting in a yellow chair. He sits on a light-colored rug, next to a small, round black table holding a drink and some bottles. Above his head hangs a large, patterned lamp with a curved base. A red flower sits on the rug near his feet, and a bright yellow, horn-shaped instrument lies on the ground below that. In the upper right corner, a cloud-like shape contains a small drawing of a tree and a house. The background of the entire scene is a solid, deep blue.

title: Hudson River Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a calm river flowing through a valley. On the right, large, leafy trees stand on a grassy bank that slopes down toward the water. A small, dark boat floats on the river near the center. In the distance, gentle hills fade into a cloudy, overcast sky. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame with carved details.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LL.D. 1781
alt_text: An enamel miniature showing a bust-length portrait of a man with white, curled hair. He faces forward, wearing a dark blue coat with a high collar and a white ruffled cravat at his neck. His expression is serious, and his skin appears pale with a slight pink flush on the cheeks. The portrait is oval-shaped and framed in a thin gold metal ring. This entire piece is set against a dark, shiny, rectangular black background.

title: Annunciation
alt_text: A painting on wood depicts a lush, green garden with a central pathway leading into the distance. A tall, arched trellis covered in climbing vines spans over the walkway, supported by rows of thin, pale posts on either side. In the foreground, two figures in light-colored robes kneel on the ground, one on the left and one on the right. Both figures have their arms raised as if gesturing toward each other. Behind the figures, beds of low plants and pink flowers stretch across the bottom of the scene. In the background, a dense wall of tall, dark green trees creates a dark horizon against a teal-colored sky.

title: Portrait
alt_text: A painting on a ceramic plate shows a side profile of a person. The person faces to the left and wears a wide, dark hat. They are dressed in a bright orange jacket. The background features simple, sketchy lines that suggest trees or a landscape. The entire round artwork is framed within a square, dark border.

title: William Williams (1731-1811)
alt_text: A painting shows an oval portrait of a middle-aged man with light, wavy hair. He has prominent sideburns and wears a dark, high-collared coat over a white shirt. The background of the portrait is a dark, solid brown color. The man looks slightly to his left with a neutral expression. The painting is enclosed within a large, rectangular gold frame with a textured, crisscross pattern on its surface.

title: Portrait of a Lady
alt_text: A painting of a young woman posing against a dark background. She has brown hair pulled back with a beaded ornament and wears a large, sheer, fan-shaped ruff collar around her neck. Her dark dress features long, pale sleeves and she wears a long strand of pearls draped around her neck. Her left hand rests gently against her chest. A small, golden bird-shaped pin is visible on the left side of her bodice.

title: Whale's Jaw, Dogtown Common, Cape Ann, Massachusetts
alt_text: A painting of large rock formations set against a bright blue sky. Two massive, pale grey stones rise up in the center, tilted at sharp angles. The stone on the left has letters painted on its surface. Dark, textured bushes and trees in shades of deep red and brown surround the rocks at the bottom. The sky above is streaked with light, swirling brushstrokes of blue and white.

title: The Last Stone Walls, Dogtown
alt_text: A painting of a landscape shows a field divided by a sturdy stone wall. The white, rocky wall runs horizontally across the middle of the scene and is held up by several wooden posts. Behind the wall, dark green trees and rolling hills fill the background under a blue sky with a single long cloud. A simple dirt path stretches across the bottom foreground. Tall, dark green grass grows in patches near the fence and along the bottom edge of the frame.

title: Sheep in Fog
alt_text: A painting of several sheep against a plain, pale background. A large ram with curled horns stands prominently in the lower left, looking directly forward. To the right of the ram, a second sheep with a dark face and small horns faces the viewer. In the middle distance, a faint, sketch-like group of four sheep stands in a row. A simple outline of another sheep appears on the far right edge of the frame. The entire scene is painted in muted tones of gray and off-white.

title: Grotesque Duel on the Ice
alt_text: A painting of figures on a frozen, wintry landscape. On the left, a person encased in a wooden barrel wears a birdcage on their head and skates on the ice. Near the center, another person crouches inside a large, light-colored animal skull while balancing a small bowl on their head. To the right, a man with red leggings carries a massive, bleached animal skull on his back while skating toward the barrel figure. In the background, a small, dark hut sits on a rocky edge with a person leaning out of it. The gray, overcast sky stretches above a distant, flat horizon with tiny silhouettes of other people.

title: Norwich Falls (or The Falls of the Yantic at Norwich)
alt_text: A painting of a quiet river landscape features a rocky cliff rising from the water on the right side. To the left, a small wooden structure stands at the water's edge, partially surrounded by trees and boulders. A slow-moving stream flows around the large cliff and spills into a wider, darker pool in the foreground. In the background, rolling hills covered with thick green and brown trees stretch across the horizon. The sky is filled with soft, cloudy light that suggests either sunrise or sunset.

title: Piece
alt_text: A cotton textile showing a repeating scene printed in reddish-brown ink on a creamy background. The fabric features outdoor images of people working and living in a rural area. On the left side, a man holding a pitchfork walks near a simple wooden hut. To the right, another building with a thatched roof stands near a group of animals. Several trees with full, leafy branches are scattered throughout the landscape. The print has a rustic, sketched style that fills the entire surface.

title: Belt- cloth woven
alt_text: A textile of cotton and wool shows a long, narrow band with colorful woven patterns. The fabric has a light cream background with thin vertical stripes in red and green running along its length. A design of alternating red and dark blue rectangular blocks runs down the center of the band. The bottom end is finished with a fringe of loose, hanging threads in red, green, and blue. At the very bottom of the image, a black label with white numbers rests on a white piece of foam.

title: Thomas Day, BA 1797
alt_text: A painted plaster sculpture of a man’s head and shoulders is set against a plain gray background. The figure has short, wavy hair and wears a draped cloth over his shoulders that is pinned at his right side. His face looks serious, with deep-set eyes, a long nose, and a firm mouth. The sculpture rests on a circular, stepped base. The entire object is light brown in color, with shadows accentuating the folds of the fabric and the details of his face.

title: Jeremiah Day, 1773-1867
alt_text: A plaster cast bust shows the head and shoulders of an older man with thin, receding hair. His face is gaunt, with deep-set eyes, a serious expression, and distinct lines around his mouth and nose. The figure is draped in smooth, layered fabric that covers his shoulders and chest like a simple robe. The material of the bust is a muted, light tan color with a matte finish. Light casts a soft shadow on the right side of the figure's neck and chest, adding depth to the folds in the fabric.

title: Piece
alt_text: A printed cotton textile shows several distinct scenes featuring figures and ships. In the lower left, a bare-chested figure stands in a large seashell drawn by sea creatures, while a fleet of ships floats in the distance. Above that, a woman sits in a smaller boat with two children near her side. In the bottom right corner, a woman and another figure wearing a helmet stand near rocky hills and a fortress wall. Trees with leafy branches appear in the background, filling out the scene. The entire design is printed in a single shade against a lighter background.

title: Barnyard Fantasy
alt_text: A painting showing abstract, swirling shapes in muted colors. A dark blue, jagged form hangs down from the top center like an organic, crooked tree limb. Below it, a smaller, teal figure with a visible eye faces toward the right. To the left, a large, rounded, brownish shape with light-colored spots stands against a pale gray background. The scene is filled with soft, wavy strokes and blurred edges throughout.

title: Ulysses Hunting the Boar (Boar Hunt of Meleager)
alt_text: A textile wall hanging made of wool and silk shows a hunting scene framed by an elaborate border. In the center, a man in a tunic holds a long spear and stands in a forest clearing. Near him, two dogs are interacting with an animal on the ground. The wide border surrounding this scene is decorated with images of seated figures and ornate designs. The entire work is rendered in shades of gray and black.

title: Ebenezer Storer II (1730–1807), M.A. (Hon.) 1750
alt_text: A jewelry miniature shows a portrait of a person painted in watercolor on ivory. The person has fair skin, bright blue eyes, and is wearing a green beret. They are dressed in a reddish-pink jacket with a white collar. This oval portrait is set inside a simple gold frame. Thick, braided strands of brown hair connect to the top and bottom of the frame, suggesting the piece is a bracelet or necklace.

title: The Virgin as a Shepherdess
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a field surrounded by several sheep. The woman has long, wavy brown hair and wears a pale, peach-colored dress under a bright blue shawl. Her right hand gently touches the head of a white lamb standing near her knee. In the background, rolling hills stretch behind the group, and a small winged figure floats in the upper right sky. Several other fluffy white sheep sit or stand near the woman's feet, holding small red flowers in their mouths.

title: Fragment of Lace
alt_text: A textile of coralline point lace shows a delicate, light-colored pattern resembling branching coral. The intricate design features twisted, vine-like shapes and many small, open loops that fill the space. These thin, thread-like structures create an airy and complex web. The piece sits against a plain, light grey background. Below the lace, a black label displays the white numbers 1946. 200 in a bold font.

title: Length of Lace
alt_text: A strip of needlepoint lace displays a delicate, openwork floral pattern. The off-white fabric is rectangular but has a slightly jagged, decorative border along the top and bottom edges. Many small, interconnected floral and leafy shapes are woven into the lace, creating a complex and airy design. Below the lace, a black rectangular label shows the white printed numbers "1946. 201." The background is a plain, light gray surface.

title: Length of Lace
alt_text: A piece of Venetian needlepoint lace shows a long, horizontal strip of fabric with a delicate, floral pattern. The lace is a creamy, off-white color and features intricate designs of leaves and blossoms woven throughout. Its bottom edge has a scalloped, jagged shape that rises and falls along the length of the strip. A black rectangular label with the white text "1946.203" sits horizontally beneath the lace. The entire object rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Length of Lace
alt_text: A piece of bobbin lace is shown lying flat against a plain, light-colored background. This long, narrow strip of fabric is white and has a delicate, net-like texture. Small, embroidered floral patterns are scattered across the middle section of the lace. The bottom edge is scalloped with a decorative border design. Below the lace, a black rectangular sign with the white text "1946.204" sits on the surface.

title: Length of Lace (2)
alt_text: A piece of lace shows two strips of off-white fabric with intricate, repeating patterns of swirling leaves and floral shapes. The two strips are wrapped around a vertical white cardboard tube on the left side of the image. The lace has an uneven, wavy edge along the top. Below the tube, a small black rectangular label with white text reads "1946.205A-B". The background is a plain, solid grey surface.

title: Misty Day
alt_text: A painting of a hazy, gray-blue seascape with choppy water. The scene shows multiple small sailboats drifting in the distance under a pale, overcast sky. In the foreground, the water has streaks of darker blue and earthy brown colors, suggesting the shallows or a beach shoreline. The painting is enclosed within a wide, textured gold frame that has a repeating diagonal pattern. A small sign with the numbers "1949.210" is attached to the top of the frame.

title: Doily
alt_text: A cotton textile doily shows a circular, lacy pattern centered on a light gray background. The center features a star-shaped design made of intricate, interconnected white threads. Surrounding the center are six rounded, flower-like motifs arranged in a ring. The outer edge of the piece is scalloped and features a delicate, open weave. The entire object is white and has a lacy, perforated appearance throughout.

title: Fragment of Crochet
alt_text: A textile of cotton shows two separate, circular, lacy pieces connected together. These pieces have intricate, open patterns that resemble stylized flowers or gears with open centers. The smaller piece sits on the left, while the larger piece is positioned to the right and slightly overlaps the first. The lacy designs are light gray in color and appear against a plain, slightly darker gray background. This fabric is delicate and thin, with many small, repeating cutouts throughout the circular shapes.

title: Fragment of Crochet
alt_text: A textile made of cotton shows a piece of delicate white lace with an irregular, triangular shape. The lace features a dense cluster of rounded, berry-like shapes near the top left corner. Below and to the right of the berries, the design transitions into an intricate, open grid pattern filled with flower-like motifs. The edges of the piece are jagged and uneven, with small loops and points extending outward. The entire object is light-colored and set against a solid, neutral background.

title: Length of Lace
alt_text: A textile piece of Limerick lace shows a delicate floral pattern on a mesh background. The left side of the rectangular fabric is covered in large, intricate flowers and leaves made of white thread. The right side features smaller, scattered floral motifs that look like tiny stars or blossoms. The overall design creates a contrast between the dense, elaborate border on the left and the sparse, simple shapes on the right. The lace rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Doily
alt_text: A piece of Carrickmacross lace shows an intricate, circular pattern on a plain background. The lace is white and appears delicate, with many small, connected floral-like shapes. The center of the circle features a dense cluster of petals surrounded by lighter, more open lacework. The overall design radiates outward from the middle toward the scalloped, uneven edge. This round textile piece fills most of the frame.

title: Square of drawn thread and embroidery
alt_text: A textile square shows an intricate pattern of cream-colored thread against a light background. The center features a star-like shape made of raised stitching. This central square is surrounded by a lattice pattern that creates a series of small, diamond-shaped holes. The edges of the piece are finished with a wavy, scalloped border. Below the textile, a black rectangular label displays the white numbers "1946.151."

title: Square of cut work and embroidery
alt_text: A linen textile shows an intricate, square-shaped lace doily with rounded edges. The center features a cross-like design set within a circle of cutwork embroidery. This central area is surrounded by four decorative corners that mirror each other, all filled with delicate, open patterns. A detailed lace border with small, pointed triangles creates a scalloped edge around the entire piece. Beneath the textile, a dark, horizontal label displays the white numbers "1946.152" printed clearly on its surface.

title: Length of bobbin lace
alt_text: A textile strip showing a detailed, off-white lace pattern is centered horizontally in the upper portion of the frame. The lace has a repeating design of diamonds filled with mesh, bordered by circular motifs along the bottom edge. Below the lace, a long black rectangular plaque displays the white numbers "1946.153" clearly printed in the center. The background behind both objects is a flat, solid, light grey color.

title: Fragment of bobbin lace
alt_text: A textile piece showing an intricate, light tan pattern of openwork lace. The design features a decorative motif with swirling loops and a central diamond-shaped grid. The lace extends out to the sides and is attached to a thin, straight strip along the bottom edge. The overall shape is somewhat symmetrical, resembling an ornate crest or flourish. Beneath the object, a black label displays the number 1946.155 in white text.

title: Fragment of bobbin lace
alt_text: A piece of white lace textile displays an intricate design on a sheer, mesh background. A large, wheel-like flower shape sits in the center, surrounded by curved, leafy patterns. Smaller floral designs are scattered across the top part of the fabric. The lace is rectangular, with a decorative border featuring repeating scallops along the bottom edge. Below the fabric, a black label displays the numbers "1946.163" in large, white, sans-serif text.

title: Fragment of bobbin lace
alt_text: A piece of textile shows a small fragment of light tan lace. The fabric has a fine, mesh-like background pattern covered in tiny dots. The bottom edge features a decorative border made of repeating bell-shaped flowers connected by thin curved lines. A small, solid rectangular patch is attached to the upper left side of the mesh. Below the fabric, a black label displays the white numbers "1946.165".

title: Length of bobbin lace
alt_text: A textile of white lace shows a long, thin strip of fabric folded in two. The lace features a repeating pattern of small floral designs along one edge. The fabric has a semi-transparent, net-like texture throughout. A rectangular black label with the white text "1946.166" sits centered below the fabric against a plain, light grey background.

title: Length of bobbin lace
alt_text: A textile showing a rectangular piece of delicate, off-white lace. The fabric has a fine, mesh-like background pattern decorated with small, scattered floral sprigs. A decorative border with a leafy vine design runs along the top edge of the piece. Attached to the bottom right corner of the lace is a small, pale paper tag with handwritten text on it. Below the lace, a black rectangular scale bar displays the white numbers "1946.168."

title: Length of bobbin lace
alt_text: A piece of lace is shown centered in the upper portion of the frame. This textile is a long, rectangular strip with an off-white, net-like pattern. The lace has a decorative, scalloped floral design running along its bottom edge. Scattered, small, round dots are stitched across the top part of the material. Below the lace, a black rectangular label features the white numbers "1946.169" printed on its surface.

title: Collar
alt_text: A piece of apparel made of lace is shaped in a wide, gentle curve like a collar. It is off-white in color with a see-through, openwork mesh pattern throughout. A repeating design of small, round floral shapes runs horizontally across the center of the curve. The outer edges are finished with a delicate, wavy scalloped pattern. title: Elias Boudinot

title: A Road across Hampstead Heath
alt_text: A painting of an open, rolling landscape under a wide, cloudy sky. In the foreground, grassy hills with patches of earth rise from the bottom, leading the eye into the distance. A long, flat ridge runs horizontally across the middle of the scene, dotted with tiny, distant figures walking along the horizon line. To the right, clusters of trees with muted green and brown leaves mark the edge of the hill. The sky above is filled with heavy, dark grey and brown clouds that suggest an overcast day.

title: Gertrude Stein
alt_text: A painting of a person with short dark hair, shown from the chest up. Behind them, there is a rolling landscape featuring soft green hills under a pale sky. The scene is rendered with loose, visible brushstrokes throughout.

title: Moonlight Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a river landscape at twilight. A full moon glows brightly in the cloudy, dark sky above the water. On the left side, a tall church tower stands near a cluster of trees and small houses. Several cows graze along the dark grassy bank in the foreground near a wooden fence. Small sailboats drift slowly across the calm river in the distance.

title: Automaton Clock in the Shape of Diana on Her Chariot
medium: Case: gilt brass and ebony; dials: partly enameled silver; movement: brass and iron
alt_text: A timepiece shows a golden figure sitting on a dark, wheeled chariot holding a bow and arrow. The chariot is shaped like a dark ebony box with decorative gold metal panels on its sides and four thin gold wheels. Perched on the front of the chariot, just below the archer, is a small, seated monkey figure. A clock dial with Roman numerals sits behind the archer’s legs, integrated into the structure. In front of the chariot, a gold cat-like animal is attached by chains and appears to be pulling the carriage forward.

The background is a soft, muted blue, suggesting trees or foliage behind them.

title: Samuel Jones (1770-1853), B.A. 1790
alt_text: A painting of an older man with graying hair, shown from the chest up against a dark, shadowy background. He wears a dark coat over a white shirt with a high, stiff collar and a dark necktie. His face is turned slightly to the right, and he has a calm expression with a hint of a smile. His hair is swept back, and his features appear soft and aged. The portrait is enclosed in a simple, rectangular gold-colored frame that stands upright.

title: Portrait of a Young Woman

A dark mark appears in the upper right corner of the painting.

title: Classical Head

The neck of the bust is slightly broken and rough along the bottom edge where it meets the base.

title: Landscape with Waterfalls

To the left, there is a tall, rocky cliff face covered in dark vegetation. The stream splashes over smooth, dark rocks as it moves across the bottom of the frame. In the distance, pale blue mountains rise up against a cloudy, light-filled sky.

title: Jongleurs

The background behind the smaller figure is a simple blue-grey panel. The entire painting is encased in an ornate, carved wooden frame.

title: Arabian Encampment
alt_text: A painting of a vast, open landscape with several horses and riders. In the center, a person wearing light-colored robes rides a brown horse away from the viewer. A large, overcast sky takes up more than half of the painting. The entire scene uses muted, earthy tones of tan and brown.

title: George Washington
alt_text: A miniature on ivory showing a portrait of a light-skinned man with white, powdered hair. He is seen from the chest up, facing toward the left side of the frame. The man wears a dark blue military-style uniform jacket with wide, light tan lapels and gold-colored shoulder epaulettes. His expression is serious, with his eyes looking off into the distance. The background is a solid, dark, brownish-grey color within an oval shape.

title: Woman (Metal Lady)

alt_text: A metal sculpture showing a tall, thin figure with an abstract shape. The figure stands against a flat, grey background, framed by dark wood. The figure’s body is formed from smooth, geometric curves and sharp angles that taper down to a narrow base. Its head is small, rounded, and tilted to one side.

title: Braunes Mädchen
alt_text: A painting showing the head and shoulders of a person with a neutral expression. The person has olive-colored skin and is wearing a reddish-brown hat or head covering. Their clothing is also brown, featuring two distinct, round white buttons. The background is composed of rough, abstract brushstrokes in varying shades of dark and light blue. The figure's left eye is bright blue, while the other is shadowed in dark tones.

title: John Bayly, Jr. (1750s–1806)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature of a man's profile view. The person has short, light gray hair pulled back in a small, thin ponytail. His skin is flushed with a reddish tone, and he has a prominent, curved nose. He wears a high-collared white shirt with a ruffled piece at the neck under a dark gray jacket. The oval portrait is encased in a simple gold metal frame with a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: The Metamorphosis of Actaeon
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows a wide landscape filled with many people and dogs. On the left side, several clothed men sit or stand near a path while handling dogs. In the center, a nude person walks near a small pond surrounded by more hunting dogs and a man in a pink cloak. On the right, a group of nude figures stands near a dark forest edge. The background displays a river winding through green fields toward a distant town with tall, pointed towers.

title: Diana (Grapes)
alt_text: A painting shows a large cluster of grapes hanging against a neutral, grey background. The grapes are grouped together in the center of the frame and appear to be dark in color. A small, thin stem connects the grapes at the top. To the right of the grapes, there is a dark, soft shadow that mimics the shape of the fruit. Handwritten text appears in the upper right corner and the bottom left corner of the paper.

title: American Interior
alt_text: A painting of a sunlit interior room shows furniture and decor from a high angle. To the left, a small wooden table holds a clear glass vase, a patterned ceramic plate, a small red bowl, and a brown ceramic mug. A dark wooden chair sits nearby on a patterned rug featuring geometric star designs. A white tabletop extends from the right edge, casting a curved shadow onto the floor. The wooden floor is covered by multiple rugs, including one with colorful stripes at the bottom.

title: Nature morte à la statuette (Still Life with Plaster Figure)
alt_text: A painting of a white statuette standing on a table among various pieces of fruit and a small bowl. The upright figure on the left is white, shaped like a woman, and faces toward the right side of the frame. In front of the figure, a bright orange fruit sits prominently on a red cloth surface. Next to the orange, several smaller, round objects and a small patterned bowl are arranged on the table. The background is filled with loose, colorful brushstrokes of brown, green, and blue. The overall style uses thick paint with visible, energetic marks.

title: Rendezvous
alt_text: A painting of a bridge over a small river in a field. On the wooden bridge, a person in a white dress walks forward while carrying a long, thin pole. Next to the walker, a person wearing a hat rides a brown horse away from the viewer. The sky above is filled with soft, gray, and brown clouds. Tall grasses grow along the banks of the river under a line of green trees. The entire scene is set within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Landscape Painting
alt_text: A painting of two large, golden-brown mounds set against a dark and stormy sky. The mounds rise from a flat, tan-colored plain that covers the bottom portion of the scene. On the crest of the central mound, several thin, dark, vertical shapes are lined up in a row. These shapes are tall and narrow, looking like thin poles or slender frames. The sky above is filled with streaky, horizontal layers of deep blue, gray, and white clouds.

title: William Strickland (1788–1854)
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in formal clothing sitting in front of a large building with tall columns. The man has brown hair with sideburns and is wearing a dark green coat over a white collared shirt. He holds a drawing pad in his left hand and a writing utensil in his right hand, which rests on the pad. Behind him, the building with white columns is set against a soft, cloudy sky and a hint of trees. A small, red fabric drape is visible on the right side of the painting.

title: Garden Scene
alt_text: A painting of a group of people outdoors in a dark, forested setting. In the foreground, four figures in ornate, period-style clothing stand and converse in a small clearing. To the left, a fifth person sits on the ground near a small dog. To the right, a man stands wearing bright red leggings, accompanied by two larger dogs. The background is composed of deep brown and black shadows that suggest thick trees and foliage.

title: The Edge of the Forest
alt_text: A painting showing a dark, wooded area with tall trees filling the background and sides. A small figure wearing a red top and white skirt stands near the center, positioned between the tree trunks. Through a gap in the trees, a small white house is visible in the distance under a pale sky. The foreground is filled with shadows and patches of muted greens, browns, and faint hints of flowers. The overall scene feels dim and moody, with very little bright light.

title: Mains tenant le vide (Hands Holding the Void)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture showing a pale, standing figure within a simple frame. The figure is tall and smooth, with a round head and long, thin limbs. It stands with its hands placed near its chest. Behind the figure, a rectangular frame rises from a small, block-like base. The entire piece is light in color and stands against a plain, dark gray background.

title: Bird-Man
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture shows a stylized, rounded shape on a light-colored base. The base has a smooth, curved top edge and widens toward the bottom, suggesting a head and shoulders. Resting on top of this base are two distinct, stacked, and layered shapes. The upper shape is bright red, while the lower one is a darker, muted grey. Both of these top shapes feature a small hole and a notched end, resembling abstract, cartoonish heads or tools.

title: Paul Revere (1735-1818)
medium: Watercolor and graphite pencil on ivory
alt_text: A miniature painting of an older man is set in a dark wooden frame with a gold inner border. The man has short, white, thinning hair and a round face with light skin. He wears a dark, double-breasted coat over a white collared shirt. He is shown from the chest up, looking directly toward the viewer with a neutral expression. The background is a soft, blended shade of dark blue and gray.

title: Frederick Wolcott (1767-1837), B.A. 1786, M.A. 1796
alt_text: A painting of an older man with gray hair who is looking directly at the viewer. He has fair skin and is wearing a dark coat over a white shirt with a ruffled cravat at his neck. A small, bright orange charm hangs from his waistband. Behind him, a large, deep red curtain hangs on the left side of the frame. The background is shadowy and dark, with a hint of a landscape visible on the right.

title: Red Tailed Hawk
alt_text: A painting of two large birds with reddish-brown and white feathers wrestling in the air. One bird is above, clutching a smaller bird and a rabbit with its sharp yellow talons. The bird underneath lies on its back with its beak open, appearing to fight or call out. Below the struggling animals, a flat, tan-colored landscape stretches out toward a distant blue mountain under a pale sky. Blood is visible on the fur of the rabbit held in the birds' claws.

title: Mobile
medium: Painted sheet metal, painted wood, and fishing line
alt_text: A sculpture made of metal, wood, and wire hangs against a solid grey background. The structure consists of a long, thin, horizontal bar suspended by wires from above. A single, smooth wooden sphere hangs from the left end of the bar. To the right, a curved, sheet-metal form hangs down. This red shape has a sharp, pointed black and yellow tail attached to its top.

title: Tsar Paul I of Russia
medium: Oil on ivory or copper, gilt bronze
alt_text: A miniature oil painting shows the portrait of a young person with pale skin and light-colored hair styled in small rolls at the sides. The person wears a dark green coat with a high, red collar and several shiny medals pinned to the chest. A bright blue sash crosses diagonally over the chest from the right shoulder. The portrait is housed in a rectangular gold-colored frame with a decorative gold crown and leaves attached to the top. The entire framed piece rests against a deep red fabric background.

title: Simultaneous Composition
alt_text: A painting of a geometric composition formed by black lines on a white background. Several rectangles of different sizes fill the spaces between the lines. These shapes are colored in flat shades of blue, yellow, light gray, and white. The painting is set within a simple white frame, which is surrounded by a thick, dark wood frame. The overall design creates a grid-like pattern across the square surface.

title: Ichabod Crane Flying from the Headless Horseman
alt_text: A painting shows a person riding a white horse through a dark, wooded area at night. The rider wears dark clothes and a wide-brimmed hat, leaning forward as the horse gallops from left to right. The background is mostly filled with deep, shadowy trees and bare branches against a gloomy sky. On the right side, a large tree trunk stands prominently in the foreground. The ground below appears muddy and uneven, with a few light-colored rocks scattered near the bottom edge.

title: Oval Construction
alt_text: A painting made of wood and paint shows a large oval-shaped board with various shapes attached to it. The background of the oval is divided into two main colored sections, with a gray area on the left and a large blue area occupying the rest. A tall, thin red vertical strip runs from the top to the bottom on the left side, overlapping the colors. Attached to this red strip is a small red circle, a white rectangle, and a yellow cylinder. A solid black circle sits alone on the right side against the blue background. The entire object has a soft shadow behind it, suggesting it stands out from a wall.

title: The Judgment of Paris
alt_text: A textile of wool showing several figures in a garden setting. On the left, a person sits while holding an object out toward another figure who stands facing them. A smaller winged figure stands in the center, aiming a bow and arrow toward the standing person. To the right, a large figure draped in flowing yellow fabric walks away. The background is filled with lush green leaves and small flowers. The entire scene is woven with muted earth tones and soft colors.

title: Thomas Cole (1801-1848)
alt_text: A miniature of a man is set inside an open red case. The portrait shows a man with light brown hair, wearing a dark coat and a white shirt. He rests his right hand against his cheek, leaning his elbow on a red surface. A folded red curtain hangs in the background behind him. To the left of the portrait, the inside of the case is lined with plain, off-white fabric. The entire portrait is framed with a bright gold border.

title: Armada
alt_text: A painting shows an abstract scene filled with many overlapping, geometric shapes in muted earth tones. A large, solid circle sits near the top left corner, colored in a dusty brown. To the right of this circle, clusters of jagged, gold-colored shapes create a textured, glowing effect against the softer background colors. Below and to the left, smaller blocks of teal, orange, and tan fill the space in irregular patterns. The entire composition feels layered, with thin lines and soft, hazy patches of green and gray blending together.

title: A Gentleman of the Schuyler Family (attributed to John Watson)
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a bright red coat and wearing a long, curly gray wig. The man stands facing forward, though his body is slightly turned to the right. He wears a white shirt with a ruffled front under his coat, which features many gold buttons. In his left hand, he holds a thin, silver-colored sword hilt. Behind him, there is a large tree on the left side and a view of distant hills and a pale sky on the right.

title: Amos Edward Lawrence (1812-1897), B.A. 1840, M.A. 1849
alt_text: A painting of an older person with white hair sitting in a chair. The person has a rounded face and is wearing a dark suit with a white shirt collar. Their hands are clasped together and rest on their lap. The person sits facing forward against a dark, plain brown background. The entire painting is framed by a simple gold border.

title: The John Hancock House
alt_text: A painting of a large, multistory house set behind a stone wall. The brick home has a sloping roof with several chimneys and green shutters on the windows. In the front yard, a large, leafy tree stands beside a small porch with steps leading up to the door. A sidewalk runs along the front of the property, where a horse-drawn carriage waits near an open gate. Several people in old-fashioned clothing walk on the sidewalk near the wall. Lush bushes with pink and yellow leaves fill the garden area around the house.

title: Samuel Fessenden Clarke (1851-1928), Ph.D. 1878
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in dark, formal clothing. The man has a long, light-colored beard and wears a small, dark cap on his head. He sits facing forward and rests his chin on his left hand. His right hand rests flat on his lap, with a visible white cuff at his wrist. The background is a very dark, solid color that makes the man stand out.

title: Acrobat
alt_text: An ivory sculpture shows a figure curled up into a diving position. The smooth, light-colored figure balances on top of a dark, cylindrical base that looks like a piece of raw tusk. The figure has its arms pulled tight against its head, and its legs are extended straight upward together. The base has a brownish, weathered texture with visible cracks and surface marks. This object stands against a plain, grey background.

title: John Bartlett (1784–1866), B.A. 1807
medium: Watercolor on wove paper with embossed design
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting shows the side profile of a man. The person faces to the left and has dark hair styled with curls at the front. He wears a dark, high-collared coat over a light-colored shirt or cravat. The portrait is set on a piece of paper with an embossed, patterned border and a metallic-looking, ornate frame that has a small cross at the very top. This entire piece is mounted inside a larger, plain black rectangular frame.

title: Dr. Hezekiah Beardsley (1748–1790)
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair next to a table. He is dressed in a dark coat, a patterned vest, and white stockings, and he holds a thick, brown book in his hand. Next to him, a wooden table holds a stack of books, an open pamphlet, and a quill pen sitting in an inkwell. Behind the man, a window shows a view of a green landscape with trees and a cloudy sky. A long, dark green curtain hangs to the right of the window. The room itself has plain, grey walls.

title: Elizabeth Hubbard Stiles (1731–1775)
alt_text: A painting of a mature woman seated at a wooden table. She wears a plain, light-colored cap tied with a bow under her chin, framing her face. She has on a long-sleeved, tan-colored dress with a white lace-trimmed collar and bodice overlay. Her hands rest on the table in front of her, holding a small, delicate object with blue accents. The background is a simple, muted green wall that creates a soft glow around her figure.

title: Joseph Reade
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up against a dark brown background. He has light skin and short, wavy brown hair brushed forward on his forehead. He wears a high-collared white shirt with a matching white necktie and a dark jacket over it. His face is turned slightly toward the right side of the frame. He has light blue eyes and looks directly at the viewer with a neutral expression.

title: Reverend Samuel Fayerweather (1725-1781), M.A. (Hon.) 1753
alt_text: A miniature portrait showing a man with white hair wearing academic robes and a flat-topped cap. He has a fair complexion, light eyes, and looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression. The man wears a dark robe with a white rectangular collar piece and a glimpse of a red hood over his shoulder. The portrait is housed in a rectangular frame with a decorative, twisted silver border. The background behind the man is a simple, dark green tone.

title: Ezra Stiles (1727–1795), B.A. 1746, M.A. 1749
alt_text: A painting of a man in a black coat with a white clerical collar sitting in a room. The man has short, powdered white hair, a pale face, and looks forward with a serious expression. His right hand is placed over his chest, while his left hand holds a small blue book with gold detailing. To the right of the man, a bookshelf holds many leather-bound books with titles on their spines. On the wall to the left, a circular blue light shines with a bright, glowing center containing faint, written characters.

title: Hercules and Antaeus
alt_text: A painting on wood shows two muscular, nude men wrestling in the center of the image. The man in the foreground stands with his back to the viewer, gripping the other man around the waist. The second man is lifted off the ground, his body twisted while he holds onto the first man’s arm. Behind them, a simple blue sky is visible above a flat, grassy landscape with a single thin tree. The painted scene is framed by bare, worn wooden borders where the surface has chipped and faded away.

title: Dog and Cock
alt_text: A painting of a still life scene arranged on a table. The composition includes a pitcher, a bowl of fruit, and other abstract shapes against a split blue and tan background. The table base is painted in dark, fringed vertical stripes. A patterned basket or box sits on top, filled with several dark, rounded fruit-like shapes. The overall style uses flat blocks of color and sharp geometric lines.

title: The Builders, Bird Nesting, Human Efforts
alt_text: A painting shows a group of men laboring to move large white frames and stacks of red bricks against a brick wall. The men wear simple, dark work clothes and appear to be lifting or balancing heavy objects with poles. Above the construction, several birds rest in branches, with some nesting in small, circular woven structures. The entire scene is set against a background of reddish-brown brickwork. The light in the painting creates sharp angles and distinct shadows on the figures and the bricks.

title: A Country School
medium: Oil on canvas mounted on composition board
alt_text: A painting of a one-room schoolhouse filled with students and a teacher. A teacher sits at a desk on the left, facing several young children who are reading or working at their small desks. Two boys stand together in the center of the room, holding open books and looking at each other. On the right side of the room, a young girl in a red dress sits reading a book near a cast-iron stove. Large windows on the back wall let in soft, dim light, casting long shadows across the wooden floorboards. The room appears worn and cozy, with the students dressed in simple, dark clothing.

title: Reconciler
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured shapes and colors arranged in a vertical composition. A bright, textured white column runs down the center of the image, appearing thick and relief-like. On the left side, dark black and shadowed areas contrast with hints of gold and yellow. The right side features a vibrant mix of deep red, blue, and black tones that blend together. Overall, the surface appears heavily layered with paint and possibly other materials, creating a rough, uneven texture.

title: Street Scene, Paris
alt_text: A painting of two urban buildings stands against a dark, cloudy sky. On the left, a tall, narrow, tan-colored apartment building rises vertically with several small, dark windows stacked in rows. To its right, a wider, white building features two levels of rectangular windows and a flat roofline. Below the buildings, a street scene includes a lone lamp post, a dark carriage, and a few small, indistinct figures walking along the pavement. The overall color palette uses muted, earthy tones for the structures, which contrast with the deep, gray shadows surrounding them.

title: Portrait of Gertrude Stein
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows the head of a person facing slightly to the left. The face has smooth, rounded features with subtle shading across the forehead and cheeks. Their hair is styled in a simple, pulled-back knot or bun at the top of the head. The bronze has a weathered, brownish-gold tone. This head rests on a simple, square, black pedestal.

title: John Hancock (1737–1793) Signer of the Declaration of Independence, President of the Continental Congress (1775–77), Governor of Mass. (1780–85)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory shows a portrait of a man in profile looking to the right. He has light skin and wears a white powdered wig that is pulled back with a dark ribbon. The man is dressed in a bright blue coat over a white ruffled shirt and cravat. He is set within an ornate, oval-shaped gold frame decorated with sculpted leaf and flower patterns. The background behind the man is a soft, muted grey-green color.

title: Virgin and Child with Angels
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing on a crescent moon while holding a small child. She has long, flowing hair and wears a long, draped red dress with a dark under-robe. Two winged figures float above her, holding a gold crown over her head. Two other winged figures hover on either side of her, one playing a small instrument and the other playing a trumpet. A soft, golden light surrounds all the figures against a background that fades into faint clouds.

title: Maquette for Big Bird
medium: Painted sheet metal and painted wire
alt_text: A sculpture of red and black metal shapes standing on thin wire legs. The body of the sculpture consists of a large, curved red piece of sheet metal attached to a dark, crescent-shaped black piece. These metal sections are joined together by visible bolts. Below the body, three long, black wire legs extend downward to support the sculpture against a plain gray background. The overall form balances on these thin legs, creating a light and airy appearance.

title: Tower
alt_text: A cellulose nitrate sculpture sits inside a clear, cube-shaped display box. The sculpture is light brown and stands on a small circular base. It features thin, flat pieces arranged in a vertical structure that includes a circular opening. Delicate, string-like lines connect the different parts of the sculpture. The entire setup is placed against a plain, light gray background.

title: Tu m'
medium: Oil on canvas, with bottlebrush, safety pins, and bolt
alt_text: A painting of abstract and mechanical forms on a long horizontal canvas. A large, faint circular outline resembling a bicycle wheel sits on the left side, with layered, colored rectangles extending toward the center. A small, human-like hand points toward a white rectangular area in the middle of the composition. Various thin, dark lines and shapes are scattered across the background, creating a sense of movement. A small black object, resembling a brush, hangs from a thin wire near the center. The background is a soft, muted cream color that stretches across the entire surface.

title: New York Harbor
alt_text: A painting of a seascape shows small sailboats floating on open water under a cloudy sky. In the center, a dark boat with a single sail stands out against the pale, shimmering surface of the water. To the right, a long, dark shoreline stretches horizontally along the horizon. Several small birds are visible in the upper left corner, flying through the grey and white clouds. The brushstrokes are loose and visible, giving the entire scene a muted, soft appearance.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of a still life includes a white vase standing on a yellow surface in the foreground. Behind the vase, a large, textured grey shape stands upright like a folded piece of paper or a book. Above this shape, a yellow rectangle leans diagonally against a dark grey background. To the left, a small black-and-white grid pattern sits on the edge of the table. A similar grid appears on the right side of the painting, slightly higher up.

title: Black on White
alt_text: A painting shows large, bold shapes in black and off-white. A dark black block occupies the top half of the center, creating a sharp diagonal line that slopes downward to the right. Below this, a block of off-white space sits on the left, mirrored by a dark black area filling the bottom right corner. These areas create a zig-zag pattern that divides the canvas into contrasting light and dark sections. The entire composition is enclosed in a dark, simple frame.

title: Monument to the Artist's Father
alt_text: A sculpture of white painted plywood shows a vertical arrangement of geometric shapes. The structure sits on a flat, rectangular base that extends slightly to the left. A tall, thin column rises straight up from the left side of the base. To the right of this column are two block-like steps of different heights. The entire object has a matte, plain white finish against a solid dark gray background.
