title: Jeremiah Dictating His Prophecy of the Destruction of Jerusalem to Baruch the Scribe, study
alt_text: A painting of two figures in a dim indoor setting, framed in gold. On the left sits a bearded man with a muscular build, wearing a light-colored tunic and a dark robe over his lap. He looks upward with his right hand raised toward the ceiling. To his right, a younger, smaller figure sits on the floor, looking up toward the man. A simple ceramic pot rests on the floor in the bottom left corner near the man's feet. The background is mostly dark and indistinct, though hints of architectural shapes are visible behind the man.

title: Solomon Porter (1753-1821), B.A. 1775
alt_text: A painting of a man presented in an oval frame. The subject is a man with short dark hair, shown from the chest up against a plain, dark brown background. He wears a dark coat over a white shirt with a high, tied collar. His expression is neutral as he looks directly toward the viewer. The painting is enclosed within a simple, light-colored wooden frame with an oval cutout in the center.

title: George Washington (1732–1799), LL.D. 1781
alt_text: A miniature on ivory shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man has short, powdered white hair and is looking directly forward with a neutral expression. He wears a dark blue coat over a white waistcoat and neckerchief. The portrait is set inside a simple, oval gold frame with a small loop at the top for hanging. The background of the portrait is a soft, blended mix of dark green and light blue colors.

title: Mr. Fowler
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up against a dark, shadowy background. He wears a dark, possibly maroon, coat with a light-colored, ruffled collar around his neck. The man has pale skin, light-colored hair, and a serious expression looking toward the viewer. The portrait is enclosed in a thick, black rectangular frame with a thin gold border inside. Below the frame, a small, white piece of paper with the handwritten text "1960.1.3" is taped to a metal display rack.

title: Mrs. Fowler
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up against a very dark background. She has brown hair pulled back with some small decorations in it and pale skin. The woman wears a reddish-brown garment with a white neckline and a light-colored bow at the back of her neck. A delicate necklace with small, bright beads sits closely around her throat. A small white label with black numbers is stuck to the lower right corner of the dark frame.

title: Friendship or Romance Allegory
alt_text: A piece of miniature jewelry shows a scene created with dissolved hair on ivory. The oval-shaped piece features a light, off-white background inside a textured metallic frame. Two birds are depicted in brown tones, perched on the rim of a wide, bowl-shaped cup sitting on a pedestal. Wispy, brush-like shapes representing trees or grass surround the cup and the birds. The entire design is delicate and minimalist, drawn with thin, dark lines.

title: Ships in Dock
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract composition of overlapping shapes and lines. The artwork is filled with a soft palette of light blue, cream, tan, and pale pink colors. Geometric shapes like triangles and rectangles are scattered throughout the canvas, mixed with curved, loose lines. Darker, bold accents of black and reddish-brown create contrast against the lighter background. The arrangement appears cluttered in the center, while the edges remain more open and sparse.

title: Portrait of a Lady
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing against a dark, plain background. She faces forward with a calm expression, wearing a dark, heavy dress with a high white collar. Beneath the outer skirt, a vibrant red fabric with gold trim hangs down to her feet. She holds a small, light-colored object in her right hand near her waist. Her dark hair is pulled back from her face, and she appears to be of slight build.

title: Café Scene
alt_text: A painting of four people sitting together around a table. A man on the left wears a dark jacket and faces toward the others, his hands resting on the table. Beside him, partially hidden, sits a woman with dark hair. Next to her is a woman wearing a bright orange top and a small red hair accessory. To her right sits a man in a dark hat and jacket, holding a small object to his mouth. Behind them is a solid red wall with several dark, framed pictures hanging on it.

title: Timothy Dwight (1752-1817), B.A. 1769, M.A. 1772
alt_text: A painting of a middle-aged man shown from the chest up. The man has a receding hairline with short, graying hair and pale skin. He wears a heavy, dark brown coat with a high collar over a white, wrapped neck cloth. His expression is serious with his gaze directed slightly to the side. The background is a solid, dark, and muted brown color that is lighter behind his head and darker toward the edges of the frame.

title: Seated Nude
alt_text: A painting of a seated figure with pale, grayish skin resting against a tree trunk. The person faces forward with tan hair, blue eyes, and a small red mark on their cheek. They are sitting on a dark green surface, with their body angled toward the left side of the frame. To their right, a thick brown tree trunk rises against a dark brown background. Some leaves, painted in black and blue, appear near the top and bottom of the tree.

title: Promenade
alt_text: A painting of abstract, jagged shapes arranged against a solid red background. Several light gray, boomerang-like forms are layered throughout the composition, angled in different directions. A dark brown, triangular shape sits prominently in the center, extending downwards. Other smaller tan and black shapes are tucked between the larger forms, creating a busy, geometric pattern. The entire arrangement creates a sense of movement with pointed edges and contrasting colors.

title: Study of the Sphinx
alt_text: A painting of a dark, abstract figure sitting on a grid-like floor. The figure is composed of thick, messy strokes of white, black, and gray paint. It occupies the center of a tan, rectangular surface outlined with sharp lines. This central area sits on a background of bright red, which takes up the bottom half of the canvas. Above the red and tan sections, the top third of the painting is a solid, dark teal color.

title: Roger Sherman (1721-1793) M.A. (Hon.) 1768
alt_text: A painted plaster bust of a man faces directly forward, showing his head and chest. He has short hair brushed back, deep-set eyes, and a serious, downturned expression on his face. The figure wears a collared jacket with a scarf or cravat tied at the neck. The surface of the sculpture is dark, with several lighter, white patches where the paint has chipped away or worn off. It sits on a simple, flat rectangular base.

title: Ferryboat at Night
alt_text: A painting on cardboard shows a dark, quiet body of water at night. A small, dark boat with bright rectangular windows sits in the center of the frame. The sky above is filled with tiny, scattered specks of light that look like stars. Dark shapes of buildings or distant land appear faintly along the horizon line on both sides of the boat. A few small, glowing lights are visible near the distant shorelines.

title: Two Forms
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and soft colors against a hazy, blended background. The composition is filled with floating forms including oblong ovals, lines, and small circles in shades of red, green, blue, and brown. Some shapes appear solid and geometric, while others are layered and semi-transparent. Dark lines and black outlines create sharp details that cut across the more blurred, colorful areas. The overall effect creates a sense of movement across the horizontal surface of the panel.

title: Tapestry
alt_text: A textile of woven wool shows a wooded landscape scene. Two large, leafy trees frame the view on the left and right sides. The background features rolling hills and a winding stream painted in muted tones of brown, gold, and green. Lush plants and small flowers grow in the foreground, filling the bottom section of the scene. A small, rectangular label with numbers is attached to the bottom edge of the fabric.

title: Verdure Tapestry
alt_text: A wool textile shows a woven landscape scene with trees, a body of water, and a building in the distance. To the left, a large, thick tree trunk with dark green leafy branches dominates the foreground. The background features a pale, beige-colored landscape with faint outlines of structures or a castle. A small stream or river flows horizontally across the middle of the scene. In the foreground, there are low bushes and grassy areas in shades of brown and tan. The bottom edge of the fabric is frayed and hangs over a plain surface with a small identification tag.

title: Female Torso
alt_text: A cast stone sculpture shows the upper body of a person. The figure is shown from the head down to the upper thighs. The person has a smooth, rounded shape with their head tilted slightly to the right. Some bunched fabric wraps around the lower part of the waist and hips on one side. The entire sculpture rests on top of a tall, rectangular pedestal.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory of a man, set in a gold oval frame. The man faces slightly to his right, with short, curly, white or powdered hair. He wears a reddish-brown coat over a ruffled white shirt with a matching white cravat at his neck. His expression is calm with his eyes directed forward toward the viewer. The oval frame has a beaded edge and a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Saint Peter Martyr
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver(?) on panel
alt_text: A painting of a young man wearing a black hooded robe over a white tunic. He is centered in the image, facing slightly to the right with a pale, serious expression. In his hands, he holds a red book and a long, green palm leaf. Behind his head, a glowing golden halo is etched into the background. The figure is framed by a decorative, raised gold border featuring carved leaf-like patterns.

title: The Mystical Nativity
alt_text: A painting of a group of people gathered in a landscape with a small shelter. In the foreground, a woman in a blue and red robe kneels with her hands clasped, looking down at a baby lying on the ground. Beside her, a man in a yellow and blue robe also kneels, resting his head on his hand near a cow and a donkey. To the left, two figures in dark robes stand and talk, while another person in a green and red robe sits on the ground with their head in their hands. The background features rocky cliffs, green fields, and distant hills under a light blue sky.

title: Saint Peter
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on panel showing a bearded man wearing ornate, formal robes and a tall, decorative hat. He stands facing slightly to his right, holding a large book in his right hand and a tall staff in his left hand. The figure wears a dark, textured robe with gold patterns over a long, plain white garment. Behind him, a flat gold background glows around his head, suggesting a halo. Several gold keys hang from his right hand near the book. The edges of the wooden panel appear worn and rustic.

title: Creation
alt_text: A painting of a lush, crowded scene featuring many different animals gathered together. In the foreground, a large, brown male lion stands facing right, near a group of deer-like creatures on the left side. Toward the right side of the frame, a large grey elephant and several tall giraffes stand together among some trees. In the background, a white horse rears up on its hind legs near a cliff, and a large white bird flies near the top left corner. The entire scene is set against a landscape of rolling hills and stylized trees painted in soft, muted earth tones. The painting is enclosed within an ornate, light-colored wooden frame with decorative carving at the top.

title: The Garden
alt_text: A painting of a stylized landscape features a soft, mauve-colored background filled with overlapping green hills and forests. Various dark green, wedge-shaped trees stand across the middle of the scene, clustered around a central, circular bush. Several large, flat geometric shapes, including red and yellow triangles and rectangles, are scattered throughout the composition. A bright yellow circle sits near the top, nestled among the green hills. Small, dark blue dots and tiny, delicate, orange-colored plants are placed sparingly across the canvas.

title: Zeus
alt_text: A painting of a seated figure with a split face colored in brown and bright yellow. The person sits against a solid light blue background, holding a long, green rectangular object in their raised right hand. Their body is covered in abstract shapes and bold lines in colors like red, green, and black. A light purple and pink shape rests on their lap, looking somewhat like a crumpled cloth or strange animal. The figure's lower legs and feet are visible at the bottom, one colored in pink and the other in dark brown, resting on a gray surface.

title: The Cryder Children
alt_text: A painting of three children posing together outdoors. A boy wearing a long green coat sits on the ground in the front, holding a small stick. Behind him, a young girl in a white dress stands holding a wooden hoop. Another girl stands in the middle, looking forward while her hand rests on a small, light-colored toy dog. The children are set against a background of soft hills and a pale sky. All three figures have light skin and dark hair.

title: Length of Cotton cloth
alt_text: A cotton textile showing a folded white cloth printed with various markings. Two circular emblems with intricate designs are stamped near the center. Above these emblems, there is a line of dark text in a cursive style. A thick, dark, decorative fringe lines the bottom edge of the fabric. Beneath the object, a black identification plaque displays the number 1951.51.103 in white text.

title: Thomas Russell (1740–1796)
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory shows a head-and-shoulders view of a person with fair skin. The subject wears a reddish-brown coat with a white cravat and has light, powdered hair that is styled loosely around the ears. The background is a soft, painted sky with shades of blue and hazy orange clouds. This oval painting is encased in a polished gold frame with a small loop at the top for wearing as a pendant. The person gazes off toward the left side of the frame with a serious expression.

title: Sea Pattern
alt_text: A painting of a rocky coastline shows rough waves crashing against stones. The ocean is painted in shades of muted green and gray, stretching toward a flat horizon line. Dark, brownish rocks cluster in the foreground and near the middle of the water. Splashes of white paint highlight the spray of the waves hitting these rocks. The entire scene is framed by a light-colored, patterned frame.

title: St. George and the Dragon
medium: Oil on canvas backed with cardboard
alt_text: A painting of a knight on a horse fighting a large, green creature. The knight wears armor and holds a long spear that points down toward the creature's back. The horse is light-colored and positioned in the center, appearing to rear up over the monster. To the left in the background, a small, pale figure with long hair stands and watches the scene. The overall style features thick, visible brushstrokes and dark, dramatic colors.

title: Reginald Marsh, B.A. 1920
alt_text: A painting shows a portrait of a man, from the chest up, set against a dark, muted background. He is turned slightly to the right with his arms crossed over his chest. The man has short, light brown hair and wears a dark suit jacket over a collared shirt and tie. A simple watch band is visible on his left wrist. The portrait is housed in a carved, weathered-looking frame with a subtle, aged appearance.

title: Mr. Cryder
medium: Oil on canvas mounted on board
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up against a dark, shadowy background. The man has short, dark hair, blue eyes, and light skin with rosy cheeks. He wears a dark coat over a crisp, high-collared white shirt with a ruffled cravat. His gaze is directed toward the viewer, and he has a faint, subtle smile on his lips. The lighting highlights his face while his coat blends into the murky, indistinct surroundings.

title: The Grave of William Penn
alt_text: A painting of a rural landscape features a light-colored, single-story building nestled among trees on the left side of the scene. In the foreground, a person walks along a dirt path, leading a group of white sheep, a spotted cow, and a dark brown cow. To the left of the building, a small horse-drawn carriage sits near several small, standing figures. A dense cluster of dark green trees frames the right side of the image, while a soft, pale pink sky appears in the background. The bottom of the painting displays a dark band containing large, capitalized white letters that form a descriptive text.

title: Woman Drying Her Hair
alt_text: A painting of a stylized, abstract human figure seated on a curved, reddish-brown chair. The figure is pale, with elongated, ribbon-like limbs painted in thick, cream-colored brushstrokes. One arm reaches upward, and a hand holds a dark, flowing shape that could be hair or fabric. The figure's lower body is covered by a pale, draped cloth that extends toward the bottom of the canvas. The background is a flat, textured shade of muted purple or dark grey.

title: John Marshall (1755-1835)
alt_text: A painting of a man facing forward, set within a thick, ornate gold frame. The man has short, dark hair and is wearing a high-collared dark coat over a white cravat tied at his throat. His expression is serious, and he looks directly toward the viewer with calm eyes. The background behind him is a plain, dark, and muted brown color that keeps the focus on his face. At the bottom of the frame, a small, rectangular label displays tiny, unreadable text.

title: Le poêle (The Stove)
alt_text: A painting of an indoor scene features a dark, metal stove standing on the left side. Beside the stove sits a silver-colored pail with a handle. Behind these objects, a dark, flat shape resembles an easel with a patterned, leafy design on its front. A small, wooden artist's palette floats in the upper right section of the composition. In the lower right corner, a textured, golden-brown object with pointed edges rests on a blue, patterned floor.

title: Jean Paul Oppenheim (1907–1933), Class of 1929
medium: Watercolor on ivory, in a gilded brass rectangular frame
alt_text: A miniature painting of a young man, created with watercolor on ivory. The portrait is held within a simple, gilded brass frame. The man wears a dark tuxedo jacket with a white shirt and a black bowtie. He is seen from the chest up, with his head turned slightly to his right, wearing a gentle smile. The background is a soft, blurry suggestion of trees and sky. The portrait is housed in a larger, hinged leather case lined with light-colored fabric.

title: Table with Bottles and Cheese
alt_text: A painting of a still life arranged on a table against a textured, dark brown background. The table is reddish-pink with a large, pale green rectangular shape painted across its front. On top of the table sits a row of various objects, including several upright bottles and small rectangular boxes in shades of brown, white, and red. The table stands on four simple, pale, vertical legs. The overall style is painterly and rough, with visible, thick brushstrokes.

title: Christ in Glory
alt_text: A champlevé enamel and gilt copper sculpture showing a figure seated within an oval frame. The central figure has a beard, wears long robes, and holds up one hand with two fingers raised while holding a rectangular object in the other. A halo with green and red sections sits behind the figure's head. The background is a deep blue and features small, colorful, circular floral designs scattered around the figure. This pointed oval plaque includes small holes along its edges for mounting.

title: An Old Lady
alt_text: A painting of an elderly woman from the chest up, set against a dark brown, plain background. She wears a simple, light-colored cap on her head and a wide, pleated white ruff collar around her neck. Her expression is calm, and she looks directly forward with weathered skin showing signs of age. She is dressed in a dark coat, possibly made of fur or heavy fabric. In one hand, which is visible near the bottom of the frame, she holds a small, reddish-brown book.

title: Baptismal Cup with the Agnus Dei
alt_text: A ceramic container shows a circular, shallow plate with a small loop handle on its top rim. The inside of the plate is decorated with a painted lamb standing in profile. The lamb is outlined in black with green shading on its body and a green halo around its head. Behind the lamb, a vertical cross with horizontal bars rises upward. A simple green leaf-like shape sits to the right of the lamb, all contained within a circular border.

title: Geometric Composition
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes scattered across a dark, forest-green background. A large, pointed blue triangle dominates the center, pointing downwards toward the bottom left. Various other shapes, including smaller triangles in brown and green, rectangular forms, and orange semicircles, are distributed throughout the dark space. A soft pink and white circular shape sits near the middle right edge. The word "BURLIUK" is painted in light, simple letters in the bottom right corner.

title: General William Sumner
alt_text: A painting of a man's head and shoulders shown in a dark setting. The man faces slightly toward the left while looking directly at the viewer. He has short, dark, wavy hair and wears a dark coat over a white shirt or scarf at his neck. His face is illuminated, highlighting his ruddy complexion. The portrait is enclosed in a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: The Nativity
alt_text: A painting shows a group of people and floating figures in an outdoor setting. A woman with long blonde hair in a dark dress and a man in a red cloak kneel on the ground with their hands pressed together. Between them, a small baby lies on a white cloth on a stone block. Above the adults, three figures with wings hover in the air while holding onto a thin, light-colored fabric. In the background, there are stone ruins, a basket filled with clothes on the ground, and a small town in the distance.

title: Andrew Oliver (1706–1774)
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory shows a head-and-shoulders view of a person with fair skin and brown eyes. The subject has short, powdered white hair that curls at the sides. They are wearing a dark purple coat over a high-collared white shirt or cravat. The portrait is oval-shaped and set inside a simple gold-colored frame with a small loop at the top for hanging. The background of the portrait is a plain, dark brownish-grey color.

title: Autumn Flower
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows stylized flowers in a vase sitting on a red table. A tall, pale yellow vase holds several abstract flower shapes in colors like purple, red, and yellow with jagged, petal-like edges. Behind the vase, the background is a dark, moody gray-blue with red curtains draped at the top. To the left of the vase, a small, round pink shape sits on the table surface. A thin red, rectangular container stands to the right side of the main vase. The entire scene is framed by a dark, painted border.

title: Man with Mandolin
alt_text: A limestone sculpture shows a tall, abstract figure made of geometric blocks. The figure stands upright with a flat top and angular sides. Its body is composed of stacked, rectangular, and cylindrical stone pieces that suggest a human shape. A curved, shield-like object protrudes from the side of the figure's midsection. The entire object has a textured, sandy-beige surface.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of an abstract city scene composed of sharp geometric shapes. Angular buildings and structures in shades of gray, brown, and white crowd the center of the frame. Various bright accents appear throughout the composition, including a round red dot on the left, a yellow square, and blue arches on the right. Dark, slanting lines crisscross the background, suggesting cranes or scaffolding. A triangular patch of dark green fills the bottom right corner, balancing the deep blue sky visible in the upper left.

title: Proun 99
medium: Water soluble and metallic paint on wood
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes on a light grey background. A large, floating cube with black, white, and textured grey sides sits near the center. Behind the cube is a tall, vertical dark grey rectangle that spans almost the entire height of the image. At the top and bottom of this rectangle are two semicircles, one dark grey and one off-white. A thin red arc curves up from the bottom left, while a grid of red lines spreads out horizontally across the lower third of the canvas. A thin black line also curves gracefully from the center of the grid toward the right side of the frame.

title: Market at Geneva
alt_text: A painting of an outdoor market street scene fills the frame. Tall buildings rise in the background, including a distinct tower with a clock face near the center. In the foreground, people walk past several stalls covered by large white or grey awnings. Tables are cluttered with vibrant red and yellow flowers, creating bright splashes of color against the street. The scene is bathed in cool, muted tones of blue, green, and grey, giving the impression of a cloudy day.

title: George Washington (1732–1799), LL.D. 1781
alt_text: A painting of a man with light skin, short gray hair, and a serious expression. He is wearing a dark blue military-style coat with a pale yellow collar and lapels. There are three silver stars on his shoulder epaulet and gold buttons down the front of his coat. A white ruffled cloth is tucked into his neck underneath his collar. The background is a plain, dark, and blurry shade of brown that creates shadows behind him.

title: Sailing [Study for mural, Men's Day Room, Chronic Diseases Hospital, Welfare Island, New York]
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes rendered in tempera on cardboard. The background is a soft, light blue, divided horizontally by a solid, muted brown band that spans the bottom of the image. Two large, white, rectangular panels sit side-by-side above the brown section, each containing smaller, colored, angular shapes in shades of grey, tan, and orange. Thin black lines define the edges of these shapes, separating them from one another and the background. The overall composition is flat and composed entirely of angular, hard-edged forms.

title: Autumn [Study for mural, Men's Day Room, Chronic Diseases Hospital, Welfare Island, New York]
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes fills the upper portion of the frame, set against a solid, light-brown background that covers the bottom third. The top section is divided into various rectangular and triangular blocks of color, including pale yellow, white, orange, pink, and light blue. Several thick, black lines cut across these shapes, creating angular borders and outlines. A single vertical strip of bright blue stands out on the left side, contrasting with the paler colors around it. The overall design looks like a puzzle of flat, colored pieces fitted together against a plain backdrop.

title: The Peaceable Kingdom of the Branch
alt_text: A painting of a child standing in a field surrounded by several animals. The young child wears a light-colored outfit and stands in the center, resting a hand on the head of a large lion. Beside them, two white sheep lie on the grass, while another large cat rests near the bottom right. In the background, a small stream flows under a tall stone bridge surrounded by dark trees. Large text in English is written around the border of the painting against a brown background.

title: Scarf
alt_text: A piece of lace showing a complex and delicate floral pattern. The off-white fabric is rectangular in shape and laid flat against a light green background. Intricate needlepoint designs form a dense border of leaves and flowers around the outer edges. The center section features an open, web-like mesh pattern that looks slightly more sparse than the solid borders. A small black rectangular tag with white text sits at the bottom edge of the display.

title: Barbe
alt_text: A textile of rose point lace shows a long, narrow strip of intricate needlework. The piece is cream-colored and features a delicate, repeating floral pattern throughout its length. Near the top, a small portion of the lace is rolled over onto itself, creating a thicker fold. The edges of the strip are scalloped and jagged, following the curves of the woven design. Below the lace, a black rectangular label rests on a light surface with the white text "1957.2.2.B" printed on it.

title: Embroidered handkerchief
medium: On a very fine linen ground
alt_text: A linen textile shows a square cloth with an elaborate, light-colored embroidered border. The center of the square is made of a plain, sheer material. Intricate patterns are stitched along the edges and corners, featuring repeated shapes and symmetrical designs. At the bottom of the image, a dark metal bar is placed horizontally on the surface. This bar has white numbers and letters printed on its face, reading "1957.2.2.F."

title: Composition
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes scattered across an olive-green background. A large, dark brown square sits in the center, featuring a small arched cutout in its middle. Surrounding the square are several other shapes, including a yellow triangle, a reddish triangular wedge, and thin, pipe-like bars. Several small, colorful dots are grouped on the far left side, while a few straight lines and small rectangles extend from the central shapes. The overall composition feels like a scattered collection of simple forms with muted, earthy colors.

title: Dutch Girl
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a chicken and a basket in a grassy field. She wears a yellow headscarf, a pinkish blouse, and a green apron with red shoes. To her left, several small white birds swim in a narrow stream. A large windmill stands in the background on the right side of the scene. The paint is applied in thick, visible brushstrokes throughout the entire work. The sky above is filled with swirls of blue, white, and yellow light.

title: Woman With Green Cow
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting outdoors with a green cow nearby. The woman wears a bright orange head covering and a white top, and she sits on the ground looking forward. To her left, a solid green cow stands in a field of patchy, textured earth. Behind them, tall, dark green plants grow on the left, while a swirling, fiery sky with streaks of red, yellow, and black fills the background. The entire image uses thick, heavy brushstrokes that create a rough and bumpy surface texture.

title: By Candlelight
medium: Oil on canvas mounted on wood
alt_text: A painting showing a woman reading a book against a dark background. She has a fair complexion and is wearing a dark, close-fitting bonnet with a delicate, ruffled lace trim. A white, lacy collar sits around her neck over her dark clothing. She is holding an open book, which catches a soft light from above, while the rest of the scene remains in deep shadow. Her eyes are downcast as she focuses on the pages held in her hands.

title: Night
alt_text: A painting shows abstract shapes and lines against a dark, textured brown background. On the left, a light-colored, angular form surrounds a pale yellow circle. To the right, red lines create a tall, ladder-like structure next to a blue, semi-circular shape filled with horizontal lines. Below these forms, thin black lines snake across the center, connecting various geometric shapes and small circles. A bright yellow circle sits near the bottom, resting on a long horizontal line. The entire composition has a grainy, worn appearance with muted earth tones.

title: Elizabeth Shrimpton
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up within an oval frame. She has light skin, dark wavy hair pulled back, and wears a pearl necklace and a light-colored, off-the-shoulder dress. A dark shawl or wrap is draped over her left shoulder, which she holds with her right hand. The background depicts a landscape with a dark sky and faint trees on the horizon. The painting is encased in an ornate, rectangular gold frame with decorative corner pieces.

title: The Keys
alt_text: A painting of a person looking out of a window in a landscape. In the center, a person with green hair stands behind a rectangular window frame, holding a key. Next to them is a large, vibrant bush covered in bright red flowers. In the background, a small dark sailing ship floats on the water under a cloudy, light-colored sky. A small black bird and three dark ants are scattered across the green grass in the foreground. Writing and a signature appear in the lower corner of the painting.

title: Cutting from an antiphonary (?): God the Father in an Initial "D" (or "O")
medium: Tempera and gold leaf on parchment
alt_text: A manuscript illustration depicts an older, bearded man with long gray hair and a yellow halo centered inside an oval rainbow. The man wears a dark tunic under a bright red cloak that wraps around his body and legs. He holds a small, light-colored sphere in his left hand and raises his right hand with two fingers extended. Behind him, the background is a deep blue, decorated with small faces that have wings. The entire scene is framed by a border filled with stylized, curving leaf-like shapes in shades of red, blue, and gold.

title: Still Life with Plants
alt_text: A painting of several potted plants sitting on a stone ledge. There are six pots of varying shapes and sizes, all holding green plants with different leaf styles. The pot on the far left contains a small, thin, spindly tree. To its right stands a taller, leafy plant with thick foliage. The remaining pots on the right side hold thinner, pointed plants that spread outward. A blurred background with arched windows or openings sits behind the plants.

title: Autumn Chilliness
alt_text: A painting of a quiet town scene during what looks like autumn or winter. A large, tan-colored building with a dark roof stands in the center background behind a low yellow wall. Bare, dark trees reach up toward a gray, cloudy sky that hangs over the entire scene. In the foreground, a path winds past green grass and a small, dark fence. Two small, dark figures are walking along the path, one slightly ahead of the other. To the left, part of a white house with a red roof and a green window frame can be seen.

title: Elisha Hutchinson (1745–1824)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a man shown from the chest up against a dark, oval background. He has pale skin, light-colored eyes, and wears a grey, powdered wig styled with short curls. His outfit includes a bright green coat with a high collar and a white cravat at his neck. The person is looking slightly to the right of the viewer with a neutral expression. The painting is framed in a decorative, rectangular gold frame with beaded edges.

title: Virgin and Child with Angels
alt_text: A painting showing a woman seated on a throne and holding a young child. The woman wears a dark red head covering and a draped cloak that partially covers a blue dress. Both the woman and the child have golden halos behind their heads, and the woman's face is painted with solemn features. Two winged figures, one on the left and one on the right, float above the throne in clouds with their hands folded together. The bottom of the painting appears worn, with areas where the original paint has flaked off to reveal the wood underneath.

title: Tree Trunks
alt_text: A painting of two tree trunks standing in a hazy, light-filled landscape. The trees are positioned in the center, and their textured, light brown bark stands out against the muted background. A small, grassy patch with scattered plants grows at the base of the trees. The rest of the scene fades into a blurry, pale greenish-yellow mist. The entire work is enclosed in a simple, rectangular wooden frame.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A stucco sculpture shows a woman holding a small child against a black background. The woman has pale skin, a calm face, and wears a blue head covering over her hair. She is dressed in a red robe with a blue cloak draped over her shoulder. The small child sits in her arms, looking off to the side with pale skin and wearing a simple red tunic. Their bodies lean close together, with the child’s arm resting around the woman's neck. The surface of the sculpture looks weathered, with small cracks in the paint on their faces and clothing.

title: California
alt_text: A painting of a person working in a field with goats. In the center, a person wearing a straw hat and brown pants holds a tool, possibly a rake, and works the green ground. Several goats in colors like white, dark blue, and light pink graze in the grass around them. A small white house with a brown roof sits in the background near a palm tree and other green plants. The sky above is filled with swirls of white and light blue paint.

title: Abstraction
medium: Oil on commercial pieced wood, covered both sides with cardboard
alt_text: A painting of abstract, colorful shapes fitted together like a jigsaw puzzle. Several large, organic forms in shades of peach, pale yellow, and cream fill the center and upper portion of the frame. The background consists of deep blue, green, and red areas that weave between these lighter shapes. Below the center, smaller clusters of bright orange, deep red, and dark green shapes sit tightly against each other. The composition is bordered on the left and right edges by a narrow, multi-colored band of solid blocks.

title: Abstraction (also) Lady in Abstract
alt_text: A painting of overlapping shapes and vibrant geometric patterns covers the entire canvas. Many colors like blue, yellow, orange, and red appear in distinct blocks, stripes, and curved forms. On the right side, a cluster of small black and white cubes creates a checkerboard effect. Several layered semicircles and diagonal lines add a sense of movement throughout the middle of the image. The bottom foreground features dark, angular brown shapes that anchor the busy composition.

title: Portrait of Berlin
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract composition filled with bright shapes, geometric forms, and figures. A large, prominent triangle in the bottom left contains a red number eight against a green background. Toward the center, a pointed arch shape surrounds a small figure sitting on clouds. A star-shaped form sits in the upper right, containing a smaller triangle with another number eight inside. To the right of the center, a circle frames a figure riding a reddish-brown horse surrounded by yellow flames. Throughout the image, thick blue and orange outlines separate these various shapes, while the background is filled with loose, textured brushstrokes of white, blue, and yellow.

title: Judge Anthony Stoddard (1678-1748)
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a man, framed in an oval shape against a dark background. He faces forward, looking directly at the viewer with a calm expression. He has shoulder-length, curly brown hair and wears a dark brown robe over a dark jacket. Around his neck, he has a long, white, rectangular neckcloth that hangs down his chest. The lighting in the painting highlights his pale face while leaving the rest of the figure in shadow.

title: Indian Composition
alt_text: A painting of a surreal, warm-colored scene features a mix of abstract shapes and distinct figures. On the right, a dark, rounded profile of a person looks toward the left side of the canvas. In the center, a tall, snake-like form curves around a dark chalice that sits upon a spiral base. Above these figures, two geometric, maze-like shapes float, one square and one rectangular, with a small silhouette of an animal inside the rectangular one. Various organic forms, including a fish and a red, blob-like shape, are scattered across the textured background of reds, yellows, and greens.

title: Four Initial Letters, O, S, U or V, E
medium: Body color and gilt on parchment
alt_text: A manuscript illumination showing four square panels, each containing a large, elaborately decorated capital letter against a background of gold. The top-left panel features a circular letter filled with swirling blue and pink floral patterns. The top-right panel displays a large, sprawling letter S in light pink, surrounded by blue and green leafy vines. The bottom-left panel shows a sturdy, green-colored letter U with pink and blue floral designs inside. The bottom-right panel contains a bold, blue letter E decorated with pale pink flowers and fine green stems. Each panel is bordered by intricate, pale line drawings on the surrounding parchment.

title: La vie est touchée
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes and hazy, gray forms. To the right, a tall, tower-like structure is built from stacked, white-bordered squares and thin lines. Floating nearby are other angular shapes that look like broken buildings or skeletal frames. Patches of bright color, such as orange, red, and blue, peek through the mostly gray and smoky background. Soft, white dots are scattered throughout the composition, resembling snow or distant lights.

title: Bifolium from a Gradual: Nativity in an Initial "P"
medium: Tempera and gold leaf on parchment
alt_text: A manuscript illumination on parchment shows musical notation lines with black square notes and Latin text. A large, ornate, red and blue letter "P" acts as a frame for a small scene depicting a woman and a man standing over a baby in a small wooden shelter. Beside the baby, a donkey and an ox stand inside the shelter with the people. The letter itself is decorated with golden swirls and features two small blue faces at the bottom. The background of the page is a textured off-white color with red musical staffs arranged around the central scene.

title: Natalie Glasko
alt_text: A painting shows a portrait of a person with a somber expression against a dark background. The figure faces forward, with their arms crossed low in the frame. Their dark clothing blends almost completely into the shadowed surroundings. Light highlights the person's face, neck, and hands, while the rest of the figure is barely visible. The entire image is enclosed in a thin, gold-colored rectangular frame.

title: Portrait of Paul Gauguin
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man has wavy, dark hair and looks directly forward with a serious expression. He wears a dark jacket over a white collared shirt that is partially visible. The background is painted in simple, blended shades of dark brown and gray. The lighting highlights his face while his clothing fades into the dim background.

title: Fourth Flurry '48
alt_text: A metal sculpture of a hanging mobile floats against a dark gray background. It consists of thin, black wires that extend outward in many directions like spindly branches. Attached to the ends of these wires are several small, flat, light-colored circular discs of varying sizes. The mobile hangs from a single point at the top and spreads downward and outward. Faint, blurred shadows of the discs are visible on the wall behind the sculpture, suggesting distance and movement.

title: Head of Mexican
alt_text: A stone sculpture showing the head and shoulders of a person. The figure wears a close-fitting cap that covers the top of their head. The person has a serious expression and looks slightly downward. A white rectangular paper tag with a green dot and handwritten numbers hangs from a string around the figure's neck. The sculpture rests on a flat, dark surface.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting showing a dark, abstract shape set against a muted background. The background is divided horizontally into a lighter gray upper section and a darker, brownish-green lower section. In the center, a jagged, geometric form appears to float or rest on the horizon line. This central shape is composed of several overlapping, angular pieces in bright colors like red, orange, and purple. The edges of these pieces show textured, colorful stripes, while other parts are solid red. A small, faint red mark is visible in the lower left corner.

title: Cutting from an antiphonary: Prophet in an initial "I"
medium: Tempera and gold leaf on parchment
alt_text: A manuscript illustration of a man praying, painted in bright colors and gold on parchment. On the left, a man with long, wavy gray hair and a beard looks upward with his hands pressed together in prayer. He wears a blue tunic over a light-colored garment. To his right stands a tall, vertical decorative column wrapped in twisted green vines that are patterned with small yellow flowers. The background behind the man is a solid, deep blue, while the area behind the column is textured with gold leaf. Intricate blue and white scrollwork ornaments decorate the top and bottom edges of the entire scene.

title: Benjamin Franklin (1706–1790), M.A. (Hon.) 1763
alt_text: A miniature oil on wood painting of a person wearing a fur hat and glasses. The person is shown from the chest up against a dark, plain background. They have a round face and are wearing a plain, brownish coat with dark buttons. Small, thin-rimmed glasses rest on their nose. The portrait is housed in a decorative, gold-colored oval frame that is set inside a larger, rectangular wooden frame.

title: L'Air
alt_text: A lead sculpture of a reclining woman rests on a rectangular base. She lies on her side with her weight propped up on her right elbow. Her left arm extends straight out to the side, and her hand is held open in front of her. Both of her legs are stretched out straight, with her right leg slightly raised above her left leg. The dark, metallic figure stands against a backdrop of stone pillars and reddish curtains hanging in a window.

title: The Plague
alt_text: A painting of hazy, abstract shapes set against a light background. To the left, a large, rounded form with dark, speckled markings sits near the bottom. In the center, there is a lighter, translucent shape that looks somewhat like a figure leaning forward. A horizontal blue strip crosses the middle of the painting behind these shapes, suggesting a horizon line. The bottom area is filled with dark, reddish-brown shadows that ground the image.

title: Untitled (Triangular Forms)
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes on a white background. It features thin black lines that outline several large triangles and smaller polygon forms. Some of these shapes are filled with solid, bright colors like blue, yellow, and red, while others are light gray or tan. A single, curved brown shape sits inside one of the central triangles. The corners of the painting also have colored accents, including a black corner on the bottom left and a yellow one on the bottom right.

title: Inkwell with Three Satyrs
alt_text: A bronze tool features a detailed scene with three carved figures. A central, bearded face with a wide, mischievous grin sits near the top of the object. Below this face, two identical figures are seated on the base, one on each side. These figures sit with their knees tucked in, and they have their arms raised as if touching their own heads. The entire piece is dark brown and appears to be cast in metal, showing smooth curves and intricate textures.

title: Young Lady in a Blue Dress
alt_text: A watercolor miniature of a young woman is set inside an oval metal locket. She has light skin and light brown hair that is pulled up, with small pink and blue flowers tucked into it. She wears a vibrant blue dress with a deep, low neckline and a white frill at the center of her chest. The background behind the woman is a simple, soft shade of grey. The entire painting is held within a polished, oval gold-colored frame with a small loop at the very top.

title: The Marriage at Cana
alt_text: A painting of a crowded indoor banquet scene featuring many people gathered around a long table. In the foreground, a figure wearing a bright red robe stands and gestures toward several large, ornate decorative jars resting on the floor. A small dog with a thin body sits quietly near these vessels. To the left, several servers in colorful period clothing carry food and drinks toward the guests. The back wall is covered in gold fabric, featuring a draped canopy in the center and three smaller framed paintings hanging high above the table.

title: Albert Einstein
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a human head sits against a plain gray background. The figure has thick, wavy hair that seems to stand up on its own. The face is marked by deep lines around the eyes and on the forehead. The sculpture rests on a black, square stand that tapers slightly toward the top. The entire piece is rendered in a warm, brown metal color with a textured surface.

title: Major George Watson
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory showing a portrait of a person. The painting is framed in a shiny, gold-colored oval shape. This oval is set against a black rectangular background. At the very top, a small, decorative gold ring with a grape-leaf design holds the frame. The person in the portrait has short, gray hair and wears a dark brown coat with a white collar.

title: Nativity in an Initial "T": Cutting from a gradual
medium: Tempera and gold leaf on parchment
alt_text: A manuscript page features an ornate painting showing a scene set within a pink architectural archway. On the left side of the scene, a bearded man kneels with his hands together, and on the right, a woman kneels before a small infant lying on the ground. A donkey and an ox stand directly behind the woman, and a wooden structure is visible in the background. The scene is framed by a wide, decorative border of swirling blue and green leaves with gold accents. Large black letters and musical staff lines with square notes are printed on the light-colored parchment surrounding the illustration.

title: High Wires
alt_text: A painting of a flat, hazy landscape with a long road stretching into the distance. On the left side of the road, two small figures stand together while a bicycle is seen further down the path. A large, dark utility pole stands prominently on the right side, with long, curving power lines sweeping across the sky. Behind the pole, a row of tall, dark green trees creates a vertical wall near some small buildings. The entire scene is painted in muted tones of beige, pale green, and brown, creating a foggy or overcast feeling.

title: Flying Fruit
alt_text: A painting of a large, upright, purple and black form that curves upward against a gray background. At the top of this central shape are several small, yellow, rounded protrusions. To the sides of the central figure, there are two distinct, leaf-like shapes in bright green and brown colors. Near the bottom, a small, circular, reddish-brown element is connected by thin, white lines to the main structure. The entire scene is set on a solid, muted gray canvas.

title: Pictographic Composition with Metal Panels
medium: Oil on canvas with lateral metallic panels
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows an assortment of abstract shapes and colorful forms against a textured, light beige background. Bright green, blue, red, and purple shapes resembling elongated hooks, bars, and circles are scattered across the center. Some elements are connected by thin, painted lines, while others stand alone near small dots and wavy marks. The main rectangular canvas is framed by two vertical, shiny metallic panels on the left and right sides. A signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the beige field.

title: Seaport Village
alt_text: A painting of a small town scene with several buildings and figures. In the center, a tall, reddish-brown building stands next to a teal, two-story house with a peaked roof. To the left, a smaller, dark brown shed sits near a reddish, blocky vehicle on wheels. Two indistinct figures stand in the foreground near the center, facing the viewer. The background features a sky filled with swirled, textured brushstrokes in shades of blue, orange, and gray.

title: Chancellerie Tapestry
alt_text: A wool and silk textile showing a central crest framed by angels. The crest is divided into two parts, with one side displaying three golden flower shapes and the other side featuring a complex, chain-like pattern. A large, circular wreath made of green leaves surrounds the central shield and is topped with a decorative crown. Two angelic figures with wings float on either side of the emblem, holding up a heavy red cloth that drapes across the top of the scene. The background below features a deep blue fabric decorated with repeated golden flower designs.

title: Seated Woman
alt_text: A painting of a seated woman wearing a peach-colored sweater and a blue skirt. She has short, reddish-brown hair and looks directly toward the viewer with a neutral expression. In her lap, she holds a bright yellow, circular object that looks like a small bowl or piece of fruit. Her legs are crossed, and she is wearing simple shoes that are visible on the floor. The background includes abstract shapes in shades of blue, green, and a tan, ladder-like structure on the right side. The floor is covered by an ornate, patterned rug in shades of red, white, and black.

title: Peter Oliver (1741–1821)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting shows a portrait of a man wearing a bright red coat. He is seen from the chest up, with his face turned toward the right. His light-colored hair is tied back, and he wears a white neckcloth that wraps around his throat. The portrait is set inside a small, oval-shaped frame made of gold with a scalloped edge. A small loop at the top of the frame suggests it was designed to be worn as jewelry.

title: Gentleman in a Red Coat
alt_text: A miniature portrait of a man shown in a watercolor on ivory. The person is captured in a head-and-shoulders view, looking directly toward the viewer with light-colored hair and a red coat. This portrait sits inside an oval, gold-colored frame, which is set against a rectangular, matte black background. At the very top, a gold-colored metal piece shaped like a leaf connects to a small ring for hanging. The overall composition creates a pendant-like appearance.

title: Gentleman in a Blue Coat
alt_text: A miniature painting shows a portrait of a light-skinned man. He has powdered white hair styled with curls at the sides and tied back. The man wears a pale gray coat with a lace-trimmed cravat tucked into his collar. He is positioned against a simple, dark, and blurry background. The entire painting is enclosed within a smooth, circular metal frame with a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: La boîte de Pandore (Pandora's box)
alt_text: A painting shows a man seen from behind, standing in the foreground while wearing a dark suit and a black bowler hat. To his right, a large white rose with dark green leaves stands on the cobblestone street. Behind him, a stone bridge with a railing stretches across the scene, next to a street lamp. In the background, there are multi-story buildings under a deep red and orange sky. The entire scene is set during what appears to be twilight or dusk.

title: Landscape with Shepherdess
alt_text: A painting of a rural landscape with a woman tending to her livestock in front of stone ruins. The woman sits on the right side of the painting, wearing a white head covering and a yellow top while holding a spinning tool. Beside her is a large group of resting animals, including several cows, goats, and sheep. A dead, gnarled tree trunk rises prominently behind the group of animals. In the distance on the left, a horse-drawn cart travels across a grassy hill under a sunset sky.

title: The Old Bridge
alt_text: A painting of massive stone arches and staircases filled with many small figures of people. Large, curved stone structures span the scene, creating deep shadows underneath them. A statue sits on top of the central railing against a cloudy sky. Tiny people walk in groups along the stairs and paths that wind through the dark passageways. The foreground is dim, while bright light shines through the open archways in the background.

title: Pilaster Fragment with Saint Catherine of Alexandria
alt_text: A painting on a tall, narrow wooden panel shows a standing figure framed by gold-colored decorations. The central figure is a young person with light skin and dark, wavy hair, wearing a golden crown and a blue dress covered by a red robe. They hold a small, dark rectangular book in their hands, which are crossed over their chest. Above their head is a golden halo with a repeating circular pattern, and the entire panel has worn edges showing raw wood. Below the figure, there is an ornate, circular golden carving set into the panel's base. Similar golden, carved floral designs appear at the top of the painting above the figure's head.

title: Miniature, framed silhouette of Thomas Hutchinson, 1740 - ?
alt_text: A miniature of a silhouette profile portrait is set inside a rectangular frame. The silhouette is a solid dark shape against a cream-colored oval background. The person faces left with a distinctively pointed nose and hair tied back in a small ponytail. This oval piece is surrounded by a black border with four small, gold flower designs in the corners. The entire portrait is encased in a simple gold-colored frame with a small metal ring at the top for hanging.

title: Untitled (Still Life on Yellow Table Cloth)
alt_text: A painting of a blue plate, a silver knife, and a piece of purple food sitting on a bright yellow surface. The background is a yellow grid pattern that creates the effect of a corner or table. The knife is long and slender, placed diagonally in the upper left section. The blue plate sits in the center of the painting and has a raised circular rim. On the right side, a block of purple material rests on the yellow grid. The entire scene is held within a simple black frame.

title: Study for the Spirit of the Dance
alt_text: A terracotta sculpture shows a group of five figures in high relief on a rectangular background. A central figure stands tall with both arms raised, holding a small round object in one hand. Two figures dance in front, each holding one of the central figure's hands. Two more figures appear in the background, slightly obscured by the others. The entire piece has a reddish-brown tone and textured, uneven surfaces throughout.

title: Abstraction I
alt_text: A painting of an indoor room shows simple, curved furniture shapes against a pale, neutral background. Two dark, rounded chair backs dominate the foreground, their shapes creating a strong visual rhythm. To the left, a small round table holds a rectangular object that looks like a book or notepad. Behind the table, a potted plant with orange flower petals sits on a stand. A long, thin, vertical blue shape stretches up the right side of the frame, resembling a curtain or window frame. The overall style uses flat colors and smooth, simplified forms.

title: Newspaper and Fruit Dish
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes and patterns features a prominent white paper strip printed with the words "LE JOURNAL." This strip rests diagonally across an arrangement of overlapping, angular planes painted in muted tones of yellow, brown, and blue. To the left of the paper, a circular form with a yellow, flower-like pattern sits atop a grey shape. The background is composed of dark, solid blocks of color that contrast with the brightly dotted textures covering much of the central area. The entire scene is made up of flat, sharp-edged forms that create a fragmented appearance.

title: Fish
medium: Oil under glass. Frame by Legrain (wood)
alt_text: A painting of a stylized stringed instrument against a muted pink background. The instrument is composed of abstract, overlapping shapes in white, blue, and black, with thin lines representing strings running down the neck. A small, red-and-white fish shape is nestled near the center of the instrument. Behind the instrument, a dark brown vertical rectangle contains a small, pale blue circle resembling a moon. The entire work is enclosed in a dark, textured wooden frame.

title: Mountain Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a mountainous landscape features a rocky path winding through the center. A person in a light-colored dress and a red head covering walks along the path, leading a pack mule and a small group of goats. On the left, a tall, steep cliff rises, while a wide, craggy mountain dominates the background under a blue and cloudy sky. Green bushes and grass grow along the edges of the path and the rocky slopes. In the distance, a small waterfall flows down between the rock formations.

title: Gatti's Hungerford Palace of Varieties. Second Turn of Katie Lawrence
alt_text: A painting of a stage performance viewed from the audience. A woman wearing a pale yellow dress stands in the center of a brightly lit stage. She is framed by ornate architectural decorations painted in red and dark tones. In the foreground, the dark silhouettes of audience members sit in rows, partially blocking the view. Some of the people in the audience wear hats and formal dark clothing. The background of the stage is dark and shadowy, contrasting with the bright figure of the performer.

title: Dr. James Lloyd (1728–1810)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting shows an elderly man with white hair looking directly forward. He wears a dark blue coat over a white shirt and collar. The portrait is set inside a small, oval-shaped frame. This oval sits centered against a square, reflective gold-colored background. A thick, black wooden frame surrounds the entire piece.

title: View on the West Mountain near Hartford
medium: Oil on canvas mounted on wood
alt_text: A painting of a landscape scene features a grassy hill with a few trees and several grazing animals. In the foreground, a person wearing a red vest sits on a large rock, looking out over the valley. A white cow walks past the seated person, while a few sheep and other cows graze on the hillside nearby. A large, bare tree stands prominently near the center of the hill, with a large, dark mountain rising in the background under a cloudy sky. To the left, a cluster of lush green trees frames the view of the open land below.

title: Landscape with Bathers
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing people gathered near a river at sunset. On the right, several figures sit or stand on a large rock ledge underneath a leaning tree. One figure is seen from behind, draping a white cloth over their shoulders. Across the river on the left, other small figures stand in or near the water by a rocky cliffside. The background features a large, dark hill and a sky filled with dramatic, puffy clouds lit by a soft, golden glow.

title: Mourning Brooch for William Coleman (ca. 1753–1787)
medium: Watercolor and chopped hair with applied ivory on ivory
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a person standing beside a pillar under a weeping willow tree. The oval item features a black border with gold lettering that runs around the entire edge. Inside the border, a woman in a long white dress leans her head against a white, cylindrical monument. The monument has the letters "WC" painted on the front and a decorative urn sitting on its top. Fine, dark lines, likely created with hair, are used to depict the drooping branches of the tree above the scene. A small metal loop at the top allows the piece to be hung or worn as a pendant.

title: Zennor
alt_text: A painting of a group of simple, block-like houses sitting under a flat gray sky. The houses are painted in shades of white and light gray with dark rectangular openings representing doors or windows. Dark green and brownish shapes fill the space between the buildings, suggesting trees or bushes. In the foreground, several rounded, pale-colored forms appear to rest on the ground. The entire scene is enclosed within a wide, decorative gold-colored frame.

title: The Circumcision of Christ
alt_text: A painting of a dark, vast cathedral interior featuring a large altar on a raised platform. Numerous small figures stand near the altar, where a central group gathers around a table. Tall, intricately carved stone columns and arches fill the background, creating deep shadows. Sunlight streams in from a high window on the left, illuminating a gold-colored structure nearby. To the right of the altar, a few more figures walk across the floor, including one leading a white animal.

title: Mourning Ring for William Coleman (c. 1753-1787)
alt_text: A piece of jewelry shows a miniature painting of a person leaning against a large pedestal urn. The scene is rendered in shades of sepia and white on an oval, ivory-colored background. Above the figure, thin, vertical lines suggest the branches of a weeping willow tree. The miniature is surrounded by a dark blue border set into a metallic ring. The border is inscribed with gold lettering that runs along the outer edge.

title: Bulto Crucifix
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture shows a figure with arms outstretched on a wooden cross. The figure has long dark hair, a beard, and a crown on its head. It wears a yellow cloth around its waist that is tied with a thin fabric belt. Red painted lines run down the figure's chest, arms, and legs to suggest marks. Above the figure's head, a small rectangular sign is attached to the cross with the letters "I.N.R.I." written on it.

title: Oinochoe
alt_text: A glass container, shaped like a pitcher, stands on a neutral background. The surface of the glass has a swirling, marbled pattern of deep blue and dark grey or black colors. This rounded vessel has a wide, flared opening at the top with a distinct pouring spout on one side. A curved handle extends from the top of the body up to the rim on the right side. The base is small and circular, supporting the larger, bulbous body above it.

title: Vanitas Still Life
alt_text: A painting of a still life on a dark, cluttered table, created with oil on panel. The center of the scene features a human skull resting on a stack of large, leather-bound books. Behind the skull, a shiny metal shield hangs draped in dark fabric, with two trumpets pointing upwards on either side. Above this central display, a glowing circular light with a faint, ghostly face hangs in the dark background. To the sides of the skull are piles of smaller books, a rolled-up paper, and a small red pipe, all sitting on a green table covering. A piece of white paper with printed text is pinned to the front edge of the table.

title: Venus
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows a tall, slender figure standing above a smaller, four-legged animal. The upright figure is smooth and elongated, with rounded shapes suggesting a torso, breasts, and hips. It has a simple, blocky head at the very top. Below this figure, a smaller, angular creature sits at the base. The base itself is rough and uneven where it meets the ground. The entire piece is light-colored against a solid gray background.

title: Man and Woman in the Cathedral
alt_text: A steel sculpture shows a tall, thin, and dark metal structure standing upright against a plain background. The object is composed of multiple flat pieces of metal welded together to form an open, elongated shape. At the bottom, a round metal base supports two vertical, spindly legs that curve inward and outward. The upper section features jagged, angular edges and several thin, horizontal arms that reach into the surrounding space. This structure is very slender and looks somewhat like a tall, abstract stick figure.

A painting of abstract, geometric shapes rendered in oil on canvas. The composition is dominated by a series of thick, dark rectangular forms that overlap against a moody, gray-toned background. These shapes create a layered effect, with some bars appearing closer to the viewer than others. Many of the shapes show visible brushstrokes, giving them a textured appearance. The overall color palette is restricted to shades of black, gray, and dark brown.

title: Portrait of Mr. William Chase, Sr.
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up against a dark, shadowy background. He wears a white powdered wig that is curled at the sides and sits above his ears. His face has a light, pinkish complexion, and he looks directly toward the viewer with a calm expression. He is dressed in a dark brown coat featuring a row of large, round gold buttons running down the side. Beneath his coat, a white cravat is tied neatly at his neck. In the bottom left corner, small, faint text is written on the dark background.

title: Portrait of Mrs. William Chase, Sr.
alt_text: A painting of a woman with pale skin and brown hair pulled back from her face. She wears a white bonnet with lace trim that is tied under her chin with a small, blue silk ribbon. Her dress is dark blue with a white, lace-trimmed collar that covers her shoulders and chest. A matching blue bow sits at the center of her chest, along with a thin string of white beads. She is framed against a dark, oval-shaped background that fades to light brown behind her head.

title: Bearded Saint in an Initial "C". Cutting from a Gradual(?)
medium: Tempera and gold leaf on parchment
alt_text: A manuscript illumination on parchment shows a man in profile looking upward. He has curly gray hair and a beard, and a golden halo glows behind his head. The man wears a maroon garment with a green draped cloth over his shoulder, and his arms are crossed at his chest. This figure is framed by a decorative, pink-colored letter shape against a bright blue background. Ornate, swirling leaves in shades of green and orange surround the letter, all set against a metallic gold background.

title: Portrait of a Man
alt_text: A painting of a man shows his head and shoulders against a dark background. He has long, dark brown hair that falls in loose curls past his shoulders. The man wears a black garment with a wide, white collar that lays flat against his chest. His face has a serious expression with pale skin, dark eyes, and thin lips. Behind him, a deep red drape hangs on the left side, while the right side is dark and shadowed.

title: Saturn Devouring a Child; Hercules Slaying the Hydra; Hercules Lifting Antaeus; Hercules Erecting the Columns of Calpe and Abyla
alt_text: A painting of four vertical panels shows muscular, nude human figures in shades of brown and white. The first panel features a man from behind, carrying a small child on his shoulder while facing a pale, curved background. In the second panel, a man turns away while wrestling with large, snake-like creatures that coil around his legs. The third panel shows a bearded man lifting a smaller person in his arms, his hands placed gently on the other person's head. The final panel depicts a figure standing while grasping a thick, smooth, cylindrical pillar. All the figures are painted with deep shadows to create a three-dimensional effect against their respective backgrounds.

title: Composition
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured shapes in shades of brown, black, white, blue, and yellow. A prominent, square-shaped structure sits in the center, framing dark, blurry lines and indistinct forms. To the left of this central box, a cluster of white and gray, mask-like shapes appears attached to a dark background. On the right side, the background is divided into simple blocks of solid color, including blue, yellow, and tan. Bold, messy paint strokes and heavy outlines define the edges of these figures throughout the work.

title: Lighter, or writing set (?)
alt_text: A tool made of leather, metal, bone, and wood shows a long, tapered, yellowish sheath standing upright on a black base. Attached to the side of the sheath is a smaller, cylindrical, cup-like container with a textured surface. Two small, smooth, bone-like pegs stick out from the top edge of the sheath. A curved metal piece connects the base to the bottom of the long sheath to keep it upright. The overall appearance is worn and aged, featuring shades of brown and tan throughout the structure.

title: Woman before a Mirror
alt_text: A painting showing a person sitting before a large, rectangular mirror. The person is angled toward the right, with their dark hair pulled back and their hands folded in their lap. They wear a bright blue top with orange clothing below it. A reflection of the person's face appears in the mirror behind them, set against a deep blue, geometric background. A small vase containing colorful flowers sits on the narrow ledge between the person and the mirror.

title: Sunny Moments
alt_text: A painting in a large, ornate, gold-colored frame showing a dark room with two people. On the right, a woman in a long, dark dress sits in a chair. A small child wearing a bright red outfit sits on the floor near her, looking toward the center of the room. Behind them, a dark, carved wooden structure stands in the shadows next to a red fabric curtain. Faint light shines into the room from the right, illuminating part of the woman and the floor. A tall, thin wooden stand sits on the left side of the scene.

title: Lady Jean
alt_text: A painting of a young girl standing in a room with bright colors. She wears a white dress with thin blue stripes, ruffled trim, and a small dark hat. Her hands hold a small red purse, and she stands on a round, patterned rug. To her right sits a tall, bright red cabinet with a vase of blue flowers on top. A dark, tufted chair is visible on the left side of the room near a window with blue shutters.

title: Man of Sorrows
alt_text: A painting on a panel shows a figure inside a large, ornate, gold-colored frame. The frame has a pointed, arch-like shape and is decorated with carvings of scrolling leaves and open, web-like patterns. In the center, there is a circular opening that frames a painted figure with long hair and their head bowed down. The figure is pale and sits with their arms folded across their stomach. The background behind the figure is gold with faint patterns, matching the color of the elaborate wooden frame.

title: Portrait of an Elderly Woman, traditionally called Mevrouw Bodolphe
alt_text: A painting of an older woman sitting in a dark, high-backed chair. She wears a thick, stiff white collar around her neck and a matching white cap on her head. Her dark dress is accented with a brown fur-trimmed bodice, and she holds a white handkerchief in one hand. The background is a plain, dark gray wall with some faint, dark lettering on the left side near her shoulder. The lighting highlights her face, her white collar, and the hands resting on the chair's wooden arms.

title: A Game of Croquet
alt_text: A painting of two women standing in a grassy field playing a game with mallets and balls. The woman on the left wears a teal dress and holds a mallet with both hands while touching her brown hair. The woman on the right wears a bright red top over a long white skirt and leans forward to strike a croquet ball with her mallet. Both women stand on a flat, green lawn under the shade of several trees in the background. Wire croquet hoops are visible on the ground near the center of the scene.

title: Les Amies
alt_text: A painting of five figures on a beach, set inside a light-colored wooden frame. In the background, four women stand side-by-side with their arms around each other, looking out toward a blue horizontal strip of water. They wear simple dresses in shades of yellow, striped gray, and dark brown. In the foreground, a single woman sits alone on the sand, facing away from the group and toward the left side of the scene. The entire background is painted in muted, sandy tones of beige and brown.

title: Old Mill (The Morning Bell)
alt_text: A painting of a rural scene shows a woman walking across a wooden bridge. She wears a bright red jacket and a hat, and she is carrying a small bucket in her hand. Behind her, three other people stand near the end of the bridge in dark clothing. To the left, a small dog stands on the bridge near a large, dark building. The background features a dense forest and another small building set against a muted sky.

title: Wash Day (in the manner of Winslow Homer)
alt_text: A painting of a person standing outdoors in front of a large, white hanging cloth. The figure, who has dark skin and short dark hair, wears a light-colored, long-sleeved dress. They are holding a piece of white fabric in their hands, as if folding or examining it. To the right of the person sits a round, light green basket on the ground. The background is a soft, warm-toned area with hints of trees under a pale sky.

title: Candlestand
alt_text: An iron object that stands tall and thin on the floor. It consists of a long, dark metal pole supported by a base shaped like curved legs. The upper portion of the pole features a twisted, spiral texture, while the very top holds a small, flat circular platform. The entire piece has a dark, matte finish. It rests directly on a colorful patterned rug in a bright, indoor space.

title: Table
alt_text: A wooden table with wrought iron accents stands in the center of a room. The rectangular tabletop is made of solid, light-brown wood with a flat surface. Below the top, the base features two wide, curved legs that flare outward at the bottom. These legs are connected by a scalloped, decorative piece of wood near the floor, with thin metal rods connecting them. In the background, green metal storage shelves hold various items, including a long, white strip of paper hanging down in the center.

title: Panel with Saint Genevieve
alt_text: A wood sculpture shows several people in a detailed scene. On the left, a man wearing a crown kneels with his hands together in prayer. Beside him and slightly behind, a group of men with hats observe the scene. In the center, a man wearing a hooded robe holds a tall staff that has a cross at the top. On the right, a woman sits and holds a small baby in her arms. The background includes a small building, a forest of evergreen trees, and rolling hills with a horse and deer at the top.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A terracotta sculpture of a woman holding a small child under a decorative arch. The woman stands in the center and wears long, draped clothing. The child is tucked into the crook of her arm, also draped in fabric. Above them, an arched frame shows a figure with wings on either side, topped by a triangular peak. Twisted columns rise on both sides of the central scene. The entire piece has a textured, weathered appearance in shades of pale brown and grey.

title: Femmes et oiseau dans la nuit
alt_text: A painting of abstract, cartoon-like figures and shapes arranged on a textured, light brown background. On the left, a pale yellow face with simple line features sits above a dark, smudged circular form. To the right, a taller, multi-colored figure features a pointed, triangular head with a red and green top, and a body marked by rows of black dashes.
