Near the bottom center, a smaller, dark-bodied character with black, curved legs and spiky antennae stands firmly. Floating around these figures are various thin black lines, zigzag patterns, small circles, and a large blue crescent shape. All these elements appear painted directly onto the rough, woven surface of the burlap canvas.

title: The Torment of the Poet
alt_text: A painting of a classical-style statue standing in front of dark, architectural buildings. The statue is white with deep, vertical folds in its robe and a featureless, reddish-orange, oval head. A large, black, concentric circular shape occupies the foreground, partially obscuring the bottom of the scene. Next to the circular shape, there is a small object that looks like a folded fan with yellow slats. The background consists of tall, shadowy structures with arches that appear dim and somewhat eerie.

title: Grand Abstrait
medium: Black granite (belgian) on hard limestone base
alt_text: A sculpture of black granite sits atop a rectangular base made of hard limestone. The upper part is a dark, polished stone with sharp, geometric angles and flat surfaces. It rests on its bottom corner, giving it a tilted and unbalanced look. Below it, the base is a tall, vertical block with a rough, textured top section. The bottom part of the base is smoother and shows visible patterns in the stone.

title: Arrival
alt_text: A painting of abstract, flowing shapes that blend together in shades of yellow, tan, and brown. The image features several large, organic forms that look somewhat like distorted figures or drapes. On the left, a tall, pale shape curves upward while surrounded by bright yellow washes. To the right, a darker, rounded form sits near a jagged, metallic-looking structure that reaches toward the top of the frame. The background is a flat, muted grey that creates a sense of depth behind the lighter foreground elements. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, making the objects appear soft and indistinct.

title: Mrs. James Wedderburn, née Isabelle Clerk
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up against a plain, dark background. She has dark hair styled in soft curls around her face. Her gaze is directed slightly to the right of the viewer. She wears a dark, low-necked dress with puffed sleeves and a delicate gold chain hanging around her neck. A small, dark brooch sits at the center of her dress neckline.

title: London From Greenwich Park
alt_text: A painting showing a wide, outdoor landscape scene with a large tree in the foreground. On the left, a tall, sprawling tree with many thin branches dominates the view. Below the tree, the ground is grassy and slopes down toward a group of small figures in the lower right area. These people appear to be gathered together, with some holding umbrellas or wearing long dresses. In the distance, a sprawling city with various buildings and structures can be seen under a cloudy sky. The entire scene is depicted in shades of grey and white.

title: Table
alt_text: A wooden table stands centrally in the frame against a stone wall. The table has a rectangular top and a single wide drawer across the front. This drawer features four carved, circular floral patterns and a small metal keyhole. Below the drawer, the table has an open space with scalloped, wavy trim along the lower edges between the legs. To the right of the table, a white electric heater rests on the floor.

title: Cliff Pool
alt_text: A painting of abstract, jagged shapes in shades of blue, white, and black. A large, bright white vertical form dominates the right side of the canvas. This white shape is surrounded by deep blue and dark gray areas that appear textured and brushed on. On the left side, blotchy black and gray marks overlay lighter blue sections, creating a sense of layered depth. The overall composition feels chaotic, with thick, energetic paint strokes across the entire surface.

title: Bench
alt_text: A wooden bench stands against a rough, light-colored stone wall. The backrest is a long, rectangular slab of dark, polished wood. Two small, round, gilded masks are attached to the backrest, placed toward the left and right sides. The seat is a smooth, wide plank of matching wood. Four carved, sturdy legs support the bench, and thin, dark metal braces curve underneath between the legs.

title: The Deluge
alt_text: A painting of many nude figures posed in a dark, wooded landscape. In the center, a fair-skinned person sits on the ground with one arm raised toward the sky. Another figure stands to the right, leaning against a tree with their arm stretched upward. To the left, a muscular figure stands with their back turned while looking toward the background. Other figures are scattered around, some sitting and some crouched, with various shades of light and shadow falling across their bodies.

title: Pair of Urns
medium: Repousse metal, fluted with scalloped rim
alt_text: A metal container showing two matching objects shaped like open urns. Both containers are made of dark metal and have a wide, circular opening at the top with a scalloped, wavy rim. The sides of the containers are fluted with deep vertical lines that curve toward a smaller base. One container sits in the foreground, while the other is placed slightly behind it. Each item sits on a blue, textured surface, and small white paper labels are tucked near the bases.

title: Henry Ward Beecher
alt_text: A sculpture of a man standing beside a pedestal shows him dressed in a long coat and formal clothes. The man has a serious expression and wears his hair short and parted on the side. He stands with one hand resting on a short, square pillar and his other hand tucked at his waist. To the left of his feet, a small, brimmed hat rests on the ground. The entire figure and the pedestal are made of a solid, light-colored material. The base of the sculpture has text engraved on the front.

title: East Rock
alt_text: A painting of a landscape set within a round, gold frame. In the center, a large, dark brown hill rises against a soft, pink and blue sky. Below the hill, a flat, grassy valley stretches across the middle of the scene, dotted with several small haystacks. In the foreground, patches of dark green trees and bushes frame the view. A small, winding path leads into the valley, where two tiny figures can be seen walking together.

title: Archbishop James Frederick Wood (1813-1883)
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting in a chair. The figure wears a dark, long-sleeved garment with a red trim down the front and a white, lacy fabric draped over their lap. They have short, light hair and look towards the viewer. The background is dark and indistinct, making it hard to see details behind the seated person. The entire image is enclosed within a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame decorated with swirling patterns. A set of numbers is visible at the bottom right corner of the frame.

title: George Washington (1732-1799), LLD 1781
alt_text: A painting of a man's head and shoulders set against a dark brown background. The man has pale skin, light blue eyes, and white hair styled in soft rolls at the sides. He wears a high-collared black coat over a white shirt with a ruffled, patterned neck covering. He faces slightly to the left, with his gaze directed off to the side. The painting is enclosed within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Two dolphins
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows a curved, sea-creature-like form lying on a flat base. The figure has a large, rounded head with a wide, open mouth at the left end. Its body curves upward in the middle and tapers toward a tail at the right. A visible seam or ridge runs along the top of the body, suggesting constructed parts. A white paper tag with handwritten numbers hangs from the tail area on a string. The background is a solid, dark color, while the base sits on a light surface.

title: Two dolphins
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a curled sea creature rests on a rectangular stone base. The figure has a smooth, curved body that loops around and tapers into a tail on the left side. Its head faces the right, featuring large, rounded eyes and a snout with an open mouth. The creature's body appears to be resting horizontally on its belly, with faint lines suggesting fins or scales along its sides. A small white label is attached to the tail section of the sculpture.

title: Retrospection
alt_text: A painting showing a woman sitting in a chair, captured in oil on wood. She sits in profile, facing toward the right, with her head bowed and hands resting in her lap. She wears a long, light-colored dress that pools on the floor at her feet. The chair she sits on has a dark frame and a red seat. The background is shadowy and murky, fading from dark brown on the left to a lighter, dusty tan on the right. The overall lighting is soft, creating a quiet and somber mood.

title: The Veteran (Portrait of George Reynolds)
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up against a very dark, indistinct background. He has dark, messy hair and a thin beard, and he looks toward the left side of the frame with a serious expression. A faint light hits his face from the side, highlighting his forehead and cheekbone while leaving the rest of the image in deep shadow. He wears a dark, textured coat over a plum-colored scarf or high-necked garment. His right hand is visible in the lower corner, fingers curled as if resting on a surface.

title: The Phantom Cart
alt_text: A painting of a vast, flat, and beige landscape under a hazy, muted sky. In the far distance, there is a small, dark, arch-shaped structure sitting on the horizon line. To the left of this arch, a tiny, indistinct figure stands against the flat, empty ground. A small, rough, and light-colored rock-like object rests in the lower left foreground, casting a sharp, dark shadow to its side. The horizon stretches wide across the center, separating the dusty ground from a pale, yellowish-grey sky.

title: Rooms for Tourists
alt_text: A painting of a white house at night with warm lights glowing in the windows. The house has several dark green awnings above its windows and a porch on the ground floor. A thick, dark green hedge runs across the entire front of the building. To the right of the hedge, a small, lighted sign stands on a post. The scene is set against a very dark, black sky.

title: Sunlight in a Cafeteria
alt_text: A painting shows a quiet, light-filled cafe interior with two separate tables where customers sit. To the left, a woman with reddish hair in a blue dress sits alone at a table with a small glass on it. On the right side of the room, a man in a dark suit sits at another table, holding a small object in his hand. Large windows at the back look out onto a grey city street with a green potted plant sitting on a ledge. A bright, angled beam of light stretches across the back wall, separating the indoor space from the view outside. The scene feels still and empty, with dark wood doors and simple blue chairs arranged throughout the room.

title: The Old Treasury (The Trumbull Gallery)
alt_text: A painting of a park scene shows two people walking on a path. In the center, a large tree with bright yellow and orange leaves stands out against the background. The path curves slightly and leads toward buildings that are partially hidden by trees. To the left of the path, a low green hedge runs alongside the ground. The colors throughout the scene are soft and muted, with light blue and grey tones in the sky above.

title: Tiger and Serpent
alt_text: A painting of a large, striped cat and a snake locked in a struggle. The cat’s head is positioned at the top left, with its mouth wide open as if roaring or biting. A long, light-colored snake winds its body across the center of the image, partially coiling around the cat's form. The background is composed of dark, earthy tones of brown and deep green. Thick, visible brushstrokes create a textured and chaotic feeling throughout the scene.

title: Standing Female Nude
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a person from the waist up, turned to look toward the right. The person has short, reddish-brown hair and pale skin. They are shown against a background that is dark black on the left and a pale, neutral beige on the right. The brushstrokes are thick and loose, especially around the edges of the body. A faint, sketchy inscription appears in the top left corner of the painting.

title: Katherine Rosen
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a high-backed armchair. She has light brown hair, pale skin, and is wearing a long, dark purple dress with a white lace collar. Her hands rest gently in her lap, and she looks off to the left side of the frame. The chair behind her is upholstered in a tufted dark material. To her right, a small table holds a colorful bouquet of flowers. The background is a dimly lit, shadowy room with a warm glow coming from the left.

title: Portrait of Ezra Pound
alt_text: A wood sculpture of a tall, thin figure stands against a plain light gray background. The object is composed of stacked, blocky sections that create an abstract, pillar-like shape. At the very top, a flat face is carved with geometric eyes and a straight nose. Below the head, the sculpture continues with various angular, wooden forms that appear to represent a body. The entire piece has a dark, matte brown color with visible grain and texture. A soft shadow falls to the left of the sculpture, indicating a light source coming from the right.

title: Female Figure (one of a pair)
alt_text: A wood sculpture of a woman stands tall on an ornate pedestal. She is posed with her right arm raised above her head, grasping an object near her hair. Her wavy hair is loose, and she wears a flowing dress that reaches to the floor. The dress has fabric that drapes and folds around her body. Beneath her feet, the pedestal flares outward at the base and is decorated with carved, swirling lines.

title: The Sounding of the Bell
alt_text: A painting shows a series of nested squares on a square background. The outermost border is a solid, bright red, followed by a blue-and-red striped square frame. Inside that frame sits another thick band of solid red. The innermost square is filled with green-and-red diagonal stripes. This geometric design creates an effect of depth by alternating between solid colors and striped patterns.

title: Torso of a Youth, possibly Apollo or Hercules
medium: White marble and specs of mica
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows a headless male torso standing on a wooden base. The figure has broad shoulders and well-defined chest muscles. A band crosses diagonally across the chest from the left shoulder down toward the waist. To the right of the torso, a tuft of textured material hangs down, perhaps representing fur or cloth. The figure's arms and legs are missing below the upper arms and upper thighs.

title: Putto
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a small child with wings. The figure stands on a dark, round pedestal that rests on a flat, square stone base with a green, mottled pattern. The child has curly hair and looks toward the right while holding one arm up in the air. A piece of fabric is draped diagonally across the child's chest and around the waist. The other hand rests near the hip, holding a long, thin object against the body. The sculpture is dark brown and appears metallic against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Young Lady
alt_text: A painting of a stylized, round-faced figure dominates the center against a textured, dark green background. The figure has a brown, mottled skin tone with deeply set, dark eyes and a small, pointed nose. The hair is divided into two distinct halves: one side is black and smooth, while the other side is a textured, golden-brown color. A necklace of small, white circular beads circles the figure's neck, sitting just above a patterned tunic. Smaller, abstract shapes and dark circular forms float around the figure in the upper part of the composition.

title: James Dwight Dana (1813-1895), B.A. 1833, M.A. 1836
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a man with dark, wavy hair. He looks to his right with a serious expression and wears a dark coat over a crisp white collar. A black necktie is knotted neatly around his neck. The coat has reddish-brown velvet lapels that add a touch of color. The background is a soft, cloudy sky filled with shades of grey and muted blue.

title: Old House, New Moon
alt_text: A painting of a white building with a dark roof sitting in a large, grassy field under a dusky sky. A large, bare tree stands prominently in the foreground, partially obscuring the front of the white building. The building features arched windows and a small tower with a cupola on top. In the distance, a few small evergreen trees are scattered across the brown, flat ground. Above, the sky is a muted blue color with several dark, horizontal clouds and a sliver of a crescent moon.

title: General George Washington
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man’s head and upper chest stands against a plain, light gray background. The figure is looking forward with a serious and calm expression on his face. He has short hair that is styled away from his forehead and gathered behind his head. The figure wears a high-collared jacket with decorative fringe on the shoulders and a ruffle at the neck. The entire bust has a smooth, dark metallic finish that creates soft highlights on his face and clothing.

title: The Old School - The Black Ball Packet Ship "Canada"
alt_text: A painting of a large sailing ship moving through choppy water. The ship has three tall masts with off-white sails that are mostly full of wind. Its hull is dark, and the deck appears to hold several figures. In the background, the sea stretches out to a line of distant, hazy hills under a cloudy sky. A small, blurry American flag flies from the back of the ship. The entire image is contained within an ornate gold frame.

title: The New School - The New York and Liverpool Black Ball Line Ship "England"
alt_text: A painting of a large sailing ship moving across the water in a gold frame. The ship has many white, full sails and a dark hull. It travels toward the left, riding over choppy, greenish-blue waves. The sky above is filled with soft, cloudy colors in shades of pink, tan, and light blue. A small tag with text and color circles hangs from the bottom right corner of the frame.

title: Mrs. Kate Harrison Goodbody
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in profile against a dark background. She wears a formal, light-colored dress with ruffled sleeves and lace details. The woman holds a small cluster of pale pink flowers in her hands, which are resting in her lap. Her hair is styled in an updo, and she wears a delicate necklace. The portrait is displayed in an ornate, gold-colored wooden frame with carved edges.

title: William Ely (1767–1847), B.A. 1787
alt_text: A watercolor on ivory miniature shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. He has light brown hair that is styled wide around his head. His face is pale with a neutral expression and light blue eyes. He wears a dark black coat with a high collar that stands up around his neck. A white ruffled cravat is tucked under his coat. The entire portrait is encased in an oval metal frame with a delicate, wavy edge and a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Young Hawk
alt_text: A quartzite sculpture shows a small, stout bird sitting on a solid base. The figure has a smooth, rounded head and chest that curves forward. A large, circular eye is carved into the side of its face above a small beak. The body is textured and compact, with simple wing shapes etched into its sides. It rests directly on a flat surface against a plain, grey background.

title: Elihu Yale with Members of his Family and an Enslaved Child
alt_text: A painting of four men sitting around a round wooden table, with a young child standing to the side. The men are wearing long, curly powdered wigs and elaborate, colorful coats. One man wears a bright red coat, another wears a deep purple coat, and a third wears a dark blue coat. The table in the center has several items on it, including two long tobacco pipes and two small metal cups. In the background, there is a large pillar and a view of a garden with a fountain and small figures playing. A child wearing a white head wrap and a simple brown coat stands near the man in the blue jacket.

title: Pieta
alt_text: A limestone sculpture of a seated woman cradling a limp, recumbent figure across her lap. The woman wears a veil over her head and long, flowing robes that bunch up around her legs. The figure lying across her is thin and appears lifeless, with arms and legs extending outward. The rough, pale stone texture covers the entire sculpture. A small paper tag hangs from the lower part of the figures. The sculpture sits on a blocky base marked with the numbers 1960.56 in a storage room with shelves.

title: A Fresh Breeze
alt_text: A painting of a seascape shows water under a sky filled with thick clouds. To the left, a tall, dark, and uneven cliff juts upward from the water. A small sailboat with white sails floats in the center of the dark blue water. In the distance on the right, a darker strip of land sits along the horizon line. Large, fluffy white clouds swirl throughout the deep teal and blue sky above.

title: Universal equinoctial ring dial
alt_text: A brass tool of circular shape sits against a tan fabric background. The outer ring is engraved with Roman numerals, numbers, and the names of several cities. A thin, horizontal bar stretches across the center of the ring, featuring the names of months on its surface. At the very top of the circle, a small oval ring is attached for hanging or carrying the object. Tiny screws hold the different metal pieces together. A small white label with text and numbers rests in the bottom right corner of the frame.

title: William Woodcock Goodbody
alt_text: A painting of a seated man wearing a suit. The man is middle-aged with short dark hair and a mustache, positioned in the center of the frame. He wears a dark gray vest and jacket over a white shirt and dark tie. His hands are clasped together in his lap, and he looks directly toward the viewer. The background is a plain, dark, indistinct color that fades into shadow behind him. The entire image is enclosed in a decorative gold-colored frame.

title: David
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a standing person next to a small dog. The person has long, wavy hair and is looking upward with their mouth slightly open. They are bare-chested and wear a simple cloth wrap around their waist. The person holds one hand to their chest while the other arm extends out to the side. At the person's feet, a small, alert dog with pointed ears sits on the round base.

title: Portrait of a Man
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting down in a formal pose. He has dark, short hair and is wearing a black coat, a grey vest, and a white shirt with a dark necktie. He sits on a red-cushioned chair that is positioned against a dark, shadowy background. The painting is held in an ornate, heavy gold frame that is cracked and missing pieces in several spots. The frame is rectangular with detailed carved patterns of leaves and swirls.

title: Cockerel
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a rider sitting on the back of a four-legged animal. The animal has a heavy, blocky body and stands on a rectangular base. Its head points forward with sharp, angular features. The rider sits upright in the middle of the animal’s back, appearing tall and upright. The surface of the entire object looks rough and textured, with deep shadows creating a dark, varied appearance.

title: Red Ballon
alt_text: A painting of abstract, misty shapes set against a muted beige background. To the left, a soft, golden sphere glows near a vertical, jagged strip of blue and grey. Below this, a brighter red sphere and a smaller, faded blue circular shape sit side-by-side. To the right, a cluster of pale, yellowish dots creates a subtle, vertical pattern that fades into the background. The overall effect is hazy and soft, blending colors without sharp edges.

title: Apollo
alt_text: A painting of two horses rearing up on a rocky hill against a cloudy, light blue sky. One horse is a deep reddish-brown color, while the horse next to it is light gray or white. To the right of the horses, a small figure stands on a yellow, wheeled cart and holds the reins. The ground underneath them is a mix of tan, orange, and green colors that suggest rough terrain. The overall style of the painting is hazy, with soft edges and blended colors throughout the scene.

title: Procession
alt_text: A painting of figures on a path in a landscape. In the foreground, a woman with fair skin and blond hair is mostly unclothed, draped in a blue fabric, and holds a small candle holder towards a man wearing a dark suit. Another man in a suit stands to the right, gesturing with his hand and looking toward the left. Further to the right, a woman stands with her back to the viewer, wearing a long green skirt and a large floral headdress. A dirt road winds into the background, where more small, distant figures walk between rocky hills and grassy fields under a blue sky.

title: Standing Mobile
alt_text: A sculpture made of wood and metal shows a delicate, branching mobile standing on three thin wire legs. A smooth, rounded wooden teardrop shape sits at the base of the structure. Extending upward and outward from this base, thin metal wires branch off in several directions. Small, flat, leaf-like shapes in light orange wood hang from the ends of these wires. A single, darker, teardrop-shaped piece of wood is attached to the highest wire.

title: The Kitchen
alt_text: A painting of a bathroom with blue and white tiled walls. A dark brown bottle sits on a flat surface in the center of the image. To the left, a light-colored shape suggests a figure sitting near a tub or sink. A large, pale, oval shape hangs in the upper right corner against the dark ceiling. The floor and some wall sections feature patterns of blue and white squares or dots.

title: Danger, Construction Ahead
alt_text: A painting of a vast desert landscape featuring tall, jagged, dark rock formations that resemble spires. A long, thin, light-colored bridge stretches horizontally from the spires out over the empty, sandy dunes. The desert stretches toward a distant, dark horizon line under a gray sky. In the far distance, another range of dark, jagged rocks lines the horizon. The scene is quiet and has a smooth, empty appearance.

title: The Harbor of La Rochelle
alt_text: A painting of a busy harbor scene showing a stone quay in the foreground and a calm waterway with boats beyond. On the left side of the quay, several people and horses are gathered near large blocks of stone and wooden crates. A figure rides a donkey toward the center, while a man stands nearby looking toward the water. In the distance, white buildings and a tall tower line the opposite bank under a sky filled with light, wispy clouds. The water reflects the structures and the soft, daytime light of the sky.

title: Western Motel
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on the edge of a bed inside a room with green walls. She wears a dark red dress and faces toward the viewer with a calm expression. A large window behind her looks out onto a flat landscape with rolling brown hills and a blue sky, where the front of a green car is parked just outside. To the left of the woman, a wooden suitcase sits on the floor near the bed. On the right side of the room, a red armchair holds a blue folded cloth. Light from the window casts long, sharp shadows across the room.

title: Urbau - Priest of Akkad
medium: Oil and mixed media on canvas
alt_text: A painting of large, dark shapes layered against each other. The composition is dominated by shades of brown, black, and deep gray. On the left side, there is a cluster of textured, rough-looking forms that appear almost rocky or sculptural. A flat, expansive dark brown shape stretches across the center and drops down toward the bottom of the frame. The background consists of hazy, lighter gray patches that contrast with the heavier, dark forms in the foreground.

title: Figure
alt_text: A painting of abstract, puzzle-like shapes fills the frame. These shapes vary in size and fit tightly against one another like an interlocking pattern. The color palette is muted, consisting mostly of light tan, sandy beige, and soft gray tones. Some areas of the paint look worn or patchy, revealing a darker surface underneath. Dark, thin lines outline most of the curved shapes, giving them a distinct separation from each other.

title: Dutch Village Scene
alt_text: A painting of an outdoor scene shows a village filled with people gathering near small houses. To the left, a group of figures sits around a table outside a large, rustic building. In the distance, several other small structures and a tall church steeple stand against a pale, cloudy sky. Smaller groups of people walk and interact in the open, grassy area that stretches across the middle of the scene. The overall color palette features muted browns, grays, and soft greens.

title: Coney Island Beach
alt_text: A painting showing a crowded beach scene with many people enjoying a sunny day. On the left side, a large, elevated wooden pier extends into the background, filled with people watching the scene below. Several groups of swimmers and sunbathers in bathing suits are gathered on the sand in the foreground and center. To the right, a tall man lifts a woman onto his shoulders, while another woman climbs onto a man's back. The sky above is filled with soft, puffy clouds, and a colorful striped umbrella sits near the middle of the crowd.

title: From the Cabin
alt_text: A painting of a dark, cluttered interior that looks out onto several different landscapes. On the left side, a large, circular window reveals a flat, pale ground stretching toward a deep blue sky. To the right of that, a tall, rectangular opening shows a bright blue sky above a field of green hills. Between these two views, the interior walls are dark and filled with geometric shapes in shades of brown and grey. A small, simple house stands near the center of the dark space. Below the circular window, a patch of red contains a single, small orange orb.

title: Hothouse
alt_text: A painting shows abstract shapes and bold, sweeping brushstrokes in a variety of colors. Thick streaks of red, orange, and yellow dominate the upper and center sections, while patches of dark blue and black appear lower down. The background mixes light pinks, tans, and dull greens, creating a textured and layered effect. Many of the brushstrokes seem to overlap or bleed into one another without forming clear, recognizable objects. A small, dark signature appears in the bottom right corner of the frame.

title: Chest Box
alt_text: A wooden container, shaped like a small, rectangular box, stands on a pale, textured surface. It is made of polished brown wood with a natural grain visible across its top and sides. The lid of the box is flat with beveled edges, while the main body has a recessed panel on the front. It is supported by four short legs that curve outward at the bottom. A small white rectangular tag with a barcode sits on the surface just in front of the box.

title: Dr. Agnew (Dr. D. Hayes Agnew) (1818–1892)
alt_text: A painting of an older man wearing a white, loose-fitting smock. The man is shown in profile, facing toward the right side of the frame with a neutral expression. His skin is pale, and he has thin white hair and a white mustache. In his right hand, which hangs loosely near his waist, he holds a thin, metallic-looking tool. He stands against a very dark, indistinct background that fades into deep brown shadows.

title: Rif
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured brushstrokes covering the entire surface in a repeating pattern. Thick dabs of paint are arranged closely together, creating a sense of movement across the canvas. The dominant colors are deep shades of red, dark blue, and black. Short, rectangular marks lean in different directions, giving the surface a dense and layered appearance. Light colors peak through in small patches, mostly near the bottom and top edges.

title: Kathrin
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a dark, high-backed chair. She wears a long, pale-colored gown with a bright pink bow at her collar. The woman holds a partially opened, bright red fan in her right hand. Her eyes look down as if she is focusing on the fan or her lap. Behind her stands a large, dark-red wooden structure, possibly a piece of furniture or a wall paneling. The scene is dim and moody, with deep shadows hiding much of the room.

title: Diana
alt_text: A gilded bronze sculpture shows a nude female figure in a standing pose. The figure balances on one foot while lifting her other leg, with her right arm raised above her head and her left arm extending outward holding a thin curved object. The sculpture has a metallic gold finish with some worn areas, giving it a textured appearance. A white rectangular tag hangs from the figure's outstretched left arm. The background is a rough, off-white wall with the number 1958.47 written on it in black.

title: William Hance Macdowell (1816-1906)
alt_text: A painting of an older man with gray hair and a gray beard. He is wearing a dark jacket, a white collared shirt, and a black bowtie. The man is facing slightly to the left against a plain, dark brown background. His expression is serious, and he is looking off to the side. The painting is enclosed within a wide, decorative gold-colored frame.

title: An Abstract Arrangement of American Indian Symbols
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and symbols against a black background. A large, white, triangle-shaped form sits in the center, featuring four yellow circles and a black-and-white checkerboard pattern at its base. To the left is a semicircular fan shape with red and white segments, while a white bird with red wings rests on the right. Smaller shapes, including a yellow zigzag line, a blue triangle, and colorful rectangular bars, are scattered near the top. The bottom portion shows a ground area made of a grid of red and green rectangles.

title: Rooms by the Sea
alt_text: A painting of an open door that looks out onto a calm blue sea. A large, bright rectangle of sunlight falls onto the floor and the wall inside the room. To the left, a portion of a room is visible, containing a dark wooden cabinet and a sliver of a red chair. The walls are painted a pale, light blue color. A doorway on the far right stands open, showing a clear horizon line where the sky meets the ocean.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting showing two simple, solid shapes against a plain background. A large, horizontal rectangle with soft, uneven edges fills the upper half of the frame. Below it sits a smaller, thinner rectangle that spans the width of the composition. The paint appears thickly applied with visible, textured brushstrokes throughout both shapes. These two forms are dark in tone, contrasting with the lighter, neutral space around them.

title: Ajax
alt_text: A silver sculpture shows a small, standing figure of a man looking upward. The figure is nude and holds one hand out in front of him with his palm facing up. His other hand is held out to the side with fingers splayed open. He stands on a small, textured square platform that rests on a dark rectangular base. The metal surface of the figure has a shiny finish with some worn, dark patches.

title: Candlestand
alt_text: A lighting device made of iron shows a tall, slender stand for holding candles. It has a long vertical pole that rises from a simple tripod base on the floor. Near the top of the pole, two arms extend outward and slightly downward to hold small, cup-shaped candle holders. A pointed spike extends vertically from the very center of the top. The entire object has a dark, uniform color and a smooth, metallic appearance.

title: A Capriccio of the Roman Forum
alt_text: A painting of stone ruins scattered across a large open field under a cloudy, blue sky. Several tall, weathered stone columns stand among crumbling walls and arches that suggest an ancient city. In the foreground and middle distance, small figures of people dressed in simple tunics walk through the landscape or sit near the rubble. A large, sculpted horse lies on the ground on the right side, near a rectangular stone tomb carved with figures. Large stone blocks and debris rest on the ground throughout the scene, creating a sense of history and decay.

title: Armchair
medium: Wood with blue velvet back and seat
alt_text: A piece of furniture made of wood with blue velvet shows an armchair with a tall, straight back. The chair has a dark wood frame with four sturdy legs connected by thin support beams. A flat, rectangular blue velvet seat sits between the arms and is decorated with a row of round, metallic studs along the front edge. Above the seat, a matching rectangular blue velvet panel forms the backrest. Between the front legs, a horizontal piece of carved wood adds decorative detail to the chair's base.

title: Green Cascades
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and colors covering the entire canvas. A large, dark shape dominates the top center, filled with thick, visible brushstrokes in shades of black and deep gray. Below this, a splash of bright orange and red paint sits on the left side, contrasting with a patch of pale white. The lower portion of the canvas features textured, sweeping strokes of green that seem to flow toward the right. On the far right, a solid black form anchors the edge, meeting the green section.

title: Low Tide
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract, irregular shape in the center against a light-colored background. This central form is made of blended patches of green, blue, and a dark reddish-brown color that fade into each other. Thick, wavy lines define the edges of the shape, giving it an organic look. To the left and bottom, large areas of a golden-yellow color fill much of the background. The upper right corner also features a smaller patch of this same golden-yellow tone.

title: Woman of the Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting of a person standing in the center. The figure has a large, heavy garment draped over their shoulders that falls down to their feet. The person’s face is broad with deep-set, dark eyes and a solemn expression. The artist uses a loose, messy style with dark streaks and drips of paint running down the entire surface. The background is a murky grey and appears unfinished or abstract. Large, bare feet are visible at the bottom of the frame, firmly planted on the ground.

title: Female Figure (one of a pair)
alt_text: A wood sculpture showing a standing woman on a tall, carved pedestal. She is wearing a long, draped dress and has flowers or leaves woven into her hair. Her left arm is raised above her head, and her hand appears to be holding a long, thin object that points upward. Her right arm hangs loosely at her side with her hand curled near her hip. The base underneath her feet is decorated with carved curves and lines that taper toward the bottom.

title: Cain and Abel
alt_text: A plastic wood sculpture shows a standing figure holding an upside-down figure. The standing figure is tall and thin with long, stick-like arms and legs. One hand is raised high in the air, while the other hand supports the legs of the figure hanging below. The second figure is positioned horizontally, with its head pointing toward the ground. Both figures are made of a rough, dark brown material and stand on a rectangular base.

title: The Microscope
alt_text: A painting of a group of people sitting around a table in a dimly lit room. On the right, an older person in a dark hood looks toward two young children, pointing a finger at a scientific instrument on the table. The children sit close together, watching the older person with curious expressions. To the far left, a person with their back to the viewer sits at the table, while another person stands in the shadows behind the group. Small, dark containers and tools are arranged on the surface of the table. A large, dark cabinet stands against the wall in the background, completing the scene.

title: Alfred Whitney Griswold (1906-1963), BA 1929, PhD 1933
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a dark suit standing inside a room. The man has short, light hair and looks toward the viewer while holding a small, dark object in one hand. He stands in front of a dark, shadowed wall that has a bookshelf filled with books on the right side. On the left, a small desk holds a dark case and a few papers. The painting is enclosed in a wide, textured gold frame that hangs on a white wall under a brass light.

title: C. Mahlon Kline (1880–1967), Ph.B. 1901
alt_text: A painting of an older man wearing a dark suit and glasses. He sits against a dark, textured background and looks directly at the viewer. In his hands, he holds a light-colored, folded piece of paper. The man has short, thin hair and appears to be smiling slightly. The lighting highlights his face and the paper while leaving the rest of the scene in shadow.

title: Sea Form (Porthmeor)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an abstract, elongated form with smooth, curved surfaces. It is colored in shades of dark and light green with brownish tones. Two large, oval-shaped holes pierce through the body of the sculpture. The form is wider at the top and narrows slightly towards the bottom. It rests on a square, dark pedestal against a plain, light gray background.

title: Europa and the Bull
medium: Bronze, brown patina and gilt, brescian marble base
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a reclining woman lying beside a large bull. The bronze figures have a smooth, dark brown surface with subtle golden highlights. The woman is draped across the bull's flank while her arm rests gently on its head. The bull is crouched down on the ground, and its single visible horn curves upward. Both figures rest on a heavy base made of polished, patterned marble in shades of tan and cream.

title: Pair of Candlesticks
alt_text: A pair of bell metal candlesticks stands side by side on a light wooden shelf. Both candlesticks are identical with tall, thin stems featuring several rounded, decorative ridges. Each has a wide, flat circular base and a smaller matching plate near the top to catch dripping wax. A sharp, pointed spike rises from the center of the top plate to hold a candle in place. Small white inventory tags hang from the thin stems of both objects.

title: Daniel Dwight (1780-1865)
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in formal, dark clothing. The man has dark, parted hair and sits with a serious expression, facing forward. He wears a black coat over a white shirt with a dark bow tie at his neck. His right hand rests on the arm of a chair, while a red curtain hangs behind him on the right side. The background is a plain, dark green shade. He has a thin, gold chain visible on his vest near the bottom of the frame.

title: Plate
alt_text: A brass dish is shown against a plain, light-colored background. The circular plate has a raised rim decorated with a repeating pattern of small, oval shapes. The center of the plate is slightly sunken and features faint, engraved outlines of several standing figures and a small tree. A white museum tag with text is attached to the top edge of the rim by a thin string. The overall surface of the metal shows signs of wear and age, with some areas appearing darker or tarnished.

title: Bust of Walter Hilliard Bidwell, BA 1927
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of an older man's head and shoulders faces directly forward. He is bald on top with tufts of hair on the sides of his head. His forehead is furrowed, and his expression appears serious or slightly grim. The man's gaze looks straight ahead with deeply set eyes above a prominent nose. This bust rests on a circular pedestal base.

title: Ewer
alt_text: A brass container shaped like a tall jug stands upright on a plain, light-colored surface. The object has a round, bulbous bottom that tapers into a slender neck with an open mouth at the top. A thin handle curves outward from the left side of the neck, connecting back to the upper body. Several horizontal ridges circle the neck and the wider part of the base, adding texture to the surface. A small white label with black text sits at the very base of the jug.

title: Mrs Norton Pitt and Her Daughter
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a young child embracing. The woman sits on a stone bench, wearing a white dress with a dark sash and a head covering. A young child with dark hair sits in her lap, hugging her waist and looking toward the viewer. Both figures have pale skin and wear simple white clothing. To the left, a dark tree stands near a faint landscape scene in the background.

title: Tankard
alt_text: A brass container is shown, shaped like a tall, lidded pitcher with a handle on its left side. The metal has a dark, muted brownish-gold tone throughout. Its body is wide at the base and tapers slightly as it goes up to a rounded lid, which is topped with a small, circular knob. A curved handle extends from the upper part of the body, and a small, white paper tag is attached to it, hanging down to the side. A small rectangular label with text sits on the surface directly in front of the base.

title: Robert Gwillym of Atherton and William Farington of Werden
alt_text: A painting of two men in a park-like setting with a small dog standing between them. One man sits on a raised rock ledge while the other stands beside him on the right. Both men wear long coats, knee-length breeches, white stockings, and dark shoes. The background shows a large landscape with rolling hills, trees, and the ruins of a stone building. A small, patterned dog with white and brown fur looks forward from near their feet. The overall scene is lit with a warm, golden light that suggests a late afternoon.

title: Bow Banger, No. 3
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes set against a solid turquoise background. At the top, a large, semi-circular purple arch frames an off-white area speckled with dark red dots. In the lower left, a square shape with thick orange and brown borders surrounds a white center. To the right of the center square, a curved, bright yellow form arches upward like a hook. Several small, scattered red circles sit in the lower right corner, balanced by a blue oval on the far left. Thick black outlines define most of the shapes throughout the composition.

title: Procession in Front of Ouspensky Cathedral (Cathedral of the Assumption)
alt_text: A painting in oil on wood shows a procession of people standing in front of a large building. The building is light-colored and features three tall, golden domes at the top. A row of figures stretches across the bottom foreground, wearing ornate robes in shades of red, yellow, and brown. Many of the people hold long staffs, flags, and banners that reach toward the top of the frame. A simple gold frame surrounds the entire scene.

title: Bucket
alt_text: A brass container shows a simple, cylindrical shape with an open top. A curved handle made of the same brass material attaches to the sides with small, decorative metal hooks. The inside of the bucket appears dark and deep, contrasting with the smooth, reflective metal of the outside walls. A small, pale yellow tag hangs from one side of the handle by a thin white string. The entire object sits on a grey, textured cloth surface.

title: Roger Sherman (1721-1793), MA (Hon.) 1768
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas shows a portrait of a man with light-colored hair. He is viewed from the chest up and is turned slightly to the right side of the frame. The man wears a simple brown coat over a white collared shirt with a dark necktie. He has a serious expression and looks toward the right. This oval-shaped painting is enclosed within an ornate, thick gold frame with intricate details.

title: Cinquedea
alt_text: A steel weapon shaped like a long, pointed dagger sits vertically against a plain, light grey background. Its blade is distinctively shaped like a long, narrow triangle, featuring many raised, parallel ridges running from the point down to the hilt. The crossguard curves upward like a crescent moon, with small, engraved decorative details visible along its surface. Below the guard, a short, dark handle leads down to a rounded pommel at the bottom. A small, rectangular paper tag with handwritten numbers hangs from the crossguard area on the right side.

title: The Streets Turn Young With Rain
alt_text: A painting showing dark, blocky shapes and streaking lines. The overall color is a mix of muted purple, gray, and dark green tones. Diagonal white lines cut across the entire scene from the upper left to the lower right, resembling rain or scratches. Within the darker sections, there are faint hints of light green or textured patterns. The artwork is framed in a thin, light-colored metal border.

title: De mains pâles aux cieux lasses (From Pale Hands to Weary Skies)
alt_text: A painting of oil on canvas shows several tall, spike-like structures rising against a gray and brown sky. These structures vary in shape, with some looking like smooth, dark pillars and others resembling jagged towers built from small, stacked forms. Several thin, white, triangular shapes stand upright between the larger structures, pointing toward the sky. In the lower-right area, one of the towers features a flat, light-colored platform. The background is a moody, hazy mix of dark clouds that fades into a lighter gray near the top.

title: Salvator Mundi
alt_text: A textile of silk with gold thread embroidery shows a small, rectangular portrait of a person in profile. The figure faces right, wearing a rounded head covering and a cloak with detailed patterns. The embroidery is mounted on a larger, neutral-colored square background that sits inside a wooden picture frame. At the bottom of the frame, a black label displays the white text "1964.59." The entire framed piece is viewed from a slightly high angle against a plain surface.

title: Cicero Discovering the Tomb of Archimedes
alt_text: A painting of a crowd of people in ancient-style robes standing in a clearing surrounded by tall trees. In the center, a man in a long white robe stands facing the group with his arm outstretched as if gesturing or speaking. To the right, a bare-chested man swings a tool toward a thick stone pillar covered in vines while another figure sits nearby. On the far left, a group of people and white horses stand near a rocky path that leads toward distant mountains. The scene is set outdoors with soft light filtering through the clouds and foliage.

title: Mirror
alt_text: A piece of furniture of gilded metal showing an octagonal frame. The frame is made of a dark wood or metal border surrounding a flat, mirrored center. This inner mirror area contains a small green rectangular sticker with the number 54 printed on it. Surrounding the mirror is a wide, decorative band made of dull gold-colored metal. This band features repetitive, raised floral patterns and scrolls embossed into the surface. A small, ornate hanging loop sits at the very top of the frame.

title: Alms box
alt_text: A wooden container of wood and iron shows a rectangular box reinforced with dark metal bands. The wood appears dark, worn, and textured with age. Thick, rusted iron straps wrap around the corners and across the lid to hold the structure together. On the top center, a large, rectangular metal lock plate sits attached to the lid. A small, white paper tag with a thin string hangs off the right side of the box.

title: Crucifixion
alt_text: A polychromed wood sculpture shows a male figure with his arms stretched out to his sides and his head tilted slightly downward to the left. He has a beard and wavy hair, and his face shows a calm, closed-eye expression. A piece of golden-colored fabric is wrapped around his hips, draped to one side. His legs are bent at the knees, with one foot crossed over the other near the bottom of the figure. The material of the sculpture is a pale, light-brown wood tone that contrasts with the brighter gold color of the cloth.

title: Poster Portrait: Marin
alt_text: A painting of colorful letters and shapes. The word "MARIN" appears in large, black capital letters across the top section. Below it, the word "PLAY" is written in large, yellow capital letters against a white background. A red arrow pierces through the middle of the word "PLAY." The bottom third of the painting is a solid blue band decorated with two small, white five-pointed stars.

title: Desk base or chest
alt_text: A piece of wooden furniture shows a small chest with four square drawers arranged in a two-by-two grid. Each drawer face features a carved diamond pattern with an oval-shaped ornament in the center. The wood has a dark, weathered brown tone and appears to be heavily carved along the borders. Small, shell-like decorative elements sit at the top edge of the chest above the two upper drawers. The entire piece rests on short, rounded feet that are propped up by small white blocks.

title: Sphere
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an abstract, circular form made of twisted metal bands. The sculpture consists of multiple dark, rough-textured, curved pieces that interlock to create a sense of movement. These metal segments intersect and overlap to form an open, spherical shape. The entire piece rests on a dark, square base that sits atop a simple white pedestal. The overall color of the sculpture is a dark, mottled greyish-black.

title: Length of fine Valenciennes lace
alt_text: A textile of linen bobbin lace shows a long, narrow strip of fabric with intricate floral patterns. The lace is an off-white, light cream color with a delicate, open weave. One end of the fabric is wrapped neatly around a smooth, white cylindrical tube on the left side. The rest of the lace extends to the right, lying flat across a solid gray surface. A small, horizontal black tag with white numbers sits at the very bottom center of the view.

title: Portrait of Jane Stanhope, Countess of Harrington, with her Sons, Charles, Viscount Petersham, and Lincoln Edwin Robert Stanhope
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting with two young children. The woman sits in the center wearing a long, white ruffled dress and looks up toward the right. To her left, a young child with brown hair wears a white outfit and places a hand on the woman's arm. On her right, an older child with curly blonde hair and a dark hat stands beside her, holding onto the woman's skirt. Behind them, a dark pillar stands on the left, while a blue sky with clouds and green trees can be seen on the right.

title: Ecce Homo (Christ as the Man of Sorrows)
alt_text: A polychromed wood sculpture shows the upper body and head of a man with a beard and long, dark hair. He wears a thick, spiky crown made of twisted branches on his head. A heavy rope is tied around his neck and binds his crossed wrists at his waist. His head is tilted back, and his eyes look upward with an expression of distress. A deep red cloth is draped over his left shoulder and covers his lower torso.

title: Oil Lamp Candlestick
alt_text: A brass lighting device stands on a white, wrinkled surface. The object has a wide, circular base that tapers into a slender, vertical stem. Near the top of the stem, there is a small, flat disc and a rounded bulbous section. This top section features a circular opening at the very peak. The entire piece is made of a smooth, dark gold-colored metal that reflects the light. A small white label with a barcode sits on the surface next to the base of the object.

title: The King
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of an abstract, standing figure against a light grey background. The figure is constructed from many thin, vertical metal bars and rectangular pieces. It has two sturdy legs, a boxy torso, a rounded head, and a tall, cylindrical top piece that looks like a hat or crown. The entire surface has a greenish, weathered texture that makes it look rough and uneven. The object stands on a simple square base.

title: Candlesticks
alt_text: A brass candlestick stands on a wrinkled white surface. It has a tall, thin stem that rises from a wide, circular base. About halfway up the stem, a small round tray sits horizontally to catch wax. The top of the candlestick features a wider cup for holding a candle. A small white label with a barcode lies flat on the surface to the right of the base.

title: Wafer Mold
alt_text: A wooden tool in the shape of a small, flat oval shows a carved image on its surface. The carving depicts a standing figure with hands held together at the chest. Above the figure's head is a simple circular halo with radiating lines. The figure appears to be wearing robes that flow out to the side. A decorative border of small, evenly spaced indentations runs around the entire edge of the oval. The wood itself is dark brown and has a smooth, weathered texture.

title: B.S. #7
alt_text: A painting showing bold, abstract shapes in black, grey, red, and blue colors. A large, dark black block dominates the center, with rough, vertical brushstrokes along its bottom edge. To the left, a thick blue column sits next to a smaller, vertical red stripe. A solid, horizontal grey band spans across the bottom of the canvas, grounding the lighter shapes. At the very far left, a thin vertical line of bright yellow appears against the edge of the frame. The background is composed of large, flat patches of grey and muted blue.

title: Roman Visitation
alt_text: A painting of two distinct square panels mounted on a brown background. Each panel features a dark circular frame containing a smaller, textured square center. The left square is painted in a deep, dark grey or black, while the right square features shades of blue and black. A vertical rectangular strip sits between the two circles, decorated with thin lines and a single small circle in its center. The entire artwork is surrounded by a wide, plain brown border.

title: Hercules and the Lion
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a muscular man wrestling a large lion. The figures are dark brown and posed in an intense, locked struggle. The man stands on the right side, bracing his leg against the lion's body. The lion is on the left, reared up on its hind legs with its head turned toward the man. Both figures are mounted on a rectangular, light-brown marble base.

title: Noah Webster, 1758–1843, B.A. 1778, LL.D 1823
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a standing man wearing a long coat and a cape. He looks downward with a serious expression on his face. His right hand is placed against his chest, while his left hand rests near his waist. The figure wears fitted trousers and dress shoes. He stands on a simple, square base against a plain grey background.

title: Shield
alt_text: A steel shield showing a circular shape made of six triangular segments that meet in the center. The surface is weathered and gray, with visible scratches and spots across its metal face. Each of the six segments features a small pair of rivets placed near the outer edge. A row of evenly spaced rivets runs around the entire outer rim of the shield. A small, bright yellow square tag is attached to the bottom edge.

title: Arbalest (hunting crossbow)
alt_text: A piece of arms and armor made of wood and metal shows a crossbow viewed from above. The long, horizontal body of the bow is made of dark wood and has a metallic track running down the center. A large, curved metal bow piece is attached perpendicularly near the front, stretching out to the top and bottom of the frame. Small metal components like a trigger mechanism sit in the middle of the wooden stock. A white rectangular label with handwritten text is tied to the center of the wooden stock. The entire object lies horizontally against a plain, smooth gray background.

title: Breastplate and cabasset
alt_text: A steel piece of armor showing a curved chest plate with a vertical ridge running down the center. This object is rounded and has a gray, textured surface that appears worn or pitted. A thin wire loop arcs over the top of the opening for the neck. A small, bright yellow sticker with the number 42 sits on the left side of the metal. A white tag hangs from the left shoulder area. The item sits on a flat, light-colored surface against a plain, light-gray background.

title: Ou es-tu (Where are you?)
alt_text: A painting of an abstract structure resting under a cloudy sky. The main object is a tall, pale rectangular block featuring a pattern of delicate, thin, dark lines. To the left of this block, a dark, shiny, and metallic-looking mass sits low, with a smooth red oval shape attached to its side. The ground beneath the structures is dark and appears to be made of lumpy, uneven forms. The entire painting is framed within a simple, rectangular gold-colored frame.

title: Impressions of Portugal
alt_text: A painting of an abstract composition in oil on canvas. The work is framed and features a busy, layered pattern of thin, intersecting lines. These vertical and horizontal lines form a loose grid across the surface in shades of black, dark brown, and orange. In the background, patches of off-white, yellow, and tan paint create a hazy, textured effect. Small, dense clusters of red and black strokes are scattered throughout the grid, appearing like scattered debris.

title: In the Adirondacks
alt_text: A painting of a quiet forest scene features a person leading a white ox along a dirt path. The person wears a bright red shirt and dark pants. They are walking near the bottom center of the image, surrounded by a dark, wooded landscape. Tall, leafy green and brown trees frame the scene, creating a dense backdrop of shadows. In the upper middle portion, a patch of light blue sky breaks through the dense canopy of branches. The ground is covered in grasses, dirt, and scattered rocks under the dim lighting of the woods.

title: Small Table
alt_text: A piece of furniture with one drawer shows a wooden table with four turned legs. The table has a rectangular, flat top with a worn and textured surface. A single drawer sits in the middle of the frame, featuring a simple metal pull handle in the center. Four thick, sculpted legs support the table and are connected near the bottom by an X-shaped wooden stretcher. A small, central finial rises where the stretcher bars meet in the middle. The entire object is light brown in color and sits on a flat, tan platform.

title: Armet
alt_text: A steel helmet shows a rounded headpiece with a visor covering the front. The visor has four horizontal rows of rectangular slits that create openings for eyes and air. A small, thin metal pin sticks out horizontally from the left side of the visor. The surface of the steel is gray and appears slightly weathered with some dark markings. The bottom edge of the helmet flares outward and has a thick, rope-like border.

title: Morion
alt_text: A steel piece of armor showing a helmet with a high, rounded crest. The helmet is dark gray and curved, with a prominent silver fleur-de-lis design on its side. A large, smooth, silver-colored brim curves upward over the front of the helmet. The bottom edge of the helmet features small, round brass-colored studs spaced evenly around it. It sits on a white, flat surface against a plain gray background.

title: Person Descending from a Vehicle
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a standing male figure beside a heavy, block-like object. The figure is on the left and stands on a rocky base with one leg slightly raised. He extends his right arm toward the object on the right side of the sculpture. The object on the right has a large, rounded top piece sitting on a stand with legs that seem to taper toward the floor. A separate human hand and forearm appear to emerge from the right object and connect to the hand of the standing figure. The entire sculpture is set against a plain white background.

title: Reconstruction: Red and White: Ionic
medium: Acrylic on canvas on masonite; polymer and dry pigment
alt_text: A painting shows an arrangement of sixteen square tiles laid out in a four-by-four grid. The tiles feature a repetitive pattern of solid orange shapes set against a stark white background. These orange shapes have curved, blocky edges that connect or align to form larger, abstract designs across the surface. Some sections of the white space create their own shapes, appearing as negative space between the orange blocks. The entire grid is framed by a thin, dark border that separates the composition from the background.

title: Axe
alt_text: An axe made of steel, wood, and bone stands against a plain background. The top part is a flat steel blade with a sharp, pointed spike projecting upward from the back. A long, thin handle attaches to the blade and extends downward. The handle is made of dark wood and is covered in rectangular bone inlays decorated with small, repeating geometric patterns. At the very bottom, the handle ends with a wider, carved piece of bone that curves slightly to a point.

title: Battle axe
alt_text: An arm or piece of armor made of wood and metal showing a hammer-like tool with a long handle. The long, horizontal handle is made of dark, reeded wood. Attached to the left end is a curved, metal head that points both upward and downward. A small, white identification tag hangs from the tool by a thin white string near the metal head. The entire object rests against a plain, light gray background.

title: Landscape with Factory by Lake, II
alt_text: A painting of a landscape under a deep red sky shows a small town tucked behind dark, foreground trees. A large, dark tree with rounded, blue-black leaves dominates the left side of the scene. To its right, two slender, pale pink trunks rise straight up against the vibrant, rust-colored background. In the lower left, a cluster of buildings with simple, blocky shapes sits nestled in the rolling green hills. A small, bright yellow figure lies resting on the grass in the bottom right corner of the composition.

title: Linstock
alt_text: A polearm made of steel and wood shows a long, thin shaft lying horizontally. The left end of the object features a sharp, pointed metal blade with a small, curved prong sticking out to one side. Just behind the blade, two thick, fluffy black tassels hang from the top of the shaft. The rest of the long, thin handle is dark in color and appears to be made of wood. The object is centered against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Telecommunications Forward Scatter Site, Nassau
alt_text: A painting of two large, dark, curved structures standing on a beach. These tall, dish-like shapes face upward against a cloudy, gray sky. Below them, a pale sandy area stretches across the foreground, while a low, rocky wall sits on the left side. A thin, light-colored railing runs horizontally in front of the structures, separating the sand from a thin band of green water. The entire scene is enclosed within a wide, textured, light-brown frame with gold trim.

title: Baigneuses aux Reflets
medium: Relief drawing w/ clay and oil on canvas
alt_text: A drawing of four figures seated together in a row. The figures are textured, brown, and somewhat abstract with rounded shapes. Below the figures is a large, smooth, light-brown reflection that mirrors their forms against a pale grey background. The entire artwork is held inside a wide, distressed white wooden frame. A hand is visible holding the left edge of the frame.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, blending colors fills the rectangular canvas. Deep navy blue dominates the upper section, with bold, sweeping strokes that curve across the surface. Toward the center, streaks of bright yellow and green emerge, cutting through the darkness like light filtering through water. The bottom portion transitions into lighter shades of teal and pale blue, creating a fluid, misty appearance. White highlights appear throughout the composition, suggesting movement and depth within the chaotic arrangement of paint.

title: Christmas Eve
alt_text: A painting of a large, bronze-colored bell hanging inside a stone archway at night. A bright, full moon shines through the opening, illuminating many tiny, winged figures swarming around the bell and clinging to the rope below it. Several of these small figures hold glowing lights, scattering sparkles in the dim atmosphere. Thick vines grow along the side of the dark stone walls of the tower. The scene is framed by the textured, reddish-brown bricks of the archway, creating a deep perspective looking out into the night sky.

title: The Mocking of Christ
alt_text: A painting shows a crowded indoor scene with many people gathered around a central figure. In the middle, a person wearing long white robes stands on a raised platform, gesturing with both hands. A large, diverse group of people surrounds the platform, including men, women, and children dressed in varied historical clothing. Some people in the crowd reach out toward the central figure, while others look on or converse with each other. The setting features tall, arched stone architecture that suggests the interior of a grand building.

title: A. Portrait of a Woman (recto) B. Woman with Warriors on Horseback (verso; unfinished)
alt_text: A painting of a woman with a long neck and short, dark hair. She has large, almond-shaped eyes and is wearing a simple necklace with square-shaped beads. In front of her sits a tall, slender vase with a bulbous bottom on a flat surface. Behind her, a thin, wooden stool stands on the left side with a small, rounded object resting on its seat. The background is painted in soft, pale shades of green and yellow, creating a quiet atmosphere.

title: Portrait of George Washington
alt_text: A painting of a man presented in an oval frame within a decorative, ornate gold frame. The man has short, powdered white hair and is looking slightly to his left. He wears a dark military-style coat with gold-colored shoulder epaulets and a yellow lapel. A white cravat or neckcloth is tied neatly at his neck. The portrait is set against a plain, light-brown background that fades to a darker edge within the oval.

title: Anne Sherman
alt_text: A miniature of a young woman painted on opaque white glass. She has wavy brown hair and is facing forward with a neutral expression. A black ribbon is tied snugly around her neck. She wears a white lacy collar over a bright blue bodice that features a small flower pinned to the front. The portrait is oval-shaped and framed within a dark, rectangular leather case.

title: Colin Mackensie
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a portrait of a person from the chest up. The person has fair skin, light brown hair, and wears a dark coat over a light-colored shirt or cravat. They are positioned slightly to the right of center and are looking toward the viewer with a calm expression. The background is a dark, blurry wash of brown and gray tones that surrounds the figure. A wide, ornate, gold-colored frame with intricate, carved scrollwork patterns surrounds the painting.

title: Portrait of a Woman
alt_text: A painting of an older woman wearing dark clothing against a plain, dark background. She has a round face with light skin and looks directly forward. A thick, pleated white ruff collar circles her neck. On her head, she wears a simple, translucent white cap that covers her hair. The woman's dark garment appears to be made of a smooth, heavy fabric.

title: Le Savant
alt_text: A painting of an older man with a white beard sitting in a dark room. He is wearing a dark, long-sleeved coat with a wide, light-brown fur collar and a white ruffled collar around his neck. The man wears a small, dark cap on his head and has his hands resting on his lap. He sits in a red upholstered chair placed against a dark background. The painting is set inside an ornate, gold-colored rectangular frame.

title: Portrait of an Unidentified Man
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a man’s head and shoulders faces forward. The bust is light grey in color and features a smooth, matte finish. The man has short, swept-back hair and a calm expression on his face. There are visible dark spots and vertical streaks marking the surface of his chest and nose. The figure sits on a round, pedestal-style base against a plain background.

title: The Baptism of Christ
alt_text: A painting showing several figures in a lush, wooded setting by a river. In the center, a man with long hair stands in the water, one hand raised and the other clutching his chest. To his right, a shirtless bearded man holds a small bowl above the first man's head and leans on a wooden staff. On the left, two figures in draped clothing stand near the water, one holding a white cloth. Above them, a bearded figure in pink robes floats in the clouds surrounded by a white bird. Near the bottom right corner, two white rabbits sit quietly at the water's edge.

title: A Zouave
alt_text: A painting of a man standing against a plain, mottled background. He wears a dark blue cap, a matching dark jacket with thin red trim, and full, reddish-brown trousers that hang to his calves. His hands are raised in front of him, as if holding a thin tool or brush. He has a mustache and is looking downward toward his hands. Below his trousers, he wears light-colored wraps or socks around his legs and simple dark shoes.

title: The Death of Sappho
alt_text: A painting of a small wooden boat on the water filled with five people. In the center, a group of men are lifting a woman wearing a white dress who is slumped over and partially submerged in the water. One man stands on the right side of the boat, reaching down to help carry her. To the left, an older man with a white beard sits near the stern of the boat holding an oar. In the back, a person wearing a blue cloak stands and raises one hand, looking toward the group. The background shows a dark, cloudy sky above a calm, misty sea.

title: Annette in the Studio
alt_text: A painting of a person standing in a dimly lit room. The figure is centered in the composition, rendered in loose, dark brushstrokes against a gray background. Behind the figure, a large, rectangular structure with faint lines suggests an interior space like a wall or doorway. The colors are muted shades of gray, brown, and black. A thick, ornate gold frame surrounds the entire image.

title: Rocky Coast, Monhegan Island, Maine
alt_text: A painting of a quiet coastal scene featuring a rocky shoreline and a calm sea. On the left, dark, mossy rocks and a grassy hillside slope down to the water's edge. The sea takes up the right half of the painting and reflects the light from the sky. Above the horizon, a expanse of soft, cloudy sky stretches across the entire scene. A few tiny, faint shapes of distant boats are visible on the horizon line. The painting is enclosed in a simple, rectangular wooden frame.

title: Rising Tide, Evening
alt_text: A painting of a rocky coastline overlooking the ocean. The scene is framed by dark, craggy rocks on the left and right sides of the foreground. Between the rocks, waves crash with white sea foam and light blue water. The middle distance shows a vast, rippling ocean stretching out toward the horizon. Above the water, the sky appears soft and cloudy with muted yellows and grays, suggesting either dawn or dusk. The entire painting is housed in a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: Reclining Figure Curved
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing an abstract, reclining figure lying on its side. The surface of the piece has a dark, greenish-brown color with a rough, textured finish. A small, rounded head sits at the upper left, while the body forms an elongated, curved shape that includes a large, hollowed-out section in the center. The sculpture rests on a simple, rectangular dark base that is placed against a plain light background.

title: A Grotesque Head
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture of a man's face is shown against a plain background. The face is dark in color and features deeply carved, thick hair that frames the head. The eyebrows are heavy and prominent, sitting above deep-set eyes that look forward. The nose is large and bulbous, and the mouth is a straight, thin slit. Patches of the original paint appear to be worn away across the surface of the forehead, cheeks, and chin.

title: Sudden Shower, Newbury Marshes
alt_text: A painting of a rural landscape features a wide, open field under a dark, stormy sky. Several tall, rounded haystacks sit scattered across the grassy meadow, which is bathed in a mix of bright light and shadow. In the foreground, a small, winding stream flows from left to right, where a few ducks swim in the water. To the right, a wooden cart filled with hay rests on the ground, while a pair of cows graze nearby. Thick, gray rain clouds hang heavily over the horizon, contrasting with the clear blue sky visible in the distance.

title: Elizabeth Goodwin
alt_text: A painting of a young person sitting in a chair. The child wears a bright red dress with puffy sleeves and white lace trim, and holds a small basket filled with strawberries. They sit in a dark blue, curved armchair. Two small, spotted dogs are positioned on the floor, one on each side of the chair. The background is a solid, dark color, and the floor appears to be covered by an ornate, patterned rug.

title: Boy with a Cat
alt_text: A painting shows a young boy standing and holding a cat in his arms. The boy wears a dark blue, long-sleeved shirt with a white collar and light-colored pants. He holds a solid grey cat horizontally across his chest. To his right, a white tablecloth covers a table where a green birdcage sits. Inside the cage, a small yellow bird rests on a perch. The floor has a detailed orange and gold pattern with leaf-like shapes.

title: Deep in the Forest
alt_text: A painting of oil on hydrostone shows two tall, bright green trees standing between dark purple shapes. The two trees are pointed, narrow, and look like flames or slender evergreens. Dark purple forms that resemble folded curtains or large, vertical pillars surround the trees. These purple shapes have thick, textured brushstrokes in shades of deep blue and violet. The scene is framed by a thin, light-colored wooden border.

title: Susan Cromwell
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a wooden chair. She wears a dark grey dress with puffed sleeves and holds a small, rectangular box with both hands. The woman has dark hair and sits against a plain, dark background. To her right, a wooden dresser with small drawers is partially visible. The entire scene is enclosed within an ornate, thick gold frame.

title: Deep in the Forest
alt_text: A painting of a stylized tree stands against a black background. The tree has a straight, red-orange trunk that splits into two thick branches at the top. Behind the tree, a large, rounded shape colored in shades of green forms the canopy. The tree sits on a flat, reddish-brown ground area at the bottom of the scene. A deep purple border frames the entire composition within a simple light-colored wooden frame.

title: Untitled (in the manner of Haberle)
alt_text: A painting shows a variety of flat objects tucked behind a dark blue ribbon stretched across a wooden board.
