The blue ribbon forms a rectangular frame and crosses in the center, held together by a key hanging vertically. Behind the ribbons, items like paper money, old newspaper clippings, and letters are arranged. A small framed portrait and a pair of thin-rimmed spectacles are visible in the upper right quadrant. A playing card and an envelope rest in the bottom right corner of the display.

title: I've Known This Before, The Jagged Edge, The Color Green
alt_text: A painting shows a pattern of repeating green triangles that look like a forest or a range of hills. The triangles are layered against a dark, textured background that appears at the very top. On the left side of the piece, a solid blue rectangle sits vertically against the green shapes. The entire image is surrounded by a thick, light blue border. The surface appears to be rough and textured throughout.

title: Weighing Cotton
medium: Oil and tempera on canvas mounted on wood panel
alt_text: A painting of people working in a field to gather a harvest. A group of figures is gathered around a wooden wagon, some climbing ladders to fill it with white sacks. Several large, full white sacks rest on the ground in the foreground. Other figures are scattered across the field, stooping down to pick items from the ground near small plants. In the background, a small wooden house sits under a large, soft cloud in the sky. The scene is set in an open, dry field with dirt paths winding through the landscape.

title: The Travels of the Pussy Cat King
alt_text: A rusted steel sculpture of assorted industrial parts sits on a dark, rectangular base. The main shape is a long, slightly curved metal pipe standing upright on the base. A large, five-pointed gear or star shape is attached to the top end of this pipe. A circular gear sits to the side, connected by thin, bent metal rods. A wide, thin strip of metal arches over the top of the entire piece, like a halo. The overall surface of the sculpture has a rough, textured, brown, and weathered appearance.

title: Roses
alt_text: A painting of a bouquet of roses arranged in a dark vase. The flowers are in shades of red, pink, cream, and white, with many green leaves mixed in. Several rose blossoms have fallen from the vase and rest on the table surface in the foreground. To the left of the arrangement, a light-colored curtain hangs down from the top edge. The background is a dark, indistinct brown color that makes the colors of the flowers stand out. The entire scene is enclosed within a thin, light-colored frame.

title: Glanmore
medium: Two mirrors(mirror diptych), wood, paint chemicals, ink
alt_text: A sculpture consisting of two mirrors, wood, paint, and ink, shown from an angled, close-up perspective. A dark, wooden panel dominates the upper left, appearing to be the back of the object. Along the bottom edge, there is a band of greenish material decorated with small, pale yellow dots. The entire piece is wrapped with a wide, white fabric strap that crosses diagonally from the top right toward the bottom left. The structure sits on a piece of white, rectangular foam padding, and the scene is dimly lit.

title: Untitled (Poured Picture)
alt_text: A painting shows bold red splashes and drips covering a white background. Thick, dark red paint is concentrated in the center, appearing as if it was poured or thrown downward. From this central mass, many thin red drips run vertically toward the bottom edge. To the left and right, smaller splatter marks fan out across the canvas. Faint outlines resembling handprints are visible within the red paint.

title: Untitled
medium: Wax, blood, oil paint, oilstick and vestment elements on cotton mounted on board
alt_text: A painting of vertical, stacked shapes on a mottled, pale background. Three fabric-like, bell-shaped objects are arranged down the center of the rectangular canvas. The top shape is light green, the middle one is olive green, and the bottom one is dark brown with a yellow cross design. A horizontal band crosses the middle of the painting behind these shapes. Smudges of dark red, pink, and gray paint are scattered throughout the background.

title: Untitled (Prinzendorf 1975; 50th Action)
medium: Wax, blood, oil paint, nails and pen on canvas mounted on board and wooden dowels
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and marks on a light background. Near the top, a series of red and orange horizontal lines sits above a prominent red circle enclosing a dark patch. Below this, a grey, textured splash spreads out across the center of the canvas, interspersed with thin, drawn circles. A white square containing a single red vertical streak rests near the bottom, surrounded by grey, splattered blotches. Additional colors, including yellow, orange, and purple, are visible as splashes and marks along the edges of the canvas.

title: Early Hudson
alt_text: A painting of two large, rocky mountains that rise up against a bright blue sky. The mountain on the left is angled sharply toward the center, casting a dark, deep shadow across its lower half. The mountain on the right is taller and features reddish-brown tones, with visible dark lines running across its surface like rock crevices. Both peaks lean toward each other, creating a narrow V-shaped gap in the center. The sky behind the peaks is painted in light, airy shades of blue and white.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A wire sculpture shows a dense, tangled mass of thin metallic strands. The clump of wire is shaped like an irregular, rounded mound that sits in the center of the frame. The colors consist of mixed shades of grey, copper, and dull green. These strands crisscross over each other in every direction, creating a messy, cloud-like texture. The object rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Royal Tribute
alt_text: A sculpture made of enamel on aluminum shows a cluster of curled, metallic strips. The ribbons are bundled densely at the top and fan out to the sides. Many other strips cascade down from the center, creating a long, flowing shape. The piece features vibrant shades of pink, orange, and purple mixed with bright, reflective gold strips. This object hangs against a dark metal grid screen that sits in front of a plain white wall.

title: Jonathan Leavitt (Yale 1786) (1764–1830)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory showing a portrait of a man, set inside an ornate gold frame. The man faces slightly to the left, with short, messy brown hair and pale skin. He wears a dark, high-collared coat over a white shirt with a ruffled collar. The background is a soft, pale blue sky that fades into a lighter tone behind him. The rectangular portrait sits inside a black velvet border, surrounded by a thick, carved gold frame with a circular hanging loop at the top.

title: View of the Shandaken Mountains
alt_text: A painting of a calm landscape with a large mountain in the background. The mountain is pale brown and takes up the upper middle part of the scene. Below the mountain, thick green trees create a dark border across the middle. A small, blurry figure stands near the edge of a pond in the foreground. The sky is filled with light yellow and blue clouds above the peak. Reflections from the sky shimmer on the water at the bottom of the painting.

title: Market Scene
alt_text: A painting of a crowded outdoor marketplace scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. Many people dressed in long skirts, bonnets, and layered clothing are gathered in a town square lined with tall buildings. Several vendors are crouched on the ground, surrounded by baskets filled with fruits, vegetables, and other goods. A stone cross on a pedestal stands in the center of the square, with more people clustered around it. The scene is set under a dark, dusky sky, with soft light illuminating the figures in the foreground.

title: Beach Scene
alt_text: A painting of a seascape scene shows a large wooden sailboat resting in shallow, dark water during a cloudy twilight. The sky is a mix of soft yellow, grey, and blue tones, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. In the foreground, a sandy, wet beach stretches across the bottom of the scene with dark reflections on the surface. To the right, a smaller boat sits near the shore, and a tiny, dark figure walks along the beach with a small animal. The entire scene is enclosed in a wide, ornate, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: The Deluge
medium: Pen and brown ink and blue, purplish-gray, and brown wash
alt_text: A drawing in ink and wash depicts a stormy landscape near a large body of water. A long, boxy ship with many small windows floats on the calm water in the upper left. Heavy rain falls in distinct, diagonal streaks across the sky, obscuring the horizon. In the foreground, twisted trees bend in the wind while people and animals gather near a small shelter. To the right, a rocky cliffside features a cluster of buildings with smoke rising from a chimney. People and livestock are also scattered across the lower right, walking along a path near the water's edge.

title: Study for Alba at Roundout II
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and textures in oil on canvas. The surface is dominated by a thick, white vertical rectangle centered in the middle of the composition. To the right of this central form stands a textured pillar-like shape painted in muted greens and off-white. The background consists of earthy, mixed tones of brown, deep red, and dark green that appear layered. Thick brushstrokes and palette knife marks create a rough, uneven texture throughout the entire piece.

title: Tuxedo Junction
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes features a central area of thick, reddish-brown brushstrokes. This textured patch is layered over a lighter rectangular background. A vertical yellow stripe runs along the right side of the background. To the left, a thin, L-shaped bar with blue and green stripes sits on the surface. The entire composition is framed by a wide, dark border.

title: Relict
alt_text: A painting of abstract marks and shapes on a large, off-white surface. A wide, vertical, brownish-grey stain runs down the entire left side of the canvas. On the right side, there is a vertical column of five red, circular hand-drawn marks that contain various scribbles and splashes. Scattered across the center are several blue and green hand-drawn shapes, including squares, circles, and a small stack of horizontal rainbow-colored lines. The background has subtle, faint splatters of color, giving it a weathered, textured appearance.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a person's head and shoulders against a solid dark background. The figure is colored in shades of yellow and tan, with brown lines forming its features. It is positioned in the lower right corner of the canvas. Large, flat ears extend from the sides of the head. The rest of the frame is filled with a dark, textured blue that suggests a night sky or a deep wall. The entire work is enclosed in a thin, simple wooden frame.

title: Small Schuettbild
alt_text: A painting of red oil paint splattered against a textured, light-colored background. The main shape is a concentrated splash of thick red paint located near the top center of the canvas. Long, vertical drips run down from this central mass toward the bottom edge. To the right, smaller, disconnected red spots look like spray or fingerprints. The background has a rough, woven surface texture.

title: Was macht er nun? (West)
alt_text: A painting showing a chaotic, abstract scene with thick brushstrokes in shades of brown, orange, and blue. In the center, a pale, angular shape resembles a simplified, skeletal head or helmet. Behind this shape, a cluster of tan, sausage-like forms extends upward against a background of bright, fiery orange. To the upper right, dark, pointed silhouettes suggest towers or spires. Below the center, the words "WAS MACHT ER NUN" are painted in bold, green capital letters.

title: Parteitag
alt_text: A painting of a crowded indoor scene created with thick, expressive brushstrokes. In the lower center, a figure wearing a tan shirt stands next to a microphone, with one arm raised high and pointing upward. A tall, pale wooden post stands vertically to the left of this figure. To the right, several framed canvases are stacked together on the floor or a stand. A large banner hangs diagonally across the upper part of the image, featuring text written in bold green letters. Swirls of dark brown, orange, and gray paint fill the background, giving the scene a chaotic and textured appearance.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of a plant with drooping flowers in a vase. The plant has a single, curved stem holding several small, pale, rounded blossoms that hang downward. A dark, cylindrical vase holds the plant on the right side of the frame. The background is painted in thick, textured strokes of yellow and pale green. A dark, horizontal surface supports the vase at the bottom of the scene.

title: Untitled (Wachs auf Nessel?)
alt_text: A painting in red wax shows a rectangular field filled with thick, textured layers. The entire surface is covered in various shades of deep, bright, and dark crimson. The wax appears melted and pooled, creating irregular bumps and smooth, shiny patches across the frame. Some darker, almost blackish-red areas sit near the center and the bottom, contrasting with the lighter, brighter reds near the top. The edges of the piece look rough and uneven, as if the material has dripped or been built up by hand.

title: Leigh
alt_text: A painting of two faces and several objects, captured within an oval frame. The composition features a person on the left looking toward the center, while a second, slightly shadowy face appears on the right. Below the faces sits a striped surface. To the left of the oval, a tall, thin arrangement includes a bird-like figure resting atop a dark shape. The entire image uses bold, expressive brushstrokes and a palette of black, white, and muted reddish-brown tones.

title: Vienna Secession
medium: Emulsion paint and mixed media on canvas
alt_text: A painting of red emulsion and mixed media on canvas features a thick, horizontal band of red across the center. Above and below this band, the canvas is covered in numerous splatters and stains in shades of red, dark brown, and grey. A large, dark, smudged shape dominates the upper left corner. Near the bottom, drips of red paint run down the canvas toward the edge. The texture appears uneven and varied throughout the surface.

title: Untitled (Silver Dispersion)
alt_text: A stainless steel mesh sculpture sits on a wooden floor made of light brown, rectangular slats. The object is a large, rounded mound that looks like a dense pile of tangled, thin metal wire. Its surface is irregular and textured, showing thousands of tiny, crisscrossing loops and gaps. The color of the mesh is a uniform, dull grey that contrasts with the warm tones of the floor beneath it.

title: Sheepscloth
medium: Mixed technique on cotton mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting of gray, liquid-looking material splashed across a light-colored surface. A tall, central column of thick, dark-gray paint dominates the middle of the composition. This center section is surrounded by hundreds of smaller, lighter splatters that radiate outward like a spray. The paint appears to have dripped downwards, creating vertical lines that extend toward the bottom edge of the frame. The entire image is enclosed within a simple, thin wooden frame.

title: Shoe
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture shows a single high-heeled shoe decorated with green pine branches. The shoe has a vibrant green background patterned with several round, orange and red ornaments. A bright red band lines the top opening of the shoe. The entire object rests on a textured gray surface. A small white label with a barcode lies horizontally in the foreground.

title: Sulfur-Covered Zinc Box (Plugged Corner)
medium: Two boxes of zinc sheeting, one covered with sulfur, with gauze plug
alt_text: A sculpture consisting of two rectangular, upright boxes set side by side against a plain grey background. The box on the left is made of dark, metallic zinc sheeting with a slightly worn and grey surface. To its right stands a second identical box, which is covered in a textured, light yellow sulfur coating. Both boxes are open on the front side, revealing their hollow, vertical interiors. A small, ragged piece of gauze is visible tucked into the bottom corner of the yellow box.

title: TM
medium: Oil and mixed media on canvas
alt_text: A painting of oil and mixed media on canvas shows an abstract composition with a rough, textured surface. A thick, raised line of bright red paint snakes vertically through the center of the canvas in a wavy pattern. The background is covered in many small, colorful splotches of paint, including light purple, pink, and yellow. A single, distinct yellow cross shape is positioned to the right of the red line. The overall surface appears bumpy and layered, with some areas looking like they are speckled with small debris.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture showing a jagged, blocky chunk of wood with a vibrant, deep purple surface. The object is roughly triangular in shape with several flat, angled sides and sharp edges. Deep, straight lines are carved into the surface, creating an intricate, fractured pattern across its face. A few small patches of brown wood texture show through where the purple paint has worn away near the top. The sculpture rests on a pale, textured surface, just behind a rectangular white label with a barcode printed on it.

title: Green Violin and Telephone S--------R (Sender--------Receiver)
medium: Violin with paint, two tin cans, string, and paper
alt_text: A sculpture made of a violin, tin cans, string, and paper shows a musical instrument resting beside a homemade telephone. The bright green violin lies on its back on a smooth, grey surface, with its neck pointing toward the right. To its left sit two cylindrical, metallic tin cans of similar size. A thin, off-white string connects the top of one can to the violin and also leads to a small, rectangular piece of paper resting on the ground. A prominent red cross symbol is painted on the side of the closer tin can. The entire scene is set against a plain, light grey background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture shows a tall, upright, abstract block of wood with a rough texture. The object is divided into several sections of different colors, including red, yellow, and blue. A large, tan, unpainted section covers the lower middle part of the sculpture. The top of the block is flat and painted black. The entire piece stands vertically against a plain gray background.

title: Black Head
medium: Oil and grease crayon on canvas
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured shapes and heavy drips of paint. A large, thick vertical mass of black dominates the center of the canvas. This central area has a rough, uneven texture that looks like layered paint. Streaks of tan, white, and a hint of red appear in the background behind the black paint. Thin, dark lines made by crayon or paint drag across the surface in various directions.

title: Bildnis Holger Friedrich (Portrait of Holger Friedrich)
alt_text: A painting of a man's face from the chest up. The man has short, dark hair and light skin, and he is looking directly at the viewer. His features are somewhat blurry and softened as if seen through a haze or a filter. He is seated inside what appears to be a car, with the rear window and a headrest visible behind him. The lighting is cool and dim, giving the entire scene a somewhat somber mood.

title: Panel of linen embroidered in wool
alt_text: An embroidered textile shows a repeating, dark-colored geometric pattern on a light, off-white background. The design features horizontal bands filled with intricate shapes, including diamonds, small birds, and decorative lines. Several vertical, rectangular columns extend downward from the central embroidered band, creating open, plain spaces between them. A final, narrower band of dark, scrolled embroidery runs along the bottom edge, just above the fringe. A thick, black fringe hangs from the very bottom of the fabric, which also has a thin line of red thread visible near the hem.

title: Actor
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a person with dark, wavy hair. The person rests their chin on their right hand and looks toward the right side of the frame with a neutral expression. They wear a garment with a textured, light-colored collar and a textured blue sleeve. The background is a solid, muted reddish-brown color. The artwork is set in a simple, rectangular frame with a dark wood outer edge and a textured, gilded inner border.

title: Seated Lady
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a woman sitting in profile. She has dark hair styled up and wears a pale, soft-colored dress decorated with floral accents. A blue cloth drapes over her lap, and her hands rest gently on the arm of a simple chair. She sits against a hazy, indistinct background of soft greens and greys. The entire portrait is framed in a thin, rectangular metal frame with decorative etching and a small hanging loop at the top.

title: Lady with Pink Roses
alt_text: A miniature painting of a woman in watercolor on ivory. The woman has dark, pinned-up hair and is looking down and to the left. She wears a light-colored top featuring a prominent pink rose pinned near her chest. Her expression is soft and gentle. The background consists of hazy, blended strokes of pale green and cream tones that create a blurry effect around her.

title: Little Boy
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting shows the head and shoulders of a young child with blonde hair. The child is framed within a small circle and looks off to the left with a serious expression. Their hair is shoulder-length and wavy. The artwork is mounted on a larger, plain, cream-colored rectangular background. A simple, light gray textured frame surrounds the entire piece.

title: American Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a concrete spillway and a large stone bridge. The smooth, tan concrete curves through the center of the image, leading the eye toward the horizon. On the right, a series of stepped concrete ledges descends along the curved path. A tall, beige bridge with dark, arched openings towers on the left side of the scene. In the background, rolling green hills and brown mountains stretch across the horizon under a clear blue sky. A small patch of bright blue water is visible near the mountains on the right.

title: Two Tone Reverse Squid
alt_text: A painting of dark, textured forms on a white background, encased within a tall black wooden frame. The artwork is composed of many thick, horizontal black lines made of looped material that span across most of the surface. These dark, interconnected shapes create a jagged, woven pattern that runs vertically down the center. Toward the bottom, the black shapes taper inward and pull away from the edges of the white background. The entire rectangular piece is oriented vertically and appears to be mounted on a light-colored wall.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of painted dots and markings layered over a fabric surface with a plaid pattern. The background fabric features horizontal and vertical stripes in shades of red, dark blue, and cream. Scattered across the center and sides are numerous orange circles of varying sizes, resembling splashes of paint. Near the middle, two thick, dark curved shapes hang downward like heavy eyelids or dripping ink, with vertical lines running from them toward the bottom. Faint, hazy patches of purple and yellow are blended directly onto the plaid fabric behind these markings. The overall composition combines rigid grid lines of the textile with looser, organic paint splatters.

title: Saint Gregory the Great
alt_text: A painting showing a man with a stern expression holding an open book. He wears a pink cap on his head and a robe with a bright yellow or gold sash. His right hand is raised near his head and holds a thin, pencil-like object. The man is looking down intently at the pages of the book he holds with both hands. The background is a soft, muted blue color, and the entire scene is framed within a circle.

title: Walter Stewart (1756-1796)
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a military uniform, standing in the foreground. He has pale skin, light hair, and wears a dark blue coat with red accents over a white vest and pants. His right hand is tucked inside his coat, and his left hand rests on his hip near a hat he is holding. In the background, a large grassy area features several small white tents and groups of people. A large, dark tree stands to the left of the man, and the sky appears cloudy and dim.

title: The First Post Cubist Collage
alt_text: A painting of light-colored, textured material features a pattern of nested, red, diamond-shaped lines. These lines originate from a small square in the center and expand outward in a repeating geometric pattern. Each red line runs parallel to the others, creating a symmetrical design that fills the entire square surface. The background looks like woven, coarse fiber with a neutral gray or beige tone. Faint, straight lines also intersect the center horizontally and vertically, cutting through the diamond shapes.

title: The Muse
alt_text: A painting of a figure standing against a solid light green background. The figure appears dark and ghostly, with its arms slightly outstretched to the sides. A red circular shape floats to the left of the figure's head, and a darker oval shape sits to the right. Below the figure, there is a red blocky form that looks like a stand or platform. A thin, dark line angles across the bottom right corner of the painting. The entire scene is framed in a simple, gold-colored border.

title: Study of Sunset (a) [recto]; Landscape with Figure (b) [verso]
alt_text: A painting showing a landscape at sunset or sunrise. On the left side, a dark, rocky hill rises up with a bare, leafless tree near its top. The center of the painting features a bright, golden-yellow light shining just above the horizon. To the right, lower hills or mountains roll into the distance with shades of green and purple. Dark, heavy clouds fill most of the upper sky, framing the bright light below. The painting is encased in an ornate, gold-colored rectangular frame.

title: Landscape with Little Girl
alt_text: A painting of a large, leafy tree standing in a grassy field. The tree has thick, dark branches and many green leaves with small specks of red. To the right of the tree's trunk, a person wearing a pale head covering and dark clothing sits on the ground. The background is filled with a dense cluster of other trees and bushes in deep shades of green. Above, the sky is cloudy with soft, muted tones of gray and white. A signature is visible in the bottom left corner of the scene.

title: Motorcycle
alt_text: A painting of a dark, abstract shape set against a bright teal background. The central figure is made of thick, heavy black and brown brushstrokes that form a tangled, mechanical mass. Large, dark lines crisscross the frame, suggesting wheels or spokes partially hidden within the clutter. The paint appears to be applied thickly, creating a rough and textured surface. The entire composition is contained within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Pickle In and Out
alt_text: A painting of a carcass resting on a chair against a plain, light-gray background. The animal carcass lies horizontally, showing patches of pale, reddish flesh mixed with areas of gray and brown fur. Its legs dangle downward toward the lower right side of the frame. The chair is drawn with simple, thin lines in a dark color and appears to be a basic wooden style. The entire scene is enclosed within a simple wooden frame.

title: Still Life (Flower in Water)
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a simple, muted composition with a textured, greenish-brown background. In the lower center, a faint, translucent rectangle suggests the shape of a vase or glass. A thin, curved line rises from this shape, ending in a messy, off-white blob at the top right. The entire surface has a thick, uneven texture with visible brushstrokes. A dark, thin blue line runs horizontally across the bottom, hinting at a tabletop surface. The painting is enclosed in a thin, light-colored wooden frame.

title: David with the Head of Goliath
alt_text: A painting of a young, shirtless person holding a dark, severed head in his left hand. He holds a long, straight sword over his shoulder with his right hand, and a bright red cloth flows out behind him. On the ground in the lower left, a large, headless body lies facedown, wrapped in purple and white robes. Patches of dark red blood are visible on the ground where the head was severed. The background displays a wide, open landscape with faint mountains and a group of distant soldiers gathered under a cloudy sky.

title: Untitled (Figure Form)
alt_text: A painting made of linoleum collage shows an abstract composition set against a flat, pale blue background. Several large, irregular shapes made of black, white, and tan material are layered together in the center. Small, rectangular strips of wood or plastic connect these larger shapes in various places. Some of the white shapes have rounded edges, while the black sections appear as darker voids between them. A small white label with black numbers sits at the very bottom edge of the blue frame.

title: Single Stack #3
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes is set within a thick, textured frame. The central area features a vertical, dark, and textured element that resembles a brushstroke or quill angled toward the top right. Below this, a rectangular block painted in shades of yellow and black sits at a diagonal angle against a grey background. The frame surrounding the piece appears to be made of rough, light-colored wood with a small, green-painted panel on the upper left corner. Below the artwork, a white label displays the black-inked number 1991.145.1.

title: Summit, Central Pacific Railroad, California
medium: Oil on paper mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a wintry mountain landscape during the day. A tall, reddish-brown tree stands prominently on the left side of the scene. The background features a steep, rocky cliff partially covered with white snow. In the foreground, several large, dark grey boulders sit scattered among patches of snow and small, low bushes. The sky above the mountains is a clear, light blue.

title: New England Landscape
alt_text: A painting shows a peaceful autumn landscape scene framed by a decorative gold border. A calm river flows horizontally across the bottom half of the frame, reflecting the trees and sky above. Dense forests with changing fall foliage in shades of orange, yellow, and green line the riverbank. The sky above is a soft, light blue with wispy, scattered clouds. The painting is enclosed in a rectangular, ornate wooden frame with carvings at the corners.

title: Independence Day
alt_text: A painting of a group of young children playing together in a dark room. Most of the children wear simple white or brightly colored pointed paper hats and old-fashioned clothing. Several of the boys hold wooden sticks as if they are marching or guarding the area, while others hold round metal pans and utensils like musical instruments. Behind them stands a large, wooden structure with a screw-like column, suggesting a rustic workshop or cellar. One child near the center holds a flag, and another on the right uses a broom as if it were a weapon or tool. The dim, earthy lighting highlights the children’s faces against the shadowy background.

title: Chimborazo Volcano
alt_text: A painting of an old, ruined stone tower standing on a hill during a sunset. The tall tower is weathered and partly glowing with a bright pink and orange light. To the right, a large, snow-capped mountain rises in the distance under a purple and hazy sky. In the foreground, a small river flows past a stone bridge nestled among dark, thick trees. A tiny, white animal stands on the rocky riverbank near the tower's base.

title: On the Saw Mill River
alt_text: A painting of a rural landscape features a calm lake nestled between grassy hills and autumn trees. In the foreground, a dark meadow stretches across the bottom, with a few small cattle grazing near the center. To the left, several trees show leaves in shades of bright red, yellow, and green. On the right side, rolling hills rise up and fade into the soft blue sky. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, ornate gold frame with intricate carved patterns.

title: The Organ Grinder (The Strolling Musician)
alt_text: A painting of an indoor scene featuring a group of people gathered in a room. To the left, a man sits at a table near a fireplace while a woman serves food. In the center, a man holding a small, box-like instrument stands next to an older man and a woman holding a baby. A small monkey wearing a red jacket performs on the floor in front of them, watched by a young boy crouching nearby. On the right side, two young men lean against an open doorway looking into the room. The room is decorated in warm, earthy tones with a window covered by a light curtain and various items hanging on the walls.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a calm river flowing through a grassy field with trees and a hazy sky. A single small boat sits on the right bank near a cluster of tall green trees. In the distance, the landscape opens up into a wide, flat meadow where a few tiny, indistinct shapes graze. The water reflects the soft, light-filled sky above, creating a mirror effect on the surface. To the left, rolling hills are visible in the far background under a pale, cloudy horizon.

title: Utilizing a Spare Moment
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting inside a cluttered, dimly lit wooden structure. The man, who has a thick beard and light-colored clothes, is focused on working with a piece of leather in his lap. To his left stands a large wooden press, and to his right are several stacked wooden barrels. The ground around him is made of wooden planks and covered with various tools and loose straw. A small pipe hangs from his mouth as he looks down at his task. The scene is filled with shadows, with most of the light focused on the man.

title: Tropical Uplands
alt_text: A painting of a vast, misty mountain valley scene. Green, rolling hills fill the lower half of the frame with a winding dirt path running through them. Several small, simple buildings sit quietly on the grassy slopes. A tall palm tree stands prominently in the foreground on the left, framing the view. The massive, hazy mountains rise in the distance, partially hidden by soft clouds and a darkening sky.

title: Mare and Colt in a Marsh
alt_text: A painting of a vast, open landscape under a cloudy, overcast sky. In the foreground, a large, dark green tree stands on the left side near a small patch of water. A white horse and a smaller dark brown foal stand together in the center of the grassy field, facing away from the viewer. To the right, several large, rounded haystacks are scattered across the flat, brown and green meadow. The distant background shows a low, rolling ridge of hills under the heavy, grey clouds.

title: Sunset, Newport Marshes
alt_text: A painting of a quiet landscape at sunset, enclosed in an ornate gold frame. A narrow river winds through the center of the scene, reflecting the soft light from the sky above. On the banks of the river, several dark, rounded haystacks sit scattered across the flat, grassy ground. The sky fills the upper half of the composition and is painted in shades of pale blue and soft, glowing pink. The overall colors of the landscape are muted and hazy, giving the scene a calm and dim atmosphere.

title: Moonrise
alt_text: A painting of a dark landscape at twilight. A glowing yellow moon sits low on the horizon, partially obscured by a group of dark trees. In the foreground, a single person in a small boat floats on a calm, dark body of water. A faint reflection of the moon shimmers on the water's surface near the boat. The rest of the scene is cast in deep, muted tones of brown, green, and blue.

title: The Sugar Camp (also known as Making Maple Sugar or Susan Ray's Maple Sugaring Kitchen)
alt_text: A painting showing two men working outside in a snowy forest. On the left, a man wearing a dark hat and light-colored shirt stirs a large, black pot over a small fire. To the right, a second man leans back against a large, wooden barrel, wearing a bright red shirt and a dark hat. Behind them, the ground is covered in patches of white snow and dark, bare tree trunks. The overall scene is dim and colored in shades of brown and gray.

title: Lake Champlain
alt_text: A painting of a vast, sunny landscape view from a high vantage point. In the foreground, two thin, golden-leafed trees stand near large gray boulders on a grassy hill. Below these trees, a wide valley stretches out, filled with dark green trees and patches of open land. A calm, wide river flows horizontally across the middle distance, reflecting the soft light of the sky. The background shows hazy, blue-toned hills that fade into the distance under a pale, clear sky.

title: Beach Scene (or Sunday on the Beach)
alt_text: A painting shows a busy beach scene filled with many people playing near the water. In the foreground, three young children in white clothes stand or crouch in the shallow waves. To the right, another small child in a red dress sits in the water. Behind them, a large group of people in dark clothing stands along the shoreline near the ocean. The background displays a calm, light blue sea under a pale sky, with a thin line of distant buildings visible along the horizon.

title: Market Stall with Fruit and Two Peasant Ladies
alt_text: A painting of two women in a street market, surrounded by an abundance of fruit. One woman stands on the right, facing a seated woman who holds a piece of fruit on the left. The scene is filled with bowls and baskets brimming with various fruits like grapes, peaches, and berries resting on a wooden table. The standing woman wears a dark vest over an orange-sleeved dress and a white head covering. Behind them, the background shows the stone walls and arched doorways of buildings in a town. The painting is framed in a thick, dark wooden frame.

title: Portrait of a Lady in Pink
alt_text: A painting of a woman in profile, looking off to the left. She has dark hair styled high on her head and is wearing a simple necklace. Her dress has red and white stripes with puffy sleeves. She holds her hands near her chest, partially covering her clothing. The woman is set against a dark, plain background. The painting is framed in a heavy, ornate gold frame.

title: Duet
alt_text: A painting of a perforated, grey, square panel on a canvas surface. The panel features a tight, repeating grid pattern made of hundreds of small, uniform circular holes. Two vertical sections near the center of the grid appear slightly darker, creating a subtle contrast against the rest of the surface. The entire square rests against a dark, metallic background that looks like storage drawers. A small, rectangular white label with black text is tucked just below the bottom edge of the painting.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a large, salmon-pink shape with an irregular outline. This shape has a curved bottom edge and vertical sides, appearing like a wide, flattened circle. A dark, thin line traces the entire perimeter of this form. The central area is a solid, uniform color. The background surrounding this painted shape is plain white.

title: Untitled
medium: Automobile lacquer (Rallye Metallic Violet) on mild steel rod
alt_text: A metal sculpture shows several thin, dark, rectangular frames sitting on a hallway floor. These frames are open on the top and sides, created from thin rods that trace the shape of low benches or open boxes. They are arranged in a line along the right side of the hallway, receding into the distance toward a bright doorway. The floor is made of large, rectangular tiles that create long, dark lines extending into the background. To the left, a solid, dark wall creates a strong shadow, while a lighter, blank wall borders the frames on the right. A ceiling with a triangular pattern is visible in the distance above the white doorway.

title: Appearances
alt_text: A painting shows a flat, abstract composition with large areas of muted, neutral colors. The background is divided into three horizontal bands of grey, light grey, and a darker grey at the very bottom. A large, dark brown triangle shape sits in the lower right corner, pointing upwards. Scattered across the center and upper right are three smaller, curved shapes in shades of white and silver. These small shapes appear to float against the large, plain grey background area.

title: She Came from Here
medium: Acrylic, watercolor, and thread on canvas
alt_text: A painting of concentric shapes displays layers of colorful patterns on a square canvas. Bright, zigzagging rings radiate outward from a small, diamond-shaped center point. Each band of color, including shades of purple, blue, orange, yellow, and black, is outlined with dark stitching. The background texture appears uneven, suggesting that watercolor and acrylic paint have bled into the fabric. The entire design is contained within a solid black border.

title: Work of Art (to the Jazz Messengers)
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes arranged in a circle against a black background. The main shape is a large circle divided into four distinct sections colored in dark green, dark red, and deep purple. A white, thin V-shaped line sits within the upper left section. A curved, gold-colored line traces the right side of the circle, connecting the top to the bottom. The entire composition appears to be split horizontally in the middle.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of two dark, indistinct figures huddled together against a reddish-brown background. The figures are positioned centrally and have thick, black hair or head coverings with a prominent yellow band across their foreheads. Below their heads, their bodies and clothing are suggested by rough, textured strokes of grey and brown paint. A muted, light-green border frames this central orange panel. The entire painting is held within a plain, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Two Figures with Doves
alt_text: A painting of two identical figures with brown skin and dark curly hair. Each figure has a long, purple, snake-like body covered in white dots and geometric patterns. They are placed side-by-side against a vibrant blue background filled with a dense, leafy pattern of black leaves. Three stylized white birds with long tails are interspersed throughout the upper half of the image. The painting is framed in a metallic, textured border.

title: Jungle Scene
alt_text: A painting of a dense, colorful jungle landscape filled with various animals. The scene is packed with bright green foliage, large patterned leaves, and tall trees under a light blue sky. Several animals are visible nestled among the plants, including zebras, tigers, a grey elephant, and spotted giraffes. The animals are scattered throughout the foreground and middle ground, with some partially hidden by the thick vegetation. Small, colorful birds fly near the top of the scene among the tree branches.

title: CLEAN UP
medium: Sponges with dye on wood pedestal
alt_text: A sculpture of a large pile of dyed sponges rests on a wooden pedestal. The sponges are varying shades of red, ranging from bright orange-red to deep burgundy and purple. Each individual sponge is textured with porous, irregular surfaces and appears to be rounded or clumped together in the shape of a small mountain. The pedestal is a simple rectangular wooden box that sits on a light-colored wooden floor. The entire arrangement creates a dense, colorful cluster that sits centrally on the flat surface.

title: Jule Quartz
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and light patterns set within a wide, gold-colored frame. The background of the painting is a mix of deep oranges, browns, and dark blues that blend together. On the right side, a bright, star-like shape bursts outward with white lines radiating into the surrounding space. Several dark, linear streaks cut diagonally across the scene, overlapping the colored areas. The painting is mounted on a textured, dark grid or chain-link background, and a small, illegible signature appears in the bottom right corner.

title: Air II
alt_text: A painting shows a large, dark circular shape centered near the top of the canvas. This dark blob is surrounded by thick, messy brushstrokes in shades of gray. The gray paint covers most of the background, creating a textured appearance. A small white mark appears just below the dark circle, adding contrast to the scene. The paint strokes are applied loosely across the entire surface.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting shows two white, side-by-side shapes outlined in thick grey brushstrokes. Each shape contains a grid of small, dark grey marks that look like short, horizontal brushstrokes. Below the grids, a rectangular section on each side is filled with a pattern of broken, horizontal dashes in a lighter grey. The entire composition sits against a plain, off-white background. The edges of the outlined shapes are slightly uneven and rounded.

title: Hilltown (Roma).
medium: Oil on paper on Masonite panel
alt_text: A painting of a stacked, abstract structure against a tan background. The central shape is made of two main layers that look like heavy, lumpy forms piled on top of each other. The bottom layer is a dark, reddish-brown color, while the top layer is a lighter, muted pink. Bold, dark, sketchy lines outline the entire structure, giving it a rough and uneven appearance. Several smaller, blocky shapes in bright orange, magenta, and dark purple sit on the very top of the structure like scattered building blocks.

title: Table and Stretchers
alt_text: A painting of several objects arranged on and below a shelf against a blue background. On the black shelf, there are two chunky, rock-like forms colored with patches of white, gray, and brown. Next to these rocks, a reddish-brown container holds several tall, thin, spoon-shaped tools. Below the shelf, a support structure made of angular, tan and red metal-looking plates creates a geometric pattern. The metal plates are decorated with rows of small, dark dots that look like rivets.

title: Portrait of Andrew Jackson
alt_text: A painting of a man shows his head and shoulders against a dark, cloudy background. The man has short, light gray hair swept back from his face, and he is looking directly ahead. He wears a dark, heavy coat with wide lapels over a high, white collared shirt or neck wrap. The man has a serious expression and a light skin tone. The entire portrait is encased in a simple, metallic-colored frame.

title: New England Inlet with Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a calm riverside landscape at sunset. In the foreground, a person sits on the grass on the left, sketching while looking toward the water. Two large, brown cows rest and stand in the grassy field near the center. To the right, a single, tall tree with leafy branches stands near the riverbank. Further out on the smooth, pale water, a small sailboat glides along while a distant boat with a rower appears on the left. The sky glows with soft orange and pink light above gentle, rolling hills in the distance.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of oil and collage on canvas shows an abstract composition of varied rectangular shapes. The surface is divided into several sections colored in shades of white, gray, beige, and red. Near the center, a small square contains a dark, textured pattern. A thin, horizontal red line cuts across the right side of the canvas. The entire work is enclosed within a simple, thin metal frame.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes in shades of grey, blue, black, and tan. A large, grey background fills most of the space. Several vertical and horizontal shapes in bright blue are painted along the edges and near the center. Dark, charcoal-colored patches are scattered throughout, blending into the surrounding colors. Towards the bottom, a few tan and brown forms break up the grey areas. The thick brushstrokes make the colors look layered and textured.

title: Lighthouse at Camden, Maine
alt_text: A painting of a sailing ship and a lighthouse at sunset. A large ship with tall masts and gathered sails sits on the left side of the frame in calm, dark water. Near the shore on the right, a tall, thin lighthouse stands atop a large, rocky island. The sky is a gradient of deep blue at the top that fades into soft orange and pink light near the horizon. In the lower left, a person is rowing a small wooden boat away from the larger ship. The overall scene is quiet and dimly lit as if the sun has just set or is about to rise.

title: The Comber
alt_text: A painting of an ocean wave crashing against a rocky shore. The wave is large and cresting with white foam, taking up most of the center and left side of the scene. The water is a mix of deep greens and lighter shades of blue. In the lower-left corner, dark, jagged brown rocks jut out into the water. Above the churning water, the sky is a flat, muted gray, suggesting a cloudy or stormy day.

title: Shirt of silk cloth trimmed with embroidery
alt_text: A silk textile in the form of a long-sleeved shirt is laid flat against a light background. This garment is light cream in color and appears to be made of a thin, slightly wrinkled, and semi-transparent fabric. Vertical rows of delicate pleats or gathers run down the length of the shirt on both the front and the sleeves. Around the rounded neckline and down the center of the chest, there is decorative trim in a darker, brownish-gold color. A small black rectangular tag with white numbers sits at the bottom edge of the image.

title: Reflections on the Gift
alt_text: A painting of a geometric composition that features a fragmented, close-up view of a hand. The hand is covered in a pattern of small, brown dots on a tan background, with thick black outlines defining its shape and knuckles. Surrounding the hand are abstract, overlapping shapes in bright, flat colors like yellow, green, blue, and black. Some areas of the background are filled with diagonal blue or black stripes, while others are filled with gradients of dots that fade from dense to sparse. The entire image has a sharp, printed appearance with high-contrast colors and bold lines.

title: Pregnant Girl in Red
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in front of a table. She has dark hair tied back and is wearing a long-sleeved, bright red shirt. Her hands are placed gently over her stomach. The background is painted in muted shades of gray and blue, which makes her red shirt stand out. The entire scene is framed in a simple, light-colored wooden border.

title: Untitled [Dark grey, dark to light]
alt_text: A painting of a solid square surface in a muted, creamy light gray color fills the entire frame. The texture appears smooth and uniform across the flat face of the object. Subtle shifts in tone suggest a soft glow that is slightly brighter toward the bottom edge. A small, dark number string is printed in the bottom left corner against the white background.

title: The Answer Is No
alt_text: A painting of many rectangular frames standing in a field or landscape. These frames are various sizes, colors, and heights, and they are scattered across the foreground and background. Some frames are empty outlines while others hold solid, flat panels that look like blank boards. The ground below appears to be a dark, flat surface with crisscrossing lines. Above this arrangement, the sky is a muted, brownish-grey color. The overall scene feels very structured and rigid, with sharp angles dominating the composition.

title: Jean Vatout: The Stubborn One
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man’s head and chest shows a rough, textured surface. The man’s face appears heavy with closed eyes and a wide, firm mouth. His hair is short and slicked back, with uneven ridges across the top of his head. He wears a shirt with a collar that folds down to his shoulders. The material has a dark, mottled brown color that varies in tone across his features.

title: Irene
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting at a table with her chin resting on her hands. The background is a bright, solid green color. She wears a green long-sleeved shirt and has her brown hair pulled back. On the orange tabletop in front of her lies a raw, cleaned fish and a bunch of green onions. To the left, a red bag hangs on the wall, filled with leafy green vegetables.

title: Intérieur
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract interior scene with furniture. A prominent dark green chair sits in the foreground, with patterned, reddish-purple fabric on its arms and back. Behind the chair, a long table or mantlepiece spans the middle area, topped by a bright, flat orange rectangle. To the right, tall, jagged blue shapes stand like statues or vases against the background. The entire image uses textured brushstrokes and a muted color palette of greens, purples, and deep oranges.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a man's face, shown from the chest up. The man has a tanned, brownish complexion and appears to have short, dark hair. His facial features are painted with loose, expressive brushstrokes in shades of brown and dark green. He wears a dark, indistinct garment over his shoulders. The background is a mix of dark, muted greens and browns that suggest a shadowed space behind him. The entire portrait is framed by a thin, plain metal border.

title: Eurydice
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a figure stands tall, resembling a mannequin or a doll. The figure has a smooth, bald head with carved facial features like eyes and a mouth. Below the head, a solid torso connects to a lower section made of several long, vertical wooden slats. These slats hang down from the waist, creating a cage-like skirt effect. The entire structure is made of dark, aged wood and sits against a plain background.

title: Early Autumn
alt_text: A painting of an open landscape in the autumn, featuring fields and rolling hills under a bright, cloudy sky. A large tree with golden-yellow leaves stands prominently on the left side of the foreground. On the right side, another tree displays vibrant red foliage, contrasting with the brownish-green grass and low bushes covering the ground. In the distance, a grassy hill rises up, dotted with a few smaller trees and faint shapes of grazing animals. The sky above is a light blue with scattered, fluffy white clouds.

title: America's Darker Moments
medium:
Cast tin figures with paint
Vitrine: wood, glass, plexiglass, florescent lights, rubber-lined electrical cord
alt_text: A sculpture display case stands on a tall, square wooden pedestal with four thin legs. The pedestal is dark brown wood, and it is braced by horizontal bars near the bottom. Above the legs sits a glass and plexiglass vitrine enclosure, which glows with interior light. Inside the case, rows of small figures are visible. A small, rectangular white tag hangs from one of the front legs of the stand. The entire object rests on a white, textured base.

title: Square of cotton, embroidered
alt_text: A cotton, satin, and silk textile displays a symmetrical, embroidered design in various colors against a plain beige background. At the center is a large, rounded floral motif surrounded by yellow and orange flame-like patterns. Two large birds with white bodies and dark spots sit on either side of the bottom half, facing outward. Below the central floral shape, two small, stylized figures hold a pitcher between them. Two long, curved shapes resembling feathers or leaves frame the top left and right corners. A small black sign with white numbers rests on a white foam support along the bottom edge.

title: Thunderstorm
alt_text: A painting of red, fluffy shapes floating against a dark blue background. These shapes look like clouds or perhaps thick, textured bursts of color. A diagonal blue band cuts across the painting, covered in many thin, vertical lines. These short white lines create the effect of falling rain across the entire scene. The paint appears thickly applied in circular motions throughout the reddish areas.

title: Les six jours ou la patineuse
alt_text: A painting of a dancer in a vibrant red dress posed in the center of a brightly lit room. The dancer has dark, short hair and wears a flowing gown with long, wing-like sleeves that stretch outward. Sharp, angular beams of white light cut across the background, creating a sense of movement. In the back, blurred shapes suggest an audience or furniture in a crowded hall. The scene uses swirling brushstrokes and geometric patterns to emphasize the energy of the dance.

title: Bird's Horns
medium:
Polychromed welded steel and raffia
3 pieces
alt_text: A sculpture of three tall, thin figures made from steel and raffia stands against a pale wall. Each figure features a long, slender pole that rests on a base made of flat metal shapes. The tops of these poles hold complex, angular structures decorated with light-colored, fringe-like material that hangs downward. The sculpture on the left has a wide, curved top section with a patterned design. The middle figure is the shortest and has a more compact headpiece. The piece on the far right has a vertical, rectangular top element and a small hook extending from its side.

title: Late Sudden Brightness
alt_text: A painting of a landscape depicts a rolling, open field beneath a dramatic, cloudy sky. The lower half of the image shows dark green and brown land, suggesting hills or fields with patches of brush and rocky ground in the foreground. Above the horizon line, the sky fills the upper portion of the frame with thick, swirling clouds. These clouds are painted in shades of cream, gray, and pale yellow, creating a sense of movement. The scene is enclosed in a simple, rectangular wooden frame that has a muted brown tone.

title: Woman Reading
alt_text: A painting of two people sitting together in muted, earthy tones. In the foreground, a figure with dark hair leans forward while looking down at a paper or book held in their hands. Behind them sits a second person, whose upper body and head are faintly visible against the background. The colors are mostly shades of tan, brown, and soft grey. The overall image has a somewhat blurry, indistinct quality.

title: Rabbits
alt_text: A painting of two rabbits in a wooden frame. The scene is set in a dark, grassy area with tall, thin, leafless sticks rising in the background. One rabbit sits in the foreground, facing towards the left, with its brown and tan fur catching the light. A second rabbit is positioned slightly behind and to the left of the first, with its alert ears pointing upward. Green, leafy plants grow in the lower left corner near the rabbits. The entire image is encased in a simple, metallic gold-colored frame.

title: Head in the Trees 2,942,771
alt_text: A sculpture of a large, oval-shaped human face painted in light, fleshy pink enamel. The face is positioned horizontally, with the eyes and nose oriented sideways. Large, round eyes with pinkish centers stare directly forward from the center of the oval. Below the eyes, a simple, stylized nose leads down to a small, outlined mouth. The background is a dark, concrete-like floor, suggesting the object is in a storage or gallery workspace.

title: Cowboy Saddle Light
alt_text: A sculpture of wood, canvas, glass, and aluminum stands against a dark background. It features a tall, branching wooden pole that acts as a stand for several dangling objects. At the very top, a multi-colored hat sits perched on a branch. A large, spherical shape made of canvas with colored panels hangs from the upper branches, held in place by a metal frame. Below this, a small, light-colored stool hangs in the air near the wooden base of the stand. A round, patterned ball also dangles near the bottom of the structure.

title: Rouen
alt_text: A painting of a city landscape is displayed in an ornate gold frame. The scene shows a wide river flowing through a town, seen from a high vantage point. A stone bridge stretches across the water, leading toward a cluster of buildings on a small island in the center. On the right side, a grassy hill slopes down toward the riverbank. The colors are muted and soft, with hazy blues, grays, and earthy greens suggesting an overcast day.

title: Untitled (narrow corner piece)
medium: Grey 1/32 inch diameter cord and wire
alt_text: A sculpture of wire shows a single, long, rectangular pole hanging against a plain light green background. This pole is narrow and stands vertically in the center of the image. Two thin lines extend horizontally from the top of the pole to the edges of the frame. A single, even thinner line drops vertically from the bottom of the pole toward the bottom of the image. The entire arrangement looks like a sparse drawing floating in space.

title: Red Vantage
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes set against a dark red background. The center of the canvas features a dense cluster of dark black paint. Bright streaks of yellow, white, blue, and green appear layered into this dark texture. The paint is applied thickly, creating a rough and raised surface. These colorful marks sit alongside the black paint in overlapping lines and patches.

title: Dance
alt_text: A painting shows a series of dark, triangular shapes scattered across a tan, rectangular background. These shapes resemble the flat bottom plates of irons and have small holes or scorch marks on their surfaces. Most of the shapes are dark brown or black, though one near the top is a lighter, textured grey color. The tan background looks like stretched fabric, with stitched edges running around the entire perimeter. The triangular shapes appear to float or drift downward from the top right toward the lower left.

title: Benno Charles Schmidt, Jr. 1942-, B.A. 1963, J.D. 1966, President of Yale 1986–1992
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a dark suit and a white shirt with a navy blue tie. He stands facing forward with a relaxed posture and his right hand resting on his hip. His left hand rests on the edge of a dark wooden table with two thick, dark books stacked on top of it. He wears thin glasses and has short, reddish-brown hair parted on the side. The background shows a light-colored interior wall with a smaller framed picture hanging to his right. The painting is encased in an ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Plane/Figure Series D (Double Panel)
medium: Acrylic and black pencil on canvas
alt_text: A painting of two large, vertical ovals side-by-side against a black background. The left oval is filled with a dull, dusty purple color. The right oval is filled with a pale, creamy yellow color. A thin, faint black pencil line outlines each oval shape. The entire composition has a flat, smooth appearance.

title: Wanamaker Block
alt_text: A painting with broad, abstract shapes in black and white. The background is a stark, off-white color that shows visible brushstrokes in some areas. Large, solid black forms dominate the center of the canvas, creating geometric shapes with jagged edges. These black sections appear heavy and thick, layered over the lighter background. Some smaller, thinner black lines and marks also appear within the white spaces.

title: III
medium: Three pieces, wishbone shape (silicone, iron, plaster), plus box
alt_text: A sculpture of three wishbone-shaped objects is displayed alongside their wooden storage box. On the far left lies a flat, rectangular wooden lid with three small, vertical slits cut into its center. In the middle, a rectangular, light-colored card shows a single, dark wishbone shape printed above three lines of small text. On the right, a rectangular wooden box contains three wishbone-shaped recesses filled with materials that look like plaster, dark metal, and light-colored silicone. These three curved shapes are stacked vertically inside the box. The entire arrangement is set against a plain, light gray background.

title: part of a bed hanging, plain cloth, embroidered
alt_text: A textile made of linen cloth shows a repeating pattern of symmetrical floral designs in shades of gray. Large, stylized flower heads and branching leaves fill the central area of the fabric. Smaller, similar plant shapes appear on both the left and right sides of the main design. The background of the fabric is light and plain. The entire pattern looks embroidered with dark thread against the lighter cloth.

title: Panel of cotton cloth, embroidered
alt_text: A cotton textile shows a pattern of red and black flowers across a light brown background. The fabric is divided into two distinct horizontal sections with different floral designs. The top section features rows of larger, fan-shaped red flowers with black details. The bottom section displays a denser, repeating pattern of four-petaled flowers interspersed with smaller buds. At the very bottom, a black label with the white number 1937.5525 rests on a white support bar.

title: Chubby Talks to God
alt_text: A sculpture of tin and nails on wood features a small, rectangular painting of a dog at its center. The dog has dark brown and white fur, and its tongue hangs out of its mouth. Around this portrait, the background consists of a white, textured surface that appears to be made of small, closely spaced nails driven into the wood. Faint, decorative lines are etched into the surface around the central image. The entire piece has a clean, framed appearance.

title: Plain cloth, embroidered
alt_text: A textile made of plain cloth shows a rectangular piece of fabric decorated with repeating patterns of colorful shapes. The background of the fabric is an off-white, light beige color. The central part of the design consists of horizontal rows of small, dark, urn-shaped figures in alternating colors of red, blue, and green. A wider border surrounds this central section on the top and bottom, featuring larger, leafy-looking shapes in various shades of green, red, and yellow. Along the left and bottom edges, there is a smaller border filled with tiny, leaf-like symbols in orange and light green.

title: Saturday All Day
alt_text: A sculpture of a large, folded metal sign sits inside a wooden crate. The metal structure has multiple angular sides, colored in bright yellow and deep black. Large yellow letters on a black background spell out "SATURDAY SPECIAL" vertically along one side. A thin metal bar runs horizontally across the front of the crate, partially obscuring the object. The wooden crate frame is light-colored and has vertical beams separating the space.

title: Cover made up of bands of linen embroidered in silk
alt_text: A linen and silk textile shows a rectangular piece of fabric with a detailed, embroidered pattern. The main body of the cloth is light cream or white and is covered in repeating floral or leaf-like shapes stitched in gold thread. This central section is framed by a wider, solid golden-yellow border that runs along all four edges. A thin line of small, repeating gold floral motifs sits just inside this outer yellow border. The entire piece looks flat and rectangular, presented against a plain background with a black identification tag at the bottom.

title: Tim Richards as a Baby (b. 1941)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature shows the portrait of a young child in a blue outfit. The child has light-colored hair and faces slightly to the left with a serious expression. They are wearing a pale yellow shirt underneath blue overalls with small white details. The painting is circular and enclosed within a thin, ornate gold metal ring. This entire piece is set inside a larger, square wooden frame with rounded edges.

title: Panel of cotton cloth, embroidered
alt_text: A textile made of cotton and silk showing a rectangular strip of fabric decorated with embroidery. The piece features two vertical panels of colorful flower patterns separated by a central band of open-weave stitching. The left panel shows blue flowers on green stems, while the right panel displays identical red flowers. A thin, zigzag border runs along the bottom edge in red and green thread. The overall background of the fabric is a light, natural off-white color.

title: Tim Richards as a Young Boy (b. 1941)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting shows a young person in profile facing to the right. They have light brown hair styled to one side and wear a dark red and black plaid shirt. The subject is set against a dark blue background. The painting is framed in a circular, metallic gold band with a fine texture. This gold band is surrounded by a larger, smooth black circular frame.

title: Henry Richards
alt_text: A miniature in watercolor on ivory shows a man from the chest up. He has light reddish-blond hair and a full beard. The man has bright blue eyes and looks toward the left. He wears a white collared shirt that is open at the neck. The portrait sits inside an oval gold frame with a small metal ring at the top against a mottled blue background.

title: Susan Richards
alt_text: A miniature painting shows a portrait of a young woman inside an oval brass frame. She has long, wavy, light brown hair that falls past her shoulders. Her face is turned slightly to her left, and she has light eyes and a fair complexion. She wears a simple, light green top. The background behind her is a mottled, deep blue color, and the frame has a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Number 13A: Arabesque
alt_text: A painting showing a chaotic pattern of thin, tangled lines against a solid, deep-brown background. These white and black lines loop and cross over each other across the entire surface of the rectangular canvas. Some lines are long and sweeping, while others are short, splattered drips of paint. The overall composition feels busy and energetic because the lines are dense in many places. The painting is enclosed within a simple, thin dark frame.

title: Small Bust on a Double Pedestal
alt_text: A plaster sculpture showing a blocky, light-colored object with a rough surface. The main part of the shape is a thick, square-sided base. Sitting on top of the base is a smaller, rectangular layer. A tiny, pointed knob rises from the very top of this smaller section. The entire object has a textured, bumpy finish. It stands against a plain, solid gray background.

title: Paysage d'hiver avec deux chiens (Winterscape with Two Dogs)
alt_text: A painting of two cream-colored dogs outlined in dark, sketch-like lines. The dogs stand side-by-side in the center, facing forward with wide, circular eyes and pointed ears. They have spindly legs and curled tails that stretch towards the right. The background is a messy mix of deep reds, browns, and dark blues, applied in thick, streaky brushstrokes. This textured background contrasts sharply with the pale, flat figures of the dogs in the foreground.

title: Jardin Bleu
alt_text: A cast polyester resin sculpture shows a three-dimensional block covered in abstract patterns. The block has an uneven, chunky shape with rounded edges. Its surface features a dense network of thick, black lines that form enclosed shapes. Inside these shapes are areas of white, grey, and deep blue. Some of the sections contain smaller details, such as parallel stripes or cross-hatching.

title: The Fisherman and The Genie: from the Arabian Nights
alt_text: A painting of a man standing on a sandy shore at sunset. The man wears a simple, light-colored cloth wrapped around his waist and a matching head covering, with his arms raised in a tense gesture. A dark cloud of smoke rises from a small, round pot sitting in the sand beside him. In the distance, a small town with domed buildings sits on the horizon line across the water. The man's form and the smoke are reflected clearly in the smooth water at the bottom of the painting.

title: Fortissimo
alt_text: A painting of abstract, colorful shapes arranged in a dense composition. The image features thick, visible brushstrokes in shades of bright yellow, deep teal, red, and blue. A dominant triangle of yellow and green angles toward the center from the upper left. Contrasting blocks of solid color, including a bold blue patch and a vertical orange stripe, divide the space. The bottom of the canvas is anchored by a layer of deep red and earthy brown tones.

title: The Pond
alt_text: A painting of abstract, vibrant shapes and colors features a large, dark green area stretching diagonally across the center. Surrounding this green shape are bold patches of red, yellow, orange, and blue. A thin, looping yellow line sits near the middle of the canvas, adding a sense of movement. The paint appears thickly applied with visible brushstrokes throughout the composition. The entire work is framed in a simple, thin gold border.

title: Interior 2
medium: Oil, pencil, paper, fabric, and metal on canvas
alt_text: A painting of abstract, collage-like shapes layered on a flat surface. A large, plain brown square sits in the upper left corner, next to several textured panels in white and reddish-brown. Below these, a strip of floral-patterned fabric occupies the center, surrounded by segments of white, textured metal and a dark blue square on the right. A thin, white piece of fabric hangs down the left side, ending in a dark, pointed shape near the bottom. Scribbled pencil marks are visible across the lighter areas of the canvas.

title: Washing Machine
alt_text: A painting shows a hand pouring yellow liquid from a rectangular box into a kitchen sink. The hand is outlined in thick black lines and holds a yellow box tilted over the center of the sink. Inside the sink, the yellow liquid swirls around a central, rounded white object. The background is a simple, light-colored surface, while the sink is depicted with clean black outlines. The entire image has a bold, graphic style with bright yellow and black ink colors.

title: Blam
alt_text: A painting of a comic-style jet plane engaged in an explosion. The white and blue jet dominates the center of the image, angled towards the left with its nose pointed upward. Bright red letters on the upper left side spell out the word "BLAM" in a jagged, cartoonish font. Yellow and orange flames erupt from behind the plane, set against a background of black smoke clouds. On the wings, a blue star is on the left and a red star is on the right. Below the plane, dark, abstract shapes swirl amidst the colorful, explosive scene.

title: Flower Garden
alt_text: A painting showing a black background with several pale, hand-like forms and a partial figure. On the far left, a person wearing a white athletic shirt with the number "1" stands with one arm hanging down at their side. Three large, pale hands rise from the bottom, positioned against the dark space. The hands on the left and right wear simple dark rings on their ring fingers. The central hand has vertical striped lines running up its palm and two small, round, white shapes on its fingers.

title: Red Robe #2
alt_text: A painting of a bright red, rectangular canvas featuring dark, sketched outlines. A central shape resembles an armchair or a person sitting down, defined by thin black lines. A metallic chain is attached across the center of the canvas. On the left side of the chain hangs a small red object, while a long, vertical red stick hangs down the right side. The overall background is a flat, deep red color with black borders on the left and right sides.

title: Untitled
medium: Oil and wax crayon on canvas
alt_text: A painting of white lines sketched against a dark, slate-gray background. These lines form many overlapping, loosely drawn rectangular shapes scattered across the surface. Some rectangles are small and tightly grouped, while others are larger and tilted at sharp angles. The overall effect creates a sense of chaotic movement and layered depth. The white markings appear hand-drawn and have a slightly rough, textured quality like crayon on canvas.

title: Blue with China Ink - Homage to John Cage
alt_text: A collage painting shows abstract shapes arranged against a light blue background. On the left side, a tall, rectangular white shape resembles a boat sail and sits on a yellow, boat-shaped base. This sail section features a red and yellow circular design near the top and a small gray circle near the middle. To the right of the sail, a large, irregularly shaped yellow form is outlined in black, resembling a puzzle piece. Scattered across the composition are smaller rectangular blocks in blue, red, and white, along with a circular pink shape near the bottom right.

title: Piece
alt_text: A brocaded cotton textile shows a repeating, symmetrical pattern of colorful flowers and small geometric shapes on a light background. The fabric is roughly square in shape and features three large, vase-like floral arrangements across the top section. Below these vases, the lower half of the textile is densely filled with a wider variety of stylized flowers, small birds, and intricate, colorful motifs. The design uses colors including soft greens, warm oranges, pinks, and muted purples. The borders of the piece are edged with smaller, regular floral patterns.

title: Embroidered sleeve bands
alt_text: A textile of cotton and wool shows a rectangular piece of off-white fabric decorated with symmetrical, geometric embroidery. The pattern is split vertically down the center, creating two identical panels side by side. Each panel features three large, diamond-shaped designs arranged in a column, surrounded by smaller, intricate zig-zag and cross-stitch motifs. The embroidery uses muted tones of green, reddish-brown, and dark gray thread. At the very bottom edge, there is a decorative, lacy fringe trim.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of several objects sitting on a flat, light-gray surface against a plain gray background. In the center, there is a tall, white bottle with a simple, slightly curved neck. To the left and right of the bottle, there are two light tan, rectangular boxes that stand upright. Tucked behind the bottle is a thin, dark brown shape, and next to it is a small blue cylinder. To the right of the rightmost box sits a shorter, green, cylindrical container.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of several objects arranged on a flat surface against a plain wall. On the left side, a tall, narrow bottle stands next to a pale yellow rectangular box. To the right of the bottle, there is a pink rectangular box with a rounded object resting behind it. Further to the right, a small blue bottle with a ridged surface sits next to a small white bottle. The entire scene is painted in muted, soft tones that create a simple and calm feeling.

title: Still Life with Fruit
alt_text: A painting of a still life with a round, orange-red fruit and a small bunch of green grapes resting on a flat, purple surface. The round fruit sits on the left, colored in shades of bright orange, red, and yellow. Behind it sits a dark, brownish object that is partially obscured by the other items.
