To the right of the fruit, a cluster of pale green grapes rests on the purple background. The background is a solid, muted purple color that fills the rest of the canvas. The lighting creates a dark shadow beneath the grapes and the fruit.

title: Antoine Odier: The Scornful One
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows the head and shoulders of a man with a rough, textured surface. His face has deep, sunken eyes under heavy brows and a mouth set in a serious, downward curve. The hair is pulled back, showing puffy sections on the sides near his ears. He wears a high-collared jacket that appears bunched or folded around his neck. The sculpture is a dark brown color against a plain, light grey background.

title: Illumination
alt_text: A painting showing a series of vertical, colorful stripes on a tan background. The stripes are grouped together off-center to the right, leaving a wide, solid tan area on the left side. Each stripe is a different solid color, including bright yellow, green, dark blue, brown, lime green, and orange. The stripes are straight and run from the top edge of the canvas almost to the bottom. They are arranged side-by-side in a narrow vertical band against the plain background.

title: Electric Chair
alt_text: A painting of a solitary chair centered in an empty, dimly lit room. The entire image is colored in a bright, washed-out yellow against dark black shadows. The chair sits on a square mat in the middle of the bare floor. A single, dark cable snakes out from the base of the chair across the floor. Thick, dark walls surround the space, and a horizontal pipe runs across the ceiling.

title: Calegli
alt_text: A painting shows a chaotic scene filled with bright, colorful, and long bone-like shapes against a divided background. The canvas is split into three main color areas: yellow on the left, red on the right, and a large black triangle in the center. The blue and pink bone-like forms are scattered across the top and right sides of the image. The lower left area features a green section filled with a messy grid of thin, intersecting lines. A small, textured blob of white and multicolored shapes floats near the top left corner.

title: Chair
alt_text: A sculpture of a chair shows a wooden seat frame completely covered in small, layered paper scraps. The brown paper creates a textured, patterned appearance over the entire surface of the curved chair back, circular seat, and four legs. Two thin pieces of wood curve upward to form a rounded backrest. A circular support ring connects the four legs underneath the seat. A small white tag hangs from the front of the circular support ring near one of the legs.

title: Box
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture shows a large white hand surrounded by various geometric shapes. It features a single, solid white hand in the center of the frame with fingers spread wide and pointing upward. Behind and around the hand, many overlapping white circles and squares are scattered across the background. These layers of cut-out shapes cast faint shadows on the white surface, giving the artwork a sense of depth. The entire piece is enclosed within a simple, shiny silver frame.

title: Cascades-Perpendiculars I
alt_text: A sculpture made of wood painted black stands vertically against a light gray background. Several tall, narrow boards of different heights are clustered together to form the main structure. Attached to the front are smaller, textured objects, including a vertical piece that resembles a tool or small spindle and a curved, handle-like form. The entire structure rests on a rectangular, block-like base. The monochromatic color makes all the disparate parts appear as a single unified shape.

title: Reef
alt_text: A painting of abstract, jagged shapes on a canvas with irregular, angular edges. Bright, thick red paint forms sharp, triangular points that dominate the center of the surface. On the left and bottom right, dark brown paint is brushed in long, aggressive lines that overlap the red sections. The background between these sharp shapes features splatters and streaks of lighter yellow, white, and teal colors. The overall effect creates a sense of movement and dense texture across the non-rectangular surface.

title: Erst ein Kuss (First a Kiss)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting and holding a small child who is kissing her cheek. The woman wears a white head covering and a long reddish-brown dress over a lighter-colored apron. She holds a small, round object in one hand. Beside her is a wooden cradle, and a small table with a bowl sits nearby. In the background, a shelf is built into the wall, and a small window lets in a dim light.

title: Jardin des Enfants
medium: Bronze, signed, cast 5/8 Valsuani, fondeur, Paris
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an arrangement of dark, abstract shapes rising from a flat base. In the center, a large, curved, blade-like piece bends forward over a rounded, flower-like form with petal shapes. To the left, a tall, thin triangular shape points upward, while a similar, taller pointed shape stands on the right side. The entire sculpture has a smooth, shiny brown surface that reflects light. The base of the sculpture sits on a plain, light-gray background.

title: La Baigneuse Drapee
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a standing figure draped in fabric. The figure has a smooth, rounded face and is looking straight ahead. Their right arm is raised slightly, holding a piece of cloth that falls down the side of their body. The figure stands on a rough, rocky base. The surface of the metal is dark brown with visible textures from the sculpting process.

title: Still Life (Sedia)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture with a gold finish shows a small, four-legged chair set on a square base. A long, slender branch covered with pointed leaves is draped diagonally across the back and seat of the chair. A piece of folded fabric also rests on the chair's seat, flowing slightly over the left side. The entire object is uniformly gold in color, including the chair, branch, and fabric. The background is a plain, dark gray surface that contrasts with the bright metallic object.

title: They'll Get you by the Smoke
alt_text: A wood sculpture with paint sits inside a rectangular wooden crate. Several long, pale wooden rods are positioned horizontally and held in place by yellow foam blocks. A curved, red-painted wooden piece sits below the rods near the center of the box. A jagged, thin, flat wooden piece with a darker edge stands vertically toward the right side. A black strap hangs down from the right section, resting against a vertical wooden board.

title: John Bacon Pearce
alt_text: A painting of a man with dark, wavy hair and sideburns who is looking forward. He wears a high-collared dark coat over a white shirt and a black cravat. One of his hands is tucked slightly inside his coat near his chest. His other hand rests on the arm of a chair, with his fingers draped over the edge. A red cloth is visible beneath him against a plain, dark brown background.

title: Spinning By Firelight--The Boyhood of George Washington Gray
alt_text: A painting of a quiet indoor room featuring three people around a spinning wheel and fireplace. A woman with a white bonnet sits in the center using a large wooden spinning wheel. To her right, a young boy sits on a brick hearth and stacks pieces of wood near a glowing fire. A man sits in a chair in the background behind the woman, looking toward the boy. The room has wooden walls and floors, and the lighting is dim with a soft glow coming from the hearth.

title: Evie & Hazel in Conversation
alt_text: A sculpture of a person lies inside a long, rectangular wooden crate lined with white foam. The figure is life-sized and positioned on its back, wearing a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt and bright blue pants. Its dark hair is styled in a short bob, and its skin tone is medium brown. A wooden bar rests across the figure’s neck area, and another bar rests across its feet to keep it in place. The entire scene is viewed from directly above, looking down into the open container.

title: Modern Head
alt_text: A brushed stainless steel sculpture stands tall on a round concrete base in a park. The sculpture features abstract, angular shapes including sharp points and curved cutouts that look like metallic wings or profiles. It is silver and reflects the light, showing a smooth, matte finish. The background shows green grass, several large trees with some autumn leaves, and a faint building in the distance. The overall structure appears thin but sturdy as it reaches upward toward the sky.

title: Tucker
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an abstract shape that resembles folded or pleated fabric. The object is brown and has multiple layers with sharp, radiating creases. Several fan-like sections overlap in the center, extending outward with wavy, irregular edges. The form appears organic and delicate, with pointed tips reaching out to the sides. It sits against a solid, light grey background, casting a soft shadow beneath it.

title: Fruits and Flowers
alt_text: A painting of a still life set on a small, round table. On the left, a tall, green glass vase holds a small bouquet of white and pink flowers. To the right, a footed bowl is filled with assorted fruits, including a red apple and some dark grapes. A long, draped red fabric lies underneath the bowl and spills over the edge of the table. Several other pieces of fruit, including a pear and a peach, are scattered on the dark surface of the table. The entire arrangement is presented in a simple, gold-colored frame.

title: 3 A.M.
alt_text: A painting of a dark wooden door with two vertical glass windows set into a wall of brown paneling. Above the door, a red sign with the word "EXIT" is visible in bright capital letters. A faint, sketchy black line drawing of a cartoonish character is superimposed over the entire scene, appearing to hold a round clock on the right side. The brown wall on the far left shows a grid pattern, while a barred window or gate covers the upper right corner. The painting's surface has a textured appearance, and there are small, rectangular signs attached to the glass of the door.

A sculpture of a four-legged animal made of aluminum, steel, and wire. The torso is shaped from many pieces of crumpled, silver-colored metal that catch the light. The animal’s head is bent low toward the ground, while its back forms a gentle curve. Its weight is held up by four thin, dark rods that serve as legs. The figure stands on a polished wooden floor in front of a blank white wall.

title: Sequoia Sonata
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting on a tree stump in a forest. The man wears a red button-up shirt, blue jeans, and tan boots, with a red hat featuring a white feather on his head. Above him, a woman with wavy reddish-brown hair is visible from the waist up, wearing a pink bikini top. Several tall, thick brown tree trunks surround the pair against a bright blue sky with faint clouds. A silver axe lies on the dark ground to the left, while a small, open black lunchbox sits on the right.

title: Local Patriots
alt_text: A painting of a forest scene shows a person-like figure standing in a clearing. The scene appears to be at twilight, with dark purple clouds in the sky above green trees. An orange path curves through the dark ground, leading toward the center of the image. The figure in the center has a spotted pattern on its skin and holds its arms up toward the sky. To the left of the figure, a thin, white, swirling line twists through the air. A large, dark shape occupies the right side of the painting, framing the scene like a tall tree trunk.

title: Tragic Spain
alt_text: A painting showing a crowded group of seven people gathered together in dim light. The figures have dark, deeply lined faces with somber expressions. One figure near the center wears a bright red shirt and reaches upward with a hand. Below them, two other figures appear to be huddled close together, with one resting their head against the other. The background is a dark, indistinct color that keeps the focus on the compact group of people.

title: Panel 12 for "the Krupp Project"
alt_text: A painting of a city skyline rising above a dark, hazy body of water. The tall buildings in the background are painted in muted, brownish tones and seem to be obscured by thick smog or mist. In the foreground, a few small boats or ships float on the water's surface, while dark smoke rises from the bottom of the scene. Across the bottom of the painting, large, bold red letters spell out the words "THE FREE WORLD." The overall mood of the image is dim and shadowy.

title: Untitled [light grey toward yellow]
alt_text: A painting of a solid, square panel painted in a flat, light cream color. The surface of the panel appears completely smooth and lacks any visible brushstrokes, shapes, or figures. The panel is mounted in front of a metal rack with horizontal bars. A small white label with the number 1995.631 is attached at the top center of the rack. There are no other details visible on the flat, beige surface.

title: Dead or Alive, Teacart Museum
medium: Various teapots and plates: porcelain, silver, clay, stoneware, steel, lace, colored leaded glass, American reproduction mahogany tea table, propane gas burner, rubber wheels
alt_text: A sculpture of various stacked objects stands inside a large wooden crate. The structure is built with tall, green metal poles arranged in vertical columns. Smaller, circular platforms are attached to these poles at different heights, holding small items like plates and teapots. A wooden table with curved legs sits near the center of the frame and supports additional parts of the display. White rope and tape secure several pieces to the metal frame to keep them in place.

title: Arab Woman
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a tall, abstract figure with a smooth, polished surface. The dark brown form stands on a round, flat base. The upper part of the sculpture widens slightly, suggesting a head or hood shape with a small opening near the top. Below this, a narrow neck connects to a curved body that tapers toward the bottom. The entire object has a graceful, elongated shape that leans slightly to one side.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a figure in a dynamic pose. The figure is made of thick, blocky metal bars arranged to look like limbs. One straight, vertical bar acts as a leg supporting the entire form on the ground. The torso is angled, with one arm stretched straight out to the side and the other arm pointing downward. A rough, dark texture marks the joints where the pieces connect.

title: Standing Nana with Serpent
alt_text: A carved and painted marble sculpture shows a white, curvy figure with arms outstretched. The figure is in a dancing pose with soft, rounded body shapes. She wears a painted bikini with colorful blue, yellow, and red patterns. Painted circles decorate her chest, including one on the left featuring a small red heart. The base of the sculpture has curved white shapes with thin, colorful lines painted on them.

title: The Cove-Marblehead
alt_text: A painting of a coastal scene set in a gold, carved frame. The painting shows two houses facing a bay with sandy ground in the foreground. On the left side, a light-colored two-story building sits near the water. To the right, a darker brown house is framed by a tall, dark green tree. A thin white string hangs down directly over the center of the image, dividing the view into two halves. In the distance, the calm water reflects a pale sky with two small white sailboats visible on the horizon.

title: Chrysanthemum
alt_text: A painting of yellow flowers against a dark blue background is divided into three vertical panels. The left panel shows three small, round yellow blossoms attached to a thin, horizontal stem. The middle panel features a single, large, full-blooming yellow flower that takes up most of the space. The right panel is entirely filled with a close-up, textured view of yellow petals swirling in a dense pattern. Small, faint, light-colored lines resembling symbols or sketches appear above the flowers in the first two panels. The overall style uses thick, visible brushstrokes throughout the image.

title: Wild Carrot
medium: Stainless steel mobile with rubber base, painted wood box
alt_text: A stainless steel sculpture shows a tall, vertical pole with many branches radiating outward. These branches support multiple small, spinning pinwheel-like structures at different heights. The entire object stands on a dark, circular base located on a flat, light-colored wooden surface. Nearby on the surface, there is a separate square metal stand and some loose white pieces. The background is a plain, dark surface that frames the silver-colored mobile.

title: Piano Lessons
alt_text: A sculpture made of bronze, steel, and marble sits within a wooden support frame. At the center is a large, almond-shaped bronze hoop with a rough, weathered texture that rests on a flat, tan-colored marble slab. This slab is supported by a simple, black metal stand. Beneath the stand, several unfinished wooden beams lie on a wooden workbench. In the background, vertical steel rods rise up from the platform, holding several small, circular metal plates.

title: Dancer and Girl
medium: Acrylic, oil, gesso, cast cloth, canvas
alt_text: A painting showing two figures against a light gray, sparse background. On the left, a person wearing a white, ruffled shirt and white trousers sits on the ground with their legs stretched out. This person has short hair, pale skin, and is wearing dark gloves and dark shoes. On the right, a person with pale skin sits on a simple white chair. This figure appears almost transparent or ghostly, blending into the pale background. The entire image is divided into two vertical sections by a thin, dark line down the center.

title: Cajun Mardi Gras
alt_text: A painting of a figure holding a skull, set within a dark frame. The figure wears a white mask with bold, black zebra-like stripes on the face and head. They have a brown complexion, a wide open mouth, and a chainmail-like pattern around their neck. The person is dressed in a yellow tunic and holds a small, white skull in their hand. In the background, dark, pointed mountains rise against a grey sky, illuminated by a pale, round moon.

title: Altoona
alt_text: A painting of large and small circular shapes floating in a dark, textured field. A massive, textured reddish-brown circle dominates the center, split vertically by a solid light blue bar. To the lower left, a smaller pale blue circle sits near several tiny, faint dots. On the bottom right, a medium-sized blue circle rests near the lower edge of the frame. Several thin, wavy yellow and purple lines stretch horizontally across the dark background. A final vertical light blue stripe runs along the far right edge of the painting.

title: Heart's Gambit
alt_text: A painting of a large heart-shaped canvas features a vibrant collage of colorful flowers. The center of the heart contains a dense, diamond-shaped pattern of small, multicolored squares. Surrounding this central geometric area are lush, detailed depictions of red poppies and other blossoms in various shades of yellow, green, and orange. The outer edges of the heart are filled with more dark leaves and swirling plant stems. This bright work is displayed against a white metal grid background.

title: Old Bottleman
medium: Oil on paper mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a man pushing a cart along a cobblestone street. The man wears a dark hat and coat and stands behind a wooden cart filled with small items. A string of brass bells hangs from the front of the cart, dangling in front of the man. In the background, a pale building wall stands with faded, colorful advertisements pasted onto it. A leafless tree on the left side of the street adds to the chilly, quiet outdoor setting.

title: There Is No Lost Funkadelic
alt_text: A painting features several abstract clusters of paint scattered across a white background. On the left side, a large, rounded shape is colored in shades of orange and brown. Near the top center, a splotch of paint blends blue, brown, and hints of white together. Towards the bottom right, a vertical patch of olive green sits next to a swirling mass of purple, blue, and light yellow. These distinct areas of thick, textured color leave large open spaces of plain white canvas in between.

title: America's Queen of Opera
alt_text: A painting of a person dressed in elaborate, old-fashioned royal clothing occupies the center of the image. The figure wears a tall, pearl-encrusted headpiece and a wide, ruffled collar that frames their face. They hold a delicate, patterned fan in one hand and are decorated with pearls around their neck and shoulders. Behind the figure, large white letters spell out a magazine title on a black background, with a yellow banner running diagonally across the top. The entire image is framed by a bright red border.

title: The August Sun and Shadow
alt_text: A painting in acrylic on canvas features a large, rectangular shape in the center. The background is a warm, light brown color with visible brushstrokes and variations in tone. Floating within the upper half of the composition is a smaller, vertical black rectangle. A thin, white border outlines this black rectangle. Dark, brush-like markings run along the inner edges of the white border.

title: Firwood Ride, Sombre Autumn
alt_text: A painting of broad, expressive brushstrokes that fill the horizontal frame with abstract shapes in earthy colors. Dark green and brownish-grey vertical streaks occupy the left side of the composition. In the center, a large block of reddish-brown paint sits next to a deep, dark teal patch. The bottom of the canvas features flat, brown areas interspersed with swatches of green. A lighter, bluish-white vertical shape appears on the far right edge.

title: Young Woman
alt_text: A painting of a young woman with dark, wavy hair and pale skin. She wears a small blue band in her hair and a dark green coat with a pink collar peeking out from underneath. Her face has rosy, rounded cheeks and dark red lips, and she looks downward with a soft expression. The background behind her is a textured green color. The artwork is set inside a heavy, off-white frame decorated with ornate carvings. A white tag with the number "1995.81.6" sits directly above the top edge of the frame.

title: The Silence
alt_text: A sculpture of plaster and lacquer shows two figures interacting against a dark background. On the left, a person wearing a rounded helmet leans forward to place their hand over the face of another person. The second figure stands on the right and appears to be leaning back slightly. Both figures are dark, glossy, and reflect light on their rounded surfaces. Their bodies are depicted from the waist up.

title: Arided
alt_text: A painting of concentric, wavy-edged shapes centered on a square canvas. The outermost ring is a thick band of orange-red that follows the square frame. Inside the red band is a thinner, wavy ring of light cream color. This cream ring surrounds a wider, wavy band of green. In the center, a bright blue shape with soft, rounded corners fills the middle of the composition. All of the shapes appear to ripple outward from the center point.

title: Home Grown Thistle
alt_text: A sculpture made of sycamore, sweetgum, and oak wood showing multiple intertwined branches inside a wooden crate. The branches are light brown with darker, pointed thorns or spikes attached to them. Purple nylon straps are wrapped around sections of the wood and connected to the sides of the plywood crate. These straps suspend the branches in the air, preventing them from touching the walls or floor of the container. The interior of the crate is made of light-colored, natural-grain plywood panels.

title: Three Standard Stoppages
medium: Thread, canvas, glass, and wood in a wooden box
alt_text: A sculpture consists of a long, rectangular wooden box with its lid propped open. Inside the box, a light-colored wooden interior panel features cutout shapes that resemble organic, wavy lines. In front of the open box, three long, thin glass panels are arranged horizontally on the surface. Each glass panel holds a strip of dark blue canvas with a single, thin white thread running across it in a gentle wave. These thin white threads vary slightly in their curve and placement on each piece of blue fabric.

title: Untitled
medium: Acrylic on Japanese tissue paper (with steel rivets for hanging)
alt_text: A painting on delicate tissue paper displays a series of horizontal, gray-toned stripes. These bands vary in intensity, ranging from soft, pale washes to darker, more saturated gray sections. The texture appears thin and slightly translucent, with faint horizontal lines running across the entire surface. The edges of the paper look uneven and fragile, suggesting a handmade quality. This work is mounted in a simple way that highlights the thin material of the surface.

title: Windermere
alt_text: A painting of a quiet lake surrounded by rolling hills at sunset. The sky is a warm yellow color that fades into the deep greens of the mountain slopes in the distance. In the foreground, rocky, uneven ground covered with dark bushes and small trees leads the eye toward the water. A single small animal stands near the center of the middle ground on a grassy ledge overlooking the lake. The water is calm, reflecting the golden light of the sky above it.

title: Study of a Young Girl Holding A Rose
alt_text: A painting of a young person shown in profile against a dark background. The subject is facing to the left with their head turned slightly away from the viewer. They have long, dark hair and are wearing a simple, light-colored garment. The background is a murky, dark tone that makes the figure stand out. A small, blurry red shape is visible in the lower left corner of the composition.

title: Woman Combing Her Hair
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a standing figure with stylized, geometric features. The figure has an elongated, smooth body that curves gently to one side. One arm is raised high above the head, creating an open space between the arm and the head. The figure rests on a small, round, golden-colored base. This base sits on top of a larger, two-tiered, matte black pedestal.

title: Horace and His Grace
medium: Painted polyester resin and 18k gold leaf
alt_text: A sculpture shows a seated figure in front of a tall, golden structure. The figure has black skin and is wearing a colorful, form-fitting outfit with green, pink, and yellow stripes on the torso. One of the figure's breasts is patterned with a red heart design, while the other features concentric circles of green, red, and blue. The figure has bright orange hair and is posed with one hand raised to its head. The golden structure behind the figure curves upward like a large arch or bird-like head.

title: John Bacon Pearce (1800-1874) (after 1830 original by Sarah Peale)
medium: Oil on canvas mounted on wood board
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up. The man has dark, wavy hair, sideburns, and brown eyes looking toward the viewer. He wears a dark, high-collared jacket with a white shirt underneath. His right hand is tucked into his jacket near his chest, while his left hand rests on the edge of a chair. The background is a plain, dark olive-brown color that fades slightly toward the edges.

title: Haiku
alt_text: A sculpture of three silver figures standing side-by-side on a dark surface. Each figure is thin, flat, and cut into a complex, abstract, and somewhat human-like shape. The silver surfaces are smooth and reflect light, giving them a bright, metallic look against the neutral background. The figure on the far left has a long, pointed arm reaching upward. The middle figure is more rounded and symmetrical, with legs that form a wide base. The figure on the right features intricate, jagged cutouts in its torso and limbs.

title: Queen for a Day
alt_text: A painting of a grid showing many small, identical buildings under a dark night sky. The grid contains five rows and six columns, with most squares depicting a single building with a lit window and a person standing outside. Each building is a simple, grey structure against a dark blue background filled with white specks. Some squares instead show a view of the night sky with a moon in various phases. Small, black silhouettes of people walk or stand on the sidewalk in front of the buildings.

title: Black September
alt_text: A sculpture made of acrylic on wood and canvas displays a wall hanging and a free-standing object. The wall piece is a large blue square featuring a white, leaf-shaped outline in the center and a dark, jagged vertical shape on the right. A small, rounded blue protrusion sits near the top edge of the leaf shape. In the foreground, a sphere painted with a black-and-white grid pattern rests on top of a rectangular blue pedestal. The pedestal sits on a brown square of material placed directly on the floor.

title: William Ellice
alt_text: A painting of a man with curly brown hair looking directly forward. He wears a dark black coat over a white collared shirt with a ruffled neckpiece. His face has reddish cheeks, and he rests his hand on a white surface, perhaps a piece of paper, while holding a thin quill. To his left, a small glass filled with liquid sits on the table. The background is a simple, dark brown wall, while a sliver of red is visible behind his right shoulder.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of pink fluorescent light shows two horizontal bars against a black background. The bottom bar is long and stretches nearly across the entire width of the frame. Directly above it, a second, much shorter bar sits centered. Both bars glow with a soft, bright pink color. They are the only shapes visible in the dark space.

title: Figure Study of Faith, for The Spirit of Religious Liberty, Rotunda, Pennsylvania State Capitol, Harrisburg
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing against a solid, bright reddish-orange background. She wears a long, flowing white gown with loose fabric draped over her shoulders. Her hair is brown and pulled back, and her face is looking forward with a neutral expression. In her hands, she holds a thin, light-colored wooden bow upright. The figure takes up most of the space within the simple gold-colored frame.

title: Figure Study of Hope, for The Spirit of Religious Liberty, Rotunda, Pennsylvania State Capitol, Harrisburg
alt_text: A painting of a woman with reddish-brown hair standing and playing a large harp. She wears a long, loose, pale dress that drapes around her body. Her arm is raised to pluck the strings of the gold-colored harp, which is positioned on her right side. The background is painted in soft, light colors like blue and cream. The entire scene is set inside a thin, gold-colored frame.

title: Study for Amfortas Released by Galahad, in The Quest and Achievement of the Holy Grail, Book Delivery Room, Boston Public Library
alt_text: A painting of an elderly man with a long white beard and white robes who sits on the ground while looking upward. A figure in a solid red robe kneels behind him, holding the older man’s wrists as if offering support. Above them, a winged figure with glowing, translucent wings arches over the pair. This winged figure has a radiant halo and soft, blended colors of pink and blue surrounding it. The entire scene is set against a deep blue, dark background.

title: Compositional study for “The Apotheosis of Pennsylvania” mural in the House of Representatives Chamber of the Pennsylvania State Capitol at Harrisburg
alt_text: A painting of a large group of people gathering in front of a grand architectural monument. In the center, a domed alcove holds a sculpted figure, and two tall columns topped with golden eagles stand on either side. Many people in diverse clothing are arranged on stone steps that lead up toward the central structure. The lower part of the scene is filled with a darker, crowded area where figures in uniforms and casual clothes mingle. Soft, white clouds fill the upper portion of the background, creating a bright contrast against the structured foreground.

title: Columbus in the New World
alt_text: A painting of a man in shiny armor kneeling on a sandy shore while holding a flag. Behind him, a large group of pink birds flies across a bright blue sky above the ocean. To his right, two figures in long, ornate, dark-colored robes stand and read from a large open book. To his left, several other people in dark clothing stand near tall poles holding large banners. In the background, a large wooden ship sits near the shoreline.

title: Volumnia, Coriolanus
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in a dark cloak. She is positioned to the right of a large, pale, square column that sits in the background. The woman wears a long, dark garment that drapes to the floor, partially covering her head. Her hands are held up near her chest, and she looks directly forward with a somber expression. The background behind the column is dim and shadowy, with hints of red near the floor.

title: Crusaders Sighting Jerusalem
alt_text: A painting of three figures standing on a rocky hill against a blue sky. On the left, a tall person in dark chainmail armor wears a crown and holds a large flag with red and white fabric. In the center stands a young person with light hair, wearing a white tunic with a red cross, holding a sword hilt to their chest. To their right, a bearded figure in a white head wrap and chainmail holds a sword with both hands. Below them, a hazy, crowded scene of small figures and wooden structures fills the background. A round metal helmet sits on the rocky ground in the bottom center foreground.

title: Figure Study of 5 AM, for The Hours, House of Representatives Chamber, Pennsylvania State Capitol, Harrisburg
alt_text: A painting of a nude figure standing against a dark background. The central figure is light-skinned and stands with arms outstretched to the sides. Their face is tilted upward, and their legs are positioned in a relaxed, standing pose. Dark, shadowy fabric or drapery surrounds the figure, filling the space behind them. The painting is framed in simple wood and sits on a metal rack.

title: The Education of Isabella the Catholic
medium: Oil on canvas mounted on wood panel
alt_text: A painting of a group of people inside a dim stone room. A woman stands in the center wearing a long, patterned dress with red and blue colors. She is surrounded by several women dressed in black habits or cloaks with white undergarments. Some of the women are walking toward a staircase on the right side of the frame, while one woman holds an object in her hands. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, decorative gold frame.

title: Figure Study of Hamlet, for The Play Scene, Hamlet, Act III, Scene II
alt_text: A painting of a person's head and neck, tilted to the side and facing upward. The person has light brown hair that is held back by a thin, yellow band. Their face is illuminated with warm tones, while the area behind them is painted with loose, dark brushstrokes. The background around the figure is unfinished, showing muted shades of gray and beige. The painted strokes remain visible, giving the entire work a textured and energetic appearance.

title: Figure Study of Ophelia, for The Play Scene, Hamlet, Act III, Scene II
alt_text: A painting of a young person with very long, wavy, reddish-orange hair. The figure faces forward against a dark, shadowy background that gets lighter near the top. They have pale skin, light eyes, and soft pink lips. They wear a simple, light-colored garment that shows only at the neck and chest. Their hair falls in thick, loose waves on both sides of their face, framing their shoulders and upper body.

title: Jephthah and His Daughter
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man wearing a helmet and military armor. The man stands facing forward, looking slightly upward and to the left. He holds a large, round shield with his left hand while pulling a long, draped cape over his right shoulder. His attire includes a breastplate and a kilt-like garment that reaches to his thighs. He stands on a plain, flat stone base against a solid, dark gray background.

title: Within the Tent of Brutus: Enter the Ghost of Caesar, Julius Caesar, Act IV, Scene III
alt_text: A painting of a seated person wearing a long, deep-red robe. This figure sits in a chair on the left side of the frame, with one hand held up to their face and the other resting on their lap. To the left of the figure stands a tall, metallic helmet with a bright red crest. Behind the seated person, a pale, ghost-like figure appears in the background, draped in a light cloth that is splattered with bright red marks. The background is painted in dark, muted brown tones that blend together.

title: An Inn-yard in Rochester, King Henry IV, Part I, Act II, Scene I
alt_text: A painting of a dimly lit barn scene with a person and several animals. In the foreground, a person wearing a green hat leans forward to brush the back of a large, brown ox. To the left of the ox, a dark rooster stands on a raised wooden platform. A small lantern hangs from the rafters above, casting a soft, warm glow over the scene. The rest of the stable is filled with deep shadows and indistinct structures made of dark stone or wood.

title: The Death of Hotspur, King Henry IV, Part I, Act V, Scene IV
alt_text: A painting of a dark, chaotic scene filled with figures in motion. The image shows many people in red and dark-colored clothing who appear to be struggling or fighting amidst tall, vertical shapes. A figure on the left stands out wearing a silver helmet and looking toward the center of the crowd. The entire scene is painted in deep, muddy browns and blacks with bright splashes of red. The whole work is contained within a thick, simple gold frame.

title: The King to the Prince of Wales: "Thou shalt have charge and sovereign trust herein," King Henry IV, Part I, Act III, Scene II
alt_text: A painting of two men standing together in a room with a decorative patterned wall. On the left, a younger man with short hair wears a vibrant, heavy cloak of yellow and orange draped over his shoulders, paired with pale leggings. Facing him on the right is an older man dressed in a long, dark robe with a hood that covers his head. The older man leans forward and rests his hands on the younger man’s shoulders in an intimate gesture. Behind them, the wall features a repeating pattern of red and dark blue squares, with small stained-glass windows visible near the top. The floor is covered in tiles that also show a repeating decorative design.

title: Sketch of Two Women
medium: Oil on both sides of panel
alt_text: A painting shows two women standing side-by-side in front of a wooden wall. The woman on the left has blonde hair and wears a white top with a red skirt. The woman on the right also has blonde hair and wears a tan top with a bright blue skirt. Both women have their hands on their hips and look toward the viewer. The background appears to be simple horizontal wooden boards in shades of tan and brown. The entire image is enclosed in a plain, medium-brown wooden frame.

title: Interior Study of Westminster Abbey, for The Coronation of King Edward VII
alt_text: A painting of the interior of a dark, cavernous room or hall. In the background, a large, ornate wooden chair stands alone on a raised platform. To the left, several smaller blue-cushioned chairs are arranged in a row against a wall. The walls appear to be made of stone, and the lighting is dim with deep shadows. A large, rectangular beige shape occupies the floor in the foreground, contrasting with the dark teal floorboards surrounding it. The overall style is loose and painterly, with visible brushstrokes throughout.

title: Study of the Coronation plate, for The Coronation of King Edward VII
alt_text: A painting of several plates and serving dishes lined up on a dark wooden shelf. These dishes are mostly gold and yellow in color and appear to be made of metal. A dark, shadowy background sits behind the items on the shelf. The bottom half of the canvas shows a blurry, warm-toned area, perhaps suggesting a wooden table or fireplace mantel. The painting is framed in a simple, light brown wooden border.

title: Study for The Coronation of King Edward VII
alt_text: A painting shows a group of people gathered in a dark, indoor setting. Many of the figures wear long robes in shades of white, red, and muted gold, standing in loose rows. A few figures towards the center appear to be wearing lighter, flowing garments. The room is very dim, with most of the background hidden in deep shadows. A large, rectangular patch of lighter, yellowish-brown floor occupies the bottom center of the scene.

title: Drapery Study of Queen Alexandra's Dress, for The Coronation of King Edward VII
alt_text: A painting of a gold dress displayed on a mannequin. The dress is long and textured, with sheer fabric sleeves that fall to the sides. It features intricate details near the shoulders and a jeweled piece at the waist. The mannequin stands in front of a blurred red sofa and a light blue wall. A cluster of golden objects rests at the top of the dress form. The painting uses soft, painterly brushstrokes throughout the scene.

title: My Gracious Lord, my father, King Henry IV, Part II, Act IV, Scene V
alt_text: A painting of two figures in a dark setting, framed in a thin gold border. In the upper portion, a person with a white head covering and a blue robe rests their hand on the head of another figure. The second person kneels below, wearing a dark green cloak and bent forward with their head bowed. A long blue curtain with dark, ornate patterns hangs vertically on the left side of the scene. Near the bottom left corner, a golden crown sits on the ground. The background is shadowy and dimly lit.

title: Sir John Falstaff with His Page, King Henry IV, Part II, Act I, Scene II
alt_text: A painting shows two people walking on a stone path next to a dark wall. A large, stout adult in a long, tattered red robe stands on the left, wearing a red hat and holding a chain near their neck. Beside them on the right, a smaller person with a dark hood and green lining walks along, carrying a round shield on their back and a sword at their hip. In the background, partially hidden, another person in a red outfit walks near some indistinct shapes. The lighting is dim, casting shadows that obscure parts of the scene.

title: Oh God of battles! Steel my soldiers' hearts!, King Henry V, Act IV, Scene I
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a person kneeling in prayer, captured in a dim, dark setting. The figure is positioned slightly to the left, facing away from the center while their head is turned in profile. They wear a long, dark cloak that falls to the ground around them. The person's hands are pressed together near their chin. The background is shadowy and murky, blending into the figure's dark clothing. The entire image is enclosed in a simple, thin gold frame.

title: Down, down to Hell, and say I sent thee thither, King Henry VI, Part III, Act V, Scene VI
alt_text: A painting of a man standing over someone lying on the ground. The standing figure is dressed in dark clothing and yellow leggings, holding a sword pointed down toward the person on the floor. The person on the ground wears pale sleeves and dark clothes, appearing to grasp at the standing man's leg. Nearby on the floor lies an open, light-colored book. The setting is dim, with shadows obscuring much of the background.

title: Goneril and Regan, King Lear, Act I, Scene I
alt_text: A painting of two women standing side by side. The woman on the left wears a long, bright red dress with a dark cloak fastened by a large brooch at her shoulder. She has long, wavy brown hair and a jeweled headband rests across her forehead. The woman on the right wears a dark, long-sleeved garment and a simpler head covering, and her hands are folded together in front of her. Both women have serious expressions and look toward the left side of the frame.

title: Study for King Lear, Act I, Scene I
alt_text: A painting of a group of people standing together in a dark room. A woman in a bright yellow dress stands in the center and holds the arm of a man dressed in dark clothing. To her left, another woman wears a long, flowing red dress. To the right, a figure in a white robe bends over with their back turned to the viewer. A small dog stands near the feet of the figures on the right side. The entire scene is enclosed in a wide, textured gold frame.

title: Connecticut Hall
alt_text: A painting of a multi-story brick building covered in ivy. The building has many rectangular windows with dark shutters and a single dark door at the center entrance. A stone pathway leads from the foreground up to the entrance, flanked by low, manicured hedges on the right. To the right of the path stands a small statue on a pedestal, surrounded by bushes. A wrought-iron fence partially blocks the view on the left side of the frame. The entire scene is enclosed within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Landscape with a Girl Minding Cattle
alt_text: A painting of three pale cows grazing in a grassy field. Two of the cows are large and stand in the middle ground, while a smaller cow walks on the left side. To the right of the cows, a person sits on the ground near a tree trunk. Dark, dense trees and foliage form a backdrop behind the animals. The entire scene is enclosed in a wide, ornate gold-colored frame that has paper protectors on each corner.

title: May Day Morning
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman walking hand in hand down a garden path. The man wears a tan outfit with a hat covered in flowers, while the woman wears a white dress and carries a matching floral hat. They are strolling through a grassy area bordered by a high stone wall and blooming trees. Small, bright pink tulips grow in a row along the edge of the path near the front of the scene. The sky above the wall is light blue with soft, pale clouds.

title: Figure study for "The Spirit of Vulcan, Genius of the  Workers in Iron and Steel" lunette in the rotunda of the Pennsylvania State Capitol at Harrisburg
alt_text: A painting of five shirtless men standing in a row, all holding long tools above their heads as if they are about to strike something. Each man is muscular and is wearing dark, rough trousers or aprons around their waists. Their skin is painted in pale, warm tones, contrasting with the dark, moody shadows in the background. The men are arranged across the frame, with the figures on the right standing straighter than the figure on the far left. The brushstrokes are loose and visible, giving the work a sense of energy and movement.

title: Diana Appears to Pericles as in a Vision, Pericles, Act V, Scene I
alt_text: A painting of a dark, interior scene with a man resting on the floor in the foreground. He is lying on his side on a blanket with his head propped up on his hand, looking toward the left. Above him, a ghostly, glowing figure rises from a cloud of smoke or mist. This figure wears a tall, ornate headdress and stands partially obscured by the dark, misty surroundings. In the background, to the right, faint stone walls and rectangular openings suggest a building or room. A small, glowing lantern stands on the floor between the man and the misty figure.

title: Study for The Reading of the Declaration of Independence, House of Representatives Chamber, Pennsylvania State Capitol, Harrisburg
alt_text: A painting of a red brick building with a large crowd gathered in front of it. The tall building has a white clock and arched windows, with a person standing on a small balcony to the right. People in old-fashioned clothing are scattered across the foreground, appearing to watch or listen to something. A woman in a long blue dress and a small child in a blue coat stand on the bottom right side. The scene feels busy and crowded, showing many figures from behind or in profile.

title: Richard, Duke of Gloucester, and the Lady Anne
alt_text: A painting of a large, solemn procession moving across a cobblestone street. A woman in a dark, structured veil and a coat featuring heraldic patterns walks near the front. Beside her, a man in a long, bright red robe holds a sword in his hand and gestures upward. Behind them, a dense crowd of people in dark, hooded clothing follows, many carrying long spears or poles. Children walk on the right side of the crowd, while a large, dark cloth is draped over the backs of those following.

title: Jedidiah Morse (1761–1826), B.A. 1783, M.A. 1786
alt_text: A painting of an elderly man with short, gray hair sitting and writing with a quill pen. He wears a gold-colored robe with a red collar over a black vest and a white neckerchief. To his left, several leather-bound books stand on a wooden shelf in front of a dark, curtained backdrop. alt_text: A painting of a person standing against a dark background while holding a tall pole and a golden crown. The person has light hair and wears a colorful, patterned tunic with a shield featuring stripes and a black eagle. Behind the figure, a flag with horizontal red, white, and green stripes waves. Decorative, stylized lettering in a gold color is painted on both sides of the central figure. The figure wears hose with one red leg and one green leg, and simple shoes.

title: The Squire of Low Degree
alt_text: A painting of a seated figure in royal robes being approached by a person kneeling on the floor. The seated person wears a golden crown and a large green cloak over white robes, while holding a thin, vertical staff. The kneeling person is dressed in a dark blue long tunic with a red cloth draped over one shoulder and carries a small pouch at their waist. They are situated in a room with a patterned green wall and a black-and-white checkered floor. Above the seated figure hangs a decorative canopy with red and gold panels.

title: The Squire of Low Degree
alt_text: A painting of a king sitting at a table and a group of figures in an indoor room. In the center, a white-bearded man wearing a gold crown and elaborate robes sits behind a long table covered in a white cloth. A younger person with light brown hair kneels on the floor in front of him, hands clasped together. To the right of the table, two tall figures stand fully covered in dark, reflective metal armor. On the left side, another person wearing a dark blue tunic and bright red pants stands near an arched doorway. The scene is set on a patterned floor of red and white diamonds, under an ornate gold-colored cloth hanging on the back wall.

title: Compositional Study, for The Benediction Upon the Quest, in The Quest and Achievement of the Holy Grail, Book Delivery Room, Boston Public Library
alt_text: A painting of a solemn scene in what appears to be a large, dim stone hall. On the left, a tall figure in a white robe stands on an elevated step with arms raised, while a figure in a dark blue cloak kneels on the floor nearby. A crowd of people stands on the right, dressed in various colorful garments, capes, and decorative robes. Behind the crowd, several vertical banners or flags hang in a row against the dark background. The lower third of the canvas is unfinished, showing rough, smeared brown and gray paint strokes against a bare, light-colored background.

title: Study of the Priest, for The Benediction Upon the Quest, in The Quest and Achievement of the Holy Grail, Book Delivery Room, Boston Public Library
alt_text: A painting of a person dressed in white robes and a white head covering. The person has their head bowed down, looking toward a rounded white object at the bottom of the canvas. A small, dark cross is visible on the fabric of their clothing near the chest. The figure stands against a deep, dark background that contrasts with their light-colored robes. Long, flowing brushstrokes in shades of cream and tan create the shape of their clothing.

title: Compositional Study, for The Castle of the Grail and the Failure of Galahad, in The Quest and Achievement of the Holy Grail, Book Delivery Room, Boston Public Library
alt_text: A painting of a group of figures in a dimly lit, arched indoor space. In the center, a person lies horizontally on a raised platform, covered by dark fabric. A crowd of people stands to the left side, dressed in muted, earth-toned clothing. On the right side, a few taller figures in pale robes stand while gesturing or looking upward. The scene is long and narrow, with shadows obscuring some of the background details.

title: Portrait of Child
alt_text: A painting of a person with long, dark hair against a very dark background. The subject is shown from the chest up and looks toward the right side of the frame with a serious expression. Light falls on the person's face, highlighting their features while the rest of the image fades into deep shadow. The artwork is enclosed in a thick, ornate, and shiny gold frame that features carved flower patterns. The corners of the frame are partially covered by protective tan paper wrapping.

title: Fete Galante
alt_text: A painting of a dark, crowded scene features several figures gathered in a dimly lit space. To the left, a group of people appear to be huddled together near a central point of light. A tall, pale, standing figure occupies the center of the composition, wearing light-colored clothing. On the right side, a figure leans forward while appearing to hold or play a musical instrument. The background is mostly obscured by deep shadows and murky brown tones that blur the details.

title: Figure Study of Stephen Girard and Boy, for The Apotheosis of Pennsylvania, House of Representatives Chamber, Pennsylvania State Capitol, Harrisburg
alt_text: A painting of a man and a young boy standing side-by-side against a dark, shadowy background. The older man is on the right, wearing a blue jacket over a light-colored vest and trousers, and he holds a cane in his left hand. His right arm rests gently on the shoulder of the boy standing next to him. The boy on the left wears a dark jacket with a white ruffled collar and dark pants. The painting is tall and narrow, showing the two figures from head to toe.

title: Study for The Reading of the Declaration of Independence, House of Representatives Chamber, Pennsylvania State Capitol, Harrisburg
alt_text: A painting of a large red brick building with many people gathered in front of it. A ghostly figure wearing a long, light-colored gown floats in the air near the top of the building's facade. A dense crowd of people in coats and hats fills the bottom portion of the scene. To the right of the building, a person stands on a wooden scaffolding structure attached to the wall. Lush green trees grow along the left side of the brick wall. The entire scene is framed by a tall, curved archway at the top of the painting.

title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small baby up toward her face. The woman wears a bright red dress covered by a flowing blue shawl. A white baby is held in her arms, looking back at her. To the right, an older man with a grey beard sits partially hidden among white, cloud-like forms. The background is a dark, hazy grey that fills the oval frame.

title: Mater Dolorosa
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows a woman with her head tilted slightly to the left. She wears a soft, white cloth wrapped over her hair and neck. Her bright blue robe has sleeves trimmed with thick, brown fur at the wrists. Her hands are pressed together in front of her chest in a gesture of prayer or quiet reflection. The background behind her is a flat, solid gold color.

title: Virgin and Child with Saint Anne
alt_text: A painting of two women, a small child, and an older man in a landscape. In the center, a woman with long wavy hair sits on the grass wearing a long pink dress, holding a small baby. To her right, a second woman with a white head covering sits wearing a dark green robe and reading from an open book. Behind them on the left, an older man with a long beard and a brown hat walks past a stone building. A large peacock with a patterned tail stands on the far right, near a body of water and a distant city. The scene is set outdoors with soft, grassy ground and hills in the background.

title: Unidentified portrait of a man
alt_text: A painting of a man facing forward, set in a gold frame. The man has short, dark hair and light skin, and he is looking directly at the viewer with a slight smile. He wears a dark coat over a white shirt and a dark necktie. The background is a very dark, indistinct color with a hint of a red curtain on the right side. Below the frame, a small white paper label reads "ILE 1937.80" in blue ink.

title: The Death of Actaeon
alt_text: A painting showing a dark, wooded landscape filled with various animals and human figures. In the foreground, several large dogs surround a fallen dark shape near a winding stream. Further back, two people sit together on a small hill under the shade of trees. A tall, pale structure with crumbling walls sits atop a grassy hill in the distance. The entire scene is bathed in muted, shadowy colors, giving it a somber mood.

title: Vincent
alt_text: A painting of a face done in shades of gray, white, and black. The subject is seen from the side and faces toward the left. Broad, messy brushstrokes define the features and the head shape against a light gray background. A dark shape near the mouth suggests a pipe or a similar object being held. The bottom right corner has a signature written in dark ink.

title: La Brouette ceux Souvenirs
alt_text: A painting on canvasboard shows abstract, colorful shapes against a light tan background. Two prominent yellow, vertical shapes sit in the center, overlapping with messy streaks of green, orange, and red paint. The colors are applied in loose, blended strokes that create an indistinct, cloudy form. The painting is mounted inside a wide, textured, off-white mat. In the bottom right corner of the painting, there is a small signature in black ink.

title: Mozart
alt_text: A painting of a young person wearing a light-colored coat and a wig. The subject faces slightly to the side with dark hair styled into short curls that frame their face. They have a calm expression with soft, flushed cheeks and large, dark eyes. The person wears a buttoned jacket over a dark vest, with a glimpse of a white collar at the neck. A dark, muted background surrounds the figure, placing all the focus on their face and upper body.

title: The Entombment
alt_text: A painting of a group of people gathered around a man lying on a stone slab. The man is pale, has long hair, and shows red wounds on his chest and hands. Surrounding him are several men and women wearing colorful, traditional robes and head coverings, with some figures looking sad and others crying. Behind the group is a solid gold background that makes the figures stand out. The painting is framed by a wide border with large, gold-painted letters that form words around the edges.

title: Humorous Abduction #3
alt_text: A painting of abstract, jagged shapes arranged in a scene against a blue and white background. Bright red, yellow, and deep blue blocks of color overlap to create distorted forms that look like figures standing or sitting together. Many thin, vertical streaks of paint drip down from these shapes toward the bottom of the canvas. The bottom edge features a band of dark gray, while the overall composition uses thick outlines in white and dark blue. The scene feels chaotic and expressive with many layered, non-realistic shapes clustered in the center.

title: Aldebaran
alt_text: A painting showing a pattern of four cross-shaped, rounded forms on a light beige background. These four shapes are arranged in a diamond configuration around the center of the canvas. Two of the crosses are a deep blue color and are positioned at the top and bottom. The other two crosses are a dark red color and are placed on the left and right sides. The arms of each cross end in small circles, giving them a soft, bubbly appearance. All four shapes are identical in size and style.

title: Landscape #87 "T"
alt_text: A painting of an abstract geometric figure set against a light grey background. The figure is composed of several block-like shapes, creating the appearance of a star or an angular human form. These blocks are painted in alternating patterns of solid black and white to create a three-dimensional effect. The central shape has arms extending diagonally outward, while other sections point downward. The overall design looks like a puzzle of cubes fitted together on a flat surface.

title: Rhyme
alt_text: A painting of a series of concentric circles centered on a square, cream-colored background. At the very middle sits a solid red circle, which is surrounded by a thin white ring. Enclosing the white ring is a wider, solid black band, followed by a thick blue ring. Around these crisp shapes is an outer layer of vibrant orange-red paint with an uneven, splattered edge. The paint appears to bleed outward like a cloud, creating a rough and irregular perimeter against the empty background.

title: Aerial
alt_text: A painting of two abstract shapes floating in a dark, mottled brown space. A large, light-colored figure with a smooth, curved shape stands on the left side, resembling a tall, thin creature. Above it, a smaller, darker, and more angular shape drifts toward the right. At the bottom of the canvas, a jagged, bright red line stretches across the width of the image. The red area appears to have sharp, triangular peaks pointing upward.

title: Été (Summer)
alt_text: A painting, oil on canvas, shows a grid of colorful, abstract geometric shapes. In the top half, a large orange circle sits on a black background next to a purple square and a blue semicircle. In the bottom half, a large red circle sits on a dark green background next to a blue semicircle and a small white rectangle. Thin black and white lines are placed vertically and horizontally between the shapes to create separation. The composition feels balanced with a mix of solid, bold colors arranged in sections.

title: Nonending Nonagon
alt_text: A painting of a bright yellow square containing a large, red number nine in the center. Behind the number is a dark, nine-sided shape that sits inside a white circle. The word "NONENDING" arcs across the top half of the circle, while "VONAGON" arcs across the bottom half. Both words appear in bold, black capital letters. Beneath the circle, the word "NONAGON" is printed in the same black font against the yellow background.

title: The Nurburg Ring
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes and swirling lines that fill the entire frame. The top portion features thick, radiating bands of alternating yellow and red that curve inward toward a center point. Below this, a large circular pattern dominates the lower two-thirds of the image, composed of jagged, interlocking shapes in bright blue and orange. Dark, thick black lines separate every distinct color section throughout the artwork. In the very center of the blue and orange spiral, a small, white rectangular shape sits by itself.

title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine of Alexandria
alt_text: A painting of a group of people outdoors. In the center, a woman in a green dress and white skirt kneels and reaches out toward a small baby held by another woman wearing a dark blue robe. An older man with a beard and reddish-orange robes sits behind them, while a woman in a brown hood looks down from above. In the background, there is a sprawling landscape with hills, a lake, and a clear blue sky. Small, angelic faces float in the upper left corner near the group.

title: Portrait of a Man
alt_text: A painting of a man's face shown in profile against a dark background. He has a full, dark beard and mustache with streaks of gray. His hair is also dark and appears tousled. He wears a heavy, brown garment that looks like fur over a red-toned vest. A thin gold chain hangs loosely around his neck.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of flowers in an urn shows a dense, colorful bouquet set against a very dark background. The arrangement includes many types of blooms in shades of red, white, pink, and purple that spill out from the top. Below the flowers sits a decorative gold urn with rounded sides and an ornate base. Faint carvings of figures appear on the front of the urn. A cluster of light blue blossoms hangs down on the lower left side, contrasting with the dark space. The entire scene is presented within an eight-sided, octagonal frame.

title: The Return from Egypt
alt_text: A painting of a family eating together outside in front of a rustic stone house. In the center, a man and a woman sit at a table covered by a white cloth with a young child on the woman's lap. A second, older child kneels beside them while a woman stands nearby holding a platter. To the right, another person kneels on the ground near a large stone block and a dark animal. The background shows a dim, cloudy sky over rolling hills.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints Catherine and Nicholas
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small baby, flanked by another woman on the left and an older man on the right. The central woman wears a red dress with a blue and gold mantle over her shoulders and a light-colored veil covering her hair. The woman on the left has long, light brown hair and wears a deep green dress while holding a thin palm frond. On the right, an older man with a white beard wears ornate red robes and holds a large book and a tall, decorative staff. Behind the group, a blue sky fades into distant, hazy mountains in the background. The scene is set behind a low, stone-colored ledge that runs across the bottom of the painting.

title: Head of a Man
alt_text: An oil painting of an older man with gray, curly hair gazing forward. He wears a heavy, dark fur collar over a green jacket. Light highlights his wrinkled forehead and the bridge of his nose. His expression is serious, and his eyes look directly toward the viewer. The background is a dark, indistinct brown shadow.

title: Herdsmen in an Italian Landscape
alt_text: A painting showing a landscape scene with people and animals traveling across an open field. In the foreground, two figures on horseback and one person walking with a small dog move from left to right. Several pack animals, possibly donkeys or oxen, carry heavy loads across the grassy ground. Behind them, a large, rounded mountain rises against a pale, warm sky. Further in the distance, a calm body of water reflects the light near a small puff of smoke. The scene is lit by soft, golden light that suggests either sunrise or sunset.

title: Two Men in a Tavern
alt_text: A painting of two men sitting together in a dark, dimly lit room. The man on the left wears a large, tall black hat and a tan jacket with red sleeves and a white ruffled collar. He holds a piece of white paper in his hands and looks towards the other man with a smile. The second man, sitting to the right, is looking up while tilting a glass to his mouth to drink. On the table between them sits a small, round wooden box and a long pipe.

title: Hamlet and Horatio
alt_text: A painting of two figures standing in a dark, wooded area. Both figures wear long, bright blue robes and have indistinct, shadowed faces. One figure holds a round, dark object in their hands. Behind them, a dark brown, twisted form rests on the ground. Several tall, bare tree trunks rise up into the dark background of the scene.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting showing a large, abstract white shape against a solid black background. The white shape resembles the letter "V" or a wishbone, but with rounded, thick ends. It spans nearly the entire height of the canvas, stretching from the top edge down toward the bottom. The sides of the white form are smooth and curved. The surrounding black space creates a stark contrast with the bright center form.

title: Interior of a Gothic Church at Night
alt_text: A painting of a dim church interior with tall, dark stone arches. On the left, a bright, golden-lit chapel area reveals a group of people gathered near an altar. Several other figures are scattered throughout the shadowed main hall, including some standing and one kneeling on the checkered floor. A man in the bottom left foreground walks toward the chapel carrying a glowing lantern. Long, dramatic shadows stretch across the stone floor, contrasting with the warm light coming from the side room.

title: Figures in Love
alt_text: A painting showing two figures embracing in a close, abstract style. The figure on the left is large with reddish-brown skin, and the figure on the right wears a white shirt and has green skin. Their heads are leaned together, creating a sense of intimacy. The background is a mix of bright yellow, red, and green brushstrokes that look textured. On the bottom right side, there is a small white scrap of paper with red text on it. The entire image uses bold, uneven brushwork and a vivid, colorful palette.

title: Santa Barbara Chairs
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting at a round white table outside on a sunny day. The man has a beard, wears glasses, and is dressed in a rust-colored shirt. He sits in a white chair at the table, which is placed on a light-colored patio surface next to a green lawn. In the foreground, two more empty outdoor chairs with white woven seats sit facing the table. A dark, shadowy hedge forms a dense background behind the man. The scene is filled with bright sunlight that creates strong shadows on the grass and patio.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a man facing forward, set against a solid, brownish-tan background. The man has short, light-brown hair and wears thin, round, wire-rimmed glasses. He is dressed in a dark brown and black plaid collared shirt with the sleeves rolled up slightly. His hands are folded loosely in front of his waist, and he wears blue jeans held up by a simple belt. A black watch with a silver face is visible on his left wrist.

title: Palette of John Ferguson Weir
alt_text: A wooden palette with oil paint shows a worn, oval-shaped board used for mixing colors. The surface is dark brown and covered in various smears of dried, textured paint in shades of blue, white, yellow, and black. A circular hole for a thumb is located on the right side of the wooden board. A small white paper tag hangs from a thin string near this thumb hole. The background behind the palette is a plain, light, and slightly wrinkled fabric.

title: Yellow Rose #5
alt_text: A painting shows an abstract shape against a solid background. The background is a soft, warm shade of tan or light orange. In the lower right, a curved shape sits anchored against the bottom edge of the frame. This shape is split into two sections: a larger, bright yellow portion on the right, and a smaller, pale green section on the left. The green part curves gently upward, appearing to overlap the yellow section.

title: The Vestibule
alt_text: A painting of a collage made with canvas on board features abstract shapes in shades of cream, beige, and black. Multiple rectangular and angular pieces of canvas are layered to create a blocky, architectural appearance. The composition is dominated by light, neutral-colored panels that form overlapping sections. Dark black areas are tucked into the corners and edges, providing a strong contrast to the lighter canvas pieces. Thin, dark lines trace some of the borders between the shapes, giving the work a sense of structure.

title: Vulcan
alt_text: A painting of abstract, broad brushstrokes features a mix of bold colors against a mostly white background. A large, dark green shape dominates the upper center, tilted diagonally toward the right. Below this, a bright, solid orange area curves across the lower section. Streaks of deep blue run vertically down the left side, while lighter gray and purple patches appear at the bottom. The paint application is thick and energetic, with some drips visible near the lower edges.

title: Hommage à Richard I, duc de Normandie
alt_text: A painting of an abstract composition with red, blue, and white marks on a black background. The center of the image features a bold, thick line of dark red paint that cuts diagonally across the canvas from left to right. Around this red shape, there are several thinner, lighter white marks that look like tangled, spindly lines. These white lines are concentrated mostly on the right side of the canvas. A patch of deep, solid blue paint sits behind the red shapes in the middle. The entire scene is set against a dark, matte black backdrop that fills the rest of the space.

title: Liberty Leading the People (after Delacroix)
alt_text: A painting of a group of people in conflict against a smoky background. In the center, a woman stands tall while waving a red, white, and blue flag in one hand and holding a rifle in the other. She is surrounded by several men who are also carrying guns and wearing various hats and clothes. Several bodies lie motionless on the ground in the foreground. The entire scene uses strong contrasts of light and dark colors.

title: Man in Chair with Beer
medium: Fiberglass and polyester resin, oil paint, and mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture of a man sitting in a chair, appearing to be asleep. The man is wearing a white t-shirt and grey slacks, and he holds a small, orange soda can in one hand. He sits in a green upholstered chair with a green pillow behind his head. On the floor to his right, a newspaper is spread out on the ground near his boots. The background is a simple corner of a room with light-colored brick walls and a concrete pillar.

title: Capella 4
alt_text: A painting of black and white vertical lines of varying widths. The composition is divided into two distinct sections. On the left, the white lines widen in the middle, creating a curved, bulging effect against the black background. On the right, the black lines widen in the middle, while the white background remains straight. These repeating patterns create a sense of movement and visual rhythm across the surface. The high contrast between the black and white areas dominates the entire image.

title: Nude on Chaise Longue
alt_text: A painting of a person lying on a red wooden lounge chair. The person is nude and curled up on a dark green cushion that covers the lounge. The lounge chair sits on a floor made of wooden planks with diagonal shadows across it. A bright light hits the person's back and hip from above. The scene uses bold colors with sharp, clean lines throughout the composition.

A painting of the exterior of a building with several signs and architectural details. A large, bright yellow script letter "R" stands out against a dark red and striped yellow background. Below this, a sign with bold, black text reads "Elevators." To the left, a vertical sign features a white box with the black numbers "5", "1", and "2" stacked vertically. A light blue sign below it displays the word "FASHIONS" in red letters. The scene is brightly lit with strong, angular shadows cast across the surfaces.

title: Slab with Ruler
alt_text: A lead sculpture on wood shows a dark, flat, rectangular surface. A diagonal crease runs from the upper left side down toward the lower right corner. This crease looks like a folded fabric or a deep wrinkle in the gray metal material. Inside this fold, a small, straight, rod-like shape is partially visible. The entire piece is enclosed within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Indian Summer
alt_text: A painting shows a vibrant, cluttered scene filled with human-like figures, animals, and stylized nature. On the left side, a large face with a textured red surface stares forward above a person wearing a light, patterned robe. Toward the center, a tall figure with pale, feather-like hair stands amidst a background of bright green, leafy trees and dotted shapes. In the bottom right corner, a black-and-white spotted dog sits alertly, facing toward the left side of the frame. Many smaller, dark shapes and faces are hidden throughout the composition, blending into the colorful, busy background.

title: Highway Diner
alt_text: A painting of a diner building with a metal exterior sitting beside a two-story house. The diner has the words "Highway Diner" written in large letters across its front above the entrance. Two vintage cars are parked on a paved lot in front of the building, and a taller, leafy tree stands to the right. A separate sign for the diner also appears on the right side of the image near the street. The scene is presented in grayscale, showing strong light and shadows on the ground.

title: Boxed Being
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture shows a tall, vertical rectangular box filled with various dark, geometric wooden shapes. The entire object is painted a matte black color and is set against a plain gray background. Inside the box, a solid square block sits at the top. Below the square, two circular wooden discs with holes in their centers are stacked side-by-side. A long, thin, vertical splinter of wood runs downward from the top square, partially covering one of the circles and resting against a larger, rectangular piece of wood that occupies the bottom half of the frame.

title: MAN
alt_text: A painting showing a thick, textured, pale pink shape centered against a dark background. The central form is bulky and rounded, with uneven, rough paint strokes creating its mass. Hints of dark paint blur the edges where the pink shape meets the black surroundings. The surface appears heavy and layered, with some deeper red tones visible near the bottom right edge. The overall composition is abstract, dominated by the contrast between the light-colored center and the surrounding dark space.

title: Still Life with Fruit and a Bird
alt_text: A painting shows a still life arrangement on a dark, flat surface. On the left, two round wooden containers are stacked, with a small jar and a metal knife resting nearby. A glass stands in the middle, while a large wicker basket lies on its side, spilling red apples and pears across the foreground. A light-colored bird sits perched on the rim of the basket. The entire scene is lit from the side against a dark, shadowy background.

title: Landscape with Huntsman
alt_text: A painting of a landscape features a large, bare tree standing in the foreground on a grassy hill. Below the tree, a calm, narrow river flows past the base of the hill towards the left side of the frame. A person wearing a bright red jacket stands on the grassy bank near the tree's base. The sky above is filled with soft, light clouds that indicate either sunrise or sunset. A highly detailed, ornate gold frame surrounds the entire painting.

title: Negra y Blanca
alt_text: A painting of an abstract shape centered on a dark, solid background. This central form is mostly light gray and beige with a rough, textured look. Darker, spindly lines cross over the top and bottom sections of this shape like a tangled net. The shape is uneven, with a rounded, blocky edge on the right and a jagged, irregular side on the left. Surrounding the entire piece is a thin, simple frame.

title: Horse and Rider
