alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a horse and its rider in motion. The figures appear to be cast in metal with a dark, textured brown surface. A person sits upright on the back of the horse with their arms slightly extended to the side. The horse is mid-stride, with its front legs lifted and its tail pointing backward. The entire sculpture is mounted on a flat, rectangular bronze base and supported by a single metal rod.

title: The Reconciliation of Jacob and Esau
alt_text: A painting of a rocky, mountainous landscape featuring a large group of soldiers in the foreground. On the left side, a tall, dark tree stands prominently over a path where a person kneels before a small group of figures. To the right, a large line of soldiers carrying long spears stretches across the lower portion of the image. The background reveals a winding river that flows through a valley between steep, craggy cliffs. In the distance, a small town with several buildings and a castle sits along the riverbank under a dark, cloudy sky.

title: River Landscape with Travelers
alt_text: A painting of a landscape scene with people near a waterway under a cloudy sky. To the left, two people in a small rowboat drift on the calm water near a simple wooden bridge. On the grassy bank to the right, large trees grow along a path where several people are walking or standing. Two of the people on the path are riding horses, while others are gathered in small groups. The sky above is gray and filled with soft, rolling clouds.

title: Volta VIII
alt_text: A painting with a black background and white lines. The image is filled with a complex pattern of white geometric shapes. These shapes include several circles, curved bands, and straight lines. Some of the circles overlap each other in the center and to the right side. Thin, white rectangles are also present, some appearing to be attached to the curved lines. The entire composition looks flat, with no clear sense of depth or shadow.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of dense, textured static fills the frame from edge to edge. The surface appears to be covered in countless tiny, irregular dots of black and white. These speckles create a vibrating, high-contrast effect that looks similar to television snow. The overall composition is uniform with no clear focal point or distinct shapes visible. It gives the impression of a textured, monochromatic field.

title: Exuberance
alt_text: A painting of a textured, abstract surface creates a uniform, deep-green pattern across the entire frame. The paint appears to be applied in short, overlapping dabs and strokes that resemble a dense forest floor or mossy rock. Variations in the green color include lighter, brighter highlights and deeper, darker shadows that look almost black. These dark spots appear randomly throughout the surface, adding a sense of depth and broken contrast. The overall effect is a busy, chaotic arrangement of light and dark specks that fill the square composition.

title: Edith Piaf
medium: Oil and paper collage on canvas
alt_text: A painting showing a colorful, abstract composition featuring a reclining figure surrounded by geometric and organic shapes. The figure stretches across the bottom portion of the canvas, defined by thin black outlines and pale, neutral skin tones. Above and around the figure, bold, flat shapes in white, black, red, and yellow float against a textured, multi-colored background. Some of these shapes look like stylized clover leaves or abstract flower petals with dark, thick outlines. The entire surface is covered in layers of paint and collage elements, creating a busy and textured visual field.

title: Honey, It's the Whitney...
alt_text: A painting showing a scene set on a sandy beach. A woman stands in the center foreground with her back to the viewer, wearing only dark-colored bikini bottoms. She holds a red telephone receiver in one hand and a green bottle in the other. Surrounding her on the sand are several rectangular canvases that appear to be paintings themselves. These canvases display various scenes, including people standing in water, a figure sitting, and a woman with her hands clasped in prayer. The background shows the ocean stretching toward the horizon under a blue sky with white clouds.

title: Landscape with a Ruin
alt_text: A painting of a ruined stone structure standing in a grassy field by a body of water. The tall, crumbling building is tan and brown, with a large arched opening in the center. In the foreground, several small figures walk along the dirt path and grass near the water's edge. One person is riding a donkey, while others are gathered with a small flock of sheep. The bright blue sky above is filled with soft, white clouds that drift over the landscape.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows four rectangular blocks arranged in a stack. Two long, flat blocks sit horizontally on the bottom, placed side-by-side. Above these, two upright blocks stand vertically, also side-by-side. The entire object has a dark brown, metallic surface with some lighter, worn spots. It stands against a plain, light grey background.

title: A Quack at Work in a Barn
alt_text: A painting shows three men inside a dimly lit, brown-walled room. One man kneels on the floor, working on an injury on the exposed lower back of a second man who sits on a wooden stool. A third, older man stands behind them, leaning forward with his hands on the seated man's shoulder. A white cloth stained with red sits near the injury, and a small ceramic jar rests on the floor directly beneath the stool. In the background, a small window with a cross-patterned frame lets in faint light.

title: Ellipse with Orange, Yellow, and Blue, I
alt_text: A painting showing colorful, angular lines on a white oval background. A vertical black line runs down the center of the oval, dividing the space in two. To the left of the black line, a thick orange band forms a right angle that points toward the center. On the right side, a yellow band forms a right angle near the top, while a blue band forms a right angle near the bottom. These colored lines create a simple, clean design against the bright white surface. The painting is mounted in front of a metal, grid-like structure.

title: Nero '56
medium: Collage; burlap, paper, and oil on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a black collage with burlap, paper, and oil on canvas features a dark, textured surface. The artwork is set within a simple, thin wooden frame. Across the center, there are several vertical shapes and rough, torn-looking patches that reveal lighter brown and tan fibers beneath the black paint. To the right, thin, crisscrossing lines stretch across the dark material like stitches or netting. The entire composition has a rough, uneven appearance with deep shadows and varied layers.

title: Sanchez Cotan: Quince, Cabbage, Melon, and Cucumber
alt_text: A painting of various produce arranged against a dark, recessed background. Hanging from the top left are two items: a round, yellow fruit and a head of leafy green cabbage. Below them, sitting on a flat ledge, is a cut-open, striped melon next to a single slice. To the right of the melon sits a small, bumpy green cucumber. The entire scene is framed by dark grey walls that create the illusion of a deep, shadowed nook.

title: SPIDER LADY NEST
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media shows a shallow, rectangular box viewed from the front. A light brown, retractable fabric shade covers the top third of the opening, held in place by a small white pull cord. Beneath the shade, the box is filled with tangled, pale, semi-transparent netting that drapes across the space. Behind the netting, dark, blurry shapes are visible against a white background with some white drips. A patch of textured, dark brown material sits on the left side of the box's inner edge. The entire structure is encased in a simple, rough wooden frame.

title: Walt's Restaurant
alt_text: A painting of a diner interior where an older man sits alone. The man has a bald head and wears a green suit jacket with a yellow tie while holding a white cup. He sits at a square table in the middle of the room, looking out a large window that faces a street and another building. In the foreground, a longer, empty table with dark surfaces sits near a pinball machine and wooden-paneled walls. A music jukebox stands behind the man, while red curtains hang along the side of the window.

title: Cratère (Crater)
alt_text: A painting of a vertical, textured composition featuring a figure-like shape on the right. This central form is painted in thick, dark shades of maroon and brown. It stands out against a background filled with lighter, muddy tones of beige and gray. The entire surface has deep, heavy brushstrokes that create a rugged and uneven appearance. The bottom right corner contains a small, dark signature and the date.

title: Mixer Changer
alt_text: A painting of a rectangular, horizontal field filled with a single, textured color. The entire surface appears to be a light, sandy yellow or soft beige shade. There are very subtle variations in the tone, with the corners appearing slightly darker or more faded than the center. A thin, gold-colored metal frame outlines the entire shape. The surface has a grainy, matte appearance.

title: Chickasaw VII
alt_text: A painting of large, rectangular green panels arranged together in a square frame. The central section is a large, bright lime-green rectangle that fills most of the upper space. Two thinner, darker green rectangular columns stand vertically on both the left and right sides of this central piece. Below the central rectangle sits a wide, darker green horizontal band that stretches across the width of the canvas. This horizontal band is separated from the top sections by a thin, dark line. A very narrow strip of dark green runs along the bottom edge of the entire painting.

title: Jeannine
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows dark, energetic brushstrokes against a plain white background. Thick black paint forms chaotic shapes, lines, and textures concentrated in the center of the surface. Some areas show lighter gray strokes that blend with the black, creating a sense of movement. The composition is unbalanced, appearing to cluster more heavily near the top. The rest of the rectangular canvas remains mostly empty, highlighting the stark contrast of the dark marks.

title: Kala 6
alt_text: A painting of two distinct horizontal sections stacked on top of each other. The upper half has a textured, mottled gray surface covered in thin, white, scribbled lines that twist and loop throughout. Below this, the bottom half is a flat, dark red color. The lower section features several thin, faint, red concentric arcs that originate from the middle of the bottom edge. These circular lines gently curve upward and outward across the red space.

title: Écriture noire (Black Writing)
alt_text: A sculpture of painted wood and metal features a large, rectangular panel with many vertical lines. The center section is a gray, textured area filled with countless thin, closely spaced vertical stripes. Over these stripes, a few faint, dark lines curve and loop across the surface in simple, rounded shapes. The entire panel is framed by plain, solid white borders at the top and bottom. The structure is set against a neutral, flat gray background that makes the object appear to hover.

title: Black Lead Saturn
alt_text: A painting of black shapes arranged on a cream-colored background. Large, dark curves dominate the upper and right portions of the canvas, framing a light-colored negative space. Below these curves, a separate, solid dark oval shape sits on the lower left side. To the right of that, a larger dark circle rests near the bottom edge. Patches of pale blue and light brown appear in the background, contrasting with the dark forms.

title: Untitled no. 126
alt_text: A painting of scattered, irregular shapes in bright colors against a white background. Deep blue, vibrant red, orange, and green blocks fill the space, separated by large white gaps. The shapes are mostly blocky and varied in size, creating a puzzle-like pattern across the canvas. Thick brushstrokes give the colored areas a textured appearance. The painting covers the entire surface with no single focal point.

title: View of the Grand Canal from the Ponte di Rialto
alt_text: A painting showing a canal scene with several boats and tall buildings along both banks. The water in the center is calm and reflects the overcast, brownish-grey sky above. On the left and right sides, groups of multi-story buildings line the water's edge, featuring many small windows. Various small boats and gondola-like vessels are docked or moving slowly along the canal. The scene is dominated by earthy, muted colors like brown, grey, and deep ochre.

title: Homo-Fly
alt_text: A painting of a green, winged creature crouching against a dark red brick wall. The creature has a pale, human-like face, large dark eyes, and a hunched body with pointed wings spread out wide. Its skin appears to be a textured mix of green shades, while its outline is surrounded by jagged, orange lines that look like radiating energy or spikes. The background is a solid brick wall pattern painted in deep, earthy red tones. Near the bottom edge, there are blurry, white vertical marks that resemble drips or streaks of paint.

title: Wilkes
alt_text: A painting of a quiet town street during the daytime. The view looks down a paved road lined with several low-rise storefronts and businesses on the left. A tall, curved sign featuring the word "WILKES" stands prominently among the buildings. On the right side of the road, a dark-colored pickup truck is parked facing away from the viewer. A bright blue sky stretches across the top of the scene, while a large, leafy green tree grows near the buildings on the right.

title: Two White Onions
alt_text: A painting of two round, pale bulbs sitting side-by-side on a light-colored surface. The bulb on the left is positioned slightly forward with its stem pointing toward the viewer. The bulb on the right is taller and more pointed at the top. A loose, curled layer of papery skin lies on the surface to the right of the second bulb. The background is a soft, neutral grey with a bright reflection at the top. The entire scene is softly lit, creating subtle shadows beneath the objects.

title: Far Rockaway Seascape No 9
medium: Oil on paper mounted on wood
alt_text: A painting of a seascape arranged in a grid of rectangular panels. The central part of the painting shows a wide, blue ocean under a cloudy sky, with small boats scattered across the water. The horizon line is soft and hazy, blending the light blue sea into the clouds above. A thick border made of separate colored rectangles frames this central scene. These border panels feature shades of orange, green, and dark brown that look like abstract, blurred landscapes. The painting feels calm and open, with smooth colors flowing into one another throughout the different sections.

title: Pearl
alt_text: A painting of abstract, blocky shapes in muted colors. The center of the work features a stack of thick, light-colored rectangular forms that resemble a ladder or a tiered structure. Dark green and black shapes surround this central element, creating a stark contrast against the lighter center. To the lower right, a distinct gray rectangular shape sits horizontally, framed by thick black lines. Other smaller, indistinct shapes in shades of brown, white, and green are scattered throughout the background.

title: Details of Cut One
medium: Gouache on board, grill, and Miami construction fence
alt_text: A sculpture of two rectangular panels depicts lush nature scenes filled with diverse wildlife. The left panel shows a large crocodile resting near a swampy area, while a manatee swims below among various fish and shells. Above the crocodile, a deer stands near tall grasses, with birds perched in the large, leafy plants that fill the background. The right panel features another crocodile swimming near more leafy foliage, with a sea turtle and a squid below it surrounded by fish and starfish. Both panels share a consistent, warm, golden-brown color palette and are framed by a grid-like border.

title: Autumn Chemistry
alt_text: A painting of a white dog's head looking to the right over a landscape scene. This scene shows tall, bright red rock formations set against a soft, pastel-colored sky. In the foreground, a large, black outline of a leaf sits on top of the colorful mountains. A small, black-and-white animal is flying near the lower right side. The entire painted scene is framed within the shape of a black artist's palette with a small pile of colorful paint blobs in the upper right corner.

title: Still Life with Reluctant Bird
alt_text: A painting showing several abstract, sculptural shapes grouped together. On the left, a tall, pale, curved form with small rectangular openings sits atop a larger, dark green, winding structure. To the right, a textured, green, and gold shape twists upward like a flame. The background is a mix of geometric blocks and swirls in shades of red, blue, yellow, and tan. These objects sit on a flat surface that looks like a table or ledge.

title: Hunting Ground
alt_text: A painting of a dark, grassy field surrounded by trees at twilight. A pale, long-bodied animal leaps through the air on the left side of the scene. On the right, only the head and shoulders of a similar animal are visible as it emerges from the tree line. The trees in the center are illuminated by a bright, silvery light that contrasts with the deep shadows. A tiny, faint shape of another animal can be seen in the distance between the trees on the left.

title: Laurel Lane
alt_text: A painting of a dirt road leading into a dense, green forest. Two large, dark evergreen trees stand on either side of the path, casting deep shadows. A bright, textured patch of white light or glare appears on the right side of the foliage, partially obscuring the branches. Patches of green grass and smaller bushes line the sides of the path as it recedes into the distance. The lighting suggests it is a bright, sunny day.

title: A Calm Sea
medium: Pen and ink and oil on panel
alt_text: A painting of several sailing ships on a calm body of water. The scene is rendered in muted gray tones, creating a hazy, overcast atmosphere. In the foreground on the left, a sailboat sits with its sails partially raised. To the right, a larger, more detailed ship floats in the distance. The shoreline in the lower right corner features dark, tangled brush and a few low-lying plants. Faint outlines of other distant boats and a flock of small birds in the sky complete the quiet view.

title: A Stormy Sea
medium: Pen and ink and oil on panel
alt_text: A painting of ships at sea using pen, ink, and oil on a panel. The scene features multiple sailing ships floating on choppy, grey water. To the left, a single, smaller boat tilts slightly while riding the waves. In the center and to the right, a larger, more detailed vessel with many masts sits prominently on the water, with a faint outline of another ship behind it. The sky above is vast, empty, and features a light, uniform grey tone.

title: A Rheinish Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a river landscape with mountains, a small town, and many people. On the right, a tall, rocky hill rises up to a large castle with multiple pointed towers. Below the castle, a dirt path winds down the hill, where small groups of people are walking and standing. To the left, a river flows through the center of the scene, with several boats carrying goods and people docked along the shore. In the distance, a small village with a church tower sits nestled among rolling, tree-covered hills. The sky above is a soft, pale yellow and blue, suggesting early morning or late afternoon light.

title: Interior of a Gothic Church
alt_text: A painting of a large church interior features tall, vaulted ceilings and long rows of stone pillars. Small groups of people in period clothing walk and stand on a floor made of black and white checkered tiles. On the left, a woman holds a child's hand while walking past a pillar with a clock. Toward the center, a priest in white robes talks to a couple, accompanied by a small white dog. The background stretches deep into the building, showing distant arches, sunlight streaming through windows, and other figures moving about.

title: The Explosion of the Powder Magazine in Delft, 1654
alt_text: A painting of a city landscape with a large fire burning on the right side. In the foreground, several small figures in dark clothes are scattered across a brown, dirt-covered ground. Some people are standing, while others appear to be crouching or lying down near piles of debris and rubble. Behind the figures, the low walls of ruined buildings stretch across the middle of the scene. In the distance, several church spires and rooftops stand out against a dark, cloudy sky that is tinged with reddish smoke. The overall mood is somber, with a contrast between the brown earth and the bright flames rising into the hazy atmosphere.

title: Musicians Outside a Tavern
alt_text: A painting of a lively street scene featuring a group of people gathered in front of a building. In the center, a man with a peg leg plays a small stringed instrument while singing with his mouth wide open. Another man stands next to him, also singing loudly and playing an instrument. A crowd of several children and a few adults surrounds the musicians, watching them with animated expressions. Above the group hangs a dark sign attached to the brick building. The background shows a dusty, narrow street with other simple buildings under a pale, muted sky.

title: Untitled
medium:
Oil and varnished caviar on canvas
Kaviar dispersion, shellack on linen (taken from RBB's log)
alt_text: A painting in shades of deep green and dark brown shows a complex, layered surface. A web of thin, lighter lines stretches across the entire composition, resembling cracked paint or veins. Overlaid on these lines are clusters of dark, textured bumps that create a sense of three-dimensional depth. A small, white, rectangular object is visible on the far right edge near the top corner. The overall effect is glossy and dense, suggesting a heavily worked surface.

title: A Kitchen
alt_text: A painting of a dim kitchen interior shows a variety of items and people. A large, feathered bird hangs upside down from a hook near the center. Below the bird, a table holds a pile of green leafy vegetables and a container of fish, while a cat stands nearby reaching for the fish. To the right, a person in a dark coat leans over a wooden cupboard, while a seated woman in a light shirt watches a fire in a large hearth. Various clay pots, a copper bowl, and scattered vegetables sit on the floor in the foreground. The scene is illuminated by warm, soft light from the fireplace.

title: The Deposition
alt_text: A painting of several figures gathered around a large wooden cross in a landscape setting. A man in a turban stands on a ladder, lowering a shirtless, wounded man down toward an older man wearing a heavy, fur-trimmed red robe. Below them, a woman with elaborate headwear kneels on the ground in a pink dress, while to her left, a woman in a dark hooded cloak stands beside a man in red robes. To the right, another woman dressed in intricate gold and red clothing stands holding a small book. The background shows a rocky, hilly landscape with a small castle in the distance under a pale blue sky.

title: A Bagpiper
medium: Oil on paper, mounted on panel
alt_text: A painting of a person with exaggerated facial features, shown from the chest up. The individual has a very large, bulbous nose, a fleshy face, and a short, stout build. They are looking upward and to the left with one hand raised near their face, fingers splayed. In their other hand, they hold a brown, ceramic-style pitcher with a handle. The background is a dark, indistinct color that fades into shadow.

title: A Woman, traditionally identified as Isabela la Católica of Castile
alt_text: A painting of a woman with light skin and reddish-brown hair parted in the middle. She wears a dark hood trimmed with gold and small pearls that frames her face. Her white dress is visible at her neck, and she wears a gold necklace with intricate designs. A thin gold chain hangs down over her chest, ending at a round pin on the front of her dress. She looks slightly to the side with a serious expression against a plain, dark green background.

title: A Jester
alt_text: A painting of a person wearing a colorful, multi-pointed hat with bells. The person is grinning wide and looking at a small, dark-furred animal sitting on their shoulder. They hold a piece of food in one hand, while the other hand grips a long orange stick topped with a carved face wearing a matching hat. On a wooden table in front sits a half-eaten egg and a glass filled with deep red liquid. The person wears dark clothing with gold chains and gold rings on their fingers.

title: Moonlit River Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a dark river scene at sunset with a town along the bank. Large, moody storm clouds fill most of the sky, with patches of bright light breaking through near the center. On the left side, tall, ruined stone buildings rise up among dark trees. A wide river flows through the middle of the scene, reflecting the golden light of the setting sun. Several small boats float on the water, while three figures stand on the grassy, shadowed shore in the foreground.

title: The Poor Painter in His Studio
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting at an easel inside a dark, cluttered room. The man wears a wide-brimmed hat and a yellow coat while holding a palette and brushes. Behind him stands an older woman wearing a white headscarf and dark clothes. A small child with a white cap stands next to her and stares toward the painter. The background is dim, showing shadowy walls and some faint objects hanging up. A few small, indistinct items are scattered on the floor in the front of the scene.

title: A Castle by a River
alt_text: A painting of a large building standing in the water under a cloudy sky. The structure, which sits on the right side of the frame, has multiple stories, tall towers, and many windows. In the foreground, a small boat with several people sits near the shore on the left. The water is calm and reflects the building and the dim, brownish sky above. Further in the distance, small sailboats can be seen near a flat coastline.

title: Banquet Still Life with Nautilus Cup
alt_text: A painting of a still life set on a table covered in a blue cloth. On the left, a large, ornate nautilus shell cup with a golden base stands on a silver tray. To the right, a ceramic bowl is overflowing with red grapes, peaches, and other fruit. Two delicate pink roses rest on the table near the silver tray. A long, curling strip of yellow lemon peel hangs off the edge of the table. In the background, a dark, shadowy wall contains a glimpse of a landscape scene through an opening.

title: Memorial
alt_text: A painting of a person standing on the right side of a chaotic and brightly colored scene. The man wears a tan jacket, a newsboy cap, and dark pants, and he leans one hand on a tall red ladder. Behind him and to the left, the scene is filled with swirling shapes and vibrant splashes of green, orange, red, and blue paint. Large, abstracted green wreaths or circular arrangements dominate the lower left foreground. Darker, indistinct forms seem to occupy the middle and upper left areas against a sky-like background of swirling white and grey.

title: A Banquet in the Ruins of a Temple
alt_text: A painting of a group of people having a meal on a balcony surrounded by tall stone columns. The people sit together at a long table covered in a white cloth, facing out toward a lush green park. To the left, one woman in a dress sits apart from the others, looking toward the group. A simple metal railing runs in front of the table, featuring a decorative face carving in the center. In the background, green trees and a small fountain rise up against a cloudy blue sky.

title: Peasant's Fun
alt_text: A painting of a group of people gathered in a dimly lit room. A man stands on the left wearing a yellow hat, a white shirt, and yellow pants, holding a glass of dark liquid up to the light. Three other people are seated or huddled near a wooden table in the center, and one woman in a blue shirt reaches across the table. Behind them, a shadowy, faint figure stands in the background to the right. A dark, ceramic jug sits on the floor in the bottom right corner of the scene.

title: The Great Bridge
alt_text: A painting of a rocky, wooded landscape with a waterfall flowing under a stone bridge. A small figure riding a donkey walks across the top of the bridge from left to right. Below the bridge, white water rushes over dark rocks in a stream that fills the foreground. Dense, dark green trees and steep cliff walls surround the bridge and the waterfall. To the right of the bridge, a leafy green tree stands against the background of the cascading water.

title: The Adoration of the Magi
alt_text: A painting showing a large group of people gathered around a seated woman holding a baby. The figures are dressed in elaborate clothing, including capes, armored sleeves, and pointed shoes. In the center, a man kneels before the baby and holds the child's foot. Surrounding them are crumbling stone buildings and large columns set against a light blue sky. Several other men observe the scene from the edges, with one offering a decorative gold cup.

title: Thomas
alt_text: A painting of a young boy with light skin and dark hair sits in a chair. He wears a cone-shaped hat and a dark jacket over a light collared shirt with a tie. His dark eyes look forward toward the viewer with a serious expression. Behind him, the background shows loose, blurry brushstrokes in shades of brown, green, and gray, suggesting an outdoor scene. The entire portrait is framed by a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: A Winter Scene
alt_text: A painting of a frozen landscape shows people moving across ice in the foreground. Several figures are scattered on the ice, including two people who appear to be playing a game with sticks. To the left, a small boat is frozen near the shore, and a simple building stands nearby. On the right, a large tree with bare, snow-covered branches sits next to a slanted, snow-covered roof. A wooden drawbridge stands in the distance over the ice, set against a dark, cloudy sky.

title: Drinnen und Draussen (Inside and Outside)
alt_text: A painting shows a split scene contrasting a crowded, opulent indoor party with a dim, somber street scene. On the right side, several well-dressed people in tuxedos and gowns enjoy a celebration at a table, including one man in the foreground smoking a cigar. A small, lit lamp and a wine bucket sit on the table among streamers and confetti. On the left side, a thin, distressed man with a crutch sits alone in a shadowy area, seemingly separated from the party by a thin red brick wall. The background on the left is hazy and filled with faint, indistinct figures moving under bare trees.

title: Saint Matthias
alt_text: A painting of a man with a long beard wearing bright red and green robes. He stands against a gold-colored background that has a curved arch at the top. The man holds a large, brown-handled axe over his left shoulder. In his right hand, he holds a long, white ribbon that curves downward across his body. This ribbon contains black text written in a fancy, flowing script. He stands on a ground that looks rocky or uneven, painted in shades of gray.

title: Saint Peter
alt_text: A wood sculpture of a man standing and wearing robes with a pointed hat. The figure has a beard and holds his right hand up with two fingers raised. In his left hand, he holds a vertical, square-shaped object. The sculpture is colored in red with gold trim details along the chest and robes. He stands on a thick, blocky base against a plain background.

title: The Temptation of Saint Anthony
alt_text: A painting showing a dark, chaotic scene filled with strange creatures and monsters in a mountainous landscape at night. In the center, an older man with a long white beard sits and holds a small open book, while a pale, luminous figure stands beside him. They are surrounded by a crowded group of dark, hairy, and animal-like beings that are interacting with them. Large, dark rock formations loom over the figures, and in the distance, fires burn on a hill and near a body of water. Small, winged creatures fly through the dark sky above, and strange beasts crawl on the ground in the foreground.

title: A Brothel Scene
alt_text: A painting shows a crowded indoor scene full of people inside a room with a large stone fireplace. Several groups of men and women dressed in varied, colorful clothing gather around a wooden table in the center, appearing to play a game with small tokens. To the right, a person leans forward near the open fire, holding long metal tongs over a small cooking pot. Above them, a separate smaller level shows figures near an open window or loft area. The walls are dark, and a wooden ceiling structure is visible at the very top.

title: Stardust Motel
alt_text: A painting of a bright outdoor scene filled with many large, colorful advertising signs and neon lights. On the left, a teal station wagon is parked near signs that feature words like Stardust and Lido, while a yellow car sits in the foreground. Several tall poles support these signs, which tower over the area against a light blue sky. A dark shopping center sign stands prominently on the right side, with other smaller signs stacked vertically beneath it. A few palm trees and asphalt parking areas fill the spaces between the signs and the cars.

title: Canadian Glaze
medium: Alkyd resin and aquatic gel on canvas
alt_text: A painting shows a vertical rectangular canvas with a light, textured surface. The background consists of soft, muted shades of off-white, light yellow, and pale beige. Several subtle, thin lines and small, raised clumps of material are scattered across the surface. These markings are slightly darker in tone, appearing as faint streaks of brown or metallic gold. The composition has an abstract appearance, with no distinct shapes or figures visible.

title: Landscape with a Foundry
alt_text: A painting shows a large, rocky cliff face dominating the left side of the scene, with tall, steep walls of brown and grey stone. At the base of these cliffs, a rustic building sits near a small stream, with smoke rising from its roof. To the right of the buildings, several small figures appear to be working near piles of straw or harvested material. A wide river winds through the valley in the background, surrounded by rolling, hazy blue hills. The entire scene is set under a pale, partly cloudy sky that transitions from soft pink to blue.

title: In Pursuit of Analogies
alt_text: A painting of several abstract shapes floating over a background with a patterned grid. A large, dark black blob dominates the center and upper left, featuring a bright red flower on a wavy stem. To the right of the black shape sits a textured, green object that looks like a segmented creature or armored form. Below these main figures, a circular, light-colored pool rests on the patterned ground. The background creates the illusion of a tiled floor receding into the distance.

title: Peasants Merrymaking in a Barn
alt_text: A painting of an indoor scene shows several people gathered in a rustic, barn-like space. In the center, a man wearing a blue jacket and a tall, dark hat stands while looking at a small, white object in his hands. A group of people sits on a low platform behind him, including one person wearing a pink jacket with their arms crossed. On the far left, a person with long dark hair sits on a low stool and gestures with one arm. In the lower right corner, another person sits and appears to be playing a stringed instrument. The room has wooden walls, a straw-covered ceiling, and a large, brightly lit white wall behind the central group.

title: The Open Window
alt_text: A painting of a still life scene arranged on and near a light-colored wooden cabinet. A window sits on the wall above the cabinet, showcasing a dark blue circular plate and a white square bowl on the sill. On the cabinet's surface, a metallic pot, a tall drinking glass, a striped vase, and a small bowl of fruit are placed. A white cloth with a blue and red floral pattern hangs over the front of the cabinet, while a solid black cloth drapes over the right side. The background wall is plain and white, framing the simple interior arrangement.

title: Queen of Sheba Breast
alt_text: A painting of simple, abstract shapes against a flat background. A large dark green crescent shape dominates the left and center of the frame, curving from the top left corner down to the bottom center. Inside the upper part of the green curve, there is a smooth, blue, rounded shape that is outlined by a thin tan border. In the lower right corner, on the flat tan background, sits a small, light purple, four-sided shape with rounded corners. Just below the purple shape is a smaller, round, orange spot. The overall composition uses solid, flat colors and rounded, organic forms.

title: Untitled (LP 8)
alt_text: A painting of abstract, vertical strokes fills the entire canvas. The colors are muted and earthy, mixing dark greens, browns, and shades of gray. Thin, long lines of paint run from the top edge down toward the bottom. Lighter patches of yellow and tan occasionally appear beneath the darker layers. The texture looks thick and layered, giving the surface a rough appearance.

title: Grey Skeletons
alt_text: A painting of four skeleton figures sitting close together against a gray background. Each figure is rendered in a loose, painterly style with broad strokes of white, gray, and black. The skeletons have hollow eye sockets and visible rib cages, with some figures overlapping one another. Splashes of bright green and yellow paint sit at the bottom of the canvas, providing a sharp contrast to the muted tones above. A signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the painting.

title: La forêt
alt_text: A painting of dark, textured, vertical shapes clustered together against an orange sky. These shapes look like rough bark or twisted wood, rising in various heights across the center and sides of the frame. The background is a solid, warm orange color that fades into a darker tone near the top. Floating near the upper right, a single, bright white circle sits suspended above the dark, jagged forms. The ground below is a dark, flat color that contrasts with the lighter sky above.

title: Wooded Landscape with Figures on a Path
alt_text: A painting of a quiet, rural landscape with a dirt path winding through it. In the bottom left, two figures walk along the path with a small dog trailing behind them. Tall, dark trees with brown and green leaves stand to the right and left, framing the scene. Two small cottages with peaked roofs are nestled in the grassy fields further back. The sky above is filled with dark, cloudy gray tones, suggesting an overcast day.

title: Saint Peter
alt_text: A painting of an elderly man with a receding hairline and grey, wavy hair. He has a thick grey beard and mustache that frame a serious expression. He wears a simple, dark brown outer garment over a lighter-colored shirt. His left hand is visible at the bottom of the frame, holding a large, dark-colored key. The man is positioned against a plain, light-colored background.

title: John Ferguson Weir's Paintbox
alt_text: A wooden paint box sits open, revealing a collection of art supplies inside. Resting on top of the open box is a flat, kidney-shaped wooden palette covered in dried, colorful dabs of oil paint. Inside the box are several compartments holding thin paintbrushes, a metal tool, and a small tube of paint. A narrow, beige cloth strip lies flat to the left of the box. Several white paper tags with handwritten numbers and text are attached to the front of the box by white strings.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a person seen from behind, sitting with their back to the viewer. The figure has light skin tones and their hair is pulled up into a loose bun. They are crouching on a surface covered in a textured, golden-yellow cloth. The background is simple, split horizontally into a darker grey lower section and a lighter, muted green upper section. The brushstrokes are visible throughout the piece, giving the figure and fabric a soft, textured appearance.

title: Sweden
alt_text: A sculpture of blue pearl granite shows several geometric shapes arranged together on a flat surface. A large, low, circular base sits in the center of the arrangement. On top of this circle, two rectangular blocks stand upright, side by side. To the left of the base, a tall triangle stands alone, while another triangle sits to the far right. A flat, rectangular slab rests across the back-left edge of the circle, and a circular disc stands upright on the right side.

title: Rev. Dr. Nathaniel William Taylor (1786-1858)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows the head, neck, and shoulders of an older man. His face has a serious expression with hollow cheeks and deep lines around his eyes and mouth. His hair is short and slicked back, revealing his ears and forehead. The statue is a single color, appearing to be a light brownish-grey tone. Strong lighting from the upper left side creates clear shadows along the right side of his face and neck.

title: Model of Tractor Mechanism
alt_text: A sculpture of painted wood and cardboard shows a long, horizontal arrangement of abstract shapes. The piece consists of a series of large, interconnected brown geometric forms against a dark, rectangular background. On the left and right ends, large circular or semi-circular shapes curve around the inner sections. Between these curves, there are several rectangular and pentagonal shapes standing upright or flat. The entire composition has a uniform, rusted-brown color with visible seams where the different materials meet.

title: Architecture, Painting, and Sculpture Protected by Athena from the Ravages of Time
medium: Plaster, gilded, shellacked, and mounted on cloth
alt_text: A gilded plaster sculpture shows a scene with several figures arranged within an oval frame. In the foreground, three seated figures are centered, including a man on the left with a beard and a woman in the middle wearing a long dress. Behind them, a figure in armor stands looking toward the right, while a large curved object extends across the top of the group. A figure partially reclines on the far left, draped in fabric. The figures are colored in a worn, metallic gold, standing out against a dark, textured blue background.

title: Scene at Delft
alt_text: A painting of a town gate with two tall spires rising above a quiet street. To the left, a small arched bridge crosses a narrow canal lined with dark, leafy trees. The road leads toward the gated entrance in the center of the scene, which is built from reddish-brown brick. A few small figures are scattered along the walkway and near the canal. The sky above is a pale, cloudy gray that fills the upper part of the frame.

title: Still Life with Bottle and Cup
medium: Collage of lace, sandpaper, cloth, netting, and paint on composition board
alt_text: A painting showing a collection of shapes and textured surfaces arranged in a layered, abstract style. In the center stands a tall, green bottle-like shape next to a smaller container with a pink top and yellow base. To the right of these objects sits a wide, light-colored bowl with a small handle. The background features various geometric patterns, including a section of red sandpaper texture, a piece of white lace, and a grid-like mesh netting. Deep blue, tan, and gray colors fill the remaining spaces to create a complex composition of overlapping planes.

title: Storm in the Vale of Clwyd
alt_text: A painting shows a rural landscape under a dramatic, cloudy sky. In the center, a windmill with its blades angled stands near a cluster of small buildings. Below the windmill, the landscape appears as a dark, grassy field with some indistinct shapes in the distance. The entire scene is set within a large, elaborate, gold-colored frame that features swirling patterns and decorations along its edges. A small, rectangular plaque is attached to the bottom center of the frame.

title: Portrait Bust of David Daggett
alt_text: A plaster cast sculpture of a man’s head and chest. The man has a serious expression with deep lines across his forehead and around his mouth. He has short, straight hair and is looking forward. He wears draped fabric over his shoulders that wraps around his chest. The entire bust sits on a rounded pedestal base against a plain background.

title: Lampshade
medium: Painted (white) tin, metal rod, wing bolt, square bolt, round metal flange, screwed to round wood base
alt_text: A sculpture of a tall, curved white shape standing on a dark wooden base. The sculpture features a thin, vertical metal rod that supports a long, flat piece of white material. This white material twists in a spiraling, crescent-like curve as it rises up the rod. The rod has a small, dark nut at the very top. At the bottom, a round, dark wooden base holds the sculpture upright. The background is a plain, solid grey surface.

title: Stacks
alt_text: A steel sculpture shows two large, rectangular panels standing upright on a paved outdoor terrace. The panels are made of flat, grey metal with thick, rusty orange borders along their edges. Streaks of rust run vertically down the surfaces of both pieces. The panels are positioned at angles to each other, with one prominently in the foreground and a smaller one in the distance. Behind them, brick walls and buildings rise up against a clear blue sky.

title: Singing Boys (I)
alt_text: A painting of a stylized, abstract face created with thick, vibrant brushstrokes. The face sits centrally on a deep blue background and is surrounded by bold patches of yellow, red, and green. Thick, textured layers of paint define distorted features, including two dark, swirling eyes and a prominent nose. The work is enclosed in a simple, thin gold frame. It hangs against a background of white metal grid shelving.

title: Shells on a Piano
alt_text: A painting shows a collection of fragmented shapes and forms arranged within an oval frame. The image uses a muted color palette of grays, browns, and off-white tones. Sharp geometric lines intersect with curved, flowing shapes to create a chaotic composition. A series of parallel lines on the left resembles sheet music or a musical staff. The entire oval artwork is set against a dark wood-grained background.

title: Vase of Flowers and Pitcher
alt_text: A painting of a still life features a dark pitcher and a bowl of flowers sitting on a table. The black pitcher on the right has red horizontal stripes and a prominent handle. To its left, a dark blue bowl holds a cluster of orange flowers with thin petals. Behind these objects, a patterned backdrop displays dark, star-shaped forms outlined in purple. The table surface in the foreground is covered by a fabric decorated with a repeating gray and white pattern and a single zigzagging purple line.

title: Equestrian Statue of Louis XIV
alt_text: A wax sculpture shows a man sitting on a horse. The man has long, curly hair and wears clothing that looks like armor with a cloak draped over his shoulder. The horse stands in profile, facing left, with one of its front legs lifted as if it is stepping forward. Both the man and the horse are made of a reddish-brown material and have smooth, detailed textures. They stand on a rectangular base that is painted black.

title: Firedog (Vulcan), one of a pair
alt_text: A pair of gilt bronze tools and equipment show two ornate, metallic sculptures. Both figures are gold-colored and sit gracefully upon elaborate, curved bases decorated with scrollwork. The figure on the left is a man holding a shield, while the figure on the right is a woman draped in fabric. Their bases feature decorative feet and floral-like ornaments at each end. These intricate metal objects are positioned side by side against a plain, light gray background.

title: Intérieur d'un Port (Waterfront Market)
alt_text: A painting of a dark, busy town scene by a waterfront. A tall, old house with a steep roof sits in the center of the image. To the left, there is a boat near a dock with white cloth draped over the edge. Several people gather near the water's edge on the right side of the painting. The scene is filled with shadows, giving it a gloomy and rustic feeling.

title: Gorge of Toja
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes in black, white, and shades of grey. Thick, visible brushstrokes create heavy, flowing forms across the canvas. Large blocks of white dominate the upper middle, while deep black patches anchor the lower and left corners. Medium grey areas connect the different sections, adding depth and shadow. The entire composition has a rough and energetic texture throughout.

title: Annunciatory Angel, One of Three Fragments from a Folding Triptych
alt_text: A painting shows a circular portrait of a figure with wings viewed from the side. The figure wears a long, draped robe in a muted purple or plum color. A detailed golden halo with circular patterns rings the figure's head. The figure has large, stylized wings that are mostly yellow and orange with touches of blue. The entire image is set against a textured, orange background that appears cracked and worn.

title: Still Life with Profile of Pitcher
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes in muted colors, including tan, yellow, gray, green, and red. The composition features sharp, angular forms that overlap and lean against each other to create a sense of depth. A bright yellow vertical rectangle stands on the right side. In the center, a large, arched gray pillar sits behind several smaller, curved blue lines. The background is a soft, light brown, while a patch of vibrant red appears in the upper left corner.

title: Girl in Yellow Chair
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting in a yellow director's chair. The person faces to the right with their knees pulled up toward their chest. They are wearing light blue patterned leggings and reddish-brown shoes. One hand is raised up near their head, while the other rests on their knee. The background is a plain, light, off-white color that fades into the chair’s frame.

title: No Title
medium: Acrylic, wood shavings, modeling compound, and rubber on Masonite
alt_text: A sculpture showing a textured, dark gray rectangular surface with several rubber tubes attached to it. The background has a rough, uneven appearance that looks like compressed wood shavings or thick paint. Seven dark rubber tubes curve vertically across the face of this square base. Some of these tubes are tied into knots and hang over the bottom edge of the board. The overall color of the object is a uniform, dark shade of charcoal or black.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints Jerome and Francis of Assisi
alt_text: A painting shows a central woman holding a small child on a ledge. On the left stands an older man with a white beard wearing a red hat, while a bearded man in a brown robe stands on the right. Both men and the woman have golden halos behind their heads, and the child also has a smaller golden halo. The child is holding a small dark bird. Above the figures, red flower garlands are draped against a blue background, and two small plaques with letters hang below them.

title: The Abduction of Deianira
medium: Oil on panel, transferred to canvas
alt_text: A painting of a landscape scene featuring three figures. On the left, a creature with the upper body of a man and the lower body of a horse carries a nude woman across a river. The woman reaches her arms out as if in distress. On the right, a man stands on a riverbank and aims a bow and arrow toward the pair. The background shows a wide, open valley with hills and a winding river under a blue sky.

title: The Temptation of Adam and Eve
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman standing in a lush, green landscape. On the left, a man with long brown hair sits on a rock and points his finger upward toward the right side of the frame. On the right, a woman with long hair stands next to a tall, dark tree. A snake is wrapped around the tree trunk, and a small, baby-like face with wings is nestled in the branches near the woman's raised hand. In the background, a blue river winds through a field toward rolling hills under a bright sky.

title: The Sacrifice of Isaac
alt_text: A painting of an older man with a white beard and a younger, kneeling boy. The older man wears long blue robes and holds a small knife to the neck of the kneeling boy, who has his hands bound behind his back. Above the man, a winged figure with a pale face and pink garments reaches down with one hand. They are situated outdoors on a stone platform in a landscape with distant blue mountains, trees, and rocky terrain. A small fire burns on the ground in front of the stone platform where the boy kneels.

title: An Allegory of Intemperance
alt_text: A painting on panel shows a bizarre outdoor scene with several unusual figures against a dark, earthy landscape. In the upper left, a person wearing a pointed helmet sits on a large wooden barrel and plays a long, thin horn. Near the barrel, a partially nude figure holds a small bowl, while other figures peek out from behind the wood. To the right, a pink tent contains a man and a woman sitting at a table with drinks. Below them, a severed pair of legs with feet sticking up rests on a plate in the grass. Various scattered items, including shoes, cloth, and a hat, lie on the ground in the foreground.

title: Portrait of a Lady with a Rabbit
alt_text: A painting of a young woman holding a small, brown rabbit. She is centered in the frame and wears a dark brown and black bodice with white sleeves. A thin, dark necklace with small, rounded beads hangs loosely against her chest. Behind her, a landscape shows green grass, two thin trees, and a light blue sky with distant hills. She has light brown hair pulled back with a narrow band, and she looks directly forward at the viewer.

title: Saint Gregory the Great
alt_text: A painting of a man standing and wearing heavy, layered robes of yellow, blue, and white. He wears an ornate, tall, layered crown and has a large gold circle behind his head. His hands are raised with palms facing forward as if gesturing. He holds a tall, wooden staff topped with a cross in his left hand. Behind him, a plain landscape with a small tree and distant hills appears on either side. At the very top, a white rectangular plaque features black text with decorative flowers.

title: Danaë and Perseus on Seriphos(?)
alt_text: A painting of a woman kneeling on the ground beside a small baby. She wears a long, dark dress and leans forward with her head bowed low. One of her arms rests on a large, dark rock behind her, while her other hand rests on the fabric beside the child. The baby lies on the ground wrapped in soft cloth. In the background on the right, a pale, indistinct shape emerges from a swirling, dark mist. The entire scene is set in deep shadow with muted colors.

title: Courtly Scene in a Park
alt_text: A painting of a group of people socializing in an outdoor, park-like setting. In the foreground, a couple dances while a larger gathering of men and women in elegant, vintage clothing sit nearby or stand chatting. To the left, two men sit on the ground, one playing a stringed instrument. A small dog stands near a woman in a green dress on the right side of the scene. In the background, large trees and a stone statue frame a view of distant hills and a small castle. The overall tone of the painting is soft and hazy with muted colors.

title: Polymnia, the Muse of Sacred Hymn
alt_text: A painting of a seated woman set within a round border. She is leaning back against a rock-like shape while looking upward to the right. She wears light-colored, draped clothing and has a calm expression. Behind her, a pattern of repeated, light-colored, six-petaled shapes fills the circular background. To her right, a small, simple pitcher sits on the surface next to her. The entire circular image is contained inside a dark, rectangular wooden frame.

title: Landscape with Water Mill
alt_text: A painting of a rocky landscape shows a small, stone building tucked between two hills. The building has a dark, arched entrance and a rusted red roof that slopes downward. The ground in the foreground is made of rough, grey, and textured earth with small patches of green brush. Steep, light-colored hills rise on both sides of the center, topped with sparse, dark green trees. A pale, blue sky fills the top portion of the frame behind the hills.

title: The Conversation
alt_text: A painting of two people standing and sitting at a counter. On the left, a woman wearing a dark coat and a hat stands leaning forward with her head resting on her hand. Beside her, a man with dark hair sits hunched over the counter, looking downward at something in front of him. Behind them, a large rectangular frame shows a blurry view of a landscape with blue and brown colors. The background wall on the left is a solid, warm reddish-brown color.

title: The Ballet Rehearsal
alt_text: A painting of multiple ballerinas in a dance studio. In the background on the left, four dancers in white skirts stand in a line and practice their positions. A large, dark wooden pole stands vertically in the middle of the floor, separating the background dancers from those in the foreground. To the right, another dancer sits on a bench, leaning forward with her head resting on her hand. Next to her, a final dancer sits, adjusting the ribbon on her ballet shoe. The entire scene is painted in muted tones with soft, visible brushstrokes.

title: Portrait of Count Charles de Mornay
alt_text: A painting of a man, shown from the chest up against a plain, brownish background. The man has short, light brown hair parted to the side, and he is wearing a dark coat over a high-collared shirt. He looks directly forward with a neutral expression on his face. He sits in a wooden chair that curves slightly behind his back. His hands are folded neatly in his lap, resting near the bottom edge of the frame.

title: Le café de nuit (The Night Café)
alt_text: A painting of a dimly lit interior space with red walls, green ceilings, and a light-colored wooden floor. In the center of the room sits a large, rectangular green pool table with a cue stick resting on its surface. A person dressed in a white coat stands near the pool table, while several other people sit alone or in small groups at tables scattered around the room. Three round, glowing lamps hang from the ceiling, casting radiating circles of light onto the red walls. A dark clock hangs on the wall near a doorway, and a bar with bottles sits in the back of the room.

title: Landscape at Dusk
alt_text: A painting of a dark, tree-filled landscape at twilight. A large, dense group of dark trees fills the right side of the frame. On the left side, several thinner and smaller trees stand against the sky. In the distance, a band of low, flat hills sits under a pale grey sky with thin streaks of pink light near the horizon. The foreground is cast in deep shadow, featuring a dark, flat surface that reflects the dim light.

title: The River Sambre in Charleroi
alt_text: A painting of a night scene shows a dark river flowing in front of old buildings with bright, glowing windows. A stone bridge with several arches spans the water, reflecting orange and yellow light from the windows below. The sky above is a deep, textured blue filled with small, speckled brushstrokes. Tall, dark silhouettes of chimneys rise above the building rooftops against the dim evening air. The entire scene is created with short, dabbing brushstrokes of blue, purple, and warm orange paint.

title: Boulevard Héloise, Argenteuil
alt_text: A painting of a quiet street scene shows a wide, light-brown road stretching into the distance. On the left side of the street, there is a row of multi-story buildings with light-colored walls and dark roofs. A few people are walking along the sidewalk near these buildings, and a horse-drawn carriage moves slowly down the middle of the road. On the right side, a line of tall, bare trees stretches away from the viewer. The sky and the air are filled with a hazy, muted gray light that suggests a cool or overcast day.

title: A Pond in Ennery
alt_text: A painting showing a rural village scene with a quiet pond in the foreground. Several stone buildings with thatched roofs sit behind a low wall, creating a cluster of homes. To the left, a person rides a white horse along the path near the water. Two women stand near the horse, talking while they face each other. In the foreground, a few white geese swim in the shallow, still water of the pond.

title: Mont Sainte-Victoire
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a large, rocky mountain in the distance under a cloudy blue sky. In the foreground and middle ground, groups of trees with bushy green and silvery leaves dot a field of golden-yellow grass. To the left, some of the trees have reddish-orange leaves, suggesting autumn colors. A few smaller structures or buildings sit nestled among the trees near the base of the mountains. The entire scene is painted with visible, short brushstrokes that give it a textured appearance.

title: Place Pigalle at Night
alt_text: A painting of a city street scene at night, dominated by dark, muted colors. In the foreground, a figure dressed in black stands with their back toward the viewer, appearing as a dark silhouette. Beyond this person, a crowd of indistinct people gathers near a row of dark trees. Large, multi-story buildings with lit windows stand in the background, glowing warmly against the dark sky. The overall tone is hazy and blurry, suggesting movement or dim lighting.

title: Basket of Fruit in the Sun
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a still life arrangement on a table covered by a white cloth. On the left side sits a woven basket filled with pale-colored fruits. To the right of the basket, a round bowl holds several reddish-brown apples. A small, square object and a lumpy, light-colored item rest on the white cloth between the basket and the bowl. The background is painted in soft, blurred shades of yellow and light green.

title: Landscape in the Midi
alt_text: A painting of a quiet landscape at sunset. In the foreground, flat tan earth spreads across the bottom, dotted with a few dark green bushes. On the left sits a simple house with a reddish roof, framed by a tall, dark tree. Across the middle ground, rolling hills in shades of purple and brown stretch toward the horizon. The sky above is a soft, muted pink and blue, suggesting the end of the day.

title: Multicolored Circle
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes and lines arranged across a pale blue background. A large, bright yellow circle with a blue half and an orange border sits near the center of the canvas. Two dark, thick diagonal lines cut across the composition, one leaning to the left and the other to the right. Various smaller shapes like triangles, rectangles, and curved lines are scattered around the main circle in shades of blue, pink, purple, and yellow. Some of these smaller forms have complex patterns, such as stripes or small circular dots. The overall effect is a busy, colorful arrangement of overlapping and distinct shapes.

title: Composition No. VII
medium: Oil on canvas mounted on aluminum
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes and forms organized in a still life style. A large, dark red vase-like shape with a textured surface sits in the center of the composition. To the left of the vase are vertical brown rectangles and a circular outline. To the right, a pale yellow block displays bold black lettering that looks like part of a word or brand name. Several vertical bars in blue, white, and black provide a structured background behind these objects. The overall arrangement uses flat colors and clean lines to create a balanced, modern-looking design.

title: The Viaduct
alt_text: A painting of an abstract city scene with large, smooth shapes and warm colors. An orange structure with three large, dark arched openings dominates the middle ground. Through the arches, we see a gray landscape, some white buildings, and a narrow balcony with railings. A flat, green boat-like shape sits in front of the center arch. Dark gray, rounded hills rise in the background behind the orange structure.

title: Untitled XIII
alt_text: A painting of overlapping, messy brushstrokes in many different colors. Thick streaks of white, gray, and black paint occupy the top left section of the canvas. Bright orange and vibrant blue strokes are scattered across the bottom half. Light pink and peach tones fill in the background areas between the bolder colors. The paint is applied with thick, visible gestures that create a sense of movement across the entire surface.

title: Bishop Saint (from the church of Saint Martin of Angers)
alt_text: A polychrome limestone sculpture of a standing figure with no head. This tall object is draped in long, flowing robes that fall straight to the ground. The surface of the stone is worn and textured, showing shades of off-white, beige, and faint hints of red. The figure's hands are clasped together at the center of its chest. It rests on a simple, slightly flared base against a solid black background.

title: Bishop Saint (from the church of Saint Martin of Angers)
alt_text: A limestone sculpture shows a tall, headless standing figure against a solid black background. The figure wears long, flowing robes that are painted in faded red and blue tones. Its arms are positioned at its sides, with the hands appearing damaged or incomplete at the ends. The figure stands on a circular base that is also colored with faint traces of red paint. The entire statue has a weathered, antique appearance with areas where the color has worn away.

title: Portrait bust of Jean le Rond d'Alembert
alt_text: A marble sculpture showing the head and shoulders of a person. The figure has a smooth face with a gentle, faint smile. Their hair is short and appears to lie flat against the scalp. The bust rests on a small, round wooden pedestal that flares out at the bottom. A thin, horizontal crack runs across the marble at the base of the neck.

title: Landscape with Buzzard
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas shows a landscape scene with tall, green trees in the foreground. Several mature trees with brown trunks stand in a group, their leafy branches filling the center of the view. To the left, a dark bird flies through the light blue and white sky. In the background, rolling hills in shades of purple and green fade into the distance. The entire scene is framed by a wide, decorative gold border with carved patterns.

title: Midi (Promenade des Anglais)
medium: Oil, feathers, macaroni, and leather on canvas in a snakeskin frame by Pierre Legrain
alt_text: A painting of a landscape features a wide, golden-yellow beach bordered by thin, tall palm trees. A dark blue band representing water stretches across the back of the scene under a light blue sky. Several small, dark shapes, possibly people, are scattered along the white sand near the water’s edge. The scene is enclosed within a textured, dark-colored rectangular frame. The frame has side panels that extend outward from the main painted area.

title: Femme debout (Standing Woman)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an extremely thin, standing human figure. The figure's body is very tall and narrow, with a rough, textured surface. Its arms hang straight down against its sides, ending in small, blocky hands. The legs are fused together to form a single pillar that stands on a thick, rectangular base. The entire object has a dark, weathered brown color.

title: Reclining Nude, Study for La Mediterranee
alt_text: A terracotta sculpture of a seated woman leaning slightly to her right. The figure is light brown and appears to have a slightly rough, textured surface. Her right arm is stretched down to support her weight on the base. Her left arm is raised above her head with her hand resting near her hair. She sits with her legs bent and resting on a narrow, flat piece of ground.

title: Femme (Woman)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a stylized, mask-like face mounted on a thick, textured pedestal. The face is rectangular with a prominent, downward-pointing nose in the center and small circular eyes on either side. Two crescent-shaped structures extend outward from the left and right sides of the rectangular head. The face features a recessed area below the nose with horizontal ridges carved into the surface. The entire sculpture is mounted on a simple, dark rectangular base against a gray background.

title: Painting
alt_text: A painting on glass shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man has short, dark brown hair and is looking to his right. He wears a dark blue military-style jacket with gold fringe on the shoulders and a large, high, orange collar. Around his neck is a white cravat tied into a bow. At the bottom of the image, the word "Lafayette" is written in cursive text on a pale background.

title: Paint Cabinet used by John Trumbull
alt_text: A mahogany, oak, and pine furniture piece stands as a chest of drawers with a glass top. The rectangular chest has a shallow, glass-topped compartment at the very top. Below this compartment, there are five identical drawers stacked vertically. Each drawer features a smooth, reddish-brown wood grain, a single keyhole in the center, and two round wooden knobs. Metal handles are attached to the side of the chest for easier lifting or moving. The entire piece rests on white foam blocks on a wooden platform.

title: Rhomboid II
alt_text: A black marble sculpture features an abstract shape with two circular cutouts. The main piece is dark, smooth, and leans slightly to the right with a curved left side and a pointed top corner. Two round holes of different sizes are carved through the center of the surface, with the upper hole being smaller than the lower one. The entire structure rests securely on a flat, rectangular black base. The background is a plain, light grey surface.

title: Bohemian Village Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a rural village set within a hilly landscape. Several small cottages with dark, sloping roofs sit clustered among trees in the middle of the scene. The foreground features earthy, reddish-brown mounds of soil or rolling terrain. In the background, dark mountains rise up against a cloudy, turbulent sky filled with strokes of blue and white. Thick, expressive brushwork defines the shapes throughout the entire scene.

title: Ye Tyle Manne (Edwin Austin Abbey (1852-1911), M.A. (Hon.) 1897)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a man seen from the side in profile. He wears a wide-brimmed hat tilted slightly down over his brow. His features include a straight nose and a rounded chin, facing toward the left. To his left, incised letters form the words "Ty le M anne" stacked vertically. In the bottom right corner, a circular mark with a line inside is etched into the surface. The entire piece is light beige and appears to be a flat square plaque.

title: Printemps (Spring)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a standing woman shows her from the head to her feet. The figure has a smooth, green-brown finish and stands on a small rectangular base. She has short, wavy hair parted down the middle with a small knot on top. The arms are missing, and the shoulders end just above where the upper arms would be. Her body is slender and faces directly forward.

title: Buffalo in Golden Gate Park
alt_text: A painting of a large, shaggy bison facing forward with a light-colored twig in its mouth. The animal stands on a patch of reddish-brown ground covered in small pine needles. A thick, textured tree trunk stands vertically along the left side of the image. Above the bison, a thin tree branch with green pine needles hangs against a gradient sky that transitions from pale pink to deep blue. The bison has a dark, fuzzy coat and two curved, cream-colored horns pointing outward.

title: Self-Portrait in Studio
alt_text: A painting of a person standing against a messy, abstract background. The person has curly, reddish-orange hair and bright blue eyes, wearing a pink pullover shirt and dark, paint-splattered pants. They hold a small, tan-colored bowl with both hands in front of their torso. The shirt is also marked with colorful paint smears. The background is a large, white space with drips and splashes of blue, red, and yellow paint. The floor area appears as a blurry mixture of many colors, including red, blue, and brown.

title: Dancer Rubbing Her Knee, known as Dancer in the Role of Harlequin
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a woman leaning forward with her hands behind her back. The figure stands in a wide stance, with one leg placed slightly further forward than the other. Her body is angled toward the viewer's right, and she looks ahead with a neutral expression. The surface of the sculpture has a rough, textured finish throughout the body. The statue rests on a flat, rectangular base against a solid, dark gray background.

title: Standing Figure in Box
alt_text: A painting of a very thin, tall figure standing inside a rectangular frame. The figure is sketched with dark, spindly lines against a muted, light-grey background. Surrounding this central box is a textured, brownish-grey field that looks like unblended paint. Faint, reddish-brown lines trace the edges of the central box. The overall color palette consists of neutral, earthy tones.

title: Marcellus, #14
alt_text: A painting showing a dark, abstract pattern of swirling lines. The entire surface is covered in fine, parallel lines drawn in a dark brown color against a black background. These lines curve and bend to form several cloud-like or brain-like shapes in the center of the canvas. The edges of the canvas are framed by simple straight lines that create a border effect. The overall image looks like a textured, topographic map made entirely of dark, wavy lines.

A painting of many long, black, wavy lines on a white background. These lines are spread across the entire surface and run generally from the top to the bottom. Each line curves and bends independently, but they follow a similar flowing pattern together. The spacing between the lines varies, creating areas that look denser or lighter. This repeated pattern gives the impression of a rippling surface or a topographic map.

title: Peasants Dancing
alt_text: A painting of a group of people having a lively outdoor party in front of houses. In the center, a man plays a violin while others dance with their arms raised. On the left, several people sit or stand near a table, enjoying drinks and conversation. A small dog sits on the ground in the foreground, watching the scene. The entire image uses dark, earthy brown tones and shows a cloudy sky above the figures.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting on a small wooden stool against a light grey wall. The person wears a dark purple long-sleeved shirt and matching trousers. Their skin on the face and hands is covered in bright red, thick, abstract line patterns. The person has messy, dark hair that looks like a cluster of squiggly lines. They wear blue shoes and are sitting on a dark brown floor.

title: Reichstag
alt_text: A painting of a large, classical building with grand columns and square towers stands against a gray, overcast sky. The structure is rendered in shades of dark gray and white, with architectural details that appear almost like a rough sketch or drawing. A wide, paved plaza with rectangular stones extends across the foreground in the bottom half of the image. A stark, horizontal stripe of bright red paint cuts across the left side of the scene. Another smaller, faint red horizontal mark appears near the base of the building on the far right side.

title: 1 2 3 4 5 4 3 2 1 Cross and Tower
alt_text: A white wooden sculpture sits on a polished wood floor against a stark black background. The structure is composed of many small, open-frame cubes stacked together to form a large, complex shape. In the center, the sculpture rises upward in a tiered, tower-like formation that narrows as it goes higher. Extending outward from the base are four symmetrical arms that also shrink in height as they move away from the center. The entire piece creates a geometric, grid-like appearance that looks like a miniature city or a scientific model.

title: Untitled
medium: Oil, acrylic, and silkscreen on canvas
alt_text: A painting with layers of images and colors. A large, jagged, red and orange splash dominates the center, looking like a bright crackling flame. Underneath this splash are faint, reddish architectural patterns, including a tall tower and a building labeled with the word "prescriptions." The top section features a blue grid pattern with text blocks that look like shipping labels or crates. To the right, a solid, light-brown shape sits against the white background. A single vertical green line runs down the left side of the composition.

title: August
alt_text: A painting of a surface completely covered in a dense, uniform pattern of small dots. The dominant color is a light, sandy yellow that fills the entire square format. Scattered among the yellow dots are many tiny specks in shades of pale blue and dark brown. These different colored dots are spread out evenly, with no distinct shapes or figures emerging from the texture. The overall effect is like looking at a close-up of textured gravel or coarse sand.

title: Triumph of Wills
alt_text: A painting of a tall, brown, textured rock formation set against a light blue sky. The rock formation is widest at the bottom and narrowest at the top, resembling a tall column or cliff. A small, blurry figure stands at the very top of the peak. On either side of the rock's base, a small palm tree stands in a green grassy field. The painting is enclosed within a rectangular frame that has a pointed, roof-like top piece marked with the number 84.

title: Matthias (1757–1818) and Thomas Bordley (1755–1771)
medium: Watercolor over graphite pencil on ivory
alt_text: A miniature watercolor shows two boys standing together and reading from an open book. The boy on the left wears a purple coat, while the boy on the right wears a dark teal coat and has his arm around the other's shoulder. To the left, a light-colored bust of a figure wearing a helmet sits on a pedestal. The background features a blue sky and distant, faint hills. The entire scene is enclosed within a dark, circular wooden frame.

title: Camille on the Beach in Trouville
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a chair on a sandy beach. The woman is in the foreground, wearing a long, light-colored dress and a dark, patterned hat while holding a large parasol.
