To her right, a small child wearing a dark jacket plays near the waves washing onto the shore. Another person wearing a green hat stands a few feet away toward the water. The ocean stretches into the distance, featuring several thin, upright poles and dark shapes in the water. A small boat with a red sail floats on the horizon.

title: Young Lady in a Sheer White Dress
alt_text: A miniature jewelry portrait shows a young woman with brown hair pulled back in a bun. She wears a light, textured white dress with short, puffed sleeves. A small, dark-colored brooch or flower accent sits on the center of her bodice. The background is a solid, deep reddish-brown color. The portrait is housed in a simple, thin oval metal frame with a small loop at the top.

title: David Bradlee (1786–1814)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a painted portrait of a man. The oval portrait is painted in watercolor on ivory and set inside a shiny gold frame with a small hanging loop at the top. The man has short, dark, wavy hair and is wearing a dark coat over a white cravat that covers his neck. He faces slightly to the left with a neutral expression on his face. The background of the portrait is a plain, light brown color with a wavy, textured pattern. Near the man's shoulder, faint cursive writing reads "Doyle 1813."

title: Portrait of a Lady
alt_text: A miniature of a watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a woman. She faces forward with her head slightly tilted to the right. The woman has light brown hair styled up with small pink and blue flowers on top. She wears a blue dress with a white ruffled edge around the neckline and a thin black ribbon around her neck. The portrait is held within an oval, gold-colored frame with a textured beaded edge. A small pin extends from the bottom of the frame.

title: Alexander Reinagle (1756–1809)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory showing the portrait of a light-skinned man with short, white, receding hair. The man faces slightly to his right, wearing a dark brown jacket over a white collared shirt with a ruffled front. A thin red trim lines the collar of his jacket near his neck. The portrait is oval-shaped and set inside a simple gold-colored frame with a small loop at the top for hanging. The background of the portrait is a soft, muted pinkish-grey color.

title: Commander Samuel Woodhouse (1784–1843)
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory shows a man looking directly forward against a soft, light-blue background. The man has curly, dark hair and light blue eyes, and he wears a dark blue jacket with gold-colored fringe on his shoulder. To his right, a simple sketch of a sailing ship with three masts sits on the horizon line. The entire portrait is encased in an oval frame with a narrow gold border and a deep, wine-red velvet backing. This oval piece is part of a larger, hinged case that features gold-colored decorative patterns around its edges.

title: Standing Female Model and Mirror
alt_text: A painting of a nude person standing in front of a mirror. The main figure faces slightly to the left with their back arched and one hand resting on their hip. A large, wavy-edged mirror stands in the bottom right corner of the frame. The mirror shows the back of the same figure from behind, reflecting their shoulders and hips. The background is a plain, light-colored wall with simple lines suggesting the edge of a room.

title: Lissa Pregnant
medium: Fiberglass and polyester resin, oil paint, and mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture of a pregnant woman sitting on a red chair. She has light-colored hair styled in loose waves and wears a pale-colored bra and underwear. Her arms rest on her lap, and her legs are crossed at the knees. The chair has a red seat and a dark wooden frame. The figure is shown against a plain, neutral background.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a man framed in a shiny, oval metal locket. The man has brown hair and is wearing a dark coat over a white shirt with a high, dark collar. He is positioned in the center, looking directly forward. Behind him, a sailing ship floats on a body of water under a cloudy, grey-blue sky. The entire piece is enclosed in a simple metal frame with a small loop at the top.

title: Lady; verso: Landscape
medium: Watercolor on ivory; verso: watercolor and chopped hair on ivory
alt_text: A miniature painting shows a portrait of a pale-skinned person with dark hair pulled upward. They are wearing a pink dress with a ruffled white lace collar. A thin, dark string hangs around their neck and rests on their chest. The portrait is housed in an oval metal frame with a small loop at the top and a tiny knob at the bottom. The background is a soft, muted greyish-green color.

title: Lady, possibly Mrs. James Gittings
medium: Watercolor on ivory; verso: plaited hair with gold cipher
alt_text: A miniature painting shows a portrait of a woman in an oval gold frame with a hanging loop at the top. The woman has light skin, blue eyes, and thin lips, looking directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. She wears a plain, white, rounded cap that covers her hair and ties under her chin. A white scarf or shawl is draped loosely around her neck and shoulders over a dark-colored dress. The background is a simple, textured, light brown color.

title: John Frederick Rohr
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory shows the head and shoulders of a young person. The person faces forward with light brown hair that falls across their forehead in wispy strands. They are dressed in a dark blue coat, a high white collar, and a light pink vest with a tiny red button visible at the bottom. The background is a soft, light blue and cream wash. The miniature is set inside a plain, smooth gold oval frame with a small loop at the top.

title: Lady
alt_text: A miniature shows an oval gold-colored frame surrounding a light-colored surface with a dark, vague silhouette in the center. The ornate border features an etched pattern of crisscrossing lines and circles with a scalloped, wavy outer edge. The central image on the flat surface appears faded or obscured, showing only dark, indistinct shapes that suggest a profile view of a head. Fine, horizontal scratches are visible across the surface of the object. A small, hinged loop at the top suggests this item could be worn or hung.

title: Mayor John Cruger of New York City (1710–1791)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry portrait of a man, painted in watercolor on ivory. The portrait is set in a small, oval-shaped gold frame. Inside the frame, a man with light skin faces forward, wearing a blue coat with a white cravat at his neck. His hair is curled at the sides and pulled back. Above and below the gold frame, dark, textured fabric extends from the piece.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A miniature portrait of a man shown from the chest up. The painting is set inside an ornate, oval-shaped golden frame with a loop at the top for hanging. The man has brown hair styled with sideburns and light-colored eyes. He wears a dark blue coat, a white high-collared shirt, and a dark cravat tied at his neck. The background of the portrait is a soft, muted mix of brown and grey tones.

title: Charles Smith
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows the bust-length portrait of a young man against a light, misty background. The man faces slightly toward the right with wavy, light brown hair. He wears a dark blue, double-breasted coat over a yellow vest and a white, ruffled shirt. A black cravat is tied snugly around his neck. The portrait is housed within an oval frame, which is set inside a green velvet-covered case with decorative gold edges.

title: Memorial for S. C. Washington
medium: Watercolor, chopped hair, gold wire, pearls, and applied ivory on ivory
alt_text: A miniature of a woman standing near a monument. The scene is set inside an octagonal gold frame. On the left, a tall, pyramid-shaped monument is decorated with tiny white pearls and gold wire. A small cutout in the monument reveals the bust of another person looking out. On the right, a woman in a long, tan dress stands with her hands clasped, looking toward the monument. The background shows dark, wispy clouds in the sky above a faint, tree-lined landscape.

title: Memorial for S. P., A. R. P., and S. P.
medium: Watercolor and chopped hair with applied ivory on ivory
alt_text: A miniature showing a woman standing next to a square stone monument. She wears a long, pale gown and stands in profile, looking toward the monument while resting a hand on it. Three urn-shaped vases sit on top of the monument, each marked with different letters. The monument itself has an inscription on its front that reads "my Parents and sister I mourn." A weeping willow tree arches over the scene, rendered in a brownish, fibrous texture. The entire image is encased in a smooth, oval-shaped frame of polished gold.

title: Romantic Allegory
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a woman standing in profile within a decorative metal frame. She wears a long, draped dress and holds a floral wreath out toward a stone pedestal. Two small birds perch on top of the pedestal, facing one another. The background depicts a soft, hazy outdoor scene with faint trees. The entire oval-shaped object is edged with a scalloped, metallic border.

title: Memorial for Solomon and Joseph Hays
medium: Watercolor, pearls, gold wire, beads, and locks of blond and brown hair (natural, chopped, and dissolved) on ivory; verso: blond and brown hair plait and gold cipher
alt_text: A miniature of a memorial scene sits inside a round gold pendant frame. The center of the image shows a woman in a long white dress standing between two rectangular pillars. Each pillar is topped with a vase and has text written on its front face. The scene is framed by two large, drooping willow trees made from fine strands of brown and blond hair. Small pearls are embedded along the bases and tops of the pillars to create a border. Above the frame, a small gold loop is attached for hanging the pendant.

title: Paleochora
medium: Casein, gesso, plaster, canvas on board
alt_text: A painting on plaster shows a rectangular wall section with two rows of arched niches. The top row contains six smaller, narrow niches outlined in faint reddish paint, while the bottom row has three larger, wider niches. The background surface is textured and painted in a worn, dusty blue color that looks cracked and aged. Faded circular designs sit in the spaces between the arches of the lower row. The entire object appears weathered, with patches of tan stone or plaster visible beneath the flaking blue paint.

title: Measurement: 8"
alt_text: An oil painting of a white number eight set against a solid black background. The numeral sits in the center and appears to be made with thick, white brushstrokes. Two horizontal arrows extend from the sides of the eight, with one pointing left and one pointing right. Floating just above the top curve of the eight are two small, vertical white marks. The painting has a high-contrast style with the white shapes clearly standing out against the dark, flat surface.

title: Transenna relief showing a Stag and Unicorn
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows a rectangular slab with a carved relief of two animals facing a central plant. The two creatures are goat-like with long, curved horns and textured markings on their necks. They stand on either side of a tall, stylized tree with broad, fan-shaped leaves. Similar fan-shaped leaves also appear in the upper corners behind the animals. The entire scene is set against a flat, light-gray stone background with a smooth border along the top edge.

title: The Adoration of the Magi, One of Three Fragments from a Folding Triptych
alt_text: A painting shows a religious scene stacked vertically within an arched frame. In the center, a woman in a blue robe sits and holds a baby under a simple wooden shelter with an ox and a donkey. Above them, a separate upper section features figures lying down and animals on a hillside under a golden, textured sky. Below the main scene, several people in brightly colored tunics and flowing robes stand, some offering gifts to the baby. At the very bottom, a crowd of people in elaborate hats ride horses that are decorated with red and white braided harnesses. The entire composition uses muted, earthy colors with gold leaf accents on the figures' halos and the sky.

title: Peasants by a River Bank
alt_text: A painting showing a dark, gloomy landscape with several small groups of people and animals near a large building. The scene is dominated by a cloudy, ominous sky that turns into bright, blue patches on the upper left side. On the right, a weathered, multi-story building with crumbling walls stands prominently in the foreground. Several people are gathered in the lower middle area, while others sit or work near the base of the structure. Mules or horses stand quietly on a path in the distance, and the terrain looks hilly and uneven.

title: Pastoral Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a quiet landscape at sunset, featuring a river flowing through the center of the scene. On the right side, two figures sit together near the edge of the water, with one figure gesturing outward toward the view. A small herd of cows grazes in the river and on the nearby grassy banks. To the left, a stone bridge leads toward a distant fortress built on a low hill. Tall, dark, leafy trees frame both sides of the scene, while the sky glows with soft, warm colors.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Saints Martin of Tours and Blaise
alt_text: A painting showing a woman seated on a throne, holding a small child on her lap. Both figures have golden halos behind their heads, as do two men standing on either side of the throne. The man on the left wears a red and gold robe, holds a tall staff, and has a smaller person kneeling beside him. The man on the right wears brown and gold robes and also holds a tall staff. Along the bottom edge of the painting, there is a line of dark lettering.

title: Landscape, July 1973
alt_text: A painting of a vast, open landscape under a pale, hazy sky. The foreground and middle ground consist of rolling fields in shades of muted green and brownish-tan. Scattered throughout the grassy hills are many tall, thin evergreen trees that cast long, dark shadows. A single utility pole stands on the right side of the frame, rising up against the empty horizon. In the far distance, the flat plains stretch out toward the horizon line, which curves slightly.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting of a young man with wavy brown hair. He is shown from the chest up against a muted, greenish background inside an oval frame. He wears a dark blue coat with a high white collar and a white cravat at his neck. His face is turned slightly toward the viewer, and he has a soft expression. The entire oval portrait is set against a deep red velvet mat inside a simple, worn gold frame.

title: Boy Facing Left
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory shows a profile portrait of a young man against a light grey background. He faces to the left, with short, light brown hair styled loosely around his forehead and ears. The man wears a high, white collared shirt with a small, ruffled white tie at his neck. Over the shirt, he has a dark, possibly black, coat with a wide lapel that cuts across his chest. The entire portrait is encased within a plain, oval-shaped metal frame.

title: Young Lady Seated in a Chair
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory showing a young woman seated indoors near a window. She has dark hair styled up and wears a blue dress with a white lace collar. A thick, dark green curtain hangs behind her, while a view of the sea with a sailing ship is visible through the window to her right. Her right arm rests on a reddish-brown wooden table beside her. The entire portrait is encased in a simple gold frame set against a larger, dark, rectangular background piece with a hanging loop at the top.

title: Lady
alt_text: A watercolor miniature portrait on paper shows a side profile of a young woman with dark hair swept into a bun. She has small curls framing her forehead and wears a light-colored dress with a green shawl draped around her shoulders. The miniature is housed inside an oval-shaped, ornate gold frame. This frame sits inside a small, rectangular leather box lined with soft fabric. The dark brown box is open, revealing the portrait framed against a tan background.

title: Young Lady
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting shows the profile of a young woman facing left. She has light brown hair pulled back with a thin, dark headband. She wears a pale, form-fitting dress with short, puffed sleeves and a ruffled collar at her neck. The portrait is set inside a simple, oval, dark wooden frame with a small metal ring at the top for hanging. The background of the portrait is a soft, muted grey.

title: Young Lady
alt_text: A miniature watercolor of a woman seen in profile facing left. She has dark hair styled in an updo with small curls near her face and a reddish hair comb at the top. She wears a white top with a ruffled collar and a dark, short-sleeved garment over it. A simple gold earring is visible on her ear. The portrait is housed in an oval, ornate gold-colored metal frame against a plain gray background.

title: Memorial
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory showing a woman sitting next to a stone tomb under a willow tree. The oval-shaped painting is enclosed in a simple metal frame with a small loop at the top. The woman, wearing a long black dress and a light-colored head covering, rests one hand against her face while leaning on the tomb. On the front of the tomb, the words "REST in Peace" are written in black script. Above the tomb stands a decorative urn, and weeping willow branches hang down from the top of the scene.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature painting of a young man, shown in a head-and-shoulders portrait. He is turned slightly to the left and has wavy brown hair and light blue eyes. The man wears a dark green coat with a high, black collar and a white cravat tied at his neck. His face is pale with rosy cheeks, and his expression is calm. The portrait is set inside a simple, oval, gold-colored frame with a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Lady
alt_text: A watercolor miniature shows a portrait of a young woman inside an oval frame. She has brown hair pulled up into a high bun and is wearing a sheer white dress with a lacy neckline. The woman faces forward with a calm expression and looks directly at the viewer. Her skin is pale, and she has dark, defined eyes. The portrait is set inside a thin, polished gold or silver oval locket with a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory showing the portrait of a young man against a plain grey background. He has short, dark brown hair and is facing forward with a serious expression. The man wears a dark black jacket with a high white collar wrapped around his neck. The oval portrait is enclosed within a thin, light-colored metal frame with a small loop at the top for hanging. The entire image is set against a solid black background.

title: Ann Thomas (later Anderson)
medium: Watercolor on ivory in a papier-mâché frame with mother‑of‑pearl inlay
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a young person. The subject has light brown, wavy hair framing their face and wears a blue dress with a lace-trimmed neckline. This portrait is set inside a gold-colored oval frame that rests on a square, black background. The black border is decorated with delicate, inlaid flowers and leaves that shimmer like pearl. A small, rounded metal hanger is attached to the top center of the frame.

title: James T. Carroll
alt_text: A miniature showing a watercolor on ivory portrait of a young child. The child has light brown hair and sits centered within an oval frame. They are wearing a simple, white, off-the-shoulder garment that drapes across their chest. The background is a soft blend of white and reddish-brown colors. The entire portrait is encased in an ornate, metallic oval frame topped with a decorative hanging ring.

title: British Officer
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory shows the bust-length portrait of a man with light skin. He has short, powdered white hair and is looking directly at the viewer. The man wears a dark blue coat with visible buttons, a black collar, and a white cravat at his neck. He is set against a soft, light blue background with wispy white clouds. The portrait is housed in a simple oval metal frame with a small ring at the top for hanging.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a man framed within an oval metal setting. The man has wavy brown hair, sideburns, and blue eyes, and he looks directly at the viewer. He wears a dark coat over a high white collar and a white ruffled cravat. The background is a painted landscape scene with soft blue, white, and orange tones, suggesting a cloudy sky and rocky ground. Small metal loops on the top and sides of the frame indicate it was meant to be worn or hung.

title: Lady in a Yellow Dress
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory of a woman shown from the chest up. She has dark, curly hair pulled up with a decorative comb. The woman wears a ruffled white collar around her neck and a yellow dress featuring a small pink flower. A gold-colored oval frame surrounds the portrait, and a small metal loop sits at the very top for hanging. The background of the portrait is a soft, pale blue color.

title: Child in a Pink Dress
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting on ivory shows a portrait of a young child inside an open, hinged case. The child has short brown hair and round, rosy cheeks, and is wearing a bright pink, off-the-shoulder dress. In their small hands, the child holds a single pink flower with green leaves. The miniature sits within a simple gold-colored frame, which is encased in a dark, box-like container. The left side of the open container is lined with dark maroon velvet that features a decorative, stamped floral pattern.

title: Baby in a White and Blue Dress
alt_text: A miniature painting of a baby in a gold frame. The oval-shaped frame has a small, circular loop at the top for hanging. The baby is shown from the chest up against a soft, pale blue background. They wear a white, ruffled dress with a bright red beaded necklace around their neck. The baby holds a small, white, bell-shaped object in their hands near the bottom of the portrait.

title: Child
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory showing a young girl with brown hair in tight, vertical curls. She is framed by an oval gold locket with a decorative border and a small hanging loop at the top. The girl has fair skin, light-colored eyes, and wears a simple white, off-the-shoulder dress with ruffled edges. A thin, red beaded necklace rests against her neck. She holds a small, green sprig with tiny flowers in her hands near the bottom of the frame.

title: Memorial Portrait of a Child
alt_text: A miniature painting showing a young child with soft, wavy brown hair and light skin. The child is framed in an oval shape, focusing on their head and bare shoulders. They have wide, alert eyes that look forward with a neutral expression. The background is a soft, blended mix of pale blue and light pink, creating a hazy effect around the child. A textured, gold-colored oval frame surrounds the portrait against a darker brown background.

title: Memorial for the Benson Family
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a person standing in profile next to a decorative stone urn. The person wears a long dress, a cape, and a hat, while looking toward the urn which rests on a square pedestal. Behind them, a large willow tree with drooping branches hangs over the scene, and the ground is covered in textured brown foliage. A black oval border frames the artwork and contains gold-colored text written along its edge. A simple silver metal loop sits at the very top of the oval frame.

title: Gentleman
medium: Watercolor on ivory; verso: reverse-glass painting and gilding
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a person with short, dark brown hair. This person is shown from the chest up and wears a dark blue jacket with several gold buttons on the front. Underneath the jacket, a white shirt with a high collar is visible, along with a striped vest. The person faces forward with a neutral expression against a plain, off-white background. The entire portrait is set within an oval gold frame with a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Dr. Elisha Poinsett
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows the head and shoulders of an older man. He is wearing a dark brown jacket over a white vest with small, faint red patterns. Underneath, he wears a white cravat or neckcloth tied around his neck. His hair is thinning, gray, and combed down. He faces forward with a serious expression and blue eyes. The portrait is framed in a simple, oval gold metal border.

title: Lord North
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting on ivory shows a portrait of a man in an oval frame. He is looking off to the left with a serious expression on his face. His hair is styled back in a pale, grayish-white color. He wears a dark brown coat over a pale vest with several small buttons. The background is a simple, muted green color that fades darker toward the edges of the frame.

title: Memorial for J. N.
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory showing a scene with a tall monument standing in a grassy area. To the left of the monument, two women in long dresses stand close together. A man stands to the right, holding the hand of a small child. The monument is engraved with the letters "JN" and the dates "1701-1756." A green willow tree hangs over the group, while a small bird flies above the monument, and a dog stands at the base. The painting is set inside an ornate, gold-colored oval frame with swirling decorative details.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A watercolor miniature of a man is set inside an oval metal frame with a bumpy, beaded edge. The man has pale skin, thick dark eyebrows, and short, curly white hair. Behind the sculpture, a rectangular painting hangs on a white wall, featuring darker tones of brown, red, and blue. The overall space is brightly lit and empty of other objects.

title: I Saw A Spotted Man
medium: Mixed media of oak, bois d'arc and hemp
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media is shown inside a wooden shipping crate. The object features a dark, cylindrical center post with light-colored, angled wooden arm-like extensions jutting out from its sides. A cone-shaped wooden piece sits at the very top, held in place by white foam padding. Below the central post, a wide, round, brown base is visible with several stubby, dark protrusions sticking out around it. White foam blocks wrap around the middle of the sculpture to secure it within the light wood framework of the crate.

title: Tableau: Fire Plays
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media stands against a black wall. Above the main floor structure, a small square framed work displays a rabbit-like head and a thin black wand, with the word "BIOGRAPHY" printed below in yellow letters. The base of the sculpture sits on a platform patterned with black and white zebra-like stripes. Rising from this is a white rectangular wall section with the words "FIRE PLAYS" written in black and red letters. A central hearth area glows with an inner red light, revealing a small black piano sitting inside. Perched atop a grey pillar just above the white wall is a taxidermied hare head balanced with a long, thin rod across its ears.

title: Curtains...on the Corner of Echo and Normal
alt_text: A painting of mixed media shows a large, dark black rectangular background covered in various scattered elements. In the center, there is a large, brightly colored rectangular collage filled with small, confetti-like pieces in shades of yellow, red, orange, and blue. To the right of the center, a black, lamp-shaped cutout features small, circular, colorful dots and several thin white lines draped across its surface. Additional thin white lines extend downwards across the entire black background, resembling hanging strings. Small lines of text are printed faintly in red and white on the left and top sides of the dark field.

title: Hummmm
medium: Cast paper with hand-painting and marbles for eyes
alt_text: A sculpture made of cast paper shows a person's head with a textured, colorful surface. A flat piece of light wood is taped across the middle of the face with blue painter's tape. Underneath the wood, a layer of clear bubble wrap covers the eyes and nose area. The person has a thick, textured beard made of small, dark particles. The top of the head is painted with patches of pink, yellow, and green colors.

title: Holy Fools
alt_text: A painting shows two dark, shadowy figures standing side-by-side against a textured, dark background. The figures are tall and thin, with the person on the right wearing a white collar and tie that stand out against their black silhouette. Scattered across the dark surface are many small, bright yellow and orange shapes that look like abstract leaves or petals. The paint appears thick and layered, creating a rough, uneven texture throughout the entire surface. The overall color scheme is dominated by black, grey, and charcoal tones, punctuated by the vivid yellow accents.

title: Cause
alt_text: A painted wood and canvas sculpture shows a tall, abstract, human-like figure lying on a green surface. This central figure is made of a series of diamond-shaped sections colored red on the right side and black on the left, all outlined in white. It has long, jagged, thin limbs that stretch downward. To the right of the figure, a large, tan, carved wooden object with two pointed, upward-reaching prongs dominates the space. In the upper-left corner, a rounded, tan-colored wooden frame rests on plastic packaging.

title: Open Window
alt_text: A painting of a view through a window overlooking a landscape. The scene shows a white-framed window looking out over a wide river or lake that winds through green hills and small buildings. Beyond the water and hills, a city with many small structures stretches toward the horizon under a cloudy sky. In the foreground, a white window sill holds a small, blue and white patterned pitcher placed between two bright yellow fruits. The lower part of the painting shows a floor with a patterned yellow and dark blue border that casts distinct shadows.

title: Ten Years Lost in the Great Canines
alt_text: A painting of a person and a large creature standing in a colorful, abstract landscape. The person is in the center-left, wearing a blue shirt with white dots, fuzzy grey pants, and bright red boots. They are holding a tall, thin stick. To the right, a large, textured creature with long ears stands in profile, looking towards the left. The background features yellow and green ground with several dark, silhouetted animal shapes under a blue, dotted sky. The painting is enclosed in a dark, metallic-looking tubular frame that has a carved head on the top left corner and a small, round ornament on the top right.

title: Oasis
alt_text: A painting of a street corner at night seen from a high, top-down perspective. A busy sidewalk with a small, pink-walled storefront occupies the center right, while people walk or stand on the paved ground. Several streetlights cast a warm, orange glow across the scene, contrasting with the dark background. One person pushes a cart filled with bags near a curb, and a traffic light shows a bright green sign. Other people are scattered throughout the space, some standing alone and others moving in small groups.

title: Untitled (Yellow)
alt_text: A painting of abstract figures and symbols set against a bright yellow background. The canvas features various shapes drawn in black, red, and faint white lines. On the left, a large red triangle points downward near a vertical stack of black geometric shapes. In the upper right, a stick-figure person stands near a large red circular shape. Towards the bottom, there are several curved black forms and a small heart-shaped figure outlined in white. The brushwork throughout looks textured and layered, giving the surface a rough, energetic appearance.

title: Lost Innocence
alt_text: A painting of an outdoor scene shows a large, light-colored tree trunk dominating the left side of the frame. Its branches stretch across the upper part of the image, filled with thin leaves and green foliage. Below, a sloping, light green field extends into the distance toward a white fence. A few small, indistinct human figures appear on the grassy hill, one of whom is near the bottom right. The overall color palette is muted, with soft greens, grays, and whites blending throughout the landscape.

title: Dog Head with Grasshopper
alt_text: A painting of a stylized, yellow, dog-like creature head is shown laid out flat on a table. The head is large, mostly golden-yellow, and occupies the center of the canvas. It has a long, pointed snout with a dark, triangular nose on the far left. A wide, purple-outlined mouth stretches across the lower part of the face, appearing to hold a light-colored shape. The creature's eyes are simple, grey, oval shapes positioned towards the top of the head. The canvas itself is resting on a table, partially covered by white protective paper rolls.

title: (Untitled) Pitch Pine
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a tall, smooth object standing upright. The object has a rounded, dome-like top and sides that slope gently outward as they go down. The bottom is flat and rests on the ground. Its surface is a soft, muted green color with subtle dark mottling throughout. The sculpture has no distinct features or carvings. It stands against a plain, light gray background.

title: Irvine
medium: Epoxy paint on fiberglass and aluminum
alt_text: A painting shows an abstract scene filled with geometric shapes and many shades of green. Angular forms in shades of blue, orange, and purple cluster on the right side of the frame. These shapes look like shattered pieces of glass or tiles fitted together closely. Dark, deep green lines and planes dominate the background and fill the left side of the work. The overall surface appears textured with visible, crisscrossed brushstrokes.

title: Stern
medium: Epoxy enamel on fiberglass and aluminum
alt_text: A painting of abstract, multi-colored geometric shapes, including many triangles, rectangles, and overlapping curved sections. The surface is made of epoxy enamel on fiberglass and aluminum, creating a shiny, layered appearance. At the top center, a cluster of brighter, distinct triangles appears in red, blue, and yellow. A prominent, arched, off-white band curves across the upper right portion of the piece. The overall composition features faded, pastel tones of pink, green, and blue underneath the more solid, colorful shapes.

title: Okuta
alt_text: A painting of a simple landscape features abstract shapes in muted earth tones. At the top, a large, dark red hill sits against a grayish-beige sky. Below the hill, a wide band of light blue paint stretches across the middle of the frame, resembling a river or lake. Two large, brown, blob-like land masses flank the lower sides, creating a narrow blue channel between them. The entire scene is enclosed within a dark, thick wooden frame.

title: Turn Down
alt_text: A sculpture of polychromed plywood and oil paint shows two long, black, stick-like objects resting inside a wooden crate. The crate is made of light-colored, thin plywood and is open at the top. The two black sticks run lengthwise through the box and are held in place by purple fabric straps. A curved, ribbed, and light-colored section is attached to the right end of the black sticks. The entire wooden crate sits on a gray, concrete-like floor.

title: Crack and Warp Column
alt_text: A sculpture of pink wood shows a tall, narrow stack of many thin, rectangular pieces. Each piece of wood is flat and has the same shape and size. The pieces are neatly piled one on top of another to create a vertical column. The wood appears to be a consistent, reddish-pink color throughout the entire stack. Behind the sculpture are two cardboard boxes, one white and one tan, resting on a table surface.

title: Untitled (Series A)
alt_text: A series of nine paintings shows the same figure repeated in a three-by-three grid. Each square canvas features a lone, pale figure standing on what looks like a small pile of dark bottles or objects. The figure holds one arm raised above its head while the other extends outward. The backgrounds of the paintings vary in color, ranging from deep reds and browns to muted grays and tans. The overall style is dark and somewhat blurred, with the painted figure standing out against each textured background.

title: Wizard
alt_text: A sculpture made of resin, wood, and metal sits inside a wooden shipping crate. The crate is built from light-colored wooden planks arranged in a rectangular grid. Inside, the object has a large, cone-shaped yellow body that stretches across the center. A rounded, dark-colored disc is attached to one side of the yellow object near a reddish-brown wooden piece. Yellow foam padding lines the bottom of the crate to hold the sculpture securely in place.

title: Conduit
alt_text: A paper sculpture shows a long, thin, boat-like shape resting inside a rectangular cardboard box. The object is wrapped in light-colored, crinkled paper that has a camouflage pattern on it. A dark, straight metal rod runs through the center of the structure from end to end. Red string is wrapped tightly in a zigzag pattern around the top, securing the paper to the metal frame. The entire object lies flat against the bottom of the long cardboard container on a dark floor.

title: The Alternate Enclosures (from The Odyssey Series)
alt_text: A painting of a landscape rendered in bold strokes of black, white, and gray. A winding, dark ribbon of paint snakes from the foreground into the distance, separating lighter areas. The surface is heavily textured with thick, visible brushstrokes. In the lower center, a stark white circular shape is surrounded by the deep black foreground. The scene looks flat and abstract, with no clear horizon line or defined objects.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, jagged shapes and dark, moody colors. The center of the canvas is filled with overlapping triangles and diamonds in shades of yellow, orange, and red. A prominent black star shape sits in the lower middle area, contrasting with the warm colors around it. In the upper right corner, a white, circular line suggests a barbed wire pattern set against a dark blue background. A light blue, sun-like shape rises from the right side, while a reddish, spiky sun shape sits near the bottom left corner. The background is composed of deep blues, blacks, and hints of textured, dark surfaces.

title: Silver Mountain
medium: Oil on metal leaf on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a rocky landscape features large, icy-looking cliff formations painted with heavy, streaky white and pale blue brushstrokes. To the left, a tall, bright green tree with spindly branches stands against a reddish-tan cliff wall. The central background contains a flat, grey-toned area that contrasts with the textured cliffs. Below the central cliffs, a dark, rounded object with horizontal stripes rests on the ground. A small, dark purple or black brushy shape sits in the lower right corner, appearing like a small plant or rock formation.

title: Untitled (Japan)
medium: Colored pencil, acrylic and charcoal on canvas with mixed media
alt_text: A painting of a complex, layered scene filled with many diverse, small-scale drawings and shapes. On the left side, a tall, vertical band features intense, rainbow-colored vertical brushstrokes that contrast with the rest of the muted, sketched imagery. Near the center, a prominent figure sits wrapped in a textured, lace-like patterned cloth with a plain pink section at the bottom. A long, multicolored segmented line curves from the top right down towards the center, acting as a visual guide through the crowded composition. Other notable shapes include checkered boxes, a large vase with greenery, and faint architectural sketches of bridges and buildings scattered across the background. The entire surface is covered in delicate, thin lines, creating a dense, collage-like effect.

title: Good Government
alt_text: A painting of three rounded objects resting on a large, textured platform shaped like a mushroom. The central, largest object is a bright, ribbed orange sphere, flanked by a smaller purple sphere on the left and a smaller reddish-orange sphere on the right. Below this platform, a thick, ridged stem extends downward into a landscape of green, wavy ground. In the background, rolling hills extend towards a dark, shadowy horizon line. To the right of the painting, a small separate square displays a black-and-white face.

title: Trotting Horses: Fairman Rogers' Four-in-Hand
alt_text: A wax sculpture of four horses walking on a rectangular base. The figures are reddish-brown in color and have a rough, textured surface. They are arranged in two pairs, with two horses in the front and two slightly behind them. The horses are supported by thin, upright metal rods attached to the dark wooden platform beneath them. The base has a thick, pale yellow or gold-painted border.

title: Trotting Horses: Fairman Rogers' Four-in-Hand
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of four horses walking side by side on a rectangular base. The horses are dark brown with rough, textured surfaces that suggest muscular movement. There are two horses on the left and two horses on the right, all facing toward the left side of the frame. They stand on a wooden base decorated with two dark green marble inserts. The base has a smooth, shiny golden trim around its outer edge.

title: Crouching Venus
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a figure kneeling in a crouched position. The dark, textured surface of the statue has many visible marks and indentations, giving it a rugged appearance. The figure lacks arms and appears to be leaning forward with its head tilted down. It rests on a rectangular, flat base that has a rough, uneven top surface. The entire sculpture is set against a simple, solid grey background.

title: Julia Porter Dwight (1830–1869)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a young child with brown, curly hair looking directly at the viewer. She wears a white dress with puffy sleeves and holds a bright blue ribbon attached to a small, dark grey kitten. The kitten stands upright on her lap, reaching its paws up toward the ribbon. A soft, light blue and green background surrounds the child. The entire scene is encased in a simple, rectangular gold frame with a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Elizabeth Russell Fiske (ca. 1799–1833)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory shows a portrait of a woman resting her head on her hand. She has light skin, blue eyes, and short, curly brown hair that frames her face. She wears a white blouse underneath a shawl patterned with colorful, paisley-like floral designs. Her right arm leans on a dark furniture support, and her expression is calm and direct. The portrait is housed in a rectangular, ornate gold frame with a small loop at the top.

title: The Lynching, After the Lynching, The Burial
medium: Triptych: Dye on tooled and carved leather
alt_text: A painting of dye on tooled and carved leather showing a chaotic outdoor scene with many people. Several figures hang from ropes tied to large tree branches in the center of the image. A crowd of people stands in the foreground, with some individuals holding long, thin objects that resemble rifles or sticks. Two dark-colored cars are parked at the bottom of the scene, while a row of simple structures sits in the background. The figures in the crowd are dressed in various styles of clothing, including hats and vests, and some are mounted on horseback. The entire scene is set against a light brown landscape under a dark, cloudy sky.

title: Portrait of Guidobaldo II della Rovere, Duke of Urbino
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in dark, metallic armor. The man has a short, dark beard and looks directly forward with a serious expression. He wears a suit of plate armor that covers his chest and shoulders, with visible metal studs and overlapping plates on his left side. His right hand is raised, gripping a long, wooden rod or staff that extends out of the frame at the bottom. The background behind him is dark and divided into two sections, with a shadowy brown area on the left and a vertical red stripe on the right.

title: A Pond in Mortain
alt_text: A painting of a quiet river scene under a cloudy sky. A small, simple wooden boat sits in the calm water in the bottom left corner. Nearby, a white bird floats on the surface of the river. Tall, dense trees with dark green leaves fill the right side of the frame. In the distance, a flat, grassy landscape stretches toward a muted horizon line.

title: Starry Night
alt_text: A painting shows a dark night sky filled with many glowing, white stars above a shadowy field. A faint, glowing streak of light, like a shooting star, angles downward across the upper left part of the sky. Below the starry expanse, dark silhouettes of bushes and trees line the horizon. The ground in the foreground is dark brown and appears to be a field or a path stretching into the distance. A soft, dim light glows near the center of the horizon, just above the earth.

title: Sons of Washington Badge for James S. Smith
medium: Engraving on paper set in a rose‑gold pendant
alt_text: A miniature is an oval rose-gold pendant containing a small black-and-white engraving of a man. The man has short, wavy white hair and is wearing a dark coat with a white cravat at his neck. His face is turned toward the viewer, and his expression is serious. The engraving sits inside a polished frame that shows signs of wear and age. The top of the frame is engraved with the text "JAS S. SMITH" and the bottom with "FEB. 22, 1810".

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows a tall, upright woman holding a small child in her arms. The figures are carved against a background that resembles an archway with two pillars on either side. The woman is wearing a long, flowing dress and a head covering, and her face is positioned toward the left. The child is smaller and is being cradled against the woman's shoulder. The entire piece is sculpted in light, pale stone, giving it a smooth and uniform appearance.

title: Two Hummingbirds with Their Young
alt_text: A painting of two small birds with long, striped tail feathers perched on a thin tree branch. Each bird has a slender, pointed beak and green feathers on its head and chest. Below the branch, a woven cup-shaped nest hangs down, containing small, dark shapes inside. The birds face each other, with one sitting slightly higher on the branch than the other. In the background, soft blue-grey mountains rise up behind a blurry green forest canopy.

title: A Pond Seen through the Trees
alt_text: A painting of a landscape features tall, leafy trees framing a calm body of water. In the bottom left corner, a small figure wearing a red hat sits on the grassy ground. The trees have thin branches that reach toward a pale, cloudy sky. Across the water in the distance, a few small buildings with light-colored walls sit on a low hill. The overall scene is painted with muted colors and soft, hazy brushstrokes.

title: La Fête de Pourim
medium: Tin boxes, photographs, lamps, and electric wire
alt_text: A sculpture of three tall, vertical pillars stands against a light-colored brick wall. Each pillar is constructed from a stack of rectangular, dark gray tin boxes. At the top of each pillar sits a square black-and-white photograph showing a blurry, close-up face of a child. Small, dark lamps are attached to the top of each photograph, casting light downward. A black electric wire hangs from each lamp, running straight down the front of the tin boxes to the floor.

title: Solving Each Problem as It Arises
alt_text: A painting showing black text printed on a plain tan background. The words are presented in capital letters, resembling a block of typed or stenciled text. At the top, the title "SOLVING EACH PROBLEM AS IT ARISES" is written in a larger, bold font. Below the title, a longer paragraph explains the process of an artist studying their subject matter and holding an exhibition. The dark lettering contrasts sharply against the light, solid-colored canvas.

title: Family Memorial for C. L.; verso: Profile Silhouette Portrait of a Man
medium: Watercolor on ivory set back‑to‑back in a gilded copper pendant with plaited hair on both sides
alt_text: A miniature painting of a scene depicted on a gilded pendant shows a group of children gathered around a large white stone monument. The monument has a vase on top and engraved text that reads, "HIS FORM WAS VIRTUE AND HIS SOUL WAS TRUTH." A woman stands on the left holding a baby, while four older children are arranged around the base of the monument. One child stands directly in front, another sits on the ground with their head in their hand, and two others stand nearby. The oval painting is bordered by a decorative band of braided light brown hair and enclosed in a smooth, metallic gold frame.

title: American Officer
alt_text: A watercolor miniature on ivory shows a portrait of a man, set within a simple, oval frame with a small loop at the top. The man has pale skin, blue eyes, and light gray hair swept back from his forehead. He wears a dark blue uniform jacket with red trim on the collar and lapels, along with silver buttons and white epaulettes. Underneath his jacket, he wears a white cravat or neckerchief tucked into a light-colored vest. The background is a soft, blended mix of dark gray and brownish tones.

title: Piece, displaying the Baptistry floor pattern
alt_text: A cotton textile showing a repeating pattern of black shapes against a light-colored background. Four large circles contain symmetrical black birds that face each other with a plant-like shape between them. The spaces between these circles are filled with ornate, leaf-like black patterns. This rectangular piece of fabric lies flat on a light surface. A small black label with the white number "1928.1" rests in the foreground.

title: Piece
alt_text: A textile showing a repeating pattern of dark blue hexagons outlined in tan. Inside every other row of hexagons, there is a tan figure of an animal standing on its hind legs. The alternating rows of hexagons contain a tan bird holding a leafy branch in its beak. The overall design creates a grid-like appearance across the rectangular fabric. A small black label with the white numbers "1928.2" sits on the light-colored surface in front of the fabric.

title: Piece
alt_text: A cotton textile shows a repeating pattern of stylized flowers arranged in horizontal stripes against a tan background. The fabric features alternating rows of rounded, leafy shapes in orange, olive green, and grayish-purple. Each row of motifs is separated by a thinner band containing small, dark-colored flower-like icons. The material is laid flat on a light-colored surface with a small tag displaying numbers placed near the bottom edge. A thin, tangled thread is visible attached to the top center of the piece.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A textile showing a grid of woven animal figures in brown, red, and dark blue on a light background. The piece is divided into twelve square sections, each containing a single animal figure. Alternating rows feature creatures that look like birds, lions, or mythical beasts with wings. These animals face toward or away from each other within their individual squares. The material has a visible, textured weave throughout its surface. A small black rectangular tag labeled "1928.4" sits on the surface below the fabric.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A textile made of cotton and silk displays a repeating pattern of wavy, vertical stripes. The pattern alternates between wide, undulating bands of brick-red and a lighter, tan color. Both colored sections feature a textured appearance with vertical streaks running through them. The fabric is rectangular and lies flat on a plain white surface. A small, dark identification tag with the number "1928.5" sits on the table just below the bottom edge of the fabric.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A cotton textile showing a repeating pattern of animals in purple on a mustard-yellow background. The main design features four rectangular sections, each containing two creatures facing each other inside an oval border. Between these sections, smaller lion-like figures stand facing outward near a central decorative pillar. The overall fabric appears slightly worn with frayed edges along the sides. A rectangular black label with the white number "1928.6" sits on the white surface below the cloth.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A textile of silk and metal thread shows a repeating pattern of orange and blue flowers enclosed in oval shapes. Dark, wavy bands outline these shapes, creating an overall grid effect across the fabric. Within each oval section, two small, light-brown animal figures face each other below the floral arrangements. The background of the fabric is a light, neutral color. A rectangular black label with the white numbers "1928.7" sits below the cloth on the surface.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A silk textile with a repeating pattern in olive green, gold, and reddish-brown colors. The fabric features large, interconnected circular medallions that cover the entire surface. Each circle contains a mirrored pair of animal figures standing on their hind legs and facing each other. Between these circles are smaller, solid reddish-brown discs. The overall design creates a dense, interwoven appearance across the rectangular piece of material. A small black label with the white number 1928.8 sits on the white surface below the fabric.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A textile of silk showing a woven pattern of floral vines and small animals. The fabric has a tan background and is rectangular with slightly rounded corners. Throughout the design, scrolling stems connect stylized flowers and leaves colored in muted shades of red, blue, and yellow. Several small, four-legged animals are depicted throughout the pattern in various poses. Below the fabric, a small rectangular label rests on the surface and displays the text "1928.9" in white numbers.

title: Square
alt_text: A silk textile shows four large circular designs arranged in a grid pattern. Each circle is outlined with a decorative green and white band and contains figures of people and animals standing around a central tree. The figures are small, stylized, and colored in shades of dark green and off-white. The background of the entire piece is a reddish-orange color that fills the space between the large circles. A small black label with the white text "1928,10" sits on the white surface below the fabric.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A piece of brocaded silk textile displays a repeating floral pattern across its surface. The fabric is rectangular and lays flat on a plain white background. It features a muted olive-green base color interwoven with threads of reddish-brown and dull gold. These colored threads create swirling stems, leaves, and large, stylized flower blossoms. Below the fabric lies a small, rectangular black label with the white numbers "1928.11" printed on it.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A textile made of brocaded silk features a repeating pattern of stylized trees. The fabric has a light beige background covered with darker, brown-colored branches, leaves, and fruit. These tree shapes are connected by curving, ribbon-like designs that twist across the surface. Small, detailed flowers and foliage fill in the gaps between the larger trees. At the bottom of the image, a black rectangular label displays the white numbers "1928.12."

title: Fragment
alt_text: A textile shows a repeating floral pattern on a dusty blue background. The fabric features large, colorful flowers in shades of red, yellow, and deep brown, surrounded by curving leaves and stems. Smaller birds with white, outstretched wings are stitched between the floral arrangements. The intricate design is symmetrical, with a mirrored pattern across the fabric's surface. A black label with the number "1928.13" sits in white text directly below the fabric.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A piece of silk damask textile shows a large, repeating floral pattern. The fabric is a warm, deep orange-red color. The pattern appears as a lighter golden or tan shade woven into the darker fabric. Large, swirling leaf and petal shapes create an ornate design that covers the entire surface. A small, black rectangular sign with white numbers sits centered below the fabric on a plain, light surface.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A silk textile features a repeating pattern of dark shapes against a light brown background. The top section shows a row of four identical birds facing forward with wings tucked in. Below the birds, the pattern shifts to a row of four deer facing each other in pairs. Between the deer and birds are stylized plant or floral designs. A small rectangular label with the number 1928.15 sits centered along the bottom edge of the fabric.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A textile of brocaded cotton shows an intricate, repeating pattern in rust-red against a golden-brown background. This rectangular piece of fabric features stylized floral and leaf-like shapes arranged in diagonal bands across the surface. The design creates a sense of depth through these alternating, mirrored motifs. The fabric lies flat against a plain, light-colored surface. A small, rectangular label with the text "1928.16" sits directly in front of the cloth.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A silk textile showing a repeating pattern in dark green against a cream-colored background. The design features symmetrical shapes that look like stylized vases and leafy plants. Each main unit contains a central urn surrounded by leafy branches. Large, textured shapes that resemble pineapples alternate with the vases throughout the design. At the bottom of the image, a small, thin rectangular label displays the number "1928.17". The entire piece of fabric appears square and lies flat on a light-colored surface.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A velvet textile shows a repeating pattern of animals against a dark background. The fabric is rectangular and lies flat on a light-colored surface. Each repeating section features winged creatures facing each other within a decorative, curved border. Between the main animal figures, smaller bird-like shapes are arranged in pairs at the top and bottom of the frame. Below the fabric, a small rectangular label displays the number "1928.18."

title: Fragment
alt_text: A textile of velvet shows a repeating geometric pattern against a dark background. The fabric is rectangular and features interlocking circles and squares in a tan or gold color. These shapes create a dense, repeating grid across the entire surface. Dark blue squares sit within the centers of some shapes, adding depth to the design. A black label with white numbers sits at the bottom of the fabric, resting on a white surface.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A textile of brocaded silk shows a repeating pattern of stylized floral shapes on a light tan background. These floral motifs appear dark brown and resemble pineapples or pomegranates with leafy tops. Between each large floral motif, there are small, simple designs made of four tiny dots arranged in a diamond shape. The piece of fabric is rectangular and lies flat against a plain, light-colored surface. A small black rectangular label with white text reading "1928, 20" sits directly below the fabric.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A piece of brocaded silk textile shows a pattern of repeating shapes on a dark blue background. The fabric features several stylized designs that look like fans or possibly flowers, arranged in a grid-like pattern across the surface. Each design has a rounded, fluffy-looking top part in a muted brown tone, fading into long, thin, vertical lines. These shapes are spread evenly across the fabric, with two along the top, one in the center, and two along the bottom, plus one on each side. A rectangular label with the number 1928.21 sits on the white surface below the fabric.

title: Square
alt_text: A piece of brocaded silk fabric shows a repeating pattern of green leafy branches and small golden designs on a light grey background. Four curved branches frame the corners, arching inward toward the center of the cloth. At the very center of the fabric, a golden bird-like shape spreads its wings outward. Several small, three-lobed golden knot designs are tucked into the spaces between the branches. A small, dark rectangular label with white numbers sits at the bottom edge of the fabric.

title: Charlemagne Dalmatic Panel
alt_text: A silk textile showing a large scene embroidered in light threads against a dark blue background. At the center, a seated figure sits within a large circle, surrounded by many standing figures arranged in a ring. These surrounding figures wear long, light-colored robes and appear to face inward toward the central person. A wide, bright red border frames the entire image, decorated with delicate, thin patterns. The textile lies flat on a plain surface with a small, rectangular identification tag placed in the foreground.

title: Square
alt_text: A linen textile shows a symmetrical, circular pattern centered on a square piece of fabric. The design is in a dark brown color that contrasts sharply against the light tan background of the linen. A large circle contains intricate, plant-like shapes and stylized figures that look like small animals. Outside the circle, the corners of the square cloth are filled with similar leafy, scroll-like decorations. A small, black rectangular label with the white number "1928.24" sits at the bottom of the image.

title: Square
alt_text: A cotton textile shows a large, round pattern centered on a square piece of orange fabric. The circular design features intricate, dark brown, lace-like scrollwork and shapes. Small, dark animal figures, which look like birds or fish, are placed around the inner circle. The square piece of fabric has a thin border and looks slightly worn at the edges. A small, gray label with the number 1928.25 sits on the white surface below the fabric.

title: The Model
alt_text: A painting showing a standing figure beside an easel. On the left, a tall figure with dark skin stands with its side to the viewer. To the right, an easel holds a canvas depicting a simpler figure painted with blocks of red, white, and black. The background of the room is composed of messy, broad brushstrokes in shades of deep red and dark blue. A grid pattern in the upper left corner suggests a window with bright light coming through. The thick paint strokes create a rough and expressive texture across the entire surface.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture shows three stacked, oval-shaped platforms. The tiers decrease in size from the bottom to the top. Each platform has a bright, solid yellow color and smooth surfaces. The overall shape resembles a set of stairs or a tiered display stand. The object is centered against a plain, light grey background.

title: Model for Convertible Clam Shelter
medium: Mixed media; shell (a), galvanized steel pole (b), base
alt_text: A sculpture of many small shells grouped together sits on a flat, rectangular wooden base. The shells are joined to form a round, textured shape that is slightly split open on one side. This opening glows with a soft, warm orange light from inside the object. Thin, dark metal wires are attached to the top and sides of the shell cluster, anchoring it to the base. The base has a visible wood grain and rests on a simple black stand.

title: Sound/Body/Weapon
medium: Gas mask, cartridge belt, cassett tapes, cassette walkman
alt_text: A sculpture shows a gas mask positioned above a green tactical vest. The vest is covered in multiple pouches, and each pouch holds a small, clear cassette tape with a red center. A green fabric carrying case hangs from the bottom right side of the vest. Thin black wires connect the components, leading from the gas mask and the vest to a small portable electronic player tucked inside the green case. The entire arrangement rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Lady
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory showing a woman from the chest up. She is facing forward with her head tilted slightly to the right. Her dark hair is parted in the middle and pulled back smooth against her head. She wears a soft, muted greyish-brown shawl draped over her shoulders. A bright red scarf with a white frilled edge is tied around her neck. The portrait is enclosed in an oval, decorative gold frame with a circular hanging loop at the top.

title: Yale
alt_text: A painted aluminum sculpture shows the letters "YALE" stacked in two rows. The top row features the letters "Y" and "A" side by side. Below them, the letters "L" and "E" sit directly underneath. The front surfaces of the letters are a deep, glossy blue. The sides and the interior cutouts of the letters are a stark, bright white.

title: Love
alt_text: A painted aluminum sculpture of the letters L, O, V, and E, stacked to form a block. The letter L is on the far left, standing tall and straight. The O is tilted at an angle on the top right, resting on the V and the E. The letters are a bright red color on their front-facing surfaces. The sides and interior spaces of the letters are a contrasting bright blue.

title: Untitled [Sea-Landscape]
alt_text: A painting of a coastal landscape shows rolling, brownish hills overlooking a calm body of water. In the foreground, several green and yellow bushes dot the uneven, earthy slope. Two small, simple brown buildings sit on the hillside near the water's edge. A larger, darker headland stretches into the water in the middle distance, separating two bays. The sky above is muted and grayish, suggesting a cloudy day or twilight.

title: The Silver Fish and the Multitudes Have Lunch and Other Myths
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture shows a rectangular panel with a wooden crate attached to the front. The top section of the panel is painted a deep, solid blue, while the larger bottom section is made of mottled, gray galvanized metal. A tall, thin wooden cross extends vertically from the center of the panel. A small wooden shelf holds a fish on the left and a small container with dried flowers on the right. A wooden crate with vertical slats hangs directly over the bottom half of the panel.

title: Homesick Angel
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a thin, standing figure with its arms bent at the elbows. The figure has an elongated, smooth torso and legs that join together at the bottom. Its hands appear to be holding or shaped like two large, curved fish or crab-like forms that hang down at its sides. The metal has a dark, greenish-brown finish that looks worn in places. This figure stands upright on a circular, reddish-brown wooden base. The background is a soft, white textured surface.

title: Hitch
alt_text: A sand-cast glass sculpture displays a long, translucent band that twists and loops back on itself. The material has a pale, sandy color and appears rough with a textured surface throughout. Tiny bubbles are visible trapped inside the thick glass. The overall form looks like a continuous, folded ribbon or a knotted loop resting on a surface. It casts a soft, blurry shadow directly beneath its center.

title: Balanced-Unbalanced Steel
alt_text: A painted steel sculpture shows a geometric design balanced on a thin, upright pole. The top section consists of a large square frame enclosing a circle. Below this, a vertical column extends downward, decorated with a series of sharp, triangular spikes along one side. This entire structure rests on a flat, rectangular base. The sculpture stands against a plain white background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of an industrial area with large storage structures. Tall, grey, cylindrical silos stand on the right side next to a rectangular building. A smaller blue building with a curved top sits further back on the left. A single small, tan car is parked in the empty space between these structures. The ground in the foreground has patches of green, brown, and red colors. The sky behind the buildings is a pale pink.

title: Green Standing Figure
alt_text: A sculpture of three separate pieces made of wood painted with green acrylic. On the left, a large, crescent-shaped object curves toward the top right of the frame. Above it sits a dark green, rectangular block featuring a rough texture and two round, tan-colored circular insets near its top edge. To the bottom right, a diamond-shaped piece features raised, ribbed lines that meet at a point in the center. All three wooden shapes rest on a light blue, quilted cloth surface.

title: The Industry
medium: Painted wood, rope, nails, metal, and cord
alt_text: A sculpture made of wood, metal, and cord shows a human figure with industrial machinery attached to its head. The figure is painted bright turquoise and stands upright on a rectangular base. Its head is tilted to the side, supporting a complex structure of gears, wheels, and a zig-zagging frame. The machinery parts are connected by thin, straight lines that resemble cords or wires. The background behind the sculpture is plain and brown.

title: Be Home
alt_text: A painting of a dark, textured field with a single bright shape in the center. The background is painted in deep black with visible, rough brushstrokes. In the middle sits a simple, glowing golden shape that looks like a small house or building. Scattered around this central shape are several small, oval forms that resemble tiny boats or eyes. Each oval has light blue borders and dark golden stripes running through the center. Small, square patches of white and grey paint mark each of the four corners of the piece.

title: LATE
alt_text: A sculpture made of leather, formica, and wood displays four individual, block-like seats. Each of the four structures is covered in smooth black material. They are arranged in a row to form the letters L, A, T, and E. The letter shapes stand upright like stools or ottomans on a plain grey background. The entire arrangement appears clean, solid, and modern.

title: Tempest 1
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a tall, twisted column resembling a funnel cloud standing on a rectangular base. The upper part of the sculpture has a rough, textured surface with dark green and brownish tones. It rises from a thin, open metal frame that connects to a flat, square limestone base below. A small white tag hangs from the side of the twisting form. The sculpture sits in front of a large cardboard moving box with handwriting on the side.

title: The Silkscreen Paintings, 1962-64
alt_text: A lithograph on canvas showing a vertical collage of overlapping black-and-white and colored images. Near the top, a person rides a motorcycle, while handwritten text appears across the very top edge. A large, solid orange circle sits prominently on the left side against a black background. Below this, smaller pictures show city night scenes, a truck, a hanging key, and various geometric shapes. At the bottom, a black-and-white photograph shows a close-up of a person's hands holding their own wrist. A round mechanical part, resembling a headlight, sits just above the image of the hands.

title: Even with Eve
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a figure stands inside a tall, rectangular wooden shipping crate. The figure is dark brown and has a thin, rough appearance with undefined arms. It faces forward and extends vertically from the top of the crate to the bottom. The sculpture rests against a white, padded liner inside the crate. Wooden beams frame the opening, and some of the wood has visible knots.

title: Fever, 1988
alt_text: A painting of a dark, dramatic landscape under a stormy sky. The scene shows a wide field of vibrant green grass stretching across the bottom half of the image. Above the field, a few trees with bright yellow and autumn-colored leaves stand scattered in the distance. The sky fills the upper half of the painting with thick, dark clouds glowing with deep shades of red and orange. The entire painting is held within a wide, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Arrival of Unwanted Guests
alt_text: A painting showing a large, dark group of figures gathered around a long table. Each figure is rendered in a rough, sketchy style with dark, vertical brushstrokes and glowing yellow halos or rings around their heads. In the center, one figure stands taller than the others and wears a light-colored tie against a dark suit. A rectangular table sits in the foreground, covered with indistinct shapes that look like bowls or plates. On the right side, two long-necked, bird-like creatures stand among the seated figures. The background is a muted, pale green color that contrasts with the dark, frantic lines of the people.

title: View from Durham Drive
alt_text: A painting of a landscape features a wide, calm body of water surrounded by rolling hills. In the foreground, a paved road curves across the bottom of the scene. Beyond the road, green hills covered in small buildings slope down toward the lake. A large city with many white buildings sits in the distance behind the lake. The sky above is filled with soft, gray-white clouds against a pale blue background.

title: Wisconsin Dreamin'
medium: Acrylic on canvas; painted frame with keys, chain and padlock
alt_text: A painted square frame shows a colorful, textured surface with keys attached to its sides. The frame transitions from shades of red and purple at the top to green and blue at the bottom. A dark metal chain hangs across the center of the opening, connected at both sides of the frame. A padlock hangs from the middle of the chain, resting slightly lower than the chain's curve. On the right side, a piece of crumpled white fabric is tucked into the frame's edge, and a small beige paper tag hangs from the bottom bar. The entire object is mounted against a white metal grate background.

title: Truck and Drive-In
alt_text: A print showing a landscape with a large, dark, rectangular object on the left and a tall, thin structure on the right. The dark object on the left has a boxy shape and seems to rest on the ground. A tall, upright structure stands near the middle-right, colored with shades of tan and outlined in green. The ground is a mix of green, purple, and textured colors, with some round shapes scattered across the bottom. Above the landscape, the sky is filled with horizontal, hazy strokes of blue, white, and purple.

title: Interior with Red Painting
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman in a living room. A woman lies on her side on a beige couch, wearing a pink dress. A man sits on the backrest of the same couch, leaning away from her with his arms folded. Behind them is a large, solid red rectangle on a white wall. The room also features light wood floors and a white coffee table in the corner.

title: Study for Metamorphois II
alt_text: A painting of two figures on a beach with a dark, blue ocean in the background. In the center foreground, one figure lies face down on a bright pink towel spread across the sand. A second figure stands to the right, leaning forward with their back toward the viewer and dark hair hanging down. The beach area is a dusty rose color, contrasting with the deep blue water and a lighter blue sky above. A clear shadow from the standing figure stretches onto the sand. The entire scene is framed by a solid, purple-colored border.

title: Oak Leaf with Clusters
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes features a dominant background of warm yellow and orange tones layered with darker, muted colors. Dark, thin, stick-like lines crisscross the surface in various directions, creating an intricate web against the painted backdrop. Several circular forms and rectangles appear in different areas, blending into the painted surface as if they were collaged elements. Some of these shapes look like scribbles or sketched outlines, while others appear as textured, dark patches. The entire composition has a rough, distressed appearance throughout.

title: Louisa II
alt_text: A painting shows a person resting their head on a surface, viewed from a close angle. The person has dark, wavy hair and is lying with their face turned sideways toward the viewer. A bright splash of red color appears on the right side of the painting near the person's shoulder area. The background and the surface beneath the person are filled with muted, textured patterns of gray, beige, and tan colors. The entire artwork is framed in a plain, cream-colored wooden border.

title: Male and Female Figures
alt_text: A varnished pine sculpture consisting of two tall, human-like figures standing in a storage room. The figure on the left features a wide, horizontal, oval-shaped head and a slender, light-brown body. The figure on the right has a large, circular head with a spiral design inside and a similarly thin body. Both figures stand on flat, white rectangular bases located on a grey concrete floor. Behind the figures, there are several grey metal shelving racks holding various stored items.

title: Untitled (reddish, wire bound)
alt_text: A sculpture of painted wood and metal depicts an abstract figure standing on a rectangular base. The lower part of the sculpture is a solid, rectangular torso with two straight legs extending downward to the base. Attached to the top of this torso is a large, complex assembly of geometric shapes, including a tall, cone-like structure on the left side. On the right side, a star-shaped object with multiple thin, radiating arms extends outward. The entire object has a uniform reddish-brown color and casts long, sharp shadows against the white walls behind it.

title: White Poppies
alt_text: A sculpture of a human figure stands on a rectangular base. The figure is tall and slender, colored in a textured, light brown material. Instead of a head, a large, spiral-shaped wood structure rests on the figure's neck, extending outward to the right. This spiral is wrapped in places with small, clear plastic bags tied with blue tape. At the very end of the spiral, three small, identical figures stand side-by-side on a tiny shelf. The background is a flat, grey, slatted wall.

title: Jardin de un Sueno
medium: Acrylic, tempera, and oil on panel
alt_text: A painting on panel shows a wide, horizontal scene framed by a white border with inlaid crystals. The central panel displays a lush garden landscape with a winding path and various green trees and blooming bushes. A smaller, vertical rectangular image is set into the left side of the border, featuring a person with dark hair. A matching vertical image is set into the right side of the border, showing a similar person among flowers. The main scene also depicts a person standing on the right side of the garden pathway.

title: American Baroque Highboy Refrigerator
