medium: Refrigerator, rubber gasket, steel, colored leaded glass, pottery, velvet, and chrome casters with rubber wheels
alt_text: A sculpture made of a repurposed refrigerator, steel, and colored glass features pottery vessels attached to its top and sides. The central, boxy structure has a door panel filled with a grid of square, yellow, and red glass tiles. Intricate, curved steel brackets rise from the sides and top, holding three rounded, patterned pottery bowls. The entire structure rests on small, sturdy metal legs. A dark-colored gasket frames the glass door, and the unit stands on a light-colored wooden platform in what appears to be a storage area.

title: Protegee
medium: Acrylic, oil, gesso, and cast cloth
alt_text: A painting of two women standing side by side against a pale green background. The woman on the left wears a long, dark grey dress with a matching textured hat. The woman on the right wears a floor-length cream-colored dress with many ruffles and a wide-brimmed hat. Both figures have pale, somewhat indistinct faces. The clothing appears to have a thick, layered texture that stands out from the flat background.

title: It's Blood. He's Here.
medium: Oil, Magna color, and enamel on panel
alt_text: A painting in oil, magna, and enamel shows a large dusty-pink surface with text and two figures. On the left side, a rectangular doorway displays bright red, pleated curtains. A man in a dark, textured coat stands facing the doorway, and a woman in a long blue dress stands beside him. The woman wears a high white collar and a pale, curled wig on her head. White text in the top center of the pink area reads, "It's blood. He's here."

title: Out of the Mud
alt_text: A bronze and ceramic sculpture shows a dark, textured head resting on top of a tall, light-colored column. The bust is of a person with curly hair, deep wrinkles, and a serious expression. In the center of the white, cylindrical column, there is an illustration of a nude, golden figure with dark, mottled patches on its skin. The column sits on a wide, irregular base made of rough, dark, craggy material that spreads out across the floor. This dark base creates a sharp contrast with the smooth white surface of the column.

title: Adrift
alt_text: A painting of a stormy sea with two small boats features a divided composition. The canvas is split into three horizontal bands of dark, wavy, blue-and-white water separated by bands of lighter blue. A small, white rowboat sits in the middle band on the left side. A second, larger white rowboat sits in the bottom band toward the center, tilted on the waves. The entire scene is painted in thick, visible brushstrokes of blues, whites, and blacks.

title: Desert of History
alt_text: A painting of a large, rectangular red canvas is shown lying flat on the floor in a studio space. The surface of the painting is covered in a repeating pattern of small, golden-yellow creatures resembling birds, all facing in the same direction. A silver metal shovel with a long, curved wooden handle rests diagonally across the bottom part of the canvas. The painting sits on a sheet of clear plastic, with a portion of a larger white sheet bunched up near the top left corner. The rest of the room shows a concrete floor and some blurred workspace equipment in the background.

title: The Forest Painter
alt_text: A painting of an artist in a colorful, wooded scene. A man with a long beard stands in the center, wearing a striped shirt and hat while holding a paint palette. To his left, a smaller canvas on an easel displays a strange heart-like face shape above two red circles. A spotted dog stands in the foreground, looking toward the right side of the picture. The background features thick, green trees and other mysterious figures. The entire image is filled with many bright, textured colors.

title: Completely
alt_text: A painting of the word "COMPLETELY" written in large, bold, yellow capital letters. The letters are centered on a wide, rectangular, red background. The red shape sits against a backdrop that looks like a metal chain-link fence. The letters fill most of the space within the red border.

title: The Solar Calendar
alt_text: A painting of a grid made with oil on paperboard shows a large, colorful chart labeled "THE SOLAR CALENDAR 18 YEARS OF 360." The chart consists of nine columns and eight rows of painted squares, each containing a number painted in a different color. These squares are arranged in a regular pattern and create a complex, multi-colored grid against a black background. At the very bottom of the painting, a mathematical equation reads "18 x 360 = 6480." There is also a small, white rectangular shape in the bottom right corner with a signature and date written on it.

title: Pythagoras as a Boyfriend
alt_text: A painting of a bright, abstract pattern is held inside a large, rectangular wooden shipping crate. The artwork consists of three main panels separated by vertical wooden boards. The colors are mostly shades of intense red, with patches of orange, black, white, and yellow scattered throughout. Thin, dark, branch-like lines stretch horizontally across the surface of all three sections. The painting appears textured, with small shapes and dabs of paint creating a dense, busy composition. The entire display is set on a gray concrete floor against a metal mesh wall.

title: Broken Hearts
alt_text: A painting of light-skinned nude human figures arranged around large yellow heart shapes. The background is a flat, pale gray color. The figures have simple, thin outlines and appear to be interacting with the hearts, which are connected by thin yellow stems. Several of the yellow hearts have bright red splotches on them. The composition is contained within a simple, dark wood frame.

title: Rolling Penny
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a giant coin standing upright on a flat rectangular base. The coin is decorated with raised lettering that reads "UNITED STATES OF AMERICA" and "ONE CENT" along its curved edge. Small, cartoon-like figures are attached to the coin at the top and bottom. Two figures sit on the top edge, while two other figures push against the side near the base. The entire sculpture rests on a thick white rectangular foam pad placed on a concrete floor in a warehouse-like setting.

title: A-Z
alt_text: A polychromed bronze sculpture stands against a plain, light-gray background with a variety of colorful, twisting forms. At the top sits a broad, fan-shaped piece with a speckled blue and green texture. Below this, spiraling, rope-like columns in bright yellow, white, red, and blue connect to each other at sharp angles. A long, pink, vine-like structure extends out from the base and curls upward at the very end. Small, dark, leaf-shaped accents are attached to the end of this pink vine. The entire structure appears balanced on an intricate, dark, root-like support at the bottom.

title: Jack
alt_text: A painting of a green, snake-like figure laid across a background of horizontal red and white stripes. A long, dark brown rectangular object, resembling a tire tread, is placed diagonally across the center of the image. This dark shape rests on top of the green figure, partially obscuring its middle section. The snake has a smooth, curved body and is oriented horizontally. The red and white stripes are uniform in thickness and fill the entire rectangular background.

title: Model of Lipstick
medium: Plaster, balsa wood, cardboard, and spray enamel
alt_text: A model made of plaster, wood, and cardboard shows a large, stylized lipstick tube standing upright on a flat base. The top section is bright orange and shaped like a pointed lipstick. Below the tip, the cylindrical base of the tube is colored in muted, dark gold tones. This tube is mounted on a square, dark gray block that sits on a flat, rectangular platform. A small, metal-like triangular piece with a hole in the center extends from the front of the block.

title: One Foot of Color
medium: Polychrome steel with a skeletal model of a human foot and ankle
alt_text: A steel sculpture showing an abstract, mechanical-like structure. It features a base and a central upright post made of bare silver-colored metal bars. From the top of the post, a curved, notched arm extends upwards and to the right, ending in a circular silver disc. A shorter, similarly curved arm extends from the same point, topped by a small, colorful, triangular shape. Lower down on the frame sits a yellow horizontal piece with three large circular holes cut out of it. To the right of this yellow piece, a colorful, skeletal model of a human foot and ankle rests on the steel frame.

title: Study for a Bronze Souvenir Model of the Lipstick
alt_text: A model of a pointed spire sitting on a stepped base. The vertical spire is cylindrical with a cone-shaped top and fades from a dark brown at the bottom to a bright orange at the tip. It is anchored in the center of a square platform that has blocky, tiered sides. The base is painted a dark, brownish-black color with a rough, textured surface. Extending from the front of the main base is a smaller, flat platform that juts forward.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of a large, vibrant flower arrangement inside an ornate vase, set against a dark background. The bouquet contains a variety of blooms in red, pink, white, and blue, spilling out in all directions. Several tulips are prominent, with some striped red and white, while other smaller flowers fill the center. The vase sits at the bottom and is made of a gold-colored material with small carved figures of children on its front. It is decorated with leaf-like patterns around the bottom edge and stands on a pedestal base.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A textile of fabric collage and embroidery shows two abstract shapes on a light tan rectangular background. The larger shape on the left is roughly oval and upright, while the shape on the right is more tear-shaped and leans downward. Both dark black shapes are surrounded by several layers of embroidered lines that follow their organic, irregular contours. The background fabric is a coarse, light-colored material with a visible weave. A stitched border frames the entire rectangular piece on all four sides.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A textile collage on linen shows an abstract design set against a beige, woven background. The central shape is an irregular, blob-like form primarily made of grey fabric. Inside this large grey form, there are smaller shapes in black, white, and a muted yellow. The black shapes are angular, while the white shapes curve and snake through the center of the design. A signature in cursive script appears near the bottom right corner of the piece.

title: Le Rieur aux Pampres (Laughing Boy Crowned with Vine)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a person's head and shoulders. The person has a youthful face with a soft, gentle smile and dark, wavy hair. A large wreath of leaves and small round berries rests on top of their head. They are wearing draped fabric around their shoulders that is also decorated with leaves. The entire figure sits on a square base made of dark green, polished stone.

title: Robert A. Coleman (1834–1838)
medium: Watercolor on ivory in period gilded wood frame
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a young child in a gilded wood frame. The child has light skin and short, reddish-brown hair and faces forward with a soft expression. They are wearing a dark dress with short, puffed sleeves and a wide, white ruffle around the neck. In one hand, the child holds a thin, flexible stick that curves upward like a fishing rod. Behind the child is a blurry background featuring dark, stormy-looking clouds and a glimpse of a landscape with a low stone wall.

title: Landscape with Vertumnus and Pomona
medium: Oil on canvas, mounted on board
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman resting outdoors under large trees. The man sits on the left wearing a yellow jacket and a long, flowing reddish-pink garment. Beside him, a woman sits against a tree trunk, dressed in a pale purple gown with her shoulder exposed. In the dark foreground, a collection of vegetables, including a squash and large leaves, sits on the ground. A small, dark red pot rests between the two figures. In the background, there is a blurry view of a garden structure or gate near a pond.

title: The Entombment
alt_text: A painting of oil on panel shows a figure sitting in a stone tomb while comforted by a woman in a blue veil. The central figure has long brown hair, a crown of thorns, and blood on his side and hands. He sits inside a light-colored rectangular basin with a gold ring handle attached to the front. Behind them, a large wooden cross stands against a pale blue sky and distant green landscape. The entire scene is framed by an elaborate border made of dark red, green, and blue stone pieces.

title: Isabella
alt_text: A stainless steel sculpture showing a tall, thin, upright form topped with a circular shape. The sculpture rests on a small, square, flat metal base. A long, slender vertical piece rises from the center of the base, featuring wavy, uneven edges that look organic. At the top of this vertical piece sits a round, disc-like form with a cut-out center. The entire object has a dull, metallic gray finish against a light, plain background.

title: California Industrial
alt_text: A painting of large, geometric shapes arranged to look like tall, boxy structures. These flat, solid-colored forms dominate the composition with vertical and diagonal lines. Shades of muted purple, blue, tan, and gray create the primary color palette across the blocky surfaces. In the lower left, a smaller area shows darker blue and teal organic shapes that look like trees or hills against the backdrop. A few dark, slender rectangular pillars stand on the far left side, rising vertically against the lighter shapes behind them.

title: Punch-Card Flutter #3 (Black-and-White Version)
alt_text: A painting of abstract, black outlines set against a plain, light beige background. The composition is divided into several geometric shapes and organic forms by thick black lines. In the center, there is an upright, irregular shape that resembles a tree or a stylized figure. To the right, a rectangular shape contains a smaller inner rectangle. On the bottom left, a collection of squiggly, dark lines creates a dense, clustered pattern. The entire work is enclosed in a thick, white frame.

title: Sword
alt_text: A painting of four distinct panels arranged in an L-shape against a plain grey background. The top left panel features a white, decorative frame surrounding a small, darker scene of a person standing at a podium. The bottom left panel is painted in warm, reddish-brown tones and shows a lone figure holding a long, horizontal pole. The middle panel depicts a man in a dark uniform holding a sword across his face against a black background. The far right section is a collage on a bright red field, featuring multiple text-heavy clippings and black-and-white photos of historical scenes.

title: Trumpeter's Case
medium: Cast bronze with patina and brass (unique cast)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an upright, hollow object with a textured brown outer surface. The object is wide and flared at the top, tapering slightly down to a rounded bottom section. Inside the hollow center, dark, shadowy areas are visible against the metallic walls. A bright, smooth brass figure, shaped like two connected loops, sits in the middle of the opening. The sculpture stands against a plain, light grey background.

title: Column with Capital Depicting the Adoration of the Magi
alt_text: An architectural element of carved limestone shows a round column topped with an ornate capital against a black background. The main body of the column is covered in a repeating, vertical zigzag pattern that is carved into the stone. Above the zigzag section, the capital widens and features intricate carvings of winged figures and architectural arches. The base of the object rests on a simple, light-colored rectangular stand. The entire piece has a worn, greyish-white appearance.

title: Flutist
alt_text: A painting of a person playing a flute-like instrument. The figure is shown from the chest up, with their head turned slightly to the right as they hold the instrument to their lips. They are wearing a long, loose red jacket over a light green, ribbed shirt. Below them, a piece of sheet music rests on their lap. The background is a simple, dark reddish-brown wall with a vertical wooden structure on the right side.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting shows an abstract arrangement of solid, flat colors separated by thick black lines. On the left, a large, vertical shape of medium brown sits next to a smaller, bright red triangle at the top. To the right, a large, dark green curve takes up the rest of the space, marked by thin, horizontal, yellow-orange lines that look like strings. Above the green shape, there is a small, pale beige section with a textured appearance. The composition feels like a close-up detail of larger, geometric forms.

title: Henry Sherman
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a young man inside a red, hinged case. He has dark, wavy hair, sideburns, and is looking directly forward. He wears a dark jacket with high lapels and a white shirt underneath. The background is a soft, light blue wash that suggests a hazy or cloudy sky. A thin, gold metal frame surrounds the oval-shaped painting. The case itself is oval, made of deep red material, and stands slightly open on the left side.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A jewelry miniature of a young man, painted in watercolor on ivory, is enclosed in an oval metal frame with etched floral designs. The man has short, wavy, dark brown hair and sideburns that frame his light skin. He is wearing a dark, high-collared coat over a white vest and a white necktie that is knotted at his throat. His brown eyes look directly toward the viewer with a calm expression. The background is a soft, blurred mix of light brown and gray colors. A small loop at the top of the frame allows it to be worn as a pendant.

title: Girl in a Blue Dress
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a young person. The subject is centered in an oval frame, wearing a simple blue dress with short sleeves. They have light brown, curly hair and a pale face with rosy lips. The person is set against a dark, warm-toned brown background. This oval painting is encased in a thin gold metal rim, which is mounted on a larger rectangular black board.

title: Bird and Deer Going in Different Directions
alt_text: A wool textile shows a tan deer resting near a leafy tree. The deer faces toward the left side of the frame, and its body is partially cut off by the edge. Beside the deer, a large tree with dark green leaves and small orange fruit dominates the right side of the view. The background is a muted green shade, and the entire scene is framed by a solid, dark border. A small, rectangular label with the text "1930.798B" sits on the white surface below the textile.

title: Bat Boyz
alt_text: A sculpture made of baseball bats and pitch shows several tall, wooden objects leaning against a white corner. Each bat has a carved, dark head resting on top of its handle, resembling human figures. The bats vary in color from light tan to dark, polished brown. One bat on the far right has dark, spiraling tape wrapped around its bottom handle. The group stands together in an upright, bunched arrangement.

title: Well Nell
medium: Oil, printed paper, printed reproductions, fabric, and paint can lid on canvas
alt_text: A painting of abstract, mixed-media elements arranged on a canvas. A large, circular, flesh-colored paint can lid sits near the center, surrounded by a thick, white, textured ring. To the right of the center is a large, dark-toned rectangular area that looks like printed paper. The background is filled with various overlapping shapes, including a large, bright red rectangular patch on the right and several smaller green and brown geometric forms scattered across the left. Drips and smears of yellow, red, and white paint are visible near the top, while textured fabric pieces appear in the lower sections of the composition.

title: Painting for cover of "The Tiger's Eye," issues #1-4
alt_text: A painting of an abstract, geometric face divided into two distinct sides. The left side is topped with a light blue forehead area containing a single, horizontal, almond-shaped eye with a vertical pupil. The right side features a brown forehead area with a matching, horizontally oriented eye containing a black, oval pupil. The center and lower portions of the composition are filled with a complex mosaic of triangular and irregular shapes in shades of grey, tan, and cream. A curved, yellow shape extends from the bottom right side, accompanied by several short, light-colored lines resembling whiskers. The entire arrangement is set against a dark, contrasting background.

title: Painting for cover of "The Tiger's Eye," issues #5-8
alt_text: A painting of an abstract face constructed with geometric shapes and angular lines. Dark shades of blue, gray, and black dominate the composition, broken up by lighter triangles of tan and pale blue. Two large, almond-shaped eyes sit prominently in the upper half of the image. The words "The Tiger's Eye" are printed in light, script-style lettering in the upper right corner. The overall surface looks textured with visible brushstrokes throughout.

title: Two
alt_text: A wooden sculpture shows two tall, upright panels standing on a rectangular base. These two vertical forms are identical in size and shape, with flat surfaces that appear smooth and dark. Each panel has a distinct vertical strip of a slightly different tone running down its right side. The base is a thick, solid block that connects both panels at the bottom. The entire object is uniformly dark, creating a strong contrast against the light-colored background.

title: West Rock, New Haven (after Fredric Edwin Church)
alt_text: A painting of a landscape features a large, rounded hill in the center. Dark trees line the base of the hill and sit scattered across a flat meadow in the foreground. A narrow, winding stream flows through the grassy field in the bottom part of the scene. The sky above is a pale, cloudy blue that stretches across the top of the horizon. The entire work is set inside an ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Crossbuilding
alt_text: A cast iron sculpture shows a dark, cube-shaped block resting on a surface. The cube has a rectangular section on its front face that looks like a small door or panel. A thin, white string is tied horizontally around the middle of the cube. Attached to this string on the right side is a small, beige paper tag with handwritten text on it. The background appears to be an out-of-focus storage area with shelf-like structures.

title: Port-Domois, Belle-Isle
alt_text: A painting of a rocky coastline overlooking the sea. Large, craggy cliffs with orange and purple tones rise out of the deep green and blue water. One big rock formation stands in the middle of the water, catching bright light. In the foreground, slopes covered in brush frame the scene on the left and right sides. The sky above is filled with soft, cloudy streaks of white and light purple.

title: A Village Road near Auvers
alt_text: A painting showing a path leading through a rural scene under a cloudy sky. On the right side, a white building with a dark, sloped roof sits near a pile of stacked logs. A dirt road travels through the center, winding past a line of tall, slender trees on the left. In the distance, a small, dark rectangular building and a house with a chimney are visible among more trees. The colors are muted, featuring shades of gray, brown, and dull green.

title: The Jockeys
alt_text: A painting of oil on canvas showing a group of people wearing hats and bright clothing while riding large brown animals. From left to right, four figures are seen from the back or side, each wearing a distinctively colored cap, such as dark brown, red, green, or blue. The person on the far right is mostly blocked by the large, dark brown head of an animal that faces toward the left. In the background, a flat, muted landscape stretches out under a hazy, clouded sky. The colors are muted and soft, with thick brushstrokes throughout the scene.

title: A Fisherman
alt_text: A painting of a person standing alone in a small boat on a body of water. The scene is created with many small, distinct brushstrokes of color that give the water a shimmering, rippled effect. The person in the boat wears a dark vest and light sleeves, and they seem to be looking down while holding a long, thin pole. A dark, rectangular shape that looks like a barge sits in the background near a patch of green trees. The overall color palette is a mix of muted earth tones, blues, and bright green highlights.

title: Notebook Drawings: V5
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media shows a plain, rectangular piece of off-white paper. The paper has a row of small, perforated holes along its top edge. In the approximate center of the paper, there is a single, small teal rectangle. This rectangle appears to be a solid block of color and is angled slightly to the right. The rest of the surface is entirely blank and empty.

title: Silence Ignoring Gesture
alt_text: A painting of a mixed-media composition features a dark, multi-panel background decorated with various drawings and objects. In the upper center, a faint white line drawing outlines the figure of a woman, while the right side displays bright yellow, splashy painted shapes resembling flowers. The left side includes a grid of colorful geometric patterns above a red arrow icon on a white sign. Near the center, an open envelope containing a small illustrated card rests on top of a dark, grid-like square. Below these, three white squares are spaced evenly across the bottom edge, with white scribbled lines hovering above them.

title: Untitled (beige)
alt_text: A painting of an irregular, organic shape with a smooth, cream-colored surface on the left. The right side of the shape is covered in a layered, textured pattern of soft pink, blue, yellow, and green brushstrokes. A single, distinct line in a dark red color winds across this colorful section from the top right downward. A smaller, muted grey line also curves out from beneath the edge of the colorful area. The entire shape sits against a stark, black background.

title: Southeast View from the World Trade Center II
alt_text: A painting of a city at night seen from a high vantage point. Tall skyscrapers with many lit windows fill the foreground, casting a warm, yellow glow against the dark night sky. A dark blue body of water separates these buildings from a distant shoreline. A small boat carrying lights travels across the water toward the right side. On the far shore, rows of buildings and shipping docks are dotted with tiny bright lights.

title: Satin Hanging
alt_text: A textile of brocaded satin shows a long roll of fabric partially unrolled across a surface. The main part of the fabric is a muted, brownish-gold color with a complex, repeating pattern woven into its surface. A corner of this decorative fabric is folded back diagonally, revealing a bright, solid red lining underneath. The entire piece is rolled onto a cylindrical tube at the top, which is covered in the same smooth, red material. A small rectangular black label with the white numbers "1949.12" sits on the white surface below the fabric.

title: Altar frontal
alt_text: A textile of brocaded satin shows a rectangular piece of fabric lying flat on a table. The fabric has a golden, beige background with a complex pattern of faint floral shapes and lines. Thick, golden, woven bands form a border around the fabric and create rectangular panels across its surface. To the left, a dark green roll of fabric sits neatly tucked against the patterned cloth. A small, black identification tag with white numbers rests on the table below the textile.

title: Chasuble
alt_text: A textile made of velvet, shaped like a sleeveless vest or tabard, lies flat on a white surface. The piece is primarily brown velvet with panels of light-colored fabric decorated with colorful floral embroidery. These decorative panels feature large, red flowers and green, swirling vines arranged in vertical stripes. A textured, gold-colored trim outlines the fabric panels and the edges of the garment. Below the garment, a small black label displays the white numbers 1949.26.

title: Embroidered pillow cover
alt_text: A cotton textile shows a repeating, geometric pattern made of diamonds and triangles. The design features large diamonds in shades of muted red, dark brown, and beige. Inside these shapes are smaller, complex patterns that look like zigzags, hooks, and intricate lines. The entire piece has a rectangular shape with a border in a light, neutral color. This woven pattern creates a sense of symmetry across the length of the fabric.

title: Towel
alt_text: A cotton textile features an off-white, rectangular cloth with decorative embroidery on both ends. Four square-shaped geometric patterns are stitched in a vertical row on the left side, with similar patterns on the right. Both ends of the cloth are bordered by thin, colorful, checkered-style stripes. Strands of loose, multi-colored fringe hang from the top and bottom of both short edges. The center of the fabric is mostly plain, with a light brown stain in the middle and a single vertical wavy line near the right side.

title: Head cloth
alt_text: A cotton garment is shown lying flat with a light-colored rectangular center panel. The fabric is woven with distinct sections, including a darker striped panel on the left and a heavily decorated panel on the right. This right panel features a complex pattern of white geometric shapes like diamonds, triangles, and zigzags against a dark background. A similar, simpler triangular pattern is visible on the far left edge of the cloth. The entire piece has a rectangular shape and visible textile grain throughout.

title: Length of Lace
medium: Reticella (needle lace) with needle point edge
alt_text: A textile of needle lace shows a long, rectangular strip of fabric with an intricate, open-work pattern. On the left, the light-colored lace is rolled up tightly into a cylinder. The rest of the strip lies flat to the right, revealing a repeating design of circular shapes surrounded by geometric square grids. Both the top and bottom edges of the fabric feature a decorative, scalloped trim. A small, black rectangular label with white numbers sits at the bottom edge of the display, identifying the piece as 1950.769.

title: Table cover (?)
medium: Linen with reticella (needle lace) and bobbin lace edge
alt_text: A linen textile showing a rectangular piece of fabric decorated with intricate needle lace and a patterned border. The center of the cloth is divided into three horizontal panels by two stripes of openwork lace. A wide border of the same patterned lace surrounds all four sides of the fabric. This outer edge finishes in a scalloped design with points facing outward. Below the textile, a small black label displays the white numbers 1950.770.

title: Table cover
medium: Linen, reticello, drawn work, and Genoa bobbin lace
alt_text: A textile of cream-colored linen and lace shows a grid of patterned squares. Each square contains a delicate, intricate design of flowers or stars made with lace work. The piece is folded over at the top, creating a layered look. A wide decorative border with scalloped edges runs along the bottom. A small black label with the white number "1950.771" sits on the table in front of the cloth.

title: Panel
alt_text: A linen textile with a red-orange embroidered pattern is displayed flat on a surface. The fabric features a central, large four-legged animal that faces left, with a stylized mane and tail. Surrounding this central figure are symmetrical floral and bird-like designs that repeat along the top and bottom edges. The entire embroidery is created using fine, dense stitching that contrasts sharply against the light, cream-colored linen background. Below the fabric, a small black label displays the number "1950.772" in white text.

title: Towel or Cover(?)
medium: Linen with silk embroidery and bobbin lace
alt_text: A textile of linen decorated with red silk embroidery and lace edges. The piece is rectangular and off-white in color, folded slightly to show its intricate pattern. A wide border of ornate, repeating floral and geometric designs in deep red thread runs along the edges. Delicate, scalloped lace trim made of the same red thread extends from the outer borders. A small black label with white numbers sits at the bottom of the display.

title: Skirt fragment (?)
alt_text: A costume piece made of linen with red silk embroidery displays a decorative band of repeating floral patterns. The pattern features ornate, symmetric shapes of stylized flowers and vines stitched in a deep reddish-orange thread against a cream-colored fabric. Below the embroidered band, a thick layer of matching red fringe hangs down to create a textured edge. The entire piece runs horizontally across the frame. A rectangular label with the number 1950.774 sits in the lower portion of the image.

title: Length of Linen and Lace
medium: Linen, filet lace, and bobbin lace
alt_text: A textile of linen and lace shows an intricate decorative border. The upper portion is a plain, off-white linen fabric. Attached to it is a wide band of netting decorated with scrolling, leafy floral patterns stitched in a matching cream color. Below this floral section, a scalloped edge finishes the piece with a delicate, repetitive grid-like design. The entire object has a soft, beige, and off-white appearance.

title: Embroidery panels
alt_text: A textile shows a rectangular panel decorated with elaborate gold embroidery against a deep red background. In the center sits a small, square frame containing an embroidered portrait of a person wearing a hat and a red garment. To the left and right of the central portrait are large, symmetrical vases filled with leafy plants, all stitched in gold thread. A thick, braided gold border frames the entire rectangular design. Below the main piece, a white block displays the number 1956.34.1 in white text against a black background.

title: Witchcraft Scene with Dwarves
alt_text: A painting of a dark, crowded scene filled with people, animals, and strange hybrid creatures. In the upper left, a large human skull sits on a platform, topped with a lobster and a white bird. Near the center, a cat plays a violin while sitting inside a large, wooden barrel. To the right, a person in a white robe sits near a fire, reading from an open book while surrounded by owls, skeletons, and other animals. A large pig's head sits in the upper right corner with a white goose perched on top. The overall composition is chaotic and features many small figures interacting in this mysterious, shadowy space.

title: Kneeling Female Nude
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a standing woman with a full, round figure. Her body is smooth and dark, and she has her hair pulled back away from her face. She stands with one leg resting on a low, block-like support. Her left arm is extended out to the side with her palm turned upward, while her right arm rests down at her side. The statue is displayed indoors on a white floor surrounded by glass exhibit cases.

title: Careless Love
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman sitting together at a small table in a dim, brownish room. The man wears a white shirt, dark bowtie, and suspenders, and he holds an object out to his side. Beside him, a woman with a hat on her head rests her arm on the back of his chair and holds a small object in her hand. A small table sits between them with a tray of small containers and a dish on its surface. In the background, a piano stands near the wall in the shadows. The entire scene uses shades of tan, brown, and white, creating a moody and loose atmosphere.

title: Anvers
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract arrangement of objects sitting on a table inside a room. In the center, a light yellow, cloud-like shape rests above a curved gray surface. A sharp, white knife with a dark handle lies diagonally across the bottom left of the table. To the right, a tall, slender shape resembles a bottle, and several circular or oval forms appear stacked nearby. The background is composed of large, blocky geometric shapes in shades of brown, tan, and gray, framed by a muted green border.

title: Cinq noirs
alt_text: A sculpture of painted metal depicts a complex structure that balances thin wires, orange shapes, and black discs. The base consists of angled orange rods that support a central black wire extending upward. Attached to this top wire are several thin, leaf-like orange pieces that float at different heights. Lower down, the structure features several flat, dark oval shapes arranged in a descending, cascading pattern. These black pieces are suspended by thin wires and appear to hang at various angles.

title: Soft Book
alt_text: A fabric sculpture of two rectangular panels of beige canvas placed side-by-side. Each panel is covered with many overlapping black circles made of felt-like material. The circles are arranged in rows and columns to form a solid grid pattern on each side. A vertical seam separates the two panels in the center. The edges of the canvas panels appear slightly frayed and soft.

title: Combination Concrete #2
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas shows a chaotic collection of bright, flat shapes and text against a vivid red background. The composition is divided by large blocks of black, white, blue, and yellow, creating an abstract and busy scene. Several words are integrated into the design, including "DRAWING" in bold blue letters across the top, "CURVE" on a red shape near the center, and "GO SLOW" on a small white sign below it. Geometric forms like circles, thick lines, and angular blocks overlap throughout the piece. Sharp, thin white outlines trace complex, jagged shapes across the darker sections, giving the image a sense of movement.

title: Lesson One
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and a large letter X arranged against a green border. The left side features a white background filled with scattered black and red shapes, including a small black house and several zig-zagged lines. A large white letter X dominates the right side on a solid black rectangular background. Below the X, a script word is written in red, and a signature is visible vertically along the left edge. The entire composition has a flat, graphic quality with high-contrast colors.

title: The Scream
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes and a realistic animal. The composition features large blocks of solid color, including tan, pink, blue, yellow, and black, arranged in a flat, layered style. Near the center, a circular shape contains the detailed face of a snarling tiger with its mouth open. Below the tiger, a rounded, multicolored form resembles a mask or face with a single, white circular eye. Other shapes, such as a black, angular form and a purple, folded triangle, float in the background. The entire image is enclosed in a simple, thin frame.

title: Chessman
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an abstract, smooth shape balanced atop a geometric pedestal. The upper section is curved and looks somewhat like a pointed, teardrop form leaning to one side. Below this curved top is a rigid, zigzagging structure made of angular, flat planes. This central part rests on a small, stepped base made of a different material. The entire sculpture is set against a plain, dark gray background. The metallic surface has a warm, golden-brown color that catches the light smoothly.

title: Diagram of the Ankle
medium: Xeroxed paper, oil stick, and acrylic on two hinged canvases
alt_text: A painting on two joined canvases shows a chaotic mix of scribbled words, numbers, and figures. The left side features a white background with thin, outlined drawings of shoes and various hand-drawn symbols. A prominent black shape in the center has a face with a wide, toothy grin and the word "LARNYX" written on its chest. The right side has a large black area filled with bright red text, including phrases like "THE ANKLE THE ANKLE" and "JAW." Near the top right, a stylized, orange-colored face with large eyes and sharp teeth looms over the dark background. The entire work is cluttered with arrows, crosses, and scribbles that connect the different parts of the composition.

title: Buste de Diego
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows the head and upper torso of a person from the side. The surface is dark and extremely textured, appearing bumpy and uneven throughout. A long, thin neck connects the broad, jagged shoulders to the narrow head. The facial features are elongated and sharp, with a prominent nose and chin jutting forward. The entire form is stylized and stands upright against a plain, light gray background.

title: Plage
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract arrangement of thick, textured brushstrokes in shades of white, black, gray, and blue. Numerous rectangular and irregular blocks of paint are layered over one another to create a dense, cluttered surface. Several small, bright accents of orange and yellow appear throughout the composition, contrasting with the darker tones. The paint application looks heavy and sculptural, suggesting distinct ridges and peaks on the canvas. The entire work is framed in a simple, gold-colored border.

title: Resting Leaf
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of an abstract, rounded form. The upper part of the object has smooth, curved edges that stretch out to the sides. The metal surface is dark brown and reflects light in soft patches. This irregular shape balances on top of a plain, cylindrical base. The base is also a matching shade of dark brown.

title: The Studio at Night in the Woods
alt_text: A painting of many objects arranged on a dark, blue-toned surface. The scene includes a large human skull, several clear glass bottles and jars, and two small white statues on the left. Scattered among the glass containers are small mugs in shades of yellow, green, and red. The background is a blurry, hazy wash of dark blues, purples, and deep shadows. The arrangement creates a cluttered, dreamlike collection of everyday items spread horizontally across the frame.

title: Relational Painting, Tondo #48
alt_text: A painting of colorful geometric shapes arranged within a large circle. Several wide, vertical bars in shades of gray, white, and bright yellow run through the center of the composition. Smaller, horizontal rectangles in black, blue, and red cut across these vertical stripes. These shapes fill the circular space and extend to the edges of the frame. The design creates a series of interlocking, overlapping, and flat-looking color blocks.

title: Astrological Surprise
alt_text: A rusted steel sculpture shows an arrangement of industrial parts forming an open, boxy structure. On the upper left side, a circular gear with many spokes is attached to a solid, semi-circular metal plate. To the right, a long, rectangular grate with many horizontal slots runs vertically down the side. A short, thick cylinder sticks out horizontally from the middle of the right side like a handle. The entire piece rests on a simple, square metal base. The metal appears worn and dark brown with patches of surface rust throughout.

title: Amerika (Baseball)
alt_text: A painting of a group of people playing a baseball-like game in a large, blue field. Many players are scattered across the blue surface, wearing various colored uniforms and holding bats. A low, wooden fence runs along the bottom and sides of the field, separating the action from the foreground. In the immediate foreground, two people stand with their backs to the viewer, watching the game unfold. The background shows a simple, hilly landscape under a grey sky with a pale moon.

title: View of the Thames from the Vicker's Building, Millbank
alt_text: A painting showing a city landscape viewed from a high vantage point overlooking a wide river. In the middle distance, a tall, multi-towered building with a pointed spire stands prominently on the left bank. A large, curving bridge spans the river on the right side, with smaller boats visible in the water. The surrounding city buildings are painted in muted browns, grays, and whites, blending into the distance. The sky above is filled with expressive, swirling brushstrokes of blue, gray, and light pink.

title: Éléments mécaniques (Mechanical Elements)
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes clustered together against a light gray background. Bold lines and curves in metallic gray, black, and deep blue dominate the center of the canvas. Bright accents of red, yellow, and green are tucked between these forms to create contrast. Several shapes look like mechanical parts, including curved cylinders, bars, and a black circle. The entire composition is contained within an ornate, thin gold frame.

title: Park Avenue: 5 PM
alt_text: A painting showing a cartoonish, yellow figure on the left side against a bright blue background. This figure has a round head with a wide, open mouth and a torso covered in green and white dots. On the right side of the painting, large, thick, colorful letters and words are painted in red, yellow, and white. Below the figure sits a large, blue shape outlined in orange that looks like a simplified hand or glove. Several other abstract swirls and shapes are scattered across the dark blue field.

title: Nature Morte
alt_text: A painting of an abstract still life shows several geometric shapes and objects overlapping each other. A red and blue checkered pattern sits on the right side, while a similar red and green pattern rests on the left. In the center, there are several bottles and glasses with simple, dark forms. A tall, pale shape resembling a white cloth or paper folds across the bottom left. The background is a mix of muted tans, blues, and grays that create sharp, angular planes. A thin, dark wooden frame with gold trim surrounds the entire composition.

title: Jeune fille s'évadant
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a colorful figure standing on a black box. The base of the sculpture is a pair of shiny red legs crossed as if sitting. Above the legs is a small blue cube-shaped torso decorated with white circles. A round, bumpy yellow face with black eyes rests on top of the blue cube. A small red spigot-like shape sits on the very top of the head.

title: Chevalier, page et moine
medium: Gesso and oil on wood panel
alt_text: A painting in oil on wood panel shows a stylized, black-and-white scene with three main figures. On the left, a horse is depicted with sharp, angular lines and blocky features. In the center, a decorative, rigid figure stands tall and wears ornate armor or layered clothing. To the right, two profiles of people appear; one is a smaller figure holding a long spear upright. The background is simple and mostly light gray, emphasizing the dark, sketch-like outlines of the figures.

title: Femme assise (Seated Woman)
alt_text: A painting shows a stylized person sitting in a chair, with their arms crossed in front of them. The face is split into two halves: one side is purple with a blue-and-white eye, while the other side is green with a red-and-white eye. They wear a straw-colored hat with a blue pattern on top. The background is a mix of yellow and brown rectangular shapes, suggesting a room or window. Thick black outlines define the shapes of the body and the facial features throughout the composition.

title: Le peintre dans son atelier
alt_text: A painting of a figure sitting on a chair and holding a palette. The figure has a white face, a jagged green profile, and a single, staring green eye. They are wearing dark clothes and appear to be looking toward an easel standing on the right side. The easel holds a canvas that has a vertical row of dark circles on it. To the left, a tall, thin chair has a crisscross pattern on its back. In the background, there is a simple black frame that looks like a window.

title: Merzbild mit Regenbogen (Merz Picture With Rainbow)
alt_text: A sculpture of mixed media on plywood showing various wooden pieces attached to a painted surface. A circular, mechanical-looking object hangs in the upper center, casting a dark shadow behind it. Beneath this, a small, triangular wooden shape sits above a thin, horizontal strip colored like a rainbow. Several flat pieces of wood of different shapes and textures are layered across the board, mostly concentrated on the right and top sides. The background is painted with soft shapes in muted shades of blue, green, and yellow.

title: Masque nègre
alt_text: A painting of abstract, colorful shapes and figures overlapping across the canvas. A large, dark, circular shape with blue, yellow, and red highlights dominates the center of the image. To the right, a vertical red shape contains smaller, hand-drawn lines and a small white figure. A long, textured, snake-like form stretches across the bottom portion of the composition. Bright blocks of yellow, blue, and white form a busy background behind the other shapes.

title: Draped Reclining Figure
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a reclining figure rests on a dark, rectangular base. The figure is colored in mottled shades of green and brown. Its body is elongated and twisted, lying on its side with one arm supporting the upper body. The legs are bent and drawn in toward the center. This abstract form has smooth, rounded shapes that lack detailed facial features or limbs.

title: Untitled (Woman)
alt_text: A painting made of mixed media shows a dense collage of overlapping photographs and drawings. In the center, a person wears a tan-colored swimsuit and has a dark, animal-like head. A large, pale hand reaches down from the top edge, positioned near a small, round steering wheel icon. To the right, a large close-up of a woman’s face with bright eyes looks outward. Scattered throughout the background are smaller, fragmented images including a line drawing, floral patterns, and glimpses of other people.

title: Musical Instruments
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of complex, angular shapes set against a plain background. The sculpture is colored in various shades of brown and has a dark, metallic surface. It is composed of rigid, geometric forms that seem to fit together like puzzle pieces, including flat rectangles and curved, wave-like sections. A long, chain-like piece with round links loops down from the right side and rests on the bottom edge. Several short, straight bars protrude from the bottom left, giving the object a grounded look.

title: Reclining Nude on Couch
alt_text: A painting shows a nude woman lying on a couch with a bright red floral pattern. Her body is angled, and she rests her arms behind her head. A dark green cloth is draped over the couch near her legs. To the left of the couch sits a dark office chair on wheels. A wooden folding chair stands in the bottom left corner of the room. The floor is covered by a patterned rug with blue and white sections.

title: Danny's Hero Sandwich
medium: Alkyd paint on wood and canvas
alt_text: A painting of a sandwich shop stall shows two men standing behind a service counter. The man in the foreground wears a blue shirt and white apron while holding a small sandwich near his face. Behind him, a second man reaches up toward a shelf packed with various food items. Above them, a large yellow sign displays a menu of sandwich options in black text. The entire scene is framed by a store-front structure with two signs at the top that read "Danny's Hero Sandwiches."

title: Picasso Goes to Heaven
medium: Acrylic and charcoal on paper laid down on six canvases with wood extensions (accompanied by an identification chart signed by Red Grooms, ink on paper, 2006.52.43)
alt_text: A painting of many cartoonish figures fills the space against a vibrant, orange background. In the upper center, a man in a black suit with a halo stands amidst a crowd of smaller characters playing instruments and holding glasses. Toward the bottom center, a large, bald, pink-skinned man wearing a checkered loincloth and sandals walks forward with a wide grin. To his left, a smaller figure with bright green skin and a pink skirt dances near a dark green curtain. Throughout the scene, faint charcoal sketches of additional people and faces are visible across the empty red spaces, blending with the more detailed, colorful painted characters.

title: Homme Assis
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting down, created with charcoal on canvas. The figure wears a dark hat and a suit jacket over a plain shirt. They are seated on a simple, light chair with thin legs. The person’s wide-legged trousers fall down to cover their feet, which are in laced shoes. Thick, dark, sweeping lines outline the entire figure against a plain, light background.

title: Male and Female Models on a Kilim Rug
alt_text: A painting of two nude figures lying on a patterned rug. In the foreground, a person with short, dark hair lies on their stomach facing the right side of the frame with their arms stretched out. Behind them and slightly higher up in the image, a second person with chest hair lies on their side with their head turned toward the left. The rug underneath them has a complex design of blue, orange, and white geometric shapes. The edge of a white wall runs along the upper right corner of the scene.

title: La Vida
alt_text: A painting of a tall, multi-story brick apartment building features many people looking out from their windows and fire escapes. The building has a reddish-brown exterior with arched window openings that reveal bright red backgrounds. Dark metal fire escapes zigzag down the front of the structure, connecting many levels where people are gathered in small groups. At the ground level, a larger crowd of people stands along the sidewalk, with some playing instruments. The scene is densely populated and detailed, capturing everyday life in and around the apartment complex.

title: Aquitane
alt_text: A painting of bold, abstract shapes is set against a plain, off-white background. Thick, bright yellow paint fills the space, interrupted by large, irregular splotches and jagged streaks of dark black. A dominant, rounded black form sits on the left side of the composition. Below this central shape, several smaller, claw-like black marks reach upward from the bottom edge. These black sections have a rough, textured appearance, contrasting sharply with the smooth yellow areas around them.

title: Nena Sentada
alt_text: A charcoal painting of a young girl sitting in an upholstered chair. She has a large, rounded face with straight hair pulled back by a prominent bow. The girl wears a short-sleeved dress with a dark belt around her waist and a small necklace. She sits with her legs crossed and her hands resting in her lap. Her expression is solemn as she looks off toward the right side of the frame. The background is simple and suggests a corner of a room with a tiled floor.

title: Patio de Caballos
alt_text: A painting of five people, mostly on horseback, set in an indoor stone arena. A figure in a red suit stands in the foreground, facing away from the viewer while holding a large yellow cape. To the left, a person in a pink jacket holds a long spear while sitting on a white horse covered in a green cloth. Behind them, another rider on a brown horse wears a light blue jacket and also holds a long spear. To the right, a smaller figure wearing a black suit and hat rides a white horse. A curved stone wall and an arched opening, showing a crowd in the distance, form the background.

title: Ya Hoodie
alt_text: A sculpture of painted crushed metal shows an abstract, twisted shape resting against a plain gray background. The object is formed from many sheets of shiny, silver-colored metal that have been bent and crumpled into overlapping layers. Bright colors, including yellow, teal, and red, are painted on the inner sides of the metal folds. These colorful sections peek out from behind and beneath the gleaming silver surfaces. The overall shape is wide and low, suggesting a tangled or collapsed structure.

title: Studio at the Rue des Grands-Augustins
medium: Acrylic on canvas in six parts with wood frame
alt_text: A painting showing a crowded, chaotic scene filled with many different people and objects. On the left, a woman stands near a seated person reading, while a figure with no clothes stands with their back turned. In the center, a man in a white tank top leans forward near a stack of books, while another woman stands to the right holding a handkerchief near her face. A tall, tiered wooden cabinet sits on the right side next to a dog. The background is packed with fragmented, black-and-white geometric shapes and distorted figures that look like a jumbled puzzle. The overall scene feels busy and has a mix of muted tones, stark black and white contrasts, and some warm colors on the furniture and clothing.

title: Nude
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing the torso of a headless standing figure. The sculpture has a dark green, mottled surface that looks like aged metal. It depicts the smooth, rounded body of a person with no head or arms. The legs are straight and positioned close together as they connect to a rectangular base. The entire object stands vertically against a plain, light background.

title: Double French Money
alt_text: A painting of two figures placed separately on a cream-colored background. In the upper left, a reddish face stares forward with dark clothing beneath it, while the number "100" sits faintly in the upper corners. A second figure with a similar reddish complexion and military-style jacket appears in the lower right. Between and around these figures are sketchy, thin black lines that outline arches or architectural shapes. Splashes of yellow, orange, and green paint decorate the canvas with abstract shapes and text. The overall style feels unfinished and loose, with much of the white canvas showing through the paint.

title: While the Earth Revolves at Night
alt_text: A painting in three panels shows contrasting scenes in black and white, vibrant color, and blue metallic tones. The left panel is a charcoal-like gray scene featuring a large, gloved hand reaching toward several round objects and a rectangular shape below. The center panel focuses on a stylized human finger with a bright red fingernail, positioned under a blue-framed, grid-like structure. Below the fingertip, concentric circles ripple out against a dark blue background. The right panel is filled with a close-up view of mechanical gears in various shades of blue and teal. These interconnected, toothed wheels overlap each other to create a sense of industrial motion.

title: Numbered One to Nine
alt_text: A sculpture of a hanging mobile suspended in the air. The structure is made of thin red wires that connect to several flat, circular metal discs. Most of the discs are red and spread across different levels of the frame. One large yellow disc sits at the upper left, while a dark gray disc extends to the right. The entire object casts soft, round shadows onto the plain, light gray background behind it.

title: July - The Swedish Sea
medium: Oil and charcoal on canvas with metal objects
alt_text: A painting shows three separate vertical panels placed side-by-side, each featuring a large, central object against a colorful background. The left panel depicts the profile of a human skull painted in light, bony tones against splashes of red, blue, and white. The center panel displays a large, dark heart shape that fills most of the frame, set against a background of yellow and other mixed colors. The right panel shows a dark glove, positioned as if it is a hand with fingers spread wide, against a moody, dark background. Small metal objects are attached to the upper borders of the panels, appearing to connect or hold the pieces together.

title: Pan North XI
alt_text: A painting showing a chaotic arrangement of geometric shapes stacked and layered across the canvas. Large, flat blocks in shades of orange, dark purple, and deep blue overlap to create a sense of depth and complexity. Several thin, ring-like shapes and long, rectangular beams crisscross the composition at various angles. In the center, there is a small, pale rectangular area that looks like a distant window or opening. The entire scene is filled with sharp, clean lines and contrasting colors that make the shapes appear to float against a dark, shadowy background.

title: Three Bowls
alt_text: A sculpture of three tall, vase-shaped objects made of cedar and graphite stands against a plain, light background. Each vessel has a rough, grid-like texture formed by many small, rectangular blocks fitted together. The containers are dark brown and black in color, suggesting a weathered or charred appearance. They are arranged in a diagonal row, with the leftmost vessel partially hidden behind the middle one. The top of each piece is open, revealing a hollow interior.

title: La Bomba
alt_text: A painting showing abstract, blurry shapes in many shades of green, yellow, and purple. Several dark, horizontal forms appear to stretch across the middle of the scene. These shapes have soft, smeared edges that suggest movement. The background is filled with vertical, light green brushstrokes that look like tall grass. On the right side, a large, dark, diagonal shape frames the composition.

title: Shredder
alt_text: A wooden and metal sculpture stands in a grassy clearing surrounded by tall trees. It features five large, dark, circular discs arranged vertically in a row. These discs are connected by a horizontal, cylindrical metal shaft that runs through their centers. The entire structure rests on two long, low wooden beams that lie flat on the ground. The background is filled with green trees and leafy bushes.

title: Ocean
alt_text: A rusted steel sculpture of abstract shapes sits on a concrete slab outdoors. The sculpture consists of dark, angular metal pieces, including a large semi-circular curve and a straight crossbar at the top. Near the base, a smaller curved hook and a spherical weight hang from the structure. In the background, a separate, bright blue statue of a human figure stands on the grassy ground near several tall trees. A gravel path stretches behind the sculpture, leading away through the wooded area.

title: The Crommelynck Gate with Tools
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows two large, rectangular metal panels that resemble ornate gate sections. The panels are dark, rough-textured, and filled with a tangled web of diagonal lines, loops, and jagged forms. Small, stick-like projections and circular shapes are scattered throughout the open framework. Both panels stand side-by-side on a flat, rectangular base against a plain gray background. The overall look is abstract and suggests a skeleton of a gate rather than a solid barrier.

title: Thataway
medium: Wrought and cast iron and steel
alt_text: A sculpture made of iron and steel stands in a grassy area with trees in the background. The central part of the structure consists of bright orange metal beams angled upward to form a support frame. A large, dark, round sphere hangs from a horizontal arm extending from the right side of the orange frame. To the left of the main structure, a silver-colored metal tube twists in a loose, looping shape near the ground. The entire piece looks industrial and sits on a green lawn surrounded by a forest.

title: Personnage et oiseau
medium: Bronze with brown and green patina
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a tall, pyramid-shaped base with alternating horizontal stripes of dark metal and lighter space. Perched on top of this triangle is a dark, spherical object with two small, cylindrical protrusions extending from its sides. Rising out of the sphere are several thin, rod-like appendages that angle upward and outward. Attached to the ends of these rods are flat, irregular shapes that resemble small, open hands or leaves. The entire structure stands centered on a plain, rectangular white platform against a light grey background.

title: Bec-Dida Day
alt_text: A painted steel sculpture stands outdoors, featuring a large, bright blue circular disc centered on the structure. A narrow, red rectangular beam balances horizontally on top of the blue circle. Beneath the circle, a V-shaped yellow beam acts as a support, angling outward to touch the ground. The entire sculpture rests upon a flat, black rectangular base that sits on a gravel surface. In the background, a stone building with an arched doorway and green trees are visible.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A rusted steel sculpture stands on a stone base in a garden. The sculpture features a large, dark circular ring with several other geometric shapes attached to it. Inside the ring, there is a flat, dark circle in the upper left corner and a thick, horizontal bar with visible rivets extending to the right. Below these, a rectangular block sits near the bottom curve of the ring. The artwork is set against a background of green bushes, trees, and a white house with large windows.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of iron and steel shows a collection of dark metal shapes attached to a central, vertical stand. A large circular ring sits near the top, while a cylinder shape is positioned prominently in the lower center. A long, thin metal rod runs diagonally across the middle, threaded through a series of smaller loops. Other curved and flat pieces of dark iron extend from the main structure in different directions. The entire object rests on a small, square base against a plain gray background.

title: Mayflower
alt_text: A wooden sculpture shows a tall, rectangular red cabinet filled with many small, carved faces. These faces are arranged on shelves behind a pane of glass and feature various expressions, skin tones, and hairstyles. Five additional, distinct head-shaped carvings sit in a row along the very top of the cabinet, each wearing a different colored hat. The cabinet itself has four short, sturdy feet at the base. This collection of faces creates a dense, multi-colored display of features within the bright red frame.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A galvanized iron sculpture shows two nested rectangular trays resting on a flat surface. The larger tray forms the outer edge, while a slightly smaller tray sits snugly inside it. Both trays are made of dark metal with a mottled, grey-and-white crystalline pattern. The sides of the trays are straight and vertical, creating sharp corners and edges. The overall shape is square and minimalist, set against a plain, light grey background.

title: Black Olives
alt_text: A painting of several dark olives arranged on a white plate. The plate sits in the center of a flat, reddish-brown surface. A thin strip of bright blue runs horizontally across the very top of the image. Each olive casts a distinct, dark blue shadow to its side on the white surface of the plate. The overall scene uses simple, bold colors and clear, straight lines.

title: Pair of Plates from the "Herculaneum Service"
alt_text: A porcelain plate with enamel and gilding showing two decorative items side-by-side. The left plate displays a figure riding a blue sea creature and holding a golden dish. The right plate features a figure in blue cloth riding a white horse-like creature while holding a spear. Both plates have wide white borders with raised floral patterns, accented with gold. Small, gold-colored animal and tree shapes are painted in the corners of each plate's rim. A thin gold line traces the circular outer edge of both dishes.

title: The Fleet
alt_text: A painting shows a group of people standing on a terrace overlooking a river at sunset. On the left, a tall, dark streetlamp stands beside a cluster of women and a child in winter-style clothing. The group looks out over a railing at the water, where several ships and a sailboat travel across the river. Across the water, a dark, hilly shoreline stretches under a sky filled with pink, grey, and white clouds. Another small group of people, including a person in a bright red coat, stands near the railing on the right side of the terrace.

title: The Waiting Room
alt_text: A painting showing a man and a woman sitting on a large, deep red sofa. The woman sits on the left, looking toward the man while wearing a pale, sleeveless dress and having very short hair. To her right sits an older, bald man wearing a dark formal suit with a white shirt and black bow tie. He sits with his body angled toward the woman, resting his hand on the red fabric of the seat. The background is a plain, dark blue wall decorated with several framed pictures.

title: The Wrestlers
alt_text: A painting shows a fight happening in a dark, dim setting against a wooden wall. Two figures are tangled together in the center of the scene, with one appearing to flip over the other. To the left, a man in a dark suit stands by the wall, looking down at the scuffle with his hands held near his chest. The entire background is mostly black, with faint light hitting the wall and the figures. The scene feels chaotic and low-lit, focusing only on the struggle between the two main figures.

title: The Back Fence
alt_text: A painting of a house exterior surrounded by trees and a garden fence. A large building with a white gable occupies the right side of the scene, partially covered by green vines growing over its entrance. A wooden picket fence extends across the middle ground, separating the house from a quieter, shaded backyard area. On the left side, dark, leafy trees stand tall against a cloudy, gray sky. A small, separate white structure with a peaked roof sits in the foreground to the right, casting a soft shadow on the ground.

title: Critter
alt_text: A limestone sculpture of a four-legged animal stands on a flat rectangular base. The animal faces to the left with a snout, a small ear, and a smooth, rounded body. Its thick tail curves downward and rests against the back of its hind legs. The stone surface appears rough and weathered, showing a light gray, speckled texture. The animal is depicted in profile, captured mid-stride.

title: Split Discs
alt_text: A stainless steel sculpture of abstract, metallic geometric forms stands on a grey background. The base consists of two short, horizontal cylinders that support a square frame made of faceted, shiny blocks. Attached to the top of this square frame are two larger, flat, semi-circular plates that fan outward. The entire object has a bright, polished, mirror-like finish that reflects the light. The arrangement creates a balanced but asymmetrical shape that reaches upward.

title: Boban
alt_text: An oak sculpture of several thick, rough logs is displayed outdoors on a square concrete pad. The sculpture consists of two tall vertical logs, a smaller vertical log, and two horizontal beams. One long beam extends horizontally to the left, while another shorter beam connects the tops of the two taller vertical posts. The logs have a warm, natural brown color and show the texture of tree bark. The artwork sits in the middle of a grassy lawn with large leafy trees and a stone wall in the background.

title: Nathaniel Moore Heywood (1788–1832)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows the portrait of a man in a dark coat. He faces slightly toward the right and has short brown hair with sideburns. He wears a high white collared shirt with a tied cravat at his neck. His expression is serious and he looks directly at the viewer. The portrait is housed in a hinged case lined with cream-colored silk and a dark green border.

title: Untitled (Stamps)
alt_text: A mixed media painting of a rectangular board completely covered in a dense collage of small, colorful postage stamps. The stamps are square and rectangular, overlapping in a chaotic, multicolored pattern of reds, blues, greens, and browns. In the center, a raised, rectangular piece of board also covered in stamps sits on top of the main surface. This central shape has a small, circular hole cut out of its left side, creating a shadow within the opening. The entire work is flat against a plain, off-white background.

title: Untitled (Knife and Rolling Pin)
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media on board features a background completely covered in a collage of overlapping paper scraps with printed text and colorful graphics. The surface is dense with fragments in shades of red, black, beige, white, and muted blues. Mounted vertically in the center are two three-dimensional, elongated, cylindrical forms. These central shapes are also wrapped in the same collage material as the background, making them blend into the surrounding texture. Despite this camouflage, their rounded, raised forms stand out against the flat, rectangular field.

title: When You The Invisible Cowboy
alt_text: A painting showing a chaotic collage of different scenes and figures arranged across the surface. On the left, tall red rock formations rise against a blue sky, while a stylized blue human face is partially buried in the ground below. In the center, a large, black, horse-like silhouette leaps over a dark pile of rocks, topped by a small piece of red meat with a fly buzzing nearby. To the right, a bright red devil figure with yellow eyes and horns stands before a beige, modern-looking building. Below the building, a large plume of dark, swirling smoke rises from a gray cylindrical object near the bottom edge. Tiny, distorted figures appear scattered around the rocks near the bottom center of the composition.

title: Sundial In Winter
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture shows a light brown, uneven form with a wide, flat top section supported by a thick base. The flat top tilts upward and has a hollow, oval-shaped hole cut into its center. To the left of the hole, there is a cluster of complex, open-work carvings that look like tangled branches. A thin, wavy line is etched into the right side of the flat top. The base of the sculpture widens at the bottom and features a small, stepped texture on the lower left corner.

title: Cover of embroidered cotton cloth
medium: Strip of open woven cotton cloth
alt_text: A textile of open woven cotton cloth shows a rectangular pattern with repeating vertical stripes. The design is made of alternating light and dark columns that run from the top to the bottom. One set of stripes features dark, stylized shapes that resemble a stylized flower or heart. Between these are lighter columns with a delicate, geometric lattice pattern. A thin, lacy border frames the entire piece on all four sides.

title: Printed textile
alt_text: A cotton textile shows a repeating pattern printed in soft, muted tones of brown and light orange. The fabric is covered in a winding vine-like design that creates large, circular shapes. Inside these spaces, small figures of people and animals appear to be moving through a forest setting. Several large, leafy flower clusters are spaced evenly across the background. A rectangular label with the numbers "1931,1540" sits at the bottom edge of the fabric.

title: Leaf from an Antiphonary: Initial "A" with the Resurrection and Three Marys at the Tomb
medium: Tempera and gold leaf on parchment
alt_text: A manuscript page of tempera and gold leaf on parchment shows two main scenes illustrated within an ornate, gold-framed border. In the upper scene, a figure in orange robes rises from a tomb, while guards lie asleep below. The lower scene features three women in veils standing before an angel with wings who sits on a stone bench. Below these illustrations, the page contains lines of musical staff with square black notes and lines of handwritten text. Decorative flourishes of vines and small figures in colorful clothing climb up the edges of the parchment.

title: Applique mat Mola
alt_text: A textile made of cotton shows a complex, symmetrical pattern embroidered in yellow thread onto a reddish-orange background. The design is filled with maze-like lines, rectangular shapes, and small repeated patterns that cover the entire surface. A rectangular black tag with the white numbers "1954.11.198" sits on a white foam strip at the bottom center of the piece. The fabric appears slightly frayed along its top and side edges. This embroidered cloth has a blocky, geometric style throughout its intricate design.

title: Applique mat Mola
alt_text: A cotton textile shows a rectangular fabric decorated with bright, colorful patterns. Three large, circular shapes that look like stylized flowers or suns sit across the top portion of the cloth. Below these circles, smaller shapes in red, orange, black, and white fill the background space. The bottom section of the fabric is covered in a grid of small, repeated squares with dark outlines. These squares create a textured, repeating pattern that spans the entire lower width of the design.

title: Mola cloth
alt_text: A cotton textile displays a vibrant, symmetrical pattern of jagged lines across a bright red background. The design features thick, layered shapes in orange, black, and white that curve and turn to form a maze-like effect. Each colored band is outlined with small, sharp white triangles that point inward toward the black sections. The fabric is rectangular and appears to be lying flat on a light-colored surface. A small black label with white numbers sits along the bottom edge of the fabric.

title: Katherine, Marcel and the Bride
medium: Silkscreens on plywood, lexan, cast polyester resin, steel and copper
alt_text: A sculpture made of silkscreens on plywood, lexan, resin, steel, and copper depicts a miniature house interior with a view through a large window. Inside the house, an older woman with white hair sits in a chair next to a table, while a man in a rocking chair sits across from her. Behind them is a room filled with tall bookcases and patterned wallpaper. A large, cracked window pane overlays the right side of the scene, obscuring part of the room behind it. On top of the gabled roof, a small metal weather vane features a horse shape.

title: Scarf of needle net lace
alt_text: A textile made of black lace showing a repeating floral and vine pattern. The fabric is folded over itself, creating a triangular shape at the top. The lace features a detailed scalloped edge along the bottom and sides. The background is a flat, solid white surface. A small, rectangular label with the white numbers "1947.56" sits at the bottom center of the frame.

title: Figure Study, possibly for The Spirit of Vulcan, Genius of the Workers in Iron and Steel, Rotunda, Pennsylvania State Capitol, Harrisburg
alt_text: A painting of a seated, muscular man. He faces forward with a serious expression and wears a light-colored cloth draped over his shoulder and waist. His left arm extends outward to the side, and he holds a thin, vertical object that extends down toward the bottom of the frame. The background is painted in loose, dark brown and grey brushstrokes. The figure appears to be sitting on an unseen surface, leaving his legs bare and positioned vertically.

title: Bords du Loing, Saint-Mammes (The River Loing at Saint-Mammes)
