alt_text: A painting showing a row of small houses with light-colored walls and reddish roofs sitting on a grassy bank. A large, dense green tree stands behind a low stone wall to the right of the buildings. In front of the bank is a body of water that reflects the shapes and colors of the buildings and the trees. The sky above is a light blue with faint, wispy clouds. The entire scene is painted with visible, textured brushstrokes.

title: Portrait II
alt_text: A sculpture of a tall, rectangular cabinet-like object stands against a white wall. The structure is covered in a dark reddish-brown material with a wood-grain pattern. Its front is divided into several wide horizontal sections that resemble stacked drawers or panels. Resting on the flat top surface is a tall, rectangular back panel featuring a flat, mustard-yellow surface framed by the dark wood. The entire piece sits on a light-colored wooden floor.

title: Compositional Study, possibly for Mariana
alt_text: A painting of two figures in a dimly lit, shadowy room. On the left, a person sits in a chair, dressed in light-colored clothing. On the right, a second person stands facing the seated figure. The background is a very dark, murky brown that makes the figures stand out in ghostly, pale tones. The floor appears to reflect some light in the bottom right corner. The canvas itself has rough edges and sits on a wooden stand.

title: The Apparition
alt_text: A painting of figures in a dimly lit, interior setting. On the left, a tall person stands wrapped in a long, white robe against a dark blue and green background. To the right, a person in a red scarf kneels on the floor, looking toward the figure in white. Below the kneeling person, a darker shape lies stretched out on the floor. Several thin, tall candles stand upright to the right, glowing softly against the shadows.

title: Landscape Study with Three Figures
medium: Pen and ink and oil on canvas
alt_text: A painting of three people standing together on a grassy hill overlooking the sea. The figures are dressed in long, simple clothes and stand in the foreground toward the right side. Behind them, a wide band of blue water stretches across the middle of the scene. Above the water, the sky is filled with light gray and blue clouds. The ground they stand on is painted in loose strokes of green and yellow.

title: Figure Study
alt_text: A painting of a woman's face and shoulders appears against a dark, textured background. Her expression is neutral as she looks slightly off to the side with dark eyes. Her dark hair hangs loose and frames her face, blending into the shadowy surroundings. A reddish-brown garment covers her shoulder in the lower right area of the painting. Thick, visible brushstrokes create a sense of rough texture across the entire surface of the work.

title: Compositional Study, for The Arts
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas shows a group of figures in light, classical robes gathered in an architectural space. A central, taller figure sits on a throne while holding a staff, surrounded by four others who are sitting or lounging on the ground. To the left, one figure rests near a large musical instrument resembling a lyre. On the right, another person sits in front of an empty easel, holding a palette. The overall scene is rendered in muted, pale tones against a neutral background.

title: Compositional Study, for The Sciences
alt_text: A painting shows several figures gathered in a dimly lit, muted setting with scientific tools. In the center, a woman in a light-colored dress sits on a chair, resting her head on her hand in a thoughtful pose. To her left, another person sits hunched over, wearing dark clothing. On the right side, a third figure leans back while resting an elbow on a large, globe-like object. In the background, a long, thin rod or telescope angles diagonally upward across the scene.

title: Wall panel
medium: Satin and velvet with metal braid binding
alt_text: A textile of satin and velvet with metal braid binding shows an intricate, repeating pattern of large floral motifs and swirling leaves. The fabric is cream-colored and decorated with deep green leaves and reddish-brown flowers. Symmetrical designs spread across the surface, creating a mirror effect from the center outward. The cloth is rolled around a tube at the top and lies flat on a light-colored surface extending toward the viewer. A small black label with white numbers sits at the bottom edge.

title: Red/Green Architecture (yellow/violet gradation)
medium: Oil on canvas with red watercolor border around edges of canvas, laid down on cardboard mat
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes organized into a grid pattern. Most of the rectangular and square shapes are dark shades of brown, gray, and deep green. Scattered among these are a few smaller patches of bright red, pale green, and white. There are also several half-circle shapes along the bottom and middle sections of the composition. A thick, solid red border frames the entire image.

title: Compositional Study
alt_text: A painting of two figures in a dark, moody setting. To the left, a luminous, pale figure stands upright with one arm extended downward, emitting a bright white glow. To the right, a darker, crouched figure shields its face with its arms as if recoiling from the light. The background is washed in deep blue and purple tones, suggesting a shadowy or night environment. The entire painting is framed by a lighter, yellowish fabric border.

title: Compositional Study
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on a tall, dark throne while another figure kneels before her. The woman on the throne wears a light-colored dress and a tall, pointed crown, and she looks upward with her head tilted back. Her hands rest calmly in her lap. Below her, a dark-haired woman with a checkered, textured lower garment kneels on the floor, reaching her hands up toward the seated woman. The kneeling woman leans over the limp, horizontal body of another person lying on the ground. The background is a dark, indistinct shade of brown that creates a somber mood for the scene.

title: Compositional Study, possibly for The Merry Wives of Windsor
alt_text: A painting of a group of four people dressed in old-fashioned, heavy clothing. On the left, a person wearing a bright red outfit and hat sits holding a small gold cup near their face. Next to them, a person in a dark blue hooded cloak stands and looks toward the person in red. A third person with a white head covering stands behind the others, holding a piece of paper. On the far right, a fourth person wears a dark brown hood and looks down. The background is a plain, muted tan color.

title: Homage to the Square: Preparedness
alt_text: A painting of three nested squares centered on the canvas. The outer square is a large, light gray field that serves as the background. Within that, there is a medium-sized square in a muted, sandy tan color. At the very center sits a smaller, vibrant orange square. The lines of the squares are clean and straight, forming a simple geometric design.

title: Structural Constellation N-30
alt_text: A painting shows thin white lines on a solid black background. These lines form a pattern of several connected geometric shapes that look like three-dimensional blocks or rectangles. The shapes appear to overlap and weave over one another, creating a tangled, abstract structure. Some of the rectangular forms angle toward the edges of the frame, while others seem to sit in the center. The sharp white lines stand out clearly against the deep black space.

title: Standing Figure with Fingers
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a tall, narrow, and upright form. The object stands on three thin, spindly legs that taper to points at the bottom. Its main body has a sharp, angled surface with several flat planes that resemble a folded geometric shape. The texture looks rough and weathered with a muted grey and green color. One side of the sculpture is a reddish-brown tone, contrasting with the rest of the dark metallic body.

title: Untitled Relief
alt_text: A brass sculpture of an abstract, flat shape with smooth, curved edges. The object has a dull gold color that looks like metal. There is a large, irregular hole on the right side. A much smaller, triangle-shaped hole sits to the left of the larger opening. The entire form rests against a plain, light gray background.

title: Couple
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an abstract form with two tall, wing-like shapes standing upright. The two main sections are connected at the center, creating a hollow space between them. Each wing tapers toward the top and bottom, ending in thin, narrow points. The entire piece is made of a grey-green, textured metal. Several thin, rod-like legs extend from the base to hold the sculpture up.

title: Painting II
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes covers the entire surface. Thick, blocky strokes of black, white, and gray paint are layered across the canvas. These marks create a pattern of irregular rectangles, squares, and curved shapes. The paint is applied densely, hiding the background in many places. In the gaps between the dark and light marks, a muted brown color shows through the texture.

title: Untitled
medium: acrylic and collage on board mounted on board
alt_text: A painting with a geometric pattern of circles, rectangles, and stripes on a yellow background. At the center, two large, curved shapes create a white circle. Inside this circle, blue and white stripes curve along the edges, forming an oval shape of solid blue in the middle. Behind the main circular design, a thick vertical band runs from top to bottom, featuring stripes of red, black, and white. Another white band runs diagonally across the composition from the bottom left to the top right. These shapes overlap and repeat to create a sense of symmetry and balance across the surface.

title: Low Landscape No. 1
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a collection of dark, flat metal pieces arranged to form a grid-like pattern against a plain white background. The metal strips have a matte, black-brown finish and appear rough or textured like weathered wood. Some of the strips are placed horizontally, while others stand vertically to create boxy, open shapes. These elements connect to one another, leaving empty spaces of various sizes throughout the structure. The overall arrangement is wide and irregular, spanning more horizontally than it does vertically.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a long, thin, horizontal base topped with various abstract shapes. The base is a dark, flat rectangle that spans the width of the arrangement. Scattered across this base are many small, chunky geometric pieces of bronze. These pieces include angled wedges, curved segments, and vertical blocks of varying sizes. They are arranged in a row, creating a textured and jagged landscape. The entire piece has a matte, brownish metallic finish.

title: Form
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an abstract geometric shape with a gold-colored surface. The sculpture has multiple flat sides and sharp edges that meet at different angles. It is wider at the top and narrows down to a smaller base. The piece sits securely on a thin, rectangular black stand. This object is centered against a solid, neutral gray background.

title: Variations
alt_text: A sculpture of welded metal shows an abstract structure made of interconnected rods and solid shapes. A large, box-like square sits near the center, appearing textured and slightly lighter in color than the surrounding frame. To the right of this box, a tall, rectangular pillar with a rough, reddish-brown surface stands upright. Several smaller, dark red cubes are attached to the open, wire-like grid that forms the base of the sculpture. The entire piece looks like a complex, three-dimensional geometric web.

title: The Pearl
alt_text: A painting showing a single, pale, round vegetable sitting on a shelf. The vegetable has a light, greenish-white skin and a long, withered, curled stem reaching upward. It rests against a dark, textured surface that appears to be made of wood planks. To the left of the vegetable, there is a small, blurry dark shape that is hard to define. The background is a deep, reddish-brown color with thin, horizontal lines. The overall scene is simple and focuses on the quiet form of the vegetable.

title: Trees through a Window
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract scene with light brushstrokes on a white background. To the left, there are clusters of dark green and light green shapes that look like foliage. A thin, vertical brown line stands on the right side of the canvas. Above, a horizontal green line stretches across the upper portion of the image. Small patches of blue and soft pink fill out the rest of the composition.

title: Berkshire Landscape
alt_text: A painting showing an outdoor scene viewed from behind a tall, light-colored pillar. To the left of the pillar, a simple, thin-lined outline of a chair sits near patches of green and blue brushstrokes. On the right side, there are clusters of darker green shapes that look like trees or bushes against a pale background. Soft, light-colored horizontal lines run across the top of the scene, suggesting a distant horizon. A dark, handwritten signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the composition.

title: Untitled (Blue, Green, Grey, White)
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas features a collection of overlapping, geometric shapes in muted colors. The upper right area is dominated by large, angular blocks of deep blue, dark purple, and teal. Below these, a cluster of textured, jagged forms in shades of gray, dark brown, and white fills the left and center of the frame. The bottom portion is anchored by a smaller, irregular patch of green and brown tones. Soft, light gray and cream fields of color surround these shapes, creating a sense of layered space. The entire image has a patchy, uneven texture that looks similar to torn paper.

title: Moon, Flower and Surf
alt_text: A painting of an abstract composition with a dark background. At the top sits a large, light-gray circle with a darker gray center. Below the circle is a lighter, rectangular shape that has rough, jagged edges. Across this lower rectangle, thin, dark lines zig-zag back and forth. The entire image uses shades of black, gray, and white.

title: Twin Portions
alt_text: A painting showing two triangular slices of cake, each sitting on its own small, blue plate. Both slices are a warm, golden-brown color with a thick layer of white frosting on top. The cake on the left is positioned slightly closer to the viewer, while the second slice sits further back to the right. The plates rest on a light, tan surface that stretches across the background. Deep blue shadows cast by the plates stretch across the surface, connecting the two subjects visually.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an upright, flat shape with a smooth, golden-brown finish. The piece is rectangular with slightly curved sides and rests on a dark, rectangular base. Near the top right, there is a large, hollow, oval-shaped opening that goes all the way through the material. The surface of the sculpture is mostly plain and unadorned. The entire object stands centered against a plain gray background.

title: Girl Reading
alt_text: A painting of a person lying on their stomach on the floor, reading a book. The person has light skin, dark hair, and is nude. They are positioned in the center, resting on the floor which has a light, textured surface. In the foreground, a blue wooden chair stands vertically, partially obscuring the view of the person's lower body. The background consists of large, flat planes of pale green and blue paint, suggesting walls.

title: Menaçant
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured shapes in shades of brown, gray, and black. A large, stormy-looking mass of dark color dominates the center of the canvas. This central cluster includes bright streaks of deep blue and white that look like light breaking through dark clouds. The background is a hazy, muted brown that fades into lighter tones toward the top. At the bottom, a dark, heavy area suggests depth and shadows.

title: Bannered Castle
alt_text: A sculpture of a rusted metal assemblage shows a bent, angular metal frame resting on a blue fabric blanket. The object is constructed from several pieces of dull, reddish-brown iron pipes and flat metal bars joined together by rough, thick weld lines. A curved pipe segment extends from the top of the main body, while a vertical piece stands in the center with a jagged, broken opening at the bottom. A white paper tag with black printed text hangs from the upper section of the metal frame. Below the object, a separate, small rectangular tag lies flat on the blue surface.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of three human-like figures set against a textured, speckled background. On the left, a tall figure with a ruffled, patterned collar faces toward the center. In the middle, a person holds a large, stylized flower or headpiece up to their face with both hands. To the right, a smaller figure wearing a decorative cap looks on toward the center. Above all the figures, a yellow, cloud-like shape filled with dots floats near the top of the frame. The entire composition uses intricate lines and small, repetitive patterns in shades of yellow, green, and brown.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting showing a woman with long yellow hair standing next to a peacock surrounded by flowers. The woman wears a white and yellow striped shirt and holds a purple drum in her lap. To her right, a large peacock with a dark blue and green body stands among the stems and leaves. Several large, orange, round flowers with brown centers are scattered across the scene. The entire background is filled with textured green leaves and white vine patterns.

title: Hard Edge Ejecta #6
medium: Silkscreen on wood panel with saw cuts
alt_text: A painting of a monochrome composition features abstract shapes and layered textures in shades of gray and black. Several large, angular geometric planes overlap each other, creating a sense of depth and broken perspective. Thin, sharp lines cut across the surface in various directions, resembling deep scratches or straight grooves carved into the material. The dark black background appears in the upper right corner, contrasting with the lighter, mottled gray areas below. The overall effect creates a stark, fragmented appearance across the flat surface.

title: Venice San Bartolomeo
alt_text: A painting shows a tall, light-colored bell tower standing between two buildings. The tower has arched openings near the top and a small cross on its roof against a pale, cloudy sky. On the right side, a round, dark clock hangs from the side of a rough, textured brick wall. The building on the left is darker and shows several rows of windows. Thin wires stretch horizontally across the upper part of the sky.

title: Critical Placement
alt_text: A painting of a rocky, uneven landscape features a series of ancient, stone-like structures built into a hillside. Three large, boxy buildings sit at the top of the slope, each with dark, rectangular openings for doors. The ground below these structures is rough and uneven, filled with shadows and large stones. At the bottom of the scene, a group of small, dark figures appears to be climbing or moving across the terrain. The entire image is rendered in muted, monochromatic tones of beige, brown, and black.

title: My Hut at Night... The Cricket is Rummaging About, from the group of paintings Entering the Walled City, By the Day and by the Night
alt_text: A painting of a dark, abstract shape on a divided background. The left side is a vertical panel of olive green that contains a simple, light-colored outline of a tall, rounded shape. The right side is a much larger, dark purple square that features a geometric shape outlined in light lines. This geometric shape resembles a house or a structure with horizontal lines running across it. A solid, unlined rectangle sits inside the lower center of this structure. The entire composition uses muted, earthy tones and simple, sketch-like outlines.

title: Once Around
alt_text: A painting of two figures in an oil on panel work. Two pale figures stand in a dark, warm-toned room, illuminated by a soft, amber light. On the left, a figure faces to the right, with their left arm raised slightly near their head. On the right, a second figure stands with their back turned toward the viewer, facing away. Both figures are unclothed and stand against a solid, dark background that fades into shadow at the edges.

title: Study for Penn’s Treaty with the Indians, House of Representatives Chamber, Pennsylvania State Capitol, Harrisburg
alt_text: A painting of a large group of people outdoors. In the center, a person wearing a headdress shakes hands with a man dressed in a long coat and wig. They stand before a massive, dark tree that takes up the top center of the scene. To the left, several other people sit on the ground, while to the right, a row of men in dark clothing stands watching. The scene is set in a green, wooded area with a hazy blue sky visible through the tree branches.

title: Cyndi
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown in profile against a plain, light-gray background. She faces toward the left side of the frame with her eyes closed, displaying a calm expression. Her hair is styled in long, dark braids that fall behind her shoulders. A single earring shaped like a star hangs from her visible ear, reflecting light with metallic highlights. The lighting on her face is soft, casting subtle shadows under her chin and along her jawline.

title: Untitled
medium: Oil and beeswax on wood panel
alt_text: A painting of vertical stripes on a wood panel shows four dark brown, rectangular bars against a cream-colored background. These bars are spaced evenly apart and run from the top edge to the bottom edge of the rectangular surface. The surface appears to have a thick, textured finish. The painting is displayed vertically on a wooden easel, which frames the piece on both the left and right sides. Warm, orange-toned light illuminates the scene, casting a glow over the entire object.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture stands in a room and mimics the shape of a person with their arms raised. The figure is made of many flat, colorful slats of wood layered together. The colors include bright pink, yellow, orange, blue, purple, and green. It stands on a flat base made of similar dark wooden pieces. The background behind the sculpture is a plain brown wall and a gray metal shelf.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an abstract arrangement of metal lines and shapes against a plain background. The piece features a horizontal base and a separate horizontal top plate, which are connected by various curved and straight metal rods. These rods form empty rectangular frames, sharp spikes, and wavy wire-like structures in the open space between the top and bottom plates. One section contains a more dense, textured form that resembles a small, jagged creature or rock. The overall color is a dark, matte brown that looks like metal.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, intersecting lines and shapes layered over a colorful background. The background features splotches of muted orange, blue, and gray that seem to blend into one another. Dark, thin lines cross the canvas in many directions, creating a chaotic, web-like pattern across the surface. A few thick, vertical white lines stand out near the center and right side, crossing through the thinner lines. These white lines form an upright, cross-like structure that anchors the busy composition.

title: Indian Series
alt_text: A painting of a bright orange, rectangular shape that takes up the right side of the canvas. This large orange section has a thick black outline and a vertical row of six small circles running through it. To the left of the orange shape, a colorful, blocky figure sits against a solid blue background. This figure wears a tall, white, cloud-shaped hat on its top part. Below the hat, the figure shows stripes of red and yellow, with a small, rounded lavender shape hanging down from the center. Sharp, white, claw-like points curve downward underneath the lavender part.

title: F Train Over the Gowanus
alt_text: A painting of a canal running beneath a large, elevated metal bridge. The bridge stretches horizontally across the middle of the image, supported by thick, structural beams on both sides of the water. Dark, still water fills the center foreground and reflects the structure above. On the left bank, low industrial buildings and a small patch of green trees sit along the water’s edge. The right bank holds a larger white building and some vegetation. The entire scene is bathed in muted, sepia-toned colors.

title: Backswing
alt_text: A sculpture of wood strips creates a tall, twisted shape that spirals upward. The structure is made of many thin, light-colored wooden slats arranged in a vertical, open cage design. Inside the center of the wooden slats, a bright orange pattern is visible. The piece sits on a large sheet of brown paper on the floor of what appears to be a warehouse or storage area. To the right of the wooden sculpture, a dark, small figure stands on a black base.

title: Study of Light and Space #17 (93)
alt_text: A painting of two large, light-colored rectangular structures that stand against a white background. These rectangular shapes are arranged with a dark, narrow gap between them in the center. Bright, white light shines across the right side of the image, illuminating the surface of one rectangle. A thinner band of light also runs vertically along the left edge of the first rectangle. The scene creates a simple, stark contrast between the bright highlights and the deep shadows in the center.

title: Michael Twice
alt_text: A painting of two portraits on side-by-side rectangular panels. The left panel shows the profile of a man with short, dark hair, looking to the right. He wears a dark jacket over a bright red shirt. The right panel shows the same man looking straight ahead at the viewer. His expression is serious, and he wears a dark jacket over a muted grey shirt. Both figures are set against a textured, light grey background within a single frame.

title: Cherry Point
alt_text: A sculpture made of cherry, butternut, and maple rests on a gray metal shelf. The object is primarily brown with distinct wood grain patterns and smooth, curving sections. One wing-like shape extends horizontally across the center of the image, while another thicker section sits angled toward the left. This wooden piece is positioned in the middle of a storage shelf filled with other miscellaneous items. A wire basket covered in white fabric sits to the right of the wooden sculpture.

title: Black Firmament
alt_text: A painting of black and white shapes covers the entire canvas. The image is filled with irregular, swirling forms that are black against a cream-colored background. Some of the shapes resemble thick brushstrokes, while others look like blobs or organic patterns. The design fills the rectangle from edge to edge without any clear focal point. These overlapping patterns create a sense of movement across the surface.

title: Huntington Beach
alt_text: A painting showing two cars parked on a gray, paved lot under a pale blue sky. On the left, a tall, gray stone post with a round white light on top stands prominently. A dark blue, older-model car faces to the right in the center of the frame. To the right, the back of a bright yellow car is visible, angled away from the viewer. Small, thin parking meter poles are scattered between the cars and the lamp post. The scene is framed by a simple, light-colored wooden border.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A clay sculpture showing a seated person with their legs crossed. The figure has a smooth, unrefined surface that appears to be made of molded earth-toned clay. The person rests their hands on their lap and leans forward slightly with their head bowed. A thin, white string or wire is wrapped loosely around the neck of the figure, with a small white tag hanging from it. The sculpture sits on a textured, blue-grey surface that looks like a moving blanket.

title: Maquette for Complex Form 75
alt_text: A cardboard sculpture shows an abstract, geometric shape with many flat surfaces. It stands tall and pointed on one side, resembling a sharp mountain peak or pyramid. The base of the sculpture is wider and spreads out across the surface it sits on. Multiple triangles and trapezoids connect to form the overall structure. The object is a light, off-white color and is set against a plain, neutral grey background.

title: Richard Brown Baker
alt_text: A painting of a man's head and shoulders shown against a solid, orange-yellow background. The man is middle-aged with light gray hair and fair skin. He wears a dark suit jacket over a light-colored button-down shirt. A tie with thick, diagonal stripes in red, black, and white hangs down from his collar. His expression is neutral as he looks directly toward the viewer.

title: The Hunter
alt_text: A painting of a bald eagle grabbing a fish out of a body of water. The eagle has large, dark brown wings spread wide as it hovers just above the surface. Below the bird, a small fish is held in its talons, creating ripples in the dark blue water. The background shows a line of green trees and distant, hazy mountains under a blue, cloudy sky. The entire scene is framed in a thin, dark border.

title: Two Mackerels
alt_text: A painting shows two fish resting against a large, curved yellow shape. One fish is positioned vertically, pointing upward, while the other fish lies horizontally across the bottom. Both fish are silver with dark stripes along their backs and large, round eyes. Behind the yellow shape, a flat, light-colored background suggests a view of a sea or horizon line. A dark, textured vertical band runs along the left edge of the painting.

title: The RBB I Know
alt_text: A painting of an older man with short, white hair sitting in an armchair. He wears a tan checkered blazer, a white button-down shirt, and light-colored pants while sitting with his legs crossed. Behind him stands a large, abstract shape painted in shades of deep blue and dark brown. The background appears light-colored and airy around the blue form. The man looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression.

title: Tendril #2
alt_text: A sculpture of wood and metal shows a collection of curved, interlocking segments resting on a blue blanket. The object is composed of several bent, C-shaped wooden ribs that are stained in shades of tan and yellow. Strips of grey aluminum are attached to the inner edges of these wooden curves with rivets. The structure is open in the center and has a disjointed, circular shape. A single, separate wooden piece extends outward to the right, appearing to hover slightly above the blanket.

title: Water Pail
medium: Oil on incised canvas and wood
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a simple metal bucket resting in the center. The bucket is dark gray with visible rivets around the top rim and sides. Faint, etched lines on the light beige background suggest the outline of a figure sitting behind the bucket. The painting is framed in a plain wooden border and is mounted on an easel. In the background, wooden supports and other studio equipment are visible.

title: Fair Game Objective
alt_text: A painting of a person’s face being kissed on the cheek by another person. The scene is rendered in shades of black, white, and gray, with visible, heavy brushstrokes throughout. The person on the left faces mostly forward, with a prominent nose, dark eyes, and a slight expression. Their face takes up most of the frame. On the right side, a partial profile of a second person leans in to press their lips against the first person's cheek. The background is a solid, dark black color that surrounds the two faces.

title: Now I've Changed
medium: Oils on glass with hand-painted wood frame
alt_text: A painting on glass shows a portrait of a person against a two-toned background. The person has a pale, white face with dark, heavy-lidded eyes and dark lips, gazing downward. Their hair is brownish and shoulder-length, framing the face. They wear a simple blue shirt against a vibrant orange background that occupies the middle of the frame. The entire image is enclosed in a simple, painted wooden frame.

title: Untitled (#5)
alt_text: A painting made of oil on canvas sits in the center of the image, wrapped in clear plastic for protection. The surface of the painting is a solid, textured dark green color. A strip of tan tape runs horizontally across the upper third of the wrapped canvas. Written on this tape in black marker are the words "CHRIS LEA 'FIELD OF ADDRESS'" and the number "1571.1992.13". The painting is standing in a storage room with metal shelving units visible in the background and foreground.

title: People's Ragtop
alt_text: A painting of an aerial view of a city street scene. A gray car with a light-colored roof is angled across the center of the road. A person in a dark suit holding a briefcase walks on the street near the car. To the left, another person wears a dark jacket and blue pants while walking away from the car. The street is made of gray asphalt and has a white painted line on the ground. A brick-colored sidewalk with a gray curb edges the scene in the upper right corner.

title: Portal
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes in shades of yellow, orange, and brown. The center of the work features two large, solid ovals that sit side by side against a background of long, pointed triangular forms. These triangles create a zig-zag pattern that runs vertically across the frame. Behind these lighter yellow shapes, bands of brown and orange are visible in the background. The entire design is enclosed within a dark, muted border.

title: Asterix
alt_text: A painting of a geometric pattern made of many shapes and colors. In the center, a small white and gray square sits inside a large orange diamond shape. Surrounding this diamond are larger, light green triangles that form a star-like pattern. Behind these shapes, vertical and horizontal bands of yellow and brown stretch across the entire square frame. The background is composed of four solid, dark brown corner squares.

title: The Seven
alt_text: A painting shows a group of seven standing men who are unclothed. They are arranged in a horizontal row, with their bodies overlapping slightly. The figures are painted in shades of orange, red, and peach against a background of deep red and dark shadows. They look forward with serious expressions on their faces. The entire scene is enclosed within a thick black frame.

title: Untitled (a/e 291)
alt_text: A painting of vertical stripes spans the rectangular canvas from top to bottom. The image is divided into four distinct columns of varying widths and colors. On the far left, a solid, dark black band runs the entire height of the piece. To its right is a lighter, grayish-white stripe with rough, textured edges. Next is a wide, muted olive-green section that gradually shifts in tone. The far-right column is a deep, earthy brown color that completes the arrangement.

title: The Best and Worst of Times
medium: Oil on paper, mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting shows a collection of abstract shapes in warm colors. A large, orange, ring-like form sits near the center, appearing slightly broken or segmented. Inside this circle, there are messy, grey, brush-like strokes. Several long, curved, yellow shapes extend out from the center, looking like vines or stems. A dark, thin, T-shaped stick leans across the top left corner, while white curved forms occupy the upper right and bottom left corners. The background is a dense, scratchy mix of browns, reds, and faint greens.

title: Cadillac & Fronds
alt_text: A painting of a silver car parked next to a large plant. The rear of the car dominates the left side of the frame, showing its taillight, license plate, and trunk. To the right, big, bright green palm fronds fan out from the top. A bushy, dark green plant sits beneath the palm leaves near the bottom corner. The ground is a smooth, dark surface that reflects some light. The painting is set inside a simple, light-colored metal frame.

title: Automatic Writing V
alt_text: A painting of a bright lime-green rectangle with small yellow dots scattered across it. The surface of the painting has a thick, textured quality with several raised, vertical and horizontal lines running through the paint. These lines create a grid-like pattern of slightly different sized rectangles across the canvas. The yellow dots appear mostly round and are spread unevenly over the surface. The edges of the green field appear rough and uneven where the paint meets the frame.

title: Sostegno
medium: Clay, egg tempera, and gold leaf
alt_text: A painting of clay, egg tempera, and gold leaf shows a geometric grid pattern. The object is divided into five separate sections arranged in a square. In the center sits a square covered in shiny, textured gold leaf. Two smooth, cream-colored squares sit on the left and right sides of this central piece. Two long, cream-colored rectangular panels form the top and bottom borders of the arrangement. All these pieces fit together to create a flat, symmetrical surface.

title: Time Grinder
alt_text: A steel and enamel sculpture sits on a wide shelf. On the left side, a smooth, curved red block extends upward and bends. Connected to this red block is a complex frame made of thin, reddish-brown metal wires that arch and cross each other in the air. On the right side, the frame attaches to a solid, rectangular golden-brown box. A small square tag and a piece of plastic wrap rest on the shelf surface beneath the wire structure. The entire object is surrounded by storage shelving and packing materials.

title: We Two
alt_text: A wooden sculpture shows a stylized, geometric shape that resembles an abstract letter "A." The form is flat on top and rests on a large, plain table in an storage area. The left side of the sculpture is painted a bright blue, followed by a dark black stripe in the middle. The right side is a vibrant red, separated by a thin white line running down the center. Its thick, white sides provide a strong contrast against the colored top surfaces.

title: The Portrait Gallery
alt_text: A painting depicts a large, open room with classical architectural features and figures standing inside. In the center of the scene, an older man in a light-colored shirt and shorts stands facing a younger man wearing a white dress shirt and dark trousers. Behind them, the wall is painted with three distinct portraits of historical-looking individuals under decorative arches. To the left of the two men, a row of simple wooden chairs sits empty along the wall. On the far right, a woman sits on a single chair and appears to be reading a piece of paper.

title: Untitled
medium: Oil and beeswax on wood panel
alt_text: A painting of oil and beeswax on a wood panel shows a repeating pattern of dark, abstract shapes against a light background. These dark shapes are somewhat bulbous, resembling stacked teardrops or hourglasses, and are arranged in four vertical columns. The columns of dark shapes alternate with lighter, hourglass-shaped negative spaces between them. The panel itself is rectangular and rests inside a simple cardboard frame that has been slightly trimmed. The overall scene is lit with a warm, orange-toned light.

title: Untitled
medium: Graphite on paper with oil- and wax-painted frame, mounted on board
alt_text: A painting of a lone figure standing inside a rectangular architectural frame. The figure is a slender person wearing a striped shirt and shorts. They stand in the center of an open space that looks like a shallow room or niche. A heavy, dark border surrounds the central image, creating a strong contrast between the light interior and the dark edges. The entire work is enclosed within a reflective, metallic outer frame.

title: Kanown
alt_text: A painting of swirling colors set against a solid black background. A large, circular shape dominates the center, filled with warm tones of orange, yellow, and brown. Inside this circle, there is a bright white spot surrounded by a dark brown ring. Toward the top left, a smaller, textured blue and white shape sits near a splash of orange paint. Another orange patch with a dab of green rests near the bottom edge. The edges of the central shapes are soft and blended, creating a sense of movement.

title: Red Brick Victorian #16
alt_text: A painting showing a two-story brick house with a tall, ornate chimney. The house is a warm orange color and features arched windows on the upper floor. A large white porch with detailed lattice woodwork wraps around the front of the building. In front of the porch, dense bushes with light purple flowers frame the entrance and steps. The background is filled with lush green trees against a pale sky.

title: Romance Allegories
alt_text: A jewelry miniature showing a portrait inside an oval gold bracelet. The center holds a small painted scene of a woman sitting in a garden, framed by a border of white enamel with tiny gold stars and bright blue circles. The bracelet band on either side of the portrait is made of intricate, lacy gold metalwork. Tiny gold beads line the outer edge of the oval frame. The background of the entire image is a solid, neutral gray.

title: Still Life with Nautilus
medium: Colored pencil and ink wash on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a still life set against a plain, warm-brown background. A small, light-colored bowl sits in the center of the foreground on a flat, greenish surface. Behind the bowl, there is a tall, dark cylinder made of stacked rings and a gray cone-shaped object. To the left of these, a round, orange, ruffled shell-like shape rests next to a small, smooth yellow object. On the right side, a round, textured object with light gray vertical stripes sits partially tucked behind the cone.

title: Town Dock
alt_text: A painting showing several small boats tied to a wooden dock. In the foreground, two small, light-colored motorboats sit side-by-side in the water. Behind them, an orange inflatable raft with a black motor is also attached to the pier. The wooden dock extends from the right side of the frame with ropes tied to thick posts. The water appears dark and calm, reflecting the orange light of the scene.

title: Untitled
medium: Chalk on foamcore, board, and aluminum
alt_text: A sculpture made of chalk on foamcore, board, and aluminum shows a flat, rectangular base. The surface of the piece is colored white with dark, smudged textures throughout. In the center, there is a square shape with rounded corners outlined in black. Inside that square sits a six-pointed star, and in the middle of the star is a small, solid black hexagon. The entire piece rests on a smooth, brown surface.

title: Danae in Brooklyn Awaiting the Shower of Gold
alt_text: A fired terra-cotta sculpture shows a figure lying down inside a small, open structure. The figure is positioned on its back with its legs bent and arms raised above its head. A rough, textured, cloud-like shape rests on top of the walls above the figure. The entire sculpture sits on a flat, rectangular base. The walls of the structure have small, rectangular cutouts that look like windows.

title: Untitled (4)
alt_text: A painting of a square surface is covered in a dense, uniform texture. The entire area is colored a warm, rusty orange. Tiny, pebble-like bumps create a rough and bumpy appearance across the whole square. There are no patterns, lines, or other shapes visible on the surface. The background is slightly out of focus, suggesting the object is mounted on a larger display.

title: Pennsylvania
alt_text: A painting of abstract, light-colored shapes on a muted, brownish-grey background sits on a wooden cart. The artwork features delicate, swirling lines that resemble stylized wings or leaf-like forms in the center. Near the bottom, there is a circular pattern made of concentric rings that looks like a target. The canvas is vertical and rectangular, displaying a subtle texture across its surface. The wooden cart supporting the painting has a simple frame and wheels, suggesting it is being stored in a warehouse or museum backroom.

title: Spot the Winner
medium: Oil, alkyd, resin, and enamel on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a bright orange square background with dark, irregular splotches spread across the surface. The background is a flat, vivid orange color. Overlaid on this orange are various dark, brownish-black marks that look like splatters or drips. Some of the marks are small and round, while others are longer streaks that run vertically down the square. The entire square shape is framed by a simple, plain border. The background behind the square appears to be a brightly lit storage area with wooden shelves.

title: Verdite African Tribal Bust Xhosa Woman: Transkei
medium: Brown and green verdite, inlaid with ivory, stichtite, pink feldspar, serpentine, pyrophylite, and honey
alt_text: A sculpture of a person’s head and shoulders is made from several different colors and types of stone. The person has dark brown skin and wears a large, multicolored head covering made of grey, pink, and cream-colored materials. They have a green, shawl-like covering around their shoulders that is tied in the front. A necklace made of purple and light-colored round shapes sits around their neck. The sculpture is set against a plain, dark background.

title: Pocono
alt_text: A painting of a series of colored triangles against a plain white background. The large triangles point downward and alternate in color, featuring shades of red, green, purple, gold, and blue. Between these large shapes are smaller, shorter triangles that point upward. These smaller triangles are also colored, including dark green, orange, brown, and red. The white space fills the rest of the canvas, creating a jagged pattern across the painting.

title: 5316178 (Man Under Water)
alt_text: A painting showing a person with their hands raised. The person is positioned in the center against a darker background. Behind the figure, there is an arched shape that looks like a doorway or an entryway. Above the person's head, the image has horizontal lines that create a textured pattern. The entire piece uses shades of brown and gold, giving it a monochromatic appearance. The edges of the canvas appear frayed and uneven.

title: Echo
alt_text: A painting of abstract patterns covers the central square canvas. The design features a high-contrast mix of dark, forest-green paint splattered against a white background. This pattern of dark and light shapes covers the entire surface of the square piece. The paint appears to have a slightly textured, uneven application. Other framed artworks are partially visible on the left and right sides of this piece.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of an abstract design featuring dark and light shapes. A large, dark, oval shape sits horizontally in the center of a rectangular canvas. Inside this dark oval, there are two smaller, light-colored ovals side-by-side. The background surrounding the large oval is a solid, light beige color. The texture of the paint appears rough and slightly uneven across the entire surface.

title: Matrix 3, Abstractions of Greek Pediment
alt_text: A bronze and copper sculpture shows a long, rough, dark-colored object resting on a polished, shiny copper base. The central, craggy piece runs horizontally across the entire length of the rectangular copper surface. Its surface is irregular and textured, appearing like a piece of hardened lava or weathered stone. Below the sculpture, a white foam tube sits on top of a patterned surface with orange and red colors. In the bottom left corner, part of a different art piece with small round shapes is visible.

title: Stacked Circle No. 4
alt_text: A painting made with wax polymer on wood shows geometric shapes against an off-white background. The central feature is a large, solid black circle that dominates the middle of the panel. Faint, circular lines are etched into the white surface, creating an overlapping pattern around the black center. Horizontal lines also cut across the upper portion of the composition. The edges of the wooden panel appear rough, dark, and unevenly textured.

title: Cross Section
alt_text: A painting of an abstract composition set against a mottled gray and textured background. A large, bulbous white form dominates the center, twisting and looping around itself like a thick, rounded snake or maze. Inside the white shape, there are smaller, smooth areas filled with solid peach and light green colors. At the bottom of the main white form, a thin, dark line connects to a small, colorful, horizontal shape that looks like a stack of bright, rounded pebbles. The overall surface of the painting has a matte appearance with some visible texture in the paint strokes.

title: My Old Man
alt_text: A painting of a scene set outdoors in front of a long, white structure with open areas that look like stables or stalls. A large, leafy green tree stands in the foreground to the left. A man in a white shirt and dark jeans walks away from the viewer toward the center. Another man kneels on the ground, leaning over a person lying on a long, narrow platform. To the right, a man in a white t-shirt stands with his arms crossed while watching the scene. Several white buckets sit on the dry, tan ground near the people.

title: Chapter XIV
alt_text: A painting shows two boxers in a boxing ring. One boxer sits on the floor of the ring, leaning back on one arm. The second boxer stands over him, looking down and wearing dark boxing shorts and gloves. The background of the ring is dark, featuring ropes that create a corner behind the figures. The figures are painted in shades of white, gray, and black against a dark background.

title: Rope
alt_text: A terra cotta sculpture of three figures resting inside a divided black box. Each section contains a reddish-brown, clay-like figure curled in a fetal position. The figures appear to be infants with smooth, rounded bodies and delicate features. Their limbs are tucked close to their chests or faces, and they fill most of the space within their respective compartments. The box is lined with white bubble wrap around the edges, suggesting it is packed for storage or travel.

title: Steintheater (3)
alt_text: A painting on masonite showing an abstract design of swirling colors. The surface is covered in dark, blotchy patterns that look like natural stone or rock formations. Large, uneven shapes in shades of charcoal gray, black, and lighter gray overlap each other across the entire rectangular panel. The piece is supported by a simple wooden frame structure in the background. Thin, pale, vein-like lines cut through some of the darker patches, adding texture and depth.

title: The Inharmonic Cultivation of Delicate Plants
alt_text: A painting of a greenhouse interior shows several people working among many large, leafy green plants. A paved path made of orange-brown bricks runs through the center of the room. On the left, two figures wearing white shirts stand near tall plants with white coverings. Another person in a white coat crouches near a glass doorway in the back, while a person in a white shirt and tan pants stands in the foreground on the right. Large glass windows and a metal frame make up the walls and ceiling of the structure. The scene is brightly lit and filled with dense vegetation.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of oil on steel shows a minimalist geometric design centered on a dark rectangular surface. This design consists of a series of vertical white lines that curve and narrow toward a central vanishing point. The effect creates an illusion of a deep, tunnel-like space drawing the eye inward. The artwork is enclosed within a simple light-colored wooden frame and a wide white mat. The entire piece is mounted against a wall with a textured, horizontal-striped pattern.

title: The Soul Hunter
alt_text: A painting shows two large, rectangular panels placed side by side. The surface of both panels is filled with messy, layered streaks of dark black and off-white paint. These marks create a rough, textured appearance that looks like storm clouds or swirling water. A vertical gap separates the two panels in the center. The painting hangs against a white, metal grid wall in a storage room with a concrete floor.

title: La Terre Dupée
alt_text: A wood sculpture shows an upright form shaped like a shoe or boot. The object stands on a flat base and curves upward into a tall, thick neck. At the top, it extends horizontally into a flattened, toe-like section. The wood has a warm, medium-brown color with visible grain patterns and light texture. Small nicks and wear marks appear on the surface of the object.

title: Still Life with Shaker Box
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes arranged on a table against a dark wall. In the center, a tan circular disk stands upright behind an open, tan cylindrical bowl. To the right of these objects stands a tall, light-colored rectangular prism that is folded at an angle. The entire scene is set on a brown surface that stretches across the bottom of the frame. Soft lighting casts distinct shadows behind the shapes, creating a sense of depth.

title: Fourth Street
alt_text: A painting in acrylic on Masonite showing several white houses along a paved road. On the left side of the scene, a large, two-story white house with a porch stands prominently. A dark paved road travels through the center of the painting, leading toward smaller houses in the distance. Several trees with thick, green leaves create areas of shade on the lawns and the street. The overall color palette of the image includes soft whites, deep greens, and shades of grey.

title: District
alt_text: A painting of an abstract design featuring a series of rectangular shapes and straight lines. The composition is made up entirely of various shades of gray, white, and black. A prominent, tall, white rectangular block sits in the upper center, anchored by several dark lines that create a grid-like pattern around it. The surrounding shapes vary in height and width, creating a stepped, overlapping effect that moves from the center toward the edges. The darkest black bars appear on the far left and right sides of the piece, framing the lighter blocks in the middle. The entire image has a clean, geometric quality with sharp, precise edges.

title: Man Without Heart
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture shows a tall, thin figure viewed from the back. The surface of the piece has a rough, uneven texture that appears dark gray or black. Towards the top, the sculpture reveals gaps that look like lighter-colored vertical wooden bars. The figure stands upright on a square, dark base. The entire object sits on a light brown surface, with a blurred floor visible in the background.

title: Standing Nude with Chair
alt_text: A sculpture of painted plaster on wood shows a person standing next to a chair. The figure is a naked woman from the waist up, presented in a realistic style with a serious expression. Her hair is parted and flows down to her shoulders, and her arms hang down naturally at her sides. To the left of her, a simple, four-legged chair is depicted in relief against the background. The background has a dark, rough texture that contrasts with the smoother appearance of the woman and the chair. Both the figure and the chair are colored in shades of grey and black.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of abstract shapes stands on a dark, square base. The metallic sculpture features smooth, curved forms that twist and reach in different directions. It has a greenish, weathered color across its surface. The sculpture is mounted on a brown, polished stone base that has thin white veins running through it. This small object sits on a plain tan surface.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting shows a person emerging from a background of dark, swirling gray smoke or mist. The figure has a realistic, pale face and is wearing a bright red jacket. The person's right arm extends forward into the foreground, with an open hand reaching out toward the viewer. The rest of the person's body fades away into the dark gray surroundings. The entire scene is set within a simple black frame.

title: Tuna Time
alt_text: A painting of three people standing on a pier overlooking a large body of water. The figures are positioned on the left side, appearing to hold fishing rods or poles extended toward the blue, wavy water. The water is painted with thick, swirling brushstrokes of deep blue, teal, and bright white highlights. Above the water, a solid horizontal band of purple stretches across the top of the scene. The painting is framed in a dark border and is held to a metal grid wall by two white vertical straps.

title: North End Diner
alt_text: A painting of a quiet street scene shows several buildings lining the road. On the left, a tall, light green building with a large front window dominates the corner. A small, white structure with a red awning sits next to it. Further down the street, a blue diner with a red Coca-Cola sign stands in front of a larger, red brick building. A yellow car drives along the right side of the road under a partly cloudy sky. Dark power lines crisscross the open space above the buildings.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of various shapes made from canvas, wood, and paint sits against a neutral background. The work is composed of multiple thin, curved, and triangular pieces that overlap in a cluster. These pieces are painted in bright shades of green, orange, yellow, and soft pink. Some segments are stacked on top of others, creating a layered and three-dimensional effect. Near the bottom center, a small square tag with the letter Y rests on the surface below the sculpture.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting shows a face depicted with light, scratchy lines against a dark, textured background. The face is centered in the lower half of the rectangular canvas. A long, thin, rectangular object protrudes from the top of the head toward the upper right corner. The background is a solid, dark, matte brown color. The overall style appears sketchy and minimal.

title: Storm Warning
alt_text: A painting of a young boy hanging laundry on a clothesline outside. The boy is bare-chested and wears short blue jeans while reaching up to adjust a piece of white clothing on a long wire. Several white items of clothing hang on the line next to him, stretching toward the right side of the frame. The scene is set in a large, green field with rows of plants visible in the distance. Behind the field, the sky is filled with large, dramatic white clouds against a dark blue backdrop. A simple brown wooden frame surrounds the entire painting.

title: Two Horses
alt_text: A painting of two horses in a paddock with a person standing by a fence. In the background, a person wearing a bright orange top stands behind a thin white fence railing, reaching toward the head of a white and brown spotted horse. In the foreground, another white and brown horse grazes with its head pointed toward the ground. Both horses have dark manes and dark patches on their bodies. A simple white fence separates the grassy green area on the left from the dusty orange ground where the horses stand.

title: Beach Tower
alt_text: A painting of a lifeguard stand on a sandy beach. The structure is made of thin, light green lines and has a raised platform. Three figures stand on the platform under colorful triangular flags. To the left and right, smaller figures walk on the sand near the water. Long, dark shadows stretch out from each person and the lifeguard stand across the pale, tan sand.

title: Lunch with Garbo
alt_text: A painting of architectural forms features strong geometric shapes in a mix of orange, brown, and cream colors. On the left side, a diagonal ramp or ladder-like structure has dark, repeating rectangular slats that create a striped pattern. To the right, vertical and horizontal beams intersect to form a grid-like framework. The entire composition is filled with sharp, angled shadows that suggest a bright light source coming from above. The artwork is framed and sits on a surface inside what appears to be a gallery or studio space.

title: Portrait of Richard Baker
alt_text: A painting of a man's head and shoulders shown against a dark, solid background. The man has short, light-colored hair and faces slightly toward the right. He wears a dark collared shirt. His expression is calm and neutral. The painting is set within a simple, light-colored frame.

title: Untitled Head
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a woman’s head and neck is shown from a slightly high angle. The sculpture features realistic, flesh-toned paint with subtle pink blush on the cheeks and subtle shading around the eyes and nose. The figure’s eyes are closed and her head is tilted slightly to one side as if in deep sleep or meditation. Her hair is dark brown and appears slicked back or wet. The sculpture is set against a plain, light-brown background that looks like a storage shelf or table.

title: #11453 Untitled
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a geometric, abstract form made of light green, angular metal plates. The object has a tall, neck-like section that slants upward and ends in a flat, split top. Below the neck, a thicker body section flares out and rests on a base made of several vertical, finger-like metal strips. The sculpture sits on a flat, light brown surface near some crumpled white paper. In the background, part of a metallic object with blue stripes is visible.

title: Caryatid #1
alt_text: A sculpture of a tall, vertical object is shown being held by a hand. The top and bottom sections are made of textured, dark brown wood with a visible horizontal grain. A smooth, curved, darker-colored stoneware connector joins the two wooden pieces together in the middle. The entire object has a rectangular shape with uneven edges. A person's fingers are visible on the right side of the top wooden section, gripping it.

title: Casamatta
alt_text: A painting of a simple, box-like house structure in a black frame. The main building is off-white and has a flat, red triangular roof that sits at an angle. On the front wall of the structure, there is a square cutout window. To the right side of the house, there is a tall, arched green door. A small, light blue triangular section appears behind the roof peak, suggesting the sky.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A wood sculpture appears as a shallow, rectangular box divided into two sections. The larger lower section features a painted gray surface with a swirling, abstract design in black and bright yellow. Inside this swirl, a small yellow oval shape sits against a dark black background. The smaller, upper section of the box contains a light-colored, triangular piece with a pair of flat, wing-like shapes attached to its sides. The entire object rests on a flat, brownish surface next to a piece of bubble wrap.

title: Tastee
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular, multi-layered artwork shows a chaotic mix of patterns, colors, and symbols. The object is framed with decorative, light-colored borders that have repeating shapes like small flowers and geometric marks. In the center, a series of rectangular frames enclose smaller sections filled with drawings and scribbles in bright pinks, greens, and blacks. One area near the bottom features the word "TASTE" painted in large, bold letters. The entire piece has a busy, handcrafted look with varied textures and overlapping designs covering its surface.

title: The Myth of Kate
medium: Polychrome cast bronze sculpture with wood base
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a person standing against a tall, branch-like form. The figure is colored blue and wears a matching blue cap, shirt, and pants. They are holding onto the brown, textured, central trunk with both arms. The central form splits into three thick branches at the top. The entire sculpture rests on a circular, greenish base that sits on a flat, rectangular wood block.

title: A Point Which Widened
alt_text: A painting of graphite on aluminum shows abstract, sweeping lines on a light orange background. A dark, circular shape sits slightly right of center, looking like a dense swirl or a dense spiral. Dark lines arc out from this center point in various directions, resembling wind or motion. A straight, thin horizontal line runs across the lower portion of the image, anchored by faint grid-like lines in the bottom corner. Some illegible, scribbled marks appear in the top left corner, adding to the sketch-like quality of the work.

title: Pair of Stoneheads at 2,683,284 and 2,684,285
alt_text: A sculpture of two rocks painted with faces sits against a plain, off-white background. The smaller rock on the left is rounded and features a painted face with a prominent nose and mouth, as well as a series of handwritten numbers across its top. Beside it, on the right, stands a larger, taller, and more jagged rock that is also decorated with a painted face. Both faces are created with simple, bright white lines that outline eyes, noses, and lips. The contrast between the rough, brown natural texture of the stones and the smooth white paint is very clear.

title: Uxmal
alt_text: A wooden sculpture made with pastel shows a geometric shape that sits on a shelf. This angular object looks like a tilted wedge or a sliced prism. It features flat, colored faces, including a dark blue front panel, a bright green inner face, and a pale, sky-blue side section. The top edge is painted a reddish-pink color, while a section of natural, unpainted wood grain remains visible. The entire structure rests on a flat, tan surface inside a metal storage rack.

title: Sacramento Montego
alt_text: A painting of an older man standing next to a car in a driveway. The man wears a light blue button-down shirt and tan pants, with his hand resting on the trunk of a light blue sedan. The car is parked on a concrete driveway in front of a long, single-story house. To the right of the man, a large, spiky plant grows out of a bed of dirt. Bright sunlight from the left casts sharp shadows of both the car and the man onto the ground.

title: Similar Departure Units
alt_text: A sculpture of a complex, three-dimensional construction sits on a tray in an aisle of metal storage shelves. The artwork has a light, open frame made of many small, interconnected parts, including sticks, flat triangular shapes, and bent forms. These parts are covered in various textures and painted with abstract patterns in colors like red, green, black, and white. The base of the sculpture rests on a small, dark red cylindrical object. In the background, rows of gray industrial shelving stretch back into a dimly lit storage room.

title: Surveillance Drum
alt_text: A painting shows an interior room that looks like a laboratory. In the center, a person stands wearing a blue short-sleeved shirt, a white apron, and a bright red fez hat. This person is looking down at a small object they hold in their hands near a tall, curved, beige wall partition. To the right, there is a low desk with a black top and a brown office chair with wheels. A closed grey door with a rectangular window stands on the left side of the room. A large, dark circular ceiling light hangs near the top left corner of the frame.

title: Animals of La Pace / Baby University
alt_text: A painting of two squirrel-like animals facing each other against a white background. The animal on the left wears a blue hat with the words "LA PACE" written on it. The animal on the right wears a yellow helmet labeled "BABY UNIVERSITY" and has a thin line running across its nose area. Between them, there are several rectangular blocks of color that contain text like "4 1/2 OZ," "SKINLESS," and "BONE." The painting uses thick, textured brushstrokes throughout the entire piece. Both animals hold small, doll-like figures in their arms.

title: The Red Wall - Chicago
medium: Oil on canvas with construction and Plexiglas support mounted to wall
alt_text: A painting of a red brick building facade shows a detailed exterior wall with multiple windows and doors. The brick wall is a consistent reddish-brown color with visible grout lines throughout. A row of large windows spans the upper left, while a smaller door and a window sit on the upper right side. Below, a small door and two single windows are arranged across the bottom half of the wall. Several dark pipes and wires run vertically and horizontally across the brick surface, connecting various electrical boxes and utility points.

title: Face Value
alt_text: A painting of a blue scene features a glowing, rectangular window shape in the center. A large, faint outline of a pair of scissors is layered over the blue background. Near the bottom, a cutout hole shows a tan, sculpted face or mask pinned to the surface with small yellow tabs. A thin line, like a drawn slash, cuts diagonally across the entire scene from the upper left to the lower right. Small, dark, metal-looking circles are fixed in the four corners, making the entire image appear like a blue metal panel.

title: Mr. Gross's Fascination
alt_text: A painting of a crowded, chaotic scene filled with many different objects and faces. On the left, a large, dark-haired man with glasses and a hat stands prominently, surrounded by smaller, circular portraits of himself. A large playing card sits near the center, tilted slightly against a background that looks like a carnival or street fair. Text signs reading "Sex World" and "Fascination" are scattered among the painted figures and bright, colorful shapes. The right side features more people and structures painted in deep reds and dark tones. Thick, textured brushstrokes cover the entire canvas, creating a busy and intense visual display.

title: Pencil
alt_text: A painting of a large, stylized pencil stands vertically against a solid grey background. The pencil is bright yellow in the middle section and has a pointed tip at the top. The tip is colored in shades of light brown and tan, ending with a small, dark grey point. At the bottom of the pencil, a band of tan separates the yellow body from a wider, dark reddish-brown base. A thin, red horizontal line runs across the tan band near the bottom. The entire object has sharp, geometric edges and appears flat.

title: Brownstone
alt_text: A painting of a tall, thin apartment building shows its front facade from the street level. The structure is yellow with multiple floors and symmetrical windows. A prominent, curved green bay window projects out from the second floor above the main entrance. Below, a set of wide stairs leads up to a central door flanked by two smaller windows with plants. The building is topped with a grey, shingled roof featuring two decorative dormer windows.

title: Falmouth Rock
alt_text: A sculpture made of wood, glass, and stone appears inside a boxy display case. The clear glass case sits on a shelf and contains a pale, uneven, rock-like object resting on clear bubble wrap. Behind the case, metal shelves filled with other items are blurred and out of focus. The entire scene is bathed in a warm, yellowish light. The overall composition looks like a storage area for a museum collection.

title: Summer Geraniums
alt_text: A painting of a two-story house with dark grey shingled walls and bright white trim. The house has a mansard roof with two arched windows in the center. A covered front porch with white railings and columns spans the front entrance, which is reached by a short set of stairs. Dense, bushy green shrubs sit on either side of the front path and foundation. A neatly trimmed green lawn stretches from the house toward a paved sidewalk and a dirt street in the foreground. Large, leafy green trees fill the background behind the house.

title: Country Chevrolets
alt_text: A painting of two pickup trucks parked on a dirt path in front of a large, red barn. The truck in the foreground is two-toned red and white with a silver bumper and a license plate on the back. A second, all-red truck is parked further back on the path, partially blocking the view of the barn's wall. Both trucks are facing toward the left side of the frame. The barn has dark red wooden siding and occupies the right half of the background. A clear blue sky with a single small, white cloud appears above the roof of the barn.

title: No title
medium: Poster paint on mud- and cow dung-impregnated burlap
alt_text: A painting on brown fabric shows light-colored drawings scattered across the surface. In the upper left and right areas, several small, stick-like figures move in various directions. Below these figures, a large, rectangular structure with decorative borders sits in the center of the scene. To the left of this central frame stands a tree with thin branches, while another tree on the right side has a small animal sitting beneath it. Another four-legged animal stands near the base of the tree on the right.

title: Chair with Two Canvases '77
alt_text: A painting of a black wooden chair positioned in front of a neutral-colored wall. The chair is centered and seen from the front, casting a dark shadow to its left against the wall. A solid, blank white square overlaps the lower right portion of the chair, obscuring its seat and front leg. The floor beneath the chair is a warm, light brown color. The entire scene is framed by a thick, dark border.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A steel sculpture showing a low, square block with angled sides. The top surface of the block is a flat, dusty red square. The sides of the block are made of smooth, polished steel that reflects the surrounding light. It sits on a flat, brownish-orange surface inside a shallow tray or box. The object looks heavy and sits at a slight angle.

title: Night Fear
alt_text: A sculpture of a wall construction shows a flat, angled wooden panel lying on a large surface. The object is made of several long, thin wooden planks arranged diagonally to form a sloped, roof-like shape. Dark, recessed spaces appear between these wooden slats, creating a striped pattern. The structure rests on a large, plain wooden board inside a room with metal storage shelves in the background. It is angled to one side, showing the depth of the wooden slats and the gaps between them.

title: Sentry
alt_text: A painted wood construction shows a collection of geometric shapes arranged on a flat rectangular base. Two tall, rectangular blocks stand on either side, framing a smaller, cylindrical piece that looks like a simplified totem. A curved, arch-like piece of wood rests horizontally across the tops of the two tall blocks. A smaller, rectangular block lies horizontally on the right side of the base, while a small, semi-circular piece sits on the left. The entire structure is decorated with bright, repetitive stripes of orange, blue, and white paint.

title: Elevators
alt_text: A mixed media construction shows a view of an interior space inside a light-colored wooden frame. The frame surrounds a dark, blurry scene that looks like a room with several rectangular structures. These structures have thin white borders and resemble doorways or screens with light green panels inside them. A checkerboard floor pattern is visible at the bottom of the scene, though it is slightly out of focus. The entire composition appears to be captured through a reflective surface or glass that distorts the image slightly.

title: Bh/Rh
alt_text: A painting shows an abstract pattern of thin, white geometric lines set against blocks of color. The background is divided into sections of purple, green, and blue. Overlaid on this colored background is a complex grid of connected white shapes, mostly rectangles and trapezoids. Scattered across this white grid are several small, outlined rectangles in shades of orange, light green, and pink. The entire composition has a flat appearance and is framed by a reddish-brown border.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting featuring a vibrant, orange three-dimensional shape on a grey background. This object resembles a large, tilted cube or prism. It dominates the center of the canvas, resting against a dark grey circle. The orange shape shows distinct planes that create an illusion of depth, with its bottom point reaching near the base of the circle. The background is a plain, light brown color that forms a square frame around the circle.

title: Draft with Orange Doors
alt_text: A painting of a white horse standing in profile against a bright orange wall. The horse is muscular and wears a dark halter with straps visible across its face. Its long, pale tail hangs down toward the dark, paved ground. Two metal doors with orange paint serve as the background, featuring black door handles and small rectangular lights near the top. Thin, dark lines, possibly wires, stretch across the upper portion of the painting. The horse casts a distinct, dark shadow onto the orange doors behind it.

title: In the Middle
alt_text: A painting of ink on laminate shows a mostly blank, white surface. The top portion of the board features a series of thin, dark, horizontal lines spaced evenly apart. Below these lines, a single, thin, hand-drawn line meanders across the center. This line forms an irregular, wavy shape that curves upward and then dips downward toward the left side. The rest of the surface below this drawn line is empty and plain. Reflection from overhead lights creates several bright, blurry spots on the smooth surface.

title: The Three Ages of Man #8
alt_text: A painting of a park scene next to a lake or river. In the foreground, a person with short brown hair sits on the green grass playing a guitar. Nearby, two small children kneel on the ground, leaning toward each other as if playing a game. To the right, a person in a white shirt and straw hat stands in a small wooden rowboat, holding an oar. The background features a large body of water with a wooded shoreline filled with green trees.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a plaster fragment with a faded, patterned surface. The piece is roughly rectangular with jagged, broken edges and sits on a brown surface. A repeating design of white, curved lines dominates the composition. These lines form circles and floral-like shapes against a background of dull red and faint yellow colors. The surface of the plaster looks uneven and worn, suggesting it is a broken piece of a larger work.

title: Lock
alt_text: A painting of three horizontal color bands stacked vertically. The top band is a thin strip of dark brown. Below it is a wider band of a lighter, pink-toned red. The bottom half of the image is a darker, reddish-orange color. A single, thin vertical line divides the bottom reddish-orange section into two equal squares.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of an olive-green rectangular canvas is marked by many thin, horizontal lines. These lines run across the entire width of the painting. Tiny white dots or marks are evenly spaced along these thin horizontal lines. The background color of the canvas is a solid, flat shade of olive green.
