This object is mounted on a white, grid-like storage rack.

title: Winged Lozenge
alt_text: A painting featuring a bold geometric design in brown and cream colors. A large, diamond-like shape is formed by two brown triangles pointing toward the center of the canvas. The background is a flat, creamy white color that also cuts into the brown shapes with angled lines. These shapes create a sense of depth and broken symmetry across the square canvas. The painting hangs against a white metal grid storage rack, suggesting it is inside a museum or gallery collection.

title: Wannsee
alt_text: A painting of a dark, moody landscape is displayed on a wooden easel. The artwork features a hazy, grey sky covering the upper two-thirds of the canvas. A dark, rough ground or water surface occupies the bottom third, painted in shades of brown and charcoal. A thin, vertical mark stands in the center of the horizon line, resembling a distant tower or pole. The painting is framed simply and sits on a light-colored wooden rack that is part of a storage area. Several small white slips of paper lie on the floor surface near the bottom of the rack.

title: Bridge #3
alt_text: An aluminum sculpture showing a group of tall, thin, upright metal panels. The sculpture stands on a flat, rectangular base that spans the entire width of the piece. Four main vertical slabs rise from this base, with thin, uneven gaps between them. Each slab has a rough, pitted surface with a dull gray color. A small, square, tan-colored label with a "C" on it sits on the base in the lower right corner.

title: Drug Addict
medium: Fiberglass and polyester resin, oil paint, and mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture showing a person sitting on the floor against a brick wall. The figure is a man with shoulder-length dark hair and closed eyes, wearing a light-colored button-down shirt over a white undershirt. He wears reddish-purple trousers and light tan shoes that look worn or dirty. His hands rest on his lap, and small, thin objects are scattered on the floor near his legs. The background features a rough, reddish-brown brick wall that meets a plain, light-grey concrete floor.

title: Appleton Ridge Road
alt_text: A painting of a landscape features a narrow dirt road winding up a grassy hill. The road begins in the foreground and leads the eye toward the rounded crest of the hill in the distance. Lush green forests and patches of golden-brown fields cover the rolling slopes on either side of the path. A large, dark green tree stands prominently in the center of the middle ground. The sky above is a bright, clear blue filled with many scattered, white, fluffy clouds.

title: Black–Grey–White
alt_text: A painting of three identical vertical rectangular shapes arranged side by side. The background of the entire piece is a textured, mottled blue-gray color. Each of the three shapes features a light cream-colored block in its upper half, framed by a narrow brown border. Below this cream section, there is a horizontal dark brown line that separates it from the bottom portion. The bottom section of each shape shows vertical stripes in shades of brown and gray.

title: Five Pointed Star
alt_text: A sculpture made of painted wood and Plexiglas shows a layered, shadowbox-style scene. Several translucent panels are stacked to create depth behind a white rectangular frame. Abstract, organic shapes in shades of pink, yellow, teal, and blue float between the clear layers. A small, animal-like figure stands on the bottom ledge near a collection of colorful, cloud-like forms. The arrangement creates a sense of space and movement as if looking into a deep, colorful aquarium.

title: Untitled (Q 3-73-#2)
alt_text: A painting showing a rectangular field filled with a pattern of soft, vertical brushstrokes in shades of pink, mauve, and hints of yellow. Overlaid on this textured surface are thin, white diagonal lines that create sharp geometric shapes like trapezoids and parallelograms. These white lines cut across the entire composition, dividing the painted field into several distinct angular sections. The color appears slightly more purple in the center of the canvas and lighter towards the edges. The overall effect creates a sense of depth as if the geometric shapes are floating on top of the textured background.

title: Widgee Goara
alt_text: A painting of a quiet, misty landscape with large gray boulders scattered across the scene. A small, shallow pool of blue-tinted water sits in the bottom left, reflecting the cloudy sky above. Bare tree trunks and thin branches poke up through the landscape, adding to the desolate atmosphere. The rocks appear mossy and aged, resting on a forest floor covered in soft, muted earth tones. The entire scene is wrapped in a thick, gray fog that obscures the background trees.

title: Scaup Hen in Basket
alt_text: A painting in oil on panel shows a blurry scene bathed in warm, glowing orange light. A dark, indistinct shape that resembles a bird or creature is perched near the center of the frame. Below it sits a light-colored, horizontal form that looks like a ledge or a book. The entire composition has a soft, smeared quality where the edges are not sharp. The whole image is surrounded by a thick, orange-toned wooden frame.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of three rectangular panels arranged side-by-side with geometric shapes and soft colors. The left panel features a tall yellow rectangle next to a green shape that creates an L-like corner, with a pale grey area below it. The center panel is a single, solid, light mint-green rectangle that takes up the entire space. The right panel is divided into vertical stripes of varying widths in muted tones of blue, yellow, beige, and olive green. These shapes form a balanced, abstract pattern across all three sections.

title: Resting Nude
alt_text: A painting showing a person reclining on their side. The figure's upper torso and arm are visible near the top left, resting on a mass of draped, light-colored fabric. A large, dark, and mostly smooth shape dominates the lower half of the image, appearing to be the lower body covered by the cloth. The painting uses muted, golden-brown tones throughout the entire scene. A small, indistinct signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the canvas. The entire work is enclosed in a thin, simple metal frame.

title: December Boardwalk
alt_text: A painting of a stylized bridge scene is shown in a silver frame. The image is colored in shades of peach and light orange. On the left, there is a large, flat, rectangular shape representing a building or structure. To the right, a bridge structure sits on a solid, horizontal base with thin, vertical supports underneath it. The background and foreground are filled with broad, flat, light-colored areas that lack detail.

title: Chicken Wire Box #4
alt_text: A sculpture of chicken wire shaped into an open box, painted with small, colorful flecks. The box sits against a plain, light grey background with its lid tilted upward. The wire mesh creates a see-through, grid-like appearance that forms the walls and bottom of the container. Patches of bright paint in red, blue, and yellow speckle the wire surface in varying amounts. The structure casts a soft, faint shadow on the surface below it.

title: Fidelity Mutual Life Insurance Company
alt_text: A painting of a large, stone public building located on a street corner under a clear blue sky. The structure features a prominent central archway with large, grid-patterned windows and a wide, recessed entrance with steps leading up. Tall, narrow windows line the symmetrical wings of the building on both sides of the central arch. Bare, leafless trees stand in front of the building's left side near the sidewalk. A paved street curves around the front of the building, and a few small, light-colored cars are parked near the right edge.

title: Doublement
alt_text: A chrome sculpture of several long, straight bars that intersect at their center points. The bars are made of a shiny, silver-colored metal that reflects the light. Together, these intersecting pieces form a three-dimensional, star-like shape. The object rests on top of a dark gray fabric that features a repeating zig-zag stitch pattern. A dark shadow cast by the metal structure stretches across the surface of the fabric.

title: Shore Series 6
alt_text: A painting in oil and tempera showing a monochromatic, amber-toned landscape. The scene features abstract, cloud-like textures that fill the upper portion of the frame in shades of light yellow and deep brown. In the lower right corner, there is a distinct, darker rectangular area that appears more defined than the rest of the image. This inset section contains shapes that look like clustered figures or dense foliage. The overall surface looks uneven and heavily textured with layered paint strokes.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting on fiberglass-surfaced canvas shows a landscape of rich, earthy colors. A vertical band of dark, deep brown occupies the far left side of the rectangular frame. The remainder of the composition features a wide, textured field that shifts gradually in tone. This larger area fades from a warm, light golden-orange on the left toward a darker, burnt-orange shade on the right. Throughout the surface, a subtle and grainy texture creates a sense of depth across the flat color.

title: Study for Most Beautiful Foot
alt_text: A painting of a human foot resting on a leopard-print fabric. The foot is light-skinned with bright red nail polish on the toes. Behind the foot, a round, orange fruit sits near a white shape and a block of blue color. Above these, there is a blurry yellow and orange floral shape against a red background. The entire scene is set against a background of solid blocks of blue and light blue.

title: Study: Falling Man Series
alt_text: A sculpture of black Formica and Plexiglas shows several figures inside a lighted box. The box has a thick, dark outer frame. Inside, three small, dark human silhouettes stand or float on a horizontal surface. The largest figure on the left stands upright, while the figures to the right become smaller and more horizontal. The background appears bright and translucent, contrasting with the dark figures.

title: Bay of Pigs
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes in various colors fills the canvas. The scene is dominated by a collection of white, jagged forms that look like fractured geometric structures. In the background, sections of dark grey, blue, and black provide deep contrast to the brighter white elements. Streaks of red and orange appear sporadically among the darker shapes, adding small bursts of color. A signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the painting. The entire work is framed by a thin, light-colored border.

A steel sculpture sits on a square base with a short, vertical metal post. Resting on top of this post is a long, curved piece of flat steel that arches up and over. A dark, rectangular plate with jagged edges stands vertically in the center. A straight, dark metal rod pierces horizontally through this curved plate and extends out on both sides. The entire piece has a rough, rusty, brown texture.

title: Rusted Word Relief
alt_text: A sculpture made of welded steel nails shows the words "RUSTED WORD RELIEF" arranged in three horizontal rows. Each letter is formed by connecting several long, brown, rusty nails together. The text is laid out on a sheet of crumpled white paper inside a container. The metal of the nails looks uneven and has dark spots where the pieces have been joined. The entire assembly sits flat against the white background.

title: Ecstatic Torso
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract arrangement of thick, colorful shapes. The surface is textured with visible paint strokes in shades of bright red, orange, yellow, blue, and green. A large, distinct patch of light blue sits near the center of the image. Surrounding this central blue area are clusters of warm reds and oranges that fill most of the space. Smaller spots of green and dark blue are scattered throughout the background. The entire composition lacks clear edges or specific figures.

medium: Acrylic resins in on sheet metal
alt_text: A painting showing three figures arranged against a brick wall. On the left stands a pale, shirtless person with a bandaged arm and dark trousers. In the center is a pale person wearing a red cap and blue jeans, standing against the brown brick wall. To their right, another figure wearing a white jacket holds the center person's arm. The lighting creates a high-contrast look, making the figures appear slightly ghostly against the dark background.

A painting of a figure perched on a brick structure with several heads resting at the base. The figure sits at the top, facing forward with a hand resting near its chin. Beneath the figure, a cluster of at least three distinct heads appear to be huddled or lying together against the base of the brick pedestal. On both the left and right sides of the scene, thin, bare branches reach upward against a dark, murky background. The entire image has a muted, yellowish-brown tone.

title: Vol. 148 No.310
alt_text: A painting of a group of people standing amidst simple, box-like structures under a dark sky with mountains in the background. In the foreground, several individuals are crowded together with various expressions, including one person covering their mouth with their hand and another wearing a head covering. To the left, a man is partially inside one of the structures, and his arm appears to be tied with a rope. The figures have varied skin tones and are depicted in a stylized manner. The scene is lit in a way that casts deep shadows, emphasizing the dramatic poses of the people.

title: Half a Glass of Water
alt_text: A painting of a glass of water and a small razor blade sitting on a dark surface. The clear glass holds a small amount of liquid and rests in the center of the dark, flat table. To the right of the glass, a thin, silver-colored razor blade lies flat on the surface. A dim reflection of the glass appears on the table just below it. The entire scene is enclosed within a wide, simple black frame.

title: Oh Well
alt_text: A painting shows a flat, dark square panel centered within a larger, dark square frame. The central panel is a smooth, solid dark gray color. The surrounding border is a similar dark gray but has a rough, textured look with many fine, light-colored scratch marks running across it in different directions. A soft light reflects off the upper middle section of the center square. The entire piece has a matte appearance.

title: Stately Victorian
alt_text: A painting of a multi-story house with a round tower on the left and white, decorative wooden trim throughout. The house is painted in shades of pink with a green roof, and it sits centered in the frame. A wide, covered porch spans the front of the house at the ground level, featuring many arch-shaped openings. A path leads from the bottom center to the front entrance, surrounded by circular beds of small, colorful flowers. Green bushes and flowering shrubs are placed along both sides of the yard.

title: Zimbabwe Trio
alt_text: A stone sculpture of three figures stands against a plain background. The sculpture is made of polished, dark green stone with a mottled, grey-black pattern. Two taller figures curve around each other, their heads bent inward, forming an oval shape. A much smaller figure sits at the bottom, nestled between them. The entire piece rests on a simple, rounded base.

title: O.M. Fish Heads
alt_text: A painting of two fish heads resting on a small, dark dish. The dish sits in the center of the frame against a muted, beige background. The fish heads are brown and textured, appearing upright within the bowl. Light seems to highlight the curved shapes of the fish and the round edge of the dish. The background is simple and smooth with light brushstrokes.

title: Waterglass
alt_text: A painting of a glass of water sitting on a light-colored surface. The clear glass is centered in the frame and is partially filled with liquid. Several dark, small insects are scattered around the base of the glass on the surface. The background behind the glass is a solid, dark, flat color. The overall color palette of the painting is muted, consisting mostly of browns and off-whites.

title: Antipodian Spring
medium: Oil on canvas with carved wood
alt_text: A painting on canvas features a colorful, abstract composition adorned with attached wooden shapes. Two yellow wooden pillars flank the left and right sides of the image. The center of the work is filled with patches of orange, green, blue, and yellow paint, layered with black circles and long, pale blue rectangles. In the lower section, a textured, light-colored wooden piece resembling a rough fence sits beside a curved, dark archway. To the right, a painted green leaf shape with a small, hollow center projects from the edge of the frame. A thin, dark, swirled metal-like shape rests near the bottom left corner.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of aluminum and Plexiglas is square in shape. It features five horizontal black stripes that run across the entire width of the piece. These black bands divide the silver surface into four identical rectangular sections. The material has a metallic, brushed texture that catches light evenly. A thin shadow falls below the bottom edge of the sculpture against the plain background.

title: Animal Bliss
alt_text: A painting of abstract marks and stains on a pale, square canvas. Dark, thin pencil lines form tangled, vine-like shapes that spread across the surface. Several large, vertical splotches of bright yellow acrylic paint stand out against the light background. Some of these yellow shapes have thin, elongated darker centers. Faint blue pencil markings, resembling small flower clusters or starbursts, are scattered among the darker lines. The painting hangs against a white, metal grid wall.

title: Blue Presence #1
alt_text: A painting of oil on canvas shows a dense field of small, textured specks. The colors are mostly shades of blue and gray, with hints of white and dark violet scattered throughout. The composition is uniform, appearing like a heavy, mottled surface with no clear subject or pattern. Clusters of brighter, lighter specks appear in some areas, creating a subtle, shimmering effect against the darker background. The texture of the paint looks thick and rugged, as if it was applied in many small dabs.

title: True
alt_text: A painting of colorful, abstract shapes and mechanical forms arranged against a pale background. In the upper center, a circular object resembles a compass with a dark center. Below that, a large, dark, metallic object shaped like a funnel dominates the lower left, with several visible rivets and a grid pattern at the bottom. Surrounding these main elements are curling lines, rings, and smaller red and teal shapes that float in the space. Gold-colored lines frame parts of the composition, adding to the feeling of a technical drawing. The overall design looks like a complex machine made of geometric parts.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting made of mixed media on canvas shows a collage of old, yellowed newspaper clippings. The paper pieces are glued together to cover the entire rectangular surface. Faint, curved, and abstract shapes are drawn or painted on top of the text, creating a layered, textured effect. These shapes look like soft, flowing curves or shadows that move across the surface of the paper. The overall tone is a monochromatic, aged beige color that makes the text blend into the background.

title: Redundant Quality Control
alt_text: A painting of a man in a dark suit standing in front of a large, circular metal door. The man wears headphones, holds a notepad and pen, and looks toward his right. Behind a glass partition on the right, two workers in hard hats and blue shirts are unrolling white tape on a dark floor. The room is decorated in shades of brown, gray, and beige. In the foreground, the tops of two wooden chairs are partially visible.

title: Tiffany Street, East 169th Street/Bronx
alt_text: A painting of a city corner with a tall, narrow apartment building in the center. The building is light gray with rows of dark, rectangular windows and stands next to a large empty lot covered in dried, brown grass. A paved road curves through the foreground, leading past the lot and several streetlights. A dark station wagon is parked on the edge of the empty space near the street. The entire scene is washed in a warm, yellowish-brown light, creating a quiet and desolate feeling.

title: Souvenir de Toscane
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and colors divided into two vertical panels. The left panel features a narrow blue strip on the far edge with faint, repetitive markings. Next to this is a large, textured silver-white shape against a deep blue background. A wide, orange vertical wedge dominates the center of the painting, spanning both panels. The right panel also includes irregular patches of red, dark green, and yellow-green that create an uneven pattern. Thin, light-colored lines separate many of these sections from one another.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a light yellow square with small colored squares arranged in a grid. The squares are colored in bright shades of pink, green, blue, and black. The painting is propped up against a wooden frame. A dark brown carpet covers the floor beneath the painting.

title: Frederick
alt_text: A painting of a face created with thick, colorful brushstrokes on linen. The face fills the entire frame and is painted in bright, clashing colors like lime green, yellow, deep red, and dark blue. One eye is brown, while the other eye is a piercing blue. Thick black lines define the eyebrows, nose, and mouth, giving the features a heavy look. The background is a dark, warm red that sits close behind the head. The visible texture of the canvas adds depth to the layered colors of the skin.

title: Gowanus Canal From 3rd St. Bridge
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a quiet body of water in the foreground. A large, rectangular brick building with many windows sits on the right bank, surrounded by dark trees. On the left side, a smaller white building with a dark water tower on its roof stands near the water's edge. The sky above is filled with soft, gray clouds. The entire scene is reflected in the calm, smooth surface of the water, which stretches across the middle of the frame.

title: Urivya
alt_text: A slate and bluestone sculpture shows a human figure sitting in a reclining position. The body is formed from many horizontal, stacked layers of stone that give it a ribbed or ridged appearance. The figure leans back on one arm with its knees bent upward. It rests on a flat, rectangular base made of the same gray stone. Small white letters are faintly visible on the surface of the base near the figure's feet.

title: Self Portrait as a Guinea Pig
alt_text: A painting of a stylized, abstract face. The face is a central, greenish-yellow figure with deep-set, dark eyes and a pointed chin. A large, dark, curved shape sits atop the head like a hat or helmet, colored with shades of blue, red, and purple. Two orange, pipe-like lines curve around the face, connecting the top headpiece to the neck area with small blue circular attachments. The background is a textured, light-colored wash of swirling pink and white strokes. The overall style is expressive with thick, visible brushstrokes and dark outlines.

title: Long Island
alt_text: A painting of a quiet waterfront scene with a light-colored building in the background. A dark, rectangular structure with several windows sits near the center, surrounded by trees. In the foreground, a small, dark boat floats on the water next to a long dock. Dark, textured bushes fill the bottom left corner of the frame. The entire scene is set within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Femme Assise
alt_text: A painting shows abstract shapes on a solid blue background. On the left, a tall, thin, bright orange form stretches vertically across the canvas. To the right of the orange shape, a large, translucent blue mass sits perched atop a solid, jagged black base. The blue mass is rounded and looks somewhat like a tilted oval or a cloud. Dark speckles appear scattered between the orange form and the black base, creating a grainy texture in that area.

title: Parry
alt_text: A painting of a maze-like grid filled with colored blocks. Thick, black lines run horizontally and vertically across the entire canvas, creating a network of rectangular and L-shaped spaces. These spaces are filled with different soft colors, including pale blue, light yellow, light pink, and cream. The blue shapes are mostly clustered on the right side of the painting. The yellow and pink shapes are scattered throughout the rest of the grid. The pattern appears organized and rigid, covering the surface from edge to edge.

title: Distant Storm
alt_text: A painting of a landscape under a warm, glowing sky. The scene is divided into a dark, silhouetted foreground and a bright, orange-tinted sky above. The bottom half of the canvas shows a field and distant, rolling hills in deep brown and black tones. Above the horizon line, the sky transitions from a light orange to a pale peach color. A single, large, fluffy cloud dominates the upper right portion of the sky, glowing with bright yellow light. The artwork is mounted on a wooden easel frame, which is visible on the sides and bottom.

title: Untitled
medium: Acrylic on paper, mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a shirtless person with dark hair shown from the chest up. The figure faces slightly to the left, looking toward the viewer with a neutral expression. The skin of the figure appears smooth and has soft shading in shades of gray. The background is a flat, solid dark gray color that is darker than the figure. The lighting highlights the upper chest and the side of the face.

title: Corner of the Eye
alt_text: A polychrome steel sculpture shows a complex arrangement of colorful, abstract metal shapes standing on a cylindrical base. At the bottom, a horizontal blue cylinder with a black circle on its end supports a flat, round plate covered in bright, textured paint. Rising from the plate is a framework of thin metal bars and geometric forms, including a prominent eye-shaped outline. Various pieces, such as a tall diamond-shaped finial, a small black cylinder, and a sphere, are attached to the upper structure. The entire object features a mix of vibrant colors like yellow, red, green, and blue, with swirling or patchy painted textures throughout.

title: Still Life #II
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an incised geometric design on a rectangular metal slab. The surface is dark grey and has a matte finish. Several intersecting lines are carved into the metal, creating flat shapes like triangles and quadrilaterals. These shapes sit within a larger, lightly outlined rectangle that tilts toward the upper right corner. A smaller, distinct polygonal shape sits near the top of the composition.

title: Ranger
alt_text: A sculpture made of enamel on wood shows a tall, thin tower structure with a small, enclosed room at the top. The base of the tower is a four-sided, pyramid-like frame with crisscrossing struts in shades of blue, orange, and red. A thin ladder runs straight up the middle of this base to the room above. The enclosed room at the top has a peaked roof and horizontal bars forming walls that reveal an open space inside. The entire structure stands upright against a plain, light grey background.

title: Marion
medium: Oil and metallic pigment on canvas
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric patterns layered over a dark background. Broad, flat bands of bright mint green intersect and overlap to form arching shapes and angular lines. These green shapes stand out against a textured black and deep forest green surface that fills the negative space. The lines create an intricate, maze-like design across the entire square canvas. The thick paint gives the surface a rough and tactile appearance.

title: E.E.
alt_text: A painting of an acrylic-on-canvas cloth sits folded inside a rectangular cardboard box. The canvas features a repeating pattern of thick, diagonal stripes in bright pink, red, and green. A solid, plain turquoise fabric is draped over and around the striped canvas. The entire collection of fabric rests on a bed of crinkled, white tissue paper that lines the box. Several pieces of blue painter's tape attach the tissue paper to the edges of the box.

title: An Obvious Infraction
alt_text: A painting of three people standing or kneeling on a paved patio beside a dark pool. On the left, a man in a light-colored shirt and trousers walks away from the viewer toward a large, dark green bush. In the center, a woman in a blue dress stands and looks toward the right side of the scene. Beside her, an older man wearing a light shirt and dark pants kneels at the edge of the pool, leaning forward as if to look into the water. Next to him on the ground are two brown bags or cases. The entire scene is washed in a warm, orange-yellow light that covers the pavement, the wall behind the bush, and the sky.

title: Black and Blue
alt_text: A sculpture made of wood and metal depicts a geometric, mask-like shape with two tall, branch-like protrusions extending from the top. The entire surface is dark black and decorated with bright, light blue wavy lines that flow in vertical patterns. Two small, round, pinkish objects that resemble eyes are set into the upper part of the central triangular face. The overall shape of the piece is angular and tapers to a point at the bottom, suggesting a stylized animal head or face. The sculpture is displayed against a plain, light brown background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A polychrome and painted wood sculpture rests on a wooden pallet inside a storage area. The sculpture is made of many angular, brightly colored pieces of wood fitted together. These pieces are painted in shades of dark blue, bright red, orange, green, and purple. One small, separate wooden section on the left side is painted with yellow and tan tones. The entire object sits in front of a grey metal shelving unit with cardboard boxes nearby.

title: Untitled No. 37
alt_text: A painting of a dark, round container sitting on a light-colored surface. The container is wide and bowl-shaped with a narrow neck and a small opening at the top. Several faint, vertical lines extend from the neck down the sides of the object. A dark shadow stretches out from the right side of the container onto the surface behind it. The entire painting is enclosed in a simple, dark square frame.

title: Dangerous, But Home
alt_text: A painting shows a white house enclosed inside a dark, circular fence. The house has three levels of windows and a dark roof. Behind the house, there are dark, jagged mountains under a grey sky. A small, white crescent moon shines in the upper right corner of the sky. Dark, loose brushstrokes scatter across the ground outside the fence.

title: African Winged Figure With Head on Knee
alt_text: A hand-painted bronze sculpture of a winged figure crouching over a creature. The winged figure has a human-like head with curly hair and large, spread wings that extend out to the sides. Its body is muscular, and it is positioned low, with one knee bent and its hands reaching forward as if grasping or poised to spring. Beneath the figure is a second shape, which appears to be a smaller, animal-like creature with claws. The sculpture has a rough, textured surface with dark gray tones highlighted by white paint.

title: Mystic Forks
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows two distinct objects resting on a piece of white, crinkled paper. On the left lies a long, dark metal piece with a curved shape and a small circular center. To the right of the first object is a smooth, dark cylinder that appears to be hollow inside. Behind this cylinder, a pair of white, fabric gloves sits folded on the paper surface. The background consists of the white crinkled paper that covers the entire frame.

title: Tex
medium: Lacquered steel sculpture on wood base
alt_text: A steel sculpture shows two tall, pointed, dark brown metal panels standing upright on a wooden base. The panels lean toward each other, meeting at the top and leaving a thin, vertical gap between them. The metal looks textured, like rusted or aged iron, with lighter gray, metallic edges. A smaller, triangular piece of metal sits at the very top, bridging the gap between the two main panels. The entire sculpture rests on a rectangular block of light-colored wood, which sits on a brown surface.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of painted stoneware and mahogany shows a long, cylindrical brown object positioned vertically on the right side. This object has a smooth, rounded, brown head on top and a textured, ribbed lower portion. To the left of this main object, a long, thin, curved piece of brown wood extends horizontally. The background consists of a beige surface decorated with several white rectangular blocks held in place by bright red tape. Two short pieces of white ribbon or string hang loosely from the tape in the middle of the frame.

title: Cyrus
alt_text: A steel sculpture showing two curved, flat pieces of metal connected at the center. The sculpture has a long, pointed, vertical blade that rises from the middle of a horizontal, slightly arched base. The base has two curved arms that extend outward, creating a shape that looks somewhat like an anchor or a stylized letter Y. The metal has a dark, slightly textured appearance. In the background, there are cardboard shipping boxes and some white foam packing pieces on a storage floor.

title: Naked City
alt_text: A painting showing a large sofa with a tall building and a knife resting on top of it. The sofa is pink with dark red stripes and sits centered in the room. Behind the sofa is a dark silhouette of a city skyline at night. Bright turquoise curtains frame the scene on the left and right sides. A small figure of a woman lies on the floor in front of the sofa, surrounded by several cigarette butts.

title: Untitled #31
alt_text: A painting of a large, light-colored Victorian house standing against a pale blue sky. The house has multiple stories, tall arched windows, and a prominent tower on the right side with a dark, peaked roof. Decorative white trim lines the roof edges and the porch below. A low white fence runs along the bottom, covered by thick bushes filled with small pink flowers. The entire structure is painted with clean lines and detailed architectural features.

title: Infinity Collage
alt_text: A painting of an intricate geometric design features a large, off-white circle filled with a fine grid of thin, intersecting lines. This large circle contains several curving, fan-like shapes that appear to be layered on top of the grid. Below this large circle sits a much smaller, separate circle filled with irregular, overlapping brown and gold shapes. The entire composition is set against a plain, light background. The overall look is precise, mathematical, and abstract.

title: Eight and Three
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media stands on a large, shallow, rectangular tray in a storage room. The artwork consists of a tall, open wire cage frame that sits directly on the light brown surface of the tray. Various small, irregular objects are suspended inside this wire structure, including white paper tags and bits of plastic or stone. A large, white number eight is attached to the central part of the wire frame. The sculpture is surrounded by tall, metal industrial shelving units filled with other stored items, stretching back into a long, dimly lit aisle.

title: Women in the Woods #2
alt_text: A painting of stylized, block-like figures set within a hilly landscape filled with thin, bare trees. Three simplified human figures in mauve are kneeling on rounded, layered hills of purple and tan. Dark, leafless tree trunks rise vertically from the hills, framing the scene. Scattered near the bases of the hills and trees are small, triangular blue shapes and circular yellow accents. The entire image uses flat colors and bold, simple lines to create a patterned design.

title: Cab (Westford Series)
alt_text: A painting of a large, rusted metal machine sitting in a dry field. The machine is bulky and shaped somewhat like a rectangular box with curved edges, covered in patches of bright rust orange and faded blue paint. Beneath the main body, exposed mechanical parts like gears and pipes are visible. To the right and behind the machine, several large, hollow metal pipes lie on the ground. The background shows a hazy, gray landscape with thin, bare trees. The entire scene is framed by thin wooden strips on the top, bottom, and sides.

A painting of a tall, two-story house features white siding and ornate details. The house has a wide front porch with intricate decorative trim along the roofline. A small balcony on the second floor holds a box full of colorful flowers. Below the house, a short white brick fence runs across the bottom of the frame, punctuated by a matching gate in the center. Thick green bushes are planted behind and in front of the fence, partially obscuring the bottom level.

title: Two Figures with Black Speakers
alt_text: A painting shows two men sitting in chairs, facing a large, dark rectangular screen. The men are seen from behind, both wearing collared shirts and caps. They sit in red-cushioned chairs at a light-colored, angular counter. A long, black panel stands on a base in front of them, with gold-colored curtains visible behind it. Thin black wires connect the panel to the floor area near the chairs.

title: Untitled #3
alt_text: A painting showing a collection of objects against a large, plain white background. At the center sits a rectangular green paper bag with red and white text on it. Resting partially on top of the green bag are three overlapping, rectangular, pinkish-orange strips of material. Below these objects, a long, white, tube-shaped form stretches diagonally across the lower portion of the image. The entire arrangement is contained within a simple, thin metal frame.

title: Denouements XXV
medium: Charcoal, pencil and acrylic on raw canvas
alt_text: A painting of a large, tangled knot of thick rope centered on a dark reddish-brown background. The rope appears light beige or off-white and has strong, dark outlines that emphasize its twist and texture. The knot fills almost the entire space of the canvas, looping around itself in several layers. The background behind the knot is a flat, solid dark red color. The painting hangs in front of a white metal grid storage rack.

title: Spin Art
medium: Acrylic, thread, canvas belting, and canvas
alt_text: A canvas sculpture showing a rectangular, flat fabric piece with an x-shaped strap resting on top. The base is made of vertical strips in shades of brown, white, and muted green. Two long, pale green strips of canvas belting are crossed in the center to form an "X" shape over the surface. Small, bright yellow and purple fabric squares are stitched onto the corners and edges of the rectangle. The entire object lies flat on a table, with visible stitching holding the different fabric pieces together.

title: Untitled
medium: Poster paint on mud- and cow dung-impregnated burlap
alt_text: A painting on a dark, textured brown background shows white, stylized figures and patterns. On the left and right sides, two tall, symmetrical trees with spiky leaves stand vertically. In the bottom center, a square frame with decorative geometric borders surrounds a person riding a horse. Above this frame, several human figures are shown in various positions, including one appearing to hold a tool and another appearing to guide two smaller, four-legged animals. The entire scene is created using thin, white line-work that creates a bold contrast against the dark, earthy surface.

title: Kinky
medium: Paint on paper mounted on balsa wood
alt_text: A sculpture of paper mounted on balsa wood features several sharp, zig-zagging black bands layered over a pale gray background. These dark shapes are accented with small, curved segments of pale green and reddish circular lines. Thin, light-colored wooden strips lie flat against the surface in the center and upper-right areas. White tape holds some of the wooden pieces in place on the paper. Handwritten notes and small marks are scattered in the lower-right corner and near the angled black forms.

title: Smiler
alt_text: A painting of a still life scene set against a muted blue-grey wall. A small, wooden table stands in the center, supporting a bouquet of bright orange flowers in a patterned vase. Behind the table, a large, rectangular blackboard takes up much of the center wall. In the upper left corner, a dark electric fan is mounted high on the wall. A folded piece of red and white fabric rests on the floor in the foreground, stretching across the bottom of the frame.

title: Louisiana Superdome - Times Square
alt_text: A painting of a city street at night featuring large illuminated advertisements on a corner building. The central billboard shows a white sign with the words "it's open!" above an illustration of a stadium. Below this, signs for businesses such as a bookstore and a fast-food restaurant glow in orange and yellow light. Several cars with red taillights are parked or moving slowly on the wet, dark street in the foreground. Other distant signs for hotels and a soda brand add more light to the dark, nighttime sky.

title: Chair III / Black
alt_text: A painting showing a rectangular, upright object with a dark, textured surface. The object is framed by thin, dark vertical strips on both sides and a horizontal bar near the bottom. The upper section features a textured, brownish-grey panel with faint, horizontal, scratch-like markings. Below this panel, the surface is smoother, darker, and mostly plain. The entire object stands on light-colored blocks against a blurry, light background.

title: Major John Paul Stapp in Three Phases of Rapid Acceleration and Deceleration
alt_text: A painting of three busts of people shown side-by-side in a three-paneled frame. Each panel features a gold-colored, head-and-shoulders portrait of a person against a background of a light blue sky and a black horizon line. The faces of the individuals have closed eyes and expressions that look like they are crying or distressed. The three portraits are separated by vertical, gray wooden dividers. The entire artwork is enclosed in a dark gray frame with thin, reddish-orange highlights.

title: Pintura Espacial Variable
alt_text: A painting of black, white, and gray geometric shapes arranged in a symmetrical pattern. On the left and right sides, large white triangles point toward the center. In the middle, a solid black diamond shape appears to float against the background. Rectangular gray and black blocks frame the central diamond, creating an illusion of depth and three-dimensional space. The design is balanced, with the same patterns appearing at both the top and bottom of the work.

title: Still Life with Four Baskets
alt_text: A painting of various woven baskets and a wooden crate arranged against a deep burgundy wall. To the left sits a round, lidded basket made of light-colored woven reeds. In the center, a wooden crate rests on the floor, holding a round, patterned basket on its top edge. A flat, circular woven tray leans against the front of the crate, while a smaller, darker, pot-shaped basket sits beside it. Thin wooden sticks lean against the wall and the crate, casting long, diagonal shadows across the dark red surface.

title: Compositional Study, for Jesus and Mary Magdalen, Reredos (right panel), American Cathedral in Paris
alt_text: A painting of several figures standing and kneeling in a vertical rectangular frame. On the right side, a tall man with long dark hair and a beard stands while wearing a long, light-colored robe. Facing him on the left, a woman with dark hair kneels on the ground wearing a dark shawl and a long red dress. Behind them, two winged figures with light-colored clothing and dark hair appear to float in the upper portion of the scene. The background consists of vertical, brushy strokes of reddish-orange and cream colors. The edges of the canvas appear ragged and unpainted.

title: Figure Study
alt_text: A painting of an older man with gray hair and a long, white beard. He is shown from the chest up against a dark, shadowy background. He wears a heavy, dark coat with lighter, almost white streaks running down its folds. His gaze is directed to the right of the frame, and his face shows deep lines. The canvas appears to be tacked to a backing board with a visible, rough edge.

title: AKA
alt_text: A painting shows three vertical panels arranged side-by-side. The panel on the far left is white and fills about one-third of the image. The center panel is a light shade of yellow and takes up the middle section. The panel on the right is a slightly deeper yellow color that matches the height and width of the center panel. Thin, straight lines separate each of the three rectangular sections.

title: Through the Looking Glass
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular frame enclosing a deep black space. The edges of the frame are lined with rows of small, bright amber lights. These lights appear to repeat in a line, stretching backward into the center of the dark interior. The frame itself has a thin, metallic silver border around the outside. This creates the visual effect of a glowing tunnel receding into the distance.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, tangled lines that create a dense, chaotic pattern across the entire canvas. Thin, brightly colored squiggles in yellow, red, white, and green weave through a darker, more textured background. Patches of thick, speckled yellow and green paint appear as if they are clusters of moss or grass tucked into the web of lines. The center of the canvas is slightly lighter and more focused, while the edges appear darker and more crowded. Overall, the work resembles a complex, jumbled network of colorful threads or vines.

title: Manhattan Bridge '75
alt_text: A painting of a bridge, shown from a low angle, stretches across the image. The massive, dark, metal support structure of the bridge dominates the foreground on the left. Long, thin cables run diagonally from the top of the tower down toward the water. In the background, across the calm water, smaller city buildings sit along the horizon line. A simple metal railing runs horizontally along the bottom of the painting. The entire scene uses high-contrast black, white, and gray tones.

title: Amer-Wall #7
medium: Collage: plastic sponge & paint on canvas
alt_text: A painting made of plastic sponge and paint shows a rectangular grid of horizontal stripes. The surface is textured with porous, spongy material that is cut into squares and rectangles. These strips of sponge are colored white, red, and blue. The top and bottom sections alternate between white and red, while the middle section features bold blue stripes. A faint vertical seam divides the image into left and right halves.

title: Bridge #1
alt_text: A painting of a rectangular field colored in a solid shade of light gray. The field is bordered by a series of thin, horizontal bands at the top and bottom edges. These decorative bands consist of alternating lines of white, black, and gray. The main gray area occupies the vast majority of the canvas space. The entire image is oriented as a landscape rectangle.

title: Bridge #2
alt_text: A painting of a large, dark blue rectangle standing on a white, grid-patterned background. The central dark blue area takes up most of the surface. On the left and right sides of this blue panel, there are vertical orange stripes. Each orange stripe has a thin, dark line running through its center. The entire piece has a clean, geometric appearance.

title: Presidential Commemorative -- The Great Wall
alt_text: A painting of a stylized landscape features multiple green mountains shaped into sharp, repeated triangles. A long, grey walkway or wall follows the zigzagging ridges of the hills. Small, dark green circular trees are lined up in single rows along the edges of these walkways. At the top of each hill peak, a small group of tiny dark figures stands in a line. Behind the mountains, the sky transitions from a deep black at the top to a bright yellow band near the horizon line.

title: Boston Lettuce
alt_text: A painting of a pile of cardboard boxes stacked under a dark, arched stone alcove. The boxes are made of brown and tan cardboard and are mostly folded, crushed, or lying on their sides. On the right side, a white box clearly shows text reading "Boston Lettuce" and "Product of U.S.A." The stone alcove above the boxes is weathered, with chipped blue paint and patches of orange rust. The ground beneath the pile is dark and made of large, flat stones.

title: Volumes: A Variable Multiple
alt_text: A painting on a plastic panel shows a large, geometric shape made of three connected rhombuses. The overall shape is a wide, horizontal hexagon standing on its point. Inside each of the three rhombuses, nested yellow lines create a repeating diamond pattern that fades toward the edges. The left rhombus is brighter yellow, while the two on the right are paler. A person's hand holds the top right corner of the panel against a background of wooden shelves.

title: Suchowola
medium: Silkscreen, felt, linen, and paper on board
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes layered on a background of grid paper. The composition features several angular, overlapping blocks in muted tones of brown, blue, gray, and yellow. A bright yellow diagonal bar cuts across the lower-left portion of the shapes. At the bottom, a few short, vertical rectangles in orange and light pink are arranged in a row. The entire piece has a flat, graphic appearance with sharp, clean edges.

A painting of a black field with thin white lines creating a geometric pattern. The lines intersect to form a series of triangles and quadrilateral shapes that spiral toward the center. This arrangement creates an effect similar to a rotating pinwheel or camera shutter. The shapes fit together tightly without overlapping. Each section is a flat, matte black color defined by the crisp white lines.

title: Duquesa Series Double Oval #6
alt_text: A painting of two identical, side-by-side rectangular shapes with rounded corners. Each rectangle is filled with nested layers of color that go from a dark red on the outside to a pale cream in the very center. The shades of red create a warm, sunset-like gradient within both halves. The two main shapes are joined at the center by a dark, vertical band of maroon. The entire artwork is presented against a textured, light-colored metal grid background.

title: Autumn Leaves
alt_text: A painting of a fluffy, light-colored dog standing in front of a window. The dog is looking upward and holds a brown duck in its mouth. Resting on the dog's back is a white circular dish resembling an ashtray, with a thin wisp of white smoke rising from it. Its tail is long, puffy, and cloud-like, extending towards the right side of the frame. Several colorful autumn leaves float in the blue space visible through the window behind the dog. The dog stands on a small, oval-shaped patch of green grass on a wooden floor.

title: Jelly Roll and Marmalade
alt_text: A painting showing a jar and a rolled cake on a table. To the left, a small glass jar filled with liquid sits on the dark surface. Beside it, a white plate holds a pale, spiraled cake roll and one sliced piece. A thin knife rests horizontally on the table behind the plate. The entire scene is washed in a warm, monochromatic orange glow.

title: Giummo
alt_text: A painting of a man’s face framed closely from the shoulders up. He wears large, silver-rimmed glasses that cover his eyes. The left side of his face is brightly lit, showing textured skin and a single visible eye. The right side of his face is cast in deep, dark shadow. Behind him, the background is a solid, muted purple color. The man has wavy, dark hair that surrounds his head.

title: Four Skylights
alt_text: A painting of an empty flat roof looking down a long, narrow path between two buildings. On the left, a tall red brick wall stands next to a wooden water tank that sits on a support. On the right, a smooth, light-colored wall casts a long shadow across the center of the floor. Four small, rectangular glass skylights are lined up in the middle of the roof, leading the eye toward the horizon. A horizontal red beam stretches across the top of the scene, connecting the two sides of the building. In the distance, the faint outline of a city skyline appears under a pale blue sky.

title: The House of Self
alt_text: A painting of a red brick structure seen from a high angle. The structure has a pyramid-like shape with smooth white sides and corners. Several square holes are cut into the red brick walls, showing depth and space inside. The red pattern fades into white near the bottom edges of the walls. A large, empty, light-colored background surrounds the entire object.

title: UNTITLED
alt_text: A painting of an abstract design on a round canvas. The circular composition features a dense pattern of white, vein-like lines over a black background. These lines create small, irregular shapes that look similar to a cracked surface or organic cellular structures. The white lines are thicker and more clustered in the center, appearing to drift outward toward the edges of the circle. The overall image has a textured, intricate appearance with high contrast between the dark and light areas.

title: Six Vinegar Jars
alt_text: A painting of six clear bottles sitting on a grey surface. The bottles are arranged in two rows, with three bottles in the front and three tucked behind them. The bottle on the far left contains an amber-colored liquid, while the others appear mostly empty or clear. Each bottle has a white cap on top. Reflections of the surroundings and the bottle shapes are visible on the glass surfaces. Light bounces off the glass, creating bright white highlights across the curved bodies of the bottles.

title: Memory Johnny Rock Star
alt_text: A painting of a person with wavy hair standing in front of a soft, hazy background. The subject wears a bright green shirt with long sleeves and has their arms crossed in front of their chest. The background appears to be a muted sunset scene in shades of pink, orange, and light purple. The entire image has a blurred or misty quality, making the details of the person and the setting somewhat indistinct. The figure is centered in the frame.

title: Hollywood
alt_text: A steel sculpture made of various brown, rusted metal shapes rests on a blue quilted blanket. The largest part is a flat, upright piece with a wide, angled side that slopes downward. Next to it stands a tall, thick rectangular block that rises straight up. A smaller, slanted bar leans against the right side of the structure, pointing toward the ground. Beneath the slanted bar, a semi-circular base connects the different pieces. The entire object has a textured, orange-brown surface that looks weathered.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A metal sculpture features a large, silver-colored circle with a thick, straight bar running horizontally across the middle. The bar appears to be attached to the circle's front and extends past its edges on both sides. The entire object has a smooth, reflective surface that catches the light. It rests on a dark blue fabric background with a stitched, zigzag pattern. A tiny square tile with the letter "M" on it sits near the bottom edge of the metal circle.

title: The Home of Rosalind Russell and Fred Brisson, 700 Beverly Drive, Beverly Hills, CA
alt_text: A painting of a white house with dark windows sits behind a manicured green lawn and dark green bushes. Two tall, dark brown palm tree trunks frame the house on the left and right sides. A white vintage car is parked on the street in the lower right corner, casting a small dark shadow. The sky above is a pale, clear blue, suggesting a bright and sunny day. The entire scene is captured with smooth, flat colors and clean lines.

title: Cut Lip
alt_text: A painting of the words "cut lip" written in black, capitalized, serif letters across the center. The text is tilted at a diagonal angle, stretching from the middle-left toward the lower-right side of the frame. The background is a gradient of color, starting with a deep, dark brown at the top edge. This brown color fades smoothly into a lighter, peach-toned tan color at the bottom. The entire work is enclosed within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Alar
alt_text: A painting shows a stylized, symmetrical form against a stark black background. This central shape appears like a smooth, silver-grey torso with a bright red line running vertically down its middle. Dark, angular borders in shades of maroon and navy blue frame the grey areas. At the bottom, a small, triangular blue section sits between the two lower parts of the shape. Glowing red outlines surround the bottom edges, making the form stand out against the darkness.

title: Overpass I
alt_text: A painting of a wide, horizontal highway overpass stretches across a desert landscape. The overpass is supported by sturdy, dark gray concrete pillars that cast long, deep shadows onto the sand below. A strip of gray asphalt road runs horizontally beneath the bridge, catching light from the open space. The scene is framed by a clear, pale blue sky that sits above the bridge structure. This artwork hangs on a metal wire storage rack alongside other unidentified framed pieces.

title: Single Smelt
alt_text: A painting shows a fish swimming diagonally across a dark, murky background. The fish is pale and elongated, angled with its head toward the lower left corner and its tail toward the upper right. Its body has thick, visible brushstrokes in shades of cream and light gray. Below the fish, the bottom of the scene is dark and textured with muddy, indistinct shapes that suggest rocks or a riverbed. A dark, brushy signature is visible in the bottom right corner.

title: Graduation Outing
alt_text: A painting of a river scene shows many people relaxing near the water. In the foreground, several figures sit together on the grassy riverbank with their backs to the viewer. They wear long dresses and wide-brimmed hats in shades of pink, brown, and black. Across the calm, pale blue water, several small, narrow boats carrying people float past green trees. To the right, a larger, darker boat holds a crowded group of people. Above the distant treeline, a dark plume of smoke rises into the light blue sky.

title: Triple Carburetor GTO Candy Apple Blue
alt_text: A painting of a shiny, metallic car engine nestled under a car hood. A large, ribbed metal tube curves prominently across the center of the engine block. Two cylindrical air filters with smooth, silver tops sit side by side towards the back. The surface of the engine parts is highly reflective, showing distorted glints of light and dark blue colors. The surrounding engine bay appears deep blue and reflects the bright, metallic details above it.

title: The Ladder and the Sphere (1)
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture shows a tall, light-colored ladder standing vertically in the center. Behind the ladder, a large, textured circle resembles a gray moon or sphere. A dark, circular hole is cut out near the top of the ladder, revealing a reflection of the person taking the photo. The entire object has a dark, muted tone that looks like a photograph. The ladder extends vertically across both the sphere and the dark space above it.

title: East River View (Circle Line)
alt_text: A painting of a hazy cityscape across a calm body of water. A large, gray river fills the lower half of the frame, stretching from one side to the other. On the left side, a tall, thin tower and a few industrial chimneys rise above the low, dark shoreline. A long, thin bridge spans the water in the middle ground, connecting the land on both sides. To the right, a cluster of square buildings and a single very tall smokestack sit against the light, cloudy sky.

title: Main Street
alt_text: A painting of a street scene in sepia tones showing a wide, quiet road lined with low buildings. A single dark vehicle is positioned in the center of the road, heading into the distance. On the right side, a multi-story building stands prominently with a sign on its side that appears to spell out "Hotel." Other smaller, single-story structures with storefronts stretch out along the right edge of the street. Utility poles and thin, bare trees line the roadside, adding to the empty feel of the scene. The overall color palette is a warm, faded brown throughout the entire composition.

title: March Shadows
alt_text: A painting showing a street scene with a bright yellow house on the right side. In the foreground, dark, long shadows stretch across the snow-covered ground and street. Bare, dark trees stand in front of the house and along the left side of the road. Further down the street, smaller buildings and a dull gray sky are visible in the background. The scene is painted with large blocks of color and strong light and shadow.

title: Mountain
alt_text: A welded steel sculpture shows several flat, dark metal plates joined together in an abstract shape. A curved strip of metal loops up from the left side of the flat base. A rectangular plate hangs vertically in the center, appearing to float between the base and the top curve. A small, white rectangular label with some text is attached to the face of this central plate. The sculpture sits on a blue, quilted moving blanket, with blurred wooden crates visible in the background.

title: La Pioggia de la Primavera
medium: Gold leaf, egg tempera, and feather board
alt_text: A painting of rectangular shapes arranged in a geometric grid pattern. Two large squares of shimmering gold leaf occupy the top left and bottom right corners. The other two squares in the corners contain rows of vertical or horizontal bars painted in muted green and grey. Each section is outlined with thin, dark lines that frame the individual blocks. The composition looks like a simplified puzzle made of contrasting textures and solid colors.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A copper sculpture of a swirling, abstract ribbon sits against a plain, light-brown background. The object is formed from a single, thin strip of metal that loops and curves. On the left side, the strip arcs downward and touches the surface. In the center, the metal curls into a circular loop that looks like a ring. The top section then sweeps upward and outward, ending in a point that reaches toward the upper right corner.

title: Indian Summer
alt_text: A painting of a construction site shows a large, open area filled with red dirt. Along the left and back walls, there are tall, temporary wooden structures. In the center of the site, a few stacks of light-colored bricks sit on the ground. To the right, a dark vehicle is parked near a small group of people. Sunlight brightens the scene while smoke or dust rises into the air in the upper right corner. The entire painting is held within a thick, dark brown wooden frame.

title: Earth Print 7B
alt_text: A sculpture shows several distinct, natural pieces arranged together on a crinkled white cloth. To the left is a large, jagged rock that is dark green with rough, light gray stone at the base. To the right is a second, similarly shaped large dark green rock that also has a jagged edge and a rough gray base. Between these two large stones sit four thin, reddish-brown, rod-like pieces aligned vertically. A single thin, pale, flat, and rectangular piece of stone stands vertically next to the reddish rods.

title: Take the Cake
alt_text: A painting in oil and acrylic showing an abstract, blocky geometric shape against a two-toned background. The background is dark grey at the top and fades into a muted red color at the bottom. The central object appears as a three-dimensional form with multiple flat sides. Its surface is filled with dense, swirling black lines that resemble intricate fingerprints. These black lines overlay warm colors of gold, yellow, and deep red.

title: Up and Down
alt_text: A painting of three-dimensional letters and a geometric building on a green and blue background. The painting is oval-shaped and features a large, blocky building with a chimney sitting in the center. To the left of the building, a pink letter "R" floats in the upper area. In front of the building, a light grey ampersand sits on the ground next to a large, pale yellow letter "R". Each letter and the building cast shadows to their right, indicating a light source coming from the left. The background is a soft, blended mix of muted greens and purples.

title: Stovik
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes in shades of green and blue. The canvas is mostly a bright, solid green that fades slightly toward the edges. In the upper-right corner, a large, dark blue shape streaks across the surface. This blue area has rough, textured edges and looks like thick paint or spilled liquid. Scattered, small dark blue spots appear below the main shape, as if they are falling downward.

title: 9 Blocks
alt_text: A sculpture made of chrome-plated steel shows eight tall, rectangular blocks standing upright on a flat surface. The objects are metallic and silver in color, with shiny, smooth sides that reflect light. These blocks are arranged in a loose circle, with some positioned in front and some behind. The flat surface they rest on is a brownish-tan color. A grey, tray-like border edges the top and left sides of the scene.

title: The Leining Barn, Vermont
alt_text: A painting showing a large, dark structure set against a foggy, muted sky. The structure has a distinct triangular roof and stands on the horizon line. Below this building, a wide field stretches across the bottom of the canvas. The field is painted in a muted green-yellow color. Wispy, vertical brushstrokes at the very bottom edge give the impression of tall grass or stalks.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture made of dark plastic shows a geometric design with thin, light lines. The design consists of two intersecting triangular shapes, one of which is filled with many fine, parallel lines that fan out like rays. The square panel is clear at the bottom and is held upright by a rectangular plastic base. Beside the sculpture, two white paper tags with barcodes rest on a textured, light-colored fabric surface. The background behind the object is blurry and shows part of a room.

title: Mary and the Baby
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting in a rocking chair while holding a small baby. The person, who has long dark hair, wears a green shirt and blue jeans while resting their feet on a striped rug. A tall, wooden rocking chair supports them, and to the left, the white railing of a crib or porch is visible. The background consists of a bright, light-colored wall that suggests an indoor setting. A signature is visible in the lower-left corner of the painting. The entire scene is enclosed within a dark wooden frame.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A welded steel sculpture shows a collection of geometric shapes and rods arranged into an abstract, asymmetrical form. At the bottom, a flat, triangular metal plate sits on the surface, supporting a curved, thicker metal rod. This rod rises up to connect to a flat, rectangular plate that leans at an angle. Extending from the top, thin, bent rods reach out in opposite directions, each ending in a round, ball-like shape. The entire piece is made of dark, weathered metal with visible weld marks at the joints.

title: FM/#178
alt_text: A nickel-plated bronze sculpture shows a figure blended with an airplane shape. The shiny, metallic object has wide, swept-back wings and a pointed, elongated nose. A human-like body forms the fuselage, with the torso stretching out to connect the wings to the tail section. It sits on a simple, triangular metal base that is also reflective. The entire sculpture rests on a dark, quilted surface with a zig-zag pattern.

title: Project: Burke I
alt_text: A welded copper sculpture featuring two long, straight metal bars that cross each other at an angle. These bars connect to a curved, oval-shaped piece of metal near the base. The surface of the sculpture is dark and gray-brown with visible joints. It rests on a flat, tan-colored tray. Metal shelves line the background and sides of the image. A thick gray plastic border frames the tray holding the object.

title: Lofoten
alt_text: A painting on linen shows a rectangular surface with a textured appearance. The surface is colored in shades of dark gold and brown. A prominent, vertical shadow divides the canvas, creating a lighter section on the left and a darker section on the right. The overall composition appears abstract and simple.

title: Cyclist
alt_text: A sculpture made of fiberglass and epoxy shows a person riding a motorcycle. The smooth, glossy object features a rider leaning forward over the handlebars. Large, rounded shapes form the body of the motorcycle and the rider's posture. The colors are limited to deep blue, shiny black, and pale gray. The entire form is stylized and curvaceous, with no sharp edges visible.

title: Andy Warhol Do It Yourself
alt_text: A painting of a coastal scene featuring a house and two boats waiting on the shore. The image is divided into numbered sections, revealing it is a paint-by-numbers project. A small building with a red roof sits in the middle ground, surrounded by tan ground and blue water. Two boats are docked in the foreground, one dark blue and the other light gray, both with tall, thin masts sticking up toward the sky. Fluffy white clouds fill the bright blue sky above the water, while two white birds fly in the upper left corner.

title: Silver Maple, Silver Sea
alt_text: A painting of a landscape that is filled with thick gray fog. A single tree stands in the lower right, its dark shape barely visible through the mist. To the left, another smaller, ghostly bush or shrub appears in the distance. Below the foggy sky, the ground is a muted, soft brown color. The entire scene is very blurry, making it difficult to see clear details.

title: M45-1968
alt_text: A painting shows three horizontal bands of color that blend into each other. The top band is a light, bright green color. This green section curves downward in the center to meet a large, bright orange band in the middle. The bottom of the orange band also curves downward, transitioning into a pale, off-white lavender color at the bottom of the canvas. The edges where the colors meet are soft and blurry rather than sharp lines.

title: Black Moon
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a smooth, square panel in a solid, muted gray color. In the center, there is a large, circular shape painted in a warm, light peach tone. Inside this peach-colored circle, there is a small, recessed hole that looks dark gray. On the left side of the gray panel, there is a tiny, oval-shaped indent. A small, thin, vertical line hangs near the top right corner of the panel.

title: Identification #OA
alt_text: A painting of an abstract, color-filled surface in shades of pink, orange, and light blue. The colors blend together in soft, blurry patches that resemble watercolor washes. Lighter areas of white and pale peach are spread across the center and left side. Darker, saturated bands of warm pink and orange appear along the edges, especially on the right. The overall effect is hazy and cloud-like, with no clear shapes or distinct figures.

title: Personnage
alt_text: A painting of a stylized, cartoon-like portrait of a person centered against a black background. The figure has a large, fleshy, pink head and wears thick-rimmed glasses that cover most of the upper face. Two curved, striped shapes extend outwards from behind the head like horns or streamers. The figure wears a dark red shirt under a pink jacket and a bright yellow tie with dark spots. Splatters of white paint are scattered across the figure's face and clothing, and the signature "Maryan 68" is written in the bottom right corner.

title: Winter Light
alt_text: A painting showing a rectangular field filled with horizontal bands of orange. The colors range from a bright, light orange at the top to a darker, more brownish orange toward the middle and bottom. Thin, darker lines run horizontally across the surface at different intervals. The entire image is framed by a simple, solid border. The composition creates a sense of steady, flat depth.

title: Poster #3
alt_text: A painting of abstract, wavy stripes in yellow on a dark background. The background is divided into two main sections: a deep reddish-orange on the left and right sides, and a large black shape in the center. Inside the black section, several parallel yellow lines curve and bend from the bottom left toward the top right. These yellow lines have a subtle, shaded effect that makes them appear to rise up from the surface. The entire composition has a smooth, glossy finish.

title: Monument
alt_text: A painting of a nude figure crouching on top of a tall, rectangular pedestal. The scene is set in an outdoor area filled with lush, leafy trees and bushes. In the background, there are large stone buildings with towers visible among the foliage. The entire image uses a warm, orange-toned color palette that blends the landscape and figures together. The pedestal takes up a large portion of the center, standing firmly on the ground.

title: Titian "Bacchanale"
alt_text: A painting showing a large group of people gathering in an outdoor landscape. The figures are positioned in the foreground and middle ground, with many appearing to be dancing or interacting with one another. To the far right, one person reclines on the ground, while others stand or crouch nearby in poses of motion. Dark trees frame the left and top edges, and a cloudy, purplish sky fills the background. The colors throughout the scene are muted and shadowed, with distinct tones of pink, purple, and deep brown.

title: Watcher #1
alt_text: A painting made of enamel on Masonite displays two distinct sections side by side. The left half is dark blue and features a large, winding, cream-colored shape that curves into a spiral at the bottom. The right half is a warm reddish-orange color and shows a cream-colored silhouette of a face in profile looking toward the left. This rectangular artwork is wrapped in protective plastic and is sitting on a wooden frame with wheels. The wooden cart is resting on a concrete floor in what appears to be a storage room.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of aluminum construction showing a series of interconnected, smooth, metallic shapes. The piece is made of several curved, upright panels that interlock in a complex, three-dimensional arrangement. The center features a rounded, hollow opening flanked by pointed, wedge-like forms. The base consists of flat, semi-circular supports that anchor the sculpture to the surface below. The entire object has a uniform, matte silver color that reflects light softly across its rounded edges.

title: Shane
alt_text: A painting of a cartoon-like figure riding a horse against a solid orange background. The rider wears a yellow hat and a long yellow scarf, and holds a blue object that looks like a simplified gun or tool. Beneath the rider is a large, brown, blocky horse shape with four simple white legs extending downward into a yellow ground. The horse has a dark, sketched-looking tail and a blue strap across its back. A small white shape with the text "Shane" sits in the lower right corner of the background.

title: La naissance change de lieu
alt_text: A painting with a cream background features stylized black and white imagery alongside abstract yellow shapes. On the left side, a graphic symbol with the letter "C" connected to three "H" letters floats above a small, alien-like figure. To the right, a large, intricate black shape resembling an anatomical drawing dominates the center. Below this, a darker, rounded form contains a symbol with a circle and a downward-pointing cross. Thin, gray lines frame parts of the image, connecting a circular icon in the top left corner to the rest of the composition.

title: Asrah
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an abstract, metallic shape with a smooth, dark surface. The object is curved into an arch that looks somewhat like a rounded, open triangle or a flattened letter U. One end of the curve points downward toward the base, while the other side forms a long, flat leg that rests on the ground. The entire piece has a consistent, dark brown color with soft highlights reflecting light along its rounded edges. It sits on a simple, flat brown surface.

title: Figures in Conflict
alt_text: A painting of a crowded room with two figures standing in the center. The figures appear nude and are depicted in reddish-brown tones. Behind them, several people in blue clothing sit or stand near an easel holding a canvas. The background is filled with various objects, including furniture and small framed pictures. The scene uses thick, expressive paint strokes in shades of yellow, green, and blue.

title: Nov-Dec 67
alt_text: A painting of an abstract shape set against a light yellow background. In the center, a dark, rectangular form extends from the left side toward the middle. This form has a sharp, angled bend that leads into a bright green, rounded object. The dark shape is colored with varying shades of purple and blue to create a 3D effect. The painting is framed and sits on a wooden stand in a storage room.

title: Triangle en Equilibre Sur une Fleche
alt_text: A copper sculpture shows a large, shiny arrow pointing toward the viewer. The arrow has a flat, triangular head and a long, rectangular shaft. It rests on a plain white table in what looks like a storage room or archive. In the background, a person with dark hair sits at a desk while looking down at a laptop. Tall metal shelves line the walls on either side of the room.

title: Escala Sobre Blanco Pintura Generativa
alt_text: A painting of a large, pale yellow circle centered on a muted tan rectangular background. Inside the circle, fine, intersecting lines create a complex, swirling geometric pattern that draws the eye toward the center. A small, dark dot sits exactly at the center point of the entire design. The painting is framed in a thin, simple metal border and stands upright on a wooden cart. The background shows a blurry storage area filled with shelving and other unseen objects.

title: Near Walden
alt_text: A painting of an abstract composition features soft, muted colors spread across the canvas. The background is a grainy, light tan or beige tone that covers most of the surface. Faint, hazy vertical shapes in darker shades of grey and muted green rise up from the lower edge. These indistinct forms seem to blur into the background, creating a soft and diffuse effect. No sharp lines or specific subjects are visible in this subtle arrangement of color and light.

title: Untitled Kinetic Construction
