alt_text: A sculpture made of a polarized light box shows a glowing, circular design against a dark background. In the center, a bright, solid orange circle sits like a sun. Surrounding this center are several dark, curved, petal-like shapes that overlap and spin outward toward the edges. The light within the circle creates a soft, hazy gradient from orange to deep brown or black. The entire circular image is framed by a simple, square white border with a thin black edge.

title: Lumia Phoenix
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media shows a rectangular black box with glowing colors on its face. The front surface looks like a dark screen with blurry patches of light. A bright, vertical swirl of deep red fades into a soft, golden yellow toward the bottom. The rest of the screen is a dark, almost black background that makes the colored areas pop. This piece sits on a light-colored surface with a plain background.

title: Chadri
alt_text: A painting of wavy, vertical lines covers the entire square canvas. The lines are bright blue and zigzag back and forth in a repeating pattern. The background between these lines is a flat, solid red color. The width of the red gaps is about the same as the width of the blue lines. This simple design fills the space from edge to edge.

title: Astral Core
alt_text: A painting of several vertical rectangles side by side. The canvas is filled with alternating bands of bright pink and warm orange. Each band of color has a slightly lighter or darker center, creating a glowing effect. The straight, parallel lines stretch from the top of the painting to the bottom. The entire composition uses a repetitive, symmetrical pattern of these vibrant colors.

title: Man
alt_text: A painting of a person’s head and neck against a light background. The subject has dark, textured skin with visible brushstrokes and patches of paper collage. To the left of the head is a vertical section of a brown, rectangular wall or pillar. The figure wears a simple blue collared shirt. A signature and date are visible in the bottom left corner near the wall.

title: T.A.O.
alt_text: A stainless steel sculpture shows a tall, vertical pole standing on a circular base. A single curved, horizontal bar passes through the center of the vertical pole, creating a balanced, wing-like shape. Thin metal wires stretch from the top and bottom of the vertical pole to attach to the ends of the curved bar. The entire object has a shiny, metallic silver finish and rests on a textured, wavy fabric surface. A small white tag with a barcode hangs from the base of the sculpture by a string.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a figure with long, bushy brown hair and a tan torso that fades into a dark, blurry lower body. The figure faces right and reaches out with a thin arm. Above the figure, a small, pale, thin character walks along a curved red line against a dark background. To the lower left, a bright orange, horse-like creature with glowing eyes stands with a small, orange, humanoid rider on its back. The background consists of deep blues and blacks with scattered, subtle blue patches.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, fluid shapes in various colors against a white background. On the left side, soft pink and brown organic forms swirl together, resembling tangled roots or vines. The right side features sharp, mint-green geometric structures that have cut-outs resembling a grid. A small, circular magnifying glass icon appears near the top center, showing a magnified view of the grid pattern beneath it. Thin, concentric pink lines ripple faintly across the background, connecting the two sides of the composition.

title: Musical Sculpture #21
alt_text: A sculpture of metal and wood rests on a wheeled cart in a storage room. The object features a wide, funnel-shaped bowl made of silver-colored metal that points downward. Inside the bowl, many thin, tall metal rods stand straight up like blades of grass. Below this, a black three-legged stand supports the sculpture. A smaller, three-sided metal shape hangs upside down beneath the center of the stand. The entire piece sits on a flat, rectangular shelf surrounded by storage racks and a person sitting nearby.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes features a large circle centered on a background divided into four colored squares. The background squares alternate between burnt orange and slate blue. Within the large central circle, there is a textured gray circle. Inside this gray circle, two smaller semicircles overlap, one colored in split blue and orange and the other in split black and white. Thick rings of white and black outline parts of the central circle, creating a layered effect.

title: Twin Column
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture shows a long, rectangular block viewed from a slightly high angle. The flat top surface features a series of colored stripes and geometric blocks in blue, yellow, black, and white. Below the top edge, the front face of the block displays a wide, bold red stripe spanning the length. Beneath the red stripe, there are thinner, distinct stripes of white, blue, and a faint red line near the bottom edge. The overall form appears solid and horizontal, resting on a dark, partially visible surface.

title: Collapsed Rainbow
alt_text: A painted metal sculpture shows a collection of abstract shapes resting on a large orange triangle. Towards the back, a light blue cloud shape sits behind a tall, red rectangular piece covered in yellow polka dots. To the right, a red, snake-like object curves upward, while a long blue block with white dots stretches across the foreground. A dark brown, twisting metal piece with a cluster of spheres and a cube base sits on the left. These colorful objects stand out against the plain, flat background of the triangular platform.

title: London Fog #2
alt_text: A kinetic light box with mirrors shows a rectangular wooden frame containing a dark, translucent panel. The panel has a cloudy, gray surface with faint, dark smudges or shapes visible in the center. Reflections of the surroundings can be seen faintly on the surface of the glass or plastic front. The light box sits at an angle against a light-colored, plain wall or surface. A black metal handle or bar is visible near the top of the frame. A thin, dark wire hangs down from the bottom right corner of the box.

title: Principle of Unity
alt_text: A painting on board shows a grid pattern made of thin, light blue lines set against a flat, reddish-orange background. These lines crisscross to form a large diamond shape centered in the middle of the square frame. Inside the diamond, the background color shifts to a darker, duller orange or brown where the lines overlap. The grid lines continue from the edges of the diamond out to the corners of the painting, getting wider apart as they spread. The overall effect creates a sense of depth and movement on the flat surface.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a dark, abstract shape set against a light background. The main shape is black, tall, and has a rounded, irregular outline. A bright, thin yellow line outlines the entire shape, making it pop from the background. Surrounding the black shape is a hazy, soft-edged border in shades of purple and orange. This central design sits vertically in the middle of a solid, light-colored rectangular background.

title: Silvered Shoe Antlers
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media shows a single, glittery silver high-heeled shoe resting on its side. Extending upward from the opening of the shoe is a tall, white puzzle-piece shape that curves toward the top. The shoe itself has a pointed toe and a thin heel, appearing to be covered in a sparkling texture. The entire sculpture sits on a brown, flat surface inside what looks like a storage or archive room. A white tag with a barcode lies on the surface in the foreground.

title: Hand out of Cup
alt_text: A sculpture made of an assemblage of a cup and a mannequin's hand shows a hand emerging from inside a mug. The cup is a pale, off-white color and has a single handle attached to its side. A hand, also pale in color, appears to be rising out of the opening of the cup with fingers pointing upward. The object sits on a dark, textured foam mat inside a box. The background shows a piece of cardboard with handwritten red markings.

title: Saturno
alt_text: A painting made of paint, wood board, and wood shows a two-toned background split horizontally. The top section is dark black, while the bottom half is a lighter, grayish-white color. Floating in the center of the dark area is a bright red, circular emblem with a line extending downward from it. Below that, on the lighter section, sits a large, raised shape that looks somewhat like a rounded keypad with buttons. A small, U-shaped handle attached to the frame hangs off the right side of the object.

title: Personaggio
alt_text: A painting of a composition filled with overlapping, reddish shapes. The entire image is dominated by various shades of pink, red, and maroon. A large, bulbous figure that resembles a stacked hourglass or a simplified person sits in the center of the canvas. This central figure is surrounded by a grid-like pattern of squares and rectangles. Each section of the grid contains smaller, rounded shapes that look like puzzle pieces or simple cut-out forms.

title: Blat
alt_text: A welded steel sculpture features two large, abstract, arching structures that create an open, gate-like shape. The sculpture is made of many connected, dark metal pieces, including flat square plates, zigzagging serrated edges, and rounded orbs. On the left side, the structure rises from a small, rectangular base resting on a white, foam-like platform. The right side is denser, with various metal shapes, and sits directly on a large, orange wooden pallet. The background shows a storage area with crates, shelves, and various shipping supplies, suggesting the object is inside a warehouse.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a mostly white field that appears hazy and soft. The background is a very pale, cool white color that fills almost the entire frame. In the center of the canvas, there is a subtle, blurry patch of soft blue or purple color. This central shape fades gradually into the surrounding white space. The painting is enclosed in a simple, thin frame that follows the rectangular edge.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a repeating geometric pattern covering the entire square surface. The design is made of small rectangles and squares colored in orange, yellow, and blue-purple. These shapes form a grid that looks like a woven fabric or a tiled floor. A faint, circular outline is visible in the center, overlapping the background pattern. This circular shape appears slightly lighter than the surrounding grid. The painting is enclosed in a simple, thin wooden frame.

title: Hayabusa Torso
alt_text: A painting of an airplane showing it from a side profile view. The airplane is set against a solid, bright yellow background. The body of the airplane is covered in an irregular pattern of light white, olive green, and dark brown blotches. A small section along the bottom of the plane’s body features a grid-like pattern in brown and white. The shape of the plane is simple and illustrated with thick black outlines.

title: Lullaby: Portrait of Madame Roulin
alt_text: A painting of a stylized figure set against a bright yellow background. The upper half of the composition features a U-shaped blue section covered in white polka dots, resembling long arms draped downward. Below this blue section is a light beige rectangle with smaller orange spots. At the bottom of the blue shape, two simple white hands are clasped together. Two thin, yellow lines dangle from the hands toward the bottom edge of the painting. The entire scene is enclosed in a thin, gold-colored frame.

title: Hai Buun
alt_text: A painting of an abstract shape that sits against a dark green background. Two large, orange, wing-like forms stretch out from the center, decorated with thin, curved lines. Beneath these wings are smaller shapes, including a white arch, a green circular form with striped lines, and a thick blue pillar with vertical stripes. The entire group rests on top of a solid, flat yellow rectangle that spans the bottom of the painting. The overall composition feels colorful and whimsical, with distinct blocks of solid colors.

title: Organi-mushi
alt_text: A painting of a strange, multi-legged creature set against a two-toned background. The top part of the background is brown, and the bottom is a lighter pink. The creature has a long, tube-like body covered in vertical stripes of pastel yellow, blue, and white. It has sharp teeth at one end and several stick-like legs extending from its body, each tipped with a small white oval. Some of these legs form triangle shapes, while others are just straight lines.

title: Untitled
medium: Metal hook and oil on woodboard
alt_text: A painting of a plain, light gray surface is mounted on a wooden board. A small, simple metal hook is screwed into the top center of the board. The hook casts a clear, dark shadow that falls downward onto the gray painted surface below it. The shadow is shaped like a key with a long, thin shaft and a round top. The painting itself is flat and rectangular, taking up the entire view.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting showing a single, large, hand-drawn circle centered against a plain background. The circle is thick and black, created with uneven, textured brushstrokes. Its edges are slightly irregular, suggesting it was painted quickly or with a loose hand. The background is a flat, solid, off-white color that fills the rest of the canvas. This contrast makes the dark ring stand out boldly from the light space around it.

title: Swirl #15
alt_text: A sculpture of colored metal shows a repeating spiral pattern against a white background. Many thin, wavy metal strips are arranged in a tight, swirling design that radiates from a small, empty center. The strips on the left side are light green and yellow, while the strips on the right side are a deep, dark blue. The entire square piece is encased in a clear, boxy frame. The colors seem to blend from green to blue in a smooth, wave-like motion.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of two abstract shapes sitting against a black background. On the left, a large pink circle rests atop a white form that drips downward like spilled paint. The center of the pink circle holds a messy, textured splash of white, blue, and reddish colors. On the right, a large turquoise circle rests atop a solid yellow form that also has two green vertical drips. The center of this circle contains a bright orange and teal splash with rough edges.

title: Untitled #116
alt_text: A painting of a grid with blue, diamond-shaped beads on vertical bars. The frame is also light blue and matches the color of the beads. There are three vertical bars that hold these geometric shapes in place. A horizontal bar crosses through the middle of the frame to divide the beads. The background of the entire grid is a plain, off-white color.

title: Untitled No. 126
alt_text: A painting of dark, abstract shapes floating on a light, off-white background. The black shapes vary in size and form, including circles, a rounded square, and an elongated oval. Each dark shape casts a long, pale grey shadow that stretches toward the right side of the panel. These shadows create the illusion that the black shapes are floating above the surface. The arrangement of these forms is scattered across the open space.

title: Brushstroke
alt_text: A painting of a single, thick brushstroke against a background of uniform dots. The long, horizontal stroke curves up and down like a wave across the center of the image. The stroke itself is filled with bold, black and white stripes that follow its flowing shape. Behind the stroke, the entire background is covered in a tight pattern of small, evenly spaced black dots on a white field. The edges of the brushstroke look uneven, as if paint was dragged roughly across the surface.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of four black outlined shapes arranged in a diamond formation against a plain, light-colored background. Each shape resembles a box or a short, four-sided pyramid with a flat top. The shapes are outlined in thin black lines, with a top face and two visible side faces. They are spaced evenly apart from one another. The background is a solid, neutral color, appearing like textured fabric.

title: Sculpture Model Summer Solstice
alt_text: A stainless steel sculpture shows an abstract, geometric shape standing on a textured blue surface. It looks like three flat, rectangular metal plates joined together at right angles. The piece rises upward from a flat base, folds over to form a small platform, and then extends vertically like a tall, thin wall. A small, rectangular paper tag lies flat on the blue surface next to the sculpture's base. The background is slightly blurred and shows a workspace with various tools and objects.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, repeating wave-like shapes. The background is a dark, shadowy purple. On the left side, a large, rounded crescent shape glows in a lighter, dusty blue. To the right of that, several bright red, curved stripes sweep across the canvas. These red stripes follow a wavy pattern that repeats to the right edge of the frame. The entire piece is enclosed in a thin, simple metallic frame.

A painting shows a large, orange-red number two that fills most of the frame. The background is split between two different colors. The upper part of the background is a bright, solid blue. The bottom part of the background is a solid green, with a horizontal line separating it from the blue section. The number itself has curved, thick lines that extend from the top left corner down to the bottom right.

title: Surface
alt_text: A painting on a constructed canvas shows a repeating pattern of small, circular indentations. These dimples are arranged in a wide, pyramid-like triangle that starts narrow at the top and spreads out towards the bottom edge. The entire surface is a uniform, bright white color. Each small dent creates a soft, subtle shadow inside it, adding a sense of depth to the flat plane. The surrounding area of the canvas is smooth and plain white.

title: Scylla and Charybdis
alt_text: A Plexiglas sculpture stands upright in the center of the frame. It is a tall, narrow, rectangular container that appears to be made of clear, rigid plastic. Inside the container, there are faint horizontal lines that suggest layers of liquid. The sculpture rests on a flat, reddish-brown surface that extends toward the bottom of the image. The background shows an aisle in a storage room with grey metal shelves lining both sides.

title: Nyctitropic
medium: Liquitex, perforated metal, and florescent light
alt_text: A sculpture of a square, white box with a dark mesh center sits on a flat surface. The outer frame is smooth, matte white, and surrounds a recessed, perforated metal panel. A faint, circular shadow is visible in the middle of the dark mesh area. The object appears to be resting in a storage or warehouse setting. The entire structure faces directly forward.

title: Organa #6526
medium: Mercury and electric motor, with Lucite frame
alt_text: A sculpture of a circular inset displayed within a square, black frame. The circular center shows a textured, shimmering surface that resembles a map with dark landmasses against a lighter, metallic background. This circular section is outlined by a bright white ring. The entire object sits inside a larger, clear, square-shaped casing. In the bottom right corner of the black square, there is some faint, illegible cursive text.

title: Phenomena to Still
alt_text: A painting shows abstract shapes and bold lines across a light-colored background. To the left, a cluster of blended orange, dark red, and black colors forms a rounded, irregular shape. A thick, curving black line arcs over the top of this colored area. A bright yellow shape stretches diagonally from the center toward the top edge. A single, thin, dark brown line cuts sharply across the upper portion of the frame. In the lower right corner, a patch of deep blue fades into the background.

title: String Composition #413
alt_text: A sculpture of dark nylon threads is embedded inside a square block of clear Plexiglas. These threads form a long, layered shape that looks like a series of zig-zagging arches. The threads cross over each other many times, creating a dense, web-like pattern in the center of the block. A small, reddish-brown circular shape rests in the middle of these overlapping threads. The clear block is set inside a dark-colored frame.

title: Yellow Jack
alt_text: A painting of alternating black and yellow vertical stripes fills the entire rectangular frame. The stripes are all the same width and run parallel from the top edge to the bottom edge. The bright yellow stripes stand out sharply against the dark black stripes next to them. This simple, repetitive pattern creates a consistent texture across the surface. A thin wooden frame surrounds the edges of the canvas.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of polished aluminum sits on a purple surface. It is composed of sharp, angular metal pieces that form a complex, geometric shape. A triangular, pointed section leans over a lower, curved base. The edges of these metal plates are joined together by rows of small, dark rivets. In the background, a rough, brown sculpture and parts of a desk are visible.

title: Four
alt_text: A steel sculpture showing a heavy, metal block attached to a base. The top section is a smooth, rectangular piece of steel that sits horizontally. Below this block, four small, round metal cylinders hang down in a row like heavy fingers. This top part rests on a vertical, rectangular column that narrows slightly as it moves downward. A white rectangular label with typed and handwritten text is attached to the front of this column. The entire object sits on a blue padded surface in front of a blurred background.

title: Mutation Thematique Rouge
alt_text: A painting showing a rectangular canvas covered in vertical stripes. The stripes repeat in a specific pattern of colors across the surface. These colors are bright green, warm yellow, and vibrant orange. The stripes are all the same width and run from the top edge to the bottom edge. A thin, dark brown frame surrounds the outer edge of the entire piece.

title: L'empecheur de Tourner en Rond
alt_text: A painting of colorful shapes arranged in a square format. At the center is a solid red circle. This circle is surrounded by a larger blue ring. Around the blue ring is an even larger red ring that takes up most of the square. The corners of the square are colored with sections of green, contrasting with the blue background.

title: One Red Form
alt_text: A painting shows abstract shapes against a bright yellow background. Near the top, there is a single, triangular shape colored orange. Below this triangle, several irregular, black, jagged strips are arranged in a row across the center. To the right, a separate, larger black shape sits alone. The entire design uses high contrast between the dark shapes and the yellow backdrop.

title: Necklace
alt_text: A sculpture of mixed media shows a tall, rectangular frame topped by a dark blue cross. Above the frame, a dense cluster of light-colored, grape-like spheres mixes with strands of blue and white beads. Inside the frame, two circular, pink-tinted images depicting figures are stacked vertically against a dark background decorated with small, repeating patterns. The bottom section of the frame contains four small, recessed rectangles, each holding a blue light. Dangling from the very bottom edge is a row of seven dark, pear-shaped pendants.

title: Untitled
medium: Oil on cut canvas collage on paper
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes arranged to look like a four-pointed pinwheel. The design consists of four dark blue and four reddish-orange trapezoids that alternate around a central point. Each shape connects perfectly to the next, creating a star-like pattern against a plain, light-colored background. The entire design is centered within a square frame. A small, faint signature is visible in the bottom right corner.

title: Ivory Tulip
alt_text: A painting of a single, large white flower centered against a solid black background. The flower petals are smooth and curved, with soft gray shadows that give them depth. A small, vibrant green stem emerges from the bottom of the flower and disappears behind the black canvas edge. The painting itself is mounted in a light-colored wooden frame, which is held by a larger, unfinished wooden storage structure. The background of the entire scene looks like a dimly lit storage area with boxes and equipment visible.

title: Colgate
alt_text: A painting of a blue and white background features two distinct collage elements attached to the surface. In the upper portion, a rectangular piece shows a red car with black-and-white photos of faces layered on top. Below this, a semi-circular piece displays a close-up image of a person holding a glass object, with warm orange tones visible underneath. A thin, dashed white line arcs over the lower collage piece, pointing toward the right. The entire composition is split horizontally, with a large solid blue area covering the top two-thirds and a plain white space filling the bottom section.

title: Wingo
alt_text: A painting of abstract white shapes arranged on a dark teal background. In the center sits a large, rounded white form with a thick outline, surrounding a small, bright green circle. On both the left and right sides of this center shape are vertical stacks of horizontal, rectangular white blocks. Between these stacks and the center shape are thin, vertical strips of dark, textured grey. The entire composition has a balanced, symmetrical appearance.

title: Valentine
alt_text: A painting of a repeating geometric pattern against a plain, off-white background. The central design is a square composed of small, dark lines arranged in a grid. Each cell within the grid contains a single arch shape that curves upward from the bottom line. These identical, rounded shapes sit side by side and in rows to fill the entire square. The overall effect creates a texture that resembles stylized scales or rows of small tunnels.

title: 28 Yrs. Bad Luck
alt_text: A wood and glass sculpture shows a small, hollow cube framed in light-colored wood. The front side features two clear glass panels that meet in the center, forming a seam. Both glass panels are covered in a web of jagged cracks spreading from two central points. The bottom wooden frame is engraved with a star on the left, the text "7 YRS. BAD LUCK" in the middle, and another star on the right. The inside of the box is empty and reflects the light.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture made of a metal tool and a piece of bread sits on a black rectangular base. The bread is light brown, wrinkled, and shaped somewhat like a folded ear or a cluster of petals. It is clamped firmly between the metal jaws of a tool that resembles heavy-duty pliers or garden shears. The tool has silver-colored metal arms, bright red handles, and a black spring at the back. Behind the clamped bread, a small, fan-like arrangement of metal spikes or needles sticks up from the tool. The entire assembly is displayed on a flat, black stand resting on wrinkled white paper.

title: The Dangers of Traveling Alone
alt_text: A wood sculpture shows an abstract, black-and-white ink drawing applied to a three-dimensional surface. In the center, a triangular pyramid structure rises from a flat, square base. The drawings feature various swirling lines, checkerboard patterns, and organic shapes that wrap around the pyramid and the flat area surrounding it. A distinct, rounded object with a dark spot sits near the front of the pyramid on the flat surface. The entire piece has a hand-drawn, cartoonish style that covers all the visible white sides of the wood block.

title: Three Units
alt_text: A painted wood column sculpture stands upright, showing three stacked, square sections. The column has a white background on its flat sides, decorated with thin black lines, solid red rectangles, and a continuous vertical blue stripe. The top segment features a red rectangle on the right side and a blue stripe on the left. The middle segment has a large white area with a red stripe next to a black stripe. The bottom segment mirrors the top with a red rectangle on the right and a blue stripe on the left. The object sits on a plain brown surface with a dark, blurred background.

title: Round Moon
alt_text: A painting of layered abstract shapes and colors covers the entire square canvas. Thick patches of royal blue dominate the upper center section. Below this, a dense, dark block of black paint stretches horizontally across the middle and lower areas. Bright white paint is smeared throughout, creating a rough and textured look against strokes of red, brown, and green. The edges of the canvas appear worn, with visible lines and scrapes that add to the chaotic, heavily layered appearance of the work.

title: Western Movies for Yvonne and Judy
alt_text: A painting of a bright yellow grid pattern over a yellow background. The image is divided into a regular grid of twelve rectangular shapes arranged in four horizontal rows and three vertical columns. Each rectangle is a slightly different shade of yellow than the background, making the shapes appear as faint boxes within boxes. The entire surface is a uniform, flat, and solid yellow color. The arrangement is symmetrical and precise.

title: Study for "Sitting... the Wheel"
alt_text: A painting in mixed media shows a complex composition of line drawings overlaid with a three-dimensional element. At the top center, a large, dark-red, gear-like wheel sits against a background covered in faint pencil sketches. This wheel holds a smaller, rounded, brownish shape that is topped with a textured, golden, fan-like piece. Below these objects, the canvas is filled with intricate line art, including schematic-like diagrams, arrows, and outlines of a coat and a circular machine part. Small handwritten notes and labels are scattered across the drawing, providing extra detail to the technical look of the work. The entire piece combines abstract mechanical drawings with physically attached materials to create a layered appearance.

title: Woman in Interior #2
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting indoors. The figure is positioned in the center, rendered with loose, visible brushstrokes in shades of brown, gray, and dark red. The person's face is lighter in color, with simple, blurred features. Behind the figure, the background is painted with broad, sweeping strokes that suggest a wall and possibly a window or doorway. To the sides, deeper tones of dark brown and black form indistinct shapes that frame the person. The overall style is expressive and sketch-like, with little fine detail.

title: Almanac
alt_text: A painting of abstract, symmetrical shapes on a cream-colored background. The central design looks like a vertical smear of oil paint with dark browns, blues, greens, and a bright red area at the top. The colors appear to be mirrored on the left and right sides of the center line, creating a shape similar to a Rorschach inkblot. Ragged, uneven edges extend outward from the main column of paint, fading into the white space. The entire design is enclosed within a simple, thin wooden frame.

title: Pacifico
alt_text: A painting showing abstract gray shapes against a light gray background. Broad, soft-edged white lines create a glowing effect where they meet the gray forms. These white lines form a cross-like shape in the center, with four distinct gray blocks filling the corners. The edges of the gray shapes are slightly irregular and bumpy. The entire image has a smooth, hazy appearance without any visible brushstrokes.

title: Construction #27
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture of a box contains a smaller compartment with various shapes inside. The entire piece sits within a rectangular frame that has a pale, natural wood color. The inner box is divided into two sections, with the top part housing several small, delicate forms on thin stems that resemble abstract flowers or lollipops. These small shapes are painted in soft, muted pastel colors like light blue, pink, yellow, and green. The bottom section of the inner box features a large circular cutout that reveals a pale green background behind it. A solid, pink, circular disk floats within this green hole.

title: Untitled
medium: Painted tape collage on artist's board
alt_text: A painting shows a rectangular composition divided into two distinct, side-by-side sections. The left panel features a white surface covered in fine, textured lines running horizontally. The right panel displays a matching white surface, but its textured lines run vertically. Both sections fill the frame entirely and share a thin, dark border that separates them down the middle. The overall appearance is neutral and monochromatic.

title: Color Plane Movements #2
alt_text: A painting of thick, overlapping paint strokes covers the entire canvas in a jumble of colors. Bright patches of red, pink, orange, and yellow cluster in the center of the image. Surrounding these lighter areas are darker, moody strokes of forest green, deep purple, and slate blue. These short, bold brushstrokes create a textured appearance across the surface. The painting is framed in a thin, simple metallic border.

title: Garbha Danam
alt_text: A painting of human figures and abstract shapes rendered in a variety of textured colors. In the center, a large, translucent, pinkish-gold figure stands with one arm extended horizontally across the frame. To the left, several smaller, more defined shapes in shades of purple and tan appear to be standing or reclining. To the right, a bright gold, simplified figure is visible, alongside faint outlines of others. The entire surface has a thick, uneven texture with overlapping colors of brown, purple, and cream.

title: Omen
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and colorful forms set against a dark background. To the left, a small, bright blue patch of sea and sky appears behind a dark, lumpy brown shape that resembles a skull. A large, jagged white form spreads across the center of the image, near a small, bright green oval shape. On the right side, there is a large, textured red rectangular structure. Floating above this red shape, inside a black circle, is a small, textured, star-like red figure. The entire composition is filled with contrasting textures and bold, flat colors.

title: Little SL. #10
medium: Mixed media collage; handmade paper varnished with acrylic polymer emulsion
alt_text: A painting of a large platter filled with food sits against a blue and white background. A block of pale, rectangular cheese rests on the left side of a dark, oblong dish. Several slices of the same cheese are arranged in a row in front of the main block. To the left of the cheese, a cluster of small green grapes and three bright red peppers sit on the platter. To the right of the cheese, a large yellow pumpkin stands behind two round, orange peaches with green leaves attached.

title: The God Pan
alt_text: A painting shows a close-up view of a person’s torso. The skin is pale and highlighted by soft, diffused light across the chest and stomach muscles. A dark, shadowy area sits at the top left, while darker tones also define the sides and abdomen. A hand rests gently against the side of the body near the waist. Sparse hair is visible on the chest and lower stomach area. The view extends from the lower jawline down to the waist.

title: Big Wheel
alt_text: A sculpture of wood and glass features a large, circular opening at the top set against a black square background. Inside this large circle, eight thin dividers radiate from the center, creating wedge-shaped sections. Below this, three smaller, reflective golden circles are arranged in a horizontal row against a black panel. The entire piece is encased within a deep, rectangular wooden frame. The object sits on a light-colored wooden platform in a bright room.

title: Chrysler Building
alt_text: A painting of geometric, curved shapes stacked vertically against a flat, grey background. These shapes resemble a series of repeating, tiered semicircles that narrow as they rise toward the top of the frame. Each semicircle is decorated with alternating, triangular sections of solid brown and striped, light pink patterns. The lines create a radial, sunburst effect within each curved tier. The overall composition is symmetrical, balanced, and creates a sense of depth and layered height.

title: Family Reunion
alt_text: A painting shows a group of nine nude figures arranged in a dense, multi-layered composition. The people are light-skinned with dark hair and feature intricate, black-lined patterns covering their bodies like tattoos or markings. The figures are closely crowded together, with some standing and others sitting or crouching. They are set against a background of dark, patterned fabric or tiles with small flower shapes. A brown piece of tape with handwriting is stuck to the upper-left corner of the painting's frame.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of an abstract shape with five circular patterns. The background is a flat, deep red color. In the center floats an irregular, blob-like form outlined in bright green. The interior of this blob is a dark, textured purple that contrasts with the red background. Within this purple space, there are five circular designs, each made of nested rings in shades of pink, red, and white.

title: Detour
alt_text: A painting shows a vertical band of bright yellow color against a plain white background. This long, narrow shape runs down the center of the image from top to bottom. Several thin, dark lines cut through the yellow band in the middle. The edges of the yellow shape appear soft and slightly blurred against the white. Small, dark, vertical drips extend from the top of the colored section.

title: Construction #25
alt_text: A painted wood construction sculpture shows a relief pattern made of many individual white block shapes. These blocks range from long rectangles to circles, semi-circles, and small squares. The top and bottom of the sculpture feature long, flat rectangular pieces that are stacked in rows. In the center, a dense, jagged layer of smaller geometric shapes juts outward from the background. A soft, warm yellow glow reflects from behind the central shapes, adding depth to the structure.

title: Organic Construction
alt_text: A steel sculpture shows an abstract form with a smooth, metallic surface. The bottom section is a heavy, rounded base that sits flat on the surface. Rising from this base is a thin, twisted neck that supports a larger, elongated top section. This top part curves outward and includes small, square holes on its side and head. The entire object has a shiny, silver-gray color with subtle reflections.

title: Double Head 1961-13
alt_text: A sculpture of iron and steel shows an abstract, face-like form made of bent metal strips. The dark, rusted metal pieces are welded together to create open loops and shapes that suggest eyes, a nose, and a gaping mouth. Tall, curved strips of metal rise from the top of the head like jagged hair or flames. The entire structure stands on a simple, square metal base. The sculpture is set against a blurry background of storage boxes and a blue moving blanket.

title: Composition after Joseph Wright of Derby's Experiment with the Air Pump
alt_text: A painting of a crowded, chaotic scene filled with many overlapping figures and colorful abstract shapes. In the center, a man wearing a suit and large black round ears stands with his arm around a person in a red patterned garment. Nearby, a woman in a blue dress leans forward with her hands to her face. A glass bowl with floating white shapes sits near the top, while a silver bowl rests on a table in front of the central figures. The background is a mix of bright orange, yellow, and green, suggesting a busy, festive atmosphere.

title: Radiator I
alt_text: A painted iron sculpture showing a geometric object that looks like a simplified, heavy machine part. To the right, a large, rectangular platform is painted a bright, flat orange color. Attached to the left side of this orange block is a dark, metallic structure with several protruding, parallel arms or prongs. The dark metal section is worn, with rough, textured surfaces and some areas showing signs of rust or aged paint. The entire sculpture rests on a blue padded mat.

title: Alarm Bell
alt_text: A painting of a large, rectangular design. The artwork features a wide vertical rectangle with two dark brown side panels framing a lighter, cream-colored center strip. At the very top of the center strip sits a dark blue square containing a single, centered white circle. The entire piece is propped up on a simple wooden frame and sits on a wooden cart with wheels. It is located in a large storage warehouse with shelves and cardboard boxes visible in the background.

title: Study/Falling Man
alt_text: A painting of a pale, bald figure wearing a dark, striped top and glasses is positioned on the left side of a square, tan-colored canvas. The figure appears to be walking toward the right, with one leg forward and one leg back. Behind this solid figure, four faint, ghostly outlines of the same shape trail off toward the right side of the canvas. These lighter figures overlap each other and seem to fade away as they move further back. The entire composition is set against a flat, monochromatic orange background.

title: Mykonos
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes in various colors and textures. Large rectangular and rounded blocks fill the composition in a layered, overlapping arrangement. The colors include deep reds, muted olives, dark blacks, and textured blue-gray sections. Some areas have a grid pattern embedded into the paint, while other parts appear smooth and glossy. The surface has a rough, thick quality as if different materials were pressed into the canvas.

title: Tube Form #6
alt_text: A copper sculpture showing an abstract form with several intertwined parts. The object rests on a thick, dark square base. A smooth, curved neck-like structure rises from the center of the base. At the top of this curved piece is a wider, textured section that looks like a small head or joint. Several other arm-like appendages extend outward near the bottom, creating a complex, tangled appearance.

title: Sitting Around Screaming
alt_text: A painting of an interior scene showing a large, rectangular white lampshade hanging at the top against a gray background. Below the lamp, a narrow horizontal band shows a slice of a face with bright red lips and white teeth visible. Beneath that opening, a bright blue cloth drapes down in soft folds. Two pale, bare legs extend downward from behind the blue fabric. The lower part of the composition rests on a warm, tan-colored surface.

title: Drawing II
alt_text: A charcoal painting shows abstract, dark shapes against a lighter, hazy background. Several thick, blurred, and angular forms overlap in the center of the frame. The shapes have jagged edges and dark, smoky textures that bleed into the white space behind them. Faint lines sketch out additional angles and planes that seem to recede into the distance. The entire image uses only shades of gray and black to create depth and contrast.

title: Seated Girl
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting in a chair. The figure sits centrally in the frame, wearing a light-colored top with blue pants or a skirt. They are positioned on a green chair with their legs crossed. The background shows a room with horizontal bands of red and green paint. A dark, shadow-like shape stretches across the floor in the foreground. The entire scene is enclosed within a textured, light-colored matting and a simple wooden frame.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a collage construction features two rectangular panels placed side-by-side on a dark, textured background. The left panel is a deep red color and contains four pink circles arranged around a black center. The right panel has alternating horizontal stripes in shades of green, brown, and grey with small orange dots and thin lines. A dark purple horizontal line connects these two shapes with a diamond-shaped accent on each side. The entire artwork is set on a bright teal background, which is framed by a simple white border.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of an orange surface features abstract marks and textures. The background is divided horizontally by a subtle, straight line that stretches across the center. Above this line, light vertical streaks create a worn or distressed appearance. Below the center line, two thin, dark lines hang downward like ropes or strings. These lines end in small, circular shapes that resemble loops or washers resting near the bottom of the canvas.

title: Suzanne's Party
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes that look like tall, thin pillars or tree trunks. These shapes are bunched together in the center of the canvas and are painted in shades of deep red, dark purple, and light cream. Behind these vertical forms is a bright, solid yellow background that fills the entire scene. Some of the shapes overlap each other, creating a sense of depth and density. The edges of the forms are jagged and uneven, which makes them look like torn pieces of paper or fabric.

title: Beans
alt_text: A painting showing a chaotic arrangement of colorful shapes, symbols, and text against a grid-like background. To the left, a large tan shape sits in front of a bright blue grid, with a container filled with circles below it. In the center, a large, light green boat-like form is marked with a dollar sign. Several small, rectangular red boxes labeled "BEANS" are scattered near a blue, bowl-shaped object on the right. Throughout the image, loose lines draw various outlines of everyday items, including shoes, a baseball, and abstract scribbles.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of several pale figures set against a dark, shadowy background. In the foreground, a prominent, light-colored figure sits with its knees bent, facing toward the right. Behind this figure, two other similar forms sit and stand amidst a patch of bright green, grassy ground. To the far right, another figure with a reddish-purple tint appears to be partially obscured in the darkness. The entire scene is framed by a thin, dark border.

title: Birth in May
alt_text: A painting filled with abstract, swirling shapes in deep colors. The composition is dominated by large, bold lines and curves painted in bright purple. These purple shapes rest against a dark, textured background of blues, blacks, and murky greens. The paint appears thick and layered, creating a heavy and uneven surface texture across the entire piece. These colors interweave throughout the frame, with no clear subject or pattern visible.

title: McCall's
alt_text: A painting showing a large, red, heart-shaped form against a vibrant green background. The bright red area dominates the lower center of the canvas and has textured, visible brushstrokes. A dark grey rectangular shape sits directly on top of the red form. Above this, the green background fills the rest of the canvas with sweeping, diagonal paint strokes. The painting is framed by a thin, simple border.

title: Rack
alt_text: A painting of a dark, textured surface fills the entire frame. The paint appears black and is applied in thick, uneven layers across the canvas. Many long, deep grooves run diagonally across the surface from the top right toward the bottom left. There is a single, straighter line running vertically down the left side of the composition. Reflective light hits the ridges and valleys of the paint, creating highlights that break up the darkness.

title: Early in May
alt_text: A painting showing abstract shapes in shades of deep purple, blue, and green. Textured, curved lines sweep across the center of the canvas like twisted branches or antlers. Darker, indistinct forms are scattered throughout the background, blending into the painted surface. Light patches of white and pale violet create highlights within the colorful, layered composition. The entire image has a rough, thick appearance with visible brushstrokes and scraped paint.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, bold shapes and thick, textured brushstrokes fills the frame. The colors include deep navy blue, dark purple, bright red, and warm tan, all set against a lighter, neutral background. Wide, sweeping marks overlap each other to create a sense of layered motion across the surface. Patches of white and yellow break up the darker tones, adding highlights throughout the composition. The entire canvas is framed by a simple gold border.

title: Homage to Turner
alt_text: A wood mosaic sculpture shows a pattern made of small rectangular blocks. The piece is divided into two main sections by a wavy, horizontal line. The upper section is filled with light, tan-colored wooden blocks of varying sizes. The lower section consists of darker, brownish-grey blocks that are packed closely together. The entire mosaic is set inside a thin, white rectangular frame.

title: White Flower
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a large circle cut into a flat, cream-colored surface. Inside this circle, a horizontal line runs from the left side toward the middle. Hanging down from this horizontal line is a simple, three-pronged shape that looks like a fork. The entire composition is monochromatic and has the same soft, light yellow color. Subtle shadows are created by the cut lines, giving the shapes a slight depth against the smooth background.

title: Ducktrap
alt_text: A sculpture of wood blocks shows a grid of rectangles of many different sizes. Each piece of wood has a light brown color with visible natural grain patterns and dark knots. The rectangles are arranged tightly against one another to fill the entire frame. Dark lines separate each piece of wood, creating a strong grid-like pattern. Some pieces are oriented vertically, while others are placed horizontally.

title: Uruk
alt_text: A painting shows thick, abstract strokes of paint against a dark, muted background. Heavy swathes of black paint dominate the upper and center sections, creating layered, tangled shapes. Bright white highlights cut through the darker colors, suggesting depth and movement. On the left, a long, vertical streak of lighter gray pulls the eye downward. The overall composition feels chaotic, with energetic lines that seem to twist and loop across the canvas.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, swirling forms in various shades of yellow, tan, and dark brown. The center of the canvas is crowded with thick, overlapping brushstrokes that move in curved, chaotic patterns. The background is a lighter, muted cream color that provides a soft contrast to the active shapes in the middle. Smaller patches of green, black, and rust red are scattered throughout the dense cluster of brushstrokes. A signature and date appear in the bottom right corner of the painting.

title: Oedipus
alt_text: A painting of black and white abstract shapes fills the canvas. Large, solid black sections dominate the composition, appearing heavy and dark. These black areas are separated by thin, jagged white lines that snake across the entire surface. The white lines resemble cracks in broken glass or veins in dark stone. These lines vary in width, with some areas appearing more textured and brushed than others. The overall effect creates a sense of depth and contrast against the dark background.

title: Untitled (#50-B)
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows abstract, dark shapes against a lighter, warm yellow background. The artwork is framed and covered with a reflective, slightly blurry plastic or glass sheet. Near the top of the frame, the numbers "207.1960.38" are clearly visible. Large, uneven dark blobs of paint stretch across the center and sides, looking like heavy smears or splashes. The overall tone of the image is bathed in a strong, golden-orange light.

title: Red Painting
medium: Oil and burlap on canvas and wood
alt_text: A painting of textured, abstract shapes sits mounted on a wooden frame. The surface features a warm, reddish-brown color with areas of visible burlap fabric embedded into the composition. Darker, rougher patches gather toward the center, creating a sense of depth and layered material. A clear plastic sheet covers the front of the artwork, showing light reflections across the surface. Handwritten numbers are visible on the tape that secures the plastic along the top edge. The painting rests on a wheeled wooden cart against a light-colored background.

title: On the Balcony
alt_text: A painting of thick, layered oil paint shows a chaotic and textured composition. Large, flat shapes in shades of cream and tan overlap along the left and top edges of the canvas. Toward the center, a dense cluster of swirling brushstrokes features bold colors like deep red, bright yellow, and forest green. Below this center cluster, a block of dark green with vertical stripes sits near the bottom. A solid, dark, and matte section occupies the bottom right corner of the frame. The entire surface appears bumpy and heavy, with visible ridges created by the thick application of paint.

title: Head of a Woman
alt_text: A painting of an abstract, head-like form centered on a light tan, textured background. The central shape has a smooth, solid white section on its left side. To the right, rough, layered patches of tan and brown paint create a jagged texture that resembles hair or feathers. Thin, dark, pencil-like lines sweep outward from the top and right side of this form. A pale, horizontal band of orange-toned material stretches across the very top edge of the board.

title: Heir to the King
alt_text: A painting of dark, textured colors creates an abstract scene. The surface is covered in deep shades of blue, gray, and black, which look heavy and rough. Several thin, raised lines run horizontally across the painting, appearing like scratches or cords. A few faint patches of green and white break up the darker areas. In the bottom left corner, there is a small signature in red letters.

title: The Black Vessels
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas featuring large, abstract shapes in warm colors. Bold sections of deep red and bright orange cover most of the canvas. Dark blue, almost black areas sit in the background and as isolated shapes in the foreground. A few smaller, white or pale yellow accents are scattered among the intense colors. Swirling, curved lines and thick paint strokes create a sense of movement throughout the work.

title: Construction #5
alt_text: A wood sculpture showing a rectangular, three-dimensional arrangement with geometric shapes and painted surfaces. At the top, a horizontal blue bar sits above a row of small, colorful peg-like cylinders. Below this, a cream-colored panel features a protruding square block with circular cutouts containing smaller circles, petals, and empty spaces. The bottom of the piece has a scalloped edge supported by a row of thin white pillars. Several small, colorful circles on stems stand upright in the orange space behind these pillars. The entire construction is framed by a solid gray border.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes is framed in a simple, thin gold border. The composition is filled with sharp, angled strokes of black paint that cut across a light background. These black marks are layered with several lighter, muted grey-green shapes that appear to be paper collage pieces. A hazy, soft-edged spray of black ink creates a blurry effect behind the main, defined shapes. The overall image has a diagonal, energetic movement from the top left toward the bottom right.

title: Cornelia
alt_text: A painting of a square canvas filled with a reddish-orange grid pattern. A thin, vertical line runs straight down the center, dividing the entire composition into two mirror-image halves. The grid is made up of raised or textured diagonal lines that create a pattern of diamonds and triangles across the surface. The entire surface is a consistent, warm orange-brown color with subtle variations in texture. The image is framed squarely, showing the full extent of the canvas.

A painting with three horizontal bands of color in a simple, thin frame. The large middle section is a flat, solid shade of deep blue. At the top and bottom, there are two narrower bands of solid black. The overall shape of the canvas is a tall vertical rectangle. The edges of the painting are clean and straight.

title: Black Image with Red
alt_text: A painting showing a rectangular scene covered by a crinkled, translucent plastic sheet. Through the cloudy plastic, warm colors like orange, yellow, and brown dominate the background. A large, dark, vertical shape sits on the left side of the composition. In the lower section, a band of dark color stretches horizontally across the canvas. The entire scene appears slightly blurry and distorted because of the plastic covering.

title: Cross
alt_text: A painting of a collage construction shows nine white, cross-shaped tiles arranged in a grid against a cream-colored, textured background. Each cross features a black circle in its center, enclosing a small white sphere. The background is covered in small, raised cream squares and small, recessed square cutouts. The overall composition is symmetrical and square, contained within a thin white frame. The surface appears uneven and layered, creating a three-dimensional effect.

title: Arcaro's Winner
alt_text: A painting of a collage on paper features shades of orange, yellow, and black. The artwork appears to be made of layered paper scraps in various textures and shapes. Thick, dark paint drips down from the top and middle sections, creating long vertical streaks over the lighter background. In the center, a rounded or semi-circular shape sits above a rectangular piece of plain, light-colored paper. The entire composition is framed in a simple, rectangular wooden frame. The whole image has a warm, yellow-orange color cast.

title: Son of Goursar
alt_text: A painting shows a large, dark, textured shape centered against a background of muted grays and browns. The main form is a deep black rectangle with thick, rugged edges that looks like a heavy block. Above this, a smaller rectangular black shape rests on top, attached by a thin vertical line. The surfaces appear rough and layered with paint, creating a sense of depth and shadow. Subtle hints of dark red and charcoal gray are visible in the surrounding areas.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of three large, rough-edged shapes against a plain white background. At the top left, there is a dark, greyish-blue rounded shape. To its right, a similar shape is colored in a light, sandy brown. Below these two, a wide, horizontal purple shape stretches across the bottom portion of the canvas. All the shapes have soft, uneven borders that look like they were painted with thick, sweeping brushstrokes.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes is framed and mounted on a wall. It features a muted color palette dominated by shades of brown, tan, and creamy off-white. The brushstrokes are thick and blended, creating large, uneven patches of color rather than specific forms. A strip of light-brown tape runs across the top of the frame with some numbers written on it in black marker. The entire image has a warm, orange-toned glow from the surrounding lighting.

title: Khaza
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured shapes with a muted color palette. The center of the canvas features a large, light-colored, rounded form that dominates the composition. Around this shape, dark, thin, branch-like lines curve and intersect, creating a sense of movement or a cage-like structure. The background is a mix of layered, streaky gray, white, and pale yellow tones. Some areas of the surface appear rough and raised, adding depth to the visual texture. A signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the painting.

title: The Visitor
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a large, abstract, dark shape centered against a background of horizontal red and black stripes. This central form has rough, thick texture and varies in color, featuring patches of grey, white, cream, and a curved streak of blue. Within the lower part of this shape, there is a block of bright red paint with small, vertical tooth-like marks. Below the main mass, thin, uneven white lines curve and zigzag across the bottom section. The overall effect is messy and layered, with some paint colors appearing smeared into others.

title: Yellow Light
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured shapes in muted tones. The center of the piece features patches of dark brown, black, and dull orange paint applied in thick, rough strokes. These darker areas are surrounded by larger, lighter sections of beige, tan, and olive green. The paint application varies, appearing smooth and blended in some areas and thick and raised in others. The entire composition has a soft, hazy quality that fills the canvas frame.

title: Meteor I
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows an abstract, textured cluster of colors concentrated in the center of a light, muted background. The central area features thick, layered strokes of dark gray, black, olive green, and bright red paint. These colors blend into each other, creating a dense and somewhat rough, uneven surface. The surrounding background is a soft, flat shade of light gray that fades outward toward the edges of the canvas. The artwork stands on a wooden cart with wheels inside a room with a light-colored floor.

title: Assault
alt_text: A steel sculpture shows a cluster of rusty metal parts attached to a rectangular base. At the top sits a large, tilted cylinder that looks like a small drum or container. Several smaller, curved metal bars and mechanical shapes extend outward in different directions. These pieces appear to be welded together, creating a chaotic and busy arrangement. The entire sculpture is brown and weathered, resting against a plain, light background.

title: Organic Form IV
alt_text: A steel sculpture shows a dark, abstract object perched on a small base. The main body resembles a jagged, thin creature with long limbs that extend horizontally to the left and right. One long, sharp spike points downward toward the base, while another leg-like part bends at a sharp angle to touch the ground. The metal surface appears smooth and slightly weathered with a dark gray color. The sculpture has an open, skeletal frame with distinct gaps between its pieces.

title: Lilith
alt_text: A painting of abstract, tall shapes arranged against a dark, textured background. In the center, there is a cluster of vertical rectangles with varied patterns, including polka dots, wavy lines, and horizontal stripes. These shapes are colored in muted shades of pink, blue, tan, and dark grey. To the right, a separate, narrower rectangular form stands against a background of striped floor lines. A large, dark-yellow, oval shape is visible on the far right edge of the frame.

title: No. 1-59
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured shapes layered on a raw canvas background. Thick, dark strokes of black paint create a large, circular loop in the upper right area. Below this, a tangled mess of green paint forms a smaller, irregular circle on the left side. Streaks of bright red and muted yellow paint cut across the center in different directions. These bold marks contrast with the lighter, brownish tone of the unpainted canvas visible underneath.

title: Kazan
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes set against a solid, light beige background. Thick, textured brushstrokes in dark purple and black create an irregular, jagged frame that occupies the center of the canvas. In the very middle of these dark marks, there is a soft, light blue shape. Drawn directly on top of this blue area is a thick, uneven white circle. The entire work is framed by a simple gold-colored border.

title: Boy and the Bridge
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting outdoors in front of a bridge. The person has dark skin and is wearing a bright red jacket over a white shirt. They also wear dark pants and are sitting on a chair. Behind the person, a tall, metal bridge structure spans the background. The scene is painted with visible, rough brushstrokes in shades of grey, white, and brown.

title: Peinture
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and colors set against a dark background. Thick, swirling layers of grey and white paint dominate the upper and central parts of the canvas. These light-colored areas contrast sharply with the solid black void below. A single, bold vertical streak of bright red sits on the left side of the composition. Hints of deep purple and blue bleed into the black, adding subtle texture to the bottom of the work.

title: Secret Life
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured forms rendered in deep, moody colors. Thick layers of dark paint dominate the surface, creating a rough, uneven texture that catches the light. Patches of intense red and purple emerge from the shadows, providing strong contrast against the darker areas of charcoal and black. The composition feels dense and layered, with swirls of thick pigment creating irregular, organic shapes across the canvas. A few lighter highlights appear near the top and bottom, adding depth to the otherwise shadowy scene.

title: Arrival
alt_text: A painting of a thick, blue, amoeba-shaped form that sits in the center of the canvas against an orange-red background. Inside this blue shape is a circular cutout that reveals a detailed, collage-like scene with varied textures. This inner circle contains patches of tan, grey, black, and splashes of red and green. The blue border around the circle is textured with thick, uneven paint strokes and small embedded debris. The overall composition appears abstract, with visible brushwork and layered paint applications throughout the surface.

title: Sibyl
alt_text: A painting shows a large, circular, abstract form set against a lighter, brushed background. A deep, dark brown shape sits in the center of this circle, filled with thick, energetic lines. To the left of this dark center, the painting features a wide, smooth expanse of bright orange. The right side of the circle blends into muted purple and green tones, while lighter, grayish brushstrokes surround the entire form. A small, dark signature is visible in the lower-left corner of the canvas.

title: Red Abstraction
alt_text: A painting of vertical rectangular shapes arranged in columns across the entire surface. The canvas is filled with a repeating pattern of narrow, flat-topped bars that look like bricks or tiles standing upright. Most of the shapes are in shades of red, ranging from deep crimson to light pink. Interspersed among the red tones are scattered, solid-colored bars in dark navy blue and forest green. The overall effect is a textured, mosaic-like grid that covers the painting from edge to edge.

title: Fable
alt_text: A painting of oil on canvas shows a chaotic splash of thick, colorful paint against a mostly blank background. A large, heavy column of black paint dominates the left side of the frame. To the right of the black area, a wide, bright red shape curves downward, filling the center. Smaller patches of yellow, blue, and green paint are scattered around the edges and tucked into the texture. The paint appears raised and applied with visible, rough brushstrokes.

title: The Africa Coast
medium: Braided steel cable, wood, and welded steel
alt_text: A sculpture made of braided steel cable, wood, and welded steel shows a tall, thin figure lifting a circular object above its head. The figure appears elongated with spindly limbs, standing on a dark, rectangular base. Its raised arms support a rounded shape that has three small, dark holes near the bottom, resembling a face. The overall texture is rough, with a dark brown and rusted appearance. The sculpture stands vertically, balanced on a single point on the base.

title: Day's End
alt_text: A painting showing horizontal bands of red, black, and white paint. In the center, a large, rectangular block of cream and brown shades tilts diagonally. To the bottom left, a section of mustard yellow contains a single, small red dot. A dark blue-gray rectangle sits in the upper right corner, contrasting with the warm colors nearby. At the very bottom, a textured white area meets a dark, abstract shape resembling a thin, pointed arc. The entire composition is framed within a plain, thin border.

title: Hermine
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows an abstract composition with layers of dark and muted colors. A prominent, large, pale grey shape occupies the center, textured with thin, swirling circular lines that look etched into the surface. The background consists of deep forest greens, dark blacks, and muddy blues that surround the central grey form. A small patch of bright red paint sits in the upper right section, contrasting with the otherwise somber tones. The overall surface appears thick and textured, suggesting layers of heavy paint application.

title: Ception
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes in black and white. Thick, dark, ink-like strokes curl and twist across a pale, off-white background. These irregular forms create a dense, layered texture that fills the entire rectangular canvas. The edges of the shapes appear rough and jagged, contrasting sharply against the light spaces. A thin, gold-toned frame surrounds the painting, which hangs against a grey, gridded wire wall.

title: Bambola
alt_text: A bronze sculpture depicts a small, standing figure with a greenish, weathered surface. The figure has a thin body with arms extended to the sides and bent legs, giving it the appearance of dancing or moving. Its head is somewhat abstract, appearing flat on top like a wide-brimmed hat. The figure is mounted vertically onto a simple, rectangular dark wood base. This base sits on a smooth, flat surface.

title: Oto
alt_text: A painting of abstract black shapes on a plain, light-colored background. Two vertical, curved pillars stretch from the bottom to the top of the canvas, framing the center. Between these pillars, a horizontal black bar crosses the middle of the composition. Above the bar sits a small, dark, circular shape. Below the horizontal bar is a larger, round, textured form that spans most of the space between the vertical pillars.

title: Adam
alt_text: A painting showing abstract shapes and bold colors. A large, dark gray mass curves across the right side of the canvas, set against a bright red background. To the left, there are swathes of purple, black, and white paint with bright green lines. The bottom of the painting features orange and muted white areas that look like smeared brushstrokes. The entire artwork is framed and sits on a wooden easel in what appears to be a storage area.

title: Autumn
alt_text: A painting shows a flat, purple-blue background that fills most of the canvas. At the bottom, a solid, textured horizontal band of light gray creates a clear division. Floating in the upper section are three dark, horizontal brushstrokes of varying lengths and angles. To the left sits a single red, hand-drawn rectangular outline. Scattered throughout the purple area are several thin, vertical, dark lines that look like simple markings or scratches.

title: Gracieuse Figure
alt_text: A welded steel sculpture on a wood base showing abstract, thin lines that form an open shape. The metal lines rise from a small, square brown base. These lines twist and cross each other as they go upward, creating a hollow, cage-like structure. Near the top, the metal curves outward to form a shape resembling a plant or a branch with small spikes. The background is a plain, light gray surface that puts all the focus on the dark metal sculpture.

title: The Spawning
alt_text: A painting showing a variety of abstract shapes and colors layered together. Large areas of soft, smoky gray and muted gold stretch across the middle of the composition. Dark, black shapes cut across these lighter sections, creating thick, jagged lines and deep shadows. Patches of bright purple appear in several spots, adding vibrant contrast to the more neutral tones. Thin, sketch-like lines twist through the center, connecting the different blocks of color.

title: Equestrian with Sprawing Woman (Reverse: Broom Riding Witches)
alt_text: A painting on plywood shows two figures in a wooded area. In the foreground, a reddish-skinned person with dark hair lies on the green ground. Behind them, a second figure with a pale face sits on top of a dark horse. Dark, vertical tree trunks fill the background of the scene. To the left of the framed painting, a small, off-white fabric object sits on a tan surface.

title: Zoraster
alt_text: A painting with an abstract composition features a large, bright red circular shape dominating the center. This bold red line curves downward and loops around, crossing over itself in a dark black brushstroke. Thick, textured layers of white, light blue, and beige paint fill the background, creating a sense of movement. Darker streaks of black and hints of muted purple and orange paint are layered underneath and around the central red shape. A name and a year are written in light, thin lines in the bottom left corner.

title: Pilotes
alt_text: A painting of abstract forms uses thick black lines and bold splatters of red and orange against a cream background. On the upper left side, a large, curved red shape dominates the composition, appearing segmented like a puzzle piece. To the right, a darker, textured orange figure hangs vertically, with dripped paint running down its sides. Heavy black lines intersect across the canvas, connecting these shapes with chaotic, web-like strokes. Smaller spots of black and red paint are scattered throughout, adding a sense of movement to the scene.

title: The Raven
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes features a large, dark, irregular black form that dominates the center of the canvas. This central black shape is framed by thick, black, box-like lines that are painted over a light, off-white background. Underneath and surrounding the black form are smudged areas of light pink, tan, and gray, with splashes of bright red paint accenting the composition. To the right, vertical red stripes stand out against the lighter background tones. A signature in the bottom right corner appears to read "RONALD."

title: Rodeo
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and lines in bright colors. Large patches of vibrant green and yellow dominate the composition. Interspersed among the fields of color are dark, thick, black brushstrokes that curve and cut across the canvas. Below the main forms, distinct areas of deep purple and muted white add contrast to the painting's layout. The overall effect is a textured surface created by visible, layered brushwork.

title: Two Tier Painting
alt_text: A painting of a still life scene set on a vibrant red table. The red tabletop takes up the lower two-thirds of the canvas and features a small green plant in a pot next to a thin white object. Above the table, a horizontal orange stripe runs across a deep purple background. Resting on this orange ledge are three light blue shapes that resemble jars or pitchers against a dark, shadowy area. A single long, thin green vine hangs down from the top edge towards the middle of the painting. The entire work is composed of loose, textured brushstrokes in bright, contrasting colors.

title: October III - 1955
alt_text: A painting shows a chaotic arrangement of thick, textured shapes and heavy lines in dark colors. Large swaths of deep blue serve as the background for the composition. Sharp black lines and blocks of white paint crisscross the canvas, creating angular forms. Patches of muted brown, grey, and dusty pink provide small areas of contrast against the bolder strokes. The thick application of paint gives the entire image a rough and layered surface.

title: The Mandarin
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas featuring a complex arrangement of dark, intersecting lines against a muted, light brown background. Thick, black brushstrokes create a web of geometric and curved shapes that dominate the center of the frame. Some of these lines form rectangular or triangular sections, while others look like rough sketches of circles or ovals. The edges of the composition fade into a darker, almost black, color around the border. The overall effect is a dense, abstract network of lines that overlap and crisscross in a seemingly random pattern.

title: Dipinto
medium: Collage with oil and burlap on canvas
alt_text: A painting of an abstract composition created with oil, paint, and textured burlap on canvas. The upper left side features a dark, scratchy brown area containing a small square patch of white and blue. To the right, a vertical band of deep red connects to a large, textured patch of faded green and tan. The bottom half of the canvas is mostly dominated by a rough, earthy brown color over layers of green and grey. Two dark, circular shapes sit near the center of this lower section, surrounded by a grid-like burlap texture.

title: The Seine
alt_text: A painting of many dark, scratchy marks across a pale background. The background is mostly off-white, with light tan or gray areas scattered throughout. Densely packed black and brown lines swirl across the canvas in various directions. On the right side, a few longer, thinner lines angle upwards, contrasting with the tighter, shorter marks elsewhere. The overall image feels energetic and messy, as if made with quick, rhythmic strokes of a brush or pen.

title: Painting #4
alt_text: A painting of thick, dark, sweeping brushstrokes covers a blue and white background. The long, black strokes dominate the center of the canvas, moving in different directions across the frame. Beneath these dark areas, patches of bright blue paint blend into lighter, white spaces. A small section near the center reveals a splash of deep orange or red. To the left, a few faint streaks of green appear against the dark paint. The entire composition has a rough and energetic appearance.

title: Night of the Yellow Eye
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured shapes in a chaotic arrangement. The composition is dominated by thick, visible brushstrokes in dark colors like black, deep blue, and brown. A prominent white, rounded shape sits near the top center, contrasting with the dark surrounding areas. A large, blotchy patch of dark red paint lies slightly below the center. The edges of the painting show exposed, lighter-colored paper or canvas.

title: Phoenix
alt_text: A painting of abstract, sweeping brushstrokes covers the canvas with energy and movement. Dark, tangled lines of deep blue, black, and vibrant red dominate the center of the piece.
