These bold colors contrast against a background of lighter, softer tones like tan, cream, and muted yellow. Splashes of orange and green add complexity to the swirling composition. The edges of the canvas remain mostly neutral, allowing the focused, dense cluster in the middle to stand out.

title: Figure Study, Italy II
alt_text: A painting of a person’s face and shoulders fills the canvas. Thick, visible brushstrokes create the figure in shades of tan, brown, and muted green. The surface of the painting is very textured, with lumps of paint that seem to build up the features of the face. Some hints of reddish-pink color appear near the center of the face and on the shoulders. The background is a soft, light-colored blur that blends into the colors of the figure. A thin, brown wooden frame borders the entire piece.

title: Midday
alt_text: A painting of abstract, colorful shapes spread across a textured background of earthy yellow. The center of the piece features a cluster of small squares and rectangles in white, black, blue, and orange. To the right, a larger area of bold orange and yellow blocks creates a rough, irregular form. The background consists of muddy olive and golden shades that seem to blend together with visible brushstrokes. A patch of white paint sits near the bottom right corner, partially hidden by the colored shapes.

title: Surveyor's Instruments
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and symbols set against a background of bright, blended red, orange, and yellow paint. Dominating the center is a large, dark, triangular shape with long, thin legs extending downward. Near the top left, a small blue circle rests inside a yellow ring, beside a black spiral. A solid white circle sits in the bottom left, while a darker black circle surrounded by a maroon border is positioned on the bottom right. A wavy black line curves along the right side of the canvas.

title: Composition #13
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and bold colors set against a light cream background. A large, solid red circle dominates the upper-left portion, layered with smaller, angular blocks of yellow, blue, and green paint. To the right, a concentrated cluster of deep blue and black brushstrokes creates a jagged, textured effect. A smaller, solid block of deep green sits near the bottom center, anchoring the composition. Scattered, rectangular strokes of bright yellow and green are spread across the bottom half of the canvas, adding to the energetic feel.

title: Encounter
alt_text: An iron sculpture shows a small, weathered display made of rusted metal components. A thick, rectangular base supports three thin, vertical rods of different heights. Attached to the top of two rods are small, circular, flat shapes. In the center, there is a small metal block attached to the base, with other thin, L-shaped pieces sticking out from it. The sculpture sits on a light-colored surface, likely a shelf in a storage room.

title: The Blue Bottle
alt_text: A painting of a still life set against a dark red background. In the center, a light purple cloth rests on a dark surface and holds several objects. On the left side of the cloth, there is a curved, bright yellow piece of fruit. Next to the fruit, a small knife with a light blue blade points downward. On the right side of the cloth stands a tall, slender blue bottle. The entire scene is enclosed in a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Only the Wise Look Up
alt_text: A painting of five tall, pillar-like shapes standing in a row on a yellow ground. The background is a textured, light gray filled with small, scattered specks of dark color. The shapes resemble totem poles and are decorated with abstract patterns in yellow, green, brown, and purple. One figure on the left is topped with a large, golden-yellow oval form that contains a dark, eye-like shape. To the right, another figure has a smaller, jagged yellow shape at its top. These figures have thin, spindly lines connecting parts of their designs, and some have small, spiky protrusions on their sides.

title: Arc Seed
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and lines against a dark, cloudy background. The upper portion contains small, glowing red and orange dots scattered like distant lights. Below this, a large area of swirling green and blue paint stretches across the middle of the canvas. Thin, sharp white lines crisscross the entire surface, creating a tangled, web-like pattern. Near the bottom center, a bright yellow light glows softly through the surrounding dark colors.

title: Abstraction
alt_text: A painting of abstract, blurry shapes and colors creates a sense of movement. Soft shades of pale blue, white, and grey wash across most of the canvas. Near the center, a dark black shape anchors the composition, contrasting with the lighter tones surrounding it. Streaks of bright orange and red add sharp highlights near the right and center areas. The paint appears to be applied in thick, blended layers, giving the image a hazy and dreamlike quality.

title: On the Sea, October, 1954
alt_text: A painting on canvas features a collection of abstract shapes in warm yellow, orange, and brown tones. A large, bright orange circle sits slightly off-center in the upper-right section. Several dark, blocky shapes in brown and black are scattered throughout the composition, resembling irregular pillars or patches. Delicate, thin lines are drawn over parts of the painting, adding fine details to the larger colored forms. The entire artwork is held within a simple, light-colored rectangular frame.

title: Composition IV
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes on a grey background. Large, dark, brushy black forms dominate the center and right side of the frame. Thin, bright orange and white lines cross over these black areas, creating a sense of layered movement. A smaller, rectangular patch of soft pink sits near the top right, while a white block appears in the bottom right corner. To the left, a long, thin vertical line in dark red hangs down against the neutral background.

title: Painting
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes in muted tones. The composition features blocks of dark grey, olive green, and beige arranged in a layered, blocky style. In the center, a splash of bright orange sits atop a light blue shape that looks somewhat like a tilted vessel. To the right, a darker green, rectangular form stands upright against the background. Deep brown and black shadows ground the bottom of the painting, giving the image a sense of weight. The surface has visible, thick brushstrokes that add texture to the colors.

title: Carafe
alt_text: A painting of a blue, vase-like shape centered against a vibrant red and orange background. Thick, expressive brushstrokes in shades of blue create an abstract outline of a rounded object with a tall, narrow neck. Swirls of dark blue lines crisscross the bottom half of this shape like tangled yarn or netting. Bright red paint marks, ranging from tiny dots to thick slashes, appear scattered throughout the entire surface. A thin, curving yellow line cuts across the middle, adding a contrasting touch of color to the predominantly red and blue composition.

title: Still Life with Cloth
alt_text: A painting of a still life scene with a vase and some fruit. A tall, rust-colored bottle sits in the center of the table, holding a small bouquet of bright yellow flowers. The bottle rests on a bright yellow cloth that is spread across a light tan surface. Three round, green pieces of fruit are scattered on the right side of the yellow cloth. In the background, a dark blue wall contrasts with the lighter colors of the table setting.

title: Piazza San Marco #1-1954
alt_text: A painting in oil on board shows a street scene framed by two tall, dark buildings. The building on the left is painted with light gray lines, while the building on the right is a deep, solid black. Between these two structures, a glowing, tan-colored building with rounded arches stands in the background. A single, tall, reddish-brown vertical pole stands in the foreground, stretching from the bottom toward the top of the frame. The sky above is filled with thick, textured brushstrokes in shades of white, gray, and black.

title: In Transit
alt_text: A painting featuring a vibrant orange background with abstract black and white shapes. A large, dark black wedge shape dominates the center, angled toward the left side of the frame. To the right of the black shape, a large white circular form appears with textured, dark brushstrokes running across it. Below, white and grey painted areas extend across the bottom with a smaller black arch shape on the far right. A signature and the year 1954 are written in black script in the bottom right corner.

title: Seated Lady
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on a red couch against a dark wall. The woman faces forward with a calm expression, wearing a dark, heavy coat with a fur-like collar and a reddish-brown hat. She is seated on the left side of a deep red, cushioned sofa that stretches across the center of the frame. The wall behind her is a shadowy, muted gray with vertical brushstrokes. Her long, dark skirt spreads out to cover the rest of the sofa and the floor area.

title: Paris in Winter
alt_text: A painting of a city scene on a gloomy, snowy day. An arched stone bridge crosses over a dark river in the center of the scene. Tall, narrow buildings stand along the riverbank on the right side, their roofs covered in patches of white snow. Thick, dark paint strokes show a heavy, overcast sky above the buildings and trees. A few small, indistinct figures walk along the path near the bridge. The overall colors are muted with dark browns, greys, and deep greens, with bright white highlights representing snow.

title: Fish
alt_text: A painting shows a stylized, horizontal fish centered against a solid, warm-toned background. The fish has a rounded, textured body that shades from dark brown to a lighter yellow-white at the head. A simple spiral sits in the center of the white head to represent an eye. The tail is made of several overlapping, thin white lines that create a geometric, triangular shape. Similar thin lines extend from the top and bottom of the body, appearing like fins.

title: Still Life with Tomatoes
alt_text: A painting of three pieces of fruit sitting on a tabletop. On the left sits a round, red fruit with a stem. In the center is a sliced red fruit showing its internal texture. To the right lies a yellow, oval-shaped fruit. The background features a wall of light red square tiles and a dark vertical shape. The entire image is enclosed within a wide, textured wooden frame.

title: Still Life with Clock
alt_text: A painting of a still life scene set on a textured, gray tabletop. On the left, a tall, dark-framed clock with a white face stands beside a textured, brown curtain. To the right of the clock, a white bowl filled with colorful, abstract shapes sits on top of a folded newspaper. The newspaper is gray and has the word "GAZET" partially visible on its surface. A small, pale, oval object rests on the table surface in the bottom left corner. In the background, a dark wall features a small, glowing yellow crescent moon shape near the top.

title: Fantasy Queen
alt_text: A painting of a stylized figure wearing a tall, intricate crown and an olive-green garment. The figure has a long neck and a pale face with large, dark eyes. They wear a simple necklace with a single dark oval pendant at the center of their chest. A textured, brownish-red fabric drapes over their shoulders, while a hand rests at the bottom of the frame. To the right side of the figure, a curtain with a teal tint hangs against a grey background.

title: Jeanie
alt_text: A painting shows a small figure in a yellow hat standing near a calm body of water. Tall trees rise up on the right side of the scene against a hazy, yellow-toned background. A small, dark bird flies in the sky above the center of the landscape. The entire scene is framed by a painted, rounded-corner border in shades of orange and yellow. At the bottom, a small plaque painted onto the surface reads "Jeanie."

title: Metal Work
alt_text: A sculpture of a geometric shape features a flat, metallic surface with deep grooves. The sculpture is mounted on a rectangular panel, and its color is a dull, muted gold. Two wide, straight strips of metal intersect at an angle, creating a V-like formation. One strip extends diagonally upward, while the other sits horizontally below it. A dark, triangular point is visible at the very bottom left corner of the composition.

title: Rincon
alt_text: A sculpture of painted wood and metal displays a disorganized collection of brightly colored geometric shapes. Large, flat forms in shades of red, green, blue, and orange are stacked on top of each other. Some pieces are curved like crescents or leaves, while others are straight rectangles or long strips. The entire assembly sits on top of a gray metal tray with a cardboard insert. It creates a cluttered, abstract arrangement that appears to be resting on a flat surface.

title: Painting #42
alt_text: A painting of a large, two-story house with a complex roofline. The house is painted white with detailed trim and has a distinct, patterned green shingle roof with pointy gables. A wraparound porch on the front level is draped with thin, brown, leafless vines. Tall, bare trees rise up behind the house on both the left and right sides. In the foreground, a patch of grass and shrubs sits between the house and a paved walkway.

title: Information: Degas Room
medium: Gouache and graphite on paper, mounted on wood
alt_text: A painting showing two large, ghostly figures standing beneath a pair of classical columns. The two tall figures, rendered in a pale, translucent yellow tone, stand side-by-side with their hands held near their faces. Above them, a small winged figure sits atop the horizontal beam connecting the two pillars. A small man in a blue coat and yellow pants stands in the foreground, facing the columns and holding a hat at his side. The entire scene is washed in a monochromatic, golden-yellow light.

title: Untitled Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a coastal landscape shows a paved pier extending into dark water. On the left, a vibrant green grassy slope runs alongside the edge of the pier. Several short, light-colored wooden posts stand in a line along the side of the pier, casting small shadows. Across the water, rolling hills with patches of green and yellow rise against a muted, cloudy sky. A small white sailboat is visible in the water near the base of the hills.

title: Boatyard II
alt_text: A painting of stacks of wooden beams and planks in a construction area. The scene is filled with layers of brown wood, with some beams lying flat on the ground and others stacked high on wooden platforms. In the background, a large, curved wooden structure rises up against a pale blue sky. A small patch of bright green fabric or plastic is tucked underneath the wood on the left side. Shadows fall across the lower sections of the wooden pile, creating dark spaces between the beams.

title: Enough
alt_text: A bronze sculpture with a wood base shows many small, metallic figures arranged in a line. The tiny figures are posed in various stances, appearing to be linked together to form letters that spell the word "ENOUGH." Each figure has a shiny, golden-brown finish and is attached to a flat, rectangular piece of light-colored wood. The entire sculpture sits in the center of a large, shallow grey storage tray. This scene is set against a blurry, industrial-looking background that appears to be a shelving unit.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a man's face and upper chest is set within a dark frame with a gold border. The man has light, wavy hair and a short, grey-tinted beard that covers his chin. He wears a dark jacket over a white collared shirt that is open at the neck. His gaze is directed forward toward the viewer with a serious expression. The background behind him is a plain, dark, and slightly mottled brown color.

title: Aim High
alt_text: A painting of two women using bows and arrows in a dark, outdoor setting. Both figures stand in the lower portion of the frame and reach their arms upward while holding large bows. Behind them, there are dark, shadowy trees that fill the middle of the scene. High above the women, a pair of legs is visible near the top left corner, seemingly suspended in the air. The overall image has a muted, monochrome tone with strong contrasts between light and dark areas.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of an abstract composition features a tangled web of thick, black lines on a light beige background. These dark lines crisscross to form geometric shapes like triangles, rectangles, and circular patterns across the center of the canvas. Scattered among the black lines are small, flat shapes colored in muted shades of gray, dark green, and a single splash of reddish-orange. The background is mostly empty, giving the busy center a sense of floating weightlessly. The overall design looks like a complex, broken structure or a jumbled collection of sharp angles and intersecting paths.

title: Lavender Shadows
alt_text: A painting shows a street scene with several houses under a clear blue sky. In the foreground, a dark utility pole stands vertically, slicing through the scene, with power lines stretching across the top. To the right, a large white house is partially visible, featuring a porch bathed in strong shadows. Next to it sits a brown house with a prominent porch and stairs leading up. Further back on the left, another house appears in softer, muted tones, and a red chimney rises near the trees. Patches of white snow cover the ground in the lower portion of the painting.

title: Mr. Richard Brown Baker Painted from Life
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting and holding an open book. He faces forward and wears a brown suit jacket over a light-colored vest and a collared shirt with a tie. His dark hair is neatly parted, and his expression is neutral. The man holds a small book with a bright red cover open in his hands. The background is a simple, dark green color that contrasts with his suit. A worn, light-colored wooden frame surrounds the entire portrait.

title: Portrait of Marion North Brown (1881–1973)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting for a portrait against a simple dark green background. The woman has short, wavy dark hair and wears a dark blue blouse with a v-neck collar. A simple gold band sits around her neck like a choker. Her hands are resting on her lap, and she holds a thin, white object that looks like a cigarette between her fingers. She wears a small ring on one finger. The entire scene is enclosed in an ornate, distressed gold-colored frame.

title: La Petite Faucille
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an abstract, dark metal figure standing on a square, light-colored base. The sculpture is tall and thin with uneven, jagged parts that extend in several directions. A solid central pole supports the various branches and angled shapes of the bronze form. The bottom of this vertical metal piece connects to a flat, pale stone block that rests on the surface. Overall, the dark, textured metal contrasts sharply with the smooth, simple stand below it.

title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt, known as the Madonna della Pappa
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small child in her lap while an angel offers them a bowl. The woman has light brown hair and wears a pale pink top with a dark blue cloth draped over her legs. She holds a young, curly-haired child who is wrapped in a white cloth and is putting a finger to their lips. In the lower left, an angel with soft, multi-colored wings holds out a small plate with a spoon toward them. Behind the woman, an older man with a grey beard sits in the shadows and holds a small bunch of red cherries. The scene is set in an outdoor area with trees and a rocky landscape visible in the background.

title: Crack and Warp Stack
alt_text: A sculpture made of ashwood stands in the center of a room as a tall, slender pillar. It is constructed from many thin, horizontal layers of light-colored wood stacked on top of one another. Each layer has uneven, slightly curved edges, giving the column a textured and organic appearance. Behind the sculpture, the room features a high ceiling with a triangular grid pattern and smooth, light-colored wooden floors. Other smaller displays are visible in the distance, including a red cluster and some framed pieces on a wall.

title: Untitled
medium: Pig skull with globe, collaged currency, and mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture of a pig skull is covered in a collage of paper dollar bills. Bright red paint outlines the edges of the skull and the jaw. The mouth is held open to display a small, round globe. Inside the jaw are rows of small, yellow, bumpy shapes. A single metal cylinder sits inside the eye socket of the skull.

title: Limestone Pile #3 from A Reasonable Facsimile
medium: Limestone, limes (to be added on installation)
alt_text: A sculpture display shows many gray stones arranged in neat rows and columns on a brown, flat surface. Each stone has a unique white number painted on its surface. To the left of the main group, there is a smaller, separate cluster of lighter, rounder objects. The rocks vary in size and shape but mostly appear smooth and rounded. The entire collection rests on a plain background, creating an organized, grid-like appearance.

title: I Gotcha
alt_text: A painting of dark, dripping shapes against a light background. A wide band of dark gray sits along the entire top edge of the frame. This gray shape hangs down in three long, rounded drips that look like liquid running down a wall. Below the gray drips, the rest of the canvas is a flat, pale cream color. The bottom edge of the painting shows a thin, plain white border.

title: The Orchestra Pit, Old Proctor's Fifth Avenue Theatre
alt_text: A painting of the back of a person’s head and shoulders, looking toward a stage. This person is dressed in a dark jacket and is seated behind a red curtain that hangs from a shiny gold rail. On the stage in the distance, a ballerina in a pink dress bends forward, while other figures stand in the background near some musical instruments. To the left of the central figure, two men with dark hair are visible behind a music stand. The background walls are painted a dull light green, contrasting with the dark red curtain in the foreground.

title: Ice Flow Allagash
alt_text: A painting of white ice floating in deep blue water. A large, flat-topped chunk of ice sits in the center of the frame. Its side is dark and jagged, showing a clear reflection in the water below. Smaller pieces of white ice are scattered around the main block and along the bottom edge of the scene. Across the top, a solid, textured bank of white ice stretches horizontally across the view.

title: Serene Presence
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a pale, mostly white background framed by a simple gold border. In the center, there is a large, textured patch of off-white paint that looks thick and raised. Above this rough patch sits a single, dark, blurry smudge. Below the central texture, a soft, faint gray shape curves toward the bottom right corner. The overall composition is abstract and uses mostly muted, light colors.

title: Chorus Captain
alt_text: A painting of a woman wearing a large, pink feather headdress against a dark background. The woman has brown hair, wears a jeweled headband, and has a string of white pearls around her neck. She is dressed in a light pink brassiere top. Below her waist, a hint of a dark blue or green garment is visible. The woman faces forward with a serious expression and her arms rest by her sides.

title: Imitation Knotty Pine
medium: Clear pine, brass, and inlaid knotty pine
alt_text: A sculpture of a wooden box, made of clear pine with inlaid knotty pine, rests on a plain background. The box has a slanted shape, leaning to the right. Its surface is a warm orange-brown color, decorated with several darker, circular wood knots. A small, brass keyhole plate is embedded in the center of the front panel. The corners of the box show visible, rectangular joints connecting the wood pieces.

title: Untitled
medium: Maple sapling, pear wood, and yellow cedar
alt_text: A sculpture of a circular shape formed by a thin, flexible wooden sapling. The sapling is a dark brown color and curves around to create an open loop. A lighter, pale yellow strip of wood winds around the dark sapling, running mostly along the inside edge. At one end of the sapling, a small, light-colored wooden knob or bead is attached. The entire object floats against a plain, light grey background.

title: Dessert Still Life
alt_text: A painting of a table set with a variety of snacks against a dark background. On the left sits a shiny silver container with decorative handles and a lid. In the center, a tiered pedestal dish holds a pile of small, golden-brown baked goods. Below that pedestal, a large, wide bowl is overflowing with bright red raspberries. To the right, a clear glass pitcher is filled with white milk, and a smaller bowl of raspberries sits nearby.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture made of dyed canvas showing a rectangular piece of fabric with rounded bottom corners. The fabric is a solid, dusty pink or tan color with a slightly wrinkled texture. A large, deep semi-circular cutout is positioned at the top center of the piece. The edges of the canvas appear finished with a simple hem. It is displayed flat against a plain, dark background.

title: The Deposition, One of Three Panels from a Tabernacle Wing
alt_text: A painting of several figures gathered around a central person being lowered from a tall structure. The background is painted in a flat, textured gold. A pale figure hangs loosely from the arms of two others standing on ladders, while a man in red kneels below to remove something from the figure’s feet. To the left, a woman in a dark blue robe stands with her head resting on her hand, surrounded by others in colorful, layered clothing. The scene features architectural details like red roofs and patterned walls on the far left and right.

title: The Lamentation, One of Three Panels from a Tabernacle Wing
alt_text: A painting of several figures gathered around a reclining person on a dark platform. In the foreground, a figure in a blue tunic holds the upper body of the reclining person, while another figure in a pink robe lies nearby. A man with a beard stands to the left, gesturing toward them with open hands, and two women stand on the right with their arms raised high. A large, dark, Y-shaped structure stands vertically in the center behind the group. The background is covered in gold leaf, and architectural structures with red roofs appear in the upper corners.

title: Madonna of Humility, One of Three Panels from a Triptych
alt_text: A painting on a panel showing a woman holding a small child against a shimmering gold background. The woman wears a dark, hooded cloak over a reddish-pink dress and looks down toward the child. The child, seated on her lap, wears a patterned yellow cloth and looks up toward a small bird held in the woman's hand. Both figures have faint, circular halos depicted around their heads. The entire painting is enclosed within an elaborate, arched gold frame decorated with twisted columns.

title: The Crucifixion; Virgin Annunciate, One of Three Panels from a Triptych
alt_text: A painting of a tall, pointed, arched panel that is divided into two separate scenes against a gold background. The top, smaller section shows a woman in a dark robe sitting on a bench while reading a book on a stand. The larger, lower section shows a central male figure on a cross, with three other figures standing and kneeling around the base. The person on the cross has wounds on his hands and side, and the three figures below have their hands held together in prayer. Intricate, raised gold designs decorate the wooden frame separating the two scenes.

title: Study of a Female Nude
alt_text: A painting of a reclining figure lying on a textured surface. The person is nude with pale skin and is stretched out horizontally across the middle of the frame. One arm rests near their head, while the other is extended downward toward the bottom left. The background is composed of dark, indistinct shapes that suggest folds of fabric or drapery. The entire scene is painted in muted, shadowy tones with loose, visible brushstrokes.

title: Red on Green
medium: Flowers and leaves in a painted wood box
alt_text: A sculpture of flowers and leaves in a painted wood box shows two cylindrical objects displayed inside an open black case. The box lid is standing upright and displays white text printed on its black surface. Inside the base of the box, two small, wrapped bundles lie side-by-side in a recessed gray foam insert. The bundle on the left is light green, while the bundle on the right is a dark reddish-brown color. Both bundles feature a thin, white paper band wrapped around their centers.

title: Untitled (Reconstructed Capillary Action Piece)
medium: Fabric, dye, water metal pan, rolling metal stand, electric light on cord
alt_text: A sculpture made of fabric, metal, and light shows a tall, translucent yellow veil rising from a basin. The yellow fabric appears damp and stretches upward, suspended from a cord near the top of the frame. Below, a shallow, white metal basin filled with water sits on a small rolling stand with thin, curved metal legs. A bright electric light shines from within the basin, illuminating the bottom of the yellow fabric from underneath. The entire object stands against a plain, light gray background.

title: Study
alt_text: A painting of charcoal on canvas shows a large, pale triangular shape in the center. The triangle points upward, dividing the canvas into three main sections. Dark, textured charcoal marks fill the two side areas, creating a sharp contrast with the light center. Thin, faint lines crisscross over the bottom half of the light area. The overall composition is simple and abstract, relying on the contrast between light and dark tones.

title: Gymnast I
alt_text: A bronze sculpture stands in an outdoor area on a gravel path. The dark metal object has a textured, bumpy surface that looks like rough tree bark. It forms a large, irregular V-shape, with one side reaching straight up and the other side extending out to the right. Behind the sculpture, a row of tall, thin evergreen trees lines the area. A brick building with grey roof shingles and multiple windows serves as the background for the entire scene.

title: Seated Figure on Iron Seat, (from the cycle Midbrain)
alt_text: A sculpture made of burlap and resin shows a headless, armless torso of a person sitting down. The figure is brownish-tan in color with a rough, textured surface. Its hands rest on its thighs, and its legs hang down straight. The sculpture sits directly on top of a plain, dark-brown iron pedestal. The background behind the object is a simple, neutral grey.

title: Virgin and Child, known as the Madonna del Libro
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a baby, shown against a dark background in an oval frame. The woman has light skin and brown hair covered by a dark blue head covering. She wears a bright red top that stands out against the dim surroundings. The baby is resting in her lap, looking upward with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. Their bodies are painted with soft shadows that give them a gentle, rounded appearance.

title: Untitled (Gun)
alt_text: A sculpture of aluminum and plastic shows a long, vertical column of stacked, rectangular blocks attached to a wall. Each block features a large black capital letter on a white background, reading top to bottom as "MY LIFE HAD STOOD A LOADED GUN". The tower of text is tucked into the corner where two grey brick walls meet. Two bright green chairs with thin metal legs sit on the floor on either side of the corner. The room also features a grey concrete pillar and a wooden floor near the bottom of the image.

title: Doormat: Home Sweet Home
alt_text: A sculpture made of polyurethane rubber displays the words "Home Sweet Home" in large, flowing letters. The letters are a pale, peachy-pink color and appear to be raised against the background. They are arranged in three diagonal rows, starting from the top left and ending at the bottom right. The entire background is a bright, solid green color with a fine, textured grid pattern throughout. The rectangular object has slightly jagged, mesh-like edges on all four sides.

title: Color Bar III (67 Unnamed Blues)
medium: Satin and gloss enamel on MDF
alt_text: A painting on a long, narrow wooden board hangs on a white gallery wall. The piece is shaped like a very thin, horizontal rectangle that stretches across most of the view. The surface is decorated with a repeating pattern of vertical stripes in various shades of blue and white. Some stripes are wide and some are very thin, creating a complex rhythm of color. The artwork is mounted directly onto the flat, blank wall in a well-lit indoor space.

title: Annunciatory Angel, One of Three Fragments from a Folding Triptych
alt_text: A painting showing a person with long hair sitting in profile, viewed within a circular frame. The figure wears a dark red top and a long blue cloak that covers their lower half. A small, open book rests on their lap, and they hold their hands against their chest. A large, decorative gold halo with intricate markings surrounds the person's head. The background inside the circle is a textured, weathered orange color, while the corners outside the circle reveal the natural wood panel surface.

title: Verzelini's Acts of Faith (Glass from Paintings of the Life of Christ)
alt_text: A sculpture consisting of a dark wood display cabinet filled with many pieces of blown glass. The cabinet has four wide shelves that hold various types of clear, colored, and patterned glassware like vases, goblets, and plates. These objects are arranged neatly in rows, with some standing upright and others placed on small stands. Below the shelves, white placards with printed text sit on the base of the display case. The entire structure stands against a plain, light-colored wall with a gray floor underneath.

title: Mona Lisa Wipe Out or "Three Wishes"
alt_text: A painting of a ghostly, pale figure covered by a green, dotted veil. The face of the figure appears blurry and fades into the background. Three pale, cocoon-like shapes hang from the figure's mouth on thin dark wires. Below the hanging shapes, a small, dark blue piece of fabric is attached to the center of the image. The bottom of the image shows the faint, crossed arms of the figure against a darker green surface.

title: Slept (Hanna) #2
alt_text: A painting shows a close-up, horizontal view of a person lying down. The person has very pale, soft skin that blends into the background. They wear a fluffy white hat that covers the top of their head. Dark, dramatic makeup surrounds their eyes, and their lips are painted a bright, deep red. A dark, feathery-looking accessory rests near their neck and chin.

title: Level
alt_text: A painting of a snow-covered mountain peak set against a vibrant blue sky. The mountain is large and occupies most of the view, with sharp, jagged ridges covered in bright white snow and blue-tinted ice. Across the center of the painting, the word "LEVEL" is written in large, capital white letters. The text is plain, sans-serif, and sits directly over the mountain's rocky surface. The contrast between the bright, deep blue sky and the light-colored mountain creates a clear, bold composition.

title: Blühende Waldbäume II (Flowering Tree II)
alt_text: A painting of several houses nestled among trees under a blue sky. Three light-colored houses with dark roofs stand as the main buildings in the center and to the left. The front area is a mix of brown earth and patches of green grass. A pale, leafy tree stands prominently in the center, while a thin, darker tree grows near the house on the right. Darker, indistinct tree shapes rise behind the buildings against the bright blue background.

title: Titled (Art as Idea as Idea)
alt_text: A photostat on board shows a dictionary definition of the word "theory" printed in white text on a black background. The text begins with the word "theory" followed by pronunciation guides and the plural form. Beneath the header, there is etymology information and six numbered definitions. Each definition provides a different explanation for the meaning of the word. The entire layout mimics the appearance of a dictionary entry.

title: Portrait of Raymond Henniker-Heaton (1874–1963)
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up. The man has short, dark hair, a thin mustache, and a serious expression while looking off to the left. He wears a white shirt under a heavy, dark coat with a thick, textured, golden-brown fur collar. The background is composed of large, geometric shapes in shades of grey and white. These angular forms create a faceted look that resembles crumpled paper or sharp stone surfaces.

title: Moonlight
alt_text: A painting of a dark, moonlit landscape featuring a reflective river. A large, dark tree with dense foliage occupies the right side of the canvas, partially framing a bright, pale circle that glows in the upper center of the sky. To the left, another large tree stands in shadow against a deep, greenish-blue background. In the lower half, a river stretches across the scene, its surface catching soft, pale light from the moon above. The lower edges of the image are filled with dark, indistinct shapes of bushes or grassy banks.

title: Dr. Joseph Youle (1771–1795)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a watercolor portrait of a person with dark hair. The oval portrait is set in a plain gold frame with a small loop at the top. The person faces forward and has a light complexion with blue eyes. They wear a dark blue coat over a white vest and a detailed, white ruffled cravat. The background is a soft, textured beige color that fades toward the edges.

title: Memorial for Dr. Joseph Youle
medium: Watercolor and dissolved and chopped hair on ivory. Casework: Original oval locket with loose ring hanger. Verso: reverse-glass painting and gilding with inset oval compartment containing cut-gold initials JJY over hairwork.
alt_text: A miniature jewelry locket shows a scene painted with watercolor and hair on ivory. The oval piece features a person in a long dress standing on the left and leaning their head against a tombstone. The tombstone is tall and rectangular, displaying carved text that reads, "DOCR JOSEPH YOULE OB 24 FEB 1795 AE 24 YRS 27 DAYS" and "Sacred will I keep thy dear Remains." Hanging willow branches surround the scene in shades of brown and grey. A simple gold frame holds the image, complete with a round loop at the top for a necklace.

title: Remember
alt_text: A painting of vertical stripes in shades of gray, brown, and black. The composition is divided into several rectangular panels of different widths. On the left side, a light gray stripe sits next to a wider reddish-brown stripe. To the right of these, a second gray stripe and another broad reddish-brown stripe continue the pattern. Finally, a dark black section, split into two horizontal panels, fills the far right edge of the work. The paint application appears thick and slightly textured across the entire surface.

title: Untitled
medium: plexiglass, metal, mercury, and electric motor
alt_text: A sculpture of plexiglass and metal shows a dark, square box with a large circular cutout in the center. Inside this circular opening, a pool of dark liquid rests in the middle. Small, shiny, metallic fragments are scattered throughout this dark substance. The exterior frame of the object is smooth and white. A small label with a barcode sits on the surface below the sculpture.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of plexiglass, mercury, and metal consists of a black, square frame containing a dark, possibly reflective surface. In the center floats a rounded, grey shape that looks somewhat like a bubble or a jellyfish. This central object has a reddish smudge near its top and a small, dark hole or spot. Below the main rounded shape, several pale, petal-like or jagged forms dangle downwards. The entire piece is enclosed in a simple, metallic-looking frame.

title: Switchski's Syntax
medium: Casein and masking tape on canvas
alt_text: A painting with bold, block-like letters in the center that spell out the word "CHAMPION" in black. A thin piece of beige masking tape runs horizontally across the middle of the canvas, cutting through the letters. Several bright green geometric shapes, including sharp diagonal lines, are layered over the black and white background. A vibrant red border frames the top and bottom sections of the rectangular canvas. The rest of the composition features abstract black shapes and solid white circles scattered across the scene.

title: The Screen
alt_text: A painting of an abstract black shape resting on a background of blue and grey panels. This dark, thick form is curved like a wide letter U and spans across the entire upper section of the canvas. The left end of the black shape is thick and touches the left border, while the right end tapers into a point. Behind this dark shape, the background is divided into two main sections. A light blue area sits on the left side, and a larger, darker grey area fills the right side. The paint appears to have a textured, slightly uneven finish throughout.

title: Crew
alt_text: A painting of nine men seated in a line inside a long, narrow boat. The men have fair skin, short brown hair, and wear matching blue shorts. Eight of the men face forward with their bodies turned slightly to the right, each holding a long wooden oar that extends out of the boat. The person at the front of the line sits with his back to the viewer, facing toward the others. They are set against a plain, light green background that suggests water and sky.

title: Dear Traveler
alt_text: A painting of a vast, wintery landscape featuring a large, gnarled tree in the foreground. A woman with dark hair sits near the base of the tree, wearing a blue sweater and knitting a light-colored item. To her left, a figure in a furry coat stands near the water's edge, while a small child and a fox stand on the right side. The background shows a deep blue lake surrounded by snowy mountains under a purple sky. Birds of various colors are perched on the tree branches or flying in the distance. The overall color scheme is dominated by cool purples, whites, and deep blues.

title: Curve Go Slow
alt_text: A painting shows an abstract scene composed of different patterned sections arranged on a beige background. On the left, a large, dark green area filled with small, light green circles sits next to a vertical white shape. To the right, a textured blue section contains horizontal brushstrokes and a brown, triangular form near the top. A light yellow sign with the word "CURVE" and a curved black line floats in the center. Below it, a light brown square filled with a grid of dark circles displays a small sign that says "GO SLOW."

title: Combination Concrete # 2 (Black and White Version)
alt_text: A painting of black lines and shapes arranged on a light, off-white background. The composition features large letters that spell out words like "DRAWING" at the top and "NEW" on the bottom left. Various geometric forms, including squares, rectangles, and abstract wavy lines, overlap and intersect with these letters. Inside some of the shapes are smaller text phrases like "CURVE" and "GO SLOW." Thin, straight lines cut across the entire image, connecting different areas of the design. A single, stylized signature appears in yellow paint near the bottom center.

title: William Brown (1779–1805)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a fair-skinned man in an oval gold frame. The man faces slightly to his left with a neutral expression. He has light-colored hair styled close to his head. He wears a dark coat over a high, white neck cloth. The background behind him is a soft, muted blue-gray color. A small gold loop sits at the very top of the frame for hanging.

title: Ann Brown Vernet (1780–1859)
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a young woman inside an oval gold frame. She has shoulder-length brown curly hair that is styled with a light-colored headband. The woman is wearing a white dress with a yellow bodice, and she holds a stringed instrument near her chest with her left hand. The background is a soft, muted greyish-blue color. Her head is turned slightly to the right as she looks toward the viewer.

title: Elbridge Gerry
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a man framed in an oval metallic setting. He has short, white, neatly brushed hair and is looking directly toward the viewer with a slight smile. He wears a dark blue jacket over a white, ruffled neckcloth and a vest with brown and white stripes. The background is a soft, muted mix of green and dark brown shades. The frame around the portrait has a scalloped, decorative edge and includes a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: 76 Waterbody
alt_text: A rusted steel sculpture consists of a long, narrow strip lying flat on a concrete floor. The strip is rectangular and made up of smaller, square metal plates placed end-to-end. It runs diagonally from the corner where the floor meets a plain white wall, extending out toward the lower left of the frame. The metal is brown and orange with a rough, uneven texture. The surrounding floor is smooth, light gray concrete.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A miniature watercolor showing a portrait of a man framed in decorative gold. The man has curly brown hair, a light beard, and blue eyes. He wears a dark coat over a white shirt and a black cravat. The portrait is oval-shaped and set inside a gold frame with a scalloped, leafy edge. The background behind the man is a simple, light brown color.

title: Spiral
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture of a grid pattern mounted on a rectangular board. The sculpture is colored off-white and consists of several connected square frames arranged in an L-shape that turns inward. The grid forms a single vertical column on the left that extends upward and then bends to the right. Smaller attached squares extend from this vertical column, creating an open, window-like design. The entire sculpture sits on a flat, solid, off-white background with a subtle wood-grain texture.

title: Angelo Bartlett Giamatti, President of Yale 1978-1986
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair, shown from the waist up. He has a short beard and is wearing a dark grey suit with a white shirt and a pink tie. His left hand rests on the arm of the chair, while his right hand rests near a small table. On the table, there is a small red book. The background is a plain, dark, neutral brown color, and the painting is held in a large gold-colored frame with a small light attached to the top.

title: [Mi rajt ånn] #8
alt_text: A painting of a vast, snowy mountain landscape featuring sharp contrasts. The upper section shows jagged mountain peaks in bright white and shades of blue against deep black skies. Below these peaks, a large, smooth area of stark white ground dominates the left and center of the frame. To the right, a dark, rounded shape cuts into the white area, appearing like a large, solid shadow. The entire scene uses broad, flat areas of color to create a dramatic, abstract view of terrain.

title: Baby Eclipse
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes layered with dark, rich colors and textures. A large, circular form dominates the upper portion of the canvas, colored in deep shades of brown and gray. Below this circle sits a large, irregular, dark green shape that spreads across the left and center of the frame. The background is composed of dark, moody tones of red, black, and touches of bright green that look like patches of rust or moss. The entire surface appears thick and rough, suggesting a texture created by layers of paint mixed with sand.

title: Amur
alt_text: A wood and acrylic sculpture shows a very tall, thin, rectangular column standing vertically. The column is painted a solid, dark, muted purple color from top to bottom. It has sharp, straight edges and flat, smooth sides. At the very bottom, there is a thin band of black with a faint, narrow red stripe just above the floor. The object sits centered against a plain, soft grey background.

title: April
alt_text: A wood and acrylic sculpture of a tall, thin rectangular pillar stands upright. The object is a bright, solid yellow color from top to bottom. It rests on a small, white rectangular base that sits against the plain grey floor. The pillar has sharp, straight edges and flat sides. The lighting on the sculpture creates a subtle shadow on its right side, adding a sense of depth to its smooth surface. The background behind the object is a simple, neutral grey gradient.

title: Correspondence
alt_text: A painting of a bright orange background and a large, dark shape. The dark, black shape occupies the left side of the canvas. It has a smooth, curved outline that extends from the top to the bottom edge of the frame. The rest of the painting is a solid, flat expanse of vibrant orange color. The contrast between the dark curve and the orange field is very strong.

title: Die Ungeborenen (The Unborn)
medium: Oil, acrylic, and plaster on lead on canvas
alt_text: A painting on a dark, mottled gray surface displays a scattered arrangement of small, dark, t-shaped forms resembling simple shirts or dresses. These dark shapes are spread across the left, right, and top sections of the canvas. In the center sits a single, pale, branch-like form that spreads upward from a cluster of roots at the bottom. The background has a rough, speckled texture that looks like worn metal or stone. The entire composition has a muted and weathered appearance.

title: Still Life, July-December 1988-89
alt_text: A painting of objects arranged on a brown wooden table. In the foreground, there is a white gravy boat on a saucer to the left and a white handled bowl with holes in the middle. Behind these items, a white teapot with a spiraled design stands next to a dark blue, rectangular tea tin. A piece of white cloth sits bunched up near the bowl and teapot. A small deck of playing cards lies flat on the right side of the table.

title: November Landscape #2, November 1981
alt_text: A painting of a vast, flat landscape under a pale, overcast sky. The foreground is filled with a large, light-green field that shows subtle lines running toward the horizon. In the distance, a small, dark house sits amidst a cluster of thin, bare trees. The horizon line is very low, emphasizing the expanse of the cloudy, muted sky above. A simple, thin frame encloses the entire scene.

title: November Landscape, #1, November 1981
alt_text: A painting of a wide, flat landscape under a pale sky. In the foreground, a large, light green field features rows of cut grass extending toward the horizon. Further back, a small cluster of trees and buildings sits in the center of the image. The sky above is very light and misty, blending from a soft blue at the top to a hazy, white-toned horizon. Three individual trees stand neatly in a row on the far right side of the horizon line.

title: Landscape, July, 1980
alt_text: A painting of a flat, green landscape under a large, pale sky. The bright green field occupies the bottom third of the frame, stretching horizontally across the view. In the middle distance, a small cluster of dark green trees hides a group of small buildings. To the right of these trees, two more dark trees stand by themselves in the field. A thin, horizontal line divides the green field from the light gray sky above. Two slender, vertical poles stand on the horizon line on either side of the trees.

title: Bridle
alt_text: A sculpture of a salt-and-pepper hide hangs suspended in the air by several thin wires. The animal hide is white with scattered black speckles and patches of solid black fur. Several geometric shapes, including rectangles and circles, are cut out of the surface of the hide. A long, thin tuft of black hair hangs straight down from the center of the piece. The hide is spread wide, creating an irregular, star-like outline against a plain background.

title: Church Interior
alt_text: A painting of the inside of a large, stone church with very high vaulted ceilings and tall arched columns. The floor is made of large, alternating light and dark square tiles. In the foreground, small figures of men, women, and children stand and walk on the checkered floor, accompanied by two small dogs. Through the arches, you can see more people gathered in the distance near a wooden altar area. Light streams in from tall windows, casting soft shadows across the expansive, dim interior.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows two separate, boxed-in designs on a light, textured background. On the left, a tall, narrow rectangular border encloses three stacked circular shapes, each containing soft, blurry blue ovals that appear to glow. To the right of this, a smaller, fainter square border frames a single, small blue figure that looks like a winged child playing a trumpet. Both designs are simple in color and are set against an off-white, fabric-like surface. The entire piece is held within a plain, dark wood frame.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a light yellow cloth spread out with a repeating pattern of reddish-brown, leaf-like shapes. Several small, translucent plastic bags containing dark, granular material rest in the center of the fabric. The bags are bunched together and partially overlap one another. The cloth itself has visible folds and soft shadows that give it a three-dimensional appearance. The background behind the fabric is a plain, neutral color.

title: Beach Ball
medium: Oil on canvas on wood with wood artist's frame
alt_text: A painting showing two stylized figures standing on a beach. The figures are colored pink and have long, thin bodies made of straight lines and rectangular sections. Both figures are positioned on a sandy shore in front of an ocean with blue water and white, crashing waves. The figure on the right holds a yellow circle with symbols inside it. The sky above the water is a bright blue with scattered white, fluffy clouds. Small, scattered white shapes litter the sand around the feet of the figures.

title: Ode à l'Oubli
alt_text: A textile fabric book shows red lettering printed on a pale, woven linen surface. The material is laid out flat, displaying a cover spread that includes a front, spine, and back section. Red text is printed on the spine area, oriented vertically. On the right side, the same red text is printed in a larger, block-style arrangement. The woven texture of the light-colored fabric is visible across the entire background.

title: The Taking of Christ
alt_text: A painting of a group of men gathered tightly in a dark space. In the center, a man with long, brown hair and a red robe stands with his eyes closed while another bearded man leans in close to his face. To the right, a soldier wearing a polished, dark metal suit of armor reaches out and grips the first man’s shoulder. Behind them, a person with a weathered face and a beard peeks out, and an arm raised high holds up a lantern that casts light on the scene. A large, deep red fabric hangs behind the figures, draping over the scene from the top left.

title: The Bar-B-Q Inn
medium: Wood, paper, acrylic paint, metal, and red soil
alt_text: A sculpture of a small, one-story building sits on a raised platform covered in red dirt. The structure has a rectangular brick facade at the top and a pale yellow exterior on the lower half. In the center, a set of double doors is painted a reddish-purple color and framed by pale shutters. Two red signs featuring white text hang above the door on the building's front ledge. A thin, dark wire hangs down from the left side of the front exterior.

title: Geo. W. Bush
medium: Acrylic and fiber panel on Celotex, with metal frame
alt_text: A painting of a man's face, shown from the chest up. The artwork has a grainy, textured appearance that looks like static in grey and white tones. The man has short hair and is looking directly toward the viewer with a neutral expression. The image is enclosed within a shiny, metallic-looking rectangular frame. The border of the frame is grey, with a thin black edge surrounding the entire piece.

title: Virgin and Child with the Young Saint John the Baptist and Saint Catherine of Siena
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small child, with another person to her left and a small child to her right. The woman in the center wears a pink dress and has a thin golden ring floating above her head. The person on the left wears a dark veil and a crown of thorns, while holding a white flower. A second small child sits on the right, reaching out to touch a white bird held by the woman and the first child. Behind them is a dark green curtain and a landscape featuring a small stone archway in the distance.

title: Nearby a Finch Was Covering Itself with Pale Dust
alt_text: A painting of a person’s head and shoulders shown in soft, blurred charcoal-like tones on a light tan background. The person looks downward with their eyes closed and their hair pulled back in a simple style. A rectangular hair clip sits on the top right side of their hair. Over the person's chest area, there is a cluster of swirling, messy blue lines that look like a sketch. Small, faint specks and symbols appear near the top of the canvas above the head.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints Vincent Ferrer and Jerome
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on a high throne holding a small child on her lap. She wears a red dress and a blue cloak, while the child is unclothed. To her left stands a man in a black robe holding a red book, and to her right stands an older man with a long beard wearing a purple robe. The throne is carved with small figures near the bottom, and the background shows a landscape with buildings and hills under a pale sky. At the feet of the older man, a lion's head is visible near the bottom right corner. The painting shows signs of age with vertical cracks running across the surface.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of large, abstract shapes in black and white. The composition features solid black forms that contrast sharply against a pale, off-white background. These irregular shapes fit together like pieces of a puzzle across the rectangular canvas. Some shapes are rounded and soft, while others have straight edges and sharp corners. The overall effect is flat and graphic, with no visible depth or shading.

title: Labyrinth
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture of a rectangular plaque features a circular design in the center. The plaque has a textured surface with a repeating pattern of small, embossed diamonds. A circular maze pattern sits prominently in the middle, rendered in smooth, raised lines against the textured background. A single straight line extends from the bottom of the circular maze down to the lower edge of the plaque. The entire object is a uniform, warm light-brown color.

title: Caravan
alt_text: A painting of four distinct color blocks on a light gray background. On the left side sits a dark charcoal-colored rectangle made of two stacked squares. On the right side sits a larger orange shape, which is also composed of two stacked squares. A thin, horizontal dark line runs through the center of all four shapes. The entire composition creates a clean, geometric arrangement against the neutral backdrop.

title: Stem
alt_text: A painting shows a stylized portrait of a person against a solid, light blue-gray background. The person has light, cool-toned skin with a face composed of sharp angles and soft curves. Their hair is black, styled in a bob shape on one side, and trails behind the head in a curved shape. The person wears a shirt decorated with a repeating pattern of small, brown and orange geometric cubes. Their expression is neutral, featuring wide, light blue eyes and a simple, dark brown mouth.

title: Skyscrapers A
medium: Sandblasted opaque flashed glass and frame
alt_text: A painting of white lines on a black background set within a wide, square frame. The frame has a textured, medium-brown surface with small flecks throughout. Inside the frame, a black square contains groups of thin, white horizontal lines. These lines overlap with vertical stacks of short white dashes to create abstract grid-like shapes. The arrangement of these shapes leaves empty black space on the right and bottom sides.

title: Une Famille dans la désolation (A Grief-Stricken Family)
alt_text: A painting of a family sitting in a dimly lit room with stone walls. In the center, a man with a bandage around his head sits in a chair while a woman stands behind him, leaning over with her hand on his shoulder. He holds a white cloth across his lap, and a young boy leans his head against the man’s knee. To the right, a young girl stands alone with her face turned away, holding a small object to her chest. Another child sits beside the boy on the floor, resting his head on his own hands.

title: Steel Nails
alt_text: A welded steel sculpture shows the words "STEEL NAILS" spelled out in capital letters. The letters are constructed entirely from individual, dark, rusty-brown metal nails joined together. The word "STEEL" appears on top, while the word "NAILS" is positioned directly underneath it. The structure is resting on a crumpled, off-white surface. Dark welding marks are visible at the points where the nails connect to one another.

title: Revolving Control
alt_text: A painting shows a chaotic scene filled with bold, colorful, and abstract shapes layered over a grey, cloudy background. On the left, a tall, bright red geometric shape stands near a hazy, green, hill-like formation. A blue, angular shape that looks like an arrow or wing points toward the center from the right. Below the center, a dense cluster of thin, rainbow-colored lines curves across the bottom of the canvas. The entire image has a visible seam running vertically down the middle, splitting the composition into two halves. Sharp, colorful geometric fragments in yellow, red, and blue are scattered throughout the bottom foreground.

title: Flute Player and Cavaliers
alt_text: A white ceramic plate shows a raised, monochromatic design on its surface. To the left, a large, stylized tree with many thin branches arches across the top. Below the branches, several figures on horseback ride toward the right side of the plate. Another figure sits near the bottom, looking toward the horses. The entire scene is crafted in a simple, relief style that matches the color of the plate.

title: Goat's head in profile
medium: White earthenware clay, decoration in oxidized paraffin and glaze bath. Brown, green.
alt_text: A ceramic plate of white earthenware shows the head of an animal facing toward the right. The animal has long, curved horns and pointed ears on the top of its head. Its snout is pointed and dark, with a few small, green-tinted markings near its nose and mouth. The creature is colored in dark brown tones with faint, streaky green highlights that look etched into the surface. The entire design sits against a smooth, off-white circular background.

title: Diaulos Player and Faun
alt_text: A white earthenware plate shows a raised relief scene with two figures. On the left, a figure sits on a rough, textured base while playing a small, flute-like instrument held to its mouth. To the right, a second figure stands and dances with one arm raised in the air. A branch-like shape with small leaves curves over the seated figure on the left side. The entire surface is a uniform, pale white color against a grey background.

title: Jacqueline's Profile
medium: Red earthenware clay, glaze decoration, knife engraved, black patina
alt_text: A ceramic plate shows a profile view of a face. The plate has a round shape and is decorated with contrasting red and black colors. The face is red and faces toward the left side of the image, set against a dark, circular background. Fine black lines are scratched into the red surface to outline the eye, eyelashes, and hair. The rim of the plate is a thin, dark brown color.

title: Plate
alt_text: A ceramic dish of tin-glazed earthenware shows a large fish painted in blue. The fish curves upward from the bottom center, with its head resting near the lower edge of the dish. Its body is covered in a pattern of blue scales, and its tail points toward the top rim. To the left of the fish, several curved blue lines suggest the movement of water. Two small blue marks that look like crosses sit on the lower sides of the dish.

title: Plate
alt_text: A ceramic plate made of tin-glazed earthenware shows a scene painted in blue ink on a white background. The center of the plate features a tall, chimney-like structure with smoke rising from the top. To the left of the chimney, there is a simple drawing of a plant. On the right side, part of a curved fence or structure with dots and lines is visible. Below the chimney, smaller landscape elements like a low hill and some faint markings are drawn near the bottom edge.

title: Flower brick
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware container shows painted blue scenes on its white surface. The rectangular object stands on four short feet and has a series of circular holes along its flat top. The front side features a man and woman walking together in a grassy landscape with trees and distant buildings. A single standing figure appears on the narrow side panel. The blue paint is faded in some areas and the edges show signs of wear.

title: Apothecary jar
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware container shaped like a chalice with a wide, rounded body and a flaring base. The background of the object is a glossy, off-white color. A decorative band of blue painted patterns circles the middle of the jar. Inside this band, the letters "S: ZINZIB:" are printed in bold, dark blue capital letters. Smaller blue designs, including stylized floral shapes and small faces, surround the central text.

title: Wall pocket
alt_text: A ceramic container shaped like a horn or cornucopia, featuring a spiral design of blue and white stripes. The wide opening at the top flares outward, and the body tapers down to a narrow, pointed tip at the bottom. The surface has a shiny, smooth look with deep blue painted swirls against a creamy white background. It appears to be made of tin-glazed earthenware. The object is centered against a plain, light-brown background.

title: Cruet stand
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware container shows several connected, hexagonal compartments painted with blue floral designs. This object has four separate bowl-like sections joined together at their bases and sides. Each section is white on the inside and decorated on the outside with blue patterns, including stylized flowers and a bird. Textured handles connect some of the compartments to one another. The entire piece rests on small, rounded, blue-painted feet.

title: Charger
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware bowl shows a scene painted in blue, yellow, and green. In the center, a tree with a large green canopy filled with yellow fruit divides two standing figures. A snake with a yellow and brown striped pattern wraps its body around the trunk of the tree. A man stands on the left and a woman with long hair stands on the right, both looking toward the center. The bowl has a wide, decorated rim with a blue pattern that frames the central scene.

title: Société Anonyme Inc Signboard
alt_text: A painting shows a white square in the center that contains the words "SOCIÉTÉ ANONYME INC" in bold black letters. Surrounding this central white square are many rectangular bands of different colors, including red, yellow, green, blue, and brown. These colorful bands radiate outward from the edges of the white square toward the frame of the image. The effect makes the center white square look like it is deep within a tunnel. The overall composition is symmetrical and creates a strong sense of perspective.

title: Charger
alt_text: A ceramic plate shows a hand-painted scene of a figure on horseback. The plate has a wide rim decorated with a repeated pattern of blue dashes on a white background. In the center, a rider in blue clothing wears a hat with a green feather and has green wings on their back. The horse is also blue and stands in a landscape with dark blue trees and a small patch of green ground. The style of the painting is loose and colorful, resembling a sketch.

title: Model Shoes
alt_text: A ceramic container of tin-glazed earthenware showing two boot-shaped vessels. These objects are cream-colored with detailed blue patterns covering their surfaces. The blue designs include flowers, leaves, and vertical striped borders that run down the front of the boots. Each boot has a small, rounded ornament at the very top of the ankle section. The boots sit side-by-side on a plain, light-brown surface against a matching background.

title: Inkstand
alt_text: A ceramic container of tin-glazed earthenware displays a blue and white floral pattern across its surface. The rectangular piece acts as a desk stand, featuring two tall candle holders on the left and right sides. Two circular lids sit in the middle, likely covering ink wells. The front of the container slopes downward to create a shallow tray for holding pens. In the background, other similar ceramic objects and open books sit on a table.

title: Herring dish
alt_text: A ceramic container in the shape of a fish made of tin-glazed earthenware shows intricate blue patterns on a white background. The piece is shaped like a whole fish viewed from above, with its head on the left and a forked tail on the right. Detailed blue lines mimic scales across the body, while the fins are decorated with darker, striped markings. The center of the fish appears slightly hollowed out, creating a shallow dish. Small wire loops are attached to the fish's mouth and near its tail, suggesting it can be hung on a wall.

title: Lidded vase
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware container showing an ornate vase with a matching lid. The vase has a wide, rounded body that tapers toward a hexagonal base and a narrow neck. The front of the body features a painted scene of a person standing on a path near a large tree and a distant building with a steeple. Intricate, swirling blue patterns decorate the rest of the vase’s surface surrounding this central picture. A bell-shaped lid sits on top and is crowned by a sculpted figure of a small bird holding a round object in its beak. The entire object is decorated with shades of dark and light blue against a creamy white background.

title: Vase
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware vase displays a large, rounded body that tapers toward the top and stands on a flared base. The surface is cream-colored and decorated with intricate blue patterns. Centered on the front is a detailed illustration of a bouquet of flowers arranged in a textured basket. Dark blue scrollwork and leafy vine designs curl along the sides and near the bottom of the vase. The neck of the vase features a small, raised decorative element near the rim.

title: Tobacco Jar
alt_text: A ceramic container of tin-glazed earthenware and brass shows a jar decorated with blue patterns. The body of the jar is white and round with a wide middle that tapers toward the top and bottom. A dark blue decorative border featuring floral shapes and swirls wraps around the upper and lower sections of the jar. In the center, the letters "C L A R A C" are painted in capital blue block letters. A polished brass lid shaped like a beehive rests on the top opening. The entire object sits on a small, dark circular base.

title: Plate
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware plate shows a painted blue rooster standing on a mound. The rooster is positioned in the center, surrounded by detailed blue flowers and plant stems. The background of the plate is a plain, off-white color. A decorative border of repeating arches and small leaves encircles the outer edge of the plate. The entire design is done in shades of blue paint against the white surface.

title: Plate
alt_text: A ceramic plate of tin-glazed earthenware shows a painted floral pattern on a white background. The center of the plate features several blue, tear-drop shaped flowers alongside red flowers and bright green leaves. The stems of these flowers curl across the surface in a flowing, natural arrangement. Around the outer edge, a wide circular border contains a repeated pattern of dark green, tight spirals. The entire design is contained within this decorative frame, creating a clear contrast with the central floral display.

title: Garniture of Four Vases
alt_text: A container of tin-glazed earthenware shows four blue and white ceramic vessels arranged in a row on a white table. The two items in the center are fitted with metal lamp hardware at their tops and have white electrical cords trailing behind them. All four pieces have matching patterns of blue, stylized floral designs on a light background. The two outer vessels have a tall, flared shape that is wider at the top and bottom. The two inner lamp vessels have a bulbous, rounded shape that narrows at the base. Small, rectangular tags with barcodes sit on the table in front of each vessel.

title: Plate
alt_text: A ceramic plate shows a painted design with a central floral arrangement inside a basket. This basket sits on the bottom of the plate and has tall, thin lines suggesting its woven texture. The flowers above the basket are bright red with green leaves and small yellow centers. A wide border around the rim of the plate features a repeating pattern of small red and blue cross-hatched shapes. Between these shapes are more red flowers, leaves, and thin blue lines.

title: Double-gourd Vase
alt_text: A ceramic container made of earthenware features a distinct double-gourd shape with a bulbous bottom and a smaller, rounded top section. The off-white surface is decorated with hand-painted designs in shades of blue and brown. The larger bottom section depicts two figures standing outdoors near a simple wooden fence and some stylized trees. The narrower upper section is painted with smaller, repeated floral motifs arranged vertically. A series of small, dark blue dashes creates a decorative border around the very bottom edge of the base.

title: Plate
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware plate shows a colorful painted design of flowers and small insects. The round plate has a light-colored background and is decorated with a central cluster of flowers in red, yellow, green, and blue. Around the rim, smaller floral arrangements alternate with tiny, dark-colored flying insects. A thin blue circular line separates the center design from the patterned border. The plate is mounted on a wooden stand against a plain, off-white background.

title: Posset-pot
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware container painted with blue figures and scenes on a light blue background. It has a round, pot-like shape with a flat base and a wide opening at the top. Two large, curved handles extend from opposite sides of the body. A straight, narrow spout sticks out from the front, decorated with a vertical line of blue shapes. The painted decoration wraps around the center, showing small people, trees, and buildings in a sketchy, hand-drawn style.

title: Plate
alt_text: A ceramic container showing a painted plate with a blue and white design. The plate has a round, flat shape with a wide rim decorated with repeating blue patterns. In the center of the plate, a small bird sits perched next to a cluster of round fruits. The entire design uses shades of blue against a creamy off-white background. The edges of the plate appear slightly worn in some spots, with small chips along the rim.

title: Pair of Plates
alt_text: A pair of tin-glazed earthenware plates sit side by side against a plain gray background. Each circular plate features an identical scene in the center, showing a figure standing beneath a stylized tree with brown branches and blue and yellow leaves. The rim of each plate is decorated with a brown crisscross grid pattern alternating with small blue and yellow flowers. These plates have a light, off-white surface color. The scene is drawn with simple, hand-painted lines in brown, blue, and yellow.

title: Vase
alt_text: A ceramic container made of tin-glazed earthenware shows a painted scene of buildings. The tall, white vase has a wide, flared opening at the top and tapers toward the middle before widening again at the base. Its surface is decorated with dark blue patterns that frame a central image of houses and small chimneys. Below the houses, a dark blue scroll-like shape sits on the bottom part of the vase. The background behind the object is a plain, light-tan color.

title: Vase
alt_text: A ceramic container made of tin-glazed earthenware shows a tall, vase-like shape with a flared top and a wider base. The surface is decorated with a pattern of dark blue designs painted on a creamy white background. Near the top and the bottom, there are large, stylized flower-like shapes in blue. A central panel features a detailed scene of a small figure standing in a landscape with trees. The sides of this central section are filled with a textured, net-like pattern.

title: Hand-warmer or Flask
alt_text: A ceramic container made of tin-glazed earthenware shows a painted scene of a sailboat on a body of water. The central image features a small sailboat near the shore with two buildings that look like windmills nearby. The entire scene is framed by a decorative blue border with ornate, curvy scrollwork. This border surrounds the landscape on all four sides. The colors throughout the piece are shades of dark blue against a cream-white background.

title: Charger
alt_text: A ceramic plate showing a hand-painted scene of a blue lion. The lion stands in a patch of blue water at the bottom of the center circle. Behind the lion, there are feathery, purple-brown trees and three small bird shapes flying in the sky. The rim of the plate is decorated with a pattern of intersecting blue lines against a purple circle. The overall plate is off-white and has a shiny, glazed finish.

title: Plate
alt_text: A ceramic plate of tin-glazed earthenware shows a peacock standing in profile. The bird has a bright blue neck and head with reddish-brown markings on its crest. Its long, flowing tail feathers are painted in shades of yellow and reddish-brown. Behind the peacock, textured purple and brown patches suggest bushes or trees. The rim of the plate is framed by a simple blue painted line.

title: Obelisk
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware container in the shape of a tall, pointed obelisk with a square base. It is painted in blue against a white background with floral and leafy designs. The body rises from a flared section decorated with sculpted, shell-like shapes and blue accents. A small, pointed cap sits at the very top of the structure.
