The base is square and features intricate blue patterns on all sides.

title: William and Mary Plate
alt_text: A ceramic plate made of tin-glazed earthenware shows a painted design of two people. Both figures have long, dark, wavy hair and wear large, golden crowns on their heads. They are positioned side-by-side, with the figure on the left wearing a yellow sash and the figure on the right wearing a white ruffed collar. Above the figures, the letters "W" and "M" are painted in a dark, simple script. The entire surface of the plate is covered in a web of fine, dark cracks, and the edges are worn with small areas of brownish discoloration.

title: Inkstand
alt_text: A ceramic container made of tin-glazed earthenware and metal shows a shallow, oval-shaped bowl with decorative handles on either side. The off-white body of the bowl features painted designs of small, orange-dotted flowers and leafy green vines arranged in symmetrical patterns around the sides. Above these patterns, a wavy blue line accents the top rim of the bowl. The base is slightly raised and decorated with a simple green grid pattern near the bottom edge. Two dark metal brackets rise from the top of the bowl near the center.

title: Pair of Vases
alt_text: A ceramic container of tin-glazed earthenware shows a blue and white landscape scene. The vessel has a wide, rounded body that tapers toward the base and a decorative lid on top with a round knob. The surface is decorated with a detailed blue illustration of houses, trees, and small birds against a sky on a white background. Elaborate, scrolling blue designs decorate the neck, base, and edges of the scene. The entire piece sits centered on a plain, light-colored surface.

title: Puzzle Jug
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware container shows a bulbous, white jug decorated with blue paint. The neck of the jug features cut-out shapes that look like flower petals outlined in blue. Written on the rounded body of the jug are several lines of cursive blue text that wrap around the vessel. There is a small spout at the top rim and two small handle-like protrusions on either side of the opening. The surface of the jug appears glossy and is painted with simple blue lines and patterns.

title: Composition with Yellow, Blue, Black and Light Blue
alt_text: A painting of a grid pattern composed of thick black lines separating colored blocks. A large, pale gray rectangle takes up the right side of the canvas. To the left, a bright yellow square sits at the top, a pale gray square sits in the middle, and a vibrant blue square sits at the bottom. A small white rectangle rests below the large gray one, next to a black vertical bar on the bottom right. The entire composition is surrounded by a plain, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Information: Degas Room
medium: Gouache and graphite on paper, mounted on board
alt_text: A painting showing a large, faint scene with several people standing before it. The background of the artwork contains ghost-like outlines of tall, standing figures that appear to be part of a separate, larger composition. In the foreground, a small group of people, rendered in sharper detail, stand in a line facing the background scene. One figure wears a long coat, while another wears pants and a light shirt. The entire image is bathed in an intense, warm orange glow due to the room's lighting.

title: Bibliothèque (Library)
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes and objects arranged in a flat, stylized composition. On the left, a circular map of the Americas sits against a background of brown, white, and cream-colored columns. To the right of the columns, a partial view of a sculpted head appears next to a stack of three tan books resting on top of a larger, thicker book. At the bottom center, a magnifying glass with a round white lens lies on a dark green rectangular block. The entire scene uses blocks of muted colors to create a structured, abstract look.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of two figures in an outdoor setting observing a framed image. On the left, a person holds up a rectangular picture frame displaying a scene with animals, supported by a wooden structure. To the right, another person sits and sketches on a board while facing the frame. The background appears to be a textured, rocky cliffside. The entire scene is rendered in shades of brown and white, resembling a sketch or monochrome study.

title: Le renversement (Somersault)
medium: Oil, graphite, charcoal, and tempera on canvas board
alt_text: A painting of abstract, scattered shapes set against a flat, solid yellow background. A stick-figure-like character with a round, dark gray head and a mustache stands on the lower left, accompanied by the hand-drawn text "AH!!" and "HO!". Near the center, there is a cluster of bushy, green, textured shapes floating near faint pencil outlines of geometric forms. On the upper right, a thin, dark line curves upward, ending in a small red shape that resembles a flame. Several other small, thin, black outlines of circles, lines, and small objects are spread across the golden canvas.

title: Untitled (Paint Box)
alt_text: A wood, paper, copper, and fabric sculpture shows a rectangular, box-like object. The exterior has a dark, worn appearance with a grid-like pattern of dark panels. A thin, pale strip is visible along the side where the top and bottom sections meet. Two small, tarnished copper latches hold the object closed. The entire item rests on a plain white surface.

title: Ancient Garden
alt_text: A painting made of lead, paper, and wood shows a small, evergreen tree in the center. The tree is colored green and stands on a rectangular base in the middle of a square, textured background that looks like brown paper. This central square is surrounded by a border made of small, dark, rectangular lead tiles. The entire piece is set inside a simple wooden frame. A few small, wire-like shapes are scattered across the upper part of the brown background.

title: Femme assise
alt_text: A painting of an abstract figure set against a tan background. The central figure has a pale purple, circular head and a body made of many different shapes. A large, white, blouse-like form surrounds the torso. To the right side, a red curved shape with dark lines sits above a bright blue, circular form. A long, blue, diamond-like shape runs down the center of the figure's chest. Thick, dark, black lines outline all of the shapes throughout the entire image.

title: Thank you, Anthony Caro
medium: Basket, acrylic yarn, silicone caulking, plastic car part, cable, plastic orange, acrylic paint and green plastic spot
alt_text: A sculpture shows a brown woven basket sitting on a white pedestal. Inside the basket, there are several bright yellow balls of yarn stacked in two neat rows. A long, curved black plastic car part hangs over the front edge of the basket. Next to the car part, a small, round, orange-colored fruit rests on top of the yarn. The rest of the basket is filled with other indistinct items, including some pink and clear materials.

title: Animals and Plants of the Forest
alt_text: A painting of several birds, butterflies, and a small frog gathered near a large, dark tree. A brown bird with a long beak leans down toward the ground on the right, while a frog sits nearby looking up. In the center, a large, leafy green plant sits against the tree trunk, surrounded by spiky thistle flowers. Multiple birds, including one with a reddish head, perch on the branches or hover near the trunk. A small, bright white butterfly flies on the left side, while other patterned butterflies rest on the plants. The background shows a shaded, grassy landscape under a dim, cloudy sky.

title: For D.G.
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows two distinct geometric shapes sitting on a paved outdoor plaza. One form is a flat-topped pyramid with dark, solid sides that slopes downward to the ground. In front of it sits a second shape made of two triangular sections that point downward like inverted pyramids. These two objects are both a dark, matte color and appear to be made of metal plates. The plaza beneath them is constructed of large, light-colored rectangular tiles. A low brick wall runs along the bottom edge of the frame, and a patch of grass and a tree trunk are visible in the background.

title: For P.N.
alt_text: A welded bronze sculpture depicts two dark, geometric forms sitting on a light gray tiled patio. The closer object is a flat, square platform resting on two pointed, inverted pyramid shapes. Behind it sits a second object, which is shaped like a wide, truncated pyramid with slanted sides. Both sculptures are made of a smooth, dark metal that appears brownish-grey in the daylight. In the background, there is a patch of green grass, a bit of tree trunk, and a set of concrete steps.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of painted wood and wire shows a tall, abstract structure against a plain gray background. Several rectangular wooden blocks in a pale color are arranged at different angles and heights. Thin, dark metal wires connect these wooden pieces, creating loops and straight lines that snake through the air. A long, diagonal wooden beam acts as a central support for the scattered blocks. The entire arrangement stands on a single, rectangular wooden block resting on the floor.

title: Mute
alt_text: A painting showing a rectangular field filled with shades of gray. Thick layers of paint create a textured surface with horizontal brushstrokes running across the image. The center area is lighter and cooler in tone, while the edges are darker and grayer. Rough, streaky marks indicate where the brush moved back and forth over the surface. The overall effect creates a sense of depth through these subtle differences in color.

title: Untitled (Vasco Nuñez de Balboa)
medium: Sand, glass, wood, seashells, fabric, paper, and cord
alt_text: A sculpture showing a rectangular, box-like frame that is covered in tightly packed vertical strips of printed text. Inside the frame, a single sheet of paper with printed text is mounted behind a layer of glass. This paper has a perfectly circular hole cut out of its center. Four small metal tacks hold the corners of the paper in place against a light-colored background. The entire object has a deep, shadow-filled interior space between the outer frame and the inner paper.

title: January Yellows
alt_text: A painting in acrylic paint showing a series of bold, abstract shapes against a warm, brownish-red background. On the left side, two long, dark rectangular bars stack horizontally above two brighter bands of light green and yellow. Near the center, three tall, vertical shapes in dark brown, blue, and deep green stand upright. The bottom of these vertical shapes seems to fade or blur into the brown field behind them. The entire composition has a soft, hazy quality where the edges of the colors gently bleed into one another.

title: Piece
alt_text: A velvet textile shows a repeating, intricate pattern in shades of red. The fabric is a deep, rich red color with a subtle sheen from the velvet material. A delicate, yellowish-gold lace border trims the bottom and sides of the fabric. The woven pattern features swirling leaves and vine-like shapes that curve across the surface. A rectangular label with white text reading "1949:14" sits prominently just below the bottom edge of the fabric.

title: Gentleman Holding Letter
medium: Watercolor and gold powder on ivory, in wood frame
alt_text: A miniature painting shows a man dressed in formal clothing sitting for a portrait. He has dark, wavy hair and pale blue eyes, and he is wearing a black coat with a dark necktie. In his hand, he holds a small, folded piece of white paper that appears to have some faint writing on it. He is seated on a red upholstered chair or sofa. The figure is set against a simple, light blue-grey background. The portrait is housed in a simple dark wooden frame with a gold inner trim.

title: Lady Wearing Miniature and Holding Book
medium: Watercolor and gold powder on ivory, in wood frame
alt_text: A miniature of a woman sitting in a dark-colored chair. The woman has dark hair styled in ringlets on either side of her face and is wearing a black dress with a wide blue collar. She holds a small, gold-edged book in her right hand against the red upholstery of the chair. In her left hand, she holds a small, oval-shaped pendant on a long chain around her neck. Her expression is calm as she faces directly forward against a textured gray background. The entire portrait is encased in a simple, dark rectangular wooden frame.

title: Headstone (Laying NO to Rest)
alt_text: A black slate sculpture of a rounded headstone stands upright in the center of the frame. The surface of the stone is dark gray and smooth with a curved top. Engraved into the center of the slate are the words "Hear NO Lies" in simple, light-colored capital letters. Below the stone, the ground is covered in a bed of loose, small brown gravel pebbles. Behind the sculpture sits a wall made of rough-cut, reddish-brown stone blocks.

title: The Proper Marcel Sense of Endlessness
alt_text: A painting on a panel shows a white rectangular surface centered on a slightly larger white rectangular background. The smaller central rectangle is covered in thin, vertical dark lines that look like sparse raindrops or scratches. These lines are scattered across the white surface without a clear pattern. The edges of both rectangles are smooth and rounded. The contrast between the dark lines and the pale background creates a simple and clean appearance.

title: Lines and Helium
alt_text: A painting of oil on canvas that features a plain, light surface. The background is mostly white with a very slight, cool-toned tint. Several thin, dark lines cross the surface at different diagonal angles. These lines are sparse and appear faint or scratched against the pale background. The overall composition is very simple and minimalist.

title: Venice
alt_text: A painting of various colored squares layered on a flat, solid background. A large, light peach square dominates the center of a pale blue field. Inside this peach square sits a large teal rectangle that holds several smaller, overlapping shapes. These smaller shapes are squares and rectangles in muted shades of blue, grey, and yellow. The overall arrangement feels centered and flat with clean, sharp edges.

title: Dynamic Ribbon Device
alt_text: A digital video showing a television screen with a red background. The screen displays the text "Top News at 5" in a large, white, cursive font. A thick, white, wavy line stretches horizontally across the middle of the screen. Small, clear water droplets are scattered across the red surface, suggesting a wet texture. The black television frame hangs on a plain, dark gray wall.

title: Major Roger Alden (1754-1836)
medium: Oil on canvas, laid down on wood
alt_text: A painting of a young man shown from the chest up against a dark background. He faces toward the right with his head turned slightly, showing a serious expression. He wears a dark blue jacket over a gray vest and a white shirt with a high collar. A bright red sash hangs diagonally across his chest over his shoulder. His dark hair is styled close to his head.

title: Recumbant cow
alt_text: A ceramic container showing a cow resting on a small, green patch of ground. The cow has a light, off-white body with painted blue, red, and yellow floral patterns on its side. Its face features blue painted details and a small area of damage on one ear. The entire piece has a glossy, smooth finish typical of earthenware. It sits on a simple, plain background.

title: Tile
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware tile shows a landscape scene painted in blue ink on a white background. The center of the tile features a small cluster of buildings and trees resting on a horizontal blue ground line. The surface of the square tile has a visible network of fine, dark cracks throughout the glaze. Each corner of the tile is decorated with a small, simple flower motif in blue. The edges of the tile appear worn and slightly chipped in places.

title: Tile
alt_text: A ceramic tile of tin-glazed earthenware shows a floral design painted in blue. The central motif is a small, round vase filled with several upright tulip-like flowers. In each of the four corners of the tile, there is a small, decorative blue swirl pattern. The surface of the square tile has a light, off-white color with a noticeable network of fine cracks across it. Some spots on the surface appear worn or slightly discolored with age.

title: Comfort Starr Mygatt (1763–1823) and Lucy Mygatt (1794–1885)
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair while a young girl stands beside him. The man is wearing a dark blue coat, a light grey vest, white stockings, and black shoes with buckles. He sits on a small chair with green legs and a reddish-brown padded seat. Beside him, the girl wears a simple, light blue dress and has shoulder-length brown hair. The two figures stand against a plain, dark grey background. Underneath them, the floor is covered in a brown carpet featuring a repeating, multicolored star-like pattern.

title: Saint Cecilia
alt_text: A painting of a woman playing a keyboard instrument, done in oil on paper. She sits on a carved chair, looking upward with a relaxed expression. Her fair hair is partially covered by a white headpiece, and she wears a white dress with a dark blue wrap draped over her shoulder. Her hands are positioned over a set of small keys that look like a pipe organ or a harpsichord. The background is a dark, warm red color, with a tall, decorative wooden pillar on the right side.

title: The Assembly of the Gods
alt_text: A painting of a large group of people and mythical figures floating among blue clouds. A glowing, arched band filled with small stars crosses the top of the scene. A bright light erupts in the middle, surrounded by people wearing colorful, flowing clothes. In the foreground at the bottom, a man with a trident sits beside a man with a long, white beard. Other figures, some winged and others wearing armor, are scattered throughout the crowded composition.

title: Femmes aux Perroquets
alt_text: A painted bronze sculpture shows a stylized scene with two women and a large bird against a background of trees. One woman stands on the left with her face framed by dark hair and dark leaf-like shapes. A large, patterned bird perches near her, its wings spread out wide. In the center, another woman reaches upward with one hand while holding a small, flower-like object in the other. To the right, a third person sits on a rectangular bench, holding a large flower. The entire scene uses thick black outlines, white shapes, and a bright red background.

title: Habakuk
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an abstract figure standing tall against a background of green trees and hedges. The sculpture is colored a deep, shiny black and rests on a rectangular base. The figure has a large, rounded head that points upward like a beak or snout. Below the head, the body is formed by three stacked, smooth sections that get wider toward the bottom. A small, separate spherical shape sits on the flat base next to the main figure.

title: Benjamin Ferris (1771–1832)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory depicts the portrait of a young man against a light, hazy background. He has light brown, wavy hair and looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression. The man wears a dark coat over a white, high-collared shirt with a ruffled cravat. His portrait is contained within an oval gold frame, which is set inside a larger, rectangular black display board. A small, decorative gold metal hanger shaped like oak leaves and an acorn sits at the top of the black board.

title: L'Amour Carnassier
alt_text: A painting of a raw piece of meat sitting on a silver platter. The cut of meat is shaped like a curved triangle with dark red flesh and a strip of thick, pale fat along the back edge. A small figurine of a bride and groom stands on top of the meat. A curved arch made of small white flowers surrounds the couple like a wedding topper. A small pool of red liquid sits on the platter beneath the meat.

title: History of Matzah: The Story of the Jews (Part I)
alt_text: A painting of various collage-like figures and scenes layered against a textured, light-brown background that resembles stone. On the far left, a man in a long white robe stands holding a large, rectangular tablet above his head. Towards the top center and right, smaller figures appear in groups, including faint sketches of people walking and a row of architectural structures. The lower middle section features a scroll with text next to a standing nude figure and a seated woman in a dark dress. In the bottom right corner, a group of people sit around a long table as if sharing a meal. These diverse scenes and figures are painted in muted earth tones, with some areas appearing more detailed and solid than others.

title: History of Matzah: The Story of the Jews (Part II)
alt_text: A painting of a collage-style composition features various historical figures, scenes, and maps layered over a light-colored background. On the left side, a prominent building with arches is shown above a group of small figures in profile. To the right, a man in a red robe stands prominently among other people dressed in dark clothing, while a group of riders on horses occupies the lower right area. Other segments include small sketches, scattered faces, and faint outlines of geographical shapes drawn in muted colors. The entire image has a textured, busy appearance with several distinct scenes overlapping each other.

title: History of Matzah: The Story of the Jews (Part III)
alt_text: A painting of a complex, collage-like scene featuring many separate drawings, figures, and text overlays against a pale background. On the left side, a large, light-colored figure of a statue holding a torch stands near people in red clothing. Across the center, various figures in dark coats and hats are drawn in a realistic style, some interacting and others standing alone. Thin, orange lines are drawn across the lower portion, connecting specific points on a faint, map-like background to one another. Text in multiple languages appears in rectangular boxes and scattered throughout the composition. A sense of movement is created by the many disconnected, overlapping images arranged across the canvas.

title: Portuguese Church--Sketch
alt_text: A painting of a blocky, abstract landscape using muted and earthy tones. The center of the work is filled with many pale yellow and tan squares that look like a cluster of buildings or blocks. Surrounding these blocks are areas of deep blue and reddish-brown paint applied in loose, visible brushstrokes. A large, rounded brown shape sits prominently on the right side of the canvas. The background features darker horizontal bands of green and brown that suggest a horizon line or hills.

title: Portuguese Church
alt_text: A painting of a town or group of buildings rendered in shades of brown, gray, and white. A large, dark, tree-like shape dominates the left side of the composition. Below this, blocks of light-colored paint suggest small, compact buildings or stone structures. To the right, a large curved brown shape anchors the lower section, while textured, blocky marks fill the upper background. The brushstrokes are thick and visible throughout the entire scene.

title: Dancer
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a standing figure with arms outstretched to the sides. The figure appears to be a woman with her head tilted slightly downward. She stands on a small, circular base that matches the dark, shiny color of the rest of the metal body. Her pose is balanced, with her weight shifted slightly to one side. The surface of the sculpture is smooth and reflects light, highlighting the curves of the body.

title: Artemisia Prepares to Drink the Ashes of her Husband, Mausolus
alt_text: A painting of a woman with long, wavy brown hair. She has a fair complexion, rosy cheeks, and red lips, looking directly at the viewer. She wears a white, off-the-shoulder blouse and a draped purple garment over her shoulder. Her left hand holds a small golden cup near a large, ornate silver bowl. To her left, a tall, metal pitcher sits on a dark surface in front of a blue and grey fabric backdrop.

title: Neither There nor There
medium: Computer program (Macromedia Director Shockwave Studio [.exe file]) output from computer to two 15 inch LCD screens
alt_text: A video installation showing two side-by-side LCD screens displaying digital imagery. The left screen shows a person wearing a green shirt, seated and facing downward, with their lower body dissolving into static. The right screen depicts a person from behind, sitting on a chair, with their upper body and torso pixelated by static. Both figures appear set against a backdrop of a simple, sparse room with a light-colored floor and wall. Each silver monitor has a small, rectangular shape with buttons along the bottom edge.

title: Study for Emergence
medium: Color video on freestanding LCD flat panel
alt_text: A color video still shows three people arranged around a stone pedestal. On the left, a person with messy hair wears a dark, long-sleeved shirt and dark skirt. They are holding an entirely white, nude figure suspended in the air. To the right, a person with long hair wears dark pants and a large, patterned shawl draped over their shoulders. This person kneels on the pedestal, holding the feet of the white figure. The background is a simple, dark blue textured wall.

title: Le Prix
alt_text: A bronze sculpture stands on a paved ground in front of a glass wall. The piece includes a large, rounded, brownish-gold shape that rests flat against the ground. Extending from this base is a long, rigid chain that curves upward into the air. The chain ends in a single, thick circular ring at the very top. The entire object appears to be made of a solid, metallic material.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A bronze sculpture stands in an open courtyard in front of a tall brick building. The sculpture is made of several long, rectangular beams connected at sharp angles. It has a zigzag shape that rises up and then stretches horizontally along the ground. The metal has a dull, brownish color and appears smooth. A low brick wall and a large stone building serve as a backdrop for the art. The scene is lit by bright daylight, casting sharp shadows on the paved floor.

title: Saints James the Greater and John the Evangelist
alt_text: A painting of two figures standing side-by-side against a patterned, golden fabric background. On the left, a bearded man with long hair wears a wide-brimmed grey hat, a grey tunic, and a long, bright green cloak draped over his shoulder. He holds a tall, thin wooden staff in his right hand and a small, dark pouch in his left hand. To his right, a second figure with long, light brown hair wears a vibrant red robe that covers their body from neck to feet. This figure holds a gold chalice in their left hand while raising their right hand in a gesture of greeting or blessing. Both figures are barefoot and stand on a floor decorated with a simple, geometric tile pattern.

title: Saints James the Lesser and Philip
alt_text: A painting of two men standing before a decorative, patterned wall. On the left, a man with long, brown hair wears a bright green robe under a draped blue cloak, and he holds a curved wooden club in one hand and an open book in the other. On the right, a bearded man wears a large, bright pink robe over a blue garment, and he holds a tall, thin wooden cross. Both men are barefoot and stand on a floor made of gray square tiles. Behind them, a rich tapestry-like fabric features intricate gold and red floral patterns. A small, arched window with decorative, circular glass panes sits high up on the wall between the two figures.

title: The Best Decision Ever Made
alt_text: A color video showing a row of small doll-like figures sitting on a shelf against a bright window. The figures are seen as dark silhouettes against the light coming through a sheer curtain. They appear to be wearing hats and costumes of different shapes. The light from the window highlights the edges of the curtain above them. A dark, partially visible object stands on the far right edge of the shelf.

title: James Hillhouse (1754-1832), B.A. 1773, M.A. 1776, LL.D. 1823, (copy after John Vanderlyn; see cat. No. 1645)
alt_text: A painting of an older man with white hair, shown from the chest up against a dark, shadowy background. He faces slightly to the right with a serious expression and deep lines on his forehead. The man wears a dark blue coat with a high collar and a light-colored, ruffled cravat at his neck. His skin has a pale, warm tone that stands out from the dark, muted blues of the background. The entire portrait is encased in an elaborate, textured gold frame with ornate floral carvings at the corners.

title: Punch Stopped at the Border
alt_text: A urethane resin sculpture of two figures standing on a flat, rectangular base against a dark background. One figure stands behind the other, with hands positioned on the second figure's back or waist area. The figure in front wears a hat with a tall, pointed tip and a ruff around the neck. On the base near their feet, two small, open boxes sit on the ground. The entire sculpture is smooth, matte, and monochromatic white.

title: Little Lamb
alt_text: A textile of sewn fabric showing a long, grey garment hanging vertically against a plain white wall. The garment has long sleeves with puffy shoulders and a narrow, tube-like body that extends all the way to the floor. The material appears to be a textured, mottled grey fabric that looks like fur or thick fleece. The bottom of the piece curls slightly on the floor where it ends. This piece has a very slender, elongated shape that spans most of the height of the image.

title: Paradise Romance
alt_text: A sculpture of mixed materials features a large, white, bowl-shaped form sitting on a base of metallic gray blocks. Two rectangular gray blocks flank a white, tower-like structure in the center, which supports the bowl from below. On the flat surface of one gray block, there is a small, golden, rod-like object with several bead-like shapes attached to it. A single, thin, golden antenna extends vertically from the center of the white bowl. The entire arrangement rests against a solid, neutral gray background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A steel sculpture of a simple, flat, square shape rests on a plain, light-colored background. The object is black in color and has a thin, metallic rim running along the edge of its top surface. Its sides are vertical and straight, forming a low, box-like structure. The square appears to be set at an angle, showing both its top surface and one of its front-facing sides. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the dark and smooth material.

title: Preserve I
alt_text: A sculpture of a long, vertical strand shows many small, round discs strung together. The beads appear to be made of a tan-colored, textured wax material. They are stacked neatly in a single column against a plain gray background. A thin string runs through the center of all the discs, holding them in place. The entire arrangement hangs straight down from the top of the frame.

title: Reclining Figure
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a reclining figure resting on a rectangular base. The figure has a smooth, rounded head that is small compared to its large, bulky body. One bent leg rises up on the left side, while the torso slopes down toward the right. The surface of the metal has a bumpy, uneven texture that catches the light in different ways. The entire object is dark brown and sits against a plain, gray background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of an abstract, blocky shape that resembles a structure. The central shape is off-white and framed by thick, dark brown lines that create boxy, window-like voids. A single, vertical bar of bright teal paint connects the upper and lower sections of the central structure. The surrounding background consists of muted, earthy tones of beige and brown with visible brushstrokes. A small patch of dull orange is visible along the right edge of the composition.

title: Edicola, Bozzetto
alt_text: A bronze sculpture stands upright with a rounded, arch-shaped top. The surface is decorated with a complex, textured relief that looks like a collection of gears, wires, and mechanical parts. At the very top, a slightly raised, round shape stands out against a darker, jagged background. Below this, the middle section features horizontal lines and rows of small, vertical pegs that resemble an intricate machine or instrument. The entire metal piece is supported by a simple, rectangular block of dark wood at the bottom.

title: Red Bottle
alt_text: A ceramic container shows a flattened, rounded shape with a small, centered neck at the top. The surface of the dark brown object is decorated with deeply etched, light-colored lines. These carved patterns resemble abstract shapes or perhaps stylized figures against a cracked, textured background. The overall tone is earthy and muted. This object sits on a wooden surface against a plain, off-white wall.

title: Le Croisement
alt_text: A painting of a street scene featuring buildings with red roofs under a cloudy sky. On the left side of the composition, a cluster of houses with light-colored walls creates a shaded corner. A wide, empty road stretches into the distance toward the right side of the painting. A single small figure dressed in a dark blue coat walks away from the viewer on the road. The sky is filled with thick, swirling brushstrokes of white and dark gray. A simple, ornate frame surrounds the rectangular image.

title: Femme au Compotier
alt_text: A painting of a person's upper body shown in an abstract, fragmented style with many geometric shapes. The figure has angular, simplified features and wears a patterned top with dark, leafy designs on a teal background. To the left, a small, square window sits within a red and white checkered wall section. Below the figure, a bowl-like shape holds a few solid, dark-colored forms that look like fruit. The colors throughout the image include muted tones of blue, green, brown, tan, and black. Jagged, sharp lines divide the entire composition into different sections, giving the scene a busy, tiled appearance.

title: Le châle jaune (The Yellow Shawl)
alt_text: A painting of an indoor scene featuring two women in a kitchen or dining area. On the left, one woman in a blue patterned top stands near a table, holding a small object. To her right, another woman is turned away, wearing a bright yellow shawl with colorful, patterned borders over a dress. The foreground is dominated by a large table covered in a yellow and white checkered tablecloth, which is set with various dishes, bowls of fruit, and a metallic pot. Behind the figures, a wooden cabinet sits against a wall covered in a blue and white patterned paper. A portion of a chair back, painted in reddish-orange, is visible at the very bottom center of the frame.

title: Still Life with Bottle, Glass, and Lemons
alt_text: A painting of a still life set against a dark background. In the center, a dark glass bottle sits behind two round, yellow fruits that resemble lemons. Next to the bottle stands a tall, clear glass filled with dark red liquid. The objects rest on a flat, grayish-brown surface. A long, thin green leaf lies in front of the fruit near the bottom of the frame.

title: Le verre noir
alt_text: A painting of a woven basket and a glass on a table. The basket sits on the left side of the frame, showing a light tan and brown crisscross pattern with a white, folded cloth inside. To the right, a dark, rounded glass stands on a short stem. A thick, white piece of fabric rests behind and around the base of the glass. The background is a flat, muted grey, with a splash of reddish-orange visible near the bottom left corner.

title: The Lion-tamer
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in a cage between two lions, observed by two people in the foreground. The woman wears a shiny, light-colored outfit and a crown, while the lions stand on either side of her. Vertical black bars run down the entire front of the scene, creating a cage-like effect. In the foreground, a man in a black top hat and a woman in a dark hat with red and white feathers sit with their backs to the viewer. They look through the bars at the scene inside the cage. The background is a dark, indistinct color that surrounds the figures.

title: Money for Art
alt_text: A sculpture of American currency displayed inside a tall, rectangular wood cabinet. The cabinet has five shelves, each holding a single small object made of folded paper money. These paper objects are intricate and varied in shape, resembling folded origami figures. They are greenish in color, matching the look of paper bills. The cabinet is framed in dark brown wood and sits against a plain light gray background.

title: A Prophet
alt_text: A painting of a person shown from the chest up, set inside a circular frame on a square wooden panel. The figure has shoulder-length brown hair and wears a bright red tunic with a dark green band across the chest. They are holding a rolled-up parchment scroll with dark, mysterious symbols written on it. Behind the person's head is a circular, textured gold halo that shines against the dark background. A thick, carved border with a leaf-like pattern encircles the gold center, contrasting with the weathered, brownish-yellow wooden square that makes up the rest of the board.

title: Saint John the Evangelist
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows a person with short, wavy hair holding a large, red book. The figure wears a dark blue shirt and a draped, coral-red robe that covers their shoulder. Behind the person’s head is a large, circular halo etched with intricate, decorative patterns. The entire background is filled with a textured, golden color that glows warmly. The panel has an arched top, framing the upper part of the figure's head and the halo.

title: Saints John the Baptist and James
alt_text: A painting shows two bearded men standing against a bright, textured gold background. The man on the left wears a long, light-orange robe, and he holds a long staff and a rolled scroll with dark marks on it. He has long, dark hair and a beard, and a faint, circular halo circles his head. Beside him on the right, a second man wears a dark green cloak over a red tunic and holds a small, rectangular object. He also has a beard, light brown hair, and a similar circular halo behind his head. Both men stand on a dark, narrow strip of ground at the bottom of the painting.

title: The Annunciatory Angel
alt_text: A painting of a winged figure kneeling on a patterned floor against a gold background. The figure, seen in profile, wears long, layered robes in shades of yellow and reddish-pink. Large, feathered wings extend behind the figure’s back. One hand is raised and points toward the upper right corner, while the other holds a tall, thin lily flower. A circular halo with a star-like pattern surrounds the figure’s head. The entire scene is enclosed in an arched, golden frame.

title: The Virgin Annunciate
alt_text: A painting shows a woman seated on a wooden throne inside an arched frame. She wears a long, dark blue cloak over a reddish-orange dress and has a circular golden halo behind her head. The woman holds an open book with visible text, and she rests her other hand against her chest. A small, white bird flies in the upper left corner toward the woman. Behind her, a dark bench with decorative carvings sits on a patterned floor.

title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
alt_text: A painting of a man lying on a metal grid over a fire while several other men surround him. The man on the grid is light-skinned, wearing a white cloth around his waist, and he has a golden halo around his head. A man in a pink tunic leans over him with a long pole to pin him down, while another man in a yellow tunic pours dark coals onto the fire. A group of men stands in the background, some wearing helmets and holding a large, shield-like object. One man on the far right holds a bundle of brown sticks while looking away from the scene.

title: The Prophet Jeremiah
alt_text: A painting of a man with a beard, shown from the chest up. The man wears a light-colored hood over his head and shoulders, wrapping around his green robe. He holds a long, curling scroll across his chest with both hands. Dark, black text is written in a stylized font along the surface of the scroll. The background is a warm, golden yellow, and the entire image is bordered by decorative, carved-looking corners at the bottom.

title: Saint Joseph(?)
alt_text: A painting of a man's head and shoulders shown in profile, set against a dark background. The man has a bald head and a short, dark beard, and he looks downward with a serious expression. A large, circular golden halo surrounds his head, decorated with intricate, engraved floral patterns. He wears a dark robe with a wide, decorative gold collar that features similar engraved designs. The edges of the rectangular wooden panel show signs of wear and age.

title: The Vision of Saint Lucy
alt_text: A painting of a quiet interior scene shows two figures seated on the floor before a small altar. The person on the left wears a dark blue robe and holds a long, thin walking staff. Facing them on the right, another person in a reddish-brown cloak sits with their eyes closed and a golden circle around their head. In the background, a boxy altar sits inside a shallow arched alcove, with a tall, thin metal candle stand resting on the floor in front of it. Above the altar, a group of winged figures with pale skin float in the dark red alcove. The entire scene is framed by plain, reddish-brown walls on both sides.

title: Virgin and Child with Two Angels
alt_text: A painting of a woman with long blonde hair holding a young child. The woman wears a deep red dress under a dark blue cloak and has a large, round gold halo behind her head. The light-skinned child stands in front of her, also wearing a smaller gold halo. Two winged figures with small halos float on either side of the woman near the top corners. The background appears to be a garden filled with various flowers and plants.

title: The Crucifixion with Saints Jerome and Dominic
alt_text: A painting shows a figure on a wooden cross in the center, with a person kneeling on either side. The central figure is pale with a crown of thorns and has hands and feet nailed to the cross, which is set against a landscape background with trees and buildings. To the left, an older man with a beard kneels and looks up toward the cross. To the right, a person in a dark hooded robe with white trim also kneels and looks up. Both figures at the bottom have round, glowing haloes behind their heads. A small, partial view of a skull rests at the very bottom center of the painting.

title: The Virgin and Child Enthroned with Saints Peter and Paul and Ten Angels
alt_text: A painting on panel shows a woman seated on a throne, holding a small child in her lap. Both figures have golden circles behind their heads, as do the four other people standing around them. The woman wears a dark robe over a patterned red fabric that lines the back of her throne. The standing figures are dressed in varying colors of green and red, each with their own golden halo. The entire background is filled with a textured, metallic gold surface.

title: Saint John the Evangelist
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows the close-up portrait of an older man with a long, flowing white beard and gray hair. He is looking off to the left with a serious expression on his face. The man wears a bright red cloak draped over his shoulders, showing a glimpse of a blue shirt underneath at his chest. Behind his head, a faint, circular halo is etched into the textured, shimmering gold background. The entire scene is framed by a worn and slightly darkened edge.

title: Virgin Annunciate
alt_text: A painting showing a woman with a dark hood against a gold background. She wears a long, dark cloak over a patterned, reddish garment. One hand rests on her chest, while the other holds a small, round object near her waist. A detailed halo with circular patterns circles her head. The gold background is textured with many small cracks throughout.

title: Pietà
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows a semi-nude, seated man flanked by two winged figures against a gold background. The central figure has his eyes closed and appears to be leaning back, supported by the figures on either side. These figures have large wings, reddish-brown hair, and are draped in simple, flowing robes colored green and pink. The central figure sits upon a flat, stone-like ledge and wears only a light-colored cloth wrapped around his lower body. The curved, arched shape of the panel frames the three figures as they are clustered tightly together.

title: The Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting of a central figure hanging from a tall wooden cross, with a woman on the left and a man on the right standing below. The central figure has a crown of thorns and wears a blue cloth around his waist, with red marks on his hands and feet. The woman on the left wears a pink dress under a blue robe and has a white veil over her head. The man on the right wears a bright yellow tunic with a large, flowing pink cloak draped over his arm. At the bottom of the cross, a human skull rests on the dark ground. The background is a dim, hilly landscape under a dark, stormy sky.

title: Saint John the Evangelist
alt_text: A painting of a person with long, wavy brown hair seen from the chest up against a textured, gold-leaf background. The figure looks slightly downward and to the left, wearing a blue tunic with a decorated neckline draped under a pink robe. One hand is raised in a gentle gesture with fingers extended, while the other arm cradles a thick, black rectangular book. The cover of the book features detailed gold-colored designs and thin red straps. The entire surface of the painting shows a network of fine cracks from age.

title: The Deposition
alt_text: A painting of a man being removed from a large wooden cross by several other figures. The man on the cross is pale and hangs limply as a person standing on a tall ladder reaches to loosen his hand. Three people stand together on the left side, with one woman dressed in a dark robe and a man in a red robe reaching toward the man on the cross. Below them, a woman in a red cloak kneels on the ground, while another woman sits nearby in a pale robe. The entire scene is set against a bright, textured gold background, framed by a red border.

title: The Entombment
alt_text: A painting of a group of people surrounding a reclining figure. In the center, a person lies on a simple stone table, wrapped in white cloth. A woman in dark robes kneels and kisses the hand of the reclining figure. Several other figures stand around the table with sad expressions and hands raised in mourning. Above the scene, a group of smaller, winged figures with halos floats in a cloud against a textured gold background. The entire image is enclosed by a decorative red border.

title: Deposit
medium: Gouache, watercolor paper, and pencil on wood panel
alt_text: A painting shows two large, horizontal bands of color stacked on top of each other. The top half is a field of bright, varying shades of yellow-green. The bottom half is a field of warm, varying shades of reddish-orange. Both sections are filled with thousands of tiny, dense, vertical pencil marks that create a woven texture. A thin white line separates the two colored sections. The entire artwork is framed by a thin, light-colored border.

title: Untitled (Grand Hotel de l'Etoile)
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture in a rectangular wooden frame displays a white, textured background. In the lower left section, a small, colorful cutout of a person riding a horse stands on a faint horizontal line. Toward the top right, a thin circular wire hoop hangs suspended in the air. A long, delicate metal chain dangles downward from the bottom of this hoop. A torn, weathered piece of paper with printed text and a small blue stamp is attached to the center of the white background.

title: The Bermuda Group (Dean Berkeley and His Entourage)
alt_text: A painting of a group of seven people gathered outdoors near large stone columns. A man sits at a table in the foreground, looking at an open book with a woman next to him who wears a blue dress. To her right, another woman in a gold dress holds a small child on her lap. Standing behind them are three men, and one man wearing a black robe and white collar stands on the far right. The table is covered with a patterned red cloth and holds a tall, leather-bound book. The background shows a hazy landscape with trees and a cloudy sky.

title: Female Nude
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in the center with two small, winged figures behind her. The woman is pale, nude, and has reddish-brown hair. She holds a round hand mirror up in her raised right hand. In her left hand, which rests near her hip, she holds a large, dark, fan-like object. Dark, draped reddish fabric hangs behind the woman, partially covering the winged figures. The background is a dark, indistinct landscape that contrasts with the woman's light skin.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, textured, and vertical paint drips. The surface is densely layered with thick, dried acrylic paint that creates a rugged, uneven texture. Long, thin streaks of color, including shades of yellow, green, gray, and purple, run from the top edge down toward the bottom. Small patches of bright red and dark black paint are concentrated near the very top of the composition. Overall, the colors are muted and earthy, giving the work a weathered or gritty appearance.

title: Galaxy Calligraphy
alt_text: A sculpture of black granite and wood shows a rectangular stone slab resting on two wooden blocks. The top surface of the dark, rough-edged stone is mostly smooth. A shallow, circular indentation sits near the left side of the slab. To the right of that, a larger, irregularly shaped area features a textured, crystalline surface that catches the light. A small, simple circle is carved near the top center of the stone.

title: Silas in Yellow Canoe
alt_text: A painting of a person paddling a yellow canoe through a swampy forest. The person sits on the right side of the frame, facing toward the viewer with a calm expression. Fallen tree branches stretch across the foreground, partially obscuring the canoe as it cuts through the still, reflective water. In the background, tall, pale-colored trees grow closely together in a dense thicket. The color palette features muted greens, browns, and pale yellows that create a quiet, wooded atmosphere.

title: Rail Shooting on the Delaware
alt_text: A painting showing two men in a small wooden boat surrounded by tall green reeds. On the left, a man wearing a red shirt and a dark hat aims a long rifle toward the reeds. On the right, another man stands barefoot in the boat, using a long wooden pole to push it through the water. He wears a white shirt, dark pants, and a dark cap. The water is murky and brown, reflecting the boat and the men. In the background, soft green trees are visible against a pale, overcast sky.

title: Measurement: Standards & Practices
medium: Oil and acrylic on canvas, and vinyl on wall
alt_text: A painting of a small red square mounted on a large, blank white wall. A thin black line, marked with the measurement 358cm, runs horizontally across the wall through the center of the red square. Another vertical black line, marked 140cm, crosses the horizontal line at the square's location, dividing the white wall into sections. The red square itself is positioned at the intersection of these two black lines. The wall occupies most of the view, with a dark ceiling structure visible in the upper left corner and a dark floor at the bottom.

title: Centripetal
alt_text: A painting showing an abstract pattern in shades of orange. The entire square surface is filled with interlocking geometric shapes that resemble puzzle pieces. A darker, reddish-orange color forms the background, while a slightly lighter orange tone highlights the specific shapes. These shapes vary in size and have straight, angled, and curved edges. The pattern appears consistent across the entire composition, creating a uniform, flat look.

title: Centrifugal
alt_text: A painting with an abstract design made up of different shades of orange. The entire square surface is covered in flat shapes with straight, blocky edges that look like a puzzle or a maze. A darker, more reddish-orange shape sits in the center, interlocking with other forms. Surrounding the center are slightly lighter orange shapes that extend to the edges of the frame. The overall appearance is a grid-like pattern that plays with varying tones of orange.

title: Virgin and Child
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on stucco
alt_text: A stucco sculpture shows a woman and a child against a dark, textured background. The woman wears a red dress and a head covering, and her hands are pressed together in front of her chest. She tilts her head to look down at a small, blonde child sitting on her lap. The child faces the woman and reaches toward her hands with one arm. A circular, textured halo-like shape sits behind the woman's head.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A stucco sculpture showing a woman holding a small child. The figures are colored with worn gold and reddish paint against a gold background. The woman is on the left, looking down and embracing the child who faces forward. Both figures have golden, decorative halos engraved into the curved backing behind them. The sculpture has a rounded top edge and appears slightly weathered with cracks in the painted surface.

title: Saint John the Baptist in the Wilderness
alt_text: A painting showing a man with long brown hair kneeling in a rocky, outdoor landscape. He is bare-chested but draped in a large, bright red cloth that wraps around his body and legs. His right arm is stretched upward to catch water falling from a small spring in the rock face above him. In his left hand, he holds a long, thin wooden staff that has a small cross piece at the top. The background consists of hazy mountains and a dark, moody sky that suggests late or early daylight.

title: Jitterbug Atom
alt_text: A sculpture made of aluminum shows a complex, three-dimensional geometric shape. It is built from many flat, triangular panels arranged to form a polyhedron. The panels have a smooth, silver-grey, metallic finish. Thin metal bars join the edges of the triangles together to create the skeletal frame. The object sits centered against a plain, light grey background.

title: Effluencepartedinslumbering Fidget
alt_text: A painting of a vertical, narrow scene showing a textured surface of light blue, white, and pale green strokes. The center of the image is mostly a wash of these blended, light colors that look like water or sky. In the bottom left corner, there are darker, brownish forms that suggest foliage or rocks. Similar dark, warm brown tones appear as a thin strip along the far right edge of the frame. The overall appearance is soft and blurred, with visible brushwork throughout.

title: Composition No. 126
alt_text: A painting of simple geometric shapes on a flat brown background. Thin white lines form large, intersecting triangles in the center of the canvas. One small triangle is filled with a light pink color. Several short dashes in yellow, red, and dark brown are scattered around the edges of the composition. A single, small, solid black triangle sits near the middle left side.

title: Le Tricoleur
alt_text: A painting of a figure composed of many angular shapes and blocks of color. The subject appears to be seated, with sharp lines forming the head, shoulders, and legs. Warm tones of tan, yellow, and orange fill the central figure, contrasting with darker browns and greys in the background. Geometric triangles and rectangles create a textured, mosaic-like look throughout the composition. The entire work is enclosed within a simple, narrow wooden frame.

title: Tree
alt_text: A painting of a gnarled tree standing in a wooded area. The central tree has a thick, textured trunk with twisting branches that reach upward. Its bark is colored in shades of brown and gold. Surrounding the main tree, other thinner trees and green foliage fill the background. The painting is set inside a heavy, ornate gold frame with carved, swirling designs.

title: Electrical Energy
alt_text: A painting shows a vast, empty landscape under a dramatic sky filled with thick, dark storm clouds. Two large, brown, craggy mountains rise up on either side of the scene, creating a valley in the middle. The ground between the mountains appears to be a flat, brownish plain that fades into a misty horizon. Above, the heavy gray clouds dominate the view, with a small patch of lighter, white light breaking through near the left mountain. The overall mood is quiet and somber, with a soft, blurred focus throughout the entire image.

title: Denkmal
alt_text: A painting of abstract, rounded shapes set against a background of flat, muted colors. The dominant form is a large, dark-grey, curved mass that takes up much of the left side. To its right sits a softer, mauve-colored shape that resembles a curved head or hood. A long, thin, diagonal line stretches between the two, connecting a bright red mark on the top right to a smaller, pointed red triangle near the center. The background is composed of blocks of dusty rose, light purple, and dark grey.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of welded steel, canvas, and screen shows a box-like frame with an open center. The outer frame is made of several rectangular pieces of light-colored canvas stitched together with thin, dark metal wire. This canvas frame surrounds a dark, recessed area covered by a fine black mesh screen. Inside the dark center, one can see dim, indistinct shapes and angled lines that go deeper into the object. The entire structure appears boxy and slightly tilted against the plain background.

title: Hitler's Bunker
alt_text: A painting shows a chaotic scene featuring several figures with exaggerated facial features and oversized hands. In the center, a pale blue man with wide eyes sits at a desk, clutching a large black gun that he points toward his own mouth. Behind him, a man in a blue military uniform and red cap holds the back of his chair, while a large, disembodied tan fist descends from the upper right to strike the man's head. To the right of the desk, three small, dark grey, dog-like creatures with sharp teeth and matching hats stand in a row. A prominent red background featuring a black symbol hangs behind the entire group. Gold coins spill from the desk as splatters of dark red liquid appear near the man’s head and mouth.

title: U.S.S. Missouri
medium: Kneaded erasers on postcard, on painted wood
alt_text: A painting featuring a vintage postcard mounted on wood that shows the deck of a ship with large cannons. The postcard displays a man in white standing on the wooden deck near two long, dark gun barrels. Overlaid across the surface of the postcard are dozens of small, gray, lump-like objects that resemble kneaded erasers. These gray shapes are arranged in a dense pattern that covers much of the sky and the ship's machinery. The text "U.S.S. Missouri showing 13 inch Guns" is printed clearly at the bottom of the postcard.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a figure depicted in relief on a canvas. The image shows a single human-like form standing in the center, with hands placed firmly on its hips. The figure appears to be sculpted out of thick, pale, greenish-grey paint that contrasts with the surrounding background. The background is a flat, muted shade of sage green with visible brush strokes. A simple, thin white frame borders the entire rectangular artwork.

title: Still Life with Oysters
alt_text: A painting of a still life set on a table covered by a white cloth with thin red stripes. In the center, a dark round plate holds a small pile of open oyster shells. To the right, a tall, dark glass bottle stands next to a short, clear glass filled with liquid. A piece of yellow fruit peel curls off the left side of the table edge, near the plate. The background is a very dark, indistinct space that fades into shadow.

title: Portrait of an Artist, probably Sumner Russell (ca. 1808–1835)
alt_text: A miniature of a young man shown in profile from the chest up. He has curly dark hair and is wearing a dark coat with a white shirt and a wide dark neckcloth. Behind him to the right, a dark painter's palette rests, featuring small dabs of colored paint and a thin brush handle sticking up from it. The man looks toward the right side of the frame with a neutral expression. The background is a dark, indistinct color that contrasts with the man's lighter skin.

title: Large Bird, Black Face
medium: White earthenware clay with decoration in engobes, knife engraved
alt_text: A ceramic container decorated with black, white, and orange patterns. It has a round body, a narrow neck, and two thick handles that extend outward like arms. A stylized face with wide eyes appears on the neck of the vase. On the front of the belly, there is a large, dark, diamond-shaped patch that contains a simpler human-like face drawing. The entire surface is covered in etched lines and colorful marks.

title: Twilight in the Catskills
alt_text: A painting of a vast valley at sunset with mountains in the background. The sky is filled with glowing orange and red light from the sun. In the foreground, there are dark, bare tree trunks standing on a rocky ledge. A small, winding stream flows through the center of the valley far below. The landscape is shadowed and appears quiet under the dim light.

title: Katrina Portrait I
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in front of a flooded landscape. The man is in the foreground, facing forward with a serious expression and wearing a white tank top. His skin is brown, and he has a short beard. Behind him, a car is partially submerged in water, and several houses are tipped over or damaged. A bridge stretches across the background under a cloudy, grey sky.

title: Mercurio che passa davanti al sole (Mercury Passing before the Sun)
medium: Tempera and oil on textured paper, mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting of overlapping geometric shapes and curved lines. Large orange and brown circles dominate the center and right side of the canvas. Sharp, triangular white shapes cut across the scene from the upper left and middle. Bright blue accents fill the spaces between these forms, providing contrast against the dark background. The entire composition feels balanced, with interlocking curves and straight edges that seem to move across the surface.

title: Entenjagd (Duck Hunt)
alt_text: A sculpture showing a shallow, open wooden box filled with a flat, light brown substance. Small plastic bird figurines are scattered across the brown surface. On the left side, a group of dark-colored chickens stands together. Towards the center and right, smaller white and multi-colored bird figures are arranged in lines and small clusters. The open lid of the box stands vertically against a plain gray background.

title: Karpathenburg III
alt_text: A painting of a complex, layered collage featuring many different shapes, patterns, and colors. Numerous overlapping pieces appear to be cut from other materials, including textured grids, black-and-white patterns, and vibrant blocks of bright neon pink, red, blue, and yellow. On the upper right, large sweeping curves resemble flowing ribbon-like forms decorated with thin, parallel black lines. Below these, a large section features a dense red web pattern layered over darker shapes. The overall composition feels chaotic and dense, with various geometric forms scattered across the canvas in a crowded, overlapping arrangement.

title: Time Eater
alt_text: A painting showing a chaotic, textured scene filled with many small, distinct images. The background is a mix of swirling blue, grey, and brown shapes that resemble rough landscapes or clouds. Several distinct, flat, sticker-like shapes appear throughout, including a pink oval with an elephant drawing, a yellow oval with a figure, and a white cloud shape containing a small boat. In the lower-left corner, a grey figure sits on the ground, holding an object near its face. A tall, rectangular, grey structure with glowing circles sits on the right side of the canvas. The entire work is layered with squiggly lines, scribbles, and various colored shapes that create a dense and busy composition.

title: The Poker Game
alt_text: A painting of three people playing cards on a colorful blanket in a large, open field. A man in a hat sits on the left, an older man in a dark tunic sits in the middle, and a person with long dark hair sits on the right. They are gathered around a red, yellow, and blue blanket that is spread out on the dry, grassy ground. Small stacks of coins and playing cards are scattered across the blanket. Behind them, two horses stand near a small wooden cabin, and a large mountain range rises in the distance.

title: Not a Chinaman's Chance
alt_text: A painting of three men in a desert field sitting on a colorful blanket playing cards. On the left, a man in a hat and grey clothing kneels while holding a gun toward a man in the center who has his hands up in the air. To the right, a third man with long dark hair kneels on the blanket and looks toward the center figure. Behind the group, a brown horse stands waiting, and a wooden cabin sits near a large mountain range in the distance. The overall scene shows a tense interaction during a card game in a grassy, open landscape.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A glass sculpture shows a delicate, repeating lattice structure that resembles a honeycomb. The entire object is made of clear, transparent glass rods connected at multiple points. It is arranged in several vertical columns, with some parts taller than others, creating an uneven top edge. Small, pointed prongs extend upwards from the joints where the glass rods meet. The sculpture stands against a dark, smooth background that fades into a lighter gray surface at the bottom.

title: From the Bridge
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes in muted colors. On the left, a tall, dark gray vertical column features a repeating triangular pattern and small zigzag shapes along its side. Bold, thick black lines cut across the center and upper portion of the canvas, creating sharp angles against the background. In the lower background, a simple reddish-brown structure with a tall chimney sits against a large, flat rectangle of white. The background is divided into sections of pale blue at the top and a solid taupe-brown across the bottom.

title: No Title
alt_text: A sculpture consists of a rectangular glass and metal display case with three shelves holding six distinct objects. On the top shelf, a tan, folded object sits on the left, while a textured, yellow-orange, crescent-shaped piece sits on the right. The middle shelf displays a small, pale, clustered object next to a larger, honey-colored cylindrical container with a thin wire loop extending from its side. On the bottom shelf, a flat, brown, wavy form rests on the left, and a small, white, rectangular block sits on a brown base to the right. The entire case stands against a simple, neutral background.

title: Study for Schema
alt_text: A latex sculpture shows a square sheet with nine rounded bumps arranged in a grid of three rows and three columns. The entire piece is made of a smooth, amber-colored material. The surface of the flat base has a slightly wrinkled and irregular texture. Each of the nine dome-like shapes is raised and looks shiny, resembling mounds or soft, organic forms. The sculpture sits against a plain, light gray background.

title: The Resurrection of Lazarus
alt_text: A painting showing a large group of people gathered in an outdoor landscape. In the center, a man with long hair wearing blue and pink robes reaches his hand toward a pale, seated man resting on a stone ledge. The man on the ledge is shirtless and supported by two other figures, one wearing blue and the other wearing red. Many other people surround them, including a woman in the bottom left wearing a red dress, all appearing to observe the scene with different expressions. A small, light-colored dog stands on the ground near the bottom right corner of the painting. In the background, a hilly landscape with a castle sits under a cloudy, dark sky.

title: No Mind in Things
medium: Aluminum pitcher, wood table, and concrete
alt_text: A sculpture made of an aluminum pitcher, a wooden table, and concrete shows a pitcher tipped on its side. The large, metallic silver pitcher rests horizontally across the center of the wooden table's surface. A lumpy, gray mass of concrete spills out of the mouth of the pitcher and onto the table. The table itself is a dark, rectangular wooden stand with a single drawer and four thin legs. This entire arrangement is set against a plain, light gray background.

title: Willow Flower
alt_text: A sculpture made of willow and oak shows a creature-like form covered in many sharp, tapered spikes. The central body is a long, curved cylinder with small holes dotted across its tan surface. Extending from this main body are dozens of wooden spikes that point outward in all directions. Each spike is light brown near the base and fades to a dark, blackened tip. The sculpture sits on a flat, tan-colored workspace inside a room with metal storage shelves in the background.

title: Drawing from Miss Milligan
alt_text: A sculpture of charcoal on balsa endgrain shows a collection of overlapping black cube outlines. These cubes are drawn with thin, loose lines that look like a sketch. The background is a grid of light-colored, square wooden blocks arranged in a tall rectangle. The entire artwork is framed by a simple, thin wooden border. The overall composition creates a sense of depth and geometric patterns across the textured wooden surface.

title: Sphere IV
alt_text: A polished aluminum sculpture shows an arrangement of intersecting metal rings. Three large, flat bands curve to create a hollow, spherical shape. These bands are joined together to form an open, rounded structure. The sculpture sits on a brown, rectangular sheet of paper or board on a floor. In the background, a small orange traffic cone stands on the floor.

title: The Fabled Flowers of Fargo
alt_text: A painting of a surreal landscape shown in two side-by-side panels. Both panels feature a bright green grassy field filled with colorful, stylized flowers in shades of red, yellow, and blue. Long, thin green tendrils hang downward from the top of the panels like weeping willow branches or stalactites. The sky is a gradient of blue, dotted with abstract, cloud-like swirls in purple and light blue. A few distinct shapes like a lone tree in the distance break up the horizon line.

title: Antarctica
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting on the ground in a room with a green wall. The man wears a white shirt and is positioned on the right side of the frame, looking down at objects on the floor. Around him are several small figures, including a group of pale, bird-like animals near his feet and a tiny, white standing statue. A dark, round container lies on the floor nearby, next to a small, framed rectangular object with a red accent. The background is a hazy mix of green, orange, and white tones.

title: Ballynaeve
alt_text: A cherry and pine sculpture displays several sharp, pointed pieces of wood joined together. The object rests on a flat, white rectangular base. It features three long, narrow wooden legs that angle outward toward the bottom. A taller, pointed piece of wood rises diagonally from the center of the structure. Small dark metal fasteners are visible where the wooden segments connect to one another.

title: The Wheeler
alt_text: A painting of a person with long, dark hair who appears from the chest up. The person has a serious expression and is surrounded by abstract, colorful splashes of paint. Vibrant red paint outlines their body and also forms a large, horizontal shape at the bottom of the image. The background features splotches of bright green and white, which look like spray paint or watercolor washes. A diagonal streak of white light cuts across the left side of the scene.

title: Untitled (Ebony #1)
medium: Carved ebony sculpture with iron-alloy stand
alt_text: A sculpture of carved ebony shows a series of interlocking, dark wooden shapes. The sculpture is made of many angular, block-like pieces that rise upward in a complex, abstract arrangement. Near the center, a prominent piece of the dark wood rises to a point, featuring a rougher texture than the surrounding smooth, angled segments. Below this, horizontal lines suggest a stepped or layered structure within the wood. The object sits on a plain surface, likely a shelf in a storage area, with metal shelving racks visible in the background.

title: Head with Rope
alt_text: A painting of a person's head and shoulders shown in a close-up portrait. The face is painted in pale, muted tones with strong shadows that obscure the left side. The person has short, curly hair and looks directly forward with a serious expression. A thick, textured rope hangs around the person’s neck and chest area, contrasting with the smooth paint of the face. The background is a soft, dark, and uneven shade of brown.

title: The Wheel
alt_text: A painting showing a large, circular wheel in the foreground against a hazy, abstract background. The wheel is painted in shades of blue and gray with thin, spoke-like lines radiating from the center. To the right of the wheel, a dark brown, angular shape creates a sharp contrast with the soft, blurry background. The ground below the wheel is a textured, light-colored patch that looks like weathered paint. A single, thin line extends from the side of the wheel towards the left, disappearing into the hazy yellow and blue mist.

title: JS inventory #241
alt_text: A sculpture of a sofa is covered in patches of various colors and textures. The back cushion features a large, bright orange circle and patches of red, white, and black. One side of the sofa has a wooden slat armrest, while the other side is topped with a thick, rope-like bundle of light brown material. A long, dark, braided cable wraps around the back and hangs over the seat. A single, thin green string extends from the center of the orange circle out toward the right side.

title: IKON EARTH (Homage to John Cage)
medium: Pay Dirt potting soil, flexible inks on polyethylene, and ziplok closure, and compressed wood palettes
alt_text: A sculpture of two compressed wood shipping pallets is set against a plain, light grey background. On the left sits an empty, rectangular pallet with a textured, brown, pressed-wood appearance. To its right, an identical pallet holds a tall, neat stack of rectangular plastic bags. These bags are white and bright red, featuring black text that reads "EARTH" and "IKON" on their surfaces. The stack of bags is arranged in two columns and is several layers high.

title: Bacchus and Ariadne
alt_text: A painting of a man standing over a woman who is reclining on a shore. The man on the left has bare shoulders and wears a wreath of green leaves and grapes on his head. He points his right arm toward the upper left corner of the scene. The woman reclines on the right, resting on white and red fabric while wearing a pearl necklace and a small crown. Behind them, the sky is dark and stormy, with a small ship visible in the distance on the water.

title: Hanging Column, from Dawn's Wedding Feast
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture showing two long, vertical objects hanging side-by-side against a plain gray background. The object on the left is composed of many irregular, jagged pieces of wood stacked to create a rough, textured surface. The object on the right is smoother and straighter, made of long, flat wooden strips of varying lengths arranged parallel to each other. Both objects are colored a uniform, pale off-white. Thin wires attach both pieces to the top of the frame, making them appear to float in space.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a painted wood construction features abstract shapes set against a dark, textured background. In the upper middle section, a circular, flower-like form with radiating lines sits prominently. To the lower left, a geometric structure resembling a kiln or hearth is painted in shades of tan and brown with sharp, ink-like outlines. On the lower right, another angular form contains a thick, curved red stroke, contrasting with the surrounding muted tones. Deep black paint dominates the empty spaces around these objects, tying the different parts of the composition together.

title: Four paintings on tile (Quatre peintures sur un carreau)
medium: Oil on four ceramic tiles set in mortar with plaster
alt_text: A painting on four ceramic tiles set in mortar shows a grid of four distinct, square images with a muted, brownish color palette. The top-left tile depicts a grey, goblet-like shape next to a textured, rectangular object. The top-right tile features a curved white scroll shape with dark letters and small abstract patterns. The bottom-left square shows a paper-like shape decorated with a pattern of small, dark, diamond-like marks. The bottom-right tile displays a round bowl filled with dark, rounded forms that look like fruit.

title: Richard Brown Baker
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair against a plain background. The man has light hair and is wearing a dark suit with a red tie. He sits with his legs crossed, facing toward the front. The chair has dark wooden arms and a light-colored, padded seat. The painting is framed in gold and is displayed in a storage area surrounded by metal racks.

title: Reclining Construction
alt_text: A painted iron sculpture showing a collection of abstract, dark shapes suspended in the air. The main body consists of thin, metal pieces with organic, curvy edges that seem to lean or recline. These pieces are propped up at both ends by two small, vertical metal posts that are anchored to a flat, rectangular base. On the left, a small sphere is attached to the tip of one of the metal forms. Other details include small, cut-out holes and jagged edges along the surface of the iron plates. The entire piece is uniform in color, displaying a dark, rusted-brown finish throughout.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of swirling, abstract shapes fills the entire frame. The image is colored in shades of warm orange, brown, and deep black. Thick, wavy lines twist and overlap each other, creating a dense pattern that covers the canvas from edge to edge. Shadows between the layers of paint make the surface look three-dimensional. There are no recognizable objects or people visible in the scene.

title: The Ermine Muff
