alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on a dark red sofa in a dimly lit room. She wears a long, black dress and a large, wide-brimmed black hat. A white, fur-like muff rests in her lap, and a white, fringed scarf hangs around her neck. To her right, a single, light-colored chair stands on the floor. The background is mostly dark and indistinct, with hints of fabric and furniture shadows.

title: Italian Moon
alt_text: A painting of a dark, hilly landscape beneath a bright circular moon. The hills are depicted with sharp, white lines that suggest rugged texture or possibly snow. Below these lines, the hills are made of deep, dark brown and earthy tones that blend into shadows. A single, pale white circle floats in the upper center of the composition against a textured, brownish-gray sky. The entire scene has a rough, heavily layered look.

title: Prisoner I
alt_text: A painting of three people in an indoor room with tan walls and a gray floor. To the left, a bald person wearing a green outfit stands tall and faces forward. In the center, an older person with white hair kneels on the floor, facing the right. Another person in an orange shirt stands behind the kneeling person and leans toward them. A tall, rectangular red door is visible on the back wall behind the two people on the right.

title: Seven-Part Variations on Two Different Kinds of Cubes (Small version)
alt_text: A sculpture made of light-colored materials shows a grid of six small, open-faced box structures arranged on a flat, square base. Each of the six boxes has an open front and a single shelf inside, dividing the space horizontally. The boxes are arranged in two rows of three, creating a regular, organized pattern. The flat base beneath the structures features faint, thin lines drawn in graphite, marking a grid on the surface. These components are simple and uniform in size and color, sitting on a white table in an indoor room.

title: Hot Horizon
alt_text: A painting shows an abstract composition with a long band of solid orange-red color across the top. Below this band, the main area is filled with a grey and light-colored background covered in many thick black shapes like lines, curves, and blots. Scattered among these black shapes are smaller, vibrant patches of blue, bright yellow, and orange. One large, reddish-orange, star-like shape is positioned towards the right side of the center. The black shapes are varied in thickness and direction, creating a busy and textured appearance.

title: Tree Turbine
alt_text: A digital animation shows a single tall tree standing alone on top of a grassy hill. The tree is thin and evergreen, and it rises straight up from the center of the gently sloping landscape. Below the tree, the ground is covered in green grass with patches of brownish earth. The blue sky above is filled with many long, thin, white clouds stretched horizontally. Several thin metal poles are scattered across the lower parts of the hill.

title: Hanging Column, from Dawn's Wedding Feast
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture of two thin, hanging rectangular shapes against a plain gray background. The object on the left is composed of many small, overlapping, rough-edged wooden pieces that create a textured, uneven column. The object on the right is smoother and straighter, featuring long, vertical strips of wood attached to a central post. Both structures are off-white or light gray in color and hang from thin, nearly invisible wires attached to the top. They appear to be suspended in the air.

title: The Forest
alt_text: A painting of four women standing among dark, stylized trees. The two women in the front are topless, wearing long skirts and facing forward. One stands on the left with dark hair, and the other stands in the center with lighter hair and one arm raised behind her head. A third woman, mostly obscured, stands further back between the trees. To the right, a fourth woman faces away from the viewer, reaching toward a tree trunk. The background is filled with tall, thick tree trunks and dark green foliage.

title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
alt_text: A painting of a man falling from a white horse on a grassy path. The man wears armor and a long red cape as he looks up toward a figure in the sky. This figure in the clouds appears to be a man with long hair pointing down. In the background, a hilly landscape features a large castle and many smaller figures on horseback. To the left of the fallen man, a metal helmet rests on the ground.

title: Parade of Horsemen
alt_text: A copper sculpture mounted on wood shows a long, horizontal panel featuring a detailed relief. This piece displays a continuous line of figures riding horses, facing toward the left side of the frame. The entire scene is crafted in a warm, metallic gold color that catches the light against the flatter background. Vertical seams divide the long strip into three distinct sections. Small metal rings are attached to the top edge, likely for hanging the object.

title: Parade of horsemen, unmounted horses, soldiers on foot and on a chariot carrying shields
alt_text: A gilt copper sculpture shows a long, horizontal procession of many people and horses in profile. The artwork is shaped like a narrow, rectangular frieze mounted on a light-colored wooden surface. The scene depicts groups of figures moving from left to right across the metal surface. Some of the figures are riding on horses, while others walk alongside them on the ground. Two small metal rings are attached to the top edge, likely used for hanging the piece.

title: Parade of robed men, some playing the lyre, some playing flute, others carrying wine flasks and plates, 8 men leading 4 bulls
alt_text: A gilt copper sculpture shows a long, horizontal panel filled with many small human figures standing in a row. The figures are carved in shallow relief against a shiny, metallic background that spans the width of the piece. Most of the figures wear draped clothing and stand side-by-side, appearing to walk or stand in a procession. There are two small loops visible at the top edge of the panel for hanging it. The entire piece has a warm, gold color and is displayed against a wooden surface.

title: Procession of robed women and two seated couples
alt_text: A gilt copper sculpture of a long, rectangular frieze depicts a procession of numerous human figures. The scene is organized into a single, continuous row of characters standing or sitting in profile across the metal surface. On the left side, several seated figures appear to be interacting with a group of standing figures approaching them. The rest of the scene is filled with a long line of identical, standing figures facing toward the left. The entire piece has a shiny, golden-brown metallic texture that catches the light. Two small metal loops attached to the top edge suggest it is meant for hanging.

title: Parade of galloping horsemen
alt_text: A gilt copper sculpture shows a long, horizontal strip filled with many figures on horseback. The metallic surface has a bright golden color and appears to be mounted on a wood backing. A continuous line of riders moves from left to right across the entire length of the rectangular panel. Each small figure is embossed in relief, showing the horses in mid-stride and the riders seated on their backs. Two small, simple metal loops are attached to the top edge for hanging the piece.

title: Parade of galloping horsemen, with one single figure standing between the last two horsemen and the rest
alt_text: A gilt copper sculpture shows a long, rectangular frieze featuring a procession of people riding horses. Many figures are arranged in a line, moving from left to right across the golden surface. A few figures stand on foot among the horses, including one person wearing a long robe. Two small metal loops are attached to the top edge of the narrow, horizontal panel. The entire surface is raised in relief, creating depth and shadows across the scene.

title: Five groups of fighting men and women, some on horseback and some with shields
alt_text: A gilt copper sculpture of a long, narrow rectangular plaque shows many small figures in relief. The golden surface is filled with rows of people standing, crouching, and wrestling in active poses. Some of the figures hold circular shields and weapons while facing each other. There is a seam visible on the left side that divides the scene into two parts. The entire piece is attached to a flat wooden board with small nails or studs along the top and bottom edges. Two metal loops at the top allow the object to hang on a wall.

title: Men with shields fighting with women, with one woman on horseback
alt_text: A sculpture of gilt copper on wood shows a long, horizontal frieze depicting many small figures. The rectangular panel features a continuous scene of human figures in dynamic, combat-like poses. These figures hold circular shields and appear to be lunging or fighting across the entire length of the gold-colored surface. A simple decorative border with small dots runs along both the top and bottom edges of the panel. The entire piece is mounted against a wooden background with visible horizontal planks.

title: Portrait of Albert–Ernest Carrier–Belleuse (1824–1887)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a circular relief of a man's face in profile. The man faces left and has a mustache, wavy hair, and is wearing a collared jacket. Behind his head and shoulder, a smaller figure with wings is depicted in a flowing pose. Text is carved into the border around the entire edge of the circle. The sculpture is solid white and features a small metal loop at the top for hanging.

title: Medallion Portrait of Alfred Louis Charles de Musset-Pathay (1810–1857)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture in the shape of a circular medallion shows the head and shoulders of a young man. The man is turned slightly to the left and has wavy hair that curls around his ears. He has a straight nose, closed lips, and a steady, forward-facing expression. To the left of his head, the name "ALFRED DE MUSSET" is carved into the surface. To the right of his head, the words "DAVID 1831" are also carved into the plaster. A small metal loop at the top of the circle allows it to be hung.

title: Robert Storr and his Wife Rosamund Morley Playing the Viola de Gamba in Degas's Portrait of Manet and his Wife
alt_text: A painting in oil on linen showing a room with two distinct panels of scenes. In the larger left panel, a person wearing a dark coat and yellow shirt reclines on a pale, rumpled sofa. A woman wearing a long, light blue dress stands next to the sofa, facing toward the right. A wide, vertical band of unpainted brown fabric separates the two panels. In the narrower right panel, the same woman in the blue dress is shown sitting down. She holds a small book or sheet music in her hands while looking at it.

title: Autorretrato
alt_text: A painting of black lines and shapes covering the entire canvas. Many of the lines form thick, tangled patterns that look like abstract markings or symbols. In the center, a small, dark square stands out against the surrounding pattern. The background is mostly black, with thin, lighter gaps between the dense lines. These markings create a textured, maze-like effect across the surface.

title: Beethoven with Two Hands
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a person's head emerging from a block of rough, dark stone. The face has deep-set eyes, a furrowed brow, and a serious, intense expression. One hand is pressed against the side of the head, with thick, textured fingers visible near the chin and jawline. The surface of the metal is craggy and uneven, suggesting rock or earth surrounding the face. Carved into the flat bottom section are several lines of neat, handwritten script. A signature is also scratched into the lower right corner of the base.

title: Ash Head No. 3
alt_text: A sculpture of a human head and shoulders stands on a tall, thin tripod. The bust is made of a rough, textured, dark-brown material that appears crumbly and dense. It rests on a square wooden board, which is balanced on a simple black metal frame with three slender legs. The entire display is positioned in an indoor space with a bright, blurry window behind it and a wooden floor below. The sculpture has a somber expression with deep-set eyes and a defined nose.

title: Spider
medium: Acrylic and aluminum paint on canvas
alt_text: A painting of abstract forms made with acrylic and aluminum paint on canvas. A large, dark grey area takes up much of the left side, blending into lighter shades. Splashes of bright white paint stretch across the center like mist. Bold streaks of metallic bronze paint cut through the middle, creating sharp lines and drips. The right side of the canvas is a solid, vibrant orange that contrasts against the darker tones.

title: Charge
alt_text: A sculpture of forged steel and wood shows three small figures balanced on a large, curved metal blade. The blade is curved like a leaf and pivots on a metal ring attached to a rectangular wooden base. On the left side of the blade, a reclining figure stretches upward with arms raised. In the middle, a standing figure holds a thin, wire-like wand upward. On the right side of the blade, a small crouched figure balances a round sphere on its back.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, fluid shapes in muted colors covers the entire canvas. Large, irregular patches of light blue, forest green, tan, and cream overlap across the surface. A bright patch of white sits on the left side, contrasting with deeper brown and dark green areas near the bottom. The paint appears applied with wide, sweeping brushstrokes that blend softly into one another. The composition has no clear focal point and lacks recognizable objects or figures.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting showing abstract, swirling shapes and lines spread across a light, creamy background. Soft patches of yellow, pale blue, and tan wash across the surface like thin watercolor. Darker, more defined strokes of red, forest green, and teal move through the center of the canvas in jagged and curved patterns. Some of the paint appears drippy or streaked, adding texture to the otherwise smooth-looking areas. The overall composition feels loose and open, with no distinct objects or recognizable subjects depicted.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, swirling shapes rendered in bold colors. A large, curving form in bright orange dominates the center and flows toward the right side. On the left, a dark, rounded shape sits against a pale, textured background with green streaks. The bottom portion of the canvas features a patch of dark green and black. These shapes appear to be layered on top of each other, creating a sense of fluid movement.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting shows an abstract scene filled with blended colors and shapes. A prominent, curved orange band sweeps diagonally across the canvas from the upper left to the lower right. Around this band, shades of green create a textured background with spots of deep blue and dark gray. A softer patch of lighter blue rests in the upper right section. The artwork is propped upright against a wire mesh rack in what appears to be a storage room.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting shows a large, rectangular abstract composition hanging on a metal storage rack. The artwork features wide, vertical bands of color including pale yellow, light grey-blue, and a deep reddish-brown. A single, thick, curved black brushstroke cuts diagonally downward across the right side of the canvas. To the left of the main piece, another painting with softer, paler yellow and green tones is partially visible. The background consists of a metallic mesh storage system that continues to the right.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, swirling shapes in muted colors. The center of the canvas is dominated by large washes of pale yellow and soft green. A few blocky shapes, including a peach-colored square on the left and a round circle at the top right, are painted against a hazy, light-colored background. The brushstrokes look thick and blended, creating an uneven and soft texture. This painting sits among other canvases on a storage rack made of wire mesh.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting shows abstract shapes and blended colors on a large, rectangular canvas. The center features deep rust-orange and muddy brown swirls that snake across a pale, off-white background. To the left, patches of dull blue and murky green mix with the darker orange tones. Smaller, bright yellow accents appear in the lower-middle section, catching the eye against the softer colors. The painting is displayed on a metal rack alongside other framed pieces of art.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and colors across a light-colored background. To the upper left, a dark blue-green shape sits against a backdrop of muted yellow. A thin, red line curves across the center of the canvas, connecting two separate areas. On the right side, a darker green, uneven shape hangs towards the middle. At the bottom right, a textured mound of yellow and light green fills the corner. Thin drips of paint run down from the dark blue-green shape on the left.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, swirling shapes and colors. In the upper left, a bright yellow and red form surrounds a flat, tan-colored square. Large, flowing washes of white and pale grey move across the center of the canvas. A deep, rich green shape dominates the lower half, curving upward toward the right side. On the lower right, a solid block of bright orange and deep blue completes the composition.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting showing abstract, swirling shapes in bold and varied colors. A large, pale green, liquid-like mass fills the center of the canvas. This green area is surrounded by deep black and bright yellow sections that twist and turn around it. Smaller, bright orange shapes sit near the bottom right and middle left, framing the central flow. Dark blue patches are scattered throughout, providing deep contrast against the lighter background colors. The composition feels fluid and energetic, with no clear subject matter depicted.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, colorful shapes fills the frame. Large patches of vibrant green dominate the background, contrasting with curved blobs of orange, pink, and dark brown. In the center, a messy, layered shape looks like a swirl of blended colors. To the left, a smaller, vertical canvas stands partially visible on a metal storage rack. The entire scene is shown at an angle, highlighting the metallic rack holding the paintings in storage.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, colorful shapes scattered across a pale, off-white background. The most prominent shape is a bright orange, loop-like form in the lower left, resembling a twisted ribbon. To the right of this orange shape is a large, mottled area of blue and gray, which looks like a wash of watercolor paint. Near the top of the canvas, there is a wider, orange-colored splash of paint that stretches horizontally. Darker, deep green brushstrokes are scattered near the center and within the blue section, adding contrast to the lighter areas. The entire composition has a loose, fluid quality with visible brushwork throughout.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of green shapes against a lighter green background. Two thick, dark green brushstrokes intersect near the upper left side of the canvas. One stroke runs vertically, extending downward from the top edge. The other stroke runs horizontally, stretching from the vertical line toward the right side. The background is a flat, uniform field of a paler, softer green color.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting shows a beige and cream abstract composition. A thick, curving, light-brown band runs vertically up the left side and branches off toward the right side. The background is a textured, creamy off-white color that fills the rest of the canvas. The paint strokes appear heavy and layered in some areas, creating subtle shadows. This simple arrangement creates a stark contrast between the curving brown band and the pale background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting shows a vibrant display of abstract shapes and bold colors. Broad, sweeping brushstrokes of red, green, blue, and yellow create an energetic composition across the canvas. A large, bright white area dominates the center and lower parts of the piece. Deep reds stretch across the mid-section and top left, contrasting with the lighter tones. The paint appears thick, with visible textures and layers throughout the work.

title: Freeport Bridge – Black
alt_text: A painting of a dark, layered landscape or interior scene with a bright horizontal strip. The top section is a large, deep teal area that looks like a night sky. Below that, a heavy black rectangular shape stretches across the middle of the canvas. Inside this black shape is a rectangular opening, revealing a smaller, lighter view of a yellow ground and some indistinct structural lines. The bottom third of the painting is a solid, pale yellow area that reflects light. A spiky, dark, tangled cluster appears on the left edge of the painting near the black horizontal form.

title: The Many Faces of Addiction
alt_text: A painting of a screenprint on slate shows a large Venn diagram on a dark green background. Four intersecting white circles contain numerous words written in capital letters, each preceded by a small star. The words describe various substances, medical conditions, and emotional states, including terms like "alcohol," "sugar," "depression," and "work." The circles overlap in the center, creating smaller enclosed spaces that also contain list items. The entire diagram is framed in a thin silver or metal border.

title: Too Much, Too Soon
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular, dark gray block housed within a square wooden frame. The block sits horizontally in the lower half of the frame against a plain white background. On top of the block, two pale, curved objects are held down by gray strips of tape. A pile of small, smooth, tan-colored stones is clustered at the bottom left corner against the side of the block. A vertical, light-colored smear runs down the front of the dark block near the center.

title: Mountain Beans
alt_text: A sculpture display features eight small, heart-shaped ceramic pieces arranged on a white background inside a rectangular wooden frame. Each of these smooth, beige pieces has a small, dark image painted on its surface. Most of the pieces are attached to light brown paper tags with thin wire strings. Small, rectangular labels with typed text sit directly beneath or beside several of the heart shapes. The entire collection is enclosed behind glass, creating the appearance of a specimen box.

title: Telephones
alt_text: A video still shows a man talking on a telephone in an indoor setting. The man has short, light hair and wears a blue jacket over a light-colored collared shirt. He holds a dark telephone receiver to his ear with his left hand while looking slightly to the side with a serious expression. In the foreground, the glowing, rounded top of a table lamp takes up the lower-left corner. Behind him, a tall, multi-paneled room divider features dark, leafy tree designs. The background also includes vertical, light-colored curtains draped beside the divider.

title: My Ancestors (Ancestor Worship)
alt_text: A painting of a tall man in a brown jacket standing in a large white doorway. Behind him, through the open frame, is a green graveyard filled with many small, simple headstones. On the wall above the man hangs a framed portrait of another person in a blue coat. In the foreground, three children sit on a wooden floor or deck. Each child wears dark blue overalls and holds a long-handled tool that rests on the ground.

title: Compositional Study
medium: Oil and metal leaf on canvas
alt_text: A painting showing a scene with a golden sky above a rocky landscape. In the upper part, a bright, white bird with outstretched wings hovers over a stony slope. Near the top of the slope, two dark, small figures walk along the skyline. Below, a person lies flat on the ground wearing dark clothing with a bright red cloak draped over their back. A thin, wooden staff rests on the ground near the person's side.

title: St. Nicholas the Wonderworker; Feast of the Pokrov, depicting scenes from the life of St. Andrew and Epiphanius, Romanos, and the Virgin Mary with Saints Peter and Paul; St. Basil the Great, St. John Chrysostom, and St. Gregory the Theologian
alt_text: A painting on wood panels and brass showing a three-part folding shrine. The left panel displays a single central figure wearing a large crown and holding a book. The middle panel features a larger, crowded scene with several standing figures gathered beneath an architectural structure. The right panel depicts three figures standing side-by-side in long, patterned robes. Each rectangular panel is framed by a simple border and appears aged, with surface marks visible across the artwork.

title: Wilbur Sherman (1776–1856)
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair with an open book resting on his lap. The man has a receding hairline and brown eyes, and he looks directly toward the viewer. He wears a dark blue jacket over a vest with horizontal gold and black stripes. His white collared shirt features a bow tie at the neck. One hand rests on the open pages of the book, while his other arm is bent and leaning against the back of the wooden chair.

title: Caleb Sherman (1736–1822)
alt_text: A painting of an older man seated in a wooden chair against a plain, light-gray background. The man has a bald head, brown eyes, and a serious expression. He wears a dark brown jacket over a black vest with gold buttons and a white shirt with a ruffled collar. In his right hand, he holds a long, tan walking stick that angles upward toward the left edge of the frame. His left hand rests on the arm of a simple chair decorated with small gold stenciled patterns.

title: Souvenir Piece
medium: Acrylic and flocking on wood and canvas
alt_text: A sculpture shows a low, rectangular green platform holding four long sections of halved tree trunks. The wood segments lie side-by-side, with rough, brown, textured bark facing upward and smooth, flat green undersides flush against the platform. Mounted on the white wall directly behind the platform hangs a large, rectangular piece of fabric. This canvas is washed in a light, cloudy grey and features a thin, horizontal white line with three delicate, schematic drawings of upright structures above it. Dark, circular fasteners hold the four corners of the canvas against the wall.

title: What Will Come
medium: Anamorphic projection: 35mm film transferred to DVD; cold rolled steel table and cylinder
alt_text: A moving image installation shows a reflective cylinder standing in the center of a flat, circular table. The table’s surface is illuminated with a circular projection of shifting, dark, abstract shapes on a light background. These shapes appear distorted and stretched out when viewed directly on the table's surface. However, the shapes look clear and distinct when reflected onto the curved, mirror-like surface of the central cylinder. The entire scene is set against a dark background, highlighting the bright contrast of the table and the projection.

title: Pan
alt_text: A painting of a bright yellow, rounded square shape. In the center are two dark red, vertical, wavy shapes that look like stylized footprints or simple abstract forms. These two red shapes are spaced evenly apart from each other. The yellow background is painted with visible, vertical brushstrokes. The edges of the canvas are rounded, giving it a soft, squarish appearance.

title: Pepsi
alt_text: A painting showing a bright red curved shape, a white textured wavy band, and a deep blue curved shape. These three bands run diagonally across the square canvas from the top left to the bottom right. The red section at the top is a bold, solid block of color. The white band in the middle has visible brushstrokes and looks slightly gray. The blue section at the bottom right mirrors the curve of the red one above it.

title: Four Saints
alt_text: A painting on panel showing four portrait-like figures set within individual quatrefoil frames. Each figure is placed inside a gold-colored, scalloped border against a dark background. The people have shoulder-length hair and wear draped garments in shades of red, pink, and orange. The two figures on the right hold long, pale ribbons that curve across their chests. A simple, rectangular wooden frame surrounds the entire arrangement.

title: Edith Harlow (born 1879)
medium: Watercolor on ivory, set in original turned wood frame
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting shows a woman centered inside an oval, black wooden frame. The woman has brown hair pinned up and wears a dark blouse with a small black ribbon choker around her neck. She sits angled slightly to the side while looking directly toward the viewer with a calm expression. Her right arm rests in her lap, and her left arm rests on the arm of a chair. The background is a soft, textured blur of blue and grey tones.

title: Chit Chat
medium: Mixed media and single-channel video animation
alt_text: A mixed media installation showing a light-colored, box-like structure perched on top of a tall, three-legged wooden stand. The wooden stand has long, thin legs that spread out to form a tripod shape on the ground. A black rectangular opening sits at the front of the box, appearing hollow and dark inside. A thin black cord hangs from the back of the box and trails down to the floor, extending toward the left side of the frame. The entire object stands against a plain, neutral gray background.

title: Verbe
medium: Flannel, wool, tweed, cardboard, polyfill, forged steel, and wooden jigsaw puzzle pieces from Johannes Vermeer's "The Artist's Studio" (ca. 1665/66)
alt_text: A sculpture made of fabric and other materials shows a soft, white, bulb-shaped form with a wide opening. The outer surface is pale, textured, and divided into curved panels by stitched lines. Inside the opening, a dark gray surface is filled with small, colorful, jagged shapes that look like puzzle pieces. These pieces are irregularly shaped and appear to be embedded into the dark interior lining. The entire object tapers to a point on the right side and rests against a plain, gray background.

title: Untitled
medium: Lamp harp with wire on cement base
alt_text: A sculpture of a lamp harp with wire sits on a heavy, white cement base. The metal harp forms an oval shape, resembling the outline of a head. Inside this oval, a piece of wire is bent into a simple nose shape and two round circles that look like glasses. The entire structure stands on a block of white, rough-textured cement. Underneath the base is a layer of clear bubble wrap.

title: Bust of Wallace L. Pierce
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man's head and chest sits against a plain background. The figure is shown from the chest up and faces directly forward. He has short, neat hair and a prominent mustache that curls slightly at the ends. He wears a formal collared shirt, a necktie, and a buttoned vest under a suit jacket. The sculpture rests on a square, solid base that matches the white color of the figure.

title: The Archangel Raphael Prevents a Suicide
alt_text: A painting of two scenes set inside a gold frame. On the left side, two people in colorful medieval clothing walk down a narrow street lined by tall, pink buildings. On the right side, an angel with large gold wings reaches down toward a man suspended above a bench. The man wears a blue tunic and red leggings, and a small wooden stool lies overturned on the ground below him. The background is painted in shades of muted green and deep red.

title: Four Saints
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows four figures arranged in a horizontal row within a simple rectangular frame. Each figure is contained inside an individual, four-lobed gold frame with a dark green background. The first figure on the left wears a white hat and dark robe with a reddish collar. The second figure wears a white and gold hat with red robes and raises one hand. The third figure wears a wide red hat and a dark robe, and holds a green, book-like object. The fourth figure on the right wears a white and gold hat with a yellow and red robe, holding a small white scroll.

title: Compotier, verre et journal
alt_text: A painting of a still life scene with fruit and a vase resting on a table. Three round, yellow-orange fruits are clustered on a white, folded cloth in the upper left section. To the right of the fruit, a curved vase stands upright with muted pink and brown colors. Below these objects, a piece of paper lies flat on the table, showing the dark, uppercase letters "AR". The background consists of flat, muted patterns in shades of grey, tan, and dark green. The entire composition is encased in a weathered, dark green wooden frame.

title: Diana
medium: Bronze on an original marble base
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a female figure standing on one foot atop a small, round sphere. She is naked and her body is posed in a graceful arc as she pulls back the string of a long bow held in her left hand. Her right hand is near her cheek, pulling an arrow tight. She looks forward with her head turned toward the end of the arrow. The entire figure balances on a square, dark, mottled stone base.

title: Shilluk Warrior, Sudan
medium: Bronze on an original wooden base
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a standing man holding a long, thin spear. The dark, metallic figure is slender and leans on one leg, with the other leg bent at the knee. He wears a band on his upper arm and has short, textured hair on his head. The figure balances on a small, textured mound that sits atop a simple black wooden base. The entire object is centered against a plain, light gray background.

title: Tabernacle Frame with God the Father, Adoring Angels, and Seraphim
medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on panel
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows an arched, gold-decorated frame with a large, empty rectangular opening in the center. An older man with a white beard and red robes sits in an arch at the very top, with his hands outstretched. Several red-winged angel heads surround the arch and the bottom of the frame. On the left and right sides of the opening, two standing figures in long robes press their hands together in prayer. A horizontal band at the bottom displays large, dark-colored capital letters spelling out Latin text.

title: West Rock, New Haven
alt_text: A painting of a rural scene shows a large, rocky hill rising above a valley with scattered houses. In the foreground, a man in a top hat rides a horse, while another man leads a wooden cart pulled by two oxen down a dusty road. A split-rail fence runs along the left side of the road, where a few people stand on the grassy slope. Toward the center of the valley, a small white church with a tall, thin steeple sits among green trees. The sky above is pale, suggesting either dawn or dusk.

title: East Rock, New Haven
alt_text: A painting of a rural landscape features a large, flat-topped mountain rising in the center under a hazy, sunset-colored sky. In the foreground, a golden field is dotted with several rounded haystacks, with two figures walking near them. A small horse-drawn cart crosses a low wooden bridge over a quiet stream to the left. The scene is framed on both sides by large, dark leafy trees that reach toward the top of the frame. The overall atmosphere feels peaceful and warm as the day draws to an end.

title: In Memory of the Brig Sally's Distress, Stranded on Long Island, 20 Dec. 1777
medium: Watercolor on ivory, in rose-gold-over-copper brooch with beaded border and gold lettering on dark blue enamel
alt_text: A miniature of a watercolor on ivory shows a man and a woman embracing within an oval frame. The couple is seated close together, with the woman on the left and the man on the right, both looking toward each other. Behind them, a simple drawing of a sailboat with a flag sits near the horizon. The entire scene is enclosed by a dark blue border that features gold lettering circling the edge. This oval piece is surrounded by a gold, beaded frame.

title: The Crucifixion with the Virgin, Saint Mary Magdalene and Saint John the Evangelist
alt_text: A painting of a central figure hanging from a large, black, cross-shaped structure against a gold background. Above, four small winged figures float on either side of the cross, their hands reaching toward the central figure. Below, a woman in a blue robe stands on the left, and a woman in a long pink robe stands on the right. Another woman with long blonde hair kneels in front of the cross, wearing a bright orange dress and looking upward. At the very bottom, near the base of the cross, sits a small white skull.

title: David, Moses, and Two Prophets
alt_text: A painting on panel shows four people with serious expressions clustered together. On the left, a person with reddish hair looks upward with clasped hands. Beside them, a man wearing a light-colored turban and a deep red garment holds a wooden object. Partially hidden behind him, another face looks out from the shadows. To the right, an older man with a long white beard and a yellow robe holds a large, pale rectangular slab that has writing etched on it. A glowing gold arch outlines their heads against a dark, textured blue background.

title: Many Happy Returns
alt_text: A painting shows a portrait of a man attached to a light green wooden wall covered with various notes and clippings. The portrait features a dark-haired man in a brown coat facing forward. A piece of white paper hanging on the left side reads "It's here again—at last" in black letters. To the right, a small pink note with cursive writing is taped to the wood, and a yellow pencil hangs by a thin string. Small scraps of paper and torn corners are scattered across the wooden background.

title: Fusco Meats
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in front of a textured wall. The man is bald and wears a long white coat, a white undershirt, blue jeans, and brown shoes. He looks toward the right side of the frame while standing centered on a paved surface. On the wall behind him, large faded letters spell out "Fusco MEATS" in a rustic, worn style. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, gold-colored frame.

title: B-144
alt_text: A painting of many circles arranged in a target-like pattern on a white square background. The circles are all concentric, meaning they share the same center point. These rings alternate in color between a bright orange-red and a dark teal blue. The rings start with a small circle in the very center and get larger until they fill almost the entire background. This repeating pattern creates a sense of movement that draws the eye toward the middle.

title: Proserpine Accompanied by Mercury
alt_text: A painting of two figures in a semi-circular frame. A woman stands in the center wearing a long, light pink dress that flows behind her. Beside her, a small, pale, winged figure reaches toward a bush filled with pink flowers on the right side of the image. The entire scene is painted in soft, pale colors against a light yellow background. The artwork is framed in wood and is resting on a wrinkled, translucent plastic sheet.

title: Rape of Proserpine
alt_text: A painting shows two people floating together in a semi-circular scene. A man on the left reaches forward while looking upward with a serious expression. He wears dark, flowing fabric that wraps around his body and legs. Beside him, a woman wearing a bright pink dress drifts in the air with her arm outstretched toward the right. Their bodies are positioned against a soft, muted background of light greens and yellows that look like an open sky.

title: Spring
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in a garden, shaped like a semi-circle. The woman wears a long, flowing, light purple dress and holds a bundle of dark purple flowers in her arms. She stands in front of a tree with light, airy branches and leaves that stretch across the background. The background is a soft, muted green, suggesting a grassy field or park. The entire piece is enclosed in a rounded, light-colored frame and is covered in clear plastic wrapping. Three small, round, beige knobs are attached to the outer edge of the frame at the top, bottom left, and bottom right.

title: Heralds with Tambourine and Trumpet
alt_text: A painting of two women standing side-by-side inside a semi-circular frame. The woman on the left wears a light green dress and holds a round, flat tambourine near her shoulder. The woman on the right has lighter hair and wears a matching dress while holding a thin, straight flute to her lips. Both figures have long, flowing fabric draped around their arms that catches the wind. They are set against a soft, pale yellow background that fades into a hazy sky.

title: Herald with Lyre
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in a landscape. She wears a long, flowing green dress and holds a small, light-colored stringed instrument in her hands. Her reddish-brown hair is decorated with flowers, and large, flowing ribbons extend behind her shoulders. The scene is shaped like a semi-circle and uses soft pastel colors. The background appears to be a field or garden with hazy light.

title: Ceres and Proserpine Reunited
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows two women standing side by side in a semi-circular frame. Both women have fair skin and dark hair, and they wear flowing, pale pink dresses that fall to their feet. The woman on the left holds a bundle of yellow wheat stalks in her raised hand, while the woman on the right holds a circular wreath of pink flowers above her head. Their figures are surrounded by soft, muted colors including light greens, beiges, and hints of pink. The background is filled with what looks like flowering trees or bushes, painted in a blurry, gentle style. The entire scene is set against a dark, contrasting background border.

title: Ceres and Triptolemus
alt_text: A painting of two figures arranged within a semicircular frame. On the left stands a woman with her hair tied back, wearing a flowing, light-colored dress and holding a round object. To her right, a bare-chested man wears a short green tunic and dark shorts while pushing a plow. His hair is also tied back, and a large piece of fabric billows behind him in the wind. The background is a soft, muted landscape with pale yellow and pink tones. A simple, thin gold border curves along the top edge of the entire scene.

title: Summer
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in a semi-circular frame. She wears a flowing light green dress with small pink flowers around her waist. A pair of large, translucent pink wings extends from her back. She holds a small, circular wreath of flowers up in one raised hand. The background features faint green trees and soft, hazy colors.

title: Autumn
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a woman standing in an outdoor setting beneath a curved, arch-like frame. The woman has long, light-colored hair and wears a long, flowing pink dress with a green wrap draped over her shoulder and waist. She stands near thin, light-colored trees that have sparse, autumn-colored leaves. The ground around her is scattered with fallen leaves in shades of orange and brown. In the background, a flat, muted landscape stretches toward a light-colored sky.

title: Winter
alt_text: A painting of a woman walking across a landscape, presented in a semi-circular frame. The woman is wearing a long, flowing pale green dress that billows out behind her as she moves toward the right. She has reddish-brown hair and holds a thin, bare branch in her left hand. The background shows a soft, muted horizon line with light tan and yellow colors suggesting a sunset or dawn. A small, round object is mounted at the top center of the arched frame. The entire piece is wrapped in crinkled, clear plastic.

title: Wealth
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown in profile, centered within a semi-circular frame. She stands against a dark blue background and wears a long, flowing dress with a drape over her shoulder. In one hand, she holds a small, gold-colored box, and in her other hand, she holds a string of pearls. A large wreath made of green leaves and small pink berries circles her body. Swirling, light-brown ribbons frame the wreath on both the left and right sides, set against a gold-colored background.

title: Music
alt_text: A painting of a woman in a flowing white robe dancing inside a circular laurel wreath. The woman has red hair and holds a small flute in her right hand and a tambourine in her left. She is positioned in the center of a dark blue background framed by green leaves. A bright gold background fills the space outside the wreath, decorated with swirling, wavy ribbons. The painting is shaped like a semi-circle.

title: CHECKMATE (Lee + Man)
medium: Oil on ivorine with metronome, hammer and framed text
alt_text: A sculpture shows a wooden metronome standing behind a claw hammer. The metronome is pyramid-shaped with a dark brown finish and a vertical scale. A small, rectangular piece of off-white material attached to the metronome’s swinging arm features a realistic painting of an open human eye. In front of the metronome lies a standard metal hammer with a wooden handle. A circular piece of the same off-white material, also painted with a human eye, is attached to the round face of the hammer.

title: My Father's House
alt_text: A painting of a two-story house seen from directly in front at night. The house is painted in muted shades of gray and dark blue, with a deep blue sky behind it. It has a symmetrical design featuring a large porch on the ground level and a balcony above. A single, tall, dark silhouette stands behind the glass of the central front door. The windows on the upper level reflect a faint, pale light against the dark background.

title: Interior
medium: Oil on paper mounted to canvas with painted and carved wood frame
alt_text: A painting of a small, outdoor scene framed by a decorative wooden border. The thick frame is carved and painted in shades of blue and white with floral patterns. Inside this frame, a smaller rectangular painting shows a bowl filled with red fruit or flowers resting on a surface. Behind the bowl, there is a view of a rocky, brown landscape under a pale blue sky. The inner painting is surrounded by a plain, tan-colored mat or border that sits inside the wooden frame.

title: Wal-Mart Stores Inc.
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a background of bold, diagonal red and white stripes. In the center, a dark, detailed illustration depicts a woman in flowing robes. Her image is partially obscured by the wide red stripes that run across the surface. Toward the bottom center, a round corporate seal is displayed with text inside a circle. The words "Wal-Mart Stores, Inc." and "1969 Delaware" are clearly visible on this stamp.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture shows a tall, thin wooden stand placed in front of a framed artwork mounted on the wall. The tall stand has four legs connected by crossed braces in the center, and it is topped by a flat green square with a small, yellow rectangular object sitting on top. Above this stand hangs a rectangular wooden frame with a vibrant blue background. Inside the frame, faint, thin lines in yellow and white crisscross over the blue surface, creating a web-like pattern. The entire arrangement stands against a plain, light grey wall.

title: Caravel
alt_text: A painting of thick, abstract color strokes on a rectangular surface. Bright reds, oranges, and yellows dominate the left side of the frame. The right side features deep blues, greens, and darker, earthy tones. A striking, light blue vertical stripe cuts through the center of the painting, separating the warm and cool colors. The paint is applied with bold, heavy brushstrokes that blend and overlap in many places.

title: Butternut Branches
alt_text: A painting of a view looking up through leafless tree branches at the sky. On the left side of the frame, the corner of a building with two vertical, rectangular windows is visible. The branches are painted with thick, dark grey lines and stretch across the entire upper portion of the canvas. The sky in the background is painted in shades of pale blue and off-white. The painting is set within a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Untitled
medium: Watercolor on paper on balsa wood
alt_text: A painting on wood of an abstract geometric shape that resembles an arrowhead or a stylized compass. This structure consists of flat, angular bars arranged in connected lines against a plain white background. The surface of the bars is painted in shades of bright blue, transitioning to lighter and darker hues. Sections of the shape are interrupted by solid, rounded patches of vibrant orange. Thin, dark red lines arc across these blue and orange sections, adding a pattern of curves to the otherwise sharp, straight-edged object.

title: Pek for Herb—Happy Birthday
alt_text: A painting shows a fluffy, small dog against a solid gray background. The dog is drawn with bold red and yellow lines that give it a colorful, sketch-like appearance. Its fur looks thick and shaggy, with washes of green and blue coloring the body. The dog sits facing to the right, looking forward with large, dark eyes. Below the dog, a horizontal streak of bright orange paint sits on the gray surface.

title: Chair
alt_text: A wood sculpture of a tall, angular chair stands against a plain white background. The piece is made of three thick, rectangular boards of rough-hewn, brown wood. One long board serves as a vertical backrest, which extends slightly above the seat. A second board forms a horizontal seat perpendicular to the back. A third, shorter board acts as a single leg supporting the front of the seat. The wood grain is visible and has a weathered, textured appearance throughout the object.

title: Double Step 20
medium: Oil on canvas mounted on wood
alt_text: A sculpture of oil on canvas mounted on wood shows a small, three-dimensional block-like object. The top surface is painted with streaks of bright yellow over patches of blue. The sides and base are covered in a textured, dark gray material. A small, black, triangular-shaped piece juts out from the gray surface near the top corner. Another rectangular black shape is attached to the side near the bottom, creating an irregular, angular outline.

title: Fine Light
alt_text: A painting of small, repetitive brushstrokes covering the entire surface. The canvas is filled with rows of distinct, vertical dabs of paint against a dark green background. These paint dabs are mostly pale white and light blue in color. They are applied thickly and create a textured, repeating pattern across the rectangular frame. The strokes are denser and more white at the top, while they become slightly more blue and spaced out toward the bottom.

title: Young King
alt_text: A painting of an abstract, mask-like shape centered on a bright red background. The mask is multicolored, featuring patches of yellow, orange, green, and a central white strip that rises to a point at the top. Two solid blue circles act as eyes within the face shape. The lower part of the composition sits against a deep blue, V-shaped area at the bottom. Bold, dark brushstrokes define the edges and add textured, sketchy lines across the colored sections.

title: Arga
medium: Oil and pencil on unstretched canvas
alt_text: A painting on unstretched canvas shows a solid, taupe-colored square field covered in many thin, parallel lines. These horizontal pencil lines run across the entire surface from the left side to the right. The background color is a light, dusty brown. Around the edges of the canvas, the painted surface stops short, leaving a ragged border of bare, cream-colored fabric. The edges of the canvas are uneven and look roughly cut.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a room scene rendered in muted green and blue tones. A small, square table sits on the left side with a simple lamp resting on top of it. A tall, thin figure in dark clothing stands next to the table. A rectangular doorway on the right side of the room leads into a darker, shadowed area. The entire image is enclosed by a thick, chunky frame painted a distinct green color.

title: A x 3 1/3 x 9/2 = N
medium: Acrylic on canvas mounted on board
alt_text: A painting of two ghostly fish rendered in shades of purple against a dark, blurry background. The larger fish dominates the upper-left portion, showing detailed scales and a prominent, staring eye. A smaller, fainter fish head appears in the lower-right corner. Scattered across the dark background are small, white markings that look like numbers or letters, such as "A-3/3" and a few other loose characters. The entire composition has a soft, hazy quality as if seen through mist or deep water.

title: George Washington (1732–1799), LL.D. 1781
medium: Watercolor on ivory, in a rose-gold-over-silver locket; reverse: inset compartment with George Washington's hair and a rose-gold cipher, GW
alt_text: A miniature watercolor painting shows a portrait of an older man with white hair. He is wearing a dark blue military-style coat with gold-colored lapels and epaulets. His white hair is pulled back, and he has a calm expression on his face. The portrait is set inside a simple, oval, gold-colored frame. A small gold loop sits on top of the frame, allowing it to hang like a piece of jewelry.

title: A Note to Marcel
alt_text: A sculpture of the back of a framed object shows a brown, flat wooden surface. The surface is framed by a simple, thin wooden border that runs around the entire rectangle. Several flat horizontal wooden slats divide the back panel into four distinct, rectangular sections. In the center of the structure, a rectangular paper label is stuck to the wood. Dark, bold text printed on the label warns "GLASS! Handle With Care!" The wood itself appears worn with light scratches and scuffs visible on the surface.

title: Sink of Spells
medium: Iron, glass, porcelain, dirt, concrete, and a lamp
alt_text: A sculpture of iron, porcelain, and glass shows a tall metal basin supported by a dark, spindly frame. The white porcelain basin contains lumps of brown dirt and rock, along with a pale yellow piece of glass resting on the rim. A long, thin metal pipe extends upward from the frame and bends over the basin, holding a small, glowing lightbulb at its tip. The base of this stand is anchored to the floor by a rough, gray, concrete-like stone. In the background, other pieces of art are displayed on white walls in a bright, open museum gallery with light wood floors.

title: Tarp
medium: Oil on canvas over birch panel
alt_text: A painting of several figures gathered around a large, striped object. The figures have different textures and patterns, including swirling paint, solid colors, and geometric grids. One figure in the foreground appears to be textured like rough stone, while another is covered in colorful, marbled paint. They are collectively holding up a rectangular banner or cloth decorated with vertical stripes of many colors. The background is a plain, light-colored surface featuring a faint, sketched landscape with a tall, thin structure in the distance. Small, subtle leaf or twig patterns are scattered lightly across the corners of the scene.

title: Untitled
medium: Blue, yellow and red fluorescent light
alt_text: A sculpture of blue, yellow, and red fluorescent light tubes mounted on a plain white wall. A long, bright yellow tube stretches horizontally across the center of the image. Directly above the yellow light is a shorter red tube of the same style. Below the yellow light is a shorter blue tube, matching the length of the red one. All three light tubes are aligned horizontally and cast soft shadows against the background.

title: Figure Study of Sylvia, for “Who is Sylvia? what is she, that all the swains commend her?”, Two Gentlemen of Verona, Act IV, Scene II
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing against a dark, blurry background. She wears a pale yellow dress with puffy sleeves and a dark blue band across her chest. Her long, dark gloves cover her forearms and hands, which are held together in front of her. A mysterious, reddish-brown shape extends from the right side, resembling a large hand or abstract form. The painting appears unfinished, with visible raw canvas edges along the top and sides.

title: Lorenzo and Jessica, The Merchant of Venice, Act V, Scene I
alt_text: A painting of two figures standing together against a dark, shadowy background. On the left, a person wears a dark reddish or purple coat. Beside them on the right stands another person wearing a long, light-colored dress that looks white or pale cream. The background appears to be trees or tall, shadowy shapes that frame the two figures. The edges of the canvas are uneven and appear frayed, with tape visible along the borders.

title: Femme assise
alt_text: A painting of a lone figure set within a dark, rectangular space. The figure sits centrally, depicted with rough, gestural brushstrokes that blur its features. The entire scene is washed in muted tones of dusty brown, gray, and dull red. Thin, dark vertical lines suggest architectural elements, like a doorway or window frame, surrounding the person. The overall effect is moody and indistinct, with very little color contrast between the figure and the background.

title: City of Salcona
medium: Oil and colored felt-tip pens on panel in artist's frame
alt_text: A painting shows a stylized landscape filled with tall, dark, pointed mountains that have simple faces drawn onto them. Small, colorful houses sit between the mountains, surrounded by tiny stick figures and tall, thin trees. A bright blue river flows down from the center right, while the sky above is light blue with scattered stars and flying shapes. The bottom section of the artwork is a bright green panel covered with dense, hand-written text. The entire scene is enclosed within a thick, textured, white rope-like frame.

title: Le Beau est le début de l'effrayant
medium: Mixed media installation of 3 wood panels painted with acrylic and varnished, one with metal lettering, and an offset photographic reproduction
alt_text: A painting from a mixed media installation shows a central black-and-white photograph of a rugged, craggy mountain range under a cloudy sky. This photograph sits within a dark frame that takes up the center portion of the artwork. To the left of the image is a solid, dark rectangular panel. To the right is another dark rectangular panel, which features small, bright metal letters that spell out French text. The panels create a wide horizontal display that looks like a triptych.

title: Fall
medium: Waterbased dyes, resin, glue, and newspaper on canvas
alt_text: A painting shows a chaotic scene with dark, indistinct structures in the background, partially obscured by a haze or smoke. Across the middle of the image, many thin, rectangular strips are scattered as if they are falling or flying through the air. These strips look like pieces of newsprint and are white with dark markings. The pieces are clustered more densely toward the bottom left and spread out toward the top right. The overall effect creates a sense of motion and disorder against the dim backdrop.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a repeating, textured pattern covers the entire surface. The design is made of many small, rounded, and oblong shapes that look like scales or stones packed closely together. These individual shapes are filled with shades of dark brown, tan, and creamy white, giving them a mottled, uneven appearance. Dark, thin lines outline each shape, creating a grid-like network across the canvas. The entire surface appears to have a slightly glossy or varnished texture.

title: Lower East Side Lintel
medium: Steel locker, tires, cloth, and car doors
alt_text: A sculpture of a steel locker, tires, cloth, and car parts stands in an art gallery. The main horizontal part is a brown steel locker that rests on a white pillar and a stack of black tires. A piece of dark cloth hangs down from the bottom of the locker. A metal sword is stuck upright into the top of the locker. Below, a car door frame is propped up vertically on the floor. A grey, rectangular boombox sits on the wooden floor to the right of the other objects.

title: Peruvian Candelabra
medium: Acrylic, cotton, and Rhoplex on canvas
alt_text: A painting shows a circular, textured work with a dark gray background and a light-colored central figure. The background has a rough, uneven surface that appears to be made of dark, swirling material. In the center, a light-colored, candelabra-like shape rises upward. This shape has a thick, textured appearance, similar to crumpled fabric or clay. Two orange, flame-like shapes sit at the top of the two outer arms of the candelabra.

title: Mister Wink, Cosmos Ball
alt_text: A sculpture of a cartoon-like character made of polychrome plastic sits on top of a green ball. The character has a large round white head with a wide grin, one large open eye, and one closed eye with lashes. Its body is small with a blue spiral on its chest, and it perches on a ball covered in many smiling, colorful flowers. This flower-covered ball rests on a flat, silver, amoeba-shaped base that is dotted with smaller green circles. In the background, to the left, a portion of a white architectural model is visible.

title: Doll House
medium: Cast resin, wood, paper, fabric and plastic
alt_text: A sculpture of a miniature two-story house features realistic yellow brick walls and white trim. The front of the house has a dark green door with a small gold handle on the left side. To the right of the door, a bay window projects outward, framed in white. Above the door and the bay window, the second story has four more tall, arched white windows. A flat roof sits on top of the structure with two small, cylindrical chimney pots.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A glass sculpture showing an indentation shaped like a human hand. The sculpture is circular and clear, with a smooth, thick rim around the edge. In the center, there is a depression formed in the shape of a cupped palm and fingers. The material is transparent, catching the light and creating shadows inside the hand shape. The piece sits on a light gray surface, with a sliver of a brown object visible on the left side.

title: Faune des Mers
alt_text: A bronze sculpture sits on a square, black base against a plain white background. The sculpture is made of several layered, curved shapes that look somewhat like stacked blades or wings. The bronze surface has a textured, brownish-gold finish with shadows that create depth. The topmost piece curves upward into a sharp, pointed tip that reaches to the right. The overall shape of the sculpture is horizontal and slightly asymmetrical.

title: Pillar
medium: Wood and stainless steel with paint
alt_text: A painted wood and stainless steel sculpture stands tall against a plain light gray background. It consists of a long, thin, vertical pillar made of painted wood. The pillar has a smooth, light-colored surface with a rectangular hole near the top and an elongated, oval opening in the middle. The oval opening reveals a bright blue color inside the wood's hollow center. At the base, the vertical pillar rests on a square, dark, flat piece of stainless steel.

title: Structure
alt_text: A painting on linen features a composition of flat, geometric shapes separated by thick black lines. Two white squares sit vertically centered, each nested inside a larger gray rectangular block. To the left of the gray shapes, there is a tall, pale yellow rectangle at the top and a smaller, solid blue rectangle at the bottom. A second, thin yellow rectangle stands vertically along the right side of the gray forms. These various shapes are contained within a single large frame with a thin, light-colored wooden border.

title: Piano-Forte
alt_text: A painting featuring flat, geometric shapes arranged on a light gray background. A large red rectangle sits slightly left of the center, containing a smaller vertical yellow bar and a green bar. To the left of the large red shape, there is a single white vertical bar. To the right of the red shape, there is an orange vertical bar next to a blue one. Thick black outlines create maze-like borders along the top and bottom edges of the canvas. At the bottom left corner, there is a horizontal red rectangle outlined in black.

title: First Steps
alt_text: A painting shows a child standing in the foreground, while a larger adult figure looms behind them. The child is wearing a white collared shirt with blue accents and has large, wide eyes. The adult figure is dressed in a dark black garment that covers most of the background against a green wall. Both figures have simplified, angular features painted with thick, dark outlines. The adult's hands are outstretched to hold the child's hands on either side.

title: Bull Fight
medium: White earthenware clay, oxidized paraffin decoration, and white enamel bath
alt_text: A ceramic plate shows a group of brown-toned, stylized animal and human figures on a white background. In the center, a person sits on horseback holding a long, thin pole near a large, sturdy animal. Additional smaller animals are arranged around the edge of the plate in various positions. These surrounding figures include a resting bull, a standing animal, and several others that appear to be running or grazing. The figures have simple, dark outlines and a slightly textured appearance.

title: Mannikin in the Snow
alt_text: A painting of a lone figure standing in a snow-covered yard in front of stone buildings. The central figure wears a long, deep red garment and a tall, thin red hat with a white trim. Behind the figure, a gray stone wall separates the yard from low, snow-covered rooftops. The ground is blanketed in thick, pale snow with faint footprints leading toward the center. The overall scene is rendered in muted, soft tones that suggest a quiet winter day.

title: Gentleman
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. He has short, dark brown hair that is parted on the side and styled with volume on top. The man wears a black coat with a high, dark collar wrapped around his neck, revealing a small glimpse of a white shirt underneath. His expression is calm and neutral as he looks directly toward the viewer. The background behind him features soft, swirling shades of light blue, suggesting a cloudy sky. The painting is enclosed in a rectangular, gold-colored metal frame that is set inside a larger, reddish-brown velvet casing.

title: Garden Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a garden scene shows a bright yellow building in the background behind a grassy area filled with flowering bushes. Three figures wearing pale, long clothing occupy the center of the lawn. One figure stands under a bright red parasol, while two others sit nearby under a white umbrella. A large, dark green tree stands on the left side of the frame. The sky above is filled with soft, white and blue clouds.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a woman holding a small child against a bright gold background. The woman wears a dark head covering and a black cloak over a red dress. She gently holds the light-skinned child, who is looking up toward her face. The child sits on a cushion and holds a small gray bird with a red mark on its head in one hand. Behind both figures, two glowing, circular patterns are etched into the gold surface around their heads.

title: Greek Dance
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a standing woman. The woman is nude and holds her arms out to her sides, with a draped cloth hanging from her outstretched arms. She is positioned on a flat, dark rectangular wooden base. Her head is turned to the right, and she wears a simple, rounded cap on her hair. The sculpture is a deep brown color and stands against a plain, light gray background.

title: Portrait of Charles-Louis Regnault, an Officer from the Napoleonic Wars
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in a dark military uniform with his arms crossed. He has curly, reddish-brown hair and a light mustache, looking directly forward with a serious expression. His coat is black with a bright red high collar and silver fringe on his shoulders. Several shiny metal medals are pinned to the front of his jacket. He stands against a plain, dark, and cloudy gray background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a person with very dark skin sitting and holding a large, white paint palette. The person has dark, coiled hair worn in a tall, voluminous style and wears a patterned top with orange, brown, and white shapes. They hold a paintbrush over the palette, which is dotted with various colors including red, yellow, and blue. Behind the person stands a large, upright canvas with outlines and colored sections, suggesting a paint-by-numbers design. To the right, a plain black background contains a small white container holding several paintbrushes.

title: Compositional Study, for “O mistress mine, where are you roaming?”, Twelfth Night, Act II, Scene III
alt_text: A painting of three figures standing within an open, blue-toned architectural setting. To the left, a tall figure in a bright green robe stands near a figure in muted gray, both looking toward a landscape in the distance. A stone wall runs horizontally across the middle of the frame, partially framing the view behind them. On the right side, a third figure sits alone, wearing a dark garment and holding an object, possibly a small instrument. The entire scene is washed in shades of twilight blue, with bare, thin tree branches reaching across the upper sky.

title: Captain Alfred Grayson, USMC (1784/86–1823)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature of a man presented in an oval metal frame. The frame is gold-colored with a small loop at the top for hanging. Inside, a portrait shows a man with short, wavy dark brown hair facing forward. He wears a dark blue or black coat with a high collar and a light-colored neckcloth. The background behind him is a soft, light blue and white sky.

title: Plus, Minus: Backward, Forward
alt_text: An installation of dark, folded felt pieces resting on a light-colored wooden gallery floor. Two large rolls of the grey fabric sit at opposite ends of the display. Between them, several rectangular slabs of the material are laid out, some of which appear fragmented. The center of the installation features piles of smaller, broken-off pieces scattered across the floor. The gallery walls are plain white, and the ceiling above is covered in a dark, triangular grid pattern with many small lights.

title: Snow and Glow
alt_text: A painting of a bright red, boxy structure set against a dark, near-black background. To the left, a grey, textured form with curved, finger-like shapes rises up. A large, white, smooth form stretches across the bottom foreground, leading the eye toward the right. On the right side, a tall, abstract, white and grey column with rounded edges rises vertically. The overall scene uses flat planes of color and simplified, geometric shapes.

title: Hanseatic Merchant's Ring
alt_text: A brass ring is being held by a human hand. The ring is a dull gold color and has a wide, flat top shaped like an octagon. On the flat surface, there is an engraving that looks like a set of balance scales. The ring is positioned against a plain white piece of paper. In the background, a dark wooden surface is visible.

title: MOCA Torso
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows the torso of a woman from the upper thighs up to the shoulders. The smooth, dark bronze body stands on top of a textured, cylindrical base that looks like crumpled metal. This base rests on a simple, tall, black pedestal. The entire piece is centered in the frame against a plain gray background. The figure has no arms or head.

title: Sadie, the Saddest Sadist
alt_text: A video showing a black background filled with rows of large, white, block-style letters and numbers. The letters are raised and look like plastic characters from a sign board. They are arranged in five distinct horizontal rows that cover the entire frame. The text includes strings of jumbled characters mixed with words like "SADIE," "THE SADDEST," and "SADIST." The overall style is flat and graphic, with clean white edges against the dark backdrop.

title: The Blue Bowl
alt_text: A painting of a woman in a pink dress holding a small blue object near her face. She stands in profile, facing left, against a dark, shadowy background. Her light brown hair is pulled back, and she wears a dress with puffy sleeves that reflects hints of pink, white, and purple. To the left of the woman stands a cluster of tall, blue flowers growing from green leaves. The overall style of the painting uses visible brushstrokes, giving the scene a soft and blurred appearance.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of several smooth, white, abstract shapes sits on a dark floor in the corner of a room. The forms are varied, including a tall, thin, horn-like piece, a wide funnel-shaped object, and a rounded, head-like figure perched on a square base. Other shapes include a short, wide, flared base and a cylindrical tube with a small side branch. The surfaces of these objects appear matte and slightly textured. They are grouped closely together, casting faint shadows on the floor and against the white corner walls.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of large, flat, geometric shapes of color. A wide, rust-brown block occupies the left side of the frame. To its right, a tall, vibrant blue triangle extends from the bottom toward the top. A dark, black-and-blue shape creates a large, angled wedge on the right side of the canvas. These shapes meet to form strong diagonal lines across the composition. A sliver of deep red covers the top section, behind the other shapes.

title: Berettino plate with blue on blue decoration
alt_text: A ceramic plate made of tin-glazed earthenware shows a detailed scene in the center surrounded by a patterned border. The wide, outer rim is a deep blue color decorated with lighter blue swirling lines, leaf-like shapes, and small, circular patterns. In the center of the plate is a round medallion with a yellow-gold base. Three small, pale-skinned figures with tiny green wings stand and move across this golden ground. The figures are painted with soft shadows, giving them a rounded appearance against the background. A thin, dotted band separates the central image from the blue outer border.

title: Coppa amatoria (Betrothal cup)
alt_text: A ceramic dish shows a portrait of a woman with blonde hair. She has a pale face and is looking slightly down and to the side. The woman wears a yellow shirt with a dark leafy pattern printed on it. Her image is set against a vibrant blue background. A scroll with handwritten text curls behind her neck and shoulders.

title: Untitled (8-118)
alt_text: A painting of a dark, grid-like pattern filled with white dots. The dark background is a deep, muted blue. A wavy line of colorful, small square tiles stretches across the very top edge of the image. The white dots vary slightly in size and density, creating a subtle, repeating diamond shape across the canvas. This painting is contained within a thin, plain white frame.

title: Homeless
alt_text: An oil painting shows two side-by-side scenes of people seated together in a dim, enclosed space. On the left, four people are clustered together, with one man in a light blue shirt looking forward while others behind him seem weary or asleep. The lighting is soft and warm, catching the faces of the figures while the rest of the scene fades into deep shadows. On the right, four different people sit in a similar formation, with one man in a dark jacket gazing intently toward the viewer. The overall atmosphere is quiet and somber, with rich, dark tones defining the shadows and highlighted skin textures.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting on plastic showing a bold, black-and-white geometric pattern on a circular surface. The design features thick, dark bands that form right angles and straight lines across a pale, cream-colored background. These black shapes interlock, creating a maze-like effect that covers the entire circle. The white space between the dark lines varies in width, adding a sense of depth to the abstract composition. The smooth, circular object sits against a plain, light brown surface.

title: The Legend of Cupid and Psyche: An Old Woman Tells Psyche's Story; and Psyche and her Attendants
alt_text: Two pieces of painted enamel jewelry are shown against a plain gray background. Each piece is shaped like a wide, rounded trapezoid with a gold-colored scalloped border. On the left piece, two figures with long hair and colorful robes sit together on the grass near a dark rock wall. On the right piece, three figures are depicted in an indoor setting with a large draped canopy, including one seated person who is being attended to by two others. Both scenes feature dark, rich colors like blue and forest green, contrasting with the light skin tones of the figures.

title: The Crucifixion
medium: Oil on canvas laid on panel
alt_text: A painting of a man with long hair hanging on a wooden cross. He is shirtless, wearing only a white cloth wrapped around his waist, and his hands and feet are nailed to the wood. A crown of thorns rests on his head, and there are small streaks of red markings on his chest, arms, and feet. Behind him, the background shows a dark, hilly landscape under a gloomy sky. On the ground at the very bottom left, there is a human skull resting near a bone.

title: Annunciatory Angel
alt_text: A painting of a tall, narrow panel with a pointed, triangular top. The wooden surface appears faded and worn, with large areas of gold paint that have rubbed away over time to reveal brown and red tones underneath. A faint, shadowed figure sits centered in the lower portion of the panel, though the details are difficult to see. The frame edges have a ridged, architectural shape that mimics a pointed arch. The entire piece is set against a plain, solid black background.

title: Ecce Homo
alt_text: A painting of a man with long, wavy reddish-brown hair, seen from the chest up against a dark background. He wears a bright red garment and has a thick rope tied around his neck, with the loose ends extending down to his wrists. His hands are crossed over his chest, held together by the same rope. A ring-shaped halo with a reddish border circles his head, and he wears a thin, dark crown of thorns resting on his hair. He gazes forward with a calm, neutral expression. The entire image is enclosed in a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Vase
alt_text: A glass container showing a blue vase with two curved handles on the sides. The vase has a rounded body that tapers toward a flat, narrow base. Its surface is decorated with a repeating pattern of reddish-brown swirls embedded within the bright blue glass. These swirls cover the entire body of the vessel, extending up to the rounded rim.
