The vase stands against a plain, light grey background.

title: Ewer
alt_text: A glass container of glass shows a round pitcher with a narrow neck and wide opening. The main body has vertical stripes of brown and light blue twisted glass. A handle made of clear glass attaches to the neck and the shoulder of the pitcher. This handle is shaped like a creature with a scaly back and a small head that reaches toward the rim. The creature's head has a dark eye and a small red tongue sticking out from its mouth.

title: Vase
alt_text: A glass container shows a tall, slender vase with a bulbous, round body that sits on a flared, circular base. The main color is a warm, metallic bronze-gold. This base color is speckled all over with tiny, bright turquoise dots that look like splashes of paint. A thin, clear glass ring sits at the neck where the round body meets the long, thin opening. The entire object has a shimmering texture.

title: Vase
alt_text: A glass container shaped as a tall, slender vase. The object has a round, bulbous body that tapers upward into a long, narrow neck. At the very top, the neck flares open into a small, circular rim. Two thin, dark handles rise from the shoulder of the vase and arch upward before reattaching to the neck. The glass surface features swirling, marbled patterns in shades of amber, teal, dark blue, and white. The entire vessel sits on a small, circular pedestal base that also features the same swirling color pattern.

title: Vase
alt_text: A glass vase shows a tall, slender body with colorful, swirled patterns. The main part of the vase is decorated with vibrant streaks of blue, red, green, and white glass. Two clear, curved glass handles extend from the neck down to the shoulder of the vase. The vessel sits on a wide, circular base that features the same multi-colored swirling design. The overall shape is narrow and tapers slightly at the top, ending in a flared rim.

title: Pitcher
alt_text: A glass container shaped like an ornate pitcher stands against a plain background. The body of the pitcher has a rounded, teardrop shape with alternating horizontal waves of gold and turquoise glass. A tall, slender neck extends upward from the body, ending in a slightly flared pouring spout. A sculpted glass handle, shaped like a stylized sea creature, connects the rim to the shoulder of the pitcher. The base is circular and flares outward, matching the color pattern of the body.

title: Pitcher
alt_text: A glass container shaped like a decorative goblet features a bulbous, ridged bowl. The main body and the wide base have a shiny, metallic copper color filled with tiny golden sparkles. The top rim flares outward with uneven, pointed edges. A clear, light-pink figure shaped like a serpent is attached to the stem and faces outward. This creature has small, outstretched wings and a tiny pink tongue sticking out of its mouth. The entire piece stands tall on a flat, circular foot.

title: Vessel
alt_text: A glass container in the shape of a decorative goblet sits against a dark gray background. The wide bowl at the top is made of translucent blue glass with wavy, textured patterns along the rim. Below the bowl, the stem of the goblet is formed by a clear, winged creature that resembles a dragon or sea monster with a small red tongue. The base of the goblet is a flared, blue glass circle that matches the color and texture of the bowl. This detailed piece appears to have shiny silver-colored specks embedded throughout the glass material.

title: Vessel
alt_text: A glass container showing a shallow, ruffled bowl supported by a decorative stem. The bowl is made of translucent, pale blue glass with a scalloped edge that fans out widely. Below this, the central stem is shaped like a winged creature with a long, twisting tail that coils around a central support. This creature has small touches of red, yellow, and darker blue accenting its wings and head. The entire piece rests on a simple, round, pale blue base.

title: Matricola of the Confraternity of Saint Benedict
alt_text: An illuminated manuscript shows two figures sitting on a large, red-cushioned throne at the top of the scene. The figure on the left wears a blue robe, while the figure on the right wears a crown and a dress with a patterned skirt. Below them, four standing figures face upwards and hold their hands in gestures of prayer or presentation. One of these standing figures holds a small, grey architectural model in their hands. At the very bottom, a large group of people dressed in dark, hooded robes kneels while facing the figures above. Every standing and sitting figure has a gold circle, or halo, painted around their head.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a commercial building with a large tree in front. The building has a flat, gray roof and a sign near the top with illegible, dark, squiggly text. Below the sign is a band of bright orange paint stretching across the front of the structure. Several large windows reveal blurry shapes inside the building, and there is a dark door centered in the wall. To the left of the building stands a leafy green tree, and a small, circular red and white road sign is visible in the far left background.

title: The Resignation of General Washington, December 23, 1783
alt_text: A painting of a large group of people gathered inside a high-ceilinged room with columns. In the center, a man in a dark military coat and light-colored breeches stands facing left, holding out a document in his right hand. To his left, several men sit at a table covered by a red cloth, watching him. To his right, a seated figure is draped in a long red cloak, with two young girls in white dresses standing nearby. A small balcony on the upper right side of the room holds a group of women looking down at the scene below. The room is dimly lit, with soft light focusing on the man in the center.

title: This Expedition, Beloved and Despised, Continues Regardless
medium: Acrylic and enamel on two mahogany panels
alt_text: A painting showing a busy scene filled with pink floral patterns, dark silhouettes, and geometric shapes against a light blue background. On the left, several large, detailed pink flower clusters overlap with thin, dark tree branches and small silhouettes of people. The right side features a vertical stack of orange arrows, each containing a tiny blue sailboat icon and a small, dark silhouette of a person lying down. Above these, two silhouetted figures stand behind a white picket fence, while another figure stands below at an easel painting a small image. A large, bright green arrow points downward in the center, connecting to a chaotic swirl of smaller arrows and figures circling a small structure.

title: Madonna and Child with Saints Jerome and Mary Magdalene
alt_text: A painting showing a group of figures outdoors under a red canopy. On the left stands an older, bearded man with grey hair, wearing a simple grey wrap and holding a scroll, with a lion's head visible near his feet. A smiling angel holds an open book toward a central woman who holds a small, light-skinned baby on her lap. To the right, a blonde woman in a flowing yellow and pink dress kneels while looking at the child. Another small child figure is partially visible in the shadows further to the right. The background features a soft, hazy view of distant hills and trees under a cloudy sky.

title: At Calcot
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing trees near a small stream. Two large, rugged trees stand in the foreground, with their bare, tangled branches reaching toward the top of the frame. To the left, a grassy bank is painted with thick, dark brushstrokes in shades of green and brown. A narrow stream or ditch filled with blue water cuts through the center of the scene. In the distance, dim shapes suggest a horizon under a cloudy, overcast sky. The overall tone of the image is muted and cool.

title: Unknown
medium: Bronze with green patina and rough stone base
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a thin, tall figure standing on a rough, pinkish stone base. The figure is made of metal and has a light greenish-gold color. Its body is very long and slender, with textured details along the torso. At the top, the form flares out into curved, arm-like shapes that reach upward. The figure stands balanced on two thin legs that merge into the jagged rock surface below.

title: Unknown
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture shows three main parts arranged on a table and a separate rounded object to the left. In the back, a bright red and white C-shaped frame stands upright. Directly in front of it lies a curved, rectangular white panel decorated with a large red star inside a red circle. At the very front, another flat, rectangular white panel displays a matching red star and circle design. To the far left, a textured, pinkish, rounded form that resembles a head rests on a dark cloth. These items sit on a flat surface in a room with a concrete floor.

title: Unknown
alt_text: A sculpture of wire shows two separate, abstract, skeletal structures resting on a flat, tan surface. The structure on the left features several thin, dark wires that curve upward and intersect like the ribs of a bent frame. A small, coiled loop of wire hangs down from the bottom of this left assembly. To the right stands a taller, more pointed structure made of straight, crossing wires that resemble a tepee or a tower frame. Another small, coiled loop of wire is attached to the lower-left corner of this second structure. Both constructions look delicate and fragile, appearing to be made from a single type of thin, dark metal wire.

title: Nature morte aux grenades
alt_text: A sculpture of many small, colorful crystal objects arranged on a metal cart. The cart is rectangular, made of steel, and has four wheels with rubber tires. It sits on a wooden floor in front of a brick wall. Dozens of shiny, multifaceted crystal shapes are scattered across the dark, flat surface of the cart. These crystal objects come in various bright colors like blue, yellow, pink, and orange. The cart is positioned in the center of the image, showing an even spread of these crystal pieces.

title: The Ghosts Come Out at Night
medium: Watercolor and ink on Xuan paper mounted on silk
alt_text: A painting of a wide, horizontal scene in ink and watercolor shows a large group of people moving together. On the left side, a column of text runs vertically, and a dense crowd of figures is gathered near some bulky, covered carts. In the center, several people interact while one figure stands next to a small, wooden cart with wheels. Other people are scattered throughout the scene, some sitting and others standing in loose groupings. Toward the right, more figures appear, including one person carrying a large, heavy load on their back. A block of text is visible in the upper middle area, and the entire scene is depicted in soft, muted tones on paper.

title: Portrait of Alexandrine Émilie Brongniart
alt_text: A painting of a young woman who is looking directly at the viewer. She has dark brown hair styled with curls framing her face and a simple dark band across the top of her head. The woman wears a plain white dress with gathered fabric around the neckline. A delicate gold necklace with small blue oval stones rests against her collarbone. The background is a very dark, solid brown color that contrasts with her fair skin and white dress.

title: Shock and Awe
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture of four human figures stands in a dimly lit museum gallery. The figures are arranged in two pairs, with each figure mounted on a slender metal pole attached to a rectangular base. All four figures have featureless, smooth white faces that are tilted upward as if they are looking toward the ceiling. Two of the figures are wearing simple, dark sleeveless tops, while the figure on the far right wears a long coat over their clothing. The background features curved concrete walls and a dark floor that reflects the sculptures.

title: Twins
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture showing four human-shaped mannequins standing in a row and facing a large window. The figures are dark, simplified shapes that lack detailed features or arms. They are mounted on thin metal poles that rise from flat, rectangular stands on the floor. Sunlight streams through the glass, casting long, dramatic shadows across the dark tile floor. Outside the window, a brick wall is visible in the bright daylight.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, organic shapes that fill the frame in a vertical, paneled arrangement. Pale gray and beige colors serve as a muted background for these shapes. Dark brown, reddish, blue, and teal forms are scattered across the canvas in clusters. Thin, black, and white lines outline some of the shapes, adding texture and separation. The composition is balanced but uneven, with no clear focal point.

title: Letter to Uccello
alt_text: A painting of a geometric, arrow-like shape that points downward against a plain grey background. The object is divided into two distinct vertical sections. The left section is a flat, solid pale purple color and forms the sharp point of the arrow. The right section has a textured, light blue surface that curves outward toward the bottom. These two parts meet along a straight, vertical line that runs the full height of the object.

title: Figure from a Lamentation Group
alt_text: A wooden sculpture shows a person from the chest up with their head turned to the left. The figure wears a light-colored head covering that drapes over their shoulders and back. They are dressed in a red garment with a wide, rounded neckline. Their hands are clasped tightly together against their chest, with fingers slightly curled. The surface of the sculpture has visible texture and painted colors that appear worn in places. Shadows fall across the right side of the figure's face and clothing, creating a strong contrast.

title: Sun Pistachio Column
alt_text: A sculpture made of wood shows a tall vertical post attached to a flat, rectangular base. On top of this pillar sits a small, two-tiered platform. Resting on the platform is a cylindrical can decorated with the word "SUN" and an image of a red sun. A thin, stick-like object stands upright on top of the can with a small, circular piece balanced on its tip. The entire object has a light, natural wood color with painted accents.

title: An Altar for the People of the Villa Miseria
medium: Wood construction with sticks, tape, barbed wire, plaster, and wire
alt_text: A sculpture of a small wooden cabinet displays objects behind two open, pale pink doors. The top shelf holds a seated, pale figure made of plaster that sits on a small square block. Behind the figure, a large, flat, red hand is painted on the blue back wall, dripping liquid from a coin held in its palm. A twisted, vine-like stick stretches from the top right down to the shelf near a smooth, round, brown stone. On the bottom shelf, a tan, lumpy object is wrapped around its middle with dark red tape.

title: Lightweb
alt_text: A painted welded steel sculpture of a tall, cylindrical structure stands in the center of a grassy clearing. The sculpture is made of many thin, interconnected loops and oval shapes that twist together to form a dense column. These metal loops are painted a light, cool blue-white color and reflect the surrounding daylight. The sculpture rises from a round, flat concrete base set directly onto the lawn. Dark green trees and foliage frame the sculpture in the background, contrasting with its light color.

title: The Dentist
medium: Plaster, metal, glass, rubber, and aluminum paint
alt_text: A sculpture of a man standing next to a piece of machinery. The man is life-sized and painted a uniform, shiny silver color. He is looking down and appears to be working with his hands at a small table attached to the machine. The tall, silver machine features a metal arm that holds a fan, along with other mechanical parts and a small basin. A thick black cord runs from the base of the machine to a round, flat object on the floor near the man's feet. The entire scene is set against a plain, light-brown textured wall and a dark, reflective floor.

title: Signature
medium: Mixed media; polychrome steel, found metal objects, and paint
alt_text: A sculpture of mixed media shows a circular arrangement of colorful metal shards and found objects. A dark, rounded base supports a central platform holding a bright, twisted red piece that curls upward like a flame. Surrounding this center are various flat, curved shapes painted in bold blue, yellow, and red. Several slender, straight metal rods extend upward from the middle of the structure, adding height and linear texture. The entire piece looks like a jumbled collection of industrial scrap metal brought together into a single, three-dimensional form.

title: APB's (Afro-Parisian Brothers)
alt_text: A painting of two men standing together against a solid, light purple background. The man on the left wears a dark suit with a teal shirt underneath and light-colored shoes. The man on the right has shorter hair and wears a light blue long-sleeved shirt under a dark, sleeveless sweater vest with horizontal white stripes. He also wears dark blue jeans and brown shoes. Both men are looking toward the viewer with neutral expressions. Their bodies are angled slightly toward each other, and their arms hang down at their sides.

title: Man With a Heart at 3,057,226
medium: Fiberglass, cast resin, electric light, digital recording of the artist’s heartbeat, and speaker
alt_text: A sculpture of a human figure stands in the middle of a grassy lawn surrounded by trees. The figure is made of glossy, bright blue material and stands on a matching blue hexagonal base. One arm is held out to its side, while the other rests on its hip. A large, circular hole is cut into the center of the figure's chest, revealing a smooth, metallic lining. Inside this cavity, a small, dark red, oval-shaped object glows faintly.

title: Building Steam #397 (For Mozart)
alt_text: A sculpture of a book and a brass horn shows these objects combined into a single piece. An old book with a worn, beige cover stands upright on the surface. A long, slender brass tube passes horizontally through the center of the book. One end of the tube extends to the left and is capped with a small, shiny green knob. The other end of the tube emerges on the right side and flares outward into a wide, round metal bell.

title: Building Steam #386
alt_text: A sculpture made from a book shows a red volume titled "THE BOOK of KNOWLEDGE" in gold letters on the front cover. A large, circular hole has been cut out from the center of the book. The edges of the pages are visible inside this circular opening, creating a tunnel-like effect through the middle of the object. The book stands upright against a plain, light grey background. Decorative black line patterns frame the title on the cover.

title: Untitled (10-01)
medium: Cherry wood, cast bronze, aluminum, and paint
alt_text: A sculpture of painted cherry wood and cast bronze shows several interconnected, rectangular panels of pale green wood attached to an aluminum frame. These panels form an L-shaped arrangement that juts out from the white wall. Three shiny, metallic, cone-shaped ornaments are attached to the front of the wood. A single, smaller cone sits on the left section of the wood. The right section of the wood holds two larger clusters of cones, one near the top and one near the bottom.

title: Europa and the Bull
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a rough, dark brown figure set against an abstract, craggy background. The figure appears to be hunched over or seated, with its arms reaching out to the left and back. The surface of the sculpture is highly textured and uneven, with deep grooves and sharp edges. It sits upon a rectangular base made of dark green, polished marble. This base provides a smooth, solid contrast to the chaotic and fluid lines of the bronze piece above it.

title: Composition No. 135
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes floating on a solid black background. In the upper left, there is a cluster of thin white and yellow lines that form an open, angular shape. Below and to the right, a larger, solid, light-purple triangle points upward. Thin lines extend downward from this purple shape, creating the appearance of a three-dimensional form. The entire composition feels sparse and minimalist.

title: Composition No. 165
alt_text: A painting of thin white lines on a gray background. The canvas has a smooth, solid gray surface with horizontal brushstrokes visible throughout. Three thin, straight white lines cut across the composition in different directions. Two of these lines cross each other near the center of the image. A third, shorter and thicker white line stands alone in the lower right portion of the painting. The entire work is enclosed within a simple silver frame.

title: Study for the altarpiece of Saint Rosalie among the Plague-Stricken
alt_text: A painting of three figures on the ground and two figures appearing in the sky. At the bottom, a woman in a long, flowing light blue dress reclines with her eyes closed and her head tilted back. Standing behind her are two men, one wearing a bright red garment. Above them in the clouds, a winged figure reaches upward with one hand while a smaller, winged child figure looks on from a seated position. The background is a mix of dark, cloudy sky and a solid brownish area on the right side.

title: RÜN
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes covers the entire surface. Large triangles and polygon forms overlap to create a sense of depth across the rectangular canvas. The colors are soft and muted, ranging from light pink and peach to pale yellow, grey, and cream. The entire surface has a visible texture that looks like a fine, woven fabric. The shapes fit together like puzzle pieces without any clear background or foreground.

title: Un Voyage en Mer du Nord
medium: Silent, color and black-and-white 16 mm film in artist-designed film container and accompanied by the artist's book (Petersburg Press, London) of the same title
alt_text: A film container shows a circular shape with a textured, teal-colored lid. A white circular label is centered on the lid, featuring text and a small, rectangular picture. The picture on the label shows a lone sailboat on the open water. The text at the top of the label includes a name and a title in blue, and the words "Petersburg Press" appear at the very bottom. The entire object sits against a plain, light grey background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of mixed media shows a rectangular block covered in tightly wound, colorful yarn arranged in patterns. Four large circular designs dominate the surface, one in each of the four quadrants. Each circle features concentric rings of different colors, such as bright pink, deep green, yellow, and white. The background between these circles consists of darker colored yarn with tiny white specks that create a textured, dotted appearance. A diamond-shaped space of brown yarn sits in the exact center where the four circular patterns meet. The entire object is enclosed in a clear, rectangular display case.

title: Real Plant/Live Plant
medium: Closed-circuit, silent, color video with midcentury television casing, monitor, video camera with tripod, dirt, glass, and flowers
alt_text: A time-based media installation shows an old television set with flowers on a white pedestal, facing a video camera on a tripod. The small, vintage-style television has a curved screen and a dark wooden base. Two long-stemmed flowers with reddish blooms stick up out of the top of the television. A silver video camera sits atop a tall, black, three-legged tripod, pointed directly at the screen. The entire setup is placed on a smooth, light-colored wooden floor in front of a tall, blank white wall. The room has a distinctive geometric, triangular ceiling pattern above the white wall.

title: The Annunciation
alt_text: A painting of an angel appearing to a woman in a dimly lit room. The angel, dressed in white robes with large wings, floats on a dark cloud and gestures toward the sky. The woman stands opposite the angel with her hands open, wearing a reddish dress and a long blue cloak. Above them, a bright light shines down from the clouds, accompanied by a small white dove and several cherubs. The background is mostly dark and indistinct, suggesting an interior space with simple furniture.

title: Evening Spirit
alt_text: A painting of a tall, pale, and ghost-like figure standing in the center. The figure has a smooth, elongated shape and appears to be draped in flowing white fabric. Behind the figure, the background is split into two halves that show a landscape with muted brown, hilly terrain and dark, arched structures. Thin, bare branches or trees reach upward on both sides of the center figure. The overall color palette is made of cool grays, deep blacks, and earthy browns.

title: The Happy Family
alt_text: A painting of a man, a woman, and a small child resting in a natural landscape. The man lies on the ground with his back against a rock, holding the standing baby high in the air with both hands. A woman sits beside him on a large stone, leaning in to look at the child with a smile. Behind them stands a tall, pale statue of a bearded man with two faces on a pedestal. In the background, there is a large, dark tree on the right and a distant mountain range under a light, cloudy sky.

title: Pinchneck
alt_text: A color moving image showing a close-up of a person's mouth and lower face. The person is using their index fingers to pull the corners of their mouth outward. Their lips are puckered and slightly open, revealing a dark space inside the mouth. The skin has a light tone with some stubble visible on the chin. The person's fingers are horizontal and stretch across the upper part of the frame. The background is completely black and hides the rest of the person's face.

title: Black Balls
alt_text: A black-and-white film still shows a close-up of a human hand touching a dark, textured area of skin. The fingers are angled downward and appear coated in a dark, possibly viscous substance. The skin underneath the hand is shadowy and appears covered in dark, thick hair. The image is grainy with high contrast, making the textures difficult to distinguish clearly. The background is composed of soft, blurred skin tones that contrast with the dark central area.

title: Manipulating a Fluorescent Tube
alt_text: A black-and-white video shows a person sitting on the floor in a very dark room. A long, bright, rectangular light fixture rests on the floor directly in front of them, illuminating their lap and chest. The person is sitting with their legs spread wide on either side of the light. Their torso is partially visible, while their face remains obscured by shadow. The rest of the space around them is swallowed by deep darkness, creating a grainy texture throughout the scene.

title: Walk with Contrapposto
alt_text: A black-and-white video still shows a person standing and facing away from the camera. The person is positioned against what appears to be a corner or a flat wall. They are wearing a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt and dark pants. The image is grainy and has the quality of a low-resolution recording. A long, dark shadow stretches out from the person onto the wall surface to their left.

title: Wall-Floor Positions
alt_text: A black-and-white video shows a person lying on the floor in a room. The person wears a light-colored t-shirt and dark pants. They are resting their weight on one arm while their legs and the other arm are raised in the air. One leg is bent at the knee and the other is reaching upward. The person's head is tilted downward toward the floor. The background consists of plain, light-colored walls and a textured floor.

title: Violin Tuned to D.E.A.D.
alt_text: A black-and-white video shows a person standing in a sparsely furnished room. The person is viewed from behind and wears a light-colored short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers. They stand in the center of the frame, facing toward a wall on the left side. The floor is mostly bare, with a few small, dark objects scattered on the ground. A bright, light-colored wall takes up the left background, while the rest of the room appears dim and shadowed.

title: Elke Allowing the Floor to Rise Up Over Her, Face Up
alt_text: A color video showing a person lying flat on their back against a plain, light-colored background. The person is dressed in long, dark pants and a patterned, light-colored top. Their arms are spread out wide to the sides, and their legs are also splayed apart. Their head rests on the floor, and their dark hair is spread out behind them. The lighting is bright, creating a somewhat soft, hazy effect.

title: Shot to Hell
medium: Screenprint and baked enamel on aluminum
alt_text: A painting on an aluminum panel shows text and stars against a bright blue background. The words "SHOT TO HELL" appear near the top in yellow letters. Below that, the word "WHILE" is written in white letters. Further down, the words "WISHING UPON A STAR" are written in orange letters. Three black star shapes are scattered across the composition, each one enclosed in a thin black circle.

title: Figure of a Woman
alt_text: A painting of a young woman standing in a room with green walls. She wears a long, light blue dress with a white bonnet that she holds with one hand. To her side stands a wooden chair with a lacy white fabric draped over it. Behind her, a tall grandfather clock stands against the wall near a window. A wooden spinning wheel sits on the floor to her left, and a small woven basket filled with flowers rests near her feet.

title: 2012: Super Bato Saves the World
medium: Customized slot machine, coins, and cups
alt_text: A sculpture of a customized slot machine stands on a large pile of scattered gold-colored coins. The top of the machine features an oval sign with a cartoon-style black bat graphic inside an orange circle. Below this, a main panel displays the large, yellow numbers "2012" layered over a chaotic scene of flames and green shapes. The machine’s central display shows three spinning reels, and a metal lever extends from the right side. The lower section of the machine is decorated with a detailed graphic of a skull, a fire, and a burning meteor.

title: stand up next 2 a mountain (llaqtamasi)
alt_text: A sculpture of a large, thick stack of folded newspapers rests against a plain white background. The newspapers are off-white and look aged. A thin, light-colored string wraps tightly around the center of the entire bundle. On the top surface of the stack, a small black-and-white rectangular photograph is attached. The photograph shows a line of people standing side-by-side in a long row.

title: Intaglio: Frederick the Great
alt_text: A basalt sculpture of a person’s face in profile. The object is oval-shaped and black. It shows a man with hair tied back at the nape of his neck. He is wearing a high-collared jacket with a ruffled scarf or cravat near his throat. Carved letters run vertically along the right edge of the oval.

title: Intaglio: Classical Head
alt_text: A basalt sculpture shows the profile of a person’s head in relief. The dark, oval-shaped object depicts a person facing to the right. The person has curly hair with a laurel wreath resting on top. Short ribbons hang from the back of the wreath down towards the neck. The surface of the sculpture is smooth and matte against a plain, light brown background.

title: Medallion: Vitellius
alt_text: A basalt sculpture shows the side profile of a man's head and neck on a round plaque. The man faces to the right with short, curly hair. He wears a wreath of leaves on his head, which is tied with a ribbon that hangs down behind his neck. Around his shoulders, he wears a piece of fabric held by a round clasp. The relief is black and stands out against the dark, circular background.

title: Medallion: Caligula
alt_text: A basalt sculpture of a profile portrait on a round medallion. The dark-colored disc shows the head of a man facing toward the right side of the image. The man has curly hair and wears a wreath of leaves on his head that hangs down slightly behind his neck. His facial features are smooth and clearly defined against the flat, circular background. The entire object has a uniform, matte black appearance.

title: Medallion: Voltaire
alt_text: A basalt sculpture shows a dark, circular medallion featuring a profile portrait. In the center, a raised relief depicts a person facing right with long, curled hair. The figure wears layered, draped clothing on their torso. A decorative border resembling a thin wreath or ribbon circles the entire edge of the medallion. Capital letters are pressed into the surface around the profile, following the curve of the circle.

title: Portrait Medallion: Bonnie Prince Charlie
alt_text: A basalt sculpture of a round medallion shows a dark profile portrait of a person facing right. The person has curly hair and is wearing clothing that folds around the neck and shoulders. Capital letters are carved along the circular edge of the piece. A faint crack line runs diagonally across the surface of the medallion from the top right to the bottom left. This dark, circular object sits inside a clear, round plastic case.

title: Portrait Medallion: Viscount Adam Duncan
medium: Jasper, with blue background, wooden frame
alt_text: A sculpture in jasper shows a profile bust of a person set against a bright blue background. The person has light-colored skin and wavy hair styled with a bow at the back. They wear a formal jacket with a decorative tassel on the shoulder and ruffled fabric at the chest. The surface of the figure has a cracked, web-like pattern across it. This entire piece is enclosed within a dark oval wooden frame with a gold-colored inner edge.

title: Portrait Medallion: Lord Mansfield
medium: White biscuit on blue glass, metal and glass frame
alt_text: A sculpture of a person's profile is displayed inside a round frame. A white, raised bust of a man in profile faces to the right. This white figure is set against a smooth, dark blue background. The entire object is enclosed within a curved glass dome and a thin, metallic circular border. A small metal loop at the top of the frame allows the object to hang.

title: Lazarus
medium: Encoded DVD, mpeg-2, Dolby Digital 2; aspect ratio 16:9; square tin box with plastic window; artist-signed liner notes
alt_text: A digital video frame shows a group of people pushing a vintage, pale green sedan down a street. The car is worn, with noticeable rust spots along the side panel below the windows. Several people stand behind the vehicle, pushing against its trunk and rear quarter panel to move it forward. One person is visible in the driver’s seat, steering while looking ahead. In the background, there is a large white truck parked near a building and a chain-link fence.

title: Mulberry on Oak Wedge
alt_text: A wood sculpture stands in the center of a room. It is made of tall, stacked pieces of wood that have natural, rough bark on their sides and smooth, yellow-brown cut surfaces. The sculpture sits on top of a heavy, dark gray, block-like base. The room around the object looks like a storage area with cardboard boxes, doors, and a ceiling with triangular lights. The floor is light-colored concrete.

title: White Tree
alt_text: A painted metal sculpture hangs from a thin wire against a plain grey background. It consists of thin, dark metal rods connected to each other, forming a branching structure. Small, flat, white shapes that look like leaves or petals are attached to the ends of these rods. The entire structure spreads out in multiple directions, with some parts reaching higher and others hanging lower. This arrangement creates a balanced, airy, and delicate appearance.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A galvanized iron sculpture shows a large, square, grey panel hanging on a white wall. The surface of the square is divided into four horizontal rectangular sections by subtle lines that run from side to side. The entire piece has a flat, metallic texture that looks slightly speckled or uneven in tone. To the left of the large square sits a small white plaque containing text. The wall behind the object is plain and evenly lit.

title: Setting for A. Pomodoro
medium: Concrete, wood, steel, driftwood, glass, peacock feathers, and gold
alt_text: An installation of concrete, wood, steel, driftwood, glass, peacock feathers, and gold displays various sculptural elements on a raised, gray rectangular platform. The platform is divided into sections and holds several items, including a piece of raw wood, a white cube, a slender metal frame, and a tall stand topped with a golden sphere. Two small, thin, upright, light-colored rectangular blocks stand near the center of the display. To the left, a darker piece of wood sits on a thin metal support above a patch of green. The entire arrangement sits in a well-lit room with wooden floors and a coffered ceiling made of wooden triangles.

title: Galveston Bay
alt_text: A painting of a shirtless man wearing a straw hat and standing waist-deep in ocean water. He holds a fish with both hands near his chest and balances a long fishing rod against his shoulder. A fishing net sits in the water on the left, while a small metal bucket floats on the right. The background features choppy, dark waves and a sky filled with thick, textured grey clouds. The man looks directly forward with a neutral expression on his face.

title: Spring Fever
alt_text: A painting of a seated figure and a reclining figure. On the left, a person wearing a pointed white hat and dark clothes sits hunched over with their hands near their face. To the right, a second figure lies back on their elbows, appearing pale against a dark blue background. In the foreground, a small, brownish animal with a pointed snout rests near a stack of flat, rectangular objects. The entire scene is enclosed in a weathered, light-colored wooden frame with a gold inner trim.

title: Clam Diggers
alt_text: A painting showing a flat, dark landscape under a cloudy sky. In the foreground, a group of small, dark figures walks across the mud or dark ground. These figures are spaced out and appear to be moving away from the viewer. The sky takes up most of the scene and is filled with heavy, gray and brown clouds. A faint, thin line of lighter color sits on the horizon line in the distance.

title: Crucified Christ
alt_text: A gilt bronze sculpture of a figure attached to a tall, dark wooden cross. The figure is golden in color and appears to be suspended from the cross with arms stretched outward. A cloth is draped around the figure's waist, showing folds of fabric that extend slightly to the right side. The figure wears a small crown on its head and has a thin halo behind it. The cross is simple, dark, and rectangular, providing a plain backdrop for the metallic figure.

title: Poems & Placemats
medium: 43 laminated color copies and silkscreen printing on pegboard and cardboard boxes
alt_text: A sculpture made of cardboard boxes and pegboard displays features two large brown boards mounted on a brick wall with labels that read POEMS and PLACEMATS. The pegboards are covered with many small, rectangular laminated papers, including newspaper clippings, photographs, and printed pages. Below the boards on the left, a stack of three cardboard boxes sits on the floor with blue, red, and green silkscreened prints. On the right, a single open cardboard box with a large red print rests on top of a smaller gray box labeled POEMS. The entire arrangement creates a collage-like display on the wall and floor.

title: Collection of Ten Plaster Surrogates
alt_text: A sculpture of ten rectangular frames arranged in two uneven rows against a plain white wall. Each frame is a different shade of wood or brown, holding a simple white mat surrounding a solid black center. The frames vary slightly in size and width, with the largest one positioned in the bottom left. All of the black centers are also rectangles, mirroring the orientation of their individual frames. The composition is clean and minimalist, with even spacing between each framed piece.

title: Tenancingo
alt_text: A cotton sculpture shows a tall, cone-shaped object that sits on a flat surface. It is made entirely of thick, braided ropes or strands of black material. These dark strands hang down from the top, spreading out across the base like hair or fabric. Scattered within the dark texture, small specks of red and white appear. The object is set against a simple, smooth grey background.

title: Straw into Gold
medium: Steel wire with paint, tin cans, bedsprings, and blown glass
alt_text: A textile sculpture made of steel wire, tin cans, bedsprings, and blown glass hangs on a wall and extends to the floor. The left side features a cluster of small, multicolored metal tin cans attached to an intricate web of thin wire. The right side contains a dense, tangled mass of wire that resembles a large bedspring, featuring two glowing, round amber-colored glass spheres inside. Beneath the main structure, several thin, needle-like wires extend down to touch circular, wire-frame bases resting on the floor. The entire piece creates an abstract shape that fills much of the white wall space.

title: Portrait Reliefs of Sigismund of Brandenburg (1538–1566), Prince-Archbishop of Magdeburg, and Anna Schlaberg (16th century)
alt_text: An oak sculpture showing the side profiles of two people, facing each other against a plain, light background. On the left, a person with short, wavy hair appears to wear a leafy laurel wreath. On the right, another person has their head tilted slightly, with elaborate, detailed hair styled away from the face. Both figures are dark-colored, smooth, and carved into busts that cut off at the chest. The dark wood material gives them a polished, silhouette-like appearance.

title: Portrait Reliefs of Sigismund of Brandenburg (1538–1566), Prince-Archbishop of Magdeburg, and Anna Schlaberg (16th century)
alt_text: An oak sculpture shows two dark, carved wooden busts mounted against a plain white wall. The bust on the left is positioned slightly lower and shows a person facing toward the right in profile. This figure has detailed hair worn back and a rounded neckline. The second bust, higher up on the right, faces toward the left in profile and appears to have textured hair or a wreath atop its head. Beneath this second bust, a small portion of a black picture frame is visible at the very bottom edge of the view.

title: Seal Impression of the Arms of the City of Hildesheim
alt_text: A red wax sculpture shows a round seal with raised designs. In the center, a robed figure stands under an archway flanked by two tall, thin towers. Below the archway, smaller turret-like structures frame the sides of the standing figure. A band of carved letters circles the entire outer edge of the round object. The seal rests on a dark red, textured surface that looks like velvet.

title: Seal Impression of the Arms of the City of Hildesheim
alt_text: A wax sculpture of a round seal with an embossed design on its face. The seal is deep red and has a series of tiny letters or marks stamped around the outer edge. Directly beneath the wax, a small rectangular white label displays the word "Hildesheim" in simple, dark lettering. The object rests upon a flat, dark red surface with a visible cloth texture. A sliver of a gold-rimmed object, which looks like the edge of a mirror, peeks into the view from the far left side.

title: Medallion portraits of Joachim II Hector (1505–1571), Prince-elector of the Margraviate of Brandenburg, and Hedwig Jagiellon, Electress of Brandenburg (1513–1573)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows the side profile of a person in a round, framed relief. The person faces toward the left and has an elaborate hairstyle pulled back. They wear a tall, detailed collar and a necklace with a round pendant at the neck. The relief is white or light gray in color and rests on a dark surface in front of a window. Behind the piece, the window has a wooden frame with a diamond-shaped pattern.

title: Portrait of Joachim II
alt_text: A painting of a stout man wearing an ornate, reddish-orange outfit and a tall fur hat. The man has a short, grey-brown beard and mustache, and he looks straight ahead with a serious expression. He wears a dark coat with large fur lapels over a garment covered in horizontal stripes. Several heavy gold chains with jeweled pendants hang down the center of his chest. He holds a light-colored pair of gloves in his right hand and has several rings on his fingers.

title: Tunnel of Love
medium: Oil on masonite in a hand-painted frame by the artist
alt_text: A painting of a surreal, crowded scene rendered in oil on masonite. In the center, a large, green-skinned figure with oversized, round eyes wears a red shirt and blue pants while holding a knife. Two pale, nude figures with long hair stand on either side of the green character. Below them, a small child in a red shirt stands next to a woman with a patterned headscarf and a larger, green-skinned reclining figure. The bottom left shows a crowd of people in dark clothing, while a large, dark animal head looms in the upper left corner. The entire scene is enclosed in a wide, painted frame decorated with repeating patterns.

title: Virgin and Child with Four Angels
alt_text: A polychromed stucco relief shows a woman holding a small child in her lap. The woman wears a head covering and a blue cloak that drapes around them both. Four smaller figures surround them, two on each side, with their heads tilted inward. The background is a soft, muted gold color with a worn texture. The entire relief is set inside a plain, dark rectangular wooden frame.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A marble relief of a woman holding a young child. The woman has long, wavy hair covered by a headscarf and gazes downward at the child. Both figures have faint, circular halos carved behind their heads. The child sits on the woman's lap and wraps one arm around her neck. At the bottom of the rectangular stone slab is a small shield shape with detailed carvings inside.

title: Beaker with Images of Matthias (1557–1619), Holy Roman Emperor, and the Seven Electors of the Holy Roman Empire
alt_text: An enameled glass container shows two identical tall, cylindrical vessels sitting side by side on a ledge. Each vessel features a matching lid topped with a small, blue and clear glass knob. The clear glass walls are decorated with colorful painted figures of people wearing royal or religious robes. Each vessel also displays a small crest or emblem centered below the figures. A portion of a dark, ornate picture frame is visible on the far left side of the image.

title: Beaker with Images of Matthias (1557–1619), Holy Roman Emperor, and the Seven Electors of the Holy Roman Empire
alt_text: A pair of enameled glass containers stand on a shelf, with a portion of a gold-framed object visible on the left. These tall, cylindrical vessels feature matching lids topped with small blue and clear glass finials. The glass bodies are clear, but each is decorated with a colorful enameled scene showing a figure seated on a throne and wearing robes. Smaller figures are painted on either side of the central seated figures, and each container has a base trimmed with patterns in white and red. Both containers look similar in size and shape, sitting side by side against a plain white wall.

title: King Frederick I
alt_text: A brass relief shows a person's face in the center of a circular plate. The relief is mounted on a square black background inside a simple gold frame. The face has long, curly hair and a ruffled collar, and it is made of shiny gold-colored metal. There is a decorative border with small bumps around the edge of the circular plate. The entire framed piece hangs on a white wall.

title: Prussian eagle with coat-of-arms
alt_text: A gilt bronze sculpture shaped like a vertical oval plaque depicts a stylized bird with its wings spread wide. The bird faces to the left and wears a small crown on its head. Above the oval frame rests a larger, more detailed crown topped with a tiny cross. The entire piece has a golden, metallic color and appears to have a raised, textured surface. Beneath the oval, a decorative bow or knot ties the frame together at the bottom.

title: Princess Elizabeth Albertine of Saxe-Hilburghausen
alt_text: A painting of a young woman stands within a thick, ornate, gold frame. She has pale skin, fair hair styled close to her head, and is wearing a long, light-colored dress with ruffled sleeves. Her hands are resting near her waist, where she holds a small bouquet of red and white flowers. Draped over her arm is a dark, fur-lined wrap or cloak. The background is a soft, muted gray that makes her appear to be standing indoors.

title: Bonbonierre with bust of Frederick the Great, King of Prussia
alt_text: An ivory sculpture of a bust showing an older man sits in the center of the frame. The figure has a smooth face with a serious expression and wears a draped garment over his shoulders. Directly below the bust, an oval-shaped plaque depicts several small figures standing and kneeling together. To the left, a rectangular frame contains a circular portrait of a man in a hat. To the right, another framed image shows a person standing in a garden setting. These items are mounted against a dark red background.

title: Frederick the Great, King of Prussia Snuff-box
alt_text: A painted porcelain container shows a portrait inside a gilded rectangle. The container is rectangular with rounded corners and features a painted image of a person wearing a dark three-cornered hat and a blue coat. A wreath of green leaves circles the portrait, and pink ribbons are tied at the bottom. To the left sits a worn paper object with printed patterns, and to the right is a tall, textured rectangular object resembling stone. The entire group rests on a dark red surface.

title: Frederick the Great, King of Prussia tobacco boxes
alt_text: A metal container made of copper that shows embossed designs on its rectangular surface. The top features two circular medallions, one on the left and one on the right, each displaying a profile portrait of a person in military clothing. In the center, there is an oval scene of a figure riding a horse across a battlefield with other figures nearby. Small, decorative figures stand on the far left and far right ends of the container. The background of the box is filled with decorative patterns and script lettering around the circular and oval designs.

title: Frederick the Great, King of Prussia tobacco boxes
alt_text: A copper container shows detailed engravings across its flat, rectangular surface. Two circular medallions are positioned at the top and bottom of the container. These medallions feature embossed images of profiles and intricate floral patterns. The center section contains columns of stamped text running vertically between swirling decorative borders. The metal has a dull, brownish-gold finish with shadows that highlight the textures of the engravings.

title: Frederick the Great, King of Prussia tobacco boxes
alt_text: A copper container showing intricate engravings on its top surface. The object is rectangular with rounded corners and a wavy, decorative border. In the center, a circular medallion features the profile of a person looking to the left. To the left of the medallion, a scene depicts buildings and what appears to be a figure on horseback surrounded by elaborate scrollwork. To the right, a large crest or coat of arms is surrounded by banners and detailed flourishes.

title: Frederick the Great, King of Prussia tobacco boxes
alt_text: Copper containers appear as six small, rectangular metal boxes lying on a dark, polished wooden surface. Four of the boxes are placed horizontally in a loose stack on the left side of the frame. Two of the boxes stand vertically side-by-side on the right. Each box has rounded corners and intricate engravings of human figures and decorative patterns on its lid. On the far left, a glimpse of the internal metal strings and dampers of a piano rests against the wood. The containers all have a shiny, golden-brown finish that catches the light.

title: Frederick the Great, King of Prussia
alt_text: A painting on ivory shows a portrait of a man in a circular frame centered against a deep red velvet background. The man has white, curled hair and wears a dark blue coat with visible buttons and a bright star decoration on his chest. To his left sits a portion of an oval, white-toned framed object. To his right hangs a rectangular picture showing an outdoor scene with buildings and trees. Below the circular portrait, the top of a white sculpted head is partially visible.

title: Wall sconce
alt_text: A brass sculpture of a decorative wall sconce features a prominent, shield-like backplate shaped like a pointed arch. This backplate is embossed with ornate, raised details including an eagle or bird emblem at its center. Extending from the bottom of the brass plate are two curved arms, each holding a small, flat dish. A thick, cream-colored candle sits upright on each of these two dishes. The entire piece is made of shiny brass and is mounted against a plain white wall.

title: Wall sconce
alt_text: A brass sculpture of a mitre plate shows an ornate, pointed plaque with two attached candle holders. The metal surface is decorated with raised carvings that include a central bird, scrolling leaves, and a crown at the top. Two thin, curved brass arms extend from the bottom of the plate to support the candle holders. Each holder contains a thick, white, cylindrical candle. The entire object hangs against a plain, off-white wall.

title: Frederick the Great, Voltaire, and a Dog at San Souci
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture of two people and a dog gathered around a small table. One figure sits in a high-backed chair on the left, while the other stands on the right. A small, round table with two rectangular objects rests between them. A small dog stands on the oval base near the standing figure's feet. The entire scene is bright white and rests on a dark wooden surface in front of a gold picture frame.

title: Frederick II (1712–1786), King of Prussia
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture shows a seated man wearing a military-style uniform with tall boots and a wide, triangular hat. The white figure sits upright in a decorative chair with his right hand resting on a cane or sword handle. He is placed on a rectangular, pedestal-style base that has carved details around the bottom edge. The sculpture stands on a wooden surface surrounded by several framed pictures in the background. The entire piece is made of a smooth, solid white material.

title: Frederick the Great at age 69
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up. The man has pale skin, a serious expression, and white hair styled in curls on the sides. He wears a dark, buttoned jacket with a red collar and a prominent, star-shaped badge pinned to his chest. The figure is set against a dark, oval-shaped background. The entire portrait is encased in an ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Portrait Bust of Frederick II (1712–1786), King of Prussia
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man’s head and shoulders is set on a rounded pedestal. The man wears a wide, triangular hat that is tilted slightly to one side. He has a serious expression with deep-set eyes, a firm mouth, and a straight nose. A draped cloth or cloak covers his shoulders, which has visible, carved folds in the fabric. The entire piece is smooth, white, and stands against a plain, light-gray background.

title: Easel
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media features a large, colorful rectangular board resting on a black easel. The board is covered in geometric patterns and abstract shapes painted in bright yellow, red, blue, and green. Attached to the center of the board is an open book with visible pages. Various metal objects, including a wire bicycle wheel, a small lamp, and dangling hardware, are attached to the top and sides of the board. Below the board, a black frame with a yellow bar and a red leg supports the structure.

title: Frederick the Great on Horseback
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture of a person riding a horse is shown inside a box. The white, glossy figure sits on top of a small, sculpted tree stump base that supports the horse's belly. The rider wears clothing with detailed folds and holds the reins in their hands. The horse is captured mid-motion with one front leg lifted in the air. A foam block labeled "YOKE" rests just above the rider's head. The entire object sits on a white foam packing base inside a cardboard container.

title: Portrait of Frederick II (1712–1786), King of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture shows a standing military figure wearing a uniform, boots, and a tricorne hat. He holds a long, thin stick in his right hand, while two greyhound-like dogs stand on either side of his legs. The man and the dogs rest on a decorative, elevated base that features a royal-style crown and symbols carved into the front. On each side of this central figure, a white plate with a thin, decorative border sits on a small black display stand. The background shows a portion of a framed document with writing on it hanging on a wall.

title: Frederick II (1712–1786), King of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture shows a standing soldier in a uniform with two dogs sitting at his feet. The soldier wears a dark blue coat with red cuffs, a white sash, and a dark hat. He rests his hands on the top of a sword handle while looking straight ahead. Two small, light-colored dogs are positioned near his boots on a beige, oval base. Behind the figure, there is a gold-framed picture and two thick, red books with text on their spines.

title: Frederick the Great on Horseback
alt_text: A bronze plaquette sculpture shows a person riding a horse in profile. The figure on the horse wears a hat and a uniform, facing to the left side of the frame. To the right of the pair stands a tall, textured tree trunk that reaches the top of the rectangle. Below the main scene, a horizontal strip features embossed text or a decorative pattern. The entire piece rests on a light-colored wooden surface.

title: Frederick II (1712-1786), King of Prussia, on a Journey
alt_text: A painting displayed on a triptych frame shows three scenes of people gathered outdoors. The frame is made of dark tortoiseshell and inlaid with orange decorative patterns. The central panel is larger and rectangular, featuring a group of figures in 18th-century clothing standing on light-colored ground. Two smaller, oval-shaped panels flank the center, each showing a different scene of figures in similar attire. The entire object lies flat on a white cloth surface.

title: Lead Drawing #1
alt_text: A cast lead sculpture shows a rectangular panel with an uneven, slightly warped edge. The surface of the metal is marked with a grid of horizontal and vertical incised lines forming a faint circle in the center. Scattered across the panel are several raised, pill-shaped forms that appear smooth and rounded. These shapes vary slightly in size and are arranged in different directions across the grid. The metal has a dull, dark gray, and matte appearance throughout.

title: Lead Drawing #2
alt_text: A cast lead sculpture of a rectangular board with a grid pattern. The surface is textured and gray with numerous rounded, hollow indentations scattered across the squares. These depressions appear irregularly spaced, with some squares containing one oval or circular hole and others remaining empty. Thin, straight lines are etched horizontally and vertically across the surface to form the grid. The overall appearance is muted, worn, and metallic.

title: Lead Drawing #5
alt_text: A cast lead sculpture shows a rectangular panel with a dark, metallic surface. The panel features horizontal lines that resemble wood planks or grooves. Along both the left and right sides of the panel, curved ridges extend inward from the edges. These ridges are thick and rounded, creating a pattern that creates a gap in the center of the piece. A faint, U-shaped line curves across the bottom section, connecting the two sides.

title: Bookend with portrait of Frederick II (1712-1786), King of Prussia, after the Battle of Kolín
alt_text: A bronze object shaped like a person sitting in a chair serves as the main focus. The figure wears a wide, triangular hat and a long coat, and it leans on a thin cane held in one hand. Behind the figure stands a tall, textured backrest that looks like a stone wall. The bronze sculpture sits on a smooth, wooden table surface. In the background, out-of-focus framed pictures and other items sit on the same wooden surface.

title: Letter Opener with Portrait of Frederick II (1712–1786), King of Prussia
alt_text: A brass sculpture shaped like a letter opener rests diagonally across a wooden surface. The handle features a raised, ornate carving of a human figure with a hat, wearing a cape or coat. Below the figure, the handle narrows into a smooth, flattened blade that tapers to a point. Behind the metal object, several blurred, circular objects are visible inside what appears to be a display case. These background items include a dark medallion and lighter, oval-shaped portraits.

title: John Trumbull
alt_text: A miniature of a portrait painted in watercolor on ivory shows an elderly man sitting for a likeness. The man has thinning white hair, light skin, and is wearing a dark coat with a white collar. He is positioned slightly to the right, looking toward the viewer with a neutral expression. The painting is framed within a hinged, two-part wooden case. One side of the case holds the portrait, while the other side is covered in a textured, light beige fabric.

title: Frederick the Great with Staff
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man wearing a military uniform and a three-cornered hat stands in the center of the frame. He has one hand resting on his hip and his other hand holding a long, thin cane or sword that extends downward. The figure is perched on a round, shiny, dark green marble base. Behind the statue, to the left, is a black folder with a gold circular design on its cover. To the right, a framed print featuring a landscape scene sits propped up against the wall. The items are arranged on a wooden surface.

title: Portrait of Frederick II (1712-1786), King of Prussia
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a man’s head and shoulders. The man wears a large, wide-brimmed hat that slopes down on the sides. He has a serious expression and wears a scarf or wrap draped around his shoulders. The figure sits on a round base that tapers into a pedestal. To the right of the statue, a portion of an ornate, gold-colored frame is visible.

title: Frederick II (1712–1786), King of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture shows a man standing in a uniform with a small dog at his feet. The man wears a tricorne hat and a coat with a sash across his chest. He holds a long, thin object, likely a cane or sword, in his right hand. The small dog is positioned near his left leg, looking upward. This shiny white figure stands on a simple, round base.

title: Plate with Frederick II (1712-1786), King of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain bowl shows a painted portrait of a man in its center. The man wears a wide, gray, three-cornered hat and a dark blue coat featuring a silver star on the chest. The bowl has a wide, dark blue rim decorated with delicate gold vines and flowers. Two ornate, light-colored sections with gold patterns break up the blue border, one of which includes a small gold crown. The entire bowl rests on a smooth, wood-colored surface.

title: Standing Figure of King Fredrick II with Two Dogs
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man wearing a military uniform and a hat stands on a multi-layered marble base. He wears a prominent, shiny silver sash around his waist and holds a thin leash that leads down to a standing dog. A second, smaller dog sits quietly between his legs near the base. The figure stands confidently with one hand placed on his hip. The base is hexagonal and made of dark green, patterned stone with a bright gold-colored band running through its center.

title: Portrait of Young Frederick the Great
alt_text: A porcelain lighting device shows a tall, white table lamp shaped like an urn. The base of the lamp is decorated with an oval portrait of a person with light hair, wearing a bright red coat with white fur trim. Two gold-colored handles rise from the sides of the vase near the top. A patterned gold design surrounds the portrait and circles the base of the lamp. A plain, off-white lampshade sits on top, casting a soft light downward.

title: Portrait Bust of Frederick II (1712–1786), King of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture shows the head and shoulders of a person. The figure has a smooth, white finish and stares forward with wide, alert eyes. Its hair is styled with curls on both sides of the head. The person wears a collared garment with a small necktie at the center. This white bust rests on a round, solid black stand.

title: Snuff Box with Portrait of Frederick William III (1770-1840), King of Prussia
alt_text: A wooden container features an engraving on its circular lid showing the side profile of a man. The portrait depicts a person wearing a dark, high-collared coat with a large, star-shaped emblem pinned to the chest. The man faces toward the right of the lid and has short, light-colored hair. Text is etched along the curved edge of the portrait in a lighter, yellowish color against the darker background. The circular lid is slightly worn and sits against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Plate with a Portrait of Frederick William III (1770–1840), King of Prussia
alt_text: A collection of six tin-glazed earthenware plates sits arranged on a rug with a black-and-white geometric pattern. The plates are circular and display different monochrome images in their centers, including a portrait of a person and several landscape scenes of buildings. Five of the plates are decorated in shades of black and grey, while the one on the bottom left is decorated in blue and white. All the plates feature detailed borders with patterns surrounding the central illustrations. The plates are laid out in a scattered grouping across the surface of the rug.

title: Portrait of Frederick William III and Family
alt_text: A relief sculpture shows eight white portraits set against a soft sage green oval background. These portraits are small busts of people shown in profile, arranged in a rough circle inside a smooth white frame. Each bust captures the head and shoulders of a figure, with some facing left and some facing right. The figures have simple, clean details on their faces and clothing. A small black wire loop is attached to the top of the white frame for hanging.

title: Louise of Prussia
alt_text: A painting on porcelain shows a portrait of a woman inside a round gilt frame. The woman has brown, curly hair pulled back with a light green scarf wrapped around her neck. She wears a simple, light-colored dress with thin shoulder straps. Her face is pale with rosy cheeks, and she looks directly forward toward the viewer. The oval-shaped frame is thick and shiny gold. Behind the portrait, part of a wooden surface and another object with a pink rim are visible.

title: Plate with a Portrait of Louise of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain plate features a portrait of a woman at its center. The white plate has wavy edges and is decorated with a delicate pattern of small, silver flowers forming a ring around the rim. In the center, a woman with dark, curly brown hair looks forward. She wears a white top with thin straps and a pale blue scarf draped loosely around her neck. The background behind the woman is plain white, highlighting the portrait.

title: Plate with Portrait of Louise of Prussia
alt_text: A ceramic porcelain plate showing a portrait of a woman in the center. The plate is white and has a decorative border of small gold flowers around the edge. In the middle, the woman faces forward with brown hair styled with a light blue ribbon. She wears a white blouse with a scoop neckline. The background of the plate is plain white, and the entire object sits on a wrinkled white cloth.

title: Plate with a Portrait of Louise of Mecklenburg-Strelitz (1776–1810), Queen of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain plate shows the portrait of a woman in its center. The plate has a scalloped, wavy edge and a wide, dark green border decorated with gold patterns. Inside this border, the background is plain white. The woman is painted from the shoulders up, facing forward with brown curly hair and a pale, draped garment. A long, thin, light-colored scarf wraps around her neck.

title: Plate with a Portrait of Louise of Mecklenburg-Strelitz (1776–1810), Queen of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain plate features a central portrait of a woman inside a plain, circular border. The woman has wavy, light brown hair styled with a gold headband and wears a white dress with a scarf wrapped loosely around her neck. Surrounding the center image is a wide, scalloped rim decorated with an intricate, dark gold lacy pattern. The entire plate rests on a textured white fabric surface.

title: Plate with a Portrait of Louise of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain plate shows the painted portrait of a woman. The rim of the round plate is a wide, solid band of dusty pink. In the center, a woman with dark brown hair faces forward against a white background. She wears a thin, light blue scarf wrapped loosely around her neck and shoulders. Her white garment features gold trim along the neckline and shoulders. The entire plate rests on a white, textured cloth surface.

title: Plate with Portrait of Louise of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain plate displays a portrait of a young woman in its center. The woman has wavy brown hair and wears a light-colored top with a white ribbon tied around her neck. The rim of the plate is bright teal and decorated with an intricate, dark pattern. A thin, gold-colored design circles the white space directly around the woman. The plate rests on a plain, light fabric background.

title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a group of four figures on an octagonal plaque. In the center, a woman in flowing robes sits while holding a small child who reclines in her lap. Behind them to the left, a winged figure reaches out with one arm raised. To the right of the woman, a bearded man sits on the ground with his hand to his head, looking down at a book or tablet in his lap. The figures are carved in high relief with a dark, textured finish.

title: Portrait of Carol S. Meeks
alt_text: A painting of a woman seated while wearing a long, pleated green dress. She has dark hair styled back and pale skin. Her dress includes a gold brooch at the waist and drapes loosely over her arms. In the background, two pale, stylized horse figures sit on either side of her. A curved, reddish abstract shape is also visible near the horse on the right. The background behind the woman and the figures is a hazy, muted grey.

title: Christ Falling under the Cross
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a figure kneeling on one knee, leaning forward with arms outstretched. The figure has long hair, a beard, and wears long, draped robes that pool onto the ground behind it. One hand reaches forward and rests on a small, rock-like ledge, while the other arm is bent near the head. The entire sculpture is a smooth, dark brown color with metallic highlights. It rests on a low, irregular base. The background is a plain, solid grey.

title: The Crucifixion
alt_text: A sculpture of a crucifixion scene carved into a circular rock crystal intaglio. The central figure hangs on a tall cross, flanked by two other figures on smaller crosses. Below them, a large, busy crowd of people and horses fills the lower half of the circle. The carving is set within a thin, ornate gold frame, which is encased in a thick, smooth black circular border. A small metal loop at the top allows the piece to be hung.

title: Crucified Christ
alt_text: An ivory sculpture shows a man with his arms stretched out, attached to a plain black wooden cross. The man’s body is a creamy, off-white color, and he wears a cloth draped around his waist. He has a crown of thorns on his head and looks slightly downward. Above his head, a small rectangular placard is nailed to the cross with the letters "IN RI" printed on it. The cross has a small metal loop at the very top for hanging.

title: Crucified Christ
alt_text: An ivory sculpture shows a man with his arms raised high above his head as if suspended from a cross. His head is bowed, his eyes are closed, and he wears a crown made of thorns. He has a cloth wrapped around his hips, draped with soft, deep folds. Below the figure, his feet are pressed together, pointing downwards. A separate, small curled piece of ivory floats above the head of the man, looking like a scroll.

title: Saint Francis Adoring the Crucifix
alt_text: A painting of a person wearing a brown, hooded robe who is sitting in profile. This figure is looking down with their hands clasped together in prayer. In front of them lies an open book with light-colored pages. A small wooden crucifix rests horizontally in their hands. The background is very dark, making the person and the book stand out in the dim light.

title: Plate with a Portrait of Louise of Mecklenburg-Strelitz (1776–1810), Queen of Prussia
alt_text: Two porcelain plates featuring painted portraits sit on a light-colored wooden table. The plate on the left has a dark magenta border with gold details and shows a woman wearing a green bodice. The plate on the right has a lighter, decorative border of pink and green patterns and shows a woman in a white gown. Both plates are round and feature a circular image in the center. A rectangular framed picture hangs partially visible in the background, and a piece of paper rests beneath the right plate.

title: Plate with a Portrait of Louise of Mecklenburg-Strelitz (1776–1810), Queen of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain tray showing a portrait of a woman in the center. The tray is oval-shaped with an off-white background and an ornate, wavy edge. A wide band of textured, mottled green paint surrounds the center of the tray. The woman has brown, curly hair pulled back with a pink headband and wears a green dress with a white shawl around her shoulders. Her gaze is directed forward against the plain white oval background.

title: Plate with a Portrait of Louise of Prussia
alt_text: Two porcelain plates rest on a wooden table, each decorated with a central portrait of a woman. The plate on the left has a dark magenta rim with gold patterns and a central painting of a woman in a green dress. The plate on the right features a wider, lighter border with colorful, floral-like geometric designs. This right-hand plate centers on a woman wearing a white dress with a red sash. A framed picture and some papers lie on the table behind the plates.

title: Snuff Box with Portraits of Franz I (1768-1835), Emperor of Austria; Alexander I (1777-1825), Emperor of Russia; and Frederick William III (1797-1840), King of Prussia
alt_text: A tortoiseshell container shows a raised circular scene on its lid. The center of the lid features two overlapping faces carved in relief, turned toward the left. These figures appear to be wearing high-collared uniforms or similar clothing. The circular border surrounding the figures has a delicate, textured pattern. A tiny sliver of another, similar object is visible on the far left edge of the frame. The entire object rests on a textured, light-colored background.

title: Frederick William III, King of Prussia
alt_text: A collection of miniature objects is displayed against a plain, light-colored fabric surface. On the far left, a round metallic medallion with a short chain features an embossed profile. Next to it sits a small, oval black-and-white cameo of a person's silhouette. In the center is a round pin showing a portrait of a man in a military uniform against a background of draped flags. To the right of that is a dark, carved oval piece that looks like a sculpture of a face. The collection ends on the far right with a tiny, oval framed portrait of a man in a red and blue uniform.

title: Portrait of an Unidentified Man
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a man centered within a rectangular wooden frame. The oval portrait is set into the middle of the smooth, reddish-brown wood. The man has short light-brown hair and a mustache, and he is wearing a dark military-style jacket with a bright orange sash across his chest. A small, metallic, braided loop sits at the very top of the frame for hanging. The entire object casts a soft shadow against the light-colored wall behind it.

title: Plates with Scenes from Napoleon Receiving Queen Louise of Prussia at Tilsit and The Coronation of Napoleon
alt_text: Two porcelain plates are displayed against a plain background, one above the other. Each plate features a wide, white rim decorated with ornate gold patterns, including wreaths and repeating symbols. The center of the top plate shows a group of men and a woman in formal clothing standing outdoors near stone stairs. The center of the bottom plate depicts a crowded, formal interior scene with a central figure in a long cloak standing before others. The gold edges and detailed central paintings create a luxurious appearance for both items.

title: Relief Portraits of Napoleon and Josephine Commemorating their Coronation
medium: Relief portraits on a black copper base; inset precious stones; gilt crowns
alt_text: A sculpture relief shows two bust-length portraits mounted on a rectangular black copper panel within a wooden frame. On the left, a figure wears a ruffled collar and a gold-colored crown with inset jewels. On the right, a second figure wears an elaborate crown and a decorated neckline. Between the two figures, a small, light-colored embossed eagle emblem sits against the dark background. The entire rectangular panel is surrounded by a thick, polished dark wood frame.

title: Fireplace Breast with the Port of Leith's Coat of Arms
medium: An original Adam fireplace breast; architectural motifs in gesso
alt_text: A sculpture of an original fireplace mantelpiece features light-colored gesso decorations carved in architectural patterns. The mantel has a wide, horizontal wooden shelf at the top that is decorated with repetitive floral designs and a central circle containing a small vase. Narrower vertical columns on each side also display long, thin decorative patterns reaching down to the floor. Inside the large, rectangular, black opening of the fireplace stands a framed picture, which shows a crowded indoor scene with people and a chandelier. The mantel is mounted on a white wall above a wooden floor, with a patterned rug visible in the foreground.

title: Rebecca Wilson Gilchrist Schlaberg
alt_text: A framed plaster sculpture shows a white profile portrait of a woman. The portrait is oval-shaped and stands out against a solid dark background inside the frame.
