The woman has her hair pulled back, and her face is shown looking to the left. The ornate gold frame has a dark inner border that surrounds the oval relief. The entire piece hangs on a plain, light-colored wall.

title: Cup with a Portrait of Frederick William IV (1795–1861), King of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain container sits in the center of the image on a brown wooden shelf. It is a wide-mouthed vase with a gold rim and a base decorated with gold bands. The metal surface appears shiny and reflects the light in the room.

title: Plate with a View of the Royal Palace in Berlin
alt_text: A collection of six porcelain plates is arranged on a patterned rug. Each plate features a black or blue transfer-printed image in its center, surrounded by a decorative border. The plates are circular and vary slightly in their border designs, but they share a similar size. The rug underneath is light beige with a bold, dark blue geometric pattern.

title: Plate with a View of a Procession through the Brandenburg Gate
alt_text: A set of porcelain plates shows various scenes and designs. Six circular plates are arranged on a carpet with a dark blue and cream geometric pattern. The plates on the right and top feature black-and-white ink drawings of buildings and landscapes surrounded by decorative borders. One plate on the left is decorated with a detailed blue and white scene of a large building. Another plate on the far left displays a black-and-white portrait of a person in uniform. Each plate sits flat against the patterned background.

title: Plate with a View of the Palace of Prince Frederick Charles Alexander of Prussia

title: Portrait of Prince William I (1797-1888), later Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia
medium: Marble bust above a blue and gilt porcelain base
alt_text: A marble bust of a child sits on a blue and gold porcelain base. The sculpture shows the head, neck, and shoulders of a young person with soft, wavy hair. The base is a dark blue color with shiny gold rims at the top and bottom.

title: Vase with a Portrait of William I (1797–1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain vase, featuring deep blue glaze and gold decorations, sits against a plain background. The vase has an oval body, a tall neck, and a wide, hexagonal base. In the center of the body, an oval panel displays a portrait of a man with a mustache, dressed in a dark uniform with medals. Gold leaf creates an ornate border around the portrait and decorates the rim, handles, and base of the vase.

title: Vase with a Portrait of Augusta of Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach (1811–1890), Empress of Germany and Queen of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain vase with a tall, deep blue body stands on an octagonal base. The center of the vase features an oval frame outlined in gold, which contains a painted portrait of a woman looking to her left. Two ornate white handles, shaped like winged creatures, attach to the neck of the vase. Gold trim decorates the rim, the base, and the area around the neck. The background is a plain, neutral-colored wall, while the surface beneath the vase is a light tan.

title: William I, King of Prussia Ceremonial Vase
alt_text: A ceramic vase of porcelain and gold leaf sits prominently in the center of the frame. The vase is bright blue with shiny gold details, including a wide gold rim and base. On its front, there is a circular portrait of a man in a dark military uniform with medals. Flanking the vase on the left and right are two tall, plain dark blue glass bottles. Behind these items, two black-and-white framed prints show landscape scenes. The entire display is set on a light-colored surface in front of a white paneled window.

title: William I, King of Prussia in a blue tunic
alt_text: A painting of a middle-aged man wearing a formal dark uniform. He has a bald head, a thin gray mustache, and long, fluffy sideburns that frame his face. His dark jacket features a red collar and decorative white shoulder pads with pleated details. The background is a simple, dark, and solid brown color that makes the figure stand out. He is framed by an ornate, worn gold-colored border that hangs on a wall.

title: Tile with a Portrait of William I (1797–1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture shows two rectangular panels side by side. Each panel features a portrait of a man in a dark military uniform with white shoulder accents and medals on his chest. The man on the left has a bald head and a large, wide mustache. The man on the right has hair on top and a full, long beard. Both figures are set against a plain, off-white background. The two panels sit on a dark, polished wood surface.

title: Tile with a Portrait of Frederick III (1831–1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture of two separate rectangular plaques, each featuring a portrait of a man in military uniform. The plaque on the left shows an older man with a long, white mustache, wearing a dark coat adorned with medals and light-colored epaulets on his shoulders. The plaque on the right depicts a man with a full, white beard who is also dressed in a dark military coat with epaulets and medals. Both men have serious expressions and are shown from the chest up against a plain white background. The plaques rest on a dark, polished wooden surface.

title: Cup and Saucer with a Portrait of William I (1797–1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain container shows a portrait of a man with a mustache and beard. This portrait is set inside a gold-rimmed oval frame that is surrounded by delicate, lacy patterns. title: Portrait Bust of William I (1797–1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture shows the bust of a man with a bald head and long, white sideburns. He wears a dark, formal jacket with a high collar and a necktie featuring a small, gold-colored pin. title: Pokal with a Portrait of William I (1797-1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia
alt_text: Two glass containers stand side by side on a wooden surface. Both tall jars are made of translucent, amber-tinted glass and feature matching lids with round knobs on top. title: Pokal with a Portrait of Otto von Bismarck, (1815–1898), Duke of Lauenburg

title: Portrait Relief of Otto von Bismarck (1815–1898), Duke of Lauenburg

title: Portrait Relief of William I (1797–1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia

title: Portrait of William I (1797-1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia
alt_text: An iron sculpture of a man's head and shoulders rests on a wooden shelf between several books. The man has a thick mustache and large, bushy sideburns extending down from his cheeks. title: Tobacco Box of William I (1797-1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia

title: Commerative relief of William I and Frederick the Great

title: Bust of William I

title: Queen Louise of Prussia
alt_text: Porcelain miniatures showing four oval portraits of women arranged side-by-side on a plain background. Each portrait features a woman with her hair styled up and wearing a light-colored, off-the-shoulder dress. The three portraits on the left are framed in thin, simple metal bands, while the portrait on the far right has a wider, dark blue border. The paintings have a soft, delicate look, focusing on the faces and shoulders of each person. The lighting in each image is gentle and even.

title: Queen Louise of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain miniature showing four oval portraits of women arranged horizontally against a plain, light-colored background. Each small piece features a painting of a woman with dark hair and a light-colored dress, facing forward. The three miniatures on the left are set in simple, thin metal frames. The miniature on the far right is larger and encased in a thicker, dark blue border decorated with thin, gold-colored lines. All the figures appear delicate and look directly toward the viewer.

title: Kaiser Wilhelm II
alt_text: A numismatic object in the form of a black and white agate cameo is displayed alongside several other small items on a textured surface. To its left sits a circular metal medal with a short decorative chain attached to the top. To the right of the cameo is a larger circular pin featuring a painted portrait of a man in a military uniform with draped flags behind him. Next to that is a dark, carved stone bust of a person with a beard. Finally, on the far right, lies a small oval brooch containing a miniature portrait of a man in uniform.

title: Campaign Button of Prince Henry of Prussia (1862-1929)
alt_text: A piece of jewelry in the form of a button or pin is displayed among three other similar small, circular items on a light-colored surface. On the far left sits a round, dark metal medallion attached to a short chain. Next is a small, oval-shaped black and white silhouette of a person's profile. Beside it lies a round button decorated with a colorful portrait of a man in a military uniform against red and white fabric drapery. To the right of that is a dark, glossy, carved object with an intricate, somewhat abstract shape. Finally, a small, oval frame on the far right holds a tiny, colored portrait of a person in a uniform.

title: Whitby jet oval cameo with portrait of Kaiser Wilhelm I
alt_text: A piece of jewelry of Whitby jet and other materials is shown in a row on a tan surface. On the far left, a round bronze-colored medal hangs from a small metal chain. Next to it sits an oval pin with a white silhouette portrait against a black background. In the center is a round pin showing a portrait of a man in a military uniform surrounded by draped flags. To the right of the center pin is a dark, carved stone object with a sculpted face, followed by a small, oval frame containing a portrait of a man.

title: Frederick the Great
medium: Painted on ivory, elaborate gilt frame with velvet
alt_text: A painting on ivory shows a portrait of a person in military clothing, framed within a thick, dark, and decorative gilt border. The subject wears a light-colored powdered wig with a small, flat-brimmed hat tilted slightly to one side. A bright blue jacket with white trim covers their shoulders, and a large, gold star-shaped pin is attached to the chest. This central image is mounted against a deep, dark velvet background. The entire piece sits inside an elaborate, heavy gold frame that features intricate carved patterns at the corners.

title: Plate with coat of arms of Prussia
alt_text: A porcelain plate shows a central emblem surrounded by a decorative border. The plate is white and circular with a gently scalloped, gold-trimmed edge. A thin garland of green leaves and small red berries circles the rim of the plate. In the center, there is a large, stylized black eagle with its wings spread wide. A small shield with horizontal black, white, and red stripes sits on the eagle's chest, topped by a golden crown.

title: Plate with a View of the Brandenburg Gate
alt_text: A pair of round porcelain plates features an identical printed scene in black and white. At the center of each plate, a large arched structure with many columns stands tall, topped by a small figure in a chariot. Below the arch, several people walk on the ground, accompanied by horses and carriages. A small banner with text hangs in the sky above the arch. The edges of the plates are simple and circular. Other plates are partially visible at the top corners of the image.

title: Plate with a View of the Brandenburg Gate
alt_text: A porcelain plate showing a detailed print of a grand, columned building in the center. This design is repeated identically on two side-by-side plates resting on a textured white surface. Above the building on each plate is a small, scroll-like banner with text printed inside. The scene on the plates depicts people walking and riding horses in an open square in front of the structure. Portions of two other round plates are visible in the upper corners of the frame.

title: Plate with a view of the Berlin Palace
alt_text: A porcelain plate shows an illustrated scene inside a decorative border. The center of the plate features a rectangular drawing of a large, multi-story building set back from a street. In the foreground of this drawing, tiny figures of people and a horse-drawn carriage are visible. Surrounding this central picture is a wide, dark blue border filled with detailed patterns of flowers, fruits, and leaves. The background behind the plate appears to be a textured, white surface, likely a tablecloth.

title: Plate with a View of the Jagdschloss Grunewald
alt_text: A porcelain plate features a black and white illustration of a large house next to a lake. The drawing shows several trees surrounding the building and a reflection of the house in the water below. In the foreground, small figures of people walk and stand on the grassy bank of the lake. There is a faint, handwritten label at the top and another at the bottom of the plate. Another partial plate with a green rim is visible in the upper left corner of the frame.

title: Plate with a View of the Spandau Citadel
alt_text: A porcelain plate shows a black-and-white illustration of a large stone building. The building has a tall round tower on one side and a gated entrance in the middle. It sits directly behind a body of water, and its reflection is visible below it. Tall trees stand on both sides of the building. Text in cursive script appears near the bottom rim of the plate.

title: Neck badge of Royal "or Princely" House Order of Hohenzollern
alt_text: A piece of jewelry made of silver, enamel, and silk shows a long chain decorated with small, colorful patterned links. The silver chain is laid out in a large, open oval shape on a light-colored surface. A large, cross-shaped pendant with white, blue, and green enamel hangs from the right side of the chain. Inside the chain, there are several separate items including a ribbon with a small cross, a short string of coins, and two small shield-shaped pins featuring red eagle designs. These detached items are arranged in a horizontal row near the center of the image.

title: Silver and enamel watch chain with Hohenzollern insignia, "Gott Mit Uns"
alt_text: A silver and enamel jewelry set shows a long, decorative chain arranged in an oval shape. The chain is made of many connected, small links that feature alternating blue and black enamel squares. Hanging from the right side of the chain is a large, four-pointed cross with a central circle. Inside the loop of the chain, there are several separate pieces, including two small, shield-shaped badges with red designs, a four-pointed cross with a ribbon, and a line of four silver coins. The entire collection rests against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Silver watch chain set with 19th century Prussian coins
alt_text: A piece of silver jewelry shows a long, elaborate chain arranged in a large oval. The chain connects many small, patterned metal links to form a continuous loop. Resting inside this space are a cross on a black and white ribbon, a row of four round silver coins, and two small, shield-shaped badges. These shields display a detailed red design on their front surfaces. A large cross with blue and green coloring hangs prominently from the right side of the main chain.

title: Silver and enamel pins with Prussian eagle
alt_text: A piece of jewelry made of silver and enamel shows a long, decorative chain arranged in a large, open oval shape. The chain is composed of many small, linked metal pieces that alternate between silver scrollwork and colorful enamel geometric designs. Hanging from the right side of the main chain is a large, white cross with green and blue circular details at its center. Inside the curve of the chain, there are several separate items, including a small cross, a striped black-and-white ribbon attached to a metal piece, a small row of round silver coins, and two matching shield-shaped pins with red bird designs. The entire collection is displayed against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Bonboniere with portrait of Frederick the Great
alt_text: An ivory and gilt metal sculpture shows a portrait of a person inside a gold oval frame. This small oval object is placed in the center of a deep red velvet display surface. The person in the portrait has short white hair and wears a dark blue jacket with a large silver star pinned to the chest. To the left sits a reddish, irregularly shaped circular object with raised lettering around its edge. Another small, partial oval portrait frame is visible on the right side of the red display.

title: Portrait of Frederick the Great with Sans Souche background
alt_text: A miniature on ivory shows a portrait of a man in a black coat and hat. He stands outside in a garden setting, holding a thin walking stick in his right hand. The man wears a large, bright star-shaped medal on his coat and a white sash around his waist. A golden, rectangular frame surrounds the portrait, which hangs on a dark red, textured wall. Part of a white sculpture of a head and shoulders is visible in the lower left corner.

title: Portrait of Emperor William II
medium: Pressed paper(?) on green velet ground mounted with crown
alt_text: A sculpture showing a portrait bust mounted inside a frame. The white, side-profile bust of a man in a high-collared garment is centered on a dark green, velvet-like background. The entire piece is enclosed within a wide, golden-colored wooden frame. At the very top center of the frame, a small, intricate metal crown is attached. This creates a strong contrast between the bright white figure and the dark velvet behind it.

title: Mettlach stoneware beer stein with silver plate lid
alt_text: A tall stoneware container with a silver plate lid sits on a wooden surface. The body of the container is light beige and features a large, painted black eagle with outspread wings on its front. A small metal figure of a person stands on top of the hinged lid. Decorative blue and red floral patterns surround the eagle on the sides of the cylinder. A curved handle extends from the right side of the container.

title: Frederick the Great, King of Prussia tobacco boxes
alt_text: A metal container made of copper that has a gold-colored surface. It is rectangular with rounded corners and a raised, embossed design across its lid. The center of the lid features a circular emblem or medallion. On either side of the center, the metal is decorated with intricate swirling patterns and figures. The entire surface reflects light, creating bright highlights and deep shadows that emphasize the embossed details.

title: Frederick the Great, King of Prussia tobacco boxes
alt_text: A copper container showing a long, rectangular, gold-colored box with rounded ends. The lid is covered in detailed, embossed designs that look like carved gold. Five circular medallions are spaced evenly across the top, featuring different scenes with small figures and a central portrait of a person. Intricate, swirling patterns and lines of text fill the spaces between and below these circles. The overall surface is shiny and has a metallic yellow finish.

title: Frederick the Great
medium: Miniature painting on ivory with ivory frame with mother-of-pearl
alt_text: A miniature painting shows a portrait of a person inside a square frame. The painting features an oval portrait of a man wearing a dark blue military-style uniform and a large black hat. The man is looking forward with a serious expression and holding a small, brown walking stick. The frame surrounding the portrait is made of rectangular, white ivory pieces arranged in a sunburst pattern. Thin, shiny strips of mother-of-pearl accent the ivory frame, which is set against a dark red background.

title: Portrait of Willhelmina Schlaberg, Hildesheim
medium: Pastel on paper laid on canvas
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a young woman against a light blue and tan background. She faces forward with dark hair styled in a high bun with curls at the sides. She wears a dark blue dress with large, puffy sleeves and a wide, white ruffled collar around her neck. A simple rectangular, gold-colored frame surrounds the painting. The artwork hangs on a plain, light-colored wall.

title: Historiated Wine Cooler with Masks
alt_text: A ceramic container of tin-glazed earthenware shaped like a wide, shallow bowl with scalloped edges. A sculpted face with an open, gaping mouth sits on the side of the bowl, acting as a handle or decoration. The surface of the bowl is painted with a landscape scene featuring small buildings, hills, and a yellow sky. The bowl stands on a base that looks like animal paws with claws. The colors are mostly blues, yellows, and browns against a shiny, smooth surface.

title: Robert Heinecken, 1931-2006, Residual Reality
alt_text: A sculpture of a salt shaker shows a clear glass container filled with a powdery substance at the bottom. The glass bottle has a tapered, hexagonal shape and stands upright on a white surface. A shiny, silver-colored metal lid sits on top of the bottle. Printed on the front of the glass in small, black letters are the words "Robert Heinecken," the dates "1931-2006," and the words "Residual Reality." The background is a plain, tan-colored wall.

title: 3 février 1955
alt_text: A painting of dark, rectangular shapes arranged in a vertical pattern across the canvas. Most of the rectangles are solid black, but a few feature lighter, brownish, or golden highlights in their centers. The paint appears to be applied with thick, heavy strokes, creating a sense of texture. These shapes overlap and tilt in different directions, giving the composition a layered feel. A muted, greyish-brown background peeks through between the darker forms.

title: Ocean Flats I
medium: Bleach and ink on canvas mounted to wood panel
alt_text: A painting of a dark, grid-like pattern on a textured surface. The image features a series of intersecting horizontal and vertical lines that form large, somewhat irregular rectangles. The colors are muted shades of charcoal, gray, and off-white. The surface appears wrinkled and folded, which makes the straight lines look slightly wavy and distorted in some places. The overall effect is like looking through a thin, dark fabric that has been creased or crumpled.

title: The Spoon Bender
medium: Wood, polystyrene, cement, acrylic, felt, canvas, steel chair, plastic doll, and eyeglasses
alt_text: A sculpture featuring a doll inside a metal chair frame placed on top of a large, rectangular block. The pale plastic doll lies on its back within the curves of a wire-frame steel chair. Below this, a large, rectangular box is painted with soft shades of pink and orange. This box sits upon a jagged, textured base that is colored in vibrant hues of orange and red. A small stack of rectangular items, possibly books or papers, sits on the floor in the background to the right.

title: Portrait Bust of Emperor Frederick III (1831–1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture of a man wearing a military uniform stands between two books on a shelf. The bust is bright white and depicts a person with a thick, long beard and swept-back hair. The figure rests on a dark blue, rounded base that sits on a wooden surface. To the left of the sculpture is a thick black book with white text, and to the right is a tall, bright red book. The scene is lit from the front, casting soft shadows on the shelf below.

title: Desert Landscape II
alt_text: A painting on plexiglas showing a landscape with a blue sky and a yellow ground. The bright blue sky fills most of the frame and is made up of many small, repeating white dots. A single, wide, white horizontal shape stretches across the upper middle part of the sky like a cloud. Below, the ground consists of curved yellow mounds outlined in thick black lines. The entire scene is encased in a simple, metallic-colored frame.

title: Figure 3
alt_text: A painting of abstract, sweeping brushstrokes that form the shape of a large number. The entire image is filled with shades of gray, black, and white. Bold, thick paint covers the canvas in layers. The brushstrokes create two large, rounded loops stacked on top of each other. The texture appears rough and energetic across the surface.

title: Reflection
alt_text: A painting of several people in a dance studio. A woman in a red outfit and a man in a blue tank top sit on the wooden floor against a wall. Behind them, a young man with a yellow shirt and green pants lies stretched out on a long wooden bench. Further back, a mirror reflects another person standing in a pose with arms outstretched, as well as a window showing a person sitting outside. A pair of slippers rests on the floor near the bench.

title: Towards Playground in Toulouse
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture of geometric shapes mounted on a white board. Several triangles of different sizes and colors, including pink, blue, brown, and light wood, are arranged on the left side. A large, bright yellow triangle sits in the center, partially covered by a rectangular piece of blue wire mesh. On the right side, a smooth, round wooden circle sits below a long, thin, light-wood triangle. Small pieces of bright turquoise and yellow peek out from behind the other shapes.

title: The Child at the Door
alt_text: A painting of a young child standing in an open doorway. The child faces away from the viewer while looking back over their shoulder. They wear a dark blue dress, light socks, and dark shoes. In their left hand, they hold a large, light-colored object that appears to be a piece of cloth or paper. Behind the child, the room is dark, with a patterned wall visible in the background.

title: Vessels on a Choppy Sea
alt_text: A painting showing two small wooden ships sailing on a very rough and stormy sea. The larger ship in the foreground leans heavily to the side as it rides over a large, white-capped wave. Another similar ship is visible further back to the left, also tilting as it moves through the choppy water. Above the boats, a dark and cloudy sky fills most of the upper half of the frame. The overall colors are muted grays, browns, and dark blues, suggesting an overcast day.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes arranged in horizontal and vertical patterns against a dark background. Rectangular blocks in shades of blue, red, yellow, orange, and white are lined up in columns or rows across the canvas. A large, dark central area creates a deep contrast against the lighter, colorful shapes. The rectangular blocks appear to be stacked in stair-like or grid formations that move across the dark spaces. The composition uses flat colors and sharp, straight edges throughout.

title: security and serenity #2
medium: Plastic laminated wood shelves, 4 blue “Gem Lites” glitter lights, 2 white Makio Hasuike toilet brushes, and 2 black Makio Hasuike toilet brushes
alt_text: A sculpture made of two wood shelves mounted on a white wall, each holding a specific set of objects. The left shelf is a light brown color and holds two tall, cylindrical blue glitter lamps and two white, long-handled brushes. The right shelf is a darker shade of brown and holds two more tall, cylindrical blue glitter lamps and two black, long-handled brushes. Both shelves have a similar angular, geometric design. The display sits in a room with a light-colored wooden floor and a brick wall on the far left. The lighting in the room is bright and even.

title: Kaiyu ogata kaki
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture stands upright with an irregular, lumpy shape. Its surface is primarily a dark gray, with patches of earthy brown and muted orange blended across its curves. Three smooth, straight tubes protrude from different parts of the sculpture’s body. One tube points straight up from the top, while two others stick out at angles from the side. The overall appearance is hand-modeled and uneven, suggesting a textured and organic form.

title: Diana
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in dark water beside a white swan. She is light-skinned, with her dark hair pulled up, and she looks down toward her right hand. Her left hand holds a white cloth that is draped across her hips. Behind her, a dark, shadowy forest stands on one side, while a lighter, blue-tinted landscape appears in the distance. The entire painting is held within a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame with carved leaf designs.

title: Nudes Amongst a Landscape
alt_text: A painting of three nude women and a small child in a landscape setting. On the left, one woman sits on a mossy rock with her arms raised above her head. In the center, another woman reclines on the ground, leaning on one arm. To the right, a third woman stands next to a small, cherubic child. The background shows trees and a hazy, light-colored horizon. The artwork is framed in a thick, gold-colored wood border.

title: Anima Mundi 44-3
medium: Set of three prints, acrylic on plastic paper
alt_text: A painting set of three rectangular, framed prints shows abstract, colorful geometric designs. Each print features a large central rectangle surrounded by solid-colored borders or stripes on the sides, top, and bottom. The left print has a bold red center with light blue, green, and yellow accents. The middle print displays a softer, striped pink center framed by bright red horizontal bars and light blue vertical side panels. The right print is dominated by a dusty pink rectangle with a dark blue stripe on the right side and bright yellow bands across the top and bottom.

title: Dave Magadan
alt_text: A painting of a grassy field viewed from a high angle. The field is bright green and shaped like a wedge, with long, diagonal light streaks across it. In the center, a dirt path curves along the grass with two tiny figures standing near the edge. Behind the field, two tall, rectangular, light-colored structures stand against a dark background. On the right side, there is a large, slanted shape painted in shades of brown and purple. The overall style of the painting uses loose brushstrokes and muted colors.

title: Mouse Trap
medium: Gold plated bronze, wood, and metal
alt_text: A sculpture of two mousetraps sits inside a clear glass display case on a white platform. The trap on the left is made of wood with metal parts, featuring a light tan base and a large red "V" logo. The trap on the right is made of shiny gold-plated metal and mirrors the layout of the standard wooden version. Both objects are rectangular in shape and are positioned side-by-side. The entire display rests on a clean, white, raised surface.

title: Roller Roaster
medium: Steel shopping cart, grill, and mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture made of a steel shopping cart and various metal kitchen tools stands against a plain background. The cart is packed full of pots, pans, strainers, and rectangular metal containers. These kitchen items hang from the wire frame of the cart, covering its sides and front entirely. A dark grill grate sits on top of the cart as a lid. The overall shape is rectangular and cluttered with reflective, silvery metal surfaces.

title: The Good Will Umbrella
medium: Four-color silkscreen on 6 panels of acrylic plastic
alt_text: A sculpture consists of six identical rectangular panels arranged in a single row against a white wall. Each panel features the word "Mobil" in dark blue letters at the top, with a bright red circle replacing the letter "o." Below this logo, each panel contains a heading followed by two columns of small black text. The panels look like printed signs or posters displayed side-by-side. The entire work has a clean, uniform, and industrial appearance.

title: Salt
alt_text: A ceramic container made of tin-glazed earthenware shows a complex, sculptural design featuring several human figures. The central part of the object is formed by a standing woman holding a bowl in front of her. Two smaller figures sit on the left and right sides, also holding shallow bowls. Below the central woman and the two side figures are additional seated figures painted in blue and yellow tones. The entire piece is highly decorated with intricate swirls, patterns, and shiny, colorful glazes in yellow, blue, and green. The base of the container flares outward and features decorative details around its bottom edge.

title: The Retreat of Napoleon’s Army from Russia in 1812
alt_text: A painting of a cold, snowy landscape filled with exhausted and fallen figures. Groups of people dressed in thick, layered coats are huddled together, some sitting in the snow and others slumping over. In the center, several individuals are lying on the ground, appearing listless or unconscious. Behind them, a darker crowd of mounted figures on horseback looms against a stormy, gray sky. To the far right, a faint orange glow flickers, suggesting a small fire in the gloom. The scene is dark, moody, and conveys a sense of great struggle and despair.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of a long, rectangular block topped with several vertical, leaf-like shapes. The base is covered in a dense, rough texture made of many small, multi-colored fragments in shades of brown, black, white, and green. Resting on top of this base are five distinct, rounded forms that stand upright in a row. These upper shapes resemble the edges of open books or flower petals, painted in bright gradients of orange, yellow, red, and green. The entire piece sits on a flat, dark surface, viewed from a slightly high angle.

title: Invasion Barge
alt_text: A painting of abstract, geometric shapes includes several figures constructed from triangles and blocks. On the left and right, brown, layered rectangular shapes suggest stylized bodies, each with a small head and visible teeth. The background consists of fragmented shapes in shades of white, grey, brown, and black, with a small striped pattern resembling a flag near the top center. A flat, blue horizontal bar anchors the bottom of the image, while solid black sections fill the outer corners. The entire composition uses sharp, straight lines to divide the different colors and forms.

title: White Disc
medium: Painted steel in red, yellow, black and white
alt_text: A sculpture of painted steel shows a hanging mobile with many flat, thin shapes suspended by thin metal wires. The sculpture is divided into two main branches that hang from a single central wire connected to the ceiling. The branch on the right features five colorful, leaf-like paddles in red, yellow, and black. A larger, more complex cluster of shapes hangs on the left side, featuring black, white, red, and yellow pieces. Each shape hangs freely at different levels, creating a wide, branching arrangement against a plain, light grey background.

title: Two Grey Disks after a Prototype by Blinky Palermo
alt_text: A glass sculpture shows two tall, translucent gray vases standing side by side against a plain white background. Each vase has an elongated oval shape with vertical fluting along the sides. They are made of dark, smoky-colored glass that allows light to pass through them. The vases sit on a smooth white surface, casting soft shadows to the right of their bases.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of an abstract cow is set against a vibrant, solid red background. The cow is primarily white with large, irregular patches of black paint scattered across its body. A bright yellow shape sits prominently on the cow's midsection, contrasting with the surrounding colors. Near the top corners, small clusters of green and blue brushstrokes suggest foliage or abstract forms. The paint application is thick and expressive, with visible brushstrokes throughout the composition.

title: Brush
alt_text: A sculpture shows a rectangular block of light-colored wood topped with a dense, dark cluster of bristles. The base is a smooth, flat piece of wood with a natural grain pattern. Resting on top is a thick, shaggy mass of black, hair-like bristles that appear to be bundled together. The bristles have a soft, fuzzy texture that contrasts with the hard, solid wood beneath. The entire object sits against a plain, light gray background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting shows several figures standing in an outdoor, abstract landscape. On the left, a tall person in a brown outfit stands behind a smaller figure with a white, distorted face. To the right of that, two women stand close together, both wearing blue outfits and hats, with one holding a dark handbag. Further to the right, a pink-colored nude figure stands next to a small, pale child. The background consists of broad, flat sections of blue, green, and yellow paint that suggest a simple setting.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of an abstract composition features areas of bright red, muted gray, and small flecks of white. The left side is dominated by a solid block of vibrant red, while the top and center are filled with a large, sweeping field of gray. Small, irregular marks of red and white paint are scattered throughout the gray section, creating a sense of movement. On the right side, the colors blend into a denser cluster of red, gray, and white shapes. The overall effect is textured and busy, with no distinct figures or identifiable objects visible.

title: Chevaux sur la plage
alt_text: A painting showing two figures riding horses across a flat, brownish-yellow landscape. The riders are in the left foreground, moving toward the right side of the canvas. In the distance to the right, two more small, blurry figures stand near a small patch of water reflecting the sky. Above the ground, a large, cloudy, greyish-blue sky takes up the top half of the painting. The scene is painted with loose, soft brushstrokes that create a hazy effect.

title: La Rochelle
alt_text: A painting of sailboats resting in calm, gray water. Several boats with tall masts are docked near the center, their hulls painted in muted shades of blue and tan. In the foreground, a small, solitary rowboat floats quietly near the larger vessels. Behind the boats, the hazy shoreline features pale, blocky buildings and a line of dark green trees. The sky above is a cloudy, uniform shade of soft gray, blending with the water.

title: The Harbor at Cherbourg
alt_text: A painting of a harbor scene with several sailboats docked along a stone pier. The water is a muted blue color, reflecting the cloudy sky above. Several boats with tall masts are moored tightly along the edge of the pier on the left side of the scene. On the right, a wide, sandy path stretches forward, where a person in a long white dress walks with a child. The path is bordered by tall, weathered buildings that fade into the distance along the edge of the water.

title: Sculpture for Snow
alt_text: A sculpture of painted aluminum shows a large, geometric shape that stands on one narrow corner. It has flat, smooth, matte black surfaces that form sharp angles and planes. The object is situated in an open area with a ground covered in reddish-brown gravel. In the background, there is a large stone building with many windows and tall green trees. The sculpture contrasts strongly against the light-colored building and the natural setting.

title: Sculpture Park (Tony Smith)
alt_text: A single-channel video showing a dark, rectangular shape centered against a grainy, textured background. The object is slightly tilted, appearing to rest on a flat, bright surface. The overall image is black and white and appears very blurry. Vertical, rain-like streaks obscure most of the details in the scene. The object itself is darker than the surrounding area, with a lighter, geometric top edge.

title: Prison, Cell, Tower
medium: DayGlo acrylic and Roll-a-Tex on unprimed canvas
alt_text: A painting of three bright orange rectangles against a plain, light beige background. The two rectangles on the left are shorter squares that sit side-by-side. The rectangle on the far right is taller and thinner than the others. Inside the bottom-left square, there is a small, pale beige shape containing four thin vertical lines. All the orange shapes have a textured, bumpy surface.

title: Christ Carrying the Cross
alt_text: A painting of a man with long, brown hair and a beard kneeling on the ground while holding a large, wooden cross. The man is wearing a simple, light-colored robe that is bunched around his body. He leans his head against the cross and rests his hand on it, looking downward with a weary expression. The background is a very dark, solid color that makes the man and the cross stand out. He kneels on a patch of uneven, dry-looking ground.

title: Memory Form II
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture shows a small, house-like structure resting on top of a tall, rectangular white pedestal. The house model has white, rough-textured walls and a peaked roof. A large, rectangular opening in the center of the wall reveals a dark interior with a smooth, tan rectangular block inside. The model sits on a thin, dark red rectangular base that is slightly wider than the house itself. This entire assembly stands against a plain, light grey background.

title: Southern Monument IV
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture of a small, block-like structure sitting on a rectangular base. The base has a wood-colored border and a blue, painted surface resembling water. The structure itself is a white, boxy object with a green ladder attached to its side. On top of the structure sits a small metal cage containing a cone-shaped object, with a red string connecting the cage down to a small, lumpy shape on the ground. Various small, colorful geometric shapes and items are arranged across the flat roof of the structure.

title: Southern Monument XV
alt_text: A sculpture of a small, rusty metal building sitting on a base of brown, rocky ground. The structure is cube-shaped with rivets along the edges and the letters "DRIN" painted on the front. A tall, thin metal ladder leans against the right side of the building. On the flat roof, there is a pointed cone shape, a small green object, and a dark grey sphere. A rectangular window cutout sits in the center of the front wall.

title: Thunderbolt
alt_text: A sculpture made of found and cut magazines shows a book cover featuring a group of shirtless men. The black-and-white image on the cover depicts eight men standing in a line on a grassy field under a cloudy sky. In the center of the book cover, a large, cutout figure of a human body is superimposed over the group. This central figure is constructed from many layers of colorful, cut-up paper scraps in wavy, fluid patterns. The word "VERSACE" is printed in white capital letters at the bottom center, partially obscured by the colorful cutout.

title: Work of Linear - Actions
alt_text: A sculpture of a found and cut sketchbook shows pages carved into wavy, tiered layers. The open book displays intricate, irregular cutouts that create a deep, textured pattern across both facing pages. These paper layers resemble a top-down view of a landscape with hills and valleys. The paper remains creamy white and off-white throughout the entire object. The cut sections cast soft, subtle shadows that define the curved shapes.

title: Flat Globe: Minimalism
medium: Found and cut book in box frame
alt_text: A sculpture of a found and cut book in a box frame shows two open pages that have been carved and layered. The left page has white, black, and blue patterns that look like wavy lines or topographic maps. The right page features more complex, multicolored swirls of green, red, yellow, and blue. Both pages are cut deeply, creating a sense of texture and depth inside the frame. The entire piece is contained within a clean, rectangular white frame hanging on a plain gray wall.

title: Untitled V
medium: Found book pages, wood, and thread with wire stand
alt_text: A sculpture of found book pages, wood, and thread shows a book modified into a rounded, diamond-like shape. The center of the object is formed by the thick stack of open, fan-like book pages, which are light tan in color. Dark wooden handles are attached to the top and bottom of the paper stack. Pink thread is wrapped around the wooden parts where they meet the paper. A thin wire curves from the top of the sculpture down to the bottom, holding the piece in place.

title: Agrippa (A Book of the Dead)
medium: Artist's book treated with photosensitive chemicals, plastic container, computer disk
alt_text: An artist’s book sculpture is shown open, resting in front of a dark container. The book is open to two pages. The left page shows blurry, dark vertical blotches on a lighter background. The right page displays dense columns of letters and a small, blurry rectangular black-and-white photograph. Behind the open book, a dark, textured lid or case sits at an angle. A sheer, yellowish, wrinkled fabric layer is tucked between the open book and the case.

title: Michel-Ange (Cooked Book)
medium: Found and cooked book with flour and peppers in a perspex case
alt_text: A sculpture of a book inside a clear plastic box contains several dark, curved pieces embedded in a textured, light-colored paste. The top portion of the book cover remains visible, displaying large green and reddish text. A thick, sandy-colored substance covers the bottom two-thirds of the book, obscuring the original cover design. Inside this textured material, several dark, brownish, elongated shapes are arranged in rough horizontal rows. The entire object sits upright, encased in a transparent rectangular frame that protects the contents.

title: Cosmeceutical Collection
alt_text: A sculpture of mixed media shows a rectangular, hinged box lined with pink textured paper. The box is open, displaying three items resting in molded cutouts within the right side of the container. In the top slot lies a smooth, dark, rounded oval object with a light-colored circular label on its center. Below that is a small, flat, dark square with a silver rectangle on its surface. To the right of these objects, a slender, cylindrical tool with a patterned white and black handle sits upright in a long, narrow slot.

title: Top Gun
alt_text: A sculpture showing a rectangular paper print and a matching white box. The long, horizontal print is covered in very fine, dense text that creates a light gray, textured appearance. Resting on the left side of the print is a tall, white, rectangular box positioned vertically. Small black text is printed on the front of the box. The entire arrangement sits against a plain, smooth gray background.

title: Fantasy of Possession
alt_text: A sculpture of altered books stands vertically like a tall, thin pillar against a dark gray background. The object is composed of many individual books stacked on top of one another to create a long, rectangular tower. Each book has a worn, light brown paper cover with a rough and crinkled texture. The spine of the column looks slightly uneven because of the way the books are aligned. The light hits the sculpture from the left side, casting a soft shadow to the right.

title: Fusion II
alt_text: A sculpture of a book is covered in a layer of wax. The red cover of the book faces forward and has gold text printed on it. This text includes words like "American," "Illustrated," "Medical," and "Dictionary." The side edge of the book is visible on the left, showing off-white pages that are coated in a thick, waxy substance. Small, bright red streaks drip down the side of these pages.

title: Real to Reel: Webster's Third
medium: Book paper on film reel in custom case
alt_text: A sculpture of a film reel holds a long, continuous strip of paper covered in printed text. This paper strip unspools from the reel and curves across the flat, grey surface, displaying columns of dictionary definitions. Beside the reel sits a square, black case with metal corners. A small white label on the case has text written in black ink. The lighting is even and soft, casting faint shadows behind the objects.

title: Instructions for Assembly- Unpopped
alt_text: An artist's book sculpture shows an open book with a three-dimensional pop-up feature in the center. The blue, box-like pop-up is decorated with white speckles and features a circular hole looking into its interior. Grid lines are drawn on the white pages behind the pop-up, which also contains a small, rectangular label with text. Small yellow tabs are placed on the pages to the left and right of the central box. The book is standing upright on a flat, light-gray surface.

title: Married
alt_text: A lead and rusted steel sculpture shows a rectangular piece of smooth, gray metal attached to a thick, reddish-brown iron bar. Two large, silver-colored bolts hold the steel bar onto the edge of the lead sheet. The lead sheet has a slightly rippled, wavy texture. The word "MARRIED" is stamped into the center of the lead surface. The object is displayed against a solid, plain background.

title: Double Exposure
alt_text: A sculpture made of an altered book shows pages folded into a specific, symmetrical shape. The book is open at the spine and its covers extend outward to the left and right, appearing almost like wings. The pages are creased to create two distinct peaks at the top, forming an overall shape that resembles a heart or a chevron. The paper is light beige or cream in color, showing deep folds where the pages are bent. The dark, firm edges of the book's covers are visible on the sides, acting as a contrast to the lighter paper. The entire object rests against a smooth, solid grey background.

title: Art Through the Ages
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered book shows a bright red hardcover book lying open flat. Two identical white, bowl-shaped objects sit directly on top of the open pages. Each bowl is shaped like a half-sphere with a textured, circular surface that looks like the end of a tree log. The bowls are smooth and white, contrasting sharply with the bold red color of the book underneath. The entire object rests on a plain, light gray background.

title: Organic Book: Book of Hours
medium: Straw pulp, paper, alfalfa seeds, and twine
alt_text: A sculpture of compressed straw pulp and paper is roughly rectangular with uneven, ragged edges. The surface is textured and brown, appearing dense and fibrous throughout. Small, light-colored fragments of paper are embedded across the front, creating a speckled appearance. A few metallic-looking or reflective bits are also scattered within the pulp mixture. The overall shape suggests a thick, solid block resting against a plain grey background.

title: Books of Knowledge Standing Up Against the Elements
alt_text: A sculpture of burned encyclopedias shows a row of old, damaged books standing upright. The books are pushed together and lean against one another in a jagged, uneven line. They are all colored in shades of dark brown, tan, and black from fire damage. Their covers appear worn and scorched, with ragged, crumbling edges. The entire row sits on a plain, gray surface against a matching gray background.

title: Rembrandt: A Double Portrait
medium: Found book, mounted on velvet in wooden frame
alt_text: A sculpture of a book is mounted inside a decorative frame. The book is open and placed against a black velvet background. Its pages are folded vertically, giving the book a rounded, rippled appearance. The frame is thick, rectangular, and ornate with gold accents on its black edges. A small, rectangular brass-colored light fixture is attached to the top center of the frame.

title: Vein
medium: Found book in wooden frame with lamp
alt_text: A sculpture showing a book placed inside a wooden frame with a small lamp mounted on top. The frame is thick, rectangular, and painted with gold and dark brown details. Inside the frame, the pages of an open book are fanned out to form an S-shaped wave pattern. The text on the pages is dark and visible, following the curves of the rippling paper. A simple, cylindrical brass-colored lamp sits horizontally on the upper edge of the frame.

title: Electronic Voodoo
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture of an upright, rectangular book decorated with vibrant materials. The cover is textured in black with scattered gold-colored specks and a tiny, pale mask attached to the top left corner. A thick column of bright red feathers is attached to the right side of the book, spilling out onto the surface. Mixed into these feathers are small, round beads, string, and other trinkets. A cluster of loose feathers, including a distinct green one, sits at the bottom right.

title: Galileo: The Discovery of Two Great Worlds (razor blade book)
medium: Found book with razor blades, acrylic, and wax
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular book layered with numerous dark, metal razor blades. The blades are fixed vertically and at angles, creating a jagged, uneven surface that covers the top of the book. The book itself has thick, worn pages that show layers of brownish, yellowish, and blue material along the edges. The entire object sits against a plain, light grey background.

title: Book Artifact I, Book Artifact II
medium: Plaster casts with book impressions and remnants
alt_text: A sculpture of three separate plaster pieces rests on a plain gray surface. The first piece on the left is a rectangular, frame-like shape with a blue-painted border and a pale green interior containing faint printed text. The middle piece is a thin, upright vertical slab painted with a streak of blue on its front edge. To the right stands a jagged, cone-shaped white form with a vertical opening that reveals a red surface and strands of light brown, fibrous material sticking out. A tiny, broken fragment of white plaster lies on the surface near the bottom right.

title: Organic Book: Pin Migration Across a Japanese Stab Binding
medium: Artist's book made of book-straw, straw pulp, shredded paper, alfalfa seeds and pins
alt_text: A sculpture of a book is bound with thick, textured, straw-like pages that look rough and uneven. The cover of the book is made of many pale, tan-colored fibers that appear shredded and fibrous. On the left side, a thin, smooth spine in a reddish-brown color connects the pages. Bright red thread is stitched in a series of loops along this spine to hold the layers together. The overall shape is rectangular and appears bulky and handmade.

title: Deconstructing Picasso
alt_text: A sculpture made from a found and cut book shows an abstract, oval-shaped carving at its center. The cover of the book has a textured, worn appearance with patches of dark blue, brown, and ochre colors over an off-white background. The oval in the middle is deeply recessed and contains layered, paper-like edges in grey and white tones that create a swirling pattern. Near the bottom right corner of the cover, the word "picasso" is printed in simple, lowercase black letters. The overall shape is a square with worn edges and a dark spine visible on the left side.

title: New French Dictionary
alt_text: A sculpture of a cut red dictionary stands slightly open against a plain gray background. The front cover features a large, hollowed-out oval shape in the center. Through this opening, several layers of the book's pages are visible, appearing as a shallow, scooped-out interior. The right side of the book shows the jagged, cut edges of the pages stacked vertically. The overall object appears to be a hardcover book modified to look like a small container or bowl.

title: Spirit of Rome
alt_text: A sculpture made from a found and cut book shows a printed landscape scene on its front cover. A stone bridge with several arches crosses over a river in the middle of the image. A large domed building stands in the distance under a pale yellow sky. Small boats carrying figures float on the water in the foreground. A black rectangular label at the top displays the white text "SPIRIT OF PLACE" above the word "ROME." A wide, textured red strip runs along the spine on the left side of the cover.

title: Cataracts (aka Models)
alt_text: A sculpture made from a found and cut book displays two open pages. Thick, black, stencil-style letters cut out of the pages spell the word "CATARACTS" across the center of both pages. Behind the cutouts, black-and-white photographs of people in various poses appear. The book is spiral-bound in the middle and rests on a dark, rectangular background. Below the images on the right page, smaller text reads "DEBORAH LOVEN."

title: Short Hand
alt_text: A sculpture made of a found book and a finial stands upright against a plain background. The book is open, with its pages folded back to form a rounded, fan-like shape in the center. The front and back covers of the book are extended flat on either side of the curved pages. A small, round, decorative finial sits on top of the spine where the pages meet. The pages of the book are filled with small, dark text.

title: Nudes Through the Ages
alt_text: A sculpture made from a found and cut book shows the front cover of a publication. The cover is a light tan color and features a rectangular black-and-white photograph of a woman’s upper body. Below the image, large white text reads "LA FEMME NUE" over smaller italicized black text that says "DANS LA SCULPTURE." The book appears to be slightly worn at the edges and spine. At the very bottom, small curved text reads "EDITIONS DE VARENNE."

title: Myth and Guilt
alt_text: A sculpture made of a found and cut book displays an open spread of text. The book is centered against a dark, rectangular background. A dark, organic, leaf-like shape is carved out from the left page. The right page shows a delicate, layered cut-out design that rises from the center. Light gray space surrounds the entire object.

title: Steven Pors at the Bedside
alt_text: A sculpture made of altered books shows a large, circular opening cut through the center of two joined volumes. The outer structure consists of tan-colored book covers that are hinged at the spine, forming a V-shape. A thick, dark spine connects the two tan panels vertically down the center. In the middle of the circular cutout, a smaller, upright, plum-colored book spine sits suspended by itself. Gold text is printed on the dark spine and the plum spine in the center. The background is a solid, neutral gray.

title: Veiled Acts: A Play on Words
alt_text: A sculpture of a found and cut book shows a dark blue, hardcover volume standing upright. The center of the front cover has a rectangular hole cut out of the fabric material. Inside this rectangular opening, you can see a block of pages with wavy, uneven lines. The lines are dark and appear to be made of stacked, textured paper edges rather than printed text. The rest of the cover remains smooth and dark blue.

title: Interfaith
alt_text: A sculpture of a found and altered bible shows the interior pages of an open book shaped into a wave-like pattern. The pages are folded back and forth to create distinct, layered ridges that jut out from the center. These page edges are stained with a reddish-orange color, contrasting with the creamy white of the paper. Dark text is visible on the inner faces of many of the folded pages. The dark green cover of the book frames the left and right sides of the sculpture against a light grey background.

title: The Portable Knowledge of Obsolescence
medium: Found encoclypedias, table leg and pipe
alt_text: A sculpture of stacked books forms a tall, spiraling pillar that stands against a plain grey background. The column of books twists gently as it rises, with the spines of the red-covered volumes creating a textured pattern along one side. On top of the stack sits a small, metallic pipe fitting that looks like a knob or handle. The entire structure rests on three thin, dark metal legs that meet in a point at the bottom, resembling a tall, slender tripod. The sculpture appears to be balanced carefully on these narrow legs.

title: Twister
alt_text: A sculpture made from a cut phone book shows a twisted, fan-like shape suspended against a plain gray background. The object is composed of many stacked pages that have been folded and fanned out in different directions. Some of the pages are crisp white, while others have yellowed edges that create distinct colored bands throughout the structure. The overall form is irregular, with sharp, pointed sections rising toward the top and loose, drooping layers near the bottom. A soft shadow appears directly beneath the object, suggesting it is floating in space.

title: Border Crossing II
medium: Cut and altered Atlas and zippers
alt_text: A sculpture of an open atlas with its pages cut and altered by zippers. Several individual pages or sections of pages rise upward from the open book, creating a tent-like or accordion structure. Each raised section is joined or bordered by a silver-colored metal zipper. The book lies open flat on a plain, light-colored surface. The inside of the book displays detailed printed maps with light blue and gray tones.

title: Red Book
medium: Cigarettes with ink in two metal cases
alt_text: A sculpture of cigarettes with ink in two red metal cases shows two open containers resting on a light gray surface. Each case has a cream-colored paper flap on the left side, which features handwritten black text including numbers and dates. The right side of each case is filled with a neat row of cigarettes placed side-by-side. Text is printed clearly across the sides of these cigarettes, making them look like lines of a book. The metal cases are open wide, displaying both the paper flaps and the rows of cigarettes inside.

title: Altered Almanac
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered almanac and wood shows folded pages arranged on two vertical poles. A flat, rectangular base covered in printed text supports the two wooden sticks. Three distinct stacks of accordion-folded paper circles are threaded onto the poles. The top stack is round and tiered, while the middle stack is fan-like. The bottom stack has an hourglass shape with rounded, serrated edges.

title: Do We Really Know Why We Laugh?
medium: Book with paint, wood, and wire
alt_text: A sculpture of a book hangs vertically against a plain white wall. The object is completely black and appears to be an open book with thick, dark pages. A thin wire attaches to the top of the book, holding it up in the air. To the right of the object, a dark shadow is cast onto the wall. This shadow mimics the rectangular shape of the book but is slightly wider and more solid.

title: La Maison manquante [The Missing House]
alt_text: A sculpture of a folio with folders, showing a collection of scattered papers, photographs, and documents laid out on a gray background. An open book with dense, printed text on both pages sits on the left side of the display. Next to it, a colorful map covers a large area in the upper center, partially covered by smaller black-and-white photos and notes. Towards the bottom, several smaller portraits and personal documents are fanned out in a pile. On the far right, a rectangular photograph shows a tall building next to a park-like space.

title: Atlas Serie II
alt_text: A sculpture of a found book shows an open page covered by an irregular, swirling design. The left side of the book features a tan cover with visible text that reads "Atlas de Géographie." A thick, textured layer of bright blue, green, and white paint flows across the left page in a marbled pattern. To the right, a large, jagged piece of tan, wood-like material extends outward from the spine. Four thin, metallic arms attach the edges of the book and the right-side piece to the spine, holding everything together.

title: Pope Interdiction (Piece Unique) [Pope Prohibition ( Single Piece )]
alt_text: A sculpture of a found book and mixed media shows an old, tattered book partially opened with its pages fanned out. The cover is made of dark, rough material with frayed strings hanging off the edges. A rolled-up cylinder, also covered in old paper, protrudes from the book and extends outward to the right. Attached to this rolled section is a hinged metal clamp-like tool with shiny silver bars and brass screws. A small, blue and white rectangular piece is tucked between the book pages near the base of the cylinder.

title: The Volume Library
medium: Found and cut illustrated encyclopedia with glue
alt_text: A sculpture of a cut book shows a carved interior filled with layered images. The pages of the book form the outer structure, with a flat, plain yellow spine standing on the right. Deep within the center, multiple cut-out sections create a complex scene with stairs and various printed pictures. A small figure of a person standing and holding a paper is visible near the center of the carved area. The overall effect is like a multi-level structure or a tiny room built into the pages.

title: Sew What
medium: Paper, paint, fabric, thread, needles, and collage in two hinged boxes
alt_text: A sculpture made of paper, paint, fabric, thread, needles, and collage shows two hinged boxes opened up to display miniature rooms. The left box is darker, featuring black walls with a white-and-black photo collage and a small, puffy white dress hanging from a thread. The right box is lighter and has shelves that hold several tiny white dresses made of sheer fabric. Thin, white threads run through both boxes like cobwebs, attaching to some of the dresses and walls. Small, thin needles stick up like antennas from the top corners of both boxes.

title: New World Suite Number Three
alt_text: A sculpture of artist's books and cardboard shows an arrangement of three open books surrounding a central, closed black box. The book on the top right rests on a bright blue cover and displays two open pages of text. To the left, another book with an orange cover lies open, featuring printed lines of text on its creamy pages. Below the center, a third book with a dark cover lies open to show two pages of dense paragraphs. The central black box is wrapped in a light blue paper folder and features a white rectangular label with black text on its front cover.

title: Book of Zodiac Constellations
medium: Bound swatches of men's clothing fabrics, buttons, zippers, and pockets
alt_text: A sculpture of bound fabric swatches showing a series of overlapping textile pages. A thick, black binding strip runs down the left edge, secured with two silver rivets and attached to a long, looping black cord. Several layers of fabric extend to the right, showing different colors like brown and dark blue. A brown fabric panel sits on top and features a horizontal metal zipper embedded in the center. Small, white circular patches are scattered across the surface of the top brown fabric and the blue fabric underneath.

title: Untitled
medium: Foundand altered book, metallic paint and glass
alt_text: A sculpture of a book with a glass cone attached to its cover. The book is rectangular, thick, and coated in a dark, textured metallic finish. A smooth, clear glass cone sits in the center of the book's front cover. Inside the glass cone, visible printed text from the book's pages spirals upward toward the point. The object rests on a plain, light gray surface.

title: Big Stick (21st Century edition)
medium: Found pages from the complete writings of Sigmund Freud with glue and resin, set in custom leather case
alt_text: A sculpture of a baseball bat lies resting inside a long, black rectangular case. The bat is made of a textured, light beige material and stretches horizontally across the center of the case. Its surface has a grainy look, similar to compressed paper. The inside of the open case is lined with bright, smooth red fabric. The exterior of the case is dark, sturdy, and features a small carrying handle on the front edge.

title: Rondo
alt_text: A sculpture of an open, altered book sits against a plain gray background. The pages are folded and cut to create an uneven, accordion-like texture across the surface. While the left side of the book is fan-folded into many narrow, vertical ridges, the right side remains flat and displays printed text. The dark, solid binding of the book is visible along the bottom edge. Overall, the piece appears to be a repurposed book manipulated into an abstract sculptural form.

title: Expanded Communism
medium: Cut and reassembled copy of "THe 24th Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union"
alt_text: A sculpture made from a cut and reassembled book shows two rectangular sections stacked vertically against a plain gray background. The top section is a red rectangle with the words "FRIENDS SPEAK" printed in white capital letters. The bottom section is a blue rectangle turned upside down, displaying the word "OUR" and a square logo that reads "24th congress of the CPSU." The left edge of the blue cover is torn and peeling. The edges of the book's pages are visible at the very bottom and right side of the sculpture.

title: Joss Joists
medium: Joss paper with glue in a wooden case with glass cover
alt_text: A ritual object consisting of a rectangular wooden box filled with curved, light-brown paper strips. The paper appears to be thin and layered, shaped into various abstract, wavy, and folded forms. These paper shapes are packed tightly together and fill the entire space of the box. A clear glass cover sits over the top of the case, protecting the paper inside. The entire arrangement is framed by a simple, light-colored wooden border.

title: Poem
alt_text: A sculpture of an open artist's book shows a layer of delicate, lace-like silicone attached to one page. The book lies flat against a plain, light grey background. Its cover is a muted red color, and the inner pages are a crisp, clean white. On the right-hand page, the intricate, laser-cut silicone forms a rectangular shape with uneven, tattered edges. This piece appears translucent and light, resting gently on the smooth paper surface.

title: Double Africa (Yellow and Blue)
medium: Two found altered books, mounted in frame
alt_text: A sculpture of two altered books mounted inside a white frame. One book on the left has a solid, mustard-yellow cover. A second book on the right has a black cover, which is partially covered by a jagged, textured substance that looks like dark, crushed mineral or metal. This rough, grayish-brown material spills from the black book onto the yellow one, bridging the gap between them. The entire piece sits centered against a plain white background.

title: Rational Snow
alt_text: A sculpture of aerated concrete and a found book shows a large, gray rectangular block resting on an open book. The concrete block is speckled with small dark holes and fills the space above the open pages. The book itself has light brown paper pages that curve upward to meet the concrete weight. The dark green cover of the book is visible underneath the base. The background is a plain, neutral gradient of light gray.

title: Conserving Life on Earth
medium: Found paperback books with drywall screws
alt_text: A sculpture of layered paperbacks shows many books twisted into a tight, spiral shape. The pages and covers are curled inward, creating concentric rings that look like a blooming flower or a seashell. The outer surfaces show the spines and covers of multiple books in various colors like red, white, yellow, and orange. Several pages are visible as tan and cream-colored curves throughout the spiral. Tiny screws hold the dense layers of paper together in several places.

title: Au dela du bien et du mal [Beyond Good and Evil]
medium: Altered found book on painted pedestal
alt_text: A sculpture showing a tall, rectangular pedestal with a small, flat book resting on its top. The pedestal is painted with many thick, overlapping strokes of vibrant colors, including blues, reds, whites, and browns. These colorful marks create a rough, textured appearance on all visible sides of the pedestal. The book sits flat on the top surface and is a solid, medium blue color with a darker rectangular shape on its cover. The entire object stands centered against a plain, neutral gray background.

title: The future of reading Melville --> Metcalf
alt_text: A sculpture of a found book with mixed media showing a layered arrangement of objects. At the base rests a long, irregular, white shape that looks like organic matter or stone. Sitting on top of this is a pale, rectangular box covered by a draped, white, fabric-like material. Resting on the fabric are several pages of a book, some open and upright, others flat and stacked. The pages appear aged and yellowed, with visible text printed on their surfaces. The entire arrangement stands against a simple, solid grey background.

title: Lapenti Sorcier [The Sorcerer's Apprentice]
medium: Found and altered book with shells, images, stones, mirrors, keys, chains, toy pieces, and animal relics
alt_text: A sculpture of an open, altered book covered in a dense collection of mixed materials. The pages are heavily layered with cut-out images, shells, mirrors, and various found objects that create a rough, textured surface. A tall, curved piece that resembles an animal horn or antler rises from the top of the book. Toward the center, a small blue figure stands near the base, framed by brown fabric and other scraps. The entire object has a cluttered, layered look with many small details packed closely together.

title: The Office Orchestra
medium: Cardboard tube, with found office supplies
alt_text: A sculpture made of a cardboard tube with attached found office supplies stands upright. The central tube acts as a spine, holding several tall, brown cardboard pages that fan out in all directions. Each page has small text, printed diagrams, and red tab labels sticking out from the top. Some pages feature attached objects, including small metal fasteners, folded lined paper, and a miniature black box held by a green rubber band. The entire structure is set against a plain gray background.

title: A Self-conscious Effort, Continuously Progressing, on and about the Release and Reintegration of Content through Formal Means thus Altering the Discreteness of and Permitting the Relating of Information: A Proposal, a Prototype, a Policy
medium: Paper, found printed material, newspaper clippings, books, ring binders, power cord, ties, and chipboard
alt_text: A sculpture shows an arrangement of open ring binders and loose papers spread out on a flat, light-brown backing board. In the upper left section, an open binder lies flat, revealing a chart with colorful index tabs at the bottom. To the right, a clipboard holds a small sketch of a face above a thick stack of yellowed, torn papers. The bottom left section features another open binder displaying old black-and-white photographs and line drawings. Next to it, a large, messy pile of newspaper clippings and documents spills across the surface. Thin black ties dangle from the sides of the binders, and a small, tangled piece of power cord lies near the center.

title: Interleaf Book
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered found book shows pages bound together with metal rings. The book appears distressed and worn, with jagged, uneven edges where the paper is torn. Two large, silver-colored metal hoops extend from the left side of the stack of pages, holding them together loosely. The top page is plain and off-white with the black text "THE DENIAL OF DEATH" printed in the center. The background is a solid, neutral gray color.

title: Maltese Falcon, Book Itself
alt_text: A sculpture made from an altered found book shows the cover of a paperback novel. A thick, black metal spiral binding runs down the entire left side of the book. The book cover features a painting of a man’s face at the top and a woman’s face at the bottom, separated by a red band with text. The man has a serious expression and looks down toward the right, while the woman below has red lipstick and looks up toward the left. The book is open and held together by the spiral coil, creating a unique display of the original cover art.

title: Chinese Scroll
medium: Artsit's book with screenprinted textile and paper scrolls in wooden case
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist’s book sits inside a rectangular wooden case with an open front. A paper scroll with screenprinted, abstract gray shapes covers the opening of the case. On top of the black wooden frame, there is a gold-colored metal handle. To the left of the handle is a small, round red knob, and to the right is a tan wooden knob. The entire object rests against a plain, light gray background.

title: The Reading Room
medium: Found carved books and magazines, stacked with wood
alt_text: A sculpture showing a human head carved from stacked books and magazines. The sculpture is shaped like a cylindrical head and sits on a circular wooden base. The surface of the head is constructed from the visible edges of many layered pages, giving it a light, textured, and striped appearance. A deep, hollow opening runs through the center of the head from the top. Dark brown wood panels frame the edges of the structure at the top and bottom.

title: China Can Say No (Queen)
medium: Found, altered books and mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture made of found books and mixed media shows a human face that appears to be resting inside an open structure. The face is peach-toned with closed eyes and sits directly on a dark, circular base. Surrounding the face are curved, vertical walls of light blue and grey paper that frame it like wings. Above this head structure sits a thick, wavy-topped crown made of layered, multicolored paper sheets in shades of yellow, purple, and green. The entire piece has a textured appearance created by the stacked edges of many individual pages.

title: Petite stratégie de la patience [Little Patience Strategy]
alt_text: A sculpture of a long, rounded form sits on a rectangular metal base. The object is constructed from thousands of stacked layers of light-brown newspaper pages. These paper sheets are densely packed together, creating a textured, fringed appearance across the entire surface. The sculpture rests on a flat, dark-brown metal block that appears slightly weathered. The background is a plain, neutral gray color.

title: 72 Ripples
alt_text: A sculpture in the form of a hand-bound artist's book sits upright on a flat surface. The main body of the book has a dark blue cover with white speckles and a thin red spine. From the top right side of the book, a rectangular section of pages fans out into the air. This section of pages is bright white and appears to be folded or shaped to form a right angle. The overall composition creates a sharp, geometric contrast between the solid closed book and the open, airy pages.

title: 85 Ripples: 3 Skipping Stones
medium: Artist's book with fabric, gel acetate and wood
alt_text: A sculpture, designed as an artist's book, shows three book covers connected to a central wooden frame. The dark blue book covers have a pattern of thin, light circles printed on them. Inside each book section, a bright blue panel is visible. The three sections are joined at the center by white wooden beams that curve outward. The entire object sits on a plain, light grey surface.

title: 86 Ripples: Droplet
medium: Artist's book with gel acetate and wood
alt_text: An artist’s book showing a sculpture created from the pages and cover of a book. The white pages are curved upward to form a high arch over the base of the book. One end of this paper structure opens out to reveal bright orange, translucent panels. A small, dark, drop-shaped cutout is visible in the center of the red panel on the right. The entire object sits against a plain, neutral gray background.
