title: Aggregation 06-AU047
alt_text: A sculpture of Korean mulberry paper and graphite shows a dense, textured surface made of thousands of small, jagged pieces. These small fragments are layered and fitted together like a complex puzzle or cracked earth. The entire surface has a monochromatic, stony appearance with varied shades of gray, white, and brownish-black. Two deep, oval-shaped hollows are carved into the surface, one on the left and a larger one on the right. These smooth indentations contrast sharply with the rough, chaotic texture of the paper fragments surrounding them.

title: Piety
medium: Found altered & painted books on wood.
alt_text: A sculpture of many books is arranged inside a simple black frame. Most of the books are stacked vertically with their pages facing forward, displaying a muted, light-brown color. A single, large, flat, mustard-yellow book cover is placed upright on the top right side. To the left of the center, one book is painted a solid, bright blue. Another large, flat, bright-red book cover stands vertically in the bottom middle. Beneath these flat books, other books are stacked horizontally, showing their pages.

title: Book Grid #4 (Red)
medium: Found altered & painted books on wood.
alt_text: A sculpture of books arranged in a grid-like pattern on a flat surface. Large, bright red blocks of color occupy the top left, top right, and middle left areas. In the center and lower center, a collection of thin books is arranged vertically to show their spines and pages. These books have muted, yellowish-tan edges, though a few spines are colored in blue, black, and teal. To the right of these books are two rectangular blocks in shades of orange and pink. The entire assembly forms a square shape against a neutral background.

title: Axiom
medium: Found pages from newspapers and postmodern art criticism and theory books with glue, resin, and metal
alt_text: A sculpture of an axe made with metal and collage materials. The axe head is dark gray metal and is double-bladed, with sharp curved edges on both sides. Attached to the center of the head is a handle that widens toward the bottom. The handle is covered in a dense pattern of small, glued-on paper text and dark ink markings that appear to be from newspapers or books. The entire object is presented against a plain, light gray background.

title: Aspirin Mask Series
medium: Found, altered books, aspirin, and surgical masks
alt_text: A sculpture of two open, altered books displayed against a plain background. Each book lies flat and is covered with a thick, brownish, glossy coating. A round, fleshy-colored surgical mask sits in the center of the open pages on both books. The surfaces of the pages look dark and stained underneath the shiny layer. These two similar book sculptures hang side-by-side.

title: Purification (21st Century Edition)
medium: Cast soap in the shape of a book on lectern with /text from "Soap" by Francis Ponge on towel
alt_text: A sculpture of an open book resting on a small wooden lectern hangs at the top of the image. The book appears old and worn, with yellowish-brown pages. Below the lectern, a piece of fabric hangs over a wooden towel rack attached to the wall. The light-colored fabric is printed with rows of small, dark text. The entire arrangement is displayed against a plain, light-gray wall.

title: Once Here
medium: Book, tar, beeswax, oil paint, vinyl letters, and damar varnish
alt_text: A sculpture of a cylindrical object resembles a thick roll of meat. The exterior surface is a smooth, off-white material that wraps around the center. Tiny, dark letters are pressed onto this light-colored surface in vertical lines. One end of the cylinder is open, revealing a deep red interior with swirling white patterns. The entire object sits against a plain, light gray background.

title: Golden Pheasant Book
medium: Kozo paper with pheasant feathers, rabbit-skin glue, and gold leaf
alt_text: A sculpture of kozo paper, feathers, and gold leaf shows a rectangular, parchment-like sheet. The object has a straight, smooth left edge, while the other three edges are ragged and uneven. A large, irregular patch of light-colored gold leaf covers much of the center and lower portion of the surface. A delicate, brown-and-white patterned feather is attached to the top right section. The entire piece has a slightly translucent, organic quality, with soft yellow and cream tones.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of a stepladder constructed from a book. The ladder stands upright with two slanted sides that meet at a small flat top. Four horizontal rungs are spaced evenly between the two main side pieces. Dark, solid covers form the main frame of the ladder. The light-colored edges of the pages are visible along the sides and rungs of the structure.

title: Portable Travelling Library
medium: Leather case, silk-bound books, and glass
alt_text: A sculpture of a leather case shows two rectangular, dark red leather containers joined together. The case appears to be a thick, hollowed-out block with a hinged top lid. A faint, decorative border with small leaf or shell-like designs is pressed into the front and top covers. The material looks like aged, worn leather, with lighter brown edges where the color has rubbed away. The object stands upright against a plain, light grey background.

title: BLABLABLA
medium: Found and altered books and magazines, and mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture shows a cardboard box sitting on top of a tall, white, rectangular pedestal. Long, jagged strips of paper spill out from the open side of the box and drape all the way down to the floor. These strips appear to be cut from pages of books and magazines, featuring bits of colorful text and images throughout. The tangle of paper creates a heavy, textured curtain that partially covers the front of the pedestal. The background is a plain, dark gray surface.

title: That C word
medium: Polymer ceramic, coffee filters, and paper
alt_text: A sculpture made of ceramic and paper shows several fan-shaped, layered pieces stacked on top of each other. The top layer is a textured, tan-colored ceramic piece decorated with green shapes, a small hat, a pink ribbon, and embossed patterns. Underneath the ceramic piece are several light-tan coffee filters stacked together like a fan. The visible coffee filters are printed with blocks of dark text and small geometric designs along the edges. The entire object rests against a plain, light-gray background.

title: zzzbook
alt_text: A sculpture resembling a textile artist's book shows a folded fabric object on a plain grey background. The top layer is a smooth, solid black piece of fabric. Beneath the black layer, several thick, white, folded sections of fabric are visible, resembling the stacked pages of a book. The entire object has a soft, rectangular shape with rounded corners. It rests flat, appearing thick and plush like a heavy quilt or a layered piece of textile art.

title: Sponge Book
medium: Found and altered copy of "The Book of Natural History"
alt_text: A sculpture made from an altered book shows a rough, stony surface. The object is oval-shaped with a heavy, eroded texture that looks like worn rock. On its top surface, a smooth, green-colored section is inlaid like a pool or a flat landscape feature. A shallow, crater-like depression sits in the center of this green area. Faint, light-colored letters visible at the top edge spell out "BOOK" and "NATURAL". The entire piece rests on a plain gray background.

title: Decameron Lace Book
medium: Found hand-cut copy of Boccaccio’s Decameron
alt_text: A sculpture made from a book shows the pages intricately carved into a lace-like pattern. The left side of the open book features a dense, cutout design that resembles decorative paper doilies. On the right side, the title page of the book is visible, revealing printed text and a small illustration in the center. The surrounding pages are also unevenly cut, adding to the delicate appearance of the work. The entire book rests flat against a simple, solid gray background.

title: An Offering of Peace
alt_text: A glass sculpture shows two rectangular panes joined at a slight angle to stand upright. Each clear pane features rows of small, dark, horizontal, and diagonal marks that look like lines of writing. The left pane is connected to the right pane along a vertical edge. A thin, gold-colored line runs vertically along the leftmost edge of the first pane. The entire piece sits on a plain, light-colored background.

title: Fragmented (slade in pages)
alt_text: A sculpture of bound slate pages forms a rectangular, book-like object shown from a front-facing perspective. The cover is made of dark, textured grey stone that looks rough and uneven. A vertical, dark blue spine runs along the left edge of the sculpture to hold the pages together. Near the top center, a rectangular piece of white paper is attached to the slate. Written on the paper in black ink is the word "KICK" above the name "DE JONG," with a small horizontal line separating them.

title: Vessel #19
medium: Found laminated newspaper pages on wooden stand
alt_text: A sculpture of stacked, laminated newspaper pages sits on a wooden base. The main part of the object is a tall, vertical cylinder made of brown, layered paper that tapers slightly toward the bottom. At the top, the layers fan out into a wide, flat, cross-shaped ledge. This top section has a circular depression in its center. The entire sculpture rests on a rectangular, polished dark wood stand. The background is a plain, neutral gray color.

title: Vessel #31
medium: Found laminated book pages on wooden stand
alt_text: A sculpture of laminated book pages shows a circular, wheel-like shape constructed from folded paper. This paper structure sits on a light-colored, square piece of wood which is mounted to a larger, dark-brown wooden base. The pages are folded tightly around a central, circular hole that goes through the middle of the object. Three distinct, rectangular blocks of pages project outward from this central ring. The overall effect is like a swirling fan or a mechanical gear made entirely of printed text.

title: Web
medium: Found and altered Bible with knotted human hair
alt_text: A sculpture of a found and altered Bible shows the book lying open with strands of dark hair woven through the pages. The pages are folded inwards from each corner to meet in the center of the book. A dense, knotted cluster of dark, brown hair sits right in this central meeting point. Long, straight strands of hair extend from the center out toward the corners of the open book like a spiderweb. The dark, textured cover of the book frames the white pages, which are filled with small printed text.

title: Book Gear
medium: Found and altered books, with copper pipe
alt_text: A sculpture of found and altered books with a copper pipe features two wheel-shaped objects connected by a straight rod. The wheel on the left is composed of layered paper, creating a textured surface with grey and cream tones. The wheel on the right is also made of stacked, colorful paper pages in shades of orange and brown. Both wheels are connected to a central, horizontal copper pipe that runs through their centers. The pipe has dark rubber-like washers securing the wheels in place. The entire object sits against a plain, light grey background.

title: Sophia/Logos
alt_text: A sculpture made from an altered Bible showing a thick, shaggy mass of shredded paper. The object rests on a flat, dark rectangular base, which appears to be the book's original cover. The shredded strips of paper are white and cream-colored, creating a messy, fan-like texture that spills over the edges of the base. These strips are densely packed together and rise up in the center to form a rounded hump. The entire object sits against a solid, light gray background.

title: Work of the Bees
medium: Found Bible with honey and dead bee
alt_text: A sculpture made of a found Bible with honey and dead bees shows an open book covered in honeycomb structures. The pages are yellowed and filled with columns of printed black text, which is partially obscured by the honeycomb growth. The honeycomb is tan and brown, with a dense, web-like pattern of small hexagonal holes covering large sections of the paper. On the left side of the book, a large chunk of this honeycomb hangs over the edge of the cover. Small, dark specks, which appear to be the remnants of dead bees, are scattered throughout the sticky honeycomb material. The entire object lies flat against a plain, light grey background.

title: Blossoming
medium: Found and altered Bible with wire
alt_text: A sculpture made from a book showing many white paper strips that look like grass or fringes. Several small, rolled paper flowers are scattered across the top surface of the shredded pages. The paper strips are cut from pages with printed text on them. The base of the book has a dark maroon cover that is partially visible underneath the dense, shredded layers. This entire object sits centered against a plain, light grey background.

title: Labyrinth
alt_text: A sculpture of a found and altered Bible sits against a plain, light gray background. On the left side stands a thick, hardcover book with a black cover and white pages visible at its top edge. Emerging from the book is a large, messy pile of white, shredded paper strips. These strips are thin and curled, spilling out in a heap that covers most of the right side of the frame. The shredded paper has a rough, tangled texture that contrasts with the smooth, solid book cover.

title: Survival Technique (bean book)
alt_text: A sculpture of an old, open book covered in plant growth rests on a plain gray background. The pages of the book appear worn, stained, and weathered with dark patches. Several long, pale, root-like sprouts wind across the surface of both the left and right pages. The edges of the book are ragged and torn, showing significant damage to the paper. The overall appearance is earthy and textured, highlighting the contrast between the paper and the organic material.

title: Untitled (Worm hole Book)
alt_text: A sculpture of a found, worm-eaten Hebrew book sits centered on a solid gray background. The cover of the book is covered in a beige pattern that looks like small, dark, repeating shapes. A dark, thick strip runs vertically down the left side where the binding is located. Much of the book's front cover appears damaged, worn, or possibly eaten away, revealing lighter, rougher layers underneath. The edges of the book are frayed and uneven, showing signs of significant age and decay.

title: Apartment in Athens
medium: Found copy of Glenway Wescott’s Apartment in Athens with pressed dead mice
alt_text: A sculpture consisting of a worn book cover shows extensive damage and remnants of paper scraps. The rectangular book is brownish-tan with a heavily weathered surface. Patches of white and blue paper are stuck to the cover, appearing torn and peeling away. A section of black and yellow caution tape is partially visible underneath the white paper near the bottom center. The left side of the book’s spine shows signs of fraying and wear.

title: Triumph of Venice (Book with Bird)
medium: Found copy of The Doges Palace with pressed dead bird
alt_text: A sculpture of an open book shows a pressed dead bird attached to the right page. The left page is a plain, off-white surface with some light stains. On the right page, a dark-feathered bird with outstretched wings appears to be flying against a background image of a painting. Below the bird, a small dark animal head rests near a series of curved, ribbed, green lines. The scene on the right page is brightly colored with blues and greens.

title: Turtle Book
medium: Found book with pressed dead turtle
alt_text: A sculpture made of a found book shows an open volume with an illustration on the left page and a pressed, dried turtle on the right page. The book's pages are discolored, stained a brownish yellow, and appear brittle around the edges. On the left, a small black-and-white print depicting a scene with several figures is centered on the page. On the right, the preserved, dark brown remains of a turtle are flattened directly onto the paper. The turtle's shell is cracked and its head and limbs are dried, lying against the textured, crumpled surface of the page.

title: The Haarlem Museum Book
medium: Found book, dried beans in plexi box
alt_text: A sculpture of a found book is displayed flat inside a clear plastic box. The book is open to the center, showing two pages that appear weathered and stained. Dark, organic-looking debris, which resembles dried beans and plant matter, covers large sections of the book's surface. This debris also scatters across the light brown surface underneath the book. The entire arrangement is encased within a rectangular, transparent container.

title: Water Book
medium: Artist's book with plastic bags, plexi and water
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist’s book sits on a gray surface with its hard, white cover partially open. The book features several clear, thin plastic bags attached to a metal spine, and these bags appear to hold a small amount of liquid. Printed in white lettering on the frontmost bag are the words "EPERJESI AGNES" at the top and "WATER BOOK" near the bottom. A clear plastic sheet rests on the very front, protecting the first bag. The interior bags are slightly wrinkled and stacked together like pages in a book.

title: I Will Follow Him
medium: Computer hard drive, paint, paper collage, velvet, and gold leaf
alt_text: A sculpture made from a computer hard drive shows a bird of prey painted on its front. The hard drive is encased in a metal frame with gold-colored edges and a hinge on the left side. The word "Maxtor" is embossed in capital letters along the bottom gold edge. The bird, which appears to be a hawk or eagle, faces right with bright orange eyes and brown, white, and black feathers. The rest of the surface around the bird is painted black, creating a sharp contrast against the light gray background.

title: Brothers Ramaz
medium: Found and altered books, photo reproductions, and copper
alt_text: A sculpture showing a miniature house constructed from various found materials. The structure features a roof covered in a pattern of small green and red diamonds. Its front wall displays a large black-and-white photograph of six men wearing suits and ties. A small, dark green book rests in front of the house, titled "THE BROTHERS RAMAZ." The side of the building appears to be wrapped in textured, metallic copper panels.

title: Hardcover (Haiku series)
alt_text: A steel sculpture of an open book shows rough, dark lines cut into its surface. The object is composed of two rectangular metal plates connected by a central hinge that runs vertically down the middle. On the left page, a single jagged line extends horizontally from the left edge toward the hinge. On the right page, a connected pattern of jagged lines branches off and extends downward, resembling a lightning bolt or a crack. The entire surface has a mottled, grey appearance typical of polished or brushed metal.

title: Falling Leaves
alt_text: A sculpture made of driftwood, paper, and string shows a collection of blank white paper pages resting on a piece of light brown wood. The wood has a rough texture and curves upward to form a natural, organic shape. Several stacks of thin, white rectangular papers are fanned out and perched on the lower, wider part of the driftwood. The papers appear crisp and clean against the weathered, textured surface of the wood. This whole arrangement sits balanced on top of a plain, light grey rectangular pedestal against a solid grey background.

title: No 2 of Readers Digest Series
medium: Found ad altered book with mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture of a found and altered book stands upright against a plain gray background. The book's front cover is a pale yellow-green color and features a repeating pattern of dark green fern-like leaves. A thick, solid mint-green spine connects to the front cover, and this spine contains several stacked rectangular panels with printed text in white. The spine's surface looks worn and has a slight texture. The top edge of the book appears uneven and shows signs of age or wear.

title: Artificial Intelligence
alt_text: A sculpture of found books and mixed media shows a row of six upright books on a simple, black shelf. An arrow with a red tip and white feathered tail runs horizontally through the center of the books, piercing each one. From left to right, the books are varying shades of brown, green, cream, and two bright red volumes. The black shelf is U-shaped and holds the books firmly in place. The entire arrangement sits against a neutral gray background.

title: Nicholas Frank Biography pages 201-202
alt_text: An artist's book sculpture shows an open book resting on a flat surface. The book is open to a page with visible black text printed on it. Inside the cover, decorative endpapers feature a repeating pattern of blue and teal floral designs against a beige background. The book's outer covers are a solid, muted olive green color. The plain, light-colored paper pages create a bright contrast against the detailed patterned lining.

title: Iron Book
alt_text: A sculpture made of iron is shaped like a vertical rectangle with rounded corners. The left side of the object is dark, textured, and reddish-brown, while the right side is a smooth, shiny, and metallic silver color. A rough, jagged, and bumpy line of metal runs vertically down the center where the two different surfaces meet. On the far left edge, a row of four small, round metal rivets secures the dark panel to the structure. The overall object looks like a heavy, industrial door or a metal cover.

title: Visionaire 39 Play
medium: 16 flip books by Darren Aronofsky, Nick Knight, Karl Lagerfeld, Baz Luhrmann, Craig McDean, and Steven Meisel, in a wooden box
alt_text: A sculpture of a black wooden box is shown from an angle, standing upright against a gray background. The box is tall and rectangular, with a small diagonal cut at the bottom left corner. On its front edge, white text is printed vertically, reading "VISIONAIRE 39 PLAY" followed by four small geometric symbols. The surface of the box appears smooth and dark. Soft light casts a gentle shadow beneath the object.

title: Visionaire 38 Love
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular, book-shaped box stands upright on a flat surface. The box is a bright, solid light blue color. On its front face, the words "VISIONAIRE 38 LOVE" are printed in white, with the brand name "TIFFANY & CO." written below in smaller letters. A silky white ribbon is tied around the right side of the box, with its loose ends hanging down. The object casts a soft shadow on the neutral gray background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of paper and textile shows a small, rectangular object standing upright. The outer surface is made of a bright blue fabric with a visible, rough texture. A faint, circular pattern is printed in a light gold color on the front face of the blue fabric. At the top of the upright object, a stack of light-colored paper pages is visible. A thin, dark red stripe runs across the very top edge of these pages.

title: A Small Box
alt_text: A sculpture made of paper and textile shows a small, rectangular box. The outer covering is a fabric featuring vertical stripes in shades of red, green, and blue. The short side of the box reveals several stacked layers of white paper. Two narrow, green fabric straps extend from the top of the box down its front side. These straps are secured in place by small, horizontal white toggles.

title: Square Bible
alt_text: A sculpture of a book shows a worn, old bible lying open on its spine. The book is heavily damaged, with dark, peeling material covering much of its surface. Patches of off-white paper or fabric are visible underneath the dark, crumbling layers. The edges of the book's many pages are frayed and stained, suggesting significant wear or age. It rests against a plain, light gray background.

title: Point Blank
medium: Artist’s book with bullet holes and gunpowder
alt_text: A sculpture of a book cover is displayed against a light background. The front of the book is white and features six dark, circular spots that look like bullet holes surrounded by black smudge marks. Near the top of the cover, the words "POINT BLANK" are printed in thin, red capital letters. Near the bottom, the name "Kendell Geers" appears in smaller, red text. The marks and text are scattered across the otherwise plain white surface of the book.

title: Pages 2
medium: Found book pages, cut and rebound
alt_text: A sculpture in the form of a rectangular red book sits on a light grey surface. The book cover is bright red with gold lettering printed on the front and spine. The front cover displays the title and author, while the spine repeats this information vertically. The pages of the book are cut and bound so that they are visible on the right side and bottom edges. The exposed paper edges are tan and show distinct vertical lines.

title: Sacral Tale
alt_text: A sculpture of a book has a textured, off-white cover that looks like canvas or woven fabric. Cut-out letters are pasted onto the front of the cover in two rows. The top row spells the word "SACRAL" using black letters on small, rectangular scraps of tan paper. Below that, the word "TALE" appears with the letters pasted individually. The entire object has a rectangular shape and sits against a plain gray background.

title: Entropic Enyclopedia, Vol 1
medium: Sheets of oxidzed steel welded together
alt_text: A sculpture made of brown, rusty metal sheets shaped like an open book. Several rectangular panels stand upright and are attached at a central spine, creating pages that fan out to the left and right. Each metal panel features horizontal rows of raised, dark, and uneven textures that look like welding marks or scarred lines. The rust gives the entire object a textured, brownish-orange appearance. It rests on a plain surface against a neutral, shaded background.

title: Croquis-sculpture
medium: Found book pages and metal with metal bolts
alt_text: A sculpture of a stack of old book pages held tightly between two heavy metal bars. The metal bars are clamped together by several long, threaded metal bolts and nuts on the top and bottom. The pages appear thick and slightly yellowed from age. They are folded in an S-shape, bending out at the left and right sides of the clamp. The overall object stands upright against a plain grey background.

title: Book Bomb 2
medium: Tape, wire, batteries in an altered found dictionary.
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered dictionary shows a hollowed-out section in the right page. Inside this rectangular cutout, a thick, silver-colored roll of tape sits next to a bundle of batteries, wires, and other small items. The rest of the book remains intact, featuring columns of small printed text and a few tiny black-and-white pictures. The pages of the open book are aged and yellowish in color. The background behind the open book is a plain, solid grey.

title: La France Coloniale (Masque)
medium: Found book, wood, leather,sheels, glass and shells
alt_text: A sculpture made of a found book, wood, leather, and glass shows a head-like object centered against a plain background. A worn, red-colored book spine runs vertically down the front of the object, acting as a nose or bridge. On either side of the spine, two circular, dark glass eyes are set into the dark leather material. A thick layer of light-colored, wispy hair surrounds the face and falls around the sides of the object. Rising from the top are two tall, pointed antennae or horn shapes made of wood, colored with pink and purple geometric patterns. Small tufts of hair are attached to the very tips of these tall shapes.

title: Bande Dessinée [Comic Strip]
medium: Found and altered cartoons and metal can
alt_text: A sculpture made of found cartoons and a metal can shows a tightly coiled roll of paper inside a round container. The tall, cylindrical tin has a worn, grey-brown surface with mottled textures. Its lid sits slightly open, resting at an angle on the top edge of the roll. The paper inside is cream-colored and wound into many concentric circles, creating a spiral pattern. A small, dark circular hole is visible in the center of the paper roll.

title: La Mer [The Ocean]
alt_text: A sculpture of colored tissue paper and a rattan mat lies partially rolled up. A tight coil of the mat sits on the left, revealing layered sheets of paper inside. The flat, unrolled section extends to the right, showing a gradient of color. The paper starts as a pale mint green near the roll and transitions into deeper shades of turquoise and blue on the right edge. The woven rattan texture is visible along the top and bottom borders of the unrolled mat.

title: Study for Abalos and Herreros: Recycling Madrid
alt_text: A sculpture of two altered books in acrylic cases hangs on a plain light gray wall. The larger case on the left holds a book with a geometric, grid-like pattern in black and white, featuring a rectangular cutout that reveals layered, abstract white forms inside. To its right, a smaller case displays a book with a black-and-white landscape photograph of a winding road across an open, barren field. Both cases are rectangular and clear, creating small, distinct shadows on the wall behind them. The two pieces are positioned at slightly different heights, with the larger one placed higher up than the smaller one.

title: Standing Books
medium: Found books with white stoneware clay slip
alt_text: A sculpture made of books covered in white clay appears as a small, upright stack. The object looks like a partially open book with many thin pages visible in the center. The left side is darker, showing shades of grey and black where the material appears scorched or stained. In contrast, the right side and the individual pages are a lighter, creamy white color. The pages are textured and wavy, bending outward to fan open slightly. The entire form rests on a solid, uneven base that sits flat against a plain grey background.

title: The Unknown Soldier
medium: Found book page with white stoneware clay slip
alt_text: A sculpture shows a textured page from a book coated in white clay. The object sits inside a light-colored wooden frame with a black back panel. A dark, charred-looking patch dominates the upper left corner of the page. The rest of the surface is covered in a cracked, off-white crust that peels away at the edges. A small metal ring at the top center of the frame suggests it is meant for hanging on a wall.

title: Churchill, Roosevelt and Stalin - the Yalta Conference
medium: Found book page with white stoneware clay slip
alt_text: A sculpture of a book page in a light wooden frame shows remnants of paper and white clay slip. The rectangular frame holds a dark background against which a torn, scorched, and stained paper fragment is mounted. A jagged, dark, oval-shaped mark sits near the top right of the paper. Two thick, white patches of clay-like material are attached to the left side of the fragment, creating a rough, uneven texture. The paper itself appears brittle and damaged, with uneven, dark edges.

title: Cloud Book Study
medium: Artist's book with offset prints, dvd
alt_text: A sculpture in the form of an artist's book shows a rectangular, beige-colored book cover. The words "Cloud Book Study" are printed in small, white capital letters near the top center. Near the bottom center, the name "NEILSON" and the year "2011" appear in similar white lettering. A thin, light-colored ribbon is tied in a loose knot around the right edge of the book cover. The book sits flat against a plain, solid gray background.

title: Dices
medium: Artist’s book with printed vellum pages and linen cover
alt_text: An artist's book shows a dark gray or black cover made of a textured fabric material. The cover is a simple rectangle shape lying flat against a light gray background. In the upper left corner, there are two lines of text printed in a clean, white sans-serif font. The top line says "PAUL HEIMBACH" in small capital letters. Below it, the second line says "würfelwürfe" in a larger, lowercase, slanted script.

title: Unaulutu. Steinchen im Sand
medium: Screenprinted artist's book with mixed media
alt_text: A screenprinted artist's book with mixed media showing two open pages. On the left, a tan page displays simple, hand-drawn sketches including stick figures, wavy lines, and jagged patterns. These small drawings are arranged in horizontal rows across the page. To the right, a white page features a single, darker print that looks like a textured, abstract face or figure with geometric shapes inside. Both pages appear as part of a larger book lying flat on a light gray surface.

title: Tic Tac Toe
alt_text: A sculpture of three connected books sits on a plain grey background. The center book stands upright and has a dark red spine with gold lettering. To the right of it, a blue, cross-shaped book object is covered in white, scratched marks and tally marks. A third, darker, curved book object is attached to the left side of the center book. The objects are arranged to stand together, creating a complex, three-dimensional shape.

title: White Ass European Cowboy
alt_text: A sculpture made of found and altered vinyl records stands upright to resemble a thick, rectangular book. The object is primarily black, with a large red circle in the center of the cover that contains thin, concentric rings. Bold, white capital letters spelling "ARNO" are printed across the middle of this red circle. Smaller, white text appears above the circle, reading "white ass european cowboy." A similar red circle with the word "ARNO" appears on the spine, which is visible on the left side. The top of the object shows the edges of the stacked vinyl records, which look like the pages of a thick book.

title: Forest Floor Secrets
alt_text: A handmade paper sculpture showing a dense, horizontal cluster of layered, green, leaf-like shapes. The object looks like a tightly packed bunch of foliage with frayed, stringy edges. It sits low in the frame against a smooth, neutral gray background. The color is a consistent, bright lime green with hints of darker shadow within the folds of the paper. This textured mass appears slightly chaotic, with many thin, pointed ends sticking out in all directions.

title: The Dark Squares
medium: Artist's book with movable components in silk bound hard slip cover
alt_text: An artist's book is displayed open with its dark, rectangular slipcover resting next to it. The book itself is bound in dark material and lies flat on a neutral background. Its cream-colored pages are open to show two columns of printed text and small diagrams that look like game boards. The cover of the book is dark and sturdy, mirroring the color and style of the separate slipcover. The open pages fill the center of the frame, showing both a left and right side filled with text.

title: Flesh
medium: Artist’s book with cut pages and linen cover
alt_text: A sculpture in the form of a closed book shows a plain, textured red cover. The book is rectangular and sits centered against a neutral, light grey background. In the upper right quadrant of the cover, the word "FLESH" is printed in small, white, capital letters. The surface of the book appears to be made of a fabric material like linen.

title: 6 Empty Book Cases
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist's pop-up book lies open on a light gray, rectangular surface. The open book displays two pages covered in small, dense columns of black text and two small line drawings of diagrams. A white, translucent structure rises from the center of the book pages. This structure is shaped like a small, boxy frame with several rectangular cutouts inside it. It casts a soft, angled shadow onto the printed text beneath it.

title: Bibliotheque
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular wooden box holding several books. The box is made of light-colored wood and features a curved metal handle on its front side. Inside the box, a collection of books stands upright in a tight row. These books have light, paper-like covers with faint, smudged patterns in gray and pink colors. The books are positioned to fill most of the space within the open top of the box.

title: Broken Mirror (assemblage art with text)
medium: Discarded medicine cabinet, legal & short-hand papers glued to interior, text in ink on outside mirror
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular medicine cabinet features a mirrored surface with handwritten text in black ink. The glass is cracked in several places, and the edges show signs of wear and peeled paper. Handwritten words cover the mirror, moving across horizontal lines that look like a page of lined paper. A delicate floral design is painted or etched near the top center of the glass. Four small, circular metal fasteners hold the glass onto the cabinet frame, one in each corner.

title: She Enjoys It
medium: Artist's book with cardboard covers and mixed media
alt_text: An artist's book with cardboard covers shows two open, rectangular pages bound together with dark string. Both pages have textured, off-white surfaces and are lined with small staples along their outer edges. In the center, two curved rows of sharp, metallic spikes are connected to each other by thin, horizontal threads stretching across the gap between the pages. Several rectangular, light-colored strips containing printed text are embedded into the surface of the cardboard. These text strips are scattered on the lower half of the left page and the middle area of the right page.

title: Hallelujah
medium: Found rolled music pages tied with silk threads, in songbook covers
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular book cover made from dark blue fabric. The front of the cover has the word "Halleluja." embossed in gold letters in the center. Small, thin blue and yellow silk threads poke out from the edges of the book, especially on the right side. The fabric of the cover has a fine, woven texture. The book is set against a plain, light gray background.

title: The Final Testimony
medium: Found, rolled book pages, mounted to found book cover with string
alt_text: A sculpture made of found, rolled book pages shows a rectangular arrangement of tightly curled paper tubes. These tan-colored pages are stood upright and packed together in parallel lines across a book cover. Several dark, blue-black pieces of string are wrapped horizontally around the entire group of rolls, binding them in place. A small, light-colored rectangular tag is tucked behind the string near the right side of the bundle. The entire object sits against a plain, solid grey background.

title: Sage: Volume 1
alt_text: A sculpture of red clay, wood, and straw shaped like an open book. The rectangular object has a thick, textured, reddish-brown surface that looks rough and uneven. Small pieces of thin, light-yellow straw are embedded horizontally across both sides of the open book shape. These straw pieces are arranged in rows that mimic lines of text. The entire sculpture casts a soft shadow on the flat, light gray background behind and below it.

title: Déu, ciència i libertat [God, Science and Freedom]
alt_text: A glass sculpture displays a red design on a transparent pane held by a metal base. The base is made of three white aluminum rectangular bars connected at angles like an accordion. A single, tall, rectangular sheet of glass is attached to the base. Centered on this glass sheet is a rough, textured red shape that looks like an oval or a pointed arch. The color of the red design is dense and grainy, standing out sharply against the clear background.

title: Tree of Codes
alt_text: A sculpture made from a cut and altered artist's book lies open on a smooth gray surface. The spine and edges of the book's hard cover are decorated with a pattern of black, irregular circles on a white background. Inside the book, many lines of printed text on both pages have been carefully cut away, leaving gaps in the paper. Some remaining fragments of text are still visible, floating above the negative space created by the cuts. The overall effect creates a stark contrast between the black ink and the white, empty areas of the pages.

title: Untitled #7
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media shows a cluster of dark, sharp shapes that resemble burnt wood. The center of the object is dense and rough with many intersecting, jagged edges. Several long, thin, straight pieces protrude outward to the right, looking like broken beams. The overall color is a mix of charcoal black, grey, and hints of metallic silver. The entire structure rests against a smooth, solid grey background.

title: Printer's Chase
alt_text: A sculpture of burned printed material and iron shows a dark, textured square set within a rust-colored frame. The center panel is black and appears charred, with visible grooves and ridges that look like layers of compressed paper. This central square is slightly recessed and has a smooth, dark surface texture. It is surrounded by a thick, metallic border that is shaped like a blocky bracket or frame. The frame has a dull, brownish-orange color and appears to be made of heavy metal. The entire object sits against a plain, light grey background.

title: A Guide to Higher Learning
medium: Cloth covered clamshell box with mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture of a dark blue, cloth-covered clamshell box sits open on a flat surface. The box is divided into two main sections attached by a hinged spine. The left side is an empty, hollowed-out space lined with soft, dark blue fabric and contains a single small, rectangular white card with text. The right side holds several smaller, rectangular compartments filled with grid-patterned cards featuring small red dots. These smaller compartments are bordered by dark blue spines with tiny gold labels. The entire arrangement looks neat, structured, and carefully organized.

title: Medium
medium: Found books with linseed oil and water, in a Plexiglas and wood case
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular wooden box with clear sides shows two separate compartments. In the left section, a dark, reddish-brown liquid fills the space, and a book stands vertically with its spine at the bottom. The right section contains a clear liquid and holds a crumpled, wet book lying flat on the base. The cover of this second book appears stained with dark, circular spots. A light wooden frame encloses the clear walls and ceiling of the box.

title: Neo Emblamata Nova
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist's book consists of multiple rectangular panels connected by metal hinges. The book is folded in a zigzag pattern, spreading out across the surface to show several interior pages at once. Each small, off-white panel features a detailed black-ink illustration of various scenes with figures and architecture. The arrangement creates a complex shape that resembles a sprawling maze or a chain. At the bottom right, several unviewed pages are stacked together tightly against the last panel.

title: Fenced in Woman
medium: Found and burned books in customized book-urn
alt_text: A sculpture made of books fashioned into a tall, dark, and angular vessel. The object has a wide, boxy base that narrows in the middle and flares out again toward the top. A stack of thin, dark layers sits on the very top, resembling a small tiered cap. Gold lettering is visible on the front, reading "rle Stanley Gard" near the top and "The Case of the Fenced-In Woman" near the middle. The entire structure appears dark and textured, set against a plain, light grey background.

title: Works by Heine
medium: Found, altered bookpages and linnen cover
alt_text: A sculpture of a sphere sits centered on a rectangular red cloth. The sphere is made of light-tan, rough-textured paper pages that have been tightly packed and sculpted into a ball. Its surface is bumpy and uneven, showing many small, folded layers of paper. The red cloth beneath the sphere appears to be a piece of linen fabric with slightly frayed, uneven edges. A tiny, faint golden mark is visible on the cloth to the lower right of the sphere. The entire object rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Book written by the Sea, Cadaqués, Spain
medium: Found Spanish-English dictionary with salt, seaweed, and seashell
alt_text: A sculpture of a heavily damaged, open dictionary lies against a plain gray background. The pages are worn, torn, and coated with a thick, crusty, light-colored substance that resembles dried salt. Pieces of dark, withered seaweed are stuck to the surface of the paper. A small, gray, curled seashell is embedded near the center of the right page. The text on the remaining visible pages appears faded and stained.

title: Paper-re-making-Book
alt_text: A sculpture in the form of a book stands upright against a plain, light gray background. The book has a rough, off-white paper cover with a brown spine on the left edge. A rectangular patch of lighter paper is attached to the front cover, featuring printed text in black and red ink. The book's pages are thick and have textured, uneven edges that face toward the right. This object rests on a smooth surface that fades into the background.

title: The Idea of Nature
medium: Found book covers, pulped book pages, PVA glue and thread
alt_text: A sculpture made from book covers, paper, glue, and thread shows a dark, upright book cover filled with hundreds of small, textured spheres. These round, beige forms are strung together on thin threads, hanging down like curtains from inside the book. Some of the spheres have spilled out from the opening and rest in a pile on the surface below. Thin, white threads stick out from the cover, crisscrossing the dark surface like stray hairs. The entire assembly creates an organic, spilling effect that contrasts with the rigid shape of the book spine.

title: 4 Poets 4 Poems
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist's book sits upright on a flat surface. Its front cover is a dark, textured panel with a vertical, glowing bar that fades from red to yellow to blue. To the right of this bar, a bright blue neon-style light forms a fork shape above the white text "4 Poets 4 Poems." Several translucent, rectangular pages fan out to the right like an open book. Each page has faint, glowing red text printed on it and colorful light reflecting from its edges onto the surface below.

title: Poetry Desk
medium: Typewriter and wooden desk with mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture of a typewriter sits on a wooden desk. The typewriter is light tan and has a set of bright green keys. Behind the typewriter on the right, there is a small, light-colored, cylindrical object that looks like a pencil sharpener. The wooden desk has a slanted surface that tilts downward toward the viewer. A thin, black electrical cord extends from the right side of the wooden base.

title: A Counting Book
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture shows a folding object that resembles a book with two rectangular panels. The left panel features a smooth, black, glowing background with the mathematical equation for velocity integration lit up in purple and white characters. The right panel consists of a traditional abacus frame with black beads, overlaid with glowing purple and white characters displaying two different physics equations. Rulers are attached to the edges of both panels, acting as a frame for the math elements. The entire piece sits upright on a flat, light-colored surface against a plain, gray backdrop.

title: Time Travel
medium: Glass, lead, wood, filmstrip, watch, and daguerreotype
alt_text: A sculpture made of glass, wood, and metal parts forms a small, rectangular box that stands upright. The front face is divided into two sections, with the left panel made of textured glass featuring a repeating clover-like pattern. The right side is clear glass, revealing a circular watch face and a thin metal hand suspended inside the case. A dark, thin lead frame holds all the glass panels together. The object rests on a simple surface, set against a plain, neutral background.

title: No. 13: Battle at Tannenberg
medium: Oil and pencil on stripped found book spines, on wooden shelf
alt_text: A sculpture of several stacked book spines, sitting on a wooden shelf. The arrangement features two large, thick book spines lying flat at the base. Resting on top of these are several more book spines stood upright, stacked horizontally like steps. These upper spines show faint pencil drawings of maps and writing directly on their weathered, tan surfaces. A thin, white rectangular tag stands vertically near the back of the stack, and a piece of frayed string hangs off the left side.

title: Dit Peu (Karussell book)
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media shows a colorful collection of pleated, fan-like shapes arranged around a central core. The top section looks like folded paper or fabric with panels of white, red, yellow, and blue. Dark blue central panels feature printed text that includes the numbers "30." A bright red, ribbed cylinder forms a base that supports this fanned arrangement. The entire object sits against a dark, neutral background.

title: Snowball's Chance
alt_text: A sculpture of a book that has been badly burned and is lying open. The edges of the pages are blackened, curled, and brittle. Dark, charred material covers large sections of the paper, obscuring much of the printed text. The pages in the center are still somewhat visible, showing faint rows of writing beneath patches of soot and brown staining. The entire object rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Sinking
alt_text: A sculpture made of two stacks of dark-covered encyclopedias placed side-by-side. The top covers have been cut away to form a deep, uneven hole in the center. The inside of this hollow area reveals many layered, light-colored pages that descend like stairs or terraced cliffs. The sides of the books are stacked neatly and show dark spines with gold lettering. This creates a carved, topographical effect within the volumes.

title: Vulcan
alt_text: A sculpture made from found and altered French encyclopedias shows a conical shape formed by fanned-out paper pages. The object creates a rounded dome with a small circular hole cut through the center at the top. Numerous thin, white pages create a textured surface that radiates outward from the opening. Darker, horizontal bands of color run across the surface, giving the impression of rings. The edges of the paper form a scalloped or pleated rim around the bottom of the structure.

title: The Atom
medium: Burned found books with wire, paint, burlap, and wood
alt_text: A sculpture of an open book set inside a rectangular frame. The book appears old and has pages that are darkened, curled, and seemingly burned at the edges. Thin, dark wires wrap tightly around the center of the book to hold it in place. The frame around the book is made of a rough, brownish material that looks like weathered wood or plaster. A dark shadow falls behind and below the object against a plain grey background.

title: Holy Bible
alt_text: A sculpture showing an altered bible with its pages folded into a tiered, three-dimensional shape. The book lies open, revealing text and a map on the endpapers visible underneath the manipulated pages. The folded pages create a rounded, multi-layered form that rises up from the center of the book. These pages are white with darker, reddish-pink edges. The overall form resembles a small, rounded dome or a multi-level structure resting on the open book covers.

title: Ontological Fragments
alt_text: A sculpture of several old, worn books stacked on a rectangular tray. The books are weathered and look soft, with frayed edges and discolored pages that appear aged. At the bottom, two open books are laid flat side-by-side on the dark-rimmed tray. Two more closed books rest horizontally on top of them, creating a pyramid shape. The stack is centered against a plain, light grey background.

title: Ontological Fragment
medium: Found dictionary with slate and salt
alt_text: A sculpture of a found dictionary combined with slate and salt pieces. The thick book sits upright, displaying its many pages and a red spine cover. Several dark grey, thin stone slabs are arranged around the book. Some slabs stand vertically behind it, while another piece of slate lays flat on the ground. A small amount of white, rough-textured salt is visible near the base of the book and on the flat stone piece.

title: Heat Sink
medium: Found encyclopedia with iron, C-clamp, and salt
alt_text: A sculpture composed of a thick, worn book sitting at the base. A rusty metal C-clamp grips the top edge of the book. Rising from the clamp is a tall, twisting, reddish-brown rod that spirals upward. The rod appears to be textured with a crusty, salt-like material. The entire piece casts a single, soft shadow onto the plain grey surface below.

title: Livre cordage et cendres [Book rope and ash]
medium: Rope artist’s book with glue and ash
alt_text: A sculpture of an open book made from rough, knotted rope. The pages of the book are formed by a complex, net-like lattice of crisscrossing brown strands. A thick border composed of larger, heavy knots frames the entire rectangular shape. The material has a coarse, textured appearance and is covered in a dark, dusty substance. It sits flat against a plain, light gray background and casts a faint shadow below its edges.

title: Large Book with Pinwheels
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered artist's book shows several rounded, fan-like shapes layered on top of each other. These circular patterns are created from the pages of a book, fanned open and pressed flat. The largest shape is bright orange and sits in the lower-left section of the rectangular frame. Above it, there are several shades of green and olive circles, each composed of radiating, thin segments. Other smaller, pale blue and white patterns peek out from the edges, giving the piece a complex and textured appearance. The entire work is enclosed within a simple light wood frame.

title: Bible Belt
medium: Found bible attached to leather belt with Jesus belt buckle
alt_text: A sculpture of an open book lying flat on a neutral surface with a black leather belt wrapped horizontally around it. The book is open to two pages of printed text with red edges. A large, triangular gold-colored belt buckle sits prominently in the center of the leather strap. This buckle features the raised letters "JESUS" integrated into the metal design. The belt extends across the width of the open book, holding it firmly in place.

title: Integrals
medium: Found math book with optical lighting film in a wooden box.
alt_text: A sculpture showing an open book encased within a square, dark wooden frame. The book is positioned diagonally in the center, and its pages appear to be layered or blurred as if viewed through a special filter. Faint, handwritten math equations and numbers are visible on the cream-colored pages. The background behind the book is a deep, dark grey or black. The entire piece has a clean, geometric look, framed like a box against a plain grey backdrop.

title: U-90-45
medium: Found English dictionary with metal, aircraft wheels, and bolts
alt_text: A sculpture of a book held between two metal structures, each with two wheels. A thick, dark green dictionary stands upright in the center, acting as a bridge between the two mechanical bases. Each base is made of dark, weathered metal and includes two sturdy wheels with black rubber tires and light-colored rims. The wheels are arranged in pairs on either side of the book. The entire assembly sits on a smooth, grey, featureless surface. The object appears to be a creative combination of an old dictionary and heavy mechanical parts.

title: Barcelona Calling
medium: Found and altered telephone book, mounted to board
alt_text: A sculpture made of an altered telephone book shows a large, circular arrangement of paper pages. These many pages are fanned out and overlapping to create a circular shape with a small, empty hole in the center. The paper is light tan or cream-colored, and the dark, printed text on the edges creates a swirled, fan-like pattern throughout. The entire circular object is mounted against a plain, off-white background. Light shadows appear between the layered pages, giving the piece a sense of depth and texture.

title: Bookobject
medium: Found and cut musical notation book
alt_text: A sculpture of a found and cut musical notation book shows pages stretched out horizontally. The book has dark, rectangular covers on both the left and right ends. A long, continuous strip of paper filled with black musical notes connects the two covers. The paper appears creased and slightly rippled in several places along its length. The entire object is presented inside a shallow, light-colored frame against a plain background.

title: Visual Music n. 8/25
medium: Silk screened poster, leaflets, and casette tape in clothcovered case.
alt_text: A sculpture containing a large, folded paper sheet with black printed text arranged in a grid-like pattern against a light background. Below the large sheet sits a small, black open box containing a tiny rectangular piece of paper with handwriting. Next to it is a closed, square, black box with a small label on its cover. To the right of the closed box, a small, multi-page booklet is partially open. Finally, a single sheet of paper with a numbered list lies next to the booklet. All these items are arranged against a plain, solid gray surface.

title: Bookpillow
medium: Found and altered telephone books on wooden board
alt_text: A sculpture made from found and altered telephone books attached to a wooden board. The work consists of a dense, rectangular mass of paper pages that curl and twist outward in every direction. The pages are varying shades of cream, tan, and brown, with some darker edges visible throughout the cluster. The object is centered against a plain, solid grey wall, casting a soft shadow below and to the right. The overall appearance is highly textured and chaotic, resembling a thick, sponge-like surface made entirely of stacked paper.

title: Punishment #1
medium: Telephone books, pencils, shelf, and wire
alt_text: A sculpture made of telephone books, pencils, a shelf, and wire shows a long figure resting on its back. The figure is made of layered pages from books, colored in muted tones of beige, white, and gray. It lies flat on a horizontal wooden shelf that is suspended in the air by thin wires. Many long, thin, orange-colored pencils point downward from the bottom of the shelf, creating a fringe-like appearance. One hand is curled and rests against the figure's chest, while its head is round and slightly raised.

title: New Stoneage
medium: Found and altered book, glue and wood
alt_text: A sculpture made of wood, glue, and a book shows a hammer-like shape resting against a gray background. A dark, smooth wooden handle extends upward from the bottom left toward the center of the image. The head of the hammer is a thick, uneven block made of pages from a book stacked and glued together. These layered pages look like white, wavy rock formations and feature printed text on the top surface. A thin, pointed piece of wood sticks out from the top of the page stack, completing the tool-like appearance.

title: Hand
alt_text: A sculpture of a hand rests on a neutral gray surface. The object is carved from paper into the shape of an open, palm-down hand. The material appears to be tightly stacked pages, giving it a layered, beige and brownish texture. At the wrist, a small section of a red and white paper cover with printed text is visible. The fingers are slightly spread apart and bent as if resting naturally on a flat surface.

title: CLOSURE:DICTIONNAIRE
alt_text: A copper sculpture of a book stands against a plain background. The rectangular object is cast in a golden metal that reflects the light. Its front cover is completely covered in rows of evenly spaced, small, raised letters that look like printed text. The spine of the book shows decorative horizontal bands that suggest traditional bookbinding. The entire object has a uniform, shiny, metallic finish.

title: Webster's Third International Dictionary
medium: Found and altered dictionary with wood, cardboard, mirrors, and a lamp
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered dictionary lies closed on a smooth, neutral gray background. The book has a worn, cream-colored fabric cover that appears slightly stained with light brown spots. A single small, round metal grommet is set into the front cover near the top edge. The thick edge of the book's pages is stained a vibrant, solid orange color. A row of small, dark, semicircular cutouts runs along the side edge of the pages, revealing glimpses of the interior.

title: The Chrysanthemum and the Sword and the Arrow
medium: Found and altered book with therad and found printed material
alt_text: A sculpture made from an altered book and printed material shows multiple pages splayed open in an irregular, layered arrangement. The pages are worn, discolored, and held together with loose threads that hang from the edges of the paper. Several pages feature small, blurry red stains, and red arrows are printed or stamped directly onto the text. The book is opened in such a way that sections of text face in different directions, creating a chaotic, fragmented appearance. The entire object rests against a plain, neutral gray background.

title: SEED WORD BOOK (seeds sprouted in cut dictionary)
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered book stands upright against a plain grey background. The light-colored fabric cover has the words "SEED WORD BOOK" printed on the front in dark capital letters. The book is slightly open, revealing that the pages have been hollowed out to hold loose, light brown objects inside. These objects appear to be seeds, filling the carved-out space within the pages. A small, orange-colored thread is visible near the top edge of the book's spine.

title: Perspectives II: The Matterhorn
alt_text: A sculpture made from a cut and altered artist's book shows a mountain landscape. The book is open, displaying a black-and-white image of a tall, pointed mountain reflecting in a still body of water below. The paper of the mountain appears to be sliced or layered to create a wavy, topographical texture. A small, white, circular button or fastener is visible on the bottom left corner of the page. The background of the book pages is solid black, framing the light-colored mountain image.

title: The Wharf Rat
medium: Found and altered book, mummified rat, velvet and plexi glass
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular, upright book stands against a plain gray background. The book’s cover is dark blue and features raised, gold-colored capital letters. The text on the cover reads, "THE WHARF RAT BY JONI MABE," with the words stacked in four lines. The book has a visible spine on the right side that appears slightly worn. The edges of the pages are visible and have a brownish, aged tone.

title: Mediascoop
alt_text: A sculpture shows a rectangular bundle of gray wire that looks like a dense, tangled block. A long, flat white tag is attached to the front face of the wire block, covering a portion of the surface. This label contains black text in capital letters that reads "MEDIA SCOOP," followed by "INVESTIGATION AU COEUR DE L’OEUVRE," and "MADE" at the bottom. A piece of red and white striped ribbon is tied tightly around the middle of the block, wrapping over both the wire and the white label. The entire object rests against a plain, light gray background.

title: Untitled (History Book)
medium: Found and altered history book with cord
alt_text: A sculpture made from an altered history book shows a scene printed in bright orange on its cover. The book stands upright and appears slightly worn with thick, yellowed pages visible on the right side. The orange cover illustration features several figures, including a woman holding an object and a person standing on the right. In the background, tall, thin shapes resembling city buildings reach upward. A piece of dark cord or string is threaded through the lower right corner of the book's cover, binding the pages together.

title: When the Cheering Stopped
medium: Found and altered Reader's Digest books with lead sinker and cord
alt_text: A sculpture of a small, rectangular stack of bound paper resting on a flat, white surface. The stack is wrapped with thin, tan-colored cord that crisscrosses around its sides. A long, single strand of this same cord hangs vertically off the edge of the surface. Attached to the bottom end of this hanging cord is a dark, teardrop-shaped lead weight. This weight hangs suspended against the white background.

title: Never Love a Stranger
medium: Found and altered book, fabric, glass dropper, and garter belt
alt_text: A sculpture of an open, altered book with padded white fabric lining its two interior pages. On the left page, a black-and-white photograph shows a person standing in a dark suit next to someone in a light-colored dress. The right page holds two small, clear glass bottles with black dropper tops, each partially filled with a light liquid. A white lace garter sits on the surface to the right of the open book. A frayed piece of white fabric hangs down from the center spine of the book.

title: Blindfaith
medium: Found and altered Samoan bible in two drum heads
alt_text: A sculpture made of found and altered book pages in two drum heads shows a circular, tan, and brown object. It is encased within a thin, circular metal frame against a plain gray background. The center of the object features a textured, geometric pattern with concentric rings that radiate outward from a small, central square. The surrounding surface appears layered and fibrous, resembling densely packed paper pages. The light reflects faintly off the smooth, rounded edge of the metal frame.

title: Livre découpé
medium: Found and cut book stapled to a wooden plaque
alt_text: A sculpture made from a book shows pages that are cut and folded into complex, swirling shapes. The book is stapled to a light-colored wooden plaque with a thin, reddish-brown frame. The pages form a dense, three-dimensional mass in the center, resembling waves or twisted ribbons. Parts of the printed text on the original pages are still visible behind the curls of paper. The overall effect creates a sense of movement and volume on the flat surface.

title: New Age Encyclopedia Index
medium: Found and cut copy of the New Age Encyclopedia
alt_text: A sculpture made from a book shows a red volume of an encyclopedia with its pages intricately cut and folded. The pages are manipulated to curl outward into two large, fluffy clumps that flank the upright book cover. These clumps of paper are rounded and dense, appearing almost like petals or clouds. The pages themselves retain visible columns of small printed text. The entire object rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Hanging Index
medium: Found and cut hanging copy of Who’s Who in America
alt_text: A sculpture of a tall, cone-shaped object hangs from the ceiling in a white room. The entire structure is made of many thin, long strips of white paper arranged in layers. At the very top, a thick red book sits flat as a crown for the hanging paper cone. To the right of the sculpture, a white radiator stands against the wall. The floor appears to be made of light-colored wood planks.

title: Calming Words (pill book)
medium: Found and altered book with gel capsules
alt_text: A sculpture made from an altered book shows an open volume with a rectangular hollow cut into its right side. The left page is blank and cream-colored. Inside the hollow space on the right, there is a pile of many small, clear, cylindrical gel capsules. The capsules are scattered randomly, overlapping one another within the cut-out section. A bright red book cover frames the pages from underneath and behind.

title: Widows (Eggs Book)
medium: Artist’s book with blown eggs, nylon, and acrylic paint
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist’s book shows two dark pages covered in black paint. Resting on each page is a rounded, egg-shaped mound wrapped in sheer black material. The material bunches and drapes around the center of each mound. The left mound is covered completely by the fabric. The right mound has a slit in the fabric that reveals a pale, oval shape underneath.

title: Bookworm
alt_text: A sculpture made of altered found book pages in the shape of a long-sleeved shirt. The garment is constructed from strips of paper that have been loosely woven together to form a textured, open-stitch pattern. Horizontal bands of alternating light tan and cream-colored paper create a simple, striped design across the body and sleeves. The shirt lies flat against a plain, grey background. It appears to be a smaller, child-sized item with a wide, simple neckline.

title: Save Antartica
alt_text: An artist book made of pages that are cut and painted into many small bird figures. The book rests flat, but its pages are folded and fanned open to create a textured, uneven surface. These pages are densely packed with tiny, individual black-and-white figures that appear to be standing upright. The figures cluster together across the entire middle section of the book. The book’s covers are a solid, plain white color and are held apart at one end.

title: Un Libro Illegible Quadrato
alt_text: A sculpture of a folded artist's book sits against a neutral gray background. The book is square and wrapped in tan paper that is creased diagonally across the center to form a triangle. Green cursive handwriting covers the entire surface of the paper, overlapping the folds. The text appears to be written in several different languages, including English and Japanese characters. The light brown paper has a slight texture and shows faint fold lines where the pages underneath are pressed together.

title: books27NewYorkTimes, from the series Saved Books
alt_text: A sculpture of a book has been altered to display its pages in an upright, fanned-out position. The main body of the sculpture consists of many rectangular, cream-colored paper pages standing vertically like a stack. On top of the pages sits a dense, messy cluster of shredded, silver-toned material that looks like tangled hair or metallic grass. Behind the pages, the stiff, brown covers of the book are spread open to frame the central structure. The dark, tan-colored covers are printed with small, indistinct text, forming a flat backdrop for the layered pages.

title: books20Bishop, from the series Saved Books
alt_text: A sculpture of a found and altered book stands against a pitch-black background. The book is open, with its stiff, dark covers visible on the sides. The pages at the bottom are fanned out in smooth, curved layers that bow outward. Above these smooth pages, the top of the book is transformed into a dense, tangled mass of shredded paper fibers. These thin, wavy strips extend outward in all directions like a wild, unruly hairstyle.

title: Wester's New Ninth Collegiate Dictionary
alt_text: A sculpture of a found and altered dictionary lies open on a neutral surface. The thick book features a red cover and hundreds of thin, worn pages. Thick, chaotic black ink scribbles cover both the left and right pages of the open book. On the left page, the ink forms a looped, flower-like shape over the printed text. The right page is heavily marked with dense, overlapping circular lines that obscure almost all the writing underneath.

title: Pineneedle Book
medium: Found bookss with porcelain clay, and hard brick on a kiln shelf
alt_text: A sculpture shows two damaged books resting on a flat, rectangular base. One book on the left is crumpled and torn, with rough, grayish-brown pages. Beside it sits a solid, rectangular, reddish-brown brick. A second book on the right remains more intact, with stacked, rectangular pages colored in shades of dark brown and charcoal. These items sit on a flat, mottled surface that is light tan with patches of green and gray.

title: Untitled from According to Plan
medium: Found burned books and meat hook
alt_text: A sculpture of found burned books suspended from a metal meat hook. The books are stacked on top of one another to form a vertical, rough, cone-like shape. They are charred, dark brown, and black in color, with some lighter tan edges showing through. The stack hangs from a simple wire against a plain, light grey background.

title: Petite Chirugie [ Minor Surgery]
medium: Found copy of Petite Chirugie with blade cutter and glue
alt_text: A sculpture of a book with a metal cutter attached to its cover. The small, rectangular book has a dark spine and green, textured covers with white pages. A curved metal blade sits on top of the book, held in place by two dark wooden handles that extend upward. The metal blade has a rusted, reddish-brown color. The entire object rests on a plain, light-colored background.

title: Unknown
alt_text: A sculpture made of altered printed pages shows two hollow, box-like shapes stacked directly on top of one another. The material consists of strips of paper covered in printed text that have been folded and woven together to create a rigid, geometric frame. Each box has large, square-shaped openings on its sides and top, revealing the empty space inside. The paper is an off-white color with dark, typed characters visible throughout the structure. The stacked objects sit on a neutral gray surface against a soft, dark background.

title: Documentation
medium: Artist’s book with seed, soil, and Plexiglas, in a leather slipcase
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular slipcase shows a black, leather-bound box standing on a light-colored surface. The box is oriented vertically and appears to have a textured, matte surface. In the center of the front face, the word "Documentation" is printed in small, gold, capitalized letters. Below this title, a smaller word, "O'Brien," also appears in gold print. The box casts a soft shadow to the right against a plain, light grey background.

title: Framework
medium: Artist’s book with cardstock and white mohair
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist's book made of cardstock and white mohair lies against a plain gray background. The rectangular object is bound with thick, furry white mohair fibers that wrap tightly around the center of the pages. These fibers create deep, parallel indentations that divide the surface of the book into distinct sections. The edges of the pages are visible beneath the fuzzy texture of the material. A few loose strands of white fiber stick out from the right side of the binding.

title: I Assist at an Explosion
medium: Altered found book ,cotton cord, and book cloth
alt_text: A sculpture made from an altered book and cotton cord shows a dome-shaped object formed by fanned pages. The pages are tightly packed together at the base and open upward like an accordion. Many bright red strings wrap around the middle of the object, connecting the pages together. Small rectangular slips of paper with printed text hang from these red strings, dangling down around the sides. The entire structure sits against a plain, light grey background.

title: The Wizard of Jeanz #2
alt_text: A sculpture showing an open artist's book with cloth pages resting on a plain, neutral surface. On the left, one page features a black background with a textured white, cloud-like abstract pattern. The page on the right is a vibrant red and displays a repeating pattern of white rose outlines. The book pages are layered and slightly folded, casting soft shadows against the smooth background. The overall presentation is flat and clean, highlighting the contrast between the black-and-white side and the red-and-white side.

title: The Wizard of Jeanz #20
medium: Artist's book with denim and sailcloth
alt_text: A sculpture showing a bright red, honeycomb-patterned structure alongside a dark, rectangular book. The red object is made of folded, translucent fabric that expands outward like a paper lantern. To its right lies a flat, black object that looks like a small book or case with a silver metal edge. The word "THE WIZARD OF JEA" is printed in white letters on the black cover. Both items rest on a plain, light gray surface against a neutral background.

title: Wide Open
medium: Artist's book with acrylic cover and wooden stand
alt_text: A sculpture made of an artist's book with an acrylic cover and a wooden stand sits against a plain gray background. The object is angled upward, creating a slanted, triangular shape. A thick piece of reddish-brown wood forms the top edge and base of the structure. Beneath the wooden top, a translucent, brownish material covers the surface of the book. Inside this clear shell, subtle lines and layered shapes hint at the pages of the book beneath.

title: Flat Out
medium: Artist's glow-in-the-dark book with mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture, appearing as an artist's book, shows two large, heart-shaped pieces lying open on a flat surface. The left half is solid, opaque black, while the right half is semi-transparent and etched with intricate, light-colored line drawings of swirls and small shapes. The two halves have jagged, sawtooth edges where they meet in the center. A small paper tag with a barcode hangs from the bottom edge of the transparent piece. Yellow caution tape runs across the background behind the object.

title: Vessels
medium: Pexiglas with linen thread and binding
alt_text: A sculpture of clear Plexiglas contains multiple layers of thin, dark thread. The box-like frame is square and transparent, showing several pages or panels stacked inside. Each panel features a delicate, swirled pattern of thread that appears to shift in density and color. The threads on the far left are dark and tangled, while the threads on the right side are lighter and more spaced out. The side of the frame is bound together with small, visible stitches of light-colored string.

title: Reading Chair with Ottoman Vol XXXIII
medium: Found and torn books with bamboo and metal thread
alt_text: A sculpture of an armchair and a matching footstool constructed from torn books, bamboo, and metal thread. The armchair features a backrest, armrests, and a seat all formed from the thick, textured pages of stacked books. Its frame is made of thin, segmented bamboo poles connected with shiny metal wire. In front of the chair sits a small, rectangular footstool with a top made from a single, open book resting on a bamboo frame. The entire piece sits on a plain, neutral background.

title: Francis
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture showing a stack of objects that look like flat, rectangular papers or notebooks. The stack is rectangular in shape and rests on a solid, light-colored surface. The top object is a brownish-red color with dark, worn edges and indented text stamped into its center. Beneath this top layer, several thinner, lighter sheets are stacked neatly, showing uneven and slightly frayed edges. The entire object looks weathered and textured.

title: Three books: The Last Emperor , Hommage to Kolja, What It Could be
medium: Artist's book of glass and transparencies, with copper binding on marble stand
