alt_text: A sculpture of glass books with copper bindings sits on a circular green marble stand. The stand is dark green with white marble veins running through it. Three upright objects that look like small, thick books are arranged in a group on the marble base. The book on the left is filled with layers of printed text on translucent pages. The book in the back right displays a colorful map, while the small one in the center has a plain white front.

title: Landscape Narratives II
medium: Found and altered books and stones
alt_text: A sculpture of many small, rounded objects piled together on a plain, light-gray background. These objects are a mixture of smooth river stones and thick, white-edged chunks of altered books. The book pieces look like layers of paper stacked tightly, with some having vibrant patches of blue, red, green, or brown ink on their cut edges. The plain, natural stones are in various shades of gray, tan, and reddish-brown. The pieces are arranged in an informal, uneven cluster that mimics the appearance of a pile of pebbles.

title: All That's Left
medium: Artist’s book with gesso, paper, and glue
alt_text: A sculpture of an open artist's book with a textured, rounded object resting on its pages. The book is pure white, with blank pages that lie flat against a gray background. A small, rough-looking sphere sits directly in the center crease of the open book. This sphere is brown and tan in color, with a bumpy, organic surface texture. The contrast between the clean white book and the irregular brown shape is clear.

title: Book (hummingbird)
medium: Found and altered book with dead hummingbird, ribbons, fabric, and red ink
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered book sits against a plain gray background. The book has a dull green cover with a small, dark bird attached to the center. Several long, brown ribbon straps hang from the top and left side of the book, ending in small, round beads. The pages appear thick, worn, and yellowish, and they have frayed white fabric sticking out from the edges. Faint red splatters of ink or paint are visible near the bird and on the bottom edge of the cover.

title: Ab Initio
medium: Artist's book with rice paper and acrylics
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist's book is displayed fully open. The book has multiple panels standing upright in the back and several pages spread out horizontally in the front. The panels show high-contrast black and white designs, including a large ink splatter, a spiral, and complex, light-colored patterns on dark backgrounds. A rectangular cutout in the central upright panel reveals a textured, wavy surface beneath it. The overall color scheme is strictly black, white, and dark gray.

title: The Holy Sound
medium: Artist's book with rice paper and water color
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist's book made of rice paper. The upper part stands upright and features three distinct pages with unique textures. The left page shows a pattern of small dark dots, the middle page has a rectangular area with rippled texture, and the right page displays deep concentric circles. Below this, a separate section of pages lies flat on the surface. These pages show swirling dark grey patterns, rows of thin lines, and a dark oval shape that stretches across the right side. The entire work uses soft white paper and dark, ink-like marks throughout.

title: Implement of Knowledge
medium: Found and altered book with oil paint and wooden handle
alt_text: A sculpture consisting of a long, wooden handle attached to a head made of pages from a book. The light brown wooden handle is smooth and curved, stretching across the frame from the bottom left. At the top of the handle, the head of the object is shaped like an axe blade. This blade is constructed from a book that has been folded and opened at an angle. The edges of the paper pages are painted in shades of yellow and metallic orange, giving them a shiny appearance. The entire object is set against a plain, solid grey background.

title: Trophy: Harlequin
medium: Books, oil paint, applied gold leaf titles, brass sconces, horns.  These fictional Harlequin romance novel titles/authors include: Savage Capture, by Marabel Morgan; Heart Rustler, by Nancy Reagan; and Minx, by Camille Paglia
alt_text: A sculpture made of books, brass sconces, and horns shows a unique arrangement mounted on a wooden plaque. A set of nine red books is stacked vertically in a fan-like shape, with the tallest and thickest book in the center. The books feature gold-lettered titles on their spines and are held together by brass fixtures. Two large, curved animal horns extend outwards from the sides of these metal holders. The entire assembly is attached to a light-colored, shield-shaped piece of wood that hangs against a plain gray background.

title: Overlapping Pile of Books
alt_text: A black-and-white photograph shows an open book positioned horizontally against a solid black background. The pages of the book are fanned out, creating a textured shape that widens at both ends and is thinner in the middle. The book appears to be illuminated from the front, highlighting the edges of the many stacked pages. The contrast between the bright white edges of the paper and the deep black backdrop creates a stark, dramatic effect. Small, handwritten markings are visible in the white margin at the very bottom edge of the print.

title: Big Dictionary #2
alt_text: A photograph of a worn, thick book lying open on a dark, plain background. The book is angled so that its many pages are fanned out and clearly visible. The cover of the book is dark and appears rough with visible signs of wear and age. A section of the book's spine is slightly torn and hangs loose on the right side. The overall lighting is soft, highlighting the texture of the paper and the book's weathered condition.

title: Big Pile of Books
alt_text: A black-and-white photograph showing a precarious, stacked arrangement of old books against a solid black background. The books are positioned in a sculptural pile, with many resting open at different angles. One single book, with a dark spine and white lettering, sits horizontally near the top right of the group. Other books are tilted, angled, or fanned open, creating a complex, geometric shape that fills the center of the frame. The lighting highlights the rough edges of the pages and the textures of the worn book covers.

title: Heart-shaped Pile of Magazines
alt_text: A black-and-white photograph shows a single, flexible object resting against a dark background. The object is curved and folded into several smooth, repeating loops that create a shape somewhat like a reclining figure. Its surface appears to be made of thin, stacked sheets of light-colored material. The light catches the top edges of these curves, creating bright white lines that contrast with the deep shadows around them. The entire structure sits on a dark, flat surface and is framed by a white border.

title: On Barcelona
medium: Artist's book with plastic covers and lomography camera
alt_text: A sculpture shows a black book with a glossy plastic cover that has a rectangular cutout. A small, shiny gold camera is set into this cutout on the front cover. The book is slightly open, revealing a dark page on the right side. This page contains a list of numbered parts with the words "observe interpret respond" printed at the top. The overall design looks like a high-tech or modern object.

title: Unbound
alt_text: A sculpture made of cotton gauze and pigment shows two overlapping sheets of white fabric. The material looks like thin, woven mesh with a slightly rough texture. On the left side, dark, vertical dashed lines are marked onto the fabric. On the right side, there are small, dark, handwritten-looking scribbles and marks scattered across the surface. The entire piece rests against a plain, light-gray background.

title: Intervention: A Medieval Herbal, A Facsimile
alt_text: A manuscript book shows open pages filled with handwritten text and hand-painted illustrations of different plants. The left page features a tall, spindly plant with blue and green details next to a green bulbous plant with long, grass-like leaves. On the right page, two distinct plants with green leaves and small roots are drawn beside a square block of dense, dark script. All the illustrations are painted in soft, muted colors against the aged, tan paper. The surrounding background is plain, neutral gray.

title: Read'em & Wipe
medium: Found and altered book pages and toilet paper holder
alt_text: A sculpture made of found book pages and a metal toilet paper holder displays pages hanging like a roll of toilet paper. A single, tall, chrome-colored pole stands vertically on a rounded base. The roll of paper at the top consists of many light-tan pages of text that are stitched or pasted together to form one long, continuous sheet. This long strip hangs straight down, stopping just above the shiny base. The entire object is set against a plain, solid gray background.

title: The Flounder
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture shows an open book shaped like a teapot. The book's pages are textured with dark grey and white streaks to look like rock or stone. A smooth, black spout extends from the left side, while a curved black handle rises from the right. A small, round object with a white and black split design rests on the top of the open pages. The entire object sits flat on a neutral background.

title: Pageturner
medium: Found books, suitcase, security camera, microphone, motor, fans, motion sensor, monitor, and found book
alt_text: A sculpture showing a collection of electronic parts and a suitcase arranged on a black table. On the left sits a small, boxy television monitor with a square speaker resting on top of it. Next to the monitor is a tall, thin metal stand topped with a small security camera pointed toward the right. A large, open metal suitcase occupies the right side of the table. Inside the suitcase, various objects are attached, including a microphone, a small golden bowl, and scattered pages from books. Bright light shines from a small lamp attached to the inside of the suitcase lid, illuminating the contents.

title: The Song of Songs
medium: Artist's book of clear acetate, scotch tape, and mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture made of clear acetate pages shows a layered book design that appears transparent. On the left side, the pages display a fragmented illustration of a person with long, flowing reddish-brown hair. The right side features blocks of printed text that are heavily marked with blurry, dark, and reddish smudges. These pages are held within a frame made of thin, clear material with tape accents at the corners. The entire object has a deep, three-dimensional look because of the stacked, see-through layers.

title: The Silent Book
medium: Artist's book with photographic reproductions attached to leather girdle holder
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist's book is shown standing vertically on its end. The book is bound in smooth, dark green leather with a spine that features five raised bands. A long, floppy piece of the same green leather extends from the top of the spine and hangs down, creating a pouch-like shape to the left. A thin green leather strap is tied around the middle of this extended section. The cover of the book has faint stamped letters visible on its front surface.

title: Inside the Turtle
medium: Artist's book with silkscreened paper, ink, turtle shell, and turtle skeleton
alt_text: A sculpture made of an artist's book with paper, ink, and turtle parts. The object is a rectangular shape with a very rough, uneven surface that looks like dark, craggy rock. Set into the lower center of this dark material is the smooth, round, brown shell of a turtle. The background of the book-like structure features patches of faded color, including hints of blue, green, and reddish-brown. The overall appearance is dense and textured, with layers that look like they have been pressed or fused together.

title: Eighty Acres
medium: Artist's book with silkscreened paper and active fungus
alt_text: A sculpture shows a dense, oval-shaped object covered in thick, layered ridges that resemble tree bark or shelf fungi. Its colors range from deep browns and blacks to muted yellows and creams. Several small, pale, rounded structures protrude from the sides of the main body, giving it a bumpy texture. The entire object has a rough, decaying appearance with visible depth between the vertical folds. It sits on a plain surface against a neutral gray background.

title: COLLECTED WORKS, VOL. 7, DELUXE EDITION
medium: Found comic and coloring books with die cuts, wrapped in screenprinted poster
alt_text: A sculpture of an open comic book with several circular holes cut out of the pages. The left page shows a colorful comic strip with multiple panels depicting cartoon figures in various poses. The right page features a mix of text and graphics, including a drawing of a muscular figure and a blank form to fill out. These circular die-cut holes are scattered across both pages, revealing layers of pages stacked underneath. The entire book is open, showing its thick spine and many layered pages.

title: Fatherlaw
medium: Found and altered books on wooden shelves
alt_text: A sculpture of two altered books resting on separate white platforms. The books are standing upright with purple covers and gold-colored decorative patterns on the front. Narrow strips of paper, cut from the pages of the books, stretch horizontally between them. The strips are twisted and curved, connecting the two volumes like a bridge. The text from the original pages remains visible on these thin paper ribbons.

title: ME/THE
medium: Cloth-covered artist’s book with gold leaf
alt_text: A sculpture of a book made with blue cloth and gold leaf stands against a plain gray background. The book is rectangular and sits upright, with its front cover facing toward the left side of the frame. The pages of the book are completely covered in shiny, metallic gold. The blue cloth cover wraps around the spine and the back of the book, contrasting sharply with the bright gold pages. It is positioned at an angle so that both the side of the cover and the edge of the pages are clearly visible.

title: Cube
alt_text: A sculpture made of found and altered books shows a dense, rectangular block composed of many stacked and folded pages. The top surface consists of two flat, rectangular, reddish covers that meet in the center. The front face is a jumble of layered, tan-colored paper edges that swirl around a central point, creating a textured and organic pattern. On the right side of the block, a dark, vertical band wraps around the smooth, light-colored edge. The entire object rests against a plain, light grey background with a subtle shadow cast to the right.

title: Nest
medium: Found copy of The Royal English Dictionary with shredded and cut pages, hanging from transparent wire
alt_text: A sculpture of a book with its pages shredded into a fluffy, circular form hangs from a single transparent wire. The object is roughly spherical and made from thousands of thin, cut strips of paper. The paper strips are pale, cream-colored, and fan out in all directions to create a soft, feathery texture. The center of the piece is dense, while the outer edges appear airy and light. It is set against a plain, solid gray background.

title: MRS J.B. LANGRAST DID NOT RECOGNIZE HIM; SHE COULD NOT RECALL HIS VOICE
medium: Found and altered books with with paint, nails, and keys on masonite.
alt_text: A sculpture made from found books, paint, nails, and keys shows a face framed by various small, closed books. The arrangement of books forms a rectangular shape on a gray background, with different colors like red, orange, and brown covers. In the center, a painting of a person’s head and neck with a ruffled collar is surrounded by a large, heart-shaped pink form. Several metal keys are attached to the surface of the books and the painted heart, appearing to be stuck in place. Small, scattered marks and tiny objects decorate the space around the painted head.

title: Bookaxe
medium: Found dictionary with axe handle and hardware
alt_text: A sculpture of a book with an axe handle attached to it. The object looks like a heavy mallet, with a thick, hardcover dictionary serving as the head of the tool. A wooden axe handle is firmly inserted into the side of the book. On the front cover, two small, metallic pieces of hardware are fastened into the binding. The entire object rests on a plain, light grey background.

title: Eucologue
alt_text: A sculpture of a found and altered book shows the object cut into the shape of a capital letter E. The book’s cover is a mottled, dark brown color with a smooth, glossy surface. Three horizontal, shelf-like projections extend from the main spine-side block to form the letter’s arms. The cut edges of the pages are visible and appear as light beige or tan bands between the sections of the brown cover. The entire piece stands upright against a plain, neutral gray background.

title: The Things We Do for Love
alt_text: A sculpture made as an artist's book shows an open book structure with many pages arranged in a semi-circular shape. Two loop-like handles made of textured, light-colored material rise from the top of the structure. The outer covers of the book appear to be made of wrinkled or layered fabric. Inside, the pages are painted with blue and white sections, and red text that reads "Things Do Love" is visible on the right. A small, red, heart-shaped object sits in a rectangular cutout in the center of the book's spine area.

title: Potential
medium: Altered artist's book, textiles and plexiglass
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered book shows a damaged, light-beige fabric cover standing upright. A jagged hole is ripped through the center of the cover, revealing layers of inner pages inside. Several torn pieces of paper, some with spots of bright red paint, are scattered on the surface below the book. The book appears to be slightly opened at the top. The background is a simple, neutral gray color.

title: Mourning Miniature for S. Myers
medium: Watercolor on ivory, with natural and chopped hair, applied ivory (funerary plinth), gold wire, and applied pearls, in gold‑over‑copper locket; verso: hair overlaid with gold cipher “SM”
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a person standing beside a funerary monument. The person, dressed in a long white dress, leans toward a rectangular stone pedestal that sits under a large tree with drooping branches. The pedestal is divided into two panels, with text inscribed on each side that reads "SACRED WILL I KEEP THY DEAR REMAINS" and "S MYERS OB 15 OCT 1795." On top of the pedestal rests a small, dark, urn-shaped vessel decorated with tiny white beads. The entire circular scene is framed by a simple metallic border.

title: Memorial for Lucy Carew Tillinghast
medium: Watercolor on ivory in a rose-gold locket; verso: oil on paper and ink on gilt paper over straight hairwork
alt_text: A miniature painting in a rose-gold locket shows a woman outdoors. The woman, with light brown hair, kneels on the ground in a long, flowing dress that is tan and white. She is gesturing with one hand toward a large, white, stone-like urn to her left. Behind her, a large tree hangs over the scene, and tall, thin, dark green trees stand in the distance. The sky above is a pale, cloudy blue. The circular painting is enclosed in a shiny, smooth gold frame with a small loop at the top.

title: Horizontal Sculpture No. 3
alt_text: A sculpture made of painted wood that resembles a long, thin, weathered metal tool. The object features a raised, rectangular block at its center. Two long, tapering arms extend outward from this central block, curving slightly downwards at the ends. The surface is textured and painted with mottled shades of rust-orange, brown, and green, suggesting the appearance of aged metal. Hollow gaps are visible within the length of each arm, creating an open frame structure.

title: Passing Down
medium: Altered found book pages and nylon suspended from a wooden frame
alt_text: A sculpture features a square wooden frame containing four suspended objects. Each object consists of a round, textured sphere sitting inside a translucent, cone-shaped mesh sleeve. The spheres appear to be made of many tiny, overlapping layers of paper. Thin white cords attach the top point of each mesh sleeve to the underside of the wooden frame's top bar. The four sleeves hang at slightly different heights, giving the overall arrangement a staggered look.

title: Handy Man
medium: Altered and cut artist's book with wooden covers, leather binding, chains, and padlock
alt_text: A sculpture of a person standing against a plain, dark grey background. The figure has dark, shoulder-length hair and is wearing a grey zip-up hoodie over a teal shirt, paired with olive green pants and light brown shoes. Their hands are positioned in front of them, holding a rectangular book that has thick, light-colored wooden covers. The book appears to be bound with leather and has metal hardware attached to the spine and edges. The person looks directly at the viewer with a neutral expression.

title: Splits
alt_text: A brass sculpture shows two small, folded structures resting on a plain surface. Both objects are made of several triangular, metal plates joined together with thin threads. The plates have a weathered, metallic brown color with streaks of orange and gold. Small, circular holes are punched through the corners of many of these triangular panels. The structure on the left appears more open and fan-like, while the one on the right looks slightly more compact.

title: Health, Beauty, Honor
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture shows an orange rectangular soup box stacked on top of a base of tangled, translucent, pale yellow fibers. Bright red cords are wrapped tightly around the box and the fibers below, binding them together. A stack of small, rectangular orange papers rests on top of the box, held in place by the red cords. More orange papers extend outward from the front of the box like a beak. The entire structure sits on a flat, rectangular base colored with shades of blue and purple.

title: 50' Strand
medium: Altered found copies of "Growing Up in a Divided Society, an analysis of children's lives in South Africa under apartheid", wire, and thread
alt_text: A sculpture showing a long string of small, spool-shaped cutouts made of paper. The paper pieces are colored in various shades of red, blue, green, and yellow, and some appear to have printed text on them. The string of paper spools is coiled into a loose, circular pile in the foreground. A single, separate strand of the paper spools extends from the top of the pile and curves across the upper part of the image. The entire object rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Petit Larousse: Various Editions
medium: Framed miniature artist's books and pins
alt_text: A sculpture of miniature artist's books and pins displayed in a rectangular frame. Twelve tiny, book-like objects are arranged on a white background in three rows of four. These colorful rectangles vary in shade, including blue, red, maroon, and patterned designs. Each small object has a tiny white tag with text placed directly beneath it. A larger rectangular plaque sits at the bottom center of the frame with decorative text.

title: The Slow Ties of Love and Pain
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture showing a central box connected to three smaller, book-like objects. In the center, a dark, boxy structure has open compartments with a grid-like interior. Three smaller, flat stacks of dark material sit around the box on the left, right, and bottom sides. Many thin, black threads stretch out from the central box, attaching to each of these outer stacks. The entire arrangement is set against a solid, light gray background.

title: Spun Into Gold
alt_text: A sculpture made from a cut and altered artist's book shows a hardcover book closed in the center. The book has a textured, light olive-green cover featuring a small, square, metallic-gold inset in the middle. Bright yellow paper strips extend from the top and bottom edges of the book. These strips are densely packed and look like shredded paper, fanning out in a curved shape. The entire object rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Duster
medium: Printed and cut paper, wire and wood
alt_text: A sculpture of wood and printed paper shows a long, thin, vertical object resembling a mop. A straight, tan wooden pole stands upright in the center of the frame. At the top of the pole, a small, dark, twisted wire loop is attached. At the bottom of the pole, a large cluster of thin, white paper strips fans out toward the floor. These paper strips are covered in small, dark printed marks and appear to be cut into long ribbons. A dark band connects the wooden pole to the base of the paper strips.

title: From Dreams to Ashes
medium: Printed paper and photographic reproductions and matches in printed cardboard box
alt_text: A sculpture consisting of a dark, rectangular cardboard box structure that is open on one side. The tall, standing part of the box features printed, gritty black-and-white textures and holds a dense cluster of light-colored matchsticks pointing outward. Resting on the flat, extended base of the box is a smaller, separate rectangular sleeve. This sleeve is decorated with a pattern of overlapping pale circles and holds a thin, booklet-like object inside. The overall appearance is a mix of printed paper surfaces and found objects arranged in a box.

title: Ugly Women and Stupid Girls Make an Invaluable Treasure
alt_text: A sculpture of twined paper and a wooden spool sits against a gray background. A tall, black, cylindrical spool stands upright on the left. Thin, silver-colored paper is tightly wrapped around the spool in horizontal bands. A loose, silvery string hangs down from the top of the spool. This string trails to the right and connects to a messy, crumpled pile of the same silver paper.

title: Howards and Hoovers: A Sample Book of Chinese American Names
alt_text: A sculpture in the form of an artist's book displays many narrow, rectangular pages bound together at one end in a fan shape. Each page contains rectangular swatches of different colors and blocks of printed text. The colors shift from dark purples and blues on one side to softer pinks, oranges, and yellows on the other. The topmost page features a light grey grid pattern and text that reads "howards & hoovers." This object rests on a plain, grey background.

title: Study #1 for The World of Suzie Wong
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered book shows many pages folded upward to form a dense, rounded mound. The pages appear white or cream-colored and are densely packed together, obscuring the original text. A small patch of reddish, possibly stained, paper is visible on the far left side near the base. The book sits flat against a plain, light gray background. This arrangement creates a voluminous, organic texture that contrasts with the flat, hardcover spine visible at the bottom.

title: Surely All This Is Not without Meaning (Moby Dick)
medium: Found and cut copies of Herman Melville’s Moby Dick with tape
alt_text: A sculpture of a large, circular shape made from paper hangs on a plain white wall. The object is light tan in color and appears to be formed from many pieces of bound or taped paper. Its surface is not flat but has a series of folds, wrinkles, and indentations that create a rounded, bowl-like or concave appearance. These textures create subtle shadows across the surface, giving it a sense of depth and volume. The sculpture is centered in the image above a gray floor.

title: A Passage
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist's book lies open against a plain gray background. The left page of the book is smooth, white, and completely blank. The right page is made of a rough, textured paper with many vertical creases. Dark text is printed in a rectangular block on the textured right page. The edges of the paper appear to be torn and uneven, adding to the rough appearance of the book.

title: Cabin on Walden Pond
medium: Artist's book with wood, leather, dirt, plastic, and grass
alt_text: A sculpture of an open book lies flat on a light-colored surface. The book is bound in dark blue leather and lies open to reveal two internal pages. The left page is covered in a layer of dark, textured dirt with white text printed over it. The right page features a similar dirt-covered surface, but it also supports a three-dimensional wooden model of a building frame. This structure is constructed from thin, light-colored wooden slats that show the skeleton of a small, gabled building. Small, white, diagram-like drawings are also visible on the right page beneath the wooden frame.

title: Preserved Book (Series No. 4)
medium: Paper with ink, pebbles, and sand in a mason jar
alt_text: A sculpture made of paper, ink, pebbles, and sand in a mason jar. The glass jar has a round metal lid held shut with a metal clamp and a bright orange rubber seal. Inside the jar, several crumpled pieces of beige paper are stuffed together. The paper has handwritten text in dark ink on its visible surfaces. At the bottom of the jar, a layer of small, light brown pebbles and sand sits underneath the papers.

title: In Search of Paradise - Night Vision
alt_text: A sculpture showing a book with pages covered in thick, black strokes of material. The pages appear to be made of rigid, dark, board-like material stacked together. White splotches and streaks are visible within the darker areas, contrasting against the black surface. A small white label with a barcode sits at the bottom left of the dark structure. A gloved hand can be seen holding the corner of the object on the left side.

title: Umbra Terre [ Shadow on the earth]
medium: Toned Gelatin silver prints, polyester, Plexiglas, paint, ink, silicone and fluorescent light
alt_text: A sculpture showing an open book encased in a clear block of material with inner lighting. The book pages contain faint diagrams and text, with a reddish, textured base beneath it. Several small, separate photographic images are attached to the surface or embedded near the book. Thin, light-colored lines crisscross the entire surface of the display. The overall object is square and emits a soft, golden glow from inside the center of the book.

title: Electric Book
medium: Plastic artist's book with mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture made of plastic shows a large, book-shaped object sitting on a wooden pallet base. The main part of the piece is a translucent red, wavy sheet that looks like an open book. Three white, semi-circular arches are attached to the center of this plastic sheet, standing upright in a row. A small, rectangular tag with a barcode hangs from the center arch. Below the main object, the wooden pallet base has a red sticker that reads "FRAGILE" in white letters.

title: Book Faced Down - Embedded in Plaster
medium: Found cook book and plaster block
alt_text: A sculpture of a found cookbook inside a plaster block shows a rectangular, cream-colored plaster form sitting on a grey surface. A thick, off-white slab makes up the top part of the object, which appears heavy and solid. Embedded into the front bottom edge of this plaster, a partially visible, thin book lies open face-down. The brown, paper pages of the book are visible through a V-shaped cutout in the plaster. A touch of yellow-brown staining marks the plaster near the edges of the book.

title: Book Folded Back - Embedded in Plaster
medium: Found cook book and plaster block
alt_text: A sculpture featuring a cookbook embedded inside a rectangular block of white plaster. The book is open and positioned horizontally so its pages curve upward to form a cylinder. A vertical blue clip or tool holds the pages together at the center where the spine would be. A thin, dark line runs straight down from the bottom of the book's center into the solid plaster base. The plaster surrounding the book is stained with light brown marks, suggesting a seepage or discoloration.

title: Crinkled Text
alt_text: A sculpture made from an altered found book shows both pages covered in dense, crumpled bits of paper. These small paper scraps appear to be glued down in thick layers across the entire surface of the open pages. The scraps are brownish-tan in color, matching the aged, yellowed pages of the book. Each page is filled completely with this texture, leaving very little of the underlying page visible. The book itself lies flat against a plain, light grey background.

title: Paperback "Puzzle" Book
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered book shows two main fragments of yellowed paper pages that appear torn or burned. The larger piece on the left features printed lines of text with a ragged, hole-ridden edge along its top and center. A separate, smaller piece on the right displays a vertical column of numbers and words that look like a table of contents. Both fragments are covered in a shiny varnish that makes the paper look stiff and brittle. The empty space between the two parts reveals the plain grey background behind the object.

title: Wa
alt_text: A sculpture of two star-shaped objects sits against a plain gray background. Both objects are geometric spheres made of paper with printed text on it. The spheres have many sharp, pointed tips extending outward in all directions, creating a complex, open framework. One object is positioned slightly to the left and behind the other, which is closer and more centered. The light casts soft shadows beneath both of these intricate paper forms.

title: GOAT: A Tribute to Muhammad Ali
medium: Massive folio book in printed slipcase
alt_text: A massive folio book rests on a flat, neutral gray surface. The book is white with large, gold block letters on its spine that spell out "GOAT." On the front cover, two small, identical illustrations of a boxer appear against the white background. One boxer is positioned near the top left, and the other is near the bottom right, both shown in the same dynamic pose. The overall design is minimal and sparse, leaving most of the cover blank.

title: This - The History of Furniture
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered book shows a rectangular, terra-cotta orange cover. The letters "THIS" are laser-cut directly through the center of the front cover. Beneath the cutouts, a white surface is visible, creating shadows that add depth to the letters. Two small, dark rectangular marks are located on the far left and right edges of the book. The book sits against a neutral, light gray background.

title: This - Chateaux of the Loire
alt_text: An altered book sculpture shows the word "THIS" cut directly through the front cover. The book cover features a faded, greenish image of a large building reflecting in water. The word "THIS" is carved out in large, white-outlined block letters that create a deep, three-dimensional shadow effect on the pages beneath. On the left side of the cover, the word "LAROUSSE" appears in smaller white text. To the right of the cutout letters, the text "CHATEAUX OF THE LOIRE" is printed vertically in white. The entire object lies flat against a plain, light gray background.

title: Tenzin Gyatso
alt_text: A sculpture of three cut books sits against a plain background. One book is upright, showing a cover with a portrait of a person and the text "Tenzin Gyatso The Dalai Lama." A second book lies horizontally on its side, serving as a base and showing the text "Atomic Energy." A third, small, bright red book is placed vertically in the center, appearing to be cut directly into the other two books. The entire arrangement creates a cross-like shape, with parts of the covers reflecting slightly on the flat, horizontal surface.

title: Braque Scorpion Book
alt_text: A sculpture created from an altered and laser-cut found book shows a black cover with white text reading "twentieth-century masters" and "braque" at the top. The left edge of the book cover has been laser-cut with a jagged, repeating pattern. A three-dimensional scorpion shape is constructed in the center of the cover. This scorpion is made of layered metal or cut-out paper pages, showing dark and metallic silver edges. It is angled to face towards the bottom right of the cover.

title: Tower Book
medium: Artist’s books with linoleum prints in a cloth covered custom structure
alt_text: A sculpture showing a rectangular, cloth-covered structure that looks like a small building. It has a flat, roof-like top that hangs over a middle section. This middle section features a graphic print of two large, almond-shaped eyes set against a black background. The base is made of stacked rectangular blocks that are covered in the same textured, grey material as the roof. The entire object stands upright against a plain, solid grey background.

title: Inconclusive Evolution
medium: Photocopy transfer and collage in found pocket book
alt_text: A sculpture featuring a piece of printed paper tucked inside an old pocket book. The pocket book is made of dark, textured material and sits on the right side. A long, wavy strip of white paper extends from the opening of the bag toward the left. This paper displays a black-and-white print of a large bird with its wings spread wide. The strip of paper rolls up at the very end on the left, secured by a small wooden dowel.

title: Topography
alt_text: A sculpture of sandblasted glass and pigment shows a stack of twelve square glass plates resting on a black base. Thin, vertical metal rods connect the corners of the glass plates to keep them aligned in a cube shape. White lines are etched onto the surface of each glass sheet, creating a faint, layered topographic pattern. Text is also visible in small letters on several of the glass layers. The entire object sits against a plain, light grey background.

title: The Art of War
alt_text: A bamboo sculpture showing a folded book made of thin, rectangular strips. The book is composed of many slender, orange-colored bamboo slats that are bound together by thread, creating a long, accordion-folded surface. Each slat features neat, vertical columns of black ink characters written from top to bottom. On the far right, a dark, rectangular cover with gold Chinese characters sits flat, hinged to the stack of slats. The entire structure rests against a plain, light grey background, highlighting the contrast between the dark cover and the lighter bamboo pages.

title: Vidas Paralelas (Parallel Lives)
alt_text: A sculpture of two sets of packaged books and objects sits against a plain background. On the left, a rectangular book with a red cover featuring an eagle is wrapped in plastic alongside a cylindrical container holding three yellow tennis balls. On the right, a rectangular book with a dark cover featuring a spotted leopard is wrapped in plastic with a yellow tool that has a handle and a small metal head. Both packages are attached to larger rectangular backing boards printed with text and graphics in red, white, and black. A small white paper tag with a barcode hangs from the bottom center of the arrangement.

title: Great Works of Art and What Makes Them Great
medium: Found copy of Frederick Ruckstull’s Great Works of Art and What Makes Them Great with 22-karat gold-over-copper egg
alt_text: A sculpture of a red hardcover book lies flat against a plain, light-gray background. The book is rectangular and has a textured, cloth-like cover in a muted red color. Near the top center of the cover, a thin gold rectangle frames the book’s title and author name in gold text. The spine of the book is visible on the left side, appearing slightly darker than the front cover. Though the description mentions an additional object, only the closed book is visible in this view.

title: Eleven Colophon
medium: Artist's book with felt covers, attached to wooden display stand
alt_text: An artist's book with felt covers attached to a wooden display stand, resting on a round base. The dark grey, round base sits flat on a surface against a neutral background. On the left side of the base, a small, angled wedge is propped up. To the right sits the dark, rectangular book, which features a thin metallic spine and two indented vertical rectangles on its cover. The entire arrangement appears to be mounted on a smooth, grey circular platform.

title: How I Built a Wall by Dancing
medium: Artist's book of felt, clay pigment, wax, string, fur, and leather
alt_text: An artist's book lies open on a smooth gray surface. Its covers and pages are constructed from layers of thick, brown felt and dark brown animal fur. The edges of the book are rough and irregular, showing different layers of materials stacked together. Some of the internal pages appear to be made of smooth, light-colored leather or parchment. A small, orange-brown piece of material is visible at the very center of the book's spine.

title: Treasury
alt_text: A sculpture made of altered found books and glue showing a collection of small objects and containers. At the top sits an open wooden box with a lid, and below it, a smaller open drawer filled with items like a cross and a circular disk. To the right lies a small hand mirror with a rectangular glass face and a handle. Scattered below are several small shapes, including a comb, a butterfly cutout, a standing figure, and a thin, dark teal rectangular object. A dark ribbon connects a small locket-like piece to a heart-shaped object on the left side of the arrangement.

title: Big Book
medium: 5,000 sheets of copy paper, bound together
alt_text: A sculpture made of bound paper shows a stack of white sheets opened into an arch shape. The stack is divided into two main sections that curve upward from the center. The paper is bright white and creates a smooth, rounded top edge. Thousands of thin pages are visible along the sides of the paper blocks. The object sits centered against a plain gray background.

title: Altered Book Landscape
alt_text: A sculpture made from a found and cut book displays a carved shape on its open pages. The dark blue book cover sits on the left side and curves over the top of the pages. The pages are fanned out and cut into layers that create an undulating, wavy landscape. These tan paper layers rise and fall like hills and valleys across the right side of the book. The entire sculpture rests on a plain, light grey background.

title: Terminal Interface One
medium: Found book with soil and a pine stick in redwood mount
alt_text: A sculpture made of a found book, soil, and a pine stick held in a redwood mount. A thick wooden frame surrounds a rectangular center filled with dark soil. In the middle of the soil, a white symbol shaped like a backward letter E stands out against the dirt. A thin, curved pine stick is held horizontally across the bottom of the frame by two small wooden clips. Extending from the top center of the frame is a small, square wooden box attached by a vertical wooden post. The entire piece is set against a plain, light gray background.

title: Quilt Memories
medium: Artist’s book with quilted fabric, etchings, paper, newspaper, and dried plants
alt_text: An artist's book shows two open pages with very different textures. The left page is covered in a worn, quilted fabric with a pattern of tiny white dots on a reddish-brown background and patches of dark blue. The right page features a plain, textured piece of white paper centered on the quilted fabric. On this white paper, there is a small, rectangular insert containing a simple red line drawing of a hunched figure standing in profile. The edges of the book are frayed and uneven, revealing the layered materials used to construct it.

title: Redline
medium: Found and cut copy of New York City 5 Borough Pocket Atlas
alt_text: A sculpture made from a cut copy of a city atlas shows two open, spiral-bound pages. The original map pages have been meticulously sliced into thin, winding strips of paper that cross over one another in a dense, complex pattern. Bright red lines dominate the view, creating a tangled, web-like effect across both pages. Below the red strips, glimpses of white paper, faint blue shapes, and small, unreadable text suggest the original map underneath. The edges of the book are bound by a white plastic coil that runs down the center of the image.

title: Book from the Sky
medium: Four hand-printed artist’s books in a wooden case
alt_text: A sculpture of four hand-printed artist’s books is shown with a wooden case. On the far left, a wooden rectangular lid is placed face up on a gray surface. In the center, an open wooden box holds a stack of thin books bound in blue paper covers with white stitching. To the right, an open book displays cream-colored pages filled with vertical columns of black printed text. A second, closed blue book lies partly underneath the open one, showing its spine.

title: The Post Testament
alt_text: An artist's book lies open, displaying two pages of printed text side by side. The pages are creamy white with black ink arranged in two columns of dense paragraphs. A thin, dark brown ribbon acts as a bookmark, running vertically down the center crease where the two pages meet. The ribbon hangs down slightly below the bottom edge of the open book. Dark covers are visible on the far left and far right sides, framing the bright, open pages.

title: Roosevelt: The Lion and the Fox
medium: Found book, fired in an electric kiln, with detached laminated cover
alt_text: A sculpture showing a dense, crumpled object that resembles a stack of wavy paper. The object is primarily a creamy white color, with soft folds and layers throughout its body. A section near the center has a faint, pale pink tint, contrasting slightly with the white surrounding it. The texture looks very fragile and brittle, with many sharp, crinkled edges. It sits against a solid, dark gray background.

title: The Necessity of Friction
medium: Found copy of How Much is Too much?, electric motor, steel, magnesium, and sandpaper
alt_text: A sculpture shows a red book being held above a spinning gray disc. The disc is circular and made of a rough, dark material that looks like sandpaper. A long black metal arm reaches up from the side of the disc to hold the book in place. The red book is positioned horizontally, with its edge resting against the surface of the spinning plate. Underneath the disc, three metal legs support the entire object.

title: Paper Towels
medium: Metal paper towel dispenser with handmade paper towels
alt_text: A metal sculpture shows a wall-mounted paper towel dispenser. The dispenser is a rectangular box made of brushed silver metal. Near the top center of the unit, there is a round metal lock. At the bottom, a thin horizontal gap allows a single sheet of white paper to hang down. The dispenser sits against a plain, solid grey background.

title: Self-Reference
medium: Found reference books in custom book case with christmas lights
alt_text: A sculpture of a square opening cut into a dark, polished wood surface. The edges of this square hole are lined with the spines of many old books arranged vertically. The books have covers in shades of red, tan, and faded green. The inside of the opening glows with a soft, warm light from within. A smooth, light-colored surface is visible at the very bottom of the shaft.

title: Visionaire 43 Dreams
medium: Artist's book with laser-cut paper in custom slipcase
alt_text: An artist's book with laser-cut paper in a custom slipcase shows a black box viewed from an angle. The front cover is entirely covered in a repeating grid pattern that resembles many small windows on a tall building. These windows are created by laser-cut openings that reveal a silver layer beneath the black surface. The title of the book appears in small white letters near the bottom right corner of the cover. A matching vertical row of small squares runs down the spine of the book, which also features the same title text.

title: Yi Bimo's (Priest's) Manuscript
medium: Bamboo with black ink with leather covers
alt_text: A sculpture of bamboo strips bundled together with dark, textured leather covers. The bundle is tied securely with a piece of rough, twisted tan string. Several vertical bamboo slats are visible on the right side, showing black handwritten characters on their light brown surfaces. The entire bundle rests on a sheet of clear plastic bubble wrap. A white paper identification tag with a barcode hangs from the bottom of the object.

title: Tournedos de Sable
medium: Handmade paper scrolls with collage and ribbons, in plexi case
alt_text: A sculpture of paper scrolls arranged in a rectangular clear plastic case. There are fifteen small scrolls organized into three neat rows of five. Each scroll is wrapped with a thin ribbon and features various colors, textures, and fragments of text on the paper. A rectangular white tag with a barcode and black numbers is attached to one of the middle scrolls. The entire container has a handle at the bottom and rests on a flat, light-colored surface.

title: Fragments of Light V
medium: Plastic, thread, and reflective plastic material
alt_text: A sculpture of plastic, thread, and reflective material displays four rectangular panels arranged in a cross shape around a central red square. Each white panel is divided into rows by thin black lines and contains black text written in an unfamiliar script. On the left and right panels, thin strings extend outward to small, colorful beads. Another string attached to the bottom panel hangs down and loops into a knot with a bead. The entire object sits flat against a plain, light grey background.

title: Feverish Text
alt_text: A sculpture made from a found, cut, and altered book shows an open volume with text pages on either side. The center of the book contains many vertical, stacked paper edges. On each open page, a circular, layered wooden object sits embedded in a clump of white, textured material. These two objects are roughly identical in size and shape, looking like small, flat cones. The book pages themselves have a warm, brownish-orange tint.

title: The Botanist's Keepsake
alt_text: A sculpture that is an artist's book shows a fan-shaped collection of cream-colored paper pages bound by two long, gray, rounded panels. The top gray panel features a bright, four-pointed orange star in its center. A thin black string attaches the book to a separate, solid gray square object that rests flat on the surface below. To the right of the book, a small white rectangular label with a barcode and black text sits on the table. The entire assembly is displayed against a plain, light gray background.

title: Visionaire No. 55 Surprise
medium: 11 pop-up books in a cloth-covered case
alt_text: A sculpture consisting of a cloth-covered case showing a deep purple rectangular box standing upright. The box features two doors that meet in the center, running vertically along the front face. A small, rectangular silver label is centered across the seam of these doors. The text on the label reads "VISIONAIRE 55" followed by some smaller, unreadable words. The entire object sits on a plain, light grey background.

title: Tallis of Lost Prayers
alt_text: A sculpture made of paper, thread, and beads features three layered, fan-like shapes arranged in a cluster. Each shape is densely pleated and resembles a ruffled cuff or a bundle of layered materials. The colors range from soft blush pink to tan and brown, with textured, decorative bands of thread and tiny beads wrapping around sections of each piece. On the surfaces of these bundles, stitched or beaded designs clearly show the shape of human hands with outstretched fingers. These three elements are positioned closely together against a plain, solid grey background.

title: Re-Breaking the Codex
medium: Altered and cut artist's book with wooden stand
alt_text: A sculpture of an altered book sits inside a dark red box. The book pages have been cut and stacked to form an oval shape that resembles a track or a nest. Inside the oval, the paper edges create a tight, striped pattern of white and gold. The cover of the box is dark with red lighting on the left side and has text printed on it vertically. A small white label with a barcode lies on the bottom edge of the open box.

title: books28Citizens, from the series Saved Books
alt_text: A sculpture made of an altered and cut found book shows a tall, pointed shape covered in thin, white paper strips. The object tapers to a narrow, dark brown tip at the very top. Below this tip, the body of the sculpture is entirely composed of hundreds of long, curved, and overlapping strips of white paper. These paper strands cascade downward and outward, creating a dense, shaggy, and messy appearance. The entire object stands centered against a solid, deep black background.

title: Lamp Project
alt_text: A wooden cabinet shows an interior filled with many colorful, round lightbulbs. The cabinet has two open doors that reveal shelves lined with bulbs of various sizes and shades like red, yellow, blue, and green. Attached to the top of the cabinet, several other bulbs stand upright on thin, flexible black stalks against a yellow background. A row of small, circular white knobs sits centered on the wooden frame just above the cabinet doors. Inside the cabinet, a separate, small black rectangular base sits on the bottom shelf with several small upright stems.

title: Fusion Arts Book, 2/10
alt_text: A sculpture of mixed media shows two rectangular cases positioned next to one another against a plain gray background. The object on the left is a vintage-style suitcase decorated with abstract splashes of pink, purple, and green, along with small, attached items like a plastic star and metal bottle caps. Beside it stands a tall, upright box painted in shades of bright yellow and orange at the top, fading into a scene of green and magenta at the bottom. This front box displays a painted structure with columns, surrounded by several small, dark, human-like figures. A small, textured square piece is attached to the center of the yellow sky area, appearing to explode with tiny dots. The overall effect creates a contrast between the cluttered, textured appearance of the suitcase and the flatter, more illustrated look of the upright box.

title: Martin Rattler Purse
medium: Found bookcover, wooden beads, and button
alt_text: A sculpture made of a found book cover, wooden beads, and a button shows a small handbag shaped like a rectangular book. The front of the bag is bright red with a blue rectangular panel on the left side featuring drawings of red flowers. To the right of the flowers, gold letters spell out two words. A handle made of two strings of dark, round, wooden beads is attached to the top of the bag. A small, blue button sits on the top edge between the handle attachments. The sides of the bag are covered in a dark red and black floral pattern.

title: Spectral Nine
alt_text: A painting of nine square panels arranged in a three-by-three grid. Each square contains a series of concentric, smaller squares that fade from a bright, solid color in the center to lighter tones at the edges. The colors of these squares shift gradually across the grid, moving from bright yellow and orange in the top-left to deep orange and greenish-brown in the bottom-right. Thin, straight lines form the concentric square patterns within each panel. The overall effect creates a sense of depth as the inner squares appear to recede into the center of each panel.

title: Christ Crowned with Thorns; Christ Carrying the Cross; The Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting on wood panels shows a central image flanked by two smaller scenes. The main center panel features a close-up portrait of a man with long hair, a beard, and a crown of thorns that drips red streaks. Behind his head is a large, circular gold halo with faint lettering around the edge. On the left side panel, a figure in a red robe carries a large wooden cross on their shoulder. On the right side panel, a figure is depicted hanging from a cross above a small pile of rocks with a skull at the base.

title: Landscape
alt_text: A painting of an autumn forest landscape with a foreground filled with fallen logs. A large, weathered tree trunk lies horizontally across the lower part of the scene, surrounded by dried grasses, small white wildflowers, and patches of bright red leaves. Behind the fallen wood, the ground rises gently toward a dense line of trees in the distance. These trees are painted in warm shades of orange, yellow, and brown, suggesting the changing colors of the fall season. A single, tall, slender tree with few branches stands prominently near the center, rising above the rest of the woods against a pale, cloudy sky.

title: The Title Makers
alt_text: A painting of a vertical rectangle filled with complex, colorful geometric patterns. The entire border consists of a tight grid of small, multi-colored squares. Toward the top, several large, solid-colored diamond shapes point downward against a dark background. In the middle section on the left, a large, bright white circle is surrounded by several thick rings of different colors. The bottom portion of the image displays a row of small, repetitive triangles pointing up and down in alternating colors.

title: AFTQ
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes on a pale, textured grey background. Two long, white horizontal bars stretch across the center, tilted slightly upward toward the right. Between these bars, there are short, thin red diagonal lines that appear to connect the white bands. Near these red lines, small blocks of colorful, multi-layered stripes sit parallel to the white bars. Several simple black horizontal lines are also placed near these colorful shapes.

title: Sfera
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a large, smooth sphere that appears to be cracked open. The sphere has a shiny gold finish and reflects the light. Deep inside the gap, the sculpture reveals a complex interior filled with many jagged, rectangular, and gear-like shapes. The object sits on a solid, dark, rectangular base that elevates it from the surface. The background is a simple, neutral gray.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painted wood sculpture of a long, narrow block hangs against a solid grey background. The object has a light, marbled brown surface with smooth, flat sides. It is shaped like a rectangular box with slanted ends, tapering slightly toward the sides. The sculpture is mounted so it appears to float in the center of the frame. A deep, dark shadow is cast directly beneath the object, suggesting it is suspended away from the wall.

title: Self-Portrait (Ronne’s Wreath)
alt_text: A painting of a person's head and shoulders is centered against a flat, grey background. The person faces forward and wears a small crown made of tiny blue and yellow flowers. Their face is painted with thick, visible brushstrokes in shades of brown, peach, and reddish tones. They have a serious expression with their mouth slightly open. Below the neck, the figure wears a simple white garment.

title: Still Life with Blue and White Tablecloth
alt_text: A painting of food and objects arranged on a table covered with a blue-and-white cloth. At the center sits a large green plate holding two pale stalks and small orange fruits next to a small knife. To the left of the plate, two green pears rest on the fabric. To the right of the plate, a round yellow fruit sits by itself. Near the back of the table, a dark jar, a small green cucumber, and a red bell pepper are scattered across the surface. A small mirror hanging on the wall above reflects the table and some of the objects.

title: Yellow Flowers/Black Song
medium: Oil and mixed media on canvas
alt_text: A painting of vibrant flowers on a dark, textured background. Thick, raised strokes of oil paint in bright yellow, deep red, and dark green create the forms of petals and leaves across the upper portion of the canvas. A dark, rectangular shape sits in the lower center, composed of blocky, patch-like layers. Two vertical, textured bands in a light brown or tan color frame the left and right sides of the image. The entire surface appears heavy with layered paint, giving it a rough and tactile quality.

title: Two-Eared Cat
alt_text: A stainless steel sculpture shows a large, hanging geometric structure. It is shaped like an inverted pyramid that tapers down to a single point at the bottom. The object is constructed from thin metal rods arranged in a repeating grid pattern. These rods are connected by wires, creating a delicate, web-like appearance against the plain background. The sculpture hangs from the top center and widens as it extends downward.

title: Exangulous
medium: Aluminum, stainless steel, iron, and bronze, with polychrome patina
alt_text: A sculpture made of aluminum, stainless steel, iron, and bronze shows a tall, abstract figure against a plain background. The top of the sculpture features a bright blue, textured hat shape with a tall, narrow orange and pink fin-like piece pointing straight up. Below the hat, the sculpture has a mesh-like green and yellow body that looks like a honeycomb or egg carton. To the left, a dark brown, curved, cage-like structure sits at the base. On the right side, a long, thin, silver metal rod rises vertically, twisting into a corkscrew spiral shape that stretches from the base to the top of the sculpture.

title: Square Saint-Pierre, Paris
alt_text: A painting of a sunlit garden path with a lone figure standing under the trees. The scene features a light-colored, winding path that leads into the distance from the lower left. Many tall, green trees with dense leaves create a row along the middle of the composition. A person wearing a hat and a reddish-orange top stands quietly on the path near the base of the trees. The entire sky is covered in thick, textured brushstrokes of pale blue and white. On the right side, lush bushes and colorful flowers border the path before a glimpse of a house roof appears in the background.

title: Study for the Virgin and Child with Saints Cecilia and Agnes
alt_text: A painting in shades of brown showing a woman standing in the center holding a small baby. Two figures kneel on either side of her, looking up toward the central woman and child. The figure on the left has her hands crossed against her chest. The figure on the right is holding a small animal, possibly a lamb, in her arms. The entire scene is painted with a soft, glowing light against a dark and shadowy background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, swirling forms covers the canvas in layers of bright and dark colors. Thick, curved brushstrokes in deep black dominate the lower half, sweeping across from left to right. Above these dark marks, patches of vibrant red and blue are layered over the cream-colored background. Fine splatters and dots of white, black, and blue paint are scattered throughout the composition. The entire image has a chaotic and energetic feeling created by the overlapping paint.

title: Work
alt_text: A painting shows a large, solid field of bright orange-red color. Floating in the center of this background is a single, large, circular shape. This shape is painted in a muted off-white color that forms a ring or border. A thin sliver of bright yellow color peeks out from underneath parts of the white ring. The orange-red paint covers both the outside and the inside of this circular ring.

title: Work
alt_text: A painting shows a human head silhouette centered against a solid black background. The shape of the head is pale pink and filled with swirling, blended colors including yellow, green, and light blue. Extending from the right side of the profile, a spray of light-colored, textured material stretches out into the black space. A distinct, reddish-orange band of bumpy texture marks the lower right edge of the face. The overall texture is smooth and paint-like in some areas, while other parts appear rough and studded with small stones.

title: Love and Death
alt_text: A painting of a tall woman dressed in long, flowing robes standing on a step. She leans forward, reaching her right arm toward the right side of the frame. A smaller, nude figure with wings stands to her right, facing the woman and resting a hand on her. Both figures are set against a dark background, with the woman's cream-colored dress highlighted by warm light. The steps they stand on are colored in shades of light brown and yellow.

title: Katherine Dreier's Living Room
medium: Silkscreen on canvas, with artist's frame
alt_text: A painting of a room with slanted wooden ceiling beams appears in monochrome shades of greenish-yellow. A large, floor-to-ceiling bookshelf filled with many books covers the back wall. In the foreground, a low table sits in front of a soft armchair, with a table lamp nearby. A large, rectangular glass partition stands on the right side of the room, partially obscuring a view of objects behind it. The overall image has a grainy texture, similar to a newspaper print.

title: Frauen vor dem Haus
alt_text: A painting of two figures standing outdoors near a small white house. Both figures have dark hair and are wearing simple, blocky clothing in shades of brown, green, and blue. The person on the left leans forward and holds a thin walking stick, while the person on the right stands straight with their hands clasped. Each figure carries a plain dark basket at their side. The background features simple shapes in earthy tones that suggest a rustic landscape.

title: Le canal
alt_text: A painting of a straight canal stretching into the distance between two rows of bare trees. The tall trees have thin, brown branches and create a symmetrical path on both the left and right sides. A pale, light-blue sky hangs over the landscape with a few distant, darker-toned trees visible near the horizon. Beside the water, a flat path runs parallel to the trees on each bank, marked by small, dark figures spaced evenly apart. The water in the foreground is dark and reflects the scene above, while the ground near the banks is a pale, muted green.

title: Tile Note #2
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture showing an open book with small pottery shards attached to its pages. The pages are a textured, tan color and have codes written below each fragment. The book lies flat against a plain grey background. Twelve unique, colorful shards of pottery are arranged in two columns on the left and right pages. The edges of the book are dark brown, and the pages have a thick, carved appearance.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a house in a lush, green landscape. A white house with a dark roof sits on a hill in the upper-left part of the scene. Below the house, a path leads down through fields of deep green grass and foliage. On the right side, a cluster of tall, dark green trees fills much of the view. A bright, light-yellow patch appears in the distance behind the house, suggesting fields or cleared land. The sky above is a mix of pale blue and soft gray clouds.

title: If Not Now, When?
alt_text: A painting of simple white lines on a solid black background. A thin vertical line runs down the center of the square frame, and a horizontal line crosses it near the bottom. Two curved lines sweep across the image, intersecting the straight lines in different places. The lines are all a consistent, bright white color. The black background is uniform, creating a sharp contrast with the geometric white shapes.

title: Portrait of Philippe-Grégoire Delaroche, the Artist's Younger Son
alt_text: A painting of a young boy facing forward with a serious expression. He has short, wavy, reddish-brown hair and large, dark eyes. The boy wears a pale blue-grey shirt with a white collar and a dark blue necktie tied in a bow. His arms are folded across his chest. The background is a simple, light-colored wash that fades into white.

title: Thin Long Turnover—Model 26—Yellow
alt_text: A painting shows two rectangular panels layered on top of each other against a plain white background. The larger panel on the left is a solid, bright orange color and sits slightly in front of the other. This orange panel has two small, circular indentations or surface marks, one near the top and one near the bottom. Behind it, a wider but shorter yellow panel extends to the right. The entire composition has straight edges and square corners, creating a simple, layered shape.

title: Radiant Quadrant
alt_text: A painting of geometric shapes filled with thin, radiating lines. The central part of the image is a diamond shape, which is filled with lines that spread out from the very center toward the edges. Surrounding this central diamond, the pattern continues, but the lines bend to form rectangular zig-zag borders. The entire composition uses alternating red and teal lines, creating a vibrating effect. This pattern repeats to fill the square frame of the artwork.

title: John Aylsworth
alt_text: A painting of a young man sitting at a desk. He has light brown hair and pale skin, and he wears a dark suit with a black high-collared shirt. In his right hand, he holds a white quill pen that rests against the back of his wooden chair. His left hand rests on the edge of a red-painted wooden table. On the table sits a document covered in handwritten script and a small wooden box. A piece of fabric hangs loosely from the dark brown wall in the background behind him.

title: The Judgment of Midas
alt_text: A painting showing a lively gathering of people and creatures in a woodland setting. A man with a white beard sits in the center wearing a bright red cloth around his waist, while a person in blue and white robes stands nearby playing a violin. To the right, a creature with goat-like legs plays a small flute while other figures look on. In the foreground, several women with bare shoulders sit or kneel on the ground wearing colorful draped fabric. On the far right, a muscular figure with horse-like legs sits facing away from the group with an arm raised in the air. The scene is framed by dark trees on either side and opens to a lighter sky in the background.

title: Carving 12
alt_text: A sculpture of a found book treated with wax stands against a plain background. The rectangular object has been carved away on its front edge to create a deep, empty space. This hollowed-out area reveals swirled, layered patterns in shades of brown, gray, and tan, suggesting a wax substance has been shaped into the pages. The right side of the object remains intact, showing the original spine and edges of the thick book. The entire piece has a smooth, polished appearance throughout.

title: Reading Our Remains #28
medium: Found book pages with wax and thread
alt_text: A sculpture of found book pages with wax and thread shows a dense, irregular mass that sits centered against a plain gray background. The object is composed of many layers of paper that have been crumpled, folded, and bunched together to create a rough, textured surface. Pale, off-white paper edges contrast with the dark, shadowed, and ink-filled inner crevices. Tiny, thin threads are visible, stitching and binding the crumpled paper clusters into a single, cohesive form. The overall shape is somewhat rounded but jagged, resembling a gnarled rock or a cluster of dried blossoms.

title: Procession
alt_text: A sculpture made of a found book, steel, brass, and paint shows an object with a tall, vertical black spine rising from its center. This black element sits on top of a rounded, light-colored object that looks like the pages of a closed book. Two flat, rectangular panels painted in light blue extend horizontally from the sides of the book. The blue panels appear to be made of small, thin sections fastened together. The entire piece rests on a smooth, gray background and casts a dark, rectangular shadow underneath.

title: Nixon on Horseback
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a person riding a horse. The dark, metal figure shows a rider sitting hunched over in a saddle. The rider wears a wide hat and long coat with arms folded close to the body. Beneath the rider, the horse stands still with its head turned slightly to the right. The entire piece rests on a rectangular, textured base.

title: George Bush
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an extremely thin, elongated human figure in motion. The figure is captured in a stride, with one leg reaching far forward and the other trailing behind. Its long, spindly arms are outstretched, with one reaching forward and the other pushed back behind the body. The surface of the bronze is dark brown, textured, and rough, giving the figure a jagged appearance. The sculpture stands on a rectangular wooden base.

title: Still Standing
medium: Wood, felt, foam, clay, horsehair, and mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture of a life-sized mannequin wearing a simple dress. The figure stands straight and faces forward with arms hanging at its sides. It has light, short hair and a smooth, neutral-colored face. The dress is a pale, peachy-beige color and features a vertical seam down the center of the chest and skirt. The entire form is supported by a square, light-colored wooden base.

title: Dining table and set of twelve chairs
alt_text: A wooden furniture set features a large, rectangular dining table surrounded by several matching chairs. The long table has a smooth, polished brown surface with a subtle chevron wood grain pattern. Each chair is made of dark wood with white cushioned seats and backrests. The chairs are arranged in two rows along the sides of the table, with one chair positioned at the near front left. The entire setting rests on a light-colored woven floor covering in a bright, sunlit room.

title: Umbra 40
alt_text: A painting made of fiber, gold leaf, and acrylic displays a tall, rectangular shape covered in a rich, metallic gold texture. The entire surface consists of dense, curving lines that resemble the organic grain patterns of wood or perhaps flowing water. These lines swirl and loop around several small, knot-like centers throughout the piece. A few thin, dark red cracks or gaps appear near the left and bottom edges, revealing a different layer underneath. The overall effect is one of movement and depth, despite the flat, fibrous material of the work.

title: Il contadino
alt_text: A painting showing a person standing in a dark, outdoor setting. The person is viewed from behind and slightly to the side, wearing a dark vest and light-colored pants. They are bent forward as if looking at or tending to something on the ground. A thin, dark shape resembling a small tree or bush stands to their right. The entire scene is captured in very dark, muted tones with blurred edges.

title: Strada con case e cipressi
alt_text: A painting of a landscape showing a road leading towards a building. The road curves from the lower right toward the center of the frame, colored in shades of grey and blue. To the left of the road, a sloped hill rises, painted in earthy orange and green tones. Behind the hill, three tall, slender green trees stand against a pale blue sky. On the right side, a plain, light-colored building with dark-grey walls recedes into the distance. The painting is encased in an ornate, textured, metallic-gold frame.

title: Street and Mountain
alt_text: A painting of a quiet landscape with buildings nestled against a hill. Two dark, tall trees stand prominently on the left, with another similar tree rising on the right side. In the center, a series of pale, blocky shapes suggest small houses or structures built into the hillside. The foreground is a wide, textured area filled with soft, muted purple and grey tones. The sky above is hazy and light, completing this blurry, dreamlike scene.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting made of mixed media shows abstract, swirling forms in muted shades of gray, brown, and off-white. On the right side, a darker vertical shape curves slightly, suggesting the form of a slender person or a tree trunk. To the left, a large, light-colored, rounded shape sits against a backdrop of blurry, washed-out colors. Thin, dark lines weave through the composition, adding texture and movement. The overall image has a sketch-like appearance with soft, blended edges and vague, undefined shapes.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of abstract, blurry shapes and faint lines set against a muted, brownish-grey background. On the right side, a dark, vertical form resembling a figure stands out against the hazy surface. To the left, several soft, white, curved lines suggest light or movement within the shadowy space. Scattered throughout the scene are thin, short, dark marks that look like scratches or pencil strokes. The entire composition feels soft and indistinct, as if the forms are fading into a fog.

title: Vaso di fiori
alt_text: A painting of a simple floral arrangement sits in a rectangular, wooden frame with a beige mat. A slim, white vase stands in the center of a table, holding a small bouquet of soft, pinkish-orange flowers with green leaves. Several loose, fallen petals are scattered on the tabletop to the left of the vase. The background is a wash of pale, blended colors, creating a soft and hazy atmosphere behind the flowers. The entire scene is painted with loose, visible brushstrokes.

title: Vaso di rose
alt_text: A painting of a simple flower arrangement in a light blue vase. The vase sits on a flat, tan surface in front of a plain, light grey background. Three delicate pink flowers with green leaves emerge from the narrow opening of the vase. The painting is enclosed within a classic wooden frame that has a thin gold trim. In the bottom right corner of the painting, there is a red signature written in blocky letters.

title: Pellegrini
alt_text: A painting of a wide, indoor room with several figures walking across it. Three dark doorways line the back wall, each draped with bright red swags above them. A long red carpet runs horizontally across the floor, connecting the doorways. In the center, three figures dressed in dark clothing walk together toward the right side. Another dark-clothed figure stands near the far left, while a lone figure in a lighter coat walks on the right.

title: Time to Save
alt_text: A painting showing a busy still-life arrangement featuring a large bouquet of colorful flowers in a blue and white patterned pitcher. To the left of the pitcher sits a small, blue-and-orange bird perched on a bowl of fruit that includes oranges, grapes, and a sliced papaya resting on red fabric. A small human skull, a die, a round clock with Roman numerals, and an hourglass are placed on the table surface near the base of the pitcher. A large, patterned butterfly rests on bare branches reaching out from the top of the flower arrangement. The background is a soft, muted grey with faint shadows cast by the objects.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a tall, slender form stands in the center of a room. It is shaped like a vertical spindle, narrow at the bottom and top and wide in the middle. The surface appears matte and slightly rough with thin horizontal texture lines visible throughout. This object sits on a light-colored wooden floor in front of plain white walls. A soft, round shadow is cast directly beneath the base of the piece.

title: Level Group
medium: Acrylic on canvas mounted to layered plywood
