alt_text: A painting of two dark, rectangular panels set side-by-side against a plain gray background. Each panel is uniform in size and appears to be covered in a flat, matte black color. The surfaces have very faint vertical lines running from the top to the bottom. There is a small gap between the two panels. The shapes create a minimalist look with sharp, clean edges.

title: Night-Sea Music
medium: Kinetic sculpture (motors, rubber tubing, music boxes, electric cables, custom circuitry)
alt_text: A kinetic sculpture of dark wires attached to a wide, white wall. Multiple thin, black cables stretch across the wall in wavy, uneven lines. Small, dark, round objects are fixed to the ends of these cables and at points along their lengths. The wires cluster together toward the middle of the wall and spread out toward the left and right sides. This arrangement creates an abstract, organic pattern that resembles roots or branching veins.

title: Frame for portrait of John Aylsworth by Sheldon Peck, 2013.97.1
medium: Softwood with original grain-painted decoration over gesso
alt_text: A picture frame made of wood shows a dark, decorative pattern on its surface. The frame is thick and rectangular, forming a corner in the top left of the view. The wood grain pattern is painted in shades of deep reddish-brown and dark black. There are slight signs of wear along the edges where the finish has worn away. The frame sits against a pale, horizontal-lined wall.

title: Saturday Night Bath
alt_text: A painting of a woman washing clothes in a tub inside a rustic room. The woman wears a white dress and a red headscarf as she scrubs fabric in a round, wooden barrel placed on the wooden floor. A large black stove stands to her right, and a tall green cabinet is positioned on the left side of the room. A small white and black dog rests on a striped rug near a wooden chair in the foreground. Several small items sit on a white shelf attached to the back wall, below a pale, warm-colored background.

title: Lorem Ipsum
alt_text: A slate sculpture shows rows of neatly carved, flowing text set into a dark gray rectangular stone. The stone has a natural, slightly rippled texture, especially visible on the right edge. The letters are carved in a decorative, script-style font with thin lines. The light hits the carved letters from above, creating subtle shadows that make the text pop against the dark background. The arrangement of the lines creates a balanced, uniform block of writing in the center of the piece.

title: Book
medium: Artist’s book with thread and fabric cover
alt_text: A sculpture of an artist's book shows a rectangular fabric cover with messy, white stitching across its surface. The background of the fabric is a mottled, dark grey color with frayed, cream-colored edges. Thin, white threads loop and tangle horizontally across the center of the book. Long, loose strands of blue-grey thread hang from the top and bottom edges of the cover. A small white label with handwritten text is tucked into the bottom-left corner of the fabric.

title: Untitled (Head)
alt_text: A painting of a distorted face in profile view against a colorful background. The face is mostly white with sharp, black outlines, and it features one visible eye looking to the right. A large, dark shape sits behind the face, and a small, white sun-like symbol rests on the cheek. Below the face, a bright yellow shape forms a neck, which sits above a dark red torso. The left side of the background is a large white area, while the right side is solid yellow.

title: Mantelpiece
alt_text: A marble architectural element shows an ornate, light-brown fireplace surround. The stone frame features carved patterns and a flat mantel shelf. Above the fireplace, a small glass figurine of an animal sits on the mantel beneath a framed painting. Two gold-colored wall sconces with crystal accents are mounted on the white walls on either side of the painting. Inside the hearth, a dark metal fireback stands behind a rectangular heater with a metal frame. Tall, slender brass-colored metal posts stand on the hearth floor in front of the fireplace opening.

title: Pair of doors
medium: Carved and paneled pine doors with walnut finish, wrought iron
alt_text: A set of carved and paneled pine doors shows symmetrical decorations across two tall panels. The doors are dark brown and feature a repetitive grid of raised rectangular sections. Each panel contains small carvings of figures, shields, flowers, and oval shapes arranged in columns. Two circular medallions with carved profiles of faces sit in the lower half of the doors, mirrored on each side. A decorative border with a twisted rope-like pattern runs along the outer edges of the doorway.

title: Cassone
alt_text: A wooden chest with dark, detailed carvings across its entire front surface. The long rectangular box features three main panels with round or oval shapes containing figures in relief. On the far left and far right, standing human figures are carved directly into the corners. The entire structure is supported by four feet shaped like carved faces with swirling patterns. Below the main panels, a thick border runs across the base with repeating leaf-like carvings.

title: Cast iron fireback
alt_text: A piece of furniture made of cast iron shows a relief carving with multiple scenes. The top section depicts two figures standing under a canopy near several cannons and piles of round objects. To the right, a busy scene with many smaller figures is set against a background of trees and buildings. A horizontal band in the middle contains lines of embossed text written in an old script. The bottom section shows a row of four men wearing helmets in profile.

title: A Double-Sided Mourning Locket
medium: Watercolor, ink, and chopped hair on ivory
alt_text: A miniature painting of a memorial scene sits inside a gold oval frame. A rectangular monument stands in the center of the image, topped with a decorative urn. The letters "SFW" are written inside an oval laurel wreath on the front of the monument. A large willow tree with drooping branches looms behind and to the right of the structure, while a smaller tree stands in the background on the left. The ground in the foreground appears to be textured with light-colored, fine hair-like material.

title: Appoquinimink
alt_text: A painting of a vast and cloudy sky dominates this vertical scene. The colors shift from a bright, golden yellow in the center to darker, shadowy greens and grays near the edges. The brushwork creates a soft, hazy look, blending the different shades together like mist or smoke. At the very bottom right, a thin, dark line marks a horizon. Two tiny, rounded, and dark shapes sit on this horizon, appearing very small compared to the immense sky above.

title: King Solomon Sacrificing to the Idols
alt_text: A painting of a group of people gathered around an altar in a dark, outdoor setting. On the right side, two women in colorful robes pour liquid into a bowl atop a tripod stand, while smoke rises from it. A young child kneels on the ground near them, holding a metal plate. On the left, several standing figures gesture toward the altar, and one woman in a red-and-white dress points with her hand. In the background, tall stone columns and a statue stand under a stormy, cloudy sky. Some of the people have darker, shadowed faces, while others are highlighted by a bright light source.

title: Niagara Falls
alt_text: A painting of a massive waterfall cascading over a rocky cliff face into a misty pool below. Dark, stormy clouds fill the upper portion of the sky, with soft light glowing behind them. On the left, a tall, dark, tree-covered cliff side rises high above the water. A rocky, green shoreline with a few tiny figures sits in the foreground at the bottom of the scene. The entire painting is enclosed within a large, ornate, gold-colored frame with carved details.

title: Crown Street
alt_text: A painting of a city scene viewed from a high angle shows various buildings, parking lots, and vehicles. A prominent, tall, red brick building with several windows and a fire escape stands in the center of the middle ground. Below this building, a paved parking lot is filled with many parked cars in colors like white, blue, and brown. Several other buildings, including houses and larger structures, stretch out toward the horizon where trees are visible. A few bare, leafless trees are scattered among the parking areas and streets. The sky above is pale blue, suggesting a clear day.

title: NO, IT IS
medium: Triptych of three flipbook films; HD video shown on 3 flat screens.
alt_text: A triptych of three screens displays videos of old book pages. Each screen shows an open book against a textured gray background, with black text printed on the pages. The left screen shows a person running or jumping, along with a dark shape. The middle screen shows the words "NEEDING TO LET GO" printed on the left page, and a figure sitting on a chair on the right page. The right screen shows a person standing and another person performing a handstand.

title: Saint Nicholas The Wonderworker
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows a man from the chest up against a worn gold background. He has a dark, oval-shaped face, a short beard, and a serious expression. He wears a dark purple robe with a white collar marked by several dark crosses. In one hand, he holds a rectangular book with a decorative cover. A thin, circular line surrounds his head like a halo, and there are faint symbols written in the gold paint on either side of his head. The entire painting has a vertical crack running down the middle.

title: Sloth
alt_text: A painting of a woman with curly brown hair resting her chin on her hand while sitting by a window. She wears a light-colored dress and looks down at several open books on a table covered by a dark, floral patterned cloth. Behind her, a vibrant red fabric with blue leaf designs hangs down on the left side. Outside the window, a climbing plant displays several large, blooming pink roses. The overall mood is quiet and still as the woman appears to be lost in thought or reading.

title: Male Nude (Männlicher Akt)
alt_text: A painting of a nude man with a beard and dark, wavy hair. He stands facing forward against a tall, dark wooden board. His expression is somber, and his eyes are looking slightly upward. He wears a small, striped cloth covering his waist. His arms hang down at his sides, and his fingers point straight toward the ground.

title: Relief of Musical Angels
alt_text: A sculpture of alabaster shows three figures with gold accents. A large figure with wings stands in the back, looking forward. In the front left, a smaller figure holds a round, tamborine-like instrument. To the right, another figure plays a box-shaped musical instrument. The figures have wavy hair and wear robes with draped folds. Gold paint highlights the hair, wings, and edges of their clothing.

title: Instructions to Man
alt_text: A painting of a rocky, yellow-toned landscape featuring a central green river or pool. On the left, several indistinct, craggy grey figures or rock formations sit near the bank. A lone figure stands near the edge of the water in the lower center, with a faint halo shape around its head. In the background, abstract yellow and white shapes stretch upwards like tall trees or cliffs against a dark sky. The foreground is filled with a row of vertical, fence-like yellow and brown strokes.

title: Christ in Asia
alt_text: A painting of a geometric structure hovering above textured forms. The composition is contained within a rectangular, lime-green frame that features diagonal braces in the top two corners and the bottom two corners. Suspended in the upper center is a jagged, triangular shape painted in shades of light and medium blue. Below this blue shape, three lumpy, yellowish forms stretch upward, displaying horizontal, multicolored brushstrokes. A thin, white line extends from the bottom of the blue shape down into the central yellow form. The entire scene rests on a plain, off-white background.

title: Prince Fire
alt_text: A painting of a cloudy sky filled with shades of white, gray, and purple. On the left side of the frame, a large, fluffy white cloud extends diagonally from the top left down toward the center. Below this cloud, the horizon line is flat and pale, suggesting a calm or distant ground. The right side of the painting features darker, thicker clouds in muted purple tones. The light across the sky appears soft and somewhat hazy, blending the different cloud shapes together.

title: M.J. Series III
medium: Plaster, dry pigments, steel armature, Styrofoam core, burlap
alt_text: A sculpture of a human figure stands against a plain gray background. The figure is made of rough, off-white material that looks like plaster. One arm is painted a bright blue color, while the torso and upper legs have streaks of black and gray pigment. The figure stands on a flat, rectangular base that appears to be made of wood. It holds a bulky, dark object in one hand near its side.

title: Yellow Painting
alt_text: A painting shows a solid, uniform field of bright, lime-yellow color. The surface covers the entire frame from edge to edge. The tone of the yellow appears consistent across the whole area. There are no other shapes, lines, or colors visible anywhere on the surface. The texture appears mostly smooth.

title: Triptych: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Saints Peter and Jerome, Two Angels, and God the Father; Saints Francis and Ansanus with the Annunciatory Angel; Saints Bernardino and Sabinus with the Virgin Annunciate
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on panel shows a three-part altarpiece with pointed, gold-covered arches. The central panel depicts a woman in a dark robe holding a child on her lap, flanked by two standing bearded men in colorful tunics. Above them, two small winged figures hover near a small circular portrait at the very top. The side panels each show figures stacked vertically, with kneeling people in plain brown robes at the bottom and standing figures in decorative robes above them. The entire background consists of shimmering gold leaf, and the figures are dressed in robes of blue, red, orange, and brown.

title: Leaf from a gradual
alt_text: A manuscript page shows text written in black ink along with musical notes on red lines. The text appears in a dark, old-fashioned script and is interspersed with small black square notes on a four-line staff. A large, ornate capital letter on the left side is decorated with gold, blue, and red patterns, and it extends into a leafy floral shape down the side of the page. Another smaller blue and red initial letter begins one of the lines of text. The entire page is a light, parchment-like color, showing slight wear along the edges.

title: Leaf from a Gradual
medium: Tempera with gold and silver leaf
alt_text: A manuscript page shows an ornate letter and musical notation painted with tempera, gold, and silver. A large, intricate blue letter dominates the top portion, filled with a small scene of figures in a landscape. Below this illustration, thin red lines serve as a staff for square musical notes and black text. The entire page features a wide, colorful border filled with vines, leaves, and tiny figures. Several small rectangular panels depicting people are stacked vertically along the right side of the page.

title: Leaf from a gradual, introit for the first Sunday of Advent.
alt_text: A manuscript page shows lines of black musical notes on a staff with red lines and text. The central area contains rows of dark square notes mixed with lines of handwritten letters. A wide, intricate border surrounds the text, filled with detailed floral designs, small creatures, and blue and green leaf patterns. Small, stylized figures of people appear tucked into the decoration at the sides and bottom. The entire page features delicate touches of gold leaf, giving parts of the border a soft, metallic shine.

title: Leaf from a Book of Hours
alt_text: A manuscript page of tempera and gold leaf features multiple columns of dense, dark-brown Latin handwriting. The text is neatly arranged on pale, off-white parchment with faint, thin red guide lines running horizontally across the page. Several intricate, decorative capital letters in blue, red, and gold leaf are scattered throughout the text block. To the left of the writing, a small, leafy floral border extends vertically with delicate black ink flourishes. The page is surrounded by large, empty margins on all four sides, with some slight paper discoloration visible near the top and bottom edges.

title: Saint Mary Magdalene
alt_text: A painting of a figure wearing a red robe, executed in tempera and silver on a wood panel. The figure stands in the center and holds a dark, rectangular book in their hands. They are draped in a vibrant red garment that covers their head and shoulders, with their face shown in profile looking downward. The background is a worn, cream-colored surface decorated with small, repeating flower designs in the corners. Large cracks run across the entire surface of the painting, revealing the wooden panel underneath in several places.

title: Saint Francis
alt_text: A painting on a wood panel shows a figure wearing a dark, hooded robe. The person has greenish-toned skin and is looking downward with a serious expression. A faint, circular pattern surrounds the person's head like a halo. The painting surface is weathered, with visible cracks and worn areas that reveal the wooden board underneath. One hand is held up near the chest, as if in a gentle gesture.

title: Icon
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows a man with a long white beard and gray hair against a gold background. He wears a bright red robe draped over his shoulders. His right hand is raised in a gesture with his fingers shaped in a specific way, while his left hand holds a closed book. A dark-colored halo circles his head against the gold. The painting is framed by a thick, raised, and worn border painted in bright red and dark gray.

title: Two Apostles
alt_text: A painting shows two figures standing side-by-side against a dark brown background. On the left, a younger person with long reddish-brown hair holds a dark, rectangular object close to their chest. They are wearing an orange tunic with a pinkish robe draped over one shoulder. To their right, an older person with a grey beard and grey hair wears a dark green robe over a blue garment. Both figures have faint, circular halos outlined in gold above their heads, and they are shown from the waist up. The surface of the painting is worn and chipped in several places, revealing lighter colors underneath.

title: Leaf from a gradual,: introit for the Feast of Saint Andrew:, with floral border
alt_text: A manuscript page shows musical notation written on red lines with decorative borders. The center of the page contains several rows of black text and small square musical notes arranged on a staff. A large, ornate, and colorful capital letter sits in the top-left corner, and a circular, blank medallion is at the bottom center. The entire page is framed by a wide border filled with colorful flowers, green vines, and small gold accents. The paper itself appears aged and yellowish, providing a warm background for the detailed lettering and illustrations.

title: Leaf from a Book of Hours
alt_text: A manuscript page of tempera and gold leaf shows columns of black handwritten text on a light background. Along the left edge, a vertical border of delicate, black, vine-like patterns stretches from top to bottom. This ornate border features small, colorful flowers and leaves in shades of blue, red, and green. A large, decorative capital letter is positioned on the left side of the text block, embellished with gold leaf and red and blue paint. The rest of the page remains largely blank to the right of the written columns.

title: Leaf from a gradual
alt_text: A manuscript page shows musical notation and text written in ink. The page features several rows of red horizontal lines that organize square, black musical notes. In the middle left of the page, a large, ornate letter is decorated with colorful, swirling floral patterns and gold leaf. Additional text is written in black and red between the lines of music. The paper itself is a yellowish, parchment-like color.

title: Leaf from a gradual
alt_text: A manuscript on paper shows a page filled with lines of musical notation and text. The page has thin, horizontal red lines that serve as a musical staff. Small, black square shapes representing musical notes are arranged on these lines. Dark black text in a dense, calligraphic style sits between the staff lines. One large, decorative blue square letter acts as an initial at the start of a section. A few lines of text are written in a contrasting red ink on the right side.

title: Watercolor paint box, descended in the family of Rosina Cox Boardman
medium: Mahogany and oak with brass hardware and original engraved labels, containing antique and newer tools and pigments
alt_text: A wooden container made of mahogany and oak holds a variety of art supplies. The top section of the open box reveals small white ceramic dishes and a mixing tray, along with an engraved paper label fixed to the inside lid. Below this, a large drawer is pulled open to display an assortment of artist tools resting on a light-colored surface. These tools include brushes, pencils, a white palette, and metal instruments with wooden handles. Small rectangular boxes of paint and other supplies are arranged neatly in the corners of the drawer. The entire set appears organized for drawing or painting.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A miniature of a woman shown in profile. The subject is a light-skinned woman with short, blonde, wavy hair facing to the left. She wears a dark blue dress with lace sleeves. The background features a patterned wallpaper design with vertical blue and red stripes and floral accents. The portrait is oval-shaped and framed within a rectangular gold frame that hangs from a small, decorative loop at the top.

title: Five
medium: 25 baked enamel-coated steel plates with silkscreened grid, Testor’s enamel, and felt-tipped pen
alt_text: An installation of twenty-five enamel-coated steel plates arranged in a grid of five rows and five columns. Each square plate features a light grid pattern printed on its surface. The plates change gradually from top to bottom and left to right, starting with mostly empty grids. As you move across and down, small specks of color fill the squares in various patterns, like bars or blocks of mixed dots. The final plates are completely covered in dense, colorful pixelated textures.

title: Leaf from a breviary
alt_text: A manuscript page shows two narrow columns of dense, dark handwriting on a pale, aged background. Lines of text are interspersed with occasional words written in bright red ink. Elaborate, swirling borders in blue, gold, and red ink surround the blocks of text on the top, bottom, and inner margins. These decorative borders end in small, detailed floral shapes and leafy vines. Faint, thin marks resembling small, scattered insects appear in the empty space on the right side of the page.

title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Christ on the Cross with the Virgin and Saint John, within a decorative border
alt_text: A manuscript page showing a central painting framed by elaborate, colorful floral decorations. In the middle of the image, a figure hangs from a wooden cross, flanked by two standing figures draped in blue and red robes. Above the central figure, a small horizontal plaque with indecipherable letters sits against a sky with a sun and a crescent moon. Below the painting, several lines of black text are written on a light background, beginning with a large, ornate blue capital letter. The entire page is surrounded by a dense border of twisting vines, delicate flowers, and gold leaf accents.

title: Leaf from a Book of Hours; The Virgin in the Clouds, Holding the Child and Standing on a Dragon, within a rectangular frame, within a decorative border
alt_text: A manuscript page shows a central rectangular painting enclosed by a thick gold frame. Inside the frame, a woman wearing a blue robe and a crown holds a small, nude child against a background of soft, light-colored clouds. Small winged heads float in the sky around them, and a green, snake-like creature curls around the woman's feet at the bottom of the frame. Below the painting, a short inscription written in black ink sits inside a small square. Decorative borders filled with colorful floral patterns, green leaves, and butterfly shapes fill the corners outside of the central frame.

title: Leaf from a Bible
alt_text: A manuscript page shows two columns of handwritten text decorated with tempera and gold leaf. On the left side, an ornate blue initial letter contains a small painted figure of a person holding a long, thin object against a gold background. This initial connects to a long, vertical blue border that runs down the left margin with decorative flourishes. The text itself is dark ink in a dense, uniform style. The entire page is set against a plain, off-white background.

title: Leaf from a Missal
alt_text: A manuscript page of tempera and gold leaf shows two columns of handwritten Latin text on a light-colored paper. Small, colorful decorated letters, featuring gold, blue, and red patterns, mark the start of many lines. One larger, square-shaped illustration sits on the right side, showing green vine-like shapes against a gold background. Decorative flourishes of blue, red, and green paint decorate the top and bottom borders of the page. The entire design is contained within faint grid lines drawn on the paper.

title: Leaf from a Psalter
alt_text: A manuscript page on parchment shows two columns of dark, handwritten text. The text blocks are separated by a long, thin line that curves around the top and bottom of the writing. This line features small, vine-like decorations with tiny specks of gold. Along the left edge, a small, colorful creature with blue and red details sits on the decorative line. Scattered throughout the columns are occasional letters in red or blue ink.

title: Leaf from a Book of Hours
alt_text: A manuscript page illuminated with tempera and gold leaf shows dense text surrounded by an elaborate decorative border. The background of the border is a shimmering gold, covered with delicate, colorful floral patterns, swirling vines, and small animals. In the center, a rectangular painting depicts a woman wearing a white veil and a light orange cloak, with a child in blue sitting in front of her. The child has hands pressed together in prayer. To the right of this small painting, the text continues in dark, stylized handwriting. Below the text, a thin, horizontal brown branch is drawn across the page.

title: Bather
alt_text: A painting of a person leaning forward with arms outstretched. The figure is painted in muted, pale tones that blend into the surrounding colors. To the left, a light blue and white area suggests a background or water. To the right, darker shades of green, orange, and red create a dense, textured foliage. The brushstrokes are thick and visible throughout the canvas, giving the scene a loose and energetic quality.

title: A Young Woman in Arcadian Costume
alt_text: A painting of a woman with blonde hair looking toward the right. She wears a deep red dress with a sheer, light-colored scarf draped loosely over her shoulders. Her hair is styled in an updo and decorated with small flowers. Behind her, a dark and shadowy background suggests a dimly lit room or outdoor space. A small portion of a dark, animal-like shape is visible behind her left shoulder.

title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on the ground and looking at a baby lying in the straw in front of her. She wears a blue head covering and a flowing blue robe over a pink dress. A group of several men are clustered around them, appearing to watch the scene or kneel in prayer. Some of the men wear tan or red tunics, and one holds a long wooden staff. Behind the group, a brown ox stands in the dim, shadowed background of what looks like a barn. The lighting highlights the woman and the small, light-skinned baby, while the rest of the scene fades into deeper shadows.

title: Untitled Plate
alt_text: A stoneware sculpture showing a shallow, circular dish or platter. The object is primarily a dull brown and grey color with a rough, textured surface. Deep, jagged cracks or fissures run across its center, creating an irregular, star-like pattern. The edges of the circular form appear uneven and slightly broken in places. The overall look is earthen, weathered, and simple in its construction.

title: Untitled Plate
alt_text: A wood-fired stoneware sculpture of a small, bowl-like object is shown from a top-down perspective against a plain background. The object is round and clearly broken, with a rough, jagged edge along its rim. Its surface is textured and uneven, featuring a mix of grey, brown, and tan colors. To the right, a patch of smooth, reddish-brown material contrasts with the surrounding gritty, greyish clay. Several deep cracks and gaps break up the rounded form of the piece.

title: Girl with Cups
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting at a table with books and mugs. The person has short dark hair and wears a dark green shirt while leaning toward the table. On the table sits a stack of books with yellow lettering on the cover. Two white mugs are placed near the books on a white surface. Behind the person, the wall is painted in blocks of deep blue and light blue colors.

title: The Oxbow, Flooded, for Frank Moore and Dan Hodermarsky
alt_text: A painting of a vast landscape shows a wide, calm river winding through fields at sunset. Several stone bridges with rounded arches span across the water, connecting patches of trees and land. The sky above is a soft mix of light yellow and deep orange, reflecting the fading light of the day. Dark, rolling hills rise in the distance behind the river, forming a hazy horizon line. In the foreground, rectangular plots of farmland in shades of green and brown are neatly laid out.

title: Les Soleils
alt_text: A painting of sunflowers, rendered in oil on canvas, shows two large, yellow flowers arranged in a dark vase. The larger, more central flower faces forward with broad, distinct petals and a dark center. A second, slightly smaller sunflower sits partially behind and to the right, drooping slightly. The vase itself is dark, heavy, and roughly textured, appearing almost black against a light, neutral background. Strokes of paint are visible throughout the piece, giving the surfaces a thick and textured look.

title: Cavallo e Cavaliere
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a person riding a horse stands against a plain gray background. The figure sits upright on the horse's back without a saddle. Both the person and the horse are textured and dark gray in color. The horse faces left with its head slightly lowered. The sculpture rests on a small, rectangular base.

title: Four Jockeys
alt_text: A painting of four jockeys sitting on their horses, viewed from the side and behind. The jockeys wear brightly colored caps and jackets, including shades of yellow, green, and light blue. They are arranged across the frame, with one horse and rider partially visible on the far left. The background is a simple, blurred wash of light green, suggesting an outdoor setting like a grassy field. The brushstrokes are thick and visible throughout the scene.

title: Banana Harvest
alt_text: A painting of two dark-skinned people walking through a dense, green forest. Each person carries a long pole over one shoulder with large bunches of pale-colored leaves hanging from both ends. One person wears a yellow garment, and the other wears a red one. To the right of the figures stands a simple, brown building with a thatched roof. The ground is a flat, sandy color, and scattered piles of green leaves lie on the dirt between the two figures.

title: La libre inclinación del deseo (The Free Inclination of Desire)
alt_text: A painting of a vast, flat landscape under a hazy sky. On the left stands a tall, yellowish pillar shaped like a hollowed-out tree trunk, with several small compartments that each hold a single metal key. In the middle of the scene sits a rectangular block with a soft, draped form resting on top of it. Further back in the distance, a small, pale figure stands on the horizon holding a tall staff. The ground stretches out into the distance, with long shadows extending away from the pillar and the central block.

title: Everson Museum Catalogue Box
medium:
Wooden box with paperback copy of Grapefruit, glass, offset lithograph, acrylic
on canvas, plastic boxes, and mixed media
alt_text: A sculpture made of wood, plastic, and other mixed materials shows a white, box-shaped object resting on a flat, light-gray surface. The structure is mostly a large, white, square cube that sits on top of a thinner, rectangular base. On the lower base, there is black printed text that reads "yoko ono" and "grapefruit." A smaller, rectangular cutout is visible on the right side of the main white cube. The entire object is smooth and appears to have a matte finish.

title: Virgin and Child with St. John the Baptist and Three Cherubs
alt_text: A polychromed stucco relief shows a woman holding a small child. The figures are carved in a warm, brownish tone and set within a detailed, golden-framed panel. The woman has her head tilted down toward the child, who looks outward while holding a small object. To their side, a smaller figure looks up toward the woman and child. Below them, a winged head rests at the bottom of the central panel. The entire structure is topped with an arched golden ornament and features column-like sides.

title: Silver Housatonic (Benefit Edition)
alt_text: A silver sculpture shows a single, extremely long, and thin line against a plain, dark blue background. This metallic line runs vertically down the center of the image like a winding, narrow path. The shape is uneven and crooked, with many small twists and turns along its entire length. It appears delicate, almost like a piece of wire or thread suspended in space. The bright, reflective surface of the silver contrasts sharply with the deep blue color behind it.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A wooden sculpture shows a woman holding a small child in her arms. The woman has long, wavy hair and wears a robe with draped folds that fall to her feet. She holds the child upright against her chest with both hands. The child's body is small and partially covered by fabric. The entire sculpture is made of a dark, weathered wood with visible spots and texture.

title: Two Men
medium: Walnut with traces of polychromy and gilding
alt_text: A walnut sculpture showing two figures standing closely together. The foreground figure is a man wearing a flat cap and a knee-length tunic, appearing slightly shorter than the person behind him. Behind him stands a taller, adult figure wearing a similar hat and a long, flowing garment that drapes to the ground. The wood has a dark, weathered appearance with small patches of worn gold and colored paint visible on the surface. Both figures are carved as one piece, with a single, angled base supporting them both. A small white label is attached to the bottom front of the base.

title: Pair of Male Saints
alt_text: A wooden sculpture shows a figure standing inside an arched niche. The figure is wearing a tall, pointed hat and long, layered robes. In one hand, the figure holds a rectangular object that looks like a book. The wood is worn and colored in shades of brownish-red, with small holes and rough textures covering the surface. The background of the carving is slightly curved at the top, echoing the shape of the arch.

title: St. John the Baptist
alt_text: A wooden sculpture shows a standing man with long, wavy hair and a full beard. He wears a cloak draped over his shoulders and deep robes that fall to his feet. In his left arm, he cradles a small animal, possibly a lamb, and holds a rectangular, book-like object. His right hand points towards the animal. The sculpture has a dark brown, polished finish.

title: Angel holding a candlestick
alt_text: A gilded and polychromed wood sculpture showing a figure lying on its side. The figure is golden in color and wears draped clothing that covers its body. A separate, dark rectangular base sits to the right of the figure, featuring painted details on its front side. Between the figure and the base lies a small, detached piece of wood that looks like a hand. Each item has a small white tag attached with string resting on the surface below. The objects are displayed against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a seated man shows him with his wrists bound together in front of his waist. The figure is carved from dark wood and depicts a man with long hair wearing a crown of thorns on his head. He sits on a smooth, block-like base that supports his legs. His body is thin and shows clear muscle detail in his chest and arms. The sculpture is positioned against a plain, light-colored background.

title: St. Cloud
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a person standing with both hands raised to the sides of their head. The figure has short, wavy hair and a focused expression on their face. They are wearing a long, layered robe that hangs down to their feet. The dark material appears weathered and shows hints of wear across the surface. The sculpture stands on a simple, flat base against a plain light background.

title: Pair of Angels
alt_text: A polychromed wood sculpture shows two figures with wings that are posed as if flying. Both figures are small, child-like forms made of brownish, aged wood with carved features. The left figure hangs upright, while the right figure is angled, as if diving through the air. Each sculpture rests on a thin metal rod attached to a square, dark wooden base. Between the two bases sits a small white label with black text.

title: Virgin and Child with a flaming heart
alt_text: An ivory sculpture shows a standing woman holding a small child in her arms. The woman has long hair and wears a long, draped dress that falls to her feet. She holds the child against her chest with both hands. This figure stands on a smooth, curved pedestal that gets wider at the base. A small, white rectangular label with printed text is attached to the front of the pedestal.

title: St. Barbara
alt_text: A wood sculpture shows a standing woman wearing a long gown and a crown. She holds a tall, cylindrical tower in her raised left hand. Her right hand is tucked against her body, holding a small round object. The figure is carved from dark wood and stands on a rectangular base. The wood appears weathered with a dull, monochromatic finish.

title: Samson and the Lion(?)
alt_text: A sandstone sculpture of a human face pressed next to an animal head. The human face on the left is large, with almond-shaped eyes and a wide, slightly open mouth. To the right, a smaller animal head sits close to the human face, featuring a protruding snout and visible square teeth. Both figures are carved into a single, weathered block of grey-brown stone. The textured carvings show fine lines representing hair or fur wrapping around the top of both heads.

title: The Crossroads
medium: Oil, acrylic, and spray paint on canvas
alt_text: A painting showing a city street scene that appears to be dissolving into abstract forms. A central, rectangular section depicts a crosswalk with people walking and cars waiting, rendered in realistic greyscale tones. This central scene is framed by thick, swirling layers of black, white, and grey paint that look like smoke or motion blurs. The crosswalk lines extend downward, appearing to fade into drips of paint at the bottom of the canvas. The overall shape of the canvas has irregular edges that jut out on the sides and top.

title: Neon Canyons
medium: Oil, acrylic, and spray paint on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a city street scene layered with an enormous close-up of a human eye. The eye takes up the upper middle section of the image, appearing in shades of white and gray. To the right, a police car with the letters "NYPD" visible on its side cuts diagonally across the bottom. Below the eye, a dark city street stretches into the distance, surrounded by tall skyscrapers. Several words are painted across the scene, including "42 ST" and "LOEWS" near the eye, and "MEATK" on the road. The entire composition has a rough, spray-painted texture with drips of paint running down the canvas.

title: Diana and Callisto
alt_text: A painting of a group of nude figures gathered in a wooded landscape. A fountain stands in the center of the scene behind the figures. To the left, several figures sit or stand near the water. To the right, another figure sits with her back to the viewer while others stand nearby draped in red cloth. The entire scene is enclosed in a large, ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Charger with the story of Samson and Delilah
alt_text: A ceramic plate of tin-glazed earthenware shows a painted scene of people gathered in front of large stone pillars. A group of women in light-colored robes stands on the left side near a large, golden-yellow curtain hanging from the stone structure. Several men dressed in armor and tunics stand on the right, appearing to move toward the center of the scene. In the background, there is a small town with several pointed towers under a blue sky. The scene is framed by a narrow, dark gold border around the edge of the plate.

title: Footed Dish with the Virgin Handing Her Girdle to Saint Thomas
alt_text: A painted ceramic plate shows a figure in blue robes floating in the sky above a landscape. She sits on a bed of clouds, surrounded by a glowing yellow halo and smaller winged figures, as she drops a string or cord toward a person below. This person kneels on the ground near a rectangular stone tomb filled with flowers, reaching up with both hands toward the cord. The background landscape features green rolling hills, a winding blue river, and tall trees on the right side. The entire scene is painted in bright colors and is contained within the circular border of the dish.

title: Pair of Allegorical Figures with Cornucopia
alt_text: A pair of bronze sculptures shows two figures standing on rectangular marble bases. Each figure is a person with wavy hair, wearing a loose, draped robe that falls to their feet. They both wear a helmet-like headpiece and hold a large, overflowing cornucopia of fruit in one arm. The figures have similar poses, with one hand resting on their hip and the other holding the cornucopia. The bronze statues appear dark brown, contrasting with the dark red and white mottled stone of the pedestals below.

title: Obsolete Gas Tanks Awaiting Demolition IV
medium: Oil on canvas mounted to substrate
alt_text: A painting of two large, circular metal storage structures standing side by side. The structures are tall and open, made of a grid of beige metal beams. Below the metal framework, each structure has a circular base painted in a shade of pinkish-purple. In the foreground, a gray paved road leads past a simple chain-link fence. Behind the fence, some green trees and a small, light-colored building sit to the right of the structures. A pale, cloudy sky stretches out above the entire scene.

title: Head of a Satyr
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man’s head and neck. This dark, textured figure has thick, wavy hair and a short, scruffy beard. His face features a deeply furrowed brow and a grinning mouth with exposed teeth. The man wears a textured, draped garment over his shoulders that appears coarse or fabric-like. The entire piece is finished in a mottled brown color against a plain grey background.

title: Neptune riding a Dolphin with Tritons
alt_text: A terracotta sculpture of a man kneeling on a rocky base. The man has a muscular build and a beard, and he leans forward to touch something below him. Beside the man's right leg, a small, twisted creature with an open mouth crouches on the rock. Below the man, a second, smaller creature with a tail twists its body upward. The entire sculpture sits on a tiered, dark base with a smooth surface.

title: Group of Two Angels Supporting Clouds
alt_text: A terracotta sculpture shows two young figures who appear to be floating while supporting a large, bowl-shaped object above them. The figure on the left is positioned slightly behind and reaches up with both arms to steady the heavy container. The figure on the right sits on a base of swirling, cloud-like shapes and holds one side of the container aloft. Both figures have flowing hair and are draped in simple fabric that ripples around their bodies. The entire sculpture is made of a uniform, light reddish-brown clay material.

title: Crown Prince Frederick William, later Frederick III, German Emperor and King of Prussia
alt_text: A painting of a man shown from the chest up, set against a dark, moody background. The man has a short, receding hairline and a thick, brownish-gray beard. He wears a metallic breastplate over a light-colored shirt, with a bright red cloak draped over his left shoulder. A gold sash runs diagonally across his chest, decorated with a prominent star-shaped badge and a black cross. His expression is serious as he looks directly toward the viewer with light blue eyes.

title: Paysage du Midi (Landscape in the South of France)
alt_text: A painting of a landscape view looking down over trees and hills toward a distant body of water. Large, bushy trees frame the foreground in shades of muted blue, green, and pale yellow. In the middle ground, a tan-colored house with a dark roof sits nestled among the foliage. Beyond the house, rolling hills in shades of ochre and green lead to a thin, horizontal strip of blue water under a pale sky. The entire scene is created with loose, visible brushstrokes that give it a soft and textured appearance.

title: Lola
alt_text: A stoneware sculpture of a human torso with arms. The object has a rounded, pot-like belly and a small, shallow opening at the top where the neck would be. Two long, tube-like arms extend from the shoulders down to a pair of crossed legs resting on the base. The surface is textured and colored in shades of brownish-gray, with hints of reddish-brown and ash-like darker patches. The overall appearance is unfinished and earthy, lacking defined facial features or hands and feet.

title: The Dream
medium: Stoneware with glaze, overglaze, luster, and decals
alt_text: A stoneware sculpture of an abstract, multi-part form rests on a flat surface. The sculpture features a tube-like white shape that curves near the top, where the word "ACE" is printed in black letters. A flat, tongue-like piece extends from the middle, painted with shiny red and gold metallic stripes. Beneath this, a patterned section with black polka dots on white connects to a larger, dark grey base. On the lower edge of this grey base, the words "THE DREAM" are printed in black.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A charcoal and encaustic painting of overlapping patterns and inset drawings. The background consists of large, flowing shapes filled with thin, repeating lines. On the left, a rectangular section contains dense rows of scribbled text. To the right, another rectangular section displays a dark, sketchy portrait of a person seen from the side. The work is displayed in a thin, light-colored wood frame.

title: Nova I
alt_text: A painting of an abstract shape centered on a teal background. The central shape resembles a six-pointed star or flower with a soft, fuzzy outline. A pale, circular disk sits in the middle of this white star shape. To the left of the star, a large, dark green patch adds texture to the background. Several small, orange, dash-like marks appear in the upper right corner of the painting. Finally, a thin gray line runs horizontally across the lower portion of the image.

title: Anacharsis
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes set against a solid, light pink background. To the left, a long, wavy, purple vertical line extends down the canvas. Near the center, a large, dark-brown oval sits above a jagged, bright-blue shape at the bottom. Above the brown oval is an orange, cloud-like form with uneven edges. Resting on top of the orange shape is a dark-magenta rectangular area dotted with small, circular red marks.

title: Ritual
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and colorful forms layered on a dark background. A large, circular brown shape dominates the center, holding a prominent, light-colored, jagged form that reaches toward the bottom edge. To the right, a bright blue area contains black and reddish-orange outlines, while strokes of yellow and green accent the lower section. The composition features various textures of paint, with sharp, angular light-blue shapes visible in the lower left corner. The entire scene is set against a mottled, dark purple-brown backdrop that gives the image a sense of depth.

title: Barber Shop
alt_text: A painting of a storefront featuring a person standing in a doorway. To the right of the entrance stands a tall, cylindrical sign with blue, red, and white diagonal stripes. A small, simple chair with a curved back sits on the ground near the sign. The entrance is framed by muted tones, including a dark red wall on the left and various shades of blue and green around the doorway. A person in a light-colored jacket and dark pants is visible, stepping out from the dark, recessed entrance.

title: Oh Day, Verge and Bow
alt_text: A painting of an abstract, textured surface filled with layers of warm colors. Bright orange and deep red tones dominate the composition, creating a mottled and uneven appearance across the panel. A small, concentrated cluster of yellow and black paint sits near the bottom center, standing out against the surrounding darker shades. Hints of muted blue and grey peek through the layered, heavy application of paint. The surface has a rough, distressed look with varying thickness in the brushwork.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A ceramic container shows a dark, smooth vessel with a distinct bulbous body. The main part of the object is round and heart-shaped, tapering to a point at the bottom. A long, slender neck rises from the center, ending in an open spout at the top. Attached to the side of the neck are two stacked, circular handles. The surface of the piece is dark brown and appears polished or shiny.

title: Python Swallowing a Doe
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a snake coiled on a rough, rocky surface. The dark metal snake is long and winds back and forth in several tight loops across the center of the base. Its body is smooth and rounded, contrasting with the uneven, textured ground beneath it. The snake's head is tucked near the right side of the coils, slightly obscured. The entire piece is shaped like an irregular, horizontal oval.

title: Table Bronze Manifold
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an arrangement of dark metal shapes and pipes. The sculpture is box-like, with several cylindrical tubes opening toward the front. Some parts look crushed or bent, creating a textured surface of shadows and angles. The bottom of the piece has short, blocky supports that lift it slightly off the ground. The overall color is a dull, dark brownish-grey.

title: Writing Piece "No"
alt_text: A wood and steel sculpture showing a collection of metallic and wooden parts joined together. On the left, a rounded wooden knob connects to a bent metal handle that hangs down like an inverted U-shape. This central part attaches to a long, flat horizontal bar that extends to the right. A large, flat, shovel-like piece hangs vertically from the far right end of this bar. A small, hexagonal wooden piece rests on the ground near the base of this shovel-like section.

title: North Side of the Heart
alt_text: A bronze sculpture hangs from a tall, industrial-looking metal frame outside on a paved patio. The sculpture is a large, solid, heart-shaped object with a smooth, brownish-gold surface that tapers to a point at the bottom. It is suspended in the center of the structure by a single metal chain attached to a pulley system. The support frame is made of thin grey pipes and includes several loose wires, hooks, and chains hanging from its beams. A stone wall, some green trees, and a building with glass doors are visible in the background behind the sculpture.

title: Sketch Model of a Soldier's Head for the Robert Gould Shaw and the Massachusetts Fifty-Fourth Regiment Memorial
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a man's head wearing a flat cap. The surface of the metal is dark, textured, and appears rough in places. The man has a thick mustache and his expression is serious and solemn. His head sits directly on top of a tall, rectangular base made of dark green stone with white veins. The sculpture is centered against a plain gray background.

title: Sketch Model of a Soldier's Head for the Robert Gould Shaw and the Massachusetts Fifty-Fourth Regiment Memorial
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a human head with a rough, textured surface. The head is topped by a simple, folded cap and features defined eyes, a mustache, and full lips. The metal is dark and brownish-black with visible thumbprints and tool marks from its creation. It sits atop a tall, rectangular pedestal made of polished, deep green stone with white veins. The entire piece is centered against a plain gray background.

title: Sketch Model of a Soldier's Head for the Robert Gould Shaw and the Massachusetts Fifty-Fourth Regiment Memorial
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows the head of a person wearing a flat cap. The sculpture has a dark, rough texture that captures the person's intense facial features. The head rests on top of a tall, rectangular pedestal made of dark, veined green stone. This pedestal has white streaks running through its polished surface. The background is a plain, solid grey color.

title: Sketch Model of a Soldier's Head for the Robert Gould Shaw and the Massachusetts Fifty-Fourth Regiment Memorial
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing the head and neck of a man wearing a cap. The man has a serious expression with deep-set eyes and thick lips. The surface of the sculpture looks rough and textured, with visible lines throughout the metal. He wears a soft cap pulled low over his forehead. The head rests on a tall, smooth, rectangular base made of dark green stone with white veins.

title: View of Paris
alt_text: A painting showing a busy city square on a cloudy day. In the distance, a tall, pointed church spire rises above a cluster of multistory buildings. The square itself is filled with many people walking in various directions. Several horse-drawn carriages travel along a wide, paved street that curves toward the right side of the scene. The ground looks wet and reflective, suggesting it may have recently rained. Large, grand buildings line both sides of the square, casting long shadows.

title: View of Boston Harbor from Dorchester Heights
alt_text: A painting of a coastal landscape shows a grassy hillside leading down to a wide body of water under a cloudy, muted sky. To the right, a large, leafy tree stands in the foreground, catching a patch of sunlight. In the middle of the open field, a small, solitary figure walks down a gentle slope. Across the water, low, rolling hills line the distant shore, where several white sailboats are visible. The entire scene is colored in soft browns, greens, and grays, creating a calm atmosphere.

title: Tea House 1
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and lines in neutral colors. A long, dark vertical bar runs nearly the full height of the composition, slightly left of center. To the right of this bar, rectangular blocks in shades of grey and tan create a layered, flat appearance. Near the bottom right, a dark block sits squarely in the corner. Curved, scribbled lines in black are placed near the middle right area, contrasting with the straight geometric shapes. The overall color palette is muted, consisting mainly of browns, greys, and blacks.

title: Mantel
alt_text: A long marble architectural element shows a detailed relief carving along its entire front face. The central section features two winged animals, facing each other with their front paws raised near a decorative urn. Flanking these figures on both sides are swirling floral designs and garlands that extend toward the ends of the stone. At each far end, a distinct, upright urn sits above a cluster of grapes. The entire rectangular stone block rests horizontally on a wooden cart with wheels.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A polyester sculpture of a circular, bowl-like object sits on a white surface. The object is transparent and has smooth, curved edges. Its color shifts from a deep, rich purple at the outer rim to a pale, iridescent center that glows with hints of blue and green. The material has a glossy, reflective finish that makes it look almost like liquid. A small, dark shadow stretches out beneath the sculpture, grounding it against the plain background.

title: Pair of Pilgrim Flasks
alt_text: A ceramic container, made of tin-glazed earthenware, is presented here as a pair of matching bottles on a table. Both bottles are white with intricate blue painted patterns of flowers and geometric designs. The bottle on the left is slimmer and features a sculpted face on its shoulder. The bottle on the right is wider and more rounded, with small sculpted animal heads attached to its sides. Both items sit on a white tablecloth, surrounded by loose papers and measuring tape.

title: Tulip Vase
alt_text: A ceramic container shows a white vase with five individual spouts branching upward from a central base. The surface is decorated with intricate blue floral patterns painted onto the white glaze. Each of the five spouts has a slightly wider rim with a thin blue line around the top. The vase sits on a square base, which is also decorated with blue plant-like designs. This decorative vessel has a sturdy, symmetric shape that flares out like an open fan.

title: The House I Live In
alt_text: A painting of a long, one-story building made of brown earth or adobe. The building stretches across the middle of the frame and features several windows and doorways. In the background, a large blue mountain stands under a sky with a few long, wispy clouds. The foreground consists of a flat, light-colored patch of land stretching toward the base of the structure. Thin, dark vertical poles rise from the roof at various points along its length.

title: Design 6 Special
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular panel features a rhythmic, wavy surface. The front of the panel is off-white and filled with four vertical, curved ridges. These ridges create repeating, soft shapes that look like rounded waves or fabric folds. Deep, dark shadows form in the crevices between each vertical wave, adding depth and contrast. The entire object sits firmly on a simple, flat rectangular base.

title: Over Yonder
alt_text: A painting of three men standing on a dirt path with two hunting dogs. The men are wearing outdoor clothing and coats, and two carry long rifles over their shoulders. The man in the center points into the distance, while the man on the left shields his eyes from the sun. In front of them, two white and brown dogs walk down the path on leashes. In the background, a small house with a smoking chimney sits near some trees under a pale, twilight sky.

title: I Hereby Pronounce Yuh Man and Wife!
alt_text: A painting shows two men and a woman riding in a covered, open vehicle through a thick, hazy mist. In the foreground, a man wearing a wide-brimmed hat leans forward while holding the reins to steer. Beside him, partially hidden under the roof of the vehicle, a person with dark hair looks outward. Further ahead, another man in a light shirt sits in a smaller separate section, reaching forward as if helping to guide the ride. The scene is filled with a swirling, cloudy texture that obscures the ground and background.

title: Innocent Amusements
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on the edge of a round stone fountain in an open-air courtyard. She wears a draped, reddish dress and reaches her hand out toward the water. To her left, two other figures stand near a large potted plant and a curtained porch area. Several grey and white birds walk along the paved ground near the fountain. In the background, columns and vines provide shade over the courtyard, while another small statue stands on a pedestal in the distance.

title: Assumption of the Virgin
alt_text: A painting on wood shows a central scene framed by an ornate, gilded border. The gold frame features twisted columns on the sides and elaborate, swirling carvings at the top, which include a small oval medallion. Within the central painted area, a large group of people stand around a figure lying flat on a bed. Above this group, a central figure in flowing robes sits inside an oval shape against a red background. Simple buildings are painted in the background behind the gathering of people.

title: Calais Jetty, France
alt_text: A painting shows a quiet coastal scene with ships resting on the shore. Two large ships with tall masts sit on the sand on the right side of the frame. To the left, the water is calm and stretches into a misty distance. A very small boat appears faintly on the horizon near the center. The sky is a soft, pale color that blends into the water below. An ornate, carved gold frame surrounds the entire painting.

title: Phoenix
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an intricate, open-work form standing on thin, tripod-like legs. The object is composed of many irregular, textured metal branches that twist and connect in an open cage-like structure. These branching forms extend upward and outward, creating a tall, spindly silhouette against a plain grey background. The color varies from dark brown to a lighter, metallic gold in areas where light hits the ridges. The overall appearance resembles a sparse, tangled thicket or a spindly root system reaching toward the top.

title: Cattleya
alt_text: A painting of a large, abstract, organic shape that resembles a flower set against a dark background. The central form features textured layers of pink, white, and deep red paint that create a complex, ruffled appearance. At its core, streaks of bright orange and yellow are painted in a vertical, flowing pattern. Dark, thin lines of red paint drip down from the top edge onto the petals of the shape. A horizontal, blurred band of light gray paint stretches across the lower section of the painting.

title: Blue Jar with Leaf
alt_text: A glazed porcelain sculpture shows a tall, abstract object against a plain grey background. The bottom part is a wide, cone-shaped base decorated with colorful, horizontal painted brushstrokes. Sitting on top of this base is a narrower, inverted cone that is bright blue with a white rim. Attached to the left side of these pieces is a curved, upright handle made of textured, light-brown wood-like material. A small, dark green circular accent sits where the handle meets the base.

title: Leaf Bottle
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture depicts a tall, narrow object standing upright inside a wider container. At the base sits a sturdy, cone-shaped pot with a textured, dark gray and black mottled surface. A smooth, flat, light pink disc rests on top of this pot, acting as a platform for the piece above. Rising from the center of the pink disc is a long, slender, textured brown column that reaches toward the top. The column is framed by two small, decorative, triangular panels with a white and dark geometric pattern. The very top of the sculpture is crowned with a single, irregularly shaped, bright green leaf-like element.

title: Road Side Jar
alt_text: A glazed porcelain sculpture showing a tall, vase-like object with a flared top. The base of the object is cone-shaped and covered in messy, black, white, and green patterns that look like scribbles or sketches. Resting on top of this base is a rounded, white, doughnut-shaped piece. A small, bright blue, trumpet-shaped rim sits on the very top of the rounded piece. A small, tan, wooden cylinder sticks out from the side of the lower cone, near the bottom.

title: Touch Me
alt_text: A sculpture of a rectangular white panel mounted on a slightly darker gray wall. The white panel is attached at the corners with four small, round metal fasteners. In the center of the panel, the words "TOUCH ME" are cut out in capital letters. The edges of the letters appear slightly raised or outlined against the flat surface. A faint shadow is cast behind the right side of the panel, showing that it stands out from the wall.

title: Untitled
medium: Oil on canvas with metal mount
alt_text: A painting of oil on canvas with a metal mount shows a large, perfectly square shape. The square fills almost the entire center of the image. Its surface is a solid, flat, and light off-white or cream color. There are no patterns, lines, or other shapes visible on the face of the canvas. The edges of the square are straight and sharp, creating a distinct boundary against the plain white background.

title: Surgical
alt_text: A painting of the word "SURGICAL" written in the center. The background is a solid, flat color that looks like a shade of reddish-brown. The letters are white, capital, and separated by even spaces. Above the letters, a darker, blurry band of brownish-grey color stretches across the top of the canvas. This creates a soft contrast with the lighter reddish-brown field below.

title: Gift
medium: Purified pigmented beeswax and damar resin on Masonite
alt_text: A sculpture made of wax and resin on a wood board stands vertically against a solid gray background. The long, thin rectangular object has a rough, bumpy texture along its edges, resembling many small spikes. The upper section is mostly a smooth, creamy white color that blends into a soft orange hue. The lower section features a brighter, saturated orange color with a textured, layered surface. These colorful, waxy textures cover the front, while the sides are lined with many small, protruding white bumps.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A felt sculpture hangs against a plain white wall, extending down onto a wooden floor. The material is a dark, charcoal gray color and appears thick and soft. Large pieces of the fabric are draped and folded, creating overlapping layers that stick out from the surface. Several sections of the felt loop and curve, while others hang flat against the wall behind them. At the bottom, the fabric pools onto the floor in curled, bunched-up shapes.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A ceramic vase shows a tall, bulbous body with a glossy, colorful glaze. The glaze features a mottled pattern of yellow, green, and deep red, appearing almost like dripping paint. Two smooth, light-colored handles attach to the sides of the vase, arching upward from the shoulder to the rim. The rim of the vase is ruffled and wavy, creating a crown-like appearance at the top. The entire piece rests on a small, round base against a neutral gray background.

title: Elephant Cup
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture of a cup with an elephant attached to its base. The cup at the top is wide with horizontal ridges and colored in stripes of light green and yellow, resting on a smaller red section. Below this, a small blue elephant figure clings to the side of the cylindrical base. The base itself is a dark green column with a thin rope wrapped around it. A small blue rectangular tag with the white numbers "12370" is attached vertically to the side of the green base.

title: Bamboo Cup
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture of a stacked, colorful object rests against a plain grey background. The base is a rounded, dome-like shape that fades from a pinkish-orange at the bottom to a light blue at the top. Resting on top of this base is a simple, off-white bowl with a pale yellow interior. A smaller, patterned vessel with a light, crackled texture sits inside the bowl. A single, arched handle connects the upper vessel to the base, transitioning in color from blue at the top to bright green at the bottom.

title: George Washington Stanley (1775–1864, B.A. 1793)
medium: Oil on canvas, mounted to wood or panel
alt_text: A painting of an older man with white hair sitting in a dark room. The man faces forward with a serious expression and wears a dark, buttoned coat over a white shirt and a dark tie. His face shows many wrinkles, particularly across his forehead, and his light-colored eyes look directly ahead. He sits in a chair with a red backrest that is visible behind him. The background is shadowy and fades into black, focusing all attention on the man. His left hand rests on the arm of the chair.

title: Wan
medium: Purified beeswax and damar resin on plaster bunting and wire mesh
alt_text: A sculpture made of wax and resin on plaster and wire shows a long, thin, vertical rod-like form. The object is primarily a pale, creamy yellow color with streaks of muted blue running along its length. It has a rough, uneven texture that looks like layered material or skin. The top end is rounded and capped with a dark gray, matte-textured circular piece. The bottom end flares out slightly into a wider, flatter base that is edged with a brownish, crusty-looking border.

title: Arthur's Legend (Ex Rotterdam Tower Study)
alt_text: A steel sculpture made of various welded shapes stands on a solid, light-gray background. The sculpture has a wide, dark metal base that curves outward on the bottom. Above the base, a cage-like structure rises up, formed from thin, angled steel bars. Near the top of the sculpture, two large metal rings are joined together, leaning slightly to the right side. A few small, shiny, bright metal pieces are attached to the center and the base of the sculpture. The entire piece has a rough, industrial look with visible lines where the metal parts are connected.

title: Noon
alt_text: A painting of a forest scene shows a stream flowing through a wooded area. To the left, a person sits on the grassy bank near the base of a large tree with thick roots. The stream winds towards the center of the background, where distant rolling hills are visible under a pale sky. On the right side of the stream, several sheep rest in the tall grass. Tall, dark trees frame both sides of the landscape, creating a shaded pathway through the woods.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows four abstract human figures sitting in a row on a long rectangular base. The dark, smooth figures have simplified, blocky shapes and are grouped closely together. They appear to be resting on top of a low, horizontal structure that looks like a bench or a series of connected blocks. The sculpture sits on a thick, rectangular slab of textured, tan stone. In the background, a large window reveals a blurred view of trees with fall foliage and a building outside.

title: Neptune(?)
alt_text: A polychromed wood sculpture shows a bearded man in a dynamic, standing pose. He is mostly bare-chested with a cloth draped around his waist and legs. His right arm is outstretched, and his head is turned to the right. He stands on top of a base that looks like jagged rock. The figure’s body is posed with energy, suggesting movement.

title: Muse of Lyric Poetry
alt_text: A painting of a person with long reddish-brown hair playing a gold lyre. The figure wears a laurel wreath on their head and a flowing gown that is a mix of light pink and deep red. They sit leaning forward, holding the instrument with both hands while looking down at it. The background is an olive-green color with green leafy branches extending across the sides of the scene. A white architectural corner juts out at the bottom right, serving as a perch for the person. The entire scene is set within a curved, arched frame.

title: Muse of Astronomy
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in front of a white stone pillar, wearing a laurel wreath on her head. She wears a soft, purple-brown garment, and a large, flowing fabric with green, blue, and orange floral patterns drapes over her lap. Her right hand reaches out to touch a large, flat, rectangular surface propped up against the pillar. To the right of the pillar sits a round globe painted in shades of soft blue and green. Her gaze is directed upward and to the right, away from the viewer.

title: Muse of Painting
alt_text: A painting of a woman with red hair wearing a pink dress sits inside a semi-circular frame. She holds a small brush in one hand and leans against a tall, light-colored rectangular panel with her other hand. A light green vase holding several brushes sits on a stone base beside her. Behind her, deep green leaves and tree branches fill the background. Her pink dress has a detailed, dark green pattern that flows across the fabric.

title: Muse of Agriculture
alt_text: A painting of a woman reclining against a stone ledge, set within a semi-circular frame. The woman has red hair, wears a flowing green dress, and has a purple drape over her shoulder. She looks down toward her lap while holding a silver sickle in one hand and a few stalks of grain in the other. Behind her, a leafy branch with pink flowers hangs against a golden-yellow background. A large, white stone pillar stands vertically on the right side of the scene.

title: Muse of Literature
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a child posed within a semicircular frame. The woman has dark hair adorned with a gold laurel wreath and wears a light-colored dress with a deep red shawl draped over her. She rests her arm on a stack of large, thick books. A small, pale child stands to the right, reaching up to hold a green leafy branch near the woman’s shawl. The background is a flat, mustard-yellow color decorated with green painted leaves.

title: Muse of Music
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a small child in an arched frame. The woman has long, reddish-brown hair and wears a bright green dress, while sitting next to a white column. She holds a white tool with two legs, like a compass, in her hands. To her left, a pale, nude child leans back while holding a long, flowing white ribbon. Behind them, dark green leaves stand out against a golden-yellow background.

title: Muse of Electricity
alt_text: A painting of a woman with red hair reclining in a wide, arched frame. She wears a long, flowing pink dress that drapes over her legs and torso, and she rests against a white pillar. One of her arms is raised above her head, holding a glowing white light source. Beside her are a stack of books and a clear glass container filled with bright green liquid. The background is a soft yellow with dark green plant leaves behind her head.

title: Muse of Tragedy
alt_text: A painting of a person with long, dark hair who rests their chin on one hand. They wear a golden wreath on their head and are draped in a large, red fabric over a white dress. The figure leans against a light-colored, curved stone structure while holding a small, rolled-up white paper in their other hand. Behind the figure, a muted green background features dark green, leafy branches extending out from both sides. The entire scene is set within a wide, semi-circular frame with a rounded top edge.

title: Muse of Comedy
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas shows a woman with reddish-brown hair sitting against a yellow-green background. She wears a pink dress and holds a white, featureless mask up to her face. With her other hand, she holds a thin staff topped with a small, colorful jester head. The woman leans against a white stone ledge, and her long skirt, decorated with floral patterns, flows around her. Green leafy branches frame the upper part of the painting, which is set within an arched gold frame.

title: The Fall of the Rebel Angels
alt_text: A painting showing a bearded man in robes sitting on a throne in the center of the image. He is surrounded by a large, oval, reddish-gold shape filled with small faces and wings. Two tall, winged figures with golden halos stand on either side of the center figure. Below them, smaller monstrous, lizard-like creatures with sharp teeth crawl on the ground in dark, rocky surroundings. The background behind the wings is textured with gold rays.

title: The Holy Family with the Young Saint John the Baptist
alt_text: A painting of a group of figures in a warm, brownish setting. An older man with a long beard leans forward on the left side of the scene. Beside him, a child lies on its back, stretching its arms toward the man. On the right, a woman with a draped head covering looks down toward the center. The background is shadowy and creates a soft, hazy atmosphere around all the figures.

title: Fox, Henhouse and Crow

In the background, tall trees surround a large building with many windows that sits on a hill. A wide border frames the entire scene, decorated with repeating patterns of flowers, plants, and small figures. The whole image is rendered in shades of grey and white, suggesting a woven design.

title: The Archery Contest
alt_text: A wool and silk textile shows a wooded landscape scene surrounded by a decorative border. Five figures stand in the center, appearing to be engaged in some kind of outdoor activity or hunting. To their left is a large, leafy tree, and another large tree stands to their right. The background features a grassy field and hills fading into the distance. A wide, rectangular frame of flowers and foliage patterns surrounds the entire central scene.

title: The Toilers
alt_text: A textile of wool and silk depicting a detailed landscape scene. A decorative border filled with flowers and fruit wraps around the entire image. In the foreground, a large, bushy plant stands on the left near a small body of water. To the right, two figures are standing together in a grassy clearing beneath a large, leafy tree. The background shows a rolling hillside with dense trees and hints of buildings or structures in the distance.

title: Diana and Nymph
alt_text: A textile showing a garden landscape with two people resting in the lower foreground. The figures are seated among lush plants and flowers, wearing long, flowing clothes. Tall trees with thick leaves frame the sides of the image and arch over the top. In the distance, between the trees, a small bridge crosses a quiet river. A wide, patterned border with decorative swirls surrounds the entire scene.

title: The Judgement of Paris
alt_text: A textile of wool and silk shows a group of people gathered in an outdoor garden scene. A tall tree with thick leaves dominates the center of the image, while figures stand and sit in the foreground. To the left, there is a stone wall and a bridge structure near a fountain. A small building with arches can be seen in the distance on the right side. The entire scene is enclosed within a wide, ornate rectangular border featuring decorative patterns.

title: Eurydice
alt_text: A textile showing a garden scene featuring several figures among lush plants and trees. The scene is enclosed by a wide, detailed border that mimics a picture frame with ornamental designs.
