In the foreground, three figures are gathered together in a relaxed posture, partially surrounded by large, leafy bushes. Behind them, several tall, slender trees reach toward the top of the frame. To the left, potted trees with rounded crowns sit on a raised terrace overlooking the background. The entire image appears in shades of grey, indicating it is likely a black-and-white reproduction.

title: Courtship Scene
alt_text: A textile tapestry shows three figures walking together through a landscape. On the left, a person wearing a bright red cloak moves toward the center, where they hold hands with two other figures. The central figure wears a pale white dress, while the figure on the right is dressed in colorful blue and gold clothing. Large leafy green plants grow in the corner on the right side of the scene. Below this group, a wide horizontal border features detailed, repeating patterns of flowers and leaves in shades of tan and dark green.

title: Scene from the History of Cyrus
alt_text: A textile showing an intricate, woven scene with figures and elaborate borders. The main section displays a crowded landscape filled with multiple people in robes, rendered in muted earth tones of green, tan, and blue. Below this large scene, a distinct horizontal band features decorative plant motifs and geometric shapes against a lighter background. The entire piece has a soft, folded appearance typical of fabric hanging. A small, rectangular label with the numbers "1965.137" sits on the plain, light-colored surface beneath the textile.

title: Collar
alt_text: A piece of needlepoint lace apparel curves into a wide, shallow U-shape. The material is light cream in color and has a delicate, openwork mesh pattern. Spiraling floral or paisley-like shapes repeat along the entire bottom edge of the lace. A dark rectangular strip with the white numbers "1946.213" printed on it sits below the fabric. This label is centered at the bottom of the image against a plain gray background.

title: Collar
alt_text: A piece of needlepoint lace costume shows a wide, curved collar shape in a light cream color. The lace features an intricate pattern of diamond-shaped mesh filled with small, raised floral designs. The outer edge of the collar has a delicate, scalloped border. Below the collar, a rectangular black label with the white numbers "1946.215" sits against a light gray background.

title: Fragment of Lace
alt_text: A piece of tape lace is shown as a rectangular, off-white strip with a delicate, open pattern. The material looks thin and is full of small, rounded holes surrounded by intricate, knotted threads. The edges of the fabric appear slightly frayed and uneven along the top and sides. A single, thin thread hangs down from the bottom edge of the lace. Below the lace, a black rectangular label displays the white numbers "1946.218" in a simple font.

title: Strip of Lace
alt_text: A lace textile shows a long, cream-colored strip partially rolled on a cylindrical base. The lace features a delicate, net-like mesh background decorated with floral and swirling vine patterns. These intricate designs extend from the roll and lay flat across the surface to the right. A small, black rectangular sign sits below the lace, displaying the white text "1946.229". The entire object rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Strip of Lace
alt_text: A piece of lace textile shows a long, curved strip that resembles a collar. This off-white material has a delicate, net-like background decorated with stitched floral patterns. The edges of the strip are scalloped and wavy, following the curve of the piece. At the very bottom of the image, a small black rectangular label displays the white numbers 1946.230. The entire object rests against a plain, solid gray background.

title: Fragment of Lace
alt_text: A piece of lace shows a delicate, off-white floral pattern against a light background. The fabric is shaped like an irregular triangle with a jagged top edge. Fine, thread-like details create swirling vines and small flower shapes across the mesh. Below the fabric, a long, black rectangular label displays the number "1946.232" in white text. The overall appearance is light, lacy, and intricate.

title: Collar
alt_text: A piece of white lace apparel forms a curved, collar-like shape. The fabric is off-white or cream-colored and features a delicate, repeating floral pattern throughout the design. The edges of the lace are scalloped, following the curve of the floral shapes. Below the lace, a thin, rectangular black plaque displays the white numerical text "1946.233." This object rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Strip of Lace
alt_text: A piece of lace textile shows two narrow, cream-colored strips decorated with floral patterns. The lace is arranged in an L-shape on a plain, light gray background. The pattern features small, stitched flowers connected by delicate, winding stems and leaves. Below the lace, a thin, horizontal, black tag displays the white numbers "1946.234" in a clean font. The lace itself appears lightweight and slightly sheer, with the thread embroidery adding texture to the surface.

title: Fragment of Lace
alt_text: A piece of tape lace rests against a light gray background. This small, off-white textile item features curved tape patterns that wind together to form rounded, flower-like shapes. The lace has an intricate, open design with several circular gaps throughout its center. A thin strip of tape makes up the main structure of the piece, creating looping, petal-like edges. At the bottom of the image, a black label with the white numbers "1946.235" sits horizontally.

title: Strip of Lace
alt_text: A piece of tape lace shows a rectangular strip of cream-colored fabric against a plain gray background. The lace has an open, web-like pattern made of thin threads forming irregular loops and shapes. Within this intricate webbing, there are three distinct floral-like designs spaced evenly along the strip. Each design features curved, petal-like shapes that are denser than the surrounding background. A black identification label with the number "1946.247" sits centered below the piece of lace.

title: Strip of Lace
alt_text: A textile of Binche lace shows a long, thin strip of intricate, off-white fabric. The lace is rectangular in shape with irregular, jagged edges that look slightly frayed. A complex, web-like pattern of tiny loops and threads fills the entire surface of the strip. Below the lace, a black rectangular tag displays the white numbers "1946.249" in a modern font. The entire background is a neutral, light gray surface.

title: Piece
alt_text: A textile of linen embroidered with silk shows a light beige fabric decorated with a repeating pattern of dark green vines. The vines twist and curve across the cloth, connecting various stylized flowers and leaves. These floral shapes are stitched in shades of red, orange, and blue. Some blossoms are round and full, while others have long, pointed petals. A black identification tag with white numbers rests along the bottom edge of the fabric.

title: The Concert
alt_text: A textile of white wool and silk shows a complex outdoor scene filled with many small figures, plants, and structures. The design is arranged in layers, with small buildings and people scattered across hilly ground that goes from the bottom of the scene to the top. In the center, a group of people stands near a small pavilion, while figures on horseback move along a path on the right side. Several large trees and tall flowering plants fill the spaces between the people. A patterned border decorated with floral vines and ribbons frames the entire rectangular image.

title: Fragment
alt_text: A brocaded silk textile shows a rectangular piece of fabric with a dark, metallic appearance. The fabric has a fine, woven texture that creates subtle, light-colored patterns across its surface. Its edges are uneven, with loose, frayed threads hanging from the top and bottom sides. Below the textile, a separate, rectangular metal tag displays the numbers "1946.114" in white print against a dark background. The entire object rests against a plain, light-colored backdrop.

title: Strip of Lace
alt_text: A textile of bobbin lace shows a long, thin strip of intricate, cream-colored fabric. The lace features a repeating pattern of flowing, rounded shapes, swirls, and floral-like designs. It appears thin and translucent, resting against a plain, light gray surface. At the bottom of the image, a small, horizontal black rectangular label contains the white numbers "1946.239." The lace is draped slightly, with one end folded over itself toward the right side.

title: Piece
alt_text: A textile of printed linen shows a rural outdoor scene in brown ink on a light fabric background. In the foreground, two men in coats and hats stand while aiming long rifles, with a small dog walking nearby. A third person sits on the ground to their left, holding what appears to be a small animal. The background features rolling hills, several trees, and a house with a windmill on a hill in the distance. The print has a repeating, etched look with intricate lines that create shadows and texture.

title: Piece
alt_text: A textile of compound twill displays a complex, repeating pattern of large, stylized teardrop shapes. These teardrop motifs are filled with intricate floral and vine-like details in shades of red, light blue, and tan. The background alternates between vertical stripes of a muted brown color and rectangular sections of bright red. The entire piece has a woven texture that fills the frame from top to bottom. A white label with the number 1937.5274 is attached to the bottom edge of the fabric.

title: Fragment of Lace
alt_text: A piece of bobbin lace shows an intricate, openwork floral design against a light grey background. The off-white lace is shaped like a rounded, vertical segment with a smaller protrusion extending to the left. The pattern consists of delicate floral shapes and leaf-like motifs interconnected by a fine, net-like mesh. Below the lace, a black label displays the white painted text "1946.236". The entire piece has a soft, woven texture.

title: Strip of Lace
alt_text: A piece of bobbin lace showing a long, narrow strip of off-white material with a repeating pattern. The lace has a straight, woven top edge and a decorative bottom edge with small, rounded scallops. Each scallop contains a circular design created by the interwoven threads. The strip is folded back on itself at the right side to show a second layer of the same pattern. Below the lace, a small black rectangular plaque displays the white number 1946.238.

title: Strip of Lace
alt_text: A textile of Pucher lace shows a long strip of cream-colored fabric with an intricate, openwork pattern. One end of the lace is wrapped tightly around a smooth white cylinder that stands vertically on the left. The lace extends to the right, showing a scalloped edge along the top. Beneath the cylinder and the lace, a black rectangular sign lies horizontally. The sign displays the white numbers "1946.254" printed across its center.

title: Collar
alt_text: A piece of bobbin lace apparel in the shape of a wide, curved shawl. The fabric is a light, cream color with a complex, open-work pattern. The outer edge is scalloped, creating a wavy border that runs along the bottom and sides. A straight seam runs vertically down the center, dividing the fabric into two matching triangular wings. A rectangular black label with the white numbers "1947-40" sits on a white mount at the bottom center of the frame.

title: Seated Madonna
alt_text: A wooden sculpture shows a seated figure with a rounded, compact form. The figure has a smooth, dark brown surface with visible wood grain patterns. Its head is bowed, and the eyes are carved as simple, horizontal slits. The arms are folded tightly across the chest, and the legs are drawn inward to create a unified, oval shape. The figure sits directly on the ground against a plain, light grey background.

title: Table cover
alt_text: A textile of twill velvet shows a golden-yellow cloth covered in a floral pattern. The background is a mustard yellow color, and the design features large, stylized flowers in shades of red, green, and light blue. A prominent border runs along the left side and bottom edge, framed by thin, green lines. Small red blossoms are repeated in a line within the border. The fabric is draped over a wooden support with a label reading "1949.15" attached to the front.

title: Piece
alt_text: A textile made of brocaded compound satin shows an intricate pattern of curving, plant-like forms in faded colors. The fabric is primarily a muted gold or olive-yellow hue that covers the entire surface. Weaving throughout this background are swirling, vine-like shapes in shades of reddish-orange and soft blue-green. The material looks aged and slightly frayed along the edges, suggesting it is a fragment of a larger piece. At the bottom of the display, a small black label with white numbers reads "1949.20" and rests on a thin strip of white foam.

title: Piece
alt_text: A brocaded textile shows a repeating pattern of stylized floral and foliate designs. The fabric is primarily a muted gold or olive color with detailed shapes stitched in lighter pinks and darker greens. A distinct vertical seam runs down the center of the piece, suggesting it is made of two joined panels. The cloth is mounted on an angled wooden board for display. A small black label with white numbers sits along the bottom edge of the textile.

title: Kontush belt
alt_text: A piece of apparel made of brocaded silk and linen displays a long, rectangular shape with distinct color blocks. The top two-thirds of the fabric are divided vertically, with the left side being a deep red and the right side being a pale yellow, both decorated with thin, horizontal lines. At the bottom, there is a wider, light-colored panel that features two symmetrical, colorful floral designs. The entire piece is framed by narrow, decorative borders on both sides that feature small floral patterns. The material appears to be thin and slightly folded in places, lying flat against a white background.

title: Another Fight for Remembrance
alt_text: A painting of multiple figures with their arms raised high in the air. The figures are partially obscured by thick, energetic strokes of white paint that create a sense of motion. Two faces are visible near the bottom, looking forward with dark eyes above what appear to be white masks or scarves. The background is a very dark, almost black color. The bright white paint contrasts sharply against the darkness behind the figures.

title: Coffer
alt_text: A carved wood container is shown in a dark, negative image. The object is rectangular with an elaborate, intricate pattern covering its front surface. A distinct, bright white cutout shape is positioned near the bottom center of the container. The background surrounding the object is very dark and shadowy. Because of the negative lighting, the object appears as a ghostly, light-colored silhouette against a black field.

title: Landscape with Contrasting Tree Forms, II
alt_text: A painting of a landscape featuring a tall building and distant mountains under a bright orange sky. In the foreground, dark blue rocks and green plants sit on the left side of the scene. The center of the image shows a white building with a tall, slender tower standing near a body of water. A soft pink color fills the lower half of the painting, representing the water's surface. Dark grey mountains stretch across the middle ground, contrasting with the vibrant yellow and orange sky above.

title: Measure Solution Fortune Future Destiny from the series, Figure: Ground
alt_text: A brass sculpture shows a rectangular metal plate etched with words. The surface of the brass appears weathered and uneven with dark brown, bronze, and gold tones. Cut into the metal are words arranged in varying sizes, including "SOCIAL," "MEASURE," "SOLUTION," "FORTUNE," "FUTURE," and "DESTINY." Smaller words like "EACH," "LIQUID," "ENOUGH," "COMPOSED," "FROM," "WHEN," "THE," "WHOSE," and "BECOMES" are scattered around these larger terms. The overall effect is like a block of text stenciled into a rough metal sheet.

title: Heaven
alt_text: A painting of a black-and-white scene framed by text and graphics. On the right side, a woman in a dark outfit holds an open book while looking down. In the center, a rowboat with several people in it travels across a calm body of water toward a dark line of trees. Several small parachutes float in the sky above the treeline. The word "HEAVEN" is written in large, light blue outlined letters at the bottom right. In the top left corner, a light green star with a yellow, film-strip-like tail reads "Greetings from."

title: The Hollywood Dress
medium: Printed cellulose and cotton non-woven fabric
alt_text: A piece of apparel made of printed fabric is sleeveless and has an A-line shape. The dress is covered in a colorful, repeating pattern of faces that are arranged in a grid-like style. Each face is outlined in black, with flat colors like bright green, blue, pink, and yellow filling the background areas. At the very bottom of the garment, there is a horizontal band printed with small text in multiple rows. A small, square tag with the number 89 hangs from the top right edge of the neckline.

title: Centrefold
medium: Cotton T-shirt with color screenprint and airbrushing
alt_text: A T-shirt of cotton showing a graphic print on the front. The word "ARTFORUM" is printed in bold black letters near the collar. Below the text, a central image depicts a person with short dark hair wearing light-colored sunglasses. This figure is nude and surrounded by a soft, glowing aura of blended yellow, orange, and blue airbrushed colors. To the right of the figure’s hip, there is a small, handwritten-style signature in blue ink.

title: The Entombment of Christ
alt_text: A bronze relief shows a scene with several figures arranged in a dark, rocky setting. In the center, a person lies down, surrounded by a group of standing and kneeling figures who appear to be attending to them. The background features a large, gnarled tree hanging over the scene and what looks like a distant structure on a hill. The figures wear long, flowing robes that drape down to their feet. The entire piece is made of a dark, metallic material with textured surfaces that create light and shadow.

title: Rape of the Sabine Women
alt_text: A bronze relief sculpture shows a chaotic scene of people and horses in a classical city setting. Several muscular figures are locked in struggle or carrying other people, with some individuals mounted on horseback. In the center, a person stands looking toward the activity while surrounded by the action. Tall, arched architectural structures with columns fill the background behind the figures. The entire scene is rendered in a dark, metallic brown tone, creating depth through raised and recessed areas of the bronze.

title: Heptad
alt_text: A painting of horizontal stripes arranged in a long, thin rectangle. Several bands of color run from the left edge to the right edge. The widest band is a deep, muted reddish-purple color that sits slightly below the center. Above this, there are wider stripes in shades of light cream, gray, and tan. Below the main purple band, the colors are thinner and include soft pinks and grays. The entire image is enclosed within a simple, thin frame.

title: Study for a Scene from Lord Byron's "Manfred"
alt_text: A painting of a dark and mysterious scene shows shadowy forms and light. On the left side, deep brown and black shapes suggest trees or rocks that loom over the center. A pale, vertical patch of light shines through the darkness, stretching from the top down towards the bottom. To the right of this light, a faint and blurry figure in soft pinkish-red tones appears to be moving or floating. The entire surface has thick, rough brushstrokes that create a sense of texture.

title: Fox
alt_text: A stainless steel sculpture shows a four-legged animal creature with the head of a human. The body is sleek and silver, polished to a shiny, mirror-like finish. The head is a dull, matte grey color and appears to be resting on the ground. The creature is posed in a crouching position with its back arched and a long, pointed tail extending out behind it. The entire figure stands against a plain, light grey background.

title: Abenddammerung (Landscape at Dusk)
alt_text: A painting of a rolling landscape is composed of many horizontal, colorful bands of land. The sky at the top is a bright, solid orange strip. Below the sky, the landscape features wavy sections of dark blue, deep red, and rich green earth. Clusters of small, round green trees are scattered across the middle area, adding texture to the layers. The colors are very bold, creating a patterned and stylized view of the land.

title: An Easy Fording
alt_text: A painting of a person riding a horse through a shallow, light-colored river. The person wears a tan-colored shirt and a wide-brimmed hat. Nearby, three other horses carry large, beige, rectangular packs on their backs as they wade through the water. In the background, a dark green forest sits at the base of tall, jagged blue mountains. The scene is bright and lit by daylight, casting soft shadows on the water.

title: The Entry of Alexander into Babylon, from The Story of Alexander
alt_text: A wool tapestry showing a busy scene with many figures gathered outdoors. In the center, a person rides a horse while surrounded by a group of standing and seated people. Several men on the right carry a large, decorative vase on a tray. To the left, a woman holds a child near a group of seated figures. The entire image is framed by a wide border featuring detailed patterns of flowers, fruits, and leaves.

title: Parade
medium: Oil on paper mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and bold, intersecting lines. Thick layers of paint in shades of orange, deep purple, red, black, and white cover the entire surface. Dark, heavy black lines curve and zig-zag across the composition, separating the blocks of color. Some areas have solid, flat patches of orange, while other parts show visible, layered brushstrokes. The overall arrangement feels chaotic, with no clear focal point or recognizable figures.

title: Linum
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and loose, sweeping lines set against a plain white background. Large, organic blobs of orange and pale blue fill some areas of the composition. Several thin, curving lines in green, yellow, and red wander across the canvas like hand-drawn sketches. Near the center, a vertical, blocky shape adds a sense of structure to the otherwise fluid arrangement. The paint appears applied in thin, soft layers, allowing the texture of the canvas to remain visible underneath.

title: Six #2 model for Hirshhorn Museum sculpture & "Key City " module 1968
alt_text: A stainless steel sculpture of a geometric frame made from thin rods and delicate wires. The object features four vertical, cylindrical bars standing upright on a grey surface. Two additional horizontal bars intersect the vertical ones at different heights. Many thin, taut cables connect the various rods, stretching diagonally between them to create a web-like pattern. The metal structure has a smooth, reflective silver appearance against a neutral background.

title: Också
alt_text: A sculpture of maple, steel, and watercolor features a rectangular form with a zigzag pattern on its surface. The main body of the work consists of two mirror-image sections made of light brown wood, each shaped like a set of stairs seen from the side. A vertical spine runs down the center, lined with a series of pale, triangular shapes that point outward. These triangles create a sharp, jagged edge that separates the two wooden sides. The entire piece is mounted against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Still Life with Musical Instruments
alt_text: A bronze relief shows a collection of overlapping, angular, and curved shapes. The central part of the piece features a rectangular shape that slants diagonally from the top right toward the lower left. On this rectangle, there are small, etched patterns including a horizontal oval shape and parallel lines. To the lower right, a separate, smaller rectangular shape contains three evenly spaced circular cutouts. The background is composed of various flat planes and shadows that give the surface a layered look. All the forms are connected, creating a dense and textured composition within a thick frame.

title: Sutee Figure I
medium: Cloth, gauze, pitch, paper, wire and string on bronze stand
alt_text: A sculpture made of cloth, paper, and string shows a human-like figure with arms raised high. The figure is wrapped in dark, textured materials that appear worn and tattered. Its head is covered by a rounded cap or wrapping, obscuring any facial features. A gap in the midsection reveals a lighter, yellowish layer beneath the darker outer strips. The entire form stands balanced on a small, dark, rectangular base.

title: Female Head No.1
medium: Plaster, water-based pigment, graphite on wood base
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows the head of a person mounted on a thin, wooden frame. The head is off-white and features a rough, textured surface with visible indentations and marks. The facial features, including the eyes, nose, and lips, are slightly abstract and undefined. This head sits atop a narrow, triangular wooden support structure that stands on a flat wooden base. The entire object is centered against a dark, plain background.

title: Head of Markos
medium: Plaster, metallic paint, oil-based enamels, burlap wire and wood armature on bronze base
alt_text: A sculpture of a human head sits atop a thin, vertical black pole. The head is sculpted in a rough, uneven way and has a lumpy, plaster-like white surface. Patches of metallic silver, blue, and red paint are visible across the facial features and on the sides. At the base of the head, a small piece of rough, tan-colored material is visible. The entire sculpture rests on a flat, square, black metal base against a dark background.

title: Male Head No.1
medium: Plaster, graphite, wood wire, burlap, nails
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a stylized human head perched atop a wooden support structure. The white head is rough and angular, with defined facial features like a pointed nose and slightly open lips. It sits on top of three thin, wooden legs that form a tripod base attached to a flat, rectangular wooden board. The base is worn and stained with patches of paint, with a few rusty nails sticking up from its surface. One of the support legs is painted black, while the others are natural wood. The entire object is centered against a dark, plain background.

title: Untitled Head IV
medium: Plaster with dry pigment/water on bronze stand
alt_text: A sculpture of a human head sits balanced on a thin metal stand. The head is made of rough, textured plaster that appears colored with shades of bright red and muted white. It has a rounded, simplified shape with a prominent nose and hollowed-out areas for eyes. The surface looks uneven and pitted, giving it a weathered or crumbling appearance. The entire object rests on a sturdy, square black base that supports the vertical pole. The background is a solid, dark gray shadow that makes the piece stand out clearly.

title: Mujer Pegada - Maquette for Marble Relief IX
medium: Plaster, wire armature with bronze plate stand
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a standing figure attached to a dark, rectangular metal backplate. The figure is tall, thin, and textured, with a rough, uneven surface that suggests a person wrapped in cloth or draped material. A rounded hood covers the top of the figure’s head and extends down along its sides. The entire white figure stands on a small, matching white rectangular base attached to the metal plate. This dark plate acts as both a stand and a backdrop for the figure.

title: Mujer Pegada - Maquette for Marble Relief V
medium: Plaster, wire armature on wood with bronze stand
alt_text: A plaster sculpture showing a textured, upright figure mounted on a wooden board. The figure appears to be a person, but its features are rough and undefined. It stands against the center of a tall, rectangular piece of wood that has dark, weathered patches. The white plaster has a chunky, uneven surface that makes the figure look like it is emerging from the background. The entire assembly is supported at the bottom by a thin, flat bronze stand.

title: Mujer Pegada - Maquette for Marble Relief VI
medium: Plaster, wire armature on wood with bronze stand
alt_text: A sculpture of a tall, thin figure standing on a wooden backing. The figure is made of white plaster and appears rough with uneven texture across its surface. It spans almost the full height of a tall, rectangular wooden panel that has a patchy, brownish-yellow color. The panel is supported at the bottom by a thin, dark base. The white figure has a vague human shape, though its facial features and limbs are not clearly defined.

title: Mujer Pegada - Maquette for Marble Relief VII
medium: Plaster, wire armature with bronze plate stand
alt_text: A sculpture made of plaster showing the vertical, textured figure of a person standing against a flat, dark rectangular panel. The figure appears pale white and craggy, with a rough, uneven surface that makes it look like it was carved from raw stone. It is tall and slender, tapering towards the top like a hooded shape. The sculpture is mounted on a thin, dark brown rectangular metal stand that extends behind and beneath the figure. The lighting casts a soft shadow on the smooth surface to the right of the stand.

title: Mujer Pegada - Maquette for Marble Relief VIII
medium: Plaster, wire armature on wood with bronze stand
alt_text: A sculpture shows a tall, thin figure standing on a rectangular board. The figure is made of thick, rough white plaster and appears to be formed over a wire frame. It is attached to a flat, vertical piece of wood that has splashes of white material across its surface. The entire piece rests on a dark, narrow bronze stand at the bottom. The figure's surface is textured and uneven, with no clear facial features or details.

title: Mujer Pegada - Maquette for Marble Relief I
medium: Plaster, wire armature on wood with bronze stand
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows the rough, white figure of a person standing against a flat wooden board. The figure looks like it was shaped quickly, with visible finger marks and textured, layered plaster across its surface. This white figure is attached to a rectangular piece of light-colored wood that acts as a tall back panel. The entire assembly stands on a dark, thin base that extends slightly beyond the wooden panel. Overall, the piece appears to be a three-dimensional study of a human form held up by a simple support structure.

title: Mujer Pegada - Maquette for Marble Relief II
medium: Plaster, wire armature with bronze stand
alt_text: A plaster sculpture of a tall, standing figure rests against a dark metal backboard. The figure is made of rough, white plaster and has an uneven, textured surface. It appears to be a person, but facial features and limbs are not clearly defined. The figure stands on a thick, blocky base that also appears to be made of plaster. The entire sculpture is mounted vertically on a thin, dark bronze metal stand.

title: Mujer Pegada - Maquette for Marble Relief IV
medium: Plaster, wire armiture on wood with bronze stand
alt_text: A sculpture of a tall, thin figure made of white plaster stands attached to a rectangular wooden board. The figure represents a person seen from the back, with a textured surface that shows rough, layered marks. It occupies most of the height of the wood panel, which is set against a plain, dark background. The entire assembly is supported at the bottom by a flat rectangular stand. The plaster is applied unevenly, leaving some areas of the dark wooden board visible underneath.

title: Mary Julia (Cast 4/4)
medium: Bronze, oil based pigments, marble base
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a standing human figure stands on a square marble base. The figure has a rough, uneven texture, and is painted in shades of blue and teal. Its arms are missing, ending at the shoulders. The head looks forward and appears textured or darkened in color. The sculpture stands against a plain, light-gray background.

title: Maha - Ceramic Maquette VIII
alt_text: A fired clay sculpture shows a rough, human-like figure attached to a flat, rectangular backing. The rectangular background is tan and textured with horizontal lines. A lump of clay forms the figure, which has a slender body and limbs that blend into the background. The figure appears to float slightly above a small, separate clay base attached to the bottom. Dark spots and streaks are visible on the surface of the clay.

title: Maha - Ceramic Maquette X
alt_text: A fired clay sculpture shows a rough, human-like figure attached to a flat, rectangular slab. The figure is light tan in color and has a textured, lumpy surface that suggests a torso and head. It stands vertically against the center of the rectangular background, which is also made of tan clay. Behind and around the figure, there is a dark, brush-like mark made of dark grey slip glaze. The entire object rests on a thicker base made of the same light tan clay material.

title: Maha - Ceramic Maquette XI
alt_text: A fired clay sculpture of a figure embedded into a rectangular plaque. The figure is shown from the side in profile, with their head bowed and arms crossed against their chest. They are positioned against the center of the rectangular slab, appearing to merge into the background material. The surface of the slab and the figure have a textured, matte appearance with muted tones of beige and dark gray. The entire piece rests on a flat, rectangular base that extends slightly beyond the front of the plaque.

title: Maha - Ceramic Maquette IV
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture shows a slender human figure standing against a flat rectangular slab. The tall figure is attached to the right side of the slab and is made of rough, light-brown clay. The surface behind the figure is covered in a dark, textured patch of black glaze that contrasts with the tan, speckled background. The entire piece rests on a thick, horizontal base that extends forward slightly. The texture of the clay appears uneven and hand-molded throughout the object.

title: Maha - Ceramic Maquette IX
alt_text: A clay sculpture showing a tall, narrow plaque with a figure attached to one side. The surface of the plaque has a tan color and is marked with thin, horizontal lines. A roughly formed figure stands on the left side of the plaque, appearing lumpy and unfinished. The figure is attached directly to the side of the vertical slab. Two small, indistinct leaf-like shapes are pressed onto the smooth section of the plaque to the right of the figure. The entire object rests on a rectangular base.

title: Maha - Ceramic Maquette V
alt_text: A clay sculpture of a human figure standing against a flat, rectangular slab. The figure is tall and thin, with a rough, textured surface that suggests a simplified form without defined features. It stands on a small rectangular base attached to the larger slab behind it. The color of the object is a sandy, pale yellow with darker brown spots and marks throughout. The background slab has horizontal lines etched across its face.

title: Maha - Ceramic Maquette VI
alt_text: A clay sculpture shows a human figure attached to a rectangular, textured slab. The figure is light tan in color and appears rugged, with a somewhat unfinished surface. It stands on the left side of the rectangular back piece, which has horizontal, grooved lines running across it. A wide, vertical streak of reddish-brown coloring runs down the right side of the slab behind the figure. The entire sculpture rests on a flat, thick base against a dark, rectangular background.

title: Maha - Ceramic Maquette VII
alt_text: A fired clay sculpture shows a rectangular slab with a human-like figure molded onto its center. The slab is light tan with rough, textured surfaces. A large, dark brown patch of material stretches across the center and upper part of the slab, looking like thick, scraped paint. The figure is also light brown and stands upright, blending into the slab as if emerging from it. A thin, vertical crack runs from the bottom edge of the slab up through the center of the figure.

title: Sheila
alt_text: A painting of a person resting in an indoor space. The person has dark hair and sits behind a wooden headboard, looking toward the viewer. A bed in the foreground is covered with a patterned, colorful quilt in shades of yellow, blue, and black. Behind the person, a dark blue wall contrasts with a bright red doorframe to the right. A beaded curtain hangs in the background near a dark chair.

title: Archaic Grandmother
alt_text: A polychromed glazed ceramic sculpture of a woman stands on a small circular base. She wears a brightly colored, patterned dress with a short-sleeved top and a pleated skirt that hits below the knees. A matching wide-brimmed hat with decorative details sits on her head. Her skin appears pale, and she wears light-colored strappy sandals on her feet. Her left arm is missing from the elbow down, while her right arm reaches forward slightly.

title: THE FBI FILES 43
alt_text: A painting made of mixed media collage on canvas shows two distinct sections side-by-side. On the left, a figure is painted in dark, muted colors, wearing a patterned coat, set against a large, thick block of deep red paint. To the right, a rectangular paper document with jagged edges is layered over the background. This document features several lines of text that have been heavily marked over with thick, black, horizontal lines. The entire composition is framed by a thin, patterned border and an outer edge of bright red paint.

title: Portrait of a Boy with a Book
alt_text: A painting of a young person with curly brown hair looking directly at the viewer. This portrait is shaped like an oval and features a dark, plain background. The person wears a deep purple wrap with a bright blue ribbon tied at the neck and lace trim. Their white shirt sleeves are gathered and appear underneath a decorative, gold-patterned fabric. They are holding a thick, brown book with both hands in front of them.

title: Study of Trees
alt_text: A painting of a forest landscape with trees and distant hills. Large, tall trees stand in the foreground on the left, their trunks showing patches of gray and brown bark. One thick branch reaches out diagonally from a tree toward the center of the image. The ground below is shaded and filled with fallen logs and small bushes. To the right, the trees thin out to reveal a view of rolling, light-colored hills under a hazy, pale sky.

title: Fox Trot B, with Black, Red, Blue, and Yellow
alt_text: A painting of rectangular shapes filled with solid colors and divided by thick black lines. A large red rectangle sits in the upper right, while a large white square fills much of the center. To the left of the white square is a small black rectangle above a smaller blue rectangle. A thin yellow horizontal bar rests near the bottom edge. The entire composition is contained within a simple white frame.

title: Caryatid II
medium: Plaster, water-based pigments, aluminum armature on wood base
alt_text: A sculpture of a tall, standing figure made of plaster. The figure has an oval-shaped head with no facial features and smooth, slender shoulders. Its body is long and straight, narrowing at the waist and widening slightly toward the base. The surface is mostly white with patches of pale pink and light blue color. The figure stands upright on a simple, rectangular wooden base.

title: Ostrakon Plaster Maquette. No. 3
medium: Plaster, water based pigments, aluminum armature on wood base
alt_text: A sculpture of a tall, thin figure stands upright on a rectangular wooden base. The figure has a roughly shaped, white-colored body made of textured material. One arm, which appears to be a thin metal rod, hangs down along the figure's side. The surface of the main body shows uneven patches of white, yellow, and grey colors. It has a rounded, indistinct head perched on a thin, neck-like section.

title: Ostrakon Plaster Maquette. No. 4
medium: Plaster, water based pigments and aluminum armature on wood base
alt_text: A sculpture of a slender, upright human figure stands against a dark, gray background. The figure is made of a matte white material and rests on a simple, square wooden base. Its form is very smooth and simplified, with no facial features or clear limbs. One side of the torso and lower body appears rougher and less defined, looking like uncarved stone or jagged rock. A soft light shines on the sculpture, creating a subtle shadow to the right.

title: Architectural Forms - Repair of the Great Steps of Tula I
alt_text: A sculpture made of cardboard and other materials shows a three-tiered, stepped structure. Each level tapers upward like a pyramid. The front faces are painted with a rough, streaky layer of white paint. On the right side, the edges and faces are a dark, brownish red. The base is wider than the levels above it, giving the piece a sturdy look.

title: Architectural Forms-Tula Series III
alt_text: A sculpture showing three separate, off-white objects arranged in a line on a plain background. Each object is shaped like a low, flat-topped mound with rough, textured sides. A small set of two steps is carved into the front of each mound, leading up toward the flat top. The objects are similar in size and appearance, though they vary slightly in texture and tone. They are lined up one behind the other, receding into the distance.

title: Annunciation No. 1
medium: Plaster, water-based pigments, steel armature, styrofoam core, burlap, marble base
alt_text: A sculpture of a figure kneels on a flat surface against a plain grey background. The figure is pale white and appears rough, with dark grey smudges on the head, chest, and torso. One arm is raised and bent at the elbow as if pointing or gesturing to the side. The other arm hangs straight down along the body, with the hand resting near the hip. Patches of reddish-orange pigment stain the side of the figure's leg and lower body. The surface of the sculpture looks textured and uneven, suggesting layers of material.

title: Bull Jumper III
medium: Plaster, water-based pigment, steel armature with styrofoam and burlap
alt_text: A sculpture of a human figure crouching on its hands and knees. The figure is made of white material with large, rough patches of black pigment covering its back and buttocks. Its body appears thin and textured, with the white plaster coating a bumpy, uneven surface. The head is round and faces forward, showing no clear facial features. The figure is supported on a solid, light-colored surface against a gray background.

title: Coming in Last Thursday
medium: Plaster, steel armature, styrofoam core and burlap on marble base
alt_text: A sculpture of a standing female figure is rendered in a rough, textured style. The figure is mostly white, with large, irregular patches of grey and dark charcoal scattered across the torso, arms, and legs. Her body is upright, with her left arm bent at the elbow so her hand rests near her shoulder. The texture of the surface looks uneven and hand-worked, showing thick layers of material. She stands on a simple, round, tan-colored base against a plain grey background.

title: Julia
medium: Plaster, steel armature, styrofoam, wire and burlap on marble base
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a standing human-like figure on a rectangular red marble base. The figure has a rough, white surface that looks uneven and textured. Its arms are raised and bent at the elbows with the hands positioned near the shoulders. The statue stands against a plain, dark background with soft lighting. Some dark, irregular markings appear on the lower torso and legs of the figure.

title: Re-making of Mary Julia No.6
alt_text: A sculpture of a human figure sits on a wooden chair. The figure appears to be made of rough, plaster-like material that is patchy and textured. Its skin tone is a mix of off-white, grey, and light brown areas. The figure faces toward the right, with its arms resting straight down its sides. Behind it, the simple wooden chair is light brown and shows signs of wear and paint splatters. The entire scene is set against a plain, light grey background.

title: Sculpture for Love and Other Differences:Ruth
medium: Plaster water-based pigment, steel armature, styrofoam core, burlap on marble base
alt_text: A sculpture showing a standing, full-length figure with a mostly white, textured surface. The figure appears to be a woman, with patches of dark gray or black pigment across her torso, hips, and limbs. Her right arm is truncated near the shoulder, while her left arm hangs naturally at her side. Her hair is a lighter, yellowish color and falls toward her back. The figure stands on a simple, rectangular base. The entire object is set against a plain, solid gray background.

title: Arcos de Geso X
medium: Plaster, pigments, wire and wood armature
alt_text: A sculpture of a human figure stands against a rectangular, light-colored panel. The figure is shaped from yellowish plaster and appears to be a woman, shown from the front in a standing position. She has a rough, textured surface and is integrated into the background panel, which is also covered in patches of pale yellow paint. To the left of the figure, there are faint, reddish streaks on the flat surface. The entire piece is mounted on a dark, rectangular base that contrasts with the lighter artwork.

title: Architectural Forms - Megida:Emborados No.3
medium: Fiberglass, resin with wire armature and cardboard
alt_text: A sculpture made of fiberglass and resin shows a jagged, broken-off section of a wall. It has a rough texture covered in a dense grid of fine wire mesh. A rectangular opening near the bottom center creates a tunnel-like shape beneath the solid material. The piece is angled upward from the left to the right, resembling a ruined architectural fragment. Brown, fibrous material lines the base and the edges of the opening.

title: Ostrakon Plaster Maquette No.8
medium: Plaster, water based pigments and aluminum armature on wood base
alt_text: A sculpture of a headless, armless human torso stands against a dark background. The figure is made of a rough, pale, off-white material that shows texture and uneven surfaces. There is a patch of reddish pigment on the top where the neck would be. The torso tapers slightly toward the hips and has a gentle curve. It rests upright on a simple, rectangular wooden base.

title: Vestida No. 6
medium: Plaster, water-based pigments, wire armature on wood base
alt_text: A sculpture of a standing figure with a smooth, featureless, rounded head. This white, upright human-like form has a slender body with one arm held close to its side. A large, rough patch of gray, textured material covers the center of the torso and one arm, contrasting with the smooth white surface of the rest of the figure. The statue stands on a simple, square, light-colored wooden base. The entire figure is set against a dark, plain background that fades to light at the bottom.

title: Vestida No. 10
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows a standing woman in a long, flowing garment. The figure has a smooth, rounded head with no facial features, and her hair is pulled back. She stands straight with one arm resting at her side and the other slightly bent across her waist. The surface of the white plaster is marked with streaks of dark gray or black paint that follow the folds of the clothing. She is supported by a simple, rectangular wooden block base.

title: Architectural Forms-Tula Series V {Untitled Rectangles, 1969-71}
alt_text: A sculpture of a blocky, light-colored, trapezoidal object sits on a plain surface. The object is widest at the bottom and tapers to a flatter, rectangular top. Its sides are textured and appear somewhat rough, like dried concrete or plaster. Near the bottom base, some frayed wire or fabric material extends outward from underneath the form. The lighting creates a soft shadow behind and to the right of the object, emphasizing its three-dimensional shape.

title: Man and Money
alt_text: A painting shows figures in red shirts leaning out of rectangular windows in beige walls. One figure, positioned in the upper right window, wears a white triangular hat and a black mask over their eyes. Below them, a second window shows a person wearing a bright red shirt who holds a dark-colored cup filled with gold coins. This person's other hand is raised with fingers in a circular gesture. In a smaller, distant window to the left, another figure wearing a white hat holds their hands in front of their chest. The background consists of flat, tan architectural shapes against a dark blue sky.

title: Daydream
alt_text: A painting shows a person resting on sand under a dark red cloth canopy. The person lies on their side, wearing a long, light-colored shirt and looking as if they are sleeping. A large, dark red fabric hangs over them, supported by several thin poles stuck into the sandy ground. One of the person's hands reaches out toward a small dark object lying on the sand. The background is a solid, dull green color, contrasting with the sandy floor.

title: Self Portrait
medium: Acrylic polymer emilsion on gessoed masonite
alt_text: A painting of a man standing in front of an easel. The man is shown from the chest up, facing right and wearing a dark blue shirt. He holds a thin paintbrush in his right hand, reaching out to touch the surface of a large, tilted canvas. The canvas displays an abstract figure with soft, pastel colors. Behind the man and the easel, a large white-framed window fills the background with soft, pale light. Harsh, bright sunlight casts strong shadows across the wall behind the canvas.

title: Architectural Forms-Repair of the Great Steps of Tula II
alt_text: A sculpture made of cardboard, pigment, wood, and tape is shaped like a stepped pyramid with three tiers. The base level is the largest and is painted in a muted lavender color with a dark brown end. The middle tier is smaller and painted in shades of dark red and purple. The top tier is the smallest and has a flat, tan cardboard surface on top. The sides of the structure reveal exposed, layered materials like wood and tape. The object sits against a plain, light gray background.

title: Ostrakon Plaster Maquette. No. 5
medium: Plaster, water based pigments and aluminum armature on wood base
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows the figure of a tall, standing person facing slightly to the side. The figure is long and slender with a smooth face and minimal features. One side of the body appears rough and textured, as if it is unfinished or crumbling. The entire figure is stark white against a dark background. It stands upright on a rectangular, polished wooden base.

title: Arcos de Geso V
medium: Plaster, pigments, wire and wood armature
alt_text: A sculpture of plaster, pigments, wire, and wood showing a figure attached to a rectangular wall-like panel. The figure is standing on the right side of the flat surface and faces toward the left. It has a rough, textured appearance with patches of pale yellow pigment layered over white plaster. The main rectangular panel behind the figure also has large, uneven patches of this same yellow color mixed with white. The entire piece rests on a simple, dark-colored rectangular base.

title: Standing Lincoln
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a man standing before a chair. The man is tall and wears a long coat, a vest, and a bowtie, with his hands placed near his waist. His gaze is directed downward and toward the viewer, and he has a short, trimmed beard. Behind him, an ornate chair with decorative wing-like shapes on its backrest sits on a square base. The entire object has a deep reddish-brown color and a smooth, metallic surface.

title: Mirror with Landscape Leaning (Fragment Series)
medium: Acrylic paint, archival prints, wood, lamp, ladder, mirror, and reed
alt_text: A sculpture showing a collection of everyday items arranged against a plain wall on a wooden floor. In the center, a tall rectangular mirror stands upright with a streak of blue paint running down its surface toward a small, multicolored shape. Behind the mirror, a metal ladder reaches up toward the ceiling. A wooden table sits in front of the mirror, holding a single wooden chair and two small, clear glasses. A thin metal floor lamp with a curved neck stands to the left of the table. A long white string connects the table and the paint on the mirror to a gray rock resting on the floor.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of a tall white pitcher filled with a bouquet of vibrant flowers. The flowers are mostly red, orange, and white, with thick strokes of dark green leaves underneath. The pitcher sits on a flat surface in the center, casting a dark shadow to its right. Behind the flowers, an open window reveals a pale sky and a small house in the distance. The background is filled with blocky, abstract shapes in shades of blue and gray.

title: Escritorio de Salamanca (writing desk)
medium: Iron-mounted bone, inlaid painted and partly-gilded walnut
alt_text: A piece of furniture made of iron-mounted bone, inlaid painted, and partly-gilded walnut showing an open cabinet with many small drawers. The cabinet has a dark wood exterior frame with a large, flat, rectangular surface extending outward like a desk lid at the bottom. Inside, there are numerous small rectangular drawers arranged in neat rows and columns. These drawers feature elaborate golden and painted designs with vertical column-like details. A single vertical door stands in the center of the upper section, featuring a dark, keyhole-shaped opening. The entire object has a rectangular shape and a brownish, weathered look, contrasting with the detailed and bright decoration of the interior compartments.

title: In the Beginning
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes set against a dark background. The majority of the canvas is a flat, solid black. On the left side, a long, thin, vertical line stretches downward, made of multicolored segments of orange, white, and blue. To the right of this vertical line, there are three distinct, bright red marks. Two of these red marks are shaped like small, narrow rectangles, and the third is a slightly larger, irregular patch near the top.

title: Nocturne
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a human torso stands against a plain grey background. The figure is missing its head and limbs, showing only the chest, stomach, and part of the upper hips. Large, jagged pieces of bronze are missing from the front and sides, revealing a lighter, textured inner material. The torso rests on a flat, disc-shaped base that appears to be made of the same dark, textured metal. This entire sculpture sits on top of a simple, rectangular white pedestal.

title: Avant Garde (Birth Series)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a standing figure holding two spherical objects. The figure wears a tall, structured hat and a long coat that reaches to the mid-thigh. It holds a smooth, large sphere in its right hand and a smaller sphere in its left hand, which is extended forward. The figure stands on a rough, uneven base that sits on top of a plain white square pedestal. The entire sculpture has a dark, metallic gray color with visible texture throughout.

title: Rose Prentice (1771–1852)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows the portrait of a woman inside an open, hinged case. The woman has dark skin, short dark hair, and wears a colorful patterned headwrap. She also wears a white, ruffled collar over a light-colored dress with faint vertical stripes. The portrait is framed by an octagonal gold-colored border against a plain blue-grey background. On the left side of the open case, a panel of brown velvet features a small, gold floral emblem stamped in the center.

title: King Midas Turns an Oak Branch to Gold
alt_text: A painting of three people in a dark, outdoor landscape. In the foreground on the left, a person with bare shoulders and light skin reclines on the ground facing away from the viewer. Further back, another figure with bare skin sits on the grassy ground beneath the shadow of a large, dark tree. Standing to the right, a bearded man wears a long, white, draped garment with a bright yellow cloak wrapped around his shoulders. He faces toward the other two figures while reaching out his hand. Behind them, rolling hills rise toward a cloudy, dark sky in the distance.

title: Untitled #17
alt_text: A painting on panel with abstract, layered strokes of many different colors. Thick, white paint swirls across the center and upper portions of the image, obscuring parts of the background. Underneath the white, patches of muted green, blue, and deep red are visible in some areas. Darker, streaky lines and messy smudges create texture throughout the composition. The entire surface feels chaotic, with colors blending and overlapping in an uneven, rough pattern.

title: Lady Ursula Kneeling before Pompdebile, King of Hearts
alt_text: A painting of a person kneeling before a seated figure on a black-and-white checkered floor. The person on the left wears a long, pale yellow robe and has their head bowed with hands covering their face. The seated figure on the right wears a tall, flat-topped hat and layers of reddish-brown clothing while resting their feet on a small pillow. They both sit within an open stone structure with large columns. Behind them, a lush garden with green trees and a white vase is visible in the daylight.

title: Gary + Paul
medium: Acrylic on 1/32 inch plywood,  painted recto & verso;  handmade poplar stand
alt_text: A painting of two babies sitting side-by-side on what appears to be a lawn. The painting is a black-and-white image created with acrylic paint on a thin, rectangular piece of plywood. Two small children, dressed in light-colored shirts, sit close together at the bottom center of the frame. They are surrounded by the dark, textured shapes of foliage. The painting rests in an upright position on a plain, handmade wooden stand.

title: Halloween
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows an open triangular shape made of rough, dark metal. Inside this triangle, there is a separate circular form that appears to be constructed from twisted or melted metal pieces. A small, clumped shape rests in the very center of the circular form. The entire object has a textured, uneven surface that looks like burnt or raw material. It stands against a plain, light gray background.

title: Costume for a Court Lady (Lantern Bearer)
medium: Robe: hand-painted silk with velvet; cap: hand-painted silk with glass beads
alt_text: A costume of a silk robe and a cap is shown against a plain gray background. The robe is wide and cream-colored with repeating patterns of dark-outlined, yellow flowers printed across it. Dark velvet borders line the sleeves and the bottom edge of the robe. A matching small, rounded cap rests above the robe’s neck, featuring the same floral pattern. The entire outfit is mounted on a simple black stand.

title: Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting of nested colored squares inside a simple white frame. The artwork is composed of three squares stacked on top of one another. The outermost square is a brownish-yellow color. A slightly smaller square of bright orange sits in the center of that. Finally, the innermost square is a deep, solid red.

title: Study for Homage to the Square
alt_text: A painting showing a series of concentric squares in different colors. The outermost square is a frame-like border of teal, surrounding a medium-sized grey square. Inside that sits a slightly smaller, bright blue square. At the very center of the composition is a solid, dark reddish-brown square. The entire painting is held within a thick, light-colored square frame.

title: Yellow Washcloth
alt_text: A painting of a man sitting in a chair. The man is shirtless, wearing only white underwear, and has his hand near his chin. To his right stands a tall, framed mirror leaning against the wall, reflecting his own upper body as he lies on a bed. On the floor in front of him sits a small, round white bowl filled with water and a yellow sponge. The room has dark, muted walls and wooden floorboards.

title: Portrait of Bernardo di Cino Bartolini Benvenuti de’ Nobili and Four of His Sons: Bartolomeo, Carlo, Benedetto, and Alamanno
alt_text: A painting of five figures kneeling in prayer against a gold background. A large man wearing a pink cloak stands at the front, with his hands pressed together and facing to the right. Behind him are three younger men in blue and red robes, also kneeling with their hands clasped. A fifth person stands partially hidden in the far background on the left, wearing a reddish-purple garment. The figures kneel on a red rug decorated with a repeating yellow pattern. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, ornate gold frame.

title: Crucifix
alt_text: A painting on a wooden panel shows a figure attached to a dark cross. The figure has outstretched arms and a slightly tilted head surrounded by a golden halo. Below the torso, a piece of light-colored fabric drapes around the waist and legs. The figure stands on a small rectangular platform near the bottom of the cross. Two clear, glass-like stands sit on either side of the base of the cross on a wooden surface. The background behind the cross is a solid wood panel with a wavy, dark grain pattern.

title: Journey and Adoration of the Magi and the Annunciation to the Shepherds
alt_text: A painting on wood panel shows a crowded outdoor scene against a bright gold background. On the bottom left, a woman in a blue robe holds a small child, with a bearded man standing beside them. In front of them, a figure in a red cloak kneels on the ground. A group of men stands to the right, some wearing colorful tunics and hats, with horses and a donkey nearby. Above them, a rocky landscape rises toward a tall pink building with arched windows at the top right, while a winged figure stands on the hill to the left.

title: Crucifixion
alt_text: A painting of three figures set against a background of gold-colored leaf. A central figure hangs with arms outstretched on a tall, thin wooden cross. This person’s body is depicted in dark, muted tones and slants slightly to one side. Below the cross, two other figures sit on the ground, one on the left and one on the right. Both figures are wearing draped clothing in shades of dark blue and deep red, and they look up toward the figure on the cross. The entire scene is enclosed in a tall, arched, decorative wooden frame.

title: Virgin and Child with Four Angels
alt_text: A stucco sculpture displays a relief set inside a gold, rectangular frame with an oval opening. In the center, a woman sits on a bench while holding a small child in her lap, surrounded by four figures who appear to be seated or kneeling on the ground. The background of the central scene is lightly carved with architectural details like an archway. Four winged figures are painted in the corners of the rectangular frame, two in blue and two in red. A small metal ring hangs from the top edge of the frame, allowing it to be hung on a wall.

title: Shrouded Figure
medium: plaster, water-based pigment, wood, wire, burlap
alt_text: A sculpture of plaster showing a crouched figure sitting on a wood floor. The figure is mostly white, with a rough, textured surface that suggests fabric or burlap. A dark, grayish-blue area appears on the lower torso and hip of the figure. The sculpture has no head or arms, and it leans slightly backward. In the background, a white wall with a framed print hangs to the left, creating a gallery setting.

title: Shadows of Liberty
medium: Oil and rusted nails on canvas
alt_text: A painting in oil and rusted nails on canvas shows a pale-skinned person with white hair riding a white horse across a rocky landscape. The person wears a long, golden cape that appears to be constructed from thousands of rusted nails covering their chest and torso. Their right hand is raised, pointing a slender silver sword into the air. The background features a dramatic, cloudy sky with patches of sunset orange and dark blue. The horse has dark gray hair and looks toward the left, walking along a path that leads away from the viewer.

title: Orchard Bordered by Cypresses
alt_text: A painting of a blooming orchard with a dirt path cutting through the scene. On the right side, a tall, wooden structure with a fence stands near several trees covered in pale yellow and white flowers. In the background, a row of tall, thin, dark green cypress trees stretches across the horizon against a light blue sky. A dirt path runs diagonally from the lower left toward the center, bordered by patches of grass and small plants. The colors are bright and heavily textured, showing clear, thick brushstrokes throughout the entire scene.

title: La rue Lepic
alt_text: A painting of a group of people standing outside at a market stall. In the center, a man wearing a dark hat and coat stands next to a woman in a reddish jacket and a long green skirt. Behind them, to the right, another person in a dark top stands behind a table piled with goods, possibly produce. To the left, several other figures are visible in the background, walking or standing together in the street. The scene is rendered in quick, visible brushstrokes with a muted color palette. A signature is visible in the bottom left corner.

title: Figure Study of a Knight
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in metallic armor and layered clothing, sitting outdoors. The man wears a red hat with a dark feather, a brown hood, and a red tunic over his chest piece. His legs are covered in metal greaves, and he wears brown leather boots. He holds a long, straight sword with both hands, resting it on the low stone wall he sits upon. Behind him, a rough white stone wall stands next to a dark, vertical wooden post.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a child against a bright, textured gold background. The woman wears a dark blue hood over her head that drapes over her shoulders and body. She holds a small, light-skinned child on her left arm, who is wrapped in a red cloth around the waist. Both the woman and the child have glowing, patterned halos behind their heads. The top of the painting is arched, and the entire scene is framed within a dark, wooden border.

title: Saint Vincent de Paul Preaching to the Court of Louis XIII on Behalf of the Abandoned Children
alt_text: A painting showing a crowded indoor scene with people gathered in a large, stone building. On the left, a man wearing a bright red, fur-trimmed robe kneels while looking toward a central figure. A man in a white robe stands on a raised stone step in the middle, gesturing with his hands as if speaking. In the foreground, women in long dresses and children sit on the floor, and some of the children are being held. A thick red curtain hangs from the ceiling on the right side, partially covering a dark alcove. Tall stone columns stretch up towards the ceiling in the background, creating a sense of height.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture made of acrylic showing overlapping circular shapes against a solid white wall. These translucent, pale shapes create a flower-like pattern where they meet in the center. A horizontal bar of light sits in the middle of the composition, glowing from behind the layered acrylic forms. The overall effect is soft, bright, and symmetrical. The artwork is centered on a flat white surface within a larger room.

title: The Labors of the Months: May
medium: Copper painted in enamel and partially gilt
alt_text: A ceramic plate shows a detailed scene in grayscale with touches of gold and reddish-orange. In the center, a man and a woman ride a horse through a dense forest, while a smaller boy walks beside them holding the horse's reins. A small, winged figure floats in the sky above the trees. The wide rim is decorated with a complex border of curling leaves, fruit, and several small faces. The overall design features shading that gives the figures a raised, three-dimensional look.

title: Hands Up!
alt_text: A painting shows a horse-drawn carriage traveling through a narrow, rocky mountain pass at sunset. On top of the carriage, a driver sits with both hands raised high in the air. Two large brown horses pull the carriage, their heads turned toward the viewer. On the left side of the path, a man with a wide-brimmed hat walks alongside the carriage while holding a rifle. In the background, steep canyon walls rise up on either side, with a warm, glowing light visible in the distance.

title: Society Woman's Cloth (Gold)
medium: Aluminum bottle caps and copper wire
alt_text: A sculpture made of aluminum bottle caps and copper wire hangs on a gallery wall. It appears as a large, flexible, rectangular tapestry composed of thousands of small, circular metal pieces connected by wire. The surface has a golden, reflective sheen with large, bumpy ridges that create a three-dimensional, wavy texture. Throughout the piece, there are accents of red, black, and silver bottle caps mixed into the gold. The edges of the sculpture are uneven and jagged, creating an organic, fringe-like appearance.

title: Soundsuit
medium: paint, paper, cotton, wood, fabricated fiberglass
alt_text: A sculpture made of paper, cotton, and painted fiberglass stands against a corner wall. The piece is shaped like a tall figure with a textured, shaggy exterior. The lower body is covered in long, dark, fringe-like strips that resemble hair or straw. The upper torso and head are decorated with many small, circular and rectangular cutouts featuring black-and-white patterns. A tall, cylindrical top piece sits on the very top of the figure, also covered in intricate black-and-white designs.

title: Charles Milton Pope (1807–1849)
alt_text: A miniature portrait of a man, painted in watercolor on ivory, is presented in an ornate oval frame. The man has curly dark brown hair and is facing forward with a calm expression. He wears a high-collared white shirt under a black coat, with a yellow vest visible beneath the coat. The background is a soft, light-toned wash that fades into white. The metal frame is decorated with intricate carvings of leaves and has a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: If perhaps by chance I find myself encaged
medium: Oil on canvas and oil on CelluClay
alt_text: A sculpture made of oil on canvas and oil on CelluClay shows a family in a combination of painting and three-dimensional form. A man stands in the center inside a tall, white, cage-like structure made of rough, textured material. On the left side, a flat, rectangular canvas shows a painting of a woman with dark hair wearing a black dress. On the right, another canvas shows a painting of a young boy in a green jacket and a young girl in a pink shirt. The man in the middle wears a blue button-down shirt and jeans. He reaches out with both hands to touch the edges of the white, sculptural frame surrounding him.

title: Ocean Park #24
alt_text: A painting of abstract geometric shapes in muted and bright colors. Large, blocky sections of pale blue, white, green, and pink fill most of the composition. A thick, vibrant blue line cuts diagonally through the top left, bending sharply toward the center of the canvas. Smaller bands of orange, yellow, and lavender sit alongside the blue line, adding thin layers of color to the scene. The entire image appears as a collection of interlocking, flat shapes with clean, straight edges.

title: Young Woman of the Folwell Family
alt_text: A watercolor miniature of a young woman with brown hair worn in an updo. She is wearing a pale blue dress with a wide, white lacy collar around her neck. A thin, dark necklace rests against her collarbone. The portrait is oval-shaped and framed in a textured gold border with a small loop at the top for hanging. The background of the portrait is a soft, blurry mix of dark green and gray tones.

title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine of Alexandria
alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a small child as they both reach out toward a kneeling woman. The woman holding the child wears a long red dress and a blue cloak, while the kneeling woman wears a light-colored dress with a purple scarf. To the right, an older man with a long beard stands holding a stalk with pink flowers. A small winged figure floats in the dark, cloudy space near the bottom left. The scene is set against a dark background with a soft, glowing light around the heads of the main figures.

title: Lynched Figure [Study for “The Incident”]
alt_text: A painting showing a seated figure with dark skin being attended to by someone in white robes. The seated person leans back with their head tilted up, wearing a simple white cloth around their waist. A hand from the robed figure reaches down near the person’s neck, while another hand holds a long, dark, curved object that spirals near the person's leg. This coiled object resembles a snake and has a patch of yellow color on its end. The background is simple and mostly obscured by the standing figure's clothing.

title: Hero
alt_text: A nickel silver sculpture shows a complex arrangement of sharp, metal shapes. The object sits on a small, rectangular stone base. Its surface has a rough, hammered texture and a dull metallic color. Several pointed, blade-like forms extend outward from a central column. These pieces twist and overlap in a jagged, irregular pattern against a plain gray background.

title: Arcos De Geso Plaster Maquette IV (Mujer Pagada)
alt_text: A sculpture of a human-like figure standing in profile against a flat, white background. The figure is tall, narrow, and made of textured white plaster. It faces left, with its head and body pressed close to a thin, dark vertical line that runs down the center of the surface. At the bottom of the piece, dark, rough areas of pigment break up the white plaster. The entire work is rectangular and stands on a simple base.

title: Pilgrim Flask, no. 1303
alt_text: A porcelain container shows a flat, circular vessel with a bright blue finish. At the top of the circle sits a small, gold-rimmed opening. The center of the circle features a decorative, stylized design of a bird with wide wings and a fan-shaped tail. This design uses colors like green, orange, red, and yellow, with tiny details that resemble feathers. The container rests on two small, gold-edged feet at the bottom.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain container shows a cylindrical cup with a bright blue background. The body of the cup is decorated with patterns of green plant stalks and reddish-brown cattails. Bands of geometric blue and dark patterns circle the top and bottom edges of the cup. The vessel stands on three small feet that are shaped like animal paws with white claws. The inside of the cup is white, and the rim has a thin gold edge.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain vase displays a vibrant, light blue rounded body accented with bright white daisy-like flowers. Green leaf-like shapes curve elegantly around the flowers on the main part of the vase. The tall, narrow neck above the blue section features a white background decorated with repeating dark green and blue patterns trimmed in gold. At the bottom, the vase rests on a gold-colored base with an intricate, open-cut geometric pattern. The entire object sits against a simple, solid grey background.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain vase with a wide, rounded body and a flared neck sits against a plain grey background. The vase features a vibrant light blue body painted with stylized, multi-colored geometric flower patterns. Its upper neck is dark green and decorated with similar angular, symmetrical shapes in shades of red, blue, and gold. A band of dark brown with small gold squares separates the neck from the body. The vessel rests on an intricate, openwork gold-colored base with sharp, geometric cutouts.

title: Pair of Double-Stirrup Vases
alt_text: A pair of porcelain containers shaped like candle holders sits on a gray surface. Each object features a central vertical column surrounded by a circular ring that is divided into four sections. The pieces are primarily light blue with white accents and decorated with tiny, painted white flowers and green leaves. Dark blue and gold lines create geometric patterns near the base and top of each item. The bases of both holders are wide and circular, decorated with zigzagging bands of color.

title: Pair of Moonflasks
alt_text: A porcelain container of two identical, round vessels shows bright blue bodies decorated with colorful floral patterns. Each vessel has a short, cylindrical neck with a gold-colored rim at the top. The round bodies are painted with various flowers, leaves, and geometric shapes in shades of pink, yellow, and green. Both containers stand on three short, tapered, gold-colored feet. They are set against a plain, light grey background.

title: Pilgrim Bottle
alt_text: A porcelain vase shows a round, flat-sided shape in a bright turquoise blue. Gold-colored, curvy handles attach to both sides of the narrow neck. The neck features a pink, square-patterned band around the top. Intricate, painted floral scrolls in colors like white, green, orange, and purple cover the round body of the vase. The base of the vase rests on a decorative, gold-colored stand that has wavy edges.

title: Moonflask
alt_text: A porcelain container shows a round, flat-faced body with a narrow neck and a flared base. The main circular faces are creamy white and decorated with a detailed floral pattern in gold, light blue, and green. A wide, dark blue band surrounds these central circles, accented by a thin gold rim around the edge. The neck and the base are colored in bright turquoise with small white and gold designs. Tiny gold beads sit at regular intervals along the outer edge of the dark blue rim.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain vase features a bulbous body and a narrow neck painted in a bright turquoise blue. The body is decorated with small white flowers on green stems and a central blue and dark blue medallion shape. A geometric band of white, dark blue, and orange lines wraps around the upper part of the neck. The vase stands on a dark, rounded base that is decorated with carved, gold-colored vertical lines. The entire piece has a smooth, glossy finish against a plain gray background.

title: Low Vase
alt_text: A porcelain container shaped like a round bowl with three short legs. The entire exterior of the bowl is painted a smooth, light pink. A shiny gold band circles the rim at the top of the opening. A large, detailed butterfly with black, red, and white wings is painted in the center of the bowl. Geometric black and red patterns decorate the sides near the butterfly. The three stout legs at the bottom are also painted a solid gold color.

title: Vase
