alt_text: A porcelain container shaped like a tall, thin vase with a wide, bulbous body sits against a plain gray background. The base is a dark, reddish-brown color with gold decorative lines and sits on a small stand. Above the base, the middle part of the vase is a smooth, solid light pink. The long, cylindrical neck is white and decorated with a vertical pattern of green lines and small, red flower-like shapes. The very top rim of the neck is accented with a band of gold.

title: Bottle
alt_text: A porcelain container sits against a solid gray background. The vessel has a wide, rounded base that tapers into a long, thin neck, which is capped with a gold-colored knob. The white surface is decorated with a repeating pattern of soft pink, heart-shaped panels edged in gold. Inside each pink section, there is a dark purple design that looks like a leaf or a fan. Delicate green leaf patterns and small red flower buds run vertically up the neck of the piece.

title: Pair of Vases
alt_text: A porcelain container showing two matching small vases sitting side-by-side against a plain gray background. Both vessels have round, bulbous bottoms that are glossy pink and topped with a wide, flared rim. The upper part of each vase features a pink band decorated with white stylized flower patterns, black accents, and gold trim. A gold ring with dark brown rectangular markings separates the round body from the flared neck. Each vase rests on a solid gold circular base.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain vase shows a round body and a tall, straight neck painted in a bright pink color. The surface is decorated with intricate patterns of gold leaves and flowers that wrap around the bottom half and the neck. Two curved white handles attach to the sides of the vase, ending in golden sculpted heads. The rim and the base of the vase are also highlighted with bands of gold. This object stands against a plain, solid gray background.

title: Ewer
alt_text: A porcelain container in the shape of a vase shows a dark blue surface decorated with gold designs. A tall, thin neck flares open at the top, and a curved handle extends from the neck to the rounded body. The base is also circular and trimmed in gold. On the side, golden illustrations show a bird in flight, a large leafy plant, and a small dragonfly near the rim. A thin band of geometric patterns also rings the top edge of the vase.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain vase shows a tall, slender shape with a deep blue body. The vase has a bulbous, rounded middle that narrows into a long, thin neck leading to a flared opening at the top. Gold patterns decorate the neck, and small, bright blue, round beads are attached to the middle of the neck. Golden floral designs appear painted on the rounded part of the vase. The base is ornate, featuring layered bands of gold, light blue, and white with decorative curves.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain vase shows gold designs against a deep blue background. The vase has a smooth, oval body with a narrower neck and a flared rim. A band of repeating gold leaf or vine patterns circles the top of the neck. Below this, a large, thin gold branch with several needle-like clusters of leaves stretches up the side of the vase. A solid gold ring encircles the very bottom of the base.

title: Plate
alt_text: A porcelain plate shows a round, centered design featuring gold imagery against a deep blue background. In the center, a golden vase rests on a small stand, with a flowering plant growing out of it. To the right of the vase, a large bird stands among tall, leafy plants. The plate's wide rim is decorated with a repeating diamond-shaped grid pattern, filled with tiny gold flowers. The entire plate rests on a small, clear stand.

title: Double Moonflask
alt_text: A porcelain container of two joined, flat, circular vases sits against a plain grey background. Both vases are white with a smooth, matte finish. The front vase features a delicate painting of blue flowers with green leaves and thin stems. Each vase has a narrow neck and a small, square base, and both openings are edged in thin gold. The two vases are connected, with the one in front slightly overlapping the one behind it.

title: Flower Basket
alt_text: A porcelain container shaped like a curved, dual-opening horn sits against a plain gray background. The vessel is mostly glossy white with gold details. A gold-colored handle shaped like a segment of bamboo arches over the center of the piece, connecting the two flared openings. A gold-colored leaf design is painted onto the front of the white body. The overall shape of the container is symmetrical and resembles a small, low cradle.

title: Pair of Ewers
alt_text: A pair of porcelain pitchers stand side by side against a plain gray background. Each pitcher has a tall, creamy white body that is shaped like a rounded vase with a flared spout at the top. A gold-colored handle curves out from the side of each, decorated with a small flower-like detail where it connects to the neck. A gold braided band wraps around the neck of both pitchers just below the spout. Fine gold illustrations of leafy vines decorate the front of each pitcher, with the left one showing pointed leaves and the right one showing feathery, fern-like fronds.

title: Cup and Saucer
alt_text: A porcelain cup and saucer set features a clean white surface with gold decorative patterns. The cup has a flared shape with a textured handle that looks like bundled sticks. Both the cup and the saucer are decorated with shiny gold leaves and ferns. A thin gold line traces the rim of both the cup and the plate. They are displayed against a neutral gray background.

title: Plate
alt_text: A porcelain ceramic plate features a white background with a thin gold rim. A ring of dark blue stylized waves forms a circle in the middle of the plate. A single small, dark blue bird is centered inside this wave ring. A dozen identical blue birds are arranged in a circle around the outer edge of the plate, interspersed with small blue dots. The plate rests on a small, clear plastic display stand against a neutral gray background.

title: Plate, "Andalusia" Pattern
alt_text: A porcelain plate shows a repeating pattern of many folding fans in blue ink against a white background. The fans are arranged in a pile, overlapping each other across the center of the plate. Some of the fans are open wide with distinct, thin radiating lines, while others show scenic details like mountains or trees inside the fan shape. All the fans are colored in a deep blue, creating a high contrast against the smooth white surface. The plate has a simple, curved rim and rests on a clear stand.

title: Handled Cup
alt_text: A porcelain vessel with a round, bowl-like body sits on a plain grey background. The surface is smooth and cream-colored with a golden rim around the opening. Detailed gold patterns of leafy branches and small flowers decorate the front of the body. A triangular handle extends outward and upward from the right side, featuring cut-out floral designs outlined in gold.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain vase shows a bulbous body that narrows into a tall, slender neck. The base of the vase is decorated with repeating patterns of gold and dark gray leaves, lines, and flower shapes. Two handles curve upwards from the body, and they feature delicate cut-out designs trimmed in gold. At the top of the neck, a thin golden border frames the opening. The background is a simple, neutral gray.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain container stands centered against a plain gray background. The vessel features an intricate, carved openwork design resembling swirling leafy vines that wraps around the entire exterior. Above this lattice pattern, a horizontal band of soft pink interlaced loops adds color to the surface. Both the top and bottom edges are finished with narrow, gold-painted rims. Small, bright blue dots are spaced evenly along a gold line that separates the neck from the main body, as well as near the bottom base.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain container showing intricate, cut-out floral patterns across its surface. The body of the container is round and squat, while its neck rises straight up like a cylinder. The entire piece is white, with delicate, open-work designs that resemble leaves and small blossoms. Thin, vertical lines painted in gold trim separate these panels of carved detail. The top edge and the base are also accented with gold, creating a bright contrast against the white material.

title: Jar
alt_text: A porcelain container shows a round blue body decorated with white, raised designs of leaves and berries. The top rim of the container is surrounded by a gold, cut-out band that looks like delicate lace. The blue surface is smooth and glossy. The white leaves and berries seem to be carved onto the surface and sit in the middle of the container's side. The background is a plain, neutral gray.

title: Two-Handled Cup
alt_text: A porcelain container with two large, black, ear-like handles on its sides. The body of the vessel is glossy black and decorated with white figures of two people in a landscape scene. One person stands, while the other figure crouches down among small plants. A thin gold line separates the main scene from a wide, patterned band near the base of the container. The base itself is decorated with a repeating circular design in white and grey.

title: Jug
alt_text: A ceramic container made of terracotta shows a tall pitcher with a lidded top. The surface is colored in a warm, earthy orange and is decorated with black and white horizontal bands featuring small, molded butterfly shapes. One side of the handle is shaped like a dark, stylized dragon that reaches toward the neck of the jug. On the rounded body, a painted scene depicts a figure carrying a small child on their back, surrounded by simple plants. A small, dark animal figure sits on top of the removable lid.

title: Moonflask
alt_text: A porcelain ceramic container stands on two small, white and gold feet. The object is a circular, plate-like piece featuring a raised, brown monkey sitting in the branches of a tree at its center. Surrounding the monkey is a border of delicate, colorful flowers in shades of pink, blue, and green. The outer edge of the circle is decorated with a scalloped, gold-trimmed pattern. The entire piece rests against a plain, neutral-colored background.

title: Moonflask
alt_text: A porcelain plate depicts a monkey sitting in a tree against a bright yellow background. The plate has a wide, raised red border decorated with thin gold lines. A brown monkey sits in the center of the plate, perched on the dark branches of a flowering tree with white blossoms. The outer edge of the red border features a scalloped, saw-toothed design. The entire object rests on a small, tan-colored stand with two feet.

title: Moonflask
alt_text: A ceramic container made of porcelain showing a round, flat disc set on two small, gold-colored feet. The circular disc is framed by a thick, gold, decorative border that looks like stylized leaves. In the center, there is an intricate, cut-out design featuring a small monkey perched inside a tree. The tree branches are covered in tiny, reddish-orange flower buds against the gold background. Two small, white-and-gold wing-like protrusions sit at the top of the outer frame.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain container shaped like a small vase sits against a plain gray background. The vase has a bright, light blue base color and a wider body that tapers up to a narrower neck. Around the top rim, a decorative band of gold, dark blue, and black geometric patterns circles the opening. Below this, the body is painted with elaborate, symmetrical designs in white, green, and darker reds. The vase rests on a small, gold-colored base.

title: Pair of Vases
alt_text: A porcelain container set showing two identical bright blue objects. Each object has a tall, slender neck that widens into a bulbous shape at the bottom. The necks feature a band of dark blue with a small white floral pattern and a gold-colored rim. Below the bulbous section, each piece rests on a white, wedge-shaped base. The front of these bases is decorated with a dark blue band containing small white and yellow flowers.

title: Matchpot or Spillvase
alt_text: A porcelain container shows a bright turquoise base color decorated with stylized patterns. The object is cylindrical and stands on three short, gold-trimmed legs that are integrated into the decorative design. A wide, horizontal gold band circles the top rim, framed by narrow stripes of dark green. In the center, a dark blue, pointed shape holds a white floral design with small leaves. Intricate white and gold flourishes surround the sides, creating a balanced and formal appearance.

title: Pair of Vases
alt_text: A ceramic container made of porcelain shows two identical small vessels side by side against a plain gray background. Each vessel has a bright turquoise body that widens toward the base and stands on three short, pointed, gold-colored legs. The top rim of each piece is flared outward and edged with gold trim. Both containers are decorated with small, repeating patterns of blue flowers and long, dark green leaves. Dark horizontal bands encircle the middle and upper parts of each object.

title: Pair of Pilgrim Bottles
alt_text: A porcelain container showing two nearly identical round vases standing side by side against a plain background. Both vases have a bright, solid blue body, gold rims at the top and bottom, and two small gold handles at the neck. The front of each vase is decorated with hand-painted images of colorful birds, small flying butterflies, and blossoming white or pink flowers on leafy branches. The round, flattened bodies of the vessels create a striking contrast against the delicate, natural scenes painted on their surfaces. The overall design features a balance of bright, saturated blue paint and detailed, realistic artwork.

title: Low Vase, no. 1470
alt_text: A porcelain container shows a round, low shape with a vibrant, bright blue background. The top rim is edged in gold, featuring a dark brown band decorated with a geometric pattern. The sides of the container are adorned with symmetrical designs including white, star-like flowers, green leaves, and reddish-brown, boxy symbols. A wider, dark brown band with small gold dots encircles the bottom section of the bowl. The piece rests on a gold-colored base that has a cutout, rectangular, block-like design.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain container in the shape of a vase displays colorful, painted designs against a bright blue background. The cylinder is decorated with repeating patterns of leaves and flowers in shades of dark blue, red, and green. The top rim is trimmed with a solid, metallic gold band. At the bottom, a heavy gold base includes three short, outward-curving feet that raise the vase up. The turquoise blue surface provides a smooth backdrop for the painted elements.

title: Vase, "Iran" Pattern
alt_text: A porcelain vessel stands on a square base with small, rounded gold feet. The tall, rectangular body is decorated with a pattern of orange flowers, dark green leaves, and delicate brown vines on a white background. Small, gold-colored sculpted heads project from the left and right sides of the vessel near the top. A separate, cup-shaped top sits securely on the rim of the rectangular base. The entire object features consistent, repeating floral designs on both the main body and the square base.

title: Pilgrim Bottle
alt_text: A porcelain container shaped like a flattened, round vase with a wide pedestal base. Two large, golden handles shaped like delicate, open-work lattices rise from the shoulders of the vase to frame the narrow neck. The entire surface is covered in detailed, colorful patterns of orange flowers, dark blue leaves, and black geometric shapes outlined in gold. A distinct, fan-like section on the right side features darker, more complex patterns compared to the rest of the body. The object rests on a sturdy, square-shaped foot against a plain, light gray background.

title: Ewer
alt_text: A porcelain pitcher stands centered against a plain gray background. It features a deep, shiny red glaze decorated with intricate, metallic gold patterns. The vessel has a wide, rounded body that tapers into a slender neck and a flared opening at the top. A single arched handle curves from the neck down to the shoulder of the pitcher. Detailed gold bands, scrolling vine motifs, and small circular shapes ornament the entire surface.

title: Vase
alt_text: A ceramic container made of porcelain shows a round, flat-bodied vessel with a tall, slender neck. The object is a deep, glossy red color and sits on a circular base. A gold decorative pattern featuring swirling vines and leaves centers the front of the body. Gold geometric patterns decorate the rim at the top, the base of the neck, and the bottom stand. The sides of the circular body also feature a repeating golden pattern.

title: Pilgrim Bottle
alt_text: A porcelain vase shows a round, flask-shaped body with a short neck and two small handles at the top. The entire surface is covered in shiny gold, except for a large, circular patch of dark blue in the center. Inside this dark blue circle, a gold-colored bird is depicted in flight among tall, thin reeds. Small, dark blue stars are scattered across the gold shoulders of the vase around the base of the neck. The vase sits on a short, slightly raised base.

title: Moonflask
alt_text: A porcelain container showing a round, brown body decorated with a golden, serpentine creature. The central figure is a long, slender dragon with detailed scales that winds across the center of the jar. This golden decoration contrasts with the mottled, dark brown surface of the main body. The top opening and the three legs supporting the container are painted in bright gold with fine black geometric patterns. The vessel sits centered against a plain, light gray background.

title: Pilgrim Bottle
alt_text: A porcelain container in the shape of a round vase features a tall, narrow neck and two curved handles. The surface of the white vase is covered in intricate, dark blue patterns. A large, circular design with floral-like details sits in the center of the main body. The edges of the vase are decorated with swirling, leafy blue designs that frame the central circle. Both the rim at the top and the circular base at the bottom are painted with a solid band of dark blue.

title: Plate
alt_text: A porcelain plate features a golden illustration centered slightly to the left. At the bottom, a rectangular, golden stand sits beneath a rounded, fruit-like shape with textured details. From the top of this shape, thin lines branch outward across the upper left and right, decorated with numerous golden leaves and clusters of small, round berries. The entire design uses shades of metallic gold against the stark white background. A thin, delicate gold line traces the circular edge of the plate.

title: Plate
alt_text: A porcelain plate shows a painted design of flowers in a vase against a plain white background. The center of the plate features a golden-yellow vase sitting on a small, lacy gray doily. A cluster of yellow flowers and green leaves rises from the top of the vase, reaching towards the upper right side. A thin, gold-colored line trims the rounded edge of the plate. The overall scene is simple and centered on the white surface.

title: Ewer
alt_text: A porcelain container in the shape of a small pitcher stands against a plain gray background. The white ceramic piece features a rounded body, a narrow neck, and a curved handle on the right side. Bright gold paint creates a detailed floral design on the front of the body, featuring leaves and blossoms growing from a small vase. Additional gold bands accent the rim, the neck, and the base of the pitcher. A few small, simple gold stars are scattered around the main floral decoration.

title: Covered Jar
alt_text: A porcelain container shows a tall, deep blue vase with a matching lid. The body of the vase is decorated with shiny gold designs of thistle-like plants and flowers. A wide gold band with cut-out patterns circles the neck of the vase, just below where the lid rests. Two ornate gold handles shaped like abstract scrolls attach to the sides near the top. A small, pointed gold finial sits on top of the rounded lid, while a gold band edges the base.

title: Cup, Saucer, and Plate
alt_text: A porcelain cup and two matching saucers are displayed against a plain background. Each piece has a deep blue border decorated with gold patterns of ferns and small insects. The center of each saucer and the inside of the cup are plain white. The cup rests on one saucer, while the second saucer stands upright behind it. The cup has a square-shaped handle that is painted with a white and gold grid pattern.

title: Pair of Double Moonflasks
alt_text: A set of four porcelain containers shaped like flattened, circular vases stands on a plain grey surface. Each vase features a deep blue, glossy finish with intricate, shiny gold designs of leaves and branches on its front. The two vases in the foreground have different, detailed foliage patterns, while the two in the back show similar botanical designs. All four vases have a small, square base and a narrow neck, both accented with gold trim. They are arranged in two pairs, with the pair on the left placed slightly closer than the pair on the right.

title: Pitcher
alt_text: A porcelain jug shows intricate blue and gold patterns against a white background. The tall, narrow vessel has a sharp, angled spout on the left side and a curved handle on the right. Gold trim accents the base, the handle, and the decorative panels on the sides. One blue and white panel features a grid pattern, while another shows ornate gold shapes. The object sits against a plain, light grey background.

title: Pair of Pilgrim Bottles
alt_text: A porcelain pair of vases stands side by side against a plain grey background. Each vase has a round body and a short, narrow neck with two golden handles attached to the sides. The surfaces are decorated with many overlapping circles filled with different white and blue geometric patterns. Larger, golden-colored shapes resembling scrolls and other objects are layered over these patterns on the round bodies. The vases rest on ornate, solid gold stands with curved, flowing designs.

title: Plate
alt_text: A porcelain ceramic container in the shape of a plate features a light blue and white background made of overlapping circles with different small geometric patterns. Scattered across the surface are several gold and black shapes that look like stylized objects. On the left side, there is a horizontal rectangle with a grid pattern and small curls on the ends. To the right, a vertical sprig with leaves points upwards, while a small, dark, folded object sits near the bottom center. A small, round, dark shape with a gold circular symbol rests near the middle of the plate. The entire background is filled with repeating, subtle patterns of lines and dots.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain container shows a rectangular, upright shape with a soft pink color on its sides. Four small, white cylindrical openings with gold rims sit on top of the flat surface. The pink sides feature decorative, cutout patterns that look like interlocking oval leaves with gold edges. A solid, brownish-gold base with a wavy, scalloped edge supports the entire structure. The object stands against a plain, light grey background.

title: Box in the Shape of a Turtle
alt_text: A porcelain container shaped like a turtle shows the animal standing on a rectangular base. The turtle's head and legs are gold, with a smooth, shiny finish. Its shell is a bright, vibrant blue and is decorated with dark blue, leaf-like patterns. The rectangular base beneath the turtle is dark red on top with a blue border. The entire object appears small and sits against a plain, light grey background.

title: Pair of Bottles
alt_text: A porcelain container of two tall, slender vases shaped like teardrops. Both vases are cream-colored with wide, rounded bases that taper into long, thin necks. They sit side-by-side against a plain, gray background. The surfaces of the vases are decorated with delicate, colorful designs, including small circular patterns and thin, brown bamboo-like branches. Gold bands encircle the base and the neck of each vase, providing a decorative border.

title: Pair of Vases
alt_text: A porcelain container set showing two small, round jars standing side by side. Each jar has a cream-colored, spherical body with three small, brown legs supporting it at the bottom. Small handles extend from the upper sides of each jar near the open tops. The smooth surfaces are decorated with colorful, geometric patterns and patches of faint, speckled gold color. These two pieces are placed against a plain gray background.

title: Pitcher
alt_text: A porcelain pitcher with an unusual shape stands against a plain gray background. The white container has a flat, vertical back edge and a curved, pointed spout at the top. A delicate handle extends from the left side, trimmed with gold along its edges. The body of the pitcher is decorated with small, colorful painted fans and a rectangular, scroll-like design near the base. A golden border pattern wraps around the top rim and along the bottom edge, adding to the fine details of the piece.

title: Pitcher
alt_text: A porcelain container shows a tall, elegant pitcher with a curved handle on the right side. The pitcher has a white, smooth surface decorated with delicate, colorful paintings of butterflies, flowers, and circular patterns. A bright gold trim lines the handle, the spout, and the bottom edge. Near the base, a rectangular pattern runs horizontally around the sides. The spout is open at the top and curls slightly forward in a graceful shape.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain container shaped like a small, gathered pouch sits against a neutral gray background. The white ceramic vessel has a ruffled opening painted with gold trim along the edges. A sculpted gold rope wraps around the neck of the pouch, tied in a simple knot with hanging tassels. The body of the pouch is decorated with several colorful patterns, including pink flower-like designs, green geometric shapes, and a cluster of circular black-and-white symbols on the side. The surface appears smooth and glossy throughout the entire object.

title: Pair of Pilgrim Bottles
alt_text: A porcelain container of two small, round vases stands against a plain grey background. Both vases are matte white and have gold-colored handles on either side of their narrow necks. Each vase rests on three tiny, rounded gold feet. The left vase is decorated with a painted gold pattern of leafy branches and delicate flowers. The right vase features a similar gold design of small, rounded leaves arranged on slender stems.

title: Cup and Saucer
alt_text: A porcelain cup and saucer set features a creamy white base decorated with painted pansies and gold trim. The cup has a square shape with rounded corners and a curved handle on its right side. Painted green stems with yellow and purple flowers decorate the front panel of the cup. To its right, the square saucer mirrors this floral pattern on its top and bottom sections, framing a central circular indentation for the cup. The edges of both pieces are outlined in thin gold bands, and the remaining surfaces are covered in a subtle, pale, repeating floral pattern.

title: Pair of Pilgrim Bottles
alt_text: A ceramic container made of porcelain showing two matching vases with round bodies. The vases are a soft, light green color with white details. Each vase has two handles on the neck that are shaped like the heads of elephants. The handles curve outward and connect back to the circular body of the vessel. They both sit on small, white, rectangular bases.

title: Pair of Candlesticks
alt_text: A pair of porcelain candle holders stands side-by-side on a plain gray background. Both pieces feature a light green color mixed with sections of rich brown and white details. The central column of each candle holder is decorated with a white lion-like face and blue circular insets. Three curved legs support the main body, resting on a round base with a dark blue rim. Gold-colored trim outlines many of the shapes on each of these tall, elegant objects.

title: Ewer
alt_text: A ceramic container of porcelain shows a pale green jug with white details. The body of the jug is round like a ball and sits on a small pedestal base. A tall, narrow neck rises from the center with a curved handle attached to the side. The surface is decorated with a repeating pattern of small, white, four-petaled flowers across the green background. White bands also wrap around the base and the top of the neck near the opening.

title: Pair of Moonflasks
alt_text: A pair of porcelain containers shaped like round, flat flasks with gold trim stand on a plain gray background. The vessel on the left is heavily decorated with an intricate, repeating pattern in shades of orange, blue, and black that covers its entire circular face. The container on the right is mostly white, featuring only a small, centered, floral-inspired design in the same orange, blue, and black colors. Both flasks have matching golden, ornate handles and decorative bases that lift them slightly off the surface. Each flask also has a small, circular opening at the top with a gold rim.

title: Pair of Pilgrim Bottles
alt_text: A pair of porcelain vases shows a bright blue round body decorated with small white flowers and green leaves. Each vase features two small, curved handles on the sides of a narrow neck that is painted with green and yellow designs. The base of each vase is rimmed with a gold band featuring a geometric pattern. The two vases are identical in shape and color, standing side by side against a plain, light grey background. Thin, dark lines create a web-like pattern across the blue surface of both containers.

title: Tea Caddy
alt_text: A porcelain container shaped like a small square box with a lid. The object is colored a soft, light pink and has rounded corners. A decorative gold line wraps around the box horizontally and vertically, creating a cross pattern. A matching gold line accents the seam where the lid meets the base. The box sits centered against a plain gray background.

title: Cup and Saucer
alt_text: A porcelain cup and saucer decorated with stylized floral patterns in pink, white, and blue. The cup sits in the center of the saucer and has a curved handle on its right side. Both pieces are painted in a soft salmon-pink color and feature gold trim along their rims and centers. The floral designs appear as small, repeating shapes around the base of the cup and the edge of the saucer. The inside of the cup and the bottom base of the saucer are bright white.

title: Bottle
alt_text: A porcelain container shaped like a tall, slender bottle sits against a gray background. The base is wide and round, colored in a smooth, soft pink. At the very top of the thin neck rests a small, spherical gold knob. A decorative ring featuring dark, patterned shapes sits halfway up the neck. The wide bottom of the base is also decorated with intricate, multi-colored designs in gold, green, and dark accents.

title: Vase
alt_text: A porcelain vase shows a smooth, pink surface decorated with thin, dark lines and small white berries. The vase has two handles on the sides that are shaped with sharp angles and are colored gold. Both the top rim and the base of the vase also feature a shiny, gold band. The base is further detailed with a row of tiny black dots along its edge. This container rests against a plain, light grey background.

title: Bottle
alt_text: A porcelain container shows a green, teardrop-shaped vessel with a tall, narrow neck and a matching lid. The body of the container features a large, golden, oval panel covered in small, raised dots. Inside this panel is a circular design with blue, white, and red stripes arranged in a cross pattern. The vessel rests on a sturdy, circular base colored in deep green and gold. A pointed, gold finial sits on top of the green lid.

title: Pair of Candlesticks
alt_text: A porcelain container shows two figures reclining on the ground while holding upright, stack-shaped objects. The figure on the left wears a light purple jacket and looks up toward the rounded top of the stack. The figure on the right has a dark green jacket and leans back, supporting the stack with one hand. Both figures have pale, smooth skin and are dressed in loose, draped clothing in shades of brown and green. The upright stacks resemble columns made of round balls and are a creamy, off-white color.

title: Centerpiece
alt_text: A porcelain container showing a person reclining and holding up a small stand. The person is lying on their back on a white, circular base, wearing a bright blue robe that contrasts with their pale skin. Their hands reach upward to support a small, white flat platform above them. Resting on this platform are three small, rounded white bottles or jars stacked together. The base of the container is decorated with a pattern of white and blue leaf-like shapes.

title: Bowl
alt_text: A porcelain bowl showing a shallow, flower-shaped container with a wavy, irregular rim. The bowl rests on sculpted green stems that twist underneath like a base. Inside the bowl, a small, textured frog sits near the right edge. The inside of the bowl is cream-colored and decorated with gold floral patterns and small blue leaf designs. Attached to the outside rim are two light pink flower buds that look like lotus blossoms.

title: Pilgrim Bottle
alt_text: A porcelain container shaped like a flat, round flask stands against a plain background. The body is white and decorated with a repeating pattern of dark blue flowers, leaves, and small birds. A narrow neck rises from the top, featuring a thin border of blue geometric shapes and a gold rim. Two curved handles in blue and gold connect the neck to the rounded shoulders of the vessel. The base is also finished with a blue patterned border and a thin gold line.

title: Pitcher
alt_text: A porcelain ceramic pitcher sits against a plain gray background. The pitcher has a white, bulbous body decorated with bright blue painted patterns. One large blue bird in flight is clearly visible on the front of the pitcher. A wide, detailed blue border circles the bottom base, and another borders the top rim near the spout. The rim of the spout and the bottom base are lined with a thin band of gold.

title: The Temptation of Adam and Eve
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows a man and a woman standing in front of a tree. The woman stands upright on the right side of the tree, reaching one hand up to grasp a branch while holding a small, round object in her other hand. A long, coiled snake winds its way around the tree trunk behind her. To the left, a bearded man with curly hair kneels on the ground and looks up toward the woman. Lush carved leaves and flowers surround the pair and fill the background space.

title: A Cardinal Saint
alt_text: A wood sculpture shows the figure of a standing person wrapped completely in a clear plastic bag. The sculpture is tall and slender, appearing dark brown in color underneath the translucent plastic cover. The plastic bag obscures many details of the carved figure, though it appears to have a rounded head and straight, long body. To the left of the sculpture, a portion of a detailed, rectangular gold-colored picture frame is visible against a wall. A small white label hangs from a red cloth tied around the lower section of the wrapped sculpture.

title: Head of Joan Brown
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows the head and upper neck of a person. The face has a long, narrow nose and almond-shaped eyes with visible lines drawn in graphite. The hair is short and follows the rounded shape of the head. The neck is thick and tapers down to a rough, unfinished bottom edge. A small piece of wood supports the sculpture, which sits on a plain, rectangular base.

title: Bowl
alt_text: A ceramic bowl shows decorative patterns in shades of green, black, and cream. In the center, a dark, star-shaped design radiates outward within a circular border. Surrounding this center is a band filled with repeating, leaf-like shapes that curve around the middle section. The outer rim of the bowl features a series of short, parallel black lines set against a muted green background. The entire design uses simple, repeating forms to create a balanced look on the curved surface.

title: Plaster Mask IV
medium: Plaster, oil-based enamel, graphite, wire, and burlap
alt_text: A sculpture showing a textured human head mounted on a simple black stand. The head is roughly shaped with a gray, uneven surface that looks like dried plaster. There are splashes of white paint, dark graphite markings, and raw textures visible across the face. The features, such as the eyes and mouth, are indistinct and deeply carved into the material. The entire object sits against a solid, dark gray background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a glass bowl sitting on a patterned cloth. The clear, stemmed bowl holds a single, brown, twisted pretzel inside. Below the bowl lies a piece of fabric decorated with large, dark red and white flower designs. This setup rests on a smooth, flat table surface. The background and table are painted in warm, brownish-tan tones.

title: Infant Mercury
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a young, nude child standing on one leg. The child is reaching one arm upward toward the right and balancing with the other arm outstretched to the left. The figure has a smooth, dark brown, reflective finish. It stands on top of a rectangular green stone base with a slightly wider bottom. The entire sculpture is set against a plain, light grey background.

title: Indian Encampment
alt_text: A painting showing a landscape at twilight. The scene is dominated by a flat, grassy field in the foreground that stretches toward a distant tree line. Several tall, dark green trees stand out against the horizon. Two small, conical structures resembling tents are nestled among the trees in the center of the image. The sky above is painted in muted yellow and brown tones, suggesting the sun is low or has set. A heavy, ornate gold-colored frame surrounds the entire artwork.

title: Ceramic Loop IV
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture showing two main vertical, organic forms rising from a flat base. The form on the left is roughly cylindrical with a smooth, glossy red top section and a rough, tan, clay-colored base. Leaning against it on the right is a taller, textured green structure that curls slightly at the very top. The entire piece sits on a flat, irregular, cream-colored slab that is decorated with patches of bright red and yellow glaze. These colorful abstract shapes create a contrast against the solid grey background.

title: Granite Bed
alt_text: A black Indian granite sculpture rests in the middle of a grassy lawn. The sculpture features a large, rectangular block on the left end with rough, textured sides. A long, smooth, and polished platform extends from this block to the right, creating a bench-like shape. The entire piece sits on a small patch of dark mulch surrounded by bright green grass. In the background, a red brick wall stands behind several green bushes.

title: The Locust Trees with Maple
alt_text: A painting of leafless trees stands against a light, pale background. Several thin, brown and gray branches reach across the canvas, crisscrossing each other. A thick, dark tree trunk rises prominently on the right side of the frame. Other smaller trunks appear on the left, fading into the muted gray color of the background. The scene feels quiet and hazy, as if the trees are viewed through fog or mist.

title: Woman and Man
alt_text: A painting of a nude woman and a man wearing grey pants standing side-by-side against a two-tone background. The woman is on the left, facing slightly toward the left with her hands held behind her back. The man stands on the right, facing forward with his arms straight down at his sides. The background is divided into a bright blue upper section and a dark brown lower section. Both figures appear realistic with pale skin and neutral facial expressions. They are positioned closely together so that their inner arms seem to touch.

title: Rehanna
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in a library. She is positioned in the center, facing the shelves on the left while holding an open book. The woman has dark hair and wears a long, dark blue dress with a patterned jacket. Tall, dark wooden bookshelves filled with many multicolored books surround her on all sides. She is looking down at the book in her hands, and she wears simple shoes on her feet.

title: Seated Figure
alt_text: A painting of a nude woman seated in a wicker rocking chair. The woman faces forward with her right arm raised above her head and her left hand resting near her chest. She sits in a light-colored, woven chair that has a bright pink cushion behind her. Behind the chair, a tall, narrow window frame stands against a plain, brownish wall. To the right of the chair, a small, simple stool sits on the floor with a piece of light fabric draped over it. A long, thin green rug lies horizontally across the bottom of the room.

title: Goodbye Bill
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and textures formed by a grid of small, colored dots. On the left side, a series of vertical lines and blocky, rectangular shapes in brown and tan tones create a structured pattern. To the right, a large, fluffy, cloud-like cluster of light grays, whites, and purples dominates the scene. Near the top left, an area of bright orange and yellow dots creates a vibrant, warm accent against the cooler, muted colors. The background throughout the composition appears to be a bright, solid blue.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a nude woman sitting in profile. She faces to the right, with her back mostly toward the viewer. The figure is perched on a large, rumpled white cloth that covers a vibrant green surface on the left. Her hair is short and wavy, appearing dark brown in color. The background is a simple, soft beige wall that highlights the figure.

title: Self-Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a person's head and shoulders shown against a bright yellow background. The person has reddish-brown hair tied back and is wearing a dark blue turtleneck sweater. Their face is painted with thick, textured brushstrokes in shades of green, orange, and red. The person looks slightly toward the left, and their expression is neutral. The entire work is enclosed in a simple, light-colored wooden frame.

title: Judith and Holofernes
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a standing, nude woman carved from a warm, brown material. The figure is smooth and stands with her head turned slightly to her right. Her right arm crosses over her body, and her right hand rests on her hip. She stands on a block-like base that shows the natural grain of the wood. The overall appearance is polished, yet the texture of the wood remains visible throughout the piece.

title: Compositional Study, possibly for The Quest and Achievement of the Holy Grail, Book Delivery Room, Boston Public Library
alt_text: A painting of a rider on a horse and a figure on the ground. A person wearing a bright orange coat and armor sits on a dark, rearing horse in the upper half of the frame. The rider carries a shield painted with a red cross. Below them, a pale, crouching figure wearing a yellow hood looks upward toward the horse. The background is mostly dark and appears faded or unfinished. A grid-like, light-colored pattern is drawn over the bottom right area of the scene.

title: Compositional Study, for The Quest and Achievement of the Holy Grail, Book Delivery Room, Boston Public Library
alt_text: A painting of a group of riders on horseback in a framed rectangular scene. The riders are shown in profile facing left, and some carry tall, thin poles or spears. One prominent figure wears a bright red coat while riding a dark horse, and another figure rides a light blue or grey horse. A thick, dark blue band of paint sits beneath the framed scene, taking up much of the lower space. To the right of the painted scene, there is a large, unfinished empty area on the canvas.

title: Small Bust on a Pedestal
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows the upper body of a person emerging from a large, thick block. The figure consists of a narrow neck and a rounded, simplified head with faint features. The torso is flat and wide, blending into the rough, rectangular base below. Both the figure and the base have a textured, off-white surface that looks like dried, crumbled clay. The object rests on a clean, light-colored surface against a plain, muted background.

title: Woman of the Schuyler-Colfox Family
medium: Watercolor, pen and ink on paper with gilt-paper appliqué
alt_text: A miniature of a woman shown in profile, facing to the right. She has reddish-brown hair styled in short curls around her forehead and ears. A simple gold hoop earring hangs from her visible ear, and she wears a light-colored dress with a pattern of small white dots. A vibrant orange wrap is draped across her shoulders and upper arms. The entire portrait is framed within an oval shape against a plain, light brown background.

title: Reclining Nude
alt_text: A painting of a figure lying down on a dark, flat surface. The figure is painted in shades of reddish-brown and is positioned horizontally across the bottom half of the image. The person's left arm is stretched straight out to the left, while their right arm is tucked near their head. The background is a hazy mix of dark blue, gray, and dusty red tones, suggesting a cloudy or misty space. The overall brushwork is thick and textured, creating a blurry appearance for both the figure and the background.

title: Orpheus and Eurydice
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a man facing each other against a dark background. The woman on the left is nude, except for a light pink cloth draped around her waist and flowing behind her. She reaches out with one hand toward the man as if to hold him back or wave him away. The man on the right wears a gold tunic and a purple cape, along with gold sandals. He holds a wooden instrument resembling a lyre in one hand and looks intently toward the woman.

title: Vases of Flowers on a Table
alt_text: A painting of five vases arranged in a row on a long, dark table. Two large, patterned vases are spaced out, with a smaller, plain white vase standing in the center. At each far end of the row, a slender glass vase holds a small, sparse arrangement of flowers. Bright, colorful flowers bloom from all of the vases against a very dark, shadowed background. These floral displays include yellow tulips, red blossoms, and various small white and blue petals.

title: John Bogart Wright (1801-1858)
medium: Watercolor on ivory with silver mount
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory showing a portrait of a young man inside a decorative oval frame. The man has wavy, light brown hair and is facing forward with a neutral expression. He wears a dark jacket, a high white collar, and a white necktie. A small, round gold pin with a red center is visible on his shirt. The elaborate silver frame around the portrait features intricate leaf patterns and has a circular loop at the top for hanging.

title: Compositional Study, possibly for The Grove of Academe
alt_text: A painting of three people standing together in a grassy area. The person on the left wears a long, light-colored robe with a head covering. In the center, a person stands in a white garment draped with a reddish-brown cloth. To their right, the third figure wears a dark tunic underneath a bright blue cape. Green trees and leaves form a dark backdrop behind the figures. The paint on the left side of the canvas is unfinished, showing large patches of bare, light-colored background.

title: Boiler Room, London Studio
alt_text: An installation of polyester fabric and stainless-steel tubes showing the corner of a room. The structure is made of translucent, bright orange fabric stretched over a metal frame. It forms an L-shaped corner wall that looks like the inside of a utility room or a basement area. Inside the orange enclosure, you can faintly see the outlines of pipes, a water tank, and brick patterns on the walls. The entire structure rests on a plain white base against a light grey background.

title: Portrait of Benedetto Egio
alt_text: A marble sculpture of an elderly man with a long beard and a bald head. His face is carved with deep lines on his forehead and around his mouth. He is shown from the chest up, with his shoulders covered in plain robes. The bust sits on top of a pedestal made of dark, reddish-brown stone with lighter veins running through it. Faint lettering is carved into the neck of the pedestal just below the bust.

title: Ceramic Study for Seated Figure
alt_text: A clay sculpture shows an upright, abstract form. The object has a tall, chunky shape with a rough, sandy-colored texture on the left side. A smooth, shiny, deep red glaze covers the right side and drips down to a round, base-like section. Patches of white and dark, mottled gray appear scattered across the surface. The entire piece rests against a simple, light gray background.

title: Lighting up #2 (Smoker)
alt_text: A painting of a man wearing a dark hat and coat against a black background. He looks forward with a neutral expression while holding his hand to his mouth. He is wearing a blue shirt with a yellow and black striped tie underneath his heavy overcoat. His skin is pale and his features are defined by simple, shadowy brushstrokes. The entire scene is painted in dark, muted colors that contrast with his lighter face.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a rectangular, window-like frame centered on the left side of the canvas. The frame is outlined in thin, light yellow lines against a background of soft, blurred colors. Inside the frame, shades of deep blue, green, and pale pink mix together in loose brushstrokes. To the right of the frame, the painting is filled with larger, hazy washes of light green and yellowish-tan. Patches of dark blue are scattered near the bottom left corner, grounding the lighter colors above them.

title: Plastic Embrace
alt_text: A painting of two people standing together in a white claw-foot bathtub. The figures are nude, and their bodies are angled toward each other while they are draped in a sheer, white shower curtain that hangs behind them. They stand directly in front of a window that glows with bright, yellow-toned light. The room around them has blue walls and a floor covered in small, green square tiles. The overall scene is lit from behind, casting long shadows and highlighting the shapes of the figures.

title: Mann im Spiegel IV Germany
alt_text: A painting of a person standing before a bathroom mirror. The figure is tall and painted with shades of green and pink, with their hands raised to their dark hair. Behind the figure, the mirror reflects a dark reddish-brown wall on the left and a muted, blurry shape on the right. Below the mirror, a green bathroom sink is visible with two dark faucet handles and a round, light-colored object sitting on the counter. The entire room is painted in a flat, bright shade of green.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A bronze sculpture showing a collection of metallic, bar-shaped pieces joined together. The object has a shiny, light brown surface and is made of several straight rods meeting at a central point. A large vertical bar forms the base, while thinner pieces extend outward at different angles. Some bars point horizontally to the left, while others reach upward and to the right. The entire structure appears rigid, angular, and is mounted against a plain white background.

title: Iron Metal Village
alt_text: A sculpture made of cement and iron depicts a rough, rectangular block attached to a metal iron. The cement body is light brown and has a textured, uneven surface. Attached to the pointed front end of the block is the flat metal soleplate of an iron. This plate is a dark gray color with rows of small holes. A patch of light blue paint is visible on the metal plate, featuring a dark, tree-like silhouette in its center.

title: Untitled (JS07125)
alt_text: A painting of thick, abstract strokes of oil paint on a white canvas. A large, dark mass dominates the upper half, with deep black and midnight blue colors applied in heavy layers. Below this, a bright, solid green patch creates a bold, rounded shape in the center. To the left, a smaller area of muted red paint adds a splash of lighter color. The paint appears textured and layered throughout, standing out against the stark, plain background.

title: Observatoire
alt_text: A sculpture made of linen and wood displays a vertical arrangement of many thin, parallel lines. The left side is dominated by a deep, solid blue color that spans about half of the surface. As the eye moves to the right, the blue transitions into a series of vertical stripes in shades of green, cream, and darker brown. These thin stripes become more varied in color as they approach the right edge of the rectangular frame. The texture appears cord-like, giving the piece a ribbed appearance from top to bottom.

title: Private Worlds
alt_text: A painting shows three people slumped over on a wooden floor from a high overhead perspective. One person in a yellow shirt lies across the top, resting their head on their arms. To the lower left, another person wears a red shirt and faces away, with their head bowed down. A third person with a green shirt lies in the lower right corner, appearing to be asleep or unconscious. Small items, including an ashtray and some papers, are scattered on the floor near them.

title: Untitled
medium: Acrylic on board in an artist’s frame
alt_text: A painting of an abstract landscape framed in dark wood. The image is divided into four distinct shapes in muted, earthy colors. On the left, a tall, vertical green strip creates a strong border. A textured, off-white horizontal block takes up the upper middle section, while a darker brown area sits just below it. In the foreground, a single, rounded maroon shape sits prominently against the darker brown section.

title: Base 64 encoded alphabet
alt_text: A stone sculpture features a dark, square tablet carved with various overlapping letters and symbols. The letters are etched into the surface in a light grey, creating a strong contrast against the dark background. Some characters look like standard uppercase or lowercase letters of the alphabet, while others are abstract and stylized. Lines from the letters extend across the surface, connecting some characters to others in intricate patterns. The entire composition appears flat and covers nearly the whole surface of the square piece.

title: Base 64 encoded alphabet
alt_text: A stone sculpture of intricate, overlapping letters carved deep into a square slab. The surface is dark grey and has a rough, natural texture. These letters feature long, elegant curves and sharp, angular lines that cross over one another. The carving creates strong shadows within the grooves, making the lettering stand out against the background. The letters are abstract and do not form recognizable words.

title: Base 64 encoded alphabet
alt_text: A stone sculpture shows a square slab of dark, textured rock carved with white lettering in the center. The slab is a uniform charcoal gray color with faint, radiating striations across its surface. In the middle, a cluster of thin, interconnected letters is etched into the stone, resembling complex cursive script. These white characters overlap and intertwine, forming a tight block of text. The bottom right corner of the slab shows a rougher, chipped texture, contrasting with the smoother, flatter surface elsewhere.

title: Les Roseaux (The Reeds)
alt_text: A painting of a dark, irregularly shaped object sits in the center of the frame, surrounded by tangled, thin, light brown strands that resemble dried grass or roots. This central mass is jagged and mostly black with patches of dark blue and purple. To the right of the central object, two rounded, lime-green shapes sit on a pale, textured surface. Beneath these green shapes are a few thin, horizontal red lines. The background is a flat, muted brown that spans the entire painting.

title: Iron Metal Village
alt_text: A cement and iron sculpture shows a thick, curved block that resembles a piece of a roof tile. The object has a rough, sandy-colored texture across its top and curved sides. On its front-facing end, there is a smooth, flat, triangular panel colored in a dull grey. This flat front panel features a row of small, circular iron studs running along its arched edge. The overall shape is slightly tapered, creating a solid, sturdy appearance against the plain light-grey background.

title: Untitled
medium: Collage; cut paper on acrylic on canvas
alt_text: A painting shows a colorful, detailed scene overlaid with dark paper silhouettes. In the background, a busy garden or courtyard filled with small, painted figures wearing bright, historical clothing is visible. Two solid black silhouettes of people standing in long dresses are layered on top of the scene in the foreground. To the left of the silhouettes, a large black shape representing the side of a building extends from the edge of the frame. One silhouette appears to be holding their hand up toward a large, flowering tree in the background.

title: Personalities Are Portable, from the Daze Work series
medium: Acrylic, graphite, crayon, ink, tape, and cut-and-pasted paper on board
alt_text: A painting shows a room filled with various objects layered over a textured, pale background. On the left, a large, ghostly shape includes a sketch of a ornate top and a bright red, U-shaped line. Near the center, a dark wooden table with curved legs stands prominently. To the right, a black ladder leans against a wall next to a framed picture hanging alone. Other faint, sketchy details, including an empty picture frame and a chair, appear to float within the hazy, translucent space.

title: First Teachers Balance the Universe, Part I: Things That Fly (Predator)
medium: Reclaimed wool blankets, embroidery ﬂoss, and thread
alt_text: A textile made of reclaimed wool blankets features two rectangular panels displayed side by side against a white background. Both sections of the fabric show a dark plaid pattern in shades of blue, green, and red. Stitched over these backgrounds are long, flowing lines of brightly colored embroidery thread. These lines twist and loop across the surfaces like scribbles or tangled yarn. Each rectangular piece ends with a fringe along the bottom edge.

title: First Teachers Balance the Universe, Part II: Things That Fly (Prey)
medium: Reclaimed wool blankets, embroidery ﬂoss, and thread
alt_text: A textile of reclaimed wool blankets shows two large, rectangular panels displayed side-by-side. The fabric is made of stitched-together pieces of plaid wool in dark shades of blue, green, and red, with fringed edges at the bottom. Across the surface of both blankets, intricate designs are embroidered in bright pink and neon blue thread. These delicate lines form overlapping, thin shapes that resemble birds, feathers, and various small abstract patterns. The embroidery creates a light, sketching effect that contrasts with the heavy, dark texture of the plaid background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of an abstract, geometric composition featuring a grid of dark, diamond-shaped forms. The background is composed of muted grey and beige tones that create a sense of overlapping, angular planes. Vertical lines stretch across the image, punctuated by small diamonds colored in red, green, yellow, black, and white. These shapes are arranged in a regular pattern against the smoky, layered background. A bright white diamond and a contrasting red circle stand out near the lower center of the canvas. The entire work is enclosed within a simple wooden frame.

title: Sister Mary Margaret
alt_text: A painting shows the head and shoulders of a person wearing a traditional black and white habit. The person has a fair complexion, light-colored eyes, and wears thin-rimmed glasses while looking directly forward. They are dressed in a plain black gown with a high, white, rounded collar that frames the neck. Behind the figure, the background is a solid, deep reddish-brown color. Faint white line drawings of a building facade appear subtly on the red background behind the figure's head.

title: Pacific Coast Highway (Across the Pacific)
alt_text: A painting of several figures standing against abstract blocks of color. On the left, a person with a bright green shirt and dark pants stands partially in profile, with another figure behind them playing an instrument. A woman in a yellow dress stands prominently in the center, facing a tall man in a dark green vest and blue pants. The background is divided into sections of vivid blue, deep red, and dark tones. On the right side, broad, blurry shapes of yellow, teal, and blue suggest a landscape or horizon line.

title: Portrait of Five Children
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory showing five children, three in the foreground and two in the background. The three children in the front are seated or standing together, with a young child in a red dress sitting on a chair in the center. To the left is an older girl with long, curly hair wearing a bright blue dress. To the right is another child wearing a dark, patterned shirt and holding a small bunch of green grapes. Above them, the heads and shoulders of two other children appear as if floating among soft white clouds. The entire scene is enclosed within a worn, gold-colored frame.

title: unit BOLUS
medium: Cast petroleum jelly 8-lb dumbbell, stainless steel, and electronic freezing device
alt_text: A sculpture of a metal stand holds a small dumbbell made of a pale, solid material. The stand is tall, narrow, and constructed from shiny, grey stainless steel bars. Resting on top of the stand is a short, white, dumbbell-shaped object. A thin white cord connects the bottom of the stand to a square, semi-transparent grey box sitting on the floor. This box has a mesh-like top surface and a white strap wrapped around its center.

title: Landline Eleuthera
alt_text: A painting of broad horizontal stripes in different colors stacked on top of each other. The bands of color vary in width and show visible, sweeping brushstrokes. From top to bottom, the colors are a deep maroon, a bright yellow, a medium blue, a dark black, another wide band of bright yellow, a dark forest green, and a lighter grayish-blue at the very bottom. The edges of the stripes are not perfectly straight, giving the lines a fluid appearance. The entire composition has a glossy, reflective quality.

title: Cloud Wall
alt_text: A painting of a vast landscape beneath a sky filled with heavy, dark clouds. The lower third of the scene features a flat, dark green field. In the center of this green expanse, a small, bright patch of water reflects light. Above the horizon, dense, grey storm clouds stretch across the entire width of the sky. The clouds appear to roll in waves, with the darkest tones at the top and lighter, softer greys closer to the ground.

title: Golden Horde 2
alt_text: A sculpture made of mixed media stands on a tall, simple wooden base with four legs. The top part of the sculpture is a tall, pointed, dark structure that looks somewhat like a tower. This central piece is wrapped in thin gold strings and green, leafy material. Dark, rifle-like shapes poke out horizontally from the sides of the structure. A bright red ribbon hangs from the end of one of these shapes, adding a splash of color to the dark, chaotic mass.

title: Solo
alt_text: An earthenware container shows a wide, rounded shape with a small opening at the top. The surface features a complex, colorful pattern of abstract swirls, triangles, and stripes in red, black, and tan. A vibrant green section encircles the top opening and is accented by a ring of small white dots. Many areas of the pot display fine line work and stippled texture. The object sits centered against a smooth, dark grey background.

title: Shinto Bowl
medium: Hand-built and painted Santa Clara clay
alt_text: A ceramic container made of hand-built clay shows two almond-shaped halves connected by small metal rods. The left side is polished brown with white and grey painted markings including crosses and abstract shapes. The right side is decorated with wavy bands of red and grey, featuring a red dot and a star shape. The two halves create a gap in the center that reveals the dark interior space. This object rests on a plain gray surface against a dark, smooth background.

title: Seed Jar
alt_text: A ceramic container with a rounded, ball-like shape and a small opening at the top sits against a plain gray background. The surface is decorated with a complex, repeating pattern of thin black and white lines. A wide, vertical panel wraps around the center, featuring a grid of orange rectangles outlined in white. On both sides of this panel, dark black sections display rows of small, white triangles pointing inward. Near the top opening, a circular design includes delicate white lines set against black and orange shapes.

title: Polychrome Jar
alt_text: A ceramic container made of hand-built clay shows a bulbous, symmetrical shape with a wide middle that tapers toward the bottom and the top opening. The surface is decorated with a complex, repeating pattern painted in cream, dark brown, and reddish-orange. A checkered band wraps around the widest part of the pot. Above this band, large, leaf-like shapes extend upward in brown and red. Below the band, geometric shapes like triangles and diamonds fill the curved surface.

title: Polychrome Seed Pot
alt_text: A ceramic container made of hand-built clay displays a shallow, rounded shape. The top surface is decorated with intricate, dark geometric patterns arranged in flowing, curved bands. These patterns include repeating triangles and cross-hatched lines that spiral toward the center. A circular accent piece sits near the top edge, featuring an abstract, colorful design with touches of green and orange. The bowl's base is smooth and plain, contrasting with the detailed and busy decoration on its lid.

title: Polychrome Bowl with a Scorpion
alt_text: A ceramic dish made of clay features a shallow, round bowl shape. The interior surface displays an intricate pattern of black, white, and orange geometric shapes. These designs include zigzag lines, striped rectangles, and leaf-like motifs arranged in a circular formation. A thick, dark brown rim edges the entire dish. The piece rests on a plain gray surface, casting a soft, dark shadow beneath it.

title: Seed Pot with a Geometric Design
alt_text: A ceramic container made of hand-built clay shows a low, flat, and round shape. It is decorated with a complex pattern of black and white geometric shapes. The top surface features a grid of diamonds and triangles filled with thin, parallel lines. Thicker black and white shapes decorate the curved sides of the vessel. A small, dark circular hole is visible at the very center of the top.

title: Vase with a Swirl Design
alt_text: A ceramic container made of clay with slip shows a wide, rounded body that tapers to a narrow neck. The surface is decorated with a complex geometric pattern of triangles, dots, and wavy lines. These shapes are colored in contrasting black, white, and reddish-brown. A solid black background helps the white and brown details stand out clearly. The pot sits on a flat surface and casts a soft shadow behind it.

title: Seed Pot with a Lizard, Birds, and Fish
alt_text: A ceramic container shaped like a flattened, rounded bowl rests on a solid gray surface. The sides of the pot feature a black-and-white checkerboard pattern near the base. Above this band, the upper portion of the bowl is covered in dense, thin, black lines forming geometric triangles. A sculpted figure of a lizard stretches across the top surface, painted with red, black, and white markings. Several other geometric shapes and bird-like symbols are painted in black around the upper body of the vessel.

title: Bowl
alt_text: A ceramic container made of earthenware showing a rounded, black vessel with carved geometric designs. The pot features a repeating cross motif set inside a circular frame on its side. Small, four-pointed star shapes are etched into the dark surface around the main design. The vessel has a smooth, matte texture and curves inward toward a small opening at the top. The overall shape is bulbous and sits directly on a neutral gray background.

title: Vase
alt_text: A ceramic container of earthenware shows a small, smooth vase with a rounded body and a long, narrow neck. The object is a deep, reddish-brown color, with darker, shadowy patches near the base and along the sides. It has a glossy, polished surface that reflects the light. The shape of the base is wide and bulbous, tapering upward to a square-shaped opening at the top. The vase sits centered on a plain, light grey background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A ceramic container shows a spherical shape decorated with intricate patterns and birds. The upper half of the vessel features horizontal bands of thin, repetitive lines alongside small, light-colored circular shapes. Several pale birds with pink accents appear to fly across this detailed surface. The lower half of the pot is solid black and adorned with additional white, etched-style bird figures. A small, dark knob sits at the very top center of the round lid.

title: Jar
alt_text: A ceramic container of earthenware showing a geometric pattern against a dark background. The pot has a wide, rounded body that tapers to a narrow base and a small, open top. Its surface is covered with repeating, three-dimensional cube shapes that create a maze-like effect. The colors on the pot alternate between shades of brown, tan, and soft blue-gray. The texture of the pot appears ribbed or incised with fine, parallel horizontal lines throughout the pattern.

title: Vase
alt_text: A ceramic earthenware vessel showing a round body with a narrow, short neck. The smooth, off-white surface is decorated with bold patterns in black and reddish-orange paint. These designs include geometric squares, hatched lines, and long, curved bands that wrap around the pot. A dark band with a cross-hatch pattern circles the rim at the top of the vessel. The overall shape is bulbous, tapering to a rounded bottom against a plain grey background.

title: Bowl
alt_text: An earthenware vessel shows a rounded, bowl-like shape with a matte black finish. It is decorated all over with intricate, dark gray patterns of geometric shapes and lines. These designs include zigzagging lines, circles, and repeated rectangular motifs that wrap around the object. The jar has a wide, open top that tapers down to a narrow, rounded base. The overall surface appears smooth and sits against a plain, light gray background.

title: Jar
alt_text: An earthenware container showing a small, bulbous vase with a rounded shape. The surface of the vase is covered in repeating, diagonal ridges that twist from top to bottom. These fluted lines create a texture of highlights and deep shadows across the orange-brown body. The opening at the top is small and circular with a smooth edge. The vase sits centered on a solid, smooth grey background that fades from light to dark.

title: Canteen with a Parrot
medium: Hand-built, carved, and polished Santa Clara clay
alt_text: A ceramic container made of hand-built, carved, and polished dark clay shows a canteen-shaped vessel against a plain gray background. The object is round and flattened with a short, narrow neck at the top and two small handles on its sides. Carved into the front surface is a stylized image of a bird with its wings folded. The bird features a hooked beak, a curved eye, and geometric patterns on its tail feathers. The carving is matte and contrasts with the smooth, glossy surface of the rest of the vessel.

title: Bowl
alt_text: A ceramic bowl of earthenware with pigment shows two stylized birds facing each other. The interior of the tan-colored bowl features these figures drawn in black and reddish-orange lines. Both birds have geometric, pointed bodies, thin necks, and small heads. A continuous border with a wavy line and repeating leaf shapes circles the inside edge of the bowl. The entire vessel is framed by a thick, dark rim.

title: Melon Bowl with a Swirl Design
medium: Hand-built, carved, and polished Santa Clara clay
alt_text: A ceramic container shows a rounded, bowl-like shape. The surface of the pot is a dark, matte black color with a smooth texture. Rows of carved, diagonal ridges spiral across the entire body of the piece. These carved lines create a repeating pattern that leads toward a small, round opening at the top. The object rests centered against a plain gray background.

title: Bowl
alt_text: A ceramic container shows a round, low-profile bowl made of shiny, dark-colored earthenware. The surface of the bowl features a band of matte-finished carvings that wrap around the middle. These carvings create abstract, smooth shapes that stand out against the polished finish of the rest of the bowl. The bowl has a small, circular opening at the top and tapers down to a rounded base. The overall design looks smooth and dark against a soft gray background.

title: Koshare Clown Holding a Watermelon
medium: Hand-built Jemez clay with colored slip and corn husks
alt_text: A clay sculpture shows a child with a joyful, wide-open smile. The figure has dark, pigtail-style hair tied with light-colored corn husks. Horizontal orange and white stripes cover the figure's body, arms, and legs. A black skirt sits around the waist, and the child holds a small slice of watermelon in both hands. The entire sculpture stands on a simple, round black base.

title: Water Jar with a Serpent Design
medium: Hand-built, carved, and polished Santa Clara clay
alt_text: A ceramic vessel made of hand-built, carved, and polished clay stands against a plain white background. The jar has a wide, rounded middle that tapers upward to a narrow opening at the top and downward to a small base. Its surface is dark, glossy black, and reflects light near the opening. A textured band with carved, wave-like shapes wraps around the widest part of the vessel. The rest of the smooth surface is unadorned.

title: Bowl with a Bear Paw
medium: Hand-built, carved, and polished Santa Clara clay
alt_text: A ceramic container made of polished clay shows a round, dark body. The bowl is shaped like a flattened sphere with a small, open top. A circular area on the front is carved with a repeating, vertical pattern. This center design is a vibrant orange color that contrasts with the deep, dark brown surface of the rest of the pot. The polished surface reflects some light, giving the pot a smooth appearance against the plain gray background.

title: Canteen with a Spiral Design
medium: Hand-built, carved, and polished Santa Clara clay with cork and leather
alt_text: A ceramic container showing a rounded black flask with a cork stopper at the top. The vessel has a smooth, shiny, dark surface and features a carved relief design of swirling lines in the center. Two small, arched handles protrude from either side of the bottle's neck. A light-colored leather cord is knotted around the top, loops through both handles, and hangs down behind the body of the flask. The entire object is centered against a plain gray background.

title: Vase with a Fish and Dragonfly Design
medium: Hand-built, carved, and polished Santa Clara clay with slip
alt_text: A ceramic container made of hand-built, carved, and polished clay. It is a bulbous jar with a narrow, dark neck and a wide, rounded body that tapers toward the base. The surface is a rich, reddish-brown color with a smooth, polished finish. Intricate, lighter-colored carved lines decorate the body, forming abstract geometric patterns and figures. The jar sits centrally against a plain, light grey background.

title: Bowl with Women Wearing Tribal Robes
medium: Hand-built, carved, and polished Santa Clara clay with slip
alt_text: A ceramic vessel shows carved patterns around its upper section. The object is rounded and has a smooth, reddish-brown surface. A thick band near the top is filled with repeating geometric and abstract designs carved in a lighter, tan color. Below this decorated band, the lower part of the vessel is plain and tapers to a narrower base. The entire object sits against a neutral gray background.

title: Wedding Vase with Birds and Anasazi Motifs
medium: Hand-built, carved, and polished Santa Clara clay
alt_text: A ceramic container shows a polished black vessel with a round, bulbous body. At the top, two spouts rise from the center and connect with an arching handle. The smooth, shiny surface of the rounded body features deep, carved geometric patterns that wrap around its sides. These carvings include repeating angular shapes and curved lines that create a textured look against the dark clay. The entire object sits against a plain, neutral gray background.

title: Bowl
alt_text: An earthenware pot shows a rounded shape with a wide body and a narrow opening at the top. The surface of the pot is painted with a repeating geometric pattern of orange and black shapes. These shapes are outlined in thin, cream-colored lines that create blocks around the center. A larger band of black circles and orange ovals wraps horizontally around the middle of the container. The bottom section of the pot is a solid, unpainted orange color.

title: Plate with Feathers
medium: Hand-built and polished San Ildefonso clay with slip
alt_text: A ceramic plate shows a smooth, glossy black surface decorated with a repeating pattern. The center of the plate features a solid black circle, which is surrounded by a ring of many identical, leaf-shaped dark gray forms pointing outward. These leaf-like shapes are arranged in a sunburst pattern that encircles the center. Several thin, concentric circular lines frame the design near the plate’s edge. The entire object appears rounded with a shallow rim and rests against a plain, light gray background.

title: Jar
alt_text: A ceramic container shows a smooth, glossy black surface with an asymmetrical opening at the top. A tan-colored, wavy band wraps horizontally around the middle of the vessel. Above this band, a circular orange shape with a glowing green edge sits prominently on the upper left side. Two simple line-art fish, facing different directions, are etched into the black surface near the wave pattern. The container has a rounded, bulbous base that narrows toward the top.

title: Lost Boy IV, from the series Never Neverland
alt_text: A sculpture of a standing human figure is made from ceramic with pigment. The figure has a smooth, peach-colored body and is wearing a white mask over its face.
