It wears long white boots that reach up to its knees. On its hands are white gloves, with one side featuring a separate arm piece that reaches to the shoulder. A thin string hangs from the neck of the figure, holding a small dark shape that hangs near the waist.

title: Bowl
alt_text: An earthenware container showing a low, wide, rounded shape with a small opening at the center of the top. The vessel is a pale, uniform, off-white color against a dark background. Carved into the surface around the top shoulder are several simple figures of animals walking in a circle. These carvings are subtle and share the same smooth matte color as the rest of the bowl. The container sits low to the ground and has a gentle, curving profile.

title: Our Lands Are Not Lines on Paper
medium: Arches watercolor paper splints with archival ink and acrylic
alt_text: A basket made of paper splints showing a patterned cylindrical container. The exterior features bands of color that transition from light blue at the top to a dark, deep blue near the bottom. Woven throughout the sides are cream-colored paper strips printed with black text. The bottom and top sections of the basket reveal the printed words on the paper material. The overall shape is tall and rounded with a slightly flared opening at the top.

title: Deva
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a tall, abstract structure stands against a plain gray background. The sculpture is composed of many thin, tangled, and melted-looking rods that twist upward from a narrow base. Dark, brownish-gold metal forms a complex web of loops and knots that grow wider toward the top. On the left side, a prominent, curved arm reaches out and loops back toward the center. Small, smooth bumps are scattered across the textured, uneven surface of the metal throughout the piece.

title: Street Hall
alt_text: A painting of a brightly colored, abstract interior space filled with overlapping shapes and figures. The scene is dominated by bold, loose brushstrokes in yellows, blues, reds, and purples. On the right side, a figure sits on what appears to be a red couch or platform. Another figure is positioned toward the bottom right, leaning or sitting near a bright yellow area. Jagged, linear forms suggest furniture or architectural elements scattered throughout the room. The overall composition creates a sense of movement and clutter within the room.

title: My Mother Was an Antique Table
alt_text: A mixed-media sculpture shows a rectangular panel divided into two distinct sections. The top, larger section is a vibrant, dusty red color with thick, dark black paint dripping down the center. Attached to the top are several curved, wooden pieces that create an arched, textured structure. Below this, a smaller rectangular section is white with rough, black brushstrokes running vertically through it like branches. The overall composition feels abstract and focuses on the contrast between the smooth painted surfaces and the raised wooden elements.

title: Manuscript of Nature V_005_5
alt_text: A collage of twigs and pins on a panel shows small, dark brown, organic lines arranged on a white background. These thin, spindly pieces are suspended by pins and hang in five distinct vertical columns. Each individual piece twists and curls in a unique, jagged shape, resembling loose handwriting or dried stems. The display is mounted inside a plain white frame that stands out against a solid, dark green wall. The arrangement creates a visual rhythm, leaving plenty of open, white space between the vertical lines.

title: Pope Joey
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture of a person sitting on an ornate chair under an umbrella. The central figure wears a long coat, cowboy-style boots, and a tall, pointed hat. The chair has detailed carvings of branches or leaves on the back and animal feet at the base. Two small, fox-like creatures stand on the seat of the chair, one on each side of the person. An umbrella hangs directly above the figure, covering them like a canopy. The entire object is light cream or off-white in color and sits on a wooden surface.

title: Morandi set-up
alt_text: A sculpture of glass and wood features several clear, reflective glass vessels arranged on a curved wooden display stand. The glass items include a tall, thin bottle, a pitcher with a handle, and two shorter, squatter bottles with irregular shapes. All the glass containers have shiny, metallic-looking surfaces that reflect the surrounding light and room. They sit closely together in a group on the smooth, light-brown wood surface. The entire display is set against a curved wooden backdrop, with a dark green wall visible to the left.

title: X book
medium: Found book, cigar box, and wood
alt_text: A sculpture made from a found book, cigar boxes, and wood shows a cut book arranged in the shape of a large "X." The book cover is dark blue with a black-and-white portrait of a man, and the pages fan out in the center. This book sits on a light-colored rectangular wooden base with two small wooden posts. Behind the book, an open wooden cigar box stands upright. To the right on the base, there is also a very small, separate wooden "X" shape.

title: Cherries
alt_text: A painting of a pile of bright red cherries spilling out of a golden bowl. The round, shiny fruit is clustered on a piece of striped fabric on a dark table surface. Behind the spilled fruit, a silver-colored object stands against a dark, shadowy background. The painting is enclosed in a thick, ornate, gold-colored frame. The lighting focuses mainly on the red cherries and the reflective inside of the tipped-over bowl.

title: Lieutenant Thomas Grosvenor (1744–1825) and Servant (probably Asaba, an Enslaved Man)
alt_text: A painting of a chaotic scene filled with soldiers. In the center, a man wearing a dark blue coat and a tricorn hat holds a thin sword, his left hand raised in a defensive gesture. Behind him, another person stands close, holding a long rifle upright. Below them, a figure in a red jacket lies collapsed on the ground. The background is filled with blurred figures in red and tan clothing, suggesting a larger crowd or battlefield. The entire scene is painted with loose, expressive brushstrokes in muted tones of brown, red, and yellow.

title: Untitled No. 2
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes and bold colors sits inside a simple white frame. Large, messy patches of oil paint in bright orange, light purple, and yellowish-green cover much of the canvas. Near the top left, a dark, rounded shape sits like a blob against the brighter colors. A section of plain white canvas remains visible along the right edge. Thick brushstrokes add visible texture across the surface of the work.

title: Cut-Out #2
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a cow stands on a rectangular base. The cow is painted in bright red and has white lines marking different sections on its body. A smaller, green animal figure is attached to the back of the cow and appears to be falling or emerging from it. The sculpture rests on a flat, horizontal platform that is off-white in color. Small black text is printed on the corner of the base.

title: Cut-Out #3
alt_text: A sculpture of acrylic on wood displays two separate flat figures standing on a rectangular base. On the left, a light blue bird shape is shown in profile with its tail fanned out wide. To the right, a bright green shape depicts flowers in a vase with long, thin stems visible inside the glass. Both figures are cut-out shapes with white outlines that are mounted to a simple, rectangular white platform. The background is a plain, dark gray surface.

title: Cut-Out #4
alt_text: A wood sculpture painted with acrylic shows two separate shapes standing on a long, rectangular white base. On the left side, there is a flat, upright cutout shaped like a light blue dress shirt with a white tie and collar. To the right of the shirt stands a single cutout piece featuring two bright red dogs overlapping each other. The dog in the back stands slightly higher, while the dog in the front stands firmly on the base. Both figures are stylized with simple, bold lines against the plain background.

title: Cut-Out #5
alt_text: A sculpture of acrylic on wood showing two separate, flat cutout figures resting on a white, rectangular base. On the left, a teal-colored skull is depicted in profile, facing right with a simple white outline separating its features. To the right of the skull, a brown and cream-colored carpenter's plane sits horizontally on the base. The plane is shaped with a rounded handle, a main body, and a blade mechanism, all drawn in a graphic, simplified style. The base itself is a plain, long wooden platform that supports both figures against a solid grey background.

title: Cut-Out #6
alt_text: A sculpture of a green rabbit carrying a long hand saw across its ears. The sculpture is made of acrylic on wood and stands on a flat, rectangular white base. The rabbit is designed with simple, bold green shapes outlined in white, and it faces toward the left side of the image. The saw is white and appears to be balanced horizontally on top of the rabbit’s tall ears. A signature and date are written in black marker on the front edge of the white base.

title: The Nuveen Painting
medium: Oil on canvas mounted on panel
alt_text: A painting of a series of dark, abstract scenes arranged in two horizontal rows. The panels are filled with tangled, black, vine-like shapes that curl across the surface. Behind these dark lines, shapes of muted colors like blue, red, and yellowish-gold appear in patches. Faint, ghostly figures or body parts are visible within some of the panels, blending into the shadowy surroundings. The overall effect creates a sense of depth and layered, misty textures across the composition.

title: L'Attesa (The Waiting)
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in an open window frame. She faces forward, wearing a simple white slip dress, with her hands resting on the window sill. Her reflection appears in the glass pane on the left side of the window. In the room behind her, a small vase with flowers sits on a table next to a round mirror on the wall. The wall surrounding the window is a solid, warm tan color.

title: Sentinel I
medium: Red soil, pulp, ash, wood glue, wood, quartz, stone, gourd, jewelry, pine cone, and shells
alt_text: A mixed-media sculpture shows an upright human figure composed of reddish-brown materials. The torso has a human shape, but it merges upward into jagged branches and wooden textures at the head. The statue rests on a simple, low white platform in the center of a museum room. Behind the art piece, two large classical columns made of light-brown stone rise toward the ceiling. Further back, a dark wall displays a pattern of thin, white curved lines that arc across the black surface.

title: Wax seal with QR code
alt_text: A collage of wax on paper showing a single circular wax seal in the center of a rectangular sheet of paper. The paper has a cream or off-white color and a slightly textured, rough surface. The wax seal is a deep, solid red color and sits directly in the middle of the paper. Its surface contains an intricate, square grid pattern that resembles a digital code. Small, handwritten markings and a date are visible in the bottom right corner of the paper.

title: Collection of Numbers, Designs and Letters Seen by Me at the Beginning of the War in Berlin—Military in Nature
alt_text: A painting shows a large white circle containing a red circle with the number 9 inside, all set against a black background. Beneath this circle, a cluster of colorful squares and rectangles features the numbers 6, 4, and 8, as well as a small star-shaped symbol. To the left and right of the central design, long, wavy bands of green and white stripes cross the background horizontally. Two star-like shapes with thin, diagonal red stems float in the dark space near the bottom corners. Smaller white triangle shapes are arranged in rows at the very top and bottom edges of the composition.

title: Paradise Lost 1 (Burmese Python and Blue and Yellow Macaw, Everglades)
alt_text: A painting of a blue parrot, a patterned snake, and various black silhouettes set against a cream background. The parrot perches on a branch in the upper center, displaying bright blue feathers with a yellow face. Below it, a snake with brown and orange markings coils around the same branch. Several black silhouettes of plants, birds, insects, and small animals are scattered throughout the composition, each marked with a small number. At the very bottom, a horizontal band of bright blue suggests water, with two white water lilies rising from it.

title: Bust of Cupid
alt_text: A marble sculpture shows the head and upper shoulders of a young child. The child has a smooth, pale face and looks slightly upward. Tight, curly hair frames the face on both sides and gathers in a small swirl on the top of the head. The bust rests on a small, round pedestal that matches the white stone of the figure. The sculpture is set against a plain, solid grey background.

title: South American Dancers
alt_text: A painting shows an abstract scene filled with colorful shapes and a winding, chain-like form. This central chain is made of many white, overlapping circular loops that snake across the center of the canvas. Small, gray, cone-like triangles are scattered inside and around the loops. The background is composed of large, overlapping sections of green, yellow, orange, and red. Several clusters of thin, straight, and wavy lines in blue, brown, and green are layered in the corners and against the large color blocks.

title: Stripping Bare the Soul
medium: Wood, glass eyes, and ink on fabric
alt_text: A sculpture of a pale, bald doll standing next to several pieces of miniature clothing. The doll has a slim body and large, dark glass eyes, wearing a simple pink jumpsuit. To the right, four white fabric items are displayed on black metal stands. These items include a pair of small pants, a corset-like top, a loose smock, and a wide skirt. Each of the fabric pieces is covered in fine, handwritten text.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a person with short gray hair sitting at a table. The person wears a loose-fitting, light-colored shirt and rests their chin on one hand. On the table in front of them lies a rectangular palette covered in small dabs of colorful paint. The background behind the person consists of simple, muted blocks of gray and beige color. Thick, visible brushstrokes create the textures of the shirt and the wall.

title: Sky (Over Roswell, New Mexico, 5/5/00, dusk)
medium: Rhinestones and acrylic on aluminum panel
alt_text: A painting of a blue, oval-shaped object sits against a plain grey background. The surface of the oval is covered in a dense, uniform layer of tiny, reflective blue rhinestones. These stones create a glittering, textured appearance that catches the light across the entire form. The shape itself is slightly irregular, mimicking the organic look of a large, flattened stone or egg. There is no other imagery or detail visible on the panel.

title: Laughing Shadow II
alt_text: A painting of a woman's head and neck seen from the side. The figure has brown hair pulled back in a bun at the nape of her neck. Her skin is painted with soft, muted tones of peach and shadow. Darker, indistinct shapes surround the profile, creating a shadowy effect against the light, neutral background. The lower part of the painting fades into faint, blurred white lines.

title: The Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a dark room where an artist sits on the floor drawing a group of people. On the left, a man wearing a dark suit holds a sketchbook and charcoal pencil. To his right, a young boy with shoulder-length blonde hair stands wearing a dark jacket with a large, white, ruffled collar. A woman sits behind the boy holding a small child on her lap, both dressed in dark clothing. Standing in the far right background, a second woman wears a simple dark dress and a white cap. A red chair sits between the artist and the seated group, while a fan made of peacock feathers rests near the mother's hand.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A ceramic sculpture of a head and shoulders shows a metallic, silver-colored bust. The face has smooth, simple features with a rounded head shape. Its eyes are small and dark, contrasting with the shiny, reflective surface of the rest of the object. The neck and shoulders are wide and rounded at the base. The sculpture rests against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Outside In
alt_text: A painting of a geometric design made of many small, colorful shapes. The center features a grid of squares filled with triangles in black, white, red, blue, yellow, and green. Surrounding this central grid is a wide, repeating border composed of small diamond shapes. The paint is applied thickly, which gives the surface a rough, raised texture. This piece is contained within a simple, narrow wooden frame.

title: Oracle, Li Qingzhao
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture of a creature resembling a rabbit sits upright on a flat surface. The figure has long, upright ears and a rounded body with arms and legs splayed outward. Its surface is covered in a shiny, mottled glaze that blends shades of pale green, grey, and metallic blue. A dark, hollow opening is visible in the center of its chest area. The creature rests its front paws on the ground while its back legs stretch out to the sides.

title: Autumn, Bronx
alt_text: A painting of a forest with many tall, slender trees in autumn colors. The leaves are painted in bold strokes of red, orange, yellow, and deep green. These trees are set against a light background with patches of blue sky peeking through the branches. The ground is a light, neutral color, suggesting a path or open space between the trunks. Thick, expressive brushstrokes give the scene a textured and lively appearance.

title: Prayers for Souls in Purgatory: Old Woman with Cat
alt_text: A painting of an older person sitting next to a black cat. The person has pale skin, a pointed nose, and wears a blue cap along with a heavy brown coat. They have their hands clasped in front of them while looking down toward the cat. The cat is black and lies on a dark brown surface that extends across the bottom of the frame. In the background, there are stylized, gray-colored trees and a dark, indistinct jar-like shape. The entire scene is set against a deep blue, shadowy background.

title: Spinning Wheel
alt_text: A painting of abstract shapes features a large, wheel-like structure dominating the center. This circular form is outlined in dark, thick brushstrokes and radiates dark spokes toward the center point. Behind and around the wheel, layers of muted pink, grey, and yellow colors blend together. Bold, black, jagged shapes are scattered throughout the composition, providing sharp contrast to the softer tones. At the bottom, hints of striped patterns and geometric blocks add texture to the layered scene.

title: Flight to Egypt at Night
alt_text: A painting of a dark nighttime landscape showing a large, bright moon reflecting on a calm lake. A few people ride small animals, possibly donkeys or horses, along the rocky, shadowed shoreline in the foreground. To the right, several tall, dense trees cast deep shadows against the moonlit sky. The left side of the scene is more open with rolling hills fading into the distance under the heavy clouds. Warm light spills from the moon, illuminating the center of the water and the path ahead.

title: Garden with Trees and Stairs
alt_text: A painting of a lush, wooded landscape painted with thick, visible brushstrokes. In the center, a set of dark, wooden stairs leads up into a cluster of trees and greenery. Dark green and blue shapes surround the stairs, suggesting thick foliage and deep shadows. The foreground features a mix of bright yellow, green, and touches of red paint, representing grassy or floral patches. The upper portion of the scene hints at a sky with streaks of soft pink and warm light filtering through the trees.

title: Zinnias
alt_text: A painting of a vibrant flower arrangement in two vases. A large, bright green vase sits in the center on a dark, carved wooden stand. It is overflowing with a variety of colorful flowers in shades of orange, yellow, red, white, and deep purple. To the left of the large vase sits a tiny, matching blue vase holding just a few small pansies. The background is a soft, plain, light-colored curtain that hangs in gentle folds. The entire scene rests on a flat, brown surface that shows a faint reflection.

title: Virgin and Child with Saints
alt_text: A painting on a circular panel shows a group of five people gathered around a wooden table. In the foreground, a monk wearing a light-colored habit writes in an open book. Beside him, a woman holds a small, unclothed child on her lap. Behind them stand an older man with a long grey beard and another monk dressed in a dark robe. The lighting in the scene is soft and focused on the figures, set against a dark background.

title: Portrait of an Unknown Man
alt_text: A painting of a man shows him from the chest up against a plain, dark background. He is a middle-aged man with short, wavy, light brown hair and a mustache and beard. He looks toward his right, away from the viewer. He wears a black coat with a crisp, white collar turned down at his neck. His right hand rests against his chest, partly tucked into his dark clothing.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting showing a composition divided into three distinct horizontal sections. The top section contains a row of five overlapping human faces in profile, painted in warm brown tones against a cream background. The middle section features a narrower strip filled with abstract, wave-like patterns in shades of green, orange, and white. The bottom section is a larger horizontal block filled with bold, swirling blue and white shapes. The entire image is enclosed by a simple, thin border that frames the horizontal segments.

title: No. 11 (Yellow, Green, and Black)
alt_text: A painting shows three horizontal, rectangular bands of color stacked on a vertical canvas. The top section is a large, hazy rectangle of bright yellow. Below this, a thin, jagged horizontal stripe of dark green cuts across the center. The bottom section is a large, dark gray rectangle with slightly rounded corners. This central gray form is surrounded by layers of warm orange and red that bleed into the edges of the canvas.

title: Portrait of Nijinsky
alt_text: A painting of a person wearing a jester-like hat while resting against a pillow. The figure has a pale, grayish face with tired-looking eyes and a neutral expression. They wear a white, pointed hat decorated with a dark, zigzag stripe and a small tassel. The person is wrapped in a light-colored, ruffled fabric that has thin, reddish-brown lines woven into the pattern. The background is a mix of deep red and light blue areas that frame the central figure.

title: Card Players
alt_text: A painting shows two people with stylized, angular features sitting at a table and playing a card game. The person on the left wears a blue shirt and holds a fan of cards, while the person on the right wears a green shirt and rests their head on one hand. They sit across from each other at a reddish-pink table where several playing cards are scattered. To the left of the table sits a small, round yellow side table holding a bottle and glasses, with a potted plant nearby. The background features muted yellow and orange walls, with a rectangular pattern on the wall behind the right figure.

title: Isles of Shoals, Sunset
alt_text: A painting showing a calm sea under a warm, glowing sky. The sky takes up the majority of the image, fading from a pale greenish-yellow at the top to a deep orange near the horizon. A small, pale sun sits just above the horizon line in the center. Below the sky, a thin, dark horizontal line represents the water's edge, where two tiny silhouettes of ships appear very small against the horizon. The foreground consists of a solid, flat, light-beige area of water stretching across the bottom of the frame.

title: Saint John the Evangelist
alt_text: A walnut sculpture of a person standing and holding an open book. The figure has long, light-brown wavy hair and wears layered robes with gold, blue, and reddish floral patterns. One of their bare feet peeks out from beneath the long, draped garment. Beside the person's feet, a large bird stands with its beak open, looking upward. The entire figure is finished with painted details and areas of gold.

title: Saint Mark
alt_text: A sculpture of a bearded man with an open book stands against a black background. He wears a flowing robe that is painted in shades of gold and deep green with patterned details. The man holds an open, golden book in both hands in front of his chest. His gaze is directed slightly upward and to his left with a serious expression. Beside his feet on the right side sits a small, snarling lion figure made of the same material.

title: High in the Rocky Mountains
alt_text: A porcelain sculpture shows a textured, vase-like container with a wavy, folded surface. The colors are a blend of soft blues, pale greens, creams, and vibrant, saturated patches of dark blue. Its top edge is irregular, with folds and ripples that reach outward like cloth. The overall shape of the object is rounded and thick, sitting securely at the bottom. The finish appears smooth and glossy in some areas, while other parts show small speckles and uneven highlights.

title: Julia Wooster DeForest (1795–1873)
alt_text: A painting of a woman seated in a chair, shown from the chest up. She has light skin, brown hair styled in curls, and wears a large blue head covering with a white feather. She is dressed in a light blue gown with lace details and a small pink rose pinned at her chest. A patterned shawl with red and green designs rests over her lap and arm. In her right hand, she holds a small, folded white object while resting it on the red arm of the chair. The background is a dark, indistinct curtain with a pillar on the left.

title: Mehitable Curtis DeForest Lockwood (1751–1830)
alt_text: A painting of an older woman with a serious expression and round glasses. She wears a white bonnet with ruffled edges that frames her face and ties under her chin. Her dark clothing blends into the shadowy, dark background of the portrait. The figure is centered and shown from the chest up. A heavy, ornate gold frame with intricate details surrounds the painting.

title: Fanny Lewis (1790–1832)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a chair against a dark red background. She has dark hair styled in tight curls around her face and is wearing dangling earrings. A wide, ruffled white lace collar sits around her neck over a dark, velvet-like jacket. Beneath the jacket, a glimpse of a light pink or peach-colored fabric is visible. She gazes forward with a calm expression, resting one hand near her lap.

title: Caroline Mary Leffingwell Street (1790–1877)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a chair and wearing a dark dress with a white lace collar. Her hair is dark brown and styled in tight curls around her face, and she wears a small white cap. A light, folded shawl rests across her lap, and her hands are positioned in front of her. To her side, a green chair back is visible behind her shoulder. On a table next to the woman, there is a small dark object and a thin, tall figurine.

title: Sarah Hope Harvey Trumbull (1774–1824)
alt_text: A painting of a woman with her hair pulled up sits inside a heavy, ornate gold frame. The woman has a fair complexion, light brown hair, and wears a dark top with a tall, ruffled white collar around her neck. Her hands are clasped together, resting in front of her. To her right, a small, box-like object sits on a light-colored surface. A dark, reddish-brown curtain hangs as a backdrop behind her.

title: Jonathan Trumbull, Jr., Eunice Backus Trumbull, and Faith Trumbull (later Faith Trumbull Wadsworth) (1740–1809, LL.D. 1797; 1749–1826; 1769–1846)
alt_text: A painting of a man, a woman, and a child sitting together at a table. The man sits on the left, wearing a blue coat and yellow pants, with his hand resting on a closed book on the table. In the middle, the woman wears a dark dress with a sheer, light-colored veil draped over her hair and shoulders. To her right, a young child in a rust-colored dress looks forward, with one hand resting near a small basket of fruit on the table. A deep red curtain hangs in the background on the far left side. The rest of the background is dark and indistinct.

title: Sophia Smith Elliott
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in front of a landscape and a heavy curtain. She wears a dark, long-sleeved dress with a wide, lacy collar and a large, wide-brimmed hat decorated with fluffy feathers. Her right hand rests lightly on a book that is placed on a table covered by a cloth. Her left hand holds a small, white cloth or handkerchief near her waist. The background shows a dark, cloudy sky and trees to the left, while a thick, draped curtain hangs to the right.

title: Mehitable Bassett Bishop (1728–1811)
alt_text: A painting of a woman seated, viewed from the waist up. She wears a white cap tied under her chin and a pale, possibly grey-green patterned dress with white lace cuffs. A black shawl or scarf is draped over her shoulders and across her chest. Her hands rest together in her lap, and she holds a closed, thin book with a yellow-gold spine on the left side of the frame. She sits against a plain, dark grey-brown background that fades to a lighter color near her shoulder.

title: Martha Pawley LaBruce (1766–1822)
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a person with a round face, fair skin, and dark hair peeking out from under a white bonnet. This person wears a large, ruffled white collar that frames their neck and chin. Their expression is gentle, with dark eyes looking directly forward. The background is a soft, muted greyish-blue color. The painting is oval-shaped and framed within a dark red border.

title: Mary Otis Bull (1750–1786)
medium:
Watercolor on ivory
Reverse: Watercolor and chopped hair on ivory
alt_text: A miniature of a person with light skin, shown from the chest up. The person has dark brown hair tucked under a white ruffled bonnet with a blue ribbon detail. They are wearing a white wrap or shawl draped over their shoulders. A thin, dark choker necklace sits close against their neck. The background behind the person is a simple, shaded blue color. This oval portrait is set within a thin, metallic gold-toned frame.

title: Mary B. Frank (1793–1861)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up. She has dark hair parted in the middle and a neutral expression. She wears a ruffled, light-colored bonnet on her head and a wide white collar over her dark, solid-colored dress. A small patch of bright red fabric is visible on the left side of the frame near her shoulder. The background is painted in soft, dark, and blurry shades of brown. The entire image is enclosed within a simple, thick gold frame.

title: Catherine Dawson
alt_text: A painting showing a young child riding a horse in an open landscape. The child wears a light-colored outfit and a dark, brimmed hat while holding a long, thin stick. The horse stands facing to the right and is positioned in the center of the scene. To the right of the horse, two dogs sit on the ground, one larger and darker than the other. The background features grassy hills, some trees, and an open, cloudy sky.

title: Elizabeth Clinton Tallmadge (1780–1835)
alt_text: A painting of a woman seated and looking toward the viewer. She has dark hair styled up and wears a long, sheer veil that covers her head and falls over her shoulders. The woman is dressed in a dark blue gown and sits with her arm resting on the arm of a red chair. Behind her, a deep red curtain hangs on the right side of the dark, shadowy background. The entire portrait is enclosed within a wide, decorative gold frame.

title: Mary Gertrude Abbey (née Mary Gertrude Mead, 1851–1931)
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing in a long, dark gown. She faces forward with her head turned slightly to the left, wearing a high collar or accessory around her neck. Her dark dress flows down to the floor, and she holds a bright, reddish-orange cloth draped over her right arm. The background behind her is painted in soft, blended shades of brown and gold. The entire image is encased in a large, ornate, gold-colored frame.

title: Figure Study of Mary Gertrude Abbey (née Mary Gertrude Mead, 1851–1931)
alt_text: A painting of a person standing, painted in oil on canvas. The figure is shown from the front and wears a white top with long sleeves and a long, dark skirt. A large, dark-colored accessory or piece of clothing is held in front of the waist area. The background is a vertical, blurred wash of light brown and gray colors. The canvas itself appears to be unmounted or loosely hanging, with visible edges and white fabric ties at the corners.

title: Mary Eliza Mead (née Mary Eliza Scribner, 1822–1896)
alt_text: A painting of an older woman shows her from the chest up against a plain, light grey background. She has wavy, grey-brown hair styled with a white lace cap or headpiece pinned on top. The woman wears a dark, possibly black, dress with large puffy sleeves and a prominent white, lacy shawl draped over her shoulders. Her expression is calm, and she gazes directly forward with pale eyes. Handwritten text appears at the very top of the canvas, written in a cursive style.

title: Mary Eliza Mead (née Mary Eliza Scribner, 1822–1896)
alt_text: A painting of an older woman with light gray hair sits in a chair. Her hair is swept up and decorated with a small, pale purple and white floral accessory. She wears a dark black dress with a high collar that appears to be made of heavy fabric. A small, golden decorative pin sits at the center of her neckline. The background is a blurry mix of muted grays and browns, with a hint of a green chair visible behind her left shoulder.

title: Mary Gertrude Mead (later Mary Gertrude Abbey, 1851–1931)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture shows a rectangular portrait plaque with the profile view of a woman facing right. Her hair is pulled back in an updo, and she wears a dress with gathered fabric on her shoulders. The metal surface has a dark, uneven patina with patches of reddish-brown color showing through. In the upper left corner, there is engraved text in all capital letters that includes a name and a date written in Roman numerals. The entire relief has a rough, textured appearance.

title: Mary Gertrude Mead (later Mary Gertrude Abbey, 1851–1931)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture shows the profile of a woman in low relief against a flat background. Her head is turned to the right, featuring hair styled in an updo and a visible ear. Below her neck, her shoulders are draped in clothing that appears to have folds and a textured flower or ornament on one side. The background behind her contains several lines of engraved text, including a name and a date. The entire surface is a uniform, matte light gray color.

title: La Liberté
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a person’s head and upper chest rests on a rectangular white marble base. The dark brown figure has long, flowing hair that is pulled upward in a stylized shape. They look toward the upper left with a serious expression and have a draped piece of fabric covering their chest. A small, six-pointed star emblem sits centered on the draped fabric over the chest. The word "LIBERTE" is carved in capital letters into the front face of the marble base.

title: Ann Lorning Twining Hadley (1816–1897)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up. She sits facing forward with a calm, neutral expression on her face. The woman has dark hair pulled back simply and wears a black dress with a textured, light-colored lace collar. Her portrait is framed in an oval shape, which is centered within a large, rectangular, gold-colored frame. The background behind the woman is a plain, muted shade of dark brown.

title: Deposition from the Cross
alt_text: A painting showing a group of people gathered around a slumped, shirtless man seated on the ground. In the center, a woman wearing a pink dress looks upward with a sad expression while supporting the man's arm. To the right, a person in a blue shirt also holds the seated man, who is wrapped in a white cloth around his waist. Several other figures stand or kneel in the background, including a person wearing a bright orange garment. Large, dark stone pillars rise behind the group against a cloudy, dim sky.

title: Reuben Showing Jacob Joseph's Bloodied Tunic
alt_text: A painting of two men standing together in the foreground. On the left, an older man with a long white beard wears a large, patterned white turban and a purple robe. He looks upward with his hands clasped together, holding a white cloth. A younger man on the right wears a bright red cap and an orange-brown shirt, and he holds a long, greenish-brown cloth out toward the older man. A third person is partially visible behind the younger man’s shoulder, looking toward the left. In the background, a hazy landscape with trees and a few small buildings is visible under a blue, cloudy sky.

title: Virgin and Child with a Goldfinch
alt_text: A painting showing a woman holding a young child in front of a golden background. The woman wears a dark hooded robe that covers her head and shoulders. She holds the child in her arms, and the child is wearing a simple pink dress. The child holds a small white bird with red markings on its face by a thin string. Both figures have large, glowing circular patterns behind their heads.

title: Christ at the Column
alt_text: A painting on wood panel showing a man with long, wavy hair and a beard standing against a dark background. He has a thorny crown on his head with long, thin gold spikes radiating outward. A tall, dark vertical post sits in front of his chest, and his hands are tied together with a rope around the post. His pale skin is covered in many small, horizontal marks, each with droplets of red paint running down. He looks downward with a sad expression, and single tears run down both cheeks.

title: Susan Wetherill (later Susan Wetherill Cushman, 1817–1857)
alt_text: A miniature painting of watercolor on ivory shows the head and shoulders of a young woman. She is facing slightly to her left against a soft, faded, light green background. Her light brown hair is parted in the middle and pulled back, with loose curls framing her face. She has pale skin, blue eyes, and pink cheeks, and she wears a dark, possibly black, dress with a simple white collar. The painting is framed within an oval-shaped, ornate, gold-colored decorative border set inside a rectangular case.

title: Martha Wetherill Young (1833–1900)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature jewelry piece shows a portrait of a young woman with light brown hair. Her hair is styled in loose curls around her face, gathered up at the top. She wears a simple, light-colored wrap or dress that leaves her neck and shoulders bare. The woman faces toward the left, looking off into the distance with a soft, neutral expression. This portrait is set inside an oval frame with an intricate, metallic border and a small loop for hanging at the top.

title: Eleanora Westray Darley (1780–1849)
alt_text: A miniature painting on ivory shows a portrait of a young woman facing to the left. She has brown hair that is styled in tight curls on her forehead and pulled back at the crown of her head. The woman wears a simple white dress with a pale ribbon tied under the bust. A small, dark red pin sits at the center of her dress neckline. She is framed in a delicate gold oval, set against a dark rectangular background, with a small metal ornament at the very top.

title: Elizabeth Gaillard Gourdin and Theodore Gourdin (1766–1835; 1764–1826)
medium: Watercolor on ivory; verso: watercolor over graphite pencil on ivory
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a portrait of a woman wearing a white lacy cap and a high, ruffled collar. She has light skin, blue eyes, and dark hair peeking out from under her cap. Her expression is neutral as she looks forward toward the viewer. The portrait is framed by a simple gold oval pendant that hangs from a small, decorative loop at the top. The background of the portrait is a soft, muted grey-green color.

title: Dolley Payne Madison (née Dolley Payne, formerly Dolley Payne Todd, 1772–1849)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory of a young woman is displayed inside an open, oval-shaped case. The woman has dark, curly hair and wears a white turban adorned with small, colorful flowers. She is dressed in a pale gown and wears a delicate necklace with a small flower pendant. Her portrait is contained on the right side of the hinged case, which has a blue fabric trim. The left side of the open case is empty and features a plain, light beige lining.

title: Eleanor Britton Musgrave (ca. 1802–1884)
alt_text: A watercolor miniature shows a portrait of a young woman with light skin and dark brown hair. She has curls on the sides of her hair and wears it pulled up in a bun on top of her head. Her dark dress features a high, ruffled white collar that sits against her neck. She looks directly at the viewer with a neutral expression against a plain, brownish background. The portrait is housed in a smooth, oval-shaped metal frame with a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Margaret Smith Rose (1747–1799)
medium: Watercolor over graphite pencil on ivory
alt_text: A miniature portrait shows the head and shoulders of a woman with a pale complexion and blue eyes. She has a very tall, wide, dark brown hairstyle that frames her face. The woman wears a purple dress with a white lace ruffle around the neckline. Her hair is styled with a long braid resting on her left shoulder. The portrait is oval-shaped and set inside a metal locket with a small ring at the top.

title: Harriet Lynde Walter Hunter (1790–1868)
medium: Watercolor and graphite pencil on ivory
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory shows a young woman centered against a plain gray background. She faces forward with light brown hair pulled up, featuring some curls along the side of her forehead. Her pale face is framed by a white, lacy collar with multiple ruffles. She wears a simple white dress with a yellow sash around her waist. The entire image is encased in a thin, oval-shaped metal frame with a small loop at the top.

title: Margaret Hillegas Nichols (1760–1808)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a watercolor painting of a fair-skinned woman with reddish-brown, curly hair. Her hair is styled high on top, with longer, wavy locks falling down past her shoulders. She wears a white, layered dress with ruffles around the neckline. The woman faces forward with a calm, neutral expression. The painting is set inside an oval frame with a hinged, wooden cover that is partially open on the left.

title: Julia Anne Cox
alt_text: A watercolor miniature shows a portrait of a young woman with brown, curled hair. She wears a dark blue dress featuring a large, white lace collar that covers her shoulders. A thin, delicate gold chain rests around her neck, and she has small, orange drop earrings. Her pale face is turned slightly to the right against a soft, light blue and yellow background. The miniature is displayed within a small, rectangular gold border, which sits inside a larger, black, square-shaped frame with gold inner details.

title: Mary Sylvester Welles Davenport (1754–1847)
alt_text: A painting showing a woman sitting in a chair, facing forward. She wears a golden-yellow dress with a blue sash at her waist and a white, dotted shawl draped over her shoulders. On her head is a white, ruffled cap, and a single string of pearls rests against her neck. She holds a closed fan in her folded hands, resting in her lap. Behind her, a large window reveals a green landscape with trees and a white church steeple against a sunset sky. A heavy red curtain hangs to the right, framing the seated figure.

title: Thomas Holman and Lucia Ruggles Holman (1793–1826; 1793–1886)
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman posed together. They stand side by side against a dark, indistinct background. The man on the left wears a dark coat with a white cravat at his neck. The woman on the right has her dark hair pulled up and wears a dark wrap over a white, ruffled collar. The entire scene is encased in a thick, textured gold frame with decorative details at the corners.

title: Elizabeth Storer Smith (1726–1786)
medium: Oil on canvas in original gilded white-pine frame
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a yellow chair. She wears a blue dress covered by a long, reddish-brown fabric wrap. Her hands rest in her lap, holding a large cluster of light green grapes. She has a string of pearls around her neck and her dark hair is pulled up. In the background to her left, a tree stands near a landscape view of rolling hills and a body of water.

title: Abigail Trumbull Lanman (1781–1861)
alt_text: A painting of a woman is centered inside an ornate, gold-colored frame. The woman has dark hair styled around her face and is wearing a light-colored, ruffled bonnet that ties under her chin. She wears a dark, possibly black, dress with a patterned shawl draped over her shoulders. Her hands are clasped together at her waist. The background of the painting is a solid, dark, brownish color. Behind the framed artwork, portions of two blue chairs are visible on the left and right sides.

title: Hannah Gookin Kent (1691–1758)
alt_text: A painting showing a woman sitting in a high-backed red chair. She wears a dark, long-sleeved dress with white ruffled cuffs and a white head covering that drapes over her hair. A delicate, dark necklace sits around her neck, and she holds a small, rectangular brown book in her right hand. Behind her, a painted landscape scene shows trees, grass, and a river winding into the distance. The woman faces forward with a calm, neutral expression.

title: Laura Wolcott Moseley and Charles Moseley (1761–1814; 1786–1815)
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a young boy standing together in a field. The woman stands on the right, wearing a long, dark blue coat over a white dress and a large hat decorated with white feathers. She holds the hand of the boy, who stands to her left wearing a bright red suit with a wide, ruffled white collar. Their figures are positioned in the foreground, with large trees on either side of them. Behind the pair, a rolling green landscape stretches into the distance under a pale, cloudy sky.

title: Cornelia Ann Hillhouse (née Cornelia Ann Lawrence, 1802–1874)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up, set within an oval frame against a dark background. She has long, dark brown hair styled with ringlets framing her face. She wears a dark, patterned dress with a white lace collar and a bright red shawl draped over her shoulders. In the background behind her, there is a hazy landscape featuring dark rolling hills under a sunset sky with orange and red clouds. The woman faces slightly to the left, looking directly toward the viewer with a calm expression.

title: Lucretia Hubbard Champion (1760–1836)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory showing a portrait of a woman with dark brown ringlets framing her face. She wears a white bonnet with a decorative scalloped edge around her head and neck. The woman is dressed in a simple black dress with a dark purple shawl draped over her shoulders. Her expression is calm, and she looks directly forward at the viewer. The portrait is enclosed in a narrow red frame with a green inner border.

title: Mary Stiles (later Mary Stiles Holmes, 1767–1795)
alt_text: A miniature oil painting on wood showing a young child. The portrait is round and features a person with short brown hair facing forward. They wear a dark blue garment and hold a small, reddish-pink flower in their right hand. The background is a dark, smooth gray that lightens slightly around the child's face. Along the curved top edge, faint, cursive writing is visible against the dark background.

title: Mary Armistead Lightfoot (1696–1775)
alt_text: A painting of a person with fair skin and light-colored hair pulled back from their face. The person is wearing a dark-colored garment with a soft, white, V-shaped collar around their neck. They are positioned in the center, facing forward against a dark, shadowy background. The subject is framed by a simple gold border. The lighting appears soft, focusing mainly on the face and the white collar of the clothing.

title: Sophia Gough Carroll (1772–1816)
alt_text: A painting of a young woman with light skin and dark hair styled in an elaborate updo. She wears a yellow gown with a wide neckline that shows lace detailing underneath. In her right hand, she holds a small sprig of purple flowers against her chest. A thin, dark string necklace is tied around her neck with a bow. The background is a simple, dark brown tone that fades toward the edges of the oval frame.

title: Sarah Webb Swan Sullivan (1782–1851)
alt_text: A painting of a woman who sits facing slightly to the side. She wears a simple, light-colored dress with a ruffled neckline and a bright red shawl draped over her arms and shoulders. Her brown hair is styled in tight curls near her face and is tucked under a white cap. Behind her, a dark, heavy curtain hangs near a stone pillar. The background also shows a glimpse of a cloudy, light-filled sky. She rests her hands on the arm of a wooden chair.

title: Elizabeth Maynard (later Elizabeth Maynard Denny, born ca. 1770)
alt_text: A painting of a young woman shown from the waist up against a dark background. She has light brown hair pulled back with a small floral accessory. She wears a pale blue dress with lace trim at the neck and sleeves and a black ribbon tied around her neck. A small pink flower is pinned to the front of her dress, and she holds a cluster of green fruit in her left hand. The painting is set in a simple, rectangular gold-colored frame.

title: Elizabeth Huddell Cook (later Elizabeth Huddell Cook Bache, 1815–1898) as The Country Girl
alt_text: A painting showing a young woman wearing a pink bonnet and carrying a basket. She has dark hair styled with ringlets that frame her face, and her expression is gentle. She wears a light-colored shawl over her shoulders. Her left arm is bent, and her hand holds the handle of a tan, woven basket at her side. The background is a soft, twilight sky with pale blue and orange colors.

title: Eliza Hopkins Dowdall (née Eliza Hopkins Nicholl, 1786–1851)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on paper of a young woman is presented in an oval frame. She is centered in the oval with dark hair styled in small curls and is wearing a light-colored dress with a blue shawl. The oval portrait is set against a black square background that features a small, gold floral design in each of the four corners. The entire work is enclosed within a thick, ornate gold frame. The frame has a rippled texture on its inner and outer edges.

title: Katherine Bacon Trowbridge (1844–1934)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a chair. She has dark hair styled away from her face and is wearing a long-sleeved white dress with a dark blue band across her chest and waist. Her hands are folded and resting on a curved wooden table in front of her. The woman looks toward the right side of the frame with a soft expression. She is set against a plain, light brown background inside a decorative gold frame.

title: Sarah Little Tod Bulkley and Sarah Tod Bulkley (1870–1942; later Sarah Bulkley Randolph, 1897–1982)
alt_text: A painting of a woman and a young girl standing and sitting in a dimly lit room. The girl sits on a dark chair in the foreground wearing a white dress with many ruffles and a large pink bow in her hair. She also has bright red shoes on her feet. The woman stands behind her to the right, wearing a dark grey dress with lighter sleeves. Both figures look directly forward with serious expressions against a simple, dark grey wall background.

title: Anne Waldo Tyng (1708–before 1754)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a chair. The woman has light skin and brown hair pulled back, and she looks directly forward with a calm expression. She wears a dark blue dress with white frilled sleeves and a low neckline. She holds a small pink flower in her right hand near her chest, while her left hand rests on her lap near another flower. Behind her, the background shows a painted landscape with trees and hills. The entire scene is encased in a simple gold-colored frame.

title: Reverend Hiram Bingham and Sybil Moseley Bingham (1789–1869; 1792–1848)
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman posed together. The man on the left has dark hair swept upward and wears a dark coat over a white collared shirt with a necktie. Beside him, the woman on the right has her reddish-brown hair pulled back with small curls framing her face. She wears a dark top featuring a large, ruffled white collar around her neck. Both figures face forward against a simple, dark, brownish-grey background. The lighting is soft and focused mainly on their faces.

title: Helen Burrowes Breese (1781–1861)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a chair, done in oil on wood. She faces forward with a calm expression, wearing a dark dress with a wide white collar featuring lace edges. A white cloth covering sits on her head, framing her dark hair which is parted in the middle. She is positioned against a background that features a heavy red curtain on one side. To her right, the curtain pulls back to reveal a distant, outdoor scene with trees under a light, cloudy sky.

title: Margaret Mercer (1791–1846)
alt_text: A painting of a woman with brown hair styled in an updo with tight curls near her face. She is looking directly at the viewer with a calm expression and light-colored eyes. She wears a dark-colored dress with a large, white lace collar around her neck. A small, dangling earring is visible on her left ear. The background is a simple, dark, and blurry shadow.

title: Maria St. John Sheffield (1801–1889)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown in an oval portrait. She has dark hair parted in the middle and is looking directly forward. She wears a dark shawl over a lighter, textured top. A wide, gold, decorative frame surrounds the painting and features carved details of fruit and ribbons. The background behind the woman is a soft, dark green color.

title: Martha Washington (née Martha Dandridge, formerly Martha Parke Custis, 1731–1802)
alt_text: A miniature of a watercolor painting on ivory depicts an oval portrait of a woman facing forward. She has light hair swept up from her face and appears to be middle-aged. A thin, dark cord is tied closely around her neck. She wears a dark red or purple garment with light, ruffled fabric trim along the neckline. The background is a soft, muted grey, and the entire image is encased in a simple gold-colored oval frame with a small loop at the top.

title: Martha Washington (née Martha Dandridge, formerly Martha Parke Custis, 1731–1802)
medium: Watercolor on ivory, in a rose-gold-over-copper locket; reverse: watercolor and hair on ivory with an enameled rim, a cobalt-glass surround, and pearls
alt_text: A miniature jewelry portrait shows an older woman in a white cap and shawl. She faces forward with a serious expression, and her hair is mostly covered by the ruffled white headpiece trimmed with a dark band. The woman wears a dark dress underneath a folded white fabric scarf draped over her shoulders. The oval painting is set within a metallic, oval-shaped frame that hangs from a small loop at the top. The background of the portrait is a simple, warm brown color.

title: Lucretia Woodbridge Perkins Williams (1797–1829)
alt_text: A painting of a woman is shown inside an oval frame, which sits within a larger, rectangular gold frame. The woman faces forward with a neutral expression and has light, wavy hair. She wears a dark brown dress with a light, folded scarf draped over her shoulders. The background of the portrait is a simple, dark color that fades into shadow. A small, rectangular plaque with writing on it is attached to the bottom edge of the inner frame.

title: Theodosia Burr (later Theodosia Burr Alston, 1783–1812)
alt_text: A painting shows a young person with light skin and long, brown hair sitting in a chair. They are wearing a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt that has ruffled fabric around the neckline. The person looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression. Beside them, on a flat surface, are a few thick, stacked books. The background is a plain, dark green wall with a vertical strip of light on the right side.

title: Theodosia Burr Alston (1783–1812)
alt_text: A painting of a young woman shown in profile, looking toward the left. Her dark brown hair is styled simply and pulled back. She wears a plain, light-colored dress with a low v-shaped neckline. A thin, dark veil or scarf drapes loosely over her head and shoulders, blending into the dark background. Her skin is fair with light pink tones on her cheek. The entire scene is set against a very dark, indistinct background.

title: Alice Coates Langdale (1745–1787)
alt_text: A miniature of a young woman painted in watercolor on ivory sits inside a small, oval case. The woman is shown from the chest up against a simple, light blue background. She has brown hair pulled back with a light, gauzy veil draped over her head and shoulders. She wears a simple, light-colored dress with a wrap-style neckline. The painting is framed by a narrow, fuzzy green border inside a larger oval frame that is partially open on the left side.

title: Sarah Russell Sullivan (1786–1831)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a watercolor painting of a young woman on ivory. The oval portrait is set inside a thin, polished gold frame with a loop at the top for hanging. The woman has light brown hair styled in a simple updo with soft curls around her face. She wears a cream-colored dress with a ruffled collar that exposes her neck and shoulders. Her gaze is directed off to the right side of the frame against a soft, hazy background.

title: Elizabeth Green Storer (1734–1774)
alt_text: A watercolor on ivory miniature jewelry piece shows a portrait of a light-skinned woman with brown hair worn up in a braided style. She wears a blue dress with white lace trim at the neckline and a small, pink rose tucked into her bodice. The round painting is set inside a thin, gold-colored metal frame that connects to a woven, hair-like band above and below. Tiny white beads are decorated in her hair, and her expression is calm and neutral. The background behind her is a simple, muted gray wash.

title: Abigail Taylor Woolsey (1694–1777)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a chair against a dark green background. She wears a long, dark blue dress with a white cap and a white shawl around her shoulders. Her expression is calm as she faces forward. One of her hands rests on a closed book lying on her lap, while her other arm is extended onto a table to her side. A second, thicker book lies on the table next to her elbow. The lighting on her face and clothes is soft and even.

title: Elizabeth Davis Beardsley (1749–1790)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a wooden chair while holding a small book. She wears a long green dress, a white ruffled lace bonnet, and a sheer collar with a small oval pendant hanging from a black ribbon. To her left, a wooden table holds a basket full of rounded fruits near a window with pink curtains. Below the table, a white dog with a long snout looks up toward the woman. The window reveals a view of a garden with flowering bushes and a wooden fence.

title: Mary Woolsey Dwight (1754–1845)
alt_text: A painting of an older woman who faces the viewer directly against a dark brown background. She wears an elaborate, ruffled white bonnet that covers her head and frames her face. Below the bonnet, a wide, pleated white collar encircles her neck and fastens with a bow in the front. She is dressed in a simple, dark black garment with long sleeves. Part of a bright red chair back is visible behind her on the left side. Her expression is serious and neutral, with her gaze directed forward.

title: Sarah Hutchinson Oliver (1744–1780)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a portrait of a woman in watercolor on ivory. The oval portrait features a young woman with dark, upswept hair styled with a string of pearls. She faces forward with a soft, neutral expression, wearing a light purple dress with a white lace collar. The background is a simple, muted shade of green. A gold-toned frame with a scalloped edge surrounds the painting and has a small loop at the top.

title: Grizzel Oliver Waldo (1737–1761)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a woman set inside a small, oval-shaped frame. The frame is made of dark, polished wood with a gold inner edge and a small metal loop at the top for hanging. The woman has dark hair pulled back from her face and is looking toward the viewer. She wears a pink dress with a white ruffled collar and a small ribbon at her neck. Her skin is pale, and the background behind her is a simple, dark brown tone.

title: Mary Sanford Oliver (1713–1773)
alt_text: A miniature oil painting on copper depicts the head and shoulders of a woman facing forward. She has fair skin, brown hair pulled back, and wears a pearl necklace close to her neck. Her dress is dark blue with white lacy fabric covering the neckline. A small, dark flower or ribbon is pinned at the center of her chest. The portrait is housed inside a simple, oval-shaped hinged frame with a glass cover.

title: Elizabeth Hyslop Sumner (1757–1810)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up in an oval frame. She faces forward with dark, curly hair that frames her face. She wears a dress with a white ruffled collar at her neck. The background is a dark, muted green. The entire portrait is encased in an ornate, gold-colored oval frame.

title: Eunice Backus Trumbull (1749–1826)
alt_text: A miniature painting on wood showing the portrait of a woman. She faces forward against a light blue, plain background. The woman wears a white, tall-crowned bonnet with a gray band and frilly edges that frame her face. Her white clothing crosses over her chest. The portrait is housed in an oval gold frame with decorative, swirling scrollwork at the top and bottom.

title: Governor Jonathan Trumbull, Sr., and Faith Robinson Trumbull (1710–1785, LL.D. 1779; 1718–1780)
alt_text: A painting of a man and a woman standing side by side in a portrait. The man on the left has pale skin, a serious expression, and is wearing a white wig with curls over his ears. He wears a dark coat with a white cravat at his neck and holds one hand tucked into his jacket. Beside him on the right stands a woman with dark hair covered by a reddish-brown cloth or hood that drapes over her shoulders. Her face is soft, and she gazes forward with a calm look. The background is a plain, dark, brownish color that makes the figures stand out.

title: Margaret Watson Hutchinson (born 1758)
alt_text: A miniature oil painting of a person wearing a large black hat and a reddish-brown coat. The person has pale skin, light eyes, and light-colored hair styled close to the head under the wide hat. A white, ruffled fabric collar sits around their neck. The portrait is oval-shaped and set inside a rectangular gold frame with a bead-like trim. The background is a soft, dark blue, which creates a contrast with the figure.

title: Elizabeth Oliver Watson (1730–1767) (copy after portrait of 1765)
alt_text: A miniature portrait painting shows a woman with her hair pulled back. She wears a pinkish-red dress with white lace around the neckline and a white ribbon at her chest. Her dark hair is styled up with a small, pale pink bow at the crown of her head. The portrait is oval-shaped and framed in polished gold, which sits against a rectangular black background. A small gold loop for hanging, decorated with a leaf-like design, is attached to the top of the black frame.

title: Portrait of Katherine S. Dreier (1877–1952)
medium: Oil on canvas, laid down on thin wood with glazed paper coating on verso
alt_text: A painting of a woman with reddish-brown hair styled in an updo, facing forward against a soft pink background. She wears a patterned jacket in shades of orange and black with a large, dark-colored collar. A small, dark-colored decorative clasp or pin is visible at the center of her collarbone. Her facial features are painted with soft brushstrokes, giving her a calm and direct expression. The artist's name is written clearly in the bottom-left corner of the canvas.

title: Anna Susan Dummer Powell (1684–1764)
alt_text: A painting of an elderly woman sitting in a red high-backed chair. She wears a dark dress, a white shawl, and a white cap covering her head. Her face is pale and turned toward the viewer with a neutral expression. One hand rests on the arm of the chair while the other hand holds a small book on her lap. The background is a very dark, solid color that makes the woman and her bright red chair stand out.

title: Maud Cook (later Maud Cook Reid, 1869–1956)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up against a very dark background. The woman faces toward the left, her gaze directed slightly downward and away from the viewer. She has brown hair pulled back, and her pale skin is illuminated by light coming from the left side. She wears a soft, pink dress with loose, draped fabric around her shoulders and chest. The dark background helps her figure stand out clearly.

title: Elizabeth Fay Blake Barstow (1791–1869)
alt_text: A painting of an older woman is set within a large, highly decorative gold frame. The woman has pale skin, parted brown hair, and a serious expression. She wears a dark garment with a high collar that appears to have light-colored embroidery or lace near the neck. The background of the portrait is a dark, muted color that contrasts with her lighter face. The elaborate frame features raised patterns of swirling leaves and vines on all four sides.

title: Elizabeth Fay Blake Barstow (1791–1869)
alt_text: A painting of a woman with dark hair pulled back from her face. She is looking forward with a neutral expression. She wears a dark-colored dress with large, puffed sleeves and a white collar. The background is a simple, dark, and muted tone. The painting is enclosed in a thick, gold-colored frame.

title: Mary Alpin Dwight (1794–1874)
alt_text: A painting of a woman wearing a dark dress and a white lace bonnet. Her dark hair is parted down the middle, and she has a pale complexion with flushed cheeks. She wears a white ruffled collar around her neck that is fastened with a small white bow. A deep red curtain hangs partially visible on the left side of the dark, plain background. Her right hand is visible at the bottom of the frame, resting against her dark clothing.

title: Margaret Winslow Pollard (1724–1814)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up against a dark background. She has brown hair pulled back from her face and wears a white dress with a low neckline decorated with delicate lace. A bright blue fabric is draped around her arms and shoulders. The entire portrait is framed within an oval shape. The background is a soft, blended mix of dark blue and muted red tones.

title: Martha Fleming Byers (1840–1912)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a chair, shown from the waist up. She has light hair pulled back and wears a dark dress with large, ruffled white lace at the collar and sleeves. The background is a simple, dark brown color. She looks forward with a gentle expression while resting her hands in her lap. The bottom left corner of the painting is damaged with peeling paint.

title: Mary Toppan Pickman (1744–1817)
alt_text: A painting of a young woman standing and looking forward, wearing a shiny blue dress with lace details. Her dark hair is pulled back, topped with a small, decorative hairpiece. She holds a large, dark blue parasol in her hands, angled to her side. The background shows a simple outdoor setting with a stone wall and a rounded architectural feature. She wears a soft expression with light pink cheeks.

title: Elizabeth Woolsey Dunlap (1768–1848)
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory shows a person facing forward, set inside an oval metal frame with a hanging loop at the top. The subject has fair skin, rosy cheeks, and light brown, wavy hair peeking out from under a white, ruffled bonnet. They are wearing a simple, white wrap-style garment that drapes over their shoulders. A small, dark green sprig is tucked into the fabric near the chest. The background is a soft, muted greyish-brown that darkens toward the edges of the portrait.

title: Laura Woolsey Johnson (1800–1880)
alt_text: A miniature of a woman sitting in a red-bordered, gold-framed case. She has dark hair styled with curls framing her face and dark eyes looking directly forward. The woman wears a simple black dress with short, puffed sleeves. A bright purple shawl is draped over her right shoulder and arm. Her left hand is raised to her cheek, with her fingers lightly resting near her face.

title: Margaret Dunlap (1791–1837)
alt_text: A painting of a person with dark, wavy hair framing their face. The person looks off to the left with a soft, calm expression. They are wearing a large, layered white collar that appears to be made of delicate, ruffled fabric. This ruff sits high around their neck against a dark background. The lighting highlights the person's face while the shoulders fade into the black space surrounding them.

title: Susan Edwards Johnson Hudson (1825–1913)
alt_text: A painting of a young woman who looks to her left. She has dark hair parted in the middle and pulled back. She wears a soft, off-white lacy shawl draped over her shoulders. Her right hand is tucked gently into the fabric near her chest. The background is a blurry blend of dark brown and muted green colors. The portrait is framed in an ornate, shiny gold border.

title: Frances Ogden Edwards (1750–1800)
alt_text: A painting of a woman wearing a bonnet and a dark, high-necked dress. She faces forward with a neutral expression, her hair tucked under a tall, rounded white hat with a decorative lace trim. A wide, pleated white fabric collar covers her neck and shoulders over her dark brown or black dress. The subject is framed within a dark, oval-shaped background. This portrait is set inside a heavy, decorative brown wooden frame with carved details.

title: Esther Edwards Burr (1732–1758)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up against a dark, oval background. The woman has dark, curly hair with a small red flower tucked into the top. Her skin is light and she has a neutral expression while looking slightly to the side. She wears a dark, possibly greenish shawl or wrap that drapes over her shoulders. Below the wrap, a reddish, low-cut neckline is visible.

title: Rachel Moore Flagg Gwynne (1822–1884)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up, framed within an oval. She faces forward with a calm expression and dark, parted hair framing her face. She wears a deep red, wrap-style top with a textured, light-colored collar at her neck. The background is a simple, dark, and muted tone that draws focus to her face. The portrait is enclosed in an ornate, gold-colored oval frame with a twisted rope-like pattern around the edge.

title: Elizabeth Bassal Meiller Briggs
alt_text: A miniature of a woman shown in profile, facing to the right. The portrait is painted in watercolor and set inside a small, circular gold frame. This circular frame is mounted on a larger, square piece of black wood. The woman has her dark hair pulled up in a bun with small curls near her face. She is wearing a dark, high-collared garment with a ruffled texture around her neck.

title: Mary Hooker Pierpont (1673–1740)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up against a plain, dark brown background. The woman has pale skin, flushed cheeks, and dark hair pulled back from her face. She wears a dark, possibly black, wrap or garment with a light-colored, ruffled fabric collar. Her expression is calm, and she faces forward while looking directly at the viewer. Her pose is simple, with her shoulders turned slightly to one side.

title: Beatrix Cadwalader Jones (later Beatrix Cadwalader Jones Farrand, 1872–1959)
alt_text: A piece of jewelry shows a miniature painting of a woman in an oval frame. The woman has brown hair styled up, with a small, silver crescent-shaped ornament resting on the top of her head. She wears a cream-colored, draped dress with a thin strap or cord crossing over her chest. The background behind her is a soft, light blue, suggesting a cloudy sky. The entire portrait is encased in a polished, oval gold locket that has a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Mary Marsh Hale (born ca. 1710)
alt_text: A painting of a woman posing indoors for a portrait. She is wearing a long-sleeved, bright red dress with light-colored, ruffled cuffs and a matching light-colored inset at the chest. Her dark hair is pulled back, and she is looking directly toward the viewer. In her left hand, she holds a small, round, textured object. A simple landscape with trees is visible through a rectangular opening in the wall behind her left shoulder.

title: Charlotte Nichols Patterson Gilmor (1820–1846)
alt_text: A miniature portrait painting shows a young woman with light brown hair worn in curled ringlets on either side of her face. She is depicted from the chest up against a deep red background. The woman wears an off-the-shoulder white dress with a bright blue shawl draped over her shoulders. A single small pink rose is pinned to the center of her bodice. The portrait is framed in an oval gold border and set inside a hinged case.

title: Loja Gesellius Saarinen (1879–1968)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a woven wicker chair. She faces forward with a serious expression and has shoulder-length brown hair. She wears a long, dark brown dress with a pin at the collar and thin lines radiating downward. The chair is light-colored and has a rounded back against a dark, blurry background. Her hands rest calmly on the arms of the chair as she looks directly at the viewer.

title: Loja Gesellius Saarinen (1879–1968)
medium: Oil on burlap, mounted on board
alt_text: A painting shows a woman sitting on a green couch while holding up a small glass. The woman has light skin, brown hair, and is nude. She leans one elbow on a table covered by a patterned cloth that has pink and green designs. On the table, several dark bottles and drinking glasses sit together. Behind her, the background consists of dark, textured, and indistinct shapes. The bottom of the scene features a blurry blue area that looks like a floor or rug.

title: Frances Gleason Tenney Oppenheim (1907–1971)
alt_text: A painting of a woman with gray hair wearing a dark hat and a dark dress. She stands centered in the oval frame with a pearl necklace around her neck and small pearl earrings. Her dress has a large, light-colored lapel that forms a deep V-shape on her chest. Behind her, lush green leaves fill the background, appearing blurry and dark. She looks directly forward with a calm and serious expression.

title: Sarah Trumbull on Her Deathbed
alt_text: A painting of a woman lying in bed, looking upward with her arms raised. She wears a white nightgown and a ruffled white cap tied with a black band. Her face is turned to the right, and her expression seems intense or dramatic. Behind her, a dark green curtain hangs against a black background. Her hands are open and reaching toward the upper right corner of the frame.

title: Portrait of Patricia Garvan (1911–1918)
alt_text: A painting shows a young girl with blonde hair standing in a room with light-colored walls. She wears a simple, light-colored dress and a small pink flower in her hair. Her hands are clasped in front of her, and she looks directly forward. A dark shadow stretches out behind her on the wall, suggesting a light source to her right. The floor beneath her feet is a muted shade of green, and the entire scene is enclosed in an ornate, gold frame.

title: Sophia Myers Pearce (1805–1870)
alt_text: A painting of a woman with dark hair styled in high, rounded curls on top of her head. She wears a dark blue, off-the-shoulder dress with a bright yellow ribbon tied at her chest. A long, white fur wrap with black spots is draped loosely over her shoulders and arms. The woman has a light complexion and is looking forward with a slight smile. The background is a simple, dark, and muted brown color.

title: Sylvia Church Weston Sampson (1768–1836)
alt_text: A painting of a woman posing against a dark background. She has fair skin, blue eyes, and light brown hair that is styled high on her head. The woman wears a dark reddish-brown dress with a wide, white lace shawl over her shoulders. A long, thin black cord hangs down the front of the shawl. In her left hand, she holds a small, rectangular bottle. Her sleeves end in ruffled white cuffs that reach toward her hands.

title: Portrait of Elizabeth Willing Powel (1743–1830)
alt_text: A painting of a woman shown from the chest up within an oval frame. She has dark hair styled up and decorated with small orange flowers and a light green ribbon. She wears a tan bodice with a low, ruffled white neckline and sleeves that end in wide, lacy cuffs. Her expression is calm as she looks toward the viewer against a dark, plain background. The painting has visible fine cracks across the surface.

title: Tomb Effigy of Elizabeth Boott Duveneck (1846–1888)
alt_text: A plaster sculpture lies flat inside a cardboard box. The sculpture shows a person lying down on their back, covered by a thin, crinkled plastic sheet. A large, long palm leaf rests across the person's torso and legs. The figure has smooth, light-colored features, including a round face and hands folded on the chest. The entire piece is nestled snugly within the rectangular container.

title: Emilia Stiles Leavitt (1762–1833)
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a woman with light skin and dark hair. She wears a white cap with ruffles and a matching white ruffled collar over a dark dress. Her expression is calm, and she faces forward while looking slightly to the side. The painting is set inside a thin, rectangular brass frame. This portrait is surrounded by a thick, carved gold-colored wooden frame with a round metal hanger at the top.

title: Deborah McClenachan Stewart (1763–1823)
alt_text: A painting of a young woman with dark hair piled high on her head, wearing a white dress under a draped, shiny green shawl. She stands against a dark, curved wall and holds a closed, flat object in her hands. Beside her on a ledge sits a round, brown stringed instrument, two pieces of fruit, and a stack of books. The woman looks directly forward with a soft, gentle smile. Her left wrist is decorated with a small, round bracelet featuring a portrait. The room behind her is dimly lit and features an oval framed picture on the wall.
