title: Caroline Sumner Heywood (later Caroline Sumner Heywood Allen, 1796–1887)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a woman shown inside an open, oval case. The object is hinged in the center, with a dark green velvet lining on the left side and the portrait on the right side. The woman is painted against a dark background and looks directly forward with fair skin and brown, up-swept hair. She wears a dark dress with a bright red, patterned shawl draped over her shoulders, accented by a white, ruffled collar. A thin, red leather or wood frame surrounds both sides of the oval case.

title: Anna Maria Schieffelin Ferris (1788–1843)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a young woman showing her from the chest up. She has light brown hair styled in a high bun with loose curls framing her face. She wears a simple, light-colored dress with a scooped neckline. The portrait is oval-shaped and framed by a thin gold border. The entire piece is mounted on a rectangular black background and features a metal hanging loop decorated with leaves at the top.

title: Harriet E. Hulse (later Harriet E. Hulse Felthousen, 1840–1921)
alt_text: A miniature portrait on ivory shows a young child with fair skin and light hair. The child is wearing a dark, off-the-shoulder dress with short puff sleeves. Their direct, forward-facing expression is set against a simple background of pinkish sky and a thin, horizontal blue stripe representing the horizon. The portrait is oval-shaped and is enclosed in a decorative metal frame that features a round loop at the top for hanging. This object is worn as a piece of jewelry.

title: Anna Powell Mason Perkins (later Anna Powell Mason Perkins Rogers, 1805–1880)
alt_text: A miniature painting in watercolor on ivory shows the bust of a young woman facing forward. Her dark hair is styled up on top of her head with a small ornament. She wears a dark red dress with a wide, white lace collar around her neck. The portrait is set inside a thin, rectangular gold frame. This frame is mounted on a larger, black rectangular panel that has a golden flower and a hanging ring at the top.

title: Hannah Carter Smith (1764–1836)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a woman set in a gold oval pendant. The woman has light brown, curly hair that surrounds her face and falls down her neck. She is looking directly forward with a soft, calm expression on her face. She wears a simple, light-colored dress with a scooped neckline. The background is a pale, clouded blue, framing her figure. The gold frame is smooth and simple, featuring a small loop at the top for hanging.

title: Mary Hooper Schaw (née Mary Hooper, later Mary Hooper Schaw Fleming, 1780–1831)
alt_text: A miniature jewelry piece shows a watercolor portrait of a woman. She is shown from the chest up against a soft, hazy background. The woman has brown hair pulled up and wears a pale yellow dress with a low, rounded neckline. Her blue eyes look forward, and her cheeks are tinted with a light pink color. The entire portrait is set within a simple, oval gold frame with a small loop at the top.

title: Marion North Brown (later Marion North Brown Baker, 1881–1973)
alt_text: A painting of a young girl with blonde hair wearing a wide-brimmed lace bonnet. She wears a long, light-colored dress with lace details at the collar and cuffs. Her hands are positioned at the bottom of the frame, holding a small cluster of yellow and pink roses. The background is a solid, dark color that makes the girl stand out. The entire work is enclosed within an ornate, rectangular gold frame.

title: Sarah “Sally” Stearns Sherman and Sarah Sherman (1789–1845; 1814–1872)
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting and holding a young child. The woman has pale skin, blue eyes, and wears a light blue dress with a white lace collar and a white cap on her head. The child sits on the woman's lap, wearing a simple white dress and a red necklace. The child reaches out to touch the lace on the woman's collar while holding a small pink flower in their other hand. Both figures look directly forward with serious expressions against a plain, light brown background.

title: Nancy Freeman Nye (1799–1883)
alt_text: A miniature painting of a woman, rendered in watercolor on ivory, is presented in an oval format. The woman has dark hair parted in the middle and wears a dark blue off-the-shoulder dress with a delicate white necklace. She is set within a simple, narrow gold-colored frame. This frame is mounted onto a larger, square, black-colored background. A small, decorative gold-colored metal piece in the shape of a leaf and acorn sits above the oval frame, attached to a small loop for hanging.

title: Portrait of Manet Helen Fowler (1916–2004)
alt_text: A painting of a woman standing next to a dark-colored statue. The woman wears a long black dress with white lacy accents at the collar and wrists, and her dark hair is covered by a matching head wrap. She rests one hand on the waist of a small, dark, standing figure that rests on a rounded base. Behind them, a patterned wall hanging with black, white, and yellow geometric designs hangs against a soft pink wall. The entire scene is enclosed in a weathered, textured frame.

title: Clarissa Nichols Stanley (1793–1873)
medium: Oil on canvas, mounted to wood or panel
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting in a high-backed red chair, looking forward with a serious expression. She has dark hair styled close to her head, partly covered by a light-colored, lacy bonnet decorated with small pink and red floral accents. She wears a dark green dress with a white lace collar, a pink bow, and a brooch at her neck. A sheer, white, patterned shawl is draped loosely over her shoulders and wraps around her arms. Her hands are clasped together and rest gently in her lap. The background is a simple, dark, and muted wall.

title: Miniature portrait of Julia Goddard
alt_text: A miniature watercolor on ivory shows a portrait of a young person. The subject is centered in an oval frame, facing forward with brown hair parted in the middle and pulled back to the sides. They have a fair complexion, light brown eyes, and are wearing a simple, off-the-shoulder white top. The background is a soft, light blue color with a textured, cloudy look. A decorative, rectangular gold frame with carved details surrounds the oval image.

title: Portrait of Sarah Prince (1785–1867) (also known as Silver Moon or Girl at the Pianoforte)
alt_text: A painting of a young woman sitting in front of a keyboard instrument. She is wearing a simple, light-colored dress with short sleeves and has dark, wavy hair. Her left hand rests on the instrument's keys while her right hand holds up a piece of sheet music titled "The Silver Moon." The instrument is made of wood and features a row of black and white keys. The background behind the woman is a plain, dark wall.

title: By Candlelight
alt_text: A painting of an older woman reading a book. She is shown from the chest up against a very dark background. Her face is lit from the side, highlighting her features, while her clothing is dark and blends into the shadows. She wears a white lace cap on her head and a white lace collar around her neck. The book she holds is dark, and its pages are not clearly visible in the dim light.

title: Fisherfolk and Other Figures on a Beach
alt_text: A painting of a coastal scene on a panel shows a busy beach with several boats and people. In the foreground, groups of figures in long coats gather near the water's edge, some tending to horses and others standing near small piles of fish. Several wooden sailing vessels with tall masts rest in the shallow water or are pulled onto the sand. Further out, a few smaller boats appear on the calm, greyish-brown sea under a vast, cloudy sky. On the far right, a horse-drawn cart carries people along the shoreline. The overall tone of the image is muted with shades of brown, grey, and soft blue.

title: Saint Romuald
alt_text: A painting shows a man with a beard and a shaved head wearing a white robe. He is centered in the image and looks toward the right side. Behind his head, there is a large, glowing gold halo. In his left hand, he holds a red book with gold designs on the cover. His right hand grips the top of a thin, wooden staff. The background is a dark, leafy pattern.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A stoneware sculpture of a tall, irregularly shaped vessel stands on a wooden surface. The piece has a wide, rounded body that tapers slightly toward the base and features a unique, asymmetrical opening at the top. Its surface is textured with horizontal lines and has a muted color palette of seafoam green, soft blue, and earthy brown tones. The overall shape is organic and smooth, with a distinct bulge on one side near the rim. It sits centered on a slatted wooden bench against a plain, off-white wall.

title: Untitled (Mama Pot)
alt_text: A stoneware sculpture displays a rounded, bulbous shape that is split down the center. The surface is textured with rough marks and shows a blend of dark gray and brownish-copper colors. A deep, vertical cleft runs from the top down to the base, dividing the object into two main halves. The bottom of the sculpture narrows to a smaller point that supports the heavier top section. The object sits against a solid, neutral gray background.

title: Poster Portrait: O'Keeffe
alt_text: A painting of a potted plant sitting on a surface with fruit. In the center, a red pot holds tall, dark green, wavy leaves that reach toward the top of the frame. To the left of the pot, two light-colored, pear-shaped objects sit on a dark triangular surface. To the right, a bright blue patch holds a light green apple and a yellow gourd. Large red capital letters spelling "COFFEE" are arranged in a vertical column against the white background above the table. Thin black lines radiate outward from the letter "F" at the top right, resembling rays of light.

title: The Flower (Flowers)
alt_text: A painting of a pale, nude figure with long red hair standing in the center. The figure has one arm raised and looks down toward a deer standing to their left. The deer is a soft pink color and stands among light-colored, vertical plants. Behind the figure, there is a dark, indistinct background with hints of architecture and flowing fabric shapes. The entire painting is held within a tall, arched, gold-colored wooden frame.

title: Portrait of Lynette Yiadom-Boakye, Jacob Morland of Capplethwaite
alt_text: A painting of a person wearing glasses, a green jacket, and a plaid skirt standing in a field. They are holding a long rifle diagonally across their body with both hands. Dark trees frame the left side, while the right side opens up to a view of distant hills and a cloudy sky. Three brown rabbits lie on the ground near their feet. The figure wears tall black boots and stands in the center of the frame.

title: PURPLE H
alt_text: A painting shows a landscape divided into three horizontal color bands. The top band is a wide strip of deep, dark brown. Below that sits a lighter band of solid, soft purple. The bottom section is a pale, sandy tan color and features thin, dark lines that look like cracked stone or geometric patterns on the left side.

title: For Tamir
medium: Chains, driftwood, acrylic paint, and rhinestones
alt_text: A sculpture shows a piece of textured driftwood hanging in the air. The long piece of wood is covered in silver-colored rhinestones and paint, making it glitter. It hangs horizontally from the ceiling by two thin, metal chains. The chains attach to the piece of wood at each end. The background is a plain, light-colored wall with a simple concrete floor visible at the bottom.

title: Solitary Boat in Red and Blue
alt_text: A painting showing a bowl-shaped boat floating on water. The bowl is painted with thick, horizontal orange and blue stripes that wrap around its sides. Its interior is a dark, smooth gray. The vessel sits in the middle of the frame, resting on top of a calm, blue-and-gray surface that reflects the colors of the boat. Above the boat, the background is a muted, blurry green field with several small, faint white specks scattered across the top half of the painting.

title: Teletherapy
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting on a couch while looking at a smartphone. The person wears a green hoodie, dark blue pants, and glasses, with their brown hair pulled up into a messy bun. White earbuds hang from their ears as they hold a black phone in one hand. Behind them, a large window shows a bright blue sky, and a large wooden art frame leans against the wall on the right side. On the wooden floor in front of the couch sit two tan leather sandals. The person is barefoot and resting their chin on one hand.

title: The Annunciatory Angel
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting of a figure with wings kneeling on a narrow strip of dark ground against a shimmering gold background. This figure has curly blonde hair and a glowing circular halo above their head. They wear a light-colored robe covered by a decorated orange tunic, with a blue cloak draped around their shoulders. With their left hand, the figure holds a thin branch with several small leaves. The entire image is framed in a tall, pointed shape that resembles an archway.

title: The Virgin Annunciate
medium: Tempera, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painting on a pointed, wooden panel shows a figure sitting in profile against a gold background. The person wears a long, dark blue or green cloak over a dark red garment, with their arms crossed over their chest. A bright orange halo surrounds their head, which is tilted down and to the side. They are sitting on a simple, light-colored bench or stone block. The background is textured with a crackled, golden surface.

title: Untitled Escape Collage
medium: Ceramic tile, mirror tile, branded red oak flooring, vinyl, spray enamel, oil stick, black soap, and wax on panel
alt_text: A painting of a complex, layered scene filled with repeating geometric patterns and mixed media. Large, dark, liquid-like black shapes drip downward from the top, dominating the center and two side sections of the composition. Behind these drips are bright, tiled images of palm trees, tropical landscapes, and blue skies cut into diamond and triangular shapes. Small slivers of mirror and patterned surfaces reflect light and add texture to the grid-like background. The overall arrangement feels chaotic, with many overlapping colors, shapes, and dark streaks obscuring the view underneath.

title: Untitled (Potemkin with Black Square, Sailboat in Harbor)
alt_text: A charcoal drawing of a harbor scene with sailboats visible against a bright, hazy sky. The foreground is mostly filled with deep, dark shadows, including a tall, triangular shape on the right. A round, dark object sits near the bottom center by the water. Several boats with tall masts drift on the water in the middle of the scene. The light is strongest behind the boats, casting a bright reflection on the surface of the water. Faint shapes of many more masts can be seen in the distance against the hazy sky.

title: Portrait of Miss Emilia Boucherett
alt_text: A painting of a young girl wearing a white dress. She has wavy brown hair and is holding a small bunch of flowers in her hand. Her dress features a dark, wide sash tied at her waist. Behind her, a dark red curtain hangs to one side near a soft, hazy landscape. The entire portrait is enclosed within a wide, textured, gold-colored frame.

title: Images in Translation
medium: Mixed media, wood, acrylic, video projectors, archival pigment prints, tripods, tape, and plants
alt_text: A time-based media installation showing an assortment of technical equipment arranged in a dark room. On the left, a light projection displays an abstract pattern of many small, glowing rectangles onto a plain wall. Nearby, a tall, wooden, cage-like structure sits on a stool, illuminated from within. Several tripods stand across the floor, holding various video projectors and other mechanical devices that emit beams of light. The scene is cluttered with loose papers, tape, and electronic equipment, creating a busy setup in a dimly lit, gallery-like space.

title: Record Without A Cover
alt_text: A vinyl record is shown sitting on a wooden surface, with a plain white label that has black text printed in circular patterns. The outermost text reads in large, capital letters, "RECORD WITHOUT A COVER DO NOT STORE IN A PROTECTIVE PACKAGE." Smaller text spirals toward the center of the record, listing names, dates, and locations. The very center of the record features a small, simple hole. This circular object sits flat against a background of brown, vertical wood grain.

title: Untitled/ Tinsel/ Silent Listen
alt_text: A wood and metal object shows the word "SILENT" written in dark capital letters across its face. The object is rectangular with rounded corners and features a smooth, light-colored wooden surface with visible grain. The lettering is dark brown or black and centered clearly in the middle of the block. It sits against a white surface that has a faint grid pattern visible. The view is from directly above, showing the front surface of the object.

title: Winter Projects: Demeter Waits, Persephone Pines
medium: Soil, cloth bags, corn seed, and paper
alt_text: A sculpture showing two small rectangular cloth bags sitting on a white surface. The bag on top is made of a tan, textured fabric and has the words "GOLD SEED" printed on the front in dark letters. The bag on the bottom is made of the same fabric and has the words "BLACK DIRT" printed on it in similar dark letters. Both bags are cinched at the right end with a thin black string tied into a knot. The fabric of the bags looks slightly loose, as if they are filled with small, hidden items.

title: Chaldron Optical System, Issue 7 of The Thing
medium: Black rimmed glasses, and leather case
alt_text: A pair of black-rimmed glasses sits inside an open blue leather case. The case has a bright red velvet lining on the inside. Text is printed on the back inside wall of the case, and white letters are also printed along the inside of the glasses' arms. The glasses are dark black, rectangular, and positioned horizontally in the center of the open case. The background is a plain, light surface.

title: No. 671
alt_text: A stoneware sculpture of an organic, vase-like vessel stands centered against a smooth, dark background. The vessel has a textured surface with a warm, reddish-brown color that shifts to darker shades near the rim. Its shape is irregular and pinched, narrowing at the base and widening at the top into a folded or curved opening. The sides appear thin and delicate, with subtle waves and indentations creating a soft, uneven contour. The piece sits directly on the dark surface, casting no visible shadow.

title: No. 821
alt_text: A stoneware sculpture shows an open, vessel-like form against a plain, dark gradient background. The object has a tapered, rounded bottom that widens upward into a bowl shape. Its top rim is not a perfect circle but instead has distinct folds or pinch points that create a soft, irregular edge. The surface of the stoneware is textured and matte, with colors ranging from pale peach to earthy tan. This handmade appearance gives the sculpture a gentle and organic quality.

title: Myrtle
alt_text: A sculpture displays a central, textured cylinder shape painted in shades of tan, green, and dark brown. At the top of this cylinder sits a large, ruffled, and abstract form splashed with bright red, yellow, green, and blue. Below the cylinder, a smaller, bowl-like shape mirrors this colorful, multi-hued style. The entire piece has a glossy, reflective surface that gives it a wet appearance. It is mounted vertically against a plain, off-white background.

title: Brothers: Garet and Matthew Lahvis
alt_text: A painting of two young boys sitting side by side on a red bench. The boy on the left has dark hair, wears a blue sweater with red and white stripes, and rests his chin on his right hand. The boy on the right also has dark hair and wears a solid yellow long-sleeved shirt with a green stripe at the collar. Both boys have light skin and look directly toward the viewer with calm expressions. The background is a simple, light blue wash, and the boys are sitting on a long, reddish-brown bench with light-colored legs.

title: Virgin and Child with Angels and Cherubim
medium: Cartapesta with tempera, oil, gold, and silver on panel
alt_text: A painted sculpture of a woman holding a baby is set within an elaborate frame. The woman sits centrally, wearing a dark blue robe and a white head covering, and she looks down at the nude infant on her lap. To the left, a small winged boy holds a leafy branch, while another winged figure is partially visible behind the woman on the right. The entire scene is framed by golden, arched columns and intricate, decorative carvings that extend to a base holding a small, red oval emblem. The background behind the figures is a light blue color with painted garlands and a small winged head above.

title: DUÆL: Lee + Man (after Man Ray + Lee Miller)
medium: Oil on ivorine with two metronomes
alt_text: A sculpture of two wooden metronomes features painted eyes attached to their metal arms. Each pyramid-shaped wooden metronome stands upright against a plain white background. The metronome on the left is a lighter, golden wood, while the one on the right is a deeper, reddish-brown color. A small, square-shaped piece of ivorine with a realistic, painted eye is clipped onto the thin metal pendulum of each device. These eye pieces sit at an angle, giving the impression that the objects are looking at each other.

title: DUÆL: Lee + Man (after Man Ray + Lee Miller)
alt_text: A time-based media object showing two wooden metronomes placed side-by-side against a plain background. Each pyramid-shaped metronome has a thin metal pendulum arm extending diagonally from its center. Attached to the top of each pendulum is a small, pale, rectangular cutout displaying a realistic drawing of a human eye. The eye on the left metronome looks toward the right, while the eye on the right metronome looks toward the left, causing them to gaze at each other. The metronome on the left is lighter in color than the one on the right.

title: Berks County Hospital and Alms House
alt_text: A painting of a large building complex set in a wide, green landscape. In the center, a prominent, multi-story brick building with towers and a central cupola stands behind a stone wall. Several smaller outbuildings and barns with red roofs are scattered around the grounds in the foreground and to the right. Green fields surround the structures, separated by wooden fences and lined with trees. In the distance, a range of blue-tinted mountains rises under a pale, hazy sky. Text at the bottom center reads, "BERKS COUNTY HOSPITAL & ALMS HOUSE."

title: Untitled
alt_text: A stoneware sculpture showing a cylindrical vase or vessel with a roughly modeled surface. The piece is white with scattered areas of hand-painted blue, green, and brown washes. Dark, thin lines are drawn across the surface, sketching out the forms of a horse and human figures. The overall texture of the ceramic appears uneven and hand-formed. It sits against a plain, neutral background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: An earthenware sculpture shaped like a pitcher stands against a plain background. The object has a tall, wide, and slightly angular body that tapers toward the base. A large, curved handle extends prominently from the left side, pointing downward like a thick hook. The pale yellow surface is decorated with thin, abstract lines in black and light blue, which loop around the body and the handle. The opening at the top is uneven and shows a glimpse of the interior, which features similar light blue and grey painted markings.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A glazed earthenware sculpture shows a flared, open vessel with jagged, star-shaped edges. The outside of the object is a dark, mottled blue color with thin, etched lines in a reddish-brown hue. Inside the opening, the clay is a light cream color decorated with sparse, dark brown brushstrokes. The shape is wide at the top and tapers down to a narrower base. The entire object rests against a plain, dark gray background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A stoneware sculpture shows an open, bowl-shaped vessel with a smooth, matte finish. The clay is a warm, earthy terracotta or reddish-brown color that darkens slightly toward the bottom. The top rim is not a perfect circle but instead curves inward at two opposite points. These inward curves create a subtle indentation on both sides of the bowl. The vessel sits against a plain, solid grey background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A stoneware sculpture of a three-legged vessel sits against a grey background. The main body of the vessel is a dark, earthy color with a textured surface. It has a long spout extending from one side and a handle shaped like a rabbit on the opposite side. A small, light-colored knob sits in the center of the vessel's top opening. Three thick, sturdy legs support the container, raising it slightly off the surface.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A glazed earthenware sculpture shows a shallow, boat-shaped dish. The object is long and curved, resembling a wide, open bowl or tray. It has a flat, thin rim that runs around the entire edge. The surface is decorated with a repeating, intersecting grid pattern in shades of red, green, and yellow. A curved base sits underneath the center of the dish, giving it a slight tilt.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A stoneware sculpture showing a roughly cylindrical vessel with an uneven, broken rim. The object is composed of multiple pieces of fired clay joined together in an irregular, layered fashion. The surface features mottled shades of brown, tan, and gray, with a rough, textured appearance. Gaps and cracks are visible throughout the structure, revealing layers underneath the outer shell. A prominent, curved piece sits detached and raised on the top edge, adding to the fragmented look.

title: Casein Tempera #4
alt_text: A painting shows various geometric shapes against a pale, light yellow background. A large, semi-transparent purple circle dominates the upper center, containing three smaller circular shapes inside it. Below the large circle, several solid-colored spheres in blue, green, and pink float in the open space. Thin vertical lines in red and blue run down from the top, crossing through the large purple circle. Large, dark-colored shapes resembling curved wedges anchor the composition at the top and bottom corners of the frame.

title: Spine
alt_text: A sculpture of soda-fired stoneware shows many stacked, flowing layers of clay. The object is brown and has a rough, earthy texture throughout its surface. Each layer curves horizontally, creating a wavy pattern that moves across the form from left to right. A vertical seam or ridge runs down the center, dividing the layers into two main sections. The entire shape sits firmly on a flat, light-colored surface against a neutral background.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of an abstract arrangement of dark, curved objects on a light surface. These central, brown and grey forms have rounded, segmented shapes that look somewhat like shells or pieces of hardware. They are clustered together in the middle and bottom of the scene against a white and light grey background. Behind these shapes, there are splashes of bright red, pale yellow, and deep green paint that frame the composition. Bold brushstrokes and sharp angles define all the forms throughout the work.

title: Head
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of an abstract, geometric shape that narrows to a single point at the top. The main upper portion is rounded and bulbous, but features a large, triangular notch cut into its side. This notch creates a deep, hollowed-out space within the otherwise solid form. Below this complex top section sits a simple, smaller cylindrical base. The entire object has a warm, medium-brown wood grain visible throughout its smooth surface.

title: Bird Spectrum (Art, Artifact, Artifice) No. 1
alt_text: A painting of three panels, each containing many small, stylized bird shapes organized into rows against a plain white background. The left panel features birds in warm shades of red, orange, and gold. The middle panel shows a similar arrangement of birds in shades of green, yellow, and turquoise. The right panel displays birds in various tones of blue and deep purple. Each small figure is depicted simply, with subtle patterns on their bodies, and they appear to float across the surface of the panels.

title: Malcolm X #16
medium: Bronze with red patina, silk, wool, and polished cotton and synthetic fibers with a steel support
alt_text: A sculpture of bronze, red fabric, and fibers stands upright on a white platform. The upper section consists of dark, blocky bronze pieces arranged in an uneven, rectangular shape. Long, bright red ropes and soft, fabric-like strands hang down from the metal blocks. These red ropes drape all the way to the base, forming a tangled, textured pile. The contrasting dark top and vivid red bottom create a sharp visual difference.

title: Of Blossoms That Bloomed So Fine
medium: Felt, yarn, and acrylic on canvas
alt_text: A painting of a bearded man holding a bottle with a candle. The man has a reddish beard, styled hair, and wears a plaid shirt over a black t-shirt. On his wrists are wide black bands, with one band featuring silver studs. He holds a green glass bottle in his hands, which has a tall blue candle resting inside the neck. Behind him is a large window with a white grid frame, showing dark night scenery with distant purple shapes.

title: Like Magic
alt_text: A painting of two figures standing in a colorful, stylized scene filled with abstract objects and plants. On the left, a person with dark hair wears a green shirt and holds a brown, textured board, while a small white bird sits on their shoulder. A bright green bird hangs from a perch above them. On the right, a second person with yellow hair and a green visor wears a blue shirt and holds a small, crown-shaped object in one hand. Between the two figures, a cluster of red, orange, and blue shapes sits above a patch of yellow flowers on the ground. A large, purple curtain drapes down along the right side of the frame.

title: Split
medium: Casein and acrylic on Medite and Aqua-Resin
alt_text: A painting shows three stacked rectangular panels that create a geometric pattern. Each panel is divided diagonally by a line that runs from the top-left to the bottom-right. The left sides of the triangles are a solid, bright red color. The right sides of the triangles are a solid, clean white color. The panels fit together tightly to form a single, tall rectangle shape.

title: rma (12)
alt_text: A set of 12 screenprints displays black-and-white portraits arranged in two rows of six. Each portrait is rectangular and shows a different person from the chest up. The images use high-contrast lines to define facial features and hairstyles against darker backgrounds. The people shown have various hairstyles, ranging from loose hair to tight curls. The reflective surface of the background creates a shiny effect throughout the grid.

title: Grieving Angel for T. H. [Ted Hughes]
alt_text: A bronze relief sculpture shows a crouching figure on a square panel with a dark, textured surface. The person is huddled on the right side with their knees pulled up toward their chest. Their body is covered in layers of heavy, textured material that looks like thick feathers or fur. One leg extends out toward the left, showing a smooth, bare knee and foot. The background is uneven and rugged, blending into the dark color of the rest of the piece.

title: Consilia, 4.30pm, East London
alt_text: A painting of a person sitting in an armchair while holding a book. The person wears a bright blue, long-sleeved shirt and blue skirt. Behind them, a large rectangular window looks into another room with purple chairs. The walls of the room are a pale, light blue color. To the right, a curtain hangs down in shades of blue and white. The book in the person's hands has colorful, abstract marks on the cover.

title: Manayunk
alt_text: A painting of a city landscape shows a cluster of buildings behind a long, light-colored wall. In the foreground, a large, dark, flat area creates a deep shadow that stretches across the lower portion of the canvas. Several small figures of people stand near the wall, looking like tiny dark silhouettes against the lighter structures. Behind the wall, pale yellow and tan buildings rise up with some taller, darker structures in the distance. The sky above is a soft, muted blue with a single wispy cloud. The entire scene is enclosed within a thick, decorative, dark gold-colored wooden frame.

title: Metronome
alt_text: A painting of a dark, wooden metronome sitting on a horizontal shelf. The metronome is shaped like a pyramid and features a bright yellow face behind a thin vertical arm. A thin white string hangs down from the metronome, extending over the edge of the shelf. There are small, crumpled white objects scattered on the shelf near the base of the metronome. The background is a very dark, indistinct wall that fades into shadow.

title: Beatrice Beard Grover
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a human head is carved from dark brown wood. The piece is shaped like a blocky bust, showing only the head and a short neck. The facial features are formed by sharp, angular planes rather than rounded curves. You can see distinct, flat chisel marks across the forehead, cheeks, and jawline. The wood has a polished, deep brown grain that reflects light on its smooth surfaces.

title: Master Control
alt_text: A painting of the mechanical inner workings of an old machine, centered on a metal tractor-style seat. The seat sits in the middle, framed by various rusted gears, levers, and metal bars that fill the background. To the right, a long, thin rod rises vertically, and other angled pieces of machinery extend across the frame. The colors are mostly muted earth tones, featuring browns, greys, and deep blues, with a patch of bright blue sky showing through at the top right. Shadows create depth and highlight the worn texture of the metal surfaces.

title: II-25 #1 +B
alt_text: A painting of a square grid filled with a changing spectrum of colors. The entire surface is divided into small, uniform squares arranged in vertical and horizontal rows. A gradient of cool blue transitions across the left side, moving toward vibrant greens and then warm oranges and reds on the right. The colors appear to blend smoothly within the grid, creating a soft, luminous effect across the canvas. A thin border of changing colors lines the very edge of the square, echoing the rainbow spectrum in the center.

title: Bust of a Young Gentleman of the Chigi Family, possibly Francesco Piccolomini
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a person shown from the side in profile. The figure has long, wavy hair that falls down their neck and shoulders. Their head is turned slightly to the left, and they have soft facial features. A large, draped piece of fabric wraps around the figure's chest and shoulders in deep, thick folds. The entire figure sits atop a square pedestal made of reddish-brown stone with white veins. The background is a solid, dark gray color.

title: Liberty's Dots and Dashes
alt_text: A painting of flowers sits in a small, patterned pitcher that rests on a decorated surface. The pitcher is brown with horizontal bands of dark squares. Several stems emerge from the pitcher, topped with white and red blossoms. The background and surface are covered in a repeating, abstract pattern of tan, wavy lines, dark red bars, and blue shapes. Small, yellow circles are scattered throughout the background design.

title: Horizontal Obeah TJEKE
medium: Cotton textile, kaolin, nails, yarn, acrylic paint, and wood
alt_text: A sculpture of layered geometric shapes and horizontal bars mounted on a light gray wall. Several long, thin strips, some wrapped in what appears to be white and patterned textile, extend horizontally across the lower middle of the piece. Above this base, a bright red square sits on the left side, while a blue vertical rectangle with a white grid sits slightly higher in the middle. On the right side, a rectangular block features a gray, black, and yellow geometric pattern. The entire work has a precise, clean-edged appearance with varied textures and flat colors.

title: Spring
alt_text: A painting of a dark, evening landscape filled with many children playing in an open field. A large, hazy cloud stretches across the center of the deep green sky. Several children hold long, thin strings that connect to small, flying moth-like creatures hovering high above. In the center, a man in a hat stands holding a box with more strings attached, while other children run or sit on the grass nearby. To the right, a dark, leafless tree stands behind a low stone wall.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A painting of a pale, light blue surface with a few dark gray and orange lines drawn over it. The background is a soft, muted blue that looks like textured paint. Two thin, dark gray lines cross the middle, forming a T-shape on the right side. Two slanted orange lines cross the center of the canvas and meet near the bottom to form a V-shape. Scattered across the blue background are several short, thick, white brushstrokes that look like small clouds.

title: No Title
alt_text: A painting shows a flat, bright blue object in the shape of a bowtie or two triangles connected at their tips. The object is symmetrical and vertically oriented, with two sharp points extending to the top and two sharp points extending to the bottom. Its surface is painted in shades of blue that vary slightly, showing visible brushstrokes or texture. The object is centered on a plain, light grey background. A soft, dark shadow is cast behind the bottom edge, suggesting it might be slightly raised from the surface.

title: KKIMH
medium: Acrylic on canvas, mounted on wood
alt_text: A painting shows two large, irregular shapes that contrast with each other. One section is a dark, textured maroon color that fills the top left and bottom right corners. A second, smooth-looking sea-green shape weaves through the center and bottom, separating the maroon parts. Within the larger green area, there is a smaller, floating green oval shape positioned near the top center. The overall composition creates a simple design of solid, abstract forms.

title: Monument for Yale University: Giant Traveling and Telescoping Lipstick with Changeable Parts in Three Stages of Extension [Presentation model]
medium: Cardboard, canvas, glue, spray enamel, and shellac
alt_text: A model made of cardboard and canvas shows a large, upright lipstick tube mounted on the treads of a tank. The lipstick is bright red with a rounded, pointed tip at the very top. Below the red part, the tube is colored in shades of metallic gold and brown. This cylindrical tube sits on a dark, square base that connects to thick, ridged tank tracks on either side. A small, flat metal piece with a circular hole extends forward from the center of the base.

A painting of a white canvas with a small, rectangular image attached to the center. The attached image depicts a window view looking out onto a snow-covered field and distant blue hills. A grid of window panes divides the view, with a wooden fence line stretching across the background. Tan-colored masking tape holds the rectangular image onto the main white canvas surface. A thin, measured border runs along the outer edge of the large canvas frame.

title: Still Life with Peaches and Grapes
alt_text: A painting of peaches and grapes sitting on a dark surface against a black background. The central focus is a cluster of five round peaches, showing shades of yellow and reddish-orange. Behind the peaches lies a large, overflowing bunch of dark purple grapes on a wooden stem. A few small, scattered grapes are positioned near the bottom left and bottom right corners of the arrangement. The fruit is illuminated, casting soft reflections onto the dark, smooth surface below.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of fruit and honeycomb arranged on a tabletop. A glass bowl filled with peaches and dark grapes sits in the center, alongside a single pear. In front of the bowl, a pile of green grapes rests next to a large piece of golden honeycomb on a small plate. Two halved peaches sit on the table surface, their pits and textured centers visible. A few whole peaches and plums are scattered nearby, all reflecting on the polished surface of the table.

title: PHYSICHROMIE 1851
alt_text: A painting of three tall, rectangular panels filled with many thin, vertical lines. The lines are packed closely together and run from the top to the bottom of the square frame. The left and right panels feature a gradient that shifts from reddish-orange to deep purple. The center panel has a gradient that changes from bright green to yellow and orange. Narrow gaps between the panels reveal more thin, vertical lines against a light green background.

title: Wilderness View
alt_text: A painting of a calm lake surrounded by mountains and autumn trees. A large, hazy mountain peak dominates the center background, rising above a dark forest line. The shoreline on the right features a small, rustic cabin nestled among orange and gold trees. A few tiny figures stand near the water's edge, close to a small boat. The foreground shows a sandy bank with scattered tree stumps and brown grass. The overall scene is bathed in the soft, warm light of a late afternoon.

title: Red Pair Waiting
medium: Wood block and glass bottles with metal screw lids, ink, and water
alt_text: A sculpture made of a wooden block and glass bottles with metal screw lids, ink, and water sits against a plain white wall. Two clear, round bottles stand side by side on the flat top of the block. Each bottle is filled about halfway with a deep red liquid. The wooden block is tall and rectangular with a rough, weathered brown surface. A long, faint crack runs vertically down the front center of the wood.

title: A Philosopher
alt_text: A painting of an older man with a long beard holding a large open book. He wears a dark, rounded cap and a muted blue cloak over a dark shirt. With his right hand, the man points toward text on the open pages of the book. His face is weathered with deep wrinkles, and he looks directly toward the viewer. On the table in front of him lies another smaller, closed book. The background is a dark, indistinct brown color that makes the man stand out.

title: Untitled AD.15
medium: Ink and gouache on paper, laid on linen
alt_text: A painting showing a textured, abstract composition on a light, grayish background. Three dark, rectangular shapes float horizontally across the upper middle section of the frame. Below these, a thick, horizontal band of vertical dark marks stretches across the lower portion. Light gray vertical lines subtly streak down from the top, crossing over the darker shapes. The overall appearance is grainy and reminiscent of ink wash.

title: Indian Encampment
alt_text: A painting of a dark landscape at twilight. The scene is dominated by deep, muddy brown and gold tones. On the left side, tall, dark silhouettes of trees and two conical structures sit near the edge of a field. Several small, pale figures, some appearing to be riding horses, are scattered across the middle distance. The foreground is filled with murky, indistinct textures that suggest uneven ground. The sky above is a rich, textured yellow that darkens toward the edges of the canvas.

title: Every last drop
alt_text: A glazed ceramic sculpture showing a bright orange stool supporting two distinct objects. The top of the stool is a small, round platform with four thin, straight legs. Sitting on the stool is an arch-shaped form with a bumpy, textured surface that features swirls of light blue, white, and reddish-purple glaze. In front of the arch, resting on the seat, is a metallic-looking, ring-shaped object with a dark band and a polished, silver-colored center. The entire sculpture stands against a plain, light gray background.

title: In the deep water of dreams, light blue and yellow flash. Arrow. Dense strength of the drill. Forest. Arrow. Flowing force of the river. Forgetfulness, buried, in our fleeting memories. Arrow. We were dancing.
alt_text: A sculpture made of metal, plastic, and fabric hangs suspended from a single blue string against a light gray background. It features thin, spindly arms and wires that extend outward in several directions. These varied materials are colored in shades of blue, yellow, green, pink, black, and white. Some parts of the sculpture are wrapped in tight bands, while others consist of loose, dangling fibers or straight metal lines. The entire arrangement creates a complex, open, and airy structure that fills the space.

title: Neck Bones I and Neck Bones II
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows a complex geometric design divided into two vertical panels. Both sides are filled with a dense pattern of interlocking shapes like circles, arcs, sharp triangles, and straight rectangular bars. These shapes are colored in a bright palette of red, blue, green, yellow, brown, and purple. White lines clearly separate each distinct shape from the ones next to it. The composition is abstract and symmetrical, with the left side mirroring many of the curving and angular elements on the right.

title: Portrait of Jeanne Pissarro
alt_text: A painting of a young girl wearing a light yellow hat and a pink dress. She sits on a wooden chair against a tan, textured wall. The girl has long brown hair and looks directly forward with a serious expression. In her lap, she holds a small bouquet of red, white, and purple flowers. A vertical strip of wallpaper with blue and white patterns runs along the left side of the frame.

title: Frederick III (1831-1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia
alt_text: A glass sculpture shows a standing man with a long beard. He is wearing a long coat and is positioned between two large books on a wooden shelf. His right hand rests on a short, tree-stump-like pillar beside him. The sculpture has a translucent, frosted appearance and stands on a rectangular base. The books on either side provide a dark backdrop for the clear figure.

title: Medallion with Portraits of Franz I (1768-1835), Emperor of Austria; Alexander I (1777-1825), Emperor of Russia; and Frederick William III (1797-1840), King of Prussia
alt_text: A brass medal showing the profiles of three men in military-style uniforms facing right is mounted on a square piece of polished dark wood. The circular medal has a metallic gold tone and fits snugly into a recessed circular area in the center of the wooden mount. The three men are arranged side-by-side, partially overlapping one another in a relief design. To the left of the mounted medal, a piece of white paper with black printed text lies flat. The background behind both the medal and the paper appears to be a light-colored, textured surface.

title: Lacquer Snuff Box with Photograph of Frederick III (1831-1888), Emperor of Germany and King of Prussia
alt_text: A lacquer container made of wood shows the portrait of a man in profile. The man has a beard and mustache and is wearing a dark, formal military-style uniform with medals pinned to his chest. He faces toward the left side of the frame. The portrait itself is sepia-toned and has a slightly aged look. The container has rounded corners and a glossy, dark brown finish around the edges. It rests against a light gray, textured background.

title: Portrait of Frederick II (1712-1786), King of Prussia
medium: Painted on ivory; gilt brass and silk damask
alt_text: A painting on ivory shows a portrait of a person. The small, oval painting is set inside a larger, rectangular, gold-colored metal frame that features decorative carvings. The frame is placed on a light green background, which is surrounded by several circular metal medals and other decorative objects. The person in the portrait has white hair and wears a dark blue uniform with a red collar and a silver star pinned to their chest. The entire display is viewed through a glass case, causing reflections to appear on the surface.

title: Christ on the Cross
alt_text: A wood sculpture of a crucifix shows a figure attached to an ornate cross. The cross is made of pale, greenish wood and has decorative, rounded ends with carved leaf patterns. Mounted in front of the cross is a darker, brown wooden figure with arms stretched outward. This figure has long hair, a tilted head, and a cloth draped around its waist. The sculpture is displayed against a plain, light-colored background.

title: Capital with Griffin
alt_text: A limestone sculpture shows a carved animal resting on a rectangular base. The creature appears to be a lion or similar feline with a thick mane, depicted lying down on its side. Its body is smooth, while the head is turned slightly upward and shows textured details around the neck. A rectangular, off-white museum tag is tied with a string to the front of the base. This tag has a small green circular sticker and handwritten numbers on it. The object sits on a plain, grey shelf against a dark background.

title: Untitled
medium: Oil on paper, mounted on canvas
alt_text: A painting of abstract, heavy brushstrokes in dark colors. Thick, black, angular marks dominate the left and top areas of the composition. A deep, reddish-brown color fills the space behind and between the black shapes. To the right, a lighter grey section creates a vertical border against the dark center. The texture appears rough and layered with visible paint strokes throughout.

title: Virgin
medium: Polychromed stone, stone stand fixed on modern wooden stand
alt_text: A sculpture of a standing woman shown in black and white. She has a veil draped over her hair that falls down to her shoulders. Her long, heavy robe creates vertical folds that reach all the way to her feet. With her left hand, she holds a small cup-like object close to her body. She stands on a simple, multi-sided base.

title: Head of a Man
alt_text: A stone sculpture shows the front of a human face with closed eyes. The facial features, including the nose, mouth, and chin, are smooth and clearly defined. The expression appears calm or perhaps pensive. A rough, jagged stone section sits at the top of the head like hair or a headdress. The entire piece rests on a dark, rectangular wooden base. A white ribbon or tag hangs from the lower left side of the object.

title: Head of a Man
medium: Head: stone with traces of polychromy; base: wood (modern)
alt_text: A stone sculpture shows the face of a person looking slightly to the left. The face has a rough, textured surface that is light beige in color, with some darker, weathered spots on the chin and forehead. One ear is visible on the right side of the face, and it appears to have a rounded, coiled shape. The sculpture is mounted on a small black wooden block that sits at the bottom of the frame. A small white tag with a string is wrapped around the mount below the chin. The background behind the head is a folded blue cloth with a wavy pattern.

title: Portrait of a Roman Emperor
alt_text: A garnet sculpture shows the head and shoulders of a bearded man. The figure is carved from a deep, dark red stone with a polished, shiny surface. He has short, curly hair and a thick beard that covers his jaw and chin. A piece of fabric wraps around his neck and shoulders with deep, folded lines. The bust rests on a clear, round stand made of acrylic.

title: A Guardroom Scene
alt_text: A painting of three men sitting together in a dimly lit room. On the left, a man leans back in a chair with his head tilted up and eyes closed, wearing a metallic chest plate over a tan coat. A second man, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, stands behind him and looks toward the first man’s head. On the right, a third man with a beard sits at a wooden barrel that serves as a table. He holds a small bowl in his hands and looks toward the other two men. The scene is dark, with soft light highlighting the men's faces and clothing.

title: Along the Lakeshore at Dusk
alt_text: A painting of a calm landscape shows a large body of water beneath a sunset sky. A small boat sits at the edge of the shore on the right side, with one person in it wearing a hat. In the distance, large mountains rise above the horizon, glowing with soft orange and purple light. A crescent moon is faintly visible high in the sky among scattered clouds. To the left, another small sailboat drifts on the water, while a simple wooden fence sits in the foreground along the bank.

title: On Otter Creek
alt_text: A painting of a calm river winding through a wide valley toward distant mountains. A dark, covered bridge crosses the middle of the river, framed by trees on both banks. Behind the bridge, golden-green fields stretch toward rolling hills and peaks that fade into the soft, pale sky. Wispy, pinkish-white clouds drift across the upper portion of the view. The scene is quiet and lit by the soft glow of dusk or dawn.

title: After the Shower
alt_text: A painting of a meadow and trees under a cloudy sky. In the center, a thin, bare tree stands tall against the dark background. To the left, a faint, translucent rainbow arches through the sky above a line of green trees. The foreground is a wide, dark green grassy field with small patches of light scattered across the ground. Several birds appear as small white specks flying in the mid-ground. The overall color palette of the scene is dominated by deep greens and dark grays, suggesting a stormy day.

title: Still Life
alt_text: A painting of a still life setting shows objects arranged on a dark green cloth surface. A metallic pitcher and a tall, clear glass filled with amber liquid sit in the center of the table. A metal plate holds cracked walnuts and a knife with a pale handle. A folded white cloth drapes off the edge of the table, near a small piece of bread. In the background, a curved stone structure rests in deep shadow.

title: Panel
alt_text: A wood sculpture showing a long, rectangular carved panel lying on a plain surface. The carving on the surface features a prominent, circular flower-like design on the far left side. Extending from this circular shape across the rest of the panel is a pattern of repeating, leaf-like ridges that flow in a wavy arrangement. The piece appears dark in color and shows signs of wear, especially along the edges. There is a small hole visible at the extreme left end of the object.

title: Ideal Portrait of Juliette Récamier as Beatrice, after Antonio Canova
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a young woman's head and shoulders. Her hair is styled in tight, round curls that frame her forehead and temples. She wears a veil draped over her head, which hangs down along both sides of her face. Her expression is calm and looking straight ahead. The bust is made of smooth, pale stone set against a plain gray background.

title: Monument (Pyramid)
alt_text: A sculpture of wood and metal sits in the middle of a paved outdoor area. It is shaped like a pyramid with a wide base and four sloping sides made of stacked, brown, rough sticks. The structure appears to be held together by a hidden metal frame inside. The surrounding area includes a paved stone ground, a large brick wall, and a modern building with many glass windows. To the left, a large tree with green leaves casts a shadow over the scene.

title: Sky Dances Light: Forest IV, Forest V, Forest VI
medium: Tin jingles, cotton twill tape, polyester mesh, and steel
alt_text: A sculpture showing three large, hanging forms made of a dense layer of small, overlapping metallic pieces. The shapes are cloud-like or stalactite-like, with uneven, bumpy surfaces that taper toward the bottom. Each form is suspended from the ceiling by thin wires and chains, hanging at slightly different heights. The surfaces are primarily gray and silver, with hints of red and black peeking through the texture. They appear to be made of thousands of small, folded metal fragments that create a heavy, textured look.

title: The Infant Saint John the Baptist
alt_text: A painting of a young child with curly brown hair standing in an outdoor landscape. The child is mostly unclothed, wearing only a textured animal skin draped over one shoulder and across their back. They are holding a long, thin wooden staff topped with a flowing white ribbon that curls around their shoulders. In the background, there are dark trees, a cloudy sky, and a small, white sheep standing on a grassy hill. A small bowl sits on the ground near the child's feet.

title: Lamp on Wall
alt_text: A painting of a metal lantern resting on a ledge against a textured wall. The lantern is circular with a white interior reflector and a dark glass bulb in the center. A large, soft shadow extends to the right of the lantern onto the wall. The wall behind the lantern has a beige, weathered look with subtle floral patterns painted on the surface. Small letters are painted in the bottom right corner of the piece.

title: People are Strange (touch me)
medium: Powder-coated steel and print on aluminum
alt_text: A sculpture of a large black-and-white photograph is displayed against a white gallery wall. The rectangular photo depicts a person with long dark hair speaking into a microphone while another person wearing a uniform cap stands behind them. White metal railings form a rectangular barrier on the floor in front of the artwork. The floor is made of smooth, gray concrete. This arrangement creates a protective boundary between the viewer and the photograph.

title: Head
alt_text: A painting of a human face rendered in thick, layered brushstrokes. The face is framed by dark, heavy vertical strokes that create an oval shape. Intense shades of deep blue dominate the center of the face, with streaks of red, brown, and black layered throughout. Two distinct, almond-shaped eyes with clear pupils stare forward from the textured surface. Below the chin, the background transitions to a lighter, cream-colored area with a small, textured patch of olive green paint.

title: Small Head
alt_text: A painting of a face created with thick, textured layers of oil paint. The face is framed by a circular shape in shades of deep red and brown. Two dark, almond-shaped eyes stare forward from the center of the face. The background consists of flat, mossy green paint that contrasts with the rough, raised texture of the head. Some areas of the red paint look especially heavy and uneven, creating shadows and highlights on the surface.

title: Saint James
alt_text: A wood sculpture of a bearded man stands against a plain background. The figure wears a curved hat and a long robe that hangs down to his feet. He has a serious expression and his right arm is bent near his waist. The surface of the wood looks dark and shows some rough texture and cracks. A small rectangular sign sits on the base in front of the sculpture.

title: Portrait of a Man
alt_text: A painting showing a portrait of a middle-aged man seated against a dark background. He wears a wide-brimmed, black hat and a prominent white ruff collar around his neck. His clothing is all black, consisting of a jacket and cape that blend into the shadows behind him. The man has a short beard and looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression. He holds a pair of gloves or a similar dark object in his lap with both hands.

title: View of Choisel
alt_text: A painting showing a colorful garden landscape with a house in the distance. The foreground is filled with a dense mix of green leaves and flowers in shades of yellow, red, and white. Behind the flowers, a white house with a reddish-brown roof sits among several large trees. The trees have dark green and brown branches that stand out against a cloudy, light blue sky. The scene is rendered with thick, visible brushstrokes throughout.

title: Charles Reynolds (1798–1871)
alt_text: A painting of a man shows him from the chest up, seated in front of a dark, simple background. He has short brown hair and wears a dark coat over a light vest and a high white collar. Around his neck is a thick, dark cravat. In his left hand, he holds a newspaper that is partly spread out on his lap, with the word "TATOR" visible in large letters at the top. His right arm rests on the arm of a wooden chair. The entire painting is contained within a plain, dark wood frame.

title: Charlotte McCoe Reynolds (1806–1892)
alt_text: A painting of a woman with dark hair styled in rolls around her face. She wears a large, pale, lacy shawl over a dark dress that appears black. Her hair is topped with a small, reddish, shaped headpiece. She stands with her hands resting on a dark, reddish-brown surface in front of her. The background behind her is a dark, mottled gray-green color.

title: Time To Be Still
medium: Acrylic, yarn, willow, and artificial sinew on AstroTurf
alt_text: A painting made of acrylic, yarn, willow, and artificial sinew on AstroTurf shows an irregular, mound-like shape against a plain background. The main body of the object is bright yellow and textured, with a flat bottom edge and a curved, uneven top. A vertical, rectangular section of brownish-gold texture runs down the left side, topped with a small red shape. Across the middle of the yellow field, horizontal lines form wavy ridges in shades of orange and pink. Thin, dark lines divide the surface into several vertical panels.

title: Reclining Drunk
alt_text: A sculpture of a flattened green glass bottle rests on a white display pedestal. The bottle is translucent and has been pressed into a thin, wide, and slightly curved shape. The top neck of the bottle remains mostly round, while the bottom end appears flared and wider. Raised letters are barely visible on the side of the glass. The object is centered on a flat, white surface against a plain gray background.

title: Michael
medium: Oil, colored pencil, fabric, jewelry, and collage on canvas, stretched over panel
alt_text: A painting shows a shirtless man standing in front of a mirror while grooming his hair with a white electric trimmer. He is depicted in profile, facing toward the right, with his skin surface covered in a colorful, dense floral pattern. He wears blue glasses, and a string of white pearls hangs from the trimmer down to his shoulder. In front of him, a white bathroom counter holds a small bottle of lotion and a pair of pink scissors near a sink faucet. The background behind him features bold blocks of yellow, light purple, and dark blue.

title: Remembrance of Springs Past (Symphony No. 1)
alt_text: A mixed media sculpture consists of a tall, narrow, rectangular frame with four legs, resembling a miniature display case or stand. The frame is decorated with many strands of bright green, pink, and red yarn or fiber that wrap around the vertical supports. A curved, woven band forms an arch at the very top of the frame. Inside the open structure, various small items hang and sit on crossbars, including shiny beads, small pink floral-like shapes, and reflective fragments. The background is a solid, neutral gray color.

title: Hair Wall Piece
alt_text: A sculpture of rubberized hair shows a square, bowl-like shape. The object is textured with a thick, tangled, brown fibrous material. It has four sloping sides that meet at a flat, square base in the center. The bowl appears to be floating against a plain, light-colored background. A soft, gray shadow is cast directly beneath the square form.

title: Untitled
alt_text: A sculpture of a small wooden chest sits on a neutral grey background. The chest is rectangular and made of warm-toned, reddish-brown wood. It features five horizontal drawers stacked on top of each other. Each drawer has a simple brass pull handle attached to its center. The wood grain is visible and runs horizontally across the front face of the drawers.

title: Blps
alt_text: A sculpture shows ten vertical, pill-shaped objects arranged against a solid gray background. These shapes are matte black and have rounded ends. They are spaced out across the surface in a somewhat random, scattered pattern. Some of the shapes are positioned higher, while others sit lower down. The overall effect is like raindrops falling against a flat gray wall.

title: Romantic Landscape
alt_text: A painting of a quiet landscape features a wide river winding through a valley. A large, leafy tree stands prominently on the right side of the grassy foreground. Near the base of this tree, a person in a white dress sits and gazes toward the water. On the left side of the scene, smaller trees border the riverbank, and rolling hills rise in the distance under a pale blue sky. A tiny boat is visible floating on the calm, reflective surface of the water in the middle of the frame.

title: Shadow of Leaves
medium: Corrugated tin, wood, paint, nails, and enamel on wood
alt_text: A sculpture shows a textured, dark background with pieces of found materials attached to its surface. In the lower portion, a large, flat piece of weathered wood lies diagonally across rough, vertically arranged tree bark. Above this wood, a stem made of pale, painted material branches out, holding several leaves cut from corrugated metal. The metal leaves have a grey, wavy texture and appear slightly curved. The dark, painted background shows brushstrokes that create a rugged, uneven surface behind the attached objects.

title: Once There Were Many
alt_text: A sculpture of found tin mounted on wood shows a dark red square panel with rough edges. In the center, a series of small punched dots outlines the shape of a buffalo facing right. The surface of the tin is marked by vertical lines and a few patches that appear slightly raised or layered. Faint, dark, branch-like shapes are etched into the upper left corner of the red surface. The overall texture of the object looks aged and weathered with areas of rust.

title: View from near the Summit of Mount Washington, N.H.
alt_text: A painting of a vast, mountainous landscape at sunrise. In the foreground, a tall, jagged rock formation rises from a dark, craggy slope. A small figure stands near the base of this rock, wearing light-colored clothes and a reddish cloak. Below them, a layer of mist clings to the valleys between the rolling hills. In the distance, layers of mountain peaks fade into a hazy, pale sky painted in soft shades of orange, yellow, and blue. The light suggests the early morning sun is just beginning to illuminate the highest summits.

title: The Traumatics
medium: Oil, powdered pigment, and vinyl paint on canvas
alt_text: A painting of three ghostly, silhouetted figures standing side by side against a dark background. The figure on the left is illuminated with warm shades of yellow and orange that seem to fade into the dark. In the center, a second figure is painted in bright, fiery reds that blend into a sharp, deep blue on the right side. The third figure on the far right appears in cool tones of teal and cyan. Splatters and dots of these same colors are scattered around the figures, giving the scene a hazy, dreamlike appearance.

title: Self-Portrait as a Renaissance Mercenary Soldier
alt_text: A painting of an older man with a very long, white beard. He wears a dark brown garment over a long-sleeved, reddish-pink tunic with a subtle pattern. His gaze is directed downward and slightly to the left, with an expression that looks serious or thoughtful. One hand rests on a rounded, shiny metallic object, possibly a helmet, which sits in the lower foreground. The background is a simple, dark, and blurred shade of gray-brown.

title: Doge Marin Faliero Accusing Michele Steno of Insulting the Honor of the Dogaressa
alt_text: A painting of a large group of people standing inside a room with wooden panel walls. In the center, an older man in a long gold robe and white fur cape points his hand toward a younger man standing to the right. Beside the older man, a woman in a long white dress with a pale blue cape watches the interaction. The younger man wears a dark tunic and bright, vertically striped leggings. A crowd of people wearing rich red and brown clothing gathers on the left side of the room. Near the younger man, a figure leans over and holds a set of metal keys.

title: A Portrait
alt_text: A painting of a man presented in an octagonal-shaped frame. The man is shown from the chest up, facing toward the right side of the frame. He has dark hair, a beard, and is wearing a dark suit with a light-colored shirt and a cravat. The background of the portrait is a dark, solid color. The surrounding frame is ornate, rectangular, and gold in color, featuring intricate carvings of swirls and scrollwork.

title: Little Instrument
alt_text: A painting of abstract, overlapping shapes filled with many bright, vertical stripes. The upper section features a large, dark, curved form against a backdrop of muted greens and a pale orange corner. Below this, a dense arrangement of colorful vertical lines in red, orange, yellow, blue, and black stretches across the composition. A white, shield-like shape sits prominently in the upper right, interrupting the striped pattern. Throughout the image, thick black lines define various sections, adding structure to the layered colors.

title: The Piazzetta verso La Libreria, Venice, with Figures Conversing
alt_text: A painting of an open city square with a large, classical building on the right side. People in long, colorful coats walk across the ground in small groups. Two tall stone columns stand near the center and left, each topped with a small statue. The sky above is a light, pale blue with a few soft clouds. In the distance, water meets the horizon line, where a few small boat masts are visible. The scene is bathed in the warm, bright light of what looks like late afternoon.

title: Dream of Saint Joseph
alt_text: A painting of a man sleeping and an angel standing beside him. The man has long brown hair and a halo, and he leans on a table while wearing a blue shirt with gold stars and a red wrap. The angel has large wings, wears a white robe with gold stars, and points one finger upward toward the sky. Behind them lies a grassy hill with sheep and a distant city visible under a cloudy sky. In the foreground on the right, a colorful peacock stands near a small bush. A smaller, rectangular image of a woman praying is visible on the wall in the upper left corner.

title: Predella: Two Scenes from the Legend of Saint Michael
alt_text: A painting on a panel shows two separate scenes divided by a decorative vertical border. On the left, a pale purple building sits beside a woman in blue holding a baby and another woman wrapped in a long red cloak, with a golden angel hovering in the air above. The center of the frame features a patterned, column-like divider that separates the two sides of the image. On the right, a person in light clothing points toward a rocky hill where a large crowd of people in colorful robes walks up a path. A pink building with a pointed roof sits at the very top of this hill.

title: Liz with Hoops
medium: Acrylic and rhinestones on canvas, mounted on panel
alt_text: A painting of a person with dark skin who is shown from the chest up against a background of wood-like panels and green leaves. The person has textured black hair and wears large, round gold hoop earrings. They are wearing a dark high-necked shirt underneath a blue, black, and white sweater with a diamond pattern. Their eyes are accented with bright blue eyeshadow, and they are looking toward the left side of the frame. The painting has a distinct texture, appearing to be made of small, sparkly beads or stones. The corners of the painting's frame are rounded.

title: Eggplants
alt_text: A painting of three dark purple eggplants sitting on a white cloth. The cloth is folded and rests on a smooth, reddish-brown wooden table. Two of the eggplants lie somewhat horizontally, while the third is angled toward the top left corner of the frame. Each eggplant has a short, bright green stem at one end. The background is simple and dark, keeping the focus on the fruit and the table surface.

title: Head of "Victory"
medium: Patinated bronze with a green marble base
alt_text: A bronze sculpture of a human head wearing a leafy crown. The head is made of dark, greenish metal and features stylized hair wrapped in thick, pointed leaves. Below the chin, a small rectangular plaque with Greek lettering sits on top of a tall, square-shaped pedestal made of mottled green marble. The face has a serious expression with large, almond-shaped eyes and a straight nose. The entire piece is centered against a plain, light gray background.

title: Posthumous Portrait of Michel-Etienne Le Peletier de Saint-Fargeau (1736–1778)
alt_text: A painting of a man dressed in bright red robes, sitting on a stone-like bench against a dark background. He has long, dark, wavy hair and wears a large white fur collar with small black markings over his shoulders. His right hand is extended forward with his palm up, while his left hand rests on his lap. Beside him on the bench sits a small, round, dark hat with a gold band. The base of the bench features carved Latin text, and additional text is visible along the very bottom edge of the frame.

title: Portrait of María de la Concepción Vegas y Rodríguez del Toro (1800–1872)
alt_text: A painting of a woman with dark hair dressed in formal clothes. She wears a white gown with lace sleeves and several strands of pearls around her neck. Her hair is styled up with fluffy white feathers and a jeweled crescent moon ornament. In her hand, she holds a small, folded fan, and she wears a wide bracelet on her wrist. Behind her, a dark red curtain hangs to the left and a large, carved stone pillar stands on the right, which features faint text carved into its base.

title: Untitled (Pink/Green/Purple Diagonal Abstract)
alt_text: A painting on metal shows a series of diagonal stripes that run from the top edge to the bottom. The surface appears to be rippled or folded like a fan, creating vertical ridges that cross the stripes. The colors are soft and blend into each other, transitioning from light yellow at the top to a muted pink and green in the middle and bottom sections. The stripes create a gentle, rhythmic pattern across the entire rectangular surface. The overall effect is one of soft light reflecting across a textured, folded material.

title: Mike
medium: Aluminum screen, plaster, cheesecloth, sprayed zinc, and aluminum
alt_text: A sculpture made of metal and plaster shows a twisting, vertical form. The object curves in on itself, looking like two long, draped shapes knotted together at the top. Its surface is silvery and metallic, with rough, creased textures that look like crumpled fabric. The color is mostly light gray, with some darker shadows and highlights in the folds. The sculpture hangs against a plain, light gray background and casts a soft shadow behind it.

title: Undine
alt_text: A marble sculpture of a standing woman with her arms raised above her head. She holds a long, flowing veil high in the air with both hands. The thin, delicate fabric falls behind her back and drapes around her long dress. The woman gazes upward with a calm expression on her face. She stands barefoot on a small, textured base shaped like swirling clouds or waves.

title: The persistence of Land claims in a climate of change (North)
alt_text: A bronze sculpture depicts an elongated, stylized creature that looks similar to a fish or whale. The surface is carved with curved lines and shapes that create patterns along its long, tapered body. On the left side, the creature features a distinct head with an eye and a mouth. The right side tapers into a narrow, handle-like section with a small, round cap at the very end. The entire object has a smooth, dark brown finish and rests horizontally against a plain, light-gray background.

title: Marshlands
alt_text: A painting of a field with a sunset. The sun is a bright yellow circle hanging low on the horizon, partially hidden by streaks of orange and purple clouds. Below the sky, the landscape is a stretch of flat green meadow. Several rounded, brown mounds sit in the field, spaced out at different distances. In the foreground, a thin pool of water reflects the light from the sky. The ground near the bottom edge has touches of dark green grasses.

title: The Possessed
alt_text: A painting of abstract, swirling forms features a vibrant blend of warm and cool colors. Bright yellow and orange tones dominate the upper left area, resembling a glowing light or a sunrise. Thick, dark strokes of brown and rust-red swirl across the center and right side, creating a sense of movement. Patches of deep blue appear at the bottom and left edges, providing a strong contrast to the lighter colors. The paint is applied in loose, energetic layers that lack clear shapes or defined figures.

title: Lily
medium: Acrylic ink and paint on linen
alt_text: A painting of a single flower in a small glass vase. The flower is light pink with slightly wilted petals that droop over the top of the vase. It sits in a round, clear glass bowl filled with water, where the stem is partially visible. The background is a blurry mix of deep blue and purple horizontal lines. The overall texture of the image appears somewhat rough, like woven fabric.

title: Grand Plage de Biarritz
alt_text: A painting shows a coastal scene with a sandy beach meeting the ocean under a cloudy sky. Waves crash against the shore in the foreground, colored in shades of grey, blue, and white. To the right, a wide, tan-colored beach stretches along the bottom edge of the frame. In the distance, a dark, rocky headland extends into the sea, topped by a tall, thin structure resembling a lighthouse. The overall tone of the artwork is muted and somber, with visible, thick brushstrokes throughout.

title: Biarritz Seascape
alt_text: A painting of an ocean scene at twilight, rendered in oil on wood. A dark, stormy sky stretches across the top portion of the image. Below the horizon line, the deep blue sea has choppy, white-capped waves moving toward the shore. On the right side, a rocky cliff edge holds a tall, thin, light-colored structure. A strip of sandy-colored beach runs along the bottom right corner of the frame.

title: Mission Box
medium: Watercolor on paper, mounted on a wooden box
alt_text: A wooden container displays watercolor illustrations on paper panels. The front panel shows a large multi-story building surrounded by trees and a small steeple. The side panel depicts a classroom scene with figures seated at desks and text printed in the upper portion. Dark fabric with metal studs lines the edges where the panels meet. A roll of brown cloth extends slightly over the top edge of the box.

title: Virgin and Child Enthroned (also known as the Seebenstein Madonna)
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a woman holding a young child. The woman sits upright with long, wavy hair and wears a draped, folded garment that covers her body down to the floor. She gently supports the small, curly-haired child who sits on her lap, facing slightly away from her.
