The child reaches up with one hand toward the woman's neck, while she holds the child’s body with her other hand. The entire sculpture is carved from a light-brown wood with visible grain and natural texture.

title: Virgin and Child, known as the Gambaro Madonna
alt_text: A painting on panel showing a woman holding a small child in her lap. The woman wears a red dress underneath a long, flowing blue headscarf and cloak that are lined with green. She gazes directly forward while the light-skinned child, who is nude, looks off toward the side. Behind them, a landscape shows rolling green hills, a few thin trees, and a distant blue mountain range under a pale sky. The background directly behind the woman features a dark red patterned fabric panel.

title: Study for the Portrait of Mai ("Omai")
alt_text: A painting on canvas shows the head and shoulders of a person with dark hair, presented inside an oval frame. The person is looking off to the right side of the frame with a serious expression. They have dark skin and long, wavy dark hair that falls behind their head. The background is a soft, muted brown color that looks unfinished or sketch-like. The person wears a simple, dark brown garment with a light-colored collar or neckline.

title: Archangel Raphael
medium: Painted cedar with brass, glass, and silver
alt_text: A wooden sculpture of a winged figure stands on a cloud-shaped base. The figure has large, detailed gold wings spread wide behind its shoulders. It wears a gold-colored, knee-length garment with floral patterns and a short red cape over its shoulders. In one hand, the figure holds a long, thin metal staff that reaches up toward the sky. Its other hand holds a small silver fish hanging down by a thin chain. The figure wears a small crown on its head and looks upward with an expression of calm.

title: Nautilus Shell in the Form of a Goblet
medium: Engraved nautilus shell with a silver-gilt mount
alt_text: A sculpture showing an engraved nautilus shell with a silver-gilt mount stands on a pedestal base. The large, iridescent shell forms a curved, bowl-like top section, while its surface is decorated with dark, sketched drawings of insects and several figures sitting together. A golden metal creature, shaped like a small bird or head, is attached to the top curve of the shell. Below, a complex silver stand connects the bowl to the wide, decorative base. The metal parts have a warm, golden, and metallic sheen that contrasts with the smooth, pearly surface of the shell.

title: Cradle
alt_text: A painting of a dark, weathered rowboat floating against a pale, light-colored background. Inside the boat, a pale figure lies curled up in a fetal position, appearing slightly translucent and reddish-pink. Below the boat, two vertical arrangements of small, light blue, flower-like shapes are scattered across the lower half of the canvas. These blue shapes appear as delicate line drawings with soft, watery edges. Fine black specks are sprinkled lightly across the space around the boat.

title: Lone Pine
alt_text: A painting of a mountain landscape under a bright blue sky. A tall, thin pine tree stands in the left foreground, its trunk reaching upward while its branches spread out against the open air. Below the tree, the ground is covered in patches of green bushes and areas of reddish-brown dirt. In the middle distance, a dark forest of pine trees stretches across the lower portion of the frame. Beyond the forest, large, sloping mountains rise up, colored in shades of blue and purple. The entire scene is bathed in clear, natural light.

title: Ship in the Bay
alt_text: A painting in oil on canvas shows a calm harbor landscape under a cloudy, overcast sky. In the foreground, a grassy, green hillside slopes downward toward the water. A wide, light-colored body of water stretches across the middle of the frame, with small boats sailing near the distant, dark shoreline. The trees and land on the far side of the water are painted in muted, shadowy greens and browns. Dark, heavy-looking clouds fill the upper portion of the scene, reflecting subtle blue and gray tones.

title: Camel's Hump, Vermont
alt_text: A painting of mountains rising above a calm, flat body of water. The entire scene is painted in various shades of blue and deep teal. Layers of distant mountain ranges overlap one another near the center of the frame. Below the mountains, a dark, solid band represents the water, which spans the bottom third of the image. The sky above is a lighter blue that darkens slightly as it reaches the peaks.

title: Chardenal Dictionary
alt_text: A painting of a still life arrangement sits on a plain surface. A large, tan-colored earthenware pitcher stands behind a stack of several books with red and brown covers. To the right of the books, a small, dark green pitcher rests next to a yellow lemon and a reddish apple. Behind the items, part of a wooden chair is visible with its curved back support angling upward. The background features dark, angular shapes that contrast with the objects in the foreground.

title: Fifth Avenue at the Park
alt_text: A painting in oil showing a snowy city street scene during a storm. In the foreground, people walk along a sidewalk near a horse-drawn carriage with red wheels. Several tall buildings rise in the background, their windows glowing with soft yellow light against the gray, wintry sky. Brightly colored vehicles, including a green one and a yellow one, are partially visible on the left side of the street. The entire scene is covered in a light layer of snow, giving everything a soft and blurry appearance.

title: View of Vesuvius from Capri
alt_text: A painting of a calm sea at sunset with a large mountain in the distance. The vast ocean takes up the lower two-thirds of the scene and is painted in shades of soft blue. Above the water, a large, dark mountain silhouette dominates the horizon line under a pale sky filled with pink and gold clouds. A single tiny boat floats on the quiet water near the center of the image. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick, dark wood frame.

title: A woman and two men herding animals along a path, a mountainous landscape beyond
alt_text: A painting of a pastoral outdoor scene shows a group of people and animals moving through a landscape. In the center, a person rides a horse while another figure stands to the right wearing a red skirt. Several sheep and a small dog are gathered near the people in the foreground. Tall, dark trees rise in the background, contrasting with a cloudy, light sky on the left side of the frame. The entire scene is enclosed in a large, ornate, gold-colored frame decorated with carvings.

title: An Apothecary Shop
alt_text: A painting shows a dim, cluttered indoor scene with several people gathered in a large room. On the left, two figures sit near a stone fireplace, while a third person stands nearby wearing a dark coat and hat. Further to the right, a fourth person sits at a small, green table covered with plates and bowls. The floor is strewn with various scattered objects, including what look like books and glass bottles. The entire scene is enclosed within a wide, ornate gold frame with carved leaf designs.

title: Portrait of Shute Shrimpton Yeamans (1721–1769)
alt_text: A painting of a young person wearing a bright red coat and standing against a dark background. The figure rests their chin on one hand and leans on a stack of thick, dark-colored books. With their other hand, the person points to an open book lying on a flat surface in front of them. The red coat has a white collar and long sleeves that reach the wrists. The background is shadowy and plain, with no scenery or details visible behind the subject.

title: Portrait of a Young Girl
alt_text: A painting of a young child wearing an ornate dark dress with white lace trim and a white cap. The child wears a red beaded necklace and matching bracelets on both wrists. In one hand, the child holds a small, textured, round object while standing next to a dark-furred dog. The child’s other hand holds a thin, brown, rod-like item against the side of their dress. The background of the portrait is a dark, solid color that makes the child stand out.

title: Christopher Columbus before Queen Isabella
alt_text: A painting of a woman sitting on a throne while speaking to two men. The woman wears a long, patterned green dress and a white head covering, and she sits on a large, dark chair with red fabric accents. She rests one hand on the arm of the chair while looking toward the men standing to her left. One of the men holds up a large, flat, rectangular object featuring painted designs, and both men are dressed in dark clothing. They stand on a deep red rug or platform, while the walls behind them are decorated with red and gold patterns and heavy curtains.

title: Still Life with Fruit and a Macaw
alt_text: A painting of fruit and a parrot is set within a decorative gold frame. The scene shows a large cluster of light green grapes on the left, next to smaller groups of grapes and other round fruits. A bright orange and red parrot sits on the right side, facing toward the right edge of the frame. The background is very dark, suggesting a dimly lit indoor space or an outdoor scene at night. The fruit rests on what appears to be a draped white cloth covering a table.

title: Portrait of Ferdinand van Boisschot (1570–1649), Baron of Zaventem
alt_text: A painting of a man wearing a wide, white ruff collar around his neck. The man has a thin face with light brown hair and a short, pointed goatee on his chin. He looks directly forward with a serious expression. He wears a dark-colored jacket that blends into the shadowy background. On the chest of his jacket, there is a small, red symbol shaped like a cross with curved loops. The entire background is dark and indistinct.

title: Footed Dish Depicting the Judgment of Paris
alt_text: A ceramic plate made of tin-glazed earthenware shows a colorful landscape scene with several figures. In the foreground, a group of people, some partially draped in fabric, stand together on a patch of grassy ground. A small child-like figure stands among them, while another pair of figures stands slightly apart to the right, embracing or draping fabric over one another. Tall, spindly trees and large, craggy rocks frame the scene. In the background, a distant body of water sits before a collection of buildings and hills under a soft sky.

title: Passage
medium: Polymer-modified gypsum, fiberglass, glass, pigment, and wax
alt_text: A sculpture of a vertical arrangement consisting of four horizontal, wave-like troughs stacked one above another. Each trough is curved in shape and has a muted, mottled grey-tan color. Resting inside the left end of each individual trough is a smooth, clear, rounded glass insert. These four troughs are connected along the left edge by a narrow, solid vertical column. The entire object hangs against a plain, light grey background.

title: Portrait of Caroline Thurlow (b. 1772) and Catharine Thurlow (d. 1826)
alt_text: A painting of two young girls standing beside a brown upright piano. The girl on the left stands facing forward and plays the piano keys, wearing a white dress with a prominent green sash tied at the back. She wears a decorative bonnet with green details on her head. Beside her, the second girl leans her elbows on the top of the piano, looking out toward the viewer. She also wears a similar white dress and a matching bonnet. To the far left, a simple wooden stool with a black cushion sits on the floor.

title: The Lamentation
alt_text: A papier-mâché and wood relief sculpture shows a central figure flanked by two other standing figures. The central person is bare-chested with their head bowed and arms hanging down. A figure on the left stands with a hand on the central person's shoulder, while a figure on the right holds the central person’s arm. All three figures have faint, carved circles or halos around their heads. The entire scene is set within a rectangular frame decorated with gold, leafy patterns. At the bottom center, there is a small shield-shaped attachment.

title: Adoration of the Magi in an Initial E
alt_text: An illuminated manuscript showing a decorative capital letter with painted figures inside. The letter is large, ornate, and gold-colored, framing two rows of people. In the top half, three men with beards, two of whom wear crowns, look toward the right. In the bottom half, an older man with a white beard holds a small, unclothed child, while a woman in a blue robe sits beside them. Bright red, blue, and gold floral patterns wrap around the outside of the central letter. Faint lines of musical notation appear at the very bottom of the page.

title: Virgin and Child
alt_text: A glazed terracotta sculpture showing a woman holding a young child. They are both white figures with simple halos behind their heads, set against a solid dark blue background. The woman looks toward the child, while the child faces forward. This central relief is enclosed by an ornate, rectangular wooden frame with gold detailing and dark decorative patterns. The overall composition creates a structured, portrait-like appearance.

title: Bowl
alt_text: A tin-glazed earthenware bowl features a circular, low-sided design with an indented center. The surface is decorated with a pattern of dark blue flowers and vines against a cream-colored background. Thin, tan-colored lines wind around the blue flowers, creating a delicate, repeating design. In the very center of the bowl, a gold-colored, stylized symbol sits on a plain, circular patch. The edges of the bowl are slightly uneven, suggesting a handmade or aged quality.

title: Elizabeth Moffatt (later Elizabeth Moffatt Sherburne (1729/30–1762/63).
alt_text: A painting of a woman wearing a white dress and a lace cap. She has dark hair styled close to her head and is wearing small, dangling earrings. Around her neck is a lacy choker with a small pendant. She holds a thick, brown book upright with one hand while sitting in front of a dark, shaded background. To her left, the scene opens to reveal a hint of a landscape with trees under a pale sky.
